Aftermath builds on the classic idea of missile defense and turns it into a tense protection scenario where every decision has to count. You defend several bases along the bottom of the screen and try to intercept incoming projectiles before they hit. Since ammunition is limited and your own firing point can also be destroyed, the pressure quickly becomes noticeable. That constant balance between conserving shots, reacting quickly, and taking risks is what gives the game its appealing tension.

meta.name: The Afterworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.78 KB

The Afterworld throws you into a merciless trial after death, where you must earn your place in a supposedly perfect realm. A series of brutal challenges tests strength, intelligence, and reflexes under constant time pressure. Every section demands full concentration, as mistakes waste precious time and push you closer to failure. The extreme difficulty is intentional, making perseverance, learning from defeat, and repeated attempts a core part of the experience.

p: Age of Adventure - Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves (USA).D64
n: Age of Adventure - Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves (USA)

meta.path: ./Age of Adventure - Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves (USA).D64
meta.name: Alibaba and the Fourty Thieves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Billed as "the greatest adventure in history", this game was actually two games in one: "The Return of Heracles" and "Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves".
Both games are largely similar in design, as they are based on an engine that is a precursor to Stuart Smith's Adventure Construction Set. Control multiple characters from a top-down perspective on various quests in the mythological past. Find items, level up your stats, battle monsters and explore the land in these turn-based RPGs.
Both games feature a cooperative component that allows any number of players to play together by simply splitting up the available characters.

meta.name: Agent Hawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.72 KB

Agent Hawk drops you into a straightforward blast-fest where quick movement and quicker reactions decide how long you last. You guide the agent through tightening waves of enemies, dodge incoming fire and obstacles, and shoot anything that threatens your progress. Along the way you grab powerups that boost your weapons or give you a brief edge in the chaos. Each stage raises the pressure, each encounter demands more focus – turning Agent Hawk into a fast, compact fight for survival.

meta.name: Agent Orange
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.26 KB

Agent Orange places you in a fight for the survival of entire planets infected by a destructive alien weed. Piloting your ship, you travel to the affected worlds, watch the rapid spread of the growth, and deploy a special substance to eradicate it. At the same time, hostile forces attack, forcing quick decisions between combat, collecting valuable remains, and caution, since carrying too much can have fatal consequences. The appeal comes from the blend of action, resource management, and constant pressure to maintain balance under fire.

meta.name: Agent UOP
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.78 KB

Agent UOP puts you in the role of a special agent who must infiltrate a terrorist headquarters. Your mission is to plant explosives and gather evidence of their guilt. You make use of elevators, jump, crouch, and open forcefields with magnetic cards. To fight enemies you have a pistol, while ammunition and first aid kits can be found throughout the building to help you survive.

meta.name: Agent USA
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.67 KB

Agent USA begins with a failed experiment by the eccentric inventor Elma Sniddle, who uses a mysterious crystal as the power source for her latest TV machine. The device comes to evil life, attacks her with a beam of pure fuzz energy, and turns her into a distorted copy of herself. While the sinister television flees, Elma stumbles upon another crystal that restores her. She informs the CIB, and soon Agent USA is dispatched with a very big hat, ten crystals, and a passport to pursue the so-called Fuzzbomb. With free train tickets he travels across the country, but time is short – more and more people are being turned into mindless Fuzzbodies. If he fails, it could mean the end of the world.

p: Agent X II - The Mad Prof's Back (Europe).T64
n: Agent X II - The Mad Prof's Back (Europe)

meta.path: ./Agent X II - The Mad Prof's Back (Europe).T64
meta.name: Agent X II : The Mad Prof's Back!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 60.58 KB

Agent X II: The Mad Prof's Back! once again sends you into battle against the mad professor, whose plan this time is to infect humanity with acne and throw the economy into chaos. The adventure is divided into three sections: first, you control Agent X in a side-scrolling shooter, collecting weapons and battling enemy waves. Then comes a platforming sequence where you climb a tower while collecting code fragments. Finally, there is a Breakout-style stage in which a moving bat at the top of the screen unpredictably fires the ball back, keeping you on edge until the very end.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Han secuestrado a la princesa Jessica. Lánzate en su persecución y ábrete camino a través de los asteroides del espacio interestelar. Elige tu nave y tu camino, pero elige sabiamente, porque solo un camino te llevará hasta la bella princesa.

p: AGTMNS -  A Game That Makes No Sense (Europe) (Unl).T64
n: AGTMNS -  A Game That Makes No Sense (Europe) (Unl)

meta.path: ./AGTMNS -  A Game That Makes No Sense (Europe) (Unl).T64
meta.name: AGTMNS - A Game That Makes No Sense
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.69 KB

In AGTMNS: A Game That Makes No Sense, the goal is to collect underwear and avoid everything that is not underwear. The player must navigate through levels and collect as many "skivvies" as possible to progress to the next level, where even more underwear awaits. The game itself is hard to define, as it offers little in terms of clear structure or logical explanation. The main task is simply to collect underwear while avoiding everything else.

meta.name: Ah Diddums
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.98 KB

Ah Diddums is a platform game with 99 nested levels where you play as a teddy bear trying to escape from a central toy box. To progress, you must stack building bricks in the correct order to form a staircase. While the baby cries, Teddy delivers toys to comfort her – but once she's calm, the mother turns out the light. The other toys want to keep playing and try to stop you. Touching them shreds Teddy and costs a life.

meta.name: Aidon : The Apocalypse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Aidon: The Apocalypse, you fly through six dangerous sections and have to hold your own against constant waves of attacks. Along the way, you collect power-ups to prepare yourself for the tougher battles waiting at the end of each stage. Before every section, the game shows how far you still have to go – making each bit of progress feel clear as you fight shot by shot toward the next major enemy.

meta.name: Aigina's Prophecy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aigina's Prophecy sends you on a dangerous quest as Jason to rescue Princess Laira and reunite the mysterious Aura Stars. Across different areas, you fight enemies, search for hidden paths, and reveal ladders that lead you deeper into the adventure. Secrets and alternative routes encourage careful exploration rather than simply moving forward. That mix of combat, discovery, and small surprises gives the game its classic appeal.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Air Defender
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.17 KB

"Air Defender" challenges the player to shoot down a hot air balloon before it reaches the barn. The challenge lies in the limited number of shots - usually only two attempts are available per balloon flight. Precise timing is crucial to hit the balloon in time and protect the barn. Each round requires quick reactions and accuracy to ward off the impending danger.

meta.name: Air Rally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Air Rallye puts you in the cockpit, challenging you to take off, hit a set of rally points and return to the runway as quickly as possible. You constantly monitor speed, RPM, altitude, heading, fuel and visibility to guide your plane safely. With custom maps you can place your own collection points and shape how demanding each flight becomes. Every cockpit decision matters when you're chasing the perfect time.

meta.name: Air Rescue I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game is a remake of Chopper Rescue with some quality improvements.
The game is a 2D shooter where you control the helicopter from a third-person perspective. You can turn it left/right, move it up/down, fire the rocket and drop the bomb. Mobile patrol drones and stationary rocket launchers will fire at you, so avoid them and their bullets. In certain places people are standing and screaming for help, so you should lift them up and position the helicopter above them. The helicopter will crash if it runs out of fuel or collides with the wall. There are ten prisoners in each maze. Points are earned for prisoners rescued, enemy installations destroyed, and speed.

meta.name: Air Support
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.38 KB

In Air Support you command a robot army from the air using a control helicopter. From above you drop bombs on enemy units, move your own robots across the map, and issue precise orders for movement and attacks. Success depends on how well you combine overview, timing, and command decisions to eliminate opposing forces step by step. Depending on the mode, the focus shifts between strategy and fast-paced action – in the end, only the complete destruction of the enemy matters.

meta.name: Airborne Ranger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Airborne Ranger puts you in the boots of a U.S. elite soldier parachuted behind enemy lines. After the mission briefing, you equip supply pods with ammo, explosives, grenades and medkits, drop them mid-flight and jump into hostile territory. You'll sneak through snowfields, deserts or forests, blow up bunkers, rescue POWs or steal secret intel – all under time pressure and usually alone. Stealth, precision and planning make the difference between mission success and failure.

meta.name: Aircop 2000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.84 KB

Aircop 2000 puts you into a constantly scrolling side-view mission where you pilot a helicopter under relentless pressure. The experience is divided into distinct sections, each demanding different skills, ranging from pure evasion to precise attacks with limited movement options. Contact with enemies or obstacles costs valuable lives, keeping focus and timing essential throughout. Between these phases, risky refuelling sequences test your control, before the final stage challenges you to dismantle a heavily protected base through carefully timed actions – a demanding progression that consistently rewards precision and composure.

meta.name: Airline
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Airline is a business simulation. Two to four players try to successfully manage an airline. Planes need to be purchased, staff hired and routes planned. The players have two minutes in each round to make their settings for the month. The difficulty of the game lies in the time limit as well as in finding a balanced personnel planning so that the routes can be covered lucratively. Transporting freight can generate additional income. Services on board can make flights more attractive.

meta.name: Airliner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.56 KB

Airliner is a sober yet demanding flight simulation with no action or in-cockpit view. Instead, you control your plane entirely through instruments – airspeed, altitude, rate of climb, heading, and flap settings are your only guides. The goal is to navigate accurately, take off smoothly, and land safely at the correct destination. A short 3D view at the end shows either your landing or your crash. For those seeking an authentic pilot's challenge without distractions, this is pure technical flying.

meta.name: Airwolf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.79 KB

Airwolf es un juego de acción en el que tomas el control de un helicóptero y debes rescatar a cinco científicos que están prisioneros en una guarida subterránea amenazada por el enemigo. Para avanzar en el juego, debes disparar a todo lo que se encuentra en tu camino. El juego, basado en la serie de televisión, se ve desde un lateral y se mueve de pantalla en pantalla. Además, debes tener cuidado de no quedarte quieto en una posición debido a la gravedad realista del juego. En la versión en alemán se menciona que el helicóptero es el Airwolf, valorado en miles de millones de dólares y que solo Hawke, un piloto militar retirado, puede pilotar. Su misión es rescatar a los científicos que han sido secuestrados en un sistema de cuevas subterráneas en el desierto de Arizona. El juego solo otorga un vida al jugador y el objetivo es recoger a los cinco científicos y llevarlos de regreso a la base.

meta.name: Airwolf II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Airwolf II es una secuela directa de Airwolf, sin embargo, la historia de este shooter de desplazamiento lateral tiene aún menos en común con la popular serie de televisión, ya que ahora Stringfellow Hawke tiene que pilotar su helicóptero ultramoderno para combatir la invasión alienígena, encontrando nuevas armas (láseres, misiles) en camino.

meta.name: Aknakeresö
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.68 KB

“Aknakeresö” is a well-crafted minesweeper game for the Commodore 64. The goal is to uncover the entire grid without triggering any hidden mines. As you reveal tiles, numbers indicate how many mines are adjacent, and you must use logic and deduction to mark or avoid danger zones. With responsive controls, clear graphics, and a real-time display of score, time, and mine count, “Aknakeresö” delivers a focused and engaging puzzle experience for solo players.

meta.name: Akropolis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.09 KB

In Akropolis you navigate ancient catacombs using a jetpack, collecting precious statuettes and returning them safely to the starting point. Danger lurks everywhere – robotic guards attack on sight, and touching walls or traps drains your energy. Precision, timing, and sharp reflexes are essential to survive. Once all statuettes are recovered, the final boss appears – the ultimate test of your skill and endurance.

meta.name: Aktiv
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.30 KB

Un juego de fitness de la colección "The Big 100". En él, el usuario puede elegir el nivel de dificultad y la cantidad de tiempo para estar activo y luego el entrenador en pantalla lo guiará a través de una serie de ejercicios y movimientos corporales durante ese tiempo.

meta.name: Al-Strad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.34 KB

An excellent text adventure game with a strong sense of humor. Your goal is to rescue Sally Software, kidnapped by Sink. Interspersed insome in-jokes, there are some funny puns. HELP is available at some locations. Type it at every location if you want to see all of them.

meta.name: Ala
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.59 KB

You control a big flying guy who has a limited firing range and has to move horizontally - attacked by a series of unimaginative waves of attacks. There is no background or anything of note, indicating that this game was in its very early stages.

meta.name: Alcatraz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.09 KB

In this game, you take on the role of an inmate trying to escape from the notorious Alcatraz prison. You have dug a tunnel and a boat is waiting to take you to the mainland. However, the guards have found out about your plan and are trying to stop you. Starting in the courtyard, in this side-scrolling game, you must get to your tunnel from left to right, move through it, cross the land to the coast and finally onto the boat to reach freedom. Along the way, you must dodge guards, bullets and mines.

meta.name: Alcazar : The Forgotten Fortress
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.40 KB

Alcazar: The Forgotten Fortress feels like a mix of Dungeon Master and The Legend of Zelda. Your goal is to reach the main fortress Alcazar and reclaim the stolen crown. On the world map lie 22 castles to explore, each containing multiple rooms, floors, traps, and enemies. You can collect items, use a map for navigation, and either fight or avoid dangers. Four difficulty levels provide varying challenge. Taking too much damage costs a life, and losing all lives ends the quest.

meta.name: Alcon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Adaptation of the arcade game Slap Fight. So this game is a vertical shoot'em up with options. Options are selected after collecting stars from the smoking remains of enemies. This allows you to increase your speed and the power of your shot, add a side shot, use a laser, use homing missiles or protect yourself behind a force field.

meta.name: Alderan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alderan is a Tron-style arcade action game for three players.
The game comes with a level editor. You can choose a large number of worlds, the number of players, etc. and then try to prevent your line from crossing yourself or your opponent to win.

meta.name: Alesta
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Alexander the Great
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alexander the Great is a strategic war game based on the conquests of Alexander the Great. Each player controls an empire and attacks neighboring territories to gain dominance. The strength of an attack or defense is determined by various methods, such as rolling numbers, transforming numbers, or changing five-letter words. The player can decide how many transformations to perform per turn. The goal is to conquer geographical areas and replicate the power of Alexander the Great.

meta.name: ALF : The First Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En ALF: The First Adventure, controlas al extraterrestre más glotón en su misión más doméstica: recorrer cuatro laberintos por el garaje de Willie. Debes recolectar porciones de pizza (¡combustible vital!), atrapar a cuatro gatos descarriados, encontrar piezas de su nave y entregarlo todo en el orden correcto. Pero cuidado: el cazaperros y el propio Willie acechan. Si te atrapan tres veces, se acabó. Si es solo una, reinicias el nivel… pero el reloj no para. La tensión crece con una cuenta regresiva de 24 horas reales: cada segundo cuenta. ¿Podrás reparar tu nave, saciar tu hambre y evitar la deportación… sin que te descubra la familia Tanner? Una mezcla entrañable de Pac-Man, caos suburbano y humor ochentero.

meta.name: Alf in the Color Caves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.79 KB

Alf in the Color Caves has you guiding bouncy blue ALF through a maze of colorful shapes. You'll move through wriggling, squishy, and zig-zag obstacles while dodging the mischievous Wufflegumps who block your way. Only smart moves will lead ALF to the color space at the end. Make it there safely, and he'll reward you with his rainbow-colored dance and special music – a vibrant journey full of motion and surprises.

meta.name: Dungeon of the Algebra Dragons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Algebra Dragons, you embark on a journey through a dungeon while solving algebraic problems. Along the way, you must collect gold to survive, as running out of gold means a dragon will eat you. Three spider bites can also lead to your demise, while ghosts, though harmless, are a nuisance. Your goal is to reach the top floor of the dungeon, where you must find two keys that will unlock the path forward. The game combines math challenges with dungeon exploration, requiring both problem-solving skills and strategic thinking to succeed.

p: Algernon - An Introduction to Programming Logic (USA).D64
n: Algernon - An Introduction to Programming Logic (USA)

meta.name: Algernon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A computer skills game that sharpens estimation and spatial reasoning while providing a fun and challenging introduction to programming logic.

meta.name: Ali Baba
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.48 KB

The player finds himself in Ali Baba's cave and is tasked with collecting all the treasures. The task is hampered by an invisible djinn who tries to close the passages with his magical liquid, which turns into the hardest stone within ten seconds. Each time a new wall appears, the player loses 100 points, and when the score drops to zero, the game is over. The only way to prevent this is to neutralize the fluid by crossing the formation area. Once all the treasures are collected, the player moves on to the next level with a higher difficulty. The walls created from the magical liquid remain in place in subsequent levels.

p: Aliants - The Desperate Battle for Earth (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: Aliants - The Desperate Battle for Earth (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.path: ./Aliants - The Desperate Battle for Earth (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
meta.name: Aliants : The Desperate Battle for Earth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aliants: The Desperate Battle for Earth combines the struggle against an overwhelmingly powerful alien race with a mix of direct action and strategic play. After Earth has been conquered, the hopes of humanity rest on the last remaining resistance forces – and on you, who must first prove yourself before the real counterattack can begin. Its appeal comes especially from the blend of training sequences, combat-driven moments, and the later sense of a larger mission, because it is not just about quick reflexes, but also about gradually becoming the savior of a fallen world.

meta.name: Aliants : The Desperate Battle for Earth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aliants: The Desperate Battle for Earth combines the struggle against an overwhelmingly powerful alien race with a mix of direct action and strategic play. After Earth has been conquered, the hopes of humanity rest on the last remaining resistance forces – and on you, who must first prove yourself before the real counterattack can begin. Its appeal comes especially from the blend of training sequences, combat-driven moments, and the later sense of a larger mission, because it is not just about quick reflexes, but also about gradually becoming the savior of a fallen world.

meta.name: Aliard's Tome
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Years ago, a quest attempted by yourself, Malhek, in the Demon Dungeons of Cail had gone wrong and as you prepared to die you were rescued. The wizard Aliard had entered the Dungeons with his Tome of Magic Spells and managed to find you and take you back outside to safety. Problem is, the Tome was dropped and lost and now years later with Aliard getting old and feeble, the Tome is needed to cast the Spell of Rebirth to save Aliard's life. As a thank you for your rescue you have vowed to enter the Dungeons once more to retrieve the book but the monsters and creatures are stronger and where there were once lanterns lighting the way, they have all gone out leaving the place in darkness.

meta.name: Alice in Videoland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In “Alice In Videoland,” Alice must complete four challenges to return home. In the first game, she collects magic potions, cakes, keys, and a basket to access new rooms while avoiding an evil alarm clock. In the second game, she jumps from mushroom to mushroom in a colorful garden to catch rocking-horse flies that transform into red balls. In the third game, she moves across a chessboard with the help of the White Knight, while Tweedledee, Tweedledum, and the Jabberwock try to push her back. In the fourth game, Alice plays croquet and must hit the red balls from the second game through hoops before the Queen of Hearts destroys them.

meta.name: Alice in Wonderland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Alice in Wonderland” is an adventure platformer inspired by Lewis Carroll's Alice books. The player solves various puzzles, many of which are inventory-based and thematically tied to the story. The in-game time can be tracked by checking clocks scattered throughout the game. It is crucial to complete the game before the Red King awakens. With the ability to save progress at any time and undo mistakes, progress is always secured.

meta.name: Alien
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.27 KB

El juego sigue a la película, en el sentido de que al principio del juego un miembro del equipo (no siempre, pero a menudo Kane) da a luz? al extranjero. Luego depende del resto de la tripulación que controla el jugador moverse por los tres niveles del Nostromo usando los conductos de aire, intentando aislar al alienígena y destruirlo. O sácalo de la esclusa de aire del Nostromo, o como en la película, establece la autodestrucción en el barco y escapa en la cápsula de escape.

meta.name: Alien
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.42 KB

Alien takes place on the distant world of Hegira, where a massive energy fusion unit provides life-sustaining power to the planet's vast population. But slimy creatures known as Gaits have infiltrated the facility. These destructive parasites multiply rapidly and threaten to wipe out the colony. You play as Shila Byron, tasked with traversing the facility's sectors, tracking down the Gaits, and eliminating them before the energy supply collapses. Your Mobile Communication Unit constantly provides status updates and warnings as you navigate the sprawling complex. Precise control, smart use of your weapons, and quick reactions are vital to saving Hegira from destruction.

meta.name: Alien (SoftGold)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alien tells the story of Dr. Jason Stargazer, an astronomer in desperate need of money. An eccentric millionaire, Sir Roderick Lotabucks, offers a million-dollar reward for proof that UFOs actually exist. The trail leads you to the Arizona desert, specifically the area around the Little Wolf Crater, where strange magnetic anomalies and reports of alien activity stir your curiosity. Armed with scientific gear – and a lot of chewing gum – you set off on your journey. In this text adventure, you explore the area, follow clues, and gather evidence to prove the existence of UFOs and claim the reward.

meta.name: Alien 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los Xenomorfos son rápidos, escupen ácido y están... ¡justo detrás de ti! No se tiene mucha visibilidad en estos conductos de aire. Es difícil respirar. Los atrapacaras pueden estar en cualquier parte. Debes encontrar a la reina madre. Cuanto más cerca estés de ella, más aliens encontrarás... ¡más vale que no sean ellos los que te encuentren a ti! Sigue diciéndote a ti mismo, "todo esto no está pasando en realidad... ¡sólo es un juego!"

meta.name: Alien Armada
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.33 KB

Alien Attack begins with what should be a peaceful farming job on planet Scelor. But after landing, a mothership opens a dimensional warp and sends waves of hostile droids. You quickly equip your agribots with lasers to fight back. The droids hover and drop smartbombs you can't shoot – only dodge. The mothership also releases birds that home in and drop slow bombs, which you can shoot. Your goal: destroy the mothership with a single laser blast and end the invasion. But first, you'll have to defeat guardian droids that change form three times before vanishing.

meta.name: Alien Bash II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.52 KB

The task of the player controlling the cannon is to eliminate all aliens that land on Earth. There are nine levels to complete and the player has to fight with shooting units every second.

meta.name: Alien Commando : The Ship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.41 KB

"Alien Commando: The Ship" is a shoot'em-up game for the Commodore 64. The game was created with the Shoot'Em-Up Construction Kit (SEUCK) and offers a cooperative two-player mode. Players control their characters through various levels, fight enemy aliens and navigate the eponymous ship. The game is characterized by its action-packed game mechanics and the possibility of working together in co-op mode.

meta.name: Alien Commando II : Planet X
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.68 KB

Alien Commando II: Planet X tells of the Xenians, a constant threat to the Federation with their relentless border raids. All direct assaults have failed due to a narrow, heavily guarded tunnel into their planet. After many pilot losses, the Federation halted attacks and created an intense simulator. Only those who survive this brutal training are granted the honor of attempting to defeat the Xenians for real.

meta.name: Alien Commando III : Planet Ice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.23 KB

Alien Commando III: Planet Ice is the final part of the Alien Commando trilogy for the Commodore 64. The game was created with the Shoot'Em-Up Construction Kit (SEUCK) and offers a cooperative two-player mode in which players fight together against hostile aliens on the planet Ice. The action-packed game mechanics and the possibility of working together in co-op mode are what make this game stand out.

meta.name: Alien Invasion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aliens come from space and try to land on the player's planet. If they succeed, one of the three available ships will be destroyed. As the aliens approach the surface of the planet, they drop bombs that must be avoided by moving the ship left and right. You can earn additional ships by following the game's instructions and shooting the attackers in the correct order.

meta.name: Alien Kill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.90 KB

Alien Kill is a vertically scrolling, top-down shooter where the player's goal is to invade the base and eliminate as many aliens as possible.

meta.name: Alien Kill 2 : The Final Encounter
meta.desc:

A vertically scrolling shooter where the player's goal is to invade the base and eliminate as many aliens as possible. At the end of each stage there is a boss fight.

meta.name: Alien Killers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.29 KB

The player's task is to shoot all the blocks on the game board while avoiding contact with the falling alien. A question mark will appear on some destroyed blocks, which, when collected, will allow you to use stronger weapons, acceleration, additional energy, reversal of direction, etc.

meta.name: Alien Panic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.06 KB

In Alien Panic you aim to move aliens from the top to the bottom as quickly as possible – but this requires clever timing and precise actions. You dig holes for the aliens to fall into and must close them at the right moment to push them down one level. Once they reach the bottom platform, they disappear and a new one appears at the top. At the same time, you must avoid direct contact, as touching an alien sends you back and wastes valuable time – every second counts in your run for the best result.

meta.name: Alien Panic (Keypunch Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.35 KB

"Alien Panic" is an action game where the player takes on the role of a hero tasked with saving the world from one-eyed monsters. Equipped with a spacesuit and a special monster blaster, the player hunts the creatures. The objective is to lure the monsters into traps by creating holes and defeating them with special gas before they can spread their deadly disease.

meta.name: Alien Raid
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.94 KB

meta.name: Alien Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.34 KB

Alien Rescue puts you in charge after a lost space battle, where survivors have crash-landed in escape pods on an enemy planet. Your mission is to pilot your ship, pick up the pods one by one from the surface, and deliver them to your Mothership at the top of the screen. As you descend, a moving gun fires missiles upward that you must avoid or temporarily destroy with bombs. The danger increases with each rescue, as more missiles rain down while new pods land. With nine selectable difficulty levels, every mission challenges you to save as many survivors as possible.

meta.name: Alien Shootout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.37 KB

Alien Shootout places you in an abstract arena where waves of alien enemies constantly move across the playfield. You control your ship with rapid directional changes, dodge incoming attacks and eliminate threats with precision as the pace steadily increases. Focus and fast reflexes are essential to survive as long as possible and achieve a high score.

meta.name: Alien Sidestep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.20 KB

Alien Sidestep challenges you to delay an alien invasion for as long as possible by preventing enemy units from landing. The aliens behave surprisingly intelligently, dodging your shots and moving faster as their numbers thin out. Each wave increases the tension as new alien types appear and the margin for error shrinks. Once four aliens manage to get past your defenses and land, the game ends in defeat.

meta.name: Alien Smash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.00 KB

In Alien Smash you run through streets with lots of gaps with a laser weapon and have to shoot down attacking aliens. There are normal mini-bosses that fall into pieces when shot.

meta.name: Alien Storm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alien Storm en Commodore 64 es un beat'em all que te ofrece encarnar a Karla, Gordon o Scooter para salvar al mundo de la invasión Alien. Cada uno de los avatares tiene sus propias características, elige según tu estilo de juego. Atraviesa los seis niveles para llegar a la nave nodriza y enfrentarte a la reina de los alienígenas. ¡A tus armas!

meta.name: Alien Syndrome
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Una vez más, los alienígenas hacen la vida imposible a los humanos. El jugador asume el papel de Ricky o Mary, parte de un grupo secuestrado por los alienígenas. A bordo de la nave de los secuestradores, la misión del jugador es rescatar al mayor número posible de prisioneros en un tiempo limitado y escapar evitando los ataques de los alienígenas. Para ello, dispone de un variado arsenal. El clímax es una batalla épica contra la reina madre de los alienígenas.

meta.name: Alien Taskforce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.18 KB

Alien Taskforce drops you into a hostile alien world where survival depends on relentless offense and quick reactions. You fight your way through dangerous areas, face attacking enemies and force your path forward with sheer firepower. The experience centers on direct action, constant movement and the feeling of standing alone against an overwhelming threat.

meta.name: The Alien Team
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.65 KB

Parte del paquete de juegos Gamma Strike, que incluye un sistema de objetivos con mira. 
El sistema de objetivos con mira, solo se usó para el jefe de la etapa final, el resto es un shoot'em up de desplazamiento lateral relativamente estándar. Cuando llegas a la etapa de jefe del juego, el usuario cambia al dispositivo de fase de luz Gamma Strike y golpea más cerca de la diana para eliminar al jefe principal más rápidamente.
¿Puedes penetrar las defensas y superar a todos los miembros del escurridizo equipo alienígena?

meta.name: Aliens : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.12 KB

Basado en la película de ciencia ficción Aliens de 1986. Después de que el contacto se rompiera con la base en LV-426, Ripley y un grupo de soldados se dirigieron a este planeta. Si bien la versión Electric Dreams de Aliens es un juego de acción simple, esta versión presenta seis minijuegos relacionados con la película.
Dos de ellas son secuencias de acción en las que el jugador tiene que encontrar su camino a través del complejo. Él tiene control sobre cuatro marines y puede cambiar entre ellos al instante. Las otras secuencias son el aterrizaje de la nave, encontrar un camino a través de un laberinto de conductos de aire, defenderse de las hordas alienígenas y luchar contra la reina alienígena.

meta.name: Aliens : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aliens: The Computer Game (US Version) lets you relive the intensity and terror of the film firsthand. You return to LV-426 to confront the nightmare once more – this time, to survive. The game spans six distinct levels, each recreating a scene from the movie with its own gameplay style. From piloting the dropship through ring-filled courses to fending off xenomorphs in Space Invaders-style shootouts and facing the Alien Queen in the final showdown, every stage tests different skills. Activision's U.S. version differs greatly from its European counterpart, offering a cinematic blend of action, suspense, and escalating danger that perfectly captures the spirit of the film.

meta.name: Aliens from Subterrania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.28 KB

En el inquietante subsuelo de Subterrania te persiguen alienígenas enloquecidos. Puedes correr a través del laberinto para evitarlos y puedes dispararles para defenderte.
Muévete por las cuevas con el joystick. Dondequiera que vayas, los extraterrestres parecen seguirte. Tienes tres vidas, que pierdes una cada vez que un extraterrestre entra en contacto contigo.
Puedes destruir a un alienígena disparándole con el botón de disparo. Cada uno que aciertes vale 50 puntos. Y gana puntos de bonificación cada vez que llega a una nueva habitación.
Lanzado como parte del paquete de juegos "Commodore Pro-Pak"

meta.name: The Aliens of Kaladram
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.04 KB

The Aliens of Kaladram thrusts you into a vertically scrolling battle over the hostile world of Kaladram. A satellite's SOS reveals that your people have been taken there – and only you can rescue them. Piloting your warpcraft, you fight through enemy zones, dodging fire and blasting anything in your path. The aliens are relentless, and only precision flying and unwavering focus will see you through. Fail, and there's no way back to Earth – so fly boldly, fight fiercely, and survive the assault on Kaladram.

meta.name: Alienworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alienworld tells the story of Kai, who is about to marry his beloved Medb when the dark Slough Feg kidnaps her and hides her in the Cave of Dreams. When Kai swears to rescue her, Slough Feg transforms him into an insect. With the magic of the Druid Lords you set out on your perilous quest. Defeated enemies drop weapon power-ups or Zen, the cave's currency, which you can spend in shops for healing or new weapons. You have three lives that fade as your energy dots vanish. Levels scroll horizontally or vertically, moving only as you advance, and retreat is impossible. Every step counts as you fight through countless foes.

meta.name: Alioth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alioth is a sci-fi platform game set on the planet of the same name. After an unsuccessful scientific experiment, a robot & operators are sent in to destroy everything. The robot is equipped with a gun, but some of the mutants have created a protective system against the bullets.
The amount of bullets is limited, but some of the killed mutants may leave an extra ammo. The player's task is to find out 10 parts of nuclear bomb and bring them to the start location in order to destroy the base.

meta.name: All New Family Feud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The All New Family Feud, two families compete against each other and must guess the five most popular answers to questions like "Name the most famous female singer today." The number of people who gave the same answer determines the points awarded. For example, if 20 people named "Madonna," the family earns 20 points. There are three to five rounds, and at the end, the family with the most points wins.

meta.name: All New Family Feud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The All New Family Feud, two families compete against each other and must guess the five most popular answers to questions like "Name the most famous female singer today." The number of people who gave the same answer determines the points awarded. For example, if 20 people named "Madonna," the family earns 20 points. There are three to five rounds, and at the end, the family with the most points wins.

meta.name: All Risks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.20 KB

All Risks sends you on an unusual mission: you must recover the stolen success slogans of the Victoria-Vesta insurance company. In each game, one slogan has been cut into pieces and hidden in two houses – one of which is your own. Behind furniture, paintings, and objects lie the scattered fragments you must discover and reassemble. But beware: searching can be dangerous. With the right Victoria-Vesta insurance policy, you can reduce your risks – though it will cost part of your budget. Your goal is to find and rebuild the entire slogan before your funds run out or you reach the ripe age of 110.

meta.name: All-American Basketball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.89 KB

"All American Basketball" is a digital adaptation of the sport, allowing players to compete in a tournament with eight American teams or play a friendly match. Before starting, various settings can be adjusted, including the number of players, jersey colors, difficulty level, and game duration. The action is shown from a side perspective, displaying part of the court at a time. The controlled player is highlighted by blinking, with the joystick used for movement and the fire button for shooting the ball.

meta.name: Allan Border's Cricket
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.35 KB

Allan Border's Cricket brings the traditional summer sport to the screen and is one of the few games to authentically mimic cricket. You can choose from all international teams, customize players and assemble your own squad. Both Test Matches and Limited Overs Games are available, with one or two innings per side. The leg-before-wicket rule can be disabled to make the game easier to follow. Three difficulty levels – Amateur, Professional and World Class – add variety. Bowling requires placing a cursor to set delivery and controlling speed or spin, while batting relies on precise timing with automated shot execution.

meta.name: Alley Cat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are Thomas the cat and you have a date with a lady friend and you must move across the local area to get to her using walls. The game is a side view flick-screen game and you must move across each screen from the left to the right avoiding obstacles like flying boots and bottles. There are also gaps with gates and these must be jumped over but on later screens obstacles appear from the gaps like dogs and brooms. If you touch an obstacle or fall through a gap then you lose one of nine lives and start on the left of the screen you are on. Reaching the end of each screen gives you a bonus based on how long it took you to complete the screen.

meta.name: Alley-Oops! : It Turns Bowling Upside Down
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.49 KB

In Alley-Oops you move across a bowling-alley-like playfield with eight lanes, looping from one side to the other. Each lane holds bowling pins and dangerous obstacles such as wine bottles, which cost a life when touched. You can shoot the pins with your endless supply of bowling balls to earn points. Behind some pins are X and / symbols for strikes and spares – catch them to add them to your scorecard. Strikes count toward your next two hits, spares toward the next one. Once you've collected ten symbols, you finish the level and receive bonus points and an extra life. Losing a life resets your scorecard.

meta.name: Alleykat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alleykat is a vertically-scrolling racer with elements of a shoot-em up game.
The player, a speeder pilot, strives to become the Alleykat Champion by competing in eight space stadiums scattered around the galaxy. Different races like demolition derbies, time-trials, endurance epics and others feature all kinds of obstacles like rocks, pillars, bridges and hard walls, and several types of enemies race along.

meta.name: Alliance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.05 KB

Alliance is a very simple Warhawk/Lightforce clone with a very slow scrolling background for each level and very simple alien attack waves. Graphically it looks ok, nothing spectacular - but the presentation is pretty nice - including a cool title screen and a range of music tracks.

meta.name: Alloyrun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.66 KB

In Alloyrun you control a futuristic ship moving through a side-scrolling environment. Enemies approach from the right side of the screen and must be destroyed before they reach you. Your ship can move freely across the screen but can only fire to the right, so positioning becomes very important. Various obstacles and hazards also appear and must be avoided to survive. Each defeated enemy increases your score, while the game keeps track of the high score.

meta.name: Almazz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.67 KB

“Almazz” puts the player in the role of an explorer navigating a vast African savannah to find the Almazz diamond before time runs out. The hero stays cool by walking, but running increases body temperature, which ends the game if it reaches its limit. A flask allows the player to drink, but water supplies must be refilled at pools. Dangers like spear-throwers and lions make the search more challenging. Lions attack when they sense the player's presence, and attacks or hits result in game over. The player is armed with a weapon but can only refill ammunition in huts, which costs time. Riddles, items, and tablet fragments aid in the search, and after finding the diamond, a final puzzle must be solved.

meta.name: Alpha Command
meta.desc:

Alpha Command is a strategy game for the Commodore 64. In this game, players take on the role of a spaceship captain, inspired by the "Star Trek" series, and navigate through space to fight enemy ships and complete missions. The gameplay combines strategic planning with role-playing elements, with the player's decisions influencing the course of the missions.

meta.name: Alpha Omega Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alpha Omega Run is a Star Wars Arcade-influenced shooter in which you sit in your spacefighter and control the pulse weapon using a crosshair.

meta.name: Alphabet Crazy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.55 KB

Alphabet Crazy combines learning with delightfully silly shooting and turns the alphabet into an unusually action-packed target practice. Instead of simply memorizing letters, you recognize them, track them, and shoot them down, making the ABCs stick in a much livelier way. That playful contrast between a simple learning idea and a wild execution gives the game its charm. The result is a fun little experience that introduces children to the alphabet with a wink.

meta.name: Alphabet Zoo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.62 KB

Alphabet Zoo has you racing through a maze from a top-down view, collecting scattered letters. In the center, a picture shows the word you're working with, and that determines which letters you need. One mode has you grabbing the first letter of the object as many times as possible before time runs out, while the other makes you collect all letters of the word in the correct order. Teleporters shuffle you around randomly, adding a bit of chaos. You can play alone or against another player, choose uppercase, lowercase or mixed letters, and start on any level you like.

With just twelve hours to stop their plan for world domination, you'll explore, investigate, and make critical decisions in this interactive fiction game enhanced with graphics.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.42 KB

Alpine Tram Ride is an educational game designed to teach logic and problem solving. The game presents the player with a tram with four carriages; Each carriage is occupied by one of ten animals and the player's goal is to find out which animal is in which tram car. In each round, the player selects four animals and places them in the tram cars; The game shows whether the animals selected are correct and whether they are placed in the right place. Since the game does not indicate which of the four selected animals are correct, the player must find out. The game ends when the player selects the correct four animals and places them in the correct location. The game records how many rounds it takes. The goal is to solve the puzzle in as few rounds as possible.

meta.name: Altair 4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.49 KB

Disaster has happened to you while flying your Strato-Cruiser in deep space. You have encountered an asteroid storm and your ship has taken a big hit damaging the ship forcing you to search for a planet or moon to land on. More problems have arisen as your computer has told you the nearest planet is Altair 4, a galactic penal planet. All planets and races over generations have been sending their dangerous criminals to the planet and isn't the place to be visiting. Once you have landed, your quest is to find parts for your ship, to repair and leave the planet while trying to stay alive. Altair 4 is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location while you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

meta.name: Alter Ego
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.68 KB

Alter Ego is a "life simulator" that presents you with a series of life experiences that take you from infancy through old age.  You can live out your own life, or the life of someone else, possibly someone you wish you could be.  You can live out fantasies without risk, relive your childhood, or maybe see the world from your kids'/parents'/spouse's eyes.
The life situations you encounter have the ability to change or become eliminated based on previous decisions you make.  While the life you live is a fantasy, the actions you take have very real and thought-provoking responses.

meta.name: Alter Ego Female
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Alter Ego is a game which tries to simulate life itself. The player creates a character with different personality statistics, either by assigning them randomly or by answering a few introductory questions. They then guide this character through seven life phases, from infancy to old age.
The gameplay consists of a series of situations where a decision has to be made. This is done by choosing one of multiple answer possibilities, sometimes accompanied with a mood. Then the player gets presented with the outcome and goes on to the next situation. Every decision has long-time consequences and influences the personality, health and which situations await further down the road. Some decisions may even result in an early death or instant game over.

Eres un héroe resucitado de entre los muertos por el dios Zeus para rescatar a su hija Atenea. Alternate Reality: The City places you in a strange urban world after being abducted by aliens, leaving you free to search for a way back home. A key feature is the moral system, where your actions shape how others respond to you. Encounters can be resolved not only through combat but also through trickery, charm, or bribery. The result is an open-ended adventure driven largely by your choices and personal playstyle.

meta.name: American Express
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"American Express" is a fast-paced racing game where the player travels across the USA on a motorcycle while dodging enemy helicopters, trucks, and even UFOs. Before each race, useful upgrades can be purchased to enhance the journey. The controls are simple, using the joystick, while avoiding collisions with other vehicles, mines, and obstacles is crucial. From Seattle to Portland, the game offers an action-packed adventure filled with thrilling challenges.

meta.name: American Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.20 KB

American Football lets you compete against the computer or a friend from a top-down view of the field. After choosing team names and calling the coin toss, the match begins. Offensively, you can choose from ten plays like Bomb, Shotgun, Punt, or Kick. Defensively, select from Pass, Run, or Blitz coverage. After entering your play, the action unfolds automatically – every touchdown or tackle depends on your strategy.

meta.name: American Tag-Team Wrestling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 60.47 KB

"American Tag-Team Wrestling" focuses on intense team battles where each player selects two wrestlers. When one fighter is weakened, they can tag their partner at the edge of the ring to recover. The game offers both single matches for one or two players and a full tournament with three rounds of varying lengths. The control system eliminates frantic joystick shaking, allowing for a variety of kicks, throws, and punches through simple movements. When fighters get close, they engage in a grapple, giving the opportunity to lift the opponent and slam them onto the mat.

meta.name: Amity Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Amity Island places the player in the role of a shark swimming around the island. The goal is to eat swimmers while carefully avoiding humans armed with harpoons. Skillful maneuvering and quick reactions are crucial for success.

meta.name: Amnesia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The player wakes up naked and without any memories in a room on the 15th floor of a hotel. As the game begins, it turns out that the player is in Manhattan, is engaged to a woman he doesn't know and is wanted for murder in Texas. An unknown person repeatedly tries to kill the player. The player's task is to survive and regain his memory.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Amorphous is a colorful single-player puzzle game where you guide Morphe – a shape-shifting creature on a mission. Your goal is to solve each level's puzzle and eventually return to the mothership. You'll need to manage the timer, gather food, and activate the right tiles on the grid to progress. With increasing difficulty and vibrant retro visuals, this game offers a fun mix of strategy, timing – and a splash of outer space charm.

meta.name: The Amulet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.34 KB

The Amulet is a traditional text adventure where each location is described through text and you enter commands using the keyboard to interact with each location. The goal is to find seven shards of a broken amulet scattered across time.

meta.name: Amöba
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.22 KB

The game is similar to Tic, Tac, Toe and is played on a 12x12 playing field. You play against a second player - a human or against the computer. You can alternately place stones "x" or "o". The first person to get 5 in a row, horizontally, vertically or diagonally, wins the game. But be careful, the time is running, each player gets 180 seconds to think about it and you also lose these elapsed times.

meta.name: Anarchy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Anarchy es un juego de acción. En niveles laberínticos tienes que encontrar y destruir los alijos de armas de los rebeldes. Por desgracia, no podrás destruirlos si estás demasiado cerca de ellos. Así que prepara una buena técnica de aproximación para completar tu misión dentro del tiempo límite.

meta.name: Ancipital
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.96 KB

Ancipital puts you in control of a two-legged yak that fires bananas at enemies – at least on the first screen, since projectiles change in other levels. You can jump and flip onto the ceiling to fight upside down. The goal is to eliminate enemies until walls or floors open up, letting you move to the next stage shown on a mini-map. Each level features a bizarre theme, from skulls to lighters and rolling papers – classic Minter madness.

meta.name: Android Control
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.28 KB

In Android Control, you play as an android sent into a massive alien spacecraft after a small American town mysteriously vanishes. Three agents failed before you – now it's your mission to discover the aliens' plans and stop them if hostile. The ship spans 20 color-coded floors, filled with enemies and hazards. Armed with a blaster and limited bombs, you navigate using elevators and recharge at stations for energy, ammo, and zap pulses. Use those pulses to override alien circuits in timed mini-games. If the threat is real, your final task: destroy the ship.

meta.name: Android Two
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.85 KB

Android Two places the player in a maze featuring 5 Militoids to destroy within a time limit. Although they don't shoot back at the player, there are plenty of other hazards in the maze. Aliens are present, which can shoot at the player, as well as land-mines and 20 indestructible robots to block the player's path. There are 3 mazes to clear, each of which has a wrap-around design similar to the original Pac-man game and fills more than one screen. The player has five lives in which to progress as far as possible and try to beat the high score.

meta.name: Andromeda Conquest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.64 KB

“Andromeda Conquest” is a strategic space game in the style of “Risk,” where one to four players compete to build galactic empires and eliminate their opponents. Empires are established by founding new colonies in distant star systems and defending them. The first player to control ten star systems for an entire round wins. There are 48 star systems, each with unique features like strange life forms and technologies. Each player begins with a home planet and ten resource points. As the game progresses, players collect resources from their colonies, allowing for faster expansion and stronger defenses.

meta.name: Andromeda III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Andromeda III” tells the story of a spaceship captain who embarks on a journey from Earth with a small crew to uncover the secrets of an ancient race called the “Dawn People.” After traveling through a black hole, only two crew members remain—one lost to madness and the other near death. The player takes on the role of the captain, stranded alone in the midst of the black hole, tasked with exploring a mysterious new world to unravel the fate of the “Dawn People” and potentially secure their own survival.

meta.name: Andromex3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.16 KB

Andromex3 is a simple shooter game – the player must fight enemies with precise shots. Quick reactions and accuracy are crucial to succeed.

meta.name: Andy Capp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.76 KB

In this game you play the role of Andy Capp the hard drinking northern layabout from the comic strip in the British newspaper  The Mirror. The main idea of the game is to keep your alchometer as full as possible while avoid being arrested for fighting various characters including your own wife. You can stop people in the street by blowing a kiss at them. When you stand next to the person you interact by either giving them an item, talking to them or beating them up.

meta.name: Angel of the Hell
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An adventure game at the gates of hell.
...It feels like you're standing at the gateway to the underworld. The air is much colder than it should be. In the south you can see the river Styx. On the riverbank stands Kharon, the ferryman who brought you here. In the north, a skull smiles at you...

meta.name: Angle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.33 KB

Angle is a puzzle game where you must eliminate matching tiles in groups of three – but only if they form a right-angled "L" shape. This unique constraint gives the game its name and turns it into a clever brain teaser. With a ticking timer and limited lives, each move matters. Spotting the right angles and clearing the board efficiently is key to advancing.

meta.name: Angle Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.80 KB

Angle Ball is a unique take on pool played on a hexagonal table with six pockets. Balls rebound at odd angles, demanding precision and timing. The goal is to pot all balls – missing three shots in a row costs you the frame unless your opponent fails too. In single-player mode, you face 20 distinct layouts, each requiring a new approach. Two players can compete on any preset table or a custom one made with the built-in editor. Shot direction, power and spin are fully adjustable.

meta.name: Animal Hotel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Animal Hotel, you train your memory by remembering which animal lives in which hotel room. Depending on the selected difficulty, you get three to six rooms and only a few seconds to memorize the animals. Then one room is selected – can you recall who stayed there?

meta.name: Animal Magic - Save the Baby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.47 KB

While babysitting in the garden of a kindergarten, an eagle flew down and took the baby. Now it's up to you to find the baby and return it to the kindergarten. You have to explore different places like deserts, mountains and forests and you will also encounter different creatures and animals that are dangerous and don't think of killing you. You must try to get the animals to help you in your search or get rid of them in some way. Animal Magic is a text adventure with some graphical elements, where text appears on the screen describing each location you visit and images appear above the text. You enter commands using the keyboard to interact with your environment.

meta.name: Animated Strip Poker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.27 KB

"Animated Strip Poker" is a Five-Card Stud variant where the player competes against a woman, aiming to win rounds and gradually make her remove pieces of clothing. The screen displays the player's current hand, the opponent, and a small card figure indicating the next game phase. Both players start with £145 and a £10 pot. The player can raise, call, or bet based on their assessment of their five-card hand compared to the opponent's. After the first betting round, unwanted cards can be discarded and replaced, followed by another round of betting. Once a player calls, both hands are revealed. The player with the stronger hand, such as a pair, two pairs, or a full house, wins the money, while the loser removes a piece of clothing.

meta.name: Aniso
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.69 KB

Aniso is a clever puzzle game where you recreate a number pattern shown on the right by interacting with the grid on the left. A click adds 1 to a square, but clicking nearby also increases adjacent numbers, influencing the board indirectly. You can't click a square twice – only change it through surrounding moves. Numbers over 4 wrap back to 1, so careful planning is key. Build the pattern from highest to lowest, and once the last number is placed, the game ends – match it exactly to win.

meta.name: Ankh
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.43 KB

Ankh is a flick-screen arcade adventure where you control a Mindprobe exploring the surreal world of Ankh. Your goal is to reach the final room out of 64 and uncover a secret, tool, or treasure. Along the way, you'll face enemies that shoot at you – but you can shoot back. Doors open via switches, and collected objects can be used elsewhere to aid your quest. Touching enemies, walls, or wrong items drains your energy – and once it's gone, your adventure is over.

meta.name: Annaconda
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.65 KB

„Annaconda“ is an extremely difficult shooter-platformer set in overgrown forest ruins. You play as a hunter who fights off bizarre monsters with a bow and arrows. To go underground, you must use your hunter powers to transform into a faster but more vulnerable snake. Collecting treasures increases your score.

meta.name: Annals of Rome
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.82 KB

"Annals of Rome" begins in 273 BC and places the player in the role of a Roman senator with the goal of colonizing as much of the known world as possible and maintaining power against Carthaginians, Vandals, Parthians, Persians, and other major powers. A strong army is at the player's disposal, and generals can be directed to invade specific territories. The game is turn-based and progresses through phases, starting with economic decisions and tax revenue management. Officers may rebel and trigger civil wars – though with the right measures, this can usually be prevented.

meta.name: Annihilator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Annihilator es un clon de Defender para un solo jugador. El jugador controla una pequeña nave espacial sobre la superficie de un planeta rocoso. El objetivo es derribar naves espaciales alienígenas y conseguir una alta puntuación. En cuanto todos los alienígenas hayan desaparecido de la pantalla, el juego anuncia "SECTOR CLEARED" y el jugador avanza al siguiente nivel.

meta.name: Annihilator II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.95 KB

Annihilator II puts you in control of a spacecraft navigating side-scrolling stages on planets in the Messier 31 Galaxy. Your mission is to collect as many inhabitants as possible while wiping out every alien enemy to advance. Each planet features three stages, and only after eliminating all threats can you proceed. A relentless sci-fi shooter where capturing and conquering is the name of the game.

meta.name: Another Day, Another Zombie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.43 KB

Shoot 'em up created with the Shoot 'em up Construction Kit engine (SEUCK) in which you must take down the hordes of undead that harass you.

meta.name: Another World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

San Francisco 2016. A series of earthquakes has damaged several nuclear power plants, and the subsequent nuclear contamination has forced the survivors to flee underground. Their only hope to get off the continent is to use newly developed matter transporters. However, these transporters require certain types of crystals to work. Since men cannot survive on the surface, the task of collecting the crystals is assigned to a cyborg.

meta.name: Anstoss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Anstoss is a soccer manager simulation that differs from the others in its novel emphasis on the psychological aspects of the game. 
The game gives you as team manager not only full control over strategies, but also over what kind of 'pep talks' you can give at half-time and what PR measures you can take to improve public perception. 
Choose the host country and lead your team from qualifying to the World Cup in the World Cup Edition and lead your team to win the championship in the League Edition.

meta.name: Ant Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.34 KB

Ambientado en una ciudad isométrica en 3D (una de las primeras representaciones de este tipo en los videojuegos), el jugador controla a un chico o una chica y viaja por la ciudad intentando encontrar su mitad perdida saltando sobre estructuras para evitar a las hormigas, o luchando contra los insectos saltando sobre ellos o lanzando granadas.

meta.name: Anter-Planter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.68 KB

Anter-Planter challenges you to defend a vegetable plot from a relentless ant invasion. While watering and nurturing your crops, you must also poison and eliminate the pests. Balancing care with defense requires quick decisions and sharp timing – or you'll end up with a ravaged garden.

meta.name: Anti
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.06 KB

Anti challenges you to defend a futuristic city from incoming rockets by strategically placing airborne mines with your aircraft. Precision and timing are crucial – each mine can mean the difference between devastation and survival. As attacks intensify and the pressure mounts, only calm and foresight will keep the city from falling.

meta.name: Antics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.10 KB

Antics es una compilación de cuatro minijuegos: Dulcedo Cogitationis, Elvin, Chip War y Mini Boulder. Cada juego ofrece sus propias mecánicas y desafíos, desde rompecabezas hasta reacciones rápidas. Con gráficos digitalizados y sonidos coordinados, este paquete ofrece el encanto clásico de 8 bits en un formato compacto, demostrando la versatilidad de las ideas de juego sencillas.

meta.name: Antifriction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.45 KB

Destroy a number of enemy ships that are closing in on you. With each wave destroyed you can change weapons. Note the three-level differential scrolling, a major engineering achievement for the time.

meta.name: Apache Raid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Apache Raid places you in a cabin, looking out the window as you defend yourself and a party of six against attacking riders. Using a crosshair, you must shoot as many as possible before some break in through the roof and run across the room. If any escape, one of your six smiley faces turns sad – they've been scalped. Once all six are gone, you're the last – and when they get you, it's game over.

meta.name: Apache Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Apache Strike you pilot an attack helicopter through a simplified city landscape with the objective of destroying the enemy's strategic defense computer. Along the way you encounter hostile helicopters and tanks that must be shot down to continue your mission. An on-screen map displays your position as well as the direction and distance to the target, helping you navigate toward it. During the mission the onboard system provides digitized voice messages to report important events. Careful flying and accurate attacks are required if you want to reach the defense computer and complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: APB : All Points Bulletin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En All Points Bulletin eres un oficial de policía en patrulla, con una misión diaria distinta: perseguir infractores y delincuentes, y detenerlos activando la sirena en el momento justo. Al cumplir el objetivo, regresas a la comisaría… pero el camino está lleno de oportunidades: bolsas de dinero, objetos de bonificación y mejoras ocultas. Con lo recolectado puedes mejorar tu situación económica e incluso personalizar tu coche patrulla: más velocidad, mejor frenado o blindaje extra. Así, entre persecuciones frenéticas y decisiones tácticas —¿perseguir al ladrón o recoger esa bolsa antes de que desaparezca?—, el juego combina acción pura con una pizca de estrategia y progreso tangible. Ser policía nunca fue tan intenso… ni tan divertido.

meta.name: Ape Craze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.03 KB

The player controls a small character who moves sideways and can jump between numerous platforms. The goal is to collect all the items while avoiding the bombs that the monkey throws across the screen at the top left of the screen. If the player is hit by a bomb or falls more than one platform away, they lose a life. The player starts with 3 lives.

meta.path: ./Apollo 18 - Mission to the Moon (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
meta.name: Apollo 18 : Mission to the Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Apollo 18: Mission to the Moon simulates a fictional mission to the Moon in the early 1980's, following on from the last real flight (Apollo 17) before NASA cancelled the program. One of the game's key features is digitised speech, which sounds crackly like a real mission controller would. Telemetry screens provide realism, with the player having to set items and computer programs to get the crucial GO signal. The game is split into several sequences. First is launch, where pressing the button to stop a moving bar at the right point determines success. Course corrections and an orbital rendezvous (to undock the lunar module) are next. The player has to land the module safely on one of three possible landing sites before running out of fuel. The moonwalk is next, and must be completed in a set time before returning to orbit. On the way home the astronaut performs a spacewalk to capture and repair a satellite. Finally there is the re-entry sequence and splashdown.
