meta.name: Apoxoly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Apoxoly is a fast-paced horizontally scrolling space shooter with almost monochromatic graphics and good music. You start with 3 ships but you can earn some in battle. Once you have completed a level, we reassemble your spaceship equipment in a menu before you can jump into the next level. There are 5 different levels in different environments.

meta.name: Appareil a Jetons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.69 KB

In Appareil à Jetons you step into the shoes of an arcade gambler, trying your luck at a virtual slot machine. You place your bet, pull the lever, and hope the symbols line up for a winning combination. Depending on the pattern, payouts range from small prizes to the big jackpot. The game explains itself and captures the essence of traditional slot machines – simple, risky, and irresistibly engaging.

meta.name: Apple Cider Spider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Apple Cider Spider, you play a hardworking spider trying to reach your attic web for a well-deserved rest after a long day in a cider factory. But the climb is full of hazards – dodge streams of cider and a slicer on the first floor, avoid apples and a brutal blade on the second, and steer clear of falling fruit on the third. Once you reach the attic, new threats await: frogs, birds, and wasps. Quick jumps and perfect timing are key. A teddy-bear mode ensures younger players can enjoy the fun too.

meta.name: Aqua
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.16 KB

In Aqua you control a diver who searches for pearls at the bottom of the sea. You move laterally and jump between shifting platforms while managing your limited oxygen supply – return to your vessel before it runs out. Various sea creatures add danger. Once all pearls are collected, the screen refills. Each player has three lives, and the game ends when all lives are lost. The player with the highest score wins.

meta.name: Aqua Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.82 KB

Aqua Racer: Grand Prix F1 Nautica takes you off the asphalt and onto the water as a bored racing champion seeking new thrills in speedboats. To become the Aqua Racer champion, you must conquer over 20 demanding tracks. First, beat a qualifying time to enter the race – then race again against the clock to move forward. Stay within the course marked by buoys and avoid colliding with rival boats. Played from a behind-the-boat perspective, you control your craft with a joystick: forward to accelerate, back to brake, and the fire button switches between low and high gear. Your speed, gear, and target time are always displayed on screen.

meta.name: Aquanaut
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.58 KB

Aliens are polluting our oceans and turning the creatures of the deep into mutated, dangerous creatures. You are the pilot of a technologically advanced submarine and you must destroy the creatures and aliens to make the oceans safe once more. Aquanaut is a side view horizontal shooter where the screen scrolls from left to right constantly and the joystick is used to control your sub. You must shoot or avoid the creatures because if you are hit then your damage gauge increases and when it is full then it is game over. You also have a torpedo gauge showing the rate of fire and a distance gauge which increases the further you progress in the game.

meta.name: Aquanaut
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.11 KB

You are a member of the Aquanaut Patrol, where in your heavily armed underwater craft you patrol the seas keeping them safe and protected by any attack. On one such patrol you have come across the Caves of Shallic where a mighty power is gathering to attack with various crafts and weapons. It is up to you to explore the depths of the caverns and destroy as many crafts and weapons as you can before returning to base.

meta.name: Aquaplane
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.24 KB

In Aquaplane you control a speedboat towing a water-skier. The goal is to avoid obstacles like logs, boats, and sharks – both with the boat and with the skier, who moves with slight inertia and lags behind. You earn points when obstacles entering from the right exit the screen safely on the left.

meta.name: Aquavile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.24 KB

AquaVile takes you into a hostile ocean complex with a futuristic underwater craft, surrounded by bizarre creatures and machines. You move in every direction, dodge solid obstacles, and fire missiles at fish, crabs, robots, mines, and other dangers. Between slow advances, fast dodging sections, and large enemies, an intense underwater adventure unfolds – whoever stays calm and maneuvers cleanly fights deeper and deeper into the threatening facility.

meta.name: Arachne
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.32 KB

Arachne is an evil Cult that is spread all over the world and wields enormous power. The purpose of the sect is to awaken enormous supernatural powers and conquer the world. They do this by abducting people with special mental abilities, draining their energy and causing their bodies to die. It's up to you to stop their evil plans.nnnnYou do this by throwing lightning bolts at various enemies (reapers, ghosts, bubbles). You can see your progress in the level live and your protection bar must not fall to 0.

meta.name: Arachnophobia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Arachnophobia arms you with pesticide and an arachno-detector to fight off a deadly spider infestation. South American spiders have invaded homes, farms, and public buildings in the U.S., and only your “Toxi-Max” spray can stop them. Played from a side view, the game challenges you to react quickly and take out the creepy crawlers before they reach you. Simple gameplay, crawling tension.

meta.name: Arc Doors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Arc Doors you control a prince transformed into a frog, navigating watery stages filled with hazards. You hop across stones for safety or onto lily pads that constantly shrink and expand—stay too long and you'll fall in, losing a life, as the frog can't swim. The goal in each level is to reach the exit, which must first be unlocked with a key. Along the way, you'll face enemies with unique behaviors: turtles pacing back and forth, snails sliding toward you when aligned, green webs that explode on contact, mosquitoes that drain your life, and spiders that relentlessly chase you. Skill, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to survival.

meta.name: The Arc of Yesod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.90 KB

In Nodes of Yesod, a monolith was discovered on the moon that transferred data vital to earth's security to an alien planet. After an attempt to destroy the monolith failed, it was transported to its creators the Ariatans. Now it is up to Charlie to travel to the planet Ariat and prevent the Ariatans from accessing the data.
Gameplay in Arc of Yesod is very similar to its predecessor. Seen from a side-scrolling perspective, Charlie has to explore many large caverns, filled with enemies and transporters, and find eight crystals that he hopes will help him destroy the monolith for good. To get rid of his enemies, he can once again control a device similar to the mole in Nodes of Yesod. Pressing up on the joystick releases a small sphere that can be moved across the screen (while Charlie stands still) and shoot at enemies. Once again, there are enemies that are immune to the sphere, including a spaceman who, when touched, takes away one of Charlie's crystals.

meta.name: Arcade Classic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Compilation with new versions of four classic arcade games:
Asteroids
Snakes
Space Invaders
Space wars

meta.name: Arcade Classics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Arcade Classics is a compilation featuring four unofficial clones of famous arcade hits. Included are Rocks in Space (Asteroids), Worm Warz (Snake), Invaders (Space Invaders), and Space Wars. Each game recreates the classic arcade style on the C64, offering fast and straightforward action for quick sessions.

meta.name: Arcade Flight Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.23 KB

Aprenderás a volar a través de diferentes épocas. Podrás pilotar un biplano de la Primera Guerra Mundial sobre Alemania, un avión de la Segunda Guerra Mundial sobre Pearl Harbour y un avión de combate de la Tercera Guerra Mundial. Tras eliminar a todos los aviones enemigos, deberás volver a tu base para recuperar una bomba. A continuación, debes volver a territorio enemigo para lanzar la bomba sobre el cuartel general enemigo. Durante la batalla, vigila tu combustible. Para repostar, debes volar bajo sobre un depósito de combustible.

meta.name: Arcade Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

How much do you want your American football team to score? Enough to handle fractions and other math problems? That's exactly what we hope for! You need to simplify this fraction for the Gipper to make a First Down, and figure out the percentage of Gatorade poured on each coach when you have 7 coaches and 12 Gatorade coolers. If you pick the wrong answer, you might throw an interception or get penalized for offsides and lose yards.

meta.desc:

n: Arcade Fruit Machine - Cash and Grab (Europe)

meta.name: Arcade Fruit Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Arcade Fruit Machine simulates a slot machine where you insert coins and aim to unlock features like CASH'n'GRAB or CASH RUN. In CASH'n'GRAB, you collect letters to earn a bonus like “Pick a Win” or “Win Spins” – or risk a miss such as “Skill Stop”. At any time, you can cash in features or stop gambling. Your winnings update your virtual UK bank balance.

p: Arcade Game Construction Kit (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).G64
n: Arcade Game Construction Kit (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.name: Arcade Game Construction Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Arcade Game Construction Kit lets you create your own arcade-style games on the Commodore 64, complete with joystick menus and sample templates. Six included games range from space shooters to samurai adventures, pirates, kangaroos, and alien worlds. Whether you're collecting orbs as Gerg, rescuing your princess in Musashi, or exploring islands in Isle Quest – each example shows what's possible with the toolkit. AGCK invites you to tinker, experiment, and design – perfect for creative minds with a passion for games.

meta.name: Arcade Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Arcade Pilot delivers brisk horizontal shooter action in which you are not simply flying forward all the time, but can also change direction, giving the game a bit more dynamism. That idea brings a touch of Uridium to mind and adds an interesting twist at first. However, the enjoyment is noticeably held back by the single-life setup and rather middling controls, making the whole experience feel harsher than it really needs to. In the end, it comes across as a fairly solid but very unforgiving action game that can easily become a real test of patience without any extra help.

meta.name: Arcade Trivia Quiz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Arcade Trivia Quiz is a trivia game for 1, 2 or 3 players.
There are four blocks of questions. Each block contains questions in six categories:
* Art and literature
* Science
* Music
* Movie and TV
* Sports
* History and geography
The icons of the available questions flash one after the other and players must press FIRE at the right time to select the icon of their choice. All questions are multiple choice, with four answers, one correct and three incorrect.
Both the selection and answering of the questions are timed and must be completed in eight seconds.
Scoring is cash-based. All players start at £1.00 and each player stakes 20p per try. If a player makes it to the top of the pyramid by successfully answering questions, they will trigger a “Cash Run” feature that can allow them to earn extra cash – up to £5.00.

meta.name: Arcademic Skillbuilder - Alien Addition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.44 KB

Alien Addition is an educational game that mixes maths problems with the gameplay of a shoot 'em up. The player controls a cannon left and right along the bottom of the screen and has to shoot down the aliens space ships that appear above him. There are five ships in a row and they slowly begin descending down the screen. Each ship has a maths problem written on it and to shoot it down the player has to enter the correct answer for the ship above him. The player is destroyed if any ship reaches the bottom. The game otherwise runs for a fixed time which can be customized by the player. Other customization options include skill level (1 to 9) and problem range (3, 6 or 9).

meta.name: Arcademic Skillbuilder - Alligator Mix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

The player controls a large alligator on the left of the screen, whose mouth can open and close. Math equations quickly approach from the right, and a possible answer appears on the alligator's belly. The goal is to eat the equations that fulfill the answer on the belly and not eat the incorrect equations. The player receives a score every 10 questions.

meta.name: Arcademic Skillbuilder - Demolition Division
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.29 KB

This arcade-style educational game pits you against a series of tanks that advance on your territory. Each tank has a division problem on its side. Use the right answers to arm your anti-tank guns and destroy the tanks before they can reach your bunkers. But be careful! Wrong answers will cause your shot to miss. And don't relax too soon, because as soon as you destroy one tank, another pulls up to replace it!

meta.name: Arcademic Skillbuilder - Dragon Mix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.04 KB

The Dragon is a large, mythological beast, having four separate, and of course therefore quite distinctive legs, and a monstrous body with thousands of tiny scales. At one end of the large, monstrous body, we find an almost equally monstrous head, with two flaming nostrils. In this game you'll find a variety of math problems and use you increasing math skills to defend your dragon and progress in the game. For instance solving division and multiplication problems will stop the incoming rocket barrage and allow you to advance. Keep improving and remember that the dragon scales are tipped in your favor!

meta.name: Arcademic Skillbuilder - Meteor Multiplication
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

The player controls a small space station which can spin in a circle and shoot in eight separate directions. Meteors with mathematical equations approach the player, and the player must shoot the correct equation to reset its trajectory. If the player shoots the wrong meteor it approaches faster. When a meteor strikes the player's space station, it's game over.

meta.name: Arcademic Skillbuilder - Minus Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Minus Mission is a math game that helps students with learning subtraction using a creeping slime theme. Green slime blobs with subtraction problems drip down from the top of the screen toward a laser cannon at the bottom.

meta.name: ArcadeSearch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.53 KB

ArcadeSearch is a word search game with a video game theme. On a grid of 374 letters, you must find and type in twenty words. Ten are hidden vertically and ten horizontally. You have ten minutes to complete the task, earning points for each word and bonus points for leftover time. Three variations are available: arcade video games, home console games, and famous video game characters.

meta.name: Arcadia 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.84 KB

Arcadia is a space shoot 'em up along the lines of Galaxians and Space Invaders. You have a ship at the bottom of the screen. Enemy ships come at you in waves scrolling across the screen from right to left. There are twelve levels. When the last level has been completed the game cycles to level one again and continues with no increase in difficulty. You get an extra life if you clear 4 waves. They keep on coming and the object is to get a high score.

meta.name: Arcana
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.29 KB

Arcana, el castillo de los misterios, cuida el libro de magia negra más poderoso jamás escrito, el Oscuro Clavicle. Los precintos del Oscuro Clavicle están sellados y no pueden abrirse hasta la noche de la Luna en Mutación, el equinocio de Otoño. Sólo en ese momento será revelado el encantamiento de su apertura. Arcana es un delicioso juego de arcade y aventuras con unos gráficos detallados en 3D y un scroll hotizontal preciso que caracteriza 30 lugares especiales.

meta.name: Archeologist Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.60 KB

In Archeologist Duel, you compete against an opponent in an exciting race through a labyrinth. Equipped with a hat and whip, your task is to collect gold and treasures while racing against both the clock and your rival. The player who reaches the exit first, after gathering the most valuable treasures, wins the duel. The game challenges quick reflexes and strategic thinking, as you must outsmart your opponent and retrieve the treasure faster than they can.

meta.name: Archer
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.26 KB

meta.name: Archetype
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.97 KB

meta.name: Archipelago
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Archipelago you are the lone survivor of the airship Hesperus, wrecked by a typhoon over the Pacific. Chained to a grid, you wash ashore on a remote island chain. Seeking shelter, you discover a cave that descends into a vast network of underwater labyrinths linking the islands together. Hidden within these depths are the legendary jewels of a vanished civilization, each holding mystical power. Only by collecting them all can you reach the next island. But beware—once you enter the labyrinth, there's no way back. Your only defense is your fragile energy laser, and your will to survive.

meta.name: Archon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.77 KB

Archon es un videojuego de estrategia por turnos. Se basa en el principio del ajedrez, con la adición de fases de combate. Cada pieza se coloca en el tablero según su rango de movimiento y forma un ejército que representa la luz o la sombra. Cuando una unidad intenta tomar a otra, ambas son transportadas a una arena de combate para determinar el ganador. Una unidad puede permanecer herida incluso después de ganar su duelo, lo que reduce sus posibilidades de victoria en una batalla futura.  La partida se gana cuando todas las unidades contrarias son destruidas o cuando un jugador tiene cinco puntos de poder.

meta.name: Archon II : Adept
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.70 KB

El sucesor de Archon, Archon II: Adepto presenta un tablero de juego más complejo y una jugabilidad mejorada.
Cada bando (Caos u Orden) juega como un Adepto, un poderoso mago que puede lanzar hechizos contra otros Adeptos para derrotar al otro bando. El jugador puede atacar con elementos o invocando demonios. Cada bando puede invocar 4 Elementos únicos a la vez o elegir entre 4 Demonios, comunes a ambos jugadores.
La jugabilidad es similar a la del juego Archon original, recuerda a un tablero de ajedrez, requiere estrategia, pero añade elementos arcade, especialmente cuando dos Adeptos se enfrentan. El tablero de juego también cambia de vez en cuando, lo que hace que la estrategia sea menos predecible.

meta.name: Archon III : Exciter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.22 KB

In Archon III: Exciter the battle between light and dark continues unofficially in this fan-made sequel to the classic Archon series. Never commercially released or endorsed by Electronic Arts, the game was freely shared among players. Combat plays out between slow-moving sprites, stripped of melee or projectile attacks. Instead, each fighter generates a ring of “fire” that drains the opponent's health on contact. With no single-player mode or AI, the game is purely a two-player experience — a minimalist reinterpretation of Archon's concept focused entirely on timing, positioning, and control.

meta.name: Arctic Shipwreck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.02 KB

Arctic Shipwreck puts you in an unusual rescue scenario where shipwreck survivors are stranded on an unstable chunk of arctic ice. Playing as a mammoth, you shift your weight across the iceberg to counter dangerous imbalances caused by wind and the survivors' movements. Every action affects stability, and a single mistake can have fatal consequences. The appeal lies in constantly managing tension and maintaining a fragile balance until rescue finally arrives.

meta.name: Arcticfox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En 2005, unos alienígenas han invadido la Antártida para desviar el suministro de oxígeno de la Tierra. Te envían a luchar contra ellos con un tanque altamente sofisticado, el Slye-Hicks MX-100, cuyo nombre en clave es Arcticfox.
Arcticfox es un juego futurista de simulación de tanques en 3D en el que tu objetivo es destruir la fortaleza principal de los alienígenas antes de que Arcticfox sea destruido.
Los objetivos enemigos vienen en todas las formas y tamaños: aviones, tanques, trineos de reconocimiento y otros objetivos importantes como torres de comunicación, convertidores de atmósfera, etc. Tu máquina de guerra está equipada con un cañón, misiles guiados, minas, así como un radar y pantallas de visión delantera y trasera para detectar el avance del enemigo.

meta.name: Ardok the Barbarian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.01 KB

Ardok the Barbarian places you in the U.S. version of Asterix and the Cauldron, with the familiar cast replaced by barbarians but the core story unchanged. You explore about fifty screens covering your village, a Roman camp, and the forests between them. The druid's cauldron has been shattered, and you must recover its pieces while managing hunger by consuming your stock of boar meat. Encounters with Romans or boars trigger hand-to-hand duels, and defeating a boar grants fresh supplies. Careful resource use and quick fighting are key to reassembling the cauldron.

meta.name: Ardy the Aardvark
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ardy the Aardvark turns the long tongue of an aardvark into an unusual maze tool. You guide it through underground passages, collect food, and have to watch carefully which enemies are only dangerous at the tip and which are deadly on any contact. This creates a constant balance between pushing forward and pulling back cautiously. That mix of collecting, dodging, and distinctive control gives the game its special appeal.

meta.name: Arena
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.16 KB

Arena places you in a contest of mighty sorcerers, summoned by the High Mage into the arena to determine his successor. You take the role of one of these wizards and must eliminate all rivals to emerge as the ultimate victor.

meta.name: Arena
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.12 KB

Arena takes you to a distant future on a planet at the edge of the universe, where gladiatorial battles have become a brutal sport. Two fighters face each other in the arena, controlled only by their joysticks. Each begins with a laser gun, but whoever strikes the sphere that occasionally appears on the screen gains a more powerful weapon. The goal is to keep hitting the opponent until he is defeated – while a mechanical referee oversees the match and you must avoid taking too many hits yourself.

meta.name: Arena 3000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fight for your life (and highscore) against endless waves of killer robots cornering you in the futuristic Galactic Arena of the year 3000. When you clear the level, the next wave gets faster and tougher, luckily you get 3 lives and an extra one every 20 000 points. This top-down shooter offers optional dual joystick control.

meta.name: Arex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.35 KB

Entra y neutraliza al menos el 90% del territorio enemigo mientras evitas 3 tipos distintos de naves alienígenas. Una invasión exitosa gana el avance a niveles de juego posteriores y más difíciles. Arex presenta gráficos fenomenales, alta retención de puntaje y múltiples niveles de habilidad.

meta.name: The Argon Factor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are Captain Cord, Commander of Space Fleet, and you have searched the universe to clear your name of an incident that was not your fault.
Three years later, you find yourself in the Velusian Belt with your trusty robot named LAP, passing a small planet called Argon. You land on the planet and begin searching for the missing fleet and evidence to clear your name.
The Argon Factor is a graphical text adventure with on-screen text describing each location you are in and the occasional image showing what you see. You enter commands using the keyboard to interact with your surroundings, and the game plays in real time as you search the planet. The game is divided into two parts. In the first part you search the planet for evidence of your innocence, while in the second part you search for your girlfriend by solving various puzzles.

meta.name: The Argos Expedition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Argos Expedition sends you on a journey far beyond familiar limits and turns the very beginning of the mission into a major part of the adventure. At its heart is the search for relics from an ancient and mysterious culture, with their recovery and restoration promising a tremendous challenge. It quickly creates a sense of scale and uncertainty, because as part of a chosen crew you are not simply taking off, but preparing for a mission whose scope is almost impossible to grasp.

meta.name: The Argos Expedition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Argos Expedition sends you on a journey far beyond familiar limits and turns the very beginning of the mission into a major part of the adventure. At its heart is the search for relics from an ancient and mysterious culture, with their recovery and restoration promising a tremendous challenge. It quickly creates a sense of scale and uncertainty, because as part of a chosen crew you are not simply taking off, but preparing for a mission whose scope is almost impossible to grasp.

meta.name: Ark Pandora
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Ark Pandora, you play a pirate imprisoned for life on a remote island, now offered freedom if you defeat an evil high priest and his cult. Find a sacred scroll and take down as many enemies as possible. The game mixes side-scrolling action with adventure mechanics: collect, use, and manage items through icons at the bottom of the screen. The top half shows your journey, while red and green indicators warn of danger. Each hit lowers your energy – once it's gone, the game ends.

meta.name: Arkanoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 74.25 KB

El título hace referencia a una "nave nodriza" condenada de la que escapa el barco del jugador, el Vaus. Arkanoid revivió el concepto de los juegos de romper ladrillos, generando numerosos clones y juegos similares para ordenadores personales incluso más de una década después.

meta.name: Arkanoid : Revenge of Doh
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Revenge of Doh es una secuela directa del éxito arcade original Arkanoid. Junto con un motor gráfico mejorado, mejor sonido y música, mejor soporte de hardware y más niveles, Revenge of Doh también cuenta con un editor incorporado y te permite crear tus propios conjuntos de niveles.
Revenge of Doh continúa la trama de Arkanoid de la siguiente manera, tomada directamente (incluidos los errores tipográficos) del juego:
Pasó un largo período de tiempo y la fuerza de control de la dimensión Doh volvió a la vida. Ocupando la enorme nave estelar Xorg, ha entrado en nuestro universo desde una dimensión diferente. Mixtec, nave espacial tipo Arkanoid, ha lanzado la nave Vaus II para realizar un ataque preventivo a Xorg.

meta.name: Arkanoid II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Arkanoid II by Gollum, you once again control the Vaus capsule, using an energy ball to smash blocks. Some blocks hide power-ups that, when caught, widen your bat, enable lasers, or slow down the ball. You start with five lives, and each lost ball brings you closer to game over. This unofficial sequel was released before the official follow-up and stands out with clever design and the same addictive gameplay.

meta.name: Arkanoid III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.98 KB

ARKANOID III is an updated version of the original arcade blockbuster with a new intro and lots of fresh fun. Players must destroy colored blocks by guiding an Energy Ball around the screen using a spaceship called a VAUS. The game features a host of new screens and it's clear you're in for hours and hours of blockbusting fun!

meta.name: Arkanoid IV
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.00 KB

More levels, more twists, more Arkanoid Fun! The era and time of this story is unknown. After the mothership Arkanoid was destroyed a spacecraft Vaus scrambled away from it, but only to be trapped in space by someone!

meta.name: Arkanoid V
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.46 KB

Arkanoid V delivers one final large set of levels for fans of the classic block breaker. Use the Vaus paddle to keep the ball in play, clear all the blocks, and collect helpful power-ups while dodging powerdowns. The levels are cleverly designed and offer varied challenges – maybe they'll even inspire you to create your own Arkanoid VI using a level editor.

meta.name: Arktyczne Polowanie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.76 KB

Arktyczne Polowanie (Arctic Hunt) puts you in charge of Emil, a determined little penguin who must hop across drifting ice floes to bring fish home to his family. You start in the bottom left, your igloo waits in the top right – and between them lies a shifting maze of floes that sink, break or shove you forward with oily slicks. Three grumpy enemies hunt you, and only well-placed bombs can keep them away. Along the way you collect helpful items while avoiding the cursed joystick that reverses your controls. A slippery challenge where every jump matters.

meta.name: Armageddon (Ocean)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.33 KB

Armageddon is based on the arcade game Missile Command where you are the commander of a Missile Battery and you have to protect six cities in this single screen shooter. Nuclear tracers fall from the top of the screen leaving behind a trail and as you move a cross-hair around the screen, you must fire a limited supply of missiles and allow them to explode in front of each trail to destroy them. If a nuclear tracer hits a city then it is destroyed and if all cities are destroyed then it is game over. A plane occasionally flies over the screen from left to right and you get bonus points for destroying it. Once a wave is over then bonus points are awarded for any cities and missiles left before being re-armed and you then protect the remaining cities from another attack. On the C64, you can choose the wind speed (0-9) before the game starts, with zero being no wind.

meta.name: Armageddon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.48 KB

Armageddon is an strategy game for two to four players inspired by the board game Risk where each player attempts to win World domination. Each player is given a colour before a map of the world is filled with a each players armies in random territories filling the whole map. Each player can add three more armies to strengthen any territory they choose before the first player chosen by random has their go. The player can have the choice of attacking a territory or passing on their go, giving the next player his options.
If the player chooses Attack then they select one of their territories before selecting a territory that is touching or touched by a white line. An animated scene is shown for a few seconds of a battlefield before the map is revealed with the losing territory losing an army and the winning territory gaining an army. If all armies are lost then all but one of the winning players army is moved into the empty territory with an option to deploy the players armies given. The winner is the player with at least one army in all the territories.

meta.name: Armalyte
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Adéntrate en las zonas prohibidas, más allá de la pesadilla de Delta… con Armalyte. Dos luchadores por la libertad, perdidos en ocho sectores de una galaxia letal. Sin refuerzos, sin escapatoria: solo su determinación, sus reflejos y su pulso firme en los mandos los separan del olvido. Cada disparo cuenta. Cada esquiva, una promesa de supervivencia. Aquí no hay segundas oportunidades… solo el rugido de los motores, el destello de los láseres y el silencio del vacío esperando tragarte. ¿Estás listo para desafiar lo imposible?

meta.name: Armalyte : Competition Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Armalyte: Competition Edition throws you into hostile delta space to reclaim a research post surrounded by the H'siffian Khanate. Piloting your fighter through tight enemy zones, you collect crystal-like munitions pods that grant five seconds of invulnerability. Shooting these pods triggers different weapon upgrades – extra forward shots, rear fire, vertical cannons, or converging beams. Hold down FIRE to unleash your devastating super weapon and clear the screen. A fierce competition shooter demanding perfect timing, sharp reflexes, and unrelenting firepower.
meta.developer: D. Phillips, J. Kemp & J. Harries

meta.name: Armourdillo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.88 KB

Armourdillo tells the story of the peaceful planet Mobanti, suddenly invaded by a warlike species from the Milky Way – with no concept of warfare, the Mobantians send their most skilled scouts to infiltrate enemy strongholds and uncover the secrets of battle, only to learn that the invaders once destroyed their own world with weapons too powerful to control, and now act as the last survivors of their planet – Earth.

meta.name: Army Days
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.65 KB

Army Days puts you through three shooting practice days. On day one, you shoot as many targets as possible with minimal misses. Day two introduces darts and flying birds to dodge. On day three, you aim at moving targets on an open field. A simple but challenging single-screen shooter that tests your precision and reflexes.

meta.name: Army Moves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

DERDHAL es un miembro del C.O.E., Cuerpo de Operaciones Especiales. Ha sido entrenado durante largos años para convertirse en un especialista, y ahora es el primero de su promoción. Puede atravesar las líneas enemigas por tierra, mar o aire; domina todas las técnicas de la guerra en la selva; conoce todas las armas y es un experto en explosivos. ARMY MOVES, tres sistemas de combate distintos: JEEP equipado con misiles tierra-aire. HELICOPTERO COBRA para la lucha en la jungla. SOLDADO COE, miembro de un cuerpo de élite, entrenado en todas las técnicas conocidas para la guerra.

meta.name: Arne Weise
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.36 KB

meta.name: Arnie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Arnie, te lanzan en helicóptero a una base enemiga y te abres paso a través de caminos predeterminados, rodeados de muros, puentes y alambre de púas. Como un ejército de un solo hombre, disparas a soldados enemigos armados con ametralladoras o lanzacohetes, evitando el contacto y el fuego o perderás una de tus tres vidas. Ocasionalmente, aparece un soldado rojo; si lo eliminas, suelta un arma más potente con munición limitada, como un M60, un RPG7 o un lanzallamas. También aparecen vehículos como tanques y helicópteros, que debes destruir o eludir.

meta.name: Arnie 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.71 KB

En Arnie II, te abres paso a tiros por cuatro zonas hostiles como un guerrero solitario y musculoso: una planta química, un aeródromo, un puerto repleto de buques de guerra y un campo de prisioneros de guerra en la jungla. Armado con una ametralladora y granadas limitadas, luchas contra enemigos estacionarios, nidos de ametralladoras y tanques. Los búnkeres generan un sinfín de enemigos, y solo tus reflejos rápidos, tus armas y tus botiquines de primeros auxilios te mantendrán con vida.

meta.name: Arno Dash 21
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This game is a Bouder dash clone, but developed by Arno. Good thing the guy's name wasn't Ariel.

meta.name: Arrivo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.10 KB

Things are falling from the ceiling, avoid getting hit, but once they land it appears they turn into goodies which you can grab. The next level throws in another level of difficulty, jump over the rolling balls while continuing to dodge. Each level gets a bit harder, but keep on jumping and dodging, picking up the goodies and moving forward. Things fall and zip by faster and faster. How long can this go on?

meta.name: Arrow Busters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.79 KB

Did you know that a Dance Dance Revolution clone was released for the C64? Well, here it is: Use the joystick to control the direction of the arrows as they reach the top of the screen. If you succeed, they change color and you score points. The game ends when the timer drops from 300 to 0.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #03 : Arrow of Death - Part I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.82 KB

Arrow of Death: Part I continues your journey in a land where a once-saved artifact now spreads corruption, bringing illness and failing crops. To stop the threat, you search for the pieces of a powerful arrow, explore many locations, and gather items needed to solve puzzles. Progress comes from experimentation, combining objects, and interpreting sparse clues, making patience and observation essential. The focus is firmly on exploration rather than combat – a classic adventure that rewards imagination, logic, and methodical play.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #04 : Arrow of Death - Part II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.97 KB

Arrow of Death Part II continues your quest after gathering the pieces of the powerful arrow, but the knowledge to assemble it is missing. You travel through unfamiliar lands filled with strange plant life, dangers, and mysterious locations to rescue the kidnapped craftsman who holds the key. Exploration, item collection, and puzzle solving remain central, with sparse clues encouraging careful observation. The sequel deepens the adventure experience – a classic journey that rewards patience, logic, and thoughtful experimentation.

meta.name: Arscet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Game in german language!
ARSCET is the computer version of the well-known and popular game “Kniffel”. Your C64 takes care of all the annoying administrative tasks. Rolling the dice, high score list and keeping score over several rounds, so that up to half a dozen players can devote themselves entirely to the trick. The game is controlled via a joystick in port number 2. As many throws are made per game as there are lines on the game board. The player's turn is indicated by an arrow pointing to their column on the board (just like the winner at the end of the game!). You have three attempts per throw. Use the joystick to select the dice you want to keep (red color) and confirm your entry by selecting the “end symbol” (ed). Try to fill in all fields with the highest possible score. After each roll, you can choose a free space, except for those designated for settlement.

meta.name: Artax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Artax was included as a promotional gift in the April 1989 issue of Magic Disk 64 (a German C64 magazine).
A 3 level horizontal shooter where pattern memorization is key. When you shoot down a wave of enemies, your ship will automatically be energized. The first two levels have some kind of boss, while the last level ends abruptly.

meta.name: Artillery '90
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.11 KB

Artillery '90 puts you in a mountain duel where each player takes turns firing an artillery cannon to destroy the other. You have limited time to adjust barrel angle and powder strength, factoring in wind and terrain. Every shot demands precision and planning – only those who combine aim and strategy will prevail.

meta.name: Artillery Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.31 KB

Two guns face each other. Manage the range of your shot according to the dose of powder in the barrel and the strength of the wind in order to destroy the opponent.

meta.name: Artris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This game is similar to Tetris. You must therefore stack the geometric shapes that fall onto the screen to form horizontal lines. When a line is formed, it is deleted. If the shapes touch the top of the screen while stacking, the game is lost.

meta.name: Artura
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.64 KB

Artura es un juego de acción de desplazamiento lateral. El juego se inspira en parte en la mitología del Rey Arturo, ya que juegas como Artura, hijo de los Pendragons. Tu objetivo es salvar a Nimue, la aprendiz de Merdyn, de tu malvada hermanastra Morgause.
Tendrás que luchar contra muchas criaturas horribles como arañas y murciélagos con tu hacha y evitar trampas mortales mientras intentas llegar al castillo de Morgause. También tendrás que buscar 6 runas, que contienen hechizos, para liberar a Nimue. Artura contiene 4 niveles laberínticos y extremadamente complicados.

meta.name: Ashby Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.69 KB

In this text adventure written originally for the Commodore Plus 4 and converted for the C64 you must use all your cunning to search the manor, avoid the homicidal house cat and find the family secret at long last.

meta.name: Ashido
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.54 KB

Ashido is a puzzle game in which the player has to place tiles with symbols in an appropriate manner on the game board. The laying of stones is carried out according to the appropriate rules. The game offers 70 levels, all with individual passwords.

meta.name: Ask - The Real You
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

meta.name: Assault Course
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.03 KB

As a new recruit in the world liberation army, before you get shot, you must prove yourself by completing the obstacle course as quickly as possible. Climb over a wall, grab a vine, walk along a rope, crawl under barbed wire and most importantly, climb over that FUCKING IMPASSABLE TRUNK !!!!

meta.name: Assault Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The planet Targon is a nuisance to the Galactic police but it's always just been on the planet. News is coming from the planet though, that they are developing an incredibly powerful Assault Machine. It is to be used to conquer other planets. The police need to do something now.

meta.name: Assault on the Shevardino Redoubt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.52 KB

In Assault on the Shevardino Redoubt you will experience the Battle of the Shevardino Redoubt, which took place the day before the great Battle of Borodino. You have the choice to command either the French or Russian troops and decide on attack and defense to influence the course of the battle. Careful planning of your tactics is crucial, as every decision can affect the outcome of the battle and the strategic situation for the main battle to come.

meta.name: Assembloids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Assembloids challenges you to assemble faces from four different sets under intense time pressure. Each corner provides random face parts that you must quickly assign to the correct spot. The better the match, the higher your score. But the longer you play, the faster the pace becomes. Sharp reflexes and quick judgment are essential to climb the high-score ranks.

meta.name: Assembloids Basic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Assembloids BASIC has you assembling faces from four random parts appearing at the corners of the screen, all under growing time pressure. The better the fit, the higher your score – but the clock keeps getting faster. Based on the original 2012 release, this BASIC version was dropped in 2014, offering a charming and challenging reaction-based puzzle in simplified form.

meta.name: Assembly Line
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.60 KB

If your crew at the Mercedes plant keeps on schedule you win a vacation in Cairo. So fare this year you're in first place. Can you keep it up? It's not easy, but you're the best! Dash to the parts bin, snatch a part and run back to the assembly line. Place the part in the wheel on the conveyor belt, then do it again. Only 5 tiers can pass by untouched or you lose... the game, and a fantasy journey to Egypt.

meta.name: Astatin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Welcome to Astatin, the game of the nobility of Radon, brought to earth for you by Alive Designs. A new challenge If you thought it wasn't possible to further ruin your nerves, then you should get this game. For 100 levels you can solve the tasks given to you with drops of sweat on your forehead. Maybe you'll be one of the lucky ones who survive this game unscathed. The game is to match the images on the left panel with those on the right. However, the images change according to the changes/images around them, so the image you select may have an impact on the images around them. Find the pattern and pass the level.

meta.name: Asteroids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.70 KB

Asteroids es un popular videojuego arcade basado en vectores lanzado en 1979 por Atari. El objetivo del juego es disparar y destruir asteroides evitando chocar contra los fragmentos de estos. Fue uno de los juegos más populares de la Época Dorada de los videojuegos arcade.
Asteroids fue inspirado por el juego Spacewar!, el primer videojuego de computadora. En el año 1977, Cinematronics lanzó Space Wars, un juego similar, también basado en Spacewar!. Asteroids es esencialmente una versión de un jugador de Space Wars, caracterizado por la nave y los asteroides como enemigo principal. 
Asteroids fue un éxito en Estados Unidos convirtiéndose en el mejor videojuego vendido de todos los tiempos.

meta.name: Asteroids Emulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.45 KB

"Asteroids Emulator" brings the 1979 arcade classic "Asteroids" faithfully to the Commodore 64. Unlike a typical port, this program emulates the actual arcade machine's code directly on the C64 – the original CPU is interpreted by the 6510 processor, while video and sound are simulated by the emulator. The result is a gameplay experience that closely mirrors the original machine, complete with its distinctive controls and minimalist vector graphics. A technical achievement that delivers pure retro charm.

meta.name: Asteroids 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Asteroid 64 is an adaptation of the arcade classic of the same name.
Play the role of a spaceship pilot trapped in a gigantic asteroid cloud and pulverize incoming asteroids with the ship's photon cannon. In addition to the asteroids, the player also encounters an alien robot saucer that randomly shoots across the screen. The player using the controller can turn the ship in any direction (left or right) or move the ship forward. The shots are fired according to the direction of the ship. The player has three reserved ships available to replace a destroyed spaceship. The spaceship is destroyed when an asteroid collides with the spaceship or is shot by an alien robot saucer. Additionally, the player can use hyperspace warp to avoid collisions.

p: Astonishing Adventures of Mr. Weems and the She Vampires, The (Europe).T64
n: Astonishing Adventures of Mr. Weems and the She Vampires, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Astonishing Adventures of Mr. Weems and the She Vampires
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.82 KB

The Astonishing Adventures of Mr. Weems and the She Vampires is a fast-paced top-down maze game where you enter a vampire-infested mansion as Mr. Weems. Across six floors, you'll face teleporters, locked doors and endless waves of enemies. Monsters leap from coffins, and touching them drains your blood, which you must refill with flasks. Armed with a garlic gun and protective capsules, you collect key items like a mirror or crucifix to defeat the She Vampires once and for all – then fight your way out to freedom.

meta.name: Astral Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Astral Attack, you must protect six energy generators at the bottom of the screen from waves of attacking XENO aliens. When they hit energy lines, they transform into bombs and descend rapidly. You can only shoot them once they become bombs. Missing a shot may cost you a generator. When all generators are destroyed, the game ends. You control the crosshair with a joystick or, in the original version, with the Stack Light Rifle.

meta.name: Astral Fighters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Astral Fighters is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up where the player must shoot everything that comes their way. If it gets too difficult, a bomb can be used to clear the screen.

meta.name: Astral Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.22 KB

“Astral Zone” is a first-person shooter where you are the last line of defense against the invading Vengrian Empire. Controlling two neutronium cannons, you move a crosshair across the screen – left, right, up, and down – to blast aliens as they emerge from the distance. Destroy enemies to score points, but take a hit and you suffer 20% damage. Score over 5000 points, and damage is reduced by 20%. When your damage reaches 100%, the game ends. In two-player mode, players take turns whenever one takes damage – a fight for survival deep in space.

meta.name: Astro Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.28 KB

Astro Chase turns the rescue of Earth into a fast chase through space, where eight dangerous mines must be destroyed before they reach the planet. As you fly around Earth, enemy saucers pursue you and constantly force you into evasive moves and precise laser shots. Shield depots and energy generators help you survive longer, but each new round noticeably increases the pace. That mix of time pressure, pursuit, and planetary danger gives the game its gripping appeal.

meta.name: Astro Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.16 KB

In Astro Pilot you control a spacecraft and attempt to land safely on the surface of a planet. You must carefully manage thrust, speed and altitude to achieve a smooth landing. Too much velocity or incorrect use of the engines can cause the ship to crash. At the same time you must keep an eye on your fuel and plan your maneuvers accordingly. The game plays like a classic landing simulator where precise timing and careful control are essential.

meta.name: Astro Worm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.98 KB

Astro Worm focuses on a stripped-down gameplay concept where you guide a constantly growing worm around a confined playfield. The goal is to collect items while avoiding collisions with your own body or the boundaries, as speed and control become more demanding over time. The appeal lies in its simplicity and rising difficulty – concentration and precise movement determine how far you can progress.

meta.name: Astro-crest!
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.90 KB

meta.name: Astro-Grover
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Astro-Grover is an educational game for one player based on the Sesame Street franchise. It provides a playful setting in which children practice counting, adding, and subtracting. The game helps children work with numbers in five different ways (How Many Zips?, Beam That Number, Adding Countdown, Take it Away Zips!, Sum Up Sum Down) - assisted by Grover and the Zips from the planet Zap.

meta.name: Astroblaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Astroblast, pilotas una pequeña nave espacial y debes derribar los meteoritos entrantes antes de que te destruyan. Las rocas se mueven de manera impredecible por la pantalla, y cada impacto las rompe en pedazos más pequeños que representan una amenaza aún mayor. Tu objetivo es sobrevivir el mayor tiempo posible mientras acumulas la puntuación más alta.

meta.name: Astroblitz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.96 KB

In Astroblitz, you pilot a high-speed rocket plane tasked with clearing a hostile planet. You destroy flying saucers, radar dishes, spinners, and seekers while dodging volcano blasts and enemy fire. A radar at the top of the screen helps you locate threats and strike before they get too close. Survive each wave to progress, but collisions and shrapnel are deadly. Only sharp aim and quick reflexes will keep you alive.

meta.name: Astrobot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.65 KB

In Astrobot, you control a small robot who jumps from platform to platform to collect all the coins. Along the way, you must avoid alien enemies and dangerous laser dividers blocking your path. Once you've collected all the coins on the screen, you advance to the next level, where new obstacles and tougher challenges await. Skill and precise timing are key to surviving and progressing further.

meta.name: Astrobot II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.52 KB

In Astrobot II, you guide your character across platforms to collect all the hearts scattered around the screen. You must avoid the alien at all costs, as even the slightest touch forces you to start over. Once all the hearts are collected, you advance to the next level, where new challenges await. With each stage, the tension rises as it becomes harder to dodge the alien while grabbing every heart.

meta.name: Asylum
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Asylum traps you inside a nightmarish institution whose endless floors and corridors offer both hope and despair. As you wander through eerie passageways, you encounter fellow inmates and guards whose behavior is unpredictable, turning every choice into a risk. Help may prove useful or draw you deeper into chaos, and it is never clear whether caution or confrontation is the wiser path. Escaping becomes a tense mental challenge where careful wording, observation and judgment determine whether you advance or fail.

meta.name: ATA : The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

ATA: All Tetris Arcades is a well-crafted Tetris clone for the C64 with smooth gameplay, clean visuals and solid sound. Just like the original, your goal is to stack falling blocks to complete and clear lines. Scores and rankings are displayed as you chase the highscore. Despite the classic mechanics, ATA delivers a fresh look and polished feel.

meta.name: ATA : The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

ATA: All Tetris Arcades is a well-crafted Tetris clone for the C64 with smooth gameplay, clean visuals and solid sound. Just like the original, your goal is to stack falling blocks to complete and clear lines. Scores and rankings are displayed as you chase the highscore. Despite the classic mechanics, ATA delivers a fresh look and polished feel.

meta.name: Atalan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are part of a crew on a large ship in the Pacific Ocean and during the voyage an island was discovered, which the captain named Atalan. As you sail away, a huge storm hits the ship and destroys it, but luckily you have tied yourself to the mast. You are now shipwrecked on the island and must attempt to leave the island, but not before finding 18 treasures, including a ruby, a sword and a diamond. Atalan is a text adventure that displays text on the screen describing your location. You enter commands using the keyboard to interact with your environment.

meta.name: ATF : Advanced Tactical Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

ATF: Advanced Tactical Fighter puts you in control of a modern Lockheed combat jet flying over a war-torn island caught in conflict between two unknown forces. Your mission is to destroy strategic targets in any order, but while the action is fast-paced, you must manage speed, fuel, and ammo carefully. Reach a friendly base in time, and you can refuel and repair via an automatic landing sequence. Whether you engage enemy fighters head-on or sneak past in low-altitude flight is your choice – but one wrong move, and it's a one-way ticket to the ground.

meta.name: ATG : All Terrain Gardener
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.26 KB

ATG - All Terrain Gardener is about saving a flower garden from an ever-increasing flood of water by digging up the flowers and bringing them to safety. With cool layered sprites and graphics and a good rendition of “Flight Of The Bumblebee” by Tonal Tea, the game had the makings of a winner.

meta.name: Athena
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 100.98 KB

En este juego de plataformas, encarnas a Atenea, la diosa de la sabiduría, que emprende una aventura fuera del aburrido castillo donde vive. Se topa con muchos enemigos a los que combate con diversas armas, como una bala de cañón, un arco y una espada muy poderosa, pero también puede transformarse en sirena o montar en alas para explorar el mar o los cielos.

meta.name: Atlantis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.05 KB

"Atlantis" brings the classic to your Commodore 64, where you must defend the sunken city against advancing enemies. Wave after wave of Gorgon ships attack, and it's up to you to protect the city from destruction.

meta.name: Atlantis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.09 KB

"Atlantis" is a shooter where you must defend your underwater city from enemy bombers. If the bombers fly low enough over their targets, they can cause destruction, so you must take them out in time to protect your city.

meta.name: Atlantis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Atlantis is a game developed for the Commodore 64 as a Christmas gift for the community. It is a reinterpretation of the original Atlantis game for the Atari 2600. The sunken city of Atlantis is under attack by waves of hostile Gorgon ships equipped with weapons to destroy parts of the city. You are responsible for the defense posts on the edge of the city and must fend off the attackers. The Gorgon ships fly in varying patterns and altitudes, gradually descending lower. If they reach too low an altitude, they can destroy buildings in Atlantis. As the game progresses, the enemies become faster. The game ends when all the city's buildings are destroyed.

meta.name: Atlantis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Atlantis" is a shooter where you must protect the legendary city of Atlantis from attacks by forces from the world above the sea. Defend the city and prevent its destruction.

meta.name: Atlantis Lode Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Atlantis Lode Runner" is a ROM hack by the scene group Atlantis that offers additional "Lode Runner" levels for the Commodore 64. Players can look forward to new challenges in this classic game.

meta.name: Atock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Atock is a Qix-style game presented with an unusual pseudo-3D perspective. You guide your marker along the lines, drawing out areas to claim them while avoiding enemies that patrol the field and threaten to cut you off. The goal is to steadily secure larger sections of the playfield without getting caught. The mix of classic arcade mechanics and the spatial visual design gives a fresh twist to the familiar formula.

meta.name: Atom Ant
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.57 KB

The Mayor has received a ransom note threatening to blow up some of the city's buildings unless one million pounds is paid. Once again it's time for our favourite super-hero, Atom Ant, to leap into action and save the city from destruction.

meta.name: Atom Box
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.87 KB

meta.name: Atom U-Boat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Atom U-Boat places you in command of a modern submarine, armed with torpedoes and navigating through hostile waters. Using map, radar, and sonar, you track enemy movements and plan your route while constantly adjusting depth, speed, and position. The objective is to locate and sink enemy ships before they detect and attack you. Strategy, keen observation, and precise decisions are crucial for survival.

meta.name: Atomic Handball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.81 KB

“Atomic Handball” is set in the year 2040, where traditional sports have been replaced by the thrilling Atomic Handball. Instead of a regular ball, players use a floating moon ball that can only be deflected with an electron paddle. Points are scored by destroying subatomic particles. The gameplay is reminiscent of a classic Breakout-style game, where all blocks on the screen must be removed to complete the level.

meta.name: Atomic Robo-Kid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Definitivamente algo no está bien en Terra-12. Sin vacilar, las fuerzas cósmicas hostiles han bombardeado? ¡la colonia!. El planeta se ha convertido en un patio de recreo para la crueldad, formas de vida mutantes y ¡gobernantes aliens que no tienen piedad!. Mientras, los humanos supervivientes, los afortunados que encontraron refugio, esperan silenciosamente en sus escondites con la única esperanza de activar a ¡Atomic Robo-Kid! Armado con lo último en armamento nuclear y una mente pre programada, Kid se propone aniquilar a los chicos malos. ¿Estás listo para destruir mutantes y salvar el planeta?.

meta.name: Atomino
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Atomino you have to arrange atoms with each one to four free connections in a way so that stable molecules are created. The atoms fall with rising speed one after the other into a shaft, that offers space for 6 atoms, whereby the current atoms is always lowest. From there the atoms need to be placed on the game area. You can place altogether 56 atoms (7x8) there. If atoms with free connections lie next to each other they connect and as soon as a molecule without any free connections has been created, it is automatically removed from the game area. If the shaft for the atoms is more than full, the game is over.

meta.name: Atomix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Atomix" is a puzzle game where the player must reconstruct a specific molecular structure in each level. The atoms are displayed from a top-down perspective, with a small preview of the target molecule shown at the bottom left. Atoms can only be moved horizontally or vertically and will not stop until they hit a wall or another atom. This requires clever use of obstacles to achieve the correct arrangement. The game consists of 30 levels, each with a time limit.

meta.name: Attack of the Atlanteans
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.86 KB

Unidentified submarines suddenly attack your peacetime practice maneuvers. You must search for them in the depths below and destroy or be destroyed. The subs are quick and evade your missiles 'til you discover their strategy and dispel their forces. Discover the treasures that they fight to conceal.

meta.name: Attack Of The Megagalactic Cows
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.18 KB

Attack of the Megagalactic Cows is a humorous, quirky shooter where the player must navigate their spaceship through various mazes while facing strange and unpleasant enemies. The game offers an entertaining mix of action and absurd humor.

meta.name: Attack of the Mutant Aliens
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.90 KB

“Attack of the Mutant Aliens” is a side-scrolling shooter where the player pilots a spaceship and battles against hostile alien invaders. With precise shooting, the mutated aliens must be eliminated while navigating through the treacherous space environment. The game demands quick reflexes and skillful maneuvering to dodge enemy fire and protect the player's fleet. Enemies appear in various formations and colors, making each wave a fresh challenge.

meta.desc:

The Attack of the Phantom Karate Devils is a fighting game where the player has to defeat an army of shadow-like creatures who have murdered the player's master. The game is played from a side view and the joystick is used to control the hero. Different kicks and punches (high or low) can be used with points being earned for each hit. There are also thrown knifes and stars that have to be avoided or blocked. Upon reaching certain scores doors are opened that takes the player to new levels. Strength points are lost when getting struck but also when attacking. If the strength reaches zero the player dies but it is recharged when moving through a door.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The atomic core is going critical because of an alien sonic vibrator transmitter. Save Windscale! Kill the aliens! find the transmitter and destroy it before the devastating nuclear explosion rips out the heart of the countryside. The game is not just a shooter, but it's a combination of a shooter and a text adventure.

meta.name: Attacker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your Mission: Destroy Gestapo headquarters. Using your unlimited supply of 500KB bombs, blow the adjacent dam and flood the building. Intelligence reports show the dam is guarded by a machine gun bunker and a tank patrols the gorge at the bottom of the dam. Good luck and God speed, you'll need both.

Intelligence reports show the dam is guarded by a machine gun bunker and a tank patrols the gorge at the bottom of the dam. Good luck and God speed, you'll need both.

meta.name: Atv Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Visto de perfil y con opción de dos jugadores en pantalla partida, este juego recrea —con adrenalina y realismo arcade— los entonces novedosos vehículos todoterreno (ATV). Debes completar una serie de circuitos en 30 segundos: primero corres hacia tu ATV, y si te caes (algo habitual), ¡hay que volver a montar manualmente… perdiendo segundos vitales! Dominar wheelies y saltos es clave: un salto corto te deja corto; uno excesivo, volcado. Cada obstáculo —rampas, hoyos, curvas cerradas— exige la velocidad justa. No hay teoría: solo práctica, errores y esa satisfacción cuando, por fin, cruzas la meta con medio segundo de sobra… y una sonrisa de oreja a oreja.

meta.name: Auf Wiedersehen Monty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 76.28 KB

Auf Wiedersehen Monty sends you across Europe with Monty as you collect money to finally buy your own Greek island and retire in peace. You move screen by screen through varied locations that playfully reference real-world landmarks and demand careful timing and awareness. Hazards, obstacles, and collectibles force you to explore each area methodically and plan your routes. The appeal lies in the blend of exploration, precise control, and the clear goal of turning Monty's dream into reality step by step.

meta.name: Auf Wiedersehen Pet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.24 KB

Auf Wiedersehen Pet draws on the well-known television series and follows Oz through a turbulent day filled with work, a trip to the pub, and a difficult journey home at night. Rather than telling one continuous story, the game is built around three distinct sections, each with its own appeal – from bricklaying on the construction site to collecting beer glasses and carefully making your way through the darkness. Humor, chaos, and small mean surprises constantly shift back and forth, which fits the rough personality of the source material very well. That varied mix is exactly what gives the game its distinctive and slightly offbeat charm.

meta.name: Augie Doggie and Doggie Daddy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.56 KB

Augie Doggie and Doggie Daddy is a game based on the Hanna-Barbera characters father and son. In this game, you take on the role of Augie Doggy and try to rid your house of pests while Doggie Daddy takes a nap. The game is divided into four scrolling levels: “The Basement”, “Downstairs”, “Upstairs” and “The Attic”. Each level has its own pest: mice, bees and beetles. Ten of them must be removed with a net before the clock counts down to zero.
There are many obstacles and other creatures such as bats, balls or an animal in a paper airplane that drops bombs and these must be avoided because if you are touched you will lose one life out of five. There are also various items you can collect for bonus points, as well as pieces of cheese and collecting a whole wheel of cheese will give you more points.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.39 KB

Auriga turns the entrance test for a space-fighter squadron into a tough trial by fire against wave after wave of aliens. As an inexperienced pilot, you guide your ship through repeated attacks, dodge bombs, and shoot enemy formations out of the sky. After each cleared section, a risky docking sequence awaits, with falling meteorites creating the next danger. That mix of classic screen-based action, pressure to prove yourself, and short skill-based sequences gives the game its driving appeal.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.71 KB

Australian Rules Football puts you right into the action of a fast and physical contest where two teams battle for victory over several short periods. You aim to gain possession through well-timed tackles, build attacks and score as many points as possible, with different types of scores carrying different values. At the same time, you must avoid dropping the ball and losing possession, while a commentator follows the match and provides continuous updates on the score and key moments.

meta.name: Australopiticus Robustus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Australopiticus Robustus is a side-scrolling platformer where you control a caveman resembling Captain Caveman. Your goal is to navigate across platforms to reunite with your brothers Org and Gnom. Along the way, dangerous pterosaurs threaten to devour you if you're careless. Armed with a club, you can collect useful items to aid your progress, but it won't help against dinosaurs or flying foes – meaning careful movement and clever strategy are essential to survive.

meta.name: Automania : Manic Mechanic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.04 KB

Auto Mania is a platform game in which the player must help Wally, who works on a car assembly line, build a series of ten cars. Each car consists of six parts that are scattered throughout the storage room and must be collected in order to place them in the correct place on the car at the assembly point. The factory is populated with things that kill Wally on contact, such as robots, bouncing tires, and air cooling blades.

meta.name: AutoDuel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

AutoDuel takes you into a grim future of the USA, where gangs and vigilantes rule the highways and only armored cars with heavy weapons provide safety. You start out as an ordinary citizen, first needing to earn enough money for your own vehicle before taking courier jobs across the country. From there, the game is open-ended – you can explore cities, face gangsters on the roads, compete in arena battles for cash, or salvage car parts. A handful of courier missions are required to push the story forward, but otherwise freedom is yours. Vehicles can be customized in detail with machine guns, rockets, mine-layers, smokescreens, oil slicks, and different chassis types. The entire game unfolds from a top-down view, keeping the chaos of the roads always in sight.
