meta.name: Automan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este juego se basa en la serie de televisión homónima de los 80. Automan es un superdetective al estilo de Tron, generado por computadora, que utiliza un cursor brillante para crear coches y helicópteros. Una organización criminal del submundo creó un clon malvado de Automan usando el mismo programa que él. Pero no para hacer el bien. Automan debe encontrar objetos y pruebas para rastrear y destruir a su clon. Pero cuidado, hay muchos objetos esperando para matarlo. Una vez que haya reunido las pruebas y los objetos, podrá conducir hasta la siguiente ubicación. El juego es un juego de plataformas con pantalla panorámica. Para acceder a ciertas partes de una pantalla, debes ir a otra para volver a ti mismo. La barra de información inferior te indica tu ubicación, tu puntuación y la cantidad de objetos y pruebas que has recolectado. Las secciones de conducción son un laberinto en 3D.

meta.name: Autotest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.54 KB

Autotest Simulator focuses on precise top-down driving and turns each course into a test of control, speed, and clean direction changes. You choose a vehicle with its own handling and have to complete the cone-marked course as quickly as possible without picking up penalties for poor driving. Forward and reverse sections, along with careful use of the handbrake, mean that technique matters just as much as speed. That mix of skill, time pressure, and driving finesse gives the game its distinctive appeal.

meta.name: Avenger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.09 KB

Avenger es un clásico shoot 'em up inspirado en Space Invaders: controlas un cañón en la parte inferior de la pantalla y debes derribar oleadas de formaciones alienígenas antes de que alcancen la Tierra. De vez en cuando aparecen platillos voladores: difíciles de acertar, pero muy rentables en puntos. El éxito depende de reflejos rápidos, puntería precisa y una pizca de estrategia: saber cuándo disparar, cuándo esperar y cuándo apuntar al platillo fugaz que cruza el cielo por sorpresa. Cada ronda es más tensa que la anterior… y cada segundo ganado, una pequeña victoria contra la invasión. Simple, adictivo y profundamente retro.

meta.name: Avenger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 58.86 KB

"Avenger" is the sequel to "The Way of the Tiger" and follows the story of a ninja warrior seeking revenge for his foster father Naijish and recovering the stolen Scrolls of Kettsuin. The game is presented from a top-down perspective, reminiscent of "Gauntlet," and begins outside Quench Heart Keep. To enter the fortress, players must collect keys and defeat three guards. Other enemies, including homing spiders, also pose a threat. The player is armed with limited throwing weapons, and once depleted, combat must be carried out with bare hands. Pressing the "1" key calls upon divine energy from Kwon for healing, but only a limited number of times.

meta.name: Avengers (MAX)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.61 KB

"Avengers" is a classic shoot-'em-up based on the well-known "Space Invaders" concept. Players control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and must shoot waves of advancing alien formations before they reach Earth. Flying saucers occasionally appear, offering extra points when hit. Quick reflexes and precise aiming are key to achieving high scores and surviving as long as possible.

meta.name: Aviator Arcade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.39 KB

In Aviator Arcade you pilot a heavily armed combat helicopter on a dangerous mission to stop the X-Force terrorists. During the operation you search the area for hostile units and attempt to destroy their positions before they can take you down. You must maneuver your helicopter carefully, avoid incoming attacks and fire accurately at your targets. The fast pace demands both quick reflexes and tactical thinking. Only skilled flying and well-timed attacks will allow you to complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Avoid The Noid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Avoid the Noid is an advertisement ploy for Domino's Pizza. You are a pizza delivery boy who must deliver a pizza to Doom Industries while the creature Noid is set to prevent him from acheiving this goal. You must deliver the pizza to the top floor in 30 minutes or less, or the customer will get a discount and you will lose your job.

meta.name: Axe of Rage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Barbarian II: The Dungeon of Drax en Commodore 64 da un giro respecto al original: ya no son duelos uno contra uno, sino oleadas de combates contra múltiples monstruos y enemigos. Tras elegir entre el bárbaro o la princesa Marina —rescatada en la primera entrega—, te adentras en mazmorras tenebrosas en busca del malvado Drax. Cada pasillo escondido, cada trampa y cada criatura te acercan (o alejan) de tu objetivo. La acción es más frenética, el peligro, constante… y la venganza, más dulce si logras llegar hasta él. Sangre, acero y un toque de épica oscura: el legado bárbaro continúa.

meta.name: Axiens
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Axiens is a close derivative of Solar Software's Galaxions published by Alternative Software. It's a version of Galaxians where you control a ship at the bottom of the screen trying to shoot all the aliens moving across the top of the screen and firing at you. Occasionally one will swoop down zig-zagging and shooting. When all aliens are shot then they appear once more moving faster, shooting more and more aliens swooping down.

meta.name: Axis Assassin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Axis Assassin has you gliding across abstract grid fields while facing an ever-growing threat. You move your ship freely across the grid, dodging enemy attacks and dangerous webs while firing carefully aimed shots to clear the screen. Each round increases speed and pressure until a powerful foe appears, forcing a risky decision about when to use your single special weapon. If you destroy all enemies, the grid pulls you onward into deeper, more demanding stages.

meta.name: Aztec
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.74 KB

Aztec is an Indiana Jones-type action game with adventure elements, featuring our hero's quest to recover a valuable Jade Idol from a maze. Armed with only three sticks of dynamite and a pistol, the hero must get by traps, animals (lots of snakes and panthers), and natives, and find a way to make it out alive.

meta.name: Aztec Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.06 KB

In Aztec Challenge, you suddenly find yourself in the capital of the Aztec Empire in 1500 A.D. – sentenced to be a ritual sacrifice. Your only hope is to survive the brutal obstacle course known as “The Aztec Challenge.” To escape, you must conquer seven intense levels – each with unique mechanics and hazards. Dash toward a looming pyramid while dodging spear-throwers, climb a staircase with falling rocks, explore deadly chambers, and swim past vicious aquatic creatures. Quick reflexes and strong nerves are your only way to survive.

meta.name: Aztec Tomb Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.96 KB

In Aztec Tomb Adventure, you embark on a perilous expedition through the jungle to find the lost Aztec tomb. Along the way, you'll solve puzzles, escape a house, avoid hazards, cross a river, and explore an island. The game blends graphic scenes with simple text input, requiring you to navigate using commands like “go west” or “open door.” Only those with persistence, clever thinking, and keen observation will uncover the hidden tomb.

meta.name: Aztec Tomb Revisited
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.65 KB

In Aztec Tomb Revisited, your adventure continues: after finally reaching the tomb, you discover the treasure is gone – only a quarter of a seafarer's map remains. With £50 in your pocket, you set off to find the remaining pieces – a journey that takes you around the globe. The game blends graphics with classic text input – showing boxes with descriptions, items, directions, your money, and a small image of your current location. Explore, interact, and strategize – all to complete the map and uncover the hidden fortune.

meta.name: B-1 Bomber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.04 KB

In B-1 Nuclear Bomber, you have to "fly" a B-1 bomber to it's destination, and destroy the target of the mission. You input text commands to control your bomber's altitude, course, radar, weapons, and so on. And, of course, the USSR will try to stop you from bombing their targets, with an arsenal of MiGs and SAMs, and they are dealt with by the use of electronic counter-measures, evasive actions, or by shooting them down. The game ends when it reaches a logical conclusion, either by deploying your bombs and getting far enough away, returning to base, or being destroyed. After this, you get a short summary, and an option to play again. While most versions of the game were text only, both the C64 and Atari 8-Bit versions had graphics as well on some screens.

meta.name: B-24
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A simulation of WW2 air-warfare in which the player flies a B-24 as part of the 460th Bomber Group missions to Ploesti in Romania. The game operates on several levels, and the player will be required to act as a pilot, copilot, navigator, engineer and bombardier at different stages of each mission. The performance of your B-24 influences the effectiveness of your Group, Wing and ultimately the Air Force itself. B-24 is a simulator with a difference - you control your bomber (and the Group) from a top-down perspective rather than from a 1st person perspective.

meta.name: B-Bobs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

B-BOBS is an action-packed jump-and-run game, with 10 fantastic levels and a powerful bonus level. Real fun to play!
Collect coins and behead stones with your steel helmet. Fun, great graphics and strong sound - everything in this game! A real hit!

meta.name: B-1 Nuclear Bomber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

B-1 is a computer simulation of a manned bomber nuclear strike mission into Soviet Russia. The player gives commands to the computer which 'flies' the bomber on the mission. The bomber must fly to within bomb range of its target to deliver its weapon. It is opposed by nuclear-armed MIG's and SAM's of the USSR's air defense system. It defends itself with ECM, evasive action and nuclear tipped multi-purpose Phoenix missiles.

meta.name: Baal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Baal is a monster who has stolen a war machine. As the leader of the "Time Warriors", you must destroy his minions, collect the war machine pieces (they flash yellow), and destroy Baal.

meta.name: Bable Bale
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.33 KB

A Bubble Bobble clone where you have to burp several times on enemies to kill them! Pretty funny, but not as subtle as the original.

meta.name: Baby Blues
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.74 KB

In Baby Blues the player controls a crosshair and must use it to protect the baby from wildlife such as eagles, spiders, and worms; all the while popping balloons that travel across the screen. A picture of a baby bottle with milk in it can be seen on the top-left of the game screen. When all balloons are popped, the game proceeds to the next level with the difficulty and the number of balloons increased. When wildlife comes in contact with the baby, some milk is lost. The game ends when the player runs out of milk or ammo.

meta.name: Baby Jack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bomb Jack provides the inspiration for this action game. Our hero must thrust around single screen levels collecting every gem and avoiding contact with the many nasties that guard them. Levels have less ledges and more open spaces than Bomb Jack. A bonus is awarded depending on how quickly you clear the screen. You have five lives; losing one does not reset how many of the diamonds you have collected so far. You can create a full set of new levels using the provided editor.

meta.name: Baby Jack II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A single screen platformer where you avoid the crawling aliens and gather all the diamonds.

meta.name: The Baby of Can Guru
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 61.37 KB

The Baby of Can Guru is a Trial & Error-style game, in which the player controls a kangaroo that has to jump its way through screen after screen, avoiding obstacles and enemies that become increasingly difficult. Timing is crucial, as the kangaroo has no health bar and dies from one hit. Points are received for each completed screen, and although there is no time limit in the game, the number of points the player receives depend on how long it takes to complete a screen.

When you come in contact with a monster, or use your jetpack, your fuel level decreases. When the fuel gauge is empty, you will lose one of your lives.
Along the way, you will pass containers that store various chemicals, and you will be able to carry only one chemical at once, but you can switch the chemicals around. Some of the chemicals can be mixed together to create other chemicals and explosions.

Para ello, debe completar niveles mientras se ocupa de recolectar suficientes relojes. También están presentes en la progresión algunos minijuegos y una fase de conducción del DeLorean.

Diversión variada, fiel al espíritu caótico y brillante de la saga.

„Backgammon“ is a board game for two players, where the goal is to move all of your pieces (checkers) into your home board and eventually remove them from the board. Each player has 15 pieces, which are moved using two dice. The dice roll determines how many spaces a piece can be moved. The objective is to bring all pieces into your home board first, and then remove them from the board in a specific order. Obstacles include opponent's pieces, which can be "hit" and returned to the game. Tactics and risk play a significant role, as the game requires both luck and strategic thinking. The first player to remove all their pieces wins.

As your village's chosen envoy, you have to stop Lord Dominix from wiping out the mutants, exploring cities, villages, and dangerous plains filled with monsters. Conversations, equipment, and new weapons help you along the way, while real-time combat and the day-night cycle noticeably shape the journey. That mix of post-apocalyptic atmosphere, moral conflict, and direct action gives the game its distinctive appeal.

Tendrás que cruzar la ciudad: el viaje no será fácil... En los callejones, en un enorme camión de mudanzas, en las alcantarillas o en el parque, la lucha es despiadada. Tendrás que encontrar la táctica ideal para triunfar cada vez. Al final de tu viaje, te encontrarás con el gran jefe que está a punto de despegar en helicóptero con el presidente en su equipaje.

Each hit reduces your opponent's energy – but be careful not to get knocked out yourself. Challenge the CPU or another player and show who the true street-fighting champion is!

With brute force and wonderfully absurd special moves, you fight your way through Melbourne. The result is an offbeat brawling adventure that gleefully embraces slapstick, exaggerated enemies, and unapologetic street chaos.

Las carreras tienen lugar en circuitos construidos sobre las ruinas de la peligrosa zona nuclear conocida como BADLANDS, y cada carrera se disputa a tres vueltas. Los coches están equipados con armas con las que se puede disparar a los competidores para ralentizarlos. También es posible ganar o comprar mejoras de misiles que destruirán por completo un vehículo contrario.

If you are trying collect a money bag but a railcar gets in your way, you can cling onto the ceiling while it passes by. If you drop off the handholds on the ceiling at the right time, you can also ride the railcar to avoid the miners.

Another ball floats vertically up and down in the middle of the screen. When the cue ball touches the ball in question, our peaceful cue ball turns into a mean fellow whose only goal appears to be to send the player onto the boards. Among other things, lives can be deducted if the player's ball leaves the field of play, penalty points can be awarded, etc. If the counter above the scoreboard shows a 3, the game is over. The only chance is to be faster and more skilled than the computer to stay afloat. With a little practice, you too can outsmart the computer.
A final tip: By pressing the fire button you can move the racket faster - often very helpful in reaching the ball.

Each of the eight levels requires you to complete the task four times, as a new layer of platforms is added after each round. Helpful bonuses such as invincibility, extra lives, automatic level completion, and bonus points make the challenge easier.

There are three types of move ? short moves which also see you retain the square you were in, jumps in which you lose the previous square, and moves using the teleporting device to move a larger distance. There are over 100 levels, which needn't be played in sequence. The board layouts feature gaps in, which must be incorporated into your strategy, to ensure that you don't leave a space next to a large number of your pieces, which would allow an opponent to swallow them up.

The game starts with a simple court but it gets progressively more difficult with added obstacles, simple mazes and bonus items. There are 130 courts in total (64 on the C64, 30 on the BBC/Electron). A court is completed when either player scores three goals. If the computer wins in the single-player game, that is game over although the game can be restarted from the same court. Goals can score a range of points depending on how far out they are scored from.

After picking up each canister, you are automatically returned to the cave's center to start the next attempt. Completing all canisters unlocks a tougher cave with stronger gravity, followed by a third one considered impossible. Touching the walls, hitting a canister at the wrong angle, or running out of time will cost you a life.

Plus, you're racing against the clock, so precision and speed are both essential. A nerve-wracking action puzzle game inspired by “Crazy Balloon” – but with a unique twist of its own.

Bannercatch is an educational action game for two players. The game is a variant of Capture the Flag; Two human players compete against Max and his team of robots. To win the game, players must work as a team to get to Max's zone of the field, capture the flag, and return it safely before Max is able to capture the player's flag. Each time players manage to capture one of Max's flags, part of his face is revealed; The goal is to try to see Max's entire face.t.

meta.name: Banshee Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Marry the Princess and get out of Banshee Castle alive - if you can! The player has been captured by banshees within a castle. The player must find and free the princess hidden within the castle, and escape to safety. The player has limited health, and can be injured by banshee attacks and roaming jesters. A wandering monk can heal the player. The player must gather items and solve inventory puzzles. All commands are via VERB NOUN entry. There is a save/restore feature.

meta.name: Banzai!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.79 KB

Banzai! throws you into a maze packed with enemies who constantly threaten you and can even shoot through walls. To survive, you must dodge their attacks while taking them out yourself. Every move in the narrow corridors requires careful thought, as danger lurks around every corner. Quick reflexes, tactics, and precision determine how long you can endure.

meta.name: Barbarian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.04 KB

Barbarian pone al jugador en el papel de un guerrero que navega por peligrosas mazmorras. El juego se desarrolla desde una perspectiva de desplazamiento lateral y combina plataformas y combate. El joystick controla el movimiento, mientras que las teclas arriba y abajo te permiten navegar por los comandos en la parte inferior de la pantalla. Al pulsar "Disparo", se ejecuta la acción seleccionada, eliminando la necesidad de botones adicionales. El bárbaro empieza con una espada y más adelante adquiere un arco para ataques a distancia. Numerosas trampas y diversos monstruos con patrones de ataque únicos presentan desafíos constantes.

meta.name: Barbie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Barbie gets a phone call from her boyfriend Ken, asking her if she wants to go somewhere with him. Where Ken says depends on the current game being played, and can include going to the prom, going out to dinner, going to the pool, playing tennis, working out at the gym, or having a picnic. 
You control Barbie, and your job is to get her ready by going shopping and selecting dresses, swimwear, shoes, hairstyle, and other outfits. This can be done by stopping her car in front of a store and going in. You use the joystick to move the "hand" over the various items in the store. You can also select its color and pattern. Clicking on these will cause Barbie to wear it. If you change you mind, you can change into something else. When you wear something you do not need, there is no way that you can remove it.
One of these might not be relevant to the situation, so common sense should tell you what you really need. Once you are done with all of this, you travel back to Barbie's house where you can find out if you have the right outfit. If you did, then you are shown a picture of Barbie and Ken having a good time. Otherwise, you are faced with the next situation.

La pequeña ciudad de Skara Brae disfrutaba de una vida pacífica, hasta que apareció un malvado mago conocido como Mangar el Oscuro. Los monstruos invadieron la ciudad, aterrorizando a sus habitantes. Mangar lanzó el hechizo del Invierno Eterno sobre los alrededores, aislando a Skara Brae de cualquier posible ayuda. The Bard's Tale es un juego de rol de fantasía con exploración en primera persona de entornos 3D pseudolaberínticos y combates por turnos contra enemigos que aparecen aleatoriamente. A diferencia de los primeros juegos de Wizardry, la ciudad se puede explorar físicamente y también se puede acceder a partes del mundo exterior. Hay que explorar varias mazmorras antes de enfrentarse a la misión final.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Después de que un grupo de valientes héroes derrotara al hechicero Mangar y liberara a Skara Brae del invierno eterno, todo parecía ir bien en el mundo. Sin embargo, el malvado archimago Lagoth Zanta aparece y parte la Vara del Destino en siete pedazos, esparciéndolos por toda la tierra. La Vara del Destino ha protegido la tierra durante setecientos años y, sin ella, el reino caerá en el caos. Depende de los héroes volver a forjarla. Uno de ellos también debe ascender al rango de Archimago y utilizar la varita para derrotar a Lagoth Zanta.
Se trata de un juego de rol de fantasía con exploración en primera persona de un mundo pseudo-3D y combates por turnos contra enemigos que aparecen aleatoriamente. Esta secuela cuenta con seis ciudades, frente a una en su predecesor, y un área mayor. Las mazmorras contienen más trampas y puzles que antes.

Los guerreros que destruyeron al hechicero Mangar reciben una carta mientras celebran su victoria. La carta les informa de un terrible desastre: El amo de Mangar, el dios loco Tarjan, ha desatado su ira sobre la ciudad de Skara Brae, destruyéndola por completo. Los héroes viajan a un campo de refugiados cercano y se embarcan en una misión para derrotar a Tarjan.
Se trata de un juego de rol de fantasía en primera persona en el que el jugador explora laberínticas ciudades pseudo-3D, mazmorras y zonas salvajes. Se han añadido dos nuevas clases de personajes, hay más mazmorras que en juegos anteriores y esta versión añade una función de mapeado automático. El mundo del juego está dividido en varios reinos a los que se accede mediante viajes en el tiempo, cada uno con su propia temática y ambientación.

Barney Brown And The Chicago Connection puts you in the shoes of an undercover agent tasked by MI5 to deliver a top-secret document to Chicago. Starting in England, this text adventure leads you through perilous locations where you must gather clues, avoid traps, and make critical decisions. Using classic text commands like “examine” or “use,” you guide the story through a world of espionage and intrigue.

meta.name: Barney The Elf
meta.desc:

Barney the Elf is an educational puzzle game that aims to develop players' language skills in a fun way. In this educational game, various language challenges are presented to make players unscramble words, add missing words, or use appropriate articles to make sentences grammatically correct. The gameplay is structured into various tasks that require the player to complete sentences or correct words. For example, a task may be to rearrange a jumbled word to represent it correctly, or to insert another word that makes sense in the sentence.

"Baron: The Real Estate Simulation" puts you into the American real estate market, where you build wealth through speculation and smart trading. Each turn represents a month, allowing you to monitor trends, buy and sell properties, trade options, and take out loans. Starting with $35,000 and a “newbie” status, you face limitations like lower loan amounts and higher closing costs. As your net worth grows, you level up to investor or banker, gaining more advantages. The ultimate goal: reach a net worth of $1,000,000 within 60 months to earn the title of Baron.

You have picked up a barrel when the signal stops and the barrel stops flashing. If you fall off the ladder, miss the barrel, or run out of top, you will be fired and killed instantly.

Baseball tries to bring the flow of a baseball game to the screen in a compact form, placing its main focus on the direct duels between pitcher and batter. Different pitch types, timing at the plate, and reacting correctly in the field ensure that success depends not only on speed, but also on a good feel for how each play unfolds. That focus on the key moments of the sport gives the program a simple but appealing sporting character.

Basil the Great Mouse Detective follows the clever Basil through London's streets, dark sewers and his archenemy Ratigan's lair to rescue his kidnapped friend Dr. Dawson – armed with a magnifying glass and coat pockets, he searches for real clues hidden among fakes, dodges henchmen, collects cheese for energy and lays mousetraps to safely make his way through this colorful platform world.

meta.name: The Basket Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Basket Manager” puts you in charge of a basketball team, responsible for both its financial management and on-court success. You begin by assembling a roster of eight players, balancing cost with their individual stats – including speed, stamina, shot preparation, and shooting ability. Experience levels range from rookie to veteran, and your goal is to develop a strong, competitive team. Once on the court, you take direct control of your players, either the one with the ball or the closest to it. Strategy and skillful play are key to leading your team to victory.

meta.name: Basket Playoff

Basket Playoff puts you in the role of a professional basketball team coach, starting with a budget of 34 million dollars. First you assemble your squad from 50 available candidates, each with values in speed, skill, stamina, and shooting ability. The roster includes not only athletes but also stars from music, film, and politics such as Michael Jackson, Eddie Murphy, and Margaret Thatcher. After the management phase, where you buy and assign your players, the action shifts to the court. There you control the player with or near the ball, passing, shooting, and trying to score while using tactics and time-outs to stay ahead. Tournament mode and single matches provide different challenges where strategy is just as important as skill on the court.

Bat builds on the classic Pong formula and reduces it to a direct duel of ball, paddles, and quick reactions. You try to return the ball cleverly, outplay your opponent, and find the decisive opening at the right moment. The simple presentation keeps the focus entirely on timing, angles, and the constant back-and-forth. This creates an accessible skill game whose appeal comes from clear competition and instantly understandable action.

Bat Attack is a Galaxian clone, in which you control a ship that must avoid the attack of enemy bats moving left and right and try to destroy them by firing a single-shot missile that is recharged when a bat is hit or when it reaches the top of the screen. The bats attack you both, firing bullets and diving toward the bottom: if you are hit by a bat or by a bullet, you lose one of the three lives that you have at the beginning of the game. After destroying all the bats, you play a transition stage where you must avoid some disc-shaped obstacles to reach the next level, where more bats are ready to destroy you

meta.name: Batalyx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.41 KB

Batalyx is a collection of six mini-games. The goal is to collect parts of a completion icon by finishing various levels. Once the credits bar is fully displayed, an icon piece is awarded, with a total time limit shown by a shrinking progress bar. The mini-games include: Hallucino-bomblets, where you control a probe and shoot enemies; AMC2, where you fight camels; Activation of Iridis Base, where you perform joystick movements; Cippy on the Run, where you color bricks; Synchro II, where you synchronize movements; and Psychadelia 2, a light synthesizer for relaxation.

meta.name: Bath Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.08 KB

Bath Time is a single screen game where one player battles against the computer or two players battle each other to either keep the water levels of a bath at the correct level or empty/fill the bath to let a swan escape or a fish to die. There are two Sprites, one at the bottom of the screen (lower) and one at the top of the screen (upper) controlled by the players, and in a one player game you control the lower Sprite. Both Sprites move left or right to open and close valves which either fills the bath or empties the bath. If the bath becomes too full then the swan can swim away and if the bath empties then the fish dies and the upper Sprite wins but if the water level stays at the correct level between 40 seconds to one minute then the lower Sprite wins. An elephant and a boy occasionally walk to the edge of the bath with the elephant removing water while the boy puts water in.

meta.desc:

El superhéroe de los tebeos, Batman, irrumpe en tu ordenador en una explosiva aventura de arcade en la que te enfrentas a las fuerzas del mal en Gotham City. Los gráficos estilo cómic y la animación lo convierte en un juego innovador, que te proporcionará horas y horas de entretenimiento.

meta.name: Batman : The Movie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en la película de Batman de 1989. El juego consta de cinco partes diferentes, cada una de las cuales se asemeja a tipos de juegos bien conocidos. Primera parte, la planta química: Caza a Jack Napier, que ha asaltado la planta (la típica acción de plataformas, subir escaleras o usar la "Bat-cuerda" y disparar a algunos enemigos...). Segunda parte, conduciendo el "Batmóvil": El Joker te persigue y tienes que escapar hasta llegar a la "Batcueva". Evita los obstáculos, como la policía que bloquea el camino y otros. Tercera parte, en la "Batcueva": Un juego de rompecabezas en el que tienes que encontrar los productos que han sido manipulados por el Joker para resultar tóxicos mediante la combinación de tres de ellos y puestos a la venta para el consumo. Cuarta parte, manejando el "Bat-avión": Corta las cuerdas de los globos que están llenos de gas venenoso. Quinta parte, en la catedral: Caza a Joker. Esta parte se desarrolla como la primera. Finalmente te enfrentarás al Joker en una lucha que decide el destino de la ciudad de Gotham.

meta.name: Battalion Commander

Battalion Commander is a real-time tactical (platoon/company level) simulation of modern warfare. The player is put in the role of a lieutenant colonel in charge of an entire armored battalion of either U.S., Soviet, or Chinese army. A combination of 5 scenarios and 40 maps of varied terrain (rivers, hills, minefields) is available, as well as infantry, tanks, APCs, artillery, assault guns, and other units. The commands are issued by pointing a spot on the map with the cursor (using the joystick) and then pressing a key combination selecting which company/platoon has to perform what action (these include fire support, smoke screen, laying bridges, digging in, etc.). A handicap can be chosen for either side to adjust difficulty.

“Battle Command” is a strategic game that offers tactical challenges and is designed for various playstyles.

meta.name: Battle Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battle Command is a 3D arcade/strategy game, loosely derived from the same developers' Carrier Command. In a near future alternate reality, the Ultra War is fought between the two dominate races in the New World. The 'Mauler' is the latest technology - an Armored Fighting Machine capable of being lifted in and out of hostile territory by a fast Stealth Chopper, and armed with the most advanced weaponry science can devise. You command a single "Mauler" assault tank in one of a series of scenarios. These range from a railway ambush to escort duties and a raid on a riverside hideout. Before starting you must choose the right weaponry based on the mission briefing.

meta.name: Battle Droidz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Red L.E.D. / Battle Droidz” challenges the player to connect a cosmic grid of 37 hexagons to unlock a new energy source. To achieve this, three ZMX robots must traverse each hexagon and collect four capsules to activate a teleporter and clear the hexagon. Each robot has unique abilities to navigate the terrain, overcome obstacles, and tackle hazards like acid pools or steep slopes. Enemies and their generators must be destroyed, while useful bonuses within the hexagons aid progress. The goal is to create an unbroken line across the grid within one hour.

meta.name: Battle for Normandy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Here is the wargamer's dream vacation package - 25 days on the northern coast of France! Of course, we don't promise peace and quiet. Because when you open up this box, you'll find yourself in Normandy - on June 6, 1944 smack at the start of D-Day! Depending on your choice, you'll either lead or face the largest Allied amphibious force ever assembled. Its purpose: to smash Hitler's supposedly impregnable line of defence - the Atlantic Wall. Battle for Normandy is the faithful recreation of D-Day and the 24 days that followed it. To do justice to this great World War II battle, we've made sure every important historical detail has been realistically and accurately programmed into the game.

meta.name: Battle Group
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battle Group places you in tactical engagements where you coordinate small units and make turn-by-turn decisions about movement, positioning, and firepower. Each round forces you to reassess the battlefield, weigh opportunities, and manage resources while the situation evolves. With a set turn limit, a clear sense of tension builds as planning and adaptability become key to gaining the upper hand. In the end, accumulated performance determines the result – a strategic contest that rewards awareness, patience, and carefully executed manoeuvres.

meta.name: Battle Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.34 KB

Battle Island throws you into an alien invasion as a lone elite commando. Armed with your M16 and a pack of smart grenades, you must recover eight pieces of the Bailey Bridge to reach the Neutron Beam Weapons Base – and destroy the weapon to save your comrades. Along the way, swarms of alien troops, tanks, and laser emplacements stand in your path. Some enemies drop stars that grant temporary power-ups like double shots, rear fire, unstoppable bullets, or shields. Battle Island is an explosive fight for survival where every step forward is a hard-won victory.

meta.name: Battle Khaos 2
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.59 KB

meta.name: Battle Of Antietam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battle of Antietam is a grand tactical simulation of the bloodiest day of the Civil War at the little town of Sharpsburg, Maryland along Antietam Creek. The game is played in 11 turns each representing 1 hour of real time. Players are awarded points based on casualties and territorial objectives. At the end of each turn and the end of the game points are calculated and compared to a chart which determines your level of victory. The game can be played under 3 different sets of rules (Basic, Intermediate and Advanced) with 5 levels of difficulty for each and can be played against another person or the computer can play either side.

meta.name: Battle of Britain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.83 KB

In Battle of Britain you command the RAF Fighter Command during the critical air battles of 1940. Choose between single days with varying enemy activity or a full 30-day campaign. Use radar data to deploy 18 fighter squadrons, defend key locations, and manage reinforcements based on daily losses. Optional action sequences let you pilot a Spitfire in dogfights or control anti-aircraft guns for hands-on defense.

meta.name: The Battle of Midway
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Battle For Midway“ places you in command of the American Pacific fleet six months after the attack on Pearl Harbor. The Battle of Midway was the turning point in the Pacific War. If the Japanese succeed in capturing Midway Island, they will gain a base to launch attacks on Hawaii and eventually the U.S. mainland – a scenario that could decisively alter the course of World War II.

meta.name: Battle of the Parthian Kings
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battle of the Parthian Kings throws you into the chaos following the Emperor's death, where every city has broken free and rival kings seek the throne. As a king, you raise armies, hire mercenaries, forge alliances, and collect taxes to expand your power. Conquered cities must be held as you push toward final domination. Up to four players can compete or face the computer. Strategy, tactics, and leadership will determine your rise or fall.

meta.name: Battle of the Planets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.36 KB

Battle of the Planets está basado en una serie de dibujos animados infantiles de ciencia ficción del mismo nombre.
En este shoot'em up tienes que proteger los 5 planetas de tu sistema solar de una invasión alienígena liderada por Zoltar. Para ello, debes destruir las naves enemigas que se acerquen con tus láseres o misiles mientras vigilas la situación de los planetas que estás defendiendo. Puedes viajar de planeta en planeta en cualquier momento.

meta.name: Battle Stations
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this shooter seen from a 1st person perspective, you are a gunner on a battleship and you must shoot down wave after wave of enemy aircraft as they attempt to sink your ship. Controlling a sight you must move 360 degrees around your ship searching for enemy aircraft and shoot them. As well as moving the screen left or right you can also move upwards into the sky. To help you find the aircraft there is a radar provided showing you any attacks on the ship. As you take more damage, a picture of your ship starts having holes appear on it and if you take too many then you sink and it is game over.

meta.name: Battle Through Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battle Through Time takes you on a daring journey through the history of mankind. In the 26th century, scientists harness the power of time travel – but their experiment turns into a fight for survival. Driving an all-terrain vehicle, you race through ages filled with danger: from prehistoric lands swarming with dinosaurs to futuristic war zones scarred by nuclear fallout. Much like Moon Patrol, you control your vehicle, dodging obstacles and blasting enemies in your path. Each era offers new foes, new scenery, and rising tension – a full-throttle leap through time itself.

meta.name: Battle Valley
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Battle Valley" es un shoot 'em up de vista lateral para Commodore 64 que te pondrá en la piel de un soldado que intentara recuperar dos armas nucleares robadas por los terroristas. Estas estarán colocadas en cada extremo del mapeado por lo que podrás conseguirlas en cualquier orden.
Ademas, el juego ofrece tanto un helicoptero como un tanke que podrás escoger desde la base y te darán la oportunidad de cambiarlos cuando quieras.

meta.name: Battlecruiser
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battlecruiser lets you recreate the great naval battles of the 20th century – either the fierce duels between Britain and Germany in World War I or the massive fleet engagements of World War II. You command up to 20 ships at once, shaping the outcome of complex battles where every shell hit is tracked and damage is calculated with precision. Dozens of classes of warships are included, from mighty battleships to agile cruisers and torpedo boats. You can also modify ship data, create your own maps or scenarios, and forge your own epic naval encounters.

meta.name: Battlefield
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.12 KB

Battlefield is a tactical two-player top-down shooter where futuristic tanks battle it out in a confined arena. Each hit weakens your opponent, and the first to lose all lives is defeated. The arenas are filled with walls and obstacles that can serve as cover or traps, forcing players to move carefully, calculate angles, and strike at the perfect moment. Once a duel is over, a new battlefield can be selected – quick thinking and precise aim decide who wins.

meta.name: Battlefield Earth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.00 KB

Battlefield Earth is a horizontally scrolling shooter designed for one or two players – but it was never officially released. You pilot your craft across a devastated Earth as waves of alien attackers descend from all directions. Precision and timing are key as you fire rapidly and dodge for survival. The blend of classic arcade action and bleak post-apocalyptic setting gives the game a gritty edge – an unfinished relic that still shows real promise.

meta.name: Battlefront
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battlefront is a World War II corps commander simulator where players lead Axis and Allied troops. As the commander, the player issues orders to up to twelve regiments, which must carry out these commands under enemy pressure. The objectives and time frame are set; the player decides which tasks the regiments will take on while maintaining supply lines. Each round lasts six hours, during which combat occurs and troops move. The map shows the terrain in square kilometers, controlled by battalions. There are 14 types of battalions with varying levels of experience and morale. The game offers four scenarios: Crete (1941), Stalingrad (1942), Saipan (1944), and Bastogne (1944-45).

meta.name: Battles in Normandy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

“Battles in Normandy” is a turn-based strategy game focusing on the Allied landing in German-occupied Normandy in 1944. Players command units on a hexagonal grid and must capture key locations within a limited timeframe. Weather, terrain, supply, experience, and morale influence the course of battles, while various unit types can be strategically deployed.

meta.name: Battles of Napoleon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battles of Napoleon is a very realistic war game about the most famous battles of Napoleon's career - the game includes Borodino, Waterloo, Quatre Bras and Auerstadt, but you can also design your own battles. You have the option to play as either the French or the Allies, and all aspects of the battles are present here - cavalry charges, artillery fire, infantry fields and so on.

meta.name: Battleship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.88 KB

Battleship is a digital version of the classic game with expanded features. In addition to a computer opponent and the removal of cheating, the game introduces uniquely shaped, Tetris-like ships that can be placed in four directions. The Salvo mode allows each surviving ship to fire multiple shots per round, encouraging strategic follow-up. Each move is depicted as an air strike. Alongside solo and two-player matches, there's also a multiplayer mode with ongoing scoring, where the winner keeps playing until defeated.

meta.name: Battleship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.78 KB

Battle Ships lleva el clásico juego de batalla naval al siguiente nivel. En lugar de papel, juegas digitalmente contra un oponente virtual, sin trampas ni desperdicio de recursos. Pero el juego va más allá: los barcos ya no tienen formas estándar, sino que se asemejan a piezas de Tetris, girando en cuatro direcciones. En el modo Salvo, cada uno de tus seis barcos dispara cuatro tiros por turno hasta hundirse. Esto convierte cada ronda en un equilibrio táctico entre el escaneo de área amplia y los ataques dirigidos. Cada acción cobra vida con una secuencia animada de ataque aéreo.

meta.name: Battleship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.96 KB

Battleship is a straightforward adaptation of the classic game of naval combat, where you try to sink the computer's fleet by entering targeted coordinates. Each turn you guess a spot and hope for a hit, while the computer tries to locate your ships as well. The gameplay closely follows the original and offers a quick, paperless version of the well-known strategy game.

meta.name: Battleship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.63 KB

Battleship is a strategic duel for one or two players where you must locate and sink enemy warships on a grid before your own fleet is found. Both sides secretly place their ships and take turns firing at coordinates. The first to eliminate all enemy units wins. The game offers classic strategic tension in the style of Battleship – brought to digital form.

p: Battletech - The Crescent Hawk's Inception (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: Battletech - The Crescent Hawk's Inception (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.name: BattleTech : The Crescent Hawk's Inception
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

BattleTech: The Crescent Hawk's Inception casts you as Jason Youngblood, a cadet MechWarrior training at the Citadel of Pacifica in the Lyran Commonwealth. He follows in the footsteps of his famous father Jeremiah, but everything changes when the Draconis Combine launches a surprise attack. Jason barely escapes and joins forces with a member of the Crescent Hawks – a unit founded by his father. Together they search for allies to face the new threat. For Jason, it's harder than for anyone else, as he believes his father was among the attackers. The game starts with training at the Citadel, earning money and learning to fight with mechs and small arms. Afterwards, you explore Pacifica, recruit companions, and fight in turn-based battles.

meta.name: Battletrance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.97 KB

Battletrance throws you into eternal war as the Grixlons have conquered not just the universe – but even the house down the street. Your mission: destroy all power orbs and end their reign. It's a fast, no-nonsense shooter where precision alone isn't enough. You'll need sharp reflexes to dodge enemy fire, smart movement to survive tight spots, and nerves of steel to keep up with the escalating chaos. Only a mix of skill, timing, and strategy will lead you to victory.

meta.name: Battlezone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.21 KB

"Battlezone" te pone en la cabina de un tanque defendiendo la Tierra contra una invasión alienígena. Desde una vista en primera persona, recorres un campo de batalla abstracto pero tácticamente exigente, apuntando a tanques enemigos, aviones y ovnis. Un radar te ayuda a localizar enemigos por dirección y distancia, y las características del terreno pueden usarse como cobertura. Los controles simulan de manera realista las orugas del tanque: combinar comandos de avance y retroceso permite giros rápidos y maniobras ágiles. Un juego de acción 3D pionero, aún elogiado por su atmósfera inmersiva y jugabilidad estratégica.

meta.name: Batty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Commodore 64 version of Arkanoid variant Batty has no fewer than 64 levels, compared to 14 on the other versions. Basic game features are otherwise the same, with a 2 player mode in which players have access to half the screen each. Power ups include faster bat control, a larger bat and multiball. Unusual features for the style include magnets affecting the ball's motion, and enemies dropping bombs which must be avoided.

meta.name: Baywatch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.57 KB

In Baywatch it's all about endurance, not beachside drama: you're solo in a 100-meter swim, racing against the clock. The goal is to finish the distance as fast as possible. No Pamela Anderson, no slow-motion beach run – just water, walls, and willpower.

meta.name: Baywatch Nights
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.08 KB

In Baywatch Nights you play as Mitch Buchannon, but instead of lifeguarding, you're battling ghostly spirits that threaten the world. In eerie levels, you face supernatural enemies – and if you fail, it's the end of the world. Action, absurdity, and cult charm collide in this unusual spin-off.

meta.name: Bazooka Bill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.89 KB

„Bazooka Bill“ puts you in the boots of a one-man army armed with everything from punches and throwing knives to a machine gun, flamethrower and eventually a bazooka. But even with all that firepower, there's barely time to breathe – level 1 throws motorcycle-helmeted ninja soldiers and helicopters at you in waves. They rush by so fast that reacting is almost impossible – each collision drains your health. Level 2 starts at “Clark Airbase,” where elite troops cheekily kick you and dash off before you take to the skies. Level 3, Mindanao Island, brings foot soldiers armed with flails, and Level 4 begins once again at an airport on Corregidor Island, where elite soldiers return before another airborne assault. Speed, chaos and pure reflexes are your only allies – “Bazooka Bill” doesn't play nice.

meta.name: Bburago Rally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bburago Rally throws you into a toy-car race that suddenly feels alive. You steer detailed mini Bburago vehicles through twisty rally tracks, always shown from a clear top-down view. Every curve pushes your reflexes, every surface behaves differently, and obstacles constantly force quick, daring moves. The whole race carries that blend of childhood model-car charm and real competition – as if you finally get to unleash your old toys on a proper track.

meta.name: BC Bill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.28 KB

BC Bill drops you into the harsh routines of prehistoric life, where survival demands constant effort. You hunt for food by beating it before rival dinosaurs can claim it and dragging it back to your cave, all while avoiding becoming prey yourself. Food alone is not enough, though, as building a family is also essential and requires risky confrontations. The appeal comes from the unusual setting, the ever-present danger, and the relentless struggle against an unforgiving environment.

meta.name: B.C. II : Grog's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

B.C. II: Grog's Revenge continues Thor's adventure from Quest for Tires. This time, he is searching for the Meaning of Life, hidden somewhere deep in a maze of mountains. To progress, Thor must collect 100 clams to pay tolls at bridges. The mountains lead into dark, eerie caves filled with clams but also dangerous stalagmites. Outside, Grog lurks, ready to steal Thor's clams. Rocks, potholes, and pterodactyls that can eat his wheel add further hazards. Only with skill and persistence can Thor gather enough clams to reach his ultimate goal: the Meaning of Life.

meta.name: BC's Quest for Tires
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

¡Una linda chica está en problemas! Ha sido capturada por un dinosaurio, y depende de que Thor vaya montado en su infalible rueda a rescatarla. Hay muchos obstáculos en el camino por el que Thor tendrá que saltar y agacharse, incluidas rocas, árboles, ríos, pozos de lava, acantilados y, por supuesto, Fat Broad. Cuando te agachas, el personaje rebota hacia arriba y hacia abajo, así que no te agaches demasiado pronto. BC's Quest For Tires es un juego de acción de desplazamiento lateral que se parece a Moon Patrol en algunos aspectos y presenta personajes de la tira cómica BC.

meta.name: Beach Blanket Volleyball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.75 KB

Beach Blanket Volleyball is a 3 on 3 up to 2 players Commodore 64 game that attempts to create an enjoyable beach experience, but eats sand in the end.  If you can turn the sound down, DO IT!  Each volley sounds like a ship blowing up.  No other sound is heard from the game.

meta.name: Beach Buggy Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.94 KB

„Beach Buggy Simulator“ is a fast-paced action game where you race a beach buggy in the Dune Trials. Across eight stages, you must jump over rocks and fire, shoot down attacking helicopters, and reach the finish line within the time limit. Your buggy consumes fuel constantly — without it, you can't shoot or maintain speed. Only by collecting fuel cans can you stay in the race. If you complete all eight rounds, the game loops back to the beginning — fail to finish a stage in time, and it's game over.

meta.name: Beach Volley
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

While two boys playing Beach Volley a stranger passes by and give them two the possibility to play around the world for the Beach Volley Cup. They take change and start their first competition in London. The rules are easy, one of the teams has to reach seven points first. When you win you fly to other continents like America, Africa or China to meet your next opponent.
You can play against the computer (cup mode) or a second player.

meta.name: Beach-Head
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Una isla del Pacífico está bajo el control de un dictador y sus tropas. Como Comandante en Jefe de las fuerzas militares en el Pacífico, debes dirigir un desembarco exitoso. Tras escapar de los ataques de la escuadra enemiga, tu flota debe salir victoriosa de una despiadada batalla naval. Sólo entonces tus fuerzas terrestres podrán invadir la isla. Ahora que tus tropas han conseguido penetrar en el sistema defensivo enemigo, queda la tarea más difícil: asaltar la fortaleza de HUHN-LIN.

p: Beach-Head II - The Dictator Strikes Back! (USA).D64
n: Beach-Head II - The Dictator Strikes Back! (USA)

meta.name: Beach-Head II : The Dictator Strikes Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Beach-Head II: The Dictator Strikes Back continues the campaign as the supposedly defeated dictator returns and now holds twenty Allied prisoners in a new fortress. After a devastating attack on the fleet, it is up to Commander J.P. Stryker to strike back with Marines and helicopters to rescue the captives. Once again, you face multiple action-packed mission stages, operating guns, repelling assaults, and eliminating key targets to dismantle the enemy stronghold. In addition to the solo mission, this sequel also features a competitive two-player mode – an intense military assault that demands reflexes, precision, and endurance.

meta.name: Beaky and the Eggsnatchers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.00 KB

Beaky and the Egg Snatchers is a game where you play as Beaky the Condor who must protect his eggs from Eggsnatchers on the planet Crackit. Your magic power decreases each time you touch an enemy, but can destroy enemies. The game has three phases: in phase one, you collect ten eggs by shooting Eggsnatchers that drop the eggs. In phase two, you must keep the eggs warm while a timer counts down, shoot snow that lowers the temperature, and avoid a Froogle that throws nitrogen bombs. In phase three, the hatched chicks need food and protection from bombs; flying worms serve as food, and you must collect them to feed the chicks while shooting bombs that reduce food. When time is up, the next level begins, with increasing difficulty.

meta.name: Beam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.91 KB

Beam is an game in which the player has to link together energy stations. To do so he moves around the playfield and bumps into said stations. Then the last two get linked with a red energy beam which is deadly when touched. Each of the 27 levels is won when all stations are linked.
There are many obstacles which hinder the player's progress, e.g. magnets and high gravity zones which affect the craft's movement or moving balls which should not be touched. The game features to modes of control: direct or rotational (similar to Asteroids).

meta.name: Beamrider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.49 KB

Beamrider es un juego de acción arcade en 3-D. Controlas una nave espacial con la misión de limpiar 99 sectores del espacio de alienígenas hostiles. La nave espacial está situada en la parte inferior de la pantalla y sólo puede detenerse en uno de los cinco haces de luz. Estás armado con láseres y torpedos; Los torpedos son más poderosos y pueden destruir más enemigos en comparación con los láseres, sin embargo, solo obtienes tres por nivel. Para completar un sector, debes destruir quince platillos voladores blancos y después el centinela del sector. Cada sector de número par hasta el sector 16 agregará un nuevo tipo de enemigo al que enfrentarse. Estos enemigos adicionales solo intentarán ralentizar tu misión, porque solo es necesario destruir los platillos volantes para avanzar. Ocasionalmente aparecerá un power-up para ganar una vida extra, pero si le disparas accidentalmente se convertirá en un enemigo mas.

meta.name: Bear Bovver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.46 KB

Bear Bovver stars Ted the Bear, proud owner of a new Sinclair electric truck, but not of a set of batteries for it. Parked outside a building site, he must climb to the top so as to retrieve a set of batteries. The area is patrolled, but you have some bombs to drop in the hope of snaring them. There is a Baby Bear Mode, which allows you to practice negotiating the platforms without coming under threat.

meta.name: Bear George
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.63 KB

Bear George is a brightly colored, family-friendly game with fixed screens that takes you through three distinct stages. First, you help the bear eat as many falling apples as possible while unpredictable squirrels throw nuts and overeating makes him slower and heavier. After that, you guide him through a snowy passage where a frantic skier becomes a constant hazard on the way home. Inside his cave, giant spiders block the path and punish any contact harshly, but if you manage to overcome all dangers, Bear George can finally settle down to hibernate until spring.

meta.name: Beat Ball
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.95 KB

meta.name: Beat It! : Jammin' 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.99 KB

In Beat-it, sequel to Jammin', the player takes the role of the musician Rockin' Rodney (or his girlfriend Rachel) who needs to collect notes to complete his new composition. The notes are found in 60 non-scrolling levels. These are composed of vertically arranged alleys of three different colours. The player can't directly move from one colour to another; two walkways (one from left to right, the other vice versa), which are at the top and bottom of the screen, have to be used.
Enemies have different effects when touched: distorted notes steal already collected real notes, joysticks cause the controls to be reversed and a shrink causes the protagonist to split up. Others turn off the light or cause a life loss. Besides notes there are other positive and negative items to collect or avoid, respectively: cigarettes slow down the walking speed; flowers can be brought to the non-selected player character for extra points.

meta.name: Beatle Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.47 KB

The story of this game was created using a program called The Quill, a text adventure creation program, and is based on a series of Beatles song lyrics. Set in 2953, you are an archive keeper who oversees knowledge of ancient Earth as space pioneers search for a new Earth to colonize. During your research you come across “The Four Kings of EMI” and are fascinated by a computer simulation of a world influenced by the Beatles in Liverpool in the 1960s.
Experience adventures in 150 locations and meet people and places from Beatles songs such as “Maxwell, Who Has a Silver Hammer” and “Penny Lane”. Make sure you take something to eat and drink along the way because you need to maintain your health.

meta.name: Because of a Cat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Who ever thought that going out to buy a bottle of milk would be so much trouble? Facing a challenge at every turn the player must overcome insurmountable odds, including bureaucratic bank staff, transport difficulties, and even a greedy tramp! A must for those that think that life is straightforward.

meta.name: Bedlam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bedlam es un shoot'em-up espacial de desplazamiento vertical.
Un caza espacial dispara a patrones de alienígenas en espiral y cañones estacionarios, recoge extras y lucha contra naves jefes. Bedlam es material de shoot'em-up ordinario, extendido a lo largo de 16 niveles cortos y aderezado con la opción estándar de dos jugadores.

meta.name: Bee 52
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bee 52 puts you in the role of an armed bee navigating a seemingly peaceful but dangerous backyard, where you must collect enough honey each day to meet your quota. On the way to the flowers, insects, spiders, and even sprinklers try to block your progress, forcing you to fight back with stings and shots. Extra tension arises when ants attempt to steal honey from your nest, requiring active defense. The appeal comes from the mix of constant forward motion, combat, and brief power-up moments that noticeably change the pace and intensity of the action.

meta.name: Beer Belly Burt's Brew Biz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.82 KB

Beer Belly Bert in Brew Biz throws you into a completely unhinged brewery overrun by zombies and turns it into a hectic adventure full of platforms, bouncing, and constant pressure. Burt fights his way through shipping, production, and control, moves between many different rooms, collects keys, and constantly has to decide whether to take enemies out or leap over them instead. Extra air vents and nasty traps make sure you are never simply moving straight ahead, but always staying alert. That wild mix of exploration, action, and offbeat premise is exactly what gives the game its distinctive charm.

meta.name: Behind The Front
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.93 KB

In "Behind the Front," players are placed in a military context where they must advance through enemy lines. The main objective is to move through enemy territory, fight off waves of enemy troops, and ultimately locate and destroy the enemy's secret headquarters.

meta.name: Bel Osero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.64 KB

Osero adapts a familiar board game concept to a clean and focused playfield where every placement has immediate consequences. The goal is to outmaneuver the opponent by flipping pieces and gradually gaining control of the board. Forward planning, recognizing turning points and exploiting chain reactions determine success or failure – calm in pace, yet tactically demanding right up to the final move.

meta.name: Bellringer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.45 KB

You are the Bellringer, whose mission is to find your way through four sections of a castle. The sections are separated by four thick brick walls which need to be lowered by ringing four bells in the correct order. There are eight bells at the end of each castle section, and all except one of them will lower one wall and raise another when you pull their rope. You need to be positioned just below a bell and then jump straight up in order to pull its rope.

meta.name: Bellringer II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.63 KB

You are the bell ringer and your goal is to collect as many bags of gold as possible from four castle towers. Each bag earns you 750 points. You climb the towers using ladders and reach the top by pulling up the last ladder after ringing five of eight bells in the correct order. Each correct bell raises the ladder a little; if you ring incorrectly, it lowers and you must ring the previous correct bell again. Once the ladder is fully raised, you can climb the tower. Before the next tower, you will receive a bonus of at least 1000 points depending on the number of bells. Beware of the evil knights who will drain your health if you get too close to them. In one of the towers there is a small yellow box to replenish your health. The game restarts when you have completed all four towers without resetting your points and ends when you lose health.

meta.name: Bellringer III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are the bellringer and must fight your way through various castles, collecting as many bags of gold as possible, each of which will give you 750 points. Avoid the evil knights and enemies who reduce your health with arrows, other objects or boiling water. A yellow chest can refill your health. The game ends when your health is depleted or you fall into the fire at the end of a castle. You can defeat enemies with limited magic, which you can occasionally refill in the castle. At the end of each castle there are eight bells; you must ring four of them in the correct order to lower walls and extend bridges. Once all walls are lowered and bridges extended, you can leave the castle and receive a bonus of at least 1000 points.

meta.name: Below the Root
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Below the Root draws you into the world of Green-Sky, a lush land of towering trees where the Kindar dwell high in the branches, while the Erdling were banished to tunnels beneath the roots. The fragile peace between these peoples is now threatened, and it is up to you to uncover the secret that will decide the fate of this world. The story unfolds through a blend of narrative depth and direct interaction, supported by hundreds of colorful visuals and a distinctive text menu that keeps decisions flowing smoothly. You choose one of several characters, each with unique abilities that shape how you explore Green-Sky and how the story develops.

meta.name: Below the Root

meta.name: Benji - Space Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.23 KB

In "Benji: Space Rescue," your mission is to rescue scientists held captive by robotic drones somewhere in the solar system and bring them safely back to Earth. In the engine room, you select the target planet and adjust warp and jump settings to travel faster or slower. While exploring a planet's surface, your ship's alarm warns you of enemy movement. Drones attack with lasers, and you can defend yourself using torpedoes or phasers. While transporting the scientists, you must provide them with rations to ensure their survival. Your fuel depletes constantly, so you'll need to refuel in orbit. Higher ranks require rescuing more scientists, navigating asteroid fields, and completing more challenging missions. Your time is limited — if you run out of stardays or fuel, the game is over.

meta.name: Bering
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.50 KB

meta.name: Berserker Raids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You and a fellow Prince of the Empire of Man are trapped with your fleets in the Tyriarus Nebula, Together you must deal with a Berserker wolf pack- then, if you both have survived, you must deal with each other! If you attack too late your fellow human win get you! The opportunities for treachery will be endless!

meta.name: Bert the Bug Bites Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.54 KB

Bert the Bug must go around a garden and retrieve twenty of the wizard's scrolls. This task is made difficult by killer toy mouses, fire extinguishers, kettles, and umbrellas that roam every square inch of the garden. Bert can bite back by shooting bullets at them. He loses one of his lives if he makes contact with one of the enemies or if he collides with a wall. Once Bert has collected the twenty spells, he can cast it so that the farmer runs away.

meta.name: Berzerk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.01 KB

Berzerk traps you on an alien world of endless mazes swarming with killer robots. They're fast, relentless, and shoot on sight. Your only hope is to stay calm, shoot faster, and dodge smarter. Each room brings fresh danger – but cool nerves and sharp reflexes mean big points. A punishing top-down shooter that never lets up.

meta.name: Berzerk Redux
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Berzerk Redux is a surprisingly polished homebrew remake of the arcade classic. Navigate deadly mazes filled with hostile robots that fire instantly. Quick reflexes and smart shooting are your only chance. Just like the original, it features digitized speech – including lines like “Intruder alert!” – and a catchy SID tune on the title screen. Classic arcade tension, tight controls, and retro charm brought back to life.

meta.name: Besieged
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.19 KB

Besieged is an educational game from the Sulis Software series, focusing on the quirks of English spelling. Your goal is to guide your crusading knight across a ravine to relieve the besieged city. Each correctly spelled word ensures a safe crossing, while every mistake gives the infidels an advantage. Tricky words such as “asthma,” “miscellaneous,” or “ancillary” are part of the challenge, combining spelling practice with the tension of defending your city.
meta.developer: M.C. Harding, C.P. Beesley & M.K. Hobbs

n: Best of Chess - Volume I - American Triumph (USA)

meta.name: Best of Chess : Volume I : American Triumph
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Best of Chess: Volume I: American Triumph" is an early chess program notable for its extensive learning content. The player can replay Bobby Fischer's games interactively by guessing the moves, offering an educational and engaging way to explore the grandmaster's strategies.

meta.name: Betrayal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 68.94 KB

Betrayal is a manager type strategy game. You try to gain control over various regions in order to supply your men with the necessary resources to defeat your enemies. As the game title says, the game has a main focus on illegal and secret operations in order to weaken your opponents.

meta.name: Better Dead Than Alien!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Better Dead Than Alien! delivers direct, uncompromising space action, putting you in control of a ship that can move freely across the lower part of the screen while fighting off dense alien formations. Individual attackers repeatedly break away from the pack, extra dangers such as splitting asteroids or powerful boss enemies keep the pressure high, and valuable power-ups can make all the difference at the right moment. Because you only get a single chance and careful survival matters just as much as scoring hits, the game creates a gripping flow that rewards constant focus and smart risk-taking.

meta.name: Beverly Hills Cop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eddie Murphy se hizo famoso con Policía de Beverly Hills, y Tynesoft aprovechó la licencia para crear un juego con cuatro minijuegos —en algunas versiones, practicables directamente desde el menú principal.
Primero, Axel Foley irrumpe en un almacén: acción al estilo Green Beret, disparando entre cajas y sombras.
Luego (o primero, en C64), persigues tres camiones cargados de armas al estilo Chase HQ: derriba uno a uno, evita choques y mantente en la carretera.
Después, cruzas los jardines de una mansión a tiros, eliminando a cualquiera que se interponga.
Y por último… entras al edificio: una secuencia en 3D en primera persona, minimalista pero tensa —ángulos limitados, un solo enemigo en pantalla, y adrenalina pura.
Caos, coches y carcajadas: puro espíritu Axel Foley, versión 8 bits.

meta.name: Beyond Castle Wolfenstain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your mission is to infiltrate Nazi headquarters in disguise, find the bomb agents have hidden there, and plant it outside the door to Hitler's bunker. If you go in shooting everything in sight, a guard is bound to raise the alarm and it's unlikely you'll complete the mission. Use stealth and the occasional bribe to work your way to Hitler. You might have to kill a few guards, but think before you do. Oh, and did we mention you have to escape the way you came before the bomb explodes?

meta.name: Beyond Dark Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Beyond Dark Castle continues the story of Dark Castle, following the now-named hero Prince Duncan. After toppling the Black Knight, he finds himself with Merlin's help in a hidden chamber behind the throne, where five pedestals await magical orbs. Your mission is to collect all five orbs to open the gate to the final showdown with the Black Knight. There are 15 new levels, including for the first time five scrolling ones such as Swamp and Black Forest. New features like a helicopter pack, bombs, labyrinths, and various weapons expand the gameplay. A health system replaces instant death, with elixirs and food restoring energy, and progress can be saved in the castle's Computer Room. With practice and advanced modes, plus alternative endings, the adventure offers far more depth and variety than its predecessor.

meta.name: Beyond Dark Castle
meta.desc:

meta.name: Beyond The Black Hole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Beyond the Black Hole sends you on a mission into space to uncover the disappearance of Vern Grenington and his entire station. Controlling an orb designed to feel like a classic video game, you advance through level after level. At the center of the screen, formations of objects appear that must be eliminated with skill and precision, though some stages require a more subtle approach. Step by step, your journey takes you deeper into the mysteries of the Black Hole looming ahead.

meta.name: Beyond the Forbidden Forest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Beyond the Forbidden Forest expands the familiar setting with an unusual sense of time, as the environment visibly shifts from bright daylight to star-filled night, creating a distinct atmosphere. You move freely through the forest, even beyond the visible screen, facing increasingly dangerous creatures with bow and arrows to earn valuable golden arrows. These arrows are both reward and risk, since each death cuts your supply in half. Once enough are gathered, access to dark caves is unlocked, introducing new threats and ultimately a powerful final foe that must be defeated with careful strategy – a constant balance of hunting, caution, and progression.

meta.name: Beyond the Ice Palace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La leyenda «Mas allá del Palacio de Hielo y hacia el Norte» cuenta la historia de una tierra mística donde viven extrañas criaturas. Es una tierra de fantasía y magia, de duendes y espíritus, de dioses y diablos.
Este lugar está siendo arrasado por una terrible guerra entre las fuerzas del bien y el mal, guerra que los espíritus de la luz están perdiendo.
En un último intento por restablecer el orden, los Espíritus de los Bosques se reunen con el Consejo de Ancianos y, entre todos, bendicen una flecha que lanzan al aire. Aquel que la encuentre se verá inmerso en una gran aventura, pues sobre sus hombros caerá la misión de terminar, de una vez por todas, con la desolación y la oscuridad.

meta.name: Biathlon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.09 KB

A winter sport game that combines cross-country skiing and rifle shooting. It is treated as a race, with contestants skiing through a cross-country snow trail whose distance is divided into shooting rounds. Released in the UK as part of the Golden Oldies compilation.

meta.name: Biff
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.49 KB

Biff isn't a nice chimp as he keeps being rude to his Mother, but his Mother has had enough and kicked him out of the family home. Realising he has nowhere to sleep and is starting to feel cold, Biff has decided to be nice to his Mother by doing various tasks around the jungle and hopefully be allowed to come back home. In this flick-screen arcade adventure platform game, you must find and use various objects and place them in their correct locations to complete tasks which are told to you on the screen. The tasks need to also be done in the correct order so objects that are required next flash to let you know. As you explore the jungle there are various creatures and when touched will decrease your energy and when this is empty it is game over. Also on the screen is a percentage of the game completed.

meta.name: Big Ben
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.81 KB

Big Ben is a platform game where you play as Giz, trying to escape a space complex. The evil wizard Jem has trapped you and will only release you if you ring Big Ben's bell, locked behind a tunnel that opens once you collect 30 gold coins. You'll face moving and shifting platforms, deadly traps, and patrolling helicopters that must be avoided. Giz can jump, crawl, climb poles, and use green buttons to reach higher levels. A turbo plane also helps you travel, but it has limited fuel and can only land on special pads. If you die on foot or in the plane, you lose one of five lives, but any coins you collected are kept.

meta.name: Big Bird's Funhouse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.82 KB

Big Bird's Funhouse takes you on a playful journey through a colourful house filled with activities focused on memory, matching, and observation. Alongside Big Bird, you search for hidden friends, remember patterns, and tackle varied challenges that gradually increase in difficulty. Different modes keep each session fresh while helping develop attention and recall skills. The experience blends learning with fun – a friendly game that encourages curiosity, pattern recognition, and playful discovery.

meta.name: Big Bird's Special Delivery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Big Bird's Special Delivery is a computer game for preschool children that allows the player to practice classifying objects. In a playful environment with shops, Big Bird and Little Bird work to deliver mail to one of four locations. This computer activity aims to develop children's understanding of form and function. The objects are controlled by pressing one of three keys on the computer keyboard to control Little Bird. When a game round is completed, the shops will light up after the mail has been delivered correctly. If there is a mail mix-up, store owners gently point out mistakes and encourage the child to try again.
