In The Big Deal: Floyd the Droid on Food you work in a busy kitchen and help the robot Floyd prepare incoming orders. Instead of controlling him directly, you queue his actions through a menu system and decide which tasks he should perform in sequence. Each meal requires several steps such as collecting ingredients, cutting them or preparing the plates. Efficiency is crucial, because if customers wait too long they become impatient and start causing trouble in the restaurant. Damaged equipment must be repaired, which takes even more time. Up to three meals can be programmed in advance, while an in-game cookbook helps you keep track of the recipes.

meta.name: Big Game Fishing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Finally, after many months of hard work in the busy metropolis, you have decided to treat yourself to a vacation in the clear waters of the South Seas where you can indulge in your favorite sport: GREAT GAME FISHING! But the locals won't miss a chance to make some money from you: if you don't want your vacation to end in one day, not only will you have to catch a significant amount of fish, but the type and quantity of fish will also increase required at the beginning of each day. If you fail, you won't be able to pay the cost of your boat and purchasing gas, bait, etc.
So if you rent a boat for around $60, you will be ready to catch predatory fish like black marlin, blue marlin, swordfish or tuna. Gameplay includes economic and strategic management in port or open waters, as well as fishing simulation in the sea.

meta.name: The Big KO
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Big KO! is a boxing game which gives you the chance to fight eight other boxers from Heap Big Nose to Cheap N' Nasty to become champion. You are able to name your fighter before showing you your stats of you strengths and weaknesses. The fight is shown from the side with the whole ring shown on the screen and your fighter is on the left. You can move left or right along the ring and you can either throw a left or right hook to your opponents head, or a left or right jab to his body. Every hit that connects gives the boxer a score and a KO bar increases but this decreases every time a punch is missed with a strength bar decreasing when a boxer moves and throws punches. Once the KO bar fills up then the next punch will knock down the other boxer and the fight is won. Each fight lasts three rounds and as well as winning by knockout, the fighter with the most points wins if there is no knockout. If you win the fight then you receive a code word which allows you to load the next fighter. Two players are able to play and player two plays as the fighter that has been loaded in.

p: Big Mac - The Mad Maintenance Man (Europe).T64
n: Big Mac - The Mad Maintenance Man (Europe)

meta.name: Big Mac
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.95 KB

In Big Mac, players must flip all the switches in a room and get to the exit in order to proceed to the next level. Various obstacles and puzzles stand in the way.
Though the box art refers to it as "More Adventures of Big Mac: The Mad Maintenance Man," the in-game title screen simply calls it "Big Mac: The Mad Maintenance Man."

meta.name: Big Mad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.32 KB

Big Mad is a fast-paced platform game that sends players on an exciting mission: they must grab a magic ring and safely reach the level exit before time runs out. Every second counts, as the clock is constantly ticking against the player, providing an extra adrenaline rush. The gameplay of Big Mad combines quick reflexes with strategic planning. The levels are carefully designed to challenge players with various platforms, jumps and obstacles. The path to the exit is rarely direct, so players must skillfully navigate through complex layouts, find the ring and move to the next level entrance as quickly as possible.

meta.name: The Big Sleaze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the mirror across the office I caught sight of my reflection. I looked like a deadbeat punk. That made me sore, real sore. So I pulled my rod and emptied six slugs into that ugly mug. It was a dumb thing to do but, hell, it made me feel better. Then the phone rang. I slammed one hand down on the edge of the receiver to make it flip into my hand. But something went wrong. The handset spun across the room and through the open window. I leaned out over the street below. The handset was hanging by its cord one floor down. So I figured I'd have to shout. "Spillade Investigations, whaddaya want" I yelled. It was the start of something big...

meta.name: Big Trouble in Little China
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.52 KB

Big Trouble in Little China pits you against the sinister plans of Lo Pan, who has kidnapped two green-eyed women for an ancient ritual. You alternate between three heroes – Jack Burton, Wang Chi and Egg Shen – each with unique abilities and weapons that must be found or replenished, while a Yin and Yang symbol displays their energy. Food, swords, ammunition and magic potions determine their strength. Together they fight through Chinatown, dark sewers and Lo Pan's lair to the final showdown in the marriage chamber – only by combining their strengths wisely can you defeat Lo Pan and rescue the captives.

meta.name: Bigfoot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.95 KB

Footsy the Bigfoot has vowed to rescue his girlfriend, who has been locked inside a cage by a sadistic madman. To set her free, Footsy must blow the lock open using TNT, but the only problem with this is that there are two breaks in the cable that need to be repaired. So Footsy has to walk through a series of environments in an attempt to repair the cable. In the meantime, he has to jump over lava pools, throw rocks at swarms of bees, and eat spinach and fairy cakes to replenish energy he may lose along the way.

meta.name: Biggles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

WE Johns’ tales of a brave World War 1 pilot were updated for a 1980s feature film, with a plot involving Jim, Biggles’ brother who lives in that era. Jim travels back through time to warn Biggles of a spectacular weapon the Germans have created, with the intention of changing history – for the worse.
The game is split into two separate games, and the first of these is itself split into three sub-games. The first of these is a side-view flight game, in which you must shoot down and dodge Fokkers who come at you from the right of the screen in your rickety plane, with a machine gun and bombs on board. Part two is set in modern-day London, and the characters must jump across a network of roofs in order to obtain a secret code. There are guards to avoid, and big gaps between roofs to avoid. The third part is a side-view game inspired by Green Beret, with a gun to fire at encroaching enemies, gameplay on multiple vertical levels, and grenades to collect. Lose a life in any of these and you will cycle back through them.
The second game is a more serious flight simulation however. A helicopter is beamed back in time for our intrepid hero to use. You must first go to the Allied camp to get the secret weapon’s location (and you will need the password from part one of the game for this), and then head to that location to destroy it and save the world.

meta.name: Bignoses USA Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bignoses USA Adventure puts you in the shoes of Big Nose the Caveman, mysteriously transported to modern-day New York City. Shocked by animals kept in cages, you vow to free them. You journey across three scrolling levels – Manhattan, the Wild West and the Golden Gate Bridge – dodging or shooting hostile humans and creatures. Every hit costs one of your three lives, and you control the action via joystick or keyboard.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Bigtop Barney
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.50 KB

Eres el payaso Barney y tu objetivo es entretener al público del circo con cuatro números (dificultad creciente). Puedes elegir cualquier acto a realizar, así como el número de vidas, la dificultad y variar la puntuación. Los actos que realizas se ven todos de perfil y son los siguientes:
Acto 1: Debes caminar por una cuerda floja durante 100 m en un tiempo limitado con la pantalla desplazándose constantemente. Aparecen monos y aros de fuego, hay que pisar los monos y saltar los aros. 
Acto 2: Tienes que recoger diez globos mientras evitas ser golpeado por el forzudo, Otto, que se pasea por la pantalla. 
Acto 3: Estás en un monociclo y tienes que recorrer 100 m en un tiempo limitado, la pantalla se desplaza constantemente de derecha a izquierda.
Acto 4: El último acto se desarrolla en una sola pantalla. Rebotas en uno de los tres trampolines, pero puedes saltar de uno a otro para recoger llaves.

meta.name: Bike Hike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

An educational memory game from Learning Technologies and released in 1985 featuring colorful characters you meet while on a bike ride.
The player goes on a bike ride, and as they peddle about in the park they see a number of items, including: trash bins, rabbits, frogs, deer, flowers, and more. After the bike ride, the player must remember which items they saw, how many, and they are graded on the quality of their memory. The player can choose short or long bike rides, and the number of items progressively increases as the game continues.

p: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.name: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juego basado en la película de 1989 "Las Excelentes Aventuras de Bill y Ted" (Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure).
El jugador controla a Bill y Ted mientras viajan a través de diferentes períodos de la historia, recogen objetos y hablan con los locales para tratar de encontrar personajes históricos para su presentación oral de un trabajo escolar. Como en el film, si el jugador no termina el juego en un determinado tiempo, fallará en su trabajo escolar y por consiguiente se pierde el juego.

p: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
n: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure (USA) (Disk 1 Side B)

meta.name: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juego basado en la película de 1989 "Las Excelentes Aventuras de Bill y Ted" (Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure).
El jugador controla a Bill y Ted mientras viajan a través de diferentes períodos de la historia, recogen objetos y hablan con los locales para tratar de encontrar personajes históricos para su presentación oral de un trabajo escolar. Como en el film, si el jugador no termina el juego en un determinado tiempo, fallará en su trabajo escolar y por consiguiente se pierde el juego.

meta.name: Billboard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pat Splatt, the best poster painter in Groove Town, has a lot to do. After spending all day putting up posters yesterday, he found out that his rival Nasty Norville screwed them up. You take on the role of Pat, who tries to return the posters to normal within a certain time limit. Before playing the game, you can choose which level you want to play from twelve levels. These are divided into three groups: Kids Stuff, Smart Alec and Mensa Only. Each level is more difficult than the last but has a higher time limit. The first poster is just a 2x2 grid while the last poster is 8x8. When one of these is completed, you will see a checkmark next to the level you completed. You can attempt any level at any time and if you fail one, you can try again later.

meta.name: Billiard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.42 KB

"Billiard" is a classic game of skill in which the aim is to sink the balls into the pockets with precision and tactics. The player must use the cue skillfully and hit the balls in a targeted manner in order to reach the best possible position and sink as many balls as possible. With clear rules and the familiar goal of sinking all the balls into the table, "Billiard" challenges players to carefully plan their shot direction, strength and angle. Any wrong move can make the next move more difficult, so a cool head and a steady hand are required.

meta.name: Billy the Postman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.60 KB

Billy the Postman turns the daily mail run into a completely over-the-top drive filled with obstacles and attacks. In your postal land yacht, you have to dodge bird droppings, shoot down troublesome vehicles and flying machines, and push through anything that gets between you and your route. The goal stays clear throughout: the mail must arrive, no matter how chaotic the journey becomes. This odd premise creates a fast action game that blends humor, constant fire, and wild delivery pressure.

meta.name: Bingo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.64 KB

In Bingo, you play a digital version of the classic lottery game. Randomly drawn numbers are automatically marked on the board. You can play with up to four cards at once, earning prizes for completed lines and full cards (Bingo). The gameplay is entirely chance-based, capturing the suspense of waiting for the next number just like in a real bingo hall.

meta.name: Bingo Bugglebee Presents - Home Alone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Bingo Bugglebee Presents: Home Alone“ ist ein pädagogisches Quizspiel, bei dem du auch dann gewinnen kannst, wenn du den „Buzzer“ bekommst.

meta.name: Bingo Construction Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bingo Construction Kit is a customizable bingo game for the C64, where players mark off numbers on 5x5 cards to match specific patterns. It can be played in text or graphics mode and supports up to 99 players. You can design and print your own bingo cards, set the draw delay, and pause the game to check for winners – making it perfect for large groups or personalized bingo events.

meta.name: Biology Test : 'O' Level
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.77 KB

Biology Test: 'O' Level is a collection of multiple-choice questions designed to help students practice for their exams. The questions are selected randomly from a pool and continue until the player ends the session. At the end, you receive a score summary. The goal is to test your knowledge of biological topics such as theories, concepts, and scientific discoveries, reinforcing what you've learned in an engaging way.

meta.name: Bionic Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Bionic Commando, el jugador toma el control de un soldado con un brazo biónico que se extiende y se contrae. El brazo biónico permite al soldado agarrarse a objetos fijos, balancearse y subir niveles. El brazo también puede agarrar a los adversarios y tirar de ellos hacia el protagonista.
La misión del jugador es asaltar la fortaleza del enemigo y destruir el ordenador que le permite utilizar su arma letal.

meta.name: Bionic Granny
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.99 KB

Bionic Granny is a top view single screen game where you play the role of a Bionic Granny who likes nothing better to do than wait outside a school at 4 o'clock and wait for the children. Once the children leave the school you have to move left or right on the bottom of the screen and hit them with your walking stick by touching the children as they pass you over various levels. There are three roads going down the screen where the children will walk but some move around the screen randomly. A Lollipop Lady moves around the screen and will throw lollipop sticks at you which need avoiding or you lose one of three lives. Once you hit a certain number of children then you move onto the next level.

meta.name: Bionic Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.59 KB

Los alienígenas están atacando la base de defensa terrestre Icarus y la ocuparán en hora y media. Juegas como un ninja biónico y debes utilizar diversas artes marciales, así como shruiken y espadas, para destruir o evitar a los distintos ocupantes de la base. Si alguno de los enemigos te golpea o dispara, pierdes parte de tu barra de energía y, si se agota, pierdes una de tus cinco vidas. Puedes recoger energía extra por el camino. Cada nivel se divide en dos secciones que deben completarse en un tiempo determinado.

meta.name: Bionik Granny Returns
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Bionik Granny Returns you once again play as the grumpy granny heading to the post office to collect her pension. But the modern world annoys her: people pushing, shoving, and getting in her way. So she grabs her cane and strikes back. After hitting at least five people, a coin appears to collect. Then the cycle begins again. Avoid hazards like thrown objects and survive each level. At the end of each stage, help granny cross the road and get her pension to move on.

meta.name: Bird Mother
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.44 KB

Bird Mother is a side-view game in which you play as a bird and raise a family of chicks, consisting of three parts. First, you build a nest to lay three eggs, feed the hatched chicks and finally help them fly. Obstacles must be avoided or you will lose one of three lives. In the first part, you collect twigs for the nest, in the second, you catch insects to feed the hungry chicks. In the last part, you help the chicks stay in the air until they can fly on their own, avoiding pushing them too high to avoid being caught by a bird of prey.

meta.name: The Birds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A straight-ahead shooter without much complexity. You are a grand avian being flying over a beautiful coral reef but your way is blocked by other birds, dragons and sea-salt encrusted sea creatures that leap and bite at you. Your only hope is your short-range blast attack. Send feathers flying and gain points and the ability to proceed forward on your quest. If you have a bird who's loud song has been waking you up too early in the mornings this would certainly be a way to blow off some steam as you blast these seabirds to bits. May your aim be true or the next shriek you hear could be your own!

meta.name: Bismarck : The North Sea Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.61 KB

Bismarck es un video de estrategia por turnos. En el juego, el jugador puede elegir entre controlar el acorazado alemán Bismarck o comandar la flota de buques de la Marina Real que lo persigue. Mayo de 1941, Operación Rheinübung. El acorazado alemán Bismarck intenta eludir a la flota aliada para escapar del Atlántico Norte y realizar incursiones marítimas contra los convoyes de suministro aliados. El jugador puede tomar el mando del bando británico o alemán. Puede realizar búsquedas aéreas en el mapa, consultar el pronóstico del tiempo, mover sus barcos, disparar sus cañones de cubierta y torpedos, y controlar las reparaciones durante la batalla. También puede pilotar el Fairey Swordfish y lanzar un torpedo. Los alemanes ganan si el Bismarck escapa sano y salvo hacia el sur o regresa a Francia tras hundir barcos enemigos.

meta.name: Bismark
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.44 KB

A one player implementation of the traditional game that used to be played with pen and paper but which is more often played as a board game these days. Released as part of the "30 Games" game pack. This implementation gives the player and the PC a carrier, destroyer, battleship, PT boat and a submarine which must be placed on a 10x10 grid. Ships may be placed horizontally or vertically on this grid by specifying a start co-ordinate and whether the ship is to be placed Up, Down, left or Right from that point. Ships can be re-positioned if necessary, they are not locked into place until the player presses ESC. When both players have placed their fleet they take turns to fire at the other player's grid. If it's a hit the player is informed. All tiles that a ship occupies must be hit, before a ship is sunk. The first player to sink all the other's ships wins.

meta.name: Bit Exorcist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The ghosts have left their estates in old mansions and have moved into the circuits of your computer. Your task is to find and destroy them, as well as repair the damaged chips. Each level contains more ghosts and becomes more complex. You control a small vehicle on the circuits, equipped with an anti-ectoplasm bean to deal with the ghosts, and you can detect damaged circuits on the radar. Damaged chips can be repaired by correctly directing the signal flow using the arrow keys. More details about this can be found in the note at the beginning of the game.

meta.name: Bite of the Sorority Vampires
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.77 KB

Bite of the Sorority Vampires pulls you into an eerie campus mystery where a friend's disappearance is tied to a suspicious sorority. As a member of the school newspaper, you follow leads, question people, and explore locations while a dark secret gradually comes to light. Choices, careful observation, and piecing together clues shape how far you descend into a web of rumors, temptation, and danger. The appeal lies in the slow reveal of the truth and the unsettling atmosphere that blurs the line between normal life and horror.

meta.name: Bitmania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.41 KB

Bitmania is a vertical scrolling shooter where you move around a screen destroying as many Bits as you can on your journey to the Central core of your Commodore 64. Your ship is inside a data-bus amongst the Neuron Flow and you must keep shooting the Bits and when shot they leave behind a Pod which also needs shooting over various waves. Once you have shot enough Pods then you move to another wave but if you are hit by a Bit then you lose one of three lives. Before the game you can select the speed (1-3) with one being the slowest, and the skill level (0-29) with the higher skill levels having more Bits on screen.

meta.name: Bizy-Beezzzz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are Teddy and on the way to the teddybears picnic you have got lost in a forest and you are getting hungry. As you look for the way out you discover a giant beehive full of honey so you have decided to enter the hive and collect all the honey over 16 levels. Bizy BeeZZzz is a single screen platform game where you start on the bottom right corner and you must collect the honey from various pots scattered around on the screen. You use ladders to climb to higher platforms with lifts moving up or down on later levels, and gaps have to be jumped. Giant bees patrol the hive and these can only move over platforms and up or down the ladders and if you touch one or fall through a gap then you lose one of five lives. If you don't collect all the honey before a timer reaches zero then a larger bee appears and kills you. Once all the honey is collected on a screen then you move to the next level but you can select any level at the start of the game.

meta.name: Black & White
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A board game also known as Abalone. Players are represented by opposing black and white marbles on a hexagonal board with the objective of pushing six of the opponent's marbles off the edge of the board.

meta.name: Black
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.10 KB

Black is a 2-player board game for the Commodore 64. Played on a 4 x 4 - 8 x 8 board, players take turns placing movement pieces on the board. This can make a marker dropped from the top left corner of the screen move straight, bend left, or bend right. Players take turns dropping a piece at the ending location of the marker. If the player allows the marker to roll off the board or land in the bottom right square, they lose.

meta.name: Black Belt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Black Belt attempts to accurately simulate Taekwon-Do sparring matches and closely follows standard sparring rules. Sparring matches allow computer opponents of varying difficulty levels, which affect the opponent's speed, fatigue, form and intelligence. Certain moves are only allowed to players with sufficient skill. Players can choose between 9 different kicks, 3 different punches and blocks and move in 4 cardinal directions.
The gameplay allows for a roster of multiple characters. As the player achieves a higher belt rank by defeating more experienced opponents. For each successful attack or block the player receives one point. Players can receive warnings when they leave the mat, face the opponent, make an illegal shot, or stall play. A player loses a point for every 2 warnings and is disqualified if he receives 6 warnings.

meta.name: The Black Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.63 KB

In Black Box there is an 8x8 grid which contains several atoms hidden in it. Your job is to find the location of all of the atoms by projecting rays from the side of the box and observing what happens. If a ray directly hits an atom it will be absorbed. Rays that pass within one box of an atom will be reflected. After you have fired enough rays, you can venture a guess as to an atoms location. To help prevent random guessing you lose points for a ray that completely misses an atom or an incorrect guess about the atoms location, and gain points for rays that are absorbed or reflected and for a correct guess. If you get stumped you can end the game early and peek at the location of all atoms.

meta.name: Black Crystal 1-4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Darkness has fallen on the kingdom of Beroth. The evil Tobias has summoned the Black Crystal to take revenge on the Wizarding Brotherhood for refusing him entry. With the Black Crystal in his hand, he is able to bring down the kingdom. It is up to the player to venture through the many realms of the kingdom and recover the seven rings of creation so that they can banish Tobias and his minions and destroy the Black Crystal.

meta.name: Oil Imperium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oil Imperium turns the struggle over resources into a biting economic war in which four oil companies fight across the globe for power, influence, and profit. It is not just about smartly buying and selling oil fields, but also about sabotage, espionage, and other dirty tricks that let you slow your rivals down. That blend of strategic planning, aggressive competition, and short action-driven segments gives the game a distinctive appeal, because success here never feels clean – it always carries a touch of ruthlessness.

meta.name: Black Hawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.88 KB

Black Hawk sends you on deadly runs over enemy island bases packed with tanks, missile launchers, and fighter planes. First, you take control of a guided missile camera, scouting targets and choosing the perfect moment to strike – but anything you miss will come for you later. In the second phase, it's full-on Xevious-style action as you pilot the jet directly, facing everything you failed to destroy before. The quest to inflict maximum Strategic Loss becomes a nerve-wracking test of precision, timing, and firepower.

meta.name: Black Hole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.65 KB

Black Hole is an immersive shooter with vector graphics effects, inspired by the title sequence of the Disney film Black Hole. The game's visual style draws on the film's surreal, shifting geometric shapes and futuristic look. Players navigate a universe filled with dynamic vector patterns and recurring lighting effects that honor the film's iconic design. Gameplay requires quick reactions and precision as you maneuver through a rotating maze of obstacles and enemies. The hypnotic patterns and intense colors heighten the tension and give Black Hole a unique, nostalgic appeal.

meta.name: Black Hole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.36 KB

Black Hole is a small action game featuring Snoopy and Woodstock. Woodstock has fallen out of his tree again, and you must help him back up. Using the latest ACME Corp Jet Pac, you guide him upwards while avoiding dangerous apples. If you fail to get him safely to the tree, he will fall into the dark hole below and be lost forever.

meta.name: Black Holes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Black Holes is a unique shoot'em up. The game offers an exciting mix of different genres, which sets it apart from classic shmups of its time. In Black Holes, players experience varied gameplay that changes dynamically and combines elements from traditional shooter and arcade genres. The game challenges players to navigate a universe full of black holes and cosmic dangers. Each level has new challenges and different mechanics - from classic shoot'em up sections to elements that require strategic thinking and quick reactions. This cross-genre approach ensures variety and makes Black Holes an exciting experience in which the gameplay is constantly changing.

meta.name: Black Hornet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Black Hornet puts you in the cockpit of an advanced stealth fighter capable of striking silently and escaping just as fast. Sent in as a last resort against a global threat, you battle through hostile airspace filled with enemies and ground installations determined to bring you down. Alongside aerial targets, buildings and vehicles can also be destroyed, as your mission takes you across deserts, valleys, mountains, over the sea, and even into space – speed, awareness, and precise attacks determine whether you succeed.

meta.name: Black It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The goal of BLACK IT! consists of changing the color of all the stones on the playing field so that at the end there are none left. The stones can have different colors, which - as can be seen on the right edge of the picture - have different priorities. If the ball is now moved over a stone, it changes color according to the pattern mentioned above and finally disappears completely. When all the stones are colored, all you have to do is direct the ball onto a black field and you're on to the next level. If you enter a black square and there are still stones left, you lose one of your five lives. In addition, time is on the player's neck. Once you've beaten all 50 levels or collected just enough points, you can immortalize yourself with a clean high score. The game is controlled via a joystick in Port 2. All levels can be solved, even if this may sometimes seem a bit difficult. Good luck puzzling!

meta.name: Black Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.51 KB

Black Knight sends you on a breakneck quest for gold and glory. First you thunder across the countryside on horseback, dodging chasms, potholes, lightning, and fireballs while hoping your mount clears every jump. Then you continue on foot – leaping over collapsing gaps and facing a giant serpent with nothing but your blade. Finally you confront a treacherous dwarf before you can claim the treasure you've been chasing.

meta.name: The Black Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 59.06 KB

The evil Black Knight has ripped through the valley and destroyed buildings and killed and captured the people. You are the hero who will find and kill the Knight and bring order back to the valley. You must search the surrounding areas to get the objects and weapons needed before entering a castle, kill the guards before defeating The Black Knight. Black Knight Adventure is a a text adventure that has text on screen that describes your location. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

meta.name: Black Lamp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Black Lamp is a platform games. Jack, under the player's control, has to run, jump, climb and shoot his way through the kingdom of Allegoria in search of nine different coloured lamps, while under constant assault by all manner of creatures. Eight of the nine lamps may be found randomly scattered around the kingdom (in locations which change with each new game), but the ninth lamp, the black lamp, is guarded by a dragon which must be defeated before the lamp can be recovered. Each lamp must be returned to one of several lamp racks in the kingdom. As the player can only carry a single lamp at a time, this can mean a lot of traveling back and forth. Once all the lamps have been returned to the rack, the level is complete, and the player advances to the next level. The game takes place across a series of static and scrolling rooms, which are connected by doorways leading into the foreground or background, as well as up down, left and right.

meta.name: Black Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El hechicero Zahgrim ha convertido en piedra al hechicero Aganar, le ha quitado sus seis ojos y los ha colocado en distintas partes del país para que puedan ver la destrucción que se avecina. El jugador tendrá que encontrar los seis globos oculares repartidos por el país, avanzar en la magia y enfrentarse a Zahgrim.
El área principal del juego se ve desde un lateral, con la pantalla desplazándose en varias direcciones a medida que te mueves. Comienzas tu búsqueda en la superficie de la tierra como un aprendiz armado con un número limitado de flechas y dos tipos de hechizos. En tu búsqueda, deberás explorar la tierra en la superficie, pero también bajo tierra en zonas conectadas por escaleras. Durante tu exploración te encontrarás con muchas criaturas. Si te golpean o te disparan, perderás parte de tu medidor de salud. La comida se puede utilizar o almacenar para su uso posterior.
meta.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción

meta.name: Black Panther
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Black Panther is a classic one-on-one fighting game where two warriors face off in intense duels. Various moves like backflips, forward rolls, or roundhouse kicks are executed through directional inputs combined with short or long button presses. Attacks can target high, mid, or low, while blocks and evasions require precise timing. Those who read their opponent's behavior and master their own attack range have the best chances of winning. Victory is decided either by knockout or by inflicting the most damage before time runs out.

meta.name: The Black Pearl
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.06 KB

In The Black Pearl you step into the role of a skilled hunter venturing into an unknown land filled with mystery and danger. Left on your own, you must explore carefully, make decisions, and piece together clues to progress. Information is often subtle, requiring attention and deduction to solve the challenges ahead. The atmosphere is driven by the combination of text and simple visuals that bring this unfamiliar world to life.

In Black Thunder, you play as the superhuman Crow-Ther, fighting to escape the grip of The Wizard, who has spent a century preparing for your downfall. Driving an armored car loaded with cannons and missiles, you must navigate Wizening's massive highway system to survive. The top half of the screen shows your vehicle from the side, where you control speed and firepower. The bottom half offers a top-down map, letting you choose routes and junctions in real time. Deadly machines and remote-controlled androids pursue you relentlessly. You will return one day to defeat the tyrant – but first, you must survive.

meta.name: Black Tiger

En este juego, encarnas a un bárbaro que debe matar a tres dragones que han descendido del cielo y han sumido el reino en la oscuridad. Tienes que atravesar varias zonas y destruir a los monstruos que encuentres en tu camino. Por el camino te encontrarás con ancianos que, una vez rescatados, te darán objetos como tiempo extra, más vitalidad o más monedas. También pueden venderte objetos como mejoras de armadura, armas, llaves de cofres del tesoro o pociones antienvenenamiento. Puedes recoger monedas destruyendo ciertos monstruos o rompiendo vasijas.

Blackjack is a card game similar to poker. Both players (one being the computer) must have a hand whose value is as close to 21 as possible, without ever exceeding 21 (otherwise, it's an automatic loss). Each round, you have the option to add a card to your hand or not. When neither player chooses to add a card, the player whose hand is closest to 21 without going over wins the amount allocated in dollars at the beginning of each round.

This Blackjack game allows from 1 to 5 players and uses pre-defined rules from Las Vegas, Downtown Vegas, Reno and Atlantic City. There is also a custom mode where you can define your own rules. Minimum and maximum bets are customizable as are the number of decks to be used. The game includes a hint mode for the novice player that will tell you the optimal play at any given moment and also includes an optimal play chart you can take with you when you're ready to hit the real casinos.

meta.name: Blackpool Tower
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.17 KB

In Blackpool Tower you play as a curious child locked inside the house by your aunt while she's out shopping. But you have bigger dreams — you want to escape and see the famous Blackpool Tower! You'll need to find a way out, deal with dangers like a roaring fire in the lounge or a loose snake in the garden, and be cautious crossing the road, since you're only seven years old. Along the way, collect objects to gather the 50 pence needed for entry. A charming and humorous text adventure about childhood mischief and small-scale danger in a big world.

meta.name: Blackwyche
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.15 KB

Out of dark rolling mists it came, a shdowy outline drifting slowly through the silent waters of the night. As it drew closer, there formed the gostly shape of a large galleon.
My eyes beheld a strange luminiscence surrounding the vessel, as though it was being driven towards me by some powerful supernatural force.
My heart began to pound with fear as I knew that this could not be real. How could this timeless ship have roamed the seas for more than two centuries? If so, what terrible fate could have befallen the crew?
As I gazed in wonder at this astounding sight, the ship slowly came to a halt close to my meagre craft, almost inviting me to investigate its long-since deserted decks.

meta.name: The Blade of Blackpool
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Blade of Blackpoole is an illustrated text adventure set in a medieval fantasy world. Your quest is to recover the legendary sword Myraglym, last seen at the Lake of Blackpoole. Along the way you'll traverse forests, swamps, labyrinths, and cliffs, while facing deadly foes such as a talking carnivorous plant, a lizard man, and a hungry sea monster. Helpful characters may also appear, offering riddles that hold clues to earning their aid. With 60 illustrated locations, an inventory limit, and complex command recognition, the game demands both strategy and problem-solving. Your ultimate goal is to solve every puzzle, claim the sword, and achieve the maximum score of 500 points.

meta.name: Blade Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.06 KB

Blade Runner places you in a futuristic hunt where, as an enforcer, you must track down and eliminate dangerous replidroids. From inside your skimmer, you navigate the city using multiple displays, analyze radar data and locate targets of increasing intelligence. Once a replidroid is engaged, the action shifts to the streets, where you track it with a scanner, avoid hazards and strike at the right moment. Constant awareness and precise movement are essential, as heavy traffic and unpredictable pedestrians leave no room for mistakes.

meta.name: Blades of Steel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blades Of Steel es un juego arcade de hockey sobre hielo (el modo de juego no requiere que te preocupes de las estadísticas ni de personalizar los equipos). De vez en cuando, puede estallar una pelea, lo que permite ver de cerca a ambos jugadores. El jugador tiene el control durante la secuencia del combate en miniatura, y el perdedor tiene que pasar un tiempo en el área de castigo. El árbitro interrumpe los combates cuando duran demasiado.

meta.name: Blagger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.93 KB

En este juego, los jugadores controlan a Rodger the Dodger , un ladrón cuya tarea consiste en recoger una serie de llaves y utilizarlas para abrir una caja fuerte. Hay 30 niveles que completar. Blagger debe completar estas tareas en un tiempo limitado mientras evita peligros como cactus, coches, alienígenas, sombrereros locos, bocas gigantes y chinos. Blaguer no dispone de armas para disparar, sino que debe confiar en sus habilidades de salto. Pierde una vida si entra en contacto con un peligro, sufre una caída importante o se le acaba el tiempo. El juego se pierde cuando se acaban todas las vidas. Si Blagger consigue coger las llaves y dirigirse a la caja fuerte, pasa a la siguiente fase.

meta.name: Blagger Goes to Hollywood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.04 KB

In Blagger Goes to Hollywood the infamous thief returns for another wild caper, this time sneaking through the movie sets of “Steven Speilbum” to steal his latest film. Along the way, Blagger faces a cast of iconic movie heroes – from James Bond to Superman, Tarzan, and the Incredible Hulk – each heralded by their theme tune. To defeat them, you must use the correct prop tied to their film, as anything else is useless. Every fallen star drops an item for the next battle, and once all are down, you confront Speilbum himself – only for the stars to rise again for one final cinematic showdown.

meta.name: Blakhole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.80 KB

Blakhole challenges you with a mix of skill and puzzle-solving. You control a ball through maze-like courses, collecting all the key fragments in the correct numerical order. Only after gathering them all can you access the exit – but finding it is part of the challenge. Each course tests you with time pressure, precise maneuvering, and clever routing as you overcome obstacles and complete the level.

meta.name: Blast Fest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.86 KB

Blast Fest is an intense two-player duel game that puts the competitive spirit at the forefront. In this fast-paced shooter, players compete head-to-head and must prove their reflexes and accuracy. The goal is simple but addictive: hit your opponent with skillful shots to score points. The first player to reach 10 points is declared the winner. The minimalist, action-focused gameplay makes Blast Fest a perfect game for quick matches and offers plenty of thrills. The dynamics of the duels and the constant pressure to be faster than your opponent ensure that no two games are the same.

meta.name: Blast'em

Blasteroids es una actualización de su antepasado arcade "Asteroids" en el que el objetivo es eliminar todos los sectores de asteroides y naves enemigas. Una vez completada esta tarea, el jugador se enfrenta a Mukor, el jefe que gobierna todas las galaxias.
La nave del jugador aparece primero en el centro de cuatro agujeros de gusano, entre los que debe elegir su destino. A continuación, será transportada a un sector del sistema estelar elegido.
A diferencia de "Asteroides", la nave debe reponer su suministro de combustible recogiendo cristales de asteroides de colores. Algunos sectores no ofrecen estos cristales, y si la nave se queda sin combustible, se pierde.

meta.name: Blasters Of The Univers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.61 KB

"Blasters of the Universe" is a vertically scrolling shooter. The game offers an exciting mix of action-packed gameplay and cooperative fun, as it is designed for both one player and two players in simultaneous co-op mode. In the game, players control their spaceships through endless waves of enemies as they fight their way through dangerous galaxies. The focus is on precise shots and skillful navigation through the continuously scrolling levels. The co-op function allows two players to face the hordes of enemy spaceships together and support each other, making the game an intense and collaborative experience.

meta.name: Blasters of the Univers II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.58 KB

Blasters of the Univers II is the action-packed sequel to the popular vertical-scrolling shooter Blasters of the Univers. The game offers both single-player mode and simultaneous co-op mode for two players, which makes it particularly appealing to co-op fans and retro gamers. In Blasters of the Univers II, players immerse themselves in new and challenging levels that seamlessly follow on from the design and mechanics of the first part. The mission remains clear: fend off hordes of enemy spaceships, fight through various hostile sectors and act tactically to gain the upper hand. With improved graphics and more complex enemy formations, the sequel stands out from the first part and ensures an even more intense gaming experience.

meta.name: Blaze

The ultimate test for any Space-Cadet of the Fleet is to fly through the Blaze Zone in the Andromeda System. The zone is packed full of defences and aliens that need shooting to hopefully emerge on the other side. The game is a shooter where you move a spacecraft on the bottom of the single screen left or right, and the aim is to shoot the various items and aliens that appear on the screen. You have to shoot everything on the screen to move to the next one. If you touch anything then you lose one of five lives.

Las razas Mazeli y Sahiban están en guerra. El problema es que se encuentra en un punto muerto. Para resolverlo, ambas razas han iniciado extensos programas de investigación para poner fin a la guerra. Los Mazeli han encontrado una solución: introducir la "Blazer", una nave de enorme poder destructivo. Los Sahiban, un poco asustados, deciden ir a robarla. El problema es que ningún Sahiban es lo suficientemente valiente como para hacerlo. Entra tú mismo. Tras un anuncio que buscaba a alguien valiente para intentar esta misión suicida por 25 millones de groats galácticos, respondiste a la llamada porque no tenías nada mejor que hacer. El juego es un shoot'em up vertical con vista cenital. Tienes 5 naves para completar tu misión. La nave es básica sin potenciadores, solo un cañón frontal. Los enemigos son variados y vuelan desde la parte superior o los laterales de la pantalla. También se puede disparar a las bases en la superficie. Ve a buscarlo, tigre, la raza Sahiban cuenta contigo.

meta.name: Blazing Thunder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.71 KB

Corre el año 2059. El poder militar de Zimmerad gobierna el planeta y un movimiento para derrocar el régimen está en marcha. Tú eres la última oportunidad para derrotar a Zimmerad y mantener libre a tu pueblo.
Juegas como un doble de Rambo en un carro de combate y te adentrarás en las líneas enemigas, a través de la jungla, la ciudad y el desierto y disparando a todo lo que se mueva.
Los combatientes no paran de aparecer por todas partes y algunos incluso te tienden emboscadas para ajustarse mejor a ti. También tendrás que tener cuidado con las minas, los tanques enemigos y los formidables ataques aéreos. Afortunadamente, las armas de bonificación te ayudarán en esta difícil empresa. El escenario a menudo se interpone en el camino y debe ser destruido. Una vez completado un nivel, te enfrentarás a un jefe.

meta.name: Blind Man's Bluff
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.23 KB

“Blind Man's Bluff” has you running across the playing field to complete rectangles and squares to finish the level. Meanwhile, you must avoid enemies. Up to three times per level, you can force them to jump to clear your path.

meta.name: Blinky's Scary School
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.88 KB

The first of Blinky the ghost's two outings, the ghost with the most has to progress through a series of levels and remove the hazards left by "ghost-busters". He does this by collecting the right objects to cast the all important spells. The levels themselves are flick-screen and are layered with platforms. Making the task difficult are spiders, mice and the like - watch out in particular for the jumping frogs. Once the appropriate spells have been cast (involving lots of back-tracking to collect objects and bring them to the cauldron) the objects to make an underwater diving suit must be obtained.

meta.name: Blip! : Video Classics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Video Classics (Blip!) is an updated version of one the first video games Pong and allows one player to play the computer and two players to play each other. The main aim of the game is to bounce a ball with a bat past your opponents bat to score points. There are six variants of the game with Tennis, Football, Squash and Solo Squash recreating the classic game and two modern updates 4 Bat Blip and Asterbliperoids. 4 Bat Blip has the bats at the side of the screen as well as bats at the top and bottom of the screen, Asterbliperoids is like Tennis but with asteroids in the middle of the playing field which redirect the ball when hit.

meta.name: Blitz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.43 KB

In Blitz, a plane moves across the screen at a constant speed. When the plane reaches the far right side of the screen, it moves to the left and drops down one plane's height. Below the plane are several skyscrapers of different heights. The player has to drop bombs from the plane by pressing the space bar. Each bomb can destroy six floors of the skyscraper hit. As the plane descends, it may collide with the remaining blocks, so the tallest skyscrapers should be targeted first. This can only be achieved by destroying every floor of every building and then landing safely on the flat ground.
The game is unusual in that the player only needs to press a single key to play - the space bar.

meta.name: Blitz 2000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.77 KB

Blitz 2000 puts you in control of a flying saucer circling above a city of towering skyscrapers. With each pass across the screen, your craft descends as fuel runs low, forcing careful and precise action. By dropping bombs strategically, you gradually level the buildings to create a safe landing zone. The appeal comes from balancing time pressure, planning and accurate control, as only a completely cleared city allows a successful landing.

meta.name: Blitz 3000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.48 KB

Blitz 3000 continues the battle against an overwhelming alien threat and once again throws you into a desperate mission to save Earth. You pilot a heavily armed spacecraft, fight through relentless waves of enemies and avoid deadly obstacles as the intensity steadily rises. Enhanced visuals and effects push the pace forward, while powerful foes force you to constantly adapt your tactics in order to survive and progress.

meta.name: Blitzkrieg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blitzkrieg is a strategy wargame that let's you play as German forces who have to take over Western Europe as well as England from the dates May 1st to September 30th. With various types of forces and units you give orders to them in your quest for Western European domination. The computer plays as the Europeans but the game is played in real-time and not the usual taking it in turns to place orders before the computer works out the outcome of each turn. A country will only surrender when all it's cities have fallen and the end of the game is when you have accumulated 100000 victory points, which means you can win if England falls but not France. The game is viewed showing a map of Western Europe and icons show cities, armies and terrain. The game is based on Len Deighton's history book Blitzkrieg: From the Rise of Hitler to the Fall of Dunkirk,

meta.name: Blizzard Pass
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.73 KB

In Blizzard Pass you struggle through a freezing storm to reach a dark objective – but even getting to the castle becomes a fight for survival. Every move lowers your body temperature, forcing you to act quickly and make the right decisions under pressure. You explore your surroundings, enter commands, and try to find a safe way inside before the cold overcomes you. The mix of exploration and planning means every action must be carefully considered.

meta.name: Blob
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blob is an arcade/puzzle game, which seems to be influenced by an Amiga game of the same name. The player must bounce the eponymous Blob around a maze of tiles to cause them to disappear. Some tiles are indestructible, others take more than once bounce to clear, or cause the Blob to bounce for longer than usual. The objective is to clear the level of tiles. Landing in spaces where there are no tiles causes the player to lose a life.

meta.name: The Blob
meta.desc:

In this Pac-Man clone, you play Blob, a small yellow spherical being who lives in a maze. Poor old Blob's home is being invaded by Wibblies who can kill him with one touch. Around his labyrinthine home, he has secreted four power-up potions which allow him to take out the wibbly ghosts for a limited time.

meta.name: Blobber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This is a pretty good Bubble Bobble clone but a lot tougher as you have to collect a certain amount of items to complete each level (unless you're lucky to have a key appear, opening the exit) and the nasties regenerate, often in unexpected places.

meta.name: Block Blaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.04 KB

In Block Blaster you control a small spaceship through block-like mazes, blasting your way forward. The goal is to destroy all enemy formations without being hit yourself. Speed, quick reflexes and precise shooting are essential to survive the increasingly tight playfields.

meta.name: Block Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Block Out is a 3D twist on the classic Tetris concept. Instead of rotating blocks in just two dimensions, you must spin them in all directions from a top-down perspective to make them fit neatly into the pit without leaving gaps. The game challenges your spatial awareness, as you need to view and place blocks from different angles. Difficulty can be adjusted in the options by changing pit size, speed, rows, and more.

meta.name: Block Shock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This game has really beautiful music and graphics. Interesting concept, having to shoot parts into place instead of blasting them out of there. In Block Shock you're the last chance for millions of people on your planet. Some strange buildings from far, far away cause a serious danger to the peaceful life. You just have one chance: destroy the buildings by forming them into a rectangle. Published in Italy as The Wall in Formula 64 n.98.

meta.name: Block Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.19 KB

Block Soccer thrives on humor and simplicity – you control block-shaped characters on a minimalistic pitch, aiming to get the ball into your opponent's goal. Despite its basic design, the game leaves room for clever passes and precise shots. The real fun comes in two-player mode, where chaotic yet exciting matches against a friend make every game unpredictable and entertaining.

meta.name: Block'n'Bubble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Block'n'Bubble es un juego de rompecabezas de lógica de acción para hasta dos personas simultáneamente.
El objetivo es derribar todas las burbujas. ¡Pero debes tener mucho cuidado de no quedar atrapado por una burbuja! Las burbujas a menudo están encerradas en cámaras o pasillos y primero se debe despejar el camino. Algunas piedras se pueden mover libremente y, por lo tanto, puedes deslizarte hasta las burbujas. Pero ten cuidado: ¡bloqueaste rápidamente el camino de regreso!

meta.name: Block'n'Bubble II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Block'n'Bubble II builds on its predecessor with even trickier mazes and new challenges. Once again, you must eliminate all the bubbles in each stage without getting hit yourself. The narrow corridors demand careful planning, as movable blocks can clear your path but just as easily trap you. Every move counts, and one mistake can block your escape. Fans of the first game will find an even more puzzling continuation here.

meta.name: Blockade 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.38 KB

A vertically scrolling space shooter with a strangely unique difference of having YOU be the saucer at the top of the screen, shooting down at the ships and aliens comping UP at you.

meta.name: Blockade Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.47 KB

Blockade Runner is a tense 3D shoot 'em up where you must escort a fleet of four supply freighters safely back to Earth. But hostile aliens force you into a deadly asteroid field. You'll have to dodge collisions, destroy mines, fend off enemy ships, and manage both limited fuel and overheating shields. One mistake can doom the mission – only quick reflexes and smart resource handling will see you through.

meta.name: Blockbuster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Impact blends classic breakout gameplay with modern extras. Using your paddle, you keep the ball in play and smash through bricks to clear the way. Some bricks contain special tokens you can catch. These can either be exchanged for one of nine powerful upgrades or saved until the end of the level for bonus points. With 80 built-in levels and a level editor allowing for 48 custom designs, you can adjust the difficulty from easy to brutal. Impact offers hours of addictive fun and proves that breakout-style games never lose their charm.

meta.name: Blockbusters (Macsen Software) (Europe)

meta.name: Blockbusters
meta.desc:

"Blockbusters" is a classic brick-breaker game that fits in between the well-known arcade hits Breakout and Arkanoid. In Blockbusters, the goal of the players is to use a movable bat to bounce the ball so that all destructible blocks on the screen are eliminated. The game builds on the tried and tested principle, but offers some refreshing variations and tricky level layouts that make the gameplay exciting and challenging. As the ball hits and destroys the blocks, players must skillfully move the bat to keep the ball in play and eliminate all the blocks without losing the ball.

meta.name: Blockbusters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bob Holness hosted this fondly-remembered quiz show, in which students competed to answer enough questions correctly to complete a run of answers across the board. This was the latest and most sophisticated computer version of the concept. The exact mechanics of the game have been customized slightly. You start by choosing a question, which are all represented by the first letter of the answer. You must 'buzz in' by pressing your letter to input the answer (don't worry about exact spelling). If you get the question wrong, the computer chooses a square (seemingly with no strategy). In two player games each player has their own buzzer, and a correct answer sees you choose the next question. A digitized version of Bob's face reads out the questions - just be careful if you get any where the answer is 'organism'...

meta.name: Blockbusters : Gold Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.12 KB

After winning a best-of-three match against an opponent, competitors in the TV quiz Blockbusters faced a Gold Run for prizes. Like the main game, this took place on a 5x4 grid of interlocked hexagons, each representing a question. Correct answers turn the hexagon to your colour, and incorrect answers turn it to the opposition colour (in this case, black, blocking your path). The big difference is that the questions are multi-word, with GEM perhaps representing Green Eyed Monster. In the early days players could go on to face 5 Gold Runs; in the later years it became 3 (probably because players who'd won so many standard games were more likely to win the big prizes). This home version is built around the same structure, and has 9 skill levels, dictating how much time you have.

meta.name: Blockhopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.91 KB

Block Hopper is a charming and well-made Q-Bert clone game. It allows up to two players to take on the role of a charismatic character who must hop across a pyramid-shaped arrangement of blocks to change the playing field and beat the level. Like the original Q-Bert, the goal in Block Hopper is to activate or change each block on the playing surface by jumping, while enemy creatures and obstacles put players under pressure. Using strategic movements and quick dodging, players must completely change the block area without being hit by enemies.

meta.name: Blockrockey : Blockbusters Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.42 KB

Blockrockey: Blockbusters Revenge is the exciting sequel to the 64' Blockbusters and continues the classic Arkanoid gameplay, but with improved graphics and increased challenge. This sequel offers an updated take on the block buster genre, in which players control a bat to bounce a ball and destroy all the blocks in each level. Compared to the original Blockbusters, Blockrockey offers improved visuals, with more detailed blocks and smoother gameplay, which significantly increases the fun of the game. The levels are more challenging and include new obstacles and power-ups that add variety to the gameplay and increase the difficulty. Strategic use of power-ups and precise shots are necessary to successfully master the more complex layouts.

meta.name: Blocks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blocks by J & F Publishing is a challenging puzzle game. The gameplay is simple but addictive: players must push blocks into their designated positions to successfully complete each level. With a total of 40 challenging levels, Blocks becomes increasingly challenging and requires strategic thinking and forward planning. Each level brings new layouts and obstacles, so players must plan their moves carefully to prevent a block from reaching a dead end. This puzzle game is inspired by classic "Sokoban" puzzles, but with its own style and unique challenges that steadily increase the level of difficulty.

meta.name: Blocks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Blocks" is an exciting variation of the classic memory card game that challenges players to put their concentration and memory to the test. The game contains cards with different images that are laid out on a 4x8 grid. The goal is to find pairs of cards and reveal as many matches as possible. Each player turns over two cards per turn and tries to remember the position and image of the cards. A successful pairing causes the cards to disappear from the game, while an incorrect combination is hidden again. Since the playing field consists of a larger grid, the challenge of remembering all the positions and images becomes even more difficult and requires particularly good memory and visual attention.

meta.name: Blocktower
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.01 KB

Blocktower is a digital adaptation of the classic mathematical puzzle game Tower of Hanoi. Also known as Tower of Brahma or Lucas' Tower, the game challenges players to move a series of differently sized disks from one rod to another, using a third rod as an auxiliary position. The goal of the game is to transfer all of the disks to the target rod in the same order, without a larger disk resting on a smaller one. Blocktower brings this classic puzzle into an engaging computer form, allowing players to test their problem-solving skills and patience.

meta.name: Blok Copy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.54 KB

Blok Copy is a puzzle game. The player is at presented with a 5x7 board consisting of different kinds of tiles. At the start each column has only one kind of tile but the tiles will then get shuffled around. The aim of the game is then to restore the board as it was at the start. The player uses the keyboard to move the rows and columns until the board has been restored. Once completed another board will be unlocked. There are ten in total. The time is limited so the player can't take too long.

meta.name: Blond Blubber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.04 KB

Blond Blubber is a horizontally scrolling shoot'em-up that was never officially released. You pilot a small ship through narrow caverns filled with stalactites and enemy fire, dodging and shooting your way forward. Despite its unfinished state, the game already shows smooth motion and appealing visuals – a promising concept that sadly never reached completion.

meta.name: Blood & Honour : Aidaars Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.73 KB

Blood And Honour - Aidaar's Revenge is a horizontally scrolling shooter for the C64, originally created using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit (SEUCK). The game offers classic arcade shooter action, where the player faces off against a variety of enemies and fights through intensely designed levels. In the game, the player controls a spaceship or a character that moves horizontally through the levels. The goal is to shoot down enemy units and avoid various obstacles and projectiles while the screen steadily scrolls to the right. The challenge is to fend off waves of enemies, collect power-ups and reach the end of the level as unscathed as possible.

meta.name: Blood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.40 KB

“Blood” is an atmospheric crosshairs shooter. The game puts players in a dark setting where they have to use the crosshairs to take out enemies in order to progress. The threatening atmosphere and the visually appealing backgrounds set “Blood” apart from other crosshairs shooters and give the game its own eerie mood.

meta.name: Blood 2 : Back to Brutality
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Blood 2: Back to Brutality" is the brutal sequel to the Crosshairs shooter Blood, which develops the original concept further with even more intense gameplay and an increased focus on violence and blood effects. The game was rated as an "adult game" by Gamebase, but mainly due to the explicit depiction of blood and violence, without any sexual content.

meta.name: Blood Brothers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tras el asesinato de sus padres y el incendio de su aldea en el planeta Sylonia, Hark y Kren han jurado vengarse de la banda de gángsters intergalácticos: The Scorpions. Equipados con Skywalk Jet Bikes  y diversas armas, ahora están listos para viajar al planeta Scorpia y destruir a los "Scorpions". Hermanos de armas y sangre, Hark y Kren deben explorar la superficie del planeta con sus Jet-Bikes para encontrar la entrada a las minas que deben explorar. Allí encontrarán a los "Scorpions" y tendrán que matarlos.
El juego combina investigación con motos voladoras y plataformas con vista lateral.

meta.name: Blood Hand
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.26 KB

Blood Hand is a two-player-only duel where the sole goal is to score more kills than your opponent before the timer runs out. You move through a maze of blocks, collect power-ups, and use weapons to take each other down. In the end, the winner is the one with the highest kill count – a fast and intense showdown with no compromises.

meta.name: Blood Money
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Blood Money, te embarcas en cuatro peligrosas misiones: elimina enemigos y recoge su dinero. Puedes usar el dinero en las tiendas para mejorar tu nave. Se pierde energía al chocar con enemigos o paredes; algunos enemigos no infligen daño, sino que te roban el dinero. El juego es un shoot'em-up de vista lateral con desplazamiento horizontal y vertical: una navegación precisa y reflejos rápidos son esenciales para sobrevivir en los estrechos pasajes y los ataques enemigos.

meta.name: Blood Valley
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Blood Valley you play as The Quarry – one of the unfortunate slaves released each year only to be hunted down in the deadly Valley of Gad. You can choose to be a barbarian, priest, or thief, each with unique abilities. Your goal is to either escape the valley or slay its cruel master, the Archveult. But survival means fighting off endless waves of enemies, striking fast, and never standing still. As you fulfill objectives and gather equipment, every victory feels fleeting in this relentless, violent struggle for freedom.

meta.name: Blood 'n Guts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blood 'n Guts is described as "ancient barbarian games" somewhat analogous to the Olympics, but played by Vikings in various violent events.
Among the various events available to the player, perhaps the most notable are “Drinking Beer” and “Throwing Cats,” both of which are self-explanatory titles. The other events consist of Tug of War, Rock Roller (roll a huge rock up a cliff and use it to crush your opponent before they do it to you), Tower Jump (jump from a tower and land on your head!), Human Hit ( Throwing rocks at a human target!), Mountain Walk (essentially rope walking with some added violence), Pole Fighting, Ax Throwing (again at a human target!) and Arm Wreck (arm wrestling).

meta.name: Bloodwheels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.14 KB

Bloodwheels puts you in control of a heavily armored vehicle, battling your way through a variety of hostile landscapes. You'll traverse scorching deserts, ruined towns, bridges, enemy army bases, dense jungles, and even an abandoned city. Along the way you'll face countless enemies, obstacles, and destructible environments that add both danger and opportunity. Detailed sprites and diverse scenery keep the action intense as you struggle to survive under constant fire. You can take on the mission solo or with a friend – war has never been so fast-paced and explosive.

meta.name: Bloodwych
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La tierra de Trazere estuvo antaño gobernada por la poderosa y benévola organización de magos conocida como los Bloodwych. Gobernados por el Gran Dragón, los Bloodwych mantenían el país en equilibrio, protegiéndolo del mal y llevándolo a la prosperidad. Sin embargo, el segundo al mando de los Bloodwych, llamado Zendick, se volvió contra su grupo, desterró a sus oponentes al plano astral y comenzó a trabajar en un loco plan para invocar al Señor de la Entropía. El jugador controla al campeón de Trazere, cuyo objetivo es detener a Zendick y restaurar la paz en la tierra.
Bloodwych es un juego de laberintos en 3D en primera persona. La característica especial de este juego es el soporte de pantalla dividida para dos jugadores.
Cada jugador controla a un grupo de cuatro personajes. Las cuatro clases básicas son guerrero, mago, aventurero y ladrón.
meta.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Mazmorras

meta.name: Blox
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.39 KB

meta.name: Blubria
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

bluBria is a puzzle game based on the idea of the game Memory. It allows to play up to 2 players on 3 sets of picture sets. The game consists of 56 pictures that need to be paired. Each pair gives a 5 point bonus. Guessing to pairs one after another gives access to the left bonus board, allowing extra points. No action at a designated time deducts half of the points.

meta.name: Blue Angel 69
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blue Angel 69 combines the idea of Maxit with images of sexy female androids. The player takes on the role of a specific person who is supposed to play this board game using an android. If the player wins, more of the opponent's exposed image is displayed. There are ten stages to complete.
There is an 8x8 board in the game. Each square on the board contains a point value. The aim of the game is to collect as many points as possible by moving a marker to a non-empty space to collect as many points as possible. The first player can only move the marker horizontally and the second player can only move the marker vertically. The game board contains both negative and positive point values. So ideally you want to take a high, positive point value and force your opponent to take a negative value. The game ends when no more moves are possible and the player with the most points wins.

meta.name: Blue Angels : Formation Flight Simulation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blue Angels: Formation Flight Squadron is an F/A-18 flight simulator with a focus on air shows. The Blue Angels is the U.S. Navy's flight demonstration squadron known for its precise maneuvers and precision flying. The game attempts to replicate this by offering formation flying, where you have to react and coordinate with other Blue Angels in the air. The player can practice any maneuver in the simulator: dozens of high, low and flat maneuvers, diamond 360 passes, left rolls and 4-point rolls or, for example, an entire air show. Aside from practice events, the player can perform an air show or simply take a free flight. In the air, players fly from a first-person perspective inside the aircraft or from a first-person perspective from a chase aircraft behind the player. Additionally there are 4 different camera views and 3 different game speeds.

meta.name: Blue Baron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.33 KB

In Blue Baron, you pilot a warplane in 1918 across twelve missions to bomb enemy targets and help the Allies win the war. After taking off from the airfield, you fly through dangerous skies, dodging or fighting enemy planes and balloons. Your aircraft can survive four hits – take more, and it's destroyed, costing you one of three lives. Precision bombing and a safe return are key to completing each mission.

meta.name: Blue Max
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.99 KB

Blue Max para Commodore 64 pone al jugador en la piel de un as de la aviación de la Primera Guerra Mundial, inspirado en Max Chatsworth. Los jugadores se embarcan en peligrosas misiones para destruir diversos objetivos, como puentes, edificios, tanques, aviones y barcos. Los bombardeos son particularmente peligrosos, requiriendo ataques en picado sobre objetivos terrestres, un desafío donde la sincronización y la precisión son cruciales.

meta.name: Blue Max 2001
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.74 KB

En esta secuela de Blue Max de Synapse, el año es 2001 y pilotas un platillo volante. Intenta bombardear objetivos enemigos sin que te disparen (o alcancen) los platillos enemigos o los cañones terrestres. El color del borde te indica tu estado: si parpadea en amarillo, estás peligrosamente cerca del suelo, si parpadea en rojo, estás tocando el suelo. Gris significa que estás volando bajo pero no demasiado bajo. En azul claro, la nave enemiga está a la misma altitud que usted.

meta.name: Blue Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.35 KB

Blue Moon puts you in control of an intergalactic spacecraft on a mission to rescue a stranded sister ship and crew from a hostile planet. Across five distinct stages – including docking, classic shooting, a boss battle against the egg-dropping Tecom, and a Lunar Lander-style finale – you'll need precision, reflexes, and determination to bring them safely back to the Blue Moon.

meta.name: Blue Powder - Grey Smoke
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Blue Powder Grey Smoke is a strategy war game based upon the American Civil War.
1-player versus computer or 2-player strategy game played in semi-real time. The player can choose from a number of historical and non-historical missions, from either the Confederate or Union perspective. In the non-historical setting, the positioning of troops and the characteristics of reinforcements are randomized, so as to not represent the original battle conditions. Gameplay uses a number of historically accurate types of arms. During play, the player can move between 3 different zoom levels to monitor the action of their troops in realtime, but the action can be paused at any time to issue commands. Commands are issued via a menu system, and the player can choose objectives for their individual troops, as well as the speed, offensive, and defensive positions they wish them to take.
