Blue Powder Grey Smoke is a strategy war game based upon the American Civil War.
1-player versus computer or 2-player strategy game played in semi-real time. The player can choose from a number of historical and non-historical missions, from either the Confederate or Union perspective. In the non-historical setting, the positioning of troops and the characteristics of reinforcements are randomized, so as to not represent the original battle conditions. Gameplay uses a number of historically accurate types of arms. During play, the player can move between 3 different zoom levels to monitor the action of their troops in realtime, but the action can be paused at any time to issue commands. Commands are issued via a menu system, and the player can choose objectives for their individual troops, as well as the speed, offensive, and defensive positions they wish them to take.

meta.name: Blue Thunder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.21 KB

In Blue Thunder, you pilot a high-tech jetcopter through a storm of missiles, EMP blasts, and relentless air assaults. As the last survivor of a once-mighty invasion force, your mission is critical: infiltrate a heavily defended island, destroy an unstable reactor, and rescue your captured allies. But with swarms of jet fighters and advanced defenses standing in your way, only your lightning-fast reflexes and hyper-phase lasers will keep you alive. This isn't just a rescue – it's a suicide mission. And only Blue Thunder can pull it off.

meta.name: Blueprint
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Blueprint, you must save your girlfriend Daisy from Ollie Ogre by assembling a ball-throwing machine. The parts are hidden in houses within a maze, but if you enter a house you've already visited, you get a bomb instead – and must rush it to the bin before it explodes. Time is running out, Daisy is in danger, and monsters and falling flowerpots add to the chaos. Once the machine is complete, hit the button and start launching balls to stop Ollie before he reaches Daisy.
meta.developer: B. Hindorff, D. Holmes & C. Merten

meta.name: The Blues Brothers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Como en la película, The Blues Brothers está protagonizado por Jake y Elwood. Como era de esperar, los dos hermanos se han vuelto a meter en líos, así que tendrán que ir huyendo de las garras de la ley a lo largo de los cinco niveles que componen el juego. De esta manera, tendremos que pasar por un centro comercial, huir de la prisión, cruzar el río y alcanzar la gran ciudad para ser libres.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Bluey Blob
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.86 KB

A a one player cute-em-up game created with the SEUCK engine with some interesting game sections including some interesting bosses, a section reminiscent of Freeway or Frogger and a good amount of fun from such bizarre SEUCK stuff.

meta.name: Bluey Blob 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.60 KB

Bluey Blob II, also known as Radcliffe's Revenge, is a charming cute 'em up game and the sequel to the popular Bluey Blob game. As the sequel to the first Bluey Blob title, it stays true to its humorous and colorful style while offering new levels and challenges. In Bluey Blob II, players once again take on the role of the lovable blue blob, who moves through imaginative levels and has to face various enemies and obstacles. The sequel takes the cute character on an adventure in which he fights against arch-enemy Radcliffe and his minions to save the world from his revenge. The levels are richly detailed and contain numerous cute enemies, giving the game its typical cute 'em up charm.

meta.name: BMX Freestyle Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.12 KB

"BMX Freestyle" challenges you to master six distinct BMX events – either solo or with another player. Each event tests a different skill, from balance and timing to speed and control. Pull off a 45-meter wheelie, soar past your lying friends in ramp jumps, complete 13 spins in the halfpipe, crawl to the finish in the slow race, reach over 6 meters in the high jump, and pull off as many tricks as you can in the tricks track. Once completed, all events return with tougher requirements – can you handle the pressure?

meta.name: BMX Jungle Bike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "BMX Jungle Bike," you escape a hidden jungle valley on your BMX bike after discovering and taking a treasure. The locals are unhappy with your find and pressure you as you dodge obstacles, traps, and various creatures. The game is played from a side-scrolling perspective as you move from left to right across the screens. You can control your bike's speed and jump, with jump height depending on your speed. A collision costs you one of your three lives, restarting you at the left edge of the current screen. At the start of the game, you can set the speed from 1 to 4, with 4 being the slowest.

meta.name: BMX Kidz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, the player must compete against five BMX riders in a race against the clock. There are six tracks in the game, complete with stunts and wheelies that the player must accomplish in order to proceed onto the next track. Riding the bike causes energy to be lost, but soda cans can be collected to replenish it. Also, doing stunts causes the player to crash down hard, losing spokes (wheels). Replacement spokes, like the soda cans, can be collected along the way. The game ends when the player does not qualify, runs out of time, or has no spokes left.

meta.name: BMX Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.11 KB

"BMX Ninja" puts you in the shoes of a top BMX gang member whose rivals have launched a challenge – and with your girlfriend's interest at stake, you've got no choice but to fight back. Riding your bike through side-scrolling levels, you spin-kick enemies on bikes, scooters, and skateboards. Defeat eight rival bikes to move on, but beware – losing a life resets the count. There are six different US locations to battle through, each selectable from the main menu.

meta.name: BMX Number Jump
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.15 KB

BMX Number Jump is an educational game where it improves the maths skills of children from the ages six to ten with addition, subtraction and multiplication. The game is single screen viewed from above at an elevated angle and you must ride your BMX bike around a maze looking for the answer to jump over from a question on the right of the screen. As you move around the maze there is also a Kangaroo bouncing around and this needs avoiding because if you are caught then you lose one of five lives. Jumping over the correct answer loses the kangaroo one of his five lives and when all his lives are gone then you move to another maze. Crashing or getting the wrong answer knocks you of your bike but you don't lose a life.

meta.name: BMX Racers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.09 KB

"BMX Racers" throws you into a wild ride through the park when suddenly your brakes fail – now it's just about dodging obstacles and holding on tight. Viewed from above, you must steer your bike along twisting paths, across rivers and past trees, fences, and parking lots full of cars. After each level you get a short break, but the next run is even faster and harder. Your score climbs as long as you stay on track – but one crash, and it's all over. The challenge: go the distance and beat your last score.

meta.name: BMX Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 87.55 KB

BMX Simulator te pone al manillar de una bici BMX en vista cenital, desafiándote en siete circuitos cada vez más técnicos, llenos de rampas y baches que ponen a prueba tu control. El objetivo: completar tres vueltas antes de que se agote el tiempo —cuanto más rápido, más puntos. Corres contra un rival de la IA, pero no es necesario ganarle: solo cuenta tu crono. Lo que sí brilla es una novedad de la época: la repetición en cámara lenta, para revivir (y presumir de) tus saltos, derrapes y aterrizajes al límite. Simple, ágil y adictivo: pura esencia BMX, sin florituras, con adrenalina en cada curva.

meta.name: BMX Simulator II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

BMX Simulator II es la secuela del exitoso juego de carreras, ahora más exigente y completo. Ya no compiten dos ciclistas, sino cuatro a la vez, y además de la clásica pista de tierra, debes dominar la nueva y desafiante pista de la Cantera —nivel experto, donde puedes personalizar el ancho de neumáticos y el tamaño de la corona para ajustar tracción y aceleración. La vista sigue siendo cenital, y el control es elegante en su sencillez: la palanca dirige, y el botón de disparo acelera… o frena, según cuánto lo pulses. Ganar no depende solo de velocidad: necesitas reflejos rápidos, conocimiento de cada bache y curva, y la configuración justa. Porque aquí, una décima de segundo —y un buen setup— marcan la diferencia entre el podio y el polvo.

meta.name: BMX Trials
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"BMX Trials" puts your cycling skills to the test across six unique challenges. From a classic 200-meter dash and the longest wheelie to a daring leap over a VW Beetle, each event demands precise timing and control. You'll also take on a ramp jump, a slalom course, and bunny hopping over bars. Use the joystick to steer and the fire button to build up speed. You must complete each challenge to unlock the next.

meta.name: Lee Enfield : Tournament of Death
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.12 KB

Lee Enfield: Tournament of Death is the second adventure in the Time Troubleshooter series, where the hero finds himself in the 13th century. His mission is to retrieve the Holy Shroud from the Castle of the Count of Savoy before his arch-enemy Yellow Shadow destroys it. The castle is heavily guarded, and Lee must fight his way through numerous rooms and hidden passages while facing specially trained guards, foot soldiers, and even bears. The odds of success are low, but with courage and skill, he can find the necessary items to aid him in his mission.

meta.name: Lee Enfield : Space Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An evil army of enemy space soldiers has invaded a space station. The player, taking the role of the infamous fictional character Bob Morane, must recover the control of the base, locating and destroying all the enemies. Bob Morane: Science Fiction is a multi-directional scrolling shooter game. The gameplay is similar to the game Prohibition. Like in "Prohibition", the player must locate (along the spatial base) and shoot each enemy soldier in a limited amount of time, before that the enemy soldier shoots the player. The bests scores will be archived in the High-Scores table.

meta.name: Bob Winner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bob Winner is searching for a lost civilisation somewhere in the desert, and has to gain three keys to access it by beating a boss in Paris, London, and New York respectively. The first two bosses are boxers, the last one is a gun-toting cowboy. The items necessary to beat the bosses are found on the preceding screens.
So far the rather weak story for this typical French side-view flip-screen action adventure that focuses not so much on combat but on avoiding rather unmotivated rolling barrels and flying insects and is remarkable mainly because of its at the time outstanding graphics.

meta.name: Bob's Full House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bob's Full House recreates the quiz game show format by blending trivia with bingo-style progression. Up to four players answer questions, collect numbers, and work to complete lines on their boards to earn prizes and eventually clear the entire card. Each correct answer moves you closer to victory while rivals advance alongside you. The experience mixes general knowledge with the tension of bingo – an entertaining contest that rewards knowledge, awareness, and a bit of luck.

meta.name: Bobby Bearing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.00 KB

Bobby Bearing tells the story of a young steel ball who lives in the land of Technofear and usually avoids the dangerous Metaplanes. One day, however, Bobby is tricked by his evil cousin – he and his brothers are lured into the Metaplanes and abandoned there. Now it's up to Bobby to find his way home and rescue his brothers. The Metaplanes form a maze of isometric screens full of dead ends, junctions, and tricky mechanisms such as elevators, magnets, air ducts, and hidden switches. On top of that, enemies and traps await – evil marbles, crushing stone blocks, or perilous passages where one wrong move can send you tumbling off the screen.

meta.name: Bobby Bounce Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bobby Bounce Back bounces you through a massive platforming adventure heavily inspired by Bubble Bobble – but here, trampolines replace bubbles. With over 70 levels, a real ending screen, and a quirky main character resembling Titanic Blinky with a hi-res overlay, it delivers a full retro experience. Enemies are everywhere, and only precise platforming keeps you from an early game over. It's chaotic, colorful, and packed with pure old-school energy.

meta.name: Bobix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bobix lives a quiet and peaceful life as an apprentice magician on the island Texul. After the Queen of the island falls sick and dies, Bobix discovers that the magician Bennof, his teacher, is actually an impostor who has poisoned the queen. Because Bobix tried to warn the palace guards, Bennof kidnapped Bobette and fled to another island. In order to rescue Bobette, Bobix needs to find four magic potions on four different islands.

meta.name: Bobsled
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You're the driver of an Olympic bobsled racing down a mountain. Watch out for boulders, obstacles and DON'T HIT THE CHALET! Steer quickly as you gather speed going down the slope. Can you remain in control and reach the finish line? It's the countdown and your hands are tense against the control arm. An Olympic gold medal is in your grasp as you get ready for the challenge of your life. Quick reflexes and constant observation keep you in control on your journey. Swoooosh!

meta.name: Bobsleigh
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.63 KB

In Bobsleigh you take on both the management and control of your team. You train, buy equipment and keep your finances in check – if you go bankrupt, it's over. The races are viewed from inside the sled, right behind the pilot and brakeman. You steer left and right while gravity determines your speed. Strong performances earn money for better gear and training – maybe even enough to reach the Olympic Games.

meta.name: Bocce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.90 KB

Bowls – also known as Bocce – brings the traditional sport to the screen. First, the small white ball, the jack, is rolled into play. Players then try to place their larger, heavier balls as close to the jack as possible. Points are awarded for every ball closer to the jack than the opponent's nearest one. The game screen is divided into sections: the lane viewed from above, controls for position, direction, and spin, and a sideline view of the player. Different tracks add variety, and you can play either against the computer or another player.

meta.name: The Bod Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bod the Alien's children have been kidnapped and taken to three different time periods on Earth. Egyptian pyramid, medieval castle and Victorian haunted house. Good job Bod is a good friend of Dr. Who. In the TARDIS Bod travels back in time to rescue his kids. The Bod Squad is a one-player, flick-screen platform game. You control Bod with your joystick and you can jump, squash (duck), swim and sometimes fly. To help Bod on each level there are potions, springs, teleports and hidden platforms. Switches also can be found to make walls disappear. Trying to stop Bod are many enemies, pressing your fire-button slings Bod-bombs to destroy these. Also scattered around each levels are spikes, heads that spit fire and bear-traps. Touching any of these loses one of only three lives. Another hindrance is the time limit, which can be topped up by finding a potion.

meta.name: Body Blow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.94 KB

Body Blow is a classic street beat'em-up that puts you in one-on-one fights against enemies in gritty environments. The animations are solid and give the brawls some life, while the sound effects, though quirky at first, quickly become repetitive. The game delivers a dose of entertaining action but suffers from monotony, keeping it from standing out as a truly memorable fighter.

meta.name: The Body In Focus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Body in Focus is an interactive learning program about the human body. Through different modules you discover facts about organs, systems, and their functions, with each activity focusing on a specific part of the body. Gameplay elements appear in the form of quizzes – with over 200 questions to test your knowledge and score points. The program combines clear explanations with motivating challenges, helping you strengthen your understanding of the human body.

meta.name: Body Slam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.45 KB

Body Slam throws you into the world of tag team wrestling. Four teams face off – the Mad Soldiers, the Orient Express, the Great Maskmen, and the Crush Brothers – each out to prove their dominance in the ring. Every wrestler has unique special moves, ranging from knee strikes and body slams to flying headbutts and piledrivers. Some teams have extra abilities: the Mad Soldiers and Great Maskmen can use metal chairs outside the ring, while the Orient Express and Crush Brothers can leap from the turnbuckle with devastating attacks. Wrestlers can also bounce off the ropes for running strikes. When health runs low, a teammate can be tagged in to keep the fight going.

meta.name: The Body Transparent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Body Transparent is an interactive learning game that teaches human anatomy in a playful way. You move bones, organs, and fact cards to the correct positions in the body while learning about various systems, functions, and diseases. Each correct placement increases your score – a fun and educational journey through the human body.

meta.name: BOFH : Servers Under Siege
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In BOFH: Servers Under Siege, you play the role of the infamous Bastard Operator From Hell, arriving late to find activists have taken over your workplace. Staff have been ousted, servers held hostage, and bombs placed in network closets. Naturally, you decide to take matters into your own hands. To reclaim the server room on the 6th floor, you must first defuse all the bombs by cutting three wires in the correct order. Technicians in green may know the sequence – and you're not above forcing it out of them.

meta.name: The Boggit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

After Bored of the Rings parodied JRR Tolkien's classic Lord of the Rings series, Delta 4 did the same thing with its predecessor The Hobbit, preceding New Line Cinema's identical sequence by 20 years. There is a logical 3-part structure to the adventure, but there are also jokes such as the Old Ford location on the map being near a New Ford - a new Ford Sierra car.
This interactive fiction with graphics game thus features reluctant adventurer Bimbo Faggins and devious magician Grandalf attempting to gain treasure, ultimately by appearing on a TV game show. VERB NOUN inputs are used for most instructions, although you have to TALK someone before SAYing anything to them. EXAMINEing objects is crucial to progress, and to finding the best jokes.

meta.name: Boggles - The Mind Boggler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.83 KB

„Boggles: The Mind Boggler“ offers two different puzzle games. In „Master Logic,“ players must decipher a secret number combination in as few attempts as possible. Hints are given through color codes – Blue indicates the number of correct digits, while Red shows how many are in the right position. The goal is to achieve a perfect match. In „Letter Jumble,“ a scrambled word is presented that must be rearranged correctly. Each incorrect guess is counted, and the lower the score, the better the result.

meta.name: Bogue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.66 KB

Bogue tells the story of a king kidnapped by the evil Dr. Dactor. His henchmen have taken over the once peaceful land, and the inhabitants run or hide in fear. Out of the darkness, however, a savior emerges – the hero named Bogue, who rises against the enemies to free the land.

meta.name: Bogue II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.12 KB

Bogue II brings back the coolest hero in the world – the brave grape. This time, the evil Dactor has kidnapped all your friends and plans to turn them into evil robots. Your mission is to rescue them and stop his dark scheme before it's too late.

meta.name: Bogymen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bogy Men puts you in a dark world where invisible creatures are hunting you. Only their eyes reveal their presence, and touching them costs one of your three lives. Your task is to climb from the meter at the bottom right to the coin at the top left before the time runs out. The meter lets you flash the lights briefly three times, stunning the enemies for a few seconds. Once you collect the coin, you must return to the meter to turn the lights back on. Only then do you see the Bogy Men clearly and can pick up a trident to hunt them down. When all are destroyed, you move on to the next level.

meta.name: Boing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.27 KB

In Boing you play as Len the Programmer, who must collect the royalties owed to him in a flick-screen platformer. You jump between platforms, gather money bags, and avoid falling from too great a height. Parachutes can be collected to safely drop longer distances once. Creatures roam the screens, and if you touch one, stand still too long, or fall badly, you lose your only life and the game ends instantly.

meta.name: Boing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.82 KB

In Boing you play Boris, the big ball from Bollardia, who must escape from Planet Phweeesh. To do so, you bounce through 120 zones while the screen constantly scrolls from left to right. You cannot control your bouncing, only the direction, making timing crucial to stay on the platforms. Along the way you encounter creatures that you must either avoid or destroy using limited bullets or bombs, with extra ammo to collect on the journey. Falling into the water or touching an enemy costs one of your four lives, and once they are gone, the game is over.

meta.name: Boing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.17 KB

"Boing" is a skill-based game where you must dodge falling and bouncing balls. Precise movements and quick reflexes are key to avoiding dangerous obstacles and surviving as long as possible.

meta.name: Boing!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.14 KB

In Boing! you bounce around a playfield filled with platforms, aiming to collect all the items in the correct order. Failing to do so costs you a life. Each level raises the challenge as the objects become harder to reach and your jumps demand greater precision. Skill and timing are the keys to lasting success.

meta.name: Bojo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.72 KB

Bojo the Clown is performing at a circus, and must impress the audience by bouncing on a series of trampolines to launch himself in the air. Doing so will allow him to get a balloon or two. Once one has been collected, the same one appears somewhere else and Bojo must jump on a different trampoline to get it. While collecting the balloons, he must also be on the look-out for spears which approach him from both directions. If Bojo gets skewered or misses a trampoline, he will lose a life.

meta.name: Bolo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bolo puts two players head-to-head, each with their own view in a split-screen setup. You chase each other through narrow streets and open areas, always trying to land the decisive shot first. The layout stays readable, but the tension spikes whenever you close in and every hit can turn the match around. A fast, straightforward duel where reflexes and spatial awareness mean everything.

meta.name: Bomb Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.87 KB

Bomb Ace puts you in a small plane that sweeps endlessly from left to right, reappearing on the left after each pass. Tanks roll across the ground below, and you must bomb them without hitting the surrounding buildings. Every destroyed tank earns points, every damaged structure deducts them. By changing your altitude you decide how bold or precise your drops will be, and with only 100 seconds on the clock, you squeeze out as many points as you can.

meta.name: Bomb Catch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.67 KB

Bomb Catch is a fast-paced skill game released in 2006 as part of the Minigame Competition in the 4K category. In this small but addictive game, players must catch falling bombs before they hit the ground and explode. The gameplay is simple but gripping: players move under the falling bombs and must use quick reactions to catch each bomb before it causes damage. As the speed and number of bombs increase, the challenge increases, making Bomb Catch an increasingly intense gaming experience. The minimalist controls and fast game speed make it perfect for short and exciting sessions.

meta.name: Bomb Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.95 KB

Bomb Chase has you racing through tight arenas as Smudge, collecting 20 bombs while monsters close in on you. The shifting walls move unpredictably – hesitate for a second and they cut off your escape or trap you completely. Each bomb pulls you closer to freedom, but every step becomes a gamble when the arena itself turns against you.

meta.name: Bomb Chase : 2009 Special Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bomb Chase: 2009 Special Edition throws you into a boosted version of the bomb-collecting chaos, with Smudge racing to grab 20 bombs per arena before they explode. The monsters get bolder, the walls keep sliding in your way, and every wrong move can trap you. This edition finally runs clean and stable, adds new music, selectable options, and plenty of fresh levels. You sprint from bomb to bomb with the constant feeling that time, walls, or monsters might take you out at any second – and that's exactly what makes it thrilling.

meta.name: Bomb Chase : Revival
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bomb Chase: Revival puts Smudge back into a refreshed arena where you must collect every bomb while dodging persistent enemies. The shifting walls remain unpredictable – one wrong move and you're trapped. With foes becoming more relentless, every collected bomb feels like a small victory as you push to stay ahead of the chaos.

meta.name: Bomb Fusion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.23 KB

Bomb Fusion throws you in as the daring rescuer inside a nuclear facility filled with bombs on the brink of exploding. Each device counts down mercilessly – once it hits the final seconds, you must reach it and reset it or the radiation meter will surge dangerously. While defusing bombs, fuel capsules rain from a pipe, and you must collect and deliver them to a box without losing them to the roaming ball that knocks them away. Pipes help you reach higher platforms or you can drop off the bottom to reappear at the top. Only after enough bombs are defused and enough capsules secured do you progress to the next stage – every moment feels like a race against the end of the world.

meta.name: Bomb Jack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Bomb Jack, el jugador controla a Jack, quien debe recoger todas las bombas para completar la ronda actual y pasar a la siguiente. Esto suena fácil, ¿verdad? ¡Incorrecto! Numerosos enemigos como aves, momias, tortugas y orbes hacen la tarea más difícil a Jack.
nnEn cada ronda, cuando has recolectado una número de bombas saldrá una moneda de bonificación, y si recolectas esta moneda la puntuación del jugador aumentará de 2 a 4 veces. Más a menudo que no, aparecerá la "bola de poder", y cuando la recojas, puedes derrotar a los enemigos y tener más tiempo para recoger todas las bombas. También hay la moneda "E", que le da a Jack una vida adicional, pero rara vez aparece esta moneda.
nnCuanto más progresas en el juego, más difícil se vuelve, ya que los enemigos viajan más rápido para atraparte.

meta.name: Bomb Jack II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tras salvar el mundo en la primera entrega, Bomb Jack ahora tiene un objetivo más… terrenal: recoger todo el oro posible, esparcido sobre repisas que alternan entre abiertas y cerradas. Las abiertas dan más puntos, y si logras recoger 10 seguidas, ¡ganarás una vida extra! Así que planifica bien tu ruta: prioriza las abiertas cuando puedas. El juego cambia respecto al original: Jack ya no se mueve con libertad. Ahora avanza a saltos (flick-style), teletransportándose solo a repisas situadas directamente en las cuatro direcciones cardinales. Y cuidado con los enemigos: sí, puedes empujarlos al vacío… pero cada empujón consume parte de tu energía limitada. Avaricia o supervivencia? Cada salto es una decisión.

meta.name: Bomb Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.96 KB

Bomb Mania is a mixture of Bomber Man and Pac-Man. The player's task is to gather all the stars on the board. The mission is complicated by hostile Frix race monsters and various stones blocking an access to certain places. The player may use bombs scattered around the maze to kill the enemies and destroy the walls, although the bombs must be used with extra caution, as destroying the star means a loss of life. There are a few types of walls, some of them falling apart after one blast, the other requires more explosions. The game features 123 levels all together.

meta.name: Bomb Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.68 KB

"Bomb Mania" is a Commodore C64 game for 2 to 4 players based on the classic Bomberman/Dynablaster principle. Players, trapped in a labyrinth, blast their way through walls, collect power-ups and try to eliminate each other. The main attraction is the multiplayer mode, where up to four players can compete against each other using the "4JOY" adapter specially developed for this game to be the last survivor. There are various power-ups, such as extended explosion range, more bombs or speed. Special extras include kick bombs and remote-detonated R-bombs. The game features eight levels, which repeat in an endless loop after completion.

meta.name: Bomb Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Simplified clone of BombJack where the player must collect bombs scattered on the screen while avoiding obstacles and collecting bonuses.

meta.name: Bomb Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.20 KB

Bomb Squad drops you into a bizarre dimensional feud: the twin brothers Bang and Boom are banished to the Bomb Squad Pit to finally settle their endless dispute. Across three rounds they try to blast each other out of the arena – or let wandering spirits finish the job. But the battleground is treacherous: sneaking enemies close in, narrow passageways force bold moves, and your own explosions are just as deadly as the opponent's. Occasionally you'll find helpful pickups that boost your speed, grant extra bombs, or increase blast range. Every moment becomes a dance of danger and opportunity – and in the end, only the one still standing claims victory.

meta.name: Bomb Threat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.73 KB

Bomb Threat puts you in the role of a captive trapped inside a terrorist hideout, with a bomb set to detonate in town at 4 p.m. The clock pushes forward relentlessly as you search the sealed room, testing every hint, object, and available verb to find a way out. Each action opens possibilities or dead ends – only sharp thinking, careful exploration, and quick decisions will get you free in time to reach the town and stop the explosion.

meta.name: Bombuzal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bombuzal turns you into a tiny demolition expert stranded on small islands where every bomb must go off before you can move on. Small bombs can be detonated directly, but larger ones require clever chain reactions since their blast radius is deadly. What starts out simple soon becomes a tactical fireworks show of explosions, timing and risk. Later levels throw in slippery ice, movable bombs, vanishing tiles and other devious tricks. Every move needs planning – because in Bombuzal, blowing things up is very much a thinking game.

meta.name: Bomb-Hunt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.64 KB

"Strobuster" is a simple yet well-executed clone of the classic Bomb Jack game, where the player must skillfully collect bombs.

meta.name: Bomber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.83 KB

Bomber has you catching falling bombs before they hit the ground and blow everything apart. Each round grows faster and more unpredictable, pushing you to dart back and forth without missing a single drop. The gritty title screen also hints at the word's second meaning – you're not just chasing explosives, but a bit of street-sprayer attitude as well.

meta.name: Bomber Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.25 KB

Bomber Attack puts you in a heavy bomber that steadily moves left while enemy defenses wait below. You control only your altitude and when to release your bombs – the aircraft won't let you do more. With anti-aircraft fire and intercepting fighters closing in, you must drop 25 bombs with precision while avoiding sensitive targets like hospitals. Each run becomes a tight balance between destruction and restraint, and only a steady hand will see you through.

meta.name: Bomber Run 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bomber Run 64 puts you in a plane sweeping back and forth across a tightly packed city that blocks your path. Only by dropping bombs with careful timing can you level enough buildings to clear a safe landing zone. Once you've created that space, you can refuel and head out on the next run – always racing against your own precision and the towering skyline below.

meta.name: Bomberland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bomberland is a 2D action-puzzle game where you use timed bombs to blast through enemies and brick walls on your way to defeat Lord Bomber. Bombs explode after about two seconds, so smart placement and quick escapes are key. Brick walls can block or protect, and often hide power-ups or the level's exit. Clearing the entire map earns bonus points – if you survive your own blast.

meta.name: Bomberman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.16 KB

An early version of BomberMan on the C64, created with the SEUCK engine for simultaneous play with one or two players. Champion Software later revisited this game theme in 1995's "Bomberman II: Penuts".

meta.name: Bomberman C64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bomberman C64 is a clone of Bomber Man. The player's task is to kill all the hostile creatures on the board. The player may use bombs, although the bombs must be used with extra caution, as the explosion blast moves 3 fields in each direction.
The game features 8 levels all together.

meta.name: Bomberman II Penuts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.10 KB

"Bomberman II: Penuts" is a Bomberman clone. The game relies on the tried and tested principle of the Bomberman genre, in which players strategically place bombs to destroy obstacles and eliminate enemies while moving through labyrinthine levels. In "Bomberman II: Penuts" players must use well-timed bomb explosions to catch enemies and clear the paths without getting caught in an explosion themselves. The challenge is to keep the right distance from the bombs while navigating the playing field quickly. Each level is equipped with different obstacles and enemies, which makes the gameplay exciting and varied.

meta.name: Bombi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.27 KB

Bombi is a two-player side-scrolling clone of Dyna Blaster or Bomberman. The goal is to eliminate the enemy by detonating a bomb when an enemy is within its range. To get closer to the opposing player, you have to avoid various creatures and remove walls and other obstacles in the maze.

meta.name: Bombo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.64 KB

Bombo throws you into a world scattered with bombs, chasing through iconic locations like the pyramids, old castles, and bustling New York. Each screen challenges you to collect 20 bombs, with blinking ones offering big extra points. Your jetpack grants full freedom of movement in every direction, letting you zip between platforms while dodging enemies that never let up. Every second matters – grab the most dangerous bombs first if you want to save not just the levels, but humanity itself.

meta.name: Bomb Sweeper 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Bombsweeper 64" is a technically impressive Minesweeper adaptation for the Commodore 64. The game brings the popular logic classic to the C64 and impresses with additional features that are rare for the platform: It supports real mouse interface, making navigation and selection of fields more intuitive and user-friendly, similar to modern systems. The goal in Bombsweeper 64 remains the same as in the original game: players must uncover a grid of fields without encountering hidden bombs, strategically using clues to safely identify and mark them. Players' progress and best performances are saved in the high score, which promotes a competitive spirit and ensures long-term motivation.

meta.name: Bonanza Bros.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Robo y Mobo, los infames y torpes ladrones, están metidos en problemas hasta el cuello. El Jefe de Policía los ha reclutado para limpiar la ciudad. Si fallan, ¡terminarán en la cárcel!

meta.name: Bond
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.28 KB

Bond is a colorful platformer inspired by Mario but with its own unique twist and multi-screen design. You control a small character who jumps across platforms to collect flowers, moving freely between different sections of the level. The game blends classic jump-and-run mechanics with an open structure that encourages exploration and keeps the gameplay fresh.

meta.name: Bone Cruncher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 70.54 KB

In Bone Cruncher you play as Bono, a dragon who sells soap made from skeletons. To restock, you must explore a scrolling castle filled with dirt, monsters, and gaze stones in classic Boulder Dash style. Each level has 25 skeletons to collect, requiring strategic movement, blocking paths, and avoiding enemies – some of which can devour your skeletons. Puzzle-solving and precise planning are key to soap-making success.

meta.name: Bongo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.07 KB

Bongo sends you into a hectic gem hunt as a rat while a relentless villain stays right on your tail. On each screen, you have to deal with ladders, slides, and conveyor belts that can slow you down or speed you up. The letters of Bongo's name are especially useful, letting you teleport to different parts of the screen. Its appeal comes from fast collecting, constant dodging, and the small tricks that help you eventually rescue your girlfriend and reach the next stage.

meta.name: Bonka
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Like Cuthbert Goes Digging, Bonka is a clone of Space Panic. With a constantly falling oxygen supply, you must climb the platform and eliminate the electrocuting Meanies. Hack a hole in the ground for the Meanie to fall into, then hack a hole in the meanies, or rather, hack them through the hole so they fall down and die. The game is customisable with four different speeds and between one and nine Meanies on-screen.

meta.name: Bonzo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.10 KB

In Bonzo you guide a charming little workman through a multi-tiered maze of platforms and ladders, collecting boxes along the way. Each round is unique, with ladders and boxes randomly placed. As you climb and descend, evil creatures close in, demanding precision and calm under pressure, since you can only leave ladders at exact floor levels. Clearing all boxes earns you entry to the next stage, where points are higher but the Bonzos multiply, testing your skill and nerve even further.

meta.name: Booga-Boo the Flea
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.28 KB

Booga-Boo the Flea takes you to the planet Cebolla-7, a twisting labyrinth of caverns. As a flea, you must carefully ascend and find the exit, avoiding rocks and branches that can send you crashing back to the ground. But the environment isn't your only threat – a Pterodactyl appears from time to time, trying to devour you. Only with patience, precise timing, and skillful dodging can you hope to escape the maze.

meta.name: Book of the Dead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 91.64 KB

In Book of the Dead you play as Kteth, a falcon-headed godling from Egyptian mythology, cast out of the divine realm after the great battle between Set and Horus. Now mortal and cursed with a deadly disease, your quest is to recover the lost Book of the Dead — an ancient manuscript that details how souls can journey back to the afterlife. Its fragments lie hidden on tomb walls, within sacred tomes, and in the minds of priests and spirits. Along the way, you must seek aid from other gods, overcome trials, and purify your soul to reclaim your divine nature before the curse consumes you.

meta.name: Boom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Doom, but scaled down for the Commodore 64. It is mostly in Hungarian but there isn't anything that you'll miss if you don't know the language. Fight your way to the exit point on each level collecting armament and ammunition as you go, along with the keys you need to open doors. Fight, kill pretty much everything you see. Boom, that's Doom!

meta.name: Boom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Doom, but scaled down for the Commodore 64. It is mostly in Hungarian but there isn't anything that you'll miss if you don't know the language. Fight your way to the exit point on each level collecting armament and ammunition as you go, along with the keys you need to open doors. Fight, kill pretty much everything you see. Boom, that's Doom!

meta.name: Boom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Boom" is a challenging side-scrolling shooter. The game is inspired by Amiga classics and, with its fluid gameplay and sophisticated graphics, actually exudes a strong Amiga charm that makes it stand out among the C64 titles. The developers set out to make the game even more difficult than the popular Katakis - and the first levels are already designed to challenge players with demanding waves of enemies and complex level designs. The gameplay of "Boom" rewards patience and skill: while the early levels put players to the test, progress in the later levels brings gripping new challenges and playful rewards that make the difficulty level worthwhile. The meticulously designed enemy formations and the ever-increasing complexity offer side-scrolling shooter fans an exciting and intense experience.

meta.name: Boom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Boom" is a challenging side-scrolling shooter. The game is inspired by Amiga classics and, with its fluid gameplay and sophisticated graphics, actually exudes a strong Amiga charm that makes it stand out among the C64 titles. The developers set out to make the game even more difficult than the popular Katakis - and the first levels are already designed to challenge players with demanding waves of enemies and complex level designs. The gameplay of "Boom" rewards patience and skill: while the early levels put players to the test, progress in the later levels brings gripping new challenges and playful rewards that make the difficulty level worthwhile. The meticulously designed enemy formations and the ever-increasing complexity offer side-scrolling shooter fans an exciting and intense experience.

meta.name: Boom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.16 KB

Boom is a thrilling defensive shooter. In this action-packed game, Earth faces its last line of defense as an alien armada heads toward our solar system at the speed of light. Players' mission is to repel the alien attack and protect Earth from invasion. The gameplay unfolds as an intense shooter where players must strategically fend off alien spaceships and prevent the enemy ships from reaching Earth. The radar-based display shows the advancing alien armada, so players must coordinate their attacks to avert Earth's impending doom. Each alien attack gets stronger, requiring quick reflexes and precise aim to withstand the waves.

meta.name: Boot Camp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combat School es un juego tipo Track & Field, pero con un toque militar. 
Juegas como Nick, un soldado motivado (y Joe en el modo de 2 jugadores) en busca de un ascenso.
Así pues, se le alista en el ejército, que le impone pruebas más o menos difíciles y variadas. Algunas son penalizadoras y el éxito es obligatorio, otras se compensan con una prueba de tirón extra para compensar la derrota, algunas como la pulseada no imponen ninguna penalización. Entre estas pruebas encontrarás saltos, tiro al blanco, lucha de brazos, lucha contra el instructor, pull-ups y una secuencia de vencerlos a todos. El juego es difícil, pero la ejecución es bastante pulcra.

meta.name: Bootleg Bandits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.46 KB

In Bootleg Bandits you play a smuggler delivering illegal Scotch in a heavily armed, armored car. As you race down the highways, police and local authorities pursue you relentlessly, determined to stop and destroy you. Only skilled driving, firepower, and a bit of luck will get you to your destination and away from the law.

meta.name: Booty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.41 KB

Booty es un juego de plataformas. Juegas como Jim, el camarero, que aborda un barco mercante y debe encontrar la mayor cantidad de tesoros posible para obtener su botín. ¡Necesitarás elegir estratégicamente el orden en el que buscarás en las diferentes habitaciones del barco porque solo puedes llevar una llave a la vez!

meta.name: Booze Cruise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.73 KB

Booze Cruise sends you through a twisting maze where you navigate around obstacles and enemies to reach your goal. Its simple structure and deliberately quirky presentation focus less on polish and more on chaotic fun. The experience is built around quick decisions, experimentation and embracing the absurd, with the journey often being more important than the destination.

meta.name: Rock 'n Wrestle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este es el primer juego de deportes de combate en «3D» en el que puedes esquivar a tu oponente moviéndote hacia arriba o hacia abajo por la pantalla, hacia la izquierda o hacia la derecha.
Tendrás que enfrentarte a varios oponentes uno tras otro.
Los movimientos que se ofrecen incluyen casi todo lo que encontrarías en la lucha libre real: piledrivers, giros de brazo, body slams y voleas en el tensor, todo ello totalmente animado. Los gráficos multicolores son bastante detallados.

meta.name: Boppie's Great Word Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.58 KB

Boppie's Great Word Chase combines learning and dexterity by letting you guide a bouncing ball through varied levels while collecting letters in the correct order to form words. Each letter must be picked up individually and safely brought home, all while dangerous creatures block your path and demand careful planning. Tools such as placeable blockers and umbrellas add tactical options for bypassing obstacles and reaching new areas. As the difficulty increases, level layouts, word lengths, and the way words are displayed change, challenging memory, spelling skills, and reflexes alike.

meta.name: Border Blast II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 62.30 KB

Border Blast II noticeably expands the experience by allowing full movement across the entire screen instead of limiting you to a single area. Enemies attack from all directions, demanding precise maneuvering and fast reactions. With eight-direction shooting and a special weapon that creates walls of fire on both sides of your ship, the action remains intense and relentless. The core challenge revolves around movement, control and smart use of your offensive options.

meta.name: Border Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's the 1980s and the Cold War between the Western Bloc (led by the USA) and the Eastern Bloc (led by the Soviet Union) is at its peak. The town of Ostnitz lies on the border between the fictitious Eastern Bloc state Frobnia and the also fictitious neutral Litzenburg. The US ambassador will soon arrive in Ostnitz to give a speech on the occasion of Constitution Day there. But a plot to assassinate the ambassador is soon uncovered, which would increase tensions between the superpowers.
Border Zone is a text adventure game in which the player controls three different protagonists in three chapters: an American businessman and two special agents - one Western and one Eastern. In addition to traditional text-based exploration and puzzle solving, the game has real-time elements: time passes even when the player is not interacting with the game.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

No prizes for guessing the inspiration for this one. The Great Ring needs to be returned to Mount Doom, a treacherous task to be undertaken by Fordo the Boggit. Spam, Pimply and Murky are his country-bumpkin friends, and he will later meet with Bumbadil and Hashberry, two old hippies. The main quest involves meeting up with Legoland the Elf, Giblet the Dwarf and Aragont.
In keeping with the humour, familiar locations become "the featureless plain below the pink mountain", "Lake Anadin" and the "Land of the Personal-Stereo-Wearing Goblins".

meta.name: Borrowed Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Encarnas a un detective privado con ocho casos de diversa importancia, que puedes conocer leyendo los expedientes correspondientes. Una llamada anónima altera tu rutina diaria: ¡te avisan de que alguien intenta matarte! Hay veinte personas que pueden enfadarse lo suficiente como para decidir matarte.
En este juego tienes que escribir combinaciones de verbos y sustantivos para realizar una acción. Los lugares se describen en texto y se presentan mediante imágenes, estas últimas a menudo proporcionan información adicional no incluida en la descripción del texto.

meta.name: Borzak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.47 KB

Borzak places you on a strange marshy planet after a crash leaves you separated from your spacecraft. In constantly scrolling stages, you move through hazardous terrain, leap over wide gaps and avoid dangerous creatures and obstacles. A special antigrav ability allows extremely long jumps but requires careful timing, as landing cannot be controlled freely. Speed directly affects jump distance, making every movement a calculated risk – challenging, rhythmic and built around precise control.

meta.name: Bosconian '87
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.47 KB

Bosconian '87 te sitúa en una batalla sobre la Tierra, luchando por un pueblo recién reunido contra una amenaza alienígena. Controlas una nave espacial con vista de arriba hacia abajo, destruyendo naves enemigas y rocas mientras usas un escáner para localizar estaciones espaciales que deben ser eliminadas en cada oleada. Tu nave puede detenerse o moverse en cuatro direcciones. Mantente atento al nivel de combustible, pero se puede recolectar combustible extra y mejores armas. En momentos peligrosos, puedes acoplarte a una nave nodriza para protegerte.

meta.name: Botticelli
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Botticelli challenges you to a battle of wits in which each side tries to guess what the other is thinking of. By asking clever yes-or-no questions, the computer attempts to uncover your chosen object – or you try to deduce its solution in return. Different categories add variety, and you can expand the system's knowledge by teaching it new objects with suitable questions. With every round the program becomes smarter – turning each session into a contest of logic, deduction and creativity.

meta.name: Boulder Dash II : Rockford's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In part two of the Boulder Dash series the overall game design hasn't changed compared to the original, but sixteen new levels have been created. The basis of the game is the same, you still have to mine diamonds while avoiding falling rocks and cave monsters of all sorts. As in part one, later levels become more difficult because many puzzle elements are added.

meta.name: Boulder Dash 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.96 KB

Boulder Dash III continues the series with a futuristic twist – Rockford now wears a spacesuit and explores sci-fi themed caverns. The goal remains the same: collect enough diamonds to open the portal to the next level. Along the way, boulders, monsters, and spreading slime threaten to block paths or kill Rockford. Skill is required to use falling rocks strategically, crush monsters, and unlock extra diamonds. A strict time limit and puzzle elements, such as walls that transform boulders into diamonds, make the challenge even greater.

meta.name: Boulder Dash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.51 KB

Eres Rockford, y tienes que cavar a través de cuevas infestadas de monstruos en busca de diamantes. En cada nivel debes reunir un número concreto de diamantes para abrir un portal al siguiente nivel. Los enemigos pueden ser aplastados por la caída de rocas, que quedan sueltas cuando se quita el suelo debajo de ellas o se empujan sobre un espacio vacío, pero ten cuidado porque tambien pueden aplastarte a ti. En los niveles más avanzados, la dificultad aumenta añadiendo más rompecabezas y límites de tiempo más cortos.

meta.name: Boulder Dash : Construction Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rockford the Ant regresa en otra aventura de Boulder Dash con 15 niveles nuevos y un editor de juegos fácil de usar. Los jugadores pueden crear, guardar y jugar sus propios niveles. El software incluye una función para secuenciar tus niveles en un disco de juego separado. Todos los elementos y peligros de las aventuras anteriores de Boulder Dash están de vuelta: las luciérnagas, las mariposas, las amebas en crecimiento, las paredes encantadas y, por supuesto, las rocas.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.66 KB

Rockford must dig through caves collecting gems and diamonds and reach the exit within a time limit, while avoiding various types of dangerous creatures as well as obstacles like falling rocks and the constant danger of being crushed or trapped by an avalanche, or killed by an underground explosion.

meta.name: Bounce It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bounce It challenges you to guide a basketball safely through a series of single-screen levels to the hoop – all under time pressure. Crashing into bottles, laser beams, or other hazards bursts the ball instantly. You can collect additional balls for points and extra lives, but there's a catch: a bar on the screen fills up if you stop bouncing, and once it's full, the ball explodes. You'll need to stay on the move, time every jump just right, and never stop bouncing if you want to make it to the basket.

meta.name: Bounce!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.45 KB

Bounce! sends you along a galactic jumping route where you hop from pad to pad and must keep your head at all times. Each surface has its own effect – green pads launch you far ahead, red ones slow you down, black pads are deadly trap doors that cost you a life, and white pads offer valuable bonus rewards. Hazards await along the way, and only with precise timing and smart choices will you stay in the game – a fast-paced balancing act between risk and reward.

meta.name: Bouncer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.92 KB

Bouncer challenges you to dodge bouncing bubbles that cost a life on contact. Shoot them to make them burst into smaller versions until they disappear completely. Only once all bubbles are gone can you move on to the next level. The gameplay is heavily inspired by Pang, but adds its own arcade flair where reflexes, timing, and movement are key to survival.

meta.name: Charlie's House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.96 KB

Bouncer / Charlie's House puts you in control of Hoppy as he jumps through a maze of platforms, enemies, and traps. Your goal is to collect keys and reach the exit without getting caught. From bizarre creatures to wriggling worms, you'll need quick reflexes and good timing to survive each level. Make it to the next stage and you'll face faster action, higher scores, and even crazier obstacles.

meta.name: Bounces
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.75 KB

Bounces throws you into a fast-paced futuristic arena where you battle a human or computer opponent in two 90-second halves. Score points by catching the bouncing ball and throwing it through goal slots on your rival's side – the deeper the slot, the higher the reward, but also the tougher the shot. You're tethered to your half of the screen, so overreaching drains your stamina. You can also earn points by knocking your opponent down with punches or the ball. Lose all your stamina, and you're left helpless until you recover. Brutal, strategic, and fast – only the smartest and toughest will win.

meta.name: Bouncing Heads
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.59 KB

Bouncing Heads es un juego de laberintos de arriba abajo en el que la pantalla se desplaza a medida que te mueves. El objetivo es controlar una cabeza que rebota y recoger un cierto número de labios para avanzar al siguiente nivel. A medida que te mueves por el laberinto flotante, varias criaturas caminan a tu alrededor y si golpeas a una, pierdes una de las tres vidas. Vas armado con una pistola, pero la munición es limitada, aunque puedes recoger más que están esparcidas por el laberinto. Algunas casillas tienen iconos que pueden ayudarte o entorpecerte: flechas de dirección, un reloj para añadir o quitar tiempo, un trampolín para rebotar más y agua para ahogarte. Una vez que hayas recogido suficientes labios dentro del tiempo límite, encuentras la casilla de salida y pasas al siguiente nivel.

meta.name: The Bouncing Kamungas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Bouncing Kamungas puts you in the role of a watermelon farmer armed with a pitchfork, caught in the middle of a thunderstorm as a swarm of bouncing Kamungas descends upon your fields. Your task is to plant and protect watermelons until they're ripe for harvest – all while defending them from the ravenous Kamungas. These bouncing creatures can only be defeated by standing directly beneath them with your pitchfork held high so they land on it. If a Kamunga lands on a watermelon, it gets eaten. Players earn points for every mature watermelon harvested. But there are many dangers: being struck by a Kamunga costs a life, roaming snakes threaten your movement, and holding your pitchfork aloft during a lightning strike results in electrocution. After three lost lives, it's game over.

meta.name: Bouncy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.54 KB

Bouncy puts you in control of a small figure dodging chaotic, colorful bouncing enemies. The goal is to survive long enough to reach the next level. With only three lives, every mistake counts – one touch can end it all. Precision, quick reflexes, and perfect timing are essential as enemies grow faster, more numerous, and harder to avoid with each level.

meta.name: Bouncy Balls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bouncy Balls challenges you to absorb your opponents' energy through well-aimed jumps in order to jump even higher. You win a level either by knocking all others off the screen or by reaching full energy and exiting, no matter how many opponents remain. The more precise your jumps, the better your shot at victory.

meta.name: Bouncy Balls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You win a level either by knocking all others off the screen or by reaching full energy and exiting, no matter how many opponents remain. The more precise your jumps, the better your shot at victory.

meta.name: Bouncy Cars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bouncy Cars lets one or two players race on an oval track where controlling the springy cars becomes the main challenge. With bouncy physics and delayed handling, every corner demands focus. The goal is to complete the required laps faster than your opponent without spinning out or wasting time. Easy to pick up, hard to master – especially in head-to-head competition.

meta.name: Bouncy Cars Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bouncy Cars Revenge lets one or two players race on an oval track where controlling the springy cars becomes the main challenge. With bouncy physics and delayed handling, every corner demands focus. meta.name: Bound
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.36 KB

Bound builds on the classic brick-breaking formula where you control a paddle to keep a ball in play and clear rows of blocks. The objective is to remove every block without letting the ball fall. As the game progresses, speed and difficulty increase, demanding precise timing and quick reflexes. Power-ups alter the ball's behavior or enhance the paddle, adding strategic variety to this familiar skill-based challenge.

meta.name: Bounder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.05 KB

En Bounder, el jugador controla una pelota de tenis que rebota constantemente por la pantalla.
El jugador debe mover la pelota entre rebote y rebote para que caiga en zonas favorables como la hierba o el suelo hexagonal principal. Si aterriza en zonas peligrosas como pinchos y arena, o si golpea a los enemigos en movimiento, el jugador pierde una de las siete vidas. Sin embargo, hay casillas de bonificación (flechas que permiten que la bola permanezca más tiempo en el aire o teletransportes que despejan una parte del juego).
Las 174 pantallas se dividen en 10 niveles. Al final de cada nivel hay una pantalla de bonificación.

meta.name: Bounty Bob Strikes Back!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bounty Bob Strikes Back! once again sends you into hazardous mines where, as Bounty Bob, you must walk every section of the platforms to claim territory. Ladders, slides, tubes, cannons and transporters help you reach difficult areas, requiring a unique strategy for each level. Mutants roam the mines and cost a life on contact unless you collect special items that temporarily let you defeat them. A time limit adds extra pressure – careful planning, timing and smart use of the environment determine your success.

meta.name: Bounty Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.15 KB

Bounty Hunter casts you as a bounty hunter tasked with tracking down the five members of the infamous Oil Gang and returning their stolen gold to the bank of Dodge. The game is driven by classic verb-noun text input, making every action a deliberate choice. Gathering clues, exploring locations and making decisions form the core of the experience, and mistakes cannot easily be undone. A straightforward text adventure that rewards careful thinking and attention to detail.

You must wend you way through the heavily defended fortress, destroying the guardian troops and bots before they get you. Will you be able to get your bounty? It will take a LOT of killing but... this is the way.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bounzy puts you in a spiral-shaped building against fast-moving reptiles. Your goal is to collect all items such as keys, amphorae, statues, and gems while avoiding your pursuers. Some reptiles remain on one level, while others can use ladders to chase you directly. Contact is fatal, so you must move carefully and plan ahead. The building layout, including ladders and items, is randomly generated each time, ensuring no two games are alike. The objective is to score as many points as possible and earn a place in the high-score table.

meta.name: Bowling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.47 KB

Bowling is a classic top-down bowling game designed for a single player. In this simple but fun sports game, the player takes control of the bowling ball and tries to knock down as many pins as possible by making accurate throws and scoring strikes or spares. The top-down perspective allows a clear view of the lane and pins, making it easier to plan and accurately score throws. Players can adjust their throwing angle and the strength of the throw to achieve the best results.

meta.name: Bowling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.69 KB

Bowling brings the classic alley game to the C64. You control your player down the lane, line up your shot, and set the speed to knock down as many pins as possible. The goal is to score strikes and spares across multiple frames to achieve the highest total. Despite its simple visuals, the game captures the competitive spirit of a real bowling alley and demands precise timing to deliver the perfect roll.

meta.name: Bowling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.92 KB

Bowling is a classic digital version of the popular alley game for the C64. You control the ball using simple keyboard input – pressing and releasing the “0” key rolls the ball, and pressing it again adjusts the curve for better control. Up to four players can compete, aiming for strikes, spares, and precise shots to claim victory. The game focuses on the essentials: clear visuals, tactical aiming, and the authentic bowling spirit, captured in the minimalist style of early 1980s computer gaming.

meta.name: Bowling Night
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.10 KB

En Bowling Night juegas al clásico juego de bolos, solo o con hasta dos personas. La bola se mueve rápidamente por la pista y pulsas la barra espaciadora para rodarla. La sincronización es clave para golpear el centro y conseguir strikes o spares. El juego se ajusta fielmente a las reglas reales de los bolos, incluyendo la precisión en la puntuación, lanzamientos adicionales en el décimo cuadro y el difícil objetivo de un juego perfecto de 300.

meta.name: The Boxer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.17 KB

The Boxer puts you in charge of managing the careers of boxers, shaping their progress through training, planning and smart decision-making. You develop strength, skill and stamina, select suitable fights and manage recovery to avoid burnout. Victories grant experience and reputation, unlocking tougher opponents and greater rewards, making long-term strategy more important than quick wins.

meta.name: Boxes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Boxes you take on the task of organizing freight crates scattered across the storage rooms of a large factory. By pushing the heavy boxes through narrow and winding rooms, you try to move them onto the marked target spots. Every move must be planned carefully, since a single misplaced crate can block the path and trap you in an unsolvable situation. If that happens, the current room can easily be restarted so you can try a better approach. With its many tricky storage layouts, the game challenges your planning and problem-solving skills – and if you wish, you can even design your own levels to puzzle your friends.

meta.name: Boxing Champion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Boxing Champion you choose from a large roster of fighters with different strengths in areas such as power, defense and durability. You can then compete in single bouts or fight your way through a full championship. Each match is presented like a real boxing event, complete with an announcer and show-style introductions before the fight begins. Inside the ring you control your boxer from a 3D perspective and try to gain the advantage through movement and well-timed punches. After every round the judges award points, so victory can come either through scoring or a decisive knockout.

meta.name: Boxing Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.96 KB

Boxing Manager puts you in charge of a rising heavyweight's career, guiding him from his first bouts to a shot at the world title. Through a text-based interface, you control every aspect – training, tactics, and fight selection. Each victory moves you closer to glory, but poor strategy or reckless choices can end a career in seconds. Only careful planning, patience, and a sense for the perfect punch will create a true champion.

meta.name: Bozo's Night Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Bozo's Night Outo, tu objetivo es llevar al borracho Bozo a casa sano y salvo con todas las pintas que se ha tomado. Eliges entre tres rutas: izquierda, derecha o a través del parque. Llegar a casa te da 5 pintas, pero cada noche se hace más difícil caminar derecho. Si Bozo resulta herido o lo atrapa la policía, pierde entre 1 y 5 pintas.

n: Bozuma - The Mystery of the Mummy (Europe)

meta.name: Bozuma : The Mystery of the Mummy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bozuma: The Mystery of The Mummy is set in Hamburg in the year 1912, where you take on the role of a detective investigating a mysterious case involving a mummy and its supposed curse, accompanied by your partner Wilhelm. The goal is to gather enough evidence within a week to present your findings to your superior – only then is the game won. It's a point-and-click adventure focused on realistic detective work: most of your time is spent analyzing clues and talking to people. There are no traditional puzzles – instead, the challenge lies in deciding which of the 186 locations to visit next and how to convince people to cooperate. The game also includes real-life tasks like sleeping, eating, or refueling. These don't require special skills, but they do consume time and money.

meta.name: Brain Artifice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Brain Artifice is a puzzle game in which the player needs to build combinations out of given blocks. While initially the combinations simply consist of the the same picture or colour, in later levels there are certain patterns to achieve. The blocks are initially divided over the playfield and after grabbing one of them, the player can move it freely over all the unoccupied space. If the block is near another block from the pattern - the detailed requirements change from level to level - it is stuck and can't be moved anymore.
When a whole pattern is done, the stones transform into bricks so the player knows it is time to work with the rest of the stones. All this has to be done within a time limit, and unwinnable situations are entirely possible. The game features 100 levels which introduce additional gameplay elements over time, e.g. static blocks, blocks which change their colour or hidden blocks.

meta.name: Brain Disease
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.57 KB

Brain Disease is a tricky puzzle game created in 1993 by Bela Erdei. The game challenges the mental abilities of the players and offers a series of complex brain teasers that require patience, logic and strategic thinking. With the aim of constantly engaging the player in new challenges, Brain Disease presents itself as a "treacherous" puzzle experience that really challenges the brain. Each level offers new, well-thought-out puzzles to solve, with the difficulty level continuously increasing. The challenges are designed to engage various cognitive abilities and make the player think of creative solutions. This well-thought-out structure makes the game particularly appealing to puzzle enthusiasts looking for challenging tasks.

meta.name: Brain Disease 2 - The Return
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Brain Disease II: The Return is the sequel to the challenging puzzle game Brain Disease. While the first game focused on moving blocks, this sequel introduces a new concept: instead of pushing blocks together, players must now strategically arrange balls to meet certain patterns or requirements and unlock the next level. Brain Disease II focuses on logical thinking and the ability to plan several steps in advance. Levels become increasingly complex, and players must place balls precisely to meet the requirements. Switching from blocks to balls adds a new dynamic to the gameplay, as the movement options and arrangement require additional tactical considerations.

meta.name: Brain Spasm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Brain Spasm you need to get together stones with the same symbols. The stones can be moved to the next obstacle where they stop automatically, there is no way to halt in between. Diamonds also appear on the field and can be a nuisance or a help. Many puzzle games are either too difficult or too easy. According to the description this game is an exception. It is the right mixture, as the difficulty grade rises with the own skill.

meta.name: Brain Strain
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.77 KB

meta.name: Brainstorm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.05 KB

Brainstorm challenges you with an unusual scoring system where each screen requires you to beat your previous score before the timer runs out. Inside a large playfield, you influence a constantly moving ball by drawing colored lines that alter its path and guide it into specific shapes. Red areas raise or lower the score, other colors trigger teleports or have no effect, demanding constant judgment and precise placement of lines. As the game progresses, speed and complexity increase, additional balls and expanded options add pressure – only quick thinking, careful planning, and a solid understanding of the ball's behavior will let you advance.

meta.name: Brands Delux
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.17 KB

Brands Delux(e) is a top-down scrolling racing game where you drive as long as possible while overtaking cars. You can steer left or right and switch between low and high gear – but you only score in high gear. Occasionally, you'll race at night, with only your headlights revealing the road and other cars. Some road sections narrow unexpectedly, preceded by a warning sign. Crashing into another car costs one of four lives, and you can choose from four difficulty levels, with one being the hardest.

meta.name: Brave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Brave is a sci-fi platform game set on the alien planet. While traveling back to home planet the ship has crashed. The player has to repair the ship by finding 2 parts on each of 4 bases while avoiding or eliminating numerous enemies. The amount of bullets is limited, but some of the killed mutants may leave an extra ammo.

meta.name: The Brave African Huntress
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Brave African Huntress is a unique text adventure. The game combines classic text-based narrative with appealing illustrations that bring the scenery and atmosphere to life. In the role of a brave African huntress, players embark on an exciting journey through the jungle where their task is to defeat dangerous monsters and rid the wilderness of this threat. The game uses the text adventure format to enable decisions and interactions, while the accompanying illustrations visually immerse players in the world. Players must act wisely and make strategic decisions to brave the challenges of the wilderness and defeat the sinister creatures that haunt the jungle.

meta.name: BraveStarr
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.59 KB

El planeta de New Texas es similar al Texas de la época del salvaje oeste - con místicos indios, peleas de bar y mercenarios gatillo suelto. El único hombre lo suficientemente fuerte como para mantener el orden en ese lugar es el Marshall Bravestarr. Stampede es el principal villano de la obra; su objetivo es revivir a los muertos como zombis para cumplir sus órdenes.
BraveStarr es un título de acción de desplazamiento lateral basado en la popular serie de dibujos animados de los 80. Comenzando con una cantidad limitada de tiempo, debes encontrar y rescatar a Shamen que fue capturado por el malvado Hex Tex, para ayudar a los planes de Stampede. Tienes nueve minutos para completar tu tarea.

Break Ball is a Breakout clone with strange physics that can make your life difficult.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.67 KB

Break Dance (also known as Breakdance) is a Commodore 64 rhythm game that relies on players making dancing moves that resemble the classic game Simon says. A computer character performs a pattern of five break dancing moves that must be copied by the player. One new move is added to every round, making the game more complicated as the player progresses through each stage.

meta.name: Break Fever
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.65 KB

Break Fever is a single screen game viewed from the side based on the 80s dance craze, Breakdancing where you are given various moves and you have to perform them before two judges. Before you start dancing you can change the colours of yours and the judges clothes before being presented with your first move. After being given a move you must use joystick combinations to perform it while a energy gauge increases. Once you have used your energy then you are given a comment by the judges like 'Your bad news' or 'Murder'. Some of the moves you are given are the 'Space Shuttle, 'Turtle' and the 'Head Spin'. Once all the moves have been attempted you are given a final rating before you can attempt them all again. On the B-side of the cassette was a music mix to play in your stereo while you played the game.

meta.name: Break Street
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Break Street is a breakdance game. First, you select a dancer you want to play, including the two-man team from “Double Trouble.” In warm-up mode you can test different dance moves. Movements are triggered by joystick instructions and use of the fire button. They range from simple moves like the moonwalk to more complex maneuvers like the headspin. Thanks to the same joystick action, different movements are available depending on whether you are standing or performing ground movements. The main game part gives you a time limit in which to make your moves and collect points. An energy bar on the left side of the screen decreases as you perform more complicated moves. To regain some energy, you can do a simple movement like uprock or the moonwalk. When the energy bar is completely used up, your performance is over.
