meta.name: Breaker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Breaker is an Arkanoid-style breakout clone with a twist on the classic formula. Using your paddle, you must keep the ball in play and destroy blocks, some of which release special power-ups. Catching these can grant you extra balls, laser cannons, or a larger paddle—but sometimes also disadvantages like a smaller one. Each level increases the challenge with more complex block layouts and faster-paced gameplay, requiring sharp reflexes and precision.

meta.name: Breakers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The planet Borg is threatened with a cosmic catastrophe in the form of a collision with a mysterious twin planet that cannot be detected using scientific methods. The collision occurs at regular, long intervals and represents a kind of cleansing of the planet for the planet's inhabitants, the peaceful, telepathically gifted Lau. In order for the Lau to survive the collision, they must carry out a ritual that has been passed down to an initiated group and requires several artifacts called “elements.”
They send seven Lau to get these artifacts. The Breakers kill six of the seven Lau. The seventh Lau loses consciousness during the fighting and wakes up on the space station in orbit. From this point on, the player takes on the role of the seventh Lau.
Your task is to recover the “elements”, get back to the planet Borg and successfully carry out the ritual there.

A strange and amusing Breakout variant. The Earth is being invaded by hostile creatures from outer space. The creatures are protected by a force field. Your mission is to break into the area behind the force field, and to destroy the creatures with deadly power dots. When your power dot hits the force field it will bounce back. You must use your deflector paddle to bounce the power dot back towards the creatures. Once you have destroyed the creatures, you will proceed to the next level, in which the creatures will advance faster!

meta.name: Breakout Construction Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Breakout Construction Kit" is a special version of the classic Breakout game for the Commodore 64 that offers players the opportunity to create and customize their own levels. With the construction kit approach, it brings a completely new dimension to the genre and is often referred to as "Breakout on steroids". What makes the "Breakout Construction Kit" special is the integrated level editor, which allows players to design their own obstacles, power-ups and block arrangements. This allows them to expand the classic Breakout game according to their ideas and create individual challenges. In addition to editing existing levels, completely new designs can be created, which allows endless variations and a personal gaming experience.

meta.name: Breakthrough in the Ardennes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Breakthrough in the Ardennes places you in one of the most dramatic phases of World War II, recreating the events of the Battle of the Bulge through strategic gameplay. You command one of the opposing forces and coordinate troop movements, attacks and defensive positions on a tactical map. Every decision shapes the course of the campaign, where resources, positioning and timing are critical. The focus lies on planning and battlefield awareness – a demanding simulation that translates historical conflict into strategic gameplay.

meta.name: BreakThru
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.30 KB

BreakThru es un shooter de desplazamiento lateral en 2D. Tu misión: correr, saltar, y abrirte camino a través de cinco niveles (montañas, puente, llanuras, ciudad y aeropuerto) de las defensas enemigas para recuperar el avión de combate robado. Una gran cantidad de soldados enemigos, minas, vehículos y aviones intentará detenerte, sin embargo. Ah, sí ... y no te olvides de vigilar los ataques con cohetes y las rocas que caen!

meta.name: Breakthru in 3D
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.71 KB

This is a racquetball-like game that is best described as a 3D variation of Breakout. You are at the end on a rectangular room. On the other end is a wall made of bricks or blocks. The ball travels down to the wall and knocks out a brick. It then returns to your end where you must use a squarish paddle to send the ball back to the wall. If the ball gets past the paddle, you lose a ball. In the computer version, you must knock out all the bricks of the wall to advance. Each level has more bricks per wall. You begin with 5 balls. In the console version, you must knock out 57 of the 72 bricks to advance. Each level has 72 bricks but the number of balls will lower in later levels. Level 1 starts with 99 balls.

meta.name: Breathalyzer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.56 KB

2-players only Pong-style game with a couple of variants: this flying "thing" in the middle of the screen, deviating the ball when hit, and the option to modify the course of the shot for a limited number of times.

Brian Bloodaxe es un vikingo que lleva cientos de años atrapado en un bloque de hielo. Una vez que el hielo se descongela, Brian jura conquistar Gran Bretaña, pero poco sabe que ha despertado en 1983. Brian debe viajar a 100 lugares en busca de las joyas de la corona y sentarse en el trono. En cada lugar hay objetos esparcidos y Brian debe descubrir su propósito. Los monstruos deambulan por cada lugar, complicando la tarea de Brian. Se pueden llevar hasta tres objetos a la vez, que se pueden utilizar para bloquear el camino de los monstruos o para crear plataformas adicionales.

meta.name: Brian Clough's Football Fortunes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.37 KB

Brian Clough's Football Fortunes is a football management computer board game suitable for two to five players. Each player takes on the role of a club manager. The object of the game is for each manager to successfully steer his team through the season using his skill to make his team stronger as the game proceeds. Each manager competes with human and computer controlled teams in a ten strong league and the F.A. Cup. From the second season onwards, each team will also enter a European competition (League Champions to the European Cup, F.A. Cup Winners to the Cup-Winners' Cup, and the remaining clubs will go to the UEFA Cup). The winner of Brian Clough's Football Fortunes is the manager who survives to the end of the game and has the highest number of game points. Game points are points awarded by the computer program, based on each managers performance in League and Cup competitions and on the amount of cash the player has left at the end of the game.

meta.name: Brian Jacks Superstar Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.89 KB

Brian Jack's Superstar Challenge es un juego deportivo multievento con licencia del medallista de bronce olímpico británico de 1972 Brian Jacks. En este juego, compites contra Brian en ocho pruebas diferentes y obtienes puntos en ellas en función de tu rendimiento. Las pruebas son carrera a pie, tiro con arco, ciclismo, fútbol, natación, sentadilla, piragüismo y pulseada.
No hay que batir ningún tiempo ni puntuación de clasificación y compites en todas las pruebas independientemente de tu rendimiento. El juego se desarrolla en varios niveles y si consigues más puntos que Brian, ganas el nivel y pasas al siguiente, donde se repite el proceso. A continuación, las puntuaciones de cada nivel se combinan para obtener una puntuación total. Si Brian consigue más puntos que tú al final de un nivel, pierdes el desafío.

meta.name: Brian Jack's Uchi-Mata
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.51 KB

"Brian Jack's Uchi-Mata" is a realistic and precise simulation of judo, where the player can learn and execute various throws such as O Soto Gari, Tomoe Nage, Uchi Mata, and De Ashi Barai. Matches can be fought against the computer or another player, with the option to perform illegal moves — though these are strictly penalized by the referee in competition mode. The techniques are displayed with smooth animations made up of over 400 images, making the movements particularly detailed and lifelike. The game is accompanied by high-quality music and sound effects. The joystick controls allow for precise movements, while the referee evaluates every action. The player can choose between a training mode to learn techniques or a competition mode for challenging fights.

Estás solo en el castillo Frankenstein. Los pulmones, corazones, riñones y cerebros que necesita tu hermoso Franky están repartidos por todo el castillo y sus jardines. Debes utilizar el joystick para moverte por el castillo. También debes localizar las llaves para abrir las puertas. Pero cuidado, dentro hay otros habitantes, como fantasmas y esqueletos. Si te tocan demasiado, sufrirás un infarto y morirás.

You play as part of a partnership opposing another team, aiming to fulfill your bid or prevent your opponents from doing so. Each round requires careful thinking, as you must use your cards wisely and respond to the moves of others. As difficulty increases, your skills are pushed further, encouraging you to improve and develop new strategies.

In Bridge Master you play a simulation of the card game Bridge designed both for learning and improving your skills. You can play against the computer or compete with other players while an on-screen assistant provides tips and suggestions for your current move. The game offers many customization options, including different bidding conventions and rule variations. You can also adjust the personalities of the computer opponents, making them play more aggressively, cautiously or with different strategic styles.

In Bridge Master you play a simulation of the card game Bridge where you compete against computer-controlled opponents. At the start you can select various options such as creating new player files or loading existing ones. During the game your hand and the positions of the four players at the table are displayed while you enter your moves through commands. The program is mainly designed to help players practice strategies and improve their understanding of the complex card game.

meta.name: Bridge Player II

Bridge Player II is fully dedicated to the sophisticated card game of Bridge and offers a detailed match against the computer. Randomly generated hands, a complete bidding phase, and several options for analysis make both practice and careful thinking important. You can review the course of a game, set up your own situations, and examine your decisions more closely. The result is a substantial Bridge adaptation built around tactics, learning value, and the enjoyment of thoughtful planning.

“Brilliant Maze” challenges the player to guide a little green hero through a maze to collect four diamonds. Each diamond earns 750 points, and after collecting all diamonds, an exit opens to advance to the next level. Arrows indicate the nearest diamond or the exit. Enemies must be avoided as they cost one of the three lives. Additional tools such as tar pits, shields, EMPs, or speed boosters help slow down, stun, or temporarily bypass enemies. Teleporters and trampolines make navigating the maze and reaching inaccessible areas easier.

meta.name: Bristles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.09 KB

Bristles challenges you to paint every room of a building before time runs out and without losing all your brushes (lives). Choose from eight characters and tackle six skill levels with eight buildings each. Completing a building rewards you with part of a hidden message. Use elevators and ladders to move between floors – but misstep, and you'll fall down the shaft. Watch out for Flying Half Pints, which zip across each level (except the basement); jump or duck to dodge them. Coordination and timing are the key to painting success.

meta.name: British Super League
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.56 KB

British Super League es un juego de gestión futbolística en el que debes ganar el campeonato de la British Super League para uno de los 16 equipos de tu elección. Cada equipo compite dos veces. Las opciones que tienes para influir en el juego son limitadas. Puedes cambiar la formación y la posición de los jugadores, comprar y vender jugadores en el mercado de fichajes. Una vez que estés satisfecho con tus elecciones, pasas al siguiente partido. Todo el campo se ve desde arriba. Los jugadores parpadean en el área del balón. Un temporizador realiza la cuenta atrás de 0 a 90 minutos y puedes utilizar dos sustitutos en cualquier momento del partido.

meta.name: Broadsides
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Broadsides takes you back to the Napoleonic era, simulating battles between sailing ships. You can jump straight into arcade action, steering, maneuvering, and firing rapidly, or choose the tactical mode, making the same decisions real captains faced from the quarterdeck. Beyond the historical ships, you can design your own vessels, from armament to crew. Victory comes by sinking the enemy or scoring enough points to force surrender. Defeat comes if too much of your crew is lost or if boarding enemies overwhelm your ship. If both ships sink, or no result is reached by 6 pm, the battle ends in a draw.

meta.name: Bronx Medal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Bronx Medal" is an action-packed multi-event sports game set in the streets of the Bronx. Players compete in various challenges, including races and obstacle courses, vying for the highest score. The striking visuals and urban atmosphere give the game a distinctive character.

meta.name: Brothers In Arms
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.82 KB

Brothers in Arms is a straightforward yet gripping shooter where you must take down incoming enemies with precise shots. Success relies not only on accurate aiming but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy fire and position yourself strategically. Only those who combine skill, timing, and smart movement will be able to overcome the escalating challenges and emerge victorious.

meta.name: Brothers of the Bow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.33 KB

Brothers of the Bow takes you to 11th century China, where the tyrannical Duke Zhao, fearing death, makes a demonic pact that brings ruin upon his province. The summoned entity Narodakini gains strength through enforced worship, mentally enslaves the population, and transforms the duke and his court into the living dead while her demonic servants rule in their place. Amid this chaos, seven righteous brothers from Nanchang rise against the horror after their town is attacked by mind-controlled soldiers. Guided by a remaining monk, they journey to the Shaolin temple to obtain the Sacred Arrows of Mahakala – the only weapons capable of exorcising the empowered demon. Through temples, wilderness, and the necropolis of Fengdu, they fight with courage, skill, and divine aid against a growing darkness – an epic tale of myth, sacrifice, and resistance.

meta.name: Bruce Lee
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 77.43 KB

En Bruce Lee, el objetivo del personaje es llegar hasta un hechicero en una guarida subterránea, cuya derrota puede ofrecer riquezas incalculables.
En cada zona, debes recoger los numerosos faroles estratégicamente colocados antes de salir por el pasadizo recién revelado. Algunas zonas también cuentan con escaleras mecánicas y las clásicas escaleras de mano. Hay 20 zonas que completar.
Por el camino, te enfrentarás a dos enemigos: un ninja y un guerrero de sumo verde llamado Yamo. Puedes derrotarlos dándoles puñetazos, patadas, dejándoles caer sobre sus cabezas, atrayéndoles hacia terrenos peligrosos, ... Sin embargo, incluso después de matarlos, vuelven de nuevo.

meta.name: Bubble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.09 KB

Bubble is a game with five levels. A few red and blue stones are distributed on a grid-like playing field. You have to collect them using your so-called bubble, a ball-like structure. For each red stone there are four, blue stones are worth 2 points. But the whole thing would be smooth and no fun at all if you weren't being chased by a hostile computer-controlled object. If it catches you, one of your lives will be wasted. Once all the stones have been collected, the next level is of course a little more difficult so that you don't lose interest in collecting stones.

meta.name: Bubble Bobble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.87 KB

Bubble Bobble es la historia de dos humanos, Bub y Bob, que deambulan por la misteriosa cueva de los monstruos y mágicamente se convierten en dinosaurios. La única forma de transformarse es llegar al final de la cueva ...
Bubble Bobble es un juego de plataformas, con cada nivel en una sola pantalla. Los enemigos deben ser eliminados de un nivel para pasar al siguiente. Con un jugador controlando a Bub y el otro controlando a Bob, el jugador puede saltar y recoger elementos para obtener puntos. Sin embargo, el verdadero poder que tienen Bub y Bob es la capacidad de hacer burbujas. Estas burbujas pueden ser plataformas para saltar o atrapar enemigos. Los enemigos atrapados en una burbuja deben explotar saltando sobre ellos, en donde se convertirán en fruta. Además, los power-ups a veces flotan en burbujas. Incluyen relámpagos, que vuelan horizontalmente hacia los enemigos, y agua, que arrastra al jugador y a los enemigos hacia abajo, fluyendo sobre las plataformas.

meta.name: Bubble Bobble 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.08 KB

Bubble Bobble II is an unofficial entry in the series where you guide Bub or Bob through classic single-screen levels and face various enemies. The familiar rainbow weapon is missing, leaving the focus purely on defeating foes and surviving the action-packed stages.

meta.name: Bubble Burst
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.42 KB

Bubble Burst challenges you to stop the Zeboingers from popping all the bubbles in Soapie's bathtub. You control a crosshair and shoot bubbles at the bird-like intruders before they reach the bath. If they destroy the bubbles, the foam decreases. Each round gives you only a limited amount of bubble juice, after which you can no longer defend yourself. The Zeboingers can also open the window or turn on the shower, which makes the foam vanish even faster. At the start of the game, you can choose to begin at round 1 or round 11.

meta.name: Bubble Dizzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.35 KB

Bubble Dizzy se aleja del formato arcade habitual de los juegos de Dizzy, en favor de un sencillo juego de acción y plataformas.
Debes guiar a Dizzy a través de mundos submarinos, recogiendo cuentas por el camino. Dizzy empieza en el fondo del mar y tienes que llevarlo a la cima. Para ello, salta sobre burbujas, que sólo tienen un tiempo limitado antes de explotar. Los enemigos a evitar son tiburones, pulpos y peces espada. Dizzy tiene una cantidad limitada de oxígeno, pero es posible conseguir un poco de los botes de O2.
Tras completar un nivel, obtienes una bonificación dependiendo de cuántas perlas hayas recogido y cuánto oxígeno te quede.

meta.name: Bubble Ghost
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bubble Ghost tiene que soplar una pompa para salir del castillo de su creador. Tu tarea es guiarle mientras desplaza la burbuja por los huecos de las habitaciones. La dirección de la burbuja depende de la posición desde la que se sopla.
Velas, ventiladores y otros obstáculos contribuyen a dificultar la tarea del pequeño Bubble Ghost. Bubble Ghost es invencible, pero la pompa está a punto de estallar si algo llega a tocarla. Dispones de cinco burbujas antes de que la partida termine.

meta.name: Bubble It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.17 KB

Move through the level and collect all the disk images without grabbing any of the skulls. Question Mark items can provide additional bonuses. Blow a bubble towards your pursuers, temporarily incapacitating them as they are pulled towards the top of the level. Capture all items on the screen to advance to the next level.

meta.name: Bubble Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bubble Mania is a tricky platformer - jump & run, that requires a bit of clever thinking. You control a little goblin who wants to get all the jewels in the country out of greed. This smart kleptomaniac is controlled with the joystick in port number 2. The highlight of this game is that you cannot fall into the abyss. However, our hero cannot jump. If you are very far away and the platforms on which the clunkers are located are relatively far apart, you have to use a little trick: soap bubbles constantly rise from the abyss, which will carry you for a while - at least until they burst on the ceiling. You can also cover longer distances by letting the bubbles carry you. Of course, this requires a little skill and a little tactical approach. You can fall into the deep abyss three times before you have to start again.

meta.name: Bubbler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.11 KB

El tirano Vadra ha esclavizado a los habitantes de la antigua ciudad de Irkon y los ha convertido en manchas inmóviles. Para reforzar su dominio sobre la ciudad, ha creado botellas gigantes que escupen burbujas mágicas creando enemigos mutantes que refuerzan su control. Su antiguo ayudante Kintor te ha dado la habilidad de moverte y ha creado corchos mágicos que pueden usarse para cerrar las botellas y reducir el control de Vadra. Tu tarea es tapar las botellas y derrocar al malvado mago.
El jugador controla una burbuja o blob que puede rodar, saltar, utilizar toboganes y ascensores para desplazarse por un sistema tridimensional de plataformas, torres y pendientes. A los enemigos se les puede disparar con miniburbujas, los cangrejos salen de generadores y las burbujas salen de botellas, cinco de las cuales hay que tapar en cada nivel para que el jugador pueda salir.

meta.name: Bubbles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.91 KB

An avoid-it style game. Navigate through the strange dimension dodging, zigging and zagging through the oncoming bubbles.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.33 KB

Buck Rogers: Planet of Zoom is a single player science fiction themed obstacle race, where the player controls Buck Rogers' space ship and must guide it through multiple pairs of pylons throughout the game. Controlling the ship involves side scrolling to the left or right, stop, moving forward (and faster), and moving backwards/break (and slower). Additionally, the spaceship can also fire its weapon to unleash a pair of energy bolts.

meta.name: Buddy Bubble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.18 KB

Buddy Bubble is a platform game where the screen moves in various directions when you move and the aim is to move around a maze trying to find the exit in three zones. You can jump gaps between the platforms and use ladders and elevators to help you move up or down to other platforms. Coins can be collected which go towards your score with some hidden behind walls which can be removed by switches. There are many obstacles and hazards to avoid and these are hammers which move up or down, moving platforms and platforms which open and shut. Caos, exageración y guiños al western clásico —todo con una sonrisa cómplice.

meta.name: Buffalo Roundup
meta.desc:

Riding across the field, you guide and push the animals toward a gate using careful positioning. Open edges lead to the desert, so no buffalo must escape, while fences initially block certain routes and are gradually removed. Obstacles such as water slow movement but do not harm the herd. Working against a ticking clock, you must gather every buffalo to progress to increasingly challenging levels.

This game is a Centipede clone.
Accordingly, the player controls a weapon that can be moved across the floor of a mushroom-strewn playing field and must contain the attacks of various pests: but primarily the centipede, which makes its way between the mushrooms and splits into segments when it is hit.

meta.name: Bug Blaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Bug Blaster puts you in control of a spaceship at the bottom of the screen as a multi-segmented centipede relentlessly crawls toward you. By firing repeatedly, you break it apart piece by piece – and each time you split it, the separate segments continue moving on their own, increasing the chaos. Mushrooms scatter the field and alter the creature's direction, but you can shoot them for points and to clear space. Additional enemies appear, placing new obstacles or attacking directly, and any contact costs you one of your limited lives. Only when every segment is destroyed do you advance to the next, even more frantic stage – a tense battle of constant fire against mounting danger.

meta.name: Bug Blitz
meta.desc:

Your mission is to find and destroy and army of mutant bugs who have made their homes in caverns deep beneath the planet's surface. A labyrinth of dangerous tunnels leads down to these caverns which you must negotiate skillfully in your spaceship. Once you've destroyed the bugs in a cavern, you must return through the tunnels to the planet's surface. But beware!! The surface is not safe, it is covered with a network of randomly pulling endergy fields that can easily destroy your spaceship.

meta.name: Bug Crusher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.96 KB

In Bug Crusher you control a small spaceship that can move in all directions to crush pesky bugs. You're safe only inside three bunkers at the edges – step outside and a red enemy will chase you, draining your fuel. Other enemies continuously scroll across the screen. If they hit you or your fuel runs out, you lose a life. With five lives and the option to activate temporary invincibility at the cost of fuel, every move becomes a risky mission.

meta.name: Bug Diver

Bug Diver is a single screen game viewed from the side where you are a bug who has to keep diving to the bottom of the sea to retrieve eggs. You start on the top of the screen and you must swim down to the bottom of the screen to pick up an egg while avoiding fish who are swimming to the left or right. You can move in four directions and when you reach the egg then you must swim back to the top of the screen where you then go back for another one. After collecting a couple of eggs the fish grow in size and if you touch any fish then you lose one of three lives.

meta.name: Bug Squad

Bug Squad places you as a garden defense device at the bottom of the screen, where you have to stop a crawling centipede threat. You shoot upward, clear grass from the way, and break the enemy apart piece by piece while its sections move more and more unpredictably through the field. Extra objects add new obstacles and more chaos – a fast reaction game where accurate aiming and constant movement decide your survival.

meta.name: Bugbomber

En Bugbomber, exploras los circuitos enredados de un ordenador infectado y das caza a los bichos enemigos. Armado con bombas, minas, bloqueos y crías, debes actuar estratégicamente para eliminar las amenazas. Dependiendo de la dirección del joystick al disparar, liberas diferentes armas. Los símbolos EN restauran energía, los símbolos IQ hacen a tus crías más inteligentes. En el modo individual, obtienes tres vidas más una por cada nivel completado. En el modo multijugador, puedes cooperar para limpiar el sistema o desatar el caos entre ustedes.

Bugs Bunny has to investigate different cases. He must collect the clues that will prove the guilt of different criminals. Banknotes, bitten apples, can be found in caves and sewers through which enemies have fled. But he must beware of the spiders, rats and other crows that hang out in these vile places.

meta.name: Bugsy

Bugsy takes you to 1920s Chicago, casting you as a giant rabbit with the ambition to dethrone Al Capone and become Public Enemy No. 1. Starting with nothing, you must claw your way to the top using theft, extortion, bribery, murder, and any other means necessary. The game blends text adventure with graphics that illustrate your surroundings as you type commands to interact with each location. When encountering other characters, you can choose to insult, bribe, or protect them, all part of your rise to power in the city's criminal underworld.

In "Build-It: The Bauhaus" the player takes on the role of Joey, the construction worker. He wants to fulfill his dream of having his own house and does everything himself.
This is a tile matching puzzle game. In each one-screen level there are a series of squares divided into two different colored triangles. Joey must pick up these squares and create a new square of the same color to make the four blocks disappear. He can also turn over a block on the spot. The goal of each level is to create a certain number of these same-colored squares.
Of course, there are difficulties: walls can restrict Joey's movements, new blocks appear at fixed intervals, and tools roam the levels, killing Joey by touch. Three extras are helpful that provide advantages when collecting: a temporary protective shield, a level jump and all stones transform into joker stones.

meta.name: Builder Ben

The Bulge: Battle for Antwerp puts you in the middle of Hitler's final major offensive – the Battle of the Bulge in 1944. After D-Day and the rapid Allied advance, victory seems near, until the German Panzer divisions strike back. Their goal: Antwerp, the vital Allied supply base. You take command of either army, facing not only the enemy but also snow, freezing weather, and dwindling supplies. Every move can shift the balance of power – and perhaps give you the chance to rewrite history.

meta.name: Bulldog
meta.desc:

Bulldog is a vertically scrolling shooter. As the pilot of a small ship, your goal is to force your way through enemy defenses to destroy the mothership. Your enemy, the POLONs, have greatly strengthened the path you must take: in each level you may encounter up to seven types of fire installations, as well as various walls blocking your path. If you hit a wall or are hit by enemy fire, you will lose a ship. The game ends when all your reserve ships are lost. At the end of each level you will face a mothership; To destroy this, you must turn off all weapons and other facilities on the ship. Then you move on to the next, more difficult level. Your ship is equipped with lasers to destroy obstacles, and additional power-ups can be found along the way. Extra speed, extra firepower, repeat fire, bombs and other bonuses can be picked up to help you.

meta.name: Bulldoze! : Schneeräumer im Kampf

A Tron/Worm variant. The object of this is to make the other bulldozer crash either into your trail or a wall. The game consists of 6 rounds, the game will come to a draw if the players bump directly into each other. Each round will have a slightly modified screen to make things interesting.

meta.name: Bullseye
meta.desc:

A computer game version of a famed TV quiz show based around the game of darts. The computer version features 2 players, both human-controlled - on TV there were 3 teams of 2 (one amateur darts player and one to answer questions)
The first round uses a custom board which is split both inwards (4 separate grades representing 30,50,100 and 200 points respectively) and around (10 sections lettered A-K, representing a different subject each). The first player must choose a category to aim at, and shoot a dart at it. If they hit one of the sections for that letter, they get that score and are asked the question. If they hit another category they get no bonus but are asked that question - if it's still there. Each players gets 3 goes at this, with increasingly tough questions worth 30,50,100 points.
Round 2 involves each player throwing 3 darts at a standard board, with the player who scores the most getting asked a question, with the value of the darts on offer. If they get it wrong, the other player gets a chance, for the points THEY scored. This is repeated 3 times.
After these 2 rounds, the player who is in front gets to aim at a board with 8 black segments, 8 red ones and the bullseye. The bully scores 50 points, the others reds score a randomly-selected value between 15 and 45, the blacks score zero, and hitting a red for the second time loses you that prize - hence the presenter's catchphrase "keep out of the black and into the red, nothing in this game for 2 in a bed".
Once the player has finished the round, they choose whether to gamble their score against the final Prize Board. 101 points must be scored in 4 darts (in the TV show it was 6 - 3 for each player)

meta.name: Bully's Sporting Darts
meta.desc:

Since the scoring is handled automatically, getting started feels pleasantly easy, while experienced players can still work deliberately toward high-value targets. This creates a varied darts game that successfully combines precise aiming, tactical decisions, and accessible competition.

If Bart makes it back to the hive before time runs out, you earn bonus points and are rewarded with a colorful display.

Hidden Treasure lets you search for underwater riches, Bumble Art sparks your creativity on a coordinate grid, and Roadblock adds excitement with cops and obstacles. A charming mix of learning, logic, and fun – colorful, simple, and delightfully old-school.

You can choose between a beach or indoor court and adjust from multiple difficulty levels to suit your skill. Crowd applause and lively music enhance the competitive atmosphere. Accurate timing on bumps, sets and spikes determines whether you win the rally or lose the point – teamwork and quick reflexes are essential.

meta.name: Bump!

"Bump!" is a one or two player action game in which players skillfully control two balls across a crater landscape. Two players compete against each other to test their skills. The game arena uses a panoramic screen display that offers a three-dimensional gaming experience. The action takes place at the top, while points, "lack of power" and victories are displayed at the bottom. The goal is to achieve ten victories, which requires skill. Each player controls two balls: one with the fire button pressed, the other without. There are four balls in total in the game that must be maneuvered into the craters. The balls have different strengths; one is designed to disrupt the opponent, the other to secure points and energy.

meta.name: Bump'n'Jump

Your score increases steadily, but you earn extra points by forcing other vehicles off the road or, at high speed, jumping over and destroying them. After each season, you see how many cars you have taken out and receive bonus points for each one.

Your team's matches are represented by the movement of a white dot on a green field.

You can only fire one shot at a time and you can only fire once again if a bullet hits a bunny. If you miss a bunny or just fire then the bullet will keep bouncing off walls until it hits a bunny. If you hit a bunny or touch the walls then you lose one of three lives. Once enough creatures have been collected then you move to the next level but some bunny's now have a shield and can't be shot.

Burger Chase is a single screen platformer inspired by the arcade game BurgerTime where you are a chef who has to make four burgers over four levels. You use ladders to climb up or down the various levels and the whole burger must be on the bottom of the screen for it to be completed. Moving around the screen are some rogue ingredients like eggs and sausages and these need avoiding as touching one will lose you one of three lives. You do have a limited amount of pepper which stuns them for a short time but you can kill them if you push a burger ingredient on top of them. Items appear on the screen and these can be collected for bonus points and extra pepper. Two players can play with each player taking it in turns when the other player has lost a life.

Nuestro protagonista es Chef Pepper y su objetivo es hacer hamburguesas mientras huevos, salchichas y pepinillos malvados le persiguen por el área de juego.
Para hacer una hamburguesa debes reunir todos los ingredientes y dejarlos caer desde arriba hasta el área de la hamburguesa que se encuentra abajo. Chef Pepper debe pasar por todos los ingredientes de la hamburguesa. Tan pronto como pise un ingrediente (un trozo de lechuga, por ejemplo), caerá al siguiente nivel. La comida que caiga aplastará a cualquier enemigo que te siga y también golpeará cualquier otro ingrediente que se encuentre debajo. Como defensa puedes recolectar pimenteros que te permitirán expulsar una pequeña nube de pimienta que aturdirá momentáneamente a los enemigos, permitiéndote pasar junto a ellos sin recibir daño.

meta.name: Burnin Rubber

Other cars keep trying to force you off the road – but with enough nerve, you can knock them off the track and keep charging ahead.

meta.name: Bush Patrol

In Bush Patrol you navigate through dangerous terrain, aiming to deliver as many people as possible while avoiding hazards and threats. You must dodge obstacles, choose your path carefully, and stay focused on your objective. As the game progresses, the danger increases, with enemies becoming more aggressive and leaving little room for mistakes. Only quick reactions and steady control will help you survive and score high.

The more you collect, the denser the web becomes, and one careless move can be fatal. If you get trapped, the spider descends to snatch and devour you. Skillful flying is key to gathering fruit while avoiding the deadly trap.

If he falls into debt, a loan offers temporary relief, but failing to repay it in time brings trouble from shady enforcers. The Clowns game was released as a cartridge and is only controlled via paddles in joystick port 1. However, there is also a disk version that can be played using a joystick. Cada uno presenta enemigos diversos y un objetivo único: aterrizar en una plataforma petrolífera oculta para detener a Seraffino, localizar y destruir el laboratorio submarino de Stromberg, etc. Al completar todas las misiones, ganas. ¡Buena suerte, señor Bond!

Moving openings between the lanes let you switch paths – but they can also trap you if a face gets too close.

Una vez superados todos estos peligros, te queda enfrentarte al temible caníbal, armado con una temible lanza. ¿Serás capaz de derrotarlo y salvar a la bella Penélope?

La segunda fase es un tiroteo espacial contra hordas de aviones enemigos, aquellos que no lograste destruir en la primera parte de la tarea. Tu objetivo es girar y conectar cada segmento con la fuente de energía central, volviendo todo el laberinto verde. Corres contrarreloj mientras evitas las llamas y chispas que recorren los caminos. De vez en cuando, aparece un número que cuenta regresivamente del 9 al 0; si lo tocas a tiempo, obtienes puntos de bonificación. Con cada nivel, los laberintos se hacen más grandes, complejos y llenos de peligros.

Zone Ranger es un juego de acción arcade similar a Asteroids. Eres el piloto de una nave espacial en una región mortífera del espacio. Grandes rocas asesinas, satélites errantes, bumeranes y mucho más llenan esta región. Usando los láseres de tu nave, debes destruir tantos como puedas para ganar puntos. Cada nivel también contiene agujeros de warp; entra en uno y serás transportado a una nueva ubicación, lo cual podría ser útil si te metes en problemas. Ocasionalmente, también encontrarás bengalas sónicas; toca una y te volverás invencible temporalmente. Otra rareza que podrías encontrar es un superportal, que te transportará al santuario interior donde encontrarás puntos de bonificación.

The environments are randomly generated with every playthrough, and there is no ending – your goal is simply to survive for as long as possible and cover the greatest distance.

El héroe (hay un modo para dos jugadores) corre de un lado a otro por la parte inferior de la pantalla, agachándose y esquivando balas y granadas del enemigo. La maniobra de voltereta del arcade no se implementó en la versión para PC. Los enemigos, a lo largo de los 5 niveles, aparecen rápidamente y son muchos: soldados rasos, tanques, helicópteros y jefes de final de nivel, como submarinos y máquinas de guerra. Casi todo en la pantalla puede ser destruido o abatido. Hay puntos de bonificación que se pueden obtener al destruir edificios y armas que se pueden recoger del enemigo, como ametralladoras y escopetas.

Moving across connected platforms linked by openings, you must destroy all defensive mechanisms and collect useful items along the way. Any contact with these defenses costs you one of your limited lives, making precise movement and accurate shooting essential – only after all safeguards are removed can the system be restored.

“Caesar the Cat” is a skill-based game where you play as Caesar, a cat trying to prevent mice from devouring food in the cupboard. You catch them by grabbing them in your mouth and carrying them to the larder door, which appears at the side of the screen. Different mice types offer varying points, with the highest-scoring ones being the hardest to catch. Holding down the fire button increases your speed, but you must avoid knocking jars off the shelf. The timer constantly counts down but can be extended by successfully catching mice. If too much time is lost due to broken jars or eaten food, the game ends when the timer reaches zero.

meta.name: Caesar's Travels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.42 KB

Starting from where the original Caesar the Cat game left off, Caesar is kicked out by Mr. McGregor, his owner, for smashing too much crockery in the kitchen pantry in an effort to catch mice. Caesar is placed in the yard and must find another home to go to.
Throughout the game, a series of choices appear and one must be selected with the function keys. The story being told varies depending on what choice the player makes. For example, the player may choose to climb the fence or jump onto the wall, or climb a mountain or walk along a path.
More often than not, Caesar is faced with a problem-solving question that usually requires the player to count the total number of items on the screen, and what object can they see on screen. There are 38 routes through the game and 18 different endings, all happy and non-violent - a point in the game's favor.

meta.name: The California Raisins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You control Tiny Goodbite, one of the California Raisins. All of your friends have been captured and brought to the cereal factory, and you need to come to the rescue! In this action platform game, you need to climb and jump your way through the many floors of the factory to rescue the raisins. On each level there is a key which needs to be collected so you can unlock the door to the next level. Each level is guarded by various bad guys which should be avoided; your raisin may also become energized and shoot the bad guys after landing on the green platform. Be careful when jumping around; if you fall too far or land on some machinery, your raisin will lose a life! The game ends when you have lost all of your raisins.

At first you only wear a simple blue suit and must rely on jumping over threats to survive. Special pads grant different suits equipped with weapons, allowing you to fight back. Defeated foes may drop a flashing P icon – once collected, it briefly grants overwhelming firepower that clears everything in your path. Vines and jump pads help you reach higher platforms, but taking too many hits forces you back into your basic outfit. At the end of each cavern a powerful boss awaits – only by defeating it can you advance to the next stage.

Next, they must drive an off-road vehicle through rocky terrain without hitting obstacles. The third task requires refueling a transporter before the timer runs out by repeatedly pressing left and right. Finally, the player must drive the off-road vehicle safely to the destination – going too fast on rough terrain will result in a crash.

You have to reach a specific area of the ancient building indicated in the coordinates that the computer will give you. Captivated by the story of a kidnapped king and eager to help find him, little ones move their gingerbread pawns along a rainbow path and through a land of candy characters, all subjects of King Kandy's realm.There are occasional pitfalls: land on the wrong square and you might be stuck in Molasses Swamp for a time. With all these enticing, sugarcoated images (and King Kandy plainly visible at path's end), children can't help but be delighted by Candy Land. It's delicious!

meta.name: Cannon Craze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cannon Craze you defend your space sector against an enemy invasion. You control cannons at the bottom and left edges of the screen, collect power-ups, and unlock increasingly powerful weapons. The goal is to clear each zone of enemies. Playable solo, but best experienced with two players – heavy firepower, perfect timing, and teamwork make all the difference.

meta.name: Cannonball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.56 KB

A game from the infamous “Cassette 50” collection. This game can easily be summarized as “Cannonball Pong.” The game is played like tennis, we have two gunners. the first shooter to achieve 15 victories wins. Try to get the cannonball past your opponent.

meta.name: Canoe Race Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.80 KB

Canoe Race challenges the player to achieve the fastest time on the course while skillfully steering the boat and avoiding collisions with rocks. Precise control and quick reflexes are key to success.

meta.name: Canonrider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.81 KB

In Canonrider, you float through a twisting maze on a cannonball and search for the way out. To escape, you need the right cannon, matching gunpowder, and other useful items that help clear obstacles from your path. The ball keeps sinking if you do not control it in time, while traps and bugs make every passage dangerous. Careful searching, smart dodging, and clever use of the items bring you closer to breaking free step by step.

meta.name: Canyon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.53 KB

Canyon aka Lawine is the digital adaptation of the well-known game Kugellawine, also called Avalanche. On a vertical board, balls roll down through slots interrupted by fork-shaped obstacles. When a ball hits a fork, it tips to one side and may continue downwards or come to rest on another ball. This creates a chain effect where more and more balls shift until they finally drop out. Players take turns dropping balls into the slots, with each new ball altering the paths. Points are scored depending on the color and placement of the balls, and additional settings allow the game's pace to be sped up or slowed down.

p: Captain America in the Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann (Europe).T64
n: Captain America in the Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann (Europe)

meta.path: ./Captain America in the Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann (Europe).T64
meta.name: Captain America in the Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.78 KB

Captain America in the Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann challenges the player to infiltrate the desert headquarters of the villain Megalomann. Armed with a nearly indestructible shield, Captain America can block enemy projectiles and most energy beams. However, some rooms contain deadly Rotators that emit lethal rays. Destroying them reveals codewords – essential for accessing deeper sections of the Doom Tube. The ultimate goal is to reach the final deck and disarm the rocket – but the game is played in real time, leaving only one hour to save the world.

meta.name: L'arche du Capitaine Blood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador encarna a un programador atrapado y clonado dentro de su propio juego. Poco a poco se transforma en una máquina y debe encontrar y destruir a sus cinco clones antes de perder definitivamente su forma humana.
La acción se desarrolla en Hydra, un universo imaginario, donde el jugador se desplaza de planeta en planeta, encontrándose con alienígenas de diferentes características, que pueden ayudarle o no a cumplir su misión. Captain Blood's Ark se caracteriza por su relativamente innovador sistema de diálogo, que permite al jugador crear frases a partir de iconos para comunicarse con los alienígenas.
El jugador controla una nave biológica llamada Arca, y debe lanzar sondas a las superficies de los planetas, haciéndolas navegar con éxito por el paisaje para localizar a un alienígena. El Arca también puede escanear planetas y, a veces, teletransportar alienígenas a diferentes lugares.

meta.name: Captain Cactus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.87 KB

Captain Cactus is a horizontally scrolling shooter game in the style of the classic Skramble. Players control a helicopter that flies through dangerous caves and must shoot down obstacles and enemy objects to keep the path clear. The challenge lies not only in shooting down enemies, but also in navigating skillfully, as contact with the cave floor or ceiling will destroy the helicopter. The gameplay of Captain Cactus combines reflexes and precision, as the player must constantly keep moving while aiming accurately to eliminate all obstacles and enemies.

meta.name: Captain Dynamo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.66 KB

Insane genius Austen van Flyswatter has stolen a huge collection of diamonds, and retrieving them involves navigating a succession of fiendishly-designed arrangements of platforms and traps. Does that sound like a job for a retired superhero? Captain Dynamo thinks so, and aims to recapture them for their rightful owner.
Gameplay is platform-based, with 12 vertically-scrolling levels, each containing around 50 diamonds - the more of these you can collect, the higher your score. Some will require advance planning to reach, while you will often be dependent on booster pads to reach the higher sections of a level.

meta.name: Captain Fizz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Blaster-Trons have invaded the planet Icarus, which is set as 20 levels on top of the last. The people can only be saved if a hero or two step forward and reach each of the 20 lifts in this Gauntlet-style game. Two players is the ideal, as gameplay is simultaneous and only ever fills half the screen for each player. Each level has doors which are locked with colour coded keys, as well as doors which can only be used in one direction, and lots of long corridors and mazy layouts. Both yourself and the aliens are armed with lethal lazers, although you can take several hits before dying.

meta.name: Captain Kelly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.83 KB

As Captain Kelly, a space delivery driver, you are trapped in the spaceship Obsidian 2 because the security code has failed. Security robots will try to eliminate you if they detect you. To control the ship, you must destroy a certain number of robots on each of the seven levels and then reach the Master Control Room. The screen scrolls as you move through the maze, and robot guards appear that you can defeat with limited ammunition. Hits and attacks cost energy, and your oxygen supply also decreases. Resources for recharging and teleporters that move you between levels are scattered around. A terminal shows you remaining targets. After all robots are destroyed, the level is deactivated, only teleporters remain active. In the Master Control Room, the last two satellites must be activated within a time limit to win the game.

meta.name: Capt'n Kidd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.58 KB

„Capt'n Kidd“ is an action-packed puzzle game where you play as Capt'n Kidd, racing against time to defuse bombs before they explode. Each level is set on a 15x12 grid, viewed from above, where every move counts — once you leave a tile, it disappears, requiring careful planning. To avoid getting stuck, you can shift entire rows left or right. Beware of static skulls blocking your path and moving boots that avoid empty spaces. Collect flags for bonus points, disarm all bombs, and survive through the increasingly challenging levels while managing your five lives.

meta.name: Captain of Industry
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Captain of Industry includes three games in one: In Jimmy the Self-made Man, you aim to rise from nothing to a business tycoon by managing your time and capital wisely. Cool Drinks for Sale challenges you as a lemonade vendor – forecast weather, adjust prices, and manage supplies to maximize profit. In Oil Magnate, you invest your startup funds in geological research and oil production, making risky decisions while competing for control of black gold.

p: Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future (USA).D64
n: Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future (USA)

meta.name: Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future takes the player to the year 2147, a post-apocalyptic world where the evil Lord Dread rules Earth with an iron fist. A small group of high-tech soldiers led by Captain Power fights against him and his Bio-Dread minions. However, the game's story plays little role in the gameplay. Instead, it begins with two space-shooter sequences. The first part, the training mission, involves destroying three Dread drones on a shooting range from a cockpit view. The second part, "Attack on Volcania," is a 2D side-scroller where the player eliminates approaching enemy spaceships. Once enough enemies are destroyed, the enemy base can be bombed. These shooting and bombing sequences repeat until the fortress's shields are finally taken down.

meta.name: Captain Stark : Die Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Captain Stark: The Mission" is a cleverly designed Sokoban clone. Compared to traditional Sokoban games, "Captain Stark: The Mission" offers a variety of additional features and a full 255 levels that ensure long-lasting fun and increasing challenges. In classic Sokoban style, the player has to push boxes through a maze to position them on set targets. However, "Captain Stark" stands out with a number of new features that expand the gameplay and make it more varied. These additional mechanics and obstacles bring strategic depth to the game and challenge the player to think further ahead and develop more complex solution patterns.

meta.name: Captain Starlight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.07 KB

In Captain Starlight, you guide a spaceman through thirteen narrow tunnels and try to bring him safely to the green asteroid. The cave walls leave little room for error, while obstacles and limited oxygen make every move risky. This creates a tense flight through dangerous passages – steer carefully and keep control to move closer to the goal step by step.

meta.name: Captain Zzap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

From the famous comic strip comes this multi-load action game. Flash has 3 distinct tasks to face, travelling through a desolate forest in the first, shooting or avoiding minions and avoiding the holes. The top half of the screen displays the action, while the bottom half displays a map. The Cave of Barin is his target, with the aim of taking on Barin in combat using an array of punches and kicks. After this, Flash mounts a motorcycle and rides towards Ming, with guards to fend off and energy gates to pass through in order to replenish before finally taking Ming out.

meta.name: Captive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

There must be some kind of way outta here... You have been kidnapped by Buck and Jack. They ordered the $20,000 ransom but haven't released you. Your mission is to find the money and escape captivity in this text adventure. Good luck... captive.

meta.name: The Captive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.24 KB

The Captive throws you into a haunting island setting where you must escape from the eerie Glen of Colored Corpses. You explore the area freely, search for color-coded keys to open locked doors, and collect items that often only reveal their true purpose through specific scrolls. At the same time, mysterious entities roam the land, ending the game instantly on contact, while your energy must be maintained by finding food. That mix of exploration, puzzles, limited inventory, and constant danger gives the game its tense and unsettling appeal.

meta.name: Capture
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.79 KB

"Capture" is a strategic and skill-based board game. The game principle revolves around the tactical movement of pieces, with the player attacking and occupying the opponent's squares in order to gradually dominate the playing field. In "Capture", players move their pieces strategically onto the playing field and try to occupy and take over the opponent's squares. The challenge lies in planning ahead and choosing positions wisely in order to not only push back the opponent, but also strategically control the playing field. Every move requires skill and forward thinking, as you have to protect your own squares and exploit the opponent's weak points.

meta.name: Capture
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.20 KB

Capture by Courbois Software is a unique puzzle and skill game in which players take on the role of an animal catcher who recaptures escaped monsters from the zoo. Since the creatures are too dangerous to touch directly, the player must use movable walls to capture them and imprison them in fenced areas. Gameplay revolves around strategically placing and moving walls to safely enclose the monsters. Each move must be carefully planned as the monsters move freely and try to escape the capture action. Fencing the monsters requires forward thinking and quick reactions to place the walls in time and keep the playing field under control.

meta.name: Capture 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.33 KB

"Capture 2" is a strategic game for the Commodore 64 that can be played either alone against the computer or as a duel between two players. To start the game, the fire button must be pressed on joystick port 2 to play in player versus computer mode. Alternatively, the fire button can be pressed on joystick port 1 to activate player versus player mode. The game is turn-based, with players taking turns to try to "capture" a certain number of game pieces. The aim is to proceed strategically and collect as many pieces as possible in order to end up with the highest number of points. The game ends as soon as one of the players or the computer has reached the specified number of pieces. The player with the best score is declared the winner.

meta.name: Captured
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.64 KB

Captured begins with you waking up in an unknown building after the events of Soldier One, with no idea how you got there. A note in your pocket instructs you to find parts of a code to open the exit, so you set off to explore and escape. In this flick-screen platform game you move across various levels, avoiding obstacles and creatures, losing a life if touched. You can jump and fall from any height, but you are only armed with three laser shots and one bomb, with more ammunition to be collected further into the game.

meta.name: Car Journey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.77 KB

In Car Journey you are the owner of a delivery service, delivering parcels and packages throughout the country. The aim of the delivery service is to make money. The more contracts you can deliver on time the more money you will make. Before you try to run the delivery service you can go to the driving school. The driving school (levels one and two) allows you to drive each of the four vehicles around the road network of Britain, discovering how quickly you can get from town to town and how efficiently you can drive each vehicle.

meta.name: Car-O-Matic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Car-O-Matic is a turn-based puzzle-board game for up to two players. The goal is to score more points by selecting higher numbers. Player one picks digits from a horizontal row, while player two selects from a vertical column. Selecting a digit in your own color adds points, while choosing the opponent's color subtracts points. The game ends when all digits disappear from the board, revealing the full background picture.

“Card Land” is a memory game where players match card pairs. It also includes a Ping-Pong game for added action. The game features an impressive intro sequence with appealing graphics and atmospheric sounds.

meta.name: Card Sharks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador puede elegir entre tres juegos de cartas: Póker, Corazones y Blackjack. Dependiendo del juego elegido, el jugador selecciona hasta tres oponentes.
Además de tres personajes ficticios (Luigi, Lady y Milton), el jugador puede seleccionar Mikhail Gorbachev, Ronald Reagan y Margaret Thatcher.
Los personajes comentan la situación del juego de una manera humorística.

meta.name: Cargo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.84 KB

Cargo feels like an experimental project born from the idea of creating a complete game in a very short time. The result is an unusual blend of maze and puzzle gameplay, where you methodically color in areas of the playfield and must plan your moves carefully. Visually, a distinctive star field in the background and clean, abstract structures define the experience, while influences from other familiar concepts can be sensed throughout. Even though much was planned and ultimately left unfinished, the game offers an intriguing glimpse of how technical skill and creativity can combine to form a unique puzzler.

meta.name: Carnage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.56 KB

“Carnage” is a top-down racing game where only winning matters – finish anything but first, and it's game over. All cars have equal speed, so victory depends on smart tactics and the clever use of power-ups. After each race, you earn £800 to spend in the shop on essentials like nitros, mines, or upgrades to gain the upper hand. With a total of 18 tracks to conquer, only those who drive aggressively and spend wisely will dominate the road.

meta.name: Carrier Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.54 KB

Command Carrier está ambientada en 2166, cuando las pruebas nucleares han creado unas islas llenas de energía sin explotar. Un equipo de científicos ha desarrollado dos portaaviones para colonizar este archipiélago. Tras el robo del ACC Omega por la organización terrorista STANZA, el jugador toma el control del segundo portaaviones, el ACC Epsilon, para impedir que la facción contraria colonice las islas y destruir el prototipo robado. Para ello, cuenta con vehículos anfibios: las Morsas y aviones: las Mantas. El jugador tendrá que construir dispositivos de extracción de recursos y luego fabricar combustible, armas y edificios defensivos para tomar el control y defender las islas del archipiélago.
Los gráficos son en 3D y ofrecen una innovadora combinación de juego bélico y de acción. Hay muchos elementos de estrategia en tiempo real.

meta.name: Carrier Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Carrier Force places you in the Pacific theater of 1942, allowing you to recreate historic carrier battles from a strategic command perspective. You issue orders and define overall strategy while the game handles complex operational details in the background. Several well-known naval engagements provide the setting, with ships and aircraft represented in great detail. Each phase reflects a defined span of time, after which gains and losses are weighed against each other – a demanding experience where planning, foresight and decisive action shape the final outcome.

meta.name: Carriers at War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

In 'Carriers at War', you command the land-based and/or naval components of either nationality in any one of the five historical scenarios provided. An additional scenario recreating the Pearl Harbour Raid has been included to introduce new players easily into the game. Sophisticated, machine-language programming eliminates all the administrative paperwork involved in such detailed operations, reducing your decisions to those actually faced by your historical counterpart. The game is equally rewarding whether played solitaire or with two or more human players. In fact, team play involving up to 12 players is possible in some scenarios. The full-colour, hi-res graphics complement the screen displays, presenting the relevant information in a clear and convenient format. Whether novice or veteran, 'Carriers at War' will provide you with hours of enjoyable and satisfying gaming as you strive to emulate or even surpass the feats of Yamamoto, Fletcher, Halsey or Ozawa.

meta.name: Carry on Laughing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.05 KB

Carry on Laughing puts you in the role of Mr Livewire, whose task is to tidy up the eccentric school of St. Hexidecimals. In each classroom you must turn large X marks into ticks while avoiding the many characters, creatures and roaming hazards. A room is only cleared once every mark has been changed and Mr Livewire reaches the end of the bar. Arrows on the walls lead to other classrooms, and ladders, bars or even rising bubbles allow you to reach higher levels. If an enemy touches you, you lose a life and all progress resets – so staying focused is the only way to bring order step by step.

meta.name: Cartels & Cutthroat$
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cartels & Cutthroat$ is regarded as one of the first business simulation games ever made. Up to eight players compete against each other to maximize profit in a world of fierce competition. Success depends on understanding basic financial and economic principles – such as setting production and prices where marginal costs equal marginal revenues, taking out loans when interest rates are low to expand, and minimizing cost per unit. You must also pay close attention to the state of the economy and the ever-changing preferences of consumers. If you're unsure of your next move, an in-game advisor will guide you in the right direction.

meta.name: Cascade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cascade challenges you to clear as many bubbles from the board as possible. You need at least two neighboring bubbles of the same color – but the larger the connected group, the more points you score. With every move you consider which combination will have the biggest impact and how the board will shift afterward. If you manage to remove all bubbles, you earn a generous bonus – a motivating puzzle experience where smart planning makes all the difference.

p: Case of the Mixed-up Shymer, The (Europe).T64
n: Case of the Mixed-up Shymer, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Case of the Mixed-up Shymer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.22 KB

"The Case of the Mixed-up Shymer" puts the player in the role of Sherlock Holmes' secretary. While the famous detective is busy with another case, the secretary answers a call requesting Sherlock's help. Deciding to take matters into their own hands, they set out to solve the case. On the island of Nursree, nursery school children are in an uproar – their beloved nursery rhymes have been mixed up. To restore order, the player must meet nursery rhyme characters and correct the rhymes. For instance, Humpty Dumpty survives his fall unharmed, but the player needs to make sure he actually breaks. The game is a text-only adventure, where the surroundings are described on screen, and the player must type in commands to solve the case.

meta.name: Casino Poker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.19 KB

Casino Poker is a single-player collection featuring two different poker styles. In Casino Poker you play a slot machine version of 5 Card Draw: you start with 20 points and win or lose depending on your final hand. After 15 rounds the challenge increases, requiring at least a pair of Jacks to win. The second mode, Draw Poker, is a head-to-head match between you and the dealer, where both sides can call, raise, fold, or pass.

meta.name: Castle
meta.desc:

In this platformer your aim is to find all 13 bottles that contain ingredients to a magic spice. You control a mechanoid and you will explore over one hundred of locations of a castle. Every move and every action must be carefully planned in order to avoid the dangers and explore the hidden rooms of the castle.

Al despertar de un sueño atormentado por extraños sueños y visiones, te encuentras en una lujosa habitación amueblada con plata y cristal. Lo más llamativo de la habitación es la mujer que le habla. Es alta, pechugona e inspira autoridad y sabiduría. Vuelve a hablar: "... por último, cuando hayas localizado el orbe, debes devolvérmelo. Puedes quedarte con cualquier tesoro mortal que encuentres después de que lo haya limpiado de su maldad". Ella hace una pausa, y luego dice: "Adelante, cumple mis órdenes". Te inclinas mientras dices: "Lady Artemis..."
La oscuridad te envuelve, hasta que de repente despiertas a la luz del sol del Castillo Blackstar Valley. Tu búsqueda ha comenzado...

Luckily, earlier in his research he had developed a potion which could be used to banish the demons back to their own dimension. There were only two problems, it tasted awful and it didn't remain active for very long. To overcome the first it was injected into various items of food. However there was as yet, no solution the second issue. Armed with only luck, skill and your knowledge of the potion, it's up to you to clear the demons from the castle, beginning at the bottom and ending at the small tower on the roof.

Usa tus ojos y oídos para descubrir las soluciones a los alucinantes rompecabezas. Podrías quedarte allí para siempre.

Use your intellect, so that you choose the right course and do not run against an invisible wall button on the lamp that lights you the way out of the dark room Huge monsters, of which you only see the eyes, threaten you. When he had learned as much as Ibonek could teach him, he began tampering with unknown forces. Consumed by the desire for power, he summoned all evil from the depths of hell and set it upon Kraizar. He gained control of the castle and broke it's key into numerous pieces that are now scattered throughout the town. Only the one known as the Legender can destroy Jrakhos and end his reign of evil. Thus begins our story...

Cuanto más profundo bajas, más se amontonan. Pégate al suelo de la caverna: es tu única esperanza de encontrar un arma —o dos— antes del encuentro final. Porque cuando por fin te enfrentes al Conde… ya sabes: irá directo a la yugular. Así que no dejes caer el valor, afila bien la estaca… y reza como si esta fuera tu última noche. Porque podría serlo.

The more stones are cleared at once, the higher the score. A level ends after a set number of stones (which increases with every level) has been dropped. If all four balls burst, you lose a life. Once all balloons are collected, you move on to the next stage – and after twelve stages, the journey loops back to the beginning.

You control the laser. Waves of about 70 aliens appear over the colony and drop bombs on the various buildings. The laser can destroy both ships and the slowly falling bombs. The destruction of each wave will only delay the inevitable as reinforcements will soon arrive.
At 20,000 points, demon ships will appear and fall from the top of the screen. These cause great damage if left unchecked. And at 30,000 points, neutron bombs will slowly float across the screen. These must be defended against falling alien bombs, otherwise it will explode and destroy everything.
There are 10 difficulty levels. This affects the number of aliens on screen at once, the frequency with which they drop bombs, and the proliferation of demon ships.

Your only companion is an old, unreliable magic ring given to you by the only man who ever returned alive. It warned of snakes and bats that won't hurt you but will steal weapons and supplies. Other creatures, such as the undead, are under the vampire's control and will attack you if you're careless. Some chambers fill with deadly gas - you can try to escape or use the ring. The ring also creates a trapdoor to the next level to go even deeper. Be sure to bring something to draw maps with you, because you'll need it!

Available are angled forward shots, a backward shot, an angled bouncing laser, a powerful forward laser, and up to two hovering and indestructible satellites. meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cave-Quest is a simple yet charming exploration game. The game allows players to navigate labyrinthine caves while searching for treasure and solving puzzles. The mix of exploration, puzzle solving, and item collecting helps make Cave-Quest an engaging single-player adventure that will appeal to both old and new players.

meta.name: Cavelon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.83 KB

En Cavelon, asumes el papel de un caballero en una misión para rescatar a la princesa del castillo. Para lograrlo, debes recolectar las piezas de la puerta dispersas en seis mazmorras para abrir la salida y avanzar. Al final, te enfrentarás al Mago Negro. Es una batalla contrarreloj, así que la velocidad es esencial. Puedes recolectar objetos adicionales por el camino, pero los caballeros enemigos te dispararán para evitarlo.

meta.name: Cavelon 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cavelon 64 you guide a balloon safely through the treacherous caves of Morgor. Narrow passages, electrical traps and sharp rocks are waiting to burst it, so precision and perfect timing are essential. Every mistake costs you a balloon, making patience and steady control the key to surviving the deadly caverns.

meta.name: Caveman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Caveman, un tigre dientes de sable secuestra a tu hijo desde tu cueva, y te lanzas de inmediato a seguir su rastro. Al estilo clásico de las aventuras de texto, exploras bosques, ríos y desfiladeros, recogiendo objetos como una lanza, una antorcha o un salmón, y tomando decisiones mediante comandos escritos. El mundo es hostil y está lleno de obstáculos, pero con ingenio y curiosidad puedes seguir a la bestia y rescatar a tu hijo, siempre que encuentres los comandos correctos.

Con soporte para hasta cuatro jugadores (seis en NES), debes seleccionar a tu cavernícola entre un total de seis personajes diferentes, con distintos orígenes, todos con diferentes habilidades y desventajas.
