meta.name: Cavemania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fed up with having Brontosaurus steaks for dinner, Ug the Caveman  has decided to try something new for a change - by navigating nine islands in search of the three pterodactyl eggs perched high in the mountains, and bringing them back to his cave one by one, making sure that not one egg breaks along the way. Unfortunately, searching for the eggs comes at a price. Ug must also leap across rivers, dodge erupting volcanoes, and use a number of rocks to kill any land-based predators that get in his way. If he comes into contact with any of these, he will lose some energy, which can be restored by collecting fruit. Once Ug has taken all three eggs to his cave, he has to collect some wheels so that he can travel to the next island.

meta.name: Cavern Construction Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A horizontally scrolling cave shooter, much like Skramble. You control a ship armed with bombs and air-to-air missiles with the mission of penetrating enemy territory, inflicting as many losses as possible on your opponents and hoard up treasures. Some might call it a suicide mission because of the multitude of various enemies including missiles, lasers, radar stations and boulders, and you must keep an eye on fuel consumption and fill up the tank by bombing any tanks in your path. A very special feature of the game is the ability to modify the landscape and to add and remove enemies as desired to increase or lower the challenge level.

meta.name: Cavern Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.96 KB

Professor R. Szymanski injected a DNA and acceleration serum into your brain to increase your intelligence. When the DNA level was reached, the lab exploded and the professor fell into a coma. Only he knew how to stop the experiment. A naval ship is shrunk and injected into your bloodstream to prevent the DNA from growing. You must collect eight pieces of a growth inhibitor before you reach your brain. Your blood recognizes the ship as a foreign body and blood cells attack. You must also find cell connections to move around, some require keys. Plasma spheres improve your ship and weapons. DNA Warrior is a horizontally scrolling shooter. The joystick controls your ship, the fire button fires the weapon. Use the space bar to select an upgrade after collecting a sphere. On the screen you can see the energy bar, points and the upgrade indicator.

meta.name: Cavern Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.95 KB

In Cavern Run you move a spacecraft viewed from the side, left or right as it falls down a constantly scrolling cavern and you must avoid hitting the walls or it is game over. Before you play you can select your fuel level and this decreases, which is shown on the right of the screen, but there are fuel capsules that can be collected to increase your levels. Once you crash then you are told your distance traveled before you play again to beat your last score.

meta.name: Caverns of Doom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.05 KB

In Caverns of Doom you take on the role of Cuthbert, following the notes of the explorer Jesmon Hys, who in 6502 BC uncovered the ancient tombs of Ledromica. Too old to continue, he left clues pointing to a hidden temple devoted to the god Rah — and now it's your turn to uncover it. The game unfolds as a flick-screen maze where you search chambers for treasure and bonuses while fending off monsters that appear after a few seconds. One shot is enough to destroy them, but a single touch means death. Doors can only be opened with keys, and you can carry just one at a time. Careful movement, timing, and courage are essential if you hope to reach the Temple of Rah and claim its ancient riches.

meta.name: The Caverns of Eriban
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Caverns of Eriban puts you in the role of a supply pilot navigating a vast cave system to deliver goods to scattered mining depots. After refueling and loading up on the surface, you descend into tight tunnels, avoiding or destroying obstacles where even a small mistake can cost you. The depots guide you with flashing lights, showing where supplies are needed, so you are constantly balancing navigation, risk, and efficiency. That cycle of collecting, delivering, and returning gives the game its calm but demanding rhythm.

meta.name: Caverns of Jupiter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.77 KB

A racing game where the goal is to stay safely on the track without hitting the edge.

meta.name: Caverns of Khafka
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.26 KB

Caverns of Khafka sends you into a treacherous labyrinth filled with traps, dangers, and narrow passages, where you first have to find five holy seals before you can even gain access to the pharaoh's tomb. Along the way, you face not only rocks, magma, bats, and eerie creatures, but also countless hazards that demand constant caution and good timing. What makes it especially appealing is the blend of exploration, evasion, and rising tension, because even after opening the temple, the treasure is still far from yours and the most dangerous moment is waiting right at the very end.

meta.name: Caverns of Sillahc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.00 KB

The Torms and the invading Humans don't like each other. Spotting a quick buck you have decided to take both sides. The Torms have taken the Humans' farming robots who want them back. The Humans want the Torms' power plant to be destroyed forcing them up to the surface. Your aim is to rescue the robots and navigate the underground caverns to destroy the power plant.

meta.name: Caverns of Xydrahpur
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.29 KB

The inhabitants of the planet Rydthar, who call themselves Earthlings, were forced to leave the planet and settle on the third moon, Xydrahpur. The Earthlings had built Absolute Control Stations (ACS) and placed them all over the planet, but they got out of control and took over the planet. In their new home, it is soon discovered that there is an active ACS deep in the caverns beneath the surface. A hero is needed to descend through the tunnels and deactivate the ACS, and you play one such hero, Starman Jones.
Caverns of Xydrahpur is a side-view flick-screen game in which you control Jones on his space bike and move through the tunnels of the caverns to find the ACS. On each screen there is an obstacle, such as an alien or gates, which open and close and which you have to avoid. If you touch an obstacle or the cavern walls, you lose one of five lives, but you start on the last screen you were on.

meta.name: De Grotten van Oberon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.06 KB

The Caves of Oberon takes you into a vast cave system on Oberon, one of Uranus' moons. Hidden within is the knowledge of a long extinct culture, and your task is to uncover it piece by piece. You control a saucer-like spaceship from a side view, interacting with objects such as computers, sensors, fuel tanks, and radars by directing a beam at them. To open doors, you must solve small puzzles on the computers – for example inserting a missing number into a calculation or completing a word with a missing letter. At the same time, you have to avoid colliding with the cave walls, as your ship takes damage and will eventually be destroyed. Fuel is also limited, so you need to refuel at tanks in order to progress.

meta.name: Caves of Silver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.39 KB

You were walking in the woods and came to the entrance of a cave covered by brush. People say that many years ago, Long John Silver hid his silver in the cave, but no one has found it.

meta.name: Caves of Venus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.84 KB

Caves of Venus is a fascinating platform adventure that, as the name suggests, takes place in the mysterious caves of Venus. It is often associated with the popular The Nodes of Yesod, which has similar thematic and stylistic elements. While Nodes of Yesod and its sequel Arc of Yesod focus on a journey of exploration in space, Caves of Venus offers a similar adventure atmosphere but in a different setting. Interestingly, Caves of Venus seems to be a sort of predecessor or early version of The Nodes of Yesod chronologically, even though Nodes of Yesod was released before Caves of Venus.

meta.name: The Caves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.38 KB

In this action game you have to master 6 different levels with your jetpack on your back. Pick up as much treasure as you can, avoid the traps, and keep your jetpack's fuel level up along the way.

meta.name: CBM 64 Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.34 KB

Golf allows you to play a round of golf over 18 holes, on your own or against a friend where both players take it in turn to play a shot after the other player has played one. There are a choice of two courses, a Par 3 course where you only use a 9 Iron, Sand Wedge and a Putter, or a normal course with all the clubs you require. The holes are viewed from above on the whole screen and you first choose which club you need before selecting the direction. The numbers on a clock are used (1 - 12) and when you select a number you can then select another number (0 - 9) to fine tune the direction. Lastly you select your power (1 - 10) before watching the ball move across the screen. Once on the green you can now putt which allows you to select the direction and power once again.

meta.name: Celebrity Squares
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.88 KB

Celebrity Squares is a simple yet engaging shooter game in which the player must fight enemies using precise shots. Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: Cell Defense
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.02 KB

In Cell Defense, you take command of the microscopic battle within the human body, directing immune responses to stop a viral invasion before it causes irreversible damage. The screen shows the positions of viruses, infected cells, blood vessels, and T and B cells. Each cell type has its own loss threshold – exceed it, and the game is over. Only by deploying smart strategies and directing immune forces wisely can you save the organism and eliminate the infection.

meta.name: Cells and Serpents
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cells and Serpents plunges you into a deadly dungeon crawl filled with lethal monsters and dangerous treasures. Armed with a sword and your wits, you explore room by room, facing threats like Mind Flayers, Intellect Devourers, or even Asmodeus himself. Each step could bring fortune, magical items, or instant death. Your goal: gather as much treasure as possible while surviving ever deeper into the maze. You can save your game to tape at any time – a wise move in a world where death lurks behind every door.

meta.name: Celluloid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.49 KB

Celluloid is a breakout/arkanoid style game in which you use the spaceship at the bottom of the screen to direct the ball so that the ball hits colorful "bricks" located at the top of the screen and causes them to disappear.

meta.name: Centauri Alliance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Centauri Alliance te permite formar un equipo con seis razas alienígenas, equiparlas con armas avanzadas y poderes psíquicos, y lanzarlas a una misión secreta por un cúmulo estelar para recuperar una superarma decisiva. Tu objetivo: salvar los mundos de la Alianza de una destrucción inminente. La exploración transcurre en mallas clásicas en primera persona de 10×10, el combate es por turnos, y la búsqueda constante de equipo más potente impulsa tu avance en un universo repleto de peligros, puzles y batallas tácticas: un RPG de ciencia ficción que premia la estrategia y la curiosidad.

meta.name: Centipede
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.67 KB

Centipede places the player in a mushroom-filled battlefield, controlling a movable gun to fend off various pests. The centipede weaves through the field and splits into multiple segments when hit. The spider devours both mushrooms and the player, while the flea deposits new mushrooms in its wake. The scorpion poisons mushrooms, causing the centipede to plummet uncontrollably upon contact. The game's speed can be adjusted through selectable difficulty levels.

meta.name: Centipede 2025
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.15 KB

Centipede 2025 is a modern reimagining of the classic Centipede game. The game's development aims to refresh the iconic gameplay of the original and provide players with an immersive arcade experience. In Centipede 2025, players control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and must shoot down a moving Centipede as well as other enemy creatures that slither through the screen. With improved graphics and potentially additional gameplay elements, the game offers a faster and more intense experience compared to its predecessors.

meta.name: Centric
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Centric puts you in control of a futuristic vehicle racing across a grid, where colliding with walls, obstacles or light trails – your own or your enemies' – means elimination. The goal is to be the last one standing. Four vehicle types offer unique abilities, from braking and teleporting to jumping or auto-dodging collisions. The energy bar at the bottom shows how often you can use your special move.

meta.name: Centripod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.30 KB

Centripods throws you into a chaotic battle against incoming Centripods, falling Dactoes and bouncing Caruths. Surrounded by a dense forest of obstacles, you must react fast and shoot anything that moves – a frantic fight for survival with increasing speed and relentless enemies.

meta.name: Centron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.38 KB

Centron is a fast-paced Pong-style duel where two players face off top to bottom. Controlled with joysticks, a metallic ball is launched from the planet-like center of the screen, setting the match in motion. Its initial direction is unpredictable – requiring quick reflexes and strategy to outsmart your opponent. A classic concept with a futuristic twist and direct competitive fun.

meta.name: Centropods
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.47 KB

Centropods is a single screen shooter viewed from the side inspired by the arcade game Centipede where you control a craft at the bottom of the screen and you must shoot and destroy a Centropod. You are able to move your craft left or right as well as forwards and backwards a short distance. The Centropd appears at the top of the screen and moves across and when it hits a sticky glue pod or the edge of the screen then it lowers one place and changes direction. When you hit the Centropod then it splits into two and further shooting keeps splitting it until it is finally destroyed.

meta.name: Centurio
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Centurion is a horizontally scrolling shooter. Reminiscent of the classic Scramble, the game offers an action-packed experience in which players control a spaceship battling through dangerous environments. In Centurion, players navigate through various levels where they encounter enemy spaceships, obstacles, and other threats. Controlling the ship requires precise timing and quick reactions to escape constant enemy attacks while also getting your own shots off.

meta.name: Centurions Power X Treme
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 75.05 KB

"Centurions Power X Treme" puts the player in control of Ace McCloud, Jake Rockwell, and Max Ray, who must stop Doc Terror's forces before they infiltrate a weapons development center and steal a large supply of Tyron Dichromate – a chemical used in nuclear fusion. Using their exo-frames, they penetrate the complex maze and fight against their enemy's henchmen. The player starts as a recon droid and can transform into Ace, Jake, or Roy depending on whether they are flying over sea, air, or land. By eliminating a certain number of enemies, weapons can be upgraded.

meta.name: Cetimiex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.78 KB

„Cetimiex“ is a fast-paced arcade game that tests your reflexes. Your goal is to jump over obstacles at the right moment while collecting as many points as possible. The speed of the moving objects continuously increases, making the game progressively more challenging. With simple yet addictive gameplay, „Cetimiex“ delivers a classic high-score competition – how long can you last before making a mistake?

meta.name: Chain Reaction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.31 KB

The Anti-Nuclear Party are up to their old tricks again. They have decided to infiltrate a nuclear power station and programmed the robots to empty the containment vault and attack all scientists inside it. To make matters worse, the entire facility will self-destruct in fifty minutes. 
As one of the scientists that survived the onslaught, the player must prevent this from happening by collecting eighteen fuel canisters scattered around all seven floors of the facility and disposing of them in the pit that lies at the center of the first floor, but only one canister can be carried at a time. 
If the player comes into contact with any of the robots, their radiation level increases. Once the player becomes totally contaminated, they will die. There are decontamination showers around the facility, and entering them reduces their radiation level. 
Players are also equipped with a jet-pack that can be used to fly over dangerous areas.

meta.name: Chain Reaction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.51 KB

"Chain Reaction" is an exciting shoot'em up game. The game offers a mix of action and strategic gameplay. In "Chain Reaction" the player controls a tank that must navigate through various levels and eliminate enemies along the way. The goal is to trigger chain reactions that hit a variety of enemy elements or obstacles at the same time. The ability to act precisely and strategically is crucial to achieve the best results and maximize points.

meta.name: Chain-Reaction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.95 KB

In “Chain-Reaction,” the player takes on the role of a scientist tasked with preventing a disaster at a nuclear power plant. Following sabotage by enemy robots, the objective is to collect eighteen fuel canisters scattered across multiple floors and dispose of them in a central pit. Only one canister can be transported at a time. Contact with the robots increases radiation exposure, which can be reduced using decontamination showers. A jetpack allows the player to fly over dangerous areas and accelerate the mission, ensuring the impending destruction is averted in time.

meta.name: Golf Master
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.22 KB

Golf Master allows you to play a full round of golf on a course – either alone or with up to three friends. Before starting, you can select various options, such as skill level (Beginner, Amateur, or Pro) – which affects wind conditions. You can choose whether to compete in a tournament or practice on a single hole. It's also possible to decide how many holes to play – 1–18, 1–9, 10–18, or just one hole. The game presents a top-down view of the course, and by pressing the spacebar, you can view the rest of the layout. You select your club, direction, and shot power – and watch an animation of the swing. When playing with friends, you must wait for each player to finish the hole, rather than alternating after every shot as in real golf.

p: Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip (Europe).T64
n: Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip (Europe)

meta.path: ./Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip (Europe).T64
meta.name: Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 72.12 KB

El malvado Dr. Braxis, cuyo cuartel general se encuentra en el planeta Moebius, quiere destruir la Tierra y ha secuestrado a algunos de los defensores de los Gobots y a sus congéneres. El jugador asume entonces el papel de Leader-1, el líder de los Gobots, para invadir Moebius.
Leader-1 se transforma en su segunda forma, una nave espacial futurista. Hay dos formas de enemigos que destruir: las naves espaciales se matan con el láser y los vehículos terrestres deben destruirse lanzándoles piedras (que se recogen aterrizando y excavando). El objetivo es destruir las bases enemigas recogiendo y utilizando bombas especiales distribuidas aleatoriamente por el planeta.
Tras completar la misión, el juego se cierra con una dificultad superior.

meta.name: The Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.56 KB

You have half of a sacred medallion and it is your job to retrieve the other half of the medallion as well as the blue sapphire from the land of the bear. Part of the Lockerby Collection. Written in PAW, the "Professional Adventure Writer".

meta.name: Challenger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.39 KB

Challenger gives you a harsh and uncompromising mission: you pilot your spacecraft over occupied cities and must destroy them completely in order to drive out the hostile invaders and make rebuilding possible. The game draws its immediate tension from this drastic premise, as every mission feels like another step in a relentless campaign. Its appeal lies mainly in that direct, focused approach, where you work through one city after another and have to concentrate entirely on carrying out your objective successfully.

meta.name: Chambers of Shaolin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aún eres sólo un aprendiz, pero ya sueñas con convertirte en el igual de los más grandes monjes Shaolin. No por gloria, no por honor. Mucho menos por dinero. Sino para alcanzar la plenitud en la abnegación. La dicha en el desinterés. Así que, sólo cuando hayas logrado progresar superando las diversas pruebas en las cámaras Shaolin, y luego hayas tenido el privilegio de competir contra los mejores luchadores del templo, serás juzgado apto para afrontar tu mayor desafío: acabar con el dragón rojo.

meta.name: Chameleon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.94 KB

„Chameleon“ takes place in a universe on the brink of collapse because an evil force is exploiting the source of the elements without regard for the consequences. The player takes on the role of a chameleon to restore balance and must pass through five levels. The first four represent the elements of fire, water, earth, and air. Each level requires finding two things: a hidden exit and a certain number of power points. Additionally, a sufficient number of elemental demons must be defeated by switching between four types of rockets and firing them. The player has three days to clear each level. Getting hit by enemies or encountering obstacles reduces life energy, adding to the challenge.

meta.name: Bivouac
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este juego es una de las simulaciones deportivas más originales. El alpinismo no era a priori un deporte propicio para su adaptación en un juego, pero con el patrocinio y la ayuda de Eric Escoffier (famoso alpinista francés fallecido en 1998), el programa ofrece una precisión notable. Se tienen en cuenta todos los parámetros esenciales: peso y contenido de la mochila, gestión del hambre y la fatiga, necesidad de disponer de un buen seguro para buscar en la mochila...
La ascensión se divide en tres fases. En terreno llano, hay que avanzar y saltar las grietas, comprobando la solidez del terreno. En el fondo de una grieta o de un flanco, hay que avanzar dando tirones con el piolet hasta adelantar una rodilla, apoyar el pie, tirar hacia arriba, apoyar el otro pie, y así sucesivamente. Por último, en una pared vertical, hay que elegir la extremidad que se va a mover, subirla o bajarla, tirarse hacia arriba o hacia abajo y evitar las piedras.

meta.name: The Champ
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Take your boxer to the top in this action boxing game. You start off fighting in an alleyway before finding a manager, who will guide you to the training arena. Here you must work on the punch bag, sparring and skipping rope. Eventually you will move up from small fights to the title contests. The 11 moves include high and low punches, as well as defensive moves and escapes. Full knockout rules apply, and the fighters automatically break up grappling situations.

meta.name: Champions of Krynn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La Guerra de la Lanza ha terminado, los dragonriders han sido derrotados. Pero el mal no ha abandonado Krynn. En el noreste de Ansalon, los puestos avanzados de los Caballeros de Solamnia permanecen para proteger la frágil paz. Tu grupo de aventureros es contratado para llevar a cabo misiones para los Caballeros. En vuestra primera misión, os topáis con draconianos, que se creía que habían abandonado la región. ¿Cuáles son sus planes? Durante tus viajes, te enfrentarás a peligros en muchas mazmorras y ciudades, e incluso puede que te encuentres con algunos de los héroes legendarios de la Lanza.

meta.name: Championship 3D Snooker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.15 KB

Championship 3D Snooker is a game based on snooker for one to eight players but uses six red balls instead of the normal 15 balls. In one player mode, the player must attempt to clear the table with a limited amount of shots which decreases everytime the player misses a shot or fouls. In two player mode, both players can play a game of snooker from 1 - 99 frames. There is also a tournament mode and it can either be played in knockout or league form with up to eight players able to play. Knockout has the players playing the best of five frames for each game while league is one frame.

meta.name: Championship Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Championship Baseball, you draft your team from a roster of players with varying skill attributes before the game begins. The action unfolds on a split screen – the left showing a field overview, the right focusing on the batter until the ball is hit. You can play single games or enter a 24-team, four-division championship. Optional batting practice helps you warm up, and limited managerial decisions offer additional control over gameplay.

meta.name: Sierra Championship Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

In Sierra Championship Boxing, you create your own boxer – be it a human, cartoon character, or even a kangaroo – and step into the ring. Choose from three modes: full control, coaching between rounds, or fully simulated matches. With customizable stats like height, reach, and weight, you can even recreate legendary fighters. Whether playing solo or with a friend, strategy, style, and numbers determine who stands victorious.

meta.name: Championship Chess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Championship Chess is a chess game and offers a solid chess simulation for the Commodore 64. In Championship Chess, players can compete against the computer or another player. The game's artificial intelligence offers challenging opponent performance, so players of different experience levels can enjoy an exciting and tactical game of chess. The game appeals to both beginners and experienced chess players and offers an authentic chess experience in a retro-inspired environment.

meta.name: Championship Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Championship Golf" puts you in charge of a golfer's career, starting as an amateur with £20,000 and aiming to become world number one through clever training, sponsorships, and tournament choices. You manage practice time, select between major and minor events, book anything from a B&B to a five-star hotel, and hire your caddy and coach. Once the tournament begins, you watch your golfer play, bet on others, and assess your results and ranking after each round. Smart planning and performance will grow your wealth and fame – or send you back to the start.

meta.name: Championship Jet Ski Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 59.34 KB

Jet Bike Simulator allows one or two players to race a jet ski against computer riders over a number of laps on various courses. There are three areas to race in: docks, lakes and coastline. There are a number of courses in each area and you have to complete a number of laps within a time limit to move onto the next course. There are numbered buoys on the courses that you have to ride between: if you miss a set then you don't complete a lap. The game is viewed from above and the whole course is shown on the screen. There are two difficulty levels, which set different time limits.

meta.name: Championship Lode Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Secuela del Lode Runner original, con una jugabilidad idéntica. Este paquete contenía 50 de los niveles más desafiantes jamás diseñados, y fue diseñado solo para jugadores expertos. No incluía el editor de niveles, tenías que jugar en todos los niveles en orden, pero se proporcionaba una opción para guardar el juego (aunque perdías una vida cada vez que restaurabas).

meta.name: Championship Sprint
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Championship Sprint, you race solo or with a friend across eight new top-down tracks filled with hazards like oil slicks and whirlwinds. But the real highlight is the built-in track editor, allowing you to design your own courses, add obstacles freely, and set lap counts and player numbers. The game builds on the fast-paced action of its predecessor with creative freedom and personalized racing challenges.

meta.name: Championship Sprint 1993 - The Raceists II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.95 KB

Championship Sprint 1993: The Raceists II is a ROM hack of the classic top-down racing game Championship Sprint. This hack expands on the original game, designed for 1 to 3 players, and features new race tracks that bring players additional challenges and fresh gameplay. The gameplay remains true to the original, with players navigating small vehicles through twisty tracks from a bird's eye view. The focus is on quick reactions, precise steering, and choosing the right line to overtake opponents and reach the finish line first. The added tracks in The Raceists II offer more variety and a new dynamic that enriches the experience for fans of the original.

meta.name: Championship Wrestling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Championship Wrestling, you step into the ring as one of eight eccentric fighters – including K.C. Colossus and Prince Vicious. With 25 moves like leg drops, spin kicks, atomic drops, and high-flying rope attacks, the game delivers pure arcade action. The more complex the move, the higher the score – you can even toss your opponent out of the ring. Timing, tactics, and showmanship determine who comes out on top.

meta.name: Chang's Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Chang's Adventure, you must escape from the mysterious island and reach the harbor where your boat awaits. But the path is blocked by a locked gate, and the key is held by the Temple Warlord. To defeat him, you'll first need to find the key to the temple itself. Ninjas stand in your way, and you must either avoid them or use your limited swords wisely. Completing the game is possible, but reaching a perfect 100% score requires clever planning and precise action.

meta.name: Chaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.60 KB

A crosshair shooter where you have to shoot the number of aliens shown on the left before you run out of the number shown on the right. The number of incoming enemies always starts at 40. The squadrons consist of only a few elements and jump and fall as they approach. Good luck, defenders!

meta.name: Chaos Road
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.57 KB

Chaos Road is an Ikari Warriors-inspired shoot'em up game. In Chaos Road, players control their character through enemy territories, similar to Ikari Warriors, and fight through numerous waves of enemies. The goal is to make your way through dangerous levels, defeating enemies while avoiding obstacles that make progress difficult. The gameplay relies on quick reflexes and tactical maneuvering, as players are constantly faced with enemy fire and changing enemy formations.

meta.name: Chase H.Q.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Chase H.Q." es un juego de carreras basado en puntos de control en el que el jugador asume el papel de un policía encubierto llamado Tony Gibson en este juego inspirado en "Miami Vice" de Taito. Gibson conduce un poderoso coche de policía sin marcas (parecido a un Porsche 911) junto con su compañero, 'Raymond Broady' y debe perseguir y detener a varios criminales.
El jugador tiene entre cincuenta y cinco y setenta segundos para alcanzar al criminal que huye, y luego, en el mismo período de tiempo, vuelve a chocar repetidamente contra el coche del criminal hasta que éste queda demasiado dañado para conducir. El coche del criminal se aleja constantemente, así que si el jugador choca repetidamente o conduce demasiado despacio, el criminal escapará y el juego terminará.

meta.name: Chase HQ II : Special Criminal Investigation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chase H.Q. II tiene la misma combinación de acción y carreras que la primera parte. Debes encontrar y detener los coches de cinco matones. El perfil de los sospechosos se define antes de cada misión y tu tarea es encontrarlos entre el tráfico. Para detenerlos hay que golpear sus vehículos de tal forma que pierdan el control, respetando el tiempo límite.

p: Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island, The (USA).D64
n: Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island, The (USA)

meta.name: The Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This Pac-Man inspired maze game is based upon the Tom Sawyer's Island attraction at Disneyland. Players maneuver Tom Sawyer along the island's paths in his quest to gather berries. However, Aunt Polly, Injun Joe, and after the third level, a bear, chase after Tom. He can avoid them by ducking into escape routes such as a water wheel, a teeter-totter, a raft and two caves. If Tom survives all five levels, the player wins.

meta.name: Chasm Chaser
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.83 KB

Chasm Chaser is a skill game for the Commodore 64. In this game, the player controls a character through labyrinthine caves, collects treasures and has to avoid obstacles and enemies.

meta.name: Chasm Chaser II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.62 KB

Chasm Chaser II is a skill game for the Commodore 64. In this game, the player controls a character through labyrinthine caves, collects treasures and has to avoid obstacles and enemies. The game is characterized by its challenging levels and classic 8-bit graphics.

meta.name: Chatterbee
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chatterbee is an educational game that teaches spelling. It uses the speech synthesizer Software Automatic Mouth (SAM) to read out word and sentences. The program will read a word, then define it in a sentence before reading it out again. The player's task is simply to type the word and as the letters appear on the screen the synthesizer will repeat them. Spelling a word correctly leads to points being awarded and if wrong the player gets two more chances. The game consists of ten rounds each with either five or ten words. There are 25 levels and the player can start on any of them. If the player does well the level will automatically change to a higher one.

meta.name: Chatterbee

meta.name: Cheap Skate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.81 KB

Cheap Skate puts you in the role of the new kid in town, whose skateboarding skills have caught the attention of a local gang. To join the Street Hawks, you must complete a series of tests that challenge your agility. Viewed from an isometric perspective with a constantly scrolling screen, you ride through the streets while dodging obstacles like manholes, signs, boxes, fireballs, and even rival skaters. Some poles require you to duck at just the right moment. Each trial is timed, and you must reach the finish line before the clock runs out. Crashes or timeouts cost one of your three lives, while you also manage your speed through a speed meter.

meta.name: Checkers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.36 KB

„Checkers“ is a digital adaptation of the classic board game Checkers. Two players move their pieces diagonally across the board, attempting to capture opponent's pieces by jumping over them. If a piece reaches the opponent's back row, it becomes a king and gains enhanced movement options. Strategic thinking and foresight are key to defeating the opponent.

meta.name: Checkers 1.0
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Checkers 1.0“ is a digital adaptation of the classic board game Checkers. Two players move their pieces diagonally across the board, attempting to capture opponent's pieces by jumping over them. If a piece reaches the opponent's back row, it becomes a king and gains enhanced movement options. Strategic thinking and foresight are key to defeating the opponent.

meta.name: Checkers v2.1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.12 KB

„Checkers v2.1“ is a digital adaptation of the classic board game Checkers. Two players move their pieces diagonally across the board, attempting to capture opponent's pieces by jumping over them. If a piece reaches the opponent's back row, it becomes a king and gains enhanced movement options. Strategic thinking and foresight are key to defeating the opponent.

meta.name: Cheeky Twins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

On the planet Xnyl, all the "Jams" live in peace and harmony. One reason for this is that no one has to work on Xnyl, as the Jams feed on air and love - and they need a lot of it. Love is not a problem, but air is running out and the Jams will not survive much longer. Two Jams named Pin and Ball have invented an atmosphere machine that requires tons of diamonds to produce fresh air. The problem: There are no diamonds on Xnyl. Pin and Ball, clever as they are, build a spaceship and soon discover the uninhabited but diamond-rich planet Alpha Seven. But overconfidently, they overfill the spaceship, which leads to an explosion above the Earth, radioactively infecting animals and creating mutants. Now Pin and Ball must recover the diamonds and use their vitamin catapult weapon. Help the Jams survive!

meta.name: Cheeky Twins II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cheeky Twins II is a challenging skill-based game where you control two characters simultaneously through tricky levels. Each stage presents new obstacles and tasks that require perfect timing and sharp coordination. The difficulty lies not only in dodging dangers but also in managing both twins together to reach the goal. With each level, the challenge ramps up, and only quick reflexes and focus will guide the cheeky duo to victory.

meta.name: Chem Lab
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chem Lab turns your computer into an impressive chemistry lab. With 50 different experiments and thousands of chemical reactions that can explode, boil over, or behave unpredictably, the game offers an exciting way to explore the world of chemistry.

meta.name: Chemical
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chemical is a puzzle game where the player must assemble atoms into molecules. Pressing the space key reveals the required molecular structure to replicate. Using a crosshair, the player selects an atom and moves it in a chosen direction with the joystick. Atoms travel in straight lines until they hit an obstacle, making precise planning essential. Time and level bonuses reward quick solutions, and level passwords allow players to resume their progress at a later time.

meta.name: Chemistry Test : 'O' Level
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.55 KB

“Chemistry Test: 'O' Level” is a collection of multiple-choice questions designed to prepare students for exams. The questions are randomly selected and continuously presented until the player chooses to stop. At the end, the final score is displayed.

meta.name: Chernobyl : Nuclear Power Plant Simulation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.08 KB

Chernobyl: Nuclear Power Plant Simulation is a simulation where the player takes control of a nuclear power plant. While the title references the 1986 disaster, it has no impact on gameplay. Players analyze numbers, navigate menus, and input commands via a parser, such as disabling generators or closing exhaust valves, to influence the system's behavior. The objective is to maintain smooth power generation and follow emergency procedures outlined in the manual if issues arise. Interestingly, the game was originally intended to be called "Nuclear Power Plant Simulation," but COSMI insisted on naming it "Chernobyl," despite creator Paul Norman's reservations about the title.

meta.name: Cherry Dash
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.47 KB

meta.name: Chess 7.0
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chess 7.0 places classic chess at the center and thrives on the open contest between two players, where no information is hidden and every decision is played out visibly on the board. From the fixed starting position with its differently valued pieces grows a strategic duel in which attacking, exchanging, supporting, and fighting for better positions shape the course of the game. That clear focus on tactics, planning, and gradually working toward checkmate is exactly what gives the game its timeless appeal.

meta.name: Chess Chiller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.94 KB

You're an avid chess fan and you've fallen asleep with your board, but a dream turns into a nightmare: you're standing on the edge of a huge chessboard, surrounded by a cheering crowd. Your task: carry six pawns across the board one at a time while avoiding a main piece and its traps. First you face the knight, which moves three squares at a time. As you transport the pawns, you leave a trail of blue squares. If the knight lands on a blue square, it turns red and becomes dangerous. If you touch the knight or a red square, you lose the pawn. The crowd throws objects that also turn squares red. After the knight, you face the bishop, which moves diagonally, changing black squares and making red dangerous. After the bishop, the rook, queen and king follow, each with their own challenges. If you lose all the pawns, the game is over.

meta.name: Two Man Chess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.54 KB

Two Man Chess presents classic chess in an especially direct form and focuses entirely on a duel between two players who enter their moves step by step through clear commands. Its simple presentation brings the essentials to the forefront: thinking ahead, developing your pieces wisely, and putting your opponent under pressure move by move. The appeal lies entirely in that pure concentration on strategy, board awareness, and the timeless back-and-forth of chess.

meta.name: The Chessmaster 2000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Esta entrega de la serie Chessmaster presenta un poderoso oponente de ajedrez con 12 niveles de habilidad, desde principiante hasta gran maestro. Entre sus muchas funciones se incluye una biblioteca de aperturas formada por 71.000 jugadas y la posibilidad de ver el historial de jugadas.
Para ayudar a los principiantes, hay un modo de aprendizaje que muestra todas las jugadas legales, una jugada de sugerencia que ofrece lo que el ordenador cree que es una jugada fuerte, y la posibilidad de que el maestro de ajedrez analice todas las jugadas anteriores de una partida. También se ofrecen famosas posiciones de juego reales y desafíos preestablecidos.

meta.name: The Chessmaster 2000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Esta entrega de la serie Chessmaster presenta un poderoso oponente de ajedrez con 12 niveles de habilidad, desde principiante hasta gran maestro. Entre sus muchas funciones se incluye una biblioteca de aperturas formada por 71.000 jugadas y la posibilidad de ver el historial de jugadas.
Para ayudar a los principiantes, hay un modo de aprendizaje que muestra todas las jugadas legales, una jugada de sugerencia que ofrece lo que el ordenador cree que es una jugada fuerte, y la posibilidad de que el maestro de ajedrez analice todas las jugadas anteriores de una partida. También se ofrecen famosas posiciones de juego reales y desafíos preestablecidos.

meta.name: The Fidelity Chessmaster 2100
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Fidelity Chessmaster 2100" is a version of the renowned Chessmaster series, released for the Apple IIGS. The Chessmaster series is known for its accessibility and strategic depth, appealing to both beginners and experienced players. The goal is to compete against an AI-based opponent in a game of chess and improve your skills.

n: Chester Field - Challenge to Dark Gor (Japan) (Side A)

meta.path: ./Chester Field - Challenge to Dark Gor (Japan) (Side A).D64
meta.name: Chester Field - Challenge to Dark Gor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The kingdom of Guldred was invaded by General Guemon and his dark forces, who killed the king. A brave knight named Gazem fled with the dethroned queen and her daughter Karen to the paradise island of Chesterfield. But Guemon's troops were there and sank their ship, killed the queen, kidnapped Karen, and left Gazem near death. Before he died, Gazem was able to report Guldred's plight to the brave knight Kein. Now Guldred's fate rests on Kein's shoulders. In Chester Field: Ankoku Shin e no Chōsen, an action RPG, Kein must survive eight levels of labyrinths, knights, and battles on land, sea, and air to bring peace. Along the way, he can gain health by collecting jars from defeated enemies and use metal to purchase magical equipment on Chesterfield.

meta.name: Chevalier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.51 KB

Chevalier is reminiscent of Pitfall but set in a larger world full of dangers. You must use precise jumps to avoid cacti and other obstacles. In the end, even a leap of faith into the unknown awaits – only those with courage and perfect timing will progress.

meta.name: Chevy Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.59 KB

Compites contra el reloj en cuatro niveles con diferentes secciones. El coche se muestra desde atrás como en Outrun y conduces por una calle. Utilizando dos marchas, intentas adelantar a los coches que te bloquean el paso. Las curvas harán chirriar tus neumáticos. Si chocas contra obstáculos como coches o señales, reducirás la velocidad, pero no podrás chocar.

meta.name: Chewing Charlie
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.41 KB

meta.name: Chicago's 30
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.65 KB

Un juego de acción trepidante para los amantes de emociones fuertes.
Si decides entrar en acción, tu misión será guiar al mejor detective de la ?Poli? de Chicago, ?ELLIOT EL GRANDE?, hasta un almacén clandestino de bebidas.
Tendrás que salir del puerto, atravesar los bajos fondos, entrar en la ciudad y llegar al almacén; cuatro niveles plagados de peligros.
Tu habilidad y tu ametralladora serán los únicos aliados con que contar.
El juego de la ?PASMA? te dejará ?PASMADO?.

meta.name: Chicken
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.06 KB

The deadly game of Chicken, played for decades by rival macho speed freaks with ego problems, now you too can go head-to-head in a bout of truck smashing - but without the after effects! In order to be able to smash into your opponent you must first increase the crunch power, which is done by collecting the steel girders that appear. Whoever collected the last girder his/her car colour will be displayed in the bottom border, showing who has the most crunch power and the ability to smash the other truck. Various extras can be collected to increase your smashing ability, shields will protect you from your opponent, turbo power to increase your speed, flame weapons to totally wipe your opponent out, and an assortment of other accessories and road hazards.

meta.name: Chicken Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.36 KB

You are a hyper hen, running around a maze, eating corn scattered along the corridors, Chicken Chase adds to the challenge in the form of Gompeys, birdlike creatures that cruise the board from top to bottom at regular intervals. Adding to the fun are coyote boxes. At several spots on the maze one of these critters is penned up, depending on the level you've reached, one or more of them will be released when you pass its cage. Since coyotes like to eat chickens, this is another problem to avoid. They also cruise the side roads, so you'll need a new hiding plays from the Gompeys when a coyote is nearby. Each level completed lets a few more coyotes loose and things go a bit faster.

meta.name: Chickin Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.68 KB

Chickin Chase is an action game. The player controls a rooster who must ensure that his wife can give birth to his children peacefully. Snakes, rats and raccoons will try to make you fail in your goal.

meta.name: Chiller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.17 KB

Whilst trying to reach the haunted mansion in which your kidnapped lady is held, your car runs out of fuel. As a result, you must progress on foot to reach her.
The areas you must travel through include the forest, cinema, a ghetto and the graveyard. All are filled with ghouls, zombies, ghosts or bats, all ready to drain your energy. To complete each screen you must collect the five blue crosses. Once you reach the mansion and find her, you must escort your girlfriend back through the same territories, switching between characters to collect the blue (him) and red (her) crosses as quickly as you can, still not safe.

meta.name: Chillervilla
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.40 KB

Chillervilla invites you to spend a night in a notorious haunted house where ghosts, phantoms, and poltergeists roam. Your goal is to keep your sanity intact and locate a hidden amulet somewhere within the mansion. The eerie atmosphere, shadowy rooms, and unexplained phenomena demand courage, focus, and strong nerves to solve the mystery and survive the night.

meta.name: Chilly Willy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.31 KB

Chilly Willy puts you in control of a small penguin navigating icy screens while being relentlessly chased by enemy penguins. You kick and slide ice blocks to crush opponents against walls or other blocks, all while maneuvering around immovable obstacles. Each cleared stage raises the challenge as the action becomes faster and more confined. The appeal comes from quick thinking, precise block positioning, and the constant pressure to survive without mistakes.

meta.name: Chimera
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.45 KB

"Chimera" takes place in an isometric labyrinth consisting of 8 × 8 screens, where the player must gain access to hidden or blocked areas of a spaceship. This is achieved by finding and strategically using items to bypass various obstacles. The main objective is to assemble four warheads, transport them to the ship's "blue" rooms, and activate them. Once all warheads are armed, reaching the green room is necessary to complete the mission. At the same time, food and water supplies must be carefully managed – both deplete faster when carrying items or moving through hot rooms. Occasionally, food and water can be found within the labyrinth. If resources run out or an obstacle is tackled with the wrong item, the player dies, ending the game.

meta.name: China Miner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

China Miner is a single screen platform game where you play Wally who is the only person to know the location of the Jade Mines belonging to the Pong Dynasty in China. On each of the 30 screens you must collect certain objects before collecting a key to move onto the next screen. As well as the platforms to negotiate you must also avoid the various creatures that populate the mine and if you touch any of them then you lose one of five lives, sent to the start of the screen and all objects reappear. There are various obstacles to avoid or use like lasers, moving platforms and platforms that disintegrate when stepped on. Falling from heights also lose you a life.

meta.name: The Chinese Juggler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.96 KB

Chinese Juggler is a fast-paced skill game where you must keep eight plates spinning on eight poles before the timer runs out. At the bottom of the screen, you select colored plates, each worth different points – white plates score the highest, purple the lowest. By tossing and catching a plate, you can change its color. As you place new plates, the ones already spinning slow down and need to be refreshed to keep them going. If you manage to fill all eight poles in time, you advance to the next level – but if the timer hits zero, the game is over.

meta.name: Chip Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.76 KB

The Chip Factory is a single screen platform game based on the arcade game BurgerTime. You play the role of Charlie who is a trainee accountant in a Silicon Chip factory who dreams of working in the manufacturing section making the chips themselves. One night, when everyone has gone home, Charlie fires up the machines to try his hand at making the chips.

meta.name: Chip's Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chip McCallahan es un "nerd" al que le gustaría ser aceptado en el club de informática Bit Busters", presidido por Melinda, un portento de inteligencia. Pero para entrar en el club, tiene que demostrar su inteligencia superando una prueba de iniciación resolviendo los retos que componen los numerosos niveles del juego (hasta 149 según la versión).
Chip tendrá que recoger todas las fichas electrónicas de cada nivel antes de poder eliminar el "socket" que bloquea la salida. Para ello, tendrá que calcular el orden de sus acciones, abrir puertas cogiendo la llave adecuada, empujar bloques para bloquear pasadizos o crear otros, utilizar el accesorio adecuado para llegar a zonas mortales o infranqueables (escudo azul para el agua, rojo para el fuego, crampones para caminar sobre el hielo, imán para resistir campos magnéticos...). Los primeros niveles son un tutorial y la dificultad aumenta rápidamente.

meta.name: Chipwits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chipwits is an educational game about programming a small robot called Chipwit.
Chipwit is a small robot that needs to be programmed to perform tasks. The robot must navigate a series of semi-random mazes, trying to pick up the desired items while avoiding the other items that thrive through the maze in order to maximize its score.
The player programs the Chipwit by creating action commands. These action commands contain an operator, which includes look, sing, smell, and move, and an argument, such as: B. what to look for or how far to move. Each action command can be either true or false, causing the chipwit's programming to result in a different action command.
Gameplay allows for real-time debugging of Chipwit programming.

meta.name: Choc-a-Bloc Charlie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.71 KB

Choc-a-Bloc Charlie traps you as a warehouse worker in a tight maze of blocks where only clever thinking will set you free. The room is filled with white crates, but the key is to push the four purple blocks together into a perfect square to open the exit. Every move counts – the timer is merciless, and before you know it, you're already in the next, even trickier warehouse. Planning, speed and a sharp eye are your only allies.

meta.name: Cholo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.05 KB

Tras una guerra nuclear, los pocos supervivientes se unieron a la red de túneles subterráneos bajo la ciudad de Cholo, esperando el día en que bajara la radiación. Sin embargo, la radiación era más alta de lo esperado y el ordenador funcionó mal, atrapando a la gente bajo tierra. Debes enviar un grupo de droides a la superficie para desactivar el sistema.
Empiezas con un droide RAT llamado Rizzo, pero puedes encontrar y controlar a otros, incluidos droides aéreos. Cuando encuentres la sala de ordenadores, podrás conectar tu droide al terminal y ejecutar programas. Cuidado con los guardias robot que te disparan
Sólo una pequeña parte de Cholo es habitable, así que vigila el ruido de tu contador Geiger cuando te acerques a las zonas desérticas, ya que la radiación debilita a tu droide.

meta.name: Chomp!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chomp! is a single-player game where the player controls a goldfish and tries to grow larger by eating small sea creatures and eventually other fish. The fish starts in a small fishbowl and travels from tank to tank with the goal of reaching the river outside. As the game progresses, the fish must avoid dangers such as piranhas, fishing nets, and cat paws.

meta.name: Chomper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chomper is a classic Pac-Man clone that sends you racing through colorful mazes, collecting dots while avoiding relentless enemies. After clearing four boards, you advance to the next level – identical in layout but faster and more intense. The first three boards can be chosen directly from the main menu. Despite its simplicity, Chomper delivers the same timeless tension as the original – a race against time, the enemies, and your own reflexes.

meta.name: Chomper Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.53 KB

Chomper Man es un juego de laberintos inspirado en el juego de arcade Pac-Man en el que tienes que moverte por diferentes laberintos comiendo todos los puntos mientras evitas a los enemigos. Mientras comes los puntos, puedes pulsar el botón de disparo para que te dé un impulso de velocidad, pero éste es limitado. Para ayudarte, también hay cuatro repelentes de fantasmas que, cuando se recogen, te permiten comer a los "matones" durante un breve periodo de tiempo. Si eres golpeado por un enemigo, pierdes una de tus tres vidas. Para salir de un laberinto, tienes que comer todos los puntos, pero tienes que salir del laberinto tres veces para pasar a un nuevo laberinto y la tercera vez las paredes son invisibles. Pueden jugar dos jugadores, cada uno de los cuales se turna cuando un laberinto es despejado por el otro jugador o cuando un jugador pierde todas sus vidas.

meta.name: Chop N' Drop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

IK+ (International Karate +) ahora con 3 luchadores de karate que compiten al mismo tiempo. En lugar de la patada de giro y el salto mortal, el luchador ahora puede hacer el cabezazo, el "Flip-Flop" y un salto de patada combinado, con el que uno puede lanzar al suelo a 2 luchadores al mismo tiempo. Los 3 luchadores tienen la misma velocidad, fuerza y conocen los mismos golpes y patadas. El luchador que llega a los 6 puntos primero gana la ronda. El luchador con menos puntos abandona. Después de cada dos rondas de supervivencia hay una ronda de bonificación, en la que tienes que repeler las bolas con un escudo. Si lo consigues obtendrás un "Bono de Supervivencia" de 5.000 puntos.

meta.name: Choplifter!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.16 KB

Choplifter es un juego de acción / arcade de desplazamiento lateral que te pone al mando de un helicóptero de ataque. Tu misión: ir tras las líneas enemigas y rescatar hasta 16 rehenes por nivel. Sin embargo, ten cuidado, porque los tanques y los aviones enemigos intentarán detenerte, ¡y no dejarán de disparar mientras rescates a esos rehenes! Originalmente lanzado para computadoras personales Apple II, Choplifter fue posteriormente portado a las salas de juegos y varias consolas de videojuegos. Seguirían muchos imitadores y homenajes.

meta.name: Chopp-Hopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chopp-Hopper puts you in control of a helicopter flight where avoidance and precise control are everything. Constant movement forces you to navigate through a hazardous environment, keeping clear of obstacles while trying to survive as long as possible as the pressure steadily increases. Its appeal lies in the focus on timing and reflexes, where even the smallest mistake can bring everything to an abrupt end.

meta.name: Chopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.94 KB

Chopper focuses on immediate action, putting you in control of a helicopter facing hostile targets in fast-paced encounters. Constant movement, enemy attacks, and limited space demand precise maneuvering and sharp timing, with every hit having instant consequences. The emphasis on reflexes and control creates a compact, challenging flow that keeps the pressure on until the very end.

meta.name: Chopper Commander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

As you fly and destroy, the population count will slowly go down and if it reaches zero then that Continent is lost. When the Mothership appears you must keep blasting it as it fires back at you and when destroyed it leaves behind an anti-tank weapon which then allows you to fly across the surface and destroy the tank. Once the level is successful you receive one person to add to the population number and you then go to the next Continent on the next level. You have an energy bar and if you touch an alien ship or are shot by the Mothership then you lose one life from three and it is game over when the lives are lost or all the Continents are lost.

meta.name: Chopper Hunt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.43 KB

Chopper Hunt once again puts you in control of a nimble helicopter tasked with recovering hidden treasures buried underground. Each stage features different targets – from oil barrels and money bags to mysterious symbols. To uncover them, you bomb the ground and dig deep holes while an enemy aircraft drops heavy clods of dirt to undo your progress. After picking up a treasure, you must safely return to base to secure it – if you are destroyed beforehand, you lose your prize. Since you can carry only one item at a time, careful timing and caution are essential – only after collecting everything do you advance to the next challenge.

meta.name: The Chrome Brothers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.70 KB

The Chrome Brothers has you guide two brave brothers through a maze of platforms where every jump and ladder matters. You collect bonus items, dodge knives and other foes, and with only limited ammo, timing is far more important than firepower. Each level is almost symmetrical, yet subtle differences in item placement and hazards keep things unpredictable. A precise, old-school platform challenge where survival depends on the art of evasion.

meta.name: Chubby Chester
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Chubby Chester" is a puzzle game for the Commodore 64. In this game, the player controls the character Chubby Chester through various labyrinths in which he must overcome obstacles and solve puzzles to reach the next level. The game is characterized by its challenging puzzles and simple but appealing graphics.

meta.name: Chubby Gristle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.42 KB

Chubby Gristle, el vigilante del aparcamiento, tiene la misión de comer tanta comida como sea posible y evitar cualquier visita a la granja de la salud o al gimnasio. Juegas como Chubby en este juego de plataformas inspirado en Monty Mole. Las pantallas contienen alimentos extra para recoger: hamburguesas, chocolate y más. Para avanzar por los niveles de pantallas parpadeantes, deberás saltar sobre plataformas, trepar por cuerdas y utilizar salientes móviles.

meta.name: Chuck Norris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.13 KB

In this action game, you play Chuck Norris, who is on a mission to a monastery where an important leader is being held hostage. The game consists of several screens: at the beginning and between battles, you see the path that leads to the monastery. On your way, you will encounter numerous enemies, and during battle, the view changes to a close-up. By pressing the joystick button and moving in one of four directions, you can perform kicks, punches, and blocks. Some enemies can only be defeated by certain movements. The path occasionally splits, with only one direction being correct, the others leading to dead ends. You start as a white belt and rise in rank as you win battles - until you finally become a black belt and can defeat the deadly ninjas in the monastery. Your mission must be completed within a time limit; deviating from the path or losing battles costs additional time.

meta.name: Chuck Rock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Unga Bunga' Ophelia, la esposa de Chuck Rock, ha sido capturada por ese inservible de Gary Gritter. ¡Podrá Chuck abrirse paso a través de las cinco fases con retos cada vez mayores, decenas de dinosaurios trastornados, y sorpresas a lo largo de todo el camino? ¿O terminará su amor finalmente convertido en polvo?

meta.name: Chuck Yeager's Advanced Flight Trainer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chuck Yeager's Advanced Flight Trainer puts you in the role of a test pilot and lets you fly a wide range of aircraft under demanding conditions. From fast jets to experimental machines, every flight calls for precision, control, and a strong feel for how each model handles. Stunts, formation flying, and races add variety, while multiple camera views, zoom, and a flight recorder encourage you to study your performance closely and keep improving.

meta.name: Chuckie Egg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Chucky Egg, juegas como Harry el Gallinero, que debe recoger una docena de huevos en cada nivel, mientras evita a los pájaros. Los niveles se componen de plataformas, escaleras y ascensores, y son similares al juego de plataformas Donkey Kong. También se puede recoger maíz, para aumentar los puntos y detener la cuenta atrás durante un tiempo, aunque los pájaros también pueden comerse estas semillas.
Sólo hay 8 niveles distintos. El noveno nivel es una copia del nivel 1, el décimo es una copia del nivel 2, y así sucesivamente.

meta.name: Chuckie Egg II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.88 KB

Chuckie Egg II es la secuela del juego de plataformas Chuckie Egg, pero es muy diferente del juego original. Mientras que el juego original tiene ocho niveles de una pantalla cada uno, éste tiene muchas más pantallas que forman un laberinto.
En el juego, Hen House Harry tiene que construir un huevo de chocolate gigante con los ingredientes (cacao, leche y azúcar) que se encuentran en la fábrica. Debe haber ocho de cada. También tiene que encontrar las ocho piezas de un kit de juguetes para colocar dentro del huevo.
Para conseguir todos los objetos, tienes que abrirte camino por la fábrica, evitando muchos tipos diferentes de enemigos y resolviendo rompecabezas con la ayuda de varios objetos que puedes llevar. Hay varias formas de moverse por la fábrica, cruzando plataformas, pero también cuerdas y tuberías.
A pesar de los cambios radicales con respecto al original, el juego conserva la misma banda sonora.

meta.name: Chute Pursuit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.70 KB

In Chute Pursuit, you guide your ship through the dangerous region of Frexel-Kejland and fight your way from zone to zone. To open the exit, you have to destroy all key-shaped laser locks while aliens, obstacles, and firing cannon positions make the path harder. Flashing pods boost your firepower or jump energy, and sometimes trampolines are the only way over blocked passages – shoot quickly and dodge wisely to reach the next section.

meta.name: Chutes and Ladders
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Chutes and Ladders
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Chwat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The story begins when the princess of Oms land named Cecil gets sick. As foretold she can be saved only thanks to a magic medicine. Chwat Romek sets off on a mission. Chwat is a typical for its times action adventure game, demanding finding items and using them in the right place, avoiding enemies and obstacles. Romek may carry only up to two items at a time, talk to encountered characters and use switches. The items can be left in any location and collected at a different time. Contact with enemies, water and obstacles takes some energy points. The loss of life takes the player to the initial location.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Ciphoid 9
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Earth is about to be attacked and destroyed by an alien force and it's up to you to blast and destroy them with your gun on the moon's surface. The game is a 1st person shooter with the game consisting of various stages with each shown on the whole screen. As you blast at the aliens with your gun sight, they fire back and when you are hit it reduces your shields. When your shields have gone then you watch a small animated sequence of the Earth being destroyed and it is game over.

meta.name: Circle World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.05 KB

Circle World draws you into an alien construction, a vast ring-shaped world circling a sun and abandoned by its creators. You explore the environment, encounter strange creatures, and discover advanced technology while time is constantly working against you. Step by step, you must gather clues, assess dangers, and make decisions to prevent the world's destruction. The appeal lies in exploring an unusual setting and the constant pressure to find a solution before it is too late.

meta.name: Circuit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Circuit you control an electron navigating a circuit-like environment to light up all the bulbs. You gain power by passing through specific electrical components. An arrow guides you through the complex network. If you have some knowledge of electronics, you'll enjoy the challenges even more. Technical glitches may occur when loading – just restart if the game crashes.

meta.name: Circus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.60 KB

Circus starts with your car breaking down far from anywhere. Searching for a gas station, you find a circus tent in a valley, where music plays before suddenly falling silent. You approach the entrance cautiously, hoping to find fuel. The game uses an upgraded engine that accepts full sentences and allows switching between graphics and text, making the experience easier and less frustrating.

You have entered the grounds of a Circus and the aim is to complete three tents and the Big Top within a time limit to move to the next level. Each tent is made up of various single screens and each need to be completed before you attempt another tent or the Big Top in any order. You start at the gate of the grounds viewed from an elevated angle and you attempt to make your way to the first tent or Big Top but there are people who walk in the direction you move and if you touch a person then you start back at the gate wasting valuable seconds.

meta.name: Circus Attractions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The famous Circus Morelli offers five exciting events: trampolining, tightrope-walking, juggling, knife-throwing and jumping clowns. You control the artists during their sometimes dangerous stunts. Each attraction can be practiced on its own before all five have to be performed in order in the main performance of the evening.

meta.name: Circus Charlie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.15 KB

¿Eres el payaso capaz de enfrentarse a actos circenses extremos? ¡Acércate! ¡Sube! Observa cómo el increíble payaso Charlie realiza acrobacias mortales para tu diversión. Saltar a través de aros en llamas a lomos de un león, esquivar monos salvajes en la cuerda floja, caminar sobre globos, montar en un campo de camas elásticas suspendidas, balancearse de cuerda en cuerda por encima del suelo... ¡no hay reto lo suficientemente loco para Charlie! Guía a Charlie y ayúdale a llegar al final de cada etapa, ¡y acumula puntos por el camino! ¡Un movimiento en falso y adiós Charlie! Si te equivocas demasiadas veces, Charlie será despedido.

meta.name: Circus Circus

You are Sid Chip and you are trapped in The Great Allonso's nightmare consisting of 20 circus rings full of platforms and creatures with the screen scrolling left or right when you move. You have to find the exit of each ring by using the various platforms and avoid the creatures that inhabit the nightmare. The various platforms consist of different shapes as well as disappearing and appearing ones and the exit has to be found before your energy counts down to zero. If you touch any creature then you lose one of five lives and the current ring has to be restarted. There is an extra life awarded for every five rings completed and the joystick is used to control Sid.

Circus Games te convierte en la estrella del circo. Adiestramiento de tigres, trapecio, funambulismo y equitación: todos los trucos clásicos del circo requerirán la máxima concentración para satisfacer al público. Antes de embarcarte en una gira internacional, podrás entrenarte en los cuatro eventos para perfeccionar tus trucos.

En este juego de carreras, los jugadores conducen coches de policía en lugar de los habituales coches conducidos por locos de la velocidad (como en la serie Crazy Cars). Viola la ley en lugar de hacerla cumplir mientras corres por las calles de San Francisco. Recorre el puente Golden Gate, China Town y Twin Peaks, y evita colisionar con tranvías, otros coches (conducidos por molestos ciudadanos), edificios y controles, ¡todo ello mientras intentas llegar al siguiente punto de control antes de que se agote el tiempo! Utiliza el claxon para alertar de tu presencia a los demás usuarios de la carretera.

meta.name: Citadel

Citadel is a comparatively slow-paced shooter that emphasizes planning and careful movement over fast reflexes.
On a planet that was thought to be uninhabited, an underground city complex has been discovered. The player's task is to explore this city with a remote-controlled hoverdrone, called Monitor, while trying to avoid its automatic defense systems.
Monitor is controlled from a top-down perspective and can only be moved into four directions, holding down the fire-button enables it to shoot in eight directions. There are various stationary and moving enemies that activate when Monitor gets close enough and start shooting when it moves. Some can shoot in four, others in eight directions, while others only try to ram the monitor or attack with homing shots.

meta.name: The Citadel of Chaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are a lone adventurer, trekking to the grim fort atop Craggen Rock in hopes to save the peaceful Vale of the Willow below by infiltrating the chaotic legions of the Black Tower and defeating their leader, the warlock Balthus Dire. You will rely on your spellbook, your blade, and your wits to navigate the labyrinthine corridors there and evade or escape from those of its denizens you can't easily dispatch. The Vale is depending on you! A very by-the-book adaptation of Steve Jackson's Fighting Fantasy gamebook #2, published the previous year, this computer game version dishes up its Choose-Your-Own-Adventure illustrated multiple-choice plot paths courtesy of pages of narrative text displaying down an endless scroll and automates the random RPG elements of generating and managing your character's statistics, inventory and performance in combat, ordinarily determined through die rolls.

meta.name: Citadel of Corruption
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.72 KB

You are on a hilltop to the south of the Citadel, which looms out of the darkness like an immense shadowy spectre, You can walk around the walls or inspect the raised drawbridge or the moat. How will you proceed? Released as part of the "GEMS" game pack.

meta.name: The Citadel of Yah-Mon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.60 KB

You start, alone on a small boat when the island of Yah-Mon breaks the surface under you. In the confusion your small boat is lost and you are stranded on this island. Search for and survive the Citadel of Yah-Mon, man and defeat the sorcerer within, then escape the island safely. A text adventure written in AdventureWriter/Quill.

meta.name: City Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.59 KB

In City Fighter, a simple crosshair-shoot-em-up, you have to protect the city of London against an alien invasion. The alien attackers are on their way to destroy your underground nuclear reactor. To avoid this, you have to steer a powerful cannon from right to left, trying to blast away waves of attackers. The attackers will drop bombs on you. In each wave an alien starship mounted with an aggressive missile waits for you. Avoid the bombs and missiles and don't let the attackers reach the ground of the city. Once they reach the ground they will destroy your underground reactor: Your game will be over - the city of London will be history...

meta.name: City Survivor
meta.desc:

City Survivor is an arcade game for the Commodore 64 released in 1988 by Grandslam Entertainment. In this game, the player controls a character through a city environment, avoiding various obstacles and enemies in order to survive. The game is characterized by its challenging levels and the need for quick reflexes. It was cracked by the group Bros and released on August 12, 1988. More information and downloads are available on the Lemon64 website.

meta.name: Cityattak!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.28 KB

In Cityattak!, you command the defense of a major city under siege by alien forces. Piloting a spaceship, you face three waves of assault: airstrikes, ground forces, and a giant swirling neutron ball. The final threat rolls toward mission control and can only be destroyed by bombing its core from the air. If it reaches the left side or you're hit, you lose one of three lives. Destroy all enemies to move on to the next level and face a stronger attack.

meta.name: CJ in the USA
meta.desc:

The follow-up to CJ's Elephant Antics, in which we find that The Hunter has kidnapped CJ's brothers and sisters and trapped them at various points around the USA. Needless to say, young CJ sets off to rescue them.
The game is a standard platform title, in which you can shoot peanuts at your enemies, or use bombs you collect.
You start with 9 lives, which sounds generous, but the levels are full of spikes and bad guys which can come to get you at any point. The enemies include policemen, Indians, dogs and burly American footballers (quite a stereotypical view of Americans there). Each level has a guardian at the end.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: CJ's Elephant Antics
