CJ's Elephant Antics sigue al bebé elefante CJ en su huida de su cautiverio a África, a través de cinco niveles intrincados llenos de enemigos, trampas y saltos desafiantes. Armado con cacahuetes ilimitados como munición y algunas bombas (se pueden recolectar más), te enfrentarás al peligro a cada paso. Las muertes súbitas son comunes, por lo que memorizar la distribución de los niveles es clave. En el modo para dos jugadores, la pantalla sigue al jugador principal: si te quedas atrás, pierdes una vida.

meta.name: Classic Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.09 KB

Classic Adventure was originally released as Adventure 1 by Abersoft in 1982 on the ZX Spectrum. It was later re-named Classic Adventure and published by Melbourne House on multiple platforms. This game is very true to the original, it starts with the classic opening: 'You are standing at the end of a road before a small brick building. Around you is a forest. A small stream flows out of the building and down a gully'. From this point the player can enter the building and commence exploring the cave system, reputedly modeled on Kentucky's Mammoth Caves complex. In the caves are some unsavoury characters, magic items and treasures to be collected and transported back to the well house. True to the original game, this version supports magic words such as 'Xyzy' and 'Plurgh' which will teleport the player between certain rooms. The game keeps a score which increases as the treasures are brought back to the well house.

meta.name: Classic Concentration
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Classic Concentration puts you in a mental duel – against a human or computer opponent – where your memory is the ultimate weapon. The goal is to match pairs of tiles, each hiding prize names like “Camera” or “Mexico.” Each correct match reveals part of a hidden rebus puzzle underneath. Piece by piece, the image becomes clearer – until you can guess the full answer and win. Concentration isn't just the name – it's your ticket to victory.

Classic Punter offers you the chance to make a fortune and become rich by betting on horses in a racing meeting, where you can choose the number of races between 1 and 50. One or two players can play and bet. The goal of a single player is to win £1,000,000 and in a two player game the goal is to beat the other player. At the start of the game you are presented with your first race with a selection of horses and their odds. You can choose a winning bet or a prediction bet. A win bet allows you to bet on the winner, while a prediction bet allows you to bet on the horses in first and second place.

Classic Trainer allows you to own five horses and train them over several seasons with the aim of winning the Derby at the end of the season. Each season lasts 20 weeks and you can choose from three races each week if you want to enter a horse. The game starts with a bankroll of £5000. Before each race day you have paid options available to you such as training, injury treatment, taking out loans and retaining a jockey. Once you have made your selection you will be given information on your horses' fitness, class and racing statistics, with the option to sell one.
meta.genre: Deportes con animales / Carreras de caballos

In Claws of Despair you set out as the son of a noble house on a quest to recover the legendary Staff of Sarfrin in order to save your kingdom. Equipped only with the Star of Thorgrim, which protects you from the staff's power, you explore a fantasy world filled with puzzles and encounters. Using a text parser you enter commands that determine your actions throughout the adventure. Along the way you meet wizards, dragons and other dangers that stand in your path. Ultimately you must confront the villain who guards the staff you seek.

meta.name: Clean Up Service
meta.desc:

In Clean Up Service, the crazy cowboy cleaners Otto and Bobban return to rid the Addle Hotel of mutant trash. Across eight platform levels, you dash through large hotel sections, collecting items like brooms, trash can lids, and stun guns while avoiding hostile garbage piles. Every hit costs a life, so quick reflexes are essential. The final destination is the enchanted attic, and in two-player mode both players clean up together on screen.

meta.name: Clean Up Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.93 KB

In Clean Up Time, cowboy cleaners Otto and Bobban must tidy up a vandalized hotel before staff and guests arrive. Across eight platform levels, you collect scattered paper while using stairs and poles, dodging or shooting enemies. With a timer ticking, limited lives, and only three smart bombs per level, each floor becomes a frantic race. Collecting a bucket grants bonus points – and in two-player mode, both players clean up simultaneously on screen.

meta.name: Clear-Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.07 KB

Clear-Out challenges you to remove every block on the board by touching each one exactly once. You plan routes carefully, move step by step across the structure, and avoid dead ends that would prevent completion. As layouts grow more complex, foresight and awareness become essential since a wrong path can force a restart. The simple rule creates a clever puzzle experience that rewards logic, planning, and spatial thinking.

meta.name: Clemen's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.58 KB

„Clemens' Revenge“ is a text-based adventure game in which the player takes on the role of Clemens' friend. After telling that his shop has been ransacked and he suspects a man named Salvius, he asks the player to kill him. Clemens hands over a key, a bottle of rum, a sword, and money before the adventure begins. A unique feature is that the player must remember which items they have, as there is no way to check this later in the game.

Clever and Smart te pone al mando de dos agentes únicos —torpes, caóticos, pero inquebrantables— en su misión por dar con las pistas del genial y desquiciado Dr. Bacteria. Los fans del cómic los reconocerán al instante: son Mortadelo y Filemón, aunque aquí viajan bajo sus nombres internacionales. Con su habitual combinación de ingenio (poco), suerte (menos) y explosiones (muchas), deberás investigar, resolver puzles y sortear desastres autoinfligidos. Porque, como siempre, salvar el mundo no será fácil… pero al menos será muy divertido. Una aventura fiel al espíritu del humor absurdo y visual de la serie original.

meta.name: Clever Clogs : Party Time
meta.desc:

Clever Clogs: Party Time offers six different games that playfully introduce letters, numbers, and simple tasks. With help from Mom and Dad, children can blow out candles on a cake, sing along to songs, or even draw on the screen. The games feature adjustable difficulty levels, encouraging the development of new skills as well as an early familiarity with computers.

meta.name: Cliff Hanger
meta.desc:

Cliff Hanger puts you in the role of a determined pursuer hunting down a notorious outlaw. Instead of direct combat, you rely on a variety of inventive tools to set traps and trigger over-the-top chain reactions. The experience plays out like interactive slapstick, where timing and observation matter more than raw speed. Its charm comes from the humorous presentation and the sense of reenacting a cartoon-style chase step by step.

meta.name: Clik Clak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This top-down puzzle game starts with a screen featuring a number of red cogs at different parts of the screen, and a grid of pegs (which become less complete on later levels). Your task on each level is to use a number of gears of one of 3 different sizes to ensure that all the cogs are linked together. All this has to be completed before the engine overheats. Making life harder are two creatures with the peculiar name "Poffins". One of these goes around removing pegs, and the other causes the engine to overheat further. They can be shot out of the way, or have gears placed over them to stop them. There's also a bonus round, which is a fruit machine, only with cogs and other things from the game rather than fruit.

meta.name: Clone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Clone" challenges you to replicate the pattern displayed on the right side. How the stones change when clicked is shown in the center. It requires clever problem-solving as the clock relentlessly ticks down. A tricky but fun challenge!

meta.name: The Clone Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.44 KB

The Clone Wars is a game about power, wealth, and influence in a war that captivated an entire galaxy. The story is set in the year 3714 AD, as local politicians wage war to become the sole rulers of the Clone Sector. Players control warships, cruisers, battleships, freighters, and troop carriers, mobilize the population, influence governors, and maintain morale. Simultaneously, they must manage the economy, collect taxes, train troops, fend off guerrillas, and advance technology. Strategic thinking is essential to sustain industry, protect resources, and maintain ship production to achieve their plans.

Waves of alien ships descend rapidly, while a large mothership moves horizontally across the top and shoots back. Only quick reflexes and precise timing will help you survive the alien onslaught.

Cloud Kingdoms sends you on a quest with Terry across 32 floating realms after Baron von Bansai scatters his precious crystals. Viewed from above, you explore intricate worlds, collect keys to unlock new areas and leap over hostile balls and bugs. Instead of traditional lives, a strict overall time limit governs your progress – every mistake returns you to the start of the level and drains precious seconds. Completing a stage rewards you with extra time – a fast-paced adventure where precision and smart routing are essential.

meta.name: Clowns
meta.desc:

The Clowns game was released as a cartridge and is only controlled via paddles in joystick port 1. However, there is also a disk version that can be played using a joystick. The game is about using a bobbing springboard to spin two clowns upwards through the air, thereby collecting colorful balloons. The balloons you collect earn you points. The jumping clown must land exactly on the free area of the board, otherwise he will fall. After three crashes the game is over. There are two platforms each on the right and left. The jumping clown also starts there. Strictly speaking, the gameplay is taken from the game Breakout, except that instead of a ball, two clowns jump across the screen.

meta.name: Club Backgammon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Club Backgammon is a digital version of the board game that can be played by two human players or one player against three difficulty levels of AI. It is also possible to observe a game between two AI players. The game follows the classic rules and is controlled with a cursor to move the pieces and roll the dice. There are customization options, such as changing the colors of the board, pieces, and dice, as well as adjusting the speed. The manual dice roll can be activated to enter custom dice results. An evaluation shows the remaining points, the blots, and the opponent's number of moves. A practice menu allows for customization of the game board. It is also possible to switch sides and take control of the AI opponent's pieces.

meta.name: Clubhouse Sports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Clubhouse Sports brings together a range of classic recreational games, letting you switch between different challenges. You compete in sporty activities, test your skill across multiple pinball styles, aim carefully in billiards, and tackle other timing-based tasks. Each simulation highlights a different style of play, encouraging variety and experimentation. Whether solo or against a friend, the collection delivers relaxed competition where reactions, timing, and precise control shape the outcome.

Mr. Boddy was murdered in his manor by one of his guests. You have to solve the mystery of murder: find killer, weapon and place of murder. Computer shuffles 30 cards, holds the murder cards and deals other cards to the players. Objective of game is to move around the manor, enter possible murder places, gather information of other player's cards, make suggestions and deduce the murder cards by a process of elimination. Number of moves is defined by thrown dice. When you are sure that you have deduced the correct solution to the murder, you must make an accusation to win the game.
3 levels of computer intelligence and difficulty for you. Multiplayer is up to 10 players sitting near one computer.

meta.name: Cluedo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.01 KB

Cluedo is a version of the popular board game known as Clue in the USA.
The game is a detective/puzzle game for one to six players, however in a single player game the computer plays five of them. The goal is to find out who Dr. Black killed, where he was killed and what the murder weapon was. This is achieved through an elimination process. Each player has three clue cards. If all of this has been taken into account, the solution remains unconsidered. Players can learn what other cards other players have by making suggestions. The rules of the game stipulate that the opposing players are asked in turn whether they have any of the suggested items, and if so, a card must be revealed.
This computer game is very much based on the board game and starts with rolling a high number to see whose turn it is first.

En Clystron controlas a un cíborg con aspecto de caminante en su misión de encontrar ocho piezas de máquina. Las piezas deben recolectarse en el orden correcto. Al encontrar una pieza, se desbloquea un nuevo destino de transporte. Todas las piezas deben encontrarse en un tiempo límite de 15 minutos para completar el juego.

meta.name: Co & Co
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Co & Co takes you into a cooperative adventure where teamwork matters more than rushing ahead alone. Two characters must work together to navigate a labyrinthine world, overcome obstacles, and coordinate their movements to progress as efficiently as possible. The quest to recover the separated pieces of a legendary sword provides a mythical backdrop, while the true appeal lies in shared problem-solving. Only through coordination and mutual support can the challenges be overcome and the final goal be reached.

meta.name: Co-Axis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.56 KB

Co-axis delivers a fast-paced experience where you pilot a spaceship through a constantly scrolling environment while taking on relentless waves of enemies. Precise maneuvering and smart timing are essential to avoid attacks and eliminate hostile formations efficiently. As you progress, the challenge increases noticeably, with rising speed and a steadily growing number of foes. The appeal comes from the combination of quick reactions, tactical choices, and the constant pressure to push forward.

meta.name: Coalminer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

There is a real treasure buried beneath the earth's crust and you have decided to recover it. Unfortunately, the undertaking is not that easy, as not only does a lot of digging have to be done, but there are also many infernal creatures that have been used to protect the precious thing and that you have to be careful of. The only way to destroy them is to drop some boulders on them, to achieve this you have to remove the earth from underneath them: but be careful, because it can be a double-edged sword.

meta.name: Stallone Cobra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cobra te pone en la piel de un policía de los duros, luchando sin cuartel en tres niveles laterales: ciudad, zona rural y fábrica. Oleadas de criminales te atacan con cuchillos, hachas, granadas y armas de fuego. Al principio estás desarmado —solo tus puños te defienden—, pero pronto puedes recoger cuchillos, pistolas, ametralladoras o granadas… siempre con munición limitada. ¿Herido? Una hamburguesa te devuelve la energía. ¡Pero cuidado!: no todos los que ves son enemigos. Disparar a civiles inocentes te cuesta una vida al instante. Además, en los niveles 1 y 3, debes encontrar a Ingrid, una modelo, y escoltarla sana y salva hasta la salida… mientras los villanos no paran de llegar. Equilibrar combate, protección y precisión es clave. Porque salvar el día no basta: hay que hacerlo sin dejar víctimas colaterales. Acción intensa, moral en juego y adrenalina al límite.

meta.name: Cobra Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.04 KB

Cobra Force te sitúa en la cabina del helicóptero de ataque AH-1W Super Cobra, con una misión crítica: defender tu país de una invasión. No basta con disparar a lo loco: las bases enemigas solo pueden ser destruidas por un bombardero B-2… pero antes, tú debes abrirle camino. Mientras la pantalla se desplaza lateralmente a tu ritmo, debes eliminar todas las defensas: lanzamisiles, torretas y fortificaciones. Cada disparo cuenta, cada maniobra evita una andanada. Solo cuando el cielo esté despejado, el B-2 entra en escena con su ataque demoledor. Tensión constante, coordinación precisa y una sensación de poderosa responsabilidad: no eres solo el ataque… eres la vanguardia.

meta.name: Cobra Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cobra Mission is a horizontally scrolling shooter. In Cobra Mission, players pilot a helicopter through enemy terrain, rescuing civilians while combating various adversaries. The game draws inspiration from classic titles like Scramble, offering a blend of action and rescue missions.

meta.name: Cobra Mission II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.04 KB

"Cobra Mission II" is a horizontally scrolling shooter. In "Cobra Mission," players pilot a helicopter through enemy terrain, rescuing civilians while combating various adversaries. The game draws inspiration from classic titles like "Scramble," offering a blend of action and rescue missions.
meta.developer: C. Yates, J. Wells & R. Bayliss

meta.name: Cobra Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.35 KB

"Cobra Rescue" is a side-scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. In this game, players navigate through various levels, combating enemies and rescuing hostages. The gameplay involves maneuvering a helicopter, avoiding obstacles, and engaging in combat to complete missions.

meta.name: COC : Construction of Confusion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.53 KB

In COC: Construction of Confusion, you pilot a ship through side-scrolling cave systems packed with deadly hazards, reminiscent of Scramble and Super Cobra. A hacked version of Cave of Death, the game sends you on a secret mission to planet Acorn, whose surface is cloaked in poisonous gas. Beneath it lie valuable minerals – and hostages needing rescue. But the planet's defenses have been turned against you by enemy forces. Only precise flying and fast reflexes will lead you to the rescue base.

meta.name: Coco
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.43 KB

Coco is an educational game that introduces you to the world of computer technology in a playful way. It covers basics such as memory, addressing, registers, loops, and more through quizzes, tasks, and simple exercises. The goal is to make both computer jargon and the first steps in BASIC and problem-solving strategies easy to understand. With its accessible design, it's suitable for players young and old, offering a fun entry point into computer thinking and practice.

meta.name: Coco 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Coco II is a customizable shoot 'em up that gives you surprising creative freedom. At its core, it's a simple one-on-one shooter, but the highlight is the built-in editor: you can design the sprites for both player and enemy, as well as the backgrounds. Even scoring and game parameters can be adjusted. The result is a mix of game and creation tool, letting you not only play but also build your own small shooter experience.

meta.name: Coco-Notes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.51 KB

A musical game with four modes:
1. Catch a Coco-Note - Pick notes out of a pool with your fishing pool. Once you've picked enough you can hear the band play the melody you've picked out.
2. Composin' Coco-Notes - Same game as the first, except now played with an accompaniment.
3. Beat The Clam - Race against a clam trying to claim notes from the pool and get a high score while finishing the song. Collect bonus notes for extra score and avoid the clam as he'll eat your fishing line as well.
4. Beat The Clam -- Challenge - Same game as above except the clam is much faster.

meta.name: Coconuts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.79 KB

In Coconuts, you control a monkey sitting in a coconut tree. Your task is to collect coconuts and throw them at the opposing monkey to knock him out of his tree. At the same time, you must avoid flying birds and falling coconuts, as every hit poses a danger to you.

meta.name: CODE Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.55 KB

CODE Hunter places you in a desperate mission where you guide a droid through the interior of an enemy battleship to disable its defense systems. Within compact yet tactically demanding screen layouts, you carefully place bombs to eliminate patrolling guards while your energy steadily drains away. Every mistake costs precious time or a life, as progress is only possible when all enemies are removed in time to transmit another piece of the code. The appeal lies in forward planning, smart use of special platforms, and the constant race against the clock that keeps each level tense.

meta.name: Codebreaker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.54 KB

Rid the city of gate magic by recoloring citizens' houses! To do this, generate the necessary code on your color or number sequence through successive crashes. With every crash, the colors and numbers involved change. Move your train through horizontal joystick action. Fire while moving to increase speed. The senior version allows you to change rails at hidden intersections using vertical joystick action while driving. Push the bar while your turn is at rest and your colors or numbers will roll to the left. Fire without joystick action to reverse the order of colors or numbers.

meta.name: Codeword Arguseye in Secret Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Codeword Arguseye in Secret Mission" is a classic text adventure where players input verb-subject commands to progress the story. A thrilling espionage narrative unfolds as puzzles are solved and clues are uncovered. High-resolution color graphics load during gameplay, enhancing the atmosphere. Inputs must be precise, including hyphens for certain terms. The revised version fixes earlier issues, such as an unsolvable scenario and a crash when bribing a guard.

meta.name: Cohen's Towers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.27 KB

Cohen's Towers puts you in the role of Allen, the nephew of the big boss of a powerful corporation. Working a summer job as a mail boy, your task is to collect all the packages in each tower and deliver them one by one to the mailboxes. But beware: the boss' dog Fear, the spy Bobby, and falling flower pots are out to stop you. Kissing the secretary gives you bonus points. Each time you fail, you receive a demerit – and after four demerits, it's game over. Your goal is to deliver all the mail while racking up as many points as possible.

meta.name: Coil Cop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.42 KB

Un ordenador, única secuela de la anterior aventura de Thing, ha interferido la producción de una fábrica de juguetes para que algunos de ellos se conviertan en instrumentos de maldad, cuya peligrosidad es bastante alta. Thing debe encontrar la manera de parar dicha producción y devolver la tranquilidad a esta factoría. Para ello, deberá interrumpir el programa del ordenador y colocar otro en su lugar. Ese se encuentra diseminado en forma de diskette, cassette, memoria ROM y listado, elementos que reunidos harán que el ordenador vuelvas funcionar correctamente. Pero la misión no es fácil, ya que una cantidad nada despreciable de juguetes malévolos van a impedir esta misión a nuestro curioso Thing, mitad muelle, mitad muñeco. Algunos de ellos podrán ser eliminados con facilidad saltando sobre determinados elementos de la fábrica que soltarán el objeto justo sobre ellos. Otros será mejor evitarlos por si acaso.

meta.name: Coins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Coins is a puzzle game where the player must collect coins and solve various spatial challenges. The goal is to position the coins correctly while avoiding obstacles and progressing through increasingly difficult levels. The game requires both speed and planning, as players must overcome obstacles and puzzle mechanisms to reach the next level.

meta.name: Coldiarus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Coldiarus is a clone of the classic Minesweeper with colorful graphics. The rules of the game remain unchanged. The selected point shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The game allows you to set the number of mines from 10 to 50.

meta.name: Colee
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colee is a simple puzzle-solving game. The goal requires finding all the covered pairs of pictures on the board. Discovered pairs disappear from the board. There is a time limit, the counter on the right panel indicates how many moves were done.

meta.name: Collapsar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.45 KB

Collapsar is a horizontally scrolling shooter in the style of Uridium, set in the year 2050. Several space stations were built and maintained by the famous astronaut John Brendan and his crew over 40 years. But in 2026, John and his crew died due to a life-threatening conflict with extraterrestrial forces. These aliens now threaten the entire galaxy and plan to destroy all inhabited planets with a ray gun. NATSA recognizes the danger and the President of the USA orders the training of all employees for a crucial mission. Of the candidates, only five pass the test, and four of them are sent into space on a rescue mission. They land on planet X and must infiltrate the aliens guarding it. Armed with a pulsar beamer, the task is to eliminate the aliens and free other space stations using galaxy warps.

meta.name: Collapse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.94 KB

Collapse is a simple puzzle game where players control Zen the Mole who is presented with a network of sticks that he must turn blue. Zen does this by simply walking over them while he is yellow. To get to the network, he must turn himself red so that he can build bridges that lead to it. Zen's redness disappears after a few seconds and he turns back to his default state. Once Zen has managed to turn the sticks blue, he can unleash the Rotox, a white line that moves around adjacent blue sticks, destroying them once the Rotox makes contact. When all the sticks have been destroyed, Zen proceeds to the next screen.

meta.name: Collision
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.24 KB

Collision is a fast-paced lightcycle duel inspired by Tron, where your vehicle leaves a glowing trail behind. The goal is to outmaneuver your opponent, forcing them to crash into a wall or your trail while avoiding collisions yourself. Reflexes, awareness, and timing are key to survival, as the clean colors and minimalist design perfectly capture the tension of a futuristic showdown.

meta.name: Colonial Conquest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colonial Conquest is a grand strategy game set during the late 1800's and early 1900's that puts you in charge of one of the six Imperialistic powers of the time (Great Britain, France, Germany, U.S., Russia and Japan). Using diplomacy, espionage, armies and fleets, these six countries vie for control of more than 120 minor countries and each other. Your goal in the game is to conquer as many minor nations as possible and set yourself up as the mightiest ruler on Earth. There are three scenarios, and up to six people can play each as a separate nation - or the computer can take charge of all the other nations.

meta.name: Colonial Trader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colonial Trader is an adventure game for the Commodore 64. The game combines elements of shoot'em up and economic simulation, similar to the concept of Elite. The plot begins with the inheritance of the player's father, who leaves him colony credits. With this starting capital, the player purchases an older all-round glider and begins his career as a trader between different colonies. The aim is to upgrade the glider through trade and skillful navigation in space and to become a successful trader. The graphic representation alternates between a top view in space, reminiscent of Asteroids, and static menus in the space stations. The game is accompanied musically by title music and menu sounds, while only isolated sound effects can be heard in the game itself.

meta.name: Colony
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.12 KB

In Colony you play as a service droid tasked with ensuring the survival of a distant human outpost. While you plant crops, harvest resources, and manage power, giant insects like ants and ladybugs attack your base, trying to destroy your food supply. You'll need to plan efficiently, place fences and traps, and keep your weapon charged to repel them. Balancing defense, energy, and production becomes a tense challenge – only strategic thinking and quick action will keep the colony alive.

meta.name: Color Buster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A puzzle strategy game in it, you have to match all the boxes of the same color and, when stacked correctly, move them from the starting point to the new level/location. You can only push stacked individual colors together. Be careful where you push the stacks and boxes so you don't cut yourself off.

meta.name: Color Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.21 KB

Color Mania is a computer adaptation of the codebreaker board game. The objective of the game is to guess a combination of five tokens within ten trials. After each trial computer shows how many tokens were indicated right (white X) and how many appears in combination, but in a different position (grey X).

meta.name: Color Mind
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.09 KB

„Color Mind“ is a puzzle game for the Commodore 64. The game is a digital adaptation of the classic code-breaking game „Mastermind“, where players aim to deduce a hidden color sequence through logical reasoning and deduction. Each attempt provides feedback, guiding the player toward the correct combination.

meta.name: Colora
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.93 KB

Colora is a puzzle game in which you have to recolor colorful blocks with a ball according to a certain pattern (the color changing scheme is shown at the top right) by simply rolling over them. The goal is to have all the cuboids show the same colors at the end.nnnnSounds easy? Try it!

meta.name: Colossal Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colossal Adventure takes its cue from the very earliest mainframe text adventures. Our hero must rescue the elves and find fifteen pieces of treasure. There are many dark areas, so lights and batteries are at a premium. Be careful of vicious dwarves, who can be killed using axes. You can carry up to four objects at a time; the useful ones include a newspaper, keys and sandwiches. The vocabulary includes saying spell names, DROPping items to stay within the carrying limit (and for other specific reasons), CATCHing a bird, and standard directions plus IN and OUT.

meta.name: Colossal Cave Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colossal Cave Adventure is a faithful adaptation written in BASIC of the original Colossal Cave classic text adventure by Crowther and Woods. The objective is to explore the titular cave and gather as much treasure as possible in order to get the highest score possible.

meta.name: Colossus Bridge 4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colossus Bridge 4 is a bridge game for a single player (computer playing the other 3 hands; demo mode available). The game uses the Acol bidding system and Blackwood, Stayman, and Baron conventions; also supported are take-out doubles and the strong 2 club. Other features include hand input, save/load, rebid/replay, backstep, card autoplay/recommendation and cheat option.

meta.name: Colossus Chess 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.17 KB

Colossus Chess 2∙0 is a computer program that allows you to play the computer at a game of chess. The rules of chess are followed and includes the moves 'Castling' and 'En-passent'. As well as a normal game there are various options that can be chosen to further enhance the experience of the program. You can play as either white or black as well as just allow the computer to play itself. The whole board is shown on the screen viewed from above but there is another screen that shows you all the moves that have been played as well as various stats on how the computer is thinking. The board can be set up to allow you to place the pieces in various places as well as play various check positions to solve. A tournament mode can be set up by adjusting the time allowed for each move to be played.

meta.name: Colossus Chess 4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Colossus Chess 4 is one of the most comprehensive chess programs available for home computers, created with modern programming techniques by an experienced chess programmer. It fully understands all official chess rules, including underpromotions, the fifty-move rule, and draws by repetition, and it can handle even difficult mating scenarios such as king, bishop, and knight versus king. In addition to the classic 2D view, it offers a realistic 3D board that can optionally be controlled with a joystick, making play clear and user-friendly. With its wide range of features, the program appeals both to casual players and to chess enthusiasts seeking the highest level of precision and depth.

meta.name: Colossus Mah Jong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.39 KB

This game is an adaption of the Chinese board game Mahjong. The basic playing principle (the game uses the official British rule set): the basic pool consists of 144 playing stones with different motives. Every player receives 14 out of them. With every turn, players remove one of the stones and other players can take them (but only if they can use it to shape certain patters with the stones already in their possession). The winning condition is to create the "Mah Jong" stone combination.

meta.name: The Colour of Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 122.45 KB

The Colour of Magic is an interactive adventure set in Terry Pratchett's Discworld, a flat world resting on the backs of four elephants, which in turn stand on the Great A'Tuin, a giant turtle. The directions are adapted to this unique world: Hubwards, Rimwards, Widdershins, and Turnwise. The player takes on the role of Rincewind, a wizard with an extraordinary survival instinct, who is less concerned with where he's running to than with what he's running from. Based on the book of the same name, he encounters characters like the tourist Twoflower, the Luggage, and Death, while exploring Ankh-Morpork and other parts of the Discworld.

meta.name: Colouration
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.16 KB

Do you dream in color? Be warned you might not be able to escape this dream even in your sleep! A deceptively simple game, all you have to do is match the block which appears at the bottom left of the screen to an area in the main grid above. Move the white marker around and press fire when you are in the right place. In each round you have to locate ten blocks within a certain time limit. If you choose a place that is the wrong color one of the squares on the block is blanked out, so don't guess too much. In two player mode it is a battle to see which of you finds all your blocks first.

meta.name: Coloured
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.26 KB

“Coloured” is a strategic puzzle and thinking game for the Commodore 64. In “Coloured”, players must arrange colored blocks on a grid in such a way that certain patterns or combinations are created. The game requires strategic thinking and planning, as the blocks can only be moved in a limited number of moves. As you progress, the complexity and difficulty of the puzzles increase, making the game challenging for both beginners and experienced players. The graphic design of “Coloured” is attractively implemented for the technical capabilities of the Commodore 64. The colorful representation of the blocks and the clear design of the playing field make orientation easier and contribute to the gaming atmosphere. The gameplay is accompanied by a suitable soundtrack that promotes concentration and rounds off the gaming experience.

meta.name: Coltfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.87 KB

Coltfire is a single-player action-shooter for the Commodore 64. In this game, you take on the role of a gunslinger, fighting through the main street of a western town, battling fearsome desperadoes. With its classic shoot-'em-up mechanics, the game challenges your speed and accuracy as you take down enemies in a dangerous, high-stakes environment.

meta.name: Combat Approach
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combat Approach throws you into a deadly game of cat and mouse with homing missiles relentlessly chasing your craft. Your goal is to dodge their attacks and trick them into colliding with each other to survive. You can shut down your ship to throw them off your trail, but must avoid crashing in the process. Every second counts as the tension builds, and a single mistake could mean certain death.

meta.name: Combat Course
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ponte las botas, soldado, y prepárate para cinco niveles de acción desafiante en este simulador de campo de entrenamiento. A medida que avances por los niveles, recibirás puntos por hacer lo correcto y perderás puntos por cualquier paso en falso. Puedes grabar tus intentos y revisarlos, para detectar tus errores y aprender de ellos.
El primer nivel es el recorrido físico, que requiere saltar muros, saltar trincheras y arrastrarse bajo alambre de espino. El segundo nivel es el curso "Riesgo". En esta tendrás que plantar dinamita y lanzar granadas.
En el nivel tres, el jugador tendrá que luchar cuerpo a cuerpo en el campo de combate. El cuarto nivel combina los tres anteriores en uno y, por último, el quinto nivel es un recorrido "Cobra" personalizado que lanza al jugador elementos aleatorios de todos los recorridos.

meta.name: Combat Crazy : Warbringer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Combat Crazy: Warbringer“ puts the player on a dangerous mission to eliminate Warbringer, the leader of the enemy army. The journey leads through a rainforest, a labyrinth, and a fortress, with the screen scrolling in multiple directions. Enemies are fought using a rifle or grenades, while hazards like spikes, water, and lava cause instant death. Two H-Bomb parts must be found to blow open the exit. An energy meter depletes when hit, and large turrets must be destroyed or avoided. A special function sacrifices all enemies on the screen but costs one life. Three credits allow for a continuation after a game over.

meta.name: Combat Leader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.76 KB

Combat Leader is a tactical simulation of modern warfare between tank and mechanized infantry units, where you take command at the squad, platoon, or company level. Over 70 historically accurate tanks are available, rated for speed, armor, and firepower. You can approach missions strategically or dive into arcade-style action. The goal is to destroy enemy units and complete mission objectives to earn points. The level of victory depends on your score, and adjustable difficulty makes it suitable for both beginners and experienced players, with the computer controlling enemy forces.

meta.name: Combat Lynx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combat Lynx es un juego de simulación de combate de helicópteros bastante arcade.
La misión consiste en defender tus bases de los ataques enemigos de los alrededores. Para ello, tiene a su disposición toda una gama de armas: misiles autoguiados aire-aire, cañones y minas que lanzar. También hay que repostar.
Las misiones de combate darán paso ocasionalmente a misiones de asistencia para transportar al personal y repatriar a los heridos.
El mapa facilita la localización de los vehículos que se mezclan con el paisaje, así como la diferenciación de los vehículos aliados.
Varios niveles de dificultad mantienen el juego en marcha y te ayudan a olvidar algunos de los aspectos rutinarios de las misiones.

meta.name: Combat Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.84 KB

“Combat Zone” is a classic vertically scrolling arcade shoot-'em-up where you, Colonel Mentor, are pulled out of retirement to fight an alien threat. Armed with air-to-air blasters and bombs for ground targets, you blast your way through waves of enemies. Enemy supply ships can be destroyed for hyper bombs, which clear the entire screen when detonated. Fast-paced action, precise timing, and knowing when to unleash maximum firepower are key to victory.

meta.name: Combat Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combat Zone puts you in the role of Dack MacKenzie, a one-man army skilled in helicopters, tanks, and heavy explosives. In Operation Skylark, you must stop an enemy invasion on American soil. Piloting your combat chopper, you fly over dense urban terrain, dodging fire and blasting anything in your way. Your mission is to crush the waves of attackers before they advance. With a top-down view, fast-paced gameplay, and uncompromising action, this is classic arcade shooting fueled by patriotic bravado.

meta.name: Combat Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combat Zone is a 3-player tank game. It is controlled by 2 players with the joystick and a 3rd player using the keyboard. Each round they are set up to shoot down each other in the battlefield. Power-ups appear randomly for the players to collect and at the end of each round, bonus coins can be collected and used in the shop after each round. The upgrades bought between rounds benefit the player for the rest of the game. The last player surviving is the winner. If the game is played single player, there are target practice rounds instead of a real battlefield with tanks.

meta.name: Combat Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combat Zone is a clear knockoff of Xevious, offering vertical-scrolling shooter gameplay where you control a spaceship battling endless waves of airborne and ground enemies. You're equipped with a standard weapon for air targets and bombs for ground units, aimed using a targeting reticle. Enemies come in waves over a green pixelated landscape, and points are scored through destruction. The game includes a local two-player mode and high score tracking. Despite its simple design, it delivers straightforward arcade action focused on reflexes and precision.

meta.name: Combination
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The aim of the game is to remove all the colorful, movable stones from the playing field. To do this, identical stones must be pushed together horizontally. With the joystick in Port II, you control the flashing cursor, which you can point to the desired stones to move them. By pressing the joystick button and moving left or right at the same time, the stone under the cursor can be moved sideways, but vertical movement is not possible. In addition, gravity acts on the stones: stones with free space underneath fall down until they hit another stone. You can also move a stone if there are others above it. Stones only disappear when they are in a resting position. When there are only three stones of one type left, they must be cleverly arranged so that they touch each other and disappear at the same time. The player has three attempts and a limited time limit.

meta.name: Combination Deluxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A tile matching game for your brain, created by Helfried Peyrl and the rest of The Creators team and released in 2008 in Digital Talk #98. Match pairs of tiles together, matching and moving tiles will cause ones above them to fall, make sure you can match everything!

meta.name: Combots
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combots throws you into a post-apocalyptic 2005, where an alien invasion has isolated humanity and rendered its nuclear arsenal useless. Communications have collapsed, but the resistance fights back with makeshift war machines built from scrap and stolen alien tech. On a hex-based battlefield you plan each move, maneuvering your heavy robots across varied terrain to outplay enemy units. Turn by turn you make strategic decisions that determine victory or defeat as Earth wages a tactical machine war for survival.

meta.name: Combots
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Combots throws you into a post-apocalyptic 2005, where an alien invasion has isolated humanity and rendered its nuclear arsenal useless. Communications have collapsed, but the resistance fights back with makeshift war machines built from scrap and stolen alien tech. On a hex-based battlefield you plan each move, maneuvering your heavy robots across varied terrain to outplay enemy units. Turn by turn you make strategic decisions that determine victory or defeat as Earth wages a tactical machine war for survival.

meta.name: Comedy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.64 KB

“Comedy” is an early version of a game that would later be released under the title “Kings of Comedy.” This early iteration, while not yet featuring all planned elements, was fully playable and provided a glimpse into the foundation of the game that would be expanded upon for its release a year later.

meta.name: Comet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Comet" challenges the player to navigate a spaceship through space while avoiding incoming celestial objects. The ship remains at the bottom of the screen as obstacles approach at varying speeds. Any collision results in failure, requiring precise movements and quick reactions to reach the next sector and continue deeper into space.

meta.name: The Comet Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.11 KB

"The Comet Game" is based on the idea that Halley's Comet brings bacterial life capable of threatening Earth. The player takes control of a high-tech spaceship tasked with intercepting the comet and eliminating the threat. The mission involves managing multiple tasks at once: enemy missiles must be destroyed before they hit the ship, communication with Earth must be maintained by aligning the comms beam correctly, and the ship's computer system must be kept stable by adjusting a line of LEDs to match the displayed values. A rather unusual but vital task is ensuring the crew's morale – by brewing coffee and injecting it into the crew members, who are in suspended animation.

meta.name: Comic Bakery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.27 KB

Here we are in a completely automated bakery. But what's this??!! A bunch of tricky Racoon Dogs hanging around trying to sneak off with the bread! Can you get Joe the Baker to guard his bread from the rascally Racoon Dogs?

meta.name: The Comic Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.09 KB

"The Comic Game" is a single-screen platform game for the Commodore 64 in which the player takes control of a character named Donald. In the Netherlands, Courbois Software released the game under the title "The Duck Game". In "The Comic Game", the player navigates Donald through various screens, collecting items and avoiding obstacles and enemies. The game is characterized by its simple controls and appealing difficulty level, which is suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

meta.name: Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Commando, encarnas a Super Joe, un soldado solitario con una M60 y seis granadas, avanzando sin cuartel por territorio enemigo. Morteros estallan, balas silban y granadas caen mientras cruzas trincheras, acantilados y lagos. Los rebeldes surgen de cuevas, búnkeres y vehículos, decididos a detenerte. No hay retirada. Solo adelante. Recoge munición, reabastece granadas y abre camino entre oleadas de enemigos hasta alcanzar la fortaleza. Cada paso es un acto de resistencia; cada disparo, una promesa de que no te rendirás. ¿Tienes la destreza, la resistencia… y los nervios de acero para llegar hasta el final?

meta.name: Commando 86
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.13 KB

Commando 86 is the official sequel to the classic Commando, though it was released only on home computers. Instead of the traditional run-and-gun action, it plays more like Gauntlet, with maze-like levels packed with enemies, ammo pickups, and branching paths. Despite its title, Commando 86 feels quite different from the original – it's more strategic, slower-paced, and focused on tactical movement rather than pure trigger reflexes.

meta.name: Comp-u-taire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.70 KB

Comp-u-taire is a digital take on Solitaire, bringing the classic card game to life through PETSCII graphics. As in the original, you must stack cards in alternating colors and descending order, ultimately sorting them by suit onto the foundation piles. Its simple visuals hide a game of patience, focus, and strategic planning. A quiet, thoughtful challenge wrapped in nostalgic 8-bit charm.

meta.name: Company Director 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.73 KB

Company Director 64 puts you in charge of a fledgling software company. Starting with £10,000, your goal is simple – make a million through smart business choices. Decide how much to invest, which arcade conversions to develop, and how to manage your funds. Every decision affects your success – gamble too high and you'll go bankrupt, but play it smart and you'll build an empire. A humorous, text-driven management sim capturing the ups and downs of the 1980s gaming industry dream.

meta.name: Compare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.29 KB

In Compare, your goal is to replicate the pattern on the right side by cleverly placing numbered tiles on the left. Clicking a square places a 1 there and increments all adjacent tiles by one. The challenge lies in planning ahead to ensure every number ends up exactly where it should be. Logic, foresight, and patience are key to achieving the perfect match.

meta.name: Compare II : The New Levels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.34 KB

In Compare II: The New Levels, the goal is once again to replicate the number pattern on the right by strategically placing values on the left grid. Each placed tile increases the selected square and all adjacent ones by one. The best approach is to start with the highest numbers, as the puzzles become increasingly complex. Precision and logical planning are essential to overcome each challenge.

meta.name: Competition Shootout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.72 KB

Competition Shooutout is a target-shooting game designed as part of the Gamma Strike pack, which came with a physical light-gun target system. Up to four players compete, choosing the number of rounds before testing their reflexes and aim to score the most hits. Results are displayed in large digital counters, making every shot count. A unique concept for its time, blending arcade-style shooting with real physical interaction and turning living-room competition into a high-score showdown.

meta.name: The Complete Computer Fireworks Celebration Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Complete Computer Fireworks Celebration Kit" allows players to create firework shows, add music, and integrate special messages to turn these displays into digital greeting cards. The game is a product from the mid-1980s, a time when some computer game intros and scenes amazed audiences with firework effects. This fascination led some companies to attempt to develop these simulated firework displays into full-fledged software products. While these couldn't quite compete with the best music and visual effects of scene productions, the program still represents an entertaining curiosity.

meta.name: Complex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Complex is a labyrinth adventure that challenges your reflexes, sense of direction, and quick thinking. Each level introduces a new objective – from finding a key to open a locked door and blasting a walrus with your plasma gun to chasing free-floating notes through winding cave systems. Later stages add teleporters and one-way paths to complicate navigation. Once you've completed all tasks or collected all objects, your final goal is to find the exit – made a little easier with the help of the handy overview map.

meta.name: Complex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Complex is a classic text adventure casting you as Christopher Starr, an ordinary human caught in extraordinary circumstances. Your mission is to locate the jeweled Star of S'Jignh, find the alien, and prove through courage and wisdom that you are worthy to save the world from destruction. Richly written and atmospheric, the game challenges your logic and imagination – every command could lead you closer to the truth or deeper into peril.

meta.name: Complex (Terje Christiansen - Homebrew)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.95 KB

Complex is a sprawling cave adventure where you must navigate through 25 interconnected chambers to find the exit. Each cave poses unique challenges – some require agility, others demand finding and using specific items in the right way. The cave names often provide crucial hints for progress. Movement and puzzle-solving alternate as you fight to survive dangerous passages and uncover the correct route. Precision, patience, and attention to detail are key to mastering the mysteries of the complex.

meta.name: Compunet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.76 KB

An action game with puzzle elements (contains a Tetris variant) which was release on the following: Game On 1990/08, Game On GE 1992/2, Abo Disk #2
meta.developer: G. Magymathe, P. Varga, & G. Komar

meta.name: CompuQuiz : General Interest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

"CompuQuiz: General Interest" is a quiz game that challenges the player with questions from various topics. Using knowledge, speed, and strategic thinking, the goal is to find the correct answer and demonstrate general knowledge.

meta.name: CompuQuiz : Science
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"CompuQuiz - Science" is a quiz game that challenges the player with questions about science and nature. The goal is to demonstrate knowledge in fields such as physics, biology, chemistry, and the natural world by finding the correct answers.

meta.name: Computer Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.70 KB

In Computer Adventure, you embark on an unusual quest: to buy, connect, and successfully boot up a home computer – just like the first time you ever did it. You'll explore different rooms, collect objects like a phone, outlets, or a sugar bowl, and use a set of verbs like “Take,” “Connect,” or “Fix” to progress. The game mixes everyday tasks with adventure, offering a humorous take on the struggles of early computer ownership.

meta.name: Computer Ambush
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Computer Ambush puts you in command of a ten-man infantry squad in WWII France, serving as a Sergeant. Each soldier has a name, personal dossier, and unique combat ratings, which can also be customized. Battles unfold turn by turn in tactical detail, against either another player or the computer. Victory comes through eliminating the enemy or completing your mission. It's a complex and demanding simulation that can take up to three hours – strategy and smart commands are your key to survival.

meta.name: Computer Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Computer Baseball focuses less on fast action and more on the tactical and statistical side of baseball. Rather than simply carrying out individual plays, you take on the role of a manager who adjusts lineups, changes pitchers, judges base runners, and tries to give the team a decisive edge through smart decisions. The large selection of teams and the ability to enter or edit your own team data give the game a particularly appealing character for those who want not only to play baseball, but also to plan and manage it.

Computer Quarterback is a real time strategy simulation of NFL football. There are three ways this game can be played. In the semi pro version, there are 18 offensive plays and 14 defensive plays. In the pro version, there are 36 offensive plays and 24 defensive plays. In the computer version, you play against the computer team called The Robots and this version plays the same as the semi pro version. With this game you will have to name your own team and draft players with the money you start out with. There was an optional team disk you could order through the catalog that came with this game. The team disk has NFL teams you can choose from instead of creating your own.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's time to find a decent manager for your home team - you! As the name suggests, this is a home computer adaptation of Avalon Hill's ever-popular baseball board game Statis Pro Baseball. The players put on the manager's uniform, arrange lineups and call out the moves. Season-based statistical compilations of Major League Baseball players, team by team, are available at your fingertips. Historic teams and seasons are even available on expansion disks so you can manage Roger Maris or the 1919 Black Sox.

Computer-Wordsearch challenges you to locate words hidden within a dense grid of letters, demanding focus and sharp observation. Based on selected themes, you search for the correct terms in all directions while time or scoring adds extra pressure. The experience is calm yet demanding, driven by the satisfaction of pulling each word out of apparent chaos.

meta.name: CompuZzler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

CompuZzler brings classic crossword puzzles to the screen and turns them into a relaxed brain-teaser for anyone who enjoys finding words and testing their knowledge. Instead of paper, newspapers, and smudged ink, you get puzzles that are always ready and can be solved together. This creates enjoyable mental training – calm, accessible, and especially nice for sessions where several minds work together to find the right answer.

meta.name: Con-Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.57 KB

Con-quest is a fully animated, 3D icon-driven, graphical adventure game full of thrills and excitement! Save Oskar's soul from the terrible torture of going through the eternal fires of hell! Do you have the skills and courage to take on this challenge and save the day?

meta.name: Conan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Conan“ challenges you to swing your sword and prove your strength! In search of fame and fortune, you face dangerous creatures within the dark chambers of an ancient castle. Glowing fire monsters, fierce dragons, floating eyes, and electric demons stand in your way. But the enemies aren't your only threat – bubbling lava pits, treacherous trapdoors, and deceptive ledges demand your full skill. Scorpions, giant ants, and hungry bats lurk in the shadows, while deadly stars and speeding dragonflies threaten to take you down. Only your mighty sword can save you – if you still have the strength to wield it!

meta.name: Concentration
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.99 KB

Concentration challenges you to match pairs of cards by entering grid coordinates instead of clicking. Enter the vertical (number) and horizontal (letter) values to flip cards. If they match, you score a point; if not, the next player goes. The player with the most matches wins. In single-player mode, no score is saved. The card layout remains fixed, so memory skills are everything – especially in multiplayer. A classic memory game that replaces flipping cards with keyboard precision and mental focus.

meta.name: Coney Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.47 KB

The player controls a penguin who works an ice-cream stand in the Antarctic. Customers approach the stand, and the penguin must swim to the corresponding ice floes to make the correct ice-cream come in the correct order. The penguin can move quickly while in the water, but moves slowly while on land. Ice floes move from the left to right, and if the penguin moves off the right of the screen, a life is lost. Further, jumping fish can steal the penguin's cone, causing a loss of life. At higher levels, there is more variety to ice cream types, but the reward for a successful order is greater. The player starts with 3 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.

meta.name: Conflict
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.47 KB

At last - an exciting AND challenging computer game! A total ware for two players involving both the machinery (armies, warships, missiles) and finance (stock market, oil, piracy) of modern conflict. You may lose a friend and make an enemy as you search for the advantage in these war scenarios.

meta.name: Conflict 2500
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.10 KB

It is the year 2500 and the galaxy has been at peace for many years. Until now! A fleet of planet pulverizers has invaded the sector of the galaxy under your command. Reports are telling you of a massive wave of destruction. It is up to you to rid the universe of this threat of utter destruction. Conflict 2500 is a strategic simulation of conflict in the 26th century. The game can be played solitary or with up to 10 other players by giving command of ships to individuals. The computer controls a fleet of planet pulverizers and adapts its strategy to your actions. The game can be stopped during play or can continue until one side or the other is destroyed.

meta.name: Conflict in Vietnam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Conflict in Vietnam you experience five crucial battles of the Vietnam War, from the defeat of the French colonial army in 1954 to the Viet Cong's victory in 1972. The proven “accelerated real-time” mechanics of the Command series are adapted to the unique conditions of jungle warfare, including day-night cycles, weather, terrain, supply lines, formations, and unit experience. You can play alone or compete against another player on the same computer, with randomized opponent priorities adding extra tension to the battlefield.

meta.name: Confusing Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Confusing Quest, you play through a series of mini-game episodes with characters strongly reminiscent of Creatures. In scene 1, you drop bombs from a balloon onto giant monsters. Scene 2 has you dodging traps, collecting potions, and firing a cannon to proceed once you have enough. In scene 3, shoot monsters from a distance – don't let them get close. Scene 4 mirrors your controls as you grab stars and avoid falling bombs. Finally, enter the sky and face the boss – hit him as many times as you can before he gets you.

meta.name: Confusing Quest 2½
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Confusing Quest 2½ is an arcade game for the Commodore 64. It is a sequel to the Confusing Quest series, which is known for its episodic mini-games. The game offers a collection of different challenges that require skill and strategic thinking. Each episode presents unique tasks and game mechanics that continually challenge the player.

meta.name: Confuzion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Confuzion, your goal is to ignite all bombs on each level using a spark. The spark travels along a fuse made up of sliding tiles, which move like in a classic sliding puzzle with one empty space. You must arrange the tiles to create a continuous path from the spark to each bomb. Time is limited, and hitting a dead end deducts extra time. Later levels introduce water droplets that extinguish the spark on contact – so quick thinking and careful planning are essential.

meta.name: Congo Bongo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.14 KB

In Congo Bongo you play a jungle hunter chasing the gorilla Congo across hazard-filled levels with pits, rivers, wild monkeys, snakes and coconuts. Version 1 (1983) includes two stages with basic visuals; version 2 (1985) on disk adds all four arcade levels with improved graphics. You leap over rivers using hippos, lily pads and piranhas, and must shake off monkeys that cling to your back. Your goal: reach Congo unharmed, one level at a time.

meta.name: Congo Bongo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Congo Bongo is an arcade platform game similar to Donkey Kong, but played from an isometric perspective. The player controls a safari hunter who is searching for Bongo the monkey to punish him for setting fire to his tent. The game has four single-screen levels in which the hunter must use platforms to reach the peak. In level 1 ("Primate Peak") the player climbs a cliff to avoid the monkey throwing coconuts. In level 2 ("Snake Lake") the player jumps between islands and snakes to finally escape on a hippo. In level 3 ("Rhino Ridge") the player avoids rhinos and deadly puddles. Level 4 ("Lazy Lagoon") is reminiscent of Frogger: the player crosses a body of water full of water lilies, hippos and piranhas to overcome the rhinoceros and defeat the gorilla. After that the game starts again with increased difficulty.

meta.name: Connect 4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.34 KB

Connect 4 pits you against an opponent in a race to align four discs in a row – horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Each turn, you drop a disc into the grid, aiming to build your own line while blocking your opponent's moves. Easy to learn, but rich in strategy – a timeless classic of tactical play.

meta.name: Connect Four
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.64 KB

Connect Four lets you compete against the computer or another player in a race to connect four discs in a row – vertically, horizontally, or diagonally. Players take turns dropping discs into a seven-column grid, with each disc falling to the lowest available spot. The game ends when a four-disc line is formed, and the final score is displayed. The computer offers four difficulty levels for added challenge.

meta.name: Connection : Gravity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.24 KB

Connection: Gravity challenges you with physics-based puzzles where gravity is both your enemy and ally. Using the cursor, you select green or blue stones and move them horizontally, while special “bubbles” can be moved vertically as well. Sometimes, you'll need to rotate stones by pressing down and fire. It's all about clever planning and precise moves – and with the built-in level designer, you can even create your own puzzles.

"Conquering Everest" is a management game where you lead a team of climbers, Sherpas, and porters to transport supplies and equipment from Camp 0 to Camp 6 and ultimately reach the summit of Mount Everest. Each day, you receive a weather report and have four options: Carry, Move, Route, and Summit. "Carry" allows you to bring equipment to the next camp and return, while "Move" means the team moves the equipment but stays at the next camp. "Route" is the first step before other options become available, as climbers ascend to the next camp – the distance is measured in rope lengths, and the climb may take more than one day. "Summit" is chosen from Camp 6 to start the final push to the peak. At the end of each day, the inventory of each camp is displayed before the next day and ascent begin.

meta.name: Conquest for the Crown

Conquest for the Crown is a turn-based strategy game where up to eight players battle for control of a hex-based continent. Provinces are conquered, troops moved, and new units recruited with gold. Towers and villages offer tactical advantages and increased income. Royal troops influence the game by aiding or attacking players, and the king's brother can join as a rival. Each round ends with the royal forces acting independently based on set tactics.

meta.name: Continental Circus

nnSi el coche del jugador es golpeado por un coche rival o golpea una barrera en la pista, el coche se dañará y empezará a echar humo. El jugador debe entrar en boxes lo antes posible para reparar el coche, de lo contrario el fuego se extenderá y el coche acabará explotando. Si el coche del jugador sufre una segunda colisión antes de llegar a la parada en boxes, el coche explotará, perdiendo un tiempo precioso antes de que aparezca un coche de sustitución.

Dos años más tarde, en 2633, una organización terrorista de origen alienígena llamada Blood Falcon (halcón sangriento) asume el mando de la isla como parte de sus planes de invadir la Tierra. Los soldados Bill Rizer y Lance Bean, de la unidad Contra, son enviados a la isla oceánica para detener la maléfica amenaza.

meta.name: Contract Bridge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Contract Bridge lets you play solo while the computer handles the other three hands. It's the perfect way to practice or refine your bidding and playing technique – without distractions or waiting for human players.

Contract Bridge lets you play a full game of bridge solo against the computer. With randomly dealt hands, clear visuals, full scoring, and flexible options like setting your own hands, undoing plays, or letting the computer take over, this program is ideal for beginners and seasoned players looking to train or refine their game.

meta.name: Convoy Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.49 KB

Convoy Raider puts you in command of a battleship patrolling an inland sea to hunt and destroy enemy aircraft, missiles, ships, and submarines. From the main display you switch between three radars for air, surface, and subsurface contacts, a map, a status screen, and several mini-game icons. Targets appear as white dots when in range – then you set course, enter the appropriate mini-game, and eliminate the threat.

meta.name: Conway Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.92 KB

Conway Fighter is a rare duel game in which up to three players can compete against each other simultaneously. Players must use various skills and strategies to defeat their opponents. Due to its limited release and special bonus status as part of "The Galleon," the game is hard to find and holds high collector's value.

meta.name: Cookie-Eaters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.22 KB

In Cookie-Eaters you navigate through a maze collecting all items while constantly avoiding enemies chasing you. The gameplay closely follows the classic formula but delivers its own interpretation and feel. Quick reactions and smart movement are essential, as a single mistake can quickly cost you a life. This creates a familiar yet distinct experience that keeps you coming back for another round.

meta.name: The Cool Croc Twins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Cool Croc Twins” throws you into a quirky and charming platform adventure where twin crocodiles Punk and Funk do everything they can to rescue their beloved Daisy Crocette. Spanning 60 static-screen levels, the duo hops around colorful stages, lighting up tiles, dodging enemies, and navigating blocky obstacles. The goal in each level is to light up all the tiles – a task that takes timing, coordination, and a good rhythm. Whether playing solo against the AI or teaming up in two-player mode, the game stands out with its eccentric style, playful visuals, and catchy soundtrack. Bizarre, simple, and totally addictive.

meta.name: Cool World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cool World you play as Frank Harris, a detective tasked with guarding the fragile border between reality and the cartoon realm. Your goal is to stop the seductive Holli Would from escaping into the real world. Across four worlds with four levels each, you battle mischievous doodles that bring chaos between dimensions. Using your trusty pen, you shoot and suck up the doodles to restore balance. But be careful — if too many cross over into the real world, the danger bar fills and the game is over. Collect coins to bribe your way to the next stage and enjoy a wild blend of action, humor, and surreal cartoon mayhem.

meta.name: Coplin Flight Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.32 KB

"Coplin Flight Simulator" puts you in control of an aircraft that must fly over bombing sites on the map to score points. After completing your mission, you need to land safely back on the runway. Keep an eye on your fuel – if it runs out, the game is over.

Enter Mike “Mad Dog” McTavish and Singh “Big Bang” Kapoor – two hard-edged cops on a mission to take down the gangs and bring even the highest crime bosses to justice.

Christmas in Euro-City: While most police officers are off-duty, the snowed-in metropolis explodes with crime. Bank robbers rob... Police officers Mike "Mad Dog" McTavish and Singh "Big Bang" Kapoor must work overtime to save the city - and Christmas.

meta.name: Cops'n'Robbers
meta.desc:
