You are a robber whose target is the Acme Diamond Co. and the old mine, both which are full of jewels. Once collected, the jewels need to be returned to your getaway vehicle. Making your job hard are cops who are very smart, choppers who are dangerously low to the ground, and ghosts that can kill you if you come in contact with them. You have one weapon to deal with these enemies, but it has limited ammo. If you get killed by cops or ghosts, you can enter the jail and release one of your captured men.

meta.name: CORE
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.20 KB

The asteroids have been colonised and are protected in the Federation. An evil contingent of aliens have decided to wipe-out the humans. Unable to find out why this has happened the Federation sends Mr Andrew Angello to gather information of the attacks. One such asteroid EROC 1 has just had such an attack. A faint signal is still being heard so this means the Central Computer is still working. Mr Angello needs to find the bio-memory chips so that the plan of attack and alien armaments can be studied thus saving other asteroids in the future.

meta.name: Corman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.72 KB

“Corman” is a game in the style of “Jumpman” or “Lode Runner.” The goal is to collect all scattered pellets in each level while avoiding falls and dodging the flying balls that traverse the level. The game is challenging because the player character is relatively large for this type of game. Unlike “Jumpman,” the musical capabilities of the Commodore 64 are utilized, featuring continuous background music (“The Swan” from “Carnival of the Animals”) and the “Funeral March” accompanying each lost life.

meta.name: The Cornwall Enigma
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.96 KB

The Cornwall Enigma is a detective adventure set in the picturesque surroundings of Cornwall. You embark on a search for the secret Aylesbury and try to find a way back home. Along the way, you must also find the lost Goblet, if possible. The journey takes you through various locations where you must solve puzzles and gather clues to uncover the mystery.

meta.name: Corom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Corom tells the story of a knight summoned to the land of Peloria to rescue a captive princess from a powerful sorcerer. Along the journey, he faces a wide range of enemies whose danger comes from both their attacks and their ability to defend themselves. Starting with limited equipment and a modest amount of gold, you must trade wisely and plan carefully to acquire the weapons and magic needed to survive. Progress depends on smart choices and resource management – only those who balance risk and preparation can hope to defeat the darkness once and for all.

meta.name: The Corporation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Corporation puts you in charge of a ruthless operation where profit comes first and time is the ultimate enemy. On an asteroid heading toward an inevitable collision, you oversee a mining mission and must reach a required quota before disaster strikes, while making sure to escape in time. With limited resources, you deploy specialized units, plan their tasks, choose different equipment options, and decide whether to intervene directly or rely on automated behavior. The constant balance between efficiency, budget, competition, and risk creates sustained tension and demands strategic thinking right up to the final moment.

meta.name: Correpasadizos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.10 KB

Correpasadizos is played from a top-down perspective, reminiscent of classics like Shamus or Berzerk. A coven of black magicians has stolen the Signs of the Zodiac from the Time Vaults, plunging the world into chaos. Your task is to retrieve all twelve signs by battling through 400 corridors filled with demons and deadly force fields along the walls. Enemies continually multiply, and even the slightest contact with them or the walls costs a life. Since you can only shoot while moving, constant motion is essential for survival. Once all the signs are reclaimed, you must face Jemon, the most powerful of all demons, in the final battle.

meta.name: Corruption
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Corruption puts you in the role of a successful stockbroker whose life suddenly spirals out of control. After an assassination attempt and rumors of insider trading, you are framed for a crime you did not commit, with time rapidly running out. You explore a convincingly grounded world, question characters, gather clues, and connect information to prove your innocence. The focus lies on realistic investigation and uncovering a complex conspiracy rather than traditional puzzles – tension is driven by pressure, atmosphere, and the weight of your choices.

meta.name: Corruption
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Corruption puts you in the role of a successful stockbroker whose life suddenly spirals out of control. After an assassination attempt and rumors of insider trading, you are framed for a crime you did not commit, with time rapidly running out. You explore a convincingly grounded world, question characters, gather clues, and connect information to prove your innocence. The focus lies on realistic investigation and uncovering a complex conspiracy rather than traditional puzzles – tension is driven by pressure, atmosphere, and the weight of your choices.

meta.name: Corx - Rebel Racers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Corx is a straight light-cycling race variant (with cars instead of cycles), known from the movie TRON. Two players race against each other on a plain and each vehicle leaves behind a trail which is deadly by touch. The goal is to trap the opponent; obviously the surviving party has won the battle. The screen is split into three parts: the upper and lower ones show a 3D view of the plain with the camera fixed on one of the two players and in the middle is a radar view.
The variants to this known principle are a limited amount of jumps, the ability to control the speed of the own vehicle and two AI difficulty levels. Regarding multiplayer, there can be only two vehicles on the field at the same time. However, more participants can start a tournament with knockout rules.

meta.name: Corya the Warrior-Sage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Corya the Warrior-Sage has just witnessed a dragon destroying the village of Ermahal and although a warrior-sage seldom ventures into the world of men, they will if needed. This land needs the help of Corya to destroy this dragon. The game is a text only adventure with no graphics. The screen describes your surroundings and allows you to type in commands to conquer this adventure. The game is split into three parts. The first part is to equip yourself and explore your surroundings. The second is a rescue and to recover a stolen artifact. The third and final part is to solve problems in a city and to finally confront the dragon.

meta.name: Cosmic Ark
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Alpha Ro solar system is in crisis! Their sun is about to go supernova, meaning the death of all the many planets and the exotic lifeforms who call them home. Luckily, though, the noble Atlanteans have heard of Alpha Ro's plight and have sent a vast Cosmic Ark thousands of light-years across the galaxy to try and save as many species as possible. As the captain of the Ark, the player will have to contend with deadly meteor storms and planetary defense systems to succeed the mission.

meta.name: The Cosmic Balance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Design your own starships and send them out for combat against the computer player. With limited space for equipment, a ship designer must decide whether to load up the ship with weapons and go for an all-out attack, add shields and deflectors to protect your ship, or use high tech propulsion and run rings around the opponent. Ships can be sized from a corvette class all the way to a massive battlestar. Once complete, you enter combat vs. against a similar-sized ship, which also can be you or someone else's design, or a computer generated ship. The computer resolves combat as you watch the ships battle.

meta.name: Cosmic Bounce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.63 KB

You are the pilot of the Plasmobile, and your task is to protect the vital energy source which is under attack by the Doovries. Your weapon is a plasma cannon which fires a plasma ball of indestructible energy capable of destroying everything in its path. Once fired, the plasma will continue to wreak havoc until it is recovered by your Plasmobile. it must not be allowed to destroy the energy source or you will have failed in your mission. You have nine lives, and occasionally have to ram a Doovry to protect the energy source. Play in English. Mode d'emploi en Francais. Gebrauchsanweisung auf Deutsch.

meta.name: Cosmic Brewers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cosmic Brewers is a simple clone of the arcade classic Moon Patrol. In the game, the player controls a vehicle through an alien landscape, avoiding obstacles and fighting enemy units. The gameplay requires skill and quick reactions to overcome the challenges. For those interested, Cosmic Brewers is available on the Planet Emulation website, where the game can be downloaded.

meta.name: Cosmic Capers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.56 KB

Cosmic Capers is a text adventure where your mission is, well that's the thing, starting in an English village you actually have no idea what your goal is. As you explore the village and surrounding areas, with your computer companion Bugsy, you discover spacecrafts in the area. As you progress you will have trips into space, find out objects to collect and use elsewhere, but above all you need to stay alive.

meta.name: Cosmic Causeway : Trailblazer II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.79 KB

“Cosmic Causeway: Trailblazer II” challenges the player to roll through 24 levels within a time limit. Each level features unique tiles with specific effects: red slows down, green speeds up, black holes must be avoided, cyan reverses controls, and blue allows jumping. While aliens can be shot, all other obstacles must be dodged, as collisions or falls cost valuable time. Any remaining time at the end of a level is added as a bonus to the score. White blobs on the track grant credits, which can be spent on power-ups or tricks – but only for the next level. Available options include slowing down time, closing black holes, deactivating purple tiles, or activating a shield.

meta.name: Cosmic Clash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.09 KB

Cosmic Clash is a single-screen, top-view shooter where you start at the bottom of the screen and continually move up, moving left or right, and slowing down and speeding up. Each screen features an alien invader that appears at the top of the screen and moves downward. If one of you reaches and leaves the other side of the screen, you will reappear on the other side. You must destroy the intruders while avoiding their bullets. If you kill an alien, one will respawn in the same place. There are also asteroids moving across the screen that you have to avoid. If you hit one or are hit by a bullet, you lose five lives.

meta.name: Cosmic Combat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.58 KB

Cosmic Combat is an action-packed shoot'em-up where the player pilots a spaceship and battles increasingly difficult waves of enemy aliens. The gameplay is reminiscent of classics like Gorf or Phoenix – quick reflexes and strategic shooting are key to survival.

meta.name: Cosmic Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cosmic Commando is a first-person shooter where you control a crosshair on a single screen viewed from an elevated angle. The aliens appear one at a time from the back of the screen and move downward in random patterns. You have to fire a certain amount to advance to the next level. When an alien reaches the bottom of the screen, it reappears at the top. You only have a limited amount of ammunition that cannot be refilled. The game is over once you run out of ammunition.

meta.name: Cosmic Convoy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cosmic Convoy is a side view horizontal scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls left or right when you move your ships. The System Coman is in difficulty, with the various planets within, needing supplies, and so a convoy of relief ships are moving between the planets dropping off the essential supplies. Your mission is to control a squadron of three ships to protect the convoy from alien attackers as they make their way to the next planet.

meta.name: Cosmic Cruiser : Galacto Honoris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.96 KB

Cosmic Cruiser: Galacto Honoris puts you in the suit of an astronaut on a dangerous space rescue mission. Your goal: blast open hatches with a laser cannon and bring stranded astronauts aboard your shuttle. But the void is far from empty – discarded satellites block your path, aliens try to abduct the crew, and gliders and probes open fire. Only quick reflexes and precise laser shots will see you through.

meta.name: Cosmic Crusader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game is a standard sci-fi shooter that Space Invaders fans will immediately recognize. Shoot the onrushing army of alien ships before you get shot or crushed when they get too close.
Every now and then there are nice surprises that each new level brings, such as the huge alien ships that appear from time to time and give you the chance to get a huge bonus.

meta.name: Cosmic Hero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.45 KB

Cosmic Hero is a timed futuristic game using Sokoban concept. The spacecraft carrying a substance required to save the Earth from ecological disaster has crashed. The player's task is to gather up all the vials in each cabin of the shuttle. Opening the door to the next level requires repairing the electrical system. Spare wires must be moved and placed in the proper sequence, taking into account obstacles, such as the reversal of the direction of movement (joystick) or objects blocking the road. Finding a floppy disk moves immediately to the next level, while a computer adds one life.

meta.name: Cosmic Life
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.21 KB

Cosmic Life places you in a cosmic struggle for survival where strategic placement and forward planning determine success or failure. You deploy space pioneers onto a hostile planetary surface and attempt to build stable colonies that can endure the environmental conditions. Only well-organized groups survive, while limited resources, overcrowding and unpredictable storms constantly threaten growth. At the same time, you must keep an eye on your rival and actively hinder their expansion, as only the strongest colonies will prevail in the end.

meta.name: Cosmic Pirate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.79 KB

Cosmic Pirate puts you in the role of an outlaw working for a shadowy organization and taking on risky contracts. The objective is to hijack heavily guarded space trucks, with each mission becoming more dangerous and demanding than the last. As the stakes rise, tension and challenge increase, making awareness, planning, and adaptability crucial to success – a steady descent into an ever more unforgiving world of criminal operations.

meta.name: Cosmic Relief : Prof. Renegade to the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

“Cosmic Relief: Prof. Renegade to the Rescue” takes the player 40 years into the past to find the eccentric Professor K.K. Renegade, who has predicted an asteroid impact on Earth. The player chooses one of five adventurers and ventures into the Tibetan mountains, where dangerous creatures and extreme weather conditions make the search more difficult. Unusual tools like a vacuum cleaner or a unicycle help to overcome obstacles. Once the professor is convinced, the next mission begins: building a deflector to prevent the catastrophe.

meta.name: Cosmic Relief : Prof. Renegade to the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

“Cosmic Relief: Prof. Renegade to the Rescue” takes the player 40 years into the past to find the eccentric Professor K.K. Renegade, who has predicted an asteroid impact on Earth. The player chooses one of five adventurers and ventures into the Tibetan mountains, where dangerous creatures and extreme weather conditions make the search more difficult. Unusual tools like a vacuum cleaner or a unicycle help to overcome obstacles. Once the professor is convinced, the next mission begins: building a deflector to prevent the catastrophe.

meta.name: Cosmic Split
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.34 KB

Cosmic Split is inspired by the arcade game Centipede, where you control a vehicle at the bottom of the screen and have to shoot and destroy a centipede. You can move your vehicle left or right, as well as forward and backward over a short distance. The centipede appears at the top of the screen and moves across. If it hits a mushroom or the edge of the screen, it will lower one spot and change direction. If you hit the centipede, it will split in two and will be split again and again with further shots until it is finally destroyed.

meta.name: Cosmic Split
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.08 KB

Cosmic Split challenges you on a single screen as you control a craft at the bottom and face an ever-changing threat. A long segmented creature descends from above and splits apart when hit, forcing you to constantly reassess priorities and maintain control. Numerous obstacles and additional enemies create unpredictable situations where reflexes, positioning, and precise action are essential. With each successful round the pressure increases, until one small mistake ends everything – a focused experience built around control, awareness, and constant escalation.

meta.name: Cosmic Storm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.69 KB

Released with the MAGNUM "lightphaser" lightgun, cosmic storm made up one of the six games packaged with the peripheral. The game involves protecting your planet from alien invaders by using the gun to shoot at the on-screen enemies. Player's are graded on the fly for accuracy as the aliens sweep around the screen using smooth sine-wave attack patterns.

meta.name: The Cosmic Tunnels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Cosmic Tunnels places you as the last defender of Sirref, the only habitable planet in the Relffok Galaxy. With the Jebs enforcing a power embargo, your world faces collapse. Your mission: recover energy bars from four asteroids that power the moon's energy complex. To reach them, you must survive four perilous cosmic tunnels, land on each asteroid, and collect all available bars before returning to base. Only those who fly skillfully, fight bravely, and return safely can save Sirref.

meta.name: Cosmonut
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.01 KB

There is a battle taking place on the planet of Cybor between two giant robots representing two races from the planet. Your race's robot has been infiltrated by your enemy to make it weaker so the other robot can destroy it. Taking control of a worker-droid called Cosmonut you have infiltrated your robot's head and you must find any enemy wandering around and destroy them. There are also various rooms that need sealing by completing various arcade games. Once you have sealed the rooms then you can enter the Central Control Room and make your robot stronger to finish off the other robot. All this has to be done before your robot loses all it's power.

meta.name: Cosmos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cosmos is a vertically scrolling space shooter where you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen, fighting off waves of enemies. You clear each zone by surviving or eliminating foes. With rising difficulty, speed and missile density increase. You must manage fuel, which is restored by collecting capsules or clearing full waves. Firing too rapidly causes your weapon to overheat, and warp speed temporarily slows enemies down to give you a fighting chance.

meta.name: Cosmox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Cosmox“ is a tricky mix of action and logic, where Fred must stomp towers into the ground by jumping on them. When four towers of the same height form a square, they disappear – that's your goal. A tall indicator on the bottom left shows how many levels need to be removed from each tower. But beware – if no valid tower combinations remain, you may not have planned wisely. Fred can only stand on towers – touching the regular ground is fatal. Be sure to collect energy pills regularly, or Fred will get sick. Bonus diamonds offer extra points – and sometimes the lifeline you need.

Count Duckula with his servants Igor and Nanny have brought their European style castle to ancient Egypt. Once there they set their on the Sax, an ancient Egyptian saxophone with magical powers. The Sax is hidden in the pyramid tomb of the pharaoh Upanatem, deep in the burning desert. Cont Duckula's rivals the Crow Brothers inadvertently hitched a ride on their time travel and are preparing their own expedition to foil the vampire duck.

meta.name: Count Duckula 2 Featuring Tremendous Terence
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.66 KB

Count Duckula 2 es una continuación de Count Duckula. Es un juego basado en la serie animada. En este juego el conde ha llegado al planeta Cute y ahora deberá escapar de regreso a Transylvania. Deberá evitar a conejos esponjosos de peluche y tendrá una pistola de salsa de tomate con munición ilimitada - el objetivo será llegar desde el inicio de la pantalla a la izquierda hacia la derecha.

meta.name: The Count
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.98 KB

Despiertas en un ala sellada del castillo transilvano del Conde, aparentemente restrictiva, pero que ofrece nuevos pasadizos secretos y salidas inesperadas al intrépido y oportuno explorador. A lo largo de unos días, deberás familiarizarte con la disposición del castillo y las actividades nocturnas de su residente principal, quien prefiere hacerte un refrigerio nocturno en lugar de un plato principal. Un ciclo impredecible de día y noche te obliga a buscar una fuente de luz fiable y algún medio para mantenerte despierto; de lo contrario, despertarás a la mañana siguiente de nuevo en la cama, con tus pertenencias robadas por la cleptómana criatura de la noche y tu cuello luciendo marcas de mordiscos irritados. Cada día debes acercarte gradualmente a tu objetivo de vencer al Conde, para no acabar convertido en un aperitivo más seco.

meta.name: Countdown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.70 KB

Countdown recreates the well-known word-and-numbers game show format for two players. The familiar sequence of letter rounds, number challenges and a final conundrum is reproduced. During the letters round, you build the longest possible word from nine selected vowels and consonants within a time limit, scoring points based on word length. Because a full dictionary is not stored, the game asks players to confirm whether entered words are valid. The result is a direct contest of vocabulary, speed and problem-solving skills.

meta.name: Countdown to Shutdown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.37 KB

Countdown to Meltdown places you inside a nuclear power plant where a second, even greater explosion threatens after an initial blast. The reactor core is overheating, and only by damping down the control rods in time can disaster be avoided. You command a team of android operatives through a camera and control network, navigating over 2000 rooms across eight levels. Constant time pressure and careful coordination are essential as the core grows hotter by the minute. The game blends tactical planning with large-scale exploration in a tense technological setting.

meta.name: Counter Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.41 KB

Counter Attack is inspired by the board game Connect 4 where two players take it in turns to place a counter in one of seven columns on an upright grid to make a row or force the other player to make a row vertical, horizontal or diagonal. Before the game starts there are two options that can be selected, how many counters to make a row, and if the winner is the first player to make the row or to force the other player to make one. As the game progresses placing counters, each player has a choice, either place a counter or rotate a row or column one place, left, right, up or down.

meta.name: Counterblast
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

There are three difficulty levels: Beginner, Normal and Suicidal. In the game, the player controls an airship through a labyrinthine cave system that is riddled with traps and obstacles. The aim is to navigate the airship safely through the dangerous passages, avoid enemy ships and overcome obstacles. "Counterblast" is characterized by its challenging game mechanics and the need for precise control.

meta.name: CounterForce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.10 KB

CounterForce puts you in command of an elite defense unit on a desperate mission. The Solar Convoy, humanity's last hope for colonization, must cross the hostile territory of the Epsilon Empire. Wave after wave of alien forces descend upon you, and it's your job to eliminate them before they strike. Every shot counts for the survival of the colonists – your courage, reflexes, and laser power form the final line of defense. In this battle, attack isn't just the best defense – it's the only one.

meta.name: Counting Parade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An educational 1-player counting featuring jungle and circus animals. A math skills builder intended for students age 3 to 6. The player chooses from a specified number of animals from a field of different creatures. These animals then parade across the top or bottom of the screen depending upon game type. The player must pick out the correct animal and the correct number from the counting parade.

meta.name: Country Capers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.89 KB

In Country Capers, you start in a rundown cottage in a rural town and work your way through various challenges to become a top software developer in Sydney. Explore your surroundings, solve puzzles, and make choices that shape your journey to success.

meta.name: Country Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.25 KB

You are on holiday in the Herefordshire countryside for a week, staying in a farm cottage, sightseeing around the local area as well as talking to the locals. Over the week you have heard many stories about the previous owner who died a month ago from a long illness, who it is believed buried much of his wealth around the area. With no living or known relatives there is no one to ask to confirm this so you take it with a pinch of salt at first. Many of the locals though recall seeing the owner on many nights with a box and spade walking around and so you start to believe and finally decide you will try to find the so called lost wealth. Country Quest is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

meta.name: County Cricket
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.00 KB

County cricket gives you the opportunity to manage an English county cricket team over multiple seasons and attempt to win both the title and the cup. Unlike normal county cricket where matches last for several days, the matches are limited overs where you can choose between 40 and 60 overs. After seeing the schedules and your next game, you will be presented with a number of options to help you win the game. You can select your team from a roster of players, train the team in various aspects of the game, and finally check out all the youth team players ready to move up to the men's team. After you are happy with your selection, choose heads or tails to find out whether to bat or bowl.

meta.name: Country Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game offers an overhead view of the race track where the player races against the clock. It was later released in the public domain collection Digital Marketing PD #151. In County Racer, the player controls a vehicle through various tracks with varying levels of difficulty. The game is characterized by its simple controls and focus on skill.

meta.name: Court-Side College Basketball Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Court-Side College Basketball Game is a text- and statistics-driven simulation where you manage a college basketball team. Rather than playing directly, you make tactical decisions, study stats, and analyze the flow of the match. Every detail – from free throws and rebounds to fouls – is meticulously tracked as you guide your team to victory. A perfect experience for strategy-minded fans who prefer basketball from the coach's perspective.

Cover Girl Strip Poker lets up to three players challenge one of eight digitized women to a game of poker, where each loss costs her money – and eventually clothes. Four of the girls feature short strip animations composed of several frames. You can select your language at the start and choose whether or not to hear your opponent's cheeky remarks. A zoom function is also included for those who want to admire the pixel art up close. It's more of the same poker-plus-undressing formula, just with extra features and more pixelated flair.

In this shooter, players compete against each other and must prove their accuracy while in a classic western scenario. The gameplay is designed to develop players' reflexes and strategic thinking. Instead of simply drawing quickly, players must aim carefully and choose the right time to defeat their opponent. The atmosphere is supported by appropriate graphics and a soundtrack that underlines the western theme.

The game mechanics are easy to understand and offer fast action in which players must fire precise shots to defeat their opponents. With vibrant graphics and a catchy soundtrack, the game provides an engaging experience that appeals to both casual and experienced gamers.

Cowboy Kidz has you riding alongside a moving mail train in a constantly upward-scrolling landscape, fending off danger as it appears. You protect the train by shooting or dodging bandits, switching between riding in front of or behind the train to reach the other side. Rocks and cacti must also be avoided, as touching enemies or obstacles costs one of your lives. Later stages increase the challenge with bandits firing from the train and rivers that can only be crossed via bridges, making positioning and quick reactions essential.

meta.name: Cowpat Frisbee
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.80 KB

In Cowpat Frisbee you defend yourself against an alien invasion by throwing cowpats like frisbees into the sky. From your position on the ground you aim at the approaching UFOs appearing above the city and moving in from different directions. With good timing and careful aim you try to hit as many of the flying visitors as possible before they spread across the screen. The game embraces a deliberately silly concept – instead of lasers or rockets, cowpats fly through the air, giving the alien battle a humorous and unusual twist.

meta.name: Crack Down
meta.desc:

Ben y Andy. los dos mejores agentes del Servicio Especial, acaban de aceptar una peligrosa misión, eliminar al Sr. K y a su Sistema de Vida Artificial. El Sr K planea acabar con todo tipo de vida humana en la tierra haciendo uso de los robots asesinos que él mismo ha creado. Sólo Ben y Andy podrán detenerle. Ayúdales a infiltrarse en la escalofriante ciudad del Sr. K. poner las bombas Clystron y salir corriendo antes de que exploten ¡Acabe con el Sr K!

meta.name: Crack It!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.43 KB

"Crack It!" is an appealing mastermind board game for the Commodore 64. The game has clear and attractive graphics, which make it a visual delight. In "Crack It!" players compete against each other to guess a secret color code. They must proceed strategically and use clues to decipher the right combination of colors. The appeal of the game lies in the combination of logic and tactics, which makes it exciting for both casual players and real brain teasers.

meta.name: Crack Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crack Mania is a colorful and humorous game for the Commodore 64 that can be played in both single and multiplayer modes. In this fun adventure, players take on the role of characters who must work together to collect all the crack bricks from the ground. The gameplay is reminiscent of the classic form of Pac-Man, with its own quirky twist. Players navigate through various levels as they try to collect the coveted objects while avoiding the "DT's" - a humorous reference to the difficulties the characters must overcome.

meta.name: The Crack of Doom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crack of Doom is an open-ended, mixed-moderated, play-by-mail game. It was designed and first published as Crack of Doom (or Crack of Doom I) by Duane Wilcoxson and Debbie Leonard of Advanced Gaming Enterprises in 1986. They published Crack of Doom II in 1997 which ran alongside the first version. By 1997, Crack of Doom II was running under license in the United Kingdom, first under Phildee Enterprises and later under Harlequin Games. These were fantasy role-playing games, comparable in gameplay to Advanced Dungeons & Dragons. The games were reviewed in various gaming magazines in the 1980s, 1990s, and 2000s, receiving generally positive reviews.

Crack-Up es un clon de Breakout para 1 o 2 jugadores y cuenta con 32 pantallas llenas de acción. El objetivo del juego es simplemente destruir cada muro de ladrillos y pasar a la siguiente pantalla. Pero cuidado, algunos ladrillos necesitan más de un golpe para destruirse y otros no pueden destruirse en absoluto. Para hacer el juego aún más desafiante, algunos ladrillos son invisibles. Actúan del mismo modo que los ladrillos normales (es decir, algunos pueden destruirse y otros son indestructibles), salvo que no puedes verlos. Hay 7 ladrillos de bonificación que aparecen aleatoriamente y que permiten, por ejemplo, pasar directamente al siguiente nivel, duplicar el daño, ralentizar la bola...

meta.name: Crackers Revenge
meta.desc:

Crackers Revenge is a fun platform game for the Commodore 64 that was designed as a clone of Son of Blagger. The game takes players on an adventurous mission to free captured "crackers" from the clutches of cruel software companies. In this game, players must find six keys to rescue the captured characters while avoiding dangerous flowers and mines scattered throughout the level. An interesting gameplay mechanic is the ability to press the space bar to quickly end the game, which offers players a humorous and sometimes frustrating twist.

The only way for the Dark Lord to be destroyed is to collect various items, including the most important, the True Ring and throw them in The Crack of Fire, high in the Mountains of Moldak. With your companion, Garston the Wise you must explore the land, find the objects and one by one take them to The Crack of Fire and throw them in. You will encounter many creatures and some have to be killed or you will die.

In The Cranmore Diamond Caper, you find yourself in a hotel room across the street from the CRANMORE building, where the famous CRANMORE DIAMOND is on display. Given your predicament, you have little choice but to plan a daring theft of this precious gem - after all, that's why you're here. The town is small, with a few shops, a hotel, and a police station that you're determined to avoid. It's nearly 5 p.m. on the last day of the exhibition, and you have about nine hours to put your plan into action before the diamond is out of reach. You look out of the hotel window, the streetlights bathing the evening in a soft glow, and after a calming sip of brandy, you prepare for the decisive moment of your plan.

With your co-pilot, T.C. Barton you must avoid touching the walls and other objects that will cause your balloon to burst and lose one of five lives. The balloon sways constantly but the balloon does stay in the same position when not moving. The exit has a timer counting down and the quicker you get to it the more bonus points you receive and there is also a square that can be collected for more points. Once you reach the exit you receive an extra life and on later levels there are magnets that slowly drag you towards them.

The colorful graphics and catchy sound make the game a visual and acoustic delight.

You will first encounter boulders rolling towards you and they must be jumped over before facing dinosaurs running towards you and you must use your axe to get rid of them. Dodos are next and they bounce along the screen and you must avoid them before facing birds flying overhead dropping rocks. If you are hit by any object or creature then you lose one of three lives.

Er*bert is a clone of the arcade game Q*Bert with some minor modifications. As in the original game, your must leap up and down an isometric landscape of square blocks while avoiding predators (in this case, Boris the gorilla and Coily the snake) and other obstacles (such as falling boulders and trapped squares). Every time a square is visited it changes colour, and the goal is to visit all blocks without being killed. There are also single use teleporter disks at the edges of the playing area, allowing Er*bert to escape from tight situations.

meta.name: Crazy Golf

Crazy Golf is a fun and colorful mini golf game for the Commodore 64 that takes players into an imaginative golf world. The game is characterized by its creative and often crazy course layouts, which are peppered with various obstacles and challenges. The controls are simple and intuitive, so that both beginners and experienced players can quickly immerse themselves in the game. The different courses require strategic thinking and precise aiming to get the ball into the hole. With its charming graphic style and catchy sound, Crazy Golf offers a happy and relaxing gaming experience.

When you get to the end of the beach path, as noted by the distance marker, you go to the next level. In the bonus levels between each jogging level, you must try to catch the falling drinks and other items. Then on to the forest where creepy crawlies, porcupines and forest birds try to catch you. The nighttime level has crows, bats and bullfrogs to avoid, along with the other creatures.

meta.name: Crazy Kong

The platforms are connected by ladders and as you climb and move up the screen, a giant ape on the top of the screen rolls barrels along the platforms towards you. You must jump over the barrels or you lose one of three lives if you are hit but there are hammers that can be collected and smash the barrels for a limited time. As well as getting to the top of the screen to get to the next screen you must also collect all the diamonds on the screen.

In Crazy Men, players take on the role of a character who must navigate through various levels to collect objects, or "Crazy Men." The gameplay is simple and accessible, but still offers enough challenges to keep players engaged. While they collect the items they collect, they must avoid various obstacles and enemies that make progress difficult.

meta.name: Crazy Paving

In Crazy Paving you play as Howard the Robot, cleaning up Zigmund's mess by placing paving stones across multiple interconnected levels. As the screen scrolls with your movement, you search for the correct spots, place tiles, and juggle keys, gates, and useful tools. Since you can carry only one item at a time, every decision matters, especially when moving between levels to solve tasks. Meanwhile, creatures roam the maze, forcing you to dodge or eliminate them to stay on track. A demanding mix of planning, timing, and awareness.

meta.name: Crazy Runner

Crazy Runner is a fun platform game for the Commodore 64. In this game, players take on the role of a character who must navigate through different levels to collect hearts to gain access to the next screen. The gameplay requires skill and speed as players must avoid numerous obstacles, including wandering monsters, falling hazards, and other challenges to overcome.

Finding it hard to wake up in the morning? Got the dog-walking blues? Inside this package you'll find machines that can do almost anything - from waking to walking, from beating the heat to helping you eat!

Thinking about actions and reactions is the key to perfecting the connections. So build with care, and conquer life's chores in ways you never have before!

In the infamous torture chambers, you must save your friends by cleverly sabotaging the demons' deadly contraptions. With its twisted humor, cartoon gore, and unique mix of action and puzzle-solving, the game delivers a wild and wickedly funny adventure.

"Cricket 64" is an interactive cricket game simulating a limited overs match between England and the West Indies. Before the game begins, players can customize player names, decide the batting and bowling order, and adjust field positions. The match is displayed from an elevated perspective, allowing the player to watch as the bowler delivers the ball and the batsman responds — hitting, missing, getting out, or driving the ball into play. When the ball is hit, players can choose whether to attempt a run, with the nearest fielder highlighted to retrieve the ball. After each over, the scoreboard can be reviewed, and a new bowler can be selected to continue the game.

meta.name: Cricket Captain

This version of Cricket Captain lacks the ability to play the matches that is featured in the others. Instead, the C64 displays a running scorecard, while on the Spectrum the whole screen is used for a top-down view of the field, with lines illustrating where each shot was played, and flash announcements of dismissals. Only balls from which a player is dismissed or a run is scored are shown.
Scouts, coaches and physios are not hired, you simply have a standard one throughout. CPU v CPU matches produce a simple result instead of a full scoreline. Minor counties are not featured; cup tournaments start from the last 16 stage
A few other changes have been made. Player abilities in each field are now rated out of 10 instead of 100, but a player's bowling style and preferred bowling style to bat against are now featured. The scout now brings information about a team's players, and then gives you the chance to buy one of them, instead of searching for players of a particular ability.

The secluded Caribbean island of St. Malcolm is getting a visit from a cricket team from the UK to play the islanders with a hidden agenda to get  the rights to the local natural resource, Guano. You are the manager of the team as you fly towards the island but things don't go too well as you get hijacked and later crash the plane. After surviving the crash, your aim is to get yourself and the team to the cricket ground where the game is going to be played. Cricket Crazy is a graphic text adventure where the screen has a picture of your location and text describing what you can see. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings and if you manage to get to the ground you can interact with the actual cricket game.

meta.name: Crillion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crillion is a fast-paced action puzzle game similar to Breakout, but you control the ball directly. It bounces vertically by itself, and you steer it horizontally. The goal is to clear all color-matching blocks by hitting them with the same-colored ball. Color changes are triggered by special star-marked tiles. Avoid skull blocks – touching one costs a life and resets the level. There are also unbreakable walls and slider blocks that can only be moved when the ball matches their color.

meta.name: Crime and Punishment
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Crime and Punishment“ is a courtroom simulation in which the player takes on the role of the judge. The focus is on determining the appropriate sentence, as the defendant's guilt has already been established. The goal is to earn as many gavels as possible (up to ten) by choosing the same punishment as a real judge. Cases range from perjury and theft to murder and rape. To aid in decision-making, information about the crime is available, including the damage caused, the offender's background and personal circumstances, and their motive. Be aware that the more information you request, the fewer gavels you receive. The AI can sometimes make surprising sentencing choices.

meta.name: Crime Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crime Time is a classic third-person point-and-click adventure – with the twist that you don't click on the graphics themselves, but on control elements below them. Actions and movements are carried out by clicking on words. The story unfolds like a mystery: two friends hitchhike through the country, but because of heavy rain they stay overnight in a small hotel. One drinks too much, loses control, stumbles into the wrong room, passes out – and wakes up next to a corpse. Now you must prove your innocence.

meta.name: Crimson Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Transylvania we rescued Princess Sabrina and met Crown Prince Erik. They return upon learning of the death of King John the Good and learn that the crown has disappeared. The vampire lord Drakul seeks to uncover his secrets to become king and threatens his land.
As your guide, they accompany you on your journey to reclaim the crown, an amulet of immense power, and rid the land of the vampire. Certain tasks require their unique abilities, Princess Sabrina understands magic, and Crown Prince Erik can use items that rightfully belong to the heir to the throne, among other things.
Meet the unusual characters and creatures that roam this area. Whenever the wise man appears, talk to him and listen to his wise words. Travelers are advised to know how to solve their puzzles.

meta.name: Crimson Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Transylvania we rescued Princess Sabrina and met Crown Prince Erik. They return upon learning of the death of King John the Good and learn that the crown has disappeared. The vampire lord Drakul seeks to uncover his secrets to become king and threatens his land.
As your guide, they accompany you on your journey to reclaim the crown, an amulet of immense power, and rid the land of the vampire. Meet the unusual characters and creatures that roam this area. Whenever the wise man appears, talk to him and listen to his wise words. Travelers are advised to know how to solve their puzzles.

meta.name: Crisis Mountain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.97 KB

Crisis Mountain es un juego de plataformas clásico. Tu tarea es desactivar las bombas dejadas por terroristas en las cavernas de una montaña cuando un volcán inactivo entra en erupción inesperadamente. El tiempo es limitado ya que las bombas detonarán pronto. El juego tiene nueve divertidos niveles que superar.

meta.name: Critical Mass (Sirius Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Critical Mass" begins with a terrifying message to the United Nations—on June 9th at exactly 8 PM, the world's five largest cities will be destroyed with thermonuclear weapons. The delegates decide that only one person is crazy enough to stop this madman — the player. To prevent the impending catastrophe, clues must be gathered, locations visited, and puzzles solved. The trail leads to Paris, Rome, London, Miami, and San Juan, gradually revealing that the ruthless Count Stuportino is orchestrating the destruction from his secret lair in Martinique. To thwart his plans, two special challenges must be overcome — a water-skiing competition in Miami to win a crucial towel, and a battle using a plasma beam gun to intercept incoming nuclear missiles and save millions of lives.

meta.name: Critters
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.15 KB

meta.name: The Crooked Canyon Caper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.74 KB

The Crooked Canyon Caper places you in the middle of an investigation following a bank robbery. Your task is to question all suspects and piece together the clues to solve the case. If you succeed, you keep your job – but failure could mean the end of your career. Locations such as the bank or the Last Chance Café provide hints and opportunities to uncover the truth. Every move requires attention and a sharp sense for connections.

meta.name: Cross It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cross It is a logic puzzle where your goal is to clear the entire board by triggering deliberate chain reactions. Each click affects the adjacent squares horizontally and vertically, causing stones to appear or disappear depending on whether a stone is already there. This makes every move a careful trade-off, since a helpful action in one spot can create new trouble elsewhere. The appeal comes from planning ahead, spotting patterns and finding the right sequence of moves – easy to explain, yet surprisingly tricky to solve completely.

meta.name: Cross It II : The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cross It II: The Revenge builds on the familiar concept and noticeably raises the puzzle difficulty. Once again the goal is to clear the entire board, but the layouts are more intricate and require deeper planning. Every move affects neighboring squares and can either trigger useful chain reactions or create new obstacles. The appeal comes from carefully sequencing moves and identifying key turning points – familiar at its core, yet significantly tougher and more demanding in execution.

meta.name: Cross Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.45 KB

Cross Racer challenges you to master demanding side-view tracks while skillfully avoiding obstacles. Precise timing and clean control are essential to prevent crashes and achieve the fastest possible times. As you progress, the courses demand increasing focus and a strong sense of speed – straightforward, challenging and firmly centered on lap times and riding skill.

meta.name: Crossbow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crossbow tasks you with guiding a small group of unarmed companions safely through deadly environments. From a first-person view, you watch as your friends cross the screen one by one, while you use a crossbow to eliminate obstacles and hostile creatures before they reach them. Each setting introduces its own dangers, demanding quick reactions and sharp judgment of timing and priorities. As your group grows, so does the pressure, since every loss matters and the journey only ends when no one remains – tense, demanding and focused on protection and awareness.

meta.name: Crossbow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crossbow tasks you with guiding a small group of unarmed companions safely through deadly environments. From a first-person view, you watch as your friends cross the screen one by one, while you use a crossbow to eliminate obstacles and hostile creatures before they reach them. Each setting introduces its own dangers, demanding quick reactions and sharp judgment of timing and priorities. As your group grows, so does the pressure, since every loss matters and the journey only ends when no one remains – tense, demanding and focused on protection and awareness.

meta.name: Crosscheck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A combination of a crossword puzzle, and Scrabble, the players take turns rolling a dice numbered 1 - 9. Depending on the roll, they will be asked a trivia question, or allowed to directly post a tile on the table. The player's answer will always be as long as the number rolled. If the player answers the question correctly, the answer can be placed on the board. If the player rolls a 1 or 2, they are allowed to place a single tile of their choosing on the board. Players can have a timed game, a goal number of points, or play until they reach their home base. There are special bonus squares on the table, which award the player extra points.

meta.name: Crosses & Cirkels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.53 KB

Crosses and Circles for the Commodore 64 is reminiscent of the classic Tic-Tac-Toe. Players take turns placing crosses and circles on a grid to form a complete row. This simple but strategic gameplay makes for exciting rounds and challenges the players' concentration and tactical skills.

meta.name: Crossfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.09 KB

Crossfire is a single screen first person perspective shooter where you are a policeman leading 'The Untouchables' against the mob lead by Al Capone and 'Legs' Diamond. You must visit nine locations and shoot all the enemies that appear in various places on the screen, by aiming a crosshair at them. Civilians also appear and make you lose points if you happen to shoot them. To complete a location and move to the next one, you must stay alive until a countdown reaches zero. The enemies will shoot back at you after a short time and if you are hit, you lose one of four lives and the scene starts again.

meta.name: Crossfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.13 KB

The idea of ​​our program of the month has been around for a few years. But with a new outfit and lots of opponents, you can go alone or in pairs into numerous labyrinths full of danger. Reaction and quick thumbs on the fire button are required! Wriggling little monsters make the mazes in "Crossfire" unsafe. The player must try to survive in a small satellite in this landscape. The small nimble opponents hide behind the wall blocks, come out from behind them at confusing intervals and start firing at the character. Only then does the player have the chance to shoot at the little villains with his own weapon.

meta.name: Crossfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.57 KB

Crossfire is a fast-paced adaptation of the arcade game Targ, where you defend your city from invading alien beasts. Your ship moves through a grid-like street system and can fire in all four directions, while enemies charge at you from every side. To survive, you must dodge their shots and eliminate them with your own fire. Once all attackers are destroyed, you advance to the next level with even fiercer assaults. Ammunition is limited, so resupply is essential. Four bonus crystals appear in each stage, each worth double the points of the previous one. You begin with three ships, earning an extra one every 5000 points.

meta.name: Crossroads
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.32 KB

Crossroads puts the player in control of buses navigating realistic intersections shaped like X, T, or Y. Passengers must be picked up and dropped off at the correct stops, all while avoiding collisions with following buses. The winner is the one who transports the most passengers. Traffic signs and pedestrian crossings add to the realism and challenge.

meta.name: Crossword Magic 4.0
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crossword Magic takes an avocational classic into the technological age. If you're one of the millions of people who enjoy crossword puzzles, you can now, with speed and ease, create and play original puzzles. Create, edit, play print - all you do is choose the words; your computer does the work. Challenge yourself or stump others. Create clever cards, announcements, or invitations. If you're a crossword puzzle fan, create some Crossword Magic.

meta.name: Crossword Twister
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.92 KB

Pit your wits against the computer in this game based on a classic crossword puzzle. Assemble words from the letters which the computer provides. You may store up to 4 letters ready for use when required. Letters which cannot be used may be dumped. See how high a score you can achieve.

meta.name: Croussaider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.74 KB

Croussaider puts you in control of a drone helicopter tasked with defending cities from falling alien devices. You move across the sky, react quickly to incoming threats, and shoot them down before they reach the ground. As attacks accelerate, pressure rises, making precise aiming and constant movement essential. The straightforward defence concept builds strong tension – a reflex-driven challenge that rewards timing, awareness, and quick decision-making.

meta.name: Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.57 KB

Crown is a German slot machine simulator with a royal theme.

meta.name: Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crown is an unusual platformer where you travel through six different countries to ultimately become king. Since the levels are non-linear, you can choose the order in which to play them. Each stage features completely different mechanics: In England you ride a knight on horseback, jumping obstacles and collecting 80 shields. In Scandinavia you control a Viking in a boat, dodging whales and gathering treasure chests. In Russia you play a bear who must mimic a girl's dance to earn money. In Japan you guide a small dragon leaping from island to island, collecting most of the flying objects to avoid starving. In India you help a boy cross a bridge, dodging flying bananas and catching mice. Finally, in Arabia you fly on a magic carpet, catching at least half the lamps to stay airborne.

meta.name: Cruel Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cruel Zone throws you into a relentless battle between the heavens and hell of outer space. In classic Space-Invaders style, you pilot your ship through endless waves of enemies raining fire upon you. Each level grows tougher, the attacks faster, the gaps narrower – testing your reflexes and your nerve. Amid blazing suns, alien worlds, and metallic fortresses, you fight for seconds, lives, and points. In this zone, there's only one rule: survive.

meta.name: Crunch Point
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.63 KB

Crunch Point puts you in the role of a last-chance fighter sent into an enemy base on the moon Evans to stop a mad scientist from enslaving the galaxy through mind control. In this side-scrolling SHMUP, you battle relentless robot guardians while navigating through deadly terrain. Only by destroying the heart of his control system can freedom be restored – and madness defeated.

meta.name: Crusade in Europe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crusade in Europe places you in the decisive phase of World War II, focusing on tactical decision-making in the European theater of 1944–45. You plan operations, maneuver units with strong historical accuracy, and adapt your strategy to different starting conditions, reinforcements and difficulty levels. Whether commanding the Allies or the Axis, solo or in a head-to-head match, each scenario demands foresight, careful timing, supply management and positioning. The attention to detail and the option to choose between different unit display styles highlight the game's deep strategic nature.

meta.name: Crush
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crush is a side-scrolling shooter that shares some similarities with the game R-Type.

meta.name: Crush 'em up!
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Crush, Crumble and Chomp!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crush, Crumble & Chomp let you assume the role of a movie-style monster, becoming one of any number of giant crawling, swimming, or flying beasts. Technically CC&C is a strategy game; you have to keep an eye on several statistics, including your health, appetite, and even such minute details as the tilt of your head (helps in aiming breath weapons). Destroy the city before the human military destroys you!

meta.name: CryptoCube
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

CryptoCube challenges you to uncover 20 thematic words spread across the faces of a three-dimensional cube. Your progress is guided by the mascot Wuzzle. Each reveal has different outcomes: an empty square ends your turn with no points, a vowel grants 5 points and another round, and a consonant requires a guess – correct answers reward 10 points and another turn, while wrong ones cost 5 points and end your turn. Bonus squares let you reveal extra tiles on the current face or even on another side of the cube. Players can also add new word lists, making the game useful for practicing spelling.

meta.name: Crystal Castles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Crystal Castles you must help Bentley Bear escape a magical castle by collecting all the scattered gems. The game features an isometric view of multi-leveled castles. But beware – many creatures roam the halls. Occasionally, you'll find a magic hat that makes you temporarily invincible. Each completed castle takes you to a tougher challenge.

meta.name: Crystal Castles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.47 KB

Bentley Bear está atrapado en los castillos de cristal. Para salir, debe recoger todas las gemas que se encuentran en cada castillo. El juego se desarrolla en una falsa vista isométrica en 3D a través de castillos multiplataforma. Cuando Bentley recoge todas las gemas del nivel, pasa al siguiente castillo, más difícil. Bentley tendrá que evitar una gran variedad de criaturas peligrosas que deambulan por los niveles. De vez en cuando aparecerá un sombrero mágico. Si Bentley recoge el sombrero, será temporalmente invencible.

meta.name: Crystal Fever
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crystal Fever features smooth scrolling and impressive animations that intensify the gaming experience. Players navigate through complex levels, collecting crystals and overcoming various obstacles. A standout feature of the game is the integrated level editor, which allows you to create your own levels, which significantly increases replayability.

meta.name: Crystal Frog
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.28 KB

The Crystal Frog is a single player text adventure. "I am in a small clearing in a field. There is nothing in the immediate area but grass all around. I can hear the birds singing in the summer sunshine, together with the fresh country air." Thus starts the game, plunging the player straight into a text adventure where the object is to explore this land, find the eponymous Crystal Frog, and return with it. The player's progress is measured as a percentage score and the maximum possible score of 100% can only be achieved by visiting every location and using specific objects.

meta.name: Crystal Kingdom Dizzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.30 KB

El tesoro de cristal mágico ha sido robado y esparcido por todas las islas, por lo que depende de Dizzy encontrarlos y restablecer el orden. Una vez más, el principal enemigo de Dizzy son los piratas y algunas criaturas isleñas mortales, pero todos los amigos de Dizzy están ahí para ayudar cuando las cosas se ponen difíciles.

meta.name: The Crystal Orb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Crystal Orb draws you into a perilous adventure centered on the hunt for a powerful magical artifact. Deep within the forgotten halls of an ancient castle, riches, secrets, and constant danger await, all under the lingering shadow of a cruel sorcerer. With every step downward, tension rises, and only courage, awareness, and persistence will determine whether you escape with the coveted jewel or fail in the depths.

meta.name: Crystalcave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.82 KB

In Crystalcave the player controls a character through labyrinthine caves to collect scattered crystals while avoiding various obstacles and enemies. The challenge is to collect all the crystals and reach the exit before time runs out. The game is characterized by its fluid controls and appealing graphics, which were impressive for the time.

meta.name: Crystalcave Deluxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

New features in Crystalcave Deluxe include an integrated timer for added incentive and a display of remaining crystals. Background music has also been added to enhance the gaming experience. After completing a level, the remaining time is saved as a score that can be saved to disk. These additions make Crystalcave Deluxe an even more engaging challenge for fans of the original.

meta.name: The Crystals of Carus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Crystals of Carus is a single player text adventure with pictures and music. Ereth, the evil Lord Death, was jealous of the royal family of Carus for they were greatly loved by their people. He resolved to do them great harm and concocted a powerful spell which turned them all to stone. The only way to reverse the spell is to locate the five magical gems that are scattered throughout the land. No one knew how to set about this task so the royal family remained as statues for years until a traveller, the player, arrived and vowed to undo this great wrong.

meta.name: Cube Magik
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cube Magik is a puzzle game inspired by the concept of the famous Rubik's Cube. The player arranges tiles to solve puzzles, drawing from the essence of the iconic Hungarian toy. To enhance the gameplay experience, music for each session can be selected individually. Progress is saved using passwords, allowing players to resume from the last level reached at any time.

meta.name: The Cube
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Cube challenges your spatial thinking in a particularly tricky way: six differently shaped pieces have to be assembled into one complete cube. What seems manageable at first quickly gains surprising depth, because every element must be mentally rotated, shifted, and placed correctly. Several solutions are possible, but patience and strong visualization remain essential. This creates a demanding 3D puzzle whose appeal comes entirely from careful experimentation, persistence, and the satisfying moment when everything finally fits.

meta.name: Cubic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.81 KB

Cubic challenges you to push crates carefully through winding rooms and move them into the right positions. Every move needs thought, because one badly placed crate can quickly block the entire path to the solution. This creates a calm but tricky pushing puzzle – ideal for anyone who enjoys planning, experimenting, and working step by step toward the answer.

meta.name: Cubin'
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Cubis
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Cubotter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.64 KB

Cubotter takes you into a world of malfunctioning machines where hostile robots threaten the balance of their realm. As the last hope, you confront the mechanical menace, dodge incoming attacks and fire precise shots to eliminate the corrupted enemies. With every defeated foe you restore order to the robot domain and fight to prevent your own kind from facing extinction – a relentless mission to secure the survival of your metallic race.

meta.name: Cubulus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.47 KB

How do you turn the venerable Rubik's Cube concept into an interesting computer game? According to cult programmer Tobias Richter, it is viewed from above, with all sides displayed, and allows the player to choose the number of sides, from 4 to 25.nnnnA large number of different starting variants are offered, grouped by level of difficulty. Instead of having level-based progression, you can choose one of them from the start. Various melodies are provided for the ambience.

meta.name: Cuddly Cuburt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.19 KB

Cuddly Cuburt challenges you to change the colored cubes of a pyramid one by one by jumping carefully from tile to tile. Later stages even require multiple jumps on a cube, while more and more enemies bounce across the screen and make every route more dangerous. Side discs return you to the top, but falling off the pyramid can seriously undo your progress. This creates a lively skill game that rewards precise jumps, quick awareness, and steady nerves.

meta.name: Cue Boy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.12 KB

Welcome to this version of 8-ball pool. After picking the number of players (1 or 2), number of frames (1,3,5,7 or 9), colour of the table and if playing the computer, your opponent. Enter your name(s) and it's time for a game. The table is viewed from above and takes up the majority of the screen. At the top of the screen are a few options. Line up the shot, spin, strength of shot and reset the game. Occasionally a man with a big nose appears to update you on your game and a small man appears over the pocket the computer is aiming for.

meta.name: Cunning Running
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.52 KB

In Cunning Running, up to four players explore a top-down landscape to find hidden markers in an orienteering challenge. Using a grid system, they must interpret terrain types like forest, swamp, or open ground and plan efficient routes. Compass directions and map reading are key. The game promotes orientation, planning, and teamwork discussion – making it perfect for classroom use.

meta.name: Cup Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.62 KB

Cup Challenge is an exciting sailing simulation game designed for head-to-head competition between friends and family members. The game challenges players to prove their skills and tactical ability on the water in a head-to-head competition. In Cup Challenge, players steer their boats through various courses and conditions, using wind and waves to maximize their speed and use strategic maneuvers. The goal is to outwit the opponent through skillful navigation and better positioning and reach the finish line first.

meta.name: Cup Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cup Football is a manager game where you choose a European team from 40 European teams and try to get them to the cup final and win it.

meta.name: The Cup
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.57 KB

meta.name: Curse of Babylon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Curse of Babylon takes you to a land once full of life and prosperity, until monsters invaded and left it deserted. Now, a lone adventurer dares to enter the ruins to destroy the reigning evil. The world is built from interconnected screens, maze-like passages, vertical shafts, and treacherous chasms. There are no experience points or currency, but defeated enemies may drop healing potions, weapons, or armor. Many areas are initially locked, requiring you to find keys or return with better gear, while still giving you considerable freedom in how you choose to explore.

meta.name: The Curse of Borgan Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.53 KB

The Curse of Borgan Castle sends you on a dangerous mission into a dark castle filled with traps and hostile forces. You explore rooms, collect special items, and uncover their uses to overcome obstacles and make progress. Every decision matters, as wrong choices can block your escape or prevent the rescue of the princess. The appeal lies in careful exploration, piecing together clues, and gradually unraveling the castle's secrets.

meta.name: Curse of Ra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Curse of Ra" es un juego de puzzle en el que el jugador (Scarab) debe escapar de una pirámide resolviendo acertijos. El jugador debe eliminar todas las piedras de un tablero encontrando sus equivalentes. Sólo se pueden eliminar dos piedras con el mismo símbolo a la vez y deben estar en línea recta, horizontal o verticalmente. No todas las piedras se pueden mover, y hay teletransportadores, obstáculos y desvíos que dificultan el juego. También hay trampas, como el hielo que obliga a Scarab a moverse en una sola dirección.

meta.name: The Curse of Sherwood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.92 KB

The Curse of Sherwood throws you into a dark struggle against the Cult of Sagalia, who have seized Sherwood Forest. Robin Hood and his Merry Men failed in their first assault, and another seems doomed. As Friar Tuck, you set out to find the Bishop of Derby, meant to perform an exorcism, only to discover his corpse clutching a blood-stained parchment. The rhyme inscribed holds the key to defeating the cult once and for all. Armed with sword and wits, you must battle through the forest, uncover secrets, and drive out the forces of darkness.

meta.name: Curse of the Azure Bonds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Curse of the Azure Bonds es la secuela directa de Pool of Radiance. A pesar de algunas mejoras visibles, incluida la interfaz, hay grandes similitudes con su predecesor. Sigues jugando en el continente de Faerune. Te despiertas en una taberna. Tu grupo ha sido atacado y dado por muerto. Cuando te despiertas, tienes marcas en el antebrazo. ¿Quién pudo hacerlas y por qué? Ahora que te falla la memoria tendrás que hacer lo que te digan las marcas o hacer todo lo posible por eliminarlas. Escuchando sólo a tu coraje, decides luchar para recuperar tu libre albedrío...
