meta.name: The Curse of Volcan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Once upon a time, long before your great-grandfather was nothing more than a spark in his father's beer glass, there was a boy named Algernon the Hopeless. He lived on the small island of Rotena, in the middle of the Sea of ​​Storms. Algernon led a simple life and spent most of his time working in his small garden. One day, while digging for potatoes, he found three strange objects. When he rubbed them in his earthy gardening gloves, there was a bright flash. Algernon died, and the curse of Volcan, an evil wizard, awoke.

meta.name: The Curse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.28 KB

The Curse begins with a seemingly harmless visit to a travelling fair, but a glance into a crystal ball suddenly transports you into a strange world filled with mystery and puzzles. In a setting inspired by ancient Egypt, you explore locations, make decisions, and gradually figure out how to find your way back. Your progress is tracked throughout, giving each discovery and solved challenge real significance. The journey thrives on curiosity, careful thinking, and the sense of approaching a larger secret – an adventure where every command brings you a little closer to home.

meta.name: Cursed be the City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cursed be the City is a Gothic-themed text adventure where you play a character called Ashar, and begin your adventure bound to a rack in a dark and damp dungeon. You must find a way to escape this horrid place of misery and fear before the torturer burns out your eyes! As you can tell, this adventure is very dark in places and is not suitable for young children. Once you escape the dungeon you will eventually learn of your preordained quest. The location descriptions are generally rich with detail and it soon feels like you're reading a book. A lot of the characters in this one do have strange names, though, which makes your quest a bit confusing at times. If you're a fan of horror novels, then this one may appeal to you.

meta.name: The Cursed Key
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.66 KB

The Cursed Key traps you inside an abandoned house that quickly reveals itself as a haunted maze filled with puzzles and supernatural dangers. To escape, you search rooms, collect items, and combine them to unlock new areas and move closer to finding the cursed key. Ghosts and deadly hazards constantly pressure you, as every touch drains energy and forces careful movement. With each discovery the tension rises – will you piece together the clues in time and find a way out, or remain trapped forever – an atmospheric experience blending exploration, problem-solving, and suspense.

meta.name: Custer
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Cut-In
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.35 KB

meta.name: Cuthbert Goes Walkabout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cuthbert está en la plataforma de aterrizaje lunar, esperando la visita de estado del jefe federal. Debe encender las luces pasando por los cruces, ubicados en la esquinas de los cuadrados, antes de que los invasores moronians lo atrapen. Míralo hacer su "Danza de la Victoria" antes de atacar al próximo grupo de Invasores Moronians. ¿Podrás inscribir tu nombre en el "Salón de la Fama"? Para hacer que Cuthbert ilumine la plataforma lunar, debe activar los interruptores, que se encuentran en las esquinas de los cuadrados, caminando sobre ellos. Cuando los cuatro interruptores estén encendidos, todo el cuadrado se iluminará.

meta.name: Cuthbert in Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cuthbert in Space, you're on a Federation mission to plunder the Moronians' solar system. On each planet, you must first refuel by using a remote shuttle to retrieve yellow fuel pods and return them to the mothership. As you do, you must dodge or shoot the persistent Intergalactic Police. Once fueled, you collect as much loot as possible – but when a malfunction occurs, you must quickly retrieve spare parts and take off before the Moronians' bomb detonates.

meta.name: Cuthbert in the Jungle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.47 KB

Cuthbert in the Jungle is a direct clone of Activision's classic Pitfall. In a red, blue, yellow and green jungle, your hero (Cuthbert) must run through the landscape, avoiding falling into lakes (some of which appear out of nothing, only to disappear again), being crushed by rolling logs, being bit by snakes, scorpions or other dangerous creatures of the jungle. In the lakes live crocodiles, which can be used as stepping stones as long as their jaws are closed. In order to cross lakes, lianas may also be used, Tarzan-style. For some reason, there is a big cellar beneath the jungle into which Cuthbert may fall. It may be used as a way to avoid the dangers on the surface, but it is also inhabited by nasties, and you may run into a cul-de-sac. To spice things up, you only have 20 minutes to reach the end.

meta.name: Cuthbert in the Tombs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.88 KB

In Cuthbert in the Tombs, you play as Cuthbert, who discovers the writings of ancient explorer Jesmon Hys and ventures into the Tombs of Ledromica in search of treasure and the hidden Temple of Rah. This flick-screen maze game challenges you to explore room by room, collecting treasures and bonuses while avoiding or shooting monsters with sideways-only fire. Monsters appear a few seconds after you enter a screen, and touching one costs a life. You'll also need keys to open doors – but you can carry only one at a time. Smart planning and quick reflexes will lead you to the hidden temple.

meta.name: Cutthroats
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cutthroats takes you to the small seaport island of Hardscrabble – hardly the most exciting place to be. But as a skilled diver, you get the rare opportunity to explore the depths and salvage treasures from one of four shipwrecks. With some luck, you'll gain not only immense wealth but also the respect of the old sea dogs who have underestimated you until now.

meta.name: Cyber World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cyber World, you live in a city ruled by a tyrannical computer. As a citizen with a special mission, you hunt down terrorists on command, shoot them in a top-down cityscape, retrieve their disks, and earn money and promotions. But your loyalty is constantly tested through strange personality quizzes. Answer wrong, and you become the hunted. Buy, obey, survive – or be eliminated.

meta.name: Cyberball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.94 KB

Ábrete camino a golpes hasta el poste de la portería en Cyberball el deporte nacional del siglo XXI. Grandes Robots luchan a brazo partido por avanzar yardas en este campo de fútbol de metal crujiente del futuro. Y cuando la acción se torne crítica, ¡la pelota explotará!

meta.name: Cyberball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ábrete camino a golpes hasta el poste de la portería en Cyberball el deporte nacional del siglo XXI. Grandes Robots luchan a brazo partido por avanzar yardas en este campo de fútbol de metal crujiente del futuro. Y cuando la acción se torne crítica, ¡la pelota explotará!

meta.name: Cyberblocks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cyberblocks is an unusual puzzle game that visually resembles Tetris but follows different rules. Blocks fall from above into a marked field, with arrows showing their position. Unlike Tetris, you cannot control the falling blocks, only those already on the ground, which you shift left or right to create space. The goal is to arrange the blocks so they form the required cyberblock shapes and are destroyed. If this happens in the marked region, a background image is revealed and the stage is cleared. When blocks of the same texture touch, they merge into a larger element that cannot be separated. The game ends when you run out of cyberblocks or the tower grows too high. Before each level you can choose between two difficulty settings, each with different region shapes.

meta.name: Cyberchess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cyberchess is a 1-player chess teaching and playing tool based upon a mechanical chess playing machine. Based upon a series of four previously played games between chess grandmasters, the player must set up their own chess board and follow along with these games. Gameplay consists of multiple-choice questions, where the player tries to guess the move the grandmaster player made next. If the player gets the move correct, they are rewarded with points. If they guess incorrectly, they are docked points based upon how poor their move was in relation to the the grandmaster. The score is followed through the game, with the player ultimately being rewarded a final score based upon their chess game.

meta.name: Cyberdyne Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Players control a space marine who must search for droids on three planets - Geminus, Sirius, and Arius - while avoiding the planet's inhabitants and hazards. Energy is lost when players come into contact with an inhabitant. Up to three weapons can be used to destroy the inhabitants. Once all the droids have been collected, players make their way to the next planet where new inhabitants are introduced and the number of droids to be collected increases. Players have a limited amount of time to do this, but as well as energy and ammo, it can be replenished by purchasing more at the shop (only one shop per planet).

meta.name: Cybermen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.34 KB

After battling Meanies in Bonka, you must now fight against Cybermen to collect as much Platignum as you can from a Cosmic Space Station in this flick-screen top view maze game. Each screen has various numbers of Cybermen programmed to protect the Platignum from intruders, and they must be avoided or shot while you escape through various open doors on the edge of the screen. The Platignum is randomly placed around the station so some screens contains it while others don't and you can't go back the way you came once you go through a door. If you stay on a level for too long then a Overseer appears and is indestructible so you must leave the screen to lose it. If you are shot, touch a Cyberman or Overseer, or touch the walls then you lose one of three lives.

meta.name: Cybernoid : The Fighting Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.26 KB

Los piratas han asaltado los depósitos (almacenes) de la Federación, llevándose consigo valiosos minerales, joyas, munición y modernas armas de combate. La Federación te ha encargado que recuperes la carga y la devuelvas a los almacenes. Tu tiempo es limitado. Si lo consigues ganarás muchos puntos y una nave extra.
Los piratas han activado todos sus sistemas planetarios de defensa, evítalos y enfréntate a la tripulación de la nave pirata. Si no consigues llegar a los depósitos dentro del tiempo acordado, o si el valor de la carga recuperada es insuficiente, perderás una de tus naves Cybernoid.

meta.name: Cybernoid II : The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.03 KB

Al mando de la mortífera nave Cybernoid, tu misión es rescatar la carga que ha sido robada por una oleada de barcos piratas.
El uso correcto de la gama de sistemas de armas es, una vez más, un factor clave. Entre ellas se incluyen cañones de puntería lateral, bombas que rebotan, bombas "buscadoras" inteligentes, bombas que se mueven por el borde de la pantalla antes de encontrar un objetivo y bombas de tiempo que explotan segundos después de que las lances. Los barcos piratas derribados sueltan cargamento, y tienes que recoger el suficiente a través de numerosas pantallas. Tienes que escapar lo más rápido posible, ya que algunas pantallas son más peligrosas que otras, y no todos los alienígenas de cada pantalla actúan igual.

meta.name: Cybertrap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.22 KB

Cybertrap is an adaptation of Othello played on an 8x8 board. The goal is to strategically place your pieces to trap and flip your opponent's pieces to your color. The player with the most squares in their color at the end wins.

meta.name: Cybertron Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.69 KB

Cybertron Mission is a top-down game in which the player explores a maze of rooms to find various items. Once you find a safe, complete the level and start the next level. Movement and shooting occur in eight directions. Touching a wall results in instant death by electric shock. Enemies are generated at random positions when a room is entered. If you stay in a room for too long, a "Spook" will appear, a fast-moving creature that penetrates walls but can be temporarily stunned with gunfire. Each level is a maze of 4x4 rooms. In the first level, an item is required and the player is only faced with slow-moving "weirdos". The second level requires two items and adds unpredictable “clones” that shoot back. In the third level, three items are required and the “Cyber Droid” is introduced.

meta.name: Cyberwing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cyberwing sends you into a desperate mission against unknown aliens who have already devastated several colonies and cut off all communication with Earth. Taking remote control of a Cyberwing Mk.3, you fight through hostile formations in an attempt to stop the threat before it can strike again. The grim premise gives the fast space action extra urgency. This creates a direct defensive battle driven by constant fire, quick evasive moves, and the feeling of being the last line of resistance.

meta.name: Cyberworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cyberworld, you play as a Cyberleague agent battling through a hostile sci-fi universe filled with robots, aliens, and deadly tech. From a first-person view, you explore 3D rooms, overcome barriers, and survive space sectors full of warships. With over 100 sprites, multiple character sets, and intense sound effects, this arcade adventure delivers a fast-paced and immersive experience. Quick reflexes and courage are your best allies in this cyber nightmare.

meta.name: Cyberworld
meta.desc:

In Cyberworld, you play as a Cyberleague agent battling through a hostile sci-fi universe filled with robots, aliens, and deadly tech. With over 100 sprites, multiple character sets, and intense sound effects, this arcade adventure delivers a fast-paced and immersive experience. Quick reflexes and courage are your best allies in this cyber nightmare.

meta.name: Cyberzone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.07 KB

Cyberzone is an action-packed shooter game that puts the player in an intense scenario: infiltrating the base of a powerful cybership. The goal is clear - fight through the defenses and hit the man inside the enemy ship. The player must act precisely and quickly, because the cybership defenses are dangerous and merciless. As the game progresses, the player faces a variety of threats, including deadly hunter and scanner ships that precisely position themselves to the player's position. These enemy ships not only offer resistance, but also valuable points when shot down. But caution is advised: the cybership's lasers and the enemy battleships are extremely precise and can quickly take out the player if he or she is not alert.

meta.name: Cybex : The Cosmic-War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Cybex: The Cosmic-War“ is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up, heavily reminiscent of „Armalyte“. The player pilots a spaceship through detailed levels, facing waves of enemies. Various power-ups assist in fending off increasingly powerful foes. The colorful graphics and smooth scrolling make for a visually impressive experience.

meta.name: Cyborg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.87 KB

Cyborg casts you as a half-human, half-machine operative sent on what begins as a rescue mission and quickly turns into a fight for survival. You explore a vast hostile ship room by room, avoiding or confronting aliens and robots while computer terminals reveal vital access codes. Choices involving analysis, examination, and inventory shape your progress, as your limited power supply and regenerating shield force careful action. The appeal lies in combining exploration, tension, and constant pressure as you race to stop an alien threat in time.

meta.name: Cyborg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.89 KB

Cyborg puts you into an escalating defense mission where your objective changes and demands new skills at every stage. You first protect a massive spacecraft from attacking enemies, using a radar for orientation and careful maneuvering to keep your damaged ship operational until a tough final foe ends the section. This is followed by a dangerous tunnel run that tests precise control as speed constantly shifts. In the final phase, you leave your ship and explore an enemy base on foot, collecting crucial items and avoiding patrols to permanently neutralize the threat.

meta.name: Cyborg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Cyborg places you in a dark future where your body has been merged with an artificial intelligence and your survival depends on finding a stable source of energy. You explore an unfamiliar and often hostile environment, analyze clues, and make decisions through text input that shape the course of the story. Interactions with other characters rely on selecting predefined questions to unlock information. The appeal comes from the blend of isolation, technological dependence, and the constant pressure to find a solution in time.

meta.name: Cyborg Hunter 2025
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.14 KB

In "Cyborg Hunter 2025", you assume the role of a cyborg hunter tasked with climbing massive structures like trees, space stations, and pipes to eliminate flying robots.

meta.name: Cybotron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.45 KB

"Cybotron" presenta un futuro sombrío donde la humanidad, por pereza, pierde el control de sus propias creaciones. Lo que comenzó con robots pensantes básicos dio lugar a máquinas inteligentes que lo controlan todo, incluyendo su propia evolución. Los robots crearon unidades letales como Trones, Droides Ejecutores y Púlsares para aplastar a la humanidad. En 100 oleadas implacables, lucharás por sobrevivir y por la oportunidad de entrar en el Salón de la Fama.

meta.name: Cycle Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cycle Knight, you control a high-tech motorcycle equipped with advanced weapon systems. Travel through various lands to rescue the queen and abducted villagers. Your motorcycle can jump and attack enemies, requiring skill and quick reflexes to overcome challenges and complete your mission successfully.

p: Cycles, The - International Grand Prix Racing (USA).D64
n: Cycles, The - International Grand Prix Racing (USA)

meta.name: Cycles - International Grand Prix Racing, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Cycles: International Grand Prix Racing” puts you in the middle of realistic motorcycle races across the globe. Whether on a 125cc, 250cc, or 500cc bike, you compete against nine rivals on authentic tracks from various countries. From qualifying to race day, the action unfolds from the rider's cockpit view, offering a uniquely immersive experience. Depending on the difficulty level, driving aids like automatic shifting are available. You can race a single event – or take on an entire season and fight your way to the top of the leaderboard.

meta.name: Cyclones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cyclones players compete against each other and must outwit their opponents by skillfully placing and moving pieces. The game is characterized by its challenging puzzles and the need for tactical thinking.

meta.name: Cyclons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.58 KB

“Cyclons” is a classic space shooter where you pilot a lone spaceship and battle alien ships to rack up a high score. Before the action begins, you can customize the gameplay: toggle terrain on or off, choose whether your shots ricochet off screen edges, and select from four difficulty levels. Speed, precision, and tactical flying are key to surviving the endless war among the stars.

meta.name: Cygnus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Cygnus, you control a ball through an uneven, cave-like landscape to collect ten magic pots in each level and reach the exit in time. The ball can roll or jump to reach different levels but must avoid falling from great heights. Enemy balls patrol wide plateaus and are best jumped over. Lanterns occasionally light the way, while ray-like bands act as elevators. You have exactly six minutes to gather all pots and find the exit, with pots and remaining time adding to your score.

meta.name: Cylogic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the game, you need to recreate the scene found in the right panel in your game. Put them in the correct order. Cylogic is an incredibly addictive skill and puzzle game that requires not only a steady hand but also quick combination skills.

meta.name: Cylu
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.19 KB

If you are to be honored with the leadership of the Ostan race, you must explore a virtual reality world, collect the 24 objects which have been hidden within, and bring them all back to the base.
Cylu is viewed isometrically, and primarily consists of solving puzzles along the lines of many Ultimate Play the Game titles. Only five objects can be carried at a time, which means the route involves a lot of back-tracking. This is slightly lessened once you find some of the teleport bays, and the key to operate them.
There are 32 numbered forcefields around the game, and these must be deactivated by finding the appropriate silicon chip. Your droid requires regular re-fueling, either from canisters located in the early sections of the game, or from the RFL unit you can pick up later.

meta.name: Cyrus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The purpose of the game is to collect ten energy balls per level while making as little contact as possible with the horde of enemies that are represented in each level. You need the energy balls in order to be able to return from the world of nightmares to your own.
The collected balls are always placed at the bottom of the playing area and stand out from the rest of the background with their pulsating colors. The energy balls are collected by simply flying over them. The number of balls already picked up is displayed in a special field in the bottom frame of the screen. As soon as this field is filled, you and the jet chopper will be transported to the next of the three levels.

meta.name: Cyrus II : The Grand Master
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.32 KB

"Cyrus II" is a versatile chess program suitable for players of all skill levels. It offers rapid moves for beginners and challenging tournament-level play for experts. Features include move takebacks, replaying finished games, and setting up custom positions for problem-solving. The program is intuitive, allowing players to explore its options through experimentation. No matter which keys are pressed, Cyrus will always attempt to interpret the input and respond accordingly.

meta.name: D-2000 IFR-Trainer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

D-2000 IFR-Trainer is a civil flight simulator focused specifically on Instrument Flight Rules (IFR). Sitting in the cockpit of a modern airliner, the emphasis is on precise navigation, proper takeoff and landing procedures, and safely flying using instruments. Weather, visibility, and radio navigation are key elements. Rather than action, it offers a professional simulation experience – realistic, technically demanding, and ideal for flight students and serious sim fans.

Weather, visibility, and radio navigation are key elements. Rather than action, it offers a professional simulation experience – realistic, technically demanding, and ideal for flight students and serious sim fans.

meta.name: D-Bug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.50 KB

D-bug is an educational children's game about debugging and repairing computers.
D-Bug is a game within a game in which the player controls the character Charlie Fix-it, who lives in the player's computer and fixes bugs as they occur. At the start of each session, the human and the computer opponent play a game of Gotcha!
At times the computer breaks down and the secondary game comes into play. The player then controls a character who must diagnose and fix the computer problem. The player determines the computer problem based on the reason why the game stops working.
If the graphics are corrupted, the player knows that the fault lies in the graphics processor.
A number of different errors can be diagnosed and fixed, and if the player successfully completes the repairs they will automatically advance to a more difficult level.

meta.name: D-fuse
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.78 KB

meta.name: Daedalus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.16 KB

Daedalus is a vertically scrolling shooter developed by Andrew Smith using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit (SEUCK). It was published in Commodore Format 1993/03 (Issue #30).

meta.name: Daily Double Horse Racing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Daily Double Horse Racing, you place virtual bets on horse races and try to turn your starting bankroll into a fortune. You can wager on single outcomes like Win/Place/Show or go for multi-horse bets like Exacta, Parlay, Quinella, or the Daily Double. Bets are made at the virtual bookmaker's counter, using race forms and a manual for guidance. Up to ten races per day feature six horses each, with randomized lengths and horses, and a track condition you can select. Horse stats stay static – your judgment and luck will determine your success.
meta.genre: Deportes con animales / Carreras de caballos

meta.name: DAK : Deutsches Afrika Korps
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

DAK: Deutsches Afrika Korps puts you in charge of military operations across the North African theater. You command units, decide on movement and attacks, and seek strategic advantages under constantly changing conditions. The experience centers on tactical judgment, managing limited resources, and precise timing, as each turn can decisively shape the course of the campaign.

meta.name: DAK : Deutsches Afrika Korps
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

DAK: Deutsches Afrika Korps puts you in charge of military operations across the North African theater. You command units, decide on movement and attacks, and seek strategic advantages under constantly changing conditions. The experience centers on tactical judgment, managing limited resources, and precise timing, as each turn can decisively shape the course of the campaign.

meta.name: Dalek Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game you play the role of the Doctor from the BBC science fiction program Doctor Who. The story sees you trying to stop the Daleks from invading earth with help from your companions. The gameplay starts with you flying along the sewers of London on a hover platform blasting monsters with your laser. In later levels the gameplay turns to on foot platform jumping and shooting Daleks and Robomen with your sonic screwdriver and grenades. There are three different incarnations of the doctor for you to play as well as three different companions for a second player to play co-operatively.

meta.name: Dalek's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.13 KB

You have been captured by the Daleks, and your only chance of escape is to collect ten keys and reach the TARDIS without being spotted by the patrolling Daleks. Once all the keys are collected, you must stand next to the TARDIS door to be transported to the next level. Starting from level 2, a Robotroid may appear in the top row, and as long as it remains on the screen, all ladders will be electrically charged.

meta.name: Daley Thompson's Decathlon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.27 KB

Daley Thompson's Decathlon te convierte en el mítico atleta británico para enfrentarte a las diez pruebas más exigentes del atletismo. Desde los 100 metros hasta el lanzamiento de jabalina, todo se decide con waggle furioso de joystick: carreras desenfrenadas, saltos al límite y esfuerzos que queman los músculos… y las palmas de las manos. Tienes tres vidas: falla demasiado y la competición acaba. Cada prueba muestra una marca mínima (para seguir) y el récord mundial (para soñar). No basta con fuerza: necesitas ritmo, precisión y una pizca de obsesión. Puro arcade deportivo ochentero: sudor, pantalla parpadeante y la gloria al alcance… si aguantas hasta el final.

meta.name: Daley Thompson's Olympic Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Daley Thompson's Olympic Challenge starts in the gym with squats, sit-ups and weightlifting – the faster you waggle the joystick, the more you fill the Lucozade bottle and boost your stats. These directly affect your performance in decathlon events like sprinting, long jump, high jump or javelin. The events also rely heavily on joystick waggling. Choosing the wrong type of shoe for an event will severely hurt your chances of winning.

meta.name: Daley Thompson's Super-Test
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Daley Thompson's Super-Test expands the athletic challenge of the original game, testing you across ten distinct Olympic-style events. Instead of a traditional decathlon, you compete in a series of standalone challenges – from shooting and cycling to diving. Each event demands sharp timing, quick reflexes, and precise control. Fail to reach the qualification score and you'll lose one of your three lives. Only consistent performance across all disciplines will earn you victory and prove worthy of Daley Thompson's endurance and determination.

meta.name: The Dallas Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Dallas Quest” begins with a job straight from Sue Ellen: find the map to hidden oil fields – her ticket out from under J.R. Ewing's control. A two-million-dollar reward is on the table, but J.R. is determined to stop you. Your investigation starts at South Fork Ranch, where you encounter familiar TV characters – and a few animals along the way. The trail leads you deep into the South American jungle near Playa Peligro, where challenges are overcome with creativity, courage – and a healthy dose of absurdity. Yes, that includes drugging a monkey with tobacco.

meta.name: Dam Buster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.01 KB

In Dam Busters, the player controls a plane whose goal is to destroy a dam while being shot at by enemy defenses. The game requires precise timing and skill to successfully hit the dam and evade the attacks.

meta.name: The Dam Busters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.47 KB

„The Dam Busters“ is an early flight simulation set during World War II. The game centers on a unit tasked with heavily bombing strategic targets – in this case, dams. The mission is far from easy, as heavy enemy resistance awaits en route. However, the aircraft isn't defenseless – with machine guns on both sides and unlimited ammunition, players can fire at will as enemies approach. Ultimately, the bombing must be carried out manually – so get ready to drop the payload and give them hell!

meta.name: Damsel In Distress
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You must rescue a damsel in distress by moving across different levels to reach her. In doing so, you must first collect all the objects on the screen before you can get to the damsel. You cannot fall off a platform or move from any height, so you must find a route that allows you to jump from platform to platform and collect all the items. Various creatures will appear on the screen and start moving once you step onto their platform, so you must avoid them. Umbrellas can be used to get to lower platforms, but if you fall or touch a creature, you lose one of three lives and must restart the level.

meta.name: Damsels in Distress II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.73 KB

Damsels in Distress II sends you on a perilous rescue mission to free a kidnapped woman from the clutches of a ruthless magician. As you travel through varied locations, you face enemies, collect useful items, and make careful choices to overcome obstacles. The story unfolds gradually, blending exploration with puzzling situations that demand focus and persistence. The ultimate goal is to confront the villain and bring the captive back to safety.

meta.name: Dan Cooper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.85 KB

In Dan Cooper you pilot a plane through hostile skies as the screen continuously scrolls to the right. You must shoot down enemy craft and dodge their attacks to survive and earn points. The title likely refers to the infamous plane hijacker of the same name and was included in the April 1989 issue of Game On. Despite its simple design, the game captures the fast-paced and classic shoot-'em-up spirit typical of its era.

p: Dan Dare - Pilot of the Future (Europe).T64
n: Dan Dare - Pilot of the Future (Europe)

meta.name: Dan Dare : Pilot of the Future
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.36 KB

Mientras grabas un especial de «Esta es tu vida» en tu honor, Dan Dare, la Tierra recibe una transmisión del temible Mekon: amenaza con destruirla usando un asteroide excavado, a menos que lo nombren amo de la galaxia. Sin dudarlo, partes de inmediato en la Anastasia, acompañado del profesor Peabody, tu fiel amigo Digby y su peculiar compañero alienígena, Stripey. Pero al aterrizar, Digby y el profesor son capturados por los Treens y encerrados en lo más profundo del asteroide. Ahora, solo tú puedes rescatarlos y detener al Mekon antes de que su colosal arma alcance la Tierra. Ciencia, heroísmo y un toque de clásica épica británica: porque salvar el mundo no es un trabajo… es un deber espacial.

meta.name: Dan Dare II : Mekon's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.46 KB

En Dan Dare II: Mekon's Revenge, el sediento de poder Mekon regresa con una amenaza aún mayor: sus temibles SuperTreens —ingeniería genética hecha pesadilla— y una nave letal. Como Dan Dare, debes infiltrarte en su fortaleza volante, custodiada por estas criaturas mejoradas. Tu misión: desactivar cajas de control antes de que se agote el tiempo y avanzar al siguiente nivel. Pero el Mekon no se rinde: envía a sus Treens a reactivarlas, obligándote a actuar rápido y con precisión. Tienes seis vidas… pero cuidado: si una explosión te alcanza sin escudo activo, es Game Over inmediato. A cambio, cada 50 000 puntos ganas una vida extra, y recargas de energía están escondidas por la nave —pequeños alivios en medio del caos. Tensión, estrategia y una lucha contra el reloj: porque salvar la Tierra no espera… y el Mekon, menos.

meta.name: Dan Dare III : The Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.48 KB

En la tercera entrega de Dan Dare, nuestro héroe es secuestrado por los malvados Treens y llevado a su satélite científico en órbita alrededor de Venus. Pero Dan no se queda quieto: pronto escapa y se infiltra en su nave. Allí encuentra una lanzadera de emergencia… ¡sin combustible! Así que regresa al satélite para buscarlo. Los bidones están repartidos por cinco niveles, accesibles mediante los teletransportadores del Mekon. Para llegar, debe eliminar a los Treens con armas compradas en terminales —cada disparo, una decisión táctica. Mientras explora con su mochila propulsora (con combustible limitado), el propio Mekon aparece ocasionalmente: abatirlo suele recompensarte con los pods necesarios para activar los teletransportes. Intriga espacial, acción estratégica y un toque de ciencia-ficción clásica: Dan no solo vuela… piensa, y cada salto es una apuesta contra el vacío.

meta.name: Dance of the Vampires
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 130.17 KB

You wake up with a start and subconsciously reach for a pencil and a blank sheet of paper from your desk. Instead, you only feel the icicle-covered sleeve of Uncle's coat. When you open your eyes, the mystery is solved: you are no longer in Uncle's study at the University of Königsberg, where you usually help him. Instead, you find yourself on a narrow path that winds through increasingly dense forests and snow - on another of your uncle's "field trips". This time he is researching vampire bats and their connection to a strange human race for a book. This is of little interest to you, as you are neither adventurous nor do you have a particularly strong stomach. But the eerie wolf calls from the trees around you and the tense atmosphere put you in an oppressive mood.

meta.name: Dancing Bear
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Arrange your own exciting stage performances. Teach the bear to dance; design colorful stage settings; compose music. Combine fun with a learning experience. Introduce sequential programming; enhance perceptual motor skills; develop auditory musical skills. Store dance, stage and music routines all with the touch of of finger.

meta.name: Dancing Feats
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.46 KB

Dancing Feats is a musical game. Arrange your bass, beat, style tempo and endings in different styles such as Jazz, Rock, Blues or Boogie Woogie. Overlay your instrument for playback or just jam and try out different sounds. You can even play acapella, should you so choose. Save your creations on disk for later listening.

meta.name: Dandy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.90 KB

You play either Sheba or Thor (both are active in a simultaneous 2-player game) as you move through 15 dungeons, with the aim of collecting all the available treasure. If this is done successfully, a code will be granted - put them all together at the end of the game. Foes are released in swarms through a control box. Once all these are dead you must destroy the box, to prevent respawning.

meta.name: Danger Drive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.78 KB

Jump, dodge and shoot everything in your way. Collect fuel to progress on this dangerous Danger Drive. A car is desperate to reach its destination, but is constantly being ruthlessly prevented from doing so. The bigger the obstacle, the higher the score. Let's go!

meta.name: Danger Freak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are a stuntman and have to perform death-defying stunts, like riding a motorcycle avoiding obstacles and jumping on ramps, driving a car and jumping onto a helicopter before your car crashes against a wall, and later continue around on jetskis.
Every time you mess a trick up, the scene has to be cut. If there are too many cuts, you'll lose a "life".
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Danger Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.83 KB

"Danger Mission" puts the player in control of a UFO navigating tight caves in search of swords. Avoiding obstacles while managing fuel and energy is crucial. The winding cave systems demand precise control and quick reflexes to prevent collisions and successfully complete the mission.

meta.name: Danger Mouse in Double Trouble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.03 KB

"Danger Mouse in Double Trouble" te lanza a una aventura salvaje donde debes detener al malvado clon de Danger Mouse: primero persigues aviones enemigos en el Aerocar, luego saltas a través de cocodrilos para esquivar animales peligrosos y, finalmente, luchas hasta llegar a la fuente de energía que alimenta al doble, justo a tiempo para salvar a Penfold.

meta.name: Danger Mouse in the Black Forest Chateau
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Danger Mouse in the Black Forest Chateau puts you on a secret mission inside a trap-filled mansion where a dangerous invention must be stopped. Alongside your partner, you explore rooms, examine clues, and make decisions that shape the outcome. Each choice can move you forward or lead to trouble, making careful thinking and observation essential. The experience relies on imagination and problem solving – a light-hearted rescue adventure where every decision brings you closer to the finale.

meta.name: Danger Ranger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Danger Ranger sends you through two dangerous sections filled with keys, treasures, and relentless enemies. First, you jump across several platform levels, collect every key, and make smart use of the lift and your weapon to deal with missed routes and attacking creatures. After that, a second area awaits with treasure chests, deadly masks, and hazardous fire raining in from above and below. The action becomes denser and more demanding with every round – a varied platform adventure that calls for skill, awareness, and quick reactions.

meta.name: Danger Stones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.91 KB

In Danger Stones, you take on the role of the Eye of Sauron and navigate a maze to collect all the dungeon pellets while avoiding the Danger Stones that act as obstacles. As the game progresses, the levels become more challenging with more Danger Stones added and less cover.

meta.name: Danger! Adventurer at Work!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.06 KB

Danger! Adventurer At Work! is a humorous and adventurous game that comes in two parts. It is aimed particularly at beginners and offers a pleasant challenge without being too complex. The plot revolves around the search for a quiet room where time stands still so that you can experience adventures undisturbed.

meta.name: Danger! Adventurer at Work! Two
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.84 KB

"Danger! Adventurer at Work! Two" is the sequel to the humorous text adventure "Danger! Adventurer at Work!". After the success of finding a quiet place to play adventure games, the player is faced with a new challenge: the electricity is turned off. A vaguely remembered letter indicates that the electricity bill must be paid. The task is to find the electricity company's office and pay the bill. The game was released in 1992 by The Guild Adventure Software and once again offers a mix of humor and adventure that is suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

meta.name: Dante's Department Store
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.91 KB

Dante's Department Store throws you into a chaotic department store haunted by ghosts, monsters, and animated merchandise. As you move through the different areas, you must constantly attack and evade threats coming from all directions. The appeal lies in the unusual setting, where everyday items suddenly turn hostile, combined with a fast and direct flow that leaves little room to rest. Each scene demands focus and quick reflexes to survive the transformed store.

meta.name: Dante's Inferno
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.51 KB

Dante's poem 'Inferno' details a man's journey through hell, in the hope of reaching purgatory. This computer game interpretation takes the form of a mazelike arcade adventure. You can hold two objects at a time, to use towards solving the puzzles. The objects you need are located in the initial forest, so lots of backtracking is required. Cross the River Styx through the boatman to reach the nine circles of hell. These represent people who will not go to Heaven based on Christian theologies, from non-Christians to those who breached the Seven Deadly Sins such as sloth and gluttony. Contact with these must be avoided if you are to prove yourself pure enough to enter purgatory.

meta.name: Dare Devil Dennis : The Sequel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.26 KB

“Dare Devil Dennis: The Sequel” tells the bizarre story of Denis, who wins an Oscar for worst stuntman and gets fired – but when his crazy cousin steals the trophy, he's left with no choice but to make his way through a colorful mix of balloons, flowers and movie scenes, riding his bike across platforms, dodging dangers and reclaiming his Oscar piece by piece.

meta.name: The Dare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.73 KB

The night started off so well in The Swan pub for you, Frederick Davies, celebrating your final examinations after years of hard studying for a degree in law. After a few drinks you have been convinced to take on a dare where you are stripped and placed in a closed department store, and your goal is to escape. Pushed into a toilet cubicle you bang your head and knocked-out where you eventually wake up. With a bleeding head in the dark, you must sort your head out, get out of the cubicle before attempting to leave the store without setting off alarms or getting caught. If you do get caught then your career in law will be ruined. The Dare is a text adventure where text on the screen describes your location.

meta.name: Daredevil Dave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.46 KB

In Daredevil Dave, you play a fearless stunt rider aiming to leap over an increasing number of cars. With each successful jump, the ramps spread farther apart, and a flaming hoop adds to the challenge. You've got five bikes, but no brakes – only acceleration. Perfect timing and throttle control are your only tools. Go too fast or too slow, and you'll learn the hard way about gravity and pain.

meta.name: Dari
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.29 KB

meta.name: Dark Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El Caballero Negro ha sumido la tierra en la miseria, y la única forma de acabar con su reinado de terror es adentrarte en su mansión encantada para darle su merecido. Eres el valiente aventurero que asume esta épica misión a través de 14 zonas cada vez más desafiantes.
El juego, en su mayor parte, se juega en vista lateral, con pantallas individuales que debes superar, repletas de cuerdas, jaulas y trampillas. Enemigos que caminan, vuelan y flotan acechan en cada rincón, ¡y muchos reaparecen para ponértelo aún más difícil! Lo que hace único a Dark Castle es tu arma: rocas que puedes lanzar en 360 grados, dando un toque de realismo y estrategia al combate. Las pantallas están conectadas por áreas centrales donde solo tienes que hacer clic en una puerta para avanzar.

El Caballero Negro ha sumido la tierra en la miseria, y la única forma de acabar con su reinado de terror es adentrarte en su mansión encantada para darle su merecido. Eres el valiente aventurero que asume esta épica misión a través de 14 zonas cada vez más desafiantes.
El juego, en su mayor parte, se juega en vista lateral, con pantallas individuales que debes superar, repletas de cuerdas, jaulas y trampillas. Las pantallas están conectadas por áreas centrales donde solo tienes que hacer clic en una puerta para avanzar.

meta.name: Dark Caves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dark Caves is a H.E.R.O. clone in which the you control a treasure hunter searching for treasure under the surface of the earth. Equipped with a jetpack, a short-ranged beam weapon and a limited number of bombs, you must reach the exit before running out of energy. The amount of energy available is displayed at the bottom of the screen. It depletes over time and when the jetpack or the beam weapon is used. When navigating through the caves, you must avoid contact with enemies, spikes and other deadly objects. The beam weapon can be used to dispatch enemies, while bombs are used to destroy walls. If you have run out of bombs, you can also use the beam weapon to destroy walls, which uses up a lot of energy. In the final level, a Tetris-inspired puzzle has to be solved. However, instead of clearing lines, the goal in this case is to fill up the lower part of the screen without leaving a gap. Initially released in Magic Disk 64 1994/04.

meta.name: The Dark Dungeons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.84 KB

After surviving The Dungeons, you now enter the Dark Dungeons to find a magical scroll containing a puzzle that must be solved in order to escape and avoid a fire-breathing dragon and various other creatures.
Because it is a dark dungeon, every room you enter cannot be seen, except for the items you need or interact with. Each room is described with text. You enter a letter to tell the computer your next action. This can include moving in a certain direction, casting spells, opening items, and more. Creatures will also appear and you can attack them before they attack you and weaken or kill you. They must not lose sight of their goal: to find the magic scroll.

meta.name: Dark Empire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.77 KB

In Dark Empire you start with a single captured city on a distant alien planet and attempt to expand your empire from that base. The city serves as your headquarters where you can train troops and build different kinds of transport for air, land and sea operations. Using these units you explore the planet, attack enemy forces and secure new territory. The map only reveals areas you have already explored, and all units are represented by icons. With the cursor you select cities or units and issue commands such as move, attack or hold position. The objective is to capture more cities over the course of the turns and gradually expand your empire.

meta.name: Dark Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dark Force takes place in the year 2173, where an alien power threatens to wipe out the entire solar system with a massive laser weapon. As the last surviving pilot, you face an almost hopeless mission, fighting your way through multiple dangerous sectors to destroy the weapon's power sources. Hostile ships, heavy defenses and changing environments demand constant focus, precise control and endurance. With every success hope grows, but the pressure increases, as only the complete destruction of all generators can prevent total annihilation.

meta.name: Dark Fusion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sólo la élite más selecta ha sido capaz de superar la difícil prueba de los Cuerpos de Guerreros Guardianes; ésta exige una acción continuada para destruir las hordas de seres mutantes; excepcionales aptitudes de control para defenderte de las flotas espaciales de invasiones alienígenas y gran coraje para enfrentarte al monstruo de Foso de la Desesperación en un sangriento y despiadado combate. Después, la prueba más horripilante: entrar en la Cámara de la Metamorfosis para fundir tu esencia con la de tu enemigo vencido o enfrentarte al próximo desafío con los poderes de un simple mortal.

meta.name: Dark Lord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Viaja a través de un espejo mágico que te lleva al Altermundo, donde debes derrotar a Nequam, el Señor Oscuro que mató a tu abuelo. Dark Lord es un juego de aventura en el que el jugador lee una descripción de cada escena e ingresa comandos de una o dos palabras en el aviso. Los comandos reconocidos incluyen OBTENER, EXAMINAR, DAR y DECIR (para tener conversaciones con las personas que encuentres).

meta.name: Dark Lord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Viaja a través de un espejo mágico que te lleva al Altermundo, donde debes derrotar a Nequam, el Señor Oscuro que mató a tu abuelo. Dark Lord es un juego de aventura en el que el jugador lee una descripción de cada escena e ingresa comandos de una o dos palabras en el aviso. Los comandos reconocidos incluyen OBTENER, EXAMINAR, DAR y DECIR (para tener conversaciones con las personas que encuentres).

meta.name: The Dark Planet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You're in orbit around the Dark Planet, and your starship's engine has blown!! Fortunately the Dark Planet has some Viridian crystals that are required for the repairs. You have been stuck with the task of getting the crystals!

meta.name: Dark Side
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.32 KB

In Dark Side, you're beamed to the moon Tricuspid to prevent a deadly threat to planet Evath. The Ketars plan to use ECDs to power the Zephyr One device, unleashing fatal radiation. Your mission: destroy all ECDs in the correct order. Many are linked, and if tackled incorrectly, they regenerate instantly. Equipped with a jetpack, laser, and shield, you explore a vast 3D world filled with buildings, forests, and tunnels. But your shield is limited, fuel is scarce, and Plexors and teleport traps are everywhere.

meta.name: The Dark Side
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.16 KB

In The Dark Side, you control a spaceship that moves up and down along the left edge of the screen. Your mission is to repel incoming waves of aliens attacking from the right. Each wave includes three attacks of the same alien type, and the enemies change color each time they're hit. They shoot back, with some shots aimed directly at you – quick reflexes and dodging are essential. You can push forward briefly, but the ship is constantly pulled back. Three hits and it's game over. Timing and spatial awareness are key to survival.

p: Dark Side, The - The Return of the Christal Ball (USA).T64
n: Dark Side, The - The Return of the Christal Ball (USA)

meta.path: ./Dark Side, The - The Return of the Christal Ball (USA).T64
meta.name: The Dark Side : The Return of the Christal Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.56 KB

In The Dark Side: The Return of the Christal Ball, you play as Clagor, the last descendant of the human wizards. Your task is to return the stolen treasure and the powerful Christal Ball to your city's marketplace. The dark ruler Dran has returned and conquered the planet Cylonis, reigning with ruthless power. To stop him, you must venture through a perilous adventure armed with knowledge, courage, and magic. Goblins, trolls, dragons, and the dark emperor himself stand between you and your goal. Only by thinking wisely, watching your health, and using the correct verbs will you survive and restore balance to the world.
meta.image: Z:/Digistorage/Arley4dCloudMedia/c64/images/Dark Side, The - The Return of the Christal Ball (USA)-image.jpg
meta.thumbnail: Z:/Digistorage/Arley4dCloudMedia/c64/images/Dark Side, The - The Return of the Christal Ball (USA)-thumb.jpg

meta.boxback: Z:/Digistorage/Arley4dCloudMedia/c64/images/Dark Side, The - The Return of the Christal Ball (USA)-boxback.jpg

meta.name: A Dark Sky over Paradise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.06 KB

In the future, Earth's resources have been depleted by the ever-growing population, and the future of humanity seems bleak and harsh. The government, FourNations, has developed a plan to colonize Mars to alleviate Earth's overpopulation. Construction starts well, but costs spiral out of control, plunging Earth into a deep recession. Years later, the project is still underway, but at a sluggish pace, and you are sent to a moon base to receive unknown instructions, possibly related to launching a rocket to further the colonization project. While you are called to various meetings, a bomb explodes. You learn that it is from a terrorist group called the "Mining Group" who want to prevent the rocket launch.

meta.name: Dark Star
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Dark Star" begins with a diary entry dated August 10, 2042, in which Commander Sebastian Roehm describes the crew's dire situation. After landing on an unknown planet, they struggle to set up the essential modules, but morale is low. No one knows if returning to Earth will ever be possible, and uncertainty looms over them. With each passing hour, the risk of panic and hysteria among the crew increases.

meta.name: Dark Tower
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are trapped inside the dark tower and must find a way to escape. Dark Tower is a text adventure with an excellent parser. We don't want to say anything about the solution to this adventure at this point, because we don't want to take the tension off you. We therefore wish you a lot of fun puzzling!

meta.name: The Dark Tower
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Dark Tower tells the story of Prince Harry, who has been turned into a mutant by the tower's guardian. To regain his human form, he must collect gems scattered across 28 tower locations. Secret letters are revealed after collecting all gems, forming a puzzle to solve at the end. Each area offers multiple exits, so Harry doesn't have to conquer every location. But dangers await: roaming creatures he must leap over, chasms to swing across with ropes, falling daggers that block his path, and slopes that can't be climbed back up.

meta.name: The Dark Tower
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.36 KB

The Dark Tower te presenta como un joven novicio enviado por el abad para recuperar el legendario Cáliz Dorado, robado por una banda de orcos merodeadores que saquearon el monasterio y huyeron a la Torre Oscura, más allá de la Montaña Sombría. También secuestraron al líder de la manada de unicornios, lo torturaron y lo liberaron en el bosque. Debes recuperar tanto el cáliz como el unicornio, siendo este último tu único camino a casa. Aunque los monjes te acompañan hasta el límite del bosque, huyen a la primera señal de peligro, dejándote solo para enfrentarte a él.

meta.name: The Darkest Road
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 83.22 KB

The first part of a two-part text adventure that sees you stomping through marshes, wiggling your toes in magic shoes and snogging a mermaid. You also have to save the land from the evil ravages of the Black Wanderer with the magical power of the Silent Song.

meta.name: Darkhorn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

There are 4 sides battling to take command of Darkhorn - all can be played by human players, all giving orders simultaneously. You can be a dwarf, human or elf. The land consists of nine different map regions, with different terrains suiting different sides. Once an overall winner is found, they must face the Final Trial to take overall control. Alternatively, you can play a quick battle on one of the sixteen provided maps, or generate one at random. Choosing locations to occupy and when to fight is critical. Sword fighting is represented by a short action sequence.

meta.name: Darkipede
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Darkipede delivers a twisted take on the familiar Centipede formula and focuses on fast, direct action in a dark setting. Rather than taking its time, the game throws you straight into frantic action where you have to react to attacking creatures and keep the screen under control. That simple but effective idea gives it a sharp arcade appeal that works immediately and gives the game its own small identity.

meta.name: Darkland : The Lost Realm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.58 KB

Darkland: The Lost Realm draws you into a bizarre world where movement feels jumpy and every action must be carefully judged. You collect items, avoid attacks, and defend yourself with a highly elastic ball that serves as an unusual yet effective weapon. Armed enemies continuously descend from above, creating constant pressure and leaving little room to breathe. Despite multiple lives, the difficulty is unforgiving and demands patience, precise timing, and perseverance.

meta.name: Darkman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based on the film by Sam Raimi.  You play Peyton Westlake, returned from the dead as the many faced "Darkman", seeking your revenge against mobster Robert G.Durant.   Live through all the high spots of the movie - the breathtaking helicopter fight sequence - the skyscraper shoot-out - dice with death as you swing into heaving freeway traffic dangling from a helicopter.

meta.name: Darkness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 70.85 KB

While traveling over Africa a plane carrying adventurer Stan and his girl Megan crash lands in the jungle. Upon waking Stan cannot find his girl. Then, from the jungle he hears a scream - his beloved is in trouble! With only a rock as a weapon Stan sets off into the deep, dark Jungle.

meta.name: Darkon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Darkon" you explore a vast fantasy world, interact with different characters and face numerous challenges. It is a homage to the "Ultima" series, which is known for its deep role-playing experiences.

meta.name: Darkon II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Darkon 2" is a homage to the "Ultima" series, which is known for its deep role-playing experiences. In "Darkon 2" you explore a vast fantasy world, interact with various characters and face numerous challenges.

meta.name: The Dark Sword
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Darksword sends you on a perilous quest in which you take on the role of a hero searching for a legendary weapon of great power. As you progress through various areas, you explore the environment, collect useful items and defend yourself against numerous enemies determined to stop you. The experience is driven by constant movement, careful play and the balance between combat and exploration, with the ultimate goal always in sight – uncovering the mythical Darksword.

meta.name: Darksyde
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Darksyde, pilotas una ágil nave espacial que gira como en Uridium, mientras luchas a través de quince niveles de desplazamiento horizontal. En cada fase, debes destruir oleadas de atacantes alienígenas para que aparezcan relojes de arena coleccionables. Una vez reunidos, entras en la Fase 2, donde te espera un poderoso jefe. La velocidad, los reflejos y la potencia de fuego son clave para sobrevivir a cada desafío y liberar al universo de su amenaza.

meta.name: Darkwood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

History of Darkwood Like most lands, the truth of Darkwood's origins are shrouded by the myths of cultural memory. It is a kingdom comprised of loosely aligned territories once ruled by the outworlder queen, Yannah. Since her apparent death some 5 years ago, the kingdom has fallen victim to all the ills caused by the politics of petty jealousies and power struggles. Other lands that were once allied or even a part of Darkwood have also suffered. Belynu is nearly at war. The City-State of the Shrines has become inaccessible, and Maegeca is lost, simply gone: people whisper of it as if it was never anything more than a myth.

meta.name: Darth Vader : Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.65 KB

In Darth Vader: Adventure, you infiltrate Vader's battlecruiser disguised as a merchant ship to undertake a desperate rescue mission. The princess has been captured, her necklace holds the secret location and power of the Freedom Forces, and the rebels' treasury is in enemy hands. Your goal: rescue the princess, retrieve the necklace and the treasure – or at the very least, sabotage Vader's plans to preserve peace. Stormtroopers are everywhere, and only a stealthy hero stands a chance. Caution and courage will determine the fate of the galaxy.

meta.name: Dasher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dasher cleverly blends elements of Pac-Man and Lode Runner. You collect points, avoid enemies, and use platforms and ladders to navigate maze-like levels. It's not just about speed but also about smart pathfinding – an exciting mix of urgency and strategy.

meta.name: Dater, The II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The "Dater II" is the sequel to the original "The Dater".
In this game you control a ball that has to move through different mazes to save it. In each labyrinth you have to overcome various difficulties and pitfalls. There are laser doors with automatic closers, mandatory passages and various pitfalls (which become increasingly difficult as the level increases). You must be skilled at using the joystick because any hesitation or mistake could result in you losing a life. You also have to be quick because even if you hesitate and stay in the same place for longer than a certain time, you will lose a ball. To pass a level and move on to the next, you must safely get your ball to the exit.

meta.name: The Datestones of Ryn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Datestones of Ryn casts you as Brian Hammerhand – a reluctant mercenary, unlucky enough to draw the shortest straw and earn the most perilous mission. Retrieve the sacred stones and the head of Rex the Reaver – or fall in disgrace, slain by a blade from the shadows. The honor of the duchy rests in your hands. The journey is brief – but deadly.

meta.name: Dave Speed and the Mutants
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, players take on the role of Dave Speed, who has decided to explore a strange land where he grew up. Creatures threaten to hurt Dave wherever he goes, but Dave can stomp on these creatures to destroy them. If he eats chicken legs on the go, Dave becomes angry and can destroy creatures simply by walking into them. Some creatures leave behind fruit when destroyed, and getting them increases Dave's energy. There are rings scattered everywhere he goes, and collecting 100 of these rings results in an extra life.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Dave Winfield's Batter Up!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dave Winfield's Batter Up! is an educational baseball game created with pro player Dave Winfield. The first part, “Lessons with Dave Winfield,” includes five segments teaching grip, stance, pitch, swing, and hitting strategy. Then comes “Slugfest,” where it's all about landing the perfect hit. Whether solo or competing with up to three others – this is where you put your training to the test.

meta.name: Dave Winfield's Batter Up!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dave Winfield's Batter Up! is an educational baseball game created with pro player Dave Winfield. The first part, “Lessons with Dave Winfield,” includes five segments teaching grip, stance, pitch, swing, and hitting strategy. Then comes “Slugfest,” where it's all about landing the perfect hit. Whether solo or competing with up to three others – this is where you put your training to the test.

meta.name: Pitfall!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.26 KB

Pitfall! es una aventura clásica de plataformas donde encarnas a Harry, el Explorador, en su incursión por la selva en busca de tesoros: lingotes de oro, plata, bolsas de dinero y anillos de diamantes. Pero la jungla no perdona: troncos rodantes y caídas restan puntos; escorpiones, cocodrilos, serpientes, fuegos, pantanos y pozos sin fondo te cuestan una vida. Tienes solo 20 minutos para recogerlo todo. Cada salto, cada cuerda columpiante, cada decisión debe ser precisa. Porque aquí no basta con ser valiente: hay que ser ágil, rápido… y tener un poco de suerte. ¿Lograrás salir de la selva rico… o serás solo otro explorador olvidado entre las lianas?
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: David's Midnight Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Midnight Magic es un juego de pinball simple diseñado para 1-4 jugadores. El juego se inspira en la mesa de pinball Caballero Negro lanzada por Williams. El juego representa la primera generación de simulaciones de pinball para ordenador personal disponible con características de pinball relativamente realistas.

p: Davy - King of the Wild Frontier (Europe).T64
n: Davy - King of the Wild Frontier (Europe)

meta.name: Davy : King of the Wild Frontier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.07 KB

Davy: King of the Wild Frontier puts you in the role of Davy, stripped of his gear, clothes, and girlfriend by Indians. In this side-view flick-screen game, you must move from left to right across each screen to retrieve clothing or equipment pieces. On every screen, an Indian appears, hurling arrows or tomahawks that you must dodge by ducking or jumping. Later stages introduce rivers you must cross on moving logs, as well as snakes and cacti once your girlfriend has been rescued. With only three lives, survival depends on quick reflexes and careful timing.

meta.name: Davy Jones Locker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.34 KB

Davy Jones Locker begins in a lifeboat drifting on the open sea – the clipper Allana has sunk, and only five people and a small dog have survived. As you float with Big Jake, Pedro, Shamus, an unnamed woman, and the dog, a ship slowly emerges from the fog. Is it salvation – or something sinister? What follows is a mysterious adventure full of choices, puzzles, and dark turns – where survival is anything but certain.

meta.name: Dawn Beyond UB-11 : Motorhead II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.44 KB

Dawn Beyond UB-11: Motorhead II is the sequel to Motorhead and is set in a futuristic sci-fi world. The player once again battles enemy forces to secure various areas of a planet. The action-packed combat demands quick reflexes and precision as the player navigates through challenging levels.

meta.name: Dawn Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Dawn Patrol you take command in a dangerous naval conflict, carrying out a series of missions that draw you deeper into the war. You track enemy targets, plan your operations carefully, and aim to strike critical blows against opposing supply lines. Each mission presents new risks, requiring tactical skill and a strong sense of timing. Only by successfully completing your assignments can you contribute to ultimate victory.

meta.name: Dawn Treader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dawn Treader is the second video game in the Narnia series and is based on the third book. As the captain of the ship Dawn Treader, you navigate through storms, hurricanes, and sea serpents to reach various islands. There you encounter dragons, invisible one-legged creatures, and other fantastical beings. At the end of the journey, you reach Aslan's Country and the World's End, where card and dice adventures determine whether you complete your mission successfully.

meta.name: A Day at the Races
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.82 KB

“A Day at the Races” is a simple yet charming betting game where greyhounds chase a mechanical rabbit. As the player, you pick one of three dogs to win and then watch the race unfold to see if your choice was correct. The presentation evokes the atmosphere of a classic racetrack, complete with scoreboard and finish line. With no complex controls or strategy, the game focuses purely on the thrill of betting and cheering – a lighthearted dive into the world of race wagering in 8-bit style.

meta.name: The Day Before
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Day Before places you in a tense scenario where you must gradually uncover and avert an impending global catastrophe. You explore locations, gather clues, and make choices that shape the course of the story, while political intrigue and personal motives intertwine in the background. Puzzles, exploration, and narrative elements work together to create a constant sense of uncertainty. In the end, the outcome depends on how carefully you proceed and what conclusions you draw from the information you uncover.

p: Day in a Life of a Prehistoric Man, A (USA) (Unl).D64
n: Day in a Life of a Prehistoric Man, A (USA) (Unl)

meta.name: A Day in a Life of a Prehistoric Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A Day in the Life of a Prehistoric Man is a collection of six mini-games presented in the style of a TV show that depicts the daily life of a prehistoric man. Hosted by Salisbury Smythe, he narrates the gameplay and explains the challenges you'll face. The mini-games include collecting bones in a maze, catching flying dinogophers for food, rescuing your wife from the clutches of a cave ape, dodging fire and pteranodons, gathering diamonds while encountering bats, and surviving chaotic traffic filled with mammoth herds. Each challenge presents new dangers to overcome before moving on to the next game.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.31 KB

meta.name: Days of Thunder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.53 KB

Tom Cruise's film brought NASCAR racing to the masses, and Mindscape did the same for games players with this license. If you mentally change the driver names, it can be thought of as a recreation of real NASCAR racing rather than a direct recreation of the film. 
You play Cruise's Cole Trickle character (his name, like many of the others, is slightly different to that of a real NASCAR racer of the day) against your rivals on 8 tracks, based on real-life counterparts. The races are all on ovals, although the exact lengths, corner types and gradients are varied.  This means that the ideal racing line on one track can put you into the wall on another. Qualifying is incorporated alongside the races themselves.
From times to times you'll have to pull into the pit stop area. When doing so, you control the five members of the pit crew. Loosing time on pit will make you loose positions at the race. The other racers, however, never pit.
The NES version has 3rd-Person perspective only.

meta.name: De'Sign
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.44 KB

meta.name: Deactivators
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.99 KB

Deactivators blends puzzle-solving with arcade action, putting you in charge of a team of bomb disposal droids. You must collect them and throw them out of the building in time, as failure costs both a droid and parts of the level itself. Expanding grid-based layouts demand careful navigation and mapping, with doors, trapdoors, and poles shaping every route. Patrolling security droids add pressure but can be outsmarted with clever movement. A central control room enables teleporters and force fields, while later stages introduce shifting gravity and distorted directions, greatly increasing the demand for accuracy and planning.

meta.name: Dead End
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Dead End you take on the role of Sam Miller, a private detective who has been hired to solve the murder of Miles Dunbar and find the killer. At the beginning you are questioned by a police lieutenant before the action switches to the day before. Now you must collect clues and talk to various people to find answers to the questions surrounding the murder. The game ends when you give the lieutenant the right answers to his questions. The display shows you the environment as well as people and objects, while occasionally images visualize your current situation. To interact with the world, enter commands using the keyboard.

meta.name: Dead or Alive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.08 KB

Unos bandidos han invadido Dodge City, decididos a escapar con el botín. Como sheriff, tu trabajo es detenerlos en un juego parecido a Commando, pero sin la ambientación militar. Tu personaje tiene munición limitada, y puede reponerla pasando por encima de soldados muertos. También debes vigilar tu nivel de sed, y dirigirte al hotel de la parte superior de la pantalla antes de que llegue a cero. Además de los bandidos, su caballo cruza regularmente la pantalla y debe ser evitado.
Como extra, la versión Spectrum incluye un juego gratuito llamado A-Maze, basado en laberintos.

meta.name: Deadzone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.07 KB

Deadzone thrusts you into an intergalactic conflict where every scene presents a new challenge and a fresh style of combat. One moment demands lightning-fast reflexes, the next careful planning and tactical precision. Your enemies are powerful and relentless, and only skill and strategy will ensure survival. Blending action, variety, and intensity, Deadzone delivers a space adventure designed to push even seasoned players to their limits.

meta.name: Deadenders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.66 KB

Deadenders is a humorous text adventure with graphics that is a parody of the British television series "Eastenders". Deadline es un videojuego de detectives de ficción interactiva. El jugador es un detective de policía anónimo, convocado a una extensa finca de Connecticut para investigar el aparente suicidio del rico industrial Marshall Robner. Los sospechosos , que deambulan por la finca siguiendo sus propios intereses durante la investigación, son: Sra. Leslie Robner (esposa), Sr. McNabb (jardinero), Sra Rourke (ama de llaves), Sr. Baxter (socio comercial), Sra. Dunbar (secretaria). Una acusación oportuna puede hacer que un sospechoso desconcertado revele información previamente oculta. Sin embargo, para que un arresto sea efectivo, el jugador debe poseer pruebas contundentes de los tres elementos básicos: motivo, método y oportunidad . Sin estas, el juego termina con una descripción de por qué se liberó al presunto culpable. Los comandos de examen y registro están presentes, y también pueden tomarse huellas dactilares de objetos o pedirle al Sargento Duffy que las analice.

In Deadline you pilot a spaceship on a mission to rescue scientists from war-torn planets. Your task is to fly across the planet's surface and pick up scientists floating in the water. Once aboard, they appear on the teleport monitors of your ship. You must then fight off enemy ships and protect the scientist until he can be safely teleported away. The teleport becomes available only after you destroy a certain number of enemies. Different difficulty levels increase the challenge by requiring you to rescue more scientists.

You survived the onslaught and pillaging as a young boy from the attack by the monsters belonging to The Evil Ones who took the Princess child and the ancient scrolls that protected the land from them. Now you are a man, a warrior, who is the only man left in a land full of old people, women and children and you have vowed to return the scrolls and the Princess back to the people. You must first journey through a forest killing The Evil Ones monsters and collecting six pieces of the scrolls before entering a castle. Inside the castle you must kill more monsters as well as collect keys to open doors to rescue the Princess and escape from the castle to safety.
Deadly Evil is a side view scrolling game with platform elements where the screen scrolls either to the left or right when you move your hero. Starting on the far left of the forest you must go walk to the right avoiding or killing monsters with your sword that attack you collecting pieces of the scroll you find. Obelisks scatter the land and must be avoided because if you touch one then a wizard appears firing at you for a brief moment. Once the six pieces of the scroll have been found you then enter the castle and once again keep walking to the right until you find the Princess. Once found, you must then take her out of the castle making sure she isn't killed. During the game, if you touch any monster, get hit by any weapon then you lose part of an energy gauge (a heart on the C64) and when this empties then it is game over. Once you have the Princess she also has an energy gauge.

Their task is to defeat the enemy by skillfully dealing with the constantly horizontally moving asteroids that serve as protective shields. Do your best to avoid the deadly acid rain and reach the yellow switch on top of the screen by putting together a ladder from pieces found on the other side of the screen in this fast paced action game. There are three buildings which you can use as shelter, however the rain will eventually eat away at those as well.

Deadringer is a 1st person perspective racing game set in the future where you have to race an armoured skimmer on a ring made up of various parts to survive as well as compete against other competitors. The ring is made up of four parts with an inside edge and an outside edge, with the outside the most dangerous to drive on but the competitors can drive on any part they want. A timer counts down and you have to still be on the track when it reaches zero to win the race. As you drive various objects appear like walls, gates and mines as well as the other competitors but you are armed with a cannon which fires forwards and follows the ring. You can take so many hits but if you crash into an object then you lose one of three lives. A warp gate also appears which moves you to another part of the track.
