Death Knights of Krynn es el segundo capítulo de la épica saga Dragonlance y la secuela de “Champions of Krynn". Puedes importar tu grupo del juego anterior o crear nuevos héroes con la clásica creación de personajes de mesa: raza, clase, atributos y alineamiento moldean tu estilo de juego, aunque el alineamiento rara vez afecta a la historia. Esta vez, te enfrentas a una amenaza no muerta que convierte a los aliados caídos en enemigos aterradores y propaga la corrupción por Krynn. Debes descubrir y destruir la fuente antes de que la tierra se convierta en un reino de muertos. No hay lugar para la diplomacia: los problemas se resuelven con acero, hechizos y pura determinación. Las batallas son tácticas, los desafíos intensos y la lucha contra la corrupción, implacable.

As the pilot of the Ford Prefect 2174, you must navigate perilous corridors and take down waves of Quasar Star Fighters across nine intense levels. Each hit brings you closer to victory, but one mistake could mean extinction. Only precision, courage, and lightning-fast reflexes can save humanity from its final doom.

They are looking for the rare ore Aix, which can prolong life but causes severe aging in its raw form. Through the "Quota Law", the Empire forces humanoid planets to provide workers for the mines, otherwise they face annihilation. When Earth resists, the Empire plans to destroy it with a massive battle station, the DeathStar. The player controls the fighter Starfighter One and must penetrate the station and hit the reactor. He starts in a hangar, launches into space, crosses the trenches of the DeathStar, dodges lasers, defeats enemy fighters and hits the reactor at the perfect moment to stop the Empire.

You're chosen to stop them. Your fighter moves automatically through an endless tunnel, and you control the crosshair to target and destroy incoming enemies. Later, you face massive warships and the Varg mothership. Your ship has two independent fuel tanks, and in critical moments, you can teleport out of the arena. Vector graphics and a 3D perspective give the game its distinctive look.

Este juego se basa en Death Wish 3 (1985): un amigo de Kersey es asesinado en Nueva York, y él sale a las calles para ayudar a la policía a acabar con bandas violentas que siembran el caos. Lleva chaleco antibalas (resiste varios impactos) y puede usar cuatro armas: la 475 Wildey Magnum, escopeta, ametralladora y lanzacohetes. ¡Cuidado!: no debes disparar a ancianas, transeúntes inofensivos ni agentes.

meta.name: Decathlon

In Decathlon you compete in ten different athletics events inspired by the Olympic decathlon. Up to four players can take part, either playing through all events in sequence or selecting individual ones. The events include the 100-meter dash, long jump, shot put, high jump, 400-meter race, 110-meter hurdles, discus throw, pole vault, javelin throw and the 1500-meter race. In the running events you rapidly move the joystick to build speed while pressing the button at the right moment, for example to clear hurdles without losing momentum. In the jumping and throwing events you build up power and then release at the correct time to achieve the best result. Points are awarded for each event based on your performance, and the player with the highest total score at the end wins the gold medal.

Deceptor drops you into a futuristic world where you take on the role of a mysterious being in search of a destiny defined by your elders. You navigate extended corridors, avoid dangerous inhabitants, and rely on the unique ability to transform in order to overcome obstacles. Switching between land and air forms opens different paths and requires constant adaptation, as touching the ground immediately changes your situation. The experience centers on movement, timing, and smart use of transformations, tightly linking exploration and survival.

The game covers the North African theater during World War II.
Five different scenarios with multiple variants can be played. This, along with multiple levels of difficulty, gives the game significant replay value. Battles occur in real-time, though orders may be issued while the game is paused.

meta.name: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War Vol.1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Decisive Battles of the American Civil War, Vol. 1" puts the player in the role of a general during six battles of the American Civil War – including Bull Run, Shiloh, and Antietam. Beyond issuing orders, the player can decide how actively to engage in combat. Commands can only be given to nearby brigades, while subordinates with their own experience and leadership abilities influence execution. Outside the range of communication, only strategic foresight remains. The game delivers a fast-paced simulation with one-hour turns, limited reconnaissance, and a strong focus on casualties and morale. Maps, reports, and a straightforward command menu assist in planning. Victory points are determined by losses and control objectives. Adjustable difficulty levels, a two-player mode, and scenario editors expand the strategic options.

"Decisive Battles of the American Civil War, Vol. 2" allows the player to relive five more critical battles of the American Civil War – including Gaines Mill, Stones River, Gettysburg, Chickamauga, and Chattanooga. Just like the first volume, this turn-based, hex-based wargame focuses on simulating the limited control, restricted communication, and "fog of war" of a 19th-century battlefield, providing a challenge for players commanding either Union or Confederate forces. In addition to single and two-player gameplay, an editor is available – allowing the creation of custom scenarios.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.74 KB

meta.name: Decstone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Decstone is a clever puzzle game where you must follow a narrow path to reach the exit before the ground collapses beneath you. Each tile is marked with numbers, letters, or colors: numbers indicate how many times you can step on it before it falls, “E” marks the exit, “T” are transporters, and “I” tiles are indestructible. Colored tiles collapse all at once when you step on any of that color. Every move must be carefully planned – destroy the wrong section, and your only way out is suicide.

meta.name: Decton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Decton is a clone of the C64 game Space Taxi. You fly a hovering vehicle in a closed cave, navigating from a base platform to a blue target platform, and back to the base, without touching the walls of the cave or other obstacles.
Your home platform is colored white, the other platforms start out blue, and turn yellow when visited. Only one platform at a time should be visited before you return to your home platform, mimicking a cargo pickup/delivery. Visiting more platforms at a time does not make them all go yellow, only the first counts.

meta.name: Deep Sea Salvage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.60 KB

In this game, you play a diver who must retrieve gold bars buried at the bottom of the ocean while avoiding fish. After collecting 20 bars, the level increases and the fish patterns change. Simple but effective.

meta.name: Deep Sea Salvage 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.91 KB

An enhanced version of Deep Sea Salvage (finer, more animated, and more colorful graphics), where you must retrieve pearl necklaces from the ocean floor while avoiding schools of fish. After collecting 20 necklaces, the level increases, which changes and/or speeds up the fish patterns. Simple but effective.

meta.name: Deep Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.43 KB

To return to Earth when your ship is beyond the starfields of Orion, there are a series of beacons placed by the Elders of Earth to guide ships through a stargate. Unfortunately, the Andromedans have dispatched a large star fleet to reach the stargate and attack Earth. Your job is to guard the entrance of the gate and destroy as many enemy ships as possible, but most importantly, stop the Dragon-class star cruisers and their commanders. Deep Space is a side-view 3D shooter where you have to shoot down ships that are coming towards you.

meta.name: Deep Space : Operation Copernicus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

From: Terran Defense HQ, UPSF Date: June 5, 2123 0714 SMT Fellow Solarian Fighters: Seventeen hours ago, Andromeda Hegemony forces carried out an unprovoked attack on the United Planets Territory, treasonously killing over 200 of our citizens in the Herculis Quadrant from the Trajan group...
You, and you alone, must fly in your tiny ship through the trackless expanse of space, tracking down this violation of decency and destroying it wherever you find it. We have no doubt that you will find it or destroy it. The trust and hopes of all humanity fly with you. Good luck, Wilbur Tark, General, UPSF

meta.name: Deep Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.06 KB

Deep Strike is set in World War 2, and you form part of a squadron attempting a dangerous mission of destroying a Nazi fuel depot. Your fighter plane is armed with guns; a team of bombers are out there with you, with one always in front.
Initially you will face a few planes flying towards you. red planes shoot at you, and later there are black 'suicide planes' which aim to take you down Kamikaze style, and 'Blue Max' planes which are extra-tough.
After the first minute or so another challenge is added, in the shape of hills to fly around or over. After this, you reach the bombing zone, in which you guide the bombers behind you and instruct them which sites to bomb.
The game is viewed from the cockpit, with displays telling you of how much damage you and the bomber have taken, and whether you are steering in the right direction. A map is build in. The controls can be set in two ways, for 'up' on the joystick either equaling 'move upwards' or 'dive' (as on a real plane).

meta.name: Deep Trouble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.40 KB

Deep Trouble sends you into the dark depths of the ocean, where you dive with limited oxygen to recover hidden treasure chests. As time steadily runs out, you must evade dangerous sea creatures and choose your path carefully. Each dive becomes a tense balance between greed and caution – only smart planning and quick reactions will bring you back from the mysterious underwater world with your prize.

meta.name: The Deep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Deep the player takes the role of a ship which has to defend itself against a variety of underwater enemies, e.g. u-boats or jellyfish with weapons. All the enemies launch missiles or mines at the boat which can be dodged by moving left or right. Water bombs can be dropped to get rid of the enemies - but there are only eight available which slowly refill over time. Sometimes a helicopter drops crates which include useful extras like smart bombs, steering rockets or additional speed. The ship can also turn into a submarine to collect things under the water. Every screen has a different objective, e.g. collecting an orb, bombing an underwater station or destroying a powerful ship.

meta.name: Def Con 5
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador asume el papel de un agente del Departamento de Defensa que debe utilizar el sistema de defensa contra misiles balísticos (BMD) para proteger a Estados Unidos. Este sistema consta de elementos terrestres, terrestres y espaciales. El objetivo es destruir, derrotar, confundir o desestabilizar los misiles balísticos entrantes.
El juego se basa principalmente en texto y el jugador introduce comandos o coordenadas de 5 letras para manejar el BMD. Además de las armas activas, el jugador tiene acceso al sistema de vigilancia necesario para detectar lanzamientos de misiles y minas espaciales. Estos sistemas son susceptibles de sufrir interferencias y perturbaciones visuales debido a sus órbitas.

meta.name: Def Con 5
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador asume el papel de un agente del Departamento de Defensa que debe utilizar el sistema de defensa contra misiles balísticos (BMD) para proteger a Estados Unidos. Este sistema consta de elementos terrestres, terrestres y espaciales. El objetivo es destruir, derrotar, confundir o desestabilizar los misiles balísticos entrantes.
El juego se basa principalmente en texto y el jugador introduce comandos o coordenadas de 5 letras para manejar el BMD. Además de las armas activas, el jugador tiene acceso al sistema de vigilancia necesario para detectar lanzamientos de misiles y minas espaciales. Estos sistemas son susceptibles de sufrir interferencias y perturbaciones visuales debido a sus órbitas.

meta.name: Defcom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.10 KB

Gracias al sistema de defensa de la Tierra de la Guerra de las Galaxias, no ha habido una guerra en años. El problema es que una raza de alienígenas está utilizando el sistema para destruir ocho grandes ciudades. El jugador, que adopta el papel del capitán Nick Diamond, debe pilotar un EagleClassE751 sobre la Tierra y destruir a los alienígenas y los satélites. Al conseguir 1.000 puntos, Nick obtiene una mejora que le permite utilizar láseres duales. Durante la batalla, Nick será informado del continente en el que se encuentra.
Defcom es un shooter en 3D con una perspectiva en tercera persona desde la parte trasera de la nave. Alienígenas y satélites se acercan a la nave en la distancia. La Tierra es visible en la parte inferior de la pantalla.

meta.name: Defender
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.62 KB

Defender te pone al control de una nave de ataque rápido que defiende a la humanidad de interminables oleadas alienígenas. Te enfrentas a enemigos como Landers, Pods, Swarmers, Baiters y Bombers — siendo los Landers los más peligrosos, secuestrando humanos y convirtiéndolos en Mutantes implacables. Armado con bombas inteligentes y saltos al hiperespacio, debes eliminar las amenazas rápidamente. Si no logras salvar a los humanos, caen, o peor aún, el planeta es destruido. Los reflejos y la toma rápida de decisiones son clave para la supervivencia.

meta.name: Defender
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.21 KB

In Defender, the player fights against falling alien invaders, with numerous power-ups offering additional options. During the game, large, colored balls fall from the sky that trigger special effects when touched. A red ball increases the rate of fire, a purple one doubles the power of the shot, and a green one activates a super shot. Blue balls slow down the energy drain, orange ones destroy all aliens on the screen, brown ones build a protective barrier, light blue ones speed up the shots, and light red balls remove the barrier. Each of these balls offers a tactical advantage and makes fending off the invasion a dynamic experience.

meta.name: Defender 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.04 KB

Defender 64 is a clone of the arcade shooter Defender where you have to fly over the surface of a hostile planet viewed from the side with horizontal scrolling which scrolls when you move your Defender Class Starcruiser. The planet you are flying over orbits an alien sun and ten pioneers have settled to form a colony. Problem is, a neighbouring planet don't like the humans being there so have decided to remove them from the planet by lifting them of the surface and away into space. You have to protect the humans by blasting Landers before they can pick up a human, but if they manage to get one you can still blast a Lander and catch the falling human but be careful not to shoot them.

meta.name: Defender of the Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Defender of the Crown juegas como uno de los cuatro caballeros sajones de la Inglaterra medieval, en un momento en que el país está sumido en la confusión porque el rey ha muerto y le han robado la corona. Sajones y normandos se culpan mutuamente y luchan por el control de Inglaterra.
Tras una breve introducción del propio Robin de Locksley, comienzas el juego con un único castillo y 10 soldados a tus órdenes. Luego tendrás que construir tu ejército, tomar el control de más territorios y luchar contra los tres señores normandos, pero también a veces contra tus amigos sajones.
El juego tiene varios estilos diferentes: Puedes participar en una justa en la que tienes que derribar a tu oponente del caballo con una lanza, puedes ir a saquear un castillo en busca de botín o puedes atacar otro territorio/castillo.

meta.name: Defenders of the Earth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.52 KB

Los Defenders of The Earth es un juego de acción donde los protagonistas son los héroes veteranos de los cómics Flash Gordon, Lothar, Phantom y Mandrake. Ming ha secuestrado a sus hijos y debes liberarlos lo antes posible. Como Flash, viajas a través de las áreas de desplazamiento lateral del castillo de Ming, para huir rápidamente de los enemigos. Puedes pedir la ayuda de los otros Defensores, quienes pueden abrir puertas y desviar a los enemigos. Es necesario progresar rápidamente a través de los niveles, ya que las cámaras de seguridad de Ming están configuradas para detectar tu presencia.

meta.name: Deflectors!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Deflectors!" is an arcade game for the Commodore 64 in which the player navigates through a labyrinth while avoiding monsters and spiders. The laser beams fired by robots are particularly dangerous. By positioning themselves cleverly, the player can deflect these laser beams and thus defeat the spider in the labyrinth that is chasing him. The game requires strategic thinking and quick reflexes to escape the dangers and overcome the opponents.

meta.name: Deflektor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En este juego hay que pensar mucho, en ambos sentidos de la palabra. Este juego de rompecabezas estratégico consiste en utilizar espejos para dirigir un haz de luz hacia una sucesión de 60 pantallas. Cada espejo puede ajustarse en 16 ángulos diferentes, cada uno de los cuales envía el haz de luz alrededor de la pantalla de distintas maneras.
Antes de activar la salida, hay que eliminar las minas que haya en una pantalla pasando el rayo por encima de ellas. Otras características integradas en los niveles incluyen teletransportadores y cambiadores de ángulo aleatorios, así como peligros que hay que evitar (hacen que el rayo se sobrecaliente) y droides que se mueven para cambiar la dirección de los espejos.

meta.name: Defuzion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.71 KB

Defuzion sends you across multiple screens where you search for bombs and defuse them at the right moment while hostile creatures chase you. You move carefully through the environment, choose efficient routes, and react quickly as enemies close in or new threats appear. The constant time limit increases pressure, as hesitation reduces your chances and creates risky situations. The mix of collecting, evasion, and urgency forms an engaging skill challenge that rewards planning, quick reactions, and calm decision-making.

meta.path: ./Deja Vu - A Nightmare Comes True (USA) (Side A).D64
meta.name: Deja Vu : A Nightmare Comes True!!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Deja Vu, la acción tiene lugar en Chicago en diciembre de 1941. El nombre de su personaje Theodore "Ace" Harding - un boxeador retirado que trabaja como detective privado. Se despierta en un retrete de un pub de mala calidad sin recordar quién es ni lo que está haciendo allí. Para empeorar las cosas, pronto topas con un cadáver con tres balas enterradas en él. Efectivamente, encuentras que hay una pistola en el bolsillo con tres balas que faltan. Desde allí se tiene que averiguar lo que pasó y quién eres antes de que lo que está sucediendo a tu cerebro te convierta en un vegetal sin sentido. Por si fuera poco a la policía le gustaría mucho hablar contigo acerca del cadáver.

meta.name: Delite
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.23 KB

Delite offers an entertaining gaming experience accompanied by appealing music. Here, players can demonstrate their strategic thinking and test their skills in an engaging puzzle scenario.

meta.name: Deliverance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.43 KB

Deliverance puts the fate of a kidnapped princess in the hands of two robots: Jim and Bob. This fast-paced platformer features constantly side-scrolling action as you dodge traps, shoot or avoid enemies, and race to the level's end. Touching a creature, hitting an obstacle, or being caught by the screen costs you one of five lives. A radar helps track your progress. In two-player mode, both robots appear on screen at once but don't interact, each fighting their own battle.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Deliverance : Stormlord II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Como en Stormlord, tienes que salvar al mayor número posible de hadas, esta vez atrapándolas en el cielo mientras caen. No es tan fácil como parece, ya que este juego de plataformas con desplazamiento tiene muchas secciones en las que las hadas caen hacia pozos ardientes, y tienes que atraparlas sin chocar con los pozos.
Los controles te permiten saltar y volver a saltar mientras caes, lo que te permite, con un poco de esfuerzo, subir casi hasta la parte superior de la pantalla. Las fuerzas de la Reina Negra están ahí para detenerte. Nubes y estalactitas en los techos liberan gotas mortales. Esporádicamente se ofrece un nivel de bonificación, que te permite recoger monedas para conseguir vidas extra.

meta.name: Dell Crossword Puzzles : Volume III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dell Crossword Puzzles: Volume III offers 15 crossword puzzles of varying difficulty levels, aimed at improving vocabulary and puzzle-solving skills. The game includes features such as word and puzzle review, as well as built-in hints to assist with difficult passages. The interface presents the puzzles in a text-based format, with the clues and grid displayed on the screen. Players can type in their answers and receive instant feedback, making the gaming experience interactive and educational.

meta.name: Delta Drawing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.02 KB

Delta Drawing invites you to create colorful images while learning the basics of programming in a playful way. A small “turtle” moves across the screen, following your commands to build shapes, patterns, and entire scenes step by step. The program uses a simple functional language that lets you define routines, combine colors, and grow your picture through scripted instructions. Aimed at young beginners, it highlights how creative code can be – a learning environment that goes far beyond drawing and shows how ideas take form through precise commands.

meta.name: Delta Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The year is 2027 and you are a newspaper reporter and one of perhaps only a handful of people left alive after a nuclear holocaust in Chicago. You survived because you discovered an experimental high-tech robotic spacesuit that protects you from the deadly toxic atmosphere, at least for now.
The player can move through different rooms. The player must build his base on the partially destroyed O'Hare Airport while trying to stay alive by collecting items. Dangers such as radiation, extreme temperatures and toxins pose a constant risk to the player. The player must find weapons to defend themselves against the mutated remnants of Chicago's population. The ultimate goal is to escape Chicago and reach the Mount Mitchell radio station in North Carolina, where people are still broadcasting live.

meta.name: Delta Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.76 KB

En Delta pilotas una nave espacial a través de 32 niveles de desplazamiento lateral en la peligrosa región espacial Delta, donde la especie Hsiffan Khanate utiliza tecnología avanzada para atacar las naves Terran. Cada etapa introduce nuevos peligros estáticos y formaciones enemigas que te desafían con patrones de ataque fijos. Tu nave estándar no es lo suficientemente potente para sobrevivir mucho tiempo, por lo que debes recolectar potenciadores a través de un sistema de créditos. Cuantos más créditos tengas, más fichas azules que ofrecen mejoras de armas aparecerán, mientras que menos créditos desatan fichas grises mortales.

meta.name: Deltic Fleet Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.40 KB

“Deltic Fleet Manager” is a train and management simulation where you must operate the British Class 55 locomotives safely and on time. Precise management and strategic decision-making are essential to ensure smooth operations.

meta.name: Demolition Construction Set
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.56 KB

Demolition is inspired by the arcade game Breakout where you control a bat to remove all the bricks on the screen over various levels. Instead of hitting a ball upwards, Demolition sees you hitting the ball across the screen from left to right, moving the bat up or down. On each screen are various blocks and these need removing with some blocks taking multiple hits to remove and some blocks that can't be removed. There are also letters and these affect your game when collected and they affect your bat, speed of the ball or just bonus points. If the ball goes past your bat then you lose one of four lives.

meta.name: Demon Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.72 KB

Marooned on the ice planet Krybor, the player uses a laser cannon to destroy legions of demons that attack from above. Visually, the demons appear in waves similar to other space-themed shooters, but individually combine from the sides of the screen to the area above the player's cannon.
Each wave introduces new weapons with which the demons attack, such as long streaming lasers and laser clusters. Starting in Wave 5, demons also divide into two smaller, bird-like creatures that eventually attempt descent onto the player's cannon. Starting in Wave 9, the demons' shots follow directly beneath the monsters, making it difficult for the player to slip underneath to get in a direct shot.

meta.name: Demon Blues
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.08 KB

You are a small shaggy blue demon finding himself in a dungeon full of fallen angels, gargoyles, wasps, etc. Walking through them loses you energy, which is your life. So you have to run and jump avoiding them, collecting gems, blood drops, energy vials, and some sort of friend-demons such as eyes and tongues. On each level you have to find the keys to open a door to a magical cauldron guarded by a beautiful elf. Levels are decorated with statues of beautiful women, old men, dragons, swords, or eye walls.

meta.name: Demon from the Darkside
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.37 KB

Ten years ago, the wizard Ashmeard fought the evil Drakon and took his Golden Mask, which allowed Drakon to walk unnoticed amongst men to steal their souls. After his defeat, Drakon fled into the cave of Llindel, taking with him the Falcon staff which gave him and his minions, the shadow demons, their power. Now, the shadow demons walk the land once again and Drakon's power is returning. While Ashmeard fights the demons, he sends Morrack, his apprentice, to find and kill Drakon and retrieve the Falcon staff before Drakon's army can cross the lake. Demon from the Darkside is an illustrated text adventure, with more than a third of the game's locations being accompanied by a graphic.

meta.name: Demon Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.13 KB

Demon Knight is a text based adventure game. The beautiful maiden has been taken by the aforementioned knight and, as the player, you must explore the terrain to find and rescue her.
As you progress you must collect useful objects, (not all objects are useful so don't overburden yourself with trash), vanquish foes, solve puzzles and so on. Eventually you will meet the demon knight himself and you must defeat him to complete the game.
There are three single word commands, HELP, INVENTORY and QUIT. All other commands are limited to two words, GO EAST, KILL SKELETON, etc.

n: Demon Stalkers - The Raid on Doomfane (USA) (Disk 1)

meta.name: Demon Stalkers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Demon Stalkers” throws you into dark dungeons full of danger, where you play as either a knife-throwing hero or a crossbow-wielding heroine. Along the way, you'll find relics that permanently boost your attack, defense or magical power, as well as scrolls and amulets that offer temporary effects. Food can heal damage, but sometimes it's poisoned – just like certain scrolls can unleash a “Curse of Slow Death” that drains your health until you find the level's exit. Enemies include rats, ghosts that walk through walls, dervishes that steal your items, dormant snappers, and fireball-hurling mad magicians. Most monsters spawn from vortex points you can destroy – except for rats, which endlessly crawl from indestructible sewer grates.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Demon's Empire is an arcade adventure game for the Commodore 64, developed by Novotrade in 1989. In this game, the player takes on the role of a ghost hunter who fights his way through a dark, gothic world to face various demonic creatures. The game is characterized by its seething, eerie atmosphere and offers the player a challenging journey through a world ruled by demons.

meta.name: Demon's Kiss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.79 KB

Demons Kiss takes you into a dark castle where Alicia must be rescued from the clutches of a Demon Harpy. As a warrior, you fight through room after room of creatures and demons, using magical attacks, punches, and kicks while ladders open up new routes through the fortress. The journey becomes especially treacherous in a maze of identical-looking rooms, where keeping your bearings quickly becomes the real test. This creates a grim action adventure that effectively combines combat, exploration, and the pressure of a dangerous rescue mission.

meta.name: Demon's Winter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Demon's Winter" takes the player to the island of Ymros, which once lived in peace after the defeat of the evil sorceress Siriadne. But two centuries later, the peace is suddenly disturbed when aggressive monsters ravage the region and an unnatural cold ravages the land. A small group of five adventurers, just beginning their journey, must band together to fight the evil. They start with little equipment and skills, but after an attack on the destroyed village of Ildryn, it becomes clear that they must find the source of the eerie creatures and the frosty plague in order to save Ymros.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.17 KB

Demons of Topaz sends you to an alien planet with Ozzy after his spaceship is forced to make an emergency landing and runs out of fuel. To take off again, you explore the surface and underground areas in search of diamonds that power the ship and must carry them back safely. Hostile aliens can be fought off with a boomerang, while underground exploration is made tense by a slowly draining air supply that only refills outside. Careless play is costly, as hazards, long falls or running out of air will cost lives and demand careful, thoughtful exploration.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.11 KB

Denarius sends you into battle against the Rignalians, an alien race that has started contaminating cities in the solar system with their vital chlorine pools. Piloting your space fighter, you fly over 16 infected cities, destroy enemy spaceships, and collect as much chlorine as possible to save the solar system from colonization.

meta.name: Deneb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Deneb puts you in control of a spaceship flying through vertically scrolling levels filled with futuristic structures and enemy forces. You'll need sharp reflexes and accurate shooting to dodge obstacles, collect fuel, and eliminate threats before they get you. Every shot and movement counts – survive and score.

meta.name: Denis Through the Looking Glass
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.93 KB

Denis Through the Drinking Glass es una aventura satírica en la que juegas como Denis Thatcher, intentando desesperadamente escapar de los confines de Downing Street para llegar a tomar una pinta en el Gravedigger's Arms. Si no encuentras una bebida en diez movimientos, se acabó la partida. Las descripciones son rimadas, ingeniosas y están llenas de agudas críticas a la vida política y a la perspectiva única de Denis. La función de Ayuda ofrece poco más que sarcasmo, y aparecen titulares burlones de The Sun para ridiculizar tu progreso.

meta.name: Denniffia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Denniffia puts you in control of a spaceship blasting through enemy territory in classic shoot-'em-up style. Destroyed foes drop lettered bonuses: S gives you a shield, P adds power rockets, V boosts your speed, I grants brief invincibility so you can ram enemies, and ? offers a random surprise. Quick reflexes and smart power-up collection are key to survival.

meta.name: Denny's Quest I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.94 KB

In Denny's Quest I you join Denny on his perilous search for the evil Ghost. You'll explore colorful yet treacherous environments like caves, graveyards, hidden areas, and deserts. Puzzles, traps, and secret paths demand your full attention – a challenging adventure full of discoveries.

meta.name: Depotmaster : Old Oak Common
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.88 KB

"Depotmaster: Old Oak Common" puts the player in the role of a railway and track manager at the Old Oak Common maintenance depot, west of London. This depot serves as the central facility for storing and servicing locomotives and multiple units operating from Paddington. Here, the Great Western Railway's main lines branch off, including the historic mainline to Bristol and the 1903 "New North Main Line" to the Great Western and Great Central Joint Railway at Northolt. Amidst the busy locomotive junction, it is the player's responsibility to ensure smooth operations, coordinate train schedules, and maintain safety.

meta.name: Depthcharge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.01 KB

Depth Charge is a single-screen game in which you must protect five battleships sailing at the top of the screen from an attack by enemy submarines beneath the waves. Each battleship appears individually on the screen and you move it either left or right, while the varying number of submarines at different depths move left or right across the screen. The submarines drop various mines that fly to the surface, but you are armed with five depth charges that move around the screen trying to hit the submarines or mines. If you hit a submarine, a mine, or the depth charge at the bottom of the screen, you will be re-armed with another submarine. If you are hit by a mine, the ship will be lost and the next ship will appear. Before starting the game, you can choose your skill level (1-4), with one being the easiest.

meta.name: Derby Dash
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.45 KB

meta.name: Derby Day
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.57 KB

Derby Day lets you and up to three other players hit the virtual racetrack, betting your money on the outcome of seven races hosted by bookie Jolly Jack. Before the action begins you choose the type of odds – Fun (up to 15/1), Serious (up to 7/1), or Dead Serious (from 99/1 to 1/99) – and whether to bet in Pounds or Pence, with Pence allowing one player to act as a real-life bookie collecting cash from the others. Each player starts with £100 and is shown four horses with names and odds for the first race. Players place their bets one after another, with the chance to change a wrong choice. The race plays out in a side-view with smooth scrolling, ending with a photo finish to decide the result. The winner pays full odds, second place pays a quarter. After payouts, the horses for the next race appear, and play continues until the richest player remains – anyone losing all their money is out.

meta.desc:

Deri Colours is a logic and puzzle game for the Commodore 64. In Deri Colours players must arrange coloured blocks on a grid to create certain patterns or combinations. The game requires strategic thinking and planning as the blocks can only be moved in a limited number of moves. As you progress, the complexity and difficulty of the puzzles increase, making the game challenging for both beginners and experienced players.

meta.name: Desert Fox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.57 KB

Desert Fox is a strategy/action mix set in World War II. The player takes the role of tank commander Lone Wolf who has to foil Rommel's plans in Northern Africa. The strategic part of the game plays on a overhead map which shows Lone Wolf and Rommel's positions. The overall goal is to save the Allied depots which are attacked by Rommel's troops - the main challenge is to save all of them in time. Lone Wolf can be moved over the map and one airstrike per game can be used to buy time for one depot. Lone Wolf also has the ability to gain enemy intel with his radio - this is useful in order to find out where obstacles await.
Whenever Lone Wolf runs into one of these obstacles or Rommel, one of five action sequences starts. This includes tank duels, a turret section against incoming fighters, navigating a minefield, protecting a convoy and escaping an ambush. Those action sequences can also be played separately from the campaign. Lighting conditions change depending on the time of day.

meta.name: Desert Hawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.80 KB

Desert Hawk sends you behind enemy lines in a military helicopter to find missing comrades and bring them back safely. You can only land in suitable spots, pick up up to three people, and return them to base while tanks, aircraft, and dangerous heat-seeking missiles keep up constant pressure. Limited fuel and a fixed supply of rockets force you to manage every mission carefully. This creates a tense rescue operation that effectively combines flying skill, combat readiness, and smart resource management.

meta.name: Desert Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.62 KB

In Desert Island, you are stranded on a deserted island after a shipwreck. Your goal is to survive and find a way back to civilization. Fortunately, the island used to have a US Navy base and various items were left behind. You must use these objects cleverly to find fuel for your boat and start your journey home. It is crucial to explore the environment carefully and use the available resources wisely to defy the challenges of the island and successfully escape.

meta.name: Desert Rat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the game, you must face an enemy attack in the endless desert. The scorching sun makes it difficult to spot enemies in the distance, but you must not give up. Suddenly you spot enemy troops gathering on a hill - and the battle begins. In your desert vehicle, you race through the gloomy landscape while enemy shells explode above you and tanks become flickering piles of rubble. Your goal is to save as many of your men as possible within three minutes. If you approach a soldier, he will follow you back to headquarters, where you can save your points. But be careful: if you land in a mine, you will be sent back to the tent. If one of your men is hit, he will retreat to the left of the screen. To save him, you must take him to your headquarters and unload him there.

meta.name: Desolator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Desolator takes you into the castle of Kyros, the Great Satan, where captives are trapped behind cursed mirrors. Your mission is to smash the mirrors and break the spell. Once you succeed, you transform into the invincible Machoman, destroying everything in your path. The gameplay is reminiscent of Gauntlet and Commando, with plenty of extras to aid you in the battle against Kyros' forces.

meta.name: Destiny
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Destiny is an arcade game, where the player must find 9 poison containers scattered around the maze, while avoiding numerous inhabitants. Contact with any of the creatures takes an energy, which can't be complemented. No weapon is available, therefore a smooth movement is the key to avoid hostile beings, blocking the transition to other parts of the labyrinth.

meta.name: Destroyer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Destroyer you take command of a warship and operate various stations on board to complete your missions. Each station features its own instruments and responsibilities that must be managed during combat. Early missions introduce only a few stations, but later scenarios require you to control many of them and switch quickly between different tasks. You use sonar to detect enemy submarines, anti-aircraft guns to shoot down attacking aircraft, and the damage control station to prioritize repairs. Quick reflexes and smart decision-making are essential to keep the ship operational and complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Destroyer Escort
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Destroyer Escort you command a destroyer in the North Atlantic during World War II and must safely escort a convoy of six ships from one port to another. Before starting you choose a route between major locations such as Britain, America, Gibraltar or Murmansk and decide how strong the enemy opposition should be. During the mission you view the action from the bridge and rely on several panels for the map, navigation, damage status and weapons. Along the journey you must defend the convoy from enemy attacks while ensuring that none of the escorted ships are lost. A mission is only considered successful if every ship reaches the destination safely and your own vessel survives the voyage.

meta.name: Destruct
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.90 KB

Fly over the surface of the planet in your battle-armoured jet suit, finding off attacks by enemy aircraft and guided missiles, while avoiding the deadly landscape features. At the end of each level you'll be confronted by a gigantic mothership, invulnerable to normal lasers. So shoot the asteroids that are flying over the planet to reveal crystals. Once you've collected the crystals they can be used against the mothership. If successful a friendly alien will transport you to the next stage, during this journey you must hit the red energy orb to keep it in front of you.

meta.name: Detective
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.40 KB

On a 3 x 3 board, players try to solve Lucky Duke's murder. At the start of the game, each player is given a random code from 1 to 9 to indicate possible perpetrators, means and motives for the crime. Players must hide this information from their opponents. In each round, the player rolls a die and can advance up to that number of positions on the game board. The player must then provide their code for the possible perpetrator, means and motive. The player also receives a clue as to whether they are at the correct location of the murder. On the easy difficulty level, the player is informed whether their guesses are correct, while on the harder difficulty level the player is only informed of the number of their correct answers. Players must be careful not to give their opponents any clues, and they can move their opponents around the board by calling them out for questioning. The first player to correctly guess all four aspects of the crime is the winner.

meta.name: The Detective Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.54 KB

The Detective Game puts you in the role of Inspector Snide inside a lively mansion full of suspects, secrets, and unexpected twists. As you search rooms, gather clues, and examine objects, you encounter characters who must be questioned carefully to get closer to the culprit. Limited inventory space and the constantly advancing time mean every decision matters. It becomes especially engaging because events continue to unfold and new crimes can occur. The result is a dynamic mystery adventure driven by observation, deduction, and smart investigation.

meta.name: Detonators - Bombers Day
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Detonators: Bomber's Day is a fast-paced Bomberman-style game where two players face off in a maze of destructible blocks. The goal is to strategically place bombs to clear paths and trap your opponent before they get you. Power-ups and well-timed explosions add dynamic twists to each round. With colorful visuals, simple controls, and quick gameplay, it delivers classic competitive action full of tension and reflexes.

meta.name: Deus Ex Machina
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Deus Ex Machina is an unusual and experimental game by Mel Croucher. Until 1994, the computer controlled all defense and internal security. Tuesday evening the machine rebelled...
Players take control and follow the life of a “defect” in the form of a human body that has formed inside the machine.
The player has to guide the defect through the different stages of life and is constantly monitored by the defect police. The game cannot be lost, but depending on the number of actions the percentage shown varies. Deus Ex Machina is based on a series of vignettes with limited gameplay. On screens, the player moves a green dot between strands of DNA, fends off police examining the body, and jumps over words like "LIES" or "WAR" - with the relevance and atmosphere generally conveyed by the background soundtrack.

meta.name: Devastating Blow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.30 KB

This is a boxing game featuring Mike Tyson on the front cover. The player takes the role of an up and coming boxer who has won 20 fights so far against 'nobody' opponents. Now it's time to move up and take on the big boys.
Like other boxing games, it's a bit of a button masher but you've got to get your combinations right to get through the opponents guard. One side of the tape has a one player game, the other side has a two player game.

meta.name: Deviants
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.89 KB

Hace 100.000 años, el planeta Krauze pertenecía a una raza llamada los Deviants, pero su sed de poder desató una guerra civil. Esto casi acabó con la raza.
Ahora, en el año 5150, los humanos han comenzado a explorar otras zonas del espacio para su colonización y han elegido el planeta Krauze. La colonia ahora ha comenzado a prosperar, pero fue atacada recientemente, y la fuente provenía de un asteroide gigante que contenía una estación de batalla Deviant.
Eres parte de un equipo de Starwarriors enviados por la colonia para colocar bombas nucleares en Battlestaion, pero la misión casi sale mal ya que el equipo, excepto que tú fuiste aniquilado justo cuando se colocó la última bomba. Ahora depende de ti preparar todos los dispositivos y abandonar la estación de batalla para salvar a la gente.

meta.name: Devil Ronin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.46 KB

The world of Devil Ronin is Japan in the Sengoku Era, a time of great civil war. The Demon Shogun, lord of the oni, has decided to capitalise on the conflict and dispatched his demon armies to conquer the nation. You play the role of Kuruhito, an oni who has turned against his demon master and who now fights on the side of humanity. Fight your way through the historic prefectures of Japan, battling both mythic monsters and the human armies that serve corrupt lords aligned with the Demon Shogun.

meta.name: Devil's Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.43 KB

In Devil's Island, you are a prisoner trying to escape from a dark fortress on a remote island. You begin in your cell and explore your surroundings step by step, with the game describing everything in text. Using typed commands, you interact with objects, solve puzzles, and overcome obstacles. After escaping the prison, a dangerous jungle awaits – only then might you reach the mainland and your freedom.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.10 KB

Inside Outing puts you in the role of master thief Devon Aire, hired to search a wealthy mansion for hidden jewels and treasures left behind by an eccentric millionaire – whose widow has no clue where they're hidden. Each room is shown in isometric view and filled with typical household items, all of which can be pushed, pulled, picked up or used, with diamonds concealed in clever and unexpected places. But beware – due to the owner's love of experimental science, strange creatures roam the halls, and contact with them drains your energy from one of your three lives.

This is a collect-em up game which you play a white colored Pac-Man like character on what looks like a cross between Pac-Man and Uridium minus the shooting.

meta.name: Di's Baby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.72 KB

Di's Baby combines several small scenes into a biting satire about royal offspring. You work through different tasks, avoid obstacles, collect points, and have to complete each scene before the next one begins. Between toilet rolls, paparazzi, the drive to the hospital, and the birth itself, the result is deliberately odd – an unusual game that draws its humor from exaggerated situations and quick changes.

meta.name: Diablo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.23 KB

In Diablo you tackle a series of logic-based puzzles where a rolling ball must be guided through a network of pipe segments. As the ball moves, every segment it passes through disappears, making mistakes immediately punishing. Using a single empty space, you shift entire lines of tiles to reshape the path and keep the ball from falling into dead ends or gaps. As the puzzles progress, the rules evolve and new mechanics emerge, turning careful experimentation into precise planning – a challenging puzzle experience that rewards foresight and timing.

meta.name: Diagon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.99 KB

Diagon turns the defense of a vital energy network into a fast and intense shooter in which you have to wipe out every enemy wave on each stage. Although you can move freely around the screen, the limited firing direction forces you to pay close attention to positioning and attack timing at all times. That blend of mobility, constant pressure from multiple sides, and steady progress through new defensive levels gives the game a direct and gripping arcade appeal.

meta.name: Diamenty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.27 KB

Diamenty is a puzzle-solving game. In each level the player must push around same pattern cubes in order to connect them together. Once connected cubes of same pattern disappear from the board. The left panel shows how many same cubes are present on the board. It is very important to control the number of cubes, as there can't be only one piece left. Cubes may be connected diagonally and horizontally, two or even three simultaneously.

meta.name: Diamond
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.66 KB

For centuries, five massive prison ships floated around Zia in the Luma system, filled with prisoners whose rebellion was crushed by Malik and Zan's guards. Today it is believed that it is just a story, and if it were true, the prisoners would have been dead long ago. The story has come true when the five ships arrived in the orbit of Zan with a large load of mutant prisoners. To make matters worse, the prisoners have managed to eat their way through the ship's hulls and are planning an escape. They were tasked with sending and piloting five Supertronic spacecraft to fly over the hulls of the five ships, sealing any holes and destroying any escaped prisoners. Each vehicle can be selected and controlled at any time.

meta.name: Diamond Fever
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Diamond Fever, you control the ball directly instead of using a paddle as usual. Your goal is to clear all the blocks and collect the diamonds in the center of the board. However, unlike classic breakout games, you have to make sure the ball doesn't touch the top of the screen or you'll lose it. This special mechanic increases the challenge as you navigate your way through the board and secure the diamonds.

meta.name: Diamond Jones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.09 KB

In Diamond Jones you embark on a risky adventure full of treasures and dangers. Driven by greed, Diamond Jones tries to collect the scattered diamonds in unstable caves that are about to collapse. Each cave only remains stable for 40 seconds before it collapses - a ticking time bomb that increases the pressure. Some caves are designed so challenging that they are nerve-wracking. Your goal is to collect all the diamonds with skill and speed and give the gold digger a carefree life.

meta.name: Diamond Jones II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.32 KB

In Diamond Jones II, the sequel to the first adventure, you once again go on a treasure hunt in dangerous caves. In this Boulder Dash-like game, you control the adventurous hero through nine complex caves, where scattered diamonds are waiting to be collected. But beware: Some sections are peppered with more guardians than diamonds, which requires both brains and precise control of the joystick. The guardians always move straight until they hit an obstacle, whereupon they turn at a right angle - a behavior that you can use to your advantage. In addition, time is against you, as you only have 45 seconds to collect all the diamonds before the cave collapses in a powerful avalanche.

meta.name: Diamond Mine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.46 KB

In Diamond Mine, your goal is to collect as many diamonds as possible from twenty underground shafts. Each level is shown on a single screen filled with corridors and passageways. Monsters are periodically released from a central hub and can be shot, but touching one causes you to lose all collected gems. Mines are initially covered in dust, so you can only shoot through areas you've already walked. Since most diamonds are located in the corridors, careful planning is essential. The game allows you to start from one of five different screens.

meta.name: Diamond Trail
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.55 KB

The priceless Sinclive Diamond has been stolen from the Jewel Room in the capital city of Spectraisia, Microdrivia, just before it's premier of being seen by the public. With the diamond stolen, the premier cannot be delayed or the public will doubt it's existence, so you have been assigned with the task of finding and bringing the diamond back. There is also talk of a fake version and this needs to be found as well and brought back. As you explore the surrounding areas you will get hungry so food needs to be found and eaten to keep your strength up. Diamond Trail is a text adventure where the screen has text describing each location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

meta.name: Diamond Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.48 KB

“Diamond Zone” challenges you to collect all the goodies in each level using a controllable rocket – requiring precise movement, as touching any platform will cost you a life. Careful navigation is key to gathering all diamonds without hitting the obstacles.

meta.name: Dick Tracy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dick Tracy es un juego de acción basado en la película del mismo nombre. El jugador asume el papel de Dick Tracy, un detective cuya vida da un vuelco el día en que su suegro es asesinado por un gángster llamado Big Boy Caprice. Dick Tracy sumerge al jugador en un mundo oscuro en el que cada encuentro acaba en un baño de sangre. Avanzas con la pistola en la mano mientras los gángsters te disparan desde la calle o desde las ventanas de los edificios. Puedes luchar con tus puños, una pistola o una ametralladora.

meta.name: Dickys Diamonds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Dicky" (The Owl) must retrieve the diamonds stolen by "Stephen" (The Spider) by weakening Stephen's webs until they explode and catching the diamonds when they fall... A highly addictive game where You can choose from 70 different starting levels in the menu - there is something for every ability! Lightning-fast action – incredibly challenging! Don't look now, but here comes “Cecil”...

meta.name: Dictator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are the dictator of the fictional republic of Ritimba. Your task is to keep everybody happy - the army, the peasants, the land owners.... while secretly filling your personal bank account as much as possible. You've got the secret police on your side... and the guerrillas on the other one. Every month, one of those groups makes a request. You can accept it (which might involve quite a bit of money) or deny it, making groups either happy or not. You can also choose to borrow money from the Russians or the Americans. As the old saying goes.. it's impossible to make everybody happy. So sooner or later, you'll be facing a revolution or assassination attempt. Did you purchase that helicopter or are you going to face the music?

meta.name: DIE : Death in Effect
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.55 KB

DIE: Death in Effect ofrece una experiencia de juego inmersiva donde los jugadores navegan por diferentes niveles para recolectar objetos y superar desafíos. Los gráficos y controles crean una atmósfera dinámica que te anima a poner a prueba tu destreza y velocidad de reacción. El juego combina una dinámica de juego trepidante con un estilo único que inspira nostalgia.

meta.name: Die Hard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en la película, un grupo de terroristas ha tomado el control de un rascacielos para intentar robar 600 millones de dólares. Tu misión es rescatar a tu esposa, que está atrapada en el edificio, y detener a los terroristas. El juego se juega con una perspectiva 3D que te permite buscar objetos útiles en el edificio y luchar contra los terroristas con diversas armas o a mano. Las escenas cinemáticas te mantienen al tanto de la trama a medida que avanza.

meta.name: Die Hard

In Die Hard you engage in a head-to-head tank duel where only one thing matters – outsmarting and outlasting your opponent. You freely drive your tank across the arena, throw grenades, or briefly leave it to collect fuel and ammunition. Workshops allow you to repair damage and stay battle-ready, while on-screen indicators keep track of your status and supplies. Every hit, every decision, and every movement can turn the tide – a relentless two-player showdown driven by speed, awareness, and nerve.

meta.name: Die Hard II : Die Harder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Die Hard II: Die Harder you take on the role of John McClane and face a series of dangerous missions at an airport under siege. Screen by screen you fight through different locations, taking down terrorists while carefully avoiding civilians who may suddenly cross your path. Defeated enemies drop useful equipment that grants temporary advantages and increases the pace. Each stage raises the stakes with tougher foes and more intense action – until endurance alone determines how long McClane survives the operation.

meta.name: Die Alien Slime
meta.desc:

Die Alien Slime is a simple shooter with top-down perspective, like Alien Syndrome. The player controls a lone spaceman, who must fight against aliens and activate special terminals. Many of these terminals can be found scattered around the ship. In the space base there are many barriers: doors, transport blocks and energy barriers. The space base is a labyrinth, colonized by hundreds of aliens.

meta.name: Dig Dug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.26 KB

En Dig Dug, libra una guerra subterránea con tu fiel arpón. Tendrás que derrotar al duro Pooka y al feroz Fygar para avanzar al siguiente nivel.
Haz explotar a tus enemigos para que revienten o lánzales rocas. Conseguirás puntos por deshacerte de ellos o por recoger objetos de bonificación.
Este juego clásico es a la vez un juego de acción arcade de la vieja escuela y un juego de estrategia. ¡Atrae a tus enemigos hacia donde quieras que estén y aplástalos con las rocas!

In Digital Tangram you arrange different geometric shapes to form given figures. The game challenges your spatial thinking and creativity as you try to put the right pieces into the right shape. The challenge increases with each new puzzle, making the game an exciting digital version of the classic tangram puzzle.

meta.name: Dimension X
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.09 KB

Dimension-X is an action game focused on avoiding obstacles. Although it initially appears to be a shooter, the gameplay revolves around skillful maneuvering rather than attacking.

meta.name: Dinky Doo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.74 KB

Dinky Doo is a single screen game viewed from above where you are in a nightmare due to a cheese sandwich you had eaten before bed, even though your Mother said not to. The only way out of this bad dream is to complete various levels to reach the safety of your Mother's room by collecting your hot milk on each screen. Each screen has walls and various creatures that move around the screen and if you touch the walls or a creature then you lose one of three lives. If you reach your hot milk then some of the creatures turn to cherries and these can be collected as you head towards a door that has appeared. On later levels there are lasers that turn on and off and are deadly to the touch. An oxygen bar decreases and fills up when you collect the milk and starts decreasing again as you go to the door, and this just gives you bonus points when the level is completed.

meta.name: Dino Eggs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.09 KB

While on an expedition though time to the prehistoric past, Time Master Tim accidentally brings a case of European Measles to that era. He has to return the Dino eggs to the present time in order to save them from this epidemic. Tim has to face the dino egg predators, such as spiders and snakes which will contaminate the eggs. The mother of the eggs also lurks by, and if a fire is not built, she may just step in. Will you be able to save the dinosaur race from extinction?

meta.name: Dino Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dino Wars is a strategic board game with some similarities to chess, where battles are decided through action scenes. If you've ever played Archon, you know the idea behind this game.
On a chess-like board (9x10 pieces in this game) you move different types of dinosaurs. If you hit a field that has an opposing dinosaur on it, the game switches to action mode. This is played as a beat-'em-up where you have to defeat the opposing dinosaur to win the field. Each dinosaur has its own strategies, movement restrictions and different combat abilities - which are roughly based on the historical characteristics of the real dinosaurs. Therefore, knowing which dinosaurs are likely to win the battle is crucial to strategy.
The action scenes can be played independently of the main strategic game.

By clicking on a single spot, the player affects central field (selected one) and all the fields placed directly diagonally next to the central block by their reversal - filled block disappears and a blank spot is replaced with filled block. Basically, each taken action reverses simultaneously 5 fields, one in the middle, and 4 around. The game features 99 levels.

You forge alliances, make secret deals and try to outmaneuver your partners – because in the end only one player can win. Sooner or later promises must be broken and alliances abandoned, and that tension defines the game. Every round becomes a contest of trust, deception and careful calculation, where words are often stronger than armies.

meta.name: Diplomat's Dilemma

Diplomat's Dilemma puts the player in the role of a kidnapped diplomat attempting to escape. However, before fleeing, they must secure both their briefcase and crucial evidence against the terrorists. Every decision matters in ensuring a stealthy escape and successfully completing the dangerous mission.

meta.desc:

DISC: Damned into Space-Craft puts you in control of a spaceship flying through four intense levels filled with enemy formations. Foes vary in size, speed, and attack style, and collisions drain your energy. Power-ups like energy capsules, shields, smart bombs, stronger shots, and side lasers help you survive the chaos. Each level ends with a boss fight – only sharp reflexes and good timing will get you through.

You fly across the structure, avoid robots and attempt to access multiple sections hiding distinct challenges. Solving these sequences provides essential components that combine to disable the station's defenses and restore control. The constant shift between direct action and varied tasks creates a dynamic experience where each completed segment restores energy and brings you closer to your objective.

If you hit another car or the edge of the track, you lose one of three lives and have to start over.

Simple sideways maneuvers help you align each target perfectly before striking. Every hit weakens the enemy's infrastructure, but the river's bends, the constant adjustments, and the tight approach make every drop a challenge.

Along the way, you must dodge countless dangers – from river creatures and cannon-firing dragons to whirlwinds that push you off course. Each hit costs a life, though you can fight back with apples, limited in supply but replenished after losing one. The vertical scrolling view keeps the action flowing, and only quick reflexes and sharp timing will carry you safely through the rapids.

meta.name: Dizzy VI : Prince of the Yolkfolk!
meta.desc:

In "Dizzy VI: Prince of the Yolkfolk", Rockwart the Troll has cast a spell on Daisy, putting her to sleep for 100 years. Dizzy sets off to save her in a compact adventure true to the series' style. You begin underground, trapped by a botched spell, but soon explore the castle in search of Daisy. Along the way, collect stars and find food to restore energy lost from hazards. If you succeed, you and Daisy ride off into the sunset – a fairytale ending to this charming little quest.

meta.name: Dizzy : The Ultimate Cartoon Adventure
meta.desc:

El juego es una aventura de plataformas en la que Dizzy debe buscar en la tierra de cuento de hadas de Katmandú una peluca de duende, un revestimiento plateado de una nube, una pluma de vampiro Dux y un brebaje de troll y depositarlos en un caldero para hacer una poción para derrotar al malvado mago. Zak. El juego implica recolectar elementos y trasladarlos a otros lugares donde se requiere el elemento; por ejemplo, en un momento dado se necesita un impermeable para protegerse de la dañina lluvia. Esto se hace más difícil porque sólo se puede transportar un artículo en un momento dado.
A diferencia de los juegos posteriores de la serie, que se centran más en los acertijos basados ​​en inventario, este juego presenta una gran cantidad de peligros que matan al jugador al contacto. Inicialmente solo hay tres vidas para completar el juego, lo que lo convierte en un juego muy difícil de completar según los estándares actuales.

But that's just the beginning – after the fruit game, a dice challenge awaits, where you guess whether the next roll will be higher or lower. In normal mode, you play freely, but in bank mode, you start with $20 and try to climb through five increasingly demanding banks to reach the big payout. It's tension, risk, and thrill – all riding on the next throw.

meta.name: Dizzy Goes Raving
meta.desc:

The game requires skill and offers a humorous, exciting search for the friends needed for a successful party.

meta.name: Dizzy Goes SEUCK

The journey requires skill and good timing to successfully complete Dizzy's task.

As you blast through dangerous terrain like water and bamboo, defeated foes turn into bonus fruit for extra points. A unique feature is the adjustable speed, ranging from sluggishly slow to lightning fast, giving you full control over the pace of the game.

meta.name: Django

What do you think of being transported in a time machine, to the old West, where the only way to survive is to shoot before others shoot you? The aim of the game is just that: to survive the attack of armed gangsters who try to kill you. For each criminal killed you get a reward, but be careful to not hit the poor defenseless people walking n the streets. If you do, you will be penalized and required to pay a reward to the loved ones of the deceased. Fortunately at the end of your labors you can go to the saloon and participate in a good game of Blackjack.

meta.name: DNA Warrior

After a failed experiment, DNA is growing uncontrollably in your brain – and only a shrunken assault ship can stop the looming disaster. You pilot the ship through your pulsing insides, collect eight pieces of a growth inhibitor, and fight your way to the center of your mind. Only by finding all the pieces can you halt the mutation and save your life.

meta.name: Dneiper River Line

In Dneiper River Line, you take command of German forces in Southern Ukraine in 1943. Your mission is to hold a strategically vital defensive line against advancing Soviet units. The computer controls the enemy and tries to break through your thinly held front and capture key objectives. The game plays like a traditional board game with a map and unit counters, but requires tactical thinking and foresight to repel the Soviet offensive.

You enter your solutions and watch a house gradually take shape, while mistakes build the opposing structure instead. This creates a gentle incentive to pay closer attention and retry problems until they are solved correctly. Beneath its simple presentation lies a learning experience that practises maths, provides immediate feedback, and encourages persistence through its clear visual rewards.

meta.name: Doc the Destroyer

Doc the Destroyer takes place in a world devastated by centuries of pollution. The last survivors live beneath an energy dome, while dark creatures rule outside. Ignoring all warnings, Doc ventures out to convince people to return to the Earth's surface. At the start, you create your character by balancing attributes such as strength, stamina, luck, charisma, and intelligence. As you travel, each area is described in text, and you must choose whether to explore, hide, escape, or fight.

meta.name: The Amazing Spider-Man and Captain America in Dr. Doom's Revenge!
meta.desc:

Latverian president Dr. Doom is a terrible enemy, so when he hatches a plan to blow up New York City with a stolen Atomic bomb, one Marvel superhero is not enough to stop him. The main action in the game is a side-scrolling beat 'em up, in which you alternately control the two characters. They each have their own moves to deal with The Rhino, Electro and other foes. Moves are context-sensitive based on the distance between your character and the opponent. Energy bars decrease as you each take hits. After each section you get comic-book sequences as a reward, and to set the scene of the evolving story.
