⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.44 KB

Dodge'm is a racing game for the Commodore 64 in which you drive on an oval track and have to collect all the points to complete the level. You have to avoid the gray opponent who is also on the track. Skill and quick reactions are required to avoid collisions and collect all the points. The game offers a mixture of racing and skill elements and requires strategic driving to be successful.

meta.name: Dodgeball II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.53 KB

Dodgeball II is a game for the Commodore 64 that looks like a sports game at first glance, but turns out to be an action-packed adventure. Your task is to eliminate all the opponents of the opposing team by hitting them with balls before they get you. The game mixes the fun of dodgeball with dynamic shooting mechanics, making for an exciting and unusual experience.

meta.name: Dodgy Geezers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 68.79 KB

Dodgy Geezers sends you back into the criminal underworld after your release from prison, where one final big job is meant to open the way to the Costa Brava. First, you have to explore the city, track down your old accomplices, and find out exactly what is being planned. At the same time, you need to earn the respect of the local crooks before bringing your gang back together and carrying out the heist. The result is an atmospheric gangster adventure that combines exploration, dialogue, and a strong dose of shady charm.

meta.name: Dodo's Deep Doo-Doo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.16 KB

Dodo's Deep Doo-Doo takes you to 17th-century Mauritius, where you play as the last surviving dodo. Sailors armed with harpoons and muskets have set traps all over the island, and you must navigate these hazards to recover hidden eggs. A map at the start of each area shows possible nesting sites – light dots mark eggs, while black dots are empty or may even hide traps. Along the way, you can also find mounds of dirt: planting four dodo tree saplings there grants you an extra life. Only by skillfully avoiding traps, hunters, and the elements can you collect all the eggs and reach safety.

meta.name: Dogfight 2187
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.56 KB

In Dogfight 2187 you play as pilot Rhett Dexter, a believer in an ancient prophecy: an invasion from another dimension threatens to emerge through a rift in the time continuum. To stop it, you steal an experimental fighter and set out to recover nine pieces of a warp generator scattered across space. From a first-person cockpit view, you track enemies on radar, manage fuel and shields, and battle waves of hostile ships. Defeated foes may drop generator parts, which must be delivered to the rift to gradually seal it and save mankind. Besides solo play, a two-player mode lets you either compete or cooperate in the fight.

meta.name: Dolphin Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game was canceled before its official release. It was planned to feature improved gameplay compared to Uridium with additional features, but the development took too long. A preview version was released and is fully playable, with good intro music, but if it feels half-finished, that's because, in some ways, it is.

meta.name: The Dolphin's Rune
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Dolphin's Rune is an unusual blend of action and puzzle, placing you in control of a dolphin exploring a vast ocean world. You learn to swim gracefully, avoid sharks and resurface for air—while steering clear of tuna nets above. Beneath the waves you must find “color currents,” underwater tunnels that push you around unless you navigate them skillfully. Mastering these brings vision-like dream sequences filled with symbols and distinctive dolphin clicks and whistles you must remember. These sounds guide you to new color currents, mysterious seabed runes and hieroglyph fragments that can be deciphered with the included “Dolphinese-English Dictionary.” Each discovery reveals another layer of meaning—and ultimately hints at the location of a real hidden pearl somewhere in America.

meta.name: Domain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Domain is an unusual game where the player moves through various rooms, collects items, and uses them in different locations while being attacked by rats and dogs. The game contains minimal text, leaving much of the storyline open to interpretation. However, the title screen suggests that the game is loosely based on James Herbert's horror novel Domain, even though many human characters and scenes are absent. The story is set in 1986, after London has been struck by five nuclear bombs, and the player takes on the role of a survivor, possibly Steve Culver from the book. Notably, the game features unique and professionally crafted music.

meta.name: The Domes of Sha
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.01 KB

"The Domes of Sha" takes place in a distant corner of the galaxy, set in a time after the Great War that erased all records of the past. The once-thriving agricultural planet Olaxas lies in ruins, and the story begins as the player awakens in this post-apocalyptic world. The massive stone domes encircling the rugged Valley of Sha hold secrets and hidden paths. While exploring, the player encounters mysterious figures like D. Grunt and must navigate through the unknown terrain.

meta.name: Dominator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Dominator“ is an action-packed shooter where players control a small spaceship to save Earth from an alien invasion. The game starts with navigating tight passages under constant attack. The first level features vertical scrolling, with the ship in its basic form. Later levels switch to horizontal scrolling, offering power-ups like speed boosts and tail cannons. Each stage typically ends with a powerful boss that requires heavy firepower to defeat.

meta.name: Dominoes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.71 KB

„Dominoes“ offers a digital version of the classic domino game. Players take turns placing tiles against the computer, ensuring that only matching numbers connect. The goal is to play all of one's tiles before the opponent or to strategically achieve the highest score. Careful planning and tactical moves are key to winning the game.

meta.name: Dominoes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.36 KB

„Dominoes“ offers a digital version of the classic domino game. Players take turns placing tiles against the computer, ensuring that only matching numbers connect. The goal is to play all of one's tiles before the opponent or to strategically achieve the highest score. Careful planning and tactical moves are key to winning the game.

meta.name: Mensch ärgere Dich nicht
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.84 KB

The game is a computer adaptation of a German board game (Mensch ärgere dich nicht). The name of the game comes from the fact that a piece is sent back to the "Start" field when another piece lands on it, similar to the later game "Sorry!". It is a "cross-and-circle" game where the circle is folded onto the cross, similar to the Indian game "Pachisi", the Colombian "Parqués", the American games "Parcheesi" and "Trouble", the French game "Jeu des petits chevaux", and the English game "Ludo". Like in "Sorry!", the goal is to get all of one's pieces home and avoid being overtaken by other players.

meta.name: Don't Shoot That Word!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.41 KB

Don't Shoot That Word! is an educational game that works like a shooting gallery. A series of words move across the screen, and the player must shoot the correct words by targeting them with a crosshair. There are two versions of the game: the Reading Game and the Rhyme Game. In the Reading Game, the goal is to shoot the words that do not match the displayed image. After a word is shot, its letters fall down, and the player can collect bonus points by shooting these letters. In the Rhyme Game, the objective is to shoot the words that either match the image or rhyme with it. Shooting the wrong word causes the player to lose a life.

meta.name: Donald Duck's Playground
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Donald Duck's Playground” follows Donald on his mission to earn money so he can build a playground for his nephews Huey, Dewey, and Louie. In four mini-games, he takes on different jobs: on the Amquack Express he sets track junctions to deliver packages, on the farm he catches and sorts fruit, in the toy store he organizes items by shape and color while avoiding the security switch, and at the airport he sorts packages by delivery code. With the money earned, Donald buys and arranges playground equipment – all while teaching young minds the value of money and responsibility.

meta.name: Donald the Hero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.10 KB

Donald the Hero is a game for the Commodore 64 in which Donald Duck tries to become as wealthy as his Uncle Scrooge. In Duckburg, he moves across a meadow where coins fly through the air. Your goal is to catch as many coins as possible to increase Donald's wealth. Quick reflexes and skill are needed to be as successful as possible.

meta.name: Donald's Alphabet Chase
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Donald's Alphabet Chase is an educational game for children ages 2-5 featuring Donald Duck. Donald's alphabet letters have escaped and are now hiding throughout the house! You need to help Donald locate all 26 of the letters and put them back in place. By pressing a letter on the keyboard, an animation is displayed where Donald finds and catches that letter. There are six different screens a letter may be hiding on, and each letter features a different animation. When all of the letters have been collected, the game is over and a bonus screen is displayed.

meta.name: Donkey Kong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Released in the arcades in 1981, Donkey Kong was Nintendo's first real smash hit for the company. Mario scale four different industrial themed levels (construction zone, cement factory, an elevator-themed level, and removing rivets from girders) in an attempt to save the damsel in distress, Pauline, from the big ape before the timer runs out. Once the rivets are removed from the final level, Donkey Kong falls, and the two lovers are reunited. From there, the levels start over at a higher difficulty. Along the way, Mario must dodge a constant stream of barrels, "living" fireballs, and spring-weights. Mario can find a hammer which allows him to destroy the barrels and fireballs for a limited amount of time.

meta.name: Donkey Kong (Ocean)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Donkey Kong" – this is the Ocean version of the game where Jumpman tries to rescue a lady from the clutches of a giant ape named Donkey Kong. The game consists of four different single-screen levels, each representing 25 meters of the structure Donkey Kong has climbed. The final screen takes place at 100 meters.

meta.name: Donkey Kong Junior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Donkey Kong Junior flips the roles – this time, Mario is the villain, and you play as Donkey Kong's son trying to rescue his father from captivity. Climb vines, dodge snapjaws, birds and sparks, and collect fruits for extra points. This remake is based on the Atari 7800 version with enhanced graphics and sound, while staying faithful to the original arcade gameplay.

meta.name: Doolhof
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.13 KB

In Doolhof you find yourself dropped into a maze and must navigate your way to the exit. Using the joystick, you guide your character through twisting corridors in search of the white bar that marks freedom, all while the timer steadily ticks down. Every move counts, and only sharp focus and quick thinking will lead you out in time.

meta.name: Doomdark's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.54 KB

Doomdark's Revenge continues the saga of Lords of Midnight, weaving a far more intricate story. After Doomdark's fall, his daughter Shareth kidnaps young Morkin, son of Luxor the Moonprince, and twists his mind with dark magic. You begin with Luxor, Rothron the Wise, and Morkin's beloved Tarithel, but as the quest unfolds, more characters join to defeat Shareth and bring Morkin back. The game blends strategy, exploration, and diplomacy as you gather armies, forge alliances, and walk the fine line between power and corruption.

meta.name: Doriath
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.85 KB

In the dangerous and evil Deeps of Doriath lies the Coronet of Arien which will give the owner immortality when held. It was cast into the depths by Atelan, Lord of Time after himself and the Coronet were rejected by the woman he loved, Fianna. Centuries later and you, Elidaan the Loremaster have found a scroll with ancient writings written by Fianna describing the Coronet and it's powers. In this side view flick-screen arcade adventure you must explore the depths of Doriath in search of the prize.

meta.name: Doris 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Doris 2, the objective is to recreate an image in a second window within a given time limit. The player can shift entire rows either diagonally or horizontally to match the target image. Each image allows for up to ten attempts, and there are three difficulty levels. The game ends when time runs out, demanding quick perception and skilled movements to succeed.

meta.name: Dot Gobbler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.25 KB

“Dot Gobbler” is a classic Pac-Man clone where the player gobbles up dots in a maze while avoiding hungry ghouls. Collecting large power dots grants the player extra strength, allowing them to chase and eat the ghouls for bonus points. Quick thinking and precise maneuvering are essential for success.

meta.name: Dot Gobbler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.25 KB

“Dot Gobbler” is a classic Pac-Man clone where the player gobbles up dots in a maze while avoiding hungry ghouls. Collecting large power dots grants the player extra strength, allowing them to chase and eat the ghouls for bonus points. Quick thinking and precise maneuvering are essential for success.

meta.name: Dots & Boxes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Dots and Boxes, you engage in a classic game focused on completing boxes. On a grid of dots, players take turns drawing lines between adjacent dots. The player who draws the fourth line of a box fills it with their initial and earns an extra turn. The game ends when all boxes are filled, and the player with the most boxes wins. It presents strategic challenges and requires a strong understanding of tactics.

meta.name: DOUBLE
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Double combines two arcade classics into a fast-paced horizontal showdown. You return the ball as in Pong while also clearing bricks from the field, blending defense and offense in every rally. Quick reflexes and smart positioning are essential as the action constantly shifts. An included level editor lets you design your own layouts and shape the challenge to your liking – a creative spin on familiar gameplay ideas.

meta.name: Double
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.11 KB

In Double, you must reconstruct two identical patterns within a set time limit. To do this, you move entire rows — either diagonally or horizontally — by one or more spaces. Each move reduces the number of remaining moves. The game ends when time runs out or when you exhaust all your moves. It features various difficulty levels and numerous stages that challenge your pattern recognition skills and strategic thinking.

meta.name: Double Breakout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.14 KB

Double Breakout Game is a Breakout clone in which one joystick controls one paddle, and the other joystick controls the other. While technically, it can be played with two players, the game was intended by the developer for one player controlling both paddles with both controllers, making it a twin-stick breakout game.

meta.name: Double Dare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Double Dare is the computer version of the game show originally hosted by Marc Summers. Like the TV show, the game is basically a trivia game with the added enhancement of being able to answer the question, or take a dare. Dares consist of the Toss-up Challenge, the Physical Challenge, and in the last round, the Obstacle Course. Questions are varied, and in large enough number to avoid excessive repetition even over several games worth of play.

meta.name: Double Digger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.90 KB

In Double Digger, you control characters on a single screen as you navigate obstacles and search for treasures. The game requires skill and quick reflexes, especially in the challenging levels. It is designed to be most enjoyable in multiplayer mode, where two players compete simultaneously. Teamwork and strategic thinking are essential to overcome the challenges and achieve success.

meta.name: Double Dragon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Double Dragon follows twin brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee as they take on the brutal Black Warriors gang after Billy's girlfriend Marian is kidnapped in the streets of a post-apocalyptic New York. Refusing to give in to blackmail, they fight back using their martial arts skills and anything they can get their hands on. From city slums and industrial ruins to the depths of the forest, each step brings them closer to the gang's hideout and a final showdown with boss Willy. The path is tough, the enemies relentless, but the Lee brothers won't stop until Marian is safe.

meta.name: Double Dragon II : The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Double Dragon II: The Revenge intensifies the conflict with the Black Warriors as Marian is murdered by the gang in revenge for their earlier defeat. For Billy and Jimmy Lee, there's no more mercy – they set out on a relentless mission to crush the Black Warriors once and for all. With new enemies, deadly traps, and an overhauled direction-based combat system, every battle is more intense and dangerous than ever. This time, it's not about rescue – it's about revenge.

p: Double Dragon III - The Rosetta Stone (USA).D64
n: Double Dragon III - The Rosetta Stone (USA)

meta.name: Double Dragon 3 - The Rosetta Stone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Double Dragon 3" es el juego final de la trilogía. Billy y Jimmy Lee regresan de un entrenamiento de artes marciales cuando sus caminos se cruzan con una adivina. Ella les habla de un gran demonio en Egipto, su adversario más fuerte hasta el momento, y de cómo las Piedras de Rosetta pueden ayudarles. Este juego cuenta con tiendas de armas donde Billy y Jimmy pueden comprar potenciadores, trucos, energía y vidas extra para ayudarles en su misión. Los potenciadores hacen que Billy y Jimmy doblen su tamaño, aumentando el daño que hacen y su rango de ataque. Los gráficos de los personajes han cambiado, dejando de ser de dibujos animados para convertirse en personajes más realistas.

meta.name: Double Dribble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based on the arcade game, Double Dribble is a basketball action game for one or two players. You can select different time limits for games, select teams, and begin playing! Gameplay is entirely action, so no time needs to be spent customizing the teams or with statistics. You control each player on the team one at a time (the player with or about to receive the ball will be human controlled, with the computer taking over the other players temporarily.) Some versions feature a small amount of digitized sound effects, and close ups of slam dunks.

meta.name: Double Falcon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The airplane is a machine that takes you on a journey from the Earth into the skies and safely brings you back. However, anything that can fly can also come crashing down. Therefore, you must prove your skills in battles against enemy bases or opponents in the air. You can engage in duels with rival aircraft, with one player controlling the upper frame and the other controlling the lower frame. Different difficulty levels allow for varying scoring systems. Who will emerge victorious in the end? The game demands both skill and strategic thinking.

p: Double Feature - Adventures in the Microzone (USA).D64
n: Double Feature - Adventures in the Microzone (USA)

meta.name: Double Feature : Adventures in the Microzone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An Adventure: Double Feature is a collection of two adventurous graphical text adventures. In Adventures in the Microzone, the player is shrunk down to two inches after using their computer early in the morning. The objective is to explore either their own room or their grandfather's to find the computer manual needed to return to normal size. Along the way, the player must navigate a labyrinth of straws, avoid the dangers of caffeine, and be cautious not to get lost in the chaotic closet. The choices made will influence the course of the adventure.

meta.name: Double Feature : Haunted House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

A Mystery Double Feature is a collection of two adventurous games centered around mysterious themes. In Haunted House, you play a character who wakes up in the middle of the night, dreaming that their friend has gone missing in the abandoned Belmore Manor. Upon your arrival, you discover that stacks of Space Wimps arcade games are piled up there. In the basement, you encounter a ghostly comedian who entertains you with his humor. As you make your way to the ground floor, you find your friend and must navigate through the house to inform the police about thieves who are modifying Space Wimps arcade games to steal coins. The choices you make influence the course of the story and the resolution of the mystery.

p: Double Feature - Mystery at Pinecrest Manor (USA).D64
n: Double Feature - Mystery at Pinecrest Manor (USA)

meta.name: Double Feature - Mystery at Pinecrest Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A Mystery Double Feature is a collection of two adventurous games revolving around mysterious themes. In Mystery at Pinecrest Manor, you are invited to visit your Uncle Ralph at his house on the coast of Maine to witness the unveiling of a newly acquired Egyptian statue. There, you encounter a variety of other guests. After the celebration, you go to sleep, only to discover the next morning that the statue has been stolen. To solve the case, you must explore the various rooms of the manor and gather clues to determine who committed the theft. Once you have collected all the clues, you need to name the thief and find the location of the hidden statue. The choices you make will influence the course of the story and the resolution of the mystery.

meta.name: Double Feature - Northwoods Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Northwoods Adventure, you wake early on a family camping trip and set off alone to explore – either hiking through the woods or canoeing down the river. Your choices shape the journey, with options for gear like a walking stick, binoculars, or a compass and map. Along the way, you might get lost in a swamp, twist your ankle and get rescued, or crash your canoe in the rapids. Text descriptions guide you through a nature-filled interactive adventure full of unexpected turns.

meta.name: Double or Nothing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.58 KB

In Double or Nothing, you simultaneously control two characters, offering an original twist on the classic Commando game. This dual control can be occasionally confusing but provides an exciting gameplay experience. The challenge of managing both characters demands strategic thinking and precise movements, making the game an entertaining adventure.

meta.name: Double Sphere
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Double Sphere turns a futuristic arena into an unusual duel where two astronaut-like players fight for control of the ball. You move freely across the field, try to secure possession, and launch the ball into the opponent's goal at the right moment. This creates a dynamic back-and-forth driven more by timing and positioning than complex rules. The simple visuals are supported by a fitting atmosphere, giving the game its own charm despite its basic presentation.

meta.name: Double Take
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.36 KB

Eres un profesor que puede volar. La zona de juego está dividida en varios tipos de salas. Hay dos universos paralelos, y a veces eres enviado de uno a otro. Tendrás que recoger objetos de estos mundos espejo que se han intercambiado y volver a colocarlos en su lugar correcto, para restablecer el equilibrio. También tendrás que disparar a numerosos alienígenas antes de que ellos te disparen a ti, y finalmente enfrentarte a un jefe alienígena al final.

meta.name: The Double
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.71 KB

The Double is a football management simulator based on the English Football League and includes all the four top divisions from the 80s. The idea of the game is to manage a team from the bottom division and take them all the way to the top division and win 'The Double', which consists of winning the League and The FA Cup in the same season.

meta.name: Doughboy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Doughboy, you fight your way through enemy territory to rescue a prisoner of war – all under a tight five-minute time limit. Armed with a machine gun and dynamite, you must dodge minefields, barbed wire, trenches, and watchtowers while tanks, naval forces, and enemy troops try to stop you. Only those who find the necessary keys and survive increasingly complex levels can complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Down the Chimney
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.23 KB

"Down the Chimney" is a game for the Commodore 64. It is a simple game of skill in which the player has to drop presents down a chimney to deliver them to the houses below. The game is characterized by its minimalist graphics and simple game mechanics. Although "Down the Chimney" is not one of the most famous titles on the C64, it still offers a nostalgic insight into the variety of games developed for this home computer.

meta.name: Downhill : Ski Jump
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.91 KB

Downhill: Ski Jump drops you onto a fast-paced downhill run with selectable difficulty levels where quick reactions are key. Despite the name, the game is not about jumping but about dodging trees, houses and other randomly placed obstacles scattered across the slope. You weave left and right to stay alive and avoid a crash. The focus is on reflexes and survival rather than aerial tricks.

meta.name: Downhill Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This 3D skiing game is played from a behind-the-skier perspective and offers four disciplines: slalom, giant slalom, downhill and ski jump. You can train each event or compete in pairs in competition mode. You must pass gates precisely, stay on track and avoid trees and spectators. Mistakes lead to penalty points that lower your score. Up to five players can participate and compare their results at the end.

meta.name: Downhill Racer-64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.02 KB

In Downhill Racer-64 you control a skier racing down a snowy slope, dodging trees, rocks and barriers. Push forward on the joystick to go faster, pull back to slow down. The longer you survive and the more obstacles you avoid, the higher your score. Distance traveled also counts. The higher the chosen difficulty level, the faster the game – and the more points you can earn.

meta.name: Dr. J
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.40 KB

In Dr. J, you embark on an adventure where you must solve various puzzles and overcome challenges. The character, Dr. J, is on a mission to complete specific tasks, navigating through different levels. You'll need to act quickly and skillfully to progress and successfully complete the game. The blend of action and brain-teasers provides a diverse and enjoyable gaming experience.

meta.name: Jackle & Wide
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.67 KB

As you go from room to room you have to find the items which will stop you changing into Dr Jackle for good. On the way round the rooms, you come across different puzzles to solve and items to pick up. The mission takes you to a park and then onto a labyrinth. The player must dodge such as like spikes and green bottles!

n: Dr. Mad vs. the Topsy Turvy Moon Men of Mars (USA) (Unl)

“Dr. Mad vs. the Topsy Turvy Moon Men of Mars” is a platformer where the player takes on the role of a scientist battling aliens from Mars who have invaded the city. The aliens are disguised as animals, and contact with them means instant death, as does touching obstacles or taking a hit. The scientist can throw purple flasks, and levers can be used to navigate various platforms. The game features several large and intricate levels.

meta.name: Dr. Pimples Dog
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dr. Pimple's Dog turns a rescue mission into a nasty minefield adventure where every step has to be considered carefully. You move from the bottom of the screen to the top, marking your path with red paint while only receiving clues about how many mines are nearby, not where they are hidden. Later on, princesses, a paint-licking dog with a bomb, and a minah bird dropping extra mines raise the pressure considerably. That mix of logic, risk, and wonderfully absurd ideas gives the game its distinctive appeal.

n: Dr. Seuss - Fix-Up the Mix-Up Puzzler (USA)

meta.name: Dr. Seuss : Fix-Up the Mix-Up Puzzler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.64 KB

"Dr. Seuss' Fix-Up the Mix-Up Puzzler" challenges the player to reassemble scrambled figures from the world of Dr. Seuss, such as the Grinch or the Cat in the Hat. The figures consist of three parts – head, body, and feet – that must be arranged correctly within a 3x3 grid. Only one piece can be held at a time, creating an empty space that allows for movement. Higher difficulty levels introduce rotation as an added challenge. Completing a figure triggers a small animation, and the game is won once all characters are correctly assembled.

meta.name: Draconus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador asume el papel del héroe, Frognum, cuya tarea es recuperar su reino de manos de la bestia Tirano. El estilo del juego es principalmente un juego de plataformas en el que el jugador corre y salta a través de varias pantallas, que suman alrededor de cien. Muchas de las salas incluyen enemigos que generalmente siguen caminos fijos, pero también pueden enjambrar y perseguir al jugador. El jugador comienza el juego con dos armas: aliento de fuego, que es limitado pero puede reponerse recolectando elementos, y un puñetazo que es ilimitado. Una vez destruidos, los enemigos no reaparecen excepto en la versión C64, donde pueden reaparecer si se vuelve a visitar una habitación que solo se despejó parcialmente. La tarea principal es encontrar cuatro habilidades especiales y luego enfrentar la batalla final. El contacto con el enemigo reduce la energía vital de Frognum, que puede rellenarse con símbolos coleccionables. Al perder toda la energía vital, Frognum pierde una vida y se reinicia desde la última losa Record. Estas losas se encuentran en todo el mundo del juego y sirven como puntos de control. Impactar sobre el agua mientras está en forma humanoide generalmente resulta en la muerte inmediata, al igual que caer a grandes distancias o tocar púas.

meta.name: Dracula
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dracula is a text adventure based on Bram Stoker's novel of the same name. The player takes the role of Jonathan Harker, a lawyer who visits a certain Count Dracula in his castle. The game is divided into three separate text adventures which can be played independently, but build up on each other. The First Night is about Harker's travels to the castle and The Arrival deals with his time in the castle. During The Hunt, the last third of the story, the protagonist changes to Dr. Seward, the manager of the insane asylum in Whitby, Yorkshire. The game itself is mostly concerned with story telling and atmosphere; it is relatively light on puzzle solving. The parser only understands verb + noun combinations.

meta.name: Dracula II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dracula II is the sequel to Dracula's Castle and continues the story after Dracula's death. The player has left the castle, but the vampire's treasure remains hidden. The goal is to find the treasure and escape alive. This adventure is larger and more challenging than its predecessor but offers an achievable challenge for experienced players. The game is divided into two parts, with the first focusing on the journey through Transylvania to the castle. The content of the second part is only revealed upon reaching the castle.

meta.name: Drag Race Eliminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Drag Race Eliminator puts the player in control of a drag racing vehicle, competing against either a human or computer opponent. The goal is to win the race by crossing the finish line first. The player must control the throttle and shift between 2 to 4 gears, depending on the type of vehicle. The race starts with a green light, and any premature start results in disqualification. The game realistically simulates drag racing, with precise timing measured down to thousandths of a second. It features national records as default in the high score tables, and if the player breaks a record, their name is added to the list.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.89 KB

meta.name: Dragon Breed
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Zambaquous ha hecho todo lo posible para convertir la vida del pueblo de Agamen en un infierno, por lo que su rey Kayus, decide poner fin a esta amenaza.
Lo que diferencia a este juego de todos los demás shoot'em ups de desplazamiento lateral (con la excepción de Saint Dragon) es que montas un dragón, llamado Bahamoot. Tanto tú como el dragón tenéis potencia de fuego, y mantener pulsado el botón de disparo aumenta la ferocidad de los rayos de energía de Bahamoot. La cola del dragón puede controlarse indirectamente y, como es indestructible, puede utilizarse como escudo o como arma.
Hay bonificaciones que recoger mientras desciendes del dragón para recogerlas. Estos incluyen una explosión de fuego, rayos de la cola de Bahamoot, misiles teledirigidos y rayos, con sólo uno activo a la vez. Cada nivel tiene un límite de tiempo.

meta.name: Dragon Flame
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.05 KB

In Dragon Flame, you control a dragon that must shoot falling debris before it reaches you or the ground. You skillfully move the dragon across the screen to dodge and destroy the incoming objects in time. The game demands quick reactions and good coordination to fend off the approaching dangers and continue progressing successfully. It offers a fast-paced and challenging experience as you try to keep the area clear and survive longer in the game.

meta.name: Dragon Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, you take on the role of a space explorer on a planet filled with water, forests, and ancient buildings. Your mission is crucial, but the planet is inhabited by dragons, whose touch drains your life energy. To survive, you must either avoid the dragons or fight them using your laser rifle. After successfully clearing a sector, you progress to the next, facing more challenges. Your energy, remaining lives, and score are constantly displayed, so it's vital to manage your resources wisely as you defeat the dragons in all their forms. Every encounter tests your skill, strategy, and ability to survive in a dangerous alien world.

meta.name: Dragon Spirit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La princesa Alicia del reino de Mitgult ha sido secuestrada por el monstruo Zawell (resucitado por Galda, que quiere conquistar el mundo). Ahora le toca al heroico guerrero Amul transformarse en un dragón azul e ir a rescatar a la princesa.
Dragon Spirit es un shoot-em-up de desplazamiento vertical que consta de nueve niveles. Los jugadores vuelan y destruyen todo lo que encuentran a su paso. La acción se desarrolla en dos niveles, tanto en el cielo como en el suelo. El dragón tiene dos tipos diferentes de ataques: fuego que sale disparado hacia arriba por la pantalla, y fuego que cae para golpear un punto en el suelo delante del dragón. Los enemigos están presentes en el suelo y en el aire.
El jugador puede recoger bonificaciones o mejoras (cabezas extra en el dragón, salud, disparos más rápidos, ...). Hay un jefe al final de cada nivel. Es mejor tener tantas mejoras como sea posible antes de este encuentro.

meta.name: Dragon Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dragon Wars tiene lugar en la tierra mágica de Dilmun, una isla de salvación convertida en un mundo de horror por Namtar.
El jugador comienza con un grupo de cuatro en la ciudad de Purgatorio sin ningún equipo. Los usuarios de magia tampoco te ayudarán, ya que la magia ha sido prohibida.
Los objetivos principales son sobrevivir, salir del Purgatorio y derrocar a Namtar (una vez equipado por fin...).
La jugabilidad recuerda inmediatamente a la serie Bard's Tale. Se trata de un juego en 3D en primera persona, en el que los adversarios se materializan en el aire. El sistema de combate es por turnos.
A diferencia de sus predecesores, el juego cuenta con un completo sistema de habilidades, mapeado automático y muchos lugares donde utilizar realmente todas tus habilidades.

meta.name: Dragon World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dragon World draws you into a fantasy-filled realm of dragons, riddles, and hidden secrets where exploration and thinking go hand in hand. You navigate winding mazes, discover treasures, encounter strange creatures, and solve clever puzzles that require patience and focus. Flying sequences, mysterious eggs, and musical elements add variety and a fairy-tale atmosphere. The appeal comes from blending adventure and learning with playful riddles that invite curiosity and reflection.

meta.name: Dragon's Eye, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Dragon's Eye, you play as a brave warrior tasked with saving the land from an impending threat. Your goal is to find and recover the Dragon's Eye amulet before its dark power corrupts the entire world. The game starts on a strategic map, where you can explore various regions. Along the way, you will encounter enemies and engage in turn-based battles, where you issue commands that must be executed in the correct order. You can also visit cities to buy items and rest, but be cautious: the amulet has a time limit, and the evil will prevail if you don't act quickly. The game combines strategic exploration, combat, and resource management, with a race against time to prevent disaster.

meta.name: Dragon's Keep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A children's game developed in the same spirit as the Hi-Res Adventure series (Mission:Asteroid, Mystery House, etc.).
A dragon caught 16 animals (a dog, a bird, a fish, a turtle, a cat, a squirrel, a rabbit, a pig, a bear, a monkey, a cow, a calf, a hen, a puppy, a ... frog and raccoon) that need to be freed.
From your home, you travel to different locations to find all the animals the dragon has captured. Watch out for the dragon. If you see him, you will not be able to free the animal in the same picture.
Young adventurers simply choose their activity from a short list. The adventure world is very small and the animals are easy to find if you look everywhere.

meta.name: Dragon's Kingdom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.47 KB

Dragon's Kingdom puts you in the role of Darius, fighting through the ravaged land of Thalax, which was plunged into darkness by the King of Demons. The king turned himself into a griffin and unleashed demons from the Swamp of Soggoth. Across three dangerous levels, you throw unlimited swords at enemies, dodge fireballs and lava, and climb ladders and platforms. Treasure chests can hold new weapons like axes or fireballs. If you hit an enemy or obstacle, you're knocked back and briefly invincible – but the next hit costs a life.

meta.name: Dragon's Lair
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dragon's Lair te pone en la piel del intrépido caballero Dirk, quien se adentra en el peligroso castillo del dragón Singe para rescatar a la princesa Daphne. Antes de llegar a la guarida del dragón, tendrás que sobrevivir a innumerables trampas, esquivar criaturas mortales y usar tus reflejos. Tras rescatar a la princesa, comienza una segunda misión al instante: escapar del castillo, ahora invadido por el Rey Lagarto y sus secuaces. Una mezcla de plataformas, acción basada en reflejos y puzles pondrá a prueba tu ritmo y tus decisiones en cada escena.

p: Dragon's Lair Part II - Escape from Singe's Castle (Europe).D64
n: Dragon's Lair Part II - Escape from Singe's Castle (Europe)

meta.path: ./Dragon's Lair Part II - Escape from Singe's Castle (Europe).D64
meta.name: Dragon's Lair Part II : Escape from Singe's Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Dragon's Lair Part II: Escape from Singe's Castle" continues Dirk's adventure right after rescuing Princess Daphne. Instead of fleeing, he returns to the deadly castle to claim part of its treasure – guarded by the cunning and lethal Lizard King. Only lightning-fast reflexes and perfect timing will help you survive his attacks and avoid giant rolling marbles. You'll race down rapids in a barrel, fly through corridors on a magical horse, and face other dangerous trials. In the end, you must escape the realm of the mud monsters, who rise from the earth to enslave Dirk and turn him into one of them. Navigate the treacherous terrain and leap across the final chasm to win your freedom.

meta.name: Dragonfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.38 KB

¡Los tesoros del rey han sido robados! Como joven y audaz príncipe, tu objetivo es recuperarlos a todos. Los tesoros se guardan en diferentes castillos, cada uno custodiado por un dragón de fuego. Cada nivel del juego tiene dos partes, primero tienes que cruzar el puente levadizo del castillo. ¡Tendrás que saltar y esquivar las bolas de fuego de los dragones y evitar las flechas voladoras para llegar al otro lado! En la segunda parte, tienes que recoger todos los tesoros de la pantalla y ponerlos en un lugar seguro mientras evitas al dragón que corre por la parte inferior de la pantalla. Los dragones de cada nivel tienen diferentes patrones de movimiento y disparo, y a medida que avanzan los niveles se vuelven más rápidos y complicados.

meta.name: DragonHawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.68 KB

In DragonHawk, you control a fierce airborne predator battling enemies like buzzards, phoenixes, and dragon pups by swooping down on them from above – reminiscent of Joust. Enemies can do the same to you, so positioning is everything. Rapidly pressing the fire button makes your hawk flap its wings, but the faster you flap, the harder it is to control. Delay too long, and lightning bolts will strike from the sky. Collect feathers for bonus points, earn extra lives at every 1000 points, and prepare to face a giant fire-breathing serpent once all other foes are defeated.

meta.name: Dragonriders of Pern
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dragonriders of Pern puts you in the role of a Weyrleader negotiating alliances and battling the deadly Thread threatening the world. In diplomatic rounds, you convince Lord Holders or Craftsmasters, while events like dragon hatchings boost your influence. If diplomacy fails, dueling is an option – risky, but sometimes necessary. In the real-time combat phase, you ride your dragon to burn the Thread in the sky before it reaches the ground. Only through clever strategy, strong alliances, and quick decisions can you secure victory or face destruction.

meta.name: Dragons of Flame
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dragons of Flame continúa la emocionante aventura de “Heroes of the Lance” y se desarrolla entre este y “Shadow Sorcerer”. Jugado desde una perspectiva clásica de desplazamiento lateral, guías a un héroe a la vez a través de entornos peligrosos, luchando contra enemigos y usando las habilidades únicas de cada personaje para progresar. Puedes cambiar de compañero en cualquier momento; cada uno se adapta a diferentes enemigos o desafíos. La historia sigue de cerca las novelas y módulos de juego de Weiss y Hickman, sumergiéndote en el mundo de Dragonlance, más allá de las mecánicas habituales de los RPG.

meta.name: DragonsDen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"DragonsDen" puts you in the role of Den, a knight on a flying horse armed with a lance, battling an ever-growing dragon threat. Across multiple phases, you destroy dragon eggs, fend off hatchlings, dodge spiders and blades, survive arrow storms, hatch a massive dragon, and face it in a final duel. With each game cycle, enemies become faster and more aggressive, culminating in a showdown with the ultimate dragon boss. Sharp control and steady nerves are essential to claim victory in this aerial battle.

meta.name: Dragon Skulle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.13 KB

DragonSkulle opens as a dark fantasy adventure filled with ominous foreboding, drawing you toward a power that radiates fear and destruction even from afar. The Skull of Souls is not simply a mighty objective, but a malevolent force that becomes aware of your presence and answers at once with visions of death and memories of challengers who failed before you. That dense and threatening atmosphere gives the game a strong appeal, because the journey feels less like a heroic conquest and more like a dangerous step into the domain of an ancient and ravenous evil.

meta.name: Dragonstone : The Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.92 KB

Dragonstone: The Quest plunges you into the cursed kingdom of Astoria, a once-bright land now shrouded in darkness by the evil wizard Zaron. You are an adventurer, drawn by tales of the fair Princess Lianna and the legendary Dragonstone, a jewel of immense power. But betrayal strikes early – Zaron transforms you into a lizard-man and steals your weapons and armor. You awaken helpless in an inn, your fate now your own to shape. To free Astoria, you must rescue Lianna, defeat Zaron, and reclaim the Dragonstone. Each step reveals new dangers, mysteries, and trials – only courage, wit, and resolve will see you through to victory.

meta.name: DragonStrike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

DragonStrike te lleva a los cielos del mundo de Dragonlance como jinete de dragón en la Guerra de la Lanza. Participarás en emocionantes batallas aéreas, interceptarás dragones enemigos, hundirás barcos y protegerás a las fuerzas del bien. Con cada misión que completes, ascenderás de rango, obtendrás objetos mágicos, puntos de vida o recibirás un dragón más poderoso. Habilidad, coraje y una visión clara son las claves para la victoria en este campo de batalla aéreo.

meta.name: Dragonworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dragonworld tells the story of Amsel of Fandora, a reclusive scientist and visionary whose life has drastically changed. Will you be able to overcome the challenges and survive Dracula's relentless pursuit?

meta.name: Draughts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.78 KB

Draughts presents the classic game of checkers in a straightforward and easy-to-follow way, focusing entirely on the tactical contest between two players. From its simple core rules of diagonal movement, capturing, and promotion into kings, it quickly becomes a game that demands awareness, patience, and careful planning ahead. What makes it especially appealing is the way each promoted piece opens up new possibilities, turning what first seems like a calm exchange into a much more engaging duel for control and positional advantage.

meta.name: Draw Poker (ACME)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Draw Poker in this version follows the rules of Five-Card Stud. Each player is first dealt one card face down and one card face up. Depending on the rules, either a “bring-in” is required from the lowest upcard, or betting starts with the highest. After that, players receive one more face-up card followed by a betting round, continuing until five cards are dealt. Each round begins with the player showing the best poker hand so far. The winner is the one with the strongest hand at showdown – or the last player remaining after all others fold.

meta.name: Drazen Petrovic Basketball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.14 KB

Dražen Petrović Basket es un juego inspirado en el gran jugador europeo (fallecido trágicamente en un accidente de tráfico cuatro años después), que simula una competición por eliminación: empiezas en octavos de final y, según tus resultados, avanzas o no en la lucha por el título. Lo interesante es que todos los equipos tienen cinco jugadores con roles realistas: un base, dos aleros y dos pívots, cada uno con atributos propios de su posición y controlables en todo momento. Además, existen faltas personales: al acumular cinco, un jugador es expulsado. También puedes pedir time outs —dos por periodo— para cambiar tácticas, consultar estadísticas, etc.

meta.name: Dreadnought II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dreadnought II picks up right where its predecessor left off, delivering fast-paced battles across colossal battleships in space. In a horizontally scrolling view, you pilot your agile ship over intricate structures, dodging enemy fire and obstacles while eliminating enemy squadrons. The graphics are crisp and high-contrast, and the gameplay remains challenging – only precise, focused flying will get you to the next stage. Each level introduces new attack patterns and deadly surprises.

Dreadnoughts: World War II, North Atlantic places you in command of a German naval force during World War II. As leader of the Bismarck and Prinz Eugen, you begin Operation Rhine, aiming to break into the Atlantic and intercept Allied shipping. You set your course, monitor visibility, speed, and fuel, and issue tactical orders. The game combines strategic planning with historical context, giving you the chance to alter the course of the war – if you can evade the British fleet and strike effectively.

It allows the player to design and test the house of his or her dreams.

meta.name: Dream Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.55 KB

In Dream Raider, you take on the role of a cute green monster that has become lost in a hostile forest. To escape the nightmare, you must defend yourself against spiders, worms, and club-wielding men. A single hit from these creatures will reduce your health. Shoot to eliminate the threats and hurry up, as time is running out. Collect bonuses in the forest and in the air to achieve the greatest possible success.

meta.name: Dream Team Challenge 3 on 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Three-on-three basketball game featuring Patrick Ewing, Joe Dumars and Dominique Wilkins. Play as the 'Dream Team' or against the 'Dream Team'. The game features asphalt and hardwood courts in a few different locations. The game has 15 set plays that the players can execute, and a playmaker utility that allows you to come up with your own plays. The game also has a player-management utility that allows you to edit player attributes.

meta.name: Dream Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 77.60 KB

In Dream Warrior you enter a bleak future where corporations rule the world and wars are no longer fought in reality but within a dream world. They control powerful dream demons to crush their enemies, but resistance fighters still oppose them. You take the role of one such fighter, aiming to rescue your friends from Ocular, the most fearsome dream demon of all. In side-scrolling levels reminiscent of space stations, you face endless hordes of strange creatures, gather power-ups, and unlock new areas. Ultimately, you must confront Ocular itself, which can only be defeated by shutting all six of its eyes.

DreamCars lets players race against each other on a track. They control their vehicles from a top-down perspective and must skillfully manage speed and obstacles to win the race.

meta.name: Dream Team Fantasy Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dream Team Fantasy Football lets players step into the role of a team manager. They can build their own team, select, trade, and set up players. With access to detailed stats of NFL players, similar to the pros, they can make informed decisions to lead their team to success.

meta.name: Dreamworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Dreamworld, the player enters a fantastical world that unfolds from their own thoughts and dreams. After falling into a deep sleep, they find themselves in a dangerous and suspense-filled environment, filled with secrets and challenges. The goal is to find a way back to reality while facing the various dangers and adventures lurking in this dream world.

meta.name: Drelbs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.01 KB

Drelbs challenges skill and spatial reasoning as you arrange revolving doors within a labyrinth to create enclosed boxes. Only correctly formed shapes cause gates to appear, triggering brief cutscenes that allow progression to the next level. As the game advances, tougher opponents and increasing speed raise the pressure, making planning, timing and quick reactions essential.

meta.name: Drink & Drown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.45 KB

Drink & Drown is a tongue-in-cheek nightlife simulator in which you try to impress friends and potential dates while managing your money and staying just sober enough to keep going. Progress depends largely on choosing the most suitable – or least embarrassing – option from multiple-choice responses in various situations. Smart decisions earn points and unlock bonus moments, while poor judgment can quickly lead to humiliation or a blackout. The game relies heavily on satire and exaggerated party scenarios for its appeal.

meta.name: Drip
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.46 KB

Drip is a side-scrolling platform game. The player's task is to collect all the coins that spilled out of the car carrying them to the bank. The game features 42 levels full of coins and hostile creatures. The creatures may be neutralized by throwing the ball, however contact with them takes one life. After collecting all the coins Drip must reach the end of the board before the time runs out. The remaining time is recalculated for extra points. The game consists two level passwords, acquired after finishing level 10 and 20.

meta.name: Droid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.62 KB

Droid takes place on the planet Xeviou, seized by bandits. Rich in natural resources, the planet draws the attention of the Highest Intergalactic Council, which sends an advanced robot to neutralize the enemy's central computer. Unfortunately, the robot is defenseless and follows a fixed movement pattern, so it needs your protection. You control a crosshair and must eliminate all bandits before they can destroy the robot. After each cleared section, the droid's energy is fully restored. The game features five stages with five levels each, where quick reflexes and accurate shooting are the key to success.

meta.name: Droid Dreams
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.47 KB

Droid Dreams puts you in control of a droid aboard a spaceship who escapes boredom by becoming a hero in his dreams. In one such dream, the ship is in danger, and only you can save it. To succeed, you must collect objects and place them in the correct locations, all while hostile droids, electric shocks, and bombs block your path. You must also monitor your oil level, which gradually decreases but can be replenished through specific actions. The game is presented in a side-scrolling view, where you move left and right to complete your mission.

meta.name: Droid Muncher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Droid Muncher“ is an arcade-style game where you navigate a maze-like field of grassy patches and wandering cats while being pursued by hostile robots. The objective is to avoid the robots and score points by moving strategically through the screen. The number of remaining robots is displayed along with your score. The challenge lies in maneuvering through the limited space while enemies close in – one wrong move could quickly end the game.

meta.name: Droids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.29 KB

Droids takes place on the unmanned warship Arachnid, which went out of control after a lightning strike. Its computer EDWARD is on red alert and will destroy Venus in less than 24 hours. Your mission is to shut down each deck by destroying a set number of droids. The game is side-view with split screens, using conveyor belts, doors, and transporters to move around. Every hit drains your energy bar, and if it empties the game ends. Terminals provide maps, energy-restoring mini-games, or deck shutdowns – the latter requiring enough destroyed droids and solving a Mastermind-style puzzle. Step by step you disable the Arachnid before it's too late.

meta.name: Star Wars : Droids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.94 KB

Star Wars: Droids is based on the animated series of the same name and focuses on the adventures of C-3PO and R2-D2. Captured by the Fromm Gang, the droids must escape from a dangerous facility. This platformer with puzzle elements has you avoiding traps, seeker droids, maintenance crews, and armed guards. The journey spans three levels: the gang's prison, a mining complex, and a research facility. Only by surviving all these dangers can Threepio and Artoo be reunited with their master, Thall Joben.

meta.name: Drol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Drol puts you in control of a flying, armed robot whose mission is to rescue wandering children scattered across multi-level platform environments. You maneuver across gaps between upper and lower levels while avoiding strange enemies such as bouncing aliens, demons, snakes, and even flying axes. A radar display at the top of the screen helps you locate the children and track incoming threats. Only through precise flight control and accurate shooting can you overcome the dangers and bring every child to safety – an action-packed rescue mission filled with constant pressure from all sides.

meta.name: Drop Down
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.76 KB

In Drop Down you collect falling stars with a box at the bottom of the screen. Simply catching them is not enough – the color of your box has to match the color of the star, otherwise it counts as missed. With every mistake the pressure rises, because missing too many stars means game over. A simple idea – but the faster and more colorful the storm of stars becomes, the more it demands your reflexes and focus.

meta.name: Dropper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.12 KB

Dropper puts the player in the role of a shooter, battling through various levels. The objective is to eliminate enemies while navigating the game's different challenges. Players must maintain control and act strategically to defeat the attacking foes and successfully master the game.

meta.name: Dropzone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dropzone es un juego de acción de ritmo rápido en el que el jugador controla a un astronauta con un jetpack que vuela sobre un paisaje árido. Los cielos están llenos de alienígenas hostiles, incluidos Planters, Blüder Storms y los veloces Nemesites. Los Plantadores y Nemesites intentan secuestrar a pequeños hombres que caminan por la superficie, a quienes el jugador debe rescatar derribando al extraterrestre sin dañar al humano. Sin embargo, algunos extraterrestres llevan androides mortales que parecen humanos pero que deben evitarse. Las personas rescatadas deben ser llevadas a la zona de salto para su seguridad y así poder completar el nivel con éxito.

meta.name: Druid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Druid is an action game inspired by the arcade hit Gauntlet. As the eponymous hero, your job is to destroy four magic skulls hidden over eight levels. 
The game is presented in a top-down view. The druid walks around the terrain seeking out the staircase that leads to the next level. On the way, he is harassed by hordes of monsters that come out of every direction and attack him, decreasing his health. To defend himself, the druid can use the spells of water, fire or electricity to toss projectiles. However, these magical weapons have limited ammo. 
The druid also has three other magical spells at his disposal - an invisibility spell which prevents the monsters from automatically approaching him, a golem spell which summons a helpful golem (which can be controlled by a second player), and a skull spell which destroys all on-screen enemies. The druid also carries around keys which open locked doors. But all these have very limited supplies. 
On his way, the druid finds many shops. Each such shop contains some keys or charges for the druid's spells, but the druid can only pick one item from each shop. 
The druid can also come across a pentagram on the ground which will restore his lost health.

meta.name: Druids Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.55 KB

Druids Moon brings back Tommy Astle, the hero from Werewolf Simulator. We learn that Tommy has always had an interest in the magic and culture of the Druids. Now, with an intense feeling of being called by someone or something, he has travelled into the depths of the English countryside to learn his fate.
He is staying at an olde worlde inn at Aven-bury. It is here that we join him at the start of an adventure that may well change his whole life.
The program is written using Incentive's Graphic Adventure Creator and has the usual limitations of graphic design and parser.

meta.name: Drunken Bat'n'Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.53 KB

Drunken Bat'n'Ball pits two players against each other, but the ball behaves anything but normally – it wobbles unpredictably across the screen, as if drunk. Reflexes and luck determine who hits and who misses. Pong is old news – this is pure chaos!

meta.name: Duck Shoot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Duck Shoot places you at a virtual shooting gallery where precision and timing are key. As your gun moves automatically along the bottom of the screen, you must carefully hit the targets at the top to progress. Moving objects in between offer bonus points, but descending ducks pose a serious threat by consuming your limited ammunition. Added tension comes from a duck flying across the top that can reset already hit targets – a constant balance of risk, accuracy, and ammo management where every shot matters.

You can carry up to two ducks at a time and must bring them safely to the shore before they leap into the water. A lurking hippo, revealed only by bubbles, adds danger – if it catches your boat, you lose a life. After rescuing ten ducks, they sing and the game restarts at a higher speed, making each round more challenging.

meta.name: Duel

In Duel you control a vehicle that leaves a continuous trail behind, similar to Tron Light Cycles or classic worm games. Up to six players can compete at the same time, trying to force others into crashing into trails or the edge of the playing field through clever maneuvering. The winner is the one who survives the longest and uses the shrinking space to their advantage.

meta.name: Duel
meta.desc:

Duel (also known as Space Birds) is a game heavily inspired by Joust. You ride a strange, bird-like creature resembling an ostrich and float through space. Your goal is to collide with your opponents' birds, knocking them out of the sky with the point of your lance. Each successful maneuver increases your score, which is displayed at the bottom of the starting platform. The game takes place in an open arena surrounded by water—so you must avoid flying too low, or you'll fall into the water and be lost. Platforms provide safe landing spots where you can rest and reorient yourself. If you leave one side of the screen, you'll reappear on the opposite side, adding an extra layer of dynamism to the gameplay.

meta.name: Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Duel you race through a hostile landscape in a futuristic flight competition, directly facing your opponent. The goal is to dodge obstacles, survive enemy attacks, and use your own weapons to gain the upper hand. Only those who react quickly, dodge skillfully, and fire precisely will reach the finish line first and triumph in this thrilling aerial showdown.

meta.name: Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.50 KB

In Duel you compete on a skateboard or BMX bike against the computer or another player. You can freely choose between skater versus skater, BMX versus BMX, or skate versus BMX matchups. The goal is to demonstrate skill, speed, and timing in fast-paced races, overcome obstacles, and reach the finish line faster than your opponent.

meta.name: Duel Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.48 KB

The border areas between two warring nations have always been the hottest and those where the two powers are measured most strenuously. You are part of one of them and your task is to destroy as many enemy combat units as possible. At the beginning you have to choose whether to fly a helicopter or an airplane (by pressing the joystick one or two respectively) or both of them to play together with a friend. The two vehicles have different firing volumes but it is always essential to be precise and quick moving for the enemy does not wait! Published in Italy as both Duel Attack and Guerra Confine.

meta.name: Duel Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Duel Strike you compete against the computer or another player while trying to solve a specific challenge in each round. Every move must be carefully planned, as each decision affects how the game continues. The puzzles require both logical thinking and quick reactions because the situation can change rapidly. The head-to-head format creates a tense contest where strategy and speed are equally important.

meta.name: The Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.38 KB

En The Duel compites en un juego de lucha para dos jugadores donde la fuerza bruta y los reflejos rápidos determinan la victoria o la derrota. Dos bárbaros se enfrentan e intentan superarse mutuamente con golpes precisos o hábiles esquivas. El juego se centra en enfrentamientos directos y llenos de acción, donde cada golpe cuenta, y el colorido y dinámico fondo hace que la batalla sea aún más intensa.

meta.name: The Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.09 KB

The Duel takes you to the Wild West, where you face off in an exciting showdown against a friend. The goal of the game is to be the fastest gunslinger. You and your opponent stand opposite each other, and only the one who draws their gun the quickest wins the duel. Precision and reaction speed are key to life and death – those who are too slow end up as a "dead man." Show your opponent who the true sharpshooter of the West is!

meta.name: The Duel : Test Drive II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the sequel to Test Drive, you can play against the time or the computer. Choose between a Ferrari F-40 and a Porsche 959, and take on your opponent, who is in the other car. There is also traffic to avoid. Each stage has a different setting, including forests and mountains, with a wide range of hazards to dodge. The game is designed to allow for scenario disks. To finish a stage, you must stop at the gas station by yourself, which allows you to refuel.

meta.name: The Duel : Test Drive II
meta.desc:

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.64 KB

Duet (Street Games) is a computerized version of the classic memory game, where players flip tiles and must remember which symbols are hidden underneath. The objective of the game is to find pairs of matching symbols by remembering their positions and strategically selecting the correct tiles.

meta.name: Duke Boys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.74 KB

In Duke Boys you guide the hero along a hazardous road by jumping over obstacles at the right moment. New dangers constantly appear, requiring quick reactions to avoid them. A poorly timed jump can cost you a life. Each obstacle you clear increases your score while the challenge steadily grows. Good timing and fast reflexes are essential if you want to survive as long as possible.

meta.name: Dukes of Hazzard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.29 KB

Driving around in the car known as the "General Lee", you must avoid all sorts of obstacles in an attempt to catch up to Jeremiah Stinge. Beware though as Boss Hog and his police force are trying to chase you. The Duke boys are as usual on the side of right in this scenario and it's Jeremiah who has orchestrated things to put them on the wrong side of the law.

meta.name: Dulcedo Cogitationis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dulcedo Cogitationis es un pequeño pero encantador juego de rompecabezas que impresiona con su presentación minimalista y su mecánica clara. El objetivo es resolver desafíos compactos a través del pensamiento lógico y la ubicación estratégica: fácil de entender, pero cada vez más complicado. Los gráficos digitalizados y el sonido armonioso crean una experiencia retro completa. Como parte de la colección Antics, este juego demuestra cuánta diversión se puede condensar en ideas compactas.

meta.name: Dumi
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.23 KB

meta.name: Dungeon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dungeon is a Pac-Man style collect-'em-up where you guide a character through a maze. The goal is to gather all the items while avoiding ghosts and monsters. To aid your progress, you can make use of doors, teleporters, and other helpful features. Running into enemies will cost you a life, so you'll need to dodge smartly, plan your path carefully, and keep your bearings in the twisting corridors.

meta.name: Dungeon Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dungeon Adventure concludes Level 9's Middle Earth lineage of fantasy interactive fiction games (later reprogrammed with graphics in Jewels of Darkness). The player is searching for magical treasures within the Demon Lord's fortress, after his defeat in Adventure Quest. There are over 200 specific locations, including rooms within the tower and outdoor locations to navigate en route. Objects range from a coffin and a giant belt to nasty images and a packing case; also watch out for Orcs, Dwarves and other creatures. The parser's vocabulary contains all the standard terms - EXAMINE, TAKE, OPEN and FILL for example.

meta.name: Dungeon Blaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dungeon Blaster is a Bomberman-style game. You navigate a maze with a supply of bombs to blast the skeleton skulls roaming the dungeon. To advance to the next level, you must clear all the skeleton skulls from the board. Easier said than done, because after a while, the skulls reappear.

meta.name: Dungeon Explorer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dungeon Explorer is an adventure game that takes the player into a perilous underground world filled with mysteries and challenges. The player navigates intricate dungeons, confronts enemies, and discovers treasures while using their skills and strategies to survive and reach their objective. A classic blend of exploration and adventure.

En Dungeon Warriors, te embarcas en una cacería de monstruos a través de mazmorras laberínticas, ya sea en solitario o con un amigo. Los enemigos deambulan por los estrechos pasillos, pero con disparos certeros puedes eliminarlos antes de que te atrapen. El movimiento táctico, los reflejos rápidos y la buena coordinación son clave para sobrevivir en cada mazmorra. Como clon del clásico Wizard of Wor, Wizard Plus ofrece una jugabilidad familiar con gráficos ligeramente actualizados y una estética renovada.

meta.name: Dungeons and Demons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dungeons and Demons is a PETscii 3D role-playing game in which you are in a dungeon in search of experience and treasure.
