meta.name: Dungeons and Dragons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.55 KB

The adventure in Dungeons and Dragons begins at a small inn located on a dusty road. Here, through conversation with the innkeeper, you may learn valuable information or quests that will aid you in your journey. Your path leads you deeper into dungeons, where you will face various challenges and dangers to overcome.

meta.name: The Dungeons
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.20 KB

meta.name: Dunjon Battler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.27 KB

In Dunjon Battler you take on the role of a swordsman fighting through dark dungeons filled with monsters. Your goal is to slay enemies with your sword, collect treasure chests to restore health, and ultimately find the sacred chalice to win. Each room holds new dangers and challenges as you search for keys, gather treasure, and fight to survive. Only the brave will emerge victorious from the dungeon.
meta.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Mazmorras

meta.name: Duonoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.57 KB

Duonoid offers a digital version of table tennis, where two players control paddles using joysticks or the keyboard. The goal is to keep the ball in play and return it skillfully. The simple concept demands quick reflexes and good timing – perfect for short duels or longer matches with a friend.

meta.name: Duotris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Duotris" is a unique take on the classic Tetris game, designed for two players sharing the same playfield. Instead of competing, players must work together to complete lines and keep the board clear for as long as possible. Communication and teamwork are key to strategically placing blocks and helping each other improve their moves.

meta.name: Dux
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.31 KB

meta.name: Dying High
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.90 KB

"Dying High" is an aerial combat game where players pilot a biplane over a European city, aiming to defeat their opponent in a duel.

meta.name: Dylan Dog : Gli Uccisori
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 101.24 KB

Dylan Dog: The Murderers places you in a dark crime scenario where a seemingly harmless invitation to a secluded mansion turns into deadly madness. You explore the house room by room, fighting dangerous enemies and using anything you can find, from bare hands to improvised weapons. Keys and locked doors shape your progress, forcing careful searching and route planning. The appeal comes from the eerie atmosphere, the constant sense of danger, and the balance between exploration and direct confrontation.

meta.name: Dynamic Duo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.16 KB

„Dynamic Duo“ lets the player control an unlikely pair: a bird and a dwarf exploring a haunted castle. The goal is to find ten hidden keys to unlock the calculation room. Each character has unique abilities – the bird is fast and can fly, while only the dwarf can open chests. The screen displays the game action along with a map and a status screen. If the characters separate or a second player joins, the map is replaced by a second game screen. Enemies can be fought off using a gun with limited ammunition.

meta.name: Dynamite
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.57 KB

Dynamite is an exciting maze game where the player takes on the role of a bank robber who must rob a bank within a limited time frame. The game features an invisible maze, and the player must navigate through it to reach the safe. To find the correct path, the player can press a fire button to reveal a map of the maze – but this can only be done a total of eight times.

meta.name: Dynamite Dan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.80 KB

Dynamite Dan puts the player in the role of secret agent Dynamite Dan, who embarks on a dangerous mission to save the world from the evil Dr. Blitzen and his assistant Donna. After landing a zeppelin on the roof of Blitzen's house, the player must explore the building, locate eight sticks of dynamite, and blow open the doctor's safe to steal the plans for a powerful Mega-Ray weapon. However, the house is filled with enemies and deadly obstacles that drain the agent's energy. To stay in the fight, food must be collected to replenish stamina. Scattered objects grant bonus points as the challenge intensifies, making every move a strategic decision.

meta.name: Dynamite Düx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los beat 'em ups de desplazamiento lateral en los que debes rescatar a una amiga atrapada no son nada inusual. También es bastante típico poder utilizar movimientos de combate directo, así como recolectar armas adicionales y comida para recargar energía. Los juegos de este tipo, que pasaron de las salas de juegos a los ordenadores domésticos, son especialmente comunes: Renegade y la serie Double Dragon son ejemplos famosos.
Sin embargo, donde este se destaca es la configuración de tu personaje como un pato llamado Bin, y con el movimiento que tiene una clara apariencia de contoneo. Los enemigos con los que luchar son todos del reino animal, pero algo deformados: cocodrilos con movimientos de boxeo y vacas armadas con cohetes, por ejemplo. Bin tiene seis niveles que superar antes de poder rescatar a Lucy de las garras de Archaca.

meta.name: Dynamite Skier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.93 KB

Dynamite Skier is a ski adventure where the player must navigate a challenging slalom course. The objective is to pass through the gates without touching them, aiming to reach the finish line as quickly as possible. The game demands quick reflexes and precise timing, as the skier is constantly in motion and must avoid obstacles. With each round, the difficulty increases, requiring faster reactions and better control.

meta.name: Dynamix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dynamix puts you in the role of a Primary Dynamic Rod Controller, where you must prove your skills during an annual test on a simulator to continue working at a real power station. The screen is split, you play on the left and the computer on the right, and your goal is to keep two dynamic rods level by mimicking the computer's movements. Five kinetic activators of different sizes appear at the top of the screen, with the computer moving three before you can start pushing activators yourself. When an activator hits a rod, it moves depending on the activator's size. You must use your activators to keep the rods level, causing a white light to flash. If the light stays active briefly, the level is completed and you move on. A countdown timer runs constantly, and if it reaches zero before you finish, the game is over.

meta.name: Dynamo Dan - The Electric Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.69 KB

Dynamo Dan: The Electric Man puts the player in the role of an electric man who must navigate through various levels while keeping an eye on his energy levels. It's crucial to avoid taking damage and steer clear of obstacles and enemies that can quickly drain his energy. The game requires fast reflexes and a good amount of skill, as any mistake results in a loss of energy. As the game progresses, managing energy and overcoming challenges becomes increasingly difficult.

meta.name: Dynamoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Dynamoid” blends tennis and ice hockey into a fast-paced screen sport – your goal is to hit the ball into your opponent's net, either against the computer or a second player. The rectangular field sets the stage for quick action as you control the ball's direction with your paddle and can stop it with the press of a button. But stay alert – if the ball stays in your half for more than nine seconds, it's counted as a delay of game and your opponent is awarded a goal.

meta.name: Dynasty Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Dynasty Wars puts you in the role of a Chinese warrior riding through enemy ranks on horseback, defeating hordes of soldiers and archers. As you move laterally through the levels, you use a chargeable spear attack – the longer you hold the fire button, the stronger the strike. You can move in all four directions and must skillfully combine attack, evasion, and timing to win the fight.

meta.name: Dystopia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.77 KB

Dystopia is a pure 1-on-1 duel where two players face off in a dystopian setting. The goal is to defeat your opponent through precise shooting and strategic movement.

meta.name: Dyter-07
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Dyter-07, Earth is under attack by alien forces. The player controls the advanced Dyter-07 attack helicopter to push them back and rescue scientists along the way. The game has eight levels with two alternating game mechanics. Each of the four tropical islands first requires clearing the surface by flying around in a side-scrolling perspective reminiscent of Choplifter. Alien enemies can be destroyed by shooting them, but after six hits the helicopter will be destroyed.
The basic goal is to destroy a series of robots that are found using radar. However, the helicopter is unable to destroy them; That's why it carries the Battledroid, a tank. When the helicopter lands, the tank is deployed and can be driven over the surface of the island.

meta.name: Eagle Empire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.54 KB

En Eagle Empire, deberás abrirte paso a través de varias oleadas de alienígenas antes de enfrentarte al fuertemente defendido Eagle Empire. Los alienígenas empiezan en la parte superior de la pantalla y varios alienígenas se fundirán intentando matarte. Debes evitar que te disparen o que toquen a un alienígena, ya que esto te hará perder una de tus tres vidas. Una vez que hayas destruido cuatro oleadas de alienígenas, podrás pasar a una enorme nave e intentar destruir al alienígena que se encuentra en su interior haciendo explotar su escudo.

meta.name: Eagles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.58 KB

Eagles sends two robot-piloted spaceships through 24 levels in a battle to repel an alien invasion. Along the way, they destroy enemy formations and tough individual foes, collect small droids, and deliver them to special drop-off points. For every five droids collected, you earn a powerful destroyer that wipes out nearly all enemies on screen. Some attacks mean instant death, while most gradually drain your energy bar – constant fire and careful maneuvering are essential for survival. The screen is split horizontally, with the second ship controlled by either another player or the AI. In two-player mode, you can fight cooperatively or compete against each other – an action-packed space shooter with a tactical collection element.

meta.name: Eagles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eagles places you in the aerial battles over France and Germany during the later years of World War I, simulating large-scale dogfights with numerous aircraft at once. You choose from several scenarios or shorter engagements and move individual planes in turn across a grid-based battlefield that includes both horizontal movement and altitude levels. Each aircraft carries an ID number that determines turn order, and visibility and firing ranges are limited, making positioning and timing crucial. Weather conditions such as clouds and wind further influence the action, requiring tactical adjustments. At the end of each mission, kills, completion time, and rank are evaluated – a strategic air combat simulation that rewards planning, awareness, and historical flair.

meta.name: Earth Defence
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.73 KB

You take on the role of Earth's last defender, aboard the armed shuttle Earth Shuttle 1. You receive an urgent message: 'A large number of unknown ships are approaching Earth. Contact has been made - the aliens are hostile and have the destruction of Earth in mind.' Since no other ship can launch in time, it is up to you to intercept the enemy ships and avert the threat. With courage and skill, you navigate through space to stop the attackers and save Earth from impending destruction.

meta.name: Earth Defence

meta.name: Earth Super Force
meta.desc:

Earth Super Force puts you in the role of the final defender in space, tasked with breaking through enemy defenses and destroying the invading forces before they reach Earth. As you fight through hazardous sections, the pressure constantly increases, knowing that failure would have devastating consequences. Quick reactions, precise attacks and endurance determine whether humanity is saved or the invasion becomes unstoppable.

meta.name: Earthquake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.92 KB

One minute you were out in a shopping centre, the next a huge Earthquake rips through the centre causing devastation around you, but at least you survived. Your aim now is to get out of the shopping centre but first you have to help the other survivors as well.

A rather novel feature allows people to play without concerning themselves with battle, or turn off the "exploration" and concentrate solely on combat.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

2200 AD: For sixty years, aliens and humans have lived in peace and friendship. Only one dangerous race, the Mecanoidz, are still involved in war against Earth and alien bases. No diplomatic steps can convince the Mecanoidz to stop attacking our planet. Under strict secrecy, the Mecanoids build thier battleship the Meca Hawk. The Meca Hawk leaves planet Meca and attacks alien bases on Mars and Centauri. It must be stopped!

meta.name: ED Dragonfly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.58 KB

In ED Dragonfly, you must fight marching creatures that resemble ants. Your goal is to defeat each of these creatures and then destroy their tombstones. With every creature you kill, another tombstone appears that must also be destroyed. The game challenges your combat skills and timing, as you work to eliminate these creatures and their remnants to progress.

meta.name: Edd the Duck!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 75.49 KB

On childrens TV in the early 90s, Edd the Duck and Wilson the arm were the familiar puppets helping with the link sections. Like most child-oriented licenses of the day, his first computer outing was a platform game, scrolling vertically and resembling Rainbow Islands, although much simplified.
Edd must progress up the levels within the time limit (water will come up to drown him - presumably polluted water through which a duck can't swim), while collecting every star. Bad guys can be stunned by shooting them, which makes them safe to touch, although nothing other than Edd actually dies. The levels are all themed around particular areas of the BBC offices, including a sci-fi set and the weather room.

meta.name: Eddie Kidd Jump Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.42 KB

Este juego, creado en torno a la leyenda de las acrobacias Eddie Kidd, te da la oportunidad de recrear sus hazañas. Empiezas intentando saltar bidones de aceite en una moto, y más adelante podrás realizar hazañas mayores como saltar una moto por encima de coches. No tienes un velocímetro que te ayude a medir la velocidad, pero puedes aprender a calibrar exactamente cómo se comporta la moto y lo que puede hacer. Puedes posicionar el inicio de tu carrera, teniendo en cuenta el viento como un efecto en la distancia. Se pueden practicar los caballitos en la rampa de aproximación. Cuanto más lejos aterrices, mejor será la puntuación.

meta.name: Ede
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.30 KB

meta.name: Edge Grinder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Edge Grinder is a fast-paced side-scrolling shooter where you pilot a ship through relentless waves of alien enemies. The screen scrolls constantly, forcing you to react quickly. Your ship's weak spot is its center, meaning you can scrape along walls and obstacles for bonus points. Shoot or dodge incoming threats – each hit costs one of your three lives. Precision flying and risk-taking are the keys to survival in this brutal arcade challenge.

meta.name: EduFun! Mathfun! : Frenzy & Flip Flop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Edufun! Frenzy & Flip Flop is a collection of two educational math games. In Frenzy, the player must quickly answer 20 subtraction or division problems before a hungry alligator eats 10 fish. If any fish remain, the player gets a bonus game, where they control a smiling face that tries to catch as many numbers as possible while avoiding cherry bombs and evil faces. In Flip Flop, the player sees 10 rounds, each with two figures, and must decide whether the left figure can be moved to match the right one or if it can be made to match through sliding, rotating, or mirroring. A perfect score leads to a special message.

meta.name: Eerie Mansion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.26 KB

“Eerie Mansion” is a text-based adventure where you must uncover the secrets of a creepy manor and find hidden treasures. Using short commands like “go north,” “open the door,” or “examine,” you interact with your surroundings. Pay attention to subtle hints and thoroughly investigate everything to solve puzzles and discover new paths. A carefully crafted map will help you navigate the mansion. But beware, as dangers lurk around every corner – dare to enter if you're brave enough!

meta.name: Egg Catcher

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.11 KB

Egg Catcher puts you in the hectic role of helping Suzanne catch the eggs that a mad farmer keeps throwing down. Every miss matters, because even a single smashed egg costs one of your limited chances. There is hardly any time to hesitate, as you constantly have to judge the next trajectory and react quickly. This simple idea turns into a brisk skill game driven entirely by speed, attention, and precise timing.

meta.name: Egg Catcher 4K
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.75 KB

A simple game where a hen moving across a rooftop drops eggs at irregular intervals, and you move a basket down to collect them. Pure scoring; the scenery only changes color slightly when you've collected the number of eggs indicated at the top of the screen.

meta.name: Eggland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.42 KB

In “Eggland,” the player takes on the role of Lolo, a blue, spherical character on a quest to rescue Princess Lala. The objective is to collect all heart frames in a room to unlock a treasure chest, whose contents eliminate monsters and open the path to the next room. Lolo wields a magical shot, activated by collecting specific heart frames. In addition to monsters, obstacles like water and movable green blocks provide further challenges.

meta.name: Eggman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eggman is a challenging puzzle game where you must arrange three yellow eggs in a row, either vertically or horizontally. However, the eggs continue moving until they hit an obstacle, requiring careful planning. Stones can be used to crush monsters, and colored eggs can be destroyed by pushing them together. After some successes, you'll receive a code to resume later. Think strategically to solve each puzzle!

meta.name: The Eidolon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Eidolon places you in an abandoned laboratory where you uncover a strange 19th-century machine. As you examine it, you are suddenly pulled into another dimension – a vast cave system whose creatures awaken at the energy it emits. Your only chance of survival lies in this mysterious vehicle, guiding it through twisting tunnels and using its energy weapon to keep the creatures at bay as you search for a way out.

meta.name: Einstein
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Einstein is a puzzle game that invites the player to solve various challenges. While it doesn't take a genius to master them, the game showcases the entertaining and creative side of thinking, all while bringing a smile to your face.

meta.name: The Einstein Memory Trainer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Einstein Memory Trainer" helps players improve their memory by using techniques such as the method of loci and the pegword system. It offers exercises to better retain names, faces, phone numbers, dates, and other information.

meta.name: Elec-Tron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Elec-Tron brings the classic Tron style back to the screen: two vehicles race through a neon-colored grid, leaving deadly light trails behind – the first to crash loses. Tactics, reflexes, and precise timing are key to outmaneuvering your opponent and climbing the highscore list. In this intense duel, every move counts, and the smallest mistake can be fatal.

meta.name: Election
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.98 KB

Election is an arcade adventure where you try to become Prime Minister while the United Kingdom held its own elections in 1987. You can choose between five candidates based on real people of the time: Matcher (Conservative), Ninnock (Labour). , Paul (Idealists), Owing (Alliance) and Pig-Iron (Alliance). Once you've chosen your candidate, it's time to go out into the wide world, viewed from above and on the screen, and try to get 101 votes or more to get the majority needed to become Prime Minister.
You travel around the area trying to convince the people moving around the various screens to vote for you by talking to them, picking up manifestos, or picking up various symbols.

meta.name: The Election Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.35 KB

"The Election Game" is a political strategy game based on a general election in British politics. The aim is for one to four players to bring a party (Conservative, Labor, Liberal Democrats or Independents) into government. Each player starts with £8,000 and must visit as many constituencies as possible out of 60 and canvass for votes.
The North American release was called Candidate and the choice was about the 1984 US presidential election.

meta.name: Election Trail
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.64 KB

Election Trail allows you to campaign to become the President of the United States of America on behalf of the Republican Party while the computer or another player battles against you for the Democrat Party for 20 periods.

meta.name: Electra
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Electro World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.82 KB

Electro World places you in a bleak future where rogue machines have pushed humanity to the brink of extinction. Equipped with a jetpack and an energy weapon, you traverse hostile areas and collect vital power cables before your fuel runs out. Aggressive electronic enemies are everywhere, forcing you to fight or evade them carefully, as even a single touch can be fatal. The appeal comes from constant time pressure, the blend of movement and combat, and the sense of gradually cutting off the enemy's power supply.

meta.name: Electron Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.92 KB

“Electron Soccer” is a fast-paced duel where you control a colored energy orb from an overhead view and try to bump a gray ball into your opponent's goal. Whether facing off against the AI or another player, quick moves, clever tactics, and perfect timing make all the difference. Minimalist design meets frantic matches where reflexes are everything.

meta.name: Elektra Glide
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.30 KB

Elektraglide is a futuristic motorcycle driving game where the player chooses to drive in one of three countries, England, Australia, or America.
On the road, there are many strange obstacles such as bouncing globes, spinning prisms, and airplanes that drop tall screens in your path. You are racing against the clock, so you must swerve around these obstacles because hitting them will force you to stop and cause you to lose time.

meta.name: Electrix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Elektrix puts the player in the role of an electrician tasked with repairing the underground cables of a power plant in Los Angeles. Over the course of 20 levels, the power plant is sabotaged by vandals, and you must fix the damaged cables before time runs out. Each level consists of screens that feature both underground and above-ground areas, which are connected by ladders. As you repair the broken cables, you must avoid various creatures that move across the screen. Losing a life occurs if you are hit by these creatures. Additionally, electrical devices can be collected for bonus points.

meta.name: Elevator Action
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres el Agente 17 (nombre en clave: " Otto") . Tu misión es la de asegurar todos los documentos secretos superiores de un edificio de seguridad y escapar en el coche, que se encuentra en el sótano del edificio. Enemigos espías están dispersos por todo el edificio de 30 pisos y tienen una sola misión: ejecutar el Agente 17 a toda costa. Hay varias formas en las que el Agente 17 puede matarlos: Disparar con su arma. Patadas saltando sobre ellos. Disparar una luz en el techo, mientras que están en un ascensor, dejando caer la luz sobre uno de ellos. Aplastarles con un ascensor.

meta.name: Elevator Ride
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.14 KB

The player tries to climb down a 10 floor elevator shaft, while trying to avoid being hit by the descending elevator. When the player stops descending, the elevator picks up speed. When the player climbs quickly, the elevator slows down. If the player touches the top or the bottom of the elevator, they fall to their doom. There are 3 levels of difficulty.

meta.name: Eleven Across
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.46 KB

Eleven Across challenges you with a tactical puzzle experience where shapes must be placed carefully to complete rows and score points. Available space quickly becomes limited, making every decision matter and forward planning essential. As the pace increases, pressure builds, and precise placement determines success or failure – simple in concept, yet consistently engaging through the constant struggle for control and efficiency.

meta.name: Elf Caper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.23 KB

Elf Caper turns a Christmas setting into a lively chase game in which you play as an elf collecting every present while snowmen relentlessly pursue you. Once all the gifts are gathered, simple evasion is no longer enough, because you can only move on after immobilizing your pursuers with Christmas trees. That blend of collecting, escaping, and cleverly disabling enemies gives the game a charming yet pleasantly frantic appeal.

meta.name: Elf Rescue

Elidon tells a fairy-tale spring quest where the crowning of the fairy queen depends on seven flowers that have not yet bloomed. As a fairy, you explore the land, search for the scattered potions, and bring them to the Finvarra flowers in time. Along the way, you switch between running and flying, avoid dangers, and use your wand to clear obstacles from your path. The limited carrying capacity makes the search even trickier, forcing you to think carefully about which items to take with you.

meta.name: Eliminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Eliminator” lets you pilot a fast-moving spaceship — flying over the surface of a planet and battling waves of alien marauders. Precise maneuvering and accurate shooting are essential to surviving the ever-growing threat.

meta.name: Eliminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un shoot 'em up ambientado en una carretera de colores de colcha de retazos, Eliminator te pone al control de una nave con un arma básica, volando a una velocidad vertiginosa. Hay barreras en el camino que evitar, a menudo colocadas en rápida sucesión, y muchos tipos malos a los que disparar o evitar - sus disparos también deben ser evitados. Algunas partes de la pista están bloqueadas a menos que puedas disparar a través de obstáculos antes de alcanzarlas, o golpear una plataforma de salto. En algunos puntos también puedes cambiar para viajar por el techo. Se pueden recolectar fichas en el camino, y usarse para obtener mejores armas, pero perder una vida te cuesta la mejor que tienes actualmente.

meta.name: Elite
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pilota tu nave espacial Cobra en un fantástico viaje de descubrimientos y aventuras, una prueba suprema de tus habilidades de combate, navegación y emprendimiento.
La mayor parte del juego consiste en viajar a diferentes sistemas estelares, comerciar con sus habitantes, ganar dinero y reputación. También se puede ganar dinero mediante misiones militares, caza de recompensas, minería de asteroides, ..... Cuando el personaje del jugador gana dinero, puede mejorar sus naves con mejores armas, escudos, mayor capacidad de carga, sistema de acoplamiento automático, etc.
Independientemente de cómo gane el dinero, por las buenas o por las malas, tendrá que correr por el espacio luchando contra naves piratas y alienígenas hostiles.

meta.name: Elite Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Once again, you're a bouncing ball, leaving destroyed pieces in your path. Clear each screen to move on to the next.
With different and beautiful level graphics and you can also jump diagonally.

meta.name: Eliza
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.24 KB

In Eliza, the computer takes on the role of a therapist, asking seemingly empathetic questions based on your previous responses. It analyzes keywords and rephrases them to keep the conversation going. What feels like true understanding is just clever text manipulation. Yet Eliza managed to convince many users they were talking to a real person – paving the way for AI and early text adventures.

meta.name: Eliza 3.1
meta.desc:

In Eliza 3.1, the computer takes on the role of a therapist, asking seemingly empathetic questions based on your previous responses. It analyzes keywords and rephrases them to keep the conversation going. What feels like true understanding is just clever text manipulation. Yet Eliza managed to convince many users they were talking to a real person – paving the way for AI and early text adventures.

meta.name: Ellak's Tomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.61 KB

In Ellak's Tomb you first create a party of adventurers, assign names, choose classes, and begin with limited stamina and some gold. You then explore a dangerous labyrinth in first-person view, encountering creatures, traps, and magical surprises while carefully managing tactics and resources. Stamina decreases when wounded but can be restored with rest or supplies, while gold is used for equipment and provisions. The goal is to recover treasures and keep your party alive for as long as possible.

meta.name: The Ellisnore Diamond
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.01 KB

In The Ellisnore Diamond, you are summoned back to your childhood village to recover the lost Ellisnore Diamond and free the restless spirit of Sir Roger Durwood, also known as Blackbeard. Once rewarded with the diamond for his service, his life became clouded by betrayal and disgrace. After his political downfall and the loss of his honor, he hid the diamond to support the parish — only to forget its hiding place and die burdened with guilt. Now, after a devastating storm has ravaged the village, you must not only recover your lost cottage key but also unravel the mystery of Blackbeard's legacy.

meta.name: Elven Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.21 KB

The Black Witch has been caught and burnt until there was nothing left along with her possessions. An Elf creeps back to the scene and scans the scene to find the legend is true, the book of Immortality cannot be destroyed. Picking up the book, Elf opens it and starts to read the pages...
Elven Warrior is a flick-screen platformer where you play the role of Elf as you explore the land and the underground passages for various bottles of potion to fill a cauldron up. As you search the land there are various creatures that must be avoided or shot with one of various limited weapons that can be found and collected, a long bow, staffs or axes. If you touch a creature then you lose part of a health meter but if you fall into water or touch spikes then this empties the meter and it is game over.

meta.name: Elvin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.66 KB

Elvin is an action-packed flight game that was released as part of a four-game bundle. The player controls an aircraft and must overcome various challenges throughout the game. Featuring digital graphics and a range of sound effects, Elven enhances the player's experience by creating an immersive atmosphere as they navigate through exciting aerial missions and obstacles. The game combines fast-paced action with skillful flight control, offering an engaging experience for fans of flight simulators and arcade-style games.

meta.name: Elvira : Mistress of the Dark
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Elvira, conocida por varias comedias de terror de pacotilla, es la heroína de este juego de rol en primera persona.
El tío de Elvira, Elmo, que fue una persona muy impopular en vida, ha muerto recientemente y ha dejado a Elvira un viejo castillo. Elvira está muy contenta, ya que quiere convertirlo en una atracción turística.
Por desgracia, en Halloween, los muertos se despiertan en el castillo. Para empeorar las cosas, la tatarabuela de Elvira, Emelda, que murió hace 100 años, también quiere volver al reino de los vivos para apoderarse del mundo.
Para evitarlo, Elvira contrata a un cazafantasmas, que será interpretado por el jugador. El héroe debe resolver rompecabezas y luchar contra diversas criaturas. Las batallas tienen lugar en tiempo real y hay que ser preciso para no morir. El castillo también encierra mil peligros que pueden ser fatales.

meta.name: Elvira : The Arcade Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Elvira: The Arcade Game sends you on an action-packed journey across multiple dangerous worlds that must be unlocked step by step. You explore fiery and icy realms before finally gaining access to a mysterious castle claimed by Elvira through an unusual inheritance. Along the way you use magic and weapons, collect helpful items to restore strength and open treasure chests filled with rewards. When progress becomes difficult, merchants offer valuable information in exchange for rune stones – a blend of exploration, combat and smart resource management that steadily increases the challenge.

meta.name: Elvira II : The Jaws of Cerberus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Elvira, una estrella de cine de terror, una bruja y tu novia, está en problemas. Un demonio Cerberus la ha secuestrado para matarla y obtener su poder. Para salvar a Elvira, llegas a los estudios de Black Widow Productions, donde está detenida. Desafortunadamente, todo el estudio está lleno de monstruos, ya que los escenarios de las películas de terror se han vuelto reales.
Elvira II: The Jaws of Cerberus es un juego de aventura/RPG en primera persona. Empiezas eligiendo una de las cuatro clases para tu personaje (que determina tus atributos iniciales, como Fuerza, Inteligencia, etc.).

meta.name: Emerald Isle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Emerald Isle" begins with a dangerous mission to deliver important documents across the Caribbean. But a sudden storm over the Bermuda Triangle puts the plane in peril – leaving parachuting as the only escape. The landing takes place on the mysterious Emerald Isle – a place from which no one has ever returned. However, legend has it that one exception exists: whoever rises to become the ruler of the island may leave. The path to freedom is filled with dangers – deadly predators and strange natives being the least of them. If the player fails, they will awaken elsewhere on the island – retaining all collected possessions.

meta.name: Emerald Mine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.60 KB

In Emerald Mine, the player finds themselves deep inside a cave, where they must collect emeralds and diamonds while avoiding monsters and dealing with the effects of gravity. If the player is standing under a falling rock, they will be crushed. The game also offers a two-player mode, where two players can explore the caves and collect treasures simultaneously. In addition to the 80 standard levels, there are 20 exclusive levels for the two-player mode, adding extra variety and challenge for cooperative or competitive gameplay. The game combines puzzle-solving, action, and strategic planning, as players must carefully navigate the cave's dangers while gathering valuable gems.

meta.name: Emerald Mine II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.58 KB

Emerald Mine II is a Boulder Dash variant and features no gameplay changes in comparison to its predecessor besides the new level editor. The player's goal is to collect diamonds which are surrounded by dirt. When walking over a dirt spot, it is cleared and a stone above it will fall down - with unhealthy results if the player or a monster is hit by it. Other items include dynamite to clear out boulders and keys for certain doors. The need to plan ahead and find out the required steps to reach the diamonds give the game a puzzle-solving character. Besides the about hundred levels in single-player, there are additional levels for two players.

meta.name: Emerald Miner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Emerald Mine, the player must collect a minimum count of gems in a labyrinth and reach the then-opened gate. Gems, stones, bombs and drips are subject to a vertical gravitation. Furthermore, elements exist which guide the movement of the player like different wall types, and a number of enemies, some of which seek out the player. There are also further elements, like the dynamite which may be exploded at a chosen place, and the doors, for whose passing the matching key must be collected. Hence, it is an extended Boulder Dash clone. Solving a level grants access to the next one, and there is a separate highscore list for each level. In the two player game, both players play in the same labyrinth screen, and every four levels there is a level especially designed for player cooperation. The game consists of 80 one-player levels, of which 60 are also used in the two-player mode, and of 20 extra levels for the two-player mode.

meta.name: Emilio Butragueno Futbol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.43 KB

Emilio Butragueño, el futbolista número 1, merecía el mejor video-juego.
Un alarde de técnica que ha resuelto los gráficos y los movimientos de los jugadores con tal perfección que necesitarás poner en juego toda tu habilidad y experiencia. ¡Haz equipo con Butragueño!

meta.name: Emlyn Hughes Arcade Quiz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Emlyn Hughes' Arcade Quiz, you control a character through ten mazes, aiming to reach the "Win" bar. The maze scrolls from left to right, and you must be quick enough to avoid reaching the "Lose" bar. Along the way, you'll encounter various types of blocks: Question Blocks, where correct answers allow you to progress, but incorrect answers slow down the scrolling. You can also collect money, which is added to your total at the end of each level. Other blocks either block your path or move you in different directions, adding strategic elements to your navigation. If you reach the "Win" bar, you trigger a bonus round with quiz questions, which are based on the amount of money you've collected. After the bonus game, you can decide whether to cash out your earnings or pay to proceed to the next level. Your balance and any bonuses are clearly displayed, providing both a challenge and reward system for your quiz-solving skills.

meta.name: Emlyn Hughes International Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Emlyn Hughes International Soccer ofrece acción arcade realista y gestión del fútbol combinados en un solo juego. La amplia gama de  opciones de control se ha diseñado de tal manera que puedas sentarte y jugar sin pasar horas estudiando el manual familiarizándote con los controles. Para uno o dos jugadores, bien sea uno contra el otro o contra el ordenador. ¡Incluso puedes ver a dos equipos de IA jugando entre sí! Los niveles de habilidad y condición física de los jugadores varían, por lo que elegir el equipo adecuado es tan importante como la forma en que controlas a tus jugadores durante el juego.
Las listas de partidos, los resultados y las tablas de liga se pueden mostrar en cualquier momento durante la temporada.

meta.name: Empire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Empire turns the world map into a tactical conquest game where you compete against the computer for domination. First, you claim your own territories, distribute additional armies, and then decide round by round which neighboring regions to attack. Every victory expands your influence, but also requires smart decisions about how many troops to move into newly captured areas. The result is a classic strategy game about risk, planning, and the gradual push toward control of the entire world.

The object of the game is simple - gain control of the entire world by using your armies to crush your opponents. You'll start off with a city, which must then produce armies, that are used to conquer more cities. The array of unit types is limited to eight, including various ships, fighter planes, ground units and a submarine. This is more than made up for by the significantly different abilities each of the units possess, and the game will mostly likely appeal to the Chess and Risk player's of the world.

meta.name: Empire of Karn
meta.desc:

Empire of Karn takes you back to the world of Karn, where looming betrayal threatens the fragile alliance between two realms. Rather than starting an open war, the Emperor relies on a secret mission and sends you out with Darin to stop the schemes of the King of Vorzdeshaa. Along the way, you collect objects, solve puzzles, and use the help of your companions to gradually uncover the intrigue. The result is a classic adventure full of courtly tension, fantasy atmosphere, and puzzling tasks.

meta.name: Star Wars : The Empire Strikes Back
meta.desc:

El juego arcade de Atari Games, basado en la segunda película de Star Wars, presenta cuatro secuencias de acción inspiradas en la película. El estilo gráfico es similar al del primer juego de Star Wars, con gráficos vectoriales y perspectiva en primera persona. La primera secuencia se desarrolla en el planeta helado Hoth, donde el jugador debe destruir droides sonda imperiales. Los droides envían transmisiones al Imperio que también pueden ser atacadas y destruidas. Una vez enviadas suficientes transmisiones, el Imperio ataca. En la segunda secuencia, el jugador debe defenderse de los caminantes imperiales, ya sea disparando a un número limitado de cables de remolque a sus pies o apuntando con láseres a una pequeña zona de su cabeza. Pero tarde o temprano, el generador de energía de la base rebelde será destruido y comenzará la evacuación. En la tercera secuencia, el Halcón Milenario debe destruir cazas TIE en el espacio. En la cuarta y última secuencia, el Halcón debe navegar a través de un campo de asteroides, evitando colisiones. Una vez completadas las cuatro secciones, el juego se reinicia con un nivel de dificultad superior.

meta.name: Empius
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Empius turns the fight for domination into an extensive strategy game where several armies struggle for control across different maps. You create units, supply them with soldiers, weapons, and resources, then plan their movements across the battlefield. Every turn demands awareness, because terrain, supplies, and enemy positions can all affect the outcome of a battle. Its appeal lies in the gradual buildup, tactical decisions, and direct contest for supremacy in Empius.

meta.name: The Enchanted Cottage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.38 KB

The Enchanted Cottage casts you as a sorcerer's apprentice facing your final test: uncovering the secret behind the green door of a mysterious cottage. Armed with a spellbook whose powers remain unknown, you're transported to a strange world filled with magical clues and puzzling objects. A classic text adventure full of mystery, enchantment, and imagination.

meta.name: Enchanted Forest

The age of goblins, elves, and demons is coming to an end. Magic is no longer allowed. Elves and ghosts have caused enough havoc, carried out cruel attacks, and committed evil deeds. It is time to put an end to them, and you are the one who must do it. The creatures have taken refuge in the Enchanted Forest. Your task is to cleanse the area of them and make the world safe for mortals once again. Enchanted Forest – a game full of adventure... and magic.

Difficulty Level: Standard

Booklet - A Brief History of Magic By Gustar Woormax, Ancient Scroll from the Circle of Enchanters, Official Wax Seal.

Enclave puts you in flight over an alien city as you search for and destroy their main fuel depot to save humanity from enslavement. Along the way, collect supplies: F for Fuel, A for Ammo, and S for Speed. Between levels, you'll face the deadly Blaster ship – survival means non-stop shooting.

meta.name: Encounter

Encounter! is a fast paced arcade game set in a sci-fi environment which features fast moving three dimensional graphics. You command a probe vehicle with which you have to shoot down enemy saucers and homing missiles. When you have shot down the required number of enemies on one level (usually around 10-20) you get the chance to go through a "stargate". In the stargate you have to navigate through a hail of spheres coming at you at high speed. If you succeed you get to a new planet in different color scheme, if you fail you'll have to replay the previous planet. There's eight levels in total.

meta.name: Encounter (Severn Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.42 KB

Encounter te embarca en una misión para rescatar a una niña secuestrada por matones despiadados. Todo lo que necesitas está en el juego, aunque quizás tengas que crear algunos objetos tú mismo. Un buen dominio de la química puede ser una ventaja clave. Explora el oscuro mundo basado en texto, descubre pistas, fabrica herramientas y burla a tus enemigos para salvar a la niña a tiempo.

meta.name: Encounter Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Are you an adventurer of the first class? You may have an adventure of the 3rd kind! You see a bright flash of light and your car stops, It's aliens and they have sinister motives. Can you stop them and return safely to earth?

meta.name: Endangered Species
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Endangered Species you team up with another player to hit targets swimming across the screen. You coordinate your movements, react to the action, and try to work together as efficiently as possible. The focus is less on complexity and more on cooperation and timing. A simple experience that shines through its cooperative gameplay.

meta.name: Eindeloos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.19 KB

"Endless" was once a world-famous tourist attraction, drawing visitors from all countries to its vast cave system. But everything changed when an alien superbeing was awakened during an expedition on one of Neptune's moons. Filled with rage, it turned its attention to Earth, made "Eindeloos" its fortress, and took the form of a mystical heart to fall into a deep sleep once more. The player controls a helicopter from a multidirectional perspective and must descend into the caves to defeat the being and its armies. Along the way, they must avoid moving obstacles such as mines, energy wires, and scrolling rails.

meta.name: Enduro Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En este juego, eres un corredor de bicicleta de resistencia. La jugabilidad implica que compites contra el reloj para llegar a la línea de meta y saltar sobre las rampas. Al final de cada carrera, obtienes puntos por la cantidad de autos o bicicletas que has superado con los que puedes mejorar tu bicicleta.
Hay varios terrenos diferentes en los que puedes competir, incluyendo playas desiertas y pistas de tierra, además de una serie de cosas para desacelerarte o incluso sacarte de tu bicicleta por completo. La idea principal es encontrar la mejor ruta a través de cada nivel para ahorrar valiosos segundos y poder tomar más autos y bicicletas.
La versión japonesa del juego tiene más pistas que las versiones europeas y estadounidenses. Entre ellas se encuentra una pista de nieve, que es una de las más difíciles del juego, porque hay muchas piedras en el camino.

meta.name: Endzone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.47 KB

Endzone es un videojuego de gestión de fútbol americano para la Commodore 64. En Endzone, el jugador controla a un equipo de fútbol americano y debe competir contra otros equipos en una liga. El jugador debe tomar decisiones sobre la gestión del equipo, como la contratación de jugadores, la elección de las jugadas y el entrenamiento del equipo.

meta.name: Enemy Waters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.71 KB

Enemy Waters puts you at the helm of a patrol boat navigating through treacherous waters filled with shoals and enemy vessels. This is an "avoid it" game – no shooting, just careful dodging. Precision and quick reflexes are essential, as a single collision spells doom. Radar and meters assist in tracking threats. It's a tense survival challenge where maneuvering matters more than firepower.

meta.name: Energem Enigma
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.30 KB

As part of the Extricator trilogy, you assist Professor Roberts with a revolutionary experiment. After his return from the planet Arg, he began collecting four valuable Energems crystals essential for the experiment. Since his detector can only detect crystals within a five-location radius and the professor himself is not very athletic, he has hired you, an experienced special agent, to continue the search in the Glenbo star system. Your goal is to find all four crystals and transport them to the transport tube system, so they can be beamed back to headquarters. The planet has an atmosphere that is unhealthy for humans, but you are equipped with four refillable oxygen tanks. If successful, you will be the first to test the professor's latest project.

meta.name: Energy Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.71 KB

En Energy Warrior, eres guardián de las últimas reservas naturales de la Tierra en 2079. Tres regiones —bosque, islas y desierto— están bajo tu protección, pero los alienígenas Wavaren intentan apoderarse de ellas. Pilotando un caza J.O.S., debes limpiar diez zonas por región eliminando a todos los enemigos antes de que se agote su energía de aura. Si tres zonas caen en una misma región, serás destituido. Tu nave cuenta con láseres y una cantidad limitada de bombas blitz; la energía es escasa, y deberás decidir entre recoger bonificaciones para sobrevivir o para mantener viva la región. Solo tácticas inteligentes, reflejos rápidos y fuerza implacable salvarán al planeta.

meta.name: EnForce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.31 KB

In this game, you control two tanks on enemy territory, alongside a second player. Your goal is to avoid enemy attacks and only shoot when the indicator at the bottom of the screen shows a high value to achieve the highest score. You have a total of 9 lives, with the background changing every three lives lost. The game ends either when you run out of time or lose all your lives. With each level, the difficulty increases, making the game progressively more challenging.

meta.name: Enforcer : Fullmetal Megablaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Enforcer: Fullmetal Megablaster, you pilot a heavily armed glider through six side-scrolling zones filled with enemies and explosions. Blast through swarms, dodge projectiles, and collect power-ups like spreadshots, lasers, shields, health packs, smart bombs, and orbiting options. The EFM glider features an energy bar, allowing you to absorb multiple hits. Each stage ends with a massive boss fight. Extra gliders and upgrades are hidden throughout the zones – only sharp eyes will spot and collect them to boost your arsenal.

meta.name: The Enforcer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.88 KB

In The Enforcer, you control a robot exploring the maze-like Durge Caverns to collect parcels. The game scrolls in multiple directions as you move, requiring you to jump and climb ladders while avoiding or shooting deadly creatures and hazards. Touching enemies drains your energy bar, and once it hits zero, it's game over. All parcels must be collected within a time limit, and crosses act as checkpoints once you pass over them – precise timing and smart pathing are key.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Engineer Humpty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.99 KB

In Engineer Humpty, Humpty Dumpty takes on the role of an engineer. Your task is to guide a wrench safely to the "tools." At the start of each level, the entire setup, including conveyor belts and machines you must avoid, is displayed. After a few seconds, only a small section with the wrench is visible. Once the wrench is released, it moves downward, and you can influence its direction with joystick movements. If it touches machines or gets stuck on the edges of the conveyor belts, you lose a life. Reaching the goal causes the screen border to flash, advancing you to the next round. Skill and precision are essential.

meta.name: England Championship Special
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In England Championship Special, you control the English national team in a fast-paced top-down football game. Inspired by Kick Off, it features single-button controls for kicks, slides, and headers. The focus is on speed and simplicity rather than complex tactics – perfect for jumping straight into the action.

meta.name: Enigma
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Enigma es un juego de disparos horizontal donde controlas una nave espacial que lucha contra oleadas de enemigos. Debes derrotar a tus oponentes, evitar obstáculos y completar tu misión mientras vuelas por diferentes niveles. El juego te desafía con desafíos de dificultad creciente e intensos.

meta.name: Enigma (Mania-Soft)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.64 KB

En Enigma, arroja bolas en una de las nueve columnas, con puertas giratorias redirigiendo su camino. Su objetivo es hacer que las pelotas aterricen en su lado del tablero. Pero cada caída cambia las posiciones de la puerta para el próximo turno, que requiere estrategia, tiempo y previsión. En el modo de dos jugadores, este concepto simple se convierte en una tensa batalla en la cabeza.

meta.name: Enigma Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.55 KB

Enigma Force begins where its predecessor "Shadowfire" left off: General Zoff, the villainous galaxy dictator, has been captured by the four members of the Enigma team. But on the way to a prison world, the spaceship has to make an emergency landing on a planet. It is the homeworld of Syylk, the insectoid who is a member of the Enigma team. The people of Syylk are currently at war with a few reptilians from the star cluster around the corner to the left, who are loyal to General Zoff. Aim of the cosmic confusion game: Team up with the insectioids and prevent Zoff from escaping with a spaceship.

meta.name: Enlightenment : Druid II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Enlightenment: Druid II“ takes Hasrinaxx the Druid back to the lands of Belorn, one hundred and three years after Acamantor's banishment. His task is to explore the ten lands and gather powerful spells that will grant him access to Acamantor's five-level dungeon. There, he must use his mastery over the elements of Earth, Air, Water, and Fire to battle Acamantor's demon princes, who will guard him to the death. In the final confrontation, he must defeat Acamantor once and for all with the mystical White Orb.

meta.name: Enter the Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.50 KB

In Enter the Ninja, you play as a white-robed ninja battling enemies that move erratically across the screen. You must strike them down while dodging their shurikens and nunchakus. Occasionally, an enemy appears atop a wall and throws projectiles from above. Each hit costs a life – and when all are gone, the game ends.

meta.name: Entertainment Tonight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Entertainment Tonight“ is a trivia game for up to six players, centered around the world of entertainment. Players must answer questions from various categories, including film, television, music, and famous personalities. Often, only the last name is required as an answer. The game challenges not only knowledge but also speed, as each question comes with a time limit.

meta.name: Entity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Entity is a tricky logic game where the goal is to swap black and white pegs on a futuristic board so that each takes the other's starting position. Only right-angled moves are allowed, either to adjacent fields or by jumping over another peg. The challenge is to reach the goal in as few moves as possible. If you break the record, you can even claim a spot in the hall of fame. Entity demands planning, focus, and a good dose of patience.

meta.name: Entombed
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.40 KB

Entombed es la secuela de "El bastón de Karnath". Una vez más asumes el papel del explorador Sir Arthur Pendragon. Estás en Egipto bajo la Esfinge y acabas de encontrar el Ojo de Osiris. Con el ojo en tus manos, la cámara comienza a zumbar y a vibrar y lentamente te hundes en el suelo en la oscuridad debajo de ti. Las antorchas se encienden lentamente y notas que estás en otra cámara con un cofre que contiene un pergamino que dice que para escapar de la tierra debes recolectar otros pergaminos para regresar a la superficie.
Armado con tu látigo, recorrerás los pasillos de este laberinto luchando contra momias, mosquitos, escorpiones y cuervos. Deberás recolectar objetos en ciertas habitaciones para usarlos en otras o encontrar la acción a realizar para cruzar las diferentes puertas antes de quedarte sin oxígeno.

meta.name: Enzyme
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.24 KB

Enzyme is a varied space shooter where you can upgrade your ship and weapons between missions using the money you collect. Each playthrough is divided into several parts: first, classic levels where you fight waves of enemies. Then come bonus rounds, either navigating upward through a star field without hitting obstacles or flying sideways through a labyrinth. Finally, you return to the intro menu, where three doors open: the right one leads to a shop for better weapons, the middle one shows the high scores, and the left one contains various extras. This blend of action, upgrades, and variety makes the shooter stand out.

meta.name: Eon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eon takes you to the year 2010, when a giant asteroid enters Earth's orbit. Hidden inside are five storage caves, each protected by advanced security systems. Equipped with NASA's most modern spaceship, you set out to uncover their secrets. Your ship can move freely in all directions while firing across a horizontally scrolling screen. In addition to a standard laser, you can switch to stronger beams, a disintegration shield, and reactor bombs. These bombs are vital, since only they can destroy the reactors – and only in the correct order. A display at the bottom of the screen shows if you're on the right path. After each reactor is eliminated, a boss fight awaits on a separate screen. Across five levels with varied terrain and enemies, you must manage limited shields and survive with just three lives.

meta.name: Eoroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eoroid is a text-moded puzzle solving game, played on a 20x15 board. The main goal requires removing all the blocks from the board within limited numbers of moves. By clicking on a single spot, the player affects all the fields around by their reversal, including the chosen one - filled block disappears and a blank spot is replaced with filled block. Basically, each taken action reverses simultaneously 9 fields, one in the middle, and 8 around (3x3 square).

p: EOS - Earth Orbit Station (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: EOS - Earth Orbit Station (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.name: Earth Orbit Stations
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

EOS: Earth Orbit Station puts you in charge of a privately run space station and challenges you with economic and strategic decisions in Earth orbit. You plan modules, launch missions, conduct research, and market products while constantly monitoring rival directors. Varied scenarios require flexible strategies, smart investments, and careful timing, since only the first to achieve the objectives succeeds. The appeal lies in the blend of planning, competition, and building a thriving orbital enterprise.

meta.name: The Equalizer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.31 KB

The player controls a small baby-like character who can move left and right, jump and who shoots blobs of goo from his navel. The object of the game is to collect all the fruit on a level. trying to prevent the player achieving this are all kinds of nasties like snails, lizards, bouncing jelly fish like things, and birds that drop things from above to name but a few. Contact with any one of these costs a life As if this were not enough the levels contain many jumps that have to be timed just right and just to keep it interesting the landing platforms are often populated with the aforementioned beasties.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Equestrian Showjumper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Harvey Smith Showjumper lets you compete alone or against up to five other players in show jumping events across multiple courses. You select a course and guide your horse through the arena from a side view, with the screen scrolling as you ride. The objective is to clear each fence in the correct order and finish with the fastest possible time. Knocking down a fence adds penalty time, while jumping the wrong one results in elimination. You control the horse's speed, but mistimed jumps can cause refusals or even throw you off. After each run, standings are displayed, and you can also name your horses and design custom courses for added replay value.
meta.genre: Deportes con animales / Carreras de caballos

meta.name: Equinox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.02 KB

Equinox places you on a contaminated planet where you control a specialized droid tasked with shutting down an active security system and disposing of hazardous material. You navigate through multiple facility levels, avoid defense droids and collect radioactive waste that must be discarded before it detonates. Fuel is scarce and must be located within the complex, with certain maneuvers draining it quickly. Progress also requires finding access passes, blending exploration, time management and careful movement into a tense sci-fi challenge.

meta.name: Erebus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Erebus you pilot a spacecraft through the massive automated refinery on the planet Erebus. Enemy forces from the planet Hadebus are using the facility to produce a deadly nerve gas that threatens humanity. Your mission is to destroy the alien ships and fight your way through the refinery complex. You must avoid enemy fire and take care not to collide with buildings or structures, as doing so will cost you one of your lives. Each level consists of several sections surrounding a dimensional duct that must be flown over to activate it. Once all sections are cleared, a bonus stage begins where you must survive waves of incoming ships for a short time before advancing to the next level.

meta.name: Ernie's Big Splash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this interactive game, children join Ernie as they build fun paths to help him move Rubber Duckie from the soap dish to the edge of the bathtub. Along the way, they discover cause-and-effect relationships and practice basic logic, directions (North, South, East, and West), and the sequence of events. The game encourages problem-solving skills and an understanding of simple planning and prediction.

meta.name: Ernie's Magic Shapes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.76 KB

With the wave of his magic wand, Ernie the Magician makes a shape float over his head. Another wave, and a second shape appears on a table nearby. The player now decides whether or not the two shapes match. If so, and the player agrees, Ernie nods and the two shapes float together before disappearing. If not, Ernie shakes his head "no", waves his wand, and a new shape appears on the table.

meta.name: Erotica
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Erotica is a turn-based puzzle-board game for up to two players. The goal is to score more points by selecting higher numbers. Player one picks digits from a horizontal row, while player two selects from a vertical column. Selecting a digit in your own color adds points, while choosing the opponent's color subtracts points. The game ends when all digits disappear from the board, revealing the full background picture.

meta.name: Eruca
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.80 KB

meta.name: Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Escape places you inside a remote labyrinth cut off from civilization, a place many explorers entered but never left. Viewed from above, you navigate its winding paths in search of a hidden axe needed to break through a locked blue door on the far side. All the while, a dinosaur relentlessly hunts you, punishing every misstep. Carrying the axe allows progress but slows you down, forcing smart decisions about when to drop it and flee. Once the door is smashed, the tension escalates – a time limit begins and higher difficulty levels introduce more pursuers, demanding sharp awareness, timing, and nerve.

meta.name: Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game is loosely based on the 1983 Choose Your Own Adventure book Escape from Dorado and features three mini-games. The story follows a secret agent who finds themselves in 2035 in the totalitarian state of Dorado, a remnant of the former US Southwest. The goal is to escape the regime and return to the democratic Turtalia. In the game, you navigate a 3D labyrinth representing the city streets after escaping prison, accompanied by three allies: Matt, resistance leader Zoey, and codebreaker Fred—one of whom is a traitor. Instead of deep hyperfiction, the game focuses more on primitive driving and flight simulators.

meta.name: Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.11 KB

In this game, you control a hero navigating a vast underground cave system to collect keys hidden in various locations. Along the way, you must overcome numerous and sometimes random obstacles to escape. You jump skillfully, move levers, and collect the keys to eventually reach the cave's exit. The game offers continuous unpredictability, making it both exciting and challenging.

meta.name: Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.36 KB

Escape throws you into a sequence of self-contained rooms where precise jumping and perfect timing determine success or failure. Each screen is packed with lethal hazards, moving threats, and a clear objective that must be reached within a limited time. Mistakes are punished instantly, forcing every move to be carefully planned. The appeal comes from the constant learning curve – with each attempt, patterns become clearer until a flawless run is achieved.

meta.name: Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.49 KB

Escape is a platform game. The task of the player is to find 13 crystal cubes in order to get out of the labyrinth by the magical portal. The protagonist is weaponless, so the only way to avoid enemies is a good timing and jumping ability. The maze is inhabited by numerous hostile creatures. Contact with them or with purple ladder and floor takes some amount of energy. A fall from the heights or contact with falling rocks takes life. Some useful items may be found in the maze, for example extra energy and surprise pack, with various numbers of points. Points are necessary to access local teleports, moving to another part of the labyrinth.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Escape and Evasion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.98 KB

In this game, you must escape from a Nazi POW camp. There are two different paths you can take to escape, offering two possible solutions to the game. Your first escape attempt will always fail, forcing you to try again. Since you are only allowed to move around the camp during the day and often have very few moves before the guards catch you (usually only seven moves per location), the game presents itself as a tricky puzzle that must be solved without getting caught. Luckily, the game doesn't end if you are caught, so you can always try again.

meta.name: Escape from Arth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Escape from Arth drops you onto a hostile alien world where survival depends on skill and quick thinking as you control one of two trapped cyborgs. Deadly flying machines dominate the landscape, forcing you to rely on precise movement and well-timed attacks. A jetpack opens up new paths, switches disable generators to reveal more areas, and upgrades steadily enhance your equipment. Piece by piece you work toward escaping the planet – fast-paced, challenging and driven by exploration and action.

meta.name: Escape from Arth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Escape from Arth drops you onto a hostile alien world where survival depends on skill and quick thinking as you control one of two trapped cyborgs. Deadly flying machines dominate the landscape, forcing you to rely on precise movement and well-timed attacks. A jetpack opens up new paths, switches disable generators to reveal more areas, and upgrades steadily enhance your equipment. Piece by piece you work toward escaping the planet – fast-paced, challenging and driven by exploration and action.

meta.name: Escape from Colditz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.38 KB

In this game, you control a team of four prisoners of war – a Brit, a Frenchman, an American, and a Pole – who are working together to escape from a notorious Nazi POW camp. Each of the four characters starts in their own quarters on different floors of the camp, and you can switch between them at any time. The gameplay is reminiscent of isometric games from the Spectrum era, such as The Great Escape or Head Over Heels. A key part of the challenge is collecting and using items, such as lockpicks for simple doors, keys for more secure ones, German uniforms to move around unnoticed, and shovels for digging. You must also avoid restricted areas – if you enter them, you'll be thrown into solitary confinement and lose your equipment. If you flee from guards in these areas, they'll shoot at you.

meta.name: Escape from Doomworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.28 KB

In Escape from Doomworld, you rescue stranded scientists from the planet Helcara in the Brithya sector. A hostile force has established a base near the research station, where some scientists are held captive while others have escaped and need your help. In the first part, a flick-screen platformer, you collect energy cells, keys, and a weapon while avoiding creatures. With full energy and all items collected, you move on to part two: Here, you pilot a spaceship, pick up 12 scientists, and evade enemy aliens while refueling using energy capsules. In the final section, you gather three bombs to secure the planet.

meta.name: Escape from Mars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.88 KB

In Escape from Mars, you find yourself stranded on Mars with your spaceship and must collect various items to repair your ship and escape the planet. The game follows the classic "collect the right items" principle, typical of text-based adventures from the early home computer era.

meta.name: Escape from New York
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.52 KB

The game follows the storyline of the movie Escape from New York. As Snake, you attempt to land the plane on the skyscraper. Throughout the game, you'll encounter various sections, including jumping over the grasping hands of the insane inmates and a mini-game that closely resembles Subway Surfers, where you must dodge obstacles that seem to come at you.

meta.name: Escape from Paradise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.62 KB

In Escape from Paradise you control the hero Joe as he attempts to escape a vast maze by reaching the top. The screen scrolls as he moves, and Joe must climb ropes, ladders and stairs while using elevators or springs to reach higher areas. Along the way he must avoid creatures and obstacles that drain his energy whenever they touch him. Moving or disappearing platforms and dangerous water areas make the journey even more difficult. Joe carries a gun, but it can only be used after collecting energy balls. These balls serve both as ammunition and as energy reserves, helping Joe recover if his energy meter runs out.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #05 : Escape From Pulsar 7
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.69 KB

Escape From Pulsar 7 is the fourth title in the Mysterious Adventure series of illustrated text adventures by Brian Howarth. It has a science-fiction theme influenced by the hit film "Alien". The player finds themselves trapped alone on a giant space ship. The rest of the crew are dead, killed by a mutated zoo specimen.
The player's goal is ultimately that they must escape the ship in a life pod to avoid being the creature's next meal. Explore the bunks of your comrades to find the tools needed. Only useful items can be taken, so the gameplay is quite linear, with several maze sections.

meta.name: Escape from Raka-Tua
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Escape from Raka-Tua, the volcano of Raka Tua has erupted, spewing hot lava across the island. You must figure out how to survive and escape. The game is a continuation of Volcano of Raka-Tua.

meta.name: Escape from SEUCK
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.14 KB

In Escape from SEUCK, you control Snake Plissken, who must fight his way out of a city overrun by thugs. The game is loosely based on the film Escape from New York. You battle through hostile neighborhoods to escape and regain your freedom.

meta.name: Escape from Stank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.77 KB

In Escape from Stank, you find yourself on the dangerous and foul-smelling planet Stank, where your task is to solve various puzzles and escape before you meet your demise. You can explore the planet's different rooms, where you'll find useful items that can aid in your escape. Along the way, you must be cautious of various dangers that could kill you. The game uses text commands, allowing you to move in different directions as you navigate through the environment.

meta.name: Escape from the Dark Prison
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.72 KB

Escape from the Dark Prison challenges you to escape from a dark and dangerous prison. Along the way, you'll face guards and various hazards that must either be avoided or fought. With limited strength and only a handful of lives, you must navigate the underground labyrinth and find the right path to freedom. Every move and decision brings you closer to escape or to failure.

You, along with several other rebels, have been captured by the secret police of the cruel King Safuis II and locked in a grim cell in the legendary Dungeon of the Gods. While the king's troops outside are annihilating the people, you must escape to aid the resistance against the king's tyranny. Legends say that somewhere in the dungeon lies the Chest of the Gods, which holds the power to destroy the king and his troops. This and other treasures are guarded by powerful monsters that must be defeated in order to gain access to the riches. Be brave, and may the blessing of the gods be with you!

In Escape from the Laundry, you find yourself in a platformer where you must navigate through various levels to escape. The goal is to flee from the laundry room by avoiding obstacles and overcoming different challenges along the way.

n: Escape from the Planet of the Robot Monsters (Europe)

This isometric shooter plays like “Gauntlet,” but with a wild sci-fi twist straight out of 1940s B-movies. You blast through robotic enemies, rescue scientists and collect gear, all wrapped in comic-style animations and colorful cutscenes. Alongside your partner Duke, you battle to stop an invasion that plans to use kidnapped scientists to build a zombie army to destroy Earth.

meta.name: Escape from the Waste Disposal Unit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.13 KB

Escape from the Waste Disposal Unit drops you into a hopeless situation after your original mission fails and you find yourself trapped inside a massive waste facility. Within confined areas, you must navigate through drifting garbage while managing an energy system that governs both progress and survival. A beam allows you to extract energy from the environment, but it also drains your reserves, making every action a calculated risk. Help comes from an unlikely ally that can restore energy, while rising challenges and adjustable starting conditions steadily increase the pressure on your escape.

meta.name: Lords of Chaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.21 KB

Lords of Chaos draws you into a shattered fantasy world where powerful wizards battle for control. Every turn demands careful planning, as movement, combat and magic are limited and must be used wisely. On your path to escape you gather treasure, summon creatures and unleash complex spells, while enemy mages counter you with the same tools. The appeal comes from its tactical depth, risky decisions and the constant dilemma between building power or pushing straight for the objective.

meta.name: Escape II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.40 KB

In Escape II, you navigate through impressive mazes that you can choose based on size and type. Your goal is to reach the end safely while avoiding the monsters that cross your path. Each maze presents new challenges and requires good navigation skills and quick reflexes to reach the goal without getting caught by the monsters.

meta.name: Escape MCP
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.67 KB

Escape MCP places you inside a computer after a rogue processor has digitized you. You navigate maze-like environments, collecting a key and a program disk to unlock the exit and escape. A relentless threat follows you at all times, costing a life on contact and punishing every mistake. Extra tension comes from walls and blocks that shift between visible and invisible, suddenly blocking paths – awareness, timing, and quick decisions are essential to survive.

p: Escape Route - The Adventures of Eric Hawthorne (USA) (Unl).D64
n: Escape Route - The Adventures of Eric Hawthorne (USA) (Unl)

Escape Route: The Adventures of Eric Hawthorne puts you in the role of a detective chasing down the stolen Acme Diamond. The infamous Icelady is behind the theft, and it's up to you to recover it. Combining the flair of 50s and 60s B-Movies with gameplay drawn from arcade, strategy and board games, this adventure challenges you to outwit danger and solve the case step by step.
