meta.name: Escape to Freedom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.05 KB

After a successful mission as a bomber pilot during World War II, you return to base, only to have your aircraft hit. Battling with the controls of the burning plane, you jump out with your parachute just before the aircraft crashes, landing in a barn on soft hay. After inspecting the wreckage of your plane in enemy territory, you decide to make your way to safety on foot, but you are captured and taken to a POW camp. Determined not to spend the rest of the war here, you resolve to escape the camp.

meta.name: Escape to Zanuss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Escape to Zanuss, your task is to escape from the spaceship Elektra and make your way to the planet Zanuss, where your time machine awaits in the alien city.

meta.name: The Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.15 KB

In The Escape, after years of suffering and worry, you and an elderly friend decide to fight back against the system and take to the streets. Together, you battle through the challenges, aiming to change the situation and escape.

meta.name: Escape-Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.55 KB

Escape-Man is a remake of the original Escape-Man '87, where the player navigates through a maze to collect items and avoid enemy creatures. The goal is to secure all the items without getting caught. The new version retains the classic gameplay while offering improved graphics and smoother gameplay, all while preserving the charm of the original.

meta.name: The Escaping Habit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.30 KB

It is January 1942. You are a prisoner of war in Italy, captured while on your way to a meeting with Allied commanders in North Africa. You were carrying secret papers, which, luckily, you managed to save from the enemy. You are now in a high-security camp in northern Italy, after several escape attempts. A British officer greets you and provides basic information about the camp. But secretly, he slips you a piece of paper with a warning: the Gestapo is on its way to discover the location of the secret documents. You must decide whether to attempt an escape or wait for the Gestapo and face their inevitable pressure.

meta.name: Eskimo Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Eskimo Games," you experience a wintry collection of mini-games focused on snowy fun. In "Operation Snowball," you throw snowballs at enemies building a catapult machine, aiming to destroy their projectiles. In "Eggsterminator," you collect eggs from bird nests on a cliff while avoiding birds, as collisions cost you time. "Ice N'Igloos" challenges you to gather ice blocks with an axe and deliver them to build an igloo, all while dodging seals that also steal your time. In "Miami Ice," instead of serving beer, you serve ice cream by matching scoops to the waiting customers and collecting the returned empty cones. The C64 version omits the final challenge, "Barbearian," where you battle a polar bear while the ice beneath you melts. A charming winter game packed with diverse challenges!

meta.name: Espial
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.07 KB

Espial puts you in the cockpit of a space attack pilot, engaging in a deadly battle over a massive enemy spaceship. As endless waves of hostile craft swarm toward you, you must fend off their attacks while simultaneously launching missiles and lasers at the enemy vessel. Your missiles strike where your crosshair is aimed at the moment of firing, requiring precise control and quick reflexes. But beware – enemy fire and collisions with flying objects spell certain doom. Do you have what it takes to fight through the relentless onslaught and defeat the overwhelming enemy forces?

meta.name: Espionage (Deekster Productions)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.32 KB

In Espionage you take on a dangerous secret mission in which you must steal the plans for a top secret military spy satellite. You move through a heavily guarded complex, explore different areas and search for the correct path to your objective. Using text commands, you decide which actions to perform, which places to investigate and how to deal with the obstacles inside the facility. Every step can reveal new clues or new dangers, so caution and smart decision-making are essential. Only by finding the right locations and carrying out the mission successfully can you escape with the valuable plans.

meta.name: Espionage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.76 KB

In Espionage you compete with up to three other players to become the ultimate master spy. The objective is to recover hidden microfilm canisters and return them safely to your base. Each player controls a team of agents with different movement abilities, similar to pieces in chess. Besides collecting the microfilm, you can also eliminate opposing agents by jumping over them into an empty space. Points are awarded for defeated enemies, recovered film canisters and surviving agents, and the highest score at the end determines the winner.

meta.name: Espionage Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.82 KB

While on a recce mission to investigate a secret enemy location, your plane is shot down and you are sent hurtling towards the island's surface. This is where you come in, and through text commands you must initially bring the plane under control. After this you must locate the stronghold, retrieve the information needed and then get to your aircraft carrier. To get back past enemy fire, you must return in disguise, so you must also avoid your side shooting at you by mistake.

meta.name: Essex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In “Essex,” a tour of the spaceship Essex quickly turns into a perilous adventure. A dying agent tasks the player with finding a scientist and their formula — the only means to strengthen the Federation against the alien Vollchons. The game unfolds in real-time, delivering an engaging, text-based narrative.

meta.name: Estra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.69 KB

The secret Raal Temple on Reonzar holds a delicate rescue mission: 24 stolen pieces of the statue of Estra the Snake God must be recovered. You collect them one by one and carry them through gaps in an energy field toward the center, while creatures with different movement patterns make every route dangerous. Your energy supply is also steadily draining, so tempting recharges can help – but reaching them comes with risks of its own. Estra combines focused dodging, precise route planning, and constant time pressure into an unusually tense collecting challenge.

meta.name: ESWAT
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

ESWAT: Cyber Police es un beat 'em up lateral donde avanzas de izquierda a derecha para detener a un cerebro criminal. Son 15 niveles de patrulla por las calles de Liberty: talleres, estadios, restaurantes, el centro financiero, obras y muelles. Cada escenario respira caos urbano y peligro constante. Mientras patrullas, recoges munición… pero con mala leche: en un nivel te caen 10 balas; en otro, 60. La suerte (y el instinto) marcan la diferencia. Y una vez que consigues el codiciado traje cibernético, lo llevas para el resto del juego: más resistencia, más estilo… y la sensación de que, al fin, la justicia tiene peso. Acción sin tregua, ambiente ochentero y el pulso siempre al límite.

meta.name: Eszkimo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.71 KB

In Eszkimo, you take on the role of an Eskimo child searching for your curious little brother, who constantly disappears and gets involved in the wildest adventures. As you journey through endless snowy landscapes, prepare for additional rescue missions, as there is more to discover than just your brother. Fantastic and unexpected events await, and you'll face challenges using peaceful means, such as snowballs. Good luck on your adventure!

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Eternal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Eternal” is a fast-paced sci-fi platformer where you control a small robot navigating through dangerous levels. Your goal is to reach the exit gate before time runs out, avoiding enemy units and deadly traps like stalactites, hooks, or water pools. Contact with enemies lowers your energy, while traps cost a life instantly. You have unlimited ammo to fight back, but caution is key. Each of the 27 levels contains a limited number of diamonds – collect 50 to gain an extra life.

meta.name: The Eternal Dagger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This sequel to SSI's Wizard's Crown plays very much like the original. It's a fantasy RPG where you assemble a party of adventurers and explore a map. In this game, the world is being invaded by Demons coming in from a portal to another dimension, and your job is to find the one item that can seal the portal, The Eternal Dagger.
Like Wizard's Crown, this game is notable for its detailed, tactical combat system. There was also a "quick combat" mode if you didn't want to spend the time in the tactical mode, allowing you to focus more on conventional RPG features such as exploration.

The game originally offered a £25,000 prize to the first player who completed it.

meta.name: Euro Boss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Euro Boss is a football management game for the Commodore 64 where you take on the role of a club manager and lead your team through a season. You make decisions such as team selection, training routines, transfers, stadium upgrades and ticket pricing, all aimed at achieving success in league and competition play. The game features text-based menus with navigable options rather than detailed match graphics, offering a classic, straightforward managerial experience typical of early football management simulations.

meta.name: Europe Ablaze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Europe Ablaze" puts you in command of hundreds of aircraft, planning strategic air battles over Britain, France, and Germany during World War II. As Reichsmarschall Göring or Air Chief Marshal Portal, you set priorities and tactical doctrines while observing daily events and their consequences. Alternatively, as a fleet commander, you can directly plan missions, determine attack vectors, and carefully manage resources. Up to 12 players can share air command roles, or you can leave everything to the AI to study strategies. Hex-based maps, dynamic weather, and a campaign editor provide deep planning opportunities and high replay value.

meta.name: European 5-a-Side
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.62 KB

European 5-A-Side delivers fast-paced indoor football in an enclosed arena where the walls actively influence play by rebounding the ball at sharp angles. Viewed from a slightly angled top-down perspective, you always control the player closest to the ball, including the goalkeeper inside the box, with the freedom to pass or shoot from anywhere. The speed, constant motion and unique setting create intense matches, with adjustable match length and pitch appearance adding extra flexibility.

meta.name: European Champions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

European Champions is a managerial football game where you select from one of 32 European National teams and attempt to qualify for the European Championships before trying to win the tournament. After choosing your team you presented with a number of options that allow you to see your fixtures, squad, tables, medical and other options. You are also able to select friendly games in between your qualifying matches. Once you have looked at various options you then go on to your first game. You are able to pick your team with five subs and a formation, as well as playing defensive or attacking, and choosing a passing game. The match itself shows the whole pitch with the scoreboard on the right hand side. You watch the ball move around the pitch with major incidents are shown by text. The game speed is selected before the match (1-10) and you can choose one of your subs at any time of the match.

meta.name: European Champions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game is played using a top down view. You can choose if each match should be three, six or nine minutes. When starting the game you can choose from playing a single match or a full season. When choosing single match you have to choose the two teams you want to play and whether they should be controlled by player or computer. When done with that you have some tactical options such as mentality and marking an what players that should play.

meta.name: European Football Champ
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.17 KB

European Football Champ was released to coincide with the 1992 European Championships. The game scrolls horizontally at a slight angle, and recreates the coin-op's close-up zoom effect after a player scores. Only a small area of the pitch is on screen at a time, but there is a scanner to show the whole pitch. Although the game has a referee, he often loses attention, and these moments give you a chance to foul, punch or side-swipe opposition players. One and two player options are included.

meta.name: European Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.78 KB

European Games follows the classic „Games“ formula, primarily relying on joystick-waggling with some precision elements. Across five or six disciplines, depending on the platform, speed-based events require rapid left-to-right joystick movements or pressing the fire button at the right moment. Hammer throwing involves releasing the throw when the power bar is at its peak, with additional rotation control on the Commodore. Swimming demands both joystick movement and air management – surfacing slows you down. The long jump is another joystick-heavy event, requiring precise timing for takeoff and an optional jump angle selection. Rowing functions similarly to swimming but without an air supply. Weight lifting involves maintaining a high power bar level and lifting the weight before time runs out.

meta.name: European II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.13 KB

European II lets you experience European club football in its classic pure knock-out format, focusing on tactical planning and assessment. You define your team's strength through multiple skill levels or by entering individual player abilities, and before each match you are given an indication of both teams' scoring potential. Discipline rules, away goals and penalty shoot-outs are fully implemented, ensuring every tie remains tense until the very end and that careful strategy determines progress or elimination.

meta.name: European Nations & Locations
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

European Nations & Locations is an educational game focused on the geography of Europe. Players must correctly place countries on a map, while also learning about capitals, landforms, history, and current facts. The game combines map-based learning with interactive gameplay and even allows users to add their own social studies questions – making it ideal for classroom use or focused home study.

meta.name: European Soccer Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.16 KB

European Soccer Challenge allows you to play as one of fourteen European football teams (including the mighty Wrexham) against another player or the computer. Options include the number of players, your skill level and the team you want to play as. The match is viewed from above showing a small part of the pitch. The joystick controls the nearest player to the ball and the fire button allows you to shoot or pass. The keyboard is used to select your options on the menu screens.

meta.name: Evasion
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.76 KB

meta.name: Everest Ascent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.40 KB

Everest Ascent is a strategy resource management game where the player is the leader of an expedition attempting to climb Mount Everest. With a limited starting fund of £1000, the player must juggle expenses to hire sherpas, purchase equipment that may be useful in the ascent (tents, ropes, planks), as well as rations to keep everyone fed. Able to set up various base camps on the way up, the progress of the player's expedition may also result in donations being given to the player to help his efforts (which the player can find out about if he pays out for a radio for the expedition). Of course, collecting such donations and gathering new supplies and sherpas will require returning to village to collect them. Can you keep everyone alive and strong enough to reach the summit?

meta.name: Every Second Counts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Every Second Counts is a computer game based on the popular 1980s British television show. This is a quiz show game for either three couples or six individuals. Single players compete against a computer partner, with participants competing to win seconds, not points. The player with the most seconds takes part in the final round, in which those seconds represent the time they have available to compete.

meta.name: Everyone's a Wally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 65.28 KB

En Everyone's a Wally tenemos que ayudar a una de las familias más raras de la historia del videojuego a abrir una caja fuerte para que puedan cobrar sus nóminas. 
Encuentra la combinación segura, repartida en diferentes lugares, para pagar los salarios. Cuando estés en la misma área, cambia de personaje. Wally, Wilma, Tom, Dick y Harry tienen diferentes habilidades. Camina por los objetos para recogerlos o intercambiarlos. Para ganar, lleva cada número a la caja fuerte en el orden correcto. Evita cualquier otra cosa que se mueva, incluyendo al bebé Herbert.

meta.name: Evil Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.91 KB

In Evil Crown, you manage a barony in medieval England in the year 1156. The game is divided into annual turns, where you must oversee your lands. The screen is split into two halves: On the left, you see a map of your territories, providing information on harvests and potential expansions. On the right, there are icons allowing you to adjust tax and toll settings, pay Scutage to the king, and modify your army. There is also an arcade sequence where you participate in a jousting tournament. Using the joystick, you control your lance to strike your opponent. Depending on the outcome, a graphic sequence follows, showing either a battle or a peasant uprising. Afterward, you receive the harvest results before moving on to the next yearly cycle.

meta.name: The Evil Dead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.44 KB

In The Evil Dead, you play as Ash inside a remote cabin in the woods, fighting an evil force that enters through the windows and can take over your friends. Once possessed, they turn into dangerous monsters that you must stop with weapons such as an axe or shovel. As your strength slowly fades, you collect points and try to make the Book of the Dead appear – only by burning it in the fireplace can the horror finally end.

meta.name: The Evil Prince
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Evil Prince takes you into the city of Baugur, plagued by ruthless bandits, where a bounty has been placed on their infamous leader. You choose from three distinct heroes – a brave warrior, a mysterious wizard, or a cunning witch – each with unique strengths and weaknesses that shape how the adventure unfolds. Presented in the style of a Hungarian gamebook, the game offers multiple choices at each scene. Strategic thinking and clever use of your character's abilities are key to surviving the journey and claiming the reward.

meta.name: The Evil Ridge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.59 KB

In "The Evil Ridge," the kingdom of Picar has been overrun by evil forces. Only the Scepter of Righteousness can save the realm. The player must find it in the ancient ruins of Aranto Fortress.

meta.name: Evolution
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Evolution lets you live an entire life story across six frantic stages – from a tiny amoeba to a laser-wielding human. Each step feels like a small survival trial. You start by devouring DNA while spores and microbes chase you, then wriggle through treacherous waters as a tadpole hunting flies and dodging hungry fish. Later you snatch cheese as a quick rodent, avoid snakes, and keep climbing the ladder until you gather sticks as a beaver in crocodile territory. Soon after, you defend your oranges as a gorilla against pesky monkeys before finally becoming human, blasting mutants with a laser gun. Every phase shifts the focus – and with each leap you feel the world grow bigger, tougher and more exciting.

meta.name: The Examination
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Examination is a role-playing game in the style of the "Bard's Tale" series, but with a single character instead of a group. The player takes on the role of an apprentice wizard who must travel the world to pass his final exam, which is divided into five smaller challenges. There are many dungeons to explore and monsters to defeat. Combat is turn-based and rewards experience points, leading to a level-up and improvements in the character's stats (strength, mentality, constitution, and dexterity). As a wizard, the player can learn spells, which are divided into light, compass, healing, combat, and ranged spells. New spells are acquired after completing a sub-test. The user interface displays the current situation, character stats, commands, and important information such as enemy status, dialogues, and an automap.

meta.name: Excaliba
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.84 KB

In Excaliba you once again collect door pieces to unlock the next dungeon, but this time the dangers are far greater. Alongside enemy knights, the Black Wizard appears, summoning birds and archers to stop you. Ladders let you move between platforms, and obstacles can be jumped over but not shot. If fortune favors you, you'll ride a unicorn encircled by Excalibur, making obstacles easier to avoid. Each enemy hit costs a life, and once all are gone, your quest comes to an end.

meta.name: Exile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cuando un equipo de terraformación de un planeta inexplorado envía mensajes preocupantes a la Tierra y luego no responde en absoluto, un aventurero espacial es enviado para averiguar qué ha ocurrido.
El jugador asume el papel de un astronauta que debe explorar una gigantesca red subterránea extraterrestre. Desde el principio, dispone de toda una gama de armas y poderes. Se desplaza en un jet pack, que está sujeto a la gravedad, el viento y su propia inercia. Los objetos también están sujetos a las leyes de la física. Cuando un astronauta muere, reaparece en el último punto de teletransporte. El jugador debe encontrar la forma de llegar a las profundidades del planeta para salvar al equipo de terraformación y derrotar al malvado Triax.
meta.developer: Jeremy C. Smith, Peter J. M. Irvin

meta.name: EXIS : The Planet Far Away
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Exis: The Planet Far Away challenges you to push colored spheres onto marked X spots – a task that quickly turns tricky. Push them the wrong way or against each other and you may get stuck. The gameplay is inspired by Sokoban puzzles, but set in a sci-fi world of stars, planets, and metallic walls. With limited time and lives, careful strategy is key to completing each level.

meta.name: Exodus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.89 KB

You are in a single-screen shooter where your task is to prevent creatures and objects from escaping "The Pit," an octagonal prison. The escapees appear in the center and try to reach the edge. You move your spaceship around the perimeter and shoot inward to stop them, but you must avoid hitting your friend Spud, as doing so will cost you a life. An escapee only causes a life loss if it's a llama and reaches the edge. You also lose lives if you touch anything on the perimeter. A timer is also counting down, and if it reaches zero, the game ends, but you can shoot clocks to extend your time.

meta.name: Exolon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.00 KB

Durante días y días tu viaje ha comenzado, desesperas de poder aterrizar tu nave espacial cuando, de repente, ves el final del viaje... El comité de bienvenida está en la cita. Tienes dos armas: la pistola o las granadas, estas últimas tienen la ventaja de atravesar también los muros gruesos o las paredes rocosas... Sin embargo, si los enemigos resultan ser numerosos, poderosos e indestructibles, no dudes en utilizar tu armadura hiperblindada: el exoesqueleto te protege mejor y te permite volar.
Exolon presenta unos gráficos compuestos por muchas pantallas de colores con una animación bastante buena. La progresión es lineal y puedes llenarte de energía y granadas por el camino.

meta.name: Exorcist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Exorcist confronts you with a dark world where you must fight sinister forces in continuous side-scrolling action. As you move through hazardous areas, you face changing enemies and challenges that demand quick reactions and precise timing. The experience thrives on constant motion, direct combat and the ongoing pressure of avoiding being overwhelmed by supernatural threats.

meta.name: Expedition Amazon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Expedition Amazon te pone al mando de un equipo de 4 exploradores en una expedición para mapear y estudiar (saquear) las ruinas de la civilización Inca. Su equipo está formado por un médico, un ayudante de campo, un operador de radio y un guardia. Después de equipar a su grupo con todos los suministros necesarios, viajará a su campamento base en el borde de la selva donde comenzará su viaje.
Rápidamente se encontrará con muchos peligros de la selva mientras explora, incluyendo nativos hostiles, mosquitos, enfermedades, animales salvajes y más. Cada uno de los miembros de tu equipo tiene una clasificación "EL" que indica lo cerca que están de la muerte. La muerte llega rápidamente para los nuevos miembros del equipo, pero a medida que tu equipo gana experiencia (mapeando más y más las ruinas amazónicas e incas), tu puntuación EL hace que tu equipo tenga más éxito.

meta.name: Expeditions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Expeditions brings together three different adventures that place young players in the lives of early frontier settlers, constantly asking them to make smart decisions. Whether trading, traveling, or facing the difficult journey westward, the focus is always on weighing risks, supplies, and the next move. That creates an engaging mix of challenge and discovery that introduces history in a playful way while also encouraging thinking, planning, and navigation.
meta.developer: Kevin W. Neff, Chris Fuller & Chad C. Cooper

meta.name: Expire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Expire delivers classic side-scrolling space action where you fight through enemy formations and dangerous obstacles. As the screen moves forward, you have to dodge carefully, shoot accurately, and keep an eye on your energy. The dark space setting and massive structures in the background give the action a threatening atmosphere. The result is a direct action game driven by reaction, constant fire, and steady survival.

meta.name: Exploding Wall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.61 KB

Exploding Wall is inspired by the classic Arkanoid but expands the gameplay with a scrolling playfield. Instead of clearing a single fixed screen, you can bounce the ball left or right while the paddle scrolls along. A radar below the field shows the positions of the remaining bricks. Some bricks drop bonuses such as lasers, rockets, or ball slowdowns. Aliens also appear on screen and can be eliminated by hitting them. If the ball slips past your paddle, you lose one of your three lives – so stay sharp until every brick is gone.

meta.name: Explorer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.27 KB

After trying to simulate orienteering with The Forest, Graham Relph goes further by creating a game world with no less than 4 billion locations.
These are drawn in great detail and can be viewed in two different ways, flying (top view) or walking (panoramic view). The task is to locate 9 objects, flying close enough to one of them that a beacon activates and directs you towards it. You must then find an open area to land on, then approach it by walking. You will sometimes encounter robotic insects to kill.

meta.name: Express Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.02 KB

Your aim in life is to be the greatest train robber in the Wild West, a multi-stage task recreated in this coin-op conversion. Your character has plenty of attacking kicks and punches to use on anyone who gets in his way, starting with the local banker, and then some coyotes roaming the plains, who are easier dodged than killed. After this, you find yourself atop the train, attacking a succession of guards in one-on-one beat ‘em up duels, each of which must be won outright within the time limit to avoid losing a life. Many of these shoot at you, so dodge their shots as you attack them. The game offers a practice mode, in which you have 32 lives to try to improve your skills, and a ‘normal’ mode in which you have unlimited continues as long as you can reach the high-score table with each continue – in this mode, as in the ‘advanced’ mode in which you must always start again from scratch, you have 5 lives

meta.name: Exterminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Exterminator turns everyday pest control into an action-packed game. Chicago is under siege by mutated insects, rats, and even toy tanks, and the player must clear out seven houses, each with typical rooms. Controlling a seemingly disembodied hand, the goal is to fend off the oncoming creatures using different attacks — shooting, thumping, or squashing, depending on the enemy type. To clear a room, a set number of pests must be eliminated in each vertically divided lane, changing the color of the floor tiles as progress is made.

meta.name: Exterminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.68 KB

Exterminator pits you against a descending centipede that weaves across the screen, changing direction whenever it hits obstacles. You control a droid, shoot the segments to break it apart, and decide whether to clear obstacles, which can speed up the threat's advance. Bonus targets appear from time to time, rewarding risky shots with extra points. With limited lives and increasing pace, the experience becomes a tense skill challenge that rewards reflexes, positioning, and strategic aiming.

meta.name: Extraterrestrial
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.56 KB

meta.name: Extreme
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.89 KB

Your task in Extreme essentially involves wiping out alien pirates, across 3 distinct sections. This was essentially a spare-time pet project, so you would expect some of the most advanced graphics and special effects you'll ever see on a Spectrum.
The first level involves flying around in a ship shooting out aliens, with contact depleting your energy (and causing the screen border to flash). The second section involves travelling underwater, running into landmines to set off explosions to kill surrounding enemies. The final part sees you travelling through a  building in a huge droid, taking out everything in your path. The game is quite short, and would take around 20 minutes to play through.

meta.name: Extricator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.55 KB

You have been transported to the surface of the planet Arg. Your mission is to infiltrate the alien command center, where Professor Roberts is being held captive. There are several sectors you must traverse before reaching the prison block. Each of these sectors presents its own set of challenges that must be solved in order to advance to the next area.

meta.name: Eye
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.33 KB

Eye is closely related to the board game of the same name. The game is played by two or four players on a board made up of squares of different colors. Each player has pieces of the same color, and wishes to place a certain number of his or her own pieces on the corresponding slots. The special feature of this concept is that the playing field rests on two rotating spirals, which change the distribution of the pieces on the playing field as they are used. Each turn, a player has a different number of moves at his disposal (which changes according to the game situation), each move consisting of moving a square or rotating a spiral. This computerized version also makes it possible to modify certain rules compared with the original game, and to replace all opponents with AI.

meta.name: Eye of Horus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.80 KB

Eye of Horus puts you in the role of a shaman exploring the mysterious corridors of an Egyptian pyramid in search of the magical Eye of Horus. With a clever twist, you can transform into a bird to scout the levels from above and instantly return to human form. But the path is full of devious traps, demanding your focus and adaptability.

meta.name: Eye of the Inca
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.23 KB

Eye of the Inca is an adventure game where you take on the role of an explorer who has discovered the long-lost Inca temple in the jungle. Your goal is to find the world's largest diamond, known in legends as the "Eye of the Inca."

meta.name: F-14 Tomcat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

F-14 Tomcat lets you choose between a quick mission selection and a longer pilot career. In career mode, you first take on training flights, combat maneuvers, and mock dogfights, with your performance even shaping your call sign and later assignment. After that, missions from the aircraft carrier Nimitz await, where you face hostile jets and make careful use of your available weapons. The game combines personal progression, military atmosphere, and tense aerial battles into a varied pilot journey.

¡Ponte el cinturón en tu asiento eyectable y prepárate para un emocionante combate de cazas modernos en F-15 STRIKE EAGLE! Vuela en misiones de combate que tuvieron lugar en el Sudeste Asiático, Europa y Oriente Medio. Enfréntate a aviones enemigos y destruye objetivos terrestres enemigos. Dispone de todas las sofisticadas herramientas de la guerra aérea electrónica moderna, incluidos el sistema de puntería asistida por ordenador y la pantalla de visualización. El armamento a tu disposición incluye ametralladoras, misiles guiados y bombas.

meta.name: F-16 Combat Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ha amanecido. Te reúnes con los demás pilotos en el cuartel general para discutir los objetivos del día. Tácticas, maniobras de combate... todo un mundo minuciosamente recreado en F-16 COMBAT PILOT. Durante el briefing previo al vuelo, das tus instrucciones a los armeros y planeas tu ataque...
En el punto álgido de tu entrenamiento, dominas el arte de llevar a cabo las misiones que puede realizar el F-16, desde la interceptación aire-aire hasta las misiones de reconocimiento.
Pero ahora está a punto de estallar el conflicto que esperabas que nunca llegara a producirse. La fuerza aérea, el ejército y toda la infraestructura estratégica están amenazados...
Nunca te habías enfrentado a un peligro semejante.

meta.name: F-18 Hornet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

F-18 Hornet puts you in the cockpit of a Navy jet for a solo combat flight experience. You'll take off from carriers, perform bombing runs, strafing attacks, and engage in dogfights. Across four missions, you'll face varied opponents and must complete specific combat tasks to rise through the Naval Aviator ranks. Precision, speed, and tactical skill are key to mastering the skies.

meta.name: F.1 Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“F.1 Manager” puts you in the role of a Formula 1 team manager, starting with a budget of approximately $6 million. You recruit drivers, purchase or modify cars, hire engineers and mechanics, analyze tracks, and adjust vehicle components. Alongside strategic planning, you personally drive on 16 famous circuits, managing speed, gears, and mastering corners to achieve fast lap times. You can compete in single races or the championship, with a two-player mode where players take turns.

meta.name: F1 GP Circuits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

F1 GP Circuits is a single-player Formula 1 racing game where you compete in a five-race Grand Prix season on tracks around the world. Each race is preceded by a qualifying lap, and you choose your manufacturer, driver, and country – with humorously altered names of real teams. The game scrolls vertically with limited forward view, requiring quick reactions to turns and rivals. Strategic pit stops for fuel and repairs, along with smart upgrades after each race, are key to success.

meta.name: F1 Tornado
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.40 KB

Eres el piloto de un F1 Tornado y debes pilotarlo a través de 4 niveles en Oriente Medio, destruyendo tantos cazas enemigos e instalaciones terrestres como sea posible. Al final de cada nivel debes destruir un gran complejo de equipamiento militar.
F1 Tornado es un juego de disparos de desplazamiento lateral. El joystick se utiliza para controlar tu avión. Cuando un helicóptero es derribado, deja tras de sí un icono. Recoge el icono y pulsa la barra espaciadora para mejorar tu arma.

meta.name: FA Cup Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.32 KB

F.A. Cup Football tiene licencia oficial de la FA Cup y te permite liderar a tu club inglés a la victoria. Primero, selecciona tu equipo y cuántos jugadores jugarán (máximo 8). Puedes elegir la formación y entre 3 estrategias de juego diferentes: ofensiva, equilibrada y defensiva. A veces tendrás que responder a preguntas con 3 opciones. Por ejemplo, si tu jugador quiere dejar el club, ¿qué harías? 
Al igual que en la F.A. Cup, tu oponente se decidirá por sorteo. Antes de cada partido, verás a tu próximo rival. En el juego, verás todos los partidos y verás cómo se desarrollan minuto a minuto. Si tu equipo gana, avanzas a la siguiente ronda (a menos que fuera la final). Los empates se juegan de nuevo; en aquel entonces, se usaban repeticiones infinitas en lugar de tandas de penaltis. Sucesos aleatorios, como lesiones o problemas fuera del campo, suelen ocurrir antes de las repeticiones.

meta.name: Fabuland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.95 KB

“Fabuland” is a shooter with charming graphics reminiscent of Zelda: Link. The game features engaging day-night transitions and an exciting raft sequence, setting it apart from other titles.

The Fabulous Wanda: and the Secret of Life, the Universe, and Everything throws you into a restricted space zone where a security agent offers you a deal to save your life: find Wanda on planet Copus and learn the ultimate secret. But nothing is free – you'll need klebs, the in-game currency. Nearly every challenge is a gambling task where winning enough money lets you move forward. Between games, you explore locations, talk to characters, and slowly uncover the mystery behind life and everything else.

Face Ache is a game where the player gets to create different faces. There are six parts of the face that be modified: left hair, right hair, eyes, nose, mouth and chin. By pressing the corresponding keys the game cycles through the available features. When starting out the player can freely play around with the face or start an automatic demonstration. When initiating a game the player gets to see a face for five seconds and after that gets one minute to recreate the face. When finished ten points are awarded for each correct part of the face.

meta.name: Face Off!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Face Off! es un juego de hockey de los desarrolladores MindSpan, más conocidos por su serie de juegos de béisbol HardBall. Juega un partido de exhibición, toda una temporada o ve directamente a los playoffs y lleva a tu equipo a la Copa Stanley. Para el juego básico de hockey, se usa una vista lateral tradicional, pero cada vez que tú o tu oponente disparan a la portería, el juego cambia a la vista especial Shot Cam. Ocasionalmente, cuando alguien comete una falta sucia, el juego se convierte en un juego de lucha uno contra uno; el que gana la pelea puede permanecer en el hielo mientras que el perdedor debe pasar algún tiempo en el área de penalización.

meta.name: Facemaker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.98 KB

“Facemaker” is a delightful and educational game that finally lets you make all the goofy faces your mom once warned you about. Choose from a wide range of eyes, ears, noses, mouths, and hairstyles to create your own unique face. Then bring it to life – it can blink, smile, frown, stick out its tongue, or wiggle its ears at your command. The highlight is a “Simon says…” style game mode where the face performs actions and you have to follow along in the correct sequence. A lovingly crafted game that encourages creativity, observation, and reaction – with guaranteed laughs.

meta.name: The Faces of Haarne
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.31 KB

Faces of Haarne is a single screen shooter where you play a strange creature who has to protect a face/head in the centre of the screen from various objects that move around the screen over various levels. You are able to move around the screen and to remove an object you throw your hat at them while avoiding being touched, though this does remove them as well. If you or the face/head are touched by an object, then a shape moves from right to left along a bar called Face below the playing area, and when this reaches the left side then you lose one of four lives and the face/head changes. To move off a level and shoot new objects, a timer counts down and when it reaches zero then you move to the next level but if you lose a life then it resets. Another bar has a shape moving from left to right and this is called Music, and if it reaches the right then the shape on the Face bar moves back to the right. The shape will move back to the left if you lose a life.

meta.name: The Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Factory” is an educational game designed to introduce children to the ideas of programming. The player is presented with a rectangular plate decorated with stripes and holes arranged at different angles. They then have to design a factory production line, which consists of a series of step-by-step processes that lead to the desired pattern. Each step is carried out by a machine that either cuts, punches or rotates an initially smooth plate into strips. Once the machines are selected, the manufacturing process is simulated and the resulting panel is compared to the initial specification.
There are 3 levels of difficulty. The simplest levels only require setting up two or three machines to create the desired patterns. The most difficult levels may require up to eight machines.

meta.name: Faerie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Faerie, you suddenly find yourself in a strange land after discovering and swinging a magic wand. Your task is to find valuable treasures while solving puzzles and interacting with various fantasy creatures and people. Every move shapes your fate.

meta.name: Fairy Well

In its simplicity, Fairy Well is an attractive and playable game that won the 'RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition' in 2011 (among other competitors C64anabalt and Space Lords - "Andromeda"). From the creator of Knight'n'Grail. The "Royal family" of the fairies has been imprisoned and the kingdom is in disgrace, it will be up to us, knight, queen or king (each with their own characteristics), to sift labyrinthine paintings in search of the diamonds that unlock the exit, dodging first the pitfalls, then facing the bosses and thus freeing each member. The gameplay is perfectly calibrated, the pleasant and functional aesthetics and the game taken care of to the point that it is neither excessively linear nor complex to complete. The action becomes a little more complicated by continuing the journey and the pleasure of searching every ravine, escaping the impression of repetition of the concept

meta.name: Falcon : The Renegade Lord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.74 KB

Cuando el hombre inventó el viaje en el tiempo, no tenía ni idea de los peligros que entrañaba. Para contrarrestarlos, se fundó la organización TIME, encargada de vigilar las líneas temporales y a las personas que las utilizan.
Normalmente, los agentes de TIME patrullan las líneas temporales, asegurándose de que nadie interfiera en los acontecimientos ni altere el curso de la historia. Sin embargo, en esta ocasión, la misión del jugador consiste en localizar a un agente deshonesto cuyo objetivo es perturbar el continuo espacio-tiempo patrullando las líneas temporales e intercambiando artefactos entre distintas zonas. Si no se controlan, estos artefactos mal colocados cronológicamente pueden causar alteraciones masivas a lo largo del tiempo, provocando la destrucción generalizada de las zonas temporales y consecuencias devastadoras para la humanidad.

Falcon Dash 2004: The Big Diamond is an exciting expansion of the classic game Boulder Dash and brings a breath of fresh air to the popular cave exploration and treasure hunt. This expansion was released just in time for the 2004/2005 New Year celebrations and offers players 17 new caves to explore. As in the original Boulder Dash, the focus is on navigating through labyrinthine caves, collecting gems and avoiding traps while the player strategically plans his next moves in order to reach the goal safely. Falcon Dash 2004: The Big Diamond challenges players with a variety of new layouts and obstacles that require skill and forward thinking to find the "Big Diamond".

meta.name: Falcon Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Falcon Patrol puts you in control of a jet fighter flying across a looping landscape, battling waves of increasingly aggressive enemies. A radar helps track incoming aircraft, while limited rockets and fuel force you to land on platforms to restock. But landing requires coming to a full stop directly above a pad—leaving you exposed to attack. Platforms can be destroyed, making every safe landing harder. Blending high-speed dogfights with resource strategy, Falcon Patrol is a tense side-scrolling shooter that demands sharp reflexes and careful planning.

meta.name: Falcon Patrol II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Falcon Patrol II returns you to the skies in a tense, side-scrolling shooter with enhanced strategy and danger. You still rely on a radar to track enemies and resupply platforms, but now you can fire diagonally downward, giving you more tactical options. Beyond attack helicopters, you'll face support choppers dropping anti-aircraft guns and radar jammers, reshaping the battlefield in real time. With 15 escalating difficulty levels, only swift and strategic elimination of enemies will push you forward. More intense and dynamic than its predecessor, Falcon Patrol II is a sharp evolution of arcade-style aerial warfare.

meta.name: Falconian Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.79 KB

You are at the console of a space fighter attempting to ward off the attacking fleet in a never ending battle to stay alive. Controlled from a viewpoint behind the ship, the player can move in all directions as alien vessels approach. The player receives more points for shooting an alien vessel further away. The player has limited fuel, but receives a bonus for every enemy hit.
There is a regular and advanced mode. In regular mode, the player automatically tracks enemy vessels, and merely needs to position their ship near an alien and fire. In advanced mode, the player must precisely align their ship with the enemy before firing.

meta.name: Falklands 82
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.69 KB

Falklands 82 simulates the ground conflict between Britain and Argentina following the 1982 occupation of the Falkland Islands. As a British commander, you plan your landing and advance across a map of East Falkland, engaging entrenched Argentine forces. Before the game begins, you choose a difficulty level and landing zone, then fight day by day over the course of up to 30 turns for control of key positions. Every decision shapes the course of battle.

meta.name: Fall Gelb : The France Campaign 1940
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fall Gelb: The France Campaign 1940 puts you in command of either German or Allied forces during the Western campaign of May 1940. This turn-based strategy game emphasizes planning, unit movement, and resource management – every decision can shift the course of battle. Modeled after classic hex-based wargames, it features authentic units and historically inspired scenarios. Players can customize side selection, AI control, and game length. Designed for serious wargamers, it demands sharp strategic thinking and offers a deep dive into the complexities of historical warfare.

meta.name: The Fall Guy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.61 KB

The Fall Guy puts the player in the role of a stuntman filming scenes for a movie. There are five scenes: In the first, the player must run across train cars, avoid birds throwing rocks, and jump over oven pipes. In the second, the player has to jump over ore wagons and escape a stone thrower. In the third scene, the player jumps from boat to boat without falling into the water. In the fourth, the player must jump from one tank to another while avoiding rockets. In the fifth scene, the player jumps from crate to crate on an "Elite" truck, collecting points by catching police hats. Any mistake causes the scene to restart, with only three attempts allowed per game. If the player completes all five scenes, the game becomes more difficult.

meta.name: The Fall of Rome
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In 395 B.C. As the Roman Empire began to lose its control to barbarians and armies across Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, you have the chance to save the empire by repelling attacks or your enemies in your various provinces for 12 turns attack. Each round corresponds to five years and is divided into three phases:
* Income and expense phase:
Here you look at each province and receive money from each province, with the number of enemy tribes and armies in the area influencing the amount. You have the choice to convert your mobile legions into other troops or move money to other provinces.
* Movement:
Here you move your armies through the provinces, and when you're done, the computer moves the enemies' tribes and armies.
* Battle:
Here you can attack your enemies to keep them in order or reduce their numbers.

meta.name: Fallen Angel

Fallen Angel is a side scrolling fighting game similar to Vigilante. You play the fallen angel, sent on a mission to locate the leader of a drug distribution network. Beginning in the London underground, each level will present you with two tasks to complete: find a plane ticket to reach the next level, and destroy the ring leader of the area. To do this you will need to fight the (often well armed) thugs found in the various underground train stations and on the trains themselves. Each level consists of several stations; when all the thugs in a station are defeated, you may get on the train to go to a different station.

Dizzy's third adventure sees the introduction of the Yolkfolk, including Daisy, who has got lost in the fantasy world of the title. The lands are littered with coins, and as well as completing the main task you should aim to collect as many of these as possible. There are puzzles on most screens, involving collecting objects such as keys, food and water buckets, and using them on doors, flames and such. Unlike the first two game, dialogue boxes between Dizzy and various other characters are included, giving the game a sense of character and humor as well as guiding you through the puzzles somewhat.

Controlling a cannon at the bottom of the screen, you fire at descending units and try to carve a path through their ranks. The further you go, the more aggressive and numerous the enemies become – precision, stamina, and quick reflexes are crucial if you want to survive the next assault.

Your mission is to dodge or shoot down enemies in a side-scrolling action setting that demands precision, reflexes, and survival skills. Fantax delivers straightforward but challenging shooter gameplay wrapped in a dark sci-fi atmosphere.

Graphics and sound have been polished compared to the original, but the style remains playful and minimalistic. Despite its simple mechanics, the game offers charm and challenge through timing and enemy behavior – a compact, entertaining action sequel.

Rather than simply working through dry tasks, you are encouraged to notice words carefully and enter them correctly, which trains spelling and responsiveness at the same time. Its friendly presentation and clear educational focus give the game an appealing charm that blends practice and enjoyment very nicely.

meta.name: Farmer's Daughter, The
meta.desc:

"The Farmer's Daughter" starts with a traveling lightning rod salesman whose car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. Searching for help, he walks through fields and back roads until he finally spots an old farm house in the distance. Exhausted, he reaches the front door – now facing whatever situation awaits him on the remote farm.

meta.name: Farragut's Fortune
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.75 KB

In Farragut's Fortune you step into the role of the heir to a legendary pirate whose vast treasure has remained hidden for more than a century. As the rightful successor, you know the secret and set out on a perilous journey across the seas, following clues and uncovering hidden locations. Puzzles, risky choices, and careful exploration shape your progress as you move closer to your goal – finding the lost fortune and restoring your family's legacy.

meta.name: Fast
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.56 KB

FAST is a two-player, overhead racing game set in space. It resembles a standard side-scrolling shooter, but the task here isn't to blast everything out of the sky; you've got to beat your opponent to the finish line without dying. You die by colliding with buildings, other craft or getting slammed by your opponent. Minor collisions cause your vehicle to spin out while your enemy flies off into the distance. If you die completely, you must suffer watching your opponent try to finish the track themselves.
Other features include optional random course selection, the ability to turn out the lights and race at night, and the ability to toggle the road signs that warn you to slow down if there's a tricky bit to navigate ahead. Crashing results in the computer flashing up "dummy" or "dead" on a banner.

meta.name: Fast Break
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fast Break combines basketball with noticeable tactical depth, letting you shape your team before the action even begins on the court. Because every player comes with individual strengths and weaknesses, team selection already matters long before the actual game starts with its different plays and strategic adjustments. That blend of direct three-on-three action, careful planning, and even the ability to design your own plays gives the game a particularly appealing coach-and-player feel.

meta.name: Fast Eddie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.65 KB

In Fast Eddie, you must travel from floor to floor collecting prizes. On each floor, up to two prizes appear, except on the top floor where the largest prize, High-Top, awaits. There are a total of ten prizes, which must be collected in a specific order. Each floor is patrolled by Sneakers, which you must either avoid or escape by jumping to another floor. The goal is to collect at least nine prizes, then skip High-Top to reach the key above it. The prizes increase in value, ranging from ten to ninety points. After each screen, you earn an extra life, with a maximum of three lives in total.

meta.name: Fast Food!
meta.desc:

En Fast Food, el objetivo es recoger toda la comida de la pantalla. Pero ten cuidado, la comida no es estática: se mueve muy rápido. También tendrás que evitar todo tipo de monstruos para completar los 30 niveles.

The experience thrives on humorous situations and unpredictable outcomes as you struggle to keep the hotel running smoothly.

meta.name: Fax

In "Fax", players answer questions in four categories: general knowledge, sports, history, and entertainment. With over 4800 questions and three difficulty levels, variety is guaranteed, while two timers increase the pressure – the top one shows the total round time as a bar, and the bottom one displays the score shrinking by the second. If the lower timer runs out, no points are awarded, and the next question appears. The round ends when the top bar is empty. Optionally, a cartoon appears after each answer, showing a character receiving either a dunce cap or a graduation hat – a wicked little touch that perfectly captures the game's tone.

You have been asked by a dying alien race from across the Universe to search for various amount of treasures scattered around, and return them to save them. In this graphic text adventure you see text describing each location and you can see a picture showing you what each location looks like. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with the locations and control your hero.

meta.name: Feature Bout Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Feature Bout Boxing focuses on tactical bouts where success depends not only on power but also on control, timing, and smart decisions. You balance offense with defense, land precise strikes, and aim to dominate across multiple rounds. Victories can come through judges' decisions, placing greater emphasis on strategy and consistency rather than knockouts alone. Each fight requires adapting to your opponent – a boxing experience that rewards technique, patience, and tactical awareness.

meta.name: Federation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.56 KB

Take on the might of the corrupt Empire on behalf of the ailing Federation in this epic future fantasy! Erra Quann, the treacherous alien scientist who designed Flagship Quann Tulla, the pride of the Federation, has hijacked the ship and piloted it to an outpost of the evil Empire where he plans to sell the secret of its engines. As a member of the elite Federation secret service, your mission is to stop him! The battle will take place in the energy-shattered hull of the Quann Tulla, through deep space and on to the final desperate conclusion on a distant alien world. The fate of the universe is once more (gulp!) in your hands!

meta.name: Felix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Felix is a shoot-'em-up game where you control an aircraft navigating through enemy units, shooting everything that comes your way. The game features continuous movement through various levels, where you must avoid both enemies and obstacles while firing at anything in sight. The challenge increases as you progress, with faster and more numerous foes, requiring quick reflexes and strategic shooting to survive each level.

meta.name: Felix in the Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Felix in the Factory puts you in a race against time – if the generator runs dry, it's game over, no matter how many lives you have left. As Felix, you must navigate a dangerous factory, collect oil cans, and get them back to the generator before it's too late. Gremlins prowl the floors, packages speed along conveyor belts, and a giant rat occasionally charges through. Armed with pitchforks and rat poison, you can fight back – but one wrong move could cost you a life, or worse, everything. Precision, timing, and planning are key to keeping the factory alive.

Later the group expands into the Fellowship as new companions like Boromir and Legolas join the quest. Step by step the game guides you through the key events of the story and lets you experience the novel's journey firsthand.

Fernández es un déspota que ha invadido la República de El Diablo. Los líderes legítimos del país le han pedido que destruya los escondites de Fernández y devuelva su país al pueblo.
Se trata de un clon de Commando, con desplazamiento vertical y hordas de enemigos a los que enfrentarse, en el que encontrar buenos escudos y ataques sorpresa es una estrategia especialmente útil. Tienes balas ilimitadas y granadas limitadas. Hay minas terrestres que evitar y paquetes médicos que recoger.
En cada uno de los 8 niveles debes destruir los edificios de Fernández, a los que se accede a través de una red subterránea de túneles. No te limitarás a caminar, empezarás en un jeep y también podrás utilizar motos, tanques y mucho más. En el modo de 2 jugadores, puedes compartir las tareas de conducción y disparo.

meta.name: Ferrari Formula One
meta.desc:

"Ferrari Formula One" puts you in control of the legendary Maranello-based Formula 1 team, starting your journey long before race day. You fine-tune your car at the factory, test it in the wind tunnel and on the Fiorano track before taking on training, qualifying, and race sessions. Every detail matters – from wing angles and tire types to fuel consumption – and during the race, you drive from a cockpit view with rear-view mirrors to help you avoid collisions.

Ferris's Christmas Caper follows Ferris, who has destroyed all of his family's presents on Christmas Eve. As punishment, he is kicked out of his home and must collect 25 Christmas presents scattered across C-Zone. However, the search is far from easy, as the presents are well hidden and time is running out. If he fails to gather them all in time, he will face serious trouble.

meta.name: Ferry
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.46 KB

Ferry is a timing game where the player must guide a remote-controlled supply ferry through a continuously scrolling asteroid field. The goal is to safely navigate multiple ferries across the screen using only two buttons – one to move forward and one to move back. The challenge lies in precise timing to avoid obstacles and get all ferries safely to the other side. The score is based on how long it takes and how many ferries successfully make it across – every decision counts in this chaotic space crossing.

Fetz-Out II drops you into fast single-screen battles where enemy waves cycle past repeatedly until you destroy them all. You react quickly, dodge incoming fire, and strike at the right moments while the pace remains relentless. Completing a stage immediately leads to the next, often more intense wave, keeping focus and control essential. If your ship is destroyed, you start again from the beginning – a no-nonsense action challenge that rewards reflexes, endurance, and precise timing.

meta.name: Feud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.33 KB

Los magos Learic y Leanoric mantienen una antigua rivalidad y harían cualquier cosa por eliminar al otro. Como Learic, esa es tu misión. El núcleo del juego es recolectar hierbas para lanzar hechizos: hay 24 hierbas y flores, que sirven para crear uno de 12 conjuros (cada hierba se usa en un solo hechizo, así que no hay que elegir entre ellos). Puedes combinar hechizos —como teletransporte, invisibilidad y bola de fuego—, cuyo uso deberás descubrir. La brújula indica la dirección de Leanoric respecto a ti.

meta.name: Fever : Blackjack System Counting Program

Fever: Blackjack System Counting Program teaches you how to improve your odds at blackjack through card counting. The program explains the basics, presents strategies, and offers interactive exercises to practice counting. Step by step, you learn how to evaluate probabilities and optimize your decisions. It is designed both for beginners who want to learn the technique from scratch and for advanced players seeking to sharpen their skills.

meta.name: A Fistful of Bucks
meta.desc:

A Fistful of Bucks puts you in the boots of a bounty hunter wandering the desert in search of buildings like banks, saloons, and mines. Along the way, cowboys try to stop you, and limited ammo makes survival a challenge. Inside buildings, you collect cash and bullets, often perched out of reach. Climbing ladders and jumping platforms while avoiding hostile owners is key – but a wrong fall or ambush could be your downfall.

"Fiendish Freddy's Big Top O 'Fun" es un juego de acción con múltiples eventos. El circo está en apuros: esta noche debe pagar un préstamo de $10,000 al Banco Codicioso. La función de esa noche debe recaudar ese dinero o el circo será embargado. Sin embargo, el banco no juega limpio: envía al malvado payaso Fiendish Freddy para sabotear los actos. El espectáculo consta de seis eventos diferentes: clavados, malabares, trapecio, lanzamiento de cuchillo, cuerda floja y bala de cañón. Hay un modo de práctica para eventos individuales, y hasta cinco jugadores pueden competir en el juego completo, pero deben alcanzar los $10,000 individualmente, no juntos. El premio lo otorga un jurado después de cada acto.

meta.name: The Fifth Quadrant
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.15 KB

After 20 years in space, the Orion has finally accomplished its task of galaxy mapping. Only one small nebula remains, but while making the intergalactic jump, the Orion is taken over by an alien race known as the Zimen.
In an attempt to get rid of the Zimen, the players control four robots - Captain Slog, Plot the Navigator, Engineer Knut, and Able Spaceman Bodd - which they use one at a time. Each robot is situated in different areas of the ship. Some robots can easily navigate their way through the maze of 230 rooms, while others are temporarily trapped in their rooms.
When a robot comes into contact with the Zimen, its energy is quickly drained. When all of its energy is depleted, the robot will stop functioning, and the only way it can be restored is if a passing robot transfers its energy with the non-functional one.
The Zimen materializes suddenly in the Orion's passageways with deadly persistance, and can easily trap the outnumbered crew into a corner. To help them, the robots can throw bouncing bombs at the Zimen, gaining points when they have been destroyed. 
Control panels scattered throughout the ship give a robot access to code screens. When decoded, these will unlock matter-transmitters and lifts, meaning that the robot crew can move through the ship and closer to the ultimate goal: locking into the Bridge Computer. When all four have done this, the Orion will be safe.

meta.name: 50 Mission Crush
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

50 Mission Crush (a veces Fifty Mission Crush) es un juego de guerra de estrategia por turnos que simula la carrera de la tripulación de un bombardero B-17 Flying Fortress durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. El bombardero tiene su base en la RAF Thurleigh, al norte de Londres, y forma parte de la 8.ª Fuerza Aérea. Si bien la mayoría de los juegos de SSI priorizaban la planificación estratégica a largo plazo, 50 Mission Crush se comercializó explícitamente por su ritmo rápido y relativamente rápido: cada misión no dura más de unos 10 minutos. SSI lo describió como un "juego de rol".

meta.name: Fight for Thurn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thurn is an island plagued by barbarians and ruled by chaos sometime in the Middle Ages, where four players fight for control in order to finally restore order by taking money, buying troops with it and causing even more chaos and ruin... If that sounds familiar to the interested reader is no coincidence; In fact, Battle for Thurn can clearly be described as a Defender of the Crown "multiplayer redux" variant, which, however, has been slimmed down almost to the level of the board game Risk.

meta.name: Fight Night
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Fight Night, entrarás al ring y lucharás contra once oponentes únicos antes de enfrentarte al jefe final, Bronx Bomber. Cada boxeador tiene fortalezas y debilidades únicas, además de un supergolpe especial. Además del modo principal, hay entrenamiento, sparring y un torneo multijugador. Incluso puedes crear a tu propio boxeador, personalizando su apariencia y habilidades para convertirte en campeón.

meta.name: Fighter Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Fighter Command is a strategy game that recreates the Battle of Britain in 1940. You take command of either the British RAF or the German Luftwaffe. As the Germans, you plan attacks on British airfields, radar installations, and industrial centers to weaken the RAF. As the British, you defend these targets by intercepting incoming aircraft. Daily reports on weather, reconnaissance, readiness, as well as statistics on squadron strength, losses, morale, and experience assist your planning. A map of southern England facilitates strategic navigation. You can play Eagle Day, 10-day phases, or the full 34-turn campaign.

meta.name: Fighting Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Fighting Soccer” is a fast-paced football conversion with large player sprites and a small pitch – the focus is less on passing and more on battling for possession. Holding onto the ball is tough, as defenders are faster than the ball carrier, leading to frantic mid-field scrambles. You face off against ten nations in an international Olympic tournament across five intense rounds. Dribble, shoot, head, foul – whatever it takes to win the cup.

meta.name: Fightmare Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.72 KB

Fightmare Mission takes place on a remote planet where dangerous life forms have emerged that are extremely hostile and release toxic substances when they come into contact with the atmosphere. Your task is to find and eliminate these life forms before they can poison Earth.

meta.name: Final Assault
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este juego es una de las simulaciones deportivas más originales. El alpinismo no era a priori un deporte propicio para su adaptación en un juego, pero con el patrocinio y la ayuda de Eric Escoffier (famoso alpinista francés fallecido en 1998), el programa ofrece una precisión notable. Se tienen en cuenta todos los parámetros esenciales: peso y contenido de la mochila, gestión del hambre y la fatiga, necesidad de disponer de un buen seguro para buscar en la mochila...
La ascensión se divide en tres fases. En terreno llano, hay que avanzar y saltar las grietas, comprobando la solidez del terreno. En el fondo de una grieta o de un flanco, hay que avanzar dando tirones con el piolet hasta adelantar una rodilla, apoyar el pie, tirar hacia arriba, apoyar el otro pie, y así sucesivamente. Por último, en una pared vertical, hay que elegir la extremidad que se va a mover, subirla o bajarla, tirarse hacia arriba o hacia abajo y evitar las piedras.

meta.name: Final Blow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.27 KB

Final Blow es un juego de acción basado en el deporte del boxeo. Puedes jugar los luchadores en una secuencia de competiciones de eliminación directa (las versiones de computadora también incluyen una liga round-robin). Las rondas duran un minuto, con un breve descanso entre ellas. Como en el deporte real, tu objetivo es derribar a tu oponente durante 10 segundos, debilitándolo gradualmente con una serie de golpes. Puedes bloquear los golpes para evitar que te inflijan daño. El ring es de un tamaño limitado, por lo que los jugadores pueden ser acorralados, aunque el árbitro intervendrá para romper a los boxeadores si se enredan en una posición de estancamiento. La versión de génesis no debe confundirse con el juego Master System del mismo nombre, que es completamente diferente.

meta.name: The Final Conquest : Cargo Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.08 KB

The Final Conquest: Cargo Run puts you behind the wheel of a truck racing through desert terrain, catching parachuted supply crates in the dark of night. But it's not just supplies falling from the sky – enemy bombers and kamikaze pilots attack as well. Only quick reflexes, clever dodging, and precise driving will help you survive the tasks and secure the precious cargo.

meta.name: The Final Encounter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A shoot em up game that has a stunning soundtrack but crippled by nigh-impossible attack waves. It seems your awesome chopper is piloted by a spitting monkey! However, your weapon improves - slightly - on Level Three, but you still have about 10% probability of dodging or shooting anything. Infinite lives used, for sure! I warped through some of it as it just got pointless and was about to stop recording at the high-score part, only to find that there's an end screen after it, and a real nice one at that.

meta.name: Final Fight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En los años 90, Metro City está plagada de delincuencia y violencia. Recién elegido alcalde, el ex luchador profesional Mike Haggar está decidido a eliminar las bandas que están sembrando el terror en su ciudad. Para detenerlo, Mad Gear, una poderosa organización criminal, secuestra a su hija Jessica e intenta corromperlo.
Haggar no se deja impresionar tan fácilmente, así que se pone en contacto con Cody, el novio de Jessica, y con Guy, ambos con experiencia en artes marciales y lucha callejera. Los tres hombres deciden tomarse la justicia por su mano y se adentran en los bajos fondos de Metro City en busca de Jessica. Cada uno de los protagonistas tiene un estilo de lucha diferente.

meta.name: Final Flight!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.12 KB

“Final Flight!” puts the player straight into the cockpit of a small single-engine aircraft, just moments from landing on what appears to be a safe runway – but appearances can be deceiving. With low fuel, tricky crosswinds, and a demanding approach, every landing becomes a tense challenge. Whether in clear skies or dense fog, with or without instruments, each scenario demands total focus and precise control. Flaps, throttle, pitch – everything must be perfectly aligned to touch down safely. The adrenaline hits as the tires squeal on the runway – now it's all about braking and keeping control. Only those who stay calm will master the final flight.

meta.name: Final Four College Basketball Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A statistics based college basketball game created by Lance Haffner and sold via mail order. FINAL FOUR COLLEGE BASKETBALL & BASKETBALL: THE PRO GAME Each player contributes as they did in real life. Built in Stats Compiler. You determine starting lineup, substitutions, shot selection, passing, offensive and defensive styles of play and more the College game includes 292 teams from the '86-'87 season plus 70 all-time greats.

meta.name: Final Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.96 KB

"Final Mission" puts the player in control of a Lunar Rover on the Moon's surface, dodging enemy attacks and firing back to destroy aliens. The goal is to survive as long as possible and defend against increasingly aggressive enemies. The Rover's shields are limited and deplete quickly, requiring careful gameplay. Various obstacles make navigation more challenging while enemies appear in different forms with unique attack patterns. As the game progresses, difficulty increases with more enemies and more complex obstacles.

meta.name: Final Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.17 KB

The Davis Cup has just started, and many of you will have been eagerly following the experiences of our tennis players and even the global super-champions (unfortunately, we're a bit behind in the rankings). To catch up and show the world what we're made of, there's Final TennisMatch Ball, a game where you can prove your tennis skills. The rules are, of course, widely known, so it won't be difficult to follow them. At the start, you'll choose the number of players, which team wears which color, and then it's game on. Have fun, champions!

meta.name: Final Whistle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.43 KB

Final Whistle is a football management game where you select an English team and try to get them to win the league and the FA Cup and League Cup. As well as selecting your team you can decide your starting division from Division 4 to Division 1 before being shown your next match to be played. You are presented with various options to help you as well as looking at the stats of your team and your opponents and you can scout them or any other team in any of the divisions. You can select your starting 11 from a squad of players and change various tactics like the formation. There is also a transfer market where you can buy or sell players. Once you are happy with your selections you then watch your match in progress which is shown by text with the major incidents of the game also mentioned. After the game you are shown your finances before the next match is shown and you select options once again. If your bank account is overdrawn for more than three weeks or you finish bottom of Division 4 then you will be sacked. There are three skill levels to choose and they are easy, normal and hard.

meta.name: Find Another Way!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.81 KB

"Find Another Way!" is a labyrinth game for the Commodore 64 that challenges the player to navigate through a randomly generated labyrinth. The aim of the game is to reach the exit at the bottom from the starting position at the top of the labyrinth. The random design of the levels ensures that each game is a new challenge, as the labyrinth is always structured differently. The gameplay is simple but exciting: the player has to move through winding corridors and find the right way to the exit. The random generation of the labyrinths keeps the game varied and ensures that no two games are the same. Skill and a good sense of direction are required to find the way out of the often complex and winding labyrinths.

meta.name: Finders Keepers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 63.24 KB

The King of Isbisima has entrusted you, Magic Knight, with the task of getting a present for his daughter. He sends you into the castle of Spiteland, which is overloading with treasures to uncover. Whether you return with them to please the King, or simply flee with everything you can get, is up to you.
Either way, the gameplay is platform-based, with enemies floating around to rob you of energy on contact. There are also scrolling mazes to move through. As you collect objects (often by using some of the other items you collect, to create chemical reactions of sorts and adding an element of lateral thinking), you must try to trade them for the most valuable items you can get.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.50 KB

Fiona is a witch, the most wicked witch to ever darken the sky of the computer screen. Her fellow witches have stolen the tools of her craft, and she wants them back. To do so, she must traverse the night air and search various locations to reclaim her valuable possessions.

meta.name: Fips
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.98 KB

Join Fips, the Ondulan hopping beetle, on his arduous journey across space platforms.
