meta.name: Fire & Forget II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En un incierto futuro postapocalíptico, el mundo está plagado de grupos terroristas que amenazan la poca civilización que aún existe intentando destruir las ciudades supervivientes con explosiones nucleares.
En cinco niveles, deberás alcanzar a un mortífero convoy para destruirlo. Hordas de enemigos, cada uno tan sorprendente como el siguiente, intentarán oponerse a ellos. Bípedos mecánicos, sidecares agresivos, torretas trípode y otros objetos voladores no identificados recorren a toda velocidad la carretera entre el jugador y el camión objetivo. Su vehículo ya puede desplazarse por el aire. Es cierto que la opción está sujeta a un medidor de energía, pero puede activarse en cualquier momento, siempre que tengas energía suficiente.

meta.name: Fire Ant
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.51 KB

You control an ant that must rescue the queen ant taken hostage by a group of scorpions. She is being held in the eighth chamber, but to reach her, you must navigate a series of tunnels that are being patrolled by the scorpions, and use objects scattered throughout the chambers to proceed to the next one. These objects include getting keys that will open yellow doors, and explosives that will detonate walls. Objects placed at the proper locations usually cause a chain reaction that clears the obstacles. Occasionally, scorpions are seen laying eggs, and getting these eggs will award you with bonus points. When the queen ant is rescued, the game resets to the first chamber.

meta.name: Fire Fighter 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.81 KB

Fire Fighter 64 is a strategy game where the player's task is to stop a rapidly spreading forest fire. The environment is displayed on a grid that includes forests, lakes, and houses. On each turn, the player can drop water, set a backfire, or dig a firebreak. The goal is to fight the fire while minimizing damage to surrounding properties. Constantly changing wind conditions affect the speed and direction of the fire. The player has a limited amount of time for each turn as the fire spreads. There are nine difficulty levels.

meta.name: Fire King
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The city of Stormhaven Bay once enjoyed prosperity, protected by the balance of the four elements: fire, water, earth and air. Each element had a magician who monitored and controlled it, maintaining harmony in the land. But the fire mage, the leader of the group, was killed by a terrible monster. This caused the balance to collapse and monsters began to roam the land and attack the townspeople. A brave hero is needed to defeat the fiends and restore peace!
Fire King is a sequel to Demon Stalkers. The player explores the top-down world, descends into dungeons and fights against hordes of enemies in fast-paced, action-oriented combat. Compared to its spiritual predecessors, Fire King contains more RPG elements. The player can control one of the six available characters and specialize in one of three disciplines: magic, armor and strength. Spells and other helpful items can be found in the dungeons and used against the enemies.

Fire One puts you in command of a submarine, peering through the periscope to hunt down enemy ships and submarines. Your mission: destroy the opposing fleet before they sink you. The radar above the screen tracks all vessels as you rotate your periscope and launch torpedoes – up to eight at a time before reloading. But beware: your opponent fires back simultaneously. You can dive to evade attacks, but you can't shoot until you resurface. Every move matters – timing, accuracy, and nerve decide who will dominate the deadly battle beneath the waves.

meta.name: Fire Track
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.23 KB

Fire Track sends you into a vertically scrolling battle against space pirates who have built eight colonies. Your mission is to fight through each base, destroy the reactor at the end, and plunge the colony into darkness. A second run follows where you try to destroy as many buildings as possible, with marked structures giving bonus points or even extra lives. The pirates won't surrender without a fight – contact with an enemy ship or missile means instant death. Only quick reflexes and accurate shooting will lead you to victory.

meta.name: Fire Trap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.12 KB

Fire Trap te pone al mando de una nave espacial en la parte inferior de la pantalla, disparando hacia arriba a tres naves alienígenas que se mueven y disparan directamente hacia abajo. Cada vez que una es destruida, aparece un nuevo enemigo al instante. Empiezas con tres naves, y cada impacto te cuesta uno. Una vez que todas sean destruidas, se acabó la partida. Reflejos rápidos y una puntería precisa son clave para sobrevivir a este implacable asalto alienígena.

meta.desc:

"Fire-Galaxy" places you at the bottom of the screen in control of a spaceship, facing fast-paced, chaotic waves of attacking aliens. Unlike its predecessor, the focus isn't on destroying every enemy – it's on surviving each wave. Alien ships of various colors and shapes descend with randomized movement patterns, firing continuously. Each enemy only takes one shot to eliminate, but dodging is often more important than shooting. After a few waves, a bonus round offers a breather – no bullets, just the chance to collect points before the next assault begins.

meta.name: Firefly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 61.83 KB

As commander of the Firefly, you fight your way through a hostile sector grid toward the enemy system's power source. Each area presents new decisions: some spaces are blocked, others can be bypassed through careful maneuvering, while occupied zones trigger direct firefights. Teleporters help you move quickly between sections, but too much damage will destroy your ship. Firefly combines tactical route planning with intense action and the clear goal of taking out the enemy's mechanical heart.

meta.name: Firefox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Firefox is a fast-paced Bomberman-style action game where you eliminate enemies with cleverly placed bombs and blast your way through the maze. Timing and positioning are essential, as a careless explosion can take you out just as easily as your foes. Each stage offers new layouts and opponents, all while the clock is ticking and your lives are limited.

meta.name: Fisher-price : Firehouse Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Firehouse Rescue, the player controls a firefighter driving a fire truck in the style of the popular Fisher-Price toy series. The goal is to rescue pets from trees and people from houses. The game consists of two parts: first, you navigate through a street network from a top-down perspective to find the affected house. In the second part, you position the fire ladder underneath the person or animal to be rescued and safely bring them down. Later levels increase the challenge with multiple screens, time limits, and the need to collect keys before the rescue can begin.

meta.name: Firelord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.67 KB

Firelord is an action-adventure game that spans 512 screens. There is no scrolling, the screens are displayed using the flick-screen method. In the form of the knight Sir Galaheart, the player roams the enchanted kingdom of Torot, collects four magical amulets and finally exchanges them for the holy flint. As soon as he returns it to the rightful owner, the kingdom is redeemed.

El bombero Sam y su equipo deben recorrer las calles de la ciudad y llegar rápidamente al lugar de las emergencias. Entre las muchas tareas que se le piden a Sam se encuentran incendios, retirar objetos de los tejados y liberar a niños que se han quedado con la cabeza atascada en las barandillas. Sin embargo, parece que Sam pasa la mayor parte del tiempo buscando objetos perdidos.

meta.name: Firepit

A fighting game in which opponents float freely through the air and throw various weapons such as swords, hammers or morning stars at each other. It can just about pass for a sports game for one or two players.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Fire Power" is an action-packed game where the player controls a tank across a vast outdoor landscape. Each map features two bases – one for the green team and one for the yellow team – whose locations are initially hidden. Players can either explore the map to locate the bases or engage in combat, destroying enemies and destructible buildings. Enemy turrets and fortifications are scattered across the map. Staying stationary for too long triggers enemy helicopters to appear, which can be shot down using the tank's main weapon.

Firequest continues Ugh's Stone Age adventures and sends him to a nearby volcano to bring fire back to his cave. Across varied platform stages, you collect wood, carry ladders and flames, and complete other small tasks while creatures and obstacles are waiting everywhere. Touching them or falling from a height quickly costs one of the few lives, so every section has to be approached with care. The result is a charming adventure that nicely blends skill, awareness, and small rescue-style objectives.

meta.name: FireTrap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Firetrap, el jugador asume el papel de un bombero enviado a apagar incendios en rascacielos ardiendo en la calle principal de Arcadeville. El fuego se propaga rápidamente de un edificio a otro, y tu misión comienza en la base de una torre, armado con un traje ignífugo, un propulsor y un cañón de agua. Mientras escalas verticalmente el edificio, debes rescatar a mujeres y perros atrapados por las llamas. Al tocarlos, los haces flotar a salvo gracias a un paracaídas que les entregas. También puedes apagar fuegos con tu cañón de agua, revelando bonificaciones como dinero o mejoras que te permiten flotar horizontalmente o usar el jetpack para acelerar el ascenso. Durante el ascenso, deberás evitar escombros y obstáculos peligrosos como estandartes, salientes y zonas sin agarre. Si eres golpeado o fallas un salto, el personaje cae varios pisos, perdiendo una vida. El juego termina cuando pierdes las cinco vidas disponibles.

meta.name: Firezone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Beam technology, energy shields and ground-sliding propulsion systems have revolutionized long-range ground combat. World powers like the Pacific Combine and the European League fight for territory with Grav Tanks, Striders and Leviathans. Take on the role of a commander overseeing one of these battles and balance your tactical skills with the computer or another player.
Firezone translates pen and paper tactical wargaming to the computer screen. Your main view is a hex battle map with up to seven different terrain types, showing stacks of infantry, artillery, tank and command bases. There is a structured turn flow in which players alternate movement, fire and retaliation. The game goes beyond a tabletop wargame by allowing hidden units and providing a map editor to create your own scenarios.

The new challenges demand not only precise timing and foresight but also a keen sense of the optimal path to successfully complete the levels and achieve the highest possible score.

First Moves is an introduction to chess for children aged eight and older. Success in chess depends on understanding and appreciating the movements of the individual pieces and how they work together. First Moves introduces beginners to these basic movements and strategies in a simple and direct manner. The program is divided into six main sections – each containing three games focused on a specific piece or group of pieces, starting with the king and rook and progressing to the pawns. The final section covers the handling of pieces in combination – with the goal of the game, capturing the opponent's king, always at the forefront. The package includes a full-color wall poster that reinforces the lessons and provides additional information.

meta.name: First Over Germany
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

First Over Germany is a simulation of a B-17 bomber group during World War II, recreating the events surrounding the formation of the 306th Bomb Group. You start as a lieutenant with little flying experience, selecting your crew and participating in training missions. You learn to start the aircraft, form a formation, and conduct practice bomb drops. The first missions take place in the U.S. before you fly to England to participate in bombing raids over Germany. Your crew positions, such as co-pilot, bombardier, and navigator, influence the success of the missions. Each mission has a briefing that outlines the objectives. You earn efficiency points for successful kills and completed missions but lose points for mistakes, such as crashing or breaking formation.

meta.name: First Past the Post
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.77 KB

First Past The Post is a game where the player trains horses and participates in races. The player can have up to sixteen horses in their stable and earn money by winning races, betting on their horses' performance, or buying and selling horses. Each race event consists of 1-mile, 2-mile, and 3-mile races, and the player can enter one or two horses. Before each race, the player can bet on any horse, not just their own. At the end of the event, trainer statistics are displayed, and the player has the opportunity to buy and sell horses to improve their stable. The game features various race tracks, races of different lengths, varying track conditions, and customizable horse weights. The player competes against other trainers, and a save function allows the game to be continued later.

Somos un samurai, en el Japón Feudal, que debe vengar a su maestro asesinado en manos del Rey Demonio. Nos abriremos camino por escenarios infestados de enemigos a los que hay que abatir con las armas que tenemos a disposición, tanto con nuestra espada o con las diferentes habilidades mágicas que vamos adquiriendo. El objetivo de cada nivel es conseguir un conjunto de cuatro elementos que nos permiten el acceso a la zona donde se encuentra el jefe de fin de fase, al que por supuesto debemos derrotar. A lo largo del juego adquirimos items y power-ups que mejoran nuestro ataque y también nuestra defensa.

The First Starfighter tells the story of conflict between the Kohdan and Rilos systems after the Emperor's death and his son Zolan's rise to power. As Zolan seizes Rilos space stations hidden in an asteroid field, you take control of the first starfighter to retrieve the vital Talathium Gems and destroy as many Kohdans as possible. The game combines multi-directional space battles with side-view maze sections.

These educational games featuring the Mr. Men characters from Roger Hargreaves' children's books are aimed at children aged four to eight. They playfully enhance reading skills: In Mr. Greedy's Ice-Cream Hunt, you guide Mr. Greedy through five levels to find a giant ice cream. In Mr. Silly's Hat Game, you help Mr. Silly choose hats based on shape and color. Mr. Forgetful's Wardrobe Game is a memory game where Mr. Forgetful has to match pairs of items. In Mr. Forgetful's Letter Game, the goal is to pair letters. These games were developed by elementary school teachers and include a guidebook for parents and children.

meta.desc:

In First Strike you pilot a heavily armed fighter jet and complete a series of missions set in different regions around the world. Your operations take place over locations such as the Mediterranean, the Arctic, the Far East and Central Europe. Before each mission you choose your weapons and can adjust them again during a stopover. During the flight you engage enemy targets while trying to accomplish the assigned mission objective. Successfully completing a mission allows you to earn promotions, progressing from a rookie pilot through higher military ranks. Each victory brings you closer to completing all operations and proving yourself as an elite fighter pilot.

Inter-Dimensional Espionage. Inter-Dimensional... because you can "warp" into the body of a living thing in this or any other dimension. Espionage... because there are good guys and bad. And you're a good one... with years under your belt and a multitude of successful missions behind your dark glasses. The payoff? You get a vacation, and the ultimate vacation in this business is to become a goldfish.nnnnYes, a goldfish. Hey, it's cushy. You swim a little, eat a little, live in a castle. And wouldn't you know it, you are drafted to stop them!

The goal is to navigate skillfully and solve equations accurately to achieve the highest score and reach home safely.

Fist Fighter brings five fighters together in duels set in Egypt, Japan, and America, but only one can claim the title. Using the joystick, you perform various attacks to deplete your opponent's energy bar before time runs out. The choice of location, difficulty, and fighter is yours.

Fist+ delivers intense street fights in the toughest parts of New York, where you must face two opponents at once. With sixteen different moves, you rise to 10th Dan and defend your title against increasingly skilled challengers. Animated backgrounds and a bonus game to sharpen reflexes add extra excitement.

They know Connect-Four (4 in a row), but in this board game they have to get Five in a Row before the computer does.

Five a Side turns indoor football into a fast and tightly contested duel where success depends not only on clean passing and finishing, but also on making clever use of the surrounding walls. This gives the game a distinctive rhythm, as rebounds can be used deliberately and the action feels more direct and inventive than on an open pitch. Penalties and different skill levels add further variety, making it feel like a compact and intense football variant with a character of its own.

The player pilots an AGX Hypersonic Fighter and is tasked with bombing flak batteries and other defenses to reach the fortress containing the CPU and destroy it. The game features a vertically scrolling perspective, with the ship controlled via joystick. A targeting reticle in front of the fighter allows for precision bombing of enemy structures, which fire back in an attempt to destroy the player. If hit, the player loses one of four lives.

meta.name: Flappy Bird
meta.desc:

Flappy Bird brings the familiar flapping formula into a stripped-down retro form. With each joystick input, you keep the bird in the air and try to guide it safely through the gaps between the pipes. A single touch or a fall too low ends the attempt instantly, making every small change in height matter. The result is a direct skill test that creates tension, timing, and the urge for another try with the simplest of means.

Flaschbier is a humorous puzzle game that guides the player through increasingly challenging puzzles. The game stands out with a mix of clever design and intentionally chaotic elements. Unlike similar games like Boulder Dash, the player cannot push rocks, which makes the gameplay challenging in a different way. The levels become progressively more complex, requiring the player to think strategically to overcome each challenge. The humorous undertone that runs through the entire game description highlights the increasing difficulty that grows with each "bottle of beer" – a funny concept that makes players smile as they tackle the puzzles.

The humorous undertone that runs through the entire game description highlights the increasing difficulty that grows with each "bottle of beer" – a funny concept that makes players smile as they tackle the puzzles.

meta.name: Fleet Feet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.55 KB

Beyond the stars, in a galaxy much like outs, the Spirits of Sportsdom have decreed a need for an intergalactic marathon. They named it Fleet Feet, for it was to be more of a race of swift thinking and fancy footwork. For eons, the best and brightest from every galaxy have met its unique challenge. Now it's your turn.

meta.name: Flight 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.85 KB

“Flight 64” puts the player in the role of a pilot tasked with an emergency flight in the middle of the night. The mission: pick up a patient from a nearby airport and return safely to base. With no outside visibility, you must rely entirely on cockpit instruments – altimeter, airspeed, fuel gauge, heading, and artificial horizon provide the crucial data for navigation and flight control. The destination and course are set, but turbulence and terrain variation add to the challenge. Precise control and strong situational awareness are essential to complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Flight Deck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.22 KB

“Flight Deck” takes place on an aircraft carrier from which three types of aircraft are deployed: F-14 Tomcats for air-to-air combat, A-6 Intruders for bombing runs, and RF-4 Phantoms for reconnaissance missions. The game begins with carefully launching planes from the deck, then switching to a top-down map to take control of your aircraft in flight. Recon missions over enemy islands are carried out using the Phantoms. Once the area is fully scouted, a blinking hotspot appears, signaling a target. An Intruder is then sent to strike, ideally escorted by Tomcats, as bombers have limited air combat ability. Planning, timing, and tactical coordination are key to mission success.

meta.name: Flight of the Albatross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 62.73 KB

“Flight of the Albatross” is a simple yet engaging shooter game in which the player must fight enemies using precise shots. Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: Flight of the Albatross II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.11 KB

Flight of the Albatross II is a simple yet engaging shooter game in which the player must fight enemies using precise shots. Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: The Flight of the Unicorn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.31 KB

“The Flight of the Unicorn” takes the player into a fairytale kingdom where Prince Damien – the rightful heir – must face his power-hungry sister Yssylda. Driven by jealousy over Damien's love for the witch Corrane, Yssylda abducts her, steals her magic, and curses Damien to transform into a frog at the most inconvenient moments. Though he only wished to leave the kingdom behind and begin a new life with Corrane, her capture now forces him to rescue her and escape. He is aided by Corrane's mystical familiar – a rare creature born of mist and magic, part Pegasus and part Unicorn, whose loyalty must be earned. Only with courage, magic, and determination can Damien defy his fate.

meta.name: Flight Path 737
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Flight Path 737 turns flying a passenger jet into a focused test of takeoff, climbing, and safe landing. You depart from an airport, have to clear the surrounding mountains, and then land in the valley with only one real chance. The instruments provide all the key information, but as the difficulty rises, the mountains become higher, runways shorter, and extra challenges such as fire, crosswinds, or more demanding landings are added. That mix of precision, pressure, and steadily increasing challenge gives the game its appealing training feel.

meta.name: Flight Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Flight Simulator” challenges the player to safely pilot an aircraft from London Heathrow to one of eight other airports in the United Kingdom. A map shows the current location at any time, with destinations such as Gatwick, Luton, Manchester, or Prestwick. The difficulty lies in managing altitude, speed, position, landing gear, distance measuring equipment, and flaps simultaneously. Only those who master all these elements can achieve a successful landing – precision and focus are the keys to success.

meta.name: Flight Simulator II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Flight Simulator II" puts you in control of a Piper PA-28-181 Archer II, offering a realistic flight experience where even the smallest details matter. Whether you're a student pilot learning the ropes with the help of manuals and charts or a newcomer using the easy mode, the simulation offers various difficulty levels tailored to both aspiring aviators and curious beginners. With precise instruments and authentic flight conditions, it invites you to fully immerse yourself in the world of aviation.

meta.name: Flimbo's Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Flimbo's Quest sends you on a classic rescue mission – your girlfriend Pearly has been kidnapped by the villainous Fransz Dandruff, and it's time to clean up the mess. You run and jump through bright platform levels, moving both upward and downward, blasting cute enemies that drop useful rewards. The game spans seven short, linear, and relatively easy levels – a charming, accessible quest with a playful twist.

meta.name: Flintstones : Yabba-Dabba-Dooo!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.56 KB

¡Flintstones: Yabba-Dabba-Dooo! sigue a Pedro Picapiedra en su prehistórica aventura para conquistar a Vilma. Debe construir una casa reuniendo piedras y colocándolas correctamente, mientras esquiva peligros como tortugas que muerden tobillos, rocas de pterodáctilos que caen y vecinos entrometidos que roban materiales de construcción. Una vez terminada la casa, Pedro necesita un coche para llegar a la cantera, donde gana suficiente dinero para alquilar una grúa dino para colocar el techo. Su progreso se contabiliza mediante los puntos obtenidos al construir, trabajar y, finalmente, llegar a Vilma.

meta.name: The Flintstones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.33 KB

The Flintstones te pone en los zapatos prehistóricos de Fred… y su fin de semana está lejos de ser tranquilo. En lugar de jugar a los bolos con Barney, debe pintar la sala por orden de Wilma —y encima, su suegra está de camino. El juego se divide en cuatro caóticas fases: pintar entre obstáculos, una loca carrera en coche hacia la bolera, un duelo de bolos contra Barney y rescatar a Pebbles en una frenética obra de construcción. Divertido, agitado y lleno de pequeños desastres: otro día cualquiera en la Edad de Piedra.

meta.name: Flip and Flop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.67 KB

Flip and Flop turns the familiar tile-clearing idea into a varied platform game with two distinct characters. You alternately control Flip, the jumping kangaroo, and Mitch, the climbing ape, while gradually crossing every marked field. A zookeeper, a pursuing net, and open edges make the task increasingly dangerous, though sticky tiles can briefly hold back your pursuers. Later stages grow larger and more demanding, turning the simple core idea into a surprisingly challenging test of skill.

meta.name: Flip It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.34 KB

Flip It is a strategy-based board game for the Commodore 64, inspired by the classic game Othello. The goal of the game is to capture more of the opponent's pieces than they capture of yours. The game offers dynamic gameplay mechanics where each move can drastically alter the course of the game. The challenge lies in executing a well-thought-out strategy, as a wrong move can flip the entire board in favor of the computer.

meta.name: Flippit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Flippit is a puzzle game where the player must swap the colors of the tiles so that the game board matches the image in the bottom-right corner. When the player clicks on a tile with the joystick, its color changes, and adjacent tiles are also affected. There are over 100 levels to complete. The screen also displays the number of moves and the timer. There is no time limit, but the faster and with fewer moves the player completes the board, the better their high score will be.

meta.name: Fliptris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fliptris is a variant of the classic Tetris game. In each level, a set number of rows (vertically, horizontally, or diagonally) must be completed with the same pattern. The game displays an incoming block pattern that can be shifted left or right, while the pattern on the blocks can be moved up or down. Each fully completed row disappears and reveals a piece of a hidden image. Once the entire image is uncovered, the player advances to the next level.

meta.name: Flix
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.22 KB

meta.name: Floating Point Action
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.05 KB

Floating Point Action tells the story of a prisoner locked by the evil Magniform in the cellar of his palace, trapped behind a wall of bricks. Only with skill and a paddle can you destroy the bricks one by one, bouncing the sphere back with precision. Your past experience on the National Ping Pong team finally comes in handy – but beware: once you lose all the spheres, Magniform's wrath will consume you. In cooperative play, two players can join forces to break through and open the path to freedom.

meta.name: Flower Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.98 KB

“Flower Man” is a Pac-Man-style game. Guide Flower Man through the maze, collect points, and evade enemies as you clear the game board.

meta.name: Floyd of the Jungle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Floyd of the Jungle you set out on a jungle expedition alongside George and Floyd to rescue a girl who has been lost in the wilderness. As you move through the jungle you must avoid various dangers such as alligators, elephants, birds and other wildlife. Some characters, including birds and pygmies, can be collected for points. Your main objective, however, is to reach the girl before the others do – if George or Floyd rescue her first, the level must be restarted. A handicap option is also available to adjust the challenge.

meta.name: De Kapriolen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.93 KB

Floyd the Droid takes you into London's sewers, where you play as a droid named Floyd tasked with restoring order. Your mission is to clean the tunnels and eliminate the creatures living there before moving on to other cities. Before each job you decide how Floyd should move and react by programming sequences of actions. You can also switch him to automatic mode and watch as he tries to handle the chaos on his own, or take full control in manual mode. The game blends tactics, programming, and action into a unique experience.

meta.name: Flubble And Squij
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Fluff
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.96 KB

meta.name: Flummi's World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Flummi's World takes you through a series of cleverly designed rooms where thinking is just as important as precise movement. You place and remove elements, create new paths, and overcome obstacles to reach the exit of each area. Many challenges can be solved in different ways, encouraging experimentation while still demanding planning. The appeal comes from the constant shift between problem-solving and action, and the satisfying moment when a seemingly impossible situation finally clicks.

meta.name: Flunky
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Flunky turns you into a royal servant charged with completing five quirky duties for Britain's ruling family – lighting every fire, retrieving Prince Andrew's toy boat, finding freckles for Fergie, securing a wig for Diana and satisfying the Queen's mysterious request. To access each room you collect signatures from various royals, explore the palace's multi-layered screens and dodge guards who shoot at intruders.

meta.name: Fly Harder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your home planet is being exploited by the evil Thargoid Empire, which is using the planet's energy. You and your spaceship must take action to stop this. There are 8 bases you must infiltrate in order to overload the reactors with energy capsules and sabotage their function. The game is displayed side-scrolling and resembles the ST classic Oids, where gravity and movement physics affect the ship's motion. In the 8 levels, there are many enemies, ranging from wall-mounted turrets to actual ships, as well as upgrades for weapons, fuel, and shields. Your ship can take damage, but it repairs itself over time. Losing a life resets all enemy turrets, making the game labyrinthine and methodical.

meta.name: Fly Pig
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.97 KB

Fly Pig challenges the player to fly upwards while blasting through enemies to rescue a pig held hostage by the bad guys. Skillful dodging and precise shooting are essential to accomplish the mission.

meta.name: Flyer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.73 KB

Flyer is a Commodore 64 game where you control a paper airplane. The goal is to avoid obstacles while a remix version of the classical piece "The Blue Danube" plays in the background. The gameplay challenges you to navigate the plane through increasingly difficult environments, all while the iconic waltz adds a whimsical soundtrack to your flight.

meta.name: Flyer Fox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.33 KB

„Flyer Fox“ is an action-packed aerial combat game where the player, as the pilot of the advanced Flyer Fox fighter jet, is tasked with protecting civilian aircraft from dangerous air terrorists. Each level begins with an automatic takeoff, positioning the jet behind the jumbo for defense. Enemy fighters soon appear and must be shot down with the jet's cannons before they can damage the passenger plane. The cockpit features a radar, compass, and artificial horizon to locate enemies and navigate back to the protected aircraft. A status line displays the jumbo's damage level. If the jumbo is destroyed or the Fox runs out of fuel before all enemies are eliminated, the game is over.

meta.name: Flying Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.44 KB

In this side-scrolling shooter, players control a sturdy biplane and must attack enemy trucks driving on the road below. Patrol planes and anti-aircraft guns complicate the gameplay, but success is determined by the number of trucks destroyed. If not enough trucks are destroyed, the supply of replacement planes decreases, while it increases as more points are earned. Bullets fly everywhere, hitting the plane, and a display shows how many times the plane has been hit – after nine hits, it crashes. Fuel and ammunition are not a problem, as a friendly airfield appears. However, the biggest danger comes from the ground, as players must dive sharply to shoot the trucks, leaving little room for evasive maneuvers. At higher difficulty levels, the game becomes even more challenging.

meta.name: The Flying Digger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Flying Digger is often referred to as a clone of Fort Apocalypse, but without the shooting mechanics. It's a relatively slow-paced game where the player controls a drill machine that moves in a similar multidimensional scrolling style, much like Fort Apocalypse. In this game, the focus is on rescue missions in underground caves, with an emphasis on navigation and collecting objects rather than combat.

meta.name: Flying Falcon Fight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.91 KB

Flying Falcon Fight takes place in the icy mountains of Arctovia, where half-human, half-bird creatures known as Falcons live. As the Master Falcon, you must defend your bird nests from attacks by hostile Falcons. The game features intense aerial battles where you control your birds in combat to fend off the attackers.

meta.name: Flying Feathers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.66 KB

In Flying Feathers you take the role of a warden in a boat and must protect the fish in the water from attacking eagles. Using a crosshair, you aim at the birds as they fly across the screen and try to snatch the fish. Even if an eagle has already grabbed a fish, you can still shoot it and make it drop its catch. After a while, a duck and its family may also swim across the screen and reward you with an extra fish. The game only ends once all fish have been taken. Multiple difficulty levels let you adjust how challenging the action becomes.

p: Flying in on the Big Bird (USA).T64
n: Flying in on the Big Bird (USA)

meta.name: Flying in on the Big Bird
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.34 KB

"A bizarre mix of James Bond, flying machines, old castles, rockets and egg cannons. Special Urban Service: Selective Elimination and Destruction - SUSSED for short. In the near future, SUSSED will intervene as soon as you cross the line. Their passion is death, and when they're around, you shouldn't even step on the cracks in the sidewalk. As one of their deadliest agents, you're less than thrilled to deliver 40 crates to a castle in London. The castle is armed with powerful weapons and motorized towers with RADAR and missiles. But suddenly playboy Geoff Burton appears, holding a giant yellow bird. He chases you on a flying carpet! You jump on the bird to drop 20 crates between the towers."

meta.name: Fool's Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.83 KB

Fool's Gold begins with the player being lost and alone in the desert. By chance, they stumble upon an old mine shaft, waiting to be explored. The game features over 150 rooms to discover, treasures to find, and wild animals to either avoid or fight. There are a total of 150 points to earn, which are awarded by bringing items back to the entrance of the mine.

meta.name: Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Football puts you in the role of a head coach guiding your team through a full match using strategic decisions. You select offensive and defensive plays, tailor your team's strengths across different areas, and respond to situations such as yard gains, penalties, and clock management. The action is presented step by step in text form, with decisions often made under time pressure, where mistakes can be costly and smart planning and play calling lead to success.

meta.name: Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.35 KB

Football allows two players to face each other in a head-to-head American football match, with customizable game length and team names. Each player selects an action in turn, and once both choices are made, the play is shown through an animation, making anticipation and planning essential. A variety of offensive and defensive options shape every situation, turning each match into a tactical duel where timing and smart decisions make the difference.

meta.name: Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Football puts you in the role of a head coach guiding your team through a full match using strategic decisions. You select offensive and defensive plays, tailor your team's strengths across different areas, and respond to situations such as yard gains, penalties, and clock management. The action is presented step by step in text form, with decisions often made under time pressure, where mistakes can be costly and smart planning and play calling lead to success.

meta.name: Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, you take control of a football team and can choose the team's colors. You select the numbers for the colors, not their names. You name the stadium, control the ball, and choose the plays that you then have to execute. It is a simple yet engaging football game for the Commodore 64, giving you the freedom to make all the decisions crucial for your team's success.

meta.name: Football Champions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.33 KB

Football Champions s a soccer management game. The game allows you to choose one of three UK leagues. The ultimate aim of the game is to win both the League Trophy and the FA Cup. The game offers the opportunity to carry out training and buying/selling players. During the match there is no animation. The match takes place in the text form, showing yellow/red card receivers and goal scorers. Each player in your squad has five statistics: skill, disciplinary points, injuries, goals, career goals. Each player may be trained on a number of individual skills, such as dribbling, shooting, passing, handling and tackling.

meta.name: Football Crazy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.52 KB

A UK soccer/football management game, presented in all text. You're the manager and can make all the calls, create all the trades and choose who to play and when. Keep your eyes on the championship!

meta.name: Football Director
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Football Director, you can choose any team from a league, but the team starts in the fourth division. First, you need to hire staff such as scouts, physiotherapists, and coaches. You can also recruit a youth team to find hidden talent. Each week, you have the option to sign up to two players, whose form is rated on a scale from 1 to 10. Players with a rating over 5 are unlikely to want to play in the fourth division. The matches take place off-screen and are updated minute by minute. After the games, you receive the results. Financial management is crucial: you can improve your stadium, sell players, take out loans, and pay the club's insurance. Injuries, suspensions, cup competitions, and European games all add to the challenge. Also known as McCoy Football Director.

meta.name: Football Director 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.69 KB

Football Director II is the successor to Football Director and expands on the gameplay of its predecessor. You take control of managing a football team in England, with the option to start in the top league, or for more of a challenge, begin with a smaller team in the fourth division and work your way up to international competitions. Fraction Fever has you climbing floor by floor using your pogo stick while searching for fraction visuals that match the ones shown on screen. You compare fractions, navigate toward the correct elevators, and rely on a radar to understand the layout of each level. Incorrect choices may score points but create gaps that make movement riskier, requiring precise jumps and careful timing. A strict time limit adds pressure – a learning-focused skill challenge that blends maths, awareness, and movement.

meta.name: Frak!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.67 KB

Frak! 64 puts you in control of Trogg the caveman, navigating a series of perilous platform levels. You climb ladders, leap across gaps, and collect gems for points and light bulbs for extra time before darkness falls. All keys must be gathered in the correct order to complete each stage. Statues block your path and can only be destroyed using Trogg's yo-yo – his sole means of defense. Meanwhile, balloons rise from below and daggers fall diagonally from above, turning every move into a fight for prehistoric survival.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Frank Bruno's Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Frank Bruno's Boxing you step into the ring as Frank Bruno and fight your way through a lineup of increasingly tough opponents to claim the title. The action is shown from a viewpoint directly behind your boxer, letting you feel the impact of every punch and movement. Using a mix of head and body punches along with defensive moves like dodging, ducking and blocking, you try to wear your opponent down. Each successful hit weakens his strength, though it can recover if he avoids damage for a while. After enough punishment you finally get the chance to land the decisive knockout blow.

meta.name: Frankenstein
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Frankenstein puts you in the role of Dr. Frankenstein, who after years of research has assembled a perfect being from collected body parts. But what rises from the slab is horrifying, and you flee in terror. When you return, the creature is gone, and you try to move on. Four years later, your sister is murdered by a monstrous being. You know without doubt who is to blame. Now there's only one goal: find the creature and destroy it.

meta.name: Frankenstein
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.23 KB

Frankenstein opens with the desperate reflection of Dr. Victor Frankenstein, who believed he had uncovered the secret of life. For two years, he sank into obsessive research, re-animating dead animal tissue, taking endless notes, refining his apparatus, and losing sight of everything else. Emaciated, abandoned, and wild with ambition, he aimed to be nothing less than equal to God – a creator, a giver of life.

meta.name: Frankenstein Jnr.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.48 KB

In Frankenstein Jnr. you control the son of Frankenstein's monster, who must search the castle for his father's scattered body parts to bring him back to life using 10,000 volts of electricity. Keys unlock doors, but ghosts and skeletons drain Franky Jr.'s energy, eventually causing cardiac arrest if it gets too low. You navigate a flickscreen maze one room at a time. The screen displays your energy, heartbeat, and collected items.

meta.name: Frankenstein's Legacy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.37 KB

Frankenstein's Legacy casts you as the last living descendant of the infamous Frankenstein family, summoned to the old estate. In the eerie manor, you're tasked by none other than Victor Frankenstein himself to reanimate the monster in the basement lab. You'll need to gather special components like golden electrodes and fresh organs, crack a safe, decode a secret message, and fend off a local werewolf. But just as the electricity surges and the creature begins to stir, everything spirals out of control.

meta.name: Frankie Crashed on Jupiter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Frankie Crashed on Jupiter is an English-language, somewhat bizarre text / graphic adventure. As the name of the game suggests, a certain spaceship called Frankie (according to the cover picture) builds a crash landing on Jupiter. If it were not Jupiter, you could still call that "normal," but Jupiter is a gas giant. But what you then have to gather together in the spaceship and build in order to get a codeword falls under "slightly off-hook". Curious? Just play through, then you know it too ...

meta.name: Frankie Goes to Hollywood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.68 KB

Frankie Goes to Hollywood casts you as a dull, ordinary figure in the gray routine of 1980s Liverpool. But a gruesome murder awakens your desire for something greater – the legendary Pleasuredome. As you explore homes and streets, you collect objects that can be used in various ways. Using them correctly moves you forward, while misuse leads to failure. Along the way, you'll face mini-games like shooters, mazes, and puzzles – all part of your journey from nobody to awakened.

meta.name: Frankies Horror Trip I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Frankie's Horror Trip I gives the classic platform adventure a dark new twist with fresh levels, eerie themes, and a deliberately spooky atmosphere. The redesigned stages introduce new enemies, unexpected obstacles, and creatively altered environments that change the feel while preserving the core gameplay. The result is a distinct experience that blends familiar mechanics with horror elements, challenging both curiosity and skill.

The player plays Frantic Freddie, a telephone line engineer. Each level takes place on a single screen, each with five full-width platforms connected by telegraph poles. Freddie runs along the platforms; he cannot pass through the telegraph poles but may climb up and down either side of them. The goal of the game is to collect the pots of gold resting on the platforms, as well as optional bonus items which scroll through the playing area. Each level is patrolled by three to five monstrous "Greeblies" that Freddie must avoid, lest he lose a life.The game has a total of sixteen playable levels. The 17th level has a game breaking bug, as this level mistakenly has all poles removed. This means that Freddie can't reach the platforms above him, making this level impossible to clear. The player is forced to reset/turn off the system.

meta.name: Frantic Freddy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Not to be confused with the quite famous Frantic Freddie, this is an unofficial C64 port of the lesser-known Spectravideo game Frantic Freddy.
Freddy must put all the fires and rescue all the trapped cats from building on fire. Freddy must run back and forth on the ground, dodging falling rubbish while shooting water at flames in the windows of a building. When all fires are extinguished, the game progresses to the next floor, where Freddy can climb between the floors, shooting to the left and right instead of upwards. On these levels, there are two kinds of flames – the red and the purple ones. The purple ones are more aggressive, following Freddy around the screen, and can only be put out once all the red ones are extinguished.
On the higher difficulty levels, cats turn up at intervals in the windows, falling down after a while. Freddy must catch the cats, or he will lose a life. Similarly, he loses a life if hit by a fire or falling rubbish.

meta.name: Freak Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.55 KB

You are Agent One of the Galactic Police and have been sent to a large factory to stop a professor who is using machines to create cruel creatures in five laboratories. The factory is viewed from the side at a slightly elevated angle, with the screen split into two floors and elevators having to be found and used to move through the floors to find the labs.
There are various hazards on the floor, including gargoyles on the walls that open and close their eyes. If you are nearby while your eyes are open, you will lose part of an energy bar. Other obstacles include electrified barriers and spikes that you have to jump over or you'll lose more energy. When the energy bar is empty, the game is over. The Professor occasionally appears in a flying machine and also consumes energy when touched.

meta.name: Fred
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.78 KB

Eres Fred, un intrépido arqueólogo que visita la pirámide de Tootiecarmoon en busca de tesoros, aventuras y una experiencia inolvidable. El juego consta de seis niveles en los que debes recoger tesoros y, sobre todo, un mapa para salir vivo del laberíntico interior. Debes esquivar peligros como gotas de ácido, momias, arañas y vampiros. Para defenderte dispones de una pistola con munición limitada, aunque algunos enemigos son inmunes a los disparos: en esos casos, solo te salvan el salto o la evasión. ¡Sobrevive, explora y escapa con los tesoros!

meta.name: Fred the Fruiter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.36 KB

Fred the Fruiter is a colorful and challenging game where the player must collect fruits while avoiding difficult controls and obstacles. The controls are precise and require a lot of skill, as players are confronted with various challenges that make fruit collection more difficult. As the game progresses, the difficulty increases, making it a nostalgic experience for fans of retro platform games. Those who can master the challenge of precise control will be rewarded with a fun and satisfying experience.

meta.name: Fred's Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.46 KB

Fred's Back is a platform game where the player controls Fred, a waddling head-shaped creature. On each level Fred must collect all the diamonds and then exit the level by walking off the right edge of the map. Fred loses a life if his energy, which is constantly depleting, falls down to zero; it must be replenished by collecting food. Other ways to die include touching one of the monsters that keep randomly walking onto the screen, and falling into a bottomless pit.
The levels contain brick platforms which can be broken by hitting them with Fred's head, as well as brown tiles which sometimes reveal bonus items when hit. The items include bonus diamonds, bonus lives, potions that fully replenish energy, and a weapon that allows Fred to shoot the monsters.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Fred's Back 2
meta.desc:

Just like the original Fred's Back, Fred's Back II is a platform game in which the player controls Fred, a shambling, head-shaped creature. In each level, Fred must collect all the diamonds and then exit the level by running over the right edge of the map. Fred loses a life when his ever-dwindling energy drops to zero; it must be replenished by collecting food. Other ways to die include touching one of the monsters that keep randomly running onto the screen and falling into a bottomless pit. The levels contain brick platforms that can be destroyed by hitting Fred's head, as well as brown tiles that sometimes reveal bonus items when hit. Items include bonus diamonds, bonus lives, potions that fully replenish energy, and a gun that allows Fred to shoot the monsters.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Fred's Back 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Part of the Fred's Back series, the game follows Fred, a waddling, head-shaped creature, as he navigates through each level. In every stage, Fred must collect all the diamonds and finish the level by reaching the right edge of the screen. Fred loses a life if his energy, which constantly decreases, drops to zero. To replenish his energy, Fred must collect food. Other dangers include touching randomly appearing monsters and falling into bottomless pits. The levels feature brick platforms that Fred can destroy with his head, as well as brown tiles that often release bonus items such as extra diamonds, extra lives, potions that fully refill his energy, and a weapon that allows Fred to shoot monsters.

meta.name: Fred's in Trouble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fred's in Troubles sends the likable hero on another adventurous journey filled with dangers and hidden surprises. You explore expansive areas, collect diamonds and deal with numerous enemies by either dodging them or attacking at the right moment. Bricks can be bumped from below to reveal secrets, and well-hidden bonus stages offer extra rewards. Familiar mechanics blend with distinctive touches – a fast-paced adventure that combines classic appeal with its own unique charm.

meta.name: Freddy Hardest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.56 KB

Es el playboy más sinvergüenza de toda la galaxia, heredero de una gran fortuna, lleva una vida disoluta, entregado a borracheras incontroladas, fiestas sin fin y excesos de todo tipo. Tras una de sus últimas ?Fiestecitas? perdió el control de su nave y fue a estrellarse contra la luna del planeta Ternat donde se halla la base enemiga de KALDAR.
Recuperado ya de su borrachera, Freddy Hardest que aunque no pudiera parecerlo es uno de los miembros más inteligentes del Servicio de Contraespionaje de la Agencia SPEA de la Confederación Sideral de Planetas Libres, debe lanzarse a la aventura.

meta.name: Freddy Hardest in South Manhattan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.73 KB

Freddy Hardest is back – ditching space for the streets! No more starships, now it's fists and fury as Freddy takes on gangs and thugs in pure 2D beat 'em up fashion. With a limited but deadly arsenal of karate or kung fu moves, he dishes out punches, throws, and jaw-shattering jump kicks that leave no doubt who's boss. Forget laser guns – Freddy fights old-school. A single-player classic that's more bruises than bonding, and all-out retro brawling fun.

meta.name: Freespace 2075
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.23 KB

Freespace 2075 is a relatively simple yet engaging action-puzzle game where players use space mines to eliminate enemies across various levels. The game emphasizes strategy, as players must anticipate enemy movement and place the mines at the right time and in the correct locations. While it was the developer's first major project, the game showcases solid design within the action-puzzle genre, combining tactical gameplay with space-themed graphics.

meta.name: Frenesis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.45 KB

Frenesis is a frantic 40-level action game where you must defend a central cross extending to the screen edges against waves of aliens approaching from all angles. Your only weapon is the Statron – a line of arrows that moves horizontally or vertically across the screen. The arrows always point in the direction of movement, and only when the tip of the Statron hits an alien moving toward it is the enemy destroyed. Fast reflexes and smart positioning are key to surviving the onslaught.

meta.name: Frenzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.59 KB

There is a frenzy in a scientific research center. Darting leptons, deadly sub-atomic particles, are running free in laboratory rooms, and it is your job to capture them using a robot craft with gameplay similar to Qix. Ion trails left behind by your craft while it is in a free area are used to enclose the area to capture the lepton or render the area safe from leptons. The area can be enclosed when you reach the edge of the room or safety area. Until then, while your craft is in free area, both the trail and the craft are vulnerable from a lepton hit. Later laboratory rooms developed dangerous charged omega particles which move along the ion trails and should be avoided as well.

meta.name: Frexel
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.77 KB

meta.name: Friday the 13th
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.98 KB

Jason is hiding in the forest, waiting to avenge his mother's death, when a party of teenagers visit the eerie Crystal Lake holiday camp close to the killer's filthy grotto. Jason puts on his hockey mask and sharpens his machete, ready for a razor-edges massacre.
Ten of your friends are lose in the surroundings of Crystal Lake. Jason is out there to hunt them down. It's up to you to find him and kill him before he kills you. Luckily there are a lots of weapons to be found in the scenery, ranging from small knives to chainsaws. Unfortunately Jason is looking like a normal player until he attacks or is attacked. So it's up to you to identify him and end the nightmare by killing Jason.
Depending on the number of friends surviving you'll get bonus points just to start over again with a different character.

meta.name: Frightmare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.93 KB

En Frightmare, encarnas a un hombre que experimenta una terrible pesadilla. Y si mueres en ella, mueres de verdad...
Tu misión es sobrevivir el tiempo suficiente para despertar. Por cada habitación que visitas, pasan otros 6 minutos, y a las 8:12 suena el despertador y te salva la vida.
Tu objetivo secundario es aumentar tu estado de sueño. Empiezas con un "mal sueño", pero matando monstruos y recogiendo cálices puedes conseguir sueños mucho peores, como "sueño terrible" o "visión mortal". Tu estado de sueño se muestra en forma de texto en la parte superior de la pantalla y no tiene ninguna otra repercusión en el juego.
Se trata de un juego de terror en el que te enfrentas a zombis, murciélagos, fantasmas y otras criaturas terroríficas. Si te tocan, pierdes una de tus cinco vidas.
El juego consiste en un enorme laberinto de habitaciones interconectadas.

meta.name: Frog 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.14 KB

Frog 64 puts you in control of a small frog on a perilous journey home through traffic, rivers, and lurking predators. Dodge cars, leap across sinking turtles and swirling logs, and avoid snakes and snapping alligators. One mistake spells disaster, and even reaching home is only the beginning – you'll need to guide five frogs safely back to move on. Every second counts in this tense, classic challenge of timing and survival.

meta.name: Frog Jump
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.93 KB

In Frog Jump, children playfully practice basic math skills like counting and ordering. Competing against the computer or another player, they control frogs to solve tasks. The game is specifically designed for children aged 4 to 8, combining learning with fun.

meta.name: Frog Master
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.64 KB

Frog Master can be played alone or with two players and offers over 100 different variations, ranging from simple to highly complex gameplay. The playing field has goal lines at both ends and goal areas in the center of each line. The objective is to train the animal players on the screen by clicking when they perform the desired actions. By repeatedly clicking when the tadpoles and frogs move as intended, they gradually learn to follow the player's commands.

meta.name: Frogger '93
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Frogger '93 is a lovingly crafted Frogger clone in which your goal in each level is to fill five bays at the top of the screen with frogs. To do so, you must first safely guide your frog across a busy four-lane road, carefully dodging cars and trucks. Then, you must cross a river – but since your frog can't swim, it has to hop across turtles and floating logs to reach the other side. Only with precise timing and a sharp eye can you reach all the bays and advance to the next level.

meta.name: The Official Frogger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.98 KB

"Frogger" es una adaptación de un clásico arcade en la que debes guiar con seguridad a una rana por un camino peligroso y un río caudaloso para llegar a una de las celdas en la parte superior de la pantalla. En el camino, debes esquivar coches y camiones a toda velocidad, mientras que en el río, el agua, las serpientes, las tortugas que se hunden y los caimanes representan una amenaza mortal, especialmente sus cabezas, que debes evitar. Solo saltando hábilmente sobre troncos, tortugas y caimanes podrás avanzar. Alcanzar una celda con una mosca otorga puntos de bonificación. Una vez que todas las casas estén llenas, comienza un nivel más difícil.

meta.name: Frogger

Frogger is a classic skill game where you must guide a frog safely across a busy road and a hazardous river to reach a home slot at the top of the screen. On the road, you dodge speeding cars and trucks, while on the river you jump onto logs, turtles, and sometimes crocodiles – but carefully, as some vanish or are dangerous. The goal is to fill all home slots, collecting flies for bonus points, before advancing to an even more challenging level.

"Frogger" es una adaptación de un clásico arcade en la que debes guiar con seguridad a una rana por un camino peligroso y un río caudaloso para llegar a una de las celdas en la parte superior de la pantalla. En el camino, debes esquivar coches y camiones a toda velocidad, mientras que en el río, el agua, las serpientes, las tortugas que se hunden y los caimanes representan una amenaza mortal, especialmente sus cabezas, que debes evitar. Solo saltando hábilmente sobre troncos, tortugas y caimanes podrás avanzar. Alcanzar una celda con una mosca otorga puntos de bonificación. Una vez que todas las casas estén llenas, comienza un nivel más difícil.

meta.name: Frogger 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.53 KB

Frogger 64 is a classic Frogger clone in which you guide a frog from the bottom to the top of the screen. On the way, you must dodge a busy road and a hazardous river. You earn bonus points by hopping on other frogs and collecting flies while skillfully avoiding cars and jumping across logs and turtles. You start with three lives, but an extra life is awarded at 10,000 points. The objective is to score as many points as possible and set a new high score. The game can be played with either a joystick or the keyboard.

meta.name: Frogger II : Threeedeep!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.60 KB

Frogger II: ThreeeDeep! expands on the classic gameplay and challenges you to bring your frog to safety across three different settings. First, you dive underwater and avoid dangerous fish and alligators – a turtle can be a safe platform here. After surfacing, you leap across logs, birds and even a whale to reach a life ring being towed by a tugboat. In the third section, you must hop across a flock of birds to reach a cloud at the top of the screen. Each frog has limited time to reach one of the homes on each of the three screens, and you move to the next, tougher level only after guiding a frog safely to all homes across all three stages.

meta.name: Froggy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.13 KB

Froggy is inspired by the arcade game Frogger where you have to get a frog home across three separate screens in this top view game. Starting at the bottom of the first screen, you have to cross a busy road by moving your frog forwards, backwards, left or right trying to avoid traffic moving across the screen left or right, to reach the top of the screen. The next screen sees you try to cross a jungle with various creatures once again moving across the screen before trying to cross a river. You have to swim across the river from a bank but the current keeps dragging you to the right as you try to reach a lily pad. Once you make it to your home, you then repeat the game but at a higher skill level. If you touch any creature then you lose one of three lives and you are sent back to the first screen.

meta.name: Froggy 64 : Ivasive Action
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.79 KB

Froggy 64: Ivasive Action takes the familiar Frogger formula, with you guiding a frog through dangerous areas in an attempt to safely reach the goal. Unlike the classic original, it does not stop at simply copying the idea, but adds its own twist to the action. That extra change makes the obstacles and situations feel a little different and gives the well-known concept a small but welcome fresh touch.

meta.name: Froggy Goes Splatt!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.15 KB

Why did the frog want to cross the really busy street? To get to the other side as quickly as possible and then return, all while avoiding the dangerous cars. And you must help him, because it would be cruel, discouraging, and mean to just let the poor frogs get "flattened" like that.

meta.name: Frogrun 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.74 KB

Frog Run is a top view single screen game based on the arcade game Frogger where you have to get five frogs one at a time from the bottom of the screen to one of five holes at the top of the screen before a timer reaches zero for each frog. You have to cross a busy road with traffic moving across the screen left or right, and cross a river using logs, turtles and crocodiles who are also moving across the screen, before moving into a hole. You are able to move your frog left, right, forwards and backwards as you avoid the various obstacles and if you are hit by any or fall into the water then you lose one of three lives. When you reach a bank halfway there is also a snake that has to be avoided. You are able to use the back of the crocodiles but can't move on to their heads and some turtles move underwater as well.

meta.name: Front Line
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.58 KB

Front Line es un juego de acción de desplazamiento vertical. Tu misión es infiltrarte en el territorio enemigo y destruir su fortaleza. Para llegar a la fortaleza, tendrás que atravesar un terreno variado y peligroso. Selvas, desiertos, maleza y rocas que frenan tu progreso, además, cada área tiene numerosos combatientes enemigos y tanques que intentan detenerte. Para ayudar a superar estos obstáculos, estás armado con una ametralladora y granadas; En algunos puntos del juego, incluso puede encontrarse con un tanque abandonado que puede controlar para aumentar sus probabilidades de supervivencia. Cuando llegues al final del nivel y destruyas exitosamente la fortaleza, el juego se repetirá en un nivel de dificultad más alto. El juego es para uno o dos jugadores, y hay cuatro niveles de habilidad diferentes disponibles.

meta.name: Frost Byte
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.75 KB

In Frost Byte, you control Hickey the Kreezer, a flexible creature navigating the hostile world of Cosmica to rescue his companions. With limited ammo and depleting Twang energy, you jump vertically, dodge or shoot monsters, collect power-ups, and use momentum to tackle obstacles. Three special candies enhance your abilities and help you survive increasingly tricky challenges.

meta.name: Frosty the Snowman II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.34 KB

Frosty The Snowman II continues the festive adventure with noticeable refinements. It introduces a dedicated single-player mode, improved visuals and a selection of Christmas tunes as Frosty once again helps Santa. The controls are more responsive, removing some of the frustrating blind jumps from the original while keeping the challenging platform gameplay intact. The result is a demanding but fairer and more polished experience.

meta.name: Frosty the Snowman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Frosty the Snowman is a competitive split-screen platformer where two snowmen race each other in a frantic contest. The goal is to grab a present at the end of a hazardous course and rush it back to score points. Pits and obstacles can instantly melt you, forcing careful movement under pressure. The action never really progresses to new stages, keeping the focus on endurance and rivalry. While playable solo, it shines most as a two-player showdown.

meta.name: Fruit Machine Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.55 KB

The first real Fruit Machine Simulator including: Cash Box, Nudge Box (with Compu-Nudge and Nudge Bank), Skill Climb, Winning Streak, Cash Gamble, Holds and Mega-Holds, Skill Chances and Party Time Meter! Just like the real thing!

meta.name: Fruit Machine Simulator II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.43 KB

"Fruit Machine Simulator II" lets up to four players compete, each starting with a £1.50 stake represented by individual coins. These are inserted into the virtual machine with the press of a button. Then it's all about spinning the reels and hoping for the best. When a winning combination appears, you're offered the chance to gamble your winnings higher or lower. Alongside standard features like hold and nudge, the game includes special ones – like a shuffle nudge box where you can reshuffle the reels at the cost of a nudge, or the winner spinner, where the reels keep spinning until you stop them to lock in the best prize.

meta.name: Fruitbank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fruitbank, also known as Super Nudge 2000, is a slot machine simulator featuring five reels. You begin with a chosen credit amount and try to land winning symbol combinations. The fifth reel controls a bonus mechanic where lights gradually fill; once fully lit, the Super Nudge feature allows you to shift reels for improved outcomes. Sometimes the lights carry over to the next spin, and a skill symbol can trigger the feature at the right moment. Winnings can then be gambled for higher or lower results, adding risk and excitement – a slot-style experience blending luck, timing and strategy.

meta.name: Fruitmania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fruitmania is a game that combines elements from the classics Dig Dug and Boulder Dash to create a unique and engaging experience. Players control the action with the joystick, and the game supports a single player at a time. In Fruitmania, players dig through the environment, manipulate the terrain to create paths, and defeat enemies, similar to Dig Dug, where tunnels are dug and a pump is used to defeat foes. Additionally, players must overcome obstacles like in Boulder Dash, collecting items (likely fruits) and avoiding falling rocks or other dangers that arise from the manipulation of the environment.

meta.name: Fruity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.96 KB

Fruity lässt dich mit einem Trampolin am unteren Bildschirmrand Früchte aus Bäumen sammeln. Durch geschicktes Bewegen nach links und rechts sowie gezielte Sprünge erreichst du immer höhere Äste, um alle Früchte einzusammeln. Doch Gefahr droht von oben: Ein Geier kreist über den Bäumen und kann dich bei einer Kollision davontragen, was ein Leben kostet. Auch ein falscher Aufprall auf dem Boden hat Konsequenzen. Erst wenn sämtliche Früchte gesammelt sind, geht es weiter zum nächsten Abschnitt mit neuen Varianten und steigender Herausforderung.

meta.name: Frustration
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Fröhn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.92 KB

Fröhn is a completely absurd game based on a joke from the German edition of MAD magazine. It was originally meant to parody the supposedly complicated and illogical rules of video games – and the adaptation embraces this idea. You play as the Fröhn, tasked with rescuing his Fröhnline by following bizarre poem instructions. At the start you carry the “Dong,” which doubles as a weapon. The rules are intentionally nonsensical: you must defeat strange enemies like “black warts” or “dead Goths,” feed red breads, chase off creatures, or retrieve treasures with cats. New, unrelated tasks constantly appear, turning the game into a satire of classic action-adventures. The result is deliberate chaos – more parody and gag than serious gameplay.

meta.name: Fugitive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fugitive is another simplified single screen Space Invaders alike title. As a space fighter pilot player must defeat the alien fleet, occurring in the orbit of the planet. The aircraft may be moved in all directions: left, right, top and bottom. Each contact with an enemy unit takes some amount of energy level.

meta.name: Fun Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Fun Duel, you face off in an intense space shooter against a friend to determine who is the true joystick master. You control a spaceship and must prove your skill by shooting precisely and dodging cleverly to defeat your opponent. The player who lands the most hits first wins the duel. Speed, accuracy, and quick reflexes are crucial to the outcome of this action-packed game.

meta.name: Mystery Fun House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.12 KB

Mystery Fun House es la séptima entrega de la serie original de aventuras de Scott Adams. Los acontecimientos del juego tienen lugar en un parque de atracciones. El primer rompecabezas es cómo pasar los torniquetes. Una vez dentro, el jugador debe resolver el misterio del lugar atravesando una casa de espejos, etc. Como los demás de la serie, el juego es una aventura de texto con un parser de comandos de dos palabras bastante básico. Las versiones japonesas para ordenador incorporan gráficos además de la introducción de texto.

meta.name: Fun House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Fun House" is based on a children's game show on television. The goal of the game is to test skill and knowledge through stunts and quiz questions. Two players compete against each other to win the rounds. The winner then gets to collect prizes in the maze.

meta.name: Fun With Spelling Featuring Heathcliff
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.97 KB

Heathcliff: Fun with Spelling is an educational game based on the comic strip. The player controls Heathcliff as he attempts to spell various words correctly. The game takes place in a room full of pipes and from the pipes come mice holding on to balloons each with a letter. Before starting out the player is presented with a sentence with one of the words flashing. The task is to spell this word by popping the balloons with the corresponding letter. There are two game types: beginner and advanced. In the beginner game the objective is to just pop the letters needed for the word by standing under them as they fall. One point is given for each. In the advanced game points are given for all balloons that are popped but to spell the word the joystick button has to pressed when popping the needed balloon. Both modes can be played in seven difficulty levels with increasing difficulty. Each level has between 10 and 35 sentences.

meta.name: Funball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Funball throws you into a chaotic maze as a flying ball, blasting opponents before they get you. Up to eight players can battle simultaneously in this frantic mix of arena shooter and reflex challenge. Quick thinking, fast reactions, and sharp aim are your only chance to survive this electric war of bouncing bullets.

meta.name: Fungus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.84 KB

Fungus lives on a floating island in space and must visit nearby islands to gather the mushrooms he needs for food. These islands are filled with creatures and obstacles while the world continuously scrolls from left to right. You guide Fungus up and down platforms, jump gaps and avoid dangers while collecting as many mushrooms as possible. Collisions or falling off the edges cost a life and send you back to the start. The constant movement turns each island into a careful balance between risk and reward.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Fungus II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fungus II expands the original collection-based gameplay with greater freedom of movement and new abilities. Your goal is to gather all mushrooms within a time limit and return to the starting point. Instead of fixed scrolling, the screen now follows the player, creating a more open sense of exploration. A new weapon lets you switch between shooting and jumping modes, adding tactical depth. A variety of enemies, from dragons to bomb-dropping goblins and floating laser eyes, introduce changing threats that require adaptable strategies.

meta.name: Funny Car
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.58 KB

In Funny Car you experience the thrill of driving a 1500 HP dragster. Your task is to shift gears at the right moment, monitor oil pressure, and avoid jumping the start. Perfect timing is crucial, as poor shifting or a false start will cost you the race. Quick reflexes and precision are everything – welcome to the world of drag racing.

p: Further Adventures of Alice in Videoland, The (Europe).T64
n: Further Adventures of Alice in Videoland, The (Europe)

meta.name: Alice in Videoland : The Further Adventures
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.62 KB

In “Alice in Videoland: The Further Adventures,” Alice steps through a magical mirror into a strange world after playing with her cat. On a side-scrolling, slightly elevated path, she encounters dragons that can be defeated by touching them. However, after a set number, further contact causes her to lose one of her six lives. Doors on the path must be jumped over, as touching them sends Alice back to her house. The game features nine difficulty levels and supports up to four players.
