meta.name: The Fury
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.01 KB

In 1996, the first Rim Race took place on a specially built track called the Rim, located in the Arizona desert. The track had a diameter of 20 km and a length of 60 km, and took eight years to construct. Over 1,000 drivers participated, many of whom died, and by the final race, only Seya Alkli remained as the winner. Over the course of 45 years, the race took many forms and was broadcast throughout the entire solar system. By 2045, it reached its current form. There are 12 Rims around the planet Devs, which orbits Jupiter. You play as a driver in this dangerous sport, racing at high speeds, destroying opponents, and trying to survive. You can earn money to buy better cars and weapons. There are three types of races: Time Run, Killing Race, and Tag Race. The goal is to reach "The Fury," a mysterious point on the track where a vehicle disappears at high speed.

meta.name: Future Bike Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Future Bike Simulator es un juego de acción futurista ambientado en 1999. Tras prohibir el gobierno las motocicletas, el multimillonario Finnius M. Houlder creó un aerodeslizador armado como sustituto —y aprovechó para añadirle armas. Su objetivo: conducir y eliminar a quienes se muevan más lento que él (es decir, a todos). Los enemigos abatidos dejan dinero para mejorar el vehículo entre niveles. Pierdes una vida si la barra de energía se agota, así que conviene esquivar obstáculos y otros vehículos. El movimiento se limita a izquierda y derecha; la velocidad es fija e irregulable.

meta.name: Future Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.87 KB

Future Fighter is a vertically scrolling space shooter where the player must defend Earth from hostile invaders. The game offers classic arcade action, with you controlling a spaceship as it navigates through multiple waves of enemies. Your goal is to protect Earth by taking out opponents and fighting your way through various levels. Fast-paced action and intense combat define the game, which is shaped by the typical challenges of the genre.

meta.name: Future Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.08 KB

In Future Knight you've crash-landed on a hostile planet and your love interest has been taken by aliens. First, you must navigate the maze-like wreckage of your ship, now swarming with alien intruders. Use your laser gun to blast them away and find the exit. Once on the surface, you face towering robot enemies – only by defeating them can you rescue the one you love.

meta.name: Future Shock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.65 KB

Future Shock throws you into a wonderfully bizarre story: 42 billion years ago, the Gal-Corps from planet Maltron were responsible for human evolution – but instead of doing their job, they got drunk on Tharsberg Special Brew. The result: the "Scroll of Evolution" shattered into 16 pieces and scattered across the universe. In the present, Glob is teleported mid-drink to the Supreme Being and tasked with recovering the pieces and assembling them correctly. In this side-scrolling game, you guide Glob through rooms, making use of elevators and even gravity reversal to collect the fragments. Time is against you – a candle steadily burns down while you arrange the pieces in puzzle mode.

meta.name: Fuzzy Fisherman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.29 KB

“Fuzzy Fisherman” takes you to a peaceful day by the pond. You search for worms and find the perfect fishing spot. With a bit of luck, you won't miss a catch or have to tell tales about the one that got away. A relaxing fishing experience that leaves you wanting more adventures.

meta.name: Fuzzy Fisherman II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.18 KB

“Fuzzy Fisherman II” continues the relaxing fishing experience by the river. Once again, you search for the perfect spot, bait your hooks, and reel in a big catch. A calm yet exciting day awaits you!

meta.name: G-Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.89 KB

Quick reflexes and good aiming accuracy are the main qualities you need to play this exciting shoot-'em-up well. The scenario consists of various unrelated lanes, from which targets occasionally appear. Using your laser gun, you must quickly run to each lane and destroy everything that comes your way. Pressing the F7 key activates a super laser that destroys all enemies on the screen, but only for a limited time. There are a total of 32 different screens and a laser bonus every 30,000 points.

meta.name: G-Loc R360
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.14 KB

La "Citizens Defence Force" no confía en que las Naciones Unidas mantengan la paz en el convulso mundo del siglo XXI. Han confiscado una horda de aviones y buques de guerra y, como leal a la ONU, tu trabajo es derribarlos. 
El juego se divide en varias fases, a su vez divididas en subfases en tierra y mar, cada una con un estricto límite de tiempo y un número objetivo de aviones que derribar.  Tienes misiles y armas estándar a tu disposición. Los aviones pueden sobrevivir a algunos impactos.
Si no consigues completar una sección en el tiempo asignado, perderás una vida, pero el número de aviones derribados anteriormente no se reinicia, lo que facilita el segundo intento. A medida que destruyas más enemigos, tendrás acceso a mejores aviones.

meta.name: The Graphic Adventure Creator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Graphic Adventure Creator is a versatile tool for creating text or graphic adventures. With support for up to 255 nouns, verbs, and adverbs and 9999 rooms (as long as the total stays under 23 KB), it enables complex worlds. Game logic is controlled by conditions, divided into global (high or low priority) and local rules. The parser supports multiple commands per line and includes a quick-start file with common verbs and prompts. A built-in graphics editor allows for background design, and two sample adventures help users get started right away.

meta.name: Galactic Assault
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.36 KB

Galactic Assault offers an exciting challenge where you must fight waves of attacking aliens with your powerful firepower. The goal is to survive each wave and eventually reach the mighty command ship. Eight levels with increasing speed and difficulty test even the most experienced players.

meta.name: Galactic Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.90 KB

In this game, players have to launch a spaceship from a vessel that moves left and right repeatedly until the fire button is pressed. After the ship is released, it must be guided through a field of orbs (that also move left and right) to one of the four pads at the bottom of the screen. While avoiding the orbs, the ship can be slowed down by releasing fuel so it makes navigating to the pads easier. The pads each consist of three layers, and a layer is removed when the player's ship lands on it and a small blue alien enters it. Once done, the player needs to guide the alien back to the vessel. The invaders will get released from the orbs, but the player can shoot them with a bullet.

meta.name: Galactic Battles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Just wait until you have completed a round of Galactic Battles. There is nothing like it on planet Earth and the longer you play, the harder it becomes. Oh! I almost forgot: Watch out for the Xendars, the ruthless robots.

meta.name: Galactic Conquest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Galactic Conquest, you take command of hundreds of spacecraft as you conquer other worlds and expand your empire. Along the way, you must watch out for black holes, photon storms, stars turning into novas, and of course, General Badguy. Your goal is to conquer the galaxy and grow your power while overcoming various dangers. The game accommodates 1 to 6 players and was later released as part of a collection.

meta.name: Galactic Controller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

In Galactic Controller, you have been elected as the administrator of a border colony on a planet in the remote regions of the galaxy. Your task is to efficiently manage the planet and the surrounding system. Under your leadership, spacecraft will explore space to find new worlds for the ever-growing population, while the colony, despite scientific research, increasingly relies on imported resources. Your management skills are crucial to the well-being of the colony.

meta.name: Galactic Defender
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.96 KB

"Galactic Defender" puts the player in the role of a pilot who controls a spaceship to fend off an alien invasion. The challenge is to intercept enemy UFOs and protect humanity from an impending threat. Each attack requires quick reactions and precise aiming in order to destroy the enemy ships in time. The combination of action-packed combat and the pressing danger creates an intense gaming experience that keeps the tension up until the end.

meta.name: Galactic Dogfight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.62 KB

"Galactic Dogfight" is an action-packed game for the Commodore 64 in which you compete against your opponent in intense dogfights. Your task is to shoot down your opponent's five planes, choosing between rockets and air mines. Turbo boosts help you to quickly escape from dangerous situations or to carry out surprising maneuvers. Since the number of mines and boosts is limited, clever use is crucial to successfully mastering all rounds.

meta.name: Galactic Drivers II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.99 KB

„Galactic Drivers II“ challenges the player to rescue people from enemy territory using a helicopter while dodging hostile fire. The terrain is rugged, requiring precise maneuvering to avoid crashing into obstacles. The player must skillfully navigate, react quickly, and evade enemies to successfully save as many survivors as possible.

meta.name: Galactic Empire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Galactic Empire was released in 1985 as part of the "Galactic Empire Builder" package and is also known under the title "Space Adventure." In this game, you take control of a galactic empire and must strategically build and manage it.

meta.name: Galactic Frontier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A galactic empire-like trade and strategy game, based on older games from the 1970s of this style, developed by Blue Hills Software and published by Free Spirit Software in 1986. An exciting space exploration game for the C64. Search for life forms among the 200 billion stars of our galaxy. Scientifically accurate. Great graphics! Perfect for serious astronomy students or the casual explorer who wants to boldly go where no one has gone before.

meta.name: Galactic Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Galactic Games is a sports Olympics game set in space. It offers five disciplines that can either be played individually or combined as a tournament:
100 meter slides, space hockey, mental judo, head toss and metamorph marathon

meta.name: Galactic Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Galactic Games is a sports Olympics game set in space. It offers five disciplines that can either be played individually or combined as a tournament:
100 meter slides, space hockey, mental judo, head toss and metamorph marathon

meta.name: Galactic Gardener
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.35 KB

In Galactic Gardener, you pilot a flying chair through a maze of caves to retrieve ten stolen Power Flowers. But beware: trying to collect one without a flowerpot costs a life. Dangerous obstacles like force fields, moving gates, and patrolling dragon flowers demand precision. You'll need to refuel, use teleporters, and stun enemies with spray to recover the precious blooms and survive.

meta.name: Galactic Meteors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.42 KB

In Galactic Meteors, you must destroy meteors and asteroids falling toward Earth. The game combines elements from Asteroids and classic shooters like Space Invaders or Galaxian. It is a stationary shooter where you maintain your position and fend off the descending threats. The game is reminiscent of Astrosmash: Meteor for the Mattel Intellivision.

meta.name: Galactic Muncher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.54 KB

„Galactic Muncher“ is a mix of dodge'em and catch'em gameplay, where you move the Muncher left and right to avoid obstacles while also eating enemies. Pressing a button opens the gaping mouth, allowing you to devour foes before they get you. A dial on the left shows your progress toward the next level – once it reaches the top, you advance. The dial on the right represents your life limit – if it drops to the bottom, it's game over. In two-player mode, one player controls the Muncher while the other operates the mouth – coordination is key.

meta.name: Galactyforce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the year 5000, the era of great peace is over, and a new intergalactic war breaks out. You enter the greatest battle, piloting your Delta-Glider and attacking the last planets, Tyrus and Erebus. May the stars be with you!

meta.name: Galaga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.28 KB

Galaga es un "Shoot'em Up" de Namco. Controlas una nave espacial en la parte inferior de la pantalla, desplazándote hacia la izquierda y hacia la derecha para evitar las bombas que se aproximan y los ataques kamikaze de los invasores alienígenas.
Hay un número infinito de etapas para progresar. Cada tercer nivel es una "etapa de desafío" en la que tienes la oportunidad de disparar a tantos alienígenas como sea posible y acumular puntos de bonificación.
Ciertos extraterrestres tienen rayos de extracción que pueden usar para capturar una de tus naves. Si esa no fue tu última "vida", puedes intentar derribar a ese extraterrestre y recuperar tu nave, disponiendo de dos simuláneamente y doblando tu potencia de fuego.

meta.name: Galax-i-Birds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Galax-i-Birds" puts you in control of a ship under assault by wave after wave of birds – vultures, chickens, swans, and budgies – all diving at you in kamikaze attacks. You can move left or right and fire two shots at a time. Clear all birds in a wave to advance to the next. Collisions with birds cost you a life, and the game ends when all lives are lost. Quick reflexes and sharp aim are key to surviving the feathered frenzy.

meta.name: Galaxia 7
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.89 KB

A group of interplanetary terrorist has undermined all the Plutamnite mines of the planet Galaxia 7, the only one in the entire galaxy where this important mineral can be found. The bomb system installed by the terrorists is very special: to disable it, it is necessary to find the numerous objects scattered in the various mines to use them in defusing the box. Therefore, certain that their devices will not be able to be disabled in the time left before the explosion. The terrorists have disclosed the news in order to obtain the maximum impact on public opinion. But the last word has not yet been said. There is only one person capable of attempting such an arduous undertaking: is it you?

meta.name: Galaxian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.91 KB

"Galaxian" puts you in control of the Galaxip spaceship at the bottom of the screen, facing alien formations attacking from above. You fire at drones, emissaries, hornets, and commanders – the higher the rank, the more points you earn. Your ship can only fire one shot at a time, so timing and precision are essential. As the game progresses, enemy movement and attack frequency increase, and some foes dive toward you escorted by bombers. Quick reflexes and persistence are key to surviving this iconic space battle.

meta.name: Galaxy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.25 KB

"Galaxy" is a Galaga-style shooter where you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen, fending off waves of alien ships gathered in formation at the top. Enemies fire bullets and dive down in kamikaze-style attacks. Their behavior varies by color, and some require multiple hits to destroy. To complete a level, all enemies must be eliminated. With each stage, they become faster, and larger enemies use beams to restrict your movement. After several waves, a Challenge Stage appears with a new pattern and bonus points awarded based on kills. You start with three lives, earning an extra one at 20,000 points and every 70,000 thereafter. A fast-paced Galaga variant with increasing difficulty and classic arcade action.

meta.name: Galaxy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Galaxy" greets you with a cheeky "WAIT 7 DAYS FOR CHARGING!" message – but fortunately, the game starts much faster. Your goal is to navigate a red-yellow flashing object through a deadly maze and collect all green-orange flashing dots. Menacing skulls with blinking eyes patrol the corridors and will stop you cold. Even the slightest touch of a wall causes an explosion, sending you back to the start. If you manage to collect all the points, a new maze with fresh challenges awaits. One tip – practice, practice, practice!

meta.name: Galaxy Conflict
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.48 KB

GALAXY CONFLICT Raise a fleet of Battle Eon-cruisers then move from bridge to bridge taking full control and responsibility in this battle for the heavens. Born galactic rulers will do well. Galaxy battle sets new trend!

meta.name: Galaxy Force II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En "Galaxy Force II", pilotas una nave espacial a través de seis zonas peligrosas que van desde jardines florecientes hasta mundos de lava ardiente y paisajes helados. Vuelas libremente por el espacio, atraviesas túneles y cañones estrechos, y luchas hasta llegar a la base alienígena final. Tu medidor de energía comienza en 1200 y disminuye con cada golpe o colisión con obstáculos. Con cañones a bordo infinitos y misiles guiados puedes defenderte, y al derribar y recoger naves de soporte especiales, obtienes energía y mejoras. Esta versión ampliada incluye dos niveles adicionales, así como secciones revisadas y mejor equilibradas, y ahora puedes disparar los cuatro misiles a la vez con solo presionar un botón.

meta.name: Galaxy!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.13 KB

"Galaxy!" puts you in the role of an admiral commanding a newly formed space fleet, launching ships from your homeworld to explore and conquer unknown stars. Planets you encounter may be barren or industrially valuable – some will resist, others can be colonized. Your mission is to conquer worlds, convert them into ship-producing bases, and expand your reach until the entire galaxy is under your control. Up to 20 players can compete for domination of 40 star systems. The player with the most planets at the end wins. Each match features a freshly generated galaxy – offering a new strategic challenge every time.

meta.name: Galaxys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.91 KB

Galaxys is a retro-style space shooter where players blast attacking aliens while being accompanied by intense rage/megastyle music in the background. The game offers classic fun in the style of old arcade shooters.

meta.name: Galgje
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.67 KB

meta.name: The Galleon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A very complex graphic/text adventure game that is reminiscent of the Level 9 and Melbourne House adventures in its style and manner. It contains an intelligent parser (applying a vocabulary of about 1400 words and inflections for Hungarian grammar as well as their English translation), more than 250 rooms (with detailed descriptions and a few dozen images) and almost 100 living creatures and almost 140 moving objects. In addition, it is a unique multi-protagonist game: you have to play it with two player characters at the same time (a young magician and a barbarian, who are brothers on an island), constantly switching between them and working together as a team. It even contains some minor MUD-like and RPG elements (like magic power or treasure trading, dark labyrinths and random events, etc.).

meta.name: The Galleon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A very complex graphic/text adventure game that is reminiscent of the Level 9 and Melbourne House adventures in its style and manner. It even contains some minor MUD-like and RPG elements (like magic power or treasure trading, dark labyrinths and random events, etc.).

meta.name: Galleons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.36 KB

A game of naval strategy where 1-4 player ships must depart from their respective home ports, compete to acquire hidden treasures and return with their spoils in a set amount of 50 turns.

meta.name: The Gambler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.77 KB

A poker game with sound and graphics that is challenging and entertaining. Created by a small Australian company and published in 1983.

meta.name: Gamblin' Cowboy - Lucky Luke
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Another game based on the comics good cowboy Lucky Luke, who draws his gun faster than his shadow. This time he must be lucky and quick enough to answer the questions and win the money. The game represents the board game for 2-6 players to acquire wealth through different activities specific for the Western movies. Such activities involve the taking or giving the play money based on the luck or correct answers, as players take turns moving around the board according to the roll of the dice. A typical turn begins with the rolling of the dice and advancing clockwise around the board the corresponding number of squares. When player lands on certain square, he may be teleported to another square, or win/lose the money, or be proposed to answer a question for a defined period of time. The winner is the first player who collects the sum of money defined before the start of the game.

meta.name: The Game of Awari
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.12 KB

The Game of Awari is a digital version of the classic African board game Kalaha. You play against the computer and must plan your moves carefully to capture as many seeds (or stones) as possible. Each of your six pits starts with four stones, which you distribute clockwise. The goal is to collect more stones in your store than your opponent. Strategy, foresight, and timing are key to winning – a simple yet deeply strategic game that rewards logic and keen observation.

meta.name: The Game of Harmony
meta.desc:

Este juego de puzles estratégicos presenta una jugabilidad original: controlas una nave espacial situada sobre un globo que puedes rotar y desplazar por la pantalla. Debes empujar globos hacia otros del mismo color para eliminarlos todos. La pantalla no tiene bordes, lo que permite sacar globos por los laterales y amplía tus opciones tácticas. Chocar globos de colores distintos genera pequeñas cápsulas que debes recoger rápido para obtener energía; si no, se convierten en nuevos globos. Muchos globos están unidos entre sí (o a la nave) mediante cuerdas, y los niveles incluyen barreras que actúan como obstáculos o puntos de rebote, añadiendo complejidad a la física newtoniana.

En una galaxia lejana y perdida, una mujer hermosa y malévola sometió, con su inteligencia y un inmenso ejército de Terminadores, las cinco planetas de la Confederación más allá de Alfa Centauri. Todo el poder de Gremla descansaba en la fidelidad casi religiosa de su lugarteniente Arkos; sin embargo, la inteligencia de este Mega-Terminador evolucionó hasta el punto de abandonarla y unirse a las tropas de la infantería sideral, comandadas por el general de la Estrella Azul, Mc Killer. En cuanto al juego, es un arcade frenético dividido en dos partes: para acceder a la segunda se requiere una clave de acceso que se obtiene al finalizar la primera.

meta.name: Game Over II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Game Over II puts you in the boots of Commander Serena on a dangerous rescue mission to Moon 4 of the Sotpok System – better known as Phantis. This alien world is crawling with hostile creatures and wild vegetation. Your task: rescue your captured expedition partner. The gameplay blends horizontal shooter segments in the style of “R-Type” with intense platforming action reminiscent of “Turrican.” Across four phases and six levels, you'll face 24 different enemy types. On cassette versions, the game is split into two parts – and to access the second, you must earn a code revealed only after completing the first. This FX Doble Carga system was designed to deliver double the addictive gameplay time.

meta.name: The Game Show
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Game Show plays out like a classic TV quiz, with two teams competing – each assisted by their teammate, Joe or May. You start by choosing a topic, then face twelve questions. Each question comes with up to ten clues: the sooner you guess the correct answer, the more points you earn – up to ten for the first clue, with one point less for each additional hint. After twelve rounds per team, the scores are tallied, and the team with the highest total wins. Quick thinking, sharp reasoning, and broad knowledge are the keys to victory.

meta.name: The Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.47 KB

The Game is a classic Breakout-style title where you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen, keeping the ball in play while breaking through rows of colored bricks. Every hit scores points, but missing the ball costs a life. With each level, the speed increases and precision becomes key. Its simple formula – one ball, one paddle, countless bricks – quickly becomes addictive and stands as a timeless example of pure arcade gameplay.

meta.name: Gameboy Tetris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.70 KB

"Gameboy Tetris" is a classic puzzle game where players stack falling blocks of various shapes. The goal is to complete full horizontal rows, which then disappear, making room for new blocks. Strategic placement and rotation are key to keeping the playing field clear for as long as possible. As the game progresses, the speed increases, requiring quick thinking and precise control.

meta.name: Games Creator, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Games Creator is designed to allow you to easily make your own games. No special knowledge of machine code or programming experience is necessary. Whilst writing many computer games we developed various 'editors' to help speed up the games writing process. A compilation of these editors in 'user friendly' format makes the basis for the idea of the Games Creator. When using the Games Creator you will quickly become familiar with many of the advanced facilities of the Commodore 64. The program has been ingeniously constructed to be truly user friendly whilst containing very extensive facilities as games designing skills are developed. Games Creating is a new art-form, should you need any help, or have suggestions or ideas we would be pleased to hear from you. We hope you enjoy being a Games Creator!

meta.name: Games Designer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Games Designer“ is a program that allows users to create their own games by drawing sprites, selecting colors, and defining basic game logic. It features a simple user interface where elements such as characters or objects can be designed. Various options allow sprites to be customized, enlarged, or colored. The program is aimed at creative users who want to take their first steps in game development.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.13 KB

Gammaron is a vertically scrolling space shooter clearly inspired by classic arcade predecessors. You pilot your ship over hostile terrain, dodge incoming fire and attempt to destroy enemy formations before they overwhelm you. The challenge quickly becomes apparent, as enemy shots are difficult to spot and demand intense focus. With the screen constantly advancing, pressure never lets up – a relentless test of reflexes and endurance.

meta.name: Gandalf the Sorcerer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.52 KB

Gandalf the Sorcerer is a fixed-screen shooter where you defend your castle as Gandalf against lizardmen invading from the woods. Using a crosshair, you burn them with limited firepower. Defeated foes drop coins, but if they reach the door, they'll try to break in while your apprentice stirs a cauldron. If captured, the apprentice is taken outside, triggering an isometric view where you must chase the kidnapper, defeat him, and escort the apprentice back. Fire can be replenished by climbing the tower. Taking a hit means game over, and losing three apprentices ends your quest.

meta.name: Gangbusters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.99 KB

Gangbusters immerses you and other players in the world of organized crime during Prohibition. Year by year, you decide whether to invest in gambling, extortion or bribes, hire hitmen or plan risky heists. But the more you risk, the more federal attention you draw. Those who get greedy end up behind bars. Only one will rise to the top – to become the feared Godfather.

meta.name: Gangster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.88 KB

Gangster casts you as a downtown cop armed with a LightGun, trying to stop a mass prison break across three intense stages. First outside the jail, then in a top-down car chase, and finally outside a bar full of hiding felons, you must shoot escaping prisoners while avoiding hostages and police. Limited ammo and strict penalties raise the tension – fast reflexes and sharp aim are your only lifeline.

meta.name: Gaplus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gaplus es una secuela de Galaga y tiene una jugabilidad similar. El jugador controla una nave espacial que ahora puede moverse verticalmente (limitado hasta la mitad de la pantalla) además de horizontalmente, y dispara a enjambres de alienígenas entrantes parecidos a insectos que vuelan en formación por encima y descienden para bombardearlo en un picado similar a un kamikaze. En esta secuela, el nivel se reinicia si el jugador muere antes de que todos los enemigos hayan entrado. Cuando todos los enemigos son destruidos, el jugador pasa al siguiente nivel. Al obtener ciertos potenciadores, es posible disparar 60 balas por pantalla, la mayor cantidad que cualquier juego relacionado con Galaga haya tenido.

Garfield: Big, Fat, Hairy Deal was the first licensed video game featuring Jim Davis' famous cat. Your mission is to rescue Arlene from the cat pound. You explore different locations, collecting and trading items with characters from the comics to unlock new areas. Odie follows you everywhere – swiping him gives you points – while Nermal can help by carrying items. Garfield also needs regular food and rest, otherwise he falls asleep and it's game over. Many foes drain his energy, but with clever planning and the right items you can overcome the obstacles and save Arlene.

meta.name: Garfield : Winter's Tail
meta.desc:

After a fruitful day spent on his favorite hobby (food, what else?), Garfield the cat falls asleep next to Jon's still open fridge. The chill coming out of the refrigerator induces a dream of the Swiss Alps, with Garfield going after the largest lasagna factory in the world and a mythical chicken that can lay chocolate eggs. It is the player's goal to make sure Garfield's dream comes to a happy ending before he wakes up.

meta.name: Garrison

Garrison is a top-down action game that follows a gameplay style similar to Gauntlet. Up to five characters fight their way through over 100 dungeon levels, defeating hordes of enemies and collecting potions, gold, scrolls, keys, and magical items. Each player character has different strengths and weaknesses, making the game most enjoyable in multiplayer mode, as certain levels benefit from specific abilities such as speed or magic. The enemies possess a wide variety of attacks: some shoot projectiles, others engage in close combat, some drain the player's health upon contact, and others use magic.

Alternatively, users can choose from pre-made backgrounds, characters, and a large selection of pre-programmed music and sound effects to quickly bring their projects to life.

meta.name: Gary Lineker's Hot-Shot!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.64 KB

Gary Lineker's Hot Shot! delivers fast and direct football action from a top-down perspective, with a strong focus on immediate control and fluid play. Because only part of the pitch is visible at any time, it creates a compact and intense feel in which you are constantly switching between attack and defense while quickly taking control of the right player. One of its most appealing aspects is the way shots can be shaped not just in power but also in execution, allowing even spectacular moves to emerge from the right timing and a well-judged input.

meta.name: Gary Linekers Superskills
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.27 KB

Gary Linekers Superskills is a soccer game with a catch: it is only about the training! The player has to solve a sequence of mini games in a limited amount of time (overall). The mini games are divided into three basic categories: gym (button mashing), ball juggling (using moves with the right timing) and field event. The latter is also split into three succeeding disciplines: dribbling around obstacles, penalty and kicking the ball through hung up tyres. It is important to monitor the athlete's pulse rate and energy level which can be refreshed by either taking a rest or drinking. The game automatically does it for the player if the stats get too low, but it takes more time then. The game features three difficulty levels which can be assigned separately for each participant.

meta.name: Gates of Dawn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.44 KB

Gates of Dawn places you in the role of a knight exploring a mysterious labyrinth to uncover the secret of a ghost. To pass the legendary gates, you must gather four elements – iron, stone, fire and ice – hidden across 64 interconnected rooms. The maze is shown in a 3D view, with a map tracking your progress and an arrow indicating your current facing direction. Many chambers are filled with monsters that drain your strength or cost you a life upon contact. Armed with a sword, limited power and several lives, you fight to survive – only by uniting all four elements can you finally pass through the Gates of Dawn.

meta.name: Gates of Dawn Part II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gates of Dawn Part II continues the knight's quest to uncover the mystery of the legendary gates. He faces new monsters and dangers as he ventures deeper into the perilous world. His inventory can hold several items, with one active item displayed at the top of the screen. This item can be examined, dropped or used through a selectable command list. Choices must be made quickly – only careful inventory management and timely actions will carry the knight through the next stage of his journey.

meta.name: Gateway to Apshai
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.20 KB

In Gateway to Apshai, an ancient prophecy leads you to the entrance of dangerous dungeons where the path to the forgotten temple is said to be hidden. As the descendant of a great hero, the hopes of an entire land rest on you while you make your way through dark corridors, traps, and hostile creatures. Every step can bring you closer to the magic of Apshai – or deeper into an adventure from which many before you never returned.

meta.name: Gateway to the Savage Frontier

Gateway to the Savage Frontier comienza con una misión aparentemente rutinaria: tras escoltar una caravana a salvo a la ciudad de Yartar, tus héroes se dirigen a una taberna para un merecido descanso. Pero el destino los persigue: drogados y robados, despiertan sin nada. Lo que comienza como una simple investigación pronto desvela una oscura y trascendental conspiración, liderada por los Zhentarim, ávidos de poder, que aspiran a conquistar la tierra. Formas un nuevo grupo, reúnes pistas, luchas en ciudades, tierras salvajes y mazmorras, y te enfrentas a la oscuridad que se avecina.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

GATO is a real-time 3D submarine simulation game in which the player acts as the commander of a US submarine in the Pacific against Japanese warships during World War II. The gameplay consists of missions in which the main instruction is to navigate the submarine to detect and intercept enemy warships on the randomly generated map and approach the enemy to kill them with torpedoes. The combat itself consists of a direct view of enemy ships (via periscope) and firing torpedoes to sink the ship. Be warned that enemy ships will return fire, although the player has the surprise effect of a submerged ship. When all hell breaks loose, a revealed submarine is a evasive maneuver for the Japanese guns. The mission ends when the player has successfully eliminated all targets on the map.

"Gatwick Express" is based on the famous Gatwick Express, a high-frequency passenger train service between London Victoria, Gatwick Airport, and Brighton in the southeast of England.

Entra en el mundo de los monstruos y los laberintos. Viaja por los senderos del misterio y combate en busca del alimento que te dará la energía. Tu camino estará repleto de peligrosos monstruos y legiones de enemigos, pero no estás solo en tu busca de alimentos, tesoros y pociones mágicas, tus amigos estarán contigo.

Gauntlet II es una secuela directa del legendario shoot-em-up temático de fantasía basado en laberintos lanzado un año antes. Atari ha elegido no modificar la mecánica de la jugabilidad, optando por mejorar la ya excelente acción multijugador que había creado tanto revuelo en el lanzamiento del juego original.
Como su precuela, hasta cuatro jugadores a la vez toman los roles de "Thor, El Guerrero", "Thyra, La Valkiria", "Merlin, El Mago" o "Questor, El Elfo" y deben cooperar mientras exploran y pelean en su rumbo mediante laberintos repletos de enemigos, recolectar pociones, comida y tesoros mientras buscan una salida que los llevaría hacia una la siguiente mazmorra.

“Gauntlet III: The Final Quest” sends you back into monster-filled dungeons, but this time escaping isn't just about fighting through endless hordes. Instead, you face simple quests that require finding items, delivering them, and unlocking the path forward. The new isometric view adds depth, while the original four heroes – warrior, wizard, elf, and valkyrie – are joined by four newcomers: Lizard, Neptune, Stoneman, and Iceman. The dungeon calls, but this time it takes more than brute strength to survive.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.31 KB

Gazza II throws you straight into fast-paced football action, presenting matches in a horizontally scrolling overhead view that feels more dynamic and readable than before. You pick from different national teams that noticeably vary in strength – some let you play almost effortlessly while others demand precision, timing, and clean passing. Familiar elements like the power gauge for shots return to give you control in key moments, while the focus stays on quick matches and direct showdowns. You can play solo or face a friend on the same machine, and it quickly becomes clear that feel for the game and team choice determine whether you control the pitch or struggle to keep up.

meta.name: Gazza's Super Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.91 KB

"Gazza's Super Soccer" is a football game dedicated to Paul Gascoigne, one of the most iconic players of his era. Played from a top-down perspective, it offers various modes, including league and tournament competitions, single matches, and fully controllable set-piece practice sessions. The controls allow advanced moves, including a precision gauge to determine strength, height, and curl of a shot. Uniquely, players also control the goalkeeper, making them accountable for conceding goals. On-field players have individual skills that improve with good performance, enabling them to face stronger opponents.

meta.name: GBA Championship Basketball : Two-on-Two
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

GBA Championship Basketball: Two-on-Two es un juego de baloncesto que se puede jugar en parejas, en modo cooperativo o en modo enfrentamiento. Puedes elegir a tus jugadores entre 10 superestrellas del baloncesto, cuyas acciones en el juego se basan en su estilo de juego real. Al acercarte a la canasta, tienes una amplia variedad de tiros disponibles, desde un tiro sencillo hasta un mate.

meta.name: Gee Bee Air Rally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gee Bee Air Rally adds another dimension to motor racing - literally, as the action takes place in the sky. It targets the feel of pioneering races between 250mph planes in the valleys of the southern USA between brave but honest goggle-wearing men - a sort of Mille Miglia in the sky.
The game consists of 16 courses, which are marked out by giant suspended cones, each of which is to be completed against a time limit, while avoiding contact with the other planes. You must stay within the cones, any time spent outside it results in the alloted time ticking down at a prohibitively fast rate (so don't think of short-cutting the track). After every second successful race, you take on a bonus track, in which balloons must be hit for points.

meta.name: Gem'X
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gem'X challenges you to manipulate coloured tiles to perfectly match a target pattern and work your way through increasingly tricky stages. Two grids define the action – you operate on the left while the right shows the goal – and each click shifts colours along a fixed sequence, affecting both the selected tile and its neighbours. When tiles move past the end of the sequence they disappear, causing surrounding blocks to drop and opening new opportunities or disrupting your plan. With limited moves and time pressure, the game becomes a focused puzzle experience that rewards planning and clever chain reactions, while unlockable passwords help preserve your progress.

meta.name: Gemini Wing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los humanos y los alienígenas viven en armonía en el futuro, hasta que un periodista sensacionalista aviva el odio hacia los alienígenas. Estos responden invadiendo el planeta, y depende de ti resolver una situación sorprendentemente similar a la realidad en esta conversión arcade. Gemini Wing es un shoot 'em up de desplazamiento vertical, que se distingue por su inusual sistema de potenciadores. En lugar de obtener fichas ocasionales que conducen a mejoras duraderas de armamento, se liberan ráfagas ocasionales de fichas para garantizar una ráfaga rápida de fuego mejorado. Los fondos orgánicos son detallados y tienen muchas secciones que te disparan.

meta.name: Gemstone Healer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Gemstone saga continues in Gemstone Healer, the sequel to Gemstone Warrior, where you braved the horrors of the Netherworld dungeons to recover the pieces and restore the Gemstone to its rightful place in the Temple. Now, to your dismay the Gemstone has lost its powers because the pieces have been damaged and you must return to the Netherworld to locate the healing tools and heal each part. Then you can fuse all the pieces together into a complete working Gemstone.

Gemstone Warrior es un juego de acción con elementos de aventura. Los jugadores se abren camino a través de una catacumba subterránea, haciendo tres cosas a la vez. Primero necesitan encontrar cinco piezas de una piedra preciosa, repartidas por todo el laberinto. En segundo lugar, deben evitar ser asesinados por los guardianes de la catacumba. Finalmente necesitan mapear el juego, porque el lugar es tan grande que es fácil perderse. Una vez que el Guerrero de piedras preciosas ha recogido las cinco piezas de piedras preciosas, necesita volver al punto donde comenzó el juego.
El héroe tiene que pasar a la clandestinidad debido a los demonios. Robaron la piedra preciosa de los humanos, porque estaban celosos de la buena magia que trajo a la humanidad. Lo rompieron y lo extendieron por todo su calabozo, para esconderlo.

meta.name: Gener-Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.44 KB

In Gener-Raider, you're thrust into an interplanetary war where you, the star system's top pilot, are the last hope. Piloting an advanced robotic fighter, your mission is to destroy enemy power generators that fuel entire captured cities. Each city is guarded by four deadly defense zones – space mines, laser gates, anti-air missiles, and enemy fighters. Survive them all to face and destroy the generator, then move on to the next city. It's a fast-paced shooter demanding sharp reflexes, precise flying, and nerves of steel.

meta.name: General Knowledge Builder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

General Knowledge Builder presents the player with various questions related to mathematics and logic. There are four difficulty levels, ranging from simple tasks to more complex challenges. If needed, a wordplay hint can be used to help find the correct word and answer the question.

meta.name: Genesis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.53 KB

Genesis is set in a primordial era where insectoid lifeforms battle for survival and ecosystem dominance. You play as a scorpion fending off a deadly invasion of killer spiders. Viewed from above, you patrol the top edge of a tunnel while enemies rise from below. Venom volleys destroy them, but if they reach the top, they tear lethal holes in the tunnel wall. Each wave adds platforms that let spiders dodge and change direction. A color-changing brick also moves along the edge – one color means death, the other offers shields, score multipliers, and wall repair. Accurate shooting is key – high hit rates earn extra lives. Quick reflexes and steady aim are essential to survive.

meta.name: Genloc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Genloc is a platform game similar to Hawkeye. The scientist Dr. Klein has created a "genmanipulated dragon" which has escaped from his lab. The hero, Shimon, must now destroy the dragon eggs to stop the beast from breeding.
The game consists of three levels. On each level the player must travel back and forth, in order to find and destroy eggs that appear one at a time. On his way, Shimon is menaced by undending hordes of respawning enemies of various kinds. The creatures can be avoided or shot with Shimon's gun. Shimon's energy, represented by a hourglass meter, gets depleted when he comes in close contact with the monsters, but it slowly regenerates on its own after a while. There is also a time limit, which is replenished once the player finds an egg. Running out of energy or time, or falling off the bottom of the screen, means losing a life.
After a specified number of eggs is found, the monsters disappear and a dragon boss appears, which must be killed to complete the level.

In Genocide you pilot a spaceship and must shoot down all enemies on screen in classic Space Invaders style. The enemy units move in formations and fire back as you dodge and aim your shots carefully. With each level, the difficulty increases – fast reflexes and constant firepower are key to surviving and scoring big.

meta.name: Geo-Matrix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.46 KB

Geo-Matrix is a puzzle game where you must replicate the given image on the right side within the left area. You have various shapes and patterns at your disposal while the clock is constantly ticking. Skill and speed are crucial to mastering the challenge.

meta.name: GeoDestruct
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.27 KB

In Geodestruct (also known as Meteors or Meteors), you take on the role of a defender of Earth in the year 2285. Using a crosshair, you must fend off swarms of meteorites that are hurtling towards the planet in order to destroy it. The game requires quick reactions as you must destroy the approaching meteors in time before they hit the Earth. You can play the game alone or in two-player mode and must try to prevent planetary destruction by shooting down as many meteors as possible.

meta.name: Geoff Capes Strongman Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.06 KB

In Geoff Capes Strongman Challenge, you face six classic strongman competition events, such as truck pulling, tug-of-war, and wrestling, all of which must be completed within a time limit. Points are awarded based on the remaining time. The game includes a strategic element, as you can allocate strength across the eight main muscles after a power-building phase. During the events, you need to react quickly and activate the relevant muscles via a cursor to achieve maximum performance. Any unused energy carries over to the next events, rewarding careful planning.

The player must make strategic decisions and think quickly to find the correct solutions and progress. As the game advances, the challenges become more complex, requiring precise analysis of angles, areas, and relationships.

meta.name: Geopolitique 1990
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Geopolitique 1990 is an economic simulation in which the player takes control of the USA and tries to defeat the USSR. There are seven scenarios, one representing the actual political situation in 1984 and six hypothetical situations in 1990. The success of a nation is measured by three values: gross national product (trade), prestige (politics) and national security (military). Before each game, the player chooses two of these three values, and if both reach a certain number (depending on the scenario), the game is won. Or, well, lost if the AI was faster. The game does not simulate all countries in the world; in addition to the two opponents, the USA and the USSR, there are only 14 “small countries”, which mostly represent certain regions such as Western Europe.

meta.name: Germany 1985 : When Superpowers Collide
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Germany 1985: When Superpowers Collide" is an operational-level computer strategy game simulating the conflict between NATO and Soviet forces in West Germany. Players choose between two scenarios. In "ADVANCE-TO-CONTACT," Russian and U.S. forces of equal strength race to establish a cohesive front line. In "INVASION," the battle begins with a Soviet airborne drop behind NATO lines aimed at blocking roads and capturing towns to support the advancing main forces. Terrain, especially a river dividing the 28x39 hex-grid battlefield, plays a significant role. In both scenarios, the objective is to control the most towns to achieve victory.

p: Gerry the Germ Goes Body Poppin' (Europe).T64
n: Gerry the Germ Goes Body Poppin' (Europe)

meta.name: Gerry the Germ Goes Body Poppin'
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.62 KB

Gerry the Germ didn't get his Stinkploma and was expelled from the Illtitute of Infectology. He decides to infect a human to prove he deserves it. You play as Gerry and must navigate through five body parts to make the human sick. In the lungs, you collect oxygen cans; in the kidneys, you gather kidney beans; in the stomach, you collect acid to dissolve an aspirin. In the pancreas, you infect medical supplies on a train and stop the train by throwing coal pieces at the conductor. In the heart, you must find your way across a bridge and infect the heart. If you fail, there's a bonus screen where you have to collect a toilet roll in a rowboat to block a dripping faucet.

meta.name: Gertie Goose : The Lost Eggs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.47 KB

Gertie Goose: The Lost Eggs tells the story of a goose whose eight eggs were stolen by the Demon King, and you help her recover them. Seen from an elevated viewpoint, you explore a large forest area, avoid obstacles and soldiers, and search for colored keys to unlock matching doors. Each door leads to a section of the inner sanctum where one egg must be collected and safely carried to the exit. If an enemy touches you while carrying an egg, part of it is taken by the Demon King, and in the end victory or defeat is decided by comparing the number of eggs you collected with his – with the chosen skill level determining how forgiving or demanding the challenge will be.

meta.name: Gertrude's Puzzles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.75 KB

Gertrude's Puzzles invites you into Gertrude's house, where you solve small thinking tasks from room to room by matching shapes, colors, and patterns correctly. With Gertrude's help, you move, sort, and combine objects on different play areas until each puzzle comes together neatly. Small prizes can be collected as rewards – creating a friendly educational game that playfully trains logic and careful observation.

meta.name: Gertrude's Secrets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.88 KB

Gertrude's Secrets leads you into a playful maze of chambers where Gertrude the goose has small secrets waiting for you. Instead of fighting, the focus is on puzzles: you pick up objects, place them in the right spots, and solve tasks built around colors, shapes, patterns, and sorting. With rising difficulty, collectible rewards, and many little surprises, it becomes a friendly learning adventure – especially appealing for anyone who enjoys combining discovery with puzzle-solving.

meta.name: Get Four
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.12 KB

Try to get four in a row before your opponent does. Your game piece falls into the lowest available position of the chosen column. Get Four is the classic vertical version of "Tic-Tac-Toe." You can play either against a friend or against the computer, aiming to line up four pieces in a row. The computer can use one of four different strategies.

meta.name: Get Off my Garden!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.49 KB

Get Off my Garden puts you in control of G.A.R.F., a farming robot tasked with making six Aquaronum Upshootus bloom. You must refill your tank at the tap, water the plants until they shoot upward and flower, all while fending off creatures swarming the screen like Mutant Camels and Galaxians. Armed with JM84 Pesticide, you can fight back, but every hit drains your energy – when it runs out, you lose one of seven lives. Staying on the ground restores energy, flying gives you more mobility but steadily drains your strength. If you manage to make all six plants bloom before time runs out, you advance to the next stage, with the option to jump straight into any of the first 32 levels via keyboard selection.

meta.name: Get'em
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Get'em is a fast-paced maze game heavily inspired by Forget Me Not. Your goal is to collect all the crosses in each level, which makes a key appear that unlocks the exit. Along the way, you must navigate narrow passages, avoid enemies, and find the right route to prevent getting trapped. Speed, sharp timing, and a clear overview of the maze are essential to successfully make your escape.

meta.name: Get'em DX
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Get'em DX takes you into the Nyarlu Dungeons of Infinity, where Getty and Emma are imprisoned by the Troll King. But the two heroes refuse to give up and plan yet another escape. To break free, you must collect all the crosses in the maze, causing a key to appear, which you then place into the exit lock. Meanwhile, creatures constantly emerge to block your path and stop you. Skill, timing, and clever navigation through the maze are crucial to escape captivity.

meta.name: Gettysburg : The Turning Point
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Gettysburg: The Turning Point, you take command in one of the most pivotal battles of the American Civil War. Across 42 turns – each representing one hour of the real conflict from July 1–3, 1863 – you lead your forces, secure objectives, and manage casualties. Points are awarded for territory and combat success, with victory determined by a scoring table. Three rule sets and five difficulty levels add strategic depth and historical immersion.

meta.name: GFL Championship Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

GFL Championship Football was an early adopter of the first-person perspective in team sports games. You see through the eyes of the current player – from quarterback to receiver to kicker. Passing and catching are done by aiming with on-screen hands and rotating controls to select direction. There are 28 fictional teams across four divisions, each rated in 8 skill categories. Team and play selections use diagonal movement. With classic Gridiron rules and immersive gameplay, it stands apart from the Xs-and-Os style common at the time.

meta.name: Ghost Chaser
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.41 KB

In Ghost Chaser you will meet Harry the Ghost Chaser and a host of strange adversaries as you explore the 16 different rooms of mysterious Fairport Manor. Points are scored each time you blast the various Phantom Ghosts which materialise at random. The only way to capture these spirits is to find your way into the treasure room. Scattered throughout the manor are eight keys. As you find and collect these keys, additional doors open allowing you to go deeper and deeper into the manor. Watch out for the many tricky obstacles and above all, avoid contact with anything that moves! They'll send shivers up and down your spine!

meta.name: Ghostdriver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.53 KB

Ghostdriver puts the player in control of a blue car that must collect all the flags while avoiding the unpredictable red ghost car. The player takes on the role of a peaceful citizen navigating the streets safely while reckless ghost drivers create chaos. The car is controlled using a joystick, with a button press providing a speed boost – but caution is required, as obstacles may suddenly appear. Various bonus items appear on the road: a bomb can take a life from either the player or the ghost driver, a STOP sign temporarily halts the vehicle, an “S” grants 100 bonus points, and a Smiley provides an extra life.

meta.name: Ghost Hunt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.94 KB

Ghost Hunt is a charming action game where players control a blinking circle to catch mischievous ghosts and guide them into a box on the screen. Originally known as Schloß Schreckenstein, the game was later released in other regions. Players must react quickly and skillfully to catch the ghosts and collect points.

meta.name: Ghost Hunter II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.14 KB

This is an entertaining version of the now-classic Pac-Man. The innovations compared to the classic versions are as follows: First, it allows for two-player gameplay in an exciting competition where players try to steal points from each other and lure their opponent into the ghosts' grasp. During the game, there's a last-ditch rescue option where you can become invisible for a fraction of a second by pressing the joystick button. This feature can only be used once per screen. Additionally, it is possible to regenerate lives by collecting parts of the ghost's head, which appear near the ghost cage for a limited time. There are 15 screen layouts, which can either be selected before starting or randomly chosen by the game.

meta.name: Ghost Hunters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ghost Hunters sends you as Hunk Studbuckle into the sinister Manor of Nightmares, as his brother Chuck has vanished there while hunting ghosts. Armed with a compact anti-matter ghost launcher, you move from room to room while your terror steadily rises and drains your energy – only by destroying the lurking spirits in time or retreating quickly can you survive. Scattered potions provide brief relief, yet the tension never fades, as every encounter could be your last. In two-player mode, you share the task – one controls Hunk while the other aims the weapon – making the hunt even more intense and nerve-racking.

meta.name: Ghost Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.61 KB

In "Ghost Manor," you must rescue your friend from the top floor of a grim mansion. In the cemetery outside the mansion, a friendly rainbow ghost or skeleton provides you with spears. Armed with these weapons, you fight your way through the guarded entrance and into the house, collecting treasures and crosses along the way. On the top floor, you face Dracula, who is holding your friend captive. Using the crosses, you must defeat him and free your friend before time runs out. You have only four minutes to complete this mission.

meta.name: Ghost Mansion II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.08 KB

You are Kra, the fearless adventurer who has decided to risk it all and storm the Ghost Mansion. Inside, there are many diamonds guarded by a variety of ghosts, spiders, snakes, and other vile creatures. Beware of traps and dark magic! Each room holds its own dangers. Complete all 5 levels of the Forbidden Castle by collecting all the diamonds. Access to the next screen is granted once all the diamonds on the current screen are collected.

meta.name: Ghost Mansion III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.28 KB

Ghost Mansion III is a single-player arcade game. An immeasurable wealth of diamonds is hidden in an ancient castle. It may seem like a simple task to collect the treasure, but the rooms are guarded by various traps and guardians. The player controls a small character who can move in all directions, attempting to collect all the gemstones on the screen and then reach the exit on the right side of the screen. There are a total of 5 levels, and the dangers include conveyor belts, doppelgängers, and rockets. The player starts with 5 lives.

meta.name: The Ghost of Genghis Khan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Ghost of Genghis Khan for the Commodore 64 is an interesting blend of action and narrative. The story revolves around a time portal that brings the spirit of the infamous Mongol conqueror Genghis Khan into the present. As events unfold, Dr. Helga Smith, a parapsychologist investigating the incident, is kidnapped by Khan. Players take on the role(s) of the "Guardians of Time" and must face various challenges to rescue Dr. Smith and return Khan to his rightful place in history. The game combines arcade action with a narrative element, offering players a diverse experience that includes both problem-solving and action-packed gameplay elements.

meta.name: Ghost Town
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.24 KB

El antiguo pueblo fronterizo está desierto desde hace mucho tiempo, pero aún se pueden recuperar trece tesoros de la engañosa quietud de su mina cerrada y de Boot Hill. Descubre pasadizos secretos y navega por una corriente sobrenatural subyacente usando tu analizador de texto VERBO SUSTANTIVO lo mejor que puedas mientras cabalgas sobre un potro salvaje, abres una caja fuerte y aprendes las reglas del juego con el espíritu de un chamán fallecido hace mucho tiempo.

meta.name: Ghost Trap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ghost Trap is a Pac-Man clone that combines the classic gameplay with many varied maze variations. As you navigate through the different levels, you must avoid ghosts and collect points as usual, but the mazes constantly change, adding extra challenges. Different layouts and new elements make the game feel different every time, forcing the player to adjust their strategy.

meta.name: Ghostbusters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.97 KB

En Ghostbusters, lideras un equipo encargado de salvar Nueva York de un desastre paranormal. Contratado por el alcalde y con fondos iniciales, cazas fantasmas: vigilas el mapa para detectar nuevas apariciones, conduces entre el tráfico y llegas a tiempo al lugar. Allí usas rayos de protones y trampas para capturar espíritus y reducir la energía PK de la ciudad. El dinero ganado sirve para mejorar equipo. Si la actividad paranormal se descontrola, despiertan el Templo de Zuul y Gozer —y solo con preparación previa tendrás alguna posibilidad en la batalla final.

meta.name: Ghostbusters II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ghostbusters II se desarrolla en tres intensas escenas:
1.- Cloacas: Un Cazafantasmas desciende recolectando muestras de lodo mientras fantasmas intentan cortar su cuerda o agotar su coraje. Se defiende con rayos de protones, bombas o un escudo, y recoge mejoras y piezas para el recolector de lodo.
2.- Estatua de la Libertad: Animada por el lodo, marcha hacia el Museo de Arte. Usa su antorcha para eliminar oleadas de fantasmas, mientras pequeños ayudantes recogen lodo en tierra para mantener su energía.
3.- Museo (combate final): Los cuatro Cazafantasmas descienden en rápel (puedes cambiar entre ellos) para derrotar a Janosz, rescatar al bebé Oscar y atrapar a Vigo en el cruce de rayos de protones.

meta.name: Ghosthunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.09 KB

"Ghosthunter" (1983) for the Commodore 64 is about ghosts trying to catch the player. With a spear, the ghosts must be defeated while simultaneously avoiding the water to stay safe. Speed and precision are required to survive and defeat the ghosts.

meta.name: Ghosts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.52 KB

A game from the infamous “Cassette 50” collection.
In this Pac-Man "clone," encountering a ghost means death unless you've eaten a Power Pill. Eat bonus fruits to score extra points. Eat a “*” and you can kill a ghost.

meta.name: Ghosts'n Goblins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La bella princesa es secuestrada. Su amante, el Caballero de Brillante Armadura, armado con cinco armas diferentes para combatir al enemigo, se dispone a rescatarla. El Caballero, con la ayuda de tu habilidad, deberá atravesar siete puertas custodiadas, luchando y destruyendo demonios, dragones, gigantes y zombis. Ghosts 'N Goblins es emocionante... ¡te desafía a ti y al Caballero a rescatar a la princesa, en medio de un gran peligro, escapando del Hades, la tierra de los enemigos!

meta.name: Ghosttown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.72 KB

Ghosttown sends you through a Wild West shooting gallery packed with cowboy targets and unsuspecting townsfolk. You must shoot the bandits quickly while avoiding innocent bystanders. You can't take damage, but missing targets drains your ammo, and once it's gone, the round ends. Reaching the end of the level restarts the same stage with less ammunition and faster action – a relentless challenge of speed and accuracy.

meta.name: Ghosty (France)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 410.14 KB

meta.name: Ghouls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ghouls takes you into a haunted mansion where legendary power jewels await. You battle your way through ghost caves, spooky halls, spider rooms and a deadly tower, facing traps and creatures at every turn. Poison spikes, unstable platforms and bouncing spiders demand precise jumps and sharp timing. Yellow bonuses grant points, while power jewels temporarily banish ghosts. A ticking bonus counter adds pressure – fail to reach the top in time and you lose a life. With limited lives and occasional extras, it becomes a tense race against both time and terror.

meta.name: Ghouls'n Gremlins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ghouls'n Gremlins follows closely in the footsteps of Ghosts'n Goblins, differing only in small details. You take the role of a knight whose beloved has been kidnapped by a demon. On your rescue quest, hordes of enemies stand in your way – from zombies and ghosts to demons and even carnivorous plants that shoot at you. Across four varied levels, you must battle through until you finally set her free.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Ghouls'n Ghosts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

¡Arturo regresa! El intrépido caballero vuelve en esta espectacular secuela de Ghosts 'n' Goblins (¡uno de los 10 mejores juegos de 1986, nada menos!). Han pasado tres años desde que las fuerzas del mal vinieron a sembrar el caos. Ahora han regresado y han capturado a la Princesa Hus. Pero nuestro valeroso Arturo no se amilana y cabalga al rescate, enfrentándose a un temible ejército de enemigos espeluznantes...

meta.name: G.I. Joe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

G. I. Joe: A Real American Hero es un videojuego de acción shoot 'em up de 1985.
Al principio del juego, el jugador selecciona un juego de un solo jugador o de dos jugadores. El objetivo como uno de los miembros del equipo de G.I. Joe es eliminar cualquier amenaza de Cobra y capturar ocho operativos de Cobra. El juego no se puede completar si se colocan demasiados miembros de cualquiera de los dos lados en la cárcel, ya que otros miembros son liberados para perpetuar el juego.
Se utilizan dos modos de juego: secciones de combate vehicular aéreo, donde el jugador controla a un miembro de las Fuerzas Especiales de G.I. Joe, y peleas uno contra uno con operativos de Cobra. En la parte de combate aéreo del juego, el jugador podía seleccionar a uno de los ocho miembros del equipo Joe (como Snake Eyes), para enfrentarse en combate contra uno de los ocho agentes de Cobra (como Zartan). Hay diferentes ubicaciones geográficas, como bosques, desierto y tundra ártica. Cada personaje tenía acceso a un vehículo de la serie G.I. Joe, como el helicóptero Dragonfly, el avión Rattler, el M.O.B.A.T. o el tanque H.I.S.S.

meta.name: Giant's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.33 KB

Giant's Revenge continues the story of Jack and the Beanstalk. Months after the first adventure, Jack finds a mysterious hole in his garden emitting a strange glow. Deep below, the giant—having survived the fall—has built a network of seven caves filled with traps and treasures, including the “Elixir of Life.” To claim the riches, Jack must jump with precision, avoid traps, and navigate deadly drops.

meta.name: Gift Craze
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.73 KB

meta.name: Giger Pool
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.75 KB

Giger Pool is a classic game of skill in which the aim is to sink the balls into the pockets with precision and tactics. The player must use the cue skillfully and hit the balls in a targeted manner in order to reach the best possible position and sink as many balls as possible. With clear rules and the familiar goal of sinking all the balls into the table, "Billiards" challenges players to carefully plan their shot direction, strength and angle. Any wrong move can make the next move more difficult, so a cool head and a steady hand are required.

meta.name: Gilbert : Escape from Drill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.58 KB

Gilbert: Escape from Drill follows the slimy TV alien back to his home planet, where he must quickly repair his spaceship to sign his next contract. The fed-up citizens have hidden crucial ship parts throughout a maze-like city. As you explore its twisting streets, enemies attack, but Gilbert can fight back using his snot. Defeating enough foes on a single screen reveals power-ups that grant abilities such as floating and can be stored for later use. Key clues come from arcade machines that lead to mini-games – achieve a high score and a missing ship part appears somewhere in the city, guiding you closer to escape.

meta.name: Gilligan's Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.98 KB

Gilligan's Gold takes you into a gold mine where you must collect sacks of gold while avoiding greedy bandits. To escape, you can hop on mine carts, climb down ladders, and use lifts, but beware of the deadly mine shafts. Each bag brings you closer to fortune, but only quick reflexes and clever moves will keep you ahead of your pursuers.

meta.name: Girltris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

GirlTRIS is a classic Tetris game with some adult elements. Each level requires completing designated number of puzzles rows. Filling the task discovers a new image of a girl. The game features five difficulty levels, differing with number of rows necessary to complete the task and speed of falling bricks.

meta.name: Gitty's Dream
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Clone of The Great Giana Sisters, made by Gitty with new levels
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Gitty's Dream II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Clone of The Great Giana Sisters, but with new levels
