p: Give my Regards to Broad Street (Europe).D64
n: Give my Regards to Broad Street (Europe)

meta.name: Give my Regards to Broad Street
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Give my Regards to Broad Street is based on the 1984 film of the same name and puts you in the role of Paul McCartney. After the master tape of his new album is erased, he has until midnight on Saturday to remix the song “No More Lonely Nights.” To do so, you must drive across London, track down seven band members each carrying part of the tune, and return everything to Abbey Road Studios. Maps of London and the Underground help with planning, while the on-board computer constantly shows targets, stations, and remaining time. Along the way, you must avoid crashes, dodge Rath's thugs, and time your arrivals at Tube stations to escape penalties from parking authorities.

meta.name: Gladiator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.50 KB

"Gladiator" tells the story of Marcus of Massina, who is captured and taken to Rome as a slave after his village is destroyed by Roman legions. There, he is sold to a gladiator school and must fight in the arena for glory and his freedom. Victories in combat and clever betting allow him to earn money, which he can eventually use to buy his way out. Before each battle, various weapon combinations can be chosen, each with its own advantages and disadvantages. During fights, numerous movement options are available. In addition to the single-player mode, there is also the option to compete against other players.

meta.name: Gladiator (Keypunch Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Released as part of the "Amazing Journeys" game pack. Choose your weapon well! Become an ancient gladiator trading blows with the enemy warriors that threaten to take your life. You must choose your weapons and your special fighting outfit and face your enemy.

meta.name: Gladiator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.69 KB

Gladiator puts the player in the role of Gluteus, a gladiator who must rescue his beloved Zulana from the emperor's dungeons. Zulana is to be sentenced to death for resisting the advances of Emperor Nero, and it is up to Gluteus to fight his way through the dangers of ancient Rome to save her before she becomes a victim of the lions.

meta.name: Gladiator's 2000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Gladiators 2000" lets players engage in fast-paced battles with light vehicles, where the goal is to trap the opponent in their own trails. The game is known for its intense action and minimalist graphics, reminiscent of the classic Tron games.

meta.name: The Gladiator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.72 KB

"Gladiator" puts players in the role of an experienced gladiator participating in an intense Roman arena tournament. In the game, you fight against various beasts and collect weapons scattered throughout the arena to survive. It offers vibrant and dynamic combat, diving deep into the theme of ancient Roman gladiatorial fights, while telling an engaging survival story.

meta.name: Gladiators
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.12 KB

You are the best helicopter pilot there is and due to your heroics you are now part of the Gladiator Squadron. Your job is to patrol over unconquered lands to keep the peace. One day while patrolling eight small islands you receive a call for help. To secure these islands that have great strategic importance, you must go in and destroy the enemy so land forces can move in.
To stop you in your path there are lot's of enemy vehicles like helicopters, planes, trucks and boats. Buildings, bridges and aircraft by airfields are needed to be destroyed as well. Power-ups can be collected to help you on your quest which upgrade your weapon, damage meter or score.

meta.name: Glider Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.64 KB

Glider Pilot is a flight simulation allowing you to try to fly a glider around a 160km course before landing. Before you fly you can pick five levels of weather (1 is the easiest) or adjust various weather parameters yourself. To start flying the course and to start the timer, you have to cross the runway below then you have to attempt to turn at two points on the airfield before attempting to land on the runway. As a glider has no engine you have to use thermals, which is rising warm air to keep in the air. Thermals are invisible so the position of Cumulus clouds in the distance give an indication of where the thermals are.

meta.name: Glider Rider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.12 KB

El gobierno mundial ha tomado la decisión de eliminar Abraxas Corporation, una organización de venta de armas que apoya a dictadores y terroristas. Como miembro de la fuerza de élite Silent But Deadly, has sido enviado a destruir su altamente fortificada Isla Abracus.
¡Tu misión es desactivar los 10 reactores nucleares de la isla en menos de media hora...!
Un barco te ha dejado discretamente a ti y a tu nueva especie de moto en una de las playas de la isla. En efecto, tu moto puede transformarse en ala delta, siempre que encuentres algo de pendiente para despegar.
Debes utilizar el ala delta para bombardear los reactores, que están fuertemente custodiados por láseres. Para debilitar los láseres temporalmente, puedes sacudir los pilones que los alimentan...

meta.name: Global Commander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Armageddon Man" is a game in which the player leads a conflict between the 16 nations of the U.N.N. each with its own level of technology and natural resources. The player's nation can deploy laser defense satellites to stop missile attacks launched between nations, as well as three reconnaissance satellites to track military activity. The player receives memos when one nation makes a demand on another, and the player is also able to scan radio frequencies to detect encrypted messages.

meta.name: Globetrotter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Globetrotter, you control a bat used to bounce a basketball from the left side of the level to the right, placing it in a basket before the timer runs out. You can move the bat freely across the screen and adjust its angle by holding the fire button, rotating it 360 degrees left or right. The ball bounces off obstacles but bursts if it touches certain objects – costing you 10 seconds. Once you get the ball into the basket, you move on to the next level and receive a bonus for any remaining time. Two players can play simultaneously, and both advance if one scores. If a player moves off the screen, they lose 10 seconds. At the start, you can choose one of the first five levels.

meta.name: Glug Glug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.15 KB

As a deep sea diver, you sense an opportunity to gain untold wealth from the large number of treasures which have drifted to the bottom of the ocean. You do this by attaching yourself to your diving station and moving down the infested waters, grabbing an item of treasure and moving it back up to the station.

meta.name: Gnome
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.88 KB

In Gnome, you guide a small character through a multi-level building with elevators, platforms, and hidden paths. Your goal is to collect a letter, follow the executioner, and hang the letter on a peg at the bottom. Watch out for the witch who throws lightning and can freeze you. You can switch to the background layer to hide behind objects or access secret routes. Once all letters are collected, they form a word.

meta.name: Gnome Ranger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Gnome Ranger you play Ingrid Bottomlow, a brilliant gnome exiled by her family and teleported into a forest. This text adventure is split into three parts loosely themed around animal, vegetable and mineral. You'll defeat a witch, solve the Riddle of the Shrinking Teapot, and gather precious gems. Commands like FOLLOW, GO TO and GIVE allow you to interact with characters who have their own agendas. Cooperation and item use are key, not map-making. With quirky touches like adding a 'g' to every word starting with 'n' – expect to see things like 'gnorth' and 'gnugget'.

Based upon the Milton Bradley board game of the same name, players attempt to travel through a number of different classrooms to be the first player to graduate. There are three difficulty levels available. Players take turns rolling dice, which determines how many desks they travel. As they travel to different classrooms, they receive multiple choice trivia questions related to the topic they are in. If the player answers the question correctly, they move forwards.

meta.name: Go-Kart Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.02 KB

Go-Kart Simulator is a top down multi-scrolling driving game where you control a go-kart and drive around a maze picking up all the bonuses on each level to progress to the next one. As you drive around looking for the bonuses, you will encounter other drivers and these must be avoided or you lose one of three lives. Your go-kart is equipped with a limited number of smoke-bombs which delays the other drivers for a limited time, and more bombs can be found around the maze. Also on screen is a radar showing all the bonuses, bombs and other drivers and each level has to be completed within a time limit.

meta.name: Gobang
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.68 KB

Play against the computer and try to make 5 in a row to win.

meta.name: Goblin Towers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Goblin Towers, you venture into an ancient forest where a mysterious castle is said to stand, guarded by goblins and holding a great treasure. Your journey begins in an abandoned hut, regarded by the villagers as a shrine. From there, you explore the forest until you discover the castle, then continue your search inside, always aiming to find the treasure and make your escape. The game is entirely text-based and controlled via keyboard. Commands like “Go north” or more complex ones such as “Put the red apple in a metal bucket” guide your actions and shape the course of your adventure.

meta.name: God Slayer
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.35 KB

meta.name: Gods and Heroes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.01 KB

In the sequel, you once again play as Hercules, tasked with conquering over 50 individual screens. On each screen, you must collect an item to progress to the next. You'll need to skillfully navigate platforms and avoid various creatures, as touching an enemy costs you one of your three lives. Springs help you jump higher, and there are hidden platforms that only appear when you jump on them. Some platforms are forbidden and cannot be stepped on.

meta.name: Godzilla
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.10 KB

Godzilla threatens Japan and it's up to the player to use the combined force of Japan's army, navy, air force, and nuclear arsenal to defeat him. Godzilla is a turn-based game played out over Japan and its surrounding waters which are mapped out on a grid. Godzilla starts randomly on the map and moves erratically from tile to tile. On the player's turn, the player can attack Godzilla with available units in the same sector as Godzilla, move units to an adjacent sector, launch a missile at Godzilla or authorize an atomic strike. At the end of each turn, the game tallies the damage done to Godzilla and the corresponding loss to Japanese forces and the civilian population. The game ends either with Godzilla's death or with Godzilla victorious over a devastated Japan.

meta.name: Gogo the Ghost
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.54 KB

Gogo the Ghost puts you in control of a small, friendly ghost exploring 150 chambers of a haunted castle. Your mission is to collect objects while avoiding the evil forces that threaten you. With skill and persistence, you move closer to your ultimate goal – freeing the dream princess. Convenient level codes let you continue your adventure from where you last left off.

meta.name: Gold-Dust Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The players have been stranded on a gold laden tropical island, with their job being to collect as much gold as possible before escaping the island via boat.
The island contains a well for drinking water, a forest for boat building, and a gold field. Each turn, a player can either move between different locations, dig for gold, work on building a boat, fill their well, fetch water, or trade with each other. Gameplay time is limited by a tropical cyclone which will destroy all human life on the island if not escaped in time. The players have a limited supply of water, starting with 10 days worth. If they run out of water, they will die of dehydration, thus water supplies need to be maintained.

meta.name: Golddigger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.16 KB

„Golddigger“ challenges you to dig out all the gold on each screen. However, some gold caches are difficult to access, and you have a limited amount of dynamite. Plan your route carefully to avoid dead ends and collect all the gold successfully.

meta.name: Golden Axe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En el pasado, se libró una terrible guerra entre los Dioses, los creadores del mundo, y los Titanes. Los Titanes fueron derrotados gracias a un arma superpoderosa forjada por los Dioses, llamada el "Golden Axe". Gracias a esta arma, los Titanes fueron desterrados, y los Dioses legaron la Tierra a los humanos. Sin embargo, un Titán había sobrevivido: Death Adder. Se apoderó del "Golden Axe" y la utilizó para arrasar el mundo. Secuestró al rey de Yuria y a su hija y amenazó con ejecutarlos si los habitantes no se sometían incondicionalmente. Tres héroes, decididos a vengarse de Death Adder, parten en su busca.
Cada personaje tiene una habilidad mágica especial que puede cargarse pateando a pequeñas criaturas que sueltan una poción.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #01 : Golden Baton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.36 KB

Your mission is to retrieve the Golden Baton, a priceless artifact worshipped by your race for eons. It maintains balance and keeps peace in the land, but now it has been stolen from the Palace of King Ferrenuil! Many have searched for it, none have returned. The player will face wolves and crabs, navigate a boat trip, and deal with a magical crystal. Most of the way, you use one object in some way to gain another.
Golden Baton uses the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus has the same features - a basic 2-word parser, limited vocabulary (object names plus standard words such as EXAMINE, WEAR and DROP), and brief descriptions. A Help command is also available which provides hints. Although primitive by later standards, these compare favourably to other interactive fiction of the time.

meta.name: Golden Oldies - Volume 1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Probably the first retro collection offered to the buying public – this compilation features four classic computer games (or more precisely, three computer games and an adaptation of an electronic video game). Play Eliza, Conway's Life, Crowther's Adventure or Al Alcorn's Pong. All four games are free adaptations – there's no standard version of Eliza, and this one compares well with others. Pong is presented as an ASCII representation of the game (and includes a remake with colors!). Meanwhile, Life offers various pre-formed populations, including the infamous "Glider Gun" – which holds a prominent place in Steven Levy's book Hackers.

meta.name: Golden Oldies - Volume 1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Probably the first retro collection offered to the buying public – this compilation features four classic computer games (or more precisely, three computer games and an adaptation of an electronic video game). Play Eliza, Conway's Life, Crowther's Adventure or Al Alcorn's Pong. All four games are free adaptations – there's no standard version of Eliza, and this one compares well with others. Pong is presented as an ASCII representation of the game (and includes a remake with colors!). Meanwhile, Life offers various pre-formed populations, including the infamous "Glider Gun" – which holds a prominent place in Steven Levy's book Hackers.

meta.name: The Golden Pyramids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Golden Pyramids – Suddenly, the sky darkened, and thunder and lightning intensified. Fire and death swept across the world, instilling fear in the hearts of many. The ancient leaders were awakened, their spirits rising from their eternal slumber to unite and put an end to the hunt for gold. This hunt is YOURS!

meta.name: The Golden Voyage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.97 KB

La duodécima y última aventura de la serie principal de Scott Adams, ¡y probablemente también la que menos variaciones de empaque presenta! El rey está enfermo y solo TÚ puedes salvarlo. Debes recuperar un elixir mágico de una tierra lejana antes de que sea demasiado tarde. En este juego, te adentrarás en los mares y recorrerás tierras mágicas con templos, fuentes mágicas y mucho más. Aunque este es el último juego de la serie principal, sigue utilizando el mismo analizador básico de dos palabras.

meta.name: Goldfields
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Goldfields is a historical simulation that takes you back to the 19th-century gold rush. Arriving by ship at the port of Suze, you can choose whether to work in town, head to Fields Town, or venture into mining camps such as Damp Camp or Goldfields. Your goal is to gather as much money, gold, and experience as possible within a year. Along the way, you must manage your health and legal standing, as sickness or trouble with the law can quickly end your progress. To protect yourself from robbers, you can also purchase a weapon.

meta.name: Goldshaft Deluxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Goldshaft Deluxe – You are Goldshaft, the lone force who can save Bedlam City in 1976 from a wave of crime, bribery and violence under the rule of crime boss Ugly Fat Joe. Using raw force, toughness, and a hefty dose of “Gold Taft” hairspray, you clear the streets, fight your way through thugs and gangsters, and do whatever it takes to regain control of the city.

meta.name: Archdale Golf Club
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.09 KB

In Golf you play a full 18-hole round either solo or against a friend, taking turns after each shot. After entering your name and handicap, you select how many holes to play and are shown an overhead view of the first course. You choose the right club, set your aim precisely, and control the shot's power before watching the ball soar across the screen. Once on the green, the view switches overhead, letting you fine-tune direction and power to sink the putt. Precision, touch, and focus are the keys to mastering every fairway.

meta.name: Golf : St. Andrews
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.61 KB

The St. Andrews Old Course golf program is a precise recreation of the famous St. Andrews course. The game accommodates all handicap levels, from beginners to professionals, and is very easy to use. During gameplay, you are prompted to select your club, shot power, angle, and other settings.

meta.name: Golf Construction Set
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A golf simulation, along with a course editor for creating your own golf courses.
One to four players can compete against each other with individual handicaps in match or tournament play. Wind, temperature and ground conditions can be entered by the computer or determined randomly. When playing, the left half of the screen shows the situation from the player's perspective and the right half shows a map of the course. The player can choose between different clubs. You can individually choose the direction, angle of attack and spin for each shot. The strength of the shot must be carefully calibrated.
When setting up a course, you first select the length and par before placing the tee shot. You then draw the course boundaries and add objects such as greens, bunkers, water hazards and trees. Finally, you can choose the slope along the fairway and green.

meta.name: Golf's Best : Pinehurst 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Golf's Best: Pinehurst - World's Premier Golf Course is a golf simulation that allows the player to experience the layout and character of one of the world's most famous golf courses, Pinehurst. Each hole is reproduced true to scale. Wind is also designed similarly to Pinehurst. Each hole provides a top view and a side view. The wind on the route is shown by an arrow at the bottom of the screen. The bigger the arrow, the stronger the wind blows. The screen shows where the ball is, how far from the pin, what surface it is playing from and what shot is planned. Up to 4 players can play at the same time and choose which tee type they want to play from: Medal or Championship. The order of play is determined by honor points and the player with the lowest score on the previous hole plays first.

meta.name: Golf's Best : Pinehurst 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Golf's Best: Pinehurst - World's Premier Golf Course is a golf simulation that allows the player to experience the layout and character of one of the world's most famous golf courses, Pinehurst. Each hole is reproduced true to scale. Wind is also designed similarly to Pinehurst. Each hole provides a top view and a side view. The wind on the route is shown by an arrow at the bottom of the screen. The bigger the arrow, the stronger the wind blows. The screen shows where the ball is, how far from the pin, what surface it is playing from and what shot is planned. Up to 4 players can play at the same time and choose which tee type they want to play from: Medal or Championship. The order of play is determined by honor points and the player with the lowest score on the previous hole plays first.

meta.name: Goodness Gracious
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.69 KB

In Goodness Gracious, you control a frog-like dinosaur defending a red gem – the source of its power – on a single-screen battlefield. Hostile life-forms approach from different paths across the screen, aiming to reach the gem. Your only defense is a fireball launched by holding the fire button – the longer you hold, the farther it travels. But enemies can only be defeated as the fireball falls downward. Fireballs are limited, and more are awarded only for successful hits. After killing three enemies, you advance to the next level. If a creature touches the gem or you run out of fireballs – it's game over.

meta.name: Goofy's Railway Express
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este juego presenta a Goofy y Mickey viajando en tren. Es un videojuego educativo en 2D centrado en el reconocimiento de colores, formas y matemáticas.

meta.name: The Goonies
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En The Goonies controlarás a dos de los chicos de la película a través de ocho pantallas repletas de puzles. Solo trabajando juntos podrás evitar trampas mortales, calaveras voladoras, murciélagos y a los temibles Fratellis. Tu objetivo es encontrar el tesoro del barco pirata y salvar sus hogares, con Sloth uniéndose al final para ayudar con su vida.

meta.name: GooseBusters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.13 KB

In GooseBusters you aim at flying enemies using a crosshair and must react quickly to what happens on screen. Your task is to hit targets accurately and take down as many as possible, with speed and precision determining your success. The focus is entirely on direct action and fast reflexes.

meta.name: Gordian Tomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gordian Tomb sends you into a deadly pyramid as a daring relic hunter, clearly inspired by Montezuma's Revenge. You explore screen by screen, searching for tools that let you bypass traps, reach hidden areas, and ultimately uncover the secret treasure room. But an item can only be picked up after you've first found the room where it's needed – otherwise the game shrugs with a casual “Later dude!”. Wild animals, deadly hazards, and supernatural dangers lurk everywhere, while a constantly decreasing timer keeps the pressure high. With eight lives and no way to save, every step, every tool, and every clue matters if you want to conquer the pyramid in time.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Gorf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.24 KB

Gorf challenges you across four consecutive missions. First, you defend yourself behind a protective shield against aliens in classic formation. In the second stage, the shield is gone, and enemies swoop down in unpredictable patterns while bonus ships appear as extra targets. Next comes a hyperspace flight – from a behind-the-ship perspective, you must endure alien vessels attacking in circular formations until you reach your destination. The final level pits you against a single massive mothership, equipped with the same kind of shield you once had. Only a hit on its glowing weak spot can bring it down instantly.

meta.name: Gortek and the Kryptobytes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Gortek and the Kryptobytes” takes the player on another thrilling space adventure with Gortek. On the planet Xerat, a mysterious force threatens the Kryptobytes' data center, which houses valuable information from across the universe. Together with Gortek and the Microchips, the player works to neutralize the danger and save the center before it's too late. Throughout the mission, the player learns basic programming skills, which are further developed as the adventure progresses. Skill and ingenuity are essential to overcome this cosmic challenge.

meta.name: Gortek and the Microchips (USA) (Tape 1)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.73 MB

meta.name: Gortek and the Microchips (USA) (Tape 2)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.77 MB

meta.name: Gotcha!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.47 KB

"Gotcha!" is similar in spirit to “Breakout”, but instead of paddles, you control the side-to-side movement of an automatically bouncing ball. The goal of each level is to destroy all viable blocks. Colored blocks can only be vaporized when the ball matches their color. Watch out for moving enemies and skull blocks – touching either is fatal, though skulls behave like colored blocks and can also be removed if matched. The game features 40 levels – the second half unlocks after clearing the first 20 – as well as a two-player mode and a level editor.

meta.name: Gothik
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gothik takes you to the frozen lands north of Belorn, ruled by a dark lord who has shattered the druid Hasrinaxx into six body parts and hidden them within the towers of his vast castle. As a young warrior, you infiltrate the fortress to recover the guarded fragments, reunite them with the druid's robe, and ultimately defeat the evil ruler. You choose between two heroes with different strengths – greater resilience or stronger magical powers – and fight from a top-down perspective through the towers, confronting demons and minions while gradually restoring hope piece by piece – a dark adventure that demands courage, strategy, and perseverance.

meta.name: Gothmog's Lair
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gothmog's Lair is an interactive fiction adventure in a fantasy setting. There are no general location graphics; instead there are small animated graphics of key moments. The game includes character interaction and is 'real-time', meaning the other characters (such as animals and thieves) move around at the same time as you do. However, movement and combat are turn-based - you make a move, then the NPCs do. Commands include MOVE, GET and ATTACK, requiring two-letter direction initials.

meta.name: GP Tennis Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In GP Tennis Manager, you take charge of the career of an aspiring tennis player with the goal of reaching the top of the world rankings. You start with a budget and select a rookie player from countries like France, Italy, or the USA, considering traits such as playing hand, stamina, stroke techniques, age, and height. In the management phase, you pay tournament entry fees, buy rackets, seek sponsors, and analyze opponents. After tournaments, you can choose to train or rest to improve form. Matches can be either automatically simulated or played manually. The C64 version features a top-down view, with players controllable in eight directions on the court. Before starting, you can adjust career length, difficulty level, and the number of players. In multiplayer mode, players manage their careers sequentially but can play matches simultaneously.

meta.name: GR9 Strike Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.21 KB

Take control of your GR9 Harrier jet and navigate through a territory occupied by terrorists. Your mission is to clear the way for ground troops by destroying as many of their land and air defense systems as possible. The GR9 Harrier is controlled using a joystick, and the Run-Stop button pauses the attack while the player controls the aircraft. Pressing the Q key in pause mode will cancel the current mission. Your objective is to infiltrate enemy territory and destroy their land and air defenses to pave the way for your ground troops.

meta.name: Grab It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.76 KB

Grab-It is a side view single screen game where you control a grabber released by yourself to collect Nadium Blocks to take back to your planet of Cort for your people's survival over six levels. At the top of the screen is your ship and below is the grabber you move around the screen to pick up one of the eight blocks of Nadium at the bottom of the screen. Once you pick up a block, you take it to your ship but there are creatures also on the screen that need avoiding. The first level has one creature with the further levels having various numbers of the creatures and if you touch one then you lose one of three lives. Once all the blocks have been collected then you move to the next level and you can select a level at the start of the game. Two players can play and each player takes it turn to play when the other player loses a life.

meta.name: Grab-a-Crab
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.70 KB

Grab-A-Crab is a game where you play as Hobbler the Gobbler, who eats everything. You've discovered a cave full of old turtle eggs and must consume them across various levels to satisfy your enormous appetite. While eating the eggs in the maze, you must avoid four crabs that move through the maze. If a crab catches you, you lose one of your three lives. In each corner of the maze, you'll find dodo eggs that you can eat to temporarily allow you to eat the crabs. At the center of the maze, there's a lobster pot that gives you an extra dodo egg.

meta.name: Grabber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.59 KB

Grabber is a single-screen, top-view maze game in which the player moves a creature around the screen and collects treasure in the form of bones on different levels. The screen has two mazes and the player can switch between both mazes by pressing the fire button. The player must then grab a piece of treasure and bring it to the center of one of the mazes.
There are eight treasure pieces, four for each maze, to grab and place. As the player moves, various creatures appear and move around the maze. These must be avoided. Yellow bones can be collected and these allow the player to kill the creatures. However, occasionally an indestructible creature appears that can only be avoided. The creatures that the player can kill also take the treasure from the center and place it somewhere else in the labyrinth.

meta.name: Gradius
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.76 KB

Los habitantes de Gradius están en problemas. Los Bacterions han lanzado un ataque frontal contra el planeta, y te toca volar a la batalla y salvarlos. En el camino podrás mejorar tu nave con hiper velocidad, campos de fuerza, rayos láser, misiles, cañones de doble haz y más para ayudarte en la la batalla.
Gradius es un shooter de desplazamiento lateral. Disparos a ciertos enemigos dejarán una vaina encendida detrás que se pueden recoger para agregar más potencia a tu nave. Cada nivel cuenta con una amplia variedad de enemigos tratando de detenerte, con un gran jefe al final. El juego es para un jugador o dos jugadores de forma alterna.

meta.name: Graeme Souness International Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.44 KB

"Graeme Souness International Soccer" offers a football match with selectable half length, number of players and team colors, letting you play solo or with a friend. The field is shown from an elevated top-down angle, displaying a portion of the pitch. You control the player closest to the ball – the fire button is used to shoot, pass or perform a sliding tackle.

meta.name: Graeme Souness Soccer Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.24 KB

Graeme Souness Soccer Manager is a straightforward football management game where the player must lead a team from the Conference League to the top tier. The options are limited: the player can select the starting lineup, with players rated based on both ability and fitness, scout the transfer market for better players, and request overdraft credits. The real challenge lies in managing the finances and preventing excessive wages from being paid while the team is still in the lower leagues.

meta.name: Graffiti Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are a graffiti artist who must get through four locations while avoiding all kinds of people that are constantly shooting projectiles or objects at you. These people include old men, police officers, skaters, and women that throw flowerpots on your head. If you come into contact with people, you will lose a life. When you get hit by a projectile or object, you lose one of your spray cans, and if you run out of these, you will also lose a life. When you get to the end of each location, you will reach a wall where you can spray-paint on. If you spray over the specific regions, you will get rewarded for your effort. You are on a time limit on these sections, and when time runs out, you move to the next location.

meta.name: The Grammar Examiner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

"The Grammar Examiner" is a grammar-based board game where up to four players take on the role of aspiring newspaper reporters. Moving across the board, they earn money by answering grammar questions. Various spaces trigger effects such as random movements, returning to the start, unexpected financial gains or losses, multiple-choice challenges, or text corrections. An optional AI opponent, Melvin, can be added with adjustable intelligence. The goal is to be the first to reach $23,000.

meta.name: Grand Larceny
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.92 KB

Your mission is to explore a hotel called Grand Larceny to find the plans for a supercomputer. There are many rooms and floors to explore as you find objects and various other characters in various locations. You have to use certain objects in the right places to proceed and interact with the other characters to find the plans and escape from the roof using the helicopter.nnnnGrand Larceny is an adventure with arcade elements where you control your character with a joystick, viewing him from the side and the screen scrolling as you move. Below the play area is text describing your current location and any objects in the area. Like a text adventure, you enter commands to interact with your environment and objects. There are only 24 verbs available to use. The game also features music.

meta.name: Grand Monster Slam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Grand Monster Slam” may look simple at first, but it's a fast-paced and addictive skill-based game – your goal is to shoot all balls to the opponent's side and slow them down by hitting them. With its imaginative fantasy theme, it shares much of the spirit of “M.U.D.S.” by the same designers. A training mode lets you perfect your aim before taking on tough AI opponents in tournament play. There's also a hotseat multiplayer mode, though the controls can be tricky. If you loved “M.U.D.S.” – this fun, simpler sibling is highly recommended.

meta.name: Grand Prix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.38 KB

Grand Prix is a management game where you and a friend take control of a Formula 1 team. At the beginning of the racing season, you can select your sponsors, including large and small sponsors, as well as suppliers for engines and tires. In addition to ensuring your cars are competitive, you must also manage the finances and the rest of the team. There's also the option to bet on races. Once you're satisfied with your decisions and the cars have practiced on the track, it's time for the main race. This part of the game is presented from a top-down view of the track, the start/finish line, and the pit stops. All you can do is watch the cars as they pass by and wait for the laps to finish. The controls are handled via the keyboard.

meta.name: Grand Prix Circuit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Esta simulación recrea las carreras de Fórmula 1 con todo detalle. Podrás conducir un coche McLaren, Ferrari o Williams, cada uno con diferentes cualidades, en los circuitos reales de Fórmula 1, incluidos Mónaco, Suzuka y el circuito original de Hockenheim con sus largas rectas. Los pilotos rivales también tienen sus propios estilos y puntos fuertes, y para ganar el Campeonato Mundial hay que dominarlos. El momento y la planificación de las paradas en boxes también son cruciales, aunque a finales de los años 80 la Fórmula 1 solo cambiaba neumáticos.

meta.name: Grand Prix Master
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.50 KB

Grand Prix Master es un juego de motos que revive el extinto Campeonato Mundial de 80cc, con licencia oficial de Jorge Martínez "Aspar" y sus rivales —entre ellos, un joven Alex Crivillé, futuro campeón de 500cc. Incluye modo entrenamiento, clasificatorias y carreras completas. Aunque solo compiten ocho motos controladas por la IA, el sistema de puntuación es fiel al reglamento real: no clasificar duele de verdad, sobre todo porque solo dispones de cinco motos para toda la temporada. La perspectiva es cenital, pero lo llamativo es su control: debes mover la palanca según la curva del circuito —no solo izquierda/derecha— para mantener la mejor trayectoria. Un enfoque poco común que premia la anticipación y la técnica sobre la velocidad bruta. Pura esencia de los 80cc: pequeño cilindraje, gran emoción.

meta.name: Grand Prix Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.14 KB

"Grand Prix Simulator" puts you in an overhead arcade-style race inspired by "Super Sprint", with the emphasis firmly on action rather than realism. Alone or with a friend, you'll speed through up to 14 twisty tracks featuring sharp corners, oil slicks, bonus points, and wildly impractical underpasses. Cars accelerate slowly but pack speed on the straights. You're scored based on total time and fastest lap – lose to the computer and it's game over.

meta.name: Grand Prix Simulator 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.52 KB

"Grand Prix Simulator 2" puts you back on the top-down racetrack across a variety of twisty circuits filled with hairpin turns, oil slicks, and other hazards. You must complete each course within a time limit, with leftover seconds carrying over to the next round. After every race, you can watch a replay. New features include a 3-player mode, with three cars always racing together, and a damage meter that impacts your car's handling if you collide too often with barriers or rivals.

meta.name: Grand Slam Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Steve "Iron Man" Garvey and Jose (Rookie of the Year) Canseco take you to the baseball stadium for an exciting Grand Slam Doubleheader. First, you play a regular baseball game, offering all the realistic game situations: sliders, curves, squeeze plays, stolen bases, home runs, and hit-and-run plays. All the excitement of Major League Baseball is presented in vibrant colors on the scrolling outfields, enhanced by realistic sound effects. In addition, there is a second, dynamic game where Grand Slam home runs score points for your team. The action and strategy become more intense as you showcase power and skill alongside Steve and Jose.

meta.name: Grandell Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.23 KB

Grandell Island is an adventure game from 1982 for the Commodore 64 that takes players on an exciting treasure hunt. The player must find the way to the secret Grandell Island and collect clues to discover the legendary treasure of Commodore Grandell. The game combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and decision-making to uncover the mystery of the treasure.

meta.name: Grandma's House
meta.desc:

Grandma's House is an interactive game specifically designed for children. In this game, players can design the perfect playhouse by visiting magical places and collecting wonderful items to decorate the house. It combines creativity with adventure, as players travel through various imaginative locations and find objects to bring back and beautify the house.

Grandmaster is a one player chess game where you play the computer at chess with ten skill levels (0-9). As well as adjusting the skill level you can also watch the computer play itself, receive hints, force the computer to play the move it is currently thinking and change board colour. You use the keyboard to type in your moves and the default setting is skill level one and you play as white.nn

meta.name: Grange Hill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.90 KB

Grange Hill was a British children's television program that ran from 1978 to 2008 and was set in a fictional comprehensive school in north London. 
The game is an arcade adventure with elements of a graphical text adventure and lets you slip into the role of two characters from that time in the mid-80s: Luke “Gonch” Gardner and his best friend Paul “Hollo” Holloway. Gonch's Walkman was confiscated at school for listening to it during class, and it was then stolen from the staff room. You and Hollo must sneak back to the school before midnight and try to find her or you will be punished by your mother when you return home. You have to collect and use objects in the right places as well as interact with other characters, including Imelda, the school bully, and the caretaker, Mr. Griffiths.
The game starts at 3:50 p.m. and 15 seconds in real time equals one minute of play.

meta.name: Granny's Garden
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Granny's Garden is a legendary educational game that became a fixture in British schools during the 1980s. Your task is to rescue three pairs of royal children from the clutches of a wicked witch. By typing in commands, you decide which path to take and how to act in different situations. Along the way, you encounter a whimsical cast of characters and puzzles spread across varied environments. Progress is saved through a password system, allowing you to continue later. Many years later, a multimedia-enhanced remake was released for modern operating systems.

Gonzo discovers that his friend is meant to be the main course and embarks on a rescue mission. Dr. Bunsen Honeydew assists him by providing words that Gonzo can use to build machines. These machines are needed to overcome various obstacles. Gonzo travels through locations such as Chickago, Yellowyolk National Park, Carlsbird Caverns, and the Hen-a-layin' Mountains on his way to the castle.

meta.name: Great Gurianos
meta.desc:

Great Gurianos puts you in the armor of a gladiator navigating a deadly castle. With sword and shield, you fight through four levels of traps and enemies, using precise joystick control to adjust your stance and defense. Timing is everything. Those who endure the danger are rewarded with access to the mysterious treasure stage.

meta.name: Great Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Great Mission is a text adventure where you take on the role of secret agent Harry, who must complete a secret mission. The game challenges you to be creative, use various commands, and overcome puzzles and obstacles in order to successfully complete the mission.

meta.name: The Great Nordic War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Great Northern War was a conflict in which a coalition led by the Tsarist Empire of Russia successfully challenged the dominance of the Swedish Empire in Northern, Central, and Eastern Europe. Initially, Peter I of Russia, Frederick IV of Denmark-Norway, and Augustus II the Strong of Saxony-Poland-Lithuania were leaders of the anti-Swedish alliance. Frederick IV and Augustus II were defeated by Sweden under Charles XII in 1700 and 1706, respectively, and were removed from the alliance, but rejoined after the defeat of Charles XII at the Battle of Poltava in 1709. George I of Great Britain and the Electorate of Hanover joined the coalition in 1714 for Hanover and in 1717 for Great Britain, while Frederick William I of Brandenburg-Prussia joined in 1715. In this game, you lead the troops, set the strategy, and determine when the cavalry should flank and attack. Good luck, General!

meta.name: The Great War 1914
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Great War 1914 is a turn-based strategy game set during the early months of World War I. The game spans the period from August to October (27 turns, each representing three days) and covers an area from Paris-Minsk to Antwerp-Vienna. Players take control of either the Western Allies (France, Britain, Belgium), the Central Powers (Germany, Bavaria, Austria-Hungary), or Russia. Each turn consists of three phases: strategic movement, tactical orders, and evaluation after all orders are given. Each unit has a zone of control that limits the enemy's movements. Key elements include special terrain fields that affect units, such as impassable rivers, as well as fortifications and railroads, which play a significant strategic role. The winner is determined by victory points awarded at 50 special fields, which are controlled by the faction that last moved a unit through these fields.

meta.name: Grebit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.66 KB

Help Freddie Frog and his friends get home safely. Watch out on the bumpy road as traffic gets heavier and heavier. Don't stay in one spot for too long, or you'll end up as a flattened frog—GULP! Now you need to cross a raging river by hopping from log to log—watch out, the current is strong. Can you make it home safely? Remember, frogs have more fun!

meta.name: Green Screen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.24 KB

Green Screen is a puzzle game where the player must solve various challenges by correctly arranging and combining green screens or objects. It requires precise thinking and strategic planning to master each level. As the player progresses, the tasks become more complex and demand greater planning and spatial awareness. The game stays true to the visual simplicity of classic C64 games, offering a mental challenge for those who enjoy the retro charm of this platform.

meta.name: Greenhouse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.63 KB

Greenhouse challenges the player to grow flowers and harvest them at their tallest stage – maximizing the score. Weeds must be eliminated, as they provide no points. Regular watering speeds up growth – but must be stopped in time before harvesting. In later levels – an additional challenge arises, as flowers must be protected from bees.

“Greg Norman's Ultimate Golf” features two courses with 3D modeling that accounts for ball position and shot technique. You can disable ball effects to simplify gameplay, and weather and wind effects are optional. The game is played from a 3D perspective, with an overhead view provided before each shot.

Grell & Falla puts you in charge of cleansing an enchanted garden still tainted by dark magic. You guide the dwarf Grell and the fairy Fella through a side-scrolling world, purifying corrupted insects and plants with spells or disabling them when necessary. Along the way, you actively tend the garden by planting new flora for bonus points, with skill, timing and smart use of magic determining your success.

En Gremlins, controlas a Billy desde una vista lateral mientras defiende su salón tras la medianoche de traviesos Mogwai y peligrosos Gremlins. Debes capturar a los Mogwai y devolverlos a su jaula, y eliminar a los Gremlins con tu espada. Cada nivel tiene un temporizador que termina al amanecer (6:00 h). Completar los objetivos a tiempo da más puntos, pero basta con sobrevivir para avanzar. Una frenética batalla contra el caos nocturno.

Kingston Falls is in danger of being over-run with Gremlins, Billy has been tricked by Gizmo's offsprings into feeding them after midnight. The Mogwai have already pupated and turned into the evil Gremlins, and, led by Stripe (the evilest of them all) are now causing chaos all over Kingston Falls. By taking the part of Billy you are now about to embark on a most perilous adventure. Aided by Gizmo it is your task to save Kingston Falls from being overrun with Gremlins.

meta.name: Gremlins 2 : The New Batch

Pero el plan se descubre y una nueva oleada de gremlins descontrolados es liberada. A lo largo de cinco niveles con desplazamiento lateral, debes combatir o esquivar enemigos mientras recoges objetos secretos. Vidas extra, bonificaciones de tiempo y mejoras de armas te ayudan a sobrevivir; al final de cada nivel, puedes gastar créditos en equipo aún más potente.

meta.name: Greyfell - The Legend Of Norman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.92 KB

Greyfell, a land of humanoid animals, has fallen into despair: the evil wizard Mauron has stolen the Orb of Life and is making life hell. But Norman the cat has had enough and decides to do something. The player takes on his role and accompanies Norman on the way to the castle.
Greyfell: Legend of Norman is an isometric action game with puzzle elements. Norman must go through multiple connected screens without scrolling to find objects he can use elsewhere to continue progressing. Some friendly animals, such as a drunken rabbit, give him instructions on what to do when he meets them. Unfortunately, many enemies want to kill Norman and he must either avoid them or repel them with one of three spells or strikes. If he fails to fight enemies effectively, his life energy will be reduced. It can be filled by collecting flowers in the game world.

Tras un accidente durante la prueba de una máquina del tiempo, quedas atrapado en el pasado y debes atravesar distintas épocas para regresar a casa. Greystorm es un platformer/shooter lateral donde puedes saltar, agacharte y disparar. Tiene seis niveles temáticos: Edad de Piedra, Jungla Oscura, Época Moderna, Ciudad Tecnológica, Cataratas y Edad Media. Para completar cada nivel, debes recolectar una cantidad determinada de objetos, pero cada nuevo ítem solo aparece tras recoger el anterior, obligándote a avanzar y retroceder constantemente.

You can fend off many dangers but must choose carefully when to act and when to avoid risk. The experience blends collection, protection, and quick reactions – a lively skill adventure that rewards awareness, timing, and smart routing.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.61 KB

This (American) football management game uses a menu-driven system. There are 16 teams to choose from; the Dolphins, Packers and 49ers are all in there. Players are rated out of 10 on skill, energy and form. Player trading is handled in a soccer-style transfer market, rather than with a US 'draft' format - mid-season trades for money are common. Matches have no direct tactical input, and are viewed from remote highlight shots, which do not have the distinct pitch markings of the original (an old Softstone game released under three different names).

meta.name: Grid Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.35 KB

Grid Zone is a game where you play as Ned, the dog, who must escape from eight levels of the evil Traxonian Grid Zones to rescue his owner Daisy. The story begins when they were out for a walk, and the Chiggiz appeared, capturing Daisy and imprisoning her in a force field. Ned ended up in the Grid Zone and must escape before Daisy is destroyed by an ultra-mega ray. The screen is divided into rows with gaps, some of which have moving floors. If Ned stands on a moving floor, he falls into a gap and loses a life. To complete a level, Ned must collect diamonds. There are also bouncing balls and cannons that shoot at Ned. If he gets hit, he loses a life. Before starting the game, you can choose the difficulty: medium, hard, or insane.

meta.name: Grid Zone Remix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.03 KB

Grid Zone Remix revives the classic – tougher, faster, and deadlier than ever. You guide Ned the dog through a maze of laser beams, black holes, and lethal traps. Your goal is to collect all the gems without touching the deadly orb – it may look harmless, but it will vaporize you in an instant. Limited shields, activated with the fire button, offer brief protection, but timing is everything: every second counts, every mistake is fatal. With redesigned levels, shifting attack patterns, and rising chaos, Grid Zone Remix pushes your reflexes to the edge.

meta.name: Gridlock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.96 KB

Gridlock challenges you to guide a small diamond across a grid to the lower right corner while the clock ticks down. Red dots patrol the paths, and touching one costs you a life. Reaching the goal scores points, with extra bonuses for time left on the clock. Every eight levels reward you with an extra life to keep the run going. Precision, timing, and fast reactions are the only way to survive the escalating challenge.

meta.name: Gridrunner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.42 KB

By the year 2190 the Earth is a barren and desolate wasteland. With all natural resources used up, the human race's last hopes rest with a huge orbiting solar power station know as the GRID. Now the GRID has been invaded by a race of evil droids, intent on the total subjugation of Earth. To combat these droids, an incredibly powerful and manoeuverable ship, the Gridrunner, was developed. Your mission: stop the droids and save the Earth!

meta.name: Gridtrap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.95 KB

In Gridtrap, you must defuse bombs before their timers run out – but every square you leave disappears. Careful planning is crucial to avoid trapping yourself. A roaming boot adds danger, as do fixed skulls and flags. You can shift rows to create new paths, though not all objects can be moved. Exiting one screen edge loops you to the other side. Touching the boot, landing on a skull, or letting a bomb explode costs you one of three lives. You must defuse five bombs to progress.

meta.name: Groovy Garden
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Groovy Garden puts you in charge of defending several gardens where rare Pigmy Pines are meant to grow while waves of hostile creatures try to destroy them. You control a spray gun to eliminate enemies, carefully preventing them from reaching the ground or touching your weapon, as both situations threaten your survival through rising or falling gauges. A countdown timer governs plant growth, a sleeping gardener can temporarily restore your chances, and once four Pines have grown, a new garden awaits with even tougher opposition.

meta.name: De Grotten van Oberon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.79 KB

The Caves of Oberon takes you into a vast cave system on Oberon, one of Uranus' moons. Hidden within is the knowledge of a long extinct culture, and your task is to uncover it piece by piece. You control a saucer-like spaceship from a side view, interacting with objects such as computers, sensors, fuel tanks, and radars by directing a beam at them. To open doors, you must solve small puzzles on the computers – for example inserting a missing number into a calculation or completing a word with a missing letter. At the same time, you have to avoid colliding with the cave walls, as your ship takes damage and will eventually be destroyed. Fuel is also limited, so you need to refuel at tanks in order to progress.

meta.name: Groundwar System
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.56 KB

“Groundwar System” is a simple shoot-'em-up released as a sample project for a game development tool – you control your vehicle through a hostile desert landscape in a slightly isometric perspective, taking down enemies while trying to survive as long as possible. The game offers a playful example of how a basic game system can be structured.

meta.name: Grouse Shoot : The Glorious Twelfth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.85 KB

Grouse Shoot: The Glorious Twelfth places you on a shooting range where you aim a crosshair at flying birds and take them down using the Stack Light Rifle. The gameplay is intentionally simple, focusing entirely on timing and accuracy, with every successful hit reflected immediately in the score. The game was only available bundled with the rifle and never released on its own.

meta.name: Grover's Animal Adventures
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Grover's Animal Adventures takes children on a journey through four habitats – the African Grasslands, the Atlantic Ocean, a North American Forest, and a barnyard near Sesame Street. With Grover as their guide, they choose animals and objects from nature, see them animate, and learn where they belong: land, water, or sky. Kids begin associating printed names with animals and create their own colorful nature scenes. A fun, creative way to explore nature and learn through play.

meta.name: The Growing Pains of Adrian Mole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Growing Pains of Adrian Mole continues the story of the self-proclaimed teenage intellectual as an interactive adventure spanning 18 months of his life. In each segment you are presented with choices that determine how Adrian reacts to everyday situations. Your decisions shape how his family, friends and especially Pandora perceive him, with the goal of improving his popularity and reputation. The game is divided into several parts that can be played individually or in sequence, while your score carries over as you progress. Humor, insecurity and youthful self-importance define this interactive coming-of-age experience.

meta.name: Gruds in Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Gruds in Space, you take on the role of the pilot of the Earth ship USAC 9400. Your mission is to find fuel for the war-weary Earth spaceships and deliver it to the freighter on Pluto. As you journey through the solar system, you solve puzzles, collect and use objects, and fight off alien intruders. With interactive commands like "EXAMINE," "USE," "TAKE," and "SHOOT," you navigate your ship and the galaxy to complete your mission.

meta.name: Grungy Towers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.90 KB

In Grungy Towers, a murder has been committed and it's up to you to uncover the killer. Roam the estate, question suspects, and piece together where everyone claims to have been. One person is lying, and through logic and deduction, you must find out who. You can make multiple accusations, but each wrong guess lowers your rank. A classic whodunit mystery with a sharp deductive edge.

meta.name: Gryphon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Players control Gryphon, a mythical creature living in the Land of Dreams and Legend, a land consisting of Mystical Woods, Surreal Cities, and the deadly Darklands. One day, Gryphon awoke to discover that his gold has been threatened by the Id Monsters and the pure water in the rivers and lakes turned into poison, blocking access to the different regions. You have the task of carrying gold from one area, and using them to form a bridge over the poisonous water so that Gryphon can travel to the next region while avoiding the Id Monsters, who can be dealt with by shooting bolts of pure Griffin magic.

meta.name: GTI Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.12 KB

"In 'GTI Simulator' you control your vehicle from a top-down perspective across twisty race tracks. The goal is to master all obstacles and turns as quickly as possible without skidding or losing valuable seconds. Oil slicks and narrow sections demand skill and timing – every lap counts."

meta.name: Guadalcanal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Guadalcanal” puts you at the heart of one of the Pacific War's most pivotal battles. In August 1942, U.S. Marines land on the strategically vital island, but the struggle for Guadalcanal will last six months. As commander, you control air, land, and naval forces – from carriers to supply ships – with reconnaissance and logistics being key to victory. Patrol planes and scouts aid in planning, while weather, morale, and even malaria wear down your troops over time. The campaign can be played from either the American or Japanese side, with gameplay driven by strategic and tactical maps and an icon-based interface.

meta.name: Guardian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

«Guardian» es un trepidante clon de Defender en el que pilotas una nave espacial para proteger a unos humanoides en un terreno montañoso de una invasión alienígena. Armado con un láser de disparo rápido y un número limitado de bombas inteligentes, debes eliminar amenazas antes de que causen daño. Además, puedes usar saltos hiperespaciales para desplazarte rápidamente entre zonas del planeta. Los enemigos más peligrosos son los Landers: secuestran humanoides y los elevan hasta la parte superior de la pantalla; si no los derribas a tiempo, ambos explotan. Si los abates, el humanoide cae en paracaídas y debes atraparlo y devolverlo sano y salvo. Reflejos rápidos y puntería son esenciales para sobrevivir.

meta.name: Guardian II : Revenge of the Mutants
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.22 KB

«Guardian II: Revenge of the Mutants» es un trepidante shooter de ciencia ficción en el que pilotas tu caza Mk.II para proteger la Tierra de una nueva invasión mutante. Los enemigos Raiders cruzan la pantalla secuestrando terrícolas; si los llevan hasta la parte superior, estos se convierten en mutantes —y al desaparecer todos, se acaba la partida. Si derribas a un Raider con un cautivo, este cae en paracaídas y debes recogerlo y devolverlo a salvo. Otros enemigos incluyen Hive, Dynamo, Technofighter, Firebomber y Lure. Para ayudarte, dispones de escáner de largo alcance, bomba inteligente, capa de energía, indicador de convergencia Hive y propulsor hyperfate.

Una isla tropical está oprimida por un dictador, pero por suerte uno o dos valientes soldados estadounidenses están allí para restablecer la justicia. Avanza a través de ríos, pantanos y bosques para derrocar al dictador.
El juego se desarrolla verticalmente y avanzas por la pantalla disparando a los enemigos, encontrando buenos puntos estratégicos de tiro y recogiendo potenciadores. Los soldados enemigos vienen hacia ti en grupos, así que debes tener cuidado al eliminarlos, ya sea usando tu pistola o granadas. Algunos soldados también llevan rehenes, por lo que ganarás puntos si no les disparas a ellos y disparas a sus captores. Cada nivel termina con un jefe.

meta.name: Guess That Word!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.60 KB

Guess That Word! is a simple word game where the player has three options: guess a letter, guess the whole word, or have the computer reveal a letter (which costs 2 points). The game continues until the player guesses the word correctly. When the player correctly guesses the word, they are rewarded with a cheerful melody, and their score increases.

meta.name: Guess the Number of Stars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 677.00 B

„Guess the Number of Stars“ is a simple puzzle game that challenges the player's observation skills. A random number of stars appears on the screen for a short time, and the player must remember how many were shown. Once the stars disappear, the player is asked to enter their guess. The game tests visual perception and focus by presenting new star patterns each round.

meta.name: Guesser
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Guesser is a timed puzzle-board game, based on the TV show called "5 on the 5". The player's task is to guess a five letter password in five attempts. After typing each password the game shows the result. Correctly guess a letter is highlighted with white color, the letter appearing in the password in a different position is highlighted with yellow color.

meta.name: The Guild of Thieves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Worst of it all is you're STILL in the land of Kerovnia.....if something makes it look tough to solve, that's nothing for a puzzle - something else will screw it up more.

In Gulf Strike you take control of military forces in the Persian Gulf and explore the political and strategic tensions of the region. The game combines strategic planning with large-scale air, land and naval operations involving several nations. Throughout the match you command units, coordinate attacks and attempt to gain decisive advantages. The conflict unfolds over a series of turns as each side tries to accumulate enough victory points to win. Because of the many possible choices and outcomes, each game can develop in a different and unpredictable way.

meta.name: Gumball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Juegas como un trabajador en una fábrica de chicles, donde debes avanzar en las filas de la fábrica clasificando exitosamente chicles de colores usando una máquina clasificadora de chicles al estilo Rube Goldberg.
El jugador comienza cada día a las 08.30 con una cuota fija de chicles que debe clasificar con éxito durante el día. Los chicles de diferentes colores son expulsados ​​de la máquina en la esquina superior izquierda, y se abren camino a través de una serie de dispositivos complejos para eventualmente ser depositados desde varias ranuras en la parte inferior de la máquina. El jugador controla el movimiento de varias palancas dentro de la máquina para controlar el camino de los chicles de diferentes colores. Luego, el jugador también debe mover los carritos de colores en la parte inferior de la pantalla para que se deposite el chicle del color correcto en cada carrito.

meta.name: Gumshoe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres un detective privado contratado para rescatar a la hija de un millonario, y tu investigación te lleva a un complejo de diez torres. Gumshoe es un juego de plataformas donde solo se muestra una porción de la torre; la pantalla se desplaza al moverte en cualquier dirección. Debes recorrer pisos usando escaleras, escaleras mecánicas (que cambian de dirección cada pocos segundos) y ascensores (que suben y bajan, pero no pueden ser dañados con disparos). También hay conductos de basura que, al entrar, te transportan a otra zona de la torre.

meta.name: Gun City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A western style cross-hairs shooter. Take out the bad guys but leave the little girl with the physics books. This game takes place in the dusty Far West, where you play the roll of a famous bounty killer who dedicates his life to hunting the most dangerous criminals, such as the terrible band of Billy Destroyer, who have taken over Gun City and the surrounding countryside. Your task is to free this country from the presence of criminals and to restore peace and serenity among the honest citizens. Use your aim to hit as many bandits as possible that appear at the windows and doors. You have a time limit in which you must hit a certain number of opponents and if you succeed you can move on to the next level. So get'em in the cross hairs quick!

meta.name: Gun Dogs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.30 KB

The goal of this two-player game is to shoot as many ducks as possible and retrieve them with the help of your dog to score a higher score than your opponent. You and your opponent control a hunter and a dog. When the hunter aims at a duck, press the fire button to shoot the duck with one of the barrels of the shotgun. But if you miss, press the fire button again to fire with the other barrel. Steer your dog to retrieve the duck with the use of your joystick and place the duck in the basket at the hunter's feet.

meta.name: Gun Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gun Runner es una misión de rescate en helicóptero, rápida y al estilo de Choplifter, con ocho niveles de desplazamiento horizontal. Tu objetivo: localizar y rescatar a hombres desaparecidos en el tiempo asignado, volando bajo y usando una grúa para izarlos. Unidades enemigas patrullan el cielo; debes disparar o esquivarlas —el contacto o los disparos enemigos te cuestan una vida. Comienzas con tres bombas inteligentes (limpian la pantalla), ganando una más por nivel completado. Éxito exige reflejos rápidos y vuelo preciso.

meta.name: Gun Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gun Runner drops you into a lawless space sector where pirates roam and profit comes only through guts and strategy. After a distress call from MPVA9 cuts off abruptly, the danger becomes clear. To survive and upgrade your ship, you'll need to complete delivery missions, brave hostile routes, and make smart improvements. Don't forget to check the commodities exchange – sharp trading can yield big rewards. But be warned: every run could be your last.

meta.name: Gun.Smoke
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Gun.Smoke" es un juego de disparos con desplazamiento vertical en el que juegas como un pistolero solitario que defiende Hicksville, un pueblo de la fiebre del oro, de la infame banda Wingates. Cada nivel tiene un objetivo específico, pero también debes eliminar a sus secuaces. La acción trepidante y aérea es similar a la de "Commando", con la mayor parte del juego a pie mientras la pantalla se desplaza hacia arriba y los enemigos atacan por todos lados. Puedes recoger potenciadores por el camino: encontrar un caballo te permite recibir dos disparos en lugar de uno antes de morir. También hay secciones donde puedes navegar río arriba o usar las vías del tren.

meta.name: Gunboat
meta.desc:

Gunboat puts you in control of a heavily armed hydrofoil tasked with infiltrating enemy waters to destroy their naval bases. Equipped with deck guns, torpedoes, homing missiles, and depth charges, you're met with resistance from helicopters, subs, and patrol boats. Missile sites and supply depots line the riverbanks, and if the area is quiet, you can dock to refuel or repair. The action unfolds from a tilted side-view perspective. The mission ends when your ship is destroyed, fuel runs out, the engine overheats, or all enemy bases are wiped out.

meta.name: Gunfighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.96 KB

In Gunfighter, you play as a Wild West sheriff whose town is being attacked by a group of outlaws who have taken control of several houses. You receive clues about the appearance of a particular outlaw and must patrol the streets to confront him. The doctor can grant you an extra life, but it costs $500. In addition to dealing with the outlaws, you must also avoid obstacles like red Indians and potholes in the road. You are limited to just six bullets, but you can restock at the sheriff's office. A casino mini-game is also included, where you can gamble with your money.

meta.name: Gunfighters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.66 KB

Gunfighters puts the player in the role of a gunslinger in the Wild West who must fight against a group of outlaws. The game revolves around quick duels where you draw your "Smoke Wagon" (revolver) and fire fast shots to defeat the villains and save the town. The game thrives on the classic Wild West atmosphere and requires quick reflexes and good accuracy.

meta.name: Guns 'n' Ghosts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Guns 'n' Ghosts puts you in the shoes of ghost hunters Trev or Georg, battling demons, skeletons, and other dark creatures. Across 72 platform-filled screens, you face waves of enemies that are dangerous up close. Georg wields a shotgun that must be reloaded but covers long distances, while Trev fights with an unlimited psychic attack of short range. Defeated foes drop power-ups such as ammo, instant kills, or boosted attack strength. In co-op mode, you can play side by side, even doubling up on characters. A special combination mode lets Trev hold enemies in place while Georg finishes them off. Music and sound effects enhance the eerie hunt.

meta.name: The Guns of Fort Defiance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.82 KB

Fort Defiance is an unfinished palisade blocking the path of an invading army that vastly outnumbers you during the War of 1812. You command a single Napoleonic-era artillery piece and its crew, defending the weakest point in the fortification. Your performance will determine whether the fort stands or falls. The game uses a handicap system (from 1 to 63). The lower the handicap you choose at the beginning, the quicker the enemy will retreat. The handicap system ensures that each repelled attack is followed by a more determined attempt. As the commander of the artillery piece, it is your responsibility to select the type of ammunition, the fuse lengths, the elevation, and the target.

meta.name: Gunship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gunship representa el mejor helicóptero de ataque del mundo occidental: el AH-64A Apache. Esta simulación recrea las armas, los sistemas de vuelo y el rendimiento de la máquina real. Controlas un arsenal que incluye misiles Hellfire guiados por láser, un cañón de 30 mm controlado por miras montadas en el casco, grupos de misiles de bombardeo e incluso misiles aire-aire para duelos con helicópteros enemigos. Un avión de combate inicia su entrenamiento de vuelo en una base de Estados Unidos. En los tutoriales aprenderás a utilizar el helicóptero; Una vez que se dominan los controles y las habilidades de vuelo, hay desafíos crecientes y cientos de misiones en una de cuatro regiones del mundo, incluido el Sudeste Asiático, América Central, Medio Oriente y la URSS y sus aliados del Pacto de Varsovia en Europa Occidental.

Stranded in the desert, your journey takes you through treacherous lands—from mine shafts and ghost towns to a final shootout with the Dalton Brothers. This graphic text adventure combines descriptive storytelling with visual scenes, allowing input via keyboard or joystick-driven menus. Every move brings you closer to your goal—or to your doom.

Gunslinger is a game where two players face off in a wild west duel. Both are armed and fight on an open desert field, where they can hide behind cacti for cover to avoid enemy fire. The goal is to shoot the opponent faster than they can shoot you. Timing and precision are crucial, as the game relies on quick reactions. The cacti provide cover, allowing players to hide between shots. The game focuses on fast reflexes and strategy, requiring players to anticipate and counter the movements of their opponent. It captures the tension of western films and lets players experience nerve-wracking standoff moments.

meta.name: Gunslinger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.53 KB

In Gunslinger, your goal is to shoot targets in various scenarios and sharpen your skills for future duels with the deadliest bandits of the Wild West. The levels include a shooting range, open plains with bandit-like targets, and a risky saloon showdown. Bonus points are awarded at the end of each level if you use your ammunition sparingly, which encourages accuracy.

meta.name: Gunstar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gunstar tells of an occupied Earth whose last hope lies in an attack force secretly developed on the Moon. As part of the Gunstar Fleet, you head into battle with three pilots to push back the alien invaders and liberate humanity. The mission leads through several sections that have to be cleared step by step, creating a strong sense of forward momentum. That mix of liberation struggle, futuristic military atmosphere, and direct action gives the game its driving appeal.

meta.name: Gusher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.45 KB

You have seen the move, watch the TV series and read the book. Now play the game. Test your skill on the computer to become the richest oilman in the business. Challenge your friends to economic combat as you struggle with a string of outside elements that are not always favorable to you. How do you cope with disasters at the well head, thwart production problems on pipeline building, ship crude to your tanker fleet without hitches? It's bad enough fighting nature's provocations without having to contend with all the other oil tycoons. Still, if you are the first to make your million not even the computer will be able to argue that you are the undoubted winner. Visions will also give you a personal recommendation to the Chancellor of the Exchequer within any country of your choice.
