Gutt Blaster puts you in command of an interstellar spaceship in a vertically scrolling shooter. Your mission is to travel through hyperspace and battle relentless alien hordes, leading up to a showdown with a massive wheel-shaped ship capable of wiping out all life. A mission preview at the start sets the stage – from there, it's all about reflexes and firepower.

meta.name: Gutz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 74.75 KB

Tienes que destruir a un alienígena gigante que orbita la Tierra... ¡desde dentro!
Explora 16 niveles laberínticos disparando a varios enemigos. Hay varios objetos que te ayudarán, como armas más eficaces contra ciertos tipos de enemigos y un mapa de cada nivel.
Debes destruir 4 de los órganos del invasor, los riñones, el corazón, los pulmones y, por último, el cerebro, que aparecen en los niveles 4, 8, 12 y 16 respectivamente. Sin embargo, para destruir cada órgano, primero debes encontrar las 3 partes de un arma eficaz para esa tarea.

meta.name: Guzzler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.83 KB

You are Greedy Guzzler and your task is to move about various top view mazes shown on the whole screen to collect keys which will enable you to open a food cell and eat all the food in it. Once you have cleared a food cell you become fat and you are unable to move through thin gaps in the maze. Moving about the border of the maze is Deflator Dennis and when you touch him then you are thin again. Touch him while thin though and you lose a life. Moving about the maze are Frobbies and if you touch one then you also lose a life but you are armed with a limited number of bombs to place and kill them which can also kill yourself. After four food cells are cleared then Bonus Barry runs around the maze with a letter and if you collect all the letters you spell Guzzler and receive a bonus. Barry can also die if touched by Dennis.

meta.name: Gwendolyn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Gwendolyn: Pursuit of a Princess, you play as Maracus, heir to the House of Stevius, whose bride is kidnapped on the eve of their wedding by Dwarves from Tunnelworld – once again acting under the command of the exiled Joel. Using a joystick, you explore your surroundings, gather and use items, and make choices in a world displayed through a mix of graphics and text. With every decision and discovery, you come closer to rescuing Princess Gwendolyn – if you can survive the journey.

meta.name: Gypsum Cave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A three part game set in Gypsum Cave with different goals for each section, but overall find the treasures, have the adventure and get out safely. 1. Part 1 is a traditional adventure. Check the pictures for objects. The goal is to find the Jewel. 2. In part 2 you play a guessing game as to what some of the objects as as depicted in the pictures. Locations do not have descriptions. The goal of this section is to arm yourself sufficiently with knowledge, arms and magic. 3. Part 3 consists of a mapping exercise. Note direction movement in this part of the game is by numbers instead of the normal N, S, E and W, except on two occasions that will be clear. The goal is to find the passage leading out of the caves. Good luck!

meta.name: Gyropod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gyropod is a varied C64 shooter that blends space combat with landing and exploration missions. You pilot the Galaxy Ranger, equipped with a rotating defensive rim and a cannon. The rim both shields and attacks, but as it takes damage, holes appear, leaving you exposed. Ammunition is limited, so each planet must be plundered before destruction. This triggers a Lunar Lander-style sequence where the supply pod must land gently on the surface. Once landed, you control a spaceman tasked with collecting boxes while hostile aliens pursue you. The game features customizable options like music, three difficulty levels, and 1–8 lives. A hot-seat two-player mode lets players alternate turns until all lives are lost.

meta.name: Gyroscope
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.63 KB

Gyroscope is a fast-paced skill game strongly inspired by Marble Madness. You control a spinning gyroscope from a fixed isometric view across sloped, hazard-filled tracks – packed with ramps, drops, and obstacles. The controls are sensitive – the gyro accelerates quickly, slows down slowly, and must stay stable. Time pressure and limited lives increase the tension – losing a life sends you back to the start of the level without resetting the timer. You earn points for clearing screens, time bonuses, and an extra life at 1000 points. After level 7, the game mirrors – beat level 14, and it loops back to level 1.

meta.name: Gyruss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.77 KB

Gyruss te enfrenta a los mortales Gyrusians que atacan el sistema solar. Pilotando una nave que se mueve en una trayectoria circular alrededor del borde de la pantalla, debes despejar tres oleadas de enemigos por planeta, viajando de un mundo al siguiente. Dispara satélites especiales para mejorar de un cañón simple a uno doble, y gana bonificaciones y armas en las etapas posteriores al nivel. Con su acción trepidante y movimiento radial único, Gyruss ofrece un giro fresco a los juegos de disparos arcade clásicos.

meta.name: Hacker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hacker es un juego de aventuras e intercambio basado en una idea original en aquel entonces. Te embarcas en la aventura como un auténtico hacker, sin saber qué te espera, impulsado únicamente por tu ambición. El juego se inicia con una pantalla de texto simple que te solicita la contraseña. Acceder al sistema es el primer rompecabezas que debes resolver. Una vez dentro, descubrirás que te has topado accidentalmente con una conspiración de impacto global. A partir de entonces, pilotarás un dron robótico por todo el mundo a través de un sistema de túneles en las profundidades de la tierra. En las principales ciudades, podrás salir a la superficie y hablar con personas de contacto que intercambiarán objetos por dinero. Una vez que lleguen a la ciudad correcta, podrás canjearlos por una prueba. Si se reúnen todas las pruebas, deberás informar al FBI. Por si fuera poco, descubrir las rutas y los intercambios correctos también será difícil, los frecuentes fallos del sistema y los controles de seguridad pondrán a prueba tu habilidad...

meta.name: Hacker II : The Doomsday Papers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.58 KB

“Hacker II: The Doomsday Papers” puts the player in the role of the world's greatest hacker, recruited by the CIA for a critical mission: to steal plans for a Russian project called the Doomsday Papers and prevent a global threat. The plans are stored in a guarded vault in a Russian military installation, with the combination split across four locked filing cabinets. The player uses three smuggled robots, known as Mobile Remote Units (MRUs), controlled via a specialized computer system. Skill, strategy, and technical expertise are essential to complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Hackman!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.76 KB

In Hackman!, you control a character who moves through a maze to collect items while avoiding enemy opponents. Similar to Pac-Man, your goal is to clear the entire maze of items without being caught by the enemies.

meta.name: Hades
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.34 KB

Hades sends you into the underworld as Hercules after the wicked witch Prosperina steals all the kingdom's gold and scatters it across Hades. You climb, jump, and navigate through treacherous caverns, collecting every coin you can while avoiding countless deadly traps. Each move determines whether you return as a hero or become a permanent resident of the dark realm. With a bit of luck, you'll even claim the final treasure and rise again among the mortals.

meta.name: Hades Nebula
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hades Nebula es un V-shooter lanzado por primera vez en 1987. La historia de fondo, típicamente corta y no demasiado inventiva, se puede contar en unas pocas frases. Una flota de 10 naves coloniales de la Tierra está explorando un rincón remoto del universo. El malvado Emperador Hades del Planeta Sodini es informado de la llegada de los terrícolas por sus espías y planea una emboscada. Debido a un error informático (!), la nave colonial 7 llega dos años antes que la flota principal a la Nebulosa de Orión, que ahora se renombra como Nebulosa de Hades y da refugio a todas las fuerzas Imperiales para la emboscada planeada.

meta.name: Hägar the Horrible
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hägar the Horrible turns the famous comic character into a lighthearted platform adventure where each stage starts with a clear objective. Hägar receives a shopping list from Helga and must collect the required items before reaching the exit. Along the way, he fights enemies with his shield and sword, discovers stronger weapons, and overcomes obstacles that demand skill and awareness. The appeal comes from blending classic platform gameplay with simple collection goals and the unmistakable humor of the original comics.

meta.name: Halcyon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.89 KB

Halcyon is a variation of Roc 'n Rope, where the player must navigate through various levels to collect coins while avoiding cavemen and dinosaurs searching for a victim. Unlike Roc 'n Rope, the player cannot use stun rays but must jump from platform to platform to escape the enemies. Collisions with enemies or reaching the zero point of the bonus timer result in losing a life, and the game ends when all lives are used up. Once all coins in a stage are collected, the player must reach a bird on the top platform, which will transport them to the next stage.

meta.name: Halftime Battlin' Bands
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.63 KB

Mr. Chrometone here with play-by-play info on all the exciting action in HALFTIME BATTLIN' BANDS! 
I hang out with the Jazz Scats - Swivel Hips, Wahoo and Mr. Bassman — a talented trio that'll cheer you on during a spectacular halftime extravaganza that's about to set the world on its musical ear! It's halftime at Jazz Scat Stadium and the fans are cheering for entertainment. As Drum Major of the number one football band, the scrimmage Stompers, it's up to you to create a perfect band formation — along with a sizzlin' new march — out on the football field! 
You can kick off all the fun and action right now by plopping the enclosed record onto the ol' phonograph. In four short minutes, you'll have a showstoppin' musical introduction to this Halftime game. And ol' Chrometone here will fill you in on a batch of details to boot!

n: Halley Mission, The - A Shuttle Simulation (USA)

meta.name: The Halley Mission : A Shuttle Simulation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.82 KB

As Commander of an advanced space shuttle craft your only aim is to be chosen to mastermind the ultimate mission, to launch a sophisticated probe into the tail of Halley's Comet, but first you must prove your worth...

meta.name: The Halley Project
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Halley Project, the player takes on the role of a star pilot traveling on missions between various objects in the solar system. The player starts from a base on Halley's Comet and must first fly to Earth and then return to the comet. With each completed mission, the player's rank increases. After all missions are completed, a code is provided, which the player can send to the software developer. In response, the player receives a letter with instructions on how to access a secret mission.

meta.name: Halloween Police
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.41 KB

In Halloween Police, you play a fearless cop battling through a nightmarish onslaught of horror. This vertically scrolling shooter pits you against ghosts, zombies, grim reapers, and demons rising from the depths of hell to terrorize the city. Armed and ready, you must blast your way through endless waves of enemies, relying on sharp reflexes and steady aim. Only the toughest Halloween officer will survive the night.

meta.name: Halls of Death
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.82 KB

"Halls of Death" is an adventure game in which you, as one of many explorers, search the caves and rooms of several floors to find treasure - with the hope of coming out alive. The screen is divided into five areas: two text fields, a map of the current floor, your statistics and a representation of your surroundings or the opponent in battle. You start at the bottom of a staircase and explore rooms where traps, treasures or creatures await you. You can attack, flee or use one of four spells (sleep, teleportation, lightning, fireball), although spells can also fail. If your strength drops to zero, the game ends.

meta.name: Halls of Montezuma : A Battle History of the U.S. Marine Corps
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Blind Command, the player takes on the role of a corps commander leading multiple divisions and being responsible for the lives of thousands of soldiers – the player commands historical battles from the wars with Mexico, World War I, World War II, and the Korean War. The challenge lies in the fact that commanders are often "blind" – they rely on reports from their men. There is no direct contact with the battlefield – only the reports from the troops and the orders the player gives. The soldiers must carry out the orders, but many unpredictable factors come into play – such as weather, enemies, terrain, exhaustion, and lack of supplies. The player must strive to organize the troops efficiently and make the best decisions while navigating the uncertainty and risks of command.

p: Halls of the Dwarven Kings, The (Europe).T64
n: Halls of the Dwarven Kings, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Halls of the Dwarven Kings
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.06 KB

The Halls of the Dwarven Kings begins with an encounter with a filthy rat and takes the player through the halls of the Dwarven Kings. The goal is to overcome challenges and earn a reputation as a hero in the hometown through various tasks. The journey starts with a rather mundane situation, but greater adventures and trials await the player.

meta.name: The Halls of the Things
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.80 KB

In Halls of the Things you play as an adventurer exploring a randomly generated tower filled with corridors, chambers and danger. At the start you can choose between several doors, each leading to areas of different difficulty. As you move through the tower you collect treasure and elixirs that help you survive. But the “Things” roam the halls, chasing and attacking you as soon as they spot you – and sometimes they even disguise themselves as ordinary objects until you get too close. To defend yourself you have a sword, a bow and magical spells that can be used for attack or healing. The game blends exploration, combat and treasure hunting into a dangerous adventure where each playthrough can unfold differently.

meta.name: Hammer Boy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.76 KB

Hammer Boy es un juego arcade sencillo que mezcla elementos de Kaboom! y Whack-a-Mole. Armado con un gran martillo, debes impedir que los indígenas americanos alcancen la torre tras tu fortaleza: golpéales en la cabeza y apaga los fuegos que lanzan desde los lados. Así de simple es la jugabilidad. Los niveles posteriores cambian el escenario (acorazado, castillo, base espacial) y los enemigos (piratas, caballeros, alienígenas), pero la mecánica se mantiene idéntica. Basado en un héroe de cómic.

meta.name: Hammer Bros!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.53 KB

"Hammer Bros!" takes place on a single screen where two players can move simultaneously across different platforms. The game feels reminiscent of classic arcade titles – requiring precise movement and quick reactions to avoid obstacles and defeat enemies. The environment consists of multiple levels with platforms, dynamically shaping the gameplay. Well-timed jumps and swift maneuvers are crucial to progressing through the levels and scoring points.

meta.name: Hammer of Grimmold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.09 KB

"Hammer of Grimmold" begins with an audience at the court of King Grimmold, ruler of the dwarves, who tasks the player with retrieving his legendary hammer. It was stolen by Valk – an evil magician who has hidden it within the impregnable Citadel. To complete the mission, the player must navigate dangerous areas, solve puzzles, and interact with friendly characters. If stuck, mentioning the King's name may provide crucial hints.

meta.name: Hammerfist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Hammerfist" is set in a dark future where humanity is controlled by genetically modified beings who look and act like ordinary people but subtly manipulate their minds and actions. This system works perfectly for Centro-Holographis – until two of their droids, Hammerfist and Metalisis, malfunction. In this action-packed adventure, the player takes control of both characters, switching between them at any time. Their distinct abilities must be used wisely to defeat enemies and deactivate the robots blocking the way.

meta.desc:

Hampstead throws you into the life of a broke city dreamer determined to climb the social ladder from a shabby flat. Armed with nothing but a welfare check, you attempt to break into the upscale world of Hampstead – but style, money and the right connections are essential. You explore London, gain access to exclusive circles, invest wisely and seize every opportunity to improve your status. Blending sharp humor with social satire, it becomes an ambitious struggle to rise – from nobody to respected member of high society.

meta.name: Handicap Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.14 KB

A very BASIC (as in written in BASIC language) golf game seen from above, Handicap Golf works by letting you enter the angle you want to hit your ball, using the digits of the clock, and the force of your strike on a scale between 0 and 250. An additional variable affecting the outcome is the wind, which is displayed when you input your numbers. Each hole covers one screen and features woods, bunkers and dams. Being written in BASIC, Handicap Golf uses slowly drawn text characters for graphics.

meta.name: Hang Over
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.74 KB

Hang Over drops you into a humorous text adventure where you struggle through the day after an overwhelming night out. You explore your surroundings, make choices and deal with situations that blend ordinary life with exaggerated hangover chaos. Each command opens new possibilities, and small actions can lead to unexpected outcomes. Its playful tone and unusual premise create a narrative experience driven by experimentation and discovery rather than straightforward solutions.

At the same time you must manage resources as hunger and thirst steadily decrease, pushing you to search for helpful items while hazards such as mines and surveillance systems complicate your route. Switches can provide brief safety, but mistakes are punished quickly – a tense blend of exploration, planning, and careful progression.

p: Happiest Days of Your Life, The (Europe).T64
n: Happiest Days of Your Life, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Happiest Days of Your Life
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.49 KB

In The Happiest Days of Your Life a schoolboy falls under suspicion after something is stolen from the headmaster of a private school. To prove his innocence, he must explore the school grounds and the nearby town, searching for clues and placing various items in the correct locations. Along the way he finds objects such as cassette tapes, school bags and other useful items, but he can only carry two at a time. Although the school seems empty, dangerous hazards drain his energy whenever he encounters them. This energy can be restored with food. Only by planning carefully, finding the right items and managing his energy can he clear his name and avoid being expelled.

meta.name: Happy Flappy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Happy Flappy follows the familiar Flappy Bird formula and jumps straight into the chase for the next high score. You keep the small character in the air, dodge pipes, and try to survive as long as possible with precise timing. Minor visual imperfections do little to change the fact that the simple flow quickly develops its usual pull. This creates a nostalgic skill test that awakens patience, rhythm, and the urge for one more attempt.

n: Harald Hardtooth - The Fight of the Clean Teeth (USA) (Unl)

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Harald Hardtooth is a tooth with a face, arms, legs and a bowtie, armed with a tube of toothpaste. He must use this toothpaste to shoot all manner of bacteria enough times to kill (erode?) them. The levels are made up of a sequence of platforms, which run across most of the level. Harald Hardtooth can always jump up one level, or jump down as far as necessary to reach the next ledge under him without incurring damage, although falling off the bottom of the level costs you a life. Energy is lost through contact with the bacteria, and you have a limited supply of toothpaste, with a need to collect more as the game goes on. You can also collect enhanced weaponry such as double firing.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.87 KB

You play as Special Inspector Francis, who is sent to the small market town of Harboro, where a murder has been committed and the suspect has been arrested. However, the suspect cannot be convicted because there is no evidence. Your task is to find the murder weapon. The game is part of a trilogy, which also includes Lost in the Amazon and St. Jives.

meta.name: Harbour Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.53 KB

Your mission is to take control of a submarine and get to the enemy port before attempting to destroy a cargo ship in three separate screen sections:
Stage one: You must move the submarine from left to right while avoiding touching mines or nets before your air supply is exhausted.
Stage two: You must destroy a certain number of planes and ships and kill or avoid an octopus. You can only shoot on the surface, thereby also increasing your air supply, which decreases underwater.
Phase three: In the final phase you are in a harbor and the view now switches to the first person perspective. The cargo ship that needs to be destroyed is at the back of the screen. You have to fire a torpedo at the screen and control it to hit a cross on the cargo ship while avoiding hitting barges.

meta.name: Hard Drivin'
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.84 KB

Hard Drivin' es un exitoso arcade 3D de Atari Games. Pilotas un deportivo de alto rendimiento: tu objetivo es recorrer el circuito lo más rápido posible y alcanzar cuantos más controles mejor —cada uno te da tiempo extra. El tráfico circula en ambos sentidos, así que ten cuidado al adelantar.
El circuito tiene dos tramos: Speed Track (más largo, velocidades más altas) y Stunt Track (con saltos, puentes y una rampa en loop).
Los choques no son fatales, sino espectaculares: se muestra una repetición cinemática (contra un camión de cemento, un monovolumen, etc.) y pierdes segundos mientras el coche se reinicia y acelera de nuevo.
Las versiones domésticas conservan los avanzados gráficos 3D de la época, pero carecen de la retroalimentación de fuerza del arcade.

meta.name: Hard Hat Mack
meta.desc:

Termine de construir el rascacielos evitando los tornillos que caen, los vándalos y los inspectores de construcción.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.36 KB

Dark Ward is a challenging platform game set in the kingdom of Sammon. After the power-hungry Corak makes a pact with dark forces, the realm descends into chaos. Princess Lavina falls into a deep coma, bringing her closer to death. A Sibyl predicts that only the hero Los can travel into the realm of darkness and find the sacred symbols to save the princess and defeat the dark forces. Los must battle through dangerous traps and treacherous obstacles to acquire the necessary treasure and return successfully.

meta.name: Hard 'n Heavy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jump and Run game during which a little robot (named 'Heavy' respectively 'Metal') runs through five side scrolling worlds (a la Mario). Various enemies hinder progress and can be killed using an upgradable weapons system based on bouncing balls and a flamethrower. Extras and 'diamonds' can be collected from shooting or otherwise destroying rocks and walls. There are two playing modes available, one player or two players.
Extra lives will be earned depending on the number of diamonds collected. Warp Zones and hidden entrances allow access to secret zones in the levels. Each world ends with a boss monster.

Hardball is a baseball action game for one or two players. You can throw a variety of pitches from fast balls to curve balls, steal bases, select team members, and substitute players as the game is played.

meta.name: Hardhat Construction Co.

Hardhat is an honest, hard-working employee, but his boss is a lazy worker who steals your bricks instead of getting his own. The crazy company doctor will try to paralyze you with his injections, and the mad welder would rather weld you than a piece of metal. You must avoid all these dangers while continuing to build your walls. You travel from the brick pile at the bottom of the building to the top floor, where you continue building upward. Good luck, and watch out for the falling bricks!

meta.name: Hardsync

Hardsync is a party game for the C64, named after one of the distinctive features of the SID chip. It is inspired by games like Dance Dance Revolution and StepMania. Using a special adapter, a PlayStation 2 dance pad is connected to the C64 to control the game. The adapter is documented on a website for anyone who wants to build it themselves.

„Operation Hormuz“ puts you in the cockpit of a fighter jet on a mission for the U.S. Navy to counter a hostile takeover of the Strait of Hormuz. The enemy has captured key military and naval bases, threatening the global oil supply with missile strikes launched from inland. Your task is to fly over enemy ships protected by MIG-21 fighters and then carry out a precise bombing run on a missile base. The silos can only be destroyed with highly accurate hits. After the strike, you must return to your aircraft carrier through hostile waters to refuel and rearm before taking on six more enemy installations further out in the Gulf.

meta.name: Harrier Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Harrier Attack is viewed from the side, and instantly resembles titles such as Wings of Fury and Jetstrike. You're on board of a Harrier and must reach the enemy island, destroying planes and ground installations as you go, then destroy their base and fly back to yours. Your Harrier is armed with both bombs and a gun. You must be careful not to fly at full speed throughout your journey as fuel is limited. There are 5 difficulty levels - the latter ones increase the volume and pace of the enemy, and add more mountains to avoid.

meta.name: Harrier Combat Simulator
meta.desc:

"In 'Harrier Combat Simulator' you take on the role of an elite pilot flying a solo mission over hostile desert territory in an AV-8B Harrier Jump Jet. Your objective is to destroy a heavily guarded enemy command center with critical oil reserves. Vertical takeoff and landing, supersonic speed and impressive armament are at your disposal – but the enemy fields top pilots, tank battalions and hundreds of SAMs. One mistake could be your last."

meta.name: Harvey Headbanger

Rotund drinkers Harvey Headbanger and Hamish Highball are at war in this single-screen action duel with a strategic edge. Walking across each of the 64 squares will turn them to your colour. Create a 3x3 box of these squares to release cocktails (of your own colour, so only you can use them) and top up your energy. Contact costs each player energy, but the player with a higher energy level can get up first. The aim to win a point is to trap your opponent inside a box of your squares. You can play to anything from 1 to 10 points, and at 5 difficulty levels in a one-player game.

Hat Trick is an ice hockey game where two players compete against each other. Each controls both a skater and a goalie at the same time. The objective is to shoot the puck into the opponent's goal while defending your own. Each match lasts two minutes, and quick movement, accurate shots, and sharp reflexes decide the winner.

meta.name: Hatchet Honeymoon

Para reclamar su herencia, debe pasar la primera semana de su luna de miel con su hermosa joven esposa en la antigua finca familiar en una isla tormentosa. Tu objetivo es concebir un heredero. Si su esposa no queda embarazada en esta semana, perderá la fortuna familiar. Esperas una semana de descubrimientos posteriores a la boda, pero poco sabes el horror que te espera dentro de las paredes oscuras de la finca.

meta.name: H.A.T.E : Hostile All Terrain Encounter

Año 2320: la galaxia está en caos, la amenaza alienígena crece y la escasez de pilotos de asalto experimentados debilita las defensas de los sectores civilizados. ¡Se te necesita para repeler a las fuerzas hostiles… pero primero debes calificar! Prepárate para dirigirte a Stripworld, el campo de entrenamiento de todos los pilotos de combate galácticos.

meta.name: Haunted House

In Haunted House, you play as a ghost tasked with preventing 20 souls from escaping the haunted mansion. Souls randomly appear from eight doors, aiming to grab a key and vanish through a vortex. If you fail to catch them in time, you must follow them into a maze, avoiding snakes and walls to recapture them before they escape again. As the game progresses, bats appear and the speed increases, making the challenge even harder.

meta.name: Haunted House

In Haunted House, you take on the role of a young adventurer searching for treasures in a haunted mansion. As you explore the castle, graveyard, and mysterious passages, you'll encounter ghosts, vampires, and other spooky creatures. To progress, you'll need to solve simple puzzles and make decisions. This text adventure is designed for kids aged 8 to 13, blending light-hearted scares with fun, age-appropriate problem solving.

Have a Nice Day! es un shooter minimalista con un toque de humor negro: tu objetivo es eliminar caras sonrientes de la pantalla con disparos precisos. Con munición ilimitada, cada impacto cuenta, ya que tu precisión se controla constantemente. Los gráficos sencillos esconden una exigencia de precisión y sincronización para mantener tu tasa de acierto al 100 %. Ya sea para aliviar el estrés o para practicar tiro al blanco, aquí, tu cínico interior se divierte.

meta.name: Havoc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.10 KB

Havoc takes place in the year 2024, in a world where global disarmament has finally become reality and the World Peace Force maintains order. But the mad mullah Mustapha Fracas has seized decommissioned cruise missiles and now threatens your homeland. From the safety of the WPF bunker, you control an unmanned interceptor fighter via satellite uplink. Viewed from an isometric perspective, the game challenges you to navigate tight terrain, dodge narrow passages, destroy enemy missiles and tanks, and manage your fuel level to avoid crashing.

meta.name: Havoc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 85.38 KB

"Havoc" puts you in the cockpit of a Soviet Mi-28 attack helicopter – or an AH-64 Apache if you prefer – as you battle through seven war zones. Each level ends with a powerful helicopter boss that must be destroyed. Enemy planes and ground installations stand in your way, but friendly units also fly nearby – hitting them turns allies into enemies and causes you to lose collected bonuses. To support your mission, you can gather packs that restore damage, lives, and weapons. Precision, strategy, and quick reflexes are key to completing your mission successfully.

meta.name: Hawk
meta.desc:

Hawk is a space shooter where the player controls a spacecraft and fights through waves of enemy ships and obstacles. The goal of the game is to survive and defeat various enemies. The player must dodge enemy fire and shoot back with their own weapons. The game features smooth background scrolling and increasing challenges.

meta.name: Hawk Patrol
meta.desc:

Hawk Patrol is an arcade shooter where the player controls Harry, a "fantastic shooting falcon." The goal of the game is to destroy enemy battle ships that approach from both sides of the screen while avoiding various hazards such as aliens, collisions with the ground, and rising rockets. The challenge lies in overcoming waves of enemy ships without getting hit.

meta.name: Hawk Storm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.98 KB

Hawk Storm is a brave warrior living on the planet Edos, and its citizens look up to him for survival. Edos has only one source of energy: the giant capacitoid crystals, capable of storing energy by day and regenerate that energy during the icy cold nights. Having realized this, the evil Nevik warriors decided to steal all but two of these crystals, making it impossible to sustain normal life on the planet. As a result, all of the people are forced to go in a Life Suspension Program, except Hawk, who must recover all thirty-two stolen crystals if Edos is to survive.

meta.name: Hawkeye

A bi-directional horizontally scrolling platform game, Hawkeye has the player in control of an SLF (Synthetic Life Form) controlled from an underground bunker by the Xamoxians. On each level, the eyes of the hawks in the status panel flash to indicate the direction to travel in to find a puzzle piece. Four pieces are needed to complete the level, but there were also other pickups such as ammo and energy. There were 12 levels to complete plus a hidden bonus level.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A bi-directional horizontally scrolling platform game, Hawkeye has the player in control of an SLF (Synthetic Life Form) controlled from an underground bunker by the Xamoxians. On each level, the eyes of the hawks in the status panel flash to indicate the direction to travel in to find a puzzle piece. Four pieces are needed to complete the level, but there were also other pickups such as ammo and energy. There were 12 levels to complete plus a hidden bonus level.

meta.name: Hazar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.24 KB

The aim of HAZAR is to enclose the blue discs horizontally, vertically or diagonally from two sides with their own (red) discs. With the glowing cursor, the player drives to the desired field and places a red disc there at the push of a button. All blue (= opposing) targets that are now enclosed between this one and one or more "old" targets are then turned over to the red side by the helicopter, and points are awarded for each one won in this way.
If the fire button is then pressed again, the computer now executes its move, and the helicopter hovers up again to transform the enclosed red disks into blue as an "executive organ".
It is important that every move must win at least one disc. If the player is temporarily unable to profitably place a disc, the computer continues to play on its own until the player has the opportunity to place their own targets again. Whoever has the most disc on the screen wins.

In a spin-off from one the most popular cartoon franchises of the day, the evil Skeletor has captured the magic-giving Ilearth Stone. This allows him to take control of Castle Grayskull, kidnap the Sorceress, and create a horde of fighters to attack He-Man's palace. He-Man must first rescue Orko from an 'imprison' spell (by collecting the right ingredients to cast a counter-spell), before taking on the full horror of the defences Skeletor has placed around the Ilearth stone.

meta.name: Head Coach
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.28 KB

Head Coach puts you in the role of an NFL coach tasked with building and leading your team through the season. You assemble the squad through trades and draft picks, set up offense, defense, and kicker, and make tactical calls during each game. Matches are presented with simple visuals of runs, passes, and field goal attempts. Strong strategies can take you to the playoffs and even the Super Bowl. A standout feature is the College Draft, where you select new players for the next season. The ultimate challenge is to win the trophy three years in a row at the highest difficulty level.

meta.name: Head On
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.24 KB

Head On is a one player arcade racing game featuring two vehicles travelling in opposite directions on a circular track with 6 lanes. The goal is to collect as many pellets as possible without coming in contact with the opponent vehicle. The opponent vehicle will always try to change lane towards the player, and can move one lane per opening. The player can change two lanes per opening, and must outmaneuver their opponent. Because shorter inside lanes take less time to traverse, the time between two vehicles passing remains variable.
There are 9 levels of difficulty, which influence the opponent's speed. The player starts with 5 vehicles. It's game over when all are destroyed.

meta.name: Head over Heels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.30 KB

Headus Mouthion (Head) y Footus Underium (Heels) son dos espías del Planeta Libertad (Planet Freedom). Son enviados a Blacktooth para liberar los planetas esclavizados de Penitentiary, Safari, Book World y Egyptus, y así poder derrotar al Emperador para prevenir que otros planetas caigan bajo su poder. Capturados y separados, los espías son trasladados a la prisión del cuartel general del Castillo de Blacktooth. Primero deberán escapar. Luego, a través del mercado, deben llegar hasta la estación Lunar (Moonbase), donde podrán usar los teletransportadores para viajar a los planetas esclavizados. Allí deberán localizar y recobrar las coronas robadas. La liberación de los planetas y la derrota del Emperador permitirá a Head y Heels volver al planeta Libertad (Planet Freedom) como héroes.

meta.name: Head Start
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.43 KB

Alphonse T. Nurd (later renamed Ivan Mop in the Bug-Byte re-release) is an assistant to the scientist Bogdan Schtunk and is curious to discover what his boss is working on. One night, while experimenting, Alphonse discovers the Atomic Particle People Splitter. Upon activating the machine, Alphonse splits into two individuals. To prevent Schtunk from noticing, he must bring his double to the Recombination Chamber. The laboratory is divided into five areas, where Alphonse must solve puzzles to progress. His double, however, enjoys its newfound freedom and tries to sabotage him. Schizofrenia is a side-view platformer where the player controls Alphonse, with points, lives, levels, and time displayed on the screen.

meta.name: Head the Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this colorful platform game you have to guide your little green moon face through three levels, each of which has four rounds.
Collecting gems is optional and will give you bonus points at the end of each level. Tapping the joystick down selects other items (shield and bomb). At the end of each level you will receive an additional copy. If you shoot everything in the following bonus level, you will get an extra life.
At the end of each round, except the last, you are given a choice of three paths marked with arrows. Some rounds in later levels repeat and you must enter the remaining paths that you did not take before.

meta.name: Headache
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.58 KB

In Headache you control Ned, who works inside a human head and is responsible for carrying nerve impulses to the correct destination. When a nerve center signals that an impulse is ready, you must collect it and deliver it either to the brain or from the brain down to the neck. While performing these tasks you must deal with several dangers: creatures called Throbs move around the head and can block your path, while the dangerous Head Banger climbs up from the neck toward the brain. Stopping him is crucial to prevent a massive headache. If Ned manages to survive long enough and keep the impulses flowing correctly, the head eventually returns to a clear state.
meta.developer: Andrew E. Bailey & Jon K. Menzies

meta.name: Heart Attack!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Heart Attack!" is a classic collecting game for the Commodore 64. Inspired by "Pac-Man", the game challenges the player to collect a playing field full of dots or special objects while avoiding enemies that chase him. The gameplay of "Heart Attack!" is typical for the genre: the player controls a character that moves through a maze, collecting all the dots. The goal is to clear the entire playing field without being caught by the enemies. The enemies chase the player through the maze, making collecting an exciting challenge that requires quick reactions and smart moves. Like "Pac-Man", the player may be able to collect certain power-ups that give him an advantage or allow him to drive away the enemies for a short time.

meta.name: Heart of Africa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

January, 1890. The Africa of your imagination is about to become real.
BOOK PASSAGE TO ANY PORT: You have the thinnest of leads, the diary of a madman who disappeared hunting for the hidden tomb of a legendary pharaoh. You also have no time to waste. There are over 30 cities and settlements to visit, and you're not the only one on the trail.
SEARCH FOR CLUES AND EQUIPMENT: What the natives know will help, if you can get them to talk. The tools and goods inside their huts will help, too - shovels, canteens, canoe paddles, whips, ropes, machetes, guns, maps, gifts, and more. Just be careful. Not everyone will be happy to see you.
GEOGRAPHICALLY AND HISTORICALLY ACCURATE: Imagine a huge map of Africa stuffed into your computer. The Nile. The Congo. The Niger. Mt. Kilimanjaro. The Sahara. Lake Victoria. The whole thing. And if you get lost, just press the button. "The Nile River," the screen will say. What it won't say is, "about 2 miles above the falls."
AUTOMATIC MAPS AND RECORDS: As you explore, your computer draws maps and keeps a journal, recording the most important clues for later review. It also keeps a record of your last two, uh... misfortunes. "Lost incredibly valuable talisman while running from very angry rhino," it might say, or "Oops, better luck next time."

meta.name: Heartland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.84 KB

In "Heartlands," the player immerses themselves in a world to complete the story of a book whose last six pages have been lost. The objective is to defeat evil by rescuing the white pages and destroying the black ones. The game features six levels with charming themes and colorful graphics. The intricate level layouts require the player to return to the base after each section before entering the next level within a time limit. The levels are filled with wizards that must be defeated and include minor interactions with characters.

meta.name: Heat Wave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Powerboat USA: Offshore Superboat Racing puts you in a high-powered boat against several rivals and combines speed with a surprising amount of control. During each race, you need to watch engine heat, trim, and the condition of your boat, since collisions or rough sections can make repairs necessary. Your preparation with fuel and spare parts already matters before the start. This creates a fast offshore racing game that pleasantly blends speed, course knowledge, and smart forward planning.

meta.name: Heathrow Air Traffic Control
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Heathrow Air Traffic Control, you are responsible for managing all aircraft movements around London's major airport. You must coordinate landings, handle emergencies, and tackle increasingly complex scenarios. Careful planning and quick decision-making are essential to avoid collisions and ensure smooth operations.

meta.name: Heatseeker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

On the planet Tantris there are the Triphylios of Nem plants, which help keep the population alive and the vast forests pure. But increasing industry has led to high levels of pollution, damaging crops and destroying forests.
To cope with impending doom, the Gnostics constructed the Leg, a heat probe shaped like a leg that can launch a heat-absorbing ball. This can then be controlled independently of the leg and absorb the heat of the Zeal smog flames and then pass this heat on to the three plants that need to be saved.
When the ball has absorbed heat and is returned to the leg, the leg gains energy and the pass count is increased. When this counter reaches 9999, the Leg can teleport to the next jungle level, where it can search for more Zeal Smog Flames to finally save the Triphylios.

meta.name: Heavenbound
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A curious, yet technically proficient platform-shooter, where the objective of the game is to help a small, pink elephant ascend to Heaven. Basically, this involves leaping between fluffy clouds, shooting monsters and collecting the power-up tokens they occasionally leave behind.

meta.name: Heavy Metal : Modern Land Combat Vol. I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Heavy Metal: Modern Land Combat Vol. I" is an action-packed shooter where the player controls a tank through four hostile areas. As the screen automatically scrolls upward, the tank can move freely and engage enemy units. A radar on the left side helps track the tank's position and detect incoming enemies. Power-ups can be collected along the way, including a shield for extra protection, a super shot for stronger attacks, a super missile with high impact, and a speed boost for increased maneuverability. While the tank has multiple lives, a single direct hit results in an instant loss of one.

meta.name: Heavy Metal Deluxe!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A game that combines Tetris with a shoot-'em-up style. The goal is to match falling blocks by color and shoot them back to their origin to score points and advance levels. There are 32 levels that increase in speed as progress is made. Players can choose between two modes: either shooting a set number of blocks to complete a level or surviving for a predetermined duration in survival mode. The synth-pop soundtrack is vibrant and entertaining, though it doesn't quite match the "Metal" in the name.

meta.name: Heavy Metal Solid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.44 KB

An early version of the later-released "Heavy Metal Deluxe," combining Tetris with a shoot-'em-up approach. The goal is to match falling blocks by color and shoot them back to their origin to score points and advance levels. With 32 levels that speed up as progress is made, the game offers two modes: either shoot a specified number of blocks to complete the level or survive a chosen duration in survival mode. The game demands skill and strategy, delivering varied gameplay for those looking to test their abilities.

meta.name: The Heist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.00 KB

In The Heist you take the role of a cat burglar breaking into multi-level buildings to steal valuable paintings. Each floor is filled with dangers such as security systems, pits and patrolling robots that try to stop you. Since your only real means of survival is running and jumping, success depends entirely on timing and precise movement. Ladders connect the floors, allowing you to move through the building, collect the paintings and escape unharmed. Only by grabbing every artwork and skillfully avoiding the hazards can you pull off the heist successfully.

meta.name: Hektic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

«¿LANZA o LANZA? —esa es la cuestión»: quien elige lo primero lo tiene más fácil; quien opta por lo segundo, más difícil.
Con tres vidas, una cantidad limitada de energía, 15 cartuchos y el joystick en el puerto nº2, comienza la acción.
En 4 niveles de 25 pantallas cada uno —que debes recorrer a razón de 20 por minuto—, debes esquivar obstáculos y disparar al resto. Cualquier contacto con los «habitantes» del túnel reduce tu energía; tocar un objeto de la «instalación» cuesta una vida al instante (¡sospechamos veneno por contacto!).

meta.name: Hektic II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This single screen platformer is easy enough: shoot the robots to collect the disks, then put them in the flashing terminals to release your... er, kids? Published in Game On 1993/02.

meta.name: Hektik
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.16 KB

In Hektik, the goal is to eliminate all the monsters on the screen that are chasing the player. Inspired by the arcade classic "Space Panic," the player digs holes in the walkways to trap enemies and waits for a monster to fall in. The hole is then filled, causing the monster to drop a level and be killed. There are two types of monsters: red "Hunters," which die after falling one level, and green "Chasers," which need to fall multiple levels before being defeated. Adding to the challenge, the player's oxygen supply depletes over time, creating extra pressure. Once all monsters are defeated, the player progresses to the next level. Skill and strategy are key to overcoming the challenge!

meta.name: Helden
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Heli Drop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Heli Drop, the player takes on the role of Joe Starbuck, who must complete an important mission with a helicopter. His task is to pick up vital supplies and drop them at the besieged embassy in Moldova to help those trapped inside. The game is a side-scrolling shooter, where the player constantly flies from right to left, avoiding enemy helicopters and ground fire. The player has three lives, which are lost upon collision or being hit. For defense, the player can use their cannon and has three smart bombs that destroy everything on screen. Supplies must be collected and dropped precisely to complete the level.

meta.name: Heli Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Heli Rescue puts you in control of a helicopter as you explore a vast maze to collect 30 scattered keys and free captives from enemy hideouts. Along the way, you encounter four different types of helpful characters, each marked by a distinct color. You must pick them up and deliver them to the correct houses with matching flags on the roof. In return, they grant rewards: pink characters provide a key, eight yellow ones earn you an extra life, and blinking ones assist you in recovering otherwise unreachable keys. Skillful navigation and smart planning are essential to complete the rescue mission.

meta.name: Heli-Jump
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.93 KB

"Heli-Jump" challenges players to coordinate parachute jumps and rescue missions with precise timing. Skill and speed are crucial for success.

meta.name: The Helicopter Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Helicopter Mission is a side-scrolling shoot'em up game for the Commodore 64. The gameplay is reminiscent of the classic arcade title Scramble, in which the player controls a helicopter through hostile areas, avoids obstacles and fights enemies. Particularly noteworthy is the integrated level editor, which was programmed in a combination of BASIC and assembler. This editor allows players to create their own levels and customize the gaming experience.

meta.name: Helikopter Jagd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Helikopter-Jagd," you pilot a helicopter equipped with a laser gun over a seascape dotted with small islands. Your mission is to locate and rescue people before they starve or drown. Fly close to them so your helicopter can drop a ladder to pick them up. Safely deliver the rescued individuals to a platform. The upper screen displays information about your fuel supply and helicopter stability. Avoid running out of fuel by collecting yellow oil barrels floating in the water. Dodge enemy attacks and eliminate threats in the air and on the water, including gunboats, fighter jets, enemy helicopters, and a heat-seeking missile. Skill and strategy are key to completing the mission successfully.

meta.name: Helistad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Helistad" is a game where you use a helicopter to transport bricks from a barge to an island to build the tallest possible hotel. Over six days, you aim to achieve the highest score, with each day represented by the movement of the sun at the top of the screen. Each new floor earns one point, while you compete against a computer opponent or a second player building simultaneously. Natural disasters such as floods, earthquakes, gusts of wind, and lightning complicate progress, and a plane that appears regularly can cause the loss of transported bricks. The game ends after six days, regardless of whether you had to stop earlier. If the joystick remains unused, the computer takes over without awarding points.

meta.name: Hell Cat Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A classic 1st person flight simulation similar to Ace of Aces. In several missions you have to shoot down Japanese fighters and bombers. Through the front cockpit window you can see the sky and the ocean. Below the cockpit view is the instrument panel with engine power, altitude, fuel and your ammunition-counter. Through the rear window you can see the enemies on your tail.

meta.name: Hell for Leather
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.41 KB

Hell For Leather was an ambitious project by James Macdonald under his label Psycodelic Software Developments. Initially conceived as a technical showcase for smooth parallax scrolling, the project evolved into a full-fledged game. Although nearly completed, it was never officially released due to disputes over naming rights and the theft of the game at a London trade show. Despite these setbacks, the project highlights Macdonald's talent and his potential to deliver impressive results without strict deadlines.

meta.name: Hell in Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.51 KB

"Hell in Space" is a humorous and entertaining game that appeals to retro gaming fans with a touch of wit. The energetic atmosphere is enhanced by the memorable techno music on the title screen. The game provides an accessible experience, further enriched by additional programming that pushes the capabilities of the tool used. Clear instructions on the title screen ensure an easy start, keeping the focus on fun and straightforward gameplay.

meta.name: Hell Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.93 KB

"Hell Zone" immerses players in a hostile world where they must face waves of enemies and overcome obstacles. The game relies on classic shooter mechanics, emphasizing quick reflexes and skillful maneuvers. The action-packed atmosphere and challenging level design deliver an intense and engaging gaming experience.

meta.name: Hell Zone 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.84 KB

"Hell Zone II" expands on its predecessor by introducing a cooperative two-player mode, allowing players to team up against enemy forces. The setting shifts from the jungles of the first installment to an urban warehouse environment, giving the game a fresh atmosphere. With increased difficulty, the game demands precise maneuvers and coordinated actions, especially in cooperative mode, delivering an intense and challenging gameplay experience.

meta.name: Hellball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.64 KB

"Hellball" offers a humorous twist on the classic "Pong" concept, where players hit the ball back using their heads. This quirky approach adds a unique charm to the game, blending strategy with fun. The two-player mode provides thrilling duels, while the music composed by Rob Hubbard perfectly complements the gameplay experience.

meta.name: Hellcat Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Hellcat Ace" is a first-person flight simulation where the player must shoot down Japanese fighters and bombers across multiple missions. Through the front cockpit window, the sky and ocean are visible, while the instrument panel below provides critical information such as engine power, altitude, fuel levels, and ammunition count. The rear window allows players to track enemies positioned behind them. The game combines strategic flying with intense aerial combat.

meta.name: Hellfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hellfire is all about direct, uncompromising action, throwing you into a combat mission where your heavily armed helicopter is meant to blast everything in its path apart. The settings shift between day and night and across different types of terrain, giving the action some visual variety. To progress, you have to destroy enough enemy aircraft in each section – otherwise the level starts over, which adds a noticeable layer of pressure. Extras such as additional lives and smart bombs help you stay in control when things become especially chaotic.

meta.name: Hellgate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Zzyaxians want to destroy the Earth, they have decided to create hyperspace near Pluto and carry out a surprise attack.
The problem for them is that we have detected their arrival and re-entry location as they zoom toward our solar system. A Hell Gate has quickly been constructed around the re-entry point and it's up to you to control four laser heads on the gate's walls and blast everything that appears across 20 levels. When all aliens are destroyed, the next wave of Zzyaxians begins. Occasionally some goats appear and run over the gate. If they make it through without being killed, you get bonus points.
Any laser head touched causes them all to explode, but destroys everything else in the gate. You lose one life out of four and if you lose all of them, the game is over.

meta.name: Hellhole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A side scrolling platformer that casts you as a soldier dropped behind enemy lines. Battle aliens and navigate platforms to make your way home. The game boasts multiple weapons, and items to power them up. Such as teflon bullets which rip through enemies, and items to increase your firepower and rate of fire.

meta.name: The Hellion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.36 KB

"The Helion" is an intense shooter game featuring 101 challenging levels that test even the most skilled alien hunters. Its fast-paced mechanics and psychedelic graphic style create an immersive experience, heavily inspired by Jeff Minter's distinctive approach. Players can either start the adventure from the beginning or resume a few levels before their last failure, enhancing replay value.

meta.name: Hellraid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.26 KB

In a wild and enchanted world, an unforeseen event occurred in the village of Tibis, nestled at the foot of Mount Titus. The massive lava giant, dormant in the volcano's depths for centuries, suddenly awakened, threatening Tibis and the surrounding villages. Frequent earthquakes and relentless eruptions put the population in peril and drove them to despair. In their desperation, they summoned the warrior Athor to venture deep into the earth and defeat the giant. An epic adventure awaits, featuring over 160 screens and 200 animated sprites for endless gaming excitement!
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: The Helm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.58 KB

In The Helm you set out to recover the Helm of Immortality, which was stolen long ago by the evil Lich. The helm lies hidden deep within the corrupted depths of his castle, and many adventurers have already failed in trying to reclaim it. Before you can confront the Lich himself, you must explore the surrounding area, find useful objects and overcome many monsters and creatures along the way. The game is played as a text adventure, with your surroundings described on screen and your actions entered through typed commands. Only through careful exploration and smart decisions will you have a chance of recovering the helm.

The enemies remain invisible but briefly appear through flashes of lightning. The player must strike precisely with a stake, defeating each vampire with a single blow.

meta.name: Helter Skelter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Marble Madness meets pinball. Ball rolling game with a simple goal: Move the ball to hit moving targets within time limit to win the level. On the higher levels feature hazards and bonus items, and you can score some big points if you hit them in the right sequence. Most targets are cutesy-looking aliens, and a big yellow arrow shows which one you must bounce at next.

meta.name: Henry's House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.56 KB

"Henry's House" en este plataformas, el jugador debe guiar a Henry a través de las numerosas habitaciones de su casa. Cada habitación es un nivel de una pantalla llena de objetos domésticos mortales, como cepillos de dientes, teteras, tostadas voladoras o cafeteras. Tocar uno de estos objetos o caer desde demasiada altura mata a Henry. El objetivo de cada habitación es llegar a la salida; sin embargo, antes de que la salida se abra, Henry debe recoger una llave y todos los objetos repartidos por el nivel. Para que aparezca la llave, Henry suele tener que recoger un objeto especial que, a veces, añade más obstáculos a la habitación.

meta.name: Herbert's Dummy Run

Herbert's Dummy Run sends you into a department store as little Herbert, where you must find your parents before the day is over. Its appeal mainly comes from the constant mix of exploring, collecting items, and using them in the right places. Since you can only carry two objects at once, a bit of planning is required, while small action sequences and dangerous enemies keep the pressure up. The limited time and Herbert's sensitive tear meter make the whole adventure even more hectic and give it a charmingly stressful feel.

meta.name: Herby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.78 KB

Herby sends you through a sprawling maze of more than one hundred single-screen rooms connected both horizontally and vertically. Starting with five lives, you explore in eight directions while searching for the exit and avoiding numerous hazards. Vanishing barriers, moving enemies and shifting blocks demand precise timing, as a single collision is instantly fatal. Along the way, you collect keys, open doors and use items whose effects may be immediate or revealed later. Score, room number, progress percentage and carried keys are always displayed – a large-scale puzzle adventure that rewards patience and awareness.

meta.name: Maze Thriller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.81 KB

Herby Thriller once again places you alongside Herby in an action-packed adventure spanning ten challenging stages. In each room you must locate hidden keys to unlock the exit and move on. Making clever use of the pockets' special function is essential for overcoming obstacles and discovering new paths. Precise timing, smart route planning and constant awareness are key – only a balanced mix of skill and strategy will guide Herby safely to success.

meta.name: Hercules
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The 16-bit box calls this 'The Ultimate Challenge' and they're not kidding; this flick-screen platform game is one of the toughest you'll come across. In the 8-bit versions Hercules has some titanic tasks to complete, whilst in the 16-bit versions his daughter Yolanda has been cursed and can only free herself by completing the same tasks.
Unusually, the game's dozens of screens are given in a random order, with a different one after you lose each life. You have no weapon with which to harm the various creatures that lurk within. The pace of the enemies is quite hectic, but the real unique feature is that you must keep moving – each platform is set on fire a few seconds after you first touch it.

meta.name: Hercules : Slayer of the Damned!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hercules: Slayer of the Damned puts you in the role of the demigod Hercules as he battles through action-packed stages to complete the 12 labors. In various historical settings, you fight monsters to collect their symbols. Only once all are gathered can you face the ultimate foe: the Minotaur. Strength, courage, and stamina are your keys to surviving this hellish quest.

meta.name: Hermetic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hermetic throws you into a fast-scrolling space battle where you fight through hostile zones, destroy waves of enemies and dodge deadly obstacles. Quick maneuvers and accurate shooting are essential as the pace constantly increases. A standout feature is the multiplayer mode – whether cooperating or competing, the added player brings a fresh layer of tension to the experience. With its futuristic setting and relentless action, the game delivers an intense arcade thrill.

meta.name: Hermetic

A standout feature is the multiplayer mode – whether cooperating or competing, the added player brings a fresh layer of tension to the experience. With its futuristic setting and relentless action, the game delivers an intense arcade thrill.

meta.name: The Hermitage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Hermitage” is a text-based adventure set in the Middle Ages, an era ruled by superstition and religious doctrine. Playing as Ambrose the monk, the player is sent on a mission by the Archbishop to seek out and destroy an allegedly evil hermit. However, as the journey unfolds, Ambrose begins to question his mission and his faith. Internal struggles and external trials challenge him along the way, and moral decisions shape the fate of the monk. The story is thought-provoking, requiring careful choices to determine the outcome of the quest.

meta.name: H.E.R.O.: Helicopter Emergency Rescue Operation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.72 KB

¡Hay problemas en las minas! La actividad volcánica ha atrapado a numerosos mineros, y tu trabajo es salvarlos. Como Roderick Hero, tienes que atravesar el peligroso pozo minero evitando las criaturas y la lav para descubrir dónde están los mineros antes de que te quedes sin energía. Para ayudarlo en su misión, Roderick Hero tiene varios tipos de equipos útiles. Un paquete que te permitirá flotar y volar alrededor del pozo de extracción y (con suerte) evitar los muchos peligros que existen dentro. Su casco cuenta con un rayo microlaser de corto alcance que puede usarse para destruir murciélagos, arañas, serpientes y otras criaturas que encontrará en las minas.

meta.name: Hero 2020
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.24 KB

In Hero 2020, you play as the last surviving member of the Cosmo Police, whose comrades were killed while attempting to free the planet Cynep from an evil force. Now, you are the planet's last hope. The game combines elements of a shooter and a platformer: you navigate through caves, jump over obstacles, and shoot anything that moves. However, at the start, you are unarmed and can only kick or punch. You must find pyramids left behind by your fallen comrades or sometimes by slain aliens. These pyramids grant you armor, more health, and a weapon. If you find another pyramid, your weapon will be temporarily upgraded. However, each hit reduces your health, and if it drops too low, you lose both your armor and weapon. A life ends when your health reaches zero. At the end of each level, you must defeat a large boss alien.

meta.name: Hero of the Golden Talisman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.73 KB

Hero of the Golden Talisman tells the story of a hero whose town has been cursed by an evil wizard. The magical talisman that once protected it has been shattered into five pieces and hidden in a vast labyrinth filled with monsters. Your mission is to recover all the pieces, defeat the wizard, and restore peace. The adventure unfolds as a side-scrolling quest across 512 screens, divided into 64 rooms over five levels. You'll jump, climb, swim, and fight against birds, eyeball creatures, and fire-breathing dragons. Helpful objects like keys, lamps, or flags can be carried and used, while power-ups restore health and air. A map keeps track of your position, visited rooms, and highlights items, making it an essential tool to navigate the massive labyrinth.

meta.name: Hero Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El famoso juego de tablero "fantasy" se ha convertido en un juego de rol de vista isométrica en el que hay que derrotar al malvado mago Morcar. Tomas el control de un mago, un enano, un bárbaro y un elfo (cada uno con habilidades diferentes), que comienzan las misiones desde lados opuestos del tablero.
Los movimientos se determinan mediante una tirada de dados, y sólo se pueden realizar otras acciones antes o después del movimiento. Estos movimientos se realizan mediante un sistema basado en iconos. Los personajes pueden luchar contra los numerosos monstruos que acechan o lanzar hechizos para derrotarlos. Hay pociones mágicas que descubrir, pero también trampas ocultas, por lo que se recomienda trazar un mapa. Los tesoros se pueden recoger e intercambiar en la tienda después de cada nivel.

Hero Quest: Return of the Witch Lord expands the original game with a series of new, interconnected quests. This time the heroes embark on a continuous storyline that leads them into the ruined city of Kalos, where the Witch Lord has returned as a menacing threat. Gameplay follows the familiar Hero Quest formula: moving characters across isometric maps, exploring rooms, battling monsters, and collecting treasures. However, the expansion is notably harder, demanding greater strategy, careful planning, and teamwork to overcome the forces of darkness.

meta.name: Hero Time II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.63 KB

In Hero Time II, you control a brave knight who fights through the land, battling enemies and creatures. Your goal is to collect gold for bonus points and fight your way through various levels. The focus is on quick action, defeating foes, and overcoming obstacles.

meta.name: Herobotix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.62 KB

In Herobotix, you take control of a “Herobot” sent into the Alliance's base to recover the six parts of the dangerous Z-Ray weapon and download critical data from the central computer. The base is a maze filled with energy barriers and conveyor belts that block your path. Switches and terminals can disable these obstacles or display a map of the surroundings. Twelve different enemy droids oppose you—some patrol fixed routes, others charge directly, and some can shoot. Armed with a blaster, you can fight them off, or use an energy bomb that wipes out all enemies onscreen but drains half your energy. Skill and strategy are essential to secure all parts of the weapon and complete the mission.

meta.name: The Heroes of Karn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Heroes of Karn you take on the role of the mysterious Stranger from a distant land and enter a realm shaped by ancient horrors and lost legends. Your task is to free the four heroes of Karn, who were enchanted after the fall of the kingdom of Beren, while also recovering the treasures of the land. During your journey you explore different locations, collect useful objects, solve puzzles and face dangerous enemies. By typing commands you decide your actions, use items and can even order other characters to perform certain tasks. The combination of interactive storytelling, graphics and music gives the adventure a distinctive atmosphere.

meta.name: Heroes Of Midgard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.24 KB

In Heroes of Midgard, you fight as part of the Malexheim army against the legions of Hel. Your goal is to defeat the enemy hordes and save the land while battling through dangerous regions like Niflheim. The game combines classic shoot-'em-up mechanics with an engaging Norse mythology, challenging you to grow increasingly powerful as you face ever-stronger enemies.

meta.name: Heroes of the Lance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en las últimas partes del libro "Dragonlance Dragons of Autumn Twilight", los héroes descienden a una ciudad en ruinas en busca de los discos de Mishakal.
El juego consiste en un combate horizontal con un mapa laberíntico, utilizando puertas para cambiar la vista. El grupo está formado por los 8 Héroes de la Lanza, utilizando uno a la vez y el jugador puede cambiar entre ellos en cualquier momento. Cada personaje tiene diferentes tipos de ataques y hechizos, lo que los hace más adecuados para luchar contra diferentes enemigos y comportarse como personas reales.
Uno de los juegos de AD&D que se desmarca del RPG habitual.

meta.name: HES Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"HES Games" is a multi-event sports simulation that recreates six different track and field disciplines. Up to six players can compete, testing their skills in various competitions. Each attempt can be retried, and for training purposes, simulated recordings of current world record performances can be viewed. The events include the 100-meter sprint, 110-meter hurdles, long jump, platform diving, archery, and weightlifting. Precision, timing, and quick reflexes are key to achieving top performances.

meta.name: Hex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.50 KB

Hex is a pure two-player memory game where players take turns revealing elements on a grid or board, aiming to find matching pairs. Success relies on remembering the positions of previously revealed elements. The game is designed exclusively for direct competition between two players, offering simple, accessible mechanics that remain challenging and engaging.
