meta.name: Hexpert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.21 KB

Hexpert is a single screen game, with an isometric view, based on the arcade game Q*Bert where you control Bert trapped on a pyramid by the evil witch Zoganaar. Over various levels, Bert has to turn every hexagon on the pyramid from one colour to the other by landing on them to move to the next level. Also on the pyramid are bouncing balls and a snake which follows Bert and these have to be avoided or you lose one of five lives. Two spinning discs either side of the pyramid when jumped on move Bert to the top of the pyramid and can make the snake jump off the pyramid for a short time. If Bert jumps off the pyramid then it is game over.

meta.name: Hey Diddle Diddle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hey Diddle Diddle is an educational game for young children that teaches reasoning skills through the use of nursery rhymes. It is made up of three parts: storytime, storybook and rhyme game. Storytime and storybook displays all the rhymes accompanied with music and images. The difference between the two is that in the storybook the player decides when to advance in the reading. In the rhyme game, the player is presented with four or eight lines (depending on level) from a rhyme and has to put them in the correct order. The game can be played with a timer and the player's score depends on how fast the rhyme is solved. It's playable by one or two players.

meta.name: Hi Bouncer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.31 KB

Hi Bouncer puts you in the spinning shoes of Mr. Bounce, helping out beloved characters from Roger Hargreaves' Mr. Men series across four main screens, each with eight increasing difficulty levels. Whether returning items to Mr. Tall, launching windows for Mr. Lazy, catching fruit for Mr. Bump, or shading Mr. Snow with clouds, your reflexes and timing are constantly tested. Avoid puddles and steer clear of your friends, or you'll bounce out of control and lose one of your four lives. Fortunately, a practice mode with seven difficulty levels lets you gear up for the bouncy chaos ahead.

meta.name: Hi Ska Do
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

HI SKA DO is a MAH-JONG variant for the C64 that brings a little arcade atmosphere into your four walls. The aim is to remove all pieces from the playing field within a given time limit. However, since this is only possible according to fixed rules, the player must proceed with great care and consideration. With each level created, the time limit also shrinks.

meta.name: Hi-q-quiz
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.94 KB

meta.name: Hickory Dickory Dock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hickory Dickory Dock is an educational game designed to teach children how to read an analog clock. A large clock face with clearly visible hands is displayed, and players must identify the time shown and enter it correctly. Bright colors, simple graphics, and a cheerful presentation make it an engaging way for young learners to practice telling time.

meta.name: The Hidden Treasure of Inca
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.11 KB

The Hidden Treasure of Inca begins with you waking in a dry well – no explanation, no map, just your mind. This text adventure sends you on a quest for the legendary treasure of the Incas. You type in commands, explore your surroundings, solve puzzles, and make choices that determine your fate. Every line matters, every clue could unlock the next step. Only the observant, the logical, and the brave will find the treasure.

meta.name: Hide And Seek
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.26 KB

"Hide and Seek" is a learning package designed for children aged four to ten. It includes three games aimed at enhancing memory and matching skills. In "Find It," the child sees six pictures, which are then turned over. The child must guess the location of a specific picture, with two attempts allowed before the solution is revealed. "Seek It" offers three difficulty levels and challenges the child to arrange nine pictures in any order. After turning the pictures over, the child is asked to identify the location of a specific picture, again with two attempts. In "What's Missing," the child chooses between recognizing an image or spelling the word for the image. Nine pictures are displayed, and then one is removed, requiring the child to guess which picture is missing.

meta.name: Hide'n Sequence
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Hide'n Sequence" provides students with the opportunity to analyze and write literary texts by arranging ideas from a selected passage into the correct sequence. This process creates a larger, cohesive narrative.

meta.name: Hideous Bill & the Gi-Gants
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.65 KB

Hideous Bill & the Gi-Gants tells a delightfully odd rescue mission in which Bill has to save his girlfriend Greta from the clutches of giant ants. Each stage has its own focus, as you first need to destroy every egg while several giants constantly try to take Bill down. The warp tunnels on both sides are especially useful for moving quickly across the area, and the scattered items add even more variety to the action. Spears, ways to trap enemies, and later even beans for breaking through walls keep introducing new ideas until the adventure finally leads to the rescue of Bill's true love.

meta.name: Hideous!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.94 KB

Hideous! blends action with a slight tactical edge, sending you into a contaminated complex in a tank surrounded by mutated creatures. The goal is not only to keep the enemies under control, but also to seal the radiation leak on each level by collecting lead blocks one by one and placing them in the right spots. That mix of combat, retrieval, and careful resource management creates real tension, because fuel and ammunition are limited and force you to think ahead. The result is a nicely pressurized adventure that constantly demands movement and attention.

meta.name: Hidihood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.42 KB

"Hidihood" is a fast-paced escape game where the goal isn't to defeat enemies but to outmaneuver them. As hordes of aliens charge toward you, your only option is to flee at full speed and survive as long as possible.

meta.name: High Flyer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.75 KB

In High Flyer, players take on the role of an airline tycoon, aiming to build the best airline possible. They manage routes, oversee aircraft maintenance, and handle finances. The game combines strategy with management and presents a challenge in both operational and financial aspects of running an airline.

meta.name: High Flyer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Do you have a knack for big business? This is your chance to run your own airline. Like all great pioneers in the business world, you start from the bottom with a small company and develop it into a multi-million dollar empire through shrewdness and entrepreneurial talent. The decisions are all yours: flight schedules and routes; which type of aircraft generates the best profits; when it's best to expand your fleet or upgrade existing planes; whether you need to borrow money from the bank and which banks offer the best exchange rates. Moreover, once you've made enough decisions for the day, you can save your progress and dive back into the high-flying world the next time you play.

meta.name: High Frontier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

High Frontier puts you in the role of a Cold War strategist tasked with developing the SDI program ("Star Wars"). Across multiple screens, you manage research, budget, personnel, and surveillance systems, analyze threats, and launch defenses against Soviet attacks. Espionage provides only vague data, so wise decisions and timely activation of your satellite defense are crucial. The President gives the final order – but whether the world stays safe is up to you.

meta.name: High Memory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.34 KB

"High Memory" challenges players to remember the colors and positions of tiles. Matching a pair earns points, while mismatched pairs result in the tiles being shuffled and a lost attempt. When no attempts remain, the game ends. At the start, players observe the game board to memorize the positions of the colors. Subsequently, the player and either a second player or the computer engage in a memory game, where incorrect guesses not only cost a turn but also rearrange the colors, increasing the difficulty.

meta.name: High Noon Shootout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.46 KB

High Noon Shootout est un jeu de tir sur cible simple, utilisant le système Stack Light Rifle (SLR). Le joueur contrôle un réticule pour atteindre les cibles.

meta.name: High Rise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.72 KB

"High Rise" is a puzzle game where the player must construct a stable tower using blocks. The character Barnaby moves beneath five chutes filled with blocks, selects suitable ones, and strategically places them on a springboard. From there, the blocks are sent to the building section and stacked. Once the tower reaches the required height, Barnaby can climb it to reach a ladder at the top of the screen and advance to the next level. Careful selection and placement of blocks are crucial, as an unstable tower will collapse. The game is timed, with each level allowing less time. In instructor mode, the game can be played without time restrictions.

In this game, the goal is to achieve the best hand using poker-like rules. The highest combination is three threes, followed by three aces, three kings, three queens, and so on. Next come straight flushes like Ace-Two-Three or Ace-King-Queen, followed by regular straights, flushes, and pairs, with a pair of aces being the most valuable. If no pairs are present, the highest card decides, starting with an ace. The player begins with £1000, aiming to reach £10000 to win the game. If all money is lost, the computer wins. Each round starts with a £10 bet. After the cards are dealt, the player can bet, pay to see the computer's cards, or fold. The best hand wins the pot unless the player folds. In the event of a tie, the money goes to the computer.

meta.name: High Rollers
meta.desc:

El juego es una adaptación de un concurso estadounidense en el que dos concursantes juegan a ganar dinero tirando dados, eliminando ciertos números y respondiendo preguntas.
Cada vez que se tiran los dados, hay que responder a una pregunta. El primer jugador debe pulsar sus botones para responder a la pregunta. Si el jugador responde correctamente, tiene el control de los dados y puede decidir lanzarlos o pasárselos al otro jugador. Por otro lado, si el jugador responde incorrectamente, el otro jugador tiene el control de los dados y puede lanzarlos o pasárselos.
En el juego en solitario, juegas contra el ordenador.

meta.name: High Seas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"High Seas" is a strategic game about naval battles in the age of sailing ships. From a graphical deck view, the player controls their ship, while a map view helps monitor positions, especially during engagements with multiple ships. The game accounts for wind conditions affecting maneuverability and the impact of different types of ammunition on opponents' wooden hulls and sails. It can be played turn-based in 10-minute intervals or in real-time with command interruptions. A standout feature is the scenario designer. The game can be played in hot-seat mode or against a computer opponent.

Highlander puts you in the role of the immortal Connor MacLeod as you fight three duels against increasingly powerful foes: Ramirez, Fizir, and the final showdown with Kurgan. Battles are won by draining the enemy's energy through successful hits or by forcing them into blocked attacks. Your moves change based on stance and joystick direction, requiring a mix of offense and defense. A two-player mode lets you duel a friend head-to-head.

meta.name: Highnoon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.62 KB

Highnoon puts you in the boots of a sheriff defending his town from outlaws trying to rob the bank or kidnap women from Saucy Sue's Saloon. With revolver in hand, you shoot in multiple directions as increasingly dangerous waves of bandits charge on horseback, toss dynamite or hide behind windows. After each cleared wave, the undertaker arrives to carry away the fallen. In the final showdown, you confront the gang at the entrance to their cave – and every stage ends with a tense bonus duel where only the fastest draw prevails.

meta.name: Highway Code
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.87 KB

This is a game intended to teach the basics of the English Highway Code circa 1984 to those learning to drive. You are presented with a quiz that will test even the finest driver on the intricacies of the Highway Code. Whether the player is learning to drive, or has been on the road for man years, this program will illustrate any weakness in a driver's technical ability.

meta.name: Highway Encounter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.32 KB

Highway Encounter places you in an isometric 3D world where you control a Vorton droid tasked with pushing a bomb along a hazardous highway into an alien base. Across numerous screens, obstacles such as barrels block your path while mines and alien enemies attempt to destroy your mission. Additional Vortons accompany you, representing extra lives that move forward alongside your active unit. If one of them is destroyed, you lose a life without direct control – an unusual blend of strategy, precision and constant forward pressure.

meta.name: Highway of Death
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.82 KB

"Highway of Death" takes the player on a dangerous highway full of challenges that require quick reactions and skill. While the vehicle is traveling at high speed, it is important to avoid obstacles and skillfully overtake competitors. The dynamic driving experience and the constant danger on the track ensure a thrilling adventure that is gripping from start to finish.

meta.name: Hillsfar

Los jugadores comienzan el juego creando un personaje. El juego ofrece tres opciones: los jugadores pueden seleccionar un personaje preestablecido, crear su propio personaje o importar personajes de entregas anteriores, como Pool of Radiance y Curse of the Azure Bonds. Al crear un personaje, los jugadores pueden determinar su raza, clase y alineamiento. El ordenador asigna un valor aleatorio a varias características del nuevo personaje, como la fuerza y la inteligencia.
El juego tiene dos vertientes: la de acción, en la que el jugador realiza "minijuegos" como la búsqueda de tesoros y el desplazamiento entre localizaciones, y la de aventura, en la que el jugador realiza misiones. La elección de la clase de personaje afecta a las misiones disponibles, con tres para cada clase. Aunque las misiones deben completarse en un orden concreto, "lo que hagas en tu tiempo libre depende de ti".

En el actual clima moral, muchos viven bajo la regla «mata o muere», y algunos la llevan al extremo, buscando peligro solo para demostrar cuán duros —y más necios— son. En este juego controlas a Kwon, apodado La Máquina Asesina Humana, quien juró exhibir el poder de su patria enfrentando a rivales en ciudades como Moscú, Ámsterdam y Barcelona. Se usa el término derribo para indicar al oponente vencido: se requieren tres derribos para avanzar al siguiente rival. Se otorgan puntos extra según la energía restante tras la victoria. Tienes cinco vidas; al agotarlas, el juego termina.

The Hobbit is based on Tolkien's tale “The Hobbit” and puts you in the role of Bilbo, who sets out on a treasure hunt with Gandalf and Thorin. Along the way, you encounter both friendly and hostile creatures, whose partly random behavior makes each playthrough different. A unique feature is the ability to talk to characters and even animals, opening up extra interactions. The adventure is told through text with illustrations but unfolds in real time – a rare feature for interactive fiction.

In Hobgoblin, you play as Zanock, the only son of the king of Altoris. Your mission is to recover the Golden Orb, which has long protected the kingdom but has now been stolen by the hobgoblins. To do so, you must fight your way through swamps and eerie landscapes filled with ghosts, undead creatures wielding knives and axes, and phantom archers with endless arrows. Armed at first with daggers, you can earn upgrades such as hatchets, stronger weapons, longer range, or extra lives. But beware – each screen flip brings new dangers, and jumps require precise timing. The challenge is tough, but only with skill and courage can you reclaim the Orb and save Altoris.

meta.name: Hockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.59 KB

"Hockey," part of the "Sports Spectacular" game package, is a minimalist hockey game with simple graphics. Players are represented by numbers, which does not detract from the gameplay or the competitive fun. Despite its simplicity, the focus remains on fast-paced and strategic action.

meta.name: Hockey Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hockey Mania is a fast-paced sports game where two or four players compete against each other. Each player controls a field skater and fights to gain possession of the puck and score goals. In four-player mode, two-player teams face off while the goalies are controlled by the AI. Smart play, precise passing, and perfect timing are key to dominating the game and leaving your opponents behind on the ice.

meta.name: Hocus Focus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.20 KB

In Daily Shocker, you play as Jeremy, a photographer exploring an underground hideout filled with strange inventions and mutations to capture photos for a big story. As you search the hideout, you can examine objects, take pictures, and interact with mutants trying to steal your film. The camera holds up to 16 photos, which must be developed at a specific location. The hideout is filled with radiation that weakens you the longer you stay. Keys are required to access higher levels, and swords help you fend off the mutants.

meta.name: Hole In One Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

For those who prefer their swings a little less destructive, Hole in One Golf offers the ultimate golf experience. Forget that you're granted unlimited access to the 18-hole course of the Fairport Country Club, complete with trees, bunkers, water hazards, and rough terrain. Ignore that you have full control over club selection, shot power, desired direction, topspin, backspin, hook, and slice. Don't even think about the fact that up to eight players can join in, without ever chasing a lost ball or filling out a scorecard.

meta.name: Mini-Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.03 KB

“Hole-In-One” (aka Mini-Golf) is a mini-golf game with a top-down perspective, controlled entirely with the mouse. You place the ball on the starting field, left-click, and drag a line from the ball to the pointer to set direction and shot power. The longer the line, the stronger the shot. Once satisfied, another left-click putts the ball. Players are allowed up to three shots over par – exceeding this results in a penalty stroke and progression to the next hole or player. A penalty stroke is also given if the ball lands in a water hazard.

meta.name: Holf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.25 KB

In Holf you drift through the vastness of space with only one goal – avoid everything that moves. Meteors, strange shapes, and hostile objects rush toward you as the screen fills with danger. Quick reflexes and precise control are your only lifeline as you struggle to survive longer than anyone else. A minimalist yet mercilessly challenging space experience.

meta.name: Holiday Games
meta.desc:

Summer, sun, vacation time, a relaxing time - or not quite? Because the stress starts with the transport of the suitcases and the vulture still knows everything for stuff in the trunk. Everything wants to be included, but there is never enough space. Once there, instead of lying lazily in the sun on the beach, you have to take part in all possible and impossible events and competitions. Then there would be "mussel diving", "cherry stone spitting", "swimming competition", "fishing" and "disco dancing".

De niño, pasabas la mayor parte de los veranos con tu tía Hildegarde y tu tío Buddy. ¡Qué recuerdos! El tío Buddy era un pez gordo de Hollywood, y la tía Hildegarde, su querida (y muy rica) esposa. No tuvieron hijos, pero a ti y a tus primos les encantaba su casa, sus fiestas, los recuerdos de Hollywood y a ellos. Claro, Buddy y Hildy eran un poco excéntricos, pero eso les daba más encanto. La tía Hildegarde se quedó con la casa cuando el tío Buddy falleció. Y ahora que ha muerto repentinamente, recuerdas su inusual testamento. Heredarás toda la propiedad, probablemente millones si logras pasar una sola noche en la casa y en los jardines, y encuentras un par de tesoros. Pero si no puedes, no heredas nada. Y así comienza Hollywood Hijinx, cuando te dejan frente a una casa oscura, no muy lejos de Hollywood...

meta.desc:

Hollywood or Bust puts you in the role of Buster Baloney, an actor in the early days of cinema tasked with finding five lost Oscars in a studio while being filmed. The studio is shown in a side-scrolling view that moves with the character. You explore multiple floors connected by ladders and enter doors leading to film sets. Security guards can be taken out with cream pies, while ghosts, which only attack from behind, can be avoided by leaning against walls. Touching a guard or ghost ends the game. Some doors lead to the street, where you're chased by a large group of cops in a constantly side-scrolling scene. You can delay the cops by throwing cream pies. A meter shows your remaining energy, which decreases when hit; if it runs out, the game ends. Cream pies can be replenished by turning a valve and collecting the flowing contents.

If he runs out of money, the game is lost - if she runs out of money, she loses a part of her clothes. If she is successful, she can buy back a part of her wardrobe. The AI adapts to the player's style, but this is only true within the same match.

After three games, the winner selects a key and a car from two separate pools, hoping to match the two and win the car.

The leader of the Kerllis IX, The Mighty Alien Presence and some of his force called Boolagrops have invaded a planet but haven't realised it is home to a superhero. You play the role of the superhero as you attempt to rid your planet of the invading force. The game is split into three levels with each one viewed from the side and the first two levels are horizontal scrolling shooters. The final level is a single screen shooter. There are seven skill levels (00 - 06) to choose from at the start of the game.

meta.name: Hook

In Hook, based on the 1991 film by Steven Spielberg, the player takes on the role of Peter Pan as he tries to save his children from Captain James Hook.
You can select the next level to play from a map of Neverland using a compass-like pointer. Depending on which one is tackled first, different paths through the game open up, but all levels must be completed before Hook can be confronted on his pirate ship. Settings include caves, forests, lagoons, cities and icy landscapes.

meta.name: Hook Dodger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.32 KB

"Hook Dodger" is a game for the Commodore 64 in which you play as a fish in a pond full of dangers. The aim is to avoid the numerous fishing hooks and catch as many worms as possible. The challenge is to maneuver skillfully to collect points without being caught.

meta.name: Hooper
meta.desc:

In Hooper you guide the little character Hooper across a grid of differently sized squares that must be completely filled to progress. Depending on the level, you either collect dots or place them along the square's lines. As you move around, dangerous creatures roam the grid – touching them costs one of your three lives. Limited jumps help you escape danger, as nearby enemies leap when you do. Once all squares are filled, you enter a bonus round where precise timing can earn extra points before advancing to the next stage. At the start, you can choose a skill level from 1 to 8.

meta.name: Hope to Hopp
meta.desc:

Benny can run and jump but has no weapons or power-ups, making it crucial to avoid obstacles. The game is an auto-scrolling side-scroller that requires precise timing to execute jumps in time. As levels get longer and platforms trickier, the difficulty increases. A change in cloud color signals the level's end, where Benny must reach the exit to advance. However, a single mistake means restarting the game.

meta.name: Hope to Hopp II

The character can run and jump but has no weapons or power-ups, leaving evasion as the only option. Hits or missteps cost one of eight lives, and losing all lives resets the game. This auto-scrolling side-scroller demands precise timing to jump at the right moment. Longer levels and more challenging platform placements increase the difficulty. The character turning cyan signals the level's end, where the exit must be reached to proceed to the next stage.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Hopeless

Hopeless puts you in the role of Al “Dutch Meat” Bluntz as you push through a large, side-scrolling complex to rescue Jane from the clutches of the infamous Manic Munk. The screen moves with your actions as you navigate platforms and penetrate the heart of the enemy's lair. Progress depends on disabling a layered security system by locating and shutting down terminals one by one. Only after the nerve center is exposed can you confront the Manic Munk, rescue Jane, and bring the adventure to a happy ending.

meta.name: Hopper Copper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.18 KB

Hopper Copper puts you in charge of restoring order to a once quiet town now plagued by four dangerous criminals. With all vehicles hidden, you bounce through the streets, track down crime locations, and try to catch the offenders within a strict time limit. Maps, position indicators, and a constantly ticking clock set the pace, while armed criminals add real danger. Every encounter demands sharp timing and awareness – a race against time where mobility, orientation, and quick decisions determine success.

meta.name: Hoppin' Mad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Hoppin' Mad you control four bouncing balls that travel through twelve varied environments – from parks and deserts to beaches and underwater worlds. Your goal is to collect up to ten balloons in each area while avoiding or crushing hazards. Any collision bursts a ball. You can adjust the speed and jump height to navigate safely. If all four balls burst, you lose a life. Once all balloons are collected, you move on to the next stage – and after twelve stages, the journey loops back to the beginning.

meta.name: The Hopping Hoodlum
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.34 KB

"The Hopping Hoodlum" is a game where you collect balloons while avoiding too much contact with enemies. A special guest appearance by Bub adds extra excitement.

meta.name: Hopto
meta.desc:

Hopto is a flick-screen platformer where you play as an explorer crossing 27 cavern screens from left to right. A T-Rex appears from the left shortly after entering each screen and vanishes if you escape in time. Hazards like lava, falling rocks, and birds must be avoided, or you lose one of three lives. Treasure appears on every screen, and collecting six in a row without dying earns a bonus. The final screen challenges you to trap the T-Rex in a cage.

meta.name: Horace Goes Skiing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.12 KB

Horace Goes Skiing starts with an unusual opening where you first have to make your way through traffic to obtain the necessary equipment. Every collision costs money that is already in short supply, making caution and timing essential. Only then do you reach the ski slope, where the action shifts into a perspective downhill run. Steering between colored gates and avoiding trees, you try to prevent crashes that can send you all the way back to the beginning – a game that blends dexterity, patience, and perseverance.

meta.name: Horror City
meta.desc:

This is a computer game about using a gun to shoot things. Alien things. In a futuristic city. I'm not really narrowing this down much, am I? It's Novotrade's 1989 Commodore 64 crosshair shooter Horror City! You start in Horror City, ready to put an end to whatever evil lurks on its streets and subway concourses. You play as Sinclair as she shoots in this Judge Dredd themed game without the official attribution. You must shoot directly at the teleport globes on your enemies belts, rather than just blasting the baddies, it is easier said than done.

meta.name: Hospital Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.51 KB

Hospital Adventure puts you in the role of a spy finishing a failed assassination attempt on the dictator of Gvench. The tyrant is recovering in a heavily guarded hospital, and you must sneak through rooms like the lobby, elevator, and cafeteria. Commands such as “look,” “stab,” or “feed” guide your actions, with every input directly affecting the outcome. The tension is high – every move counts in this nerve-wracking spy mission.

meta.name: Hostages
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Unos terroristas han asaltado una embajada y mantienen como rehenes a las personas que se encuentran en su interior. Controlas a agentes antiterroristas cuya misión es eliminar a los secuestradores. En la primera parte del juego, tienes que colocar a tus hombres en posición para que puedan disparar contra el edificio. La segunda parte consiste en entrar en el edificio para matar a los terroristas y rescatar a los rehenes. Dependiendo de cómo hayas colocado a tus francotiradores, también puedes utilizarlos para que te ayuden en esta sección del juego.

meta.name: Hot Air Balloon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pilot your hot air balloon, watch the air currents and the local weather. Drop your traps so you can save the endangered elephants and help to keep them in protected preserves.

meta.name: Hot Pop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.14 KB

In Hot Pop, you control the hero Milk, who must collect all the fruits on the screen to rescue his girlfriend trapped in a house. Your rival, Nuts, tries to stop you from achieving your goal. You climb ladders, jump across platforms, and earn points by collecting fruits, jumping over Nuts, and completing the level quickly to secure a bonus. The game features two play modes and a level editor, allowing you to create your own challenges. A fast-paced and entertaining adventure full of action and strategy!

meta.name: Hot Rod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hot Rod es un juego de carreras con vista superior influenciado por Super Sprint, en el que tres autos en miniatura compiten para completar una carrera lo más rápido posible, girando, acelerando y frenando en los momentos correctos. Usted comienza con combustible limitado, pero se puede recolectar más al cubrir la pista. Golpear los peligros puede hacer que su auto explote, lo que puede costar tiempo a medida que se reemplaza.
Inusualmente, las pistas son lineales en lugar de las vueltas, por lo que cada ronda implica cubrir una sección de la pista una vez. Después de cada carrera, puedes comprar mejoras en la tienda, dependiendo de cuánto dinero hayas ganado en la carrera anterior.
Solo se muestra una parte del circuito a la vez, y esto se desplaza siguiendo al líder. Si no te mantienes al día con esto, tu auto se mueve hacia adelante en la pista, con una deducción por multa de combustible. Esto es ligeramente similar al sistema que se usó más adelante en los juegos head to head de Micro Machines, y es especialmente punitivo cuando estás en carreteras que viajan horizontalmente y el principal automóvil de CPU está viajando verticalmente, ya que hace que el margen de error sea mucho menor.

meta.name: Hot Shot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.33 KB

Hot Shot turns a simple arena concept into a hectic duel in which you have to clear your own bricks faster than your opponent. What makes it especially appealing is the unusual way you handle the ball, first drawing it in with your device and then firing it in the direction you want, even though it behaves in a highly unpredictable way. That blend of direct competition, strange ball physics, and the constant shift between attack, control, and sudden loss of control gives the game a lively and distinctive appeal.

meta.name: Hot Tiles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.04 KB

"Hot Tiles" is a challenging puzzle game where you flip tiles to combine colors and solve patterns. The goal is to find the correct color combinations to complete the puzzle.

meta.name: Hot Wheels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hot Wheels is a licensed title based on Mattel's toy cars.
You start at a car dealership with different types of model cars, but if they don't suit your taste, you can design and build your own.
You look at your car from the side at a slightly elevated angle and can drive it to the right or left along the road. To change direction, you must enter an opening and exit in the new direction. The city itself is divided into two parts and connected by a highway. Each part of the city consists of different buildings and some buildings can be driven into, either to keep the car running smoothly or to take part in various mini-games.

meta.name: Hotel Alien
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hotel Alien places you in what once seemed like an ordinary hotel that, after a mysterious UFO sighting, becomes home to increasingly strange new guests. The kindly “Grandma” who ran the place has vanished, and it is now up to you to explore all six floors and the basement to uncover what is truly happening. You navigate via menu commands or a small minimap, enter rooms, collect clues to a cryptogram left behind by Grandma, and repeatedly encounter alien presences. Blending investigation with eerie encounters, the game unfolds as a tense exploration adventure – the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes that far more than odd guests are hiding within the hotel's walls.

p: Hotel Hell - Not a Nice Place to Die (USA) (Side A).D64
n: Hotel Hell - Not a Nice Place to Die (USA) (Side A)

meta.path: ./Hotel Hell - Not a Nice Place to Die (USA) (Side A).D64
meta.name: Hotel Hell - Not a Nice Place to Die
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's winter out at the hotel. You're the caretaker and are responsible for keeping the hotel and surrounding grounds clean and tidy. Throughout the whole period of your employment with the hotel you have never experienced a winter as bad as this. The whole place has been completely covered with a thick blanket of snow; so bad that the entire hotel staff and occupants (except you) have left the hotel for the entire winter. Fine, not a problem, you told yourself... until the strange occurrences started; occurrences so bad that you were soon fighting for your life to survive the hidden horrors of the hotel. Your goal is simple, to get out of the place as quickly as possible... alive.

meta.name: Houdini Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.09 KB

In Houdini Escape, you must help Houdini escape from a series of three death traps, each with 2, 3, or 4 locks. To open a lock, you must guess a number between 1 and 75. After each guess, you'll be told whether the number is too high or too low. You have 60 seconds to solve all the locks before you fall victim to the trap.

meta.name: House Case
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.43 KB

"House Case" is set in a creepy house and offers a dark atmosphere with atmospheric music.

meta.name: The House Jack Built
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.10 KB

The House Jack Built sends you into a sprawling home filled with rooms, hidden areas, and unusual locations that you can explore freely. You wander through basements, gardens, mazes, and even higher places, collecting items while uncovering every corner. Jack's unruly pets create constant danger, as contact costs progress and demands careful movement. Your success is measured by how many objects you recover – an open adventure that rewards curiosity, awareness, and skilful evasion.

meta.name: House of Usher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.51 KB

House of Usher is a classic single-screen platformer where you explore a spooky mansion, escape from rooms, and ultimately find your way out. You begin in the main hall with ten numbered doors, which you must complete in sequence before unlocking doors X and Y to exit the house. Each room presents unique challenges: jump over chasms, dodge cannon fire or creatures, collect items, and navigate obstacles. Touching a creature or falling from a great height costs you one of three lives and sends you back to the main hall. In Room Y, a timer adds extra pressure – fail to escape in time, and you lose all your lives. Collect hearts for bonus points and escape the mansion before it's too late!

meta.name: The House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.28 KB

"The House" is a humorous adventure in which Eddi must find the inheritance left by his Aunt Brunhild in her mansion. What initially seems simple turns out to be a challenge, as Aunt Brunhild has left her nephew traps and numerous puzzles to test him. Featuring a user interface styled like classic adventure games and support for the Commodore mouse, players must use Eddi's skill and ingenuity to uncover the treasure.

meta.name: House-Mess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.37 KB

House-Mess is a shooter where the player aims with a crosshair to hit various targets. The challenge lies in reacting quickly and precisely as the targets move. The player must carefully place their shots to score points and continue progressing in the game.

meta.name: Hover
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.28 KB

Hover is a game that demands skill and quick reflexes. You control a hovering vehicle through various challenges. Precise handling and strategic planning are crucial for success.

meta.name: Hover Bovver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.57 KB

Gordon Bennet has borrowed his neighbour's Air-Mo lawnmower. Mow your way through as many of the 16 lawns as you can before the pursuing neighbour retrieves his mower. Set your dog onto the neighbour to help you out of tight spots and don't annoy the Gardener. Try not to plough through the neat flower beds or overheat your mower!

p: How About a Nice Game of Chess! (USA).D64
n: How About a Nice Game of Chess! (USA)

meta.path: ./How About a Nice Game of Chess! (USA).D64
meta.name: Chess 7.5 - How About a Nice Game of Chess!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

How about a nice game of chess? is a chess game and teaching program.nnnnIt allows the game of chess for two players or for one player against the computer with several difficulty levels available. Allows you to graphically display the chess board and follows standard chess rules. This version is based on the same engine as the previously released Chess 7.0 and contains educational chess material to help the player improve their chess game. Unique game options include the ability to flip the board over, as well as blind play, where the ranking of the different pieces remains hidden. The computer can optionally list the best moves for players and games in progress can be saved to the hard drive.

n: How to be a Complete Bastard (Europe)

meta.name: How to be a Complete Bastard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.54 KB

How to be a Complete Bastard lets you turn a sophisticated party into a total disaster. In a house full of guests, rooms, and useful objects, your goal is to behave as offensively, crudely, and obnoxiously as possible. Food, alcohol, and coffee affect which nasty actions are available to you, while other bodily states make the chaos even more absurd. The result is a wonderfully irreverent game driven by dark humor, shameless escalation, and the goal of getting on every single party guest's nerves.

meta.name: Howard The Coder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Howard the Coder the player takes the role of Howard who wants to impress his girlfriend. To do so, he collects fragments of his code so he can finish his program. This game is a scrolling platformer in which the player has walk and jump through hazardous obstacles, e.g. moving spikes or bats. The goal is to collect said code fragments and computer parts. This is the main portion of the game, but when it is finished the player also can play Howard's game: a logic puzzle.

p: Howard the Duck - Adventure on Volcano Island (USA).D64
n: Howard the Duck - Adventure on Volcano Island (USA)

meta.path: ./Howard the Duck - Adventure on Volcano Island (USA).D64
meta.name: Howard the Duck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your two best friends Phil and Beverly have been captured by a dark overlord! He is keeping them captive in an active volcano, and you need to rescue them. As Howard the Duck, master of Quack Fu, you need to make your way through the maze-like landscapes, and jump or fight the many obstacles blocking the path using kicks and punches. Water must be navigated around, because this 'superhero' duck can't swim. Or fly without the parachute you regularly use.
Quicksand, enemy mutants and more will all get in your way before you can finally parachute into the volcano and defeat the dark overlord! Howard the Duck is based on 'Escape From Volcano island', a cartoon featuring Howard, but was released to tie in with the movie of the same name.

meta.name: Hudson Hawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hudson Hawk, un ladrón de guante blanco, debe robar tres obras de Da Vinci: el caballito balancín «La Sforza», su cuaderno de bocetos «El Códice» y un valioso cristal. Su misión lo llevará por mansiones, castillos, tejados, subterráneos y el Vaticano. El reto no es solo esquivar guardias, perros y otros enemigos, sino también evitar activar alarmas. Para defenderse, Hawk puede golpear o lanzar una bola contra sus adversarios.

meta.name: The Human Race
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.02 KB

El objetivo del juego es conseguir una alta puntuación. Esto se hace saltando por la pantalla y recogiendo objetos. Cada nivel de una pantalla está ambientado en un punto diferente de la evolución del hombre y el personaje comienza como un simio y evoluciona hasta convertirse en un cavernícola y más allá a medida que el jugador avanza en el juego.
Cada nivel es un tipo diferente de minijuego. Por ejemplo, el primer nivel es un juego de plataformas en el que el jugador salta a través de la selva comiendo plátanos y evitando criaturas desagradables como los dinosaurios, mientras que en el segundo nivel el jugador tiene que recorrer un camino a través de un lago de lava mientras evita las bolas de fuego que caen.

meta.name: Humanoids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.24 KB

"Humanoids" is set in the year 2850. Captain Gryo is trapped on the planet Vulso and must reach his Super Star Cruiser, blocked by a massive metal door. To open it, he needs a four-digit password, which can be deciphered by conquering three perilous environments. Along the way, he battles robots, comets, UFOs, aliens, and dragons, all of which he must destroy with his laser beam. Starting from the second environment, Gryo switches to a hoverbike and a jetski to progress further. At the end of each environment, he receives clues to the password. Once he reaches the door, he has limited time to enter the password before the planet explodes.

meta.name: Hummdinger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.21 KB

Humm-Dinger is a side view horizontal scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls when you move your hero using a Jet-Pack, left or right, blasting waves of aliens. In each wave you must destroy every alien so that it will drop a B icon, and when a certain amount has been collected before they touch the ground you can then face a final wave to destroy. As you move and shoot around the level, you must avoid touching the aliens or their weapons as this decreases an energy gauge faster which is slowly decreasing. When your energy gauge empties then you lose one of four lives. Allowing a B icon to hit the ground also decreases the gauge but some destroyed waves of aliens drops a F icon and when collected fills your energy gauge. Once you have completed a level then you have the chance to get bonus points by collecting all the numbered ions in order before your energy gauge empties but if you collect an icon in the wrong order then the bonus part is over and it's on to the next level.

meta.name: Humphrey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Humphrey turns block recoloring into a frantic hopping game where you constantly need to stay on the move. You jump from tile to tile, change their colors, and try to complete the whole pattern before the falling bombs catch you. With each new stage, the pressure increases as more bombs appear and bounce across the board for longer. That mix of a clear objective, quick dodging, and growing danger gives the game its appealing arcade feel.

p: Humpty Dumpty Meets the Fuzzy Wuzzies (Europe).T64
n: Humpty Dumpty Meets the Fuzzy Wuzzies (Europe)

meta.name: Humpty Dumpty Meets the Fuzzy Wuzzies
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.75 KB

In this puzzle game, Humpty must make his way to the exit, to do this, you rotate the maze 90 degrees, causing him to fall. The maze must continually be rotated not to navigate to the exit, but also to avoid three types of enemies - bombs, snappers, and of course, the Fuzzy Wuzzies. If he comes into contact with these, he will go splat. Teleports take Humpty to different places, while going through the exit takes Humpty to the next maze. There are 18 mazes in total.

meta.name: Humpty Dumpty Mystery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Humpty Dumpty Mystery is a collection of educational games for children aged 7 to 10 that promote logical thinking. In the first game, you must discover which of the twelve royal men pushed Humpty Dumpty by asking targeted questions. In the second game, Who Killed Cock Robin?, you determine the perpetrator, the crime scene, and the time of the crime by combining and eliminating clues. Both games blend puzzle-solving with fun while enhancing concentration and analytical skills.

meta.name: Humpty in the Garden
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.36 KB

Humpty in the Garden features Humpty Dumpty as a gardener. Your task is to make flowers bloom before weeds overrun them. To do this, you open and close faucets to direct water through pipes. If you manage to water enough flowers, you advance to the next round. The game ends when the weeds take over. Skill and quick action are the keys to success.

meta.name: Hunchback
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Victor Hugo never could have expected that his creation Quasimodo, the Hunchback of Notre Dame, would run such an obstacle course as is dished up in this game, dodging fireballs and arrows while leaping over pits and pikemen, sometimes with the help of a swinging bell-pull rope, in hopes of rescuing his beloved Esmeralda from the top tower -- all while being slow-but-steady chased across the castle parapets by an invincible knight in full armour.  Once you get the hang of any individual obstacle, the game starts throwing them at you in tandem, until toward the end you're tracking the swing of the rope, the thrust of the lance, the approach of the arrow and the advance of the knight all simultaneously!  Succeed, against all odds, and you get to do it again, but faster!  Even an able-bodied protagonist would have a hard time juggling all these threats, but I have a feeling a dedicated player with patience and good timing can overcome them.  Let's call it a hunch.

meta.name: Hunchback : the Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hunchback: The Adventure on Commodore 64 is an adventure game in which you play Quasimodo, the hunchback of Notre-Dame who tries to conquer the beautiful Esmeralda. This involves reading numerous texts but also by exploring various places in Paris in which you must find the right objects to use in puzzles blocking your progress.

meta.name: Hunchback at the Olympics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.20 KB

The Games of the XXIII Olympiad were held in Los Angeles in 1984 and for the first time since the advent of the video game industry, this king of sporting competitions was to be held in a first-world nation. In simpler times, this might have inspired people to head out to a track or gymnasium to try their stuff, but now for the first time an industry was poised to let the hands of the middle-class masses do all the work virtually, through joysticks, needing no facilities or specialised equipment (beyond a video game console) to try the whole gamut of events.

meta.name: Hunchback II : Quasimodo's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The archetype of the Hunchback of Notre Dame really isn't terribly nuanced: he jumps around towers, ringing bells, rescuing Esmeralda and being generally physically unattractive. Here he does all of these things, in a more platform-oriented take than the original, clambering up dangling ropes as they rise and fall, avoiding environmental threats such as rabid bats, thrown hatchets and enormous grinding clockwork gears all in the pursuit of small bells strewn across each screen's platforms. Gathering all the bells permits you to advance higher up the tower, at the top of which the damsel in distress awaits your homely visage.

meta.name: Hungaroring
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.03 KB

Hungaroring brings the excitement of Formula 1 racing to the iconic Hungaroring track. Similar to Pole Position, you control your car as the timer counts up, with your time determining your score. Gears must be shifted manually, and there are four speed levels available. You can set the number of laps and the amount of opposing cars on the track. A training mode allows you to complete a lap without opponents to get familiar with the controls. Precision and speed are the keys to victory!

meta.name: Hungry Horace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.71 KB

Horace's first outing was a Pac-Man-influenced game, taking place on a quick succession of small levels. The level designs have a lot of complex corridors and side-lines, as well as at least one wrap-around section and one tunnel – the ghosts may well be waiting for you at the end of this. Each level features one power-pill to put to use, and an increasing number of enemies as you progress. Unlike most games of the style, after collecting all the dots you must progress through an exit at the right of the screen, so it might be worth planning your path through the dots so as to finish near this.

meta.name: Hunt for Bubber's Bathtub
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.14 KB

In Jagten På Bubbers Badekar (aka Hunt for Bubber's Bathtub) you set out on a delightfully bizarre mission – a stolen bathtub must be recovered, and the journey is anything but ordinary. You move through strange environments filled with unusual characters and unexpected situations, constantly needing to react and adapt. The game's quirky style defines the entire experience, making every encounter feel unpredictable. Instead of a straightforward approach, you're thrown into a chaotic mix of action and odd ideas that keeps surprising you at every turn.

meta.name: The Hunt for Red October
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.47 KB

The Hunt for Red October es un juego de acción para la Commodore 64 inspirado en la novela de Tom Clancy A Pursuit of Red October. Eres el Capitán Marko Ramius. Tienes una cita con la Marina de los EE. UU. Y debes destruir el barco Red October Soviet. Desafortunadamente, los rusos son presistentes y hacen todo lo posible para detenerte.

meta.name: Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.38 KB

Hunter has you piloting a spacecraft across a grid-like arena where you must eliminate hostile roboships that attempt to crash into you while dodging your missiles. You move between sectors, fire carefully and decide when a shot is worth taking, since missed attacks reduce your score. Clearing each screen increases enemy speed, making positioning and timing increasingly important. The experience blends accurate shooting with tactical movement in a focused action challenge that rewards efficiency.

meta.name: Hunter Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Hunter Patrol you fly low over enemy territory, aiming to destroy key targets while facing constant attacks from enemy planes and anti-aircraft fire. You must carefully balance risky low-altitude maneuvers with aerial combat to eliminate installations and hostile aircraft. Every mistake is costly, as collisions take away precious lives. Once enough targets are destroyed, the main objective appears – a decisive strike that demands precision and perfect timing. If you fail, the dangerous mission starts again, making every success feel hard-earned.

meta.name: Hunter's Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hunter's Moon is a high-octane science fiction adventure where you pilot your ship deep into hostile territory in search of a way back through the galaxy. Inside the maze-like hives, you collect vital Starcells while relentless Worker Cells and complex defense systems keep you under pressure. Your shield offers brief protection, but only with skill, timing and clever use of bonus cells can you overcome the ever-changing challenges and reach new star systems.

meta.name: Huntress of Midgard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 60.08 KB

In Huntress of Midgard, the third installment of the Midgard Saga, the player takes on the role of Eris, the Huntress of Midgard. The sacred city faces a new evil as Morrigan's creatures seek the pieces of a talisman to seize control of Midgard, driving out its inhabitants, priestesses, and all virtuous souls. The mission is to guide Eris, battle the dark creatures, and retrieve all three talisman pieces to save Midgard from destruction. Healing potions can be collected, and four potions combine into a clever grenade, though it is lost if Eris takes damage. The people of Midgard are counting on your help.

meta.name: Hurting the Ground
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.40 KB

Hurting the Ground puts you in the role of a spaceship pilot on a desperate escape mission. A mishap has left you low on ammunition while alien pursuers close in behind you. Rather than relying on firepower, the game focuses on evasive movement, careful maneuvering and survival. Obstacles and enemies demand quick reflexes as you attempt to reach Earth alive. A fast-paced action experience where timing and ship control are key.

meta.name: Hustler's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

In Hustler's Revenge, you play a top-down, single-screen, two-player game set on a table with four pockets in each corner. Each player has their own ball (either white or black), placed beside a red ball. The objective is to be the first to reach 50 points by sinking the red ball. Sinking the red ball gives you two points. However, there are other ways to score: you can sink your opponent's ball after the red ball has been pocketed for two points, or play the red ball after your opponent sinks their ball for one point. You also earn a point if your opponent sinks their own ball. The ball moves around the table, and you must consider its inertia when making shots. After a ball is pocketed, it will take five seconds before it reappears on the table.

meta.name: Huxley Pig
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.11 KB

In Huxley Pig you guide a dreamy pig on a mission to finally get to bed – but first he must sort out the chaos in his home. Important items and outfits are hidden throughout the house, while strange characters and creepy crawlies block your path. To progress, you collect useful objects, plan your route through the rooms, and keep an eye on your energy. Only once everything is found can Huxley drift off into his imaginative dreams – with extra mini adventures waiting as a reward.

meta.name: Hyber Blob
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.20 KB

In Hyber Blob you take responsibility for a chaotic group of bouncing creatures that move relentlessly through dangerous terrain – ignoring gaps and obstacles. Your task is to build a safe path by repositioning blocks and controlling their route. You must think ahead, as once they start moving, they are hard to stop. Special elements change behavior and create unexpected situations, while a time limit adds pressure. Only smart planning and quick action will guide the group safely to their destination.

meta.name: Hybrid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.39 KB

Hybrid places you inside a heavily guarded complex where powerful Venusian aliens are imprisoned, their abilities threatening to spiral out of control. To eliminate them, a team of three droids – Brain, Robot, and Xylon – is deployed, each possessing unique powers such as activating bridges, heavy firepower, or teleportation. The top-down facility is packed with cannons, mines, energy barriers, and hostile creatures designed to stop any intruder. When all three droids reach a specific point together, they merge into the titular Hybrid and are teleported to an alien's cell to destroy it. After returning, the hunt continues for the next target – a tactical action game that demands smart switching between characters and clever use of their special abilities.

meta.name: Hydra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

If being the best speedboat racer in the world were all there was to life, you'd live on easy street. But when the government of Hydra has asked for your help in defeating Hydra's enemies by couriering parts to a secret weapon, and those enemies know you're coming... well then, life gets interesting.
Race down narrow swamp lanes to deliver parts of a secret weapon to bases at the finish of each section. Enemies will be shooting at you, but you can shoot back with Uzi Cannons and Nukes. Collect crystals along the way to boost your speed or shields.

meta.name: Hydra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

If being the best speedboat racer in the world were all there was to life, you'd live on easy street. But when the government of Hydra has asked for your help in defeating Hydra's enemies by couriering parts to a secret weapon, and those enemies know you're coming... well then, life gets interesting.
Race down narrow swamp lanes to deliver parts of a secret weapon to bases at the finish of each section. Enemies will be shooting at you, but you can shoot back with Uzi Cannons and Nukes. Collect crystals along the way to boost your speed or shields.

meta.name: Hydrax
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Hypa-Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.26 KB

Hypa-Ball is a futuristic two-player sports showdown between the Hawks and the Vipers, where you assemble a three-member team from a roster of ten players. Each athlete has slightly different strengths in power, agility, and speed, making tactical choices important before the match even begins. The objective is to pass, catch, and shoot the ball into a moving basket at the center of the arena. Two players operate in the air while one remains on the ground to collect loose balls, and you simultaneously control the ground player and the airborne player closest to the ball. With possession limited to just a few seconds, the pace remains fast and frantic – an intense future-sport experience demanding teamwork and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Hypadrop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.08 KB

In Hypadrop, you control a ball that constantly bounces back and forth on a small platform, with a cliff on both sides. Your task is to time it just right and press the fire button to shoot the ball straight down when it is in the correct position. If the ball lands on the platform, you can continue, but if it falls off either side, the game is over. Simple, yet challenging!

meta.name: Hyper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.48 KB

Hyper is an action-packed game where the player pilots a pulsating light ship through perilous caves. You can compete against a friend or the computer. Every collision with protruding rocks or stalagmites weakens your shields, which can regenerate with skillful maneuvering. However, heavier impacts significantly drain your protection. The player who best navigates their ship and survives emerges victorious.

meta.name: Hyper Active
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.38 KB

Hyper Active is an action-packed shooter in the style of Defender. The player's mission is to defend the moons of the planet Mughal, which are under attack by unknown forces. Experimental defense and interception systems being tested on the moons are at risk. Equipped with a spacesuit, the player must recover system capsules and transport them to an underground storage facility. Once a sector is secured, the mission continues to the next. Radar, autofire, and the player's health are displayed as bars, with radar failure making the mission more challenging. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to repel the threat.

meta.name: Hyper Agressive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.47 KB

Hyper Aggressive is a strategic puzzle game designed to teach players the fundamentals of the binary number system. The game board consists of red and blue tiles (representing the two players) and neutral gray tiles marked with the numbers 0 or 1. The objective is to convert tiles marked with 0 to 1 faster than your opponent using binary operators such as EOR, ORA, or AND. Since the game follows binary patterns, changing one tile also affects the values of adjacent tiles. Tactical thinking and an understanding of the logic behind the operations are key to success.

meta.name: Hyper Biker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.98 KB

The player must compete in a series of events against a human or computer opponent. Each event is difficult, with each one containing a variety of maneuvers that must be performed to allow progress. The fastest qualifying time in each event allows the rider to compete in the next one.
The option screen allows up to four riders to take part, and three control methods can be used, with two of the methods relying on a joystick, and a third one with the keyboard.

meta.name: Hyper Cars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hyper Cars is a racing game designed using a modular building system. Players can compete solo or in two-player mode, either against a computer-controlled opponent or AI. Euro music sets the tone in the background during the races. Speed and precise control are crucial to securing victory.

meta.name: Hyper Circuit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.09 KB

In "Hyper Circuit," you navigate the circuits of a chip, protecting base units from attacking creatures. Enemies and dropped mines pose dangerous obstacles, while airborne attackers can only be destroyed when they cross a circuit connection. A smart bomb that eliminates all on-screen enemies offers a tactical option but requires time to recharge. Scoring points and skillful maneuvering are crucial for successfully completing the mission.

meta.name: Hyper Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.03 KB

In Hyper Duel, you engage in an intense battle against an opponent, controlling your spacecraft and attempting to drain the enemy ship's shield energy to defeat it. Of course, your opponent can fight back, making the duel both exciting and challenging. The game offers various settings to adjust the game speed or change the duration, allowing you to tailor the challenge to your preference. Those who act quickly and strategically will have the best chance of emerging victorious.

meta.name: Hyper Snake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hyper Snake is a classic collection game where the player controls a snake to collect all the points. Each collected point lengthens the snake, increasing the game's difficulty. The goal is to gather all the points without colliding with the snake's own tail. Skill and strategy are crucial for success.

meta.name: Hyper Sports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hyper Sports challenges you across six very different events that must be completed one after another. Swimming demands rapid rhythm and well-timed breathing, skeet shooting and archery rely mainly on choosing the right moment, while gymnastics and triple jump require precise input. Weightlifting rounds things off as a pure test of power. The result is a varied competition that keeps putting speed, timing, and dexterity to the test in new ways.

meta.name: Hyper Viper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Hyper Viper, you navigate a maze from a top-down perspective as the screen scrolls with your movement. Your goal is to eat all the snakes, but only from behind, as attacking from the front results in being eaten and losing one of your three lives. If you eat a snake in the middle, it splits into more snakes that must also be dealt with. Additionally, there is an insect that can be eaten, but if left untouched, it lays eggs. These eggs hatch into dangerous creatures that must be avoided. Bonus points can be earned by collecting fruit scattered throughout the maze.

meta.name: Hyperbowl
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.20 KB

Hyperbowl is a futuristic one-on-one top-down sports game where you pilot one of ten subtly different spaceships while a scanner keeps track of the ball and your opponent. The aim is to direct the ball by collision or beam into the central goal for two points or across the goal line for one point, with unpredictable rebounds and a time or score limit adding tension.

meta.name: Hyperforce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.31 KB

Hyperforce places you in the role of a space pilot whose damaged system allows for only one final mission. Inside confined chambers, you collect appearing pods while the walls steadily close in and consume everything within their reach. You can fire at the walls to push them back temporarily – but this comes at a cost, as pods behind them are erased. Constantly weighing offense, movement and timing defines the experience, creating a tense balance between risk and progress.

meta.name: Hyperion 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hyperion II was intended to be the official sequel to Hyperion but was never released. The launch was canceled after the publisher decided to focus exclusively on 16-bit games at that time.

meta.name: Hyperrace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hyperrace is a top view scrolling game with some shooter elements where the screen scrolls constantly in the direction you move your spacecraft low over a surface. The game is either one player or two player with a split-screen so both players can play at the same time. You and a friend are both in a Space Academy and to graduate you have to complete various levels by getting from a start pad to a finish pad. As you fly around you must avoid certain obstacles with some that can be removed with your cannon. An other spacecraft makes an appearance and this needs avoiding, and if you hit anything then you lose part of an energy bar. When the bar reaches the red part then the screen starts flashing and when it empties then it is game over for that player. The player that gets to the finish pad first gets bonus points.

meta.name: Hyper Thrust
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Hyperthrust" is an action-packed shooter where two rubber balls race across the uneven, bouncy terrain of the planet "Gumball" while collecting points. Players must act within a strict time limit; otherwise, they are eliminated. The setting takes place in a world made of elastic rubber, whose inhabitants — also round rubber balls — compete in athletic challenges. At the center is the thrilling 5,000-mile race, a highlight of the annual "Gum Olympic Games." The challenge is intensified by enemy obstacles that players must eliminate with ray weapons to continue their run.

meta.name: Hysteria
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hysteria casts you as the last survivor of an elite time corps on a perilous mission across multiple eras to stop a primeval entity that has altered mankind's future. In horizontally scrolling stages set in Ancient Greece, the Dark Ages, and a futuristic space age, hostile locals hurl everything they can at you. Your objective is to collect nine fragments that assemble into the face of the entity before confronting it in a final battle. Armed with an energy conversion kit that transforms certain projectiles and enemies into useful weapons and equipment, you fight through each timeline – a fast-paced action adventure demanding skill, reflexes, and endurance.

meta.name: Hysterix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.41 KB

In "Hysterix," you control a ball across the screen to overcome enemies while defending your underwear. A humorous and straightforward game that delivers quick fun with its simple mechanics.

meta.name: I Be a Leprichaun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.20 KB

I Be a Leprichaun sends you into a fairy-tale-like chaotic setting where you have to catch leprechauns without getting yourself into trouble. Holes, frogs, and fairy folk make the path dangerous and attack you with magic. Every step demands attention, as the collecting goal and evasive movement constantly overlap. This creates a small, distinctive skill game that combines a chase for targets, obstacles, and quirky fantasy hazards.

meta.name: I Can Remember
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„I Can Remember“ is based on the classic Memory game. The player must remember which pictures are hidden under numbered tiles and match pairs correctly. When a pair is found, the images remain visible. The goal is to uncover the entire board, revealing a favorite Fisher-Price toy. As the player improves, the game becomes more challenging with more numbers and pictures to remember, putting memory skills to the test.

meta.name: I Can Remember
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„I Can Remember“ is based on the classic Memory game. The player must remember which pictures are hidden under numbered tiles and match pairs correctly. When a pair is found, the images remain visible. The goal is to uncover the entire board, revealing a favorite Fisher-Price toy. As the player improves, the game becomes more challenging with more numbers and pictures to remember, putting memory skills to the test.

meta.name: I Play : 3D Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.36 KB

3D Soccer es uno de los primeros juegos de fútbol en 3D. Controlas a un solo jugador y observas la acción desde su perspectiva. Indicar a tus compañeros que te pasen el balón es un elemento fundamental del juego; no esperes ver a tu equipo ganar sin contribuir. Al tomar posesión del balón (o pulsar el botón sin tenerlo), tu jugador se dirigirá automáticamente hacia la portería. Solo se ofrecen partidos individuales. Hay diez niveles de dificultad; la duración de los partidos y el equipamiento del equipo también se pueden modificar. Los partidos para dos jugadores se juegan en pantalla dividida. A diferencia de Sensible Soccer y Kick Off 2, aquí se aplica la regla del fuera de juego.

meta.name: I Play : 3D Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In I Play: 3D Tennis, you rise through the global tennis rankings as a pre-made or custom player, improving your skills like forehand, serve, and volley while earning prize money. Four modes are available: Singles Match, Singles Tournament, Grand Slam, and ATP Tour, though the last two require qualification. Defeating higher-ranked opponents boosts your ranking faster. The dynamic rear-view camera adjusts when approaching the net for realistic perspective. Player characters are large and smoothly animated, as are the crowd backgrounds. A mini-map and ability bar graphs are shown at the bottom of the screen.

meta.name: I Play : Football Champ
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An extension of I Play: 3-D Soccer, with a new section for planning the team tactics and a more complex simulation of a championship. Most of the core game code of predecessor was reused. Selecting the championship of Italy, England, or Germany, you should lead your team to the first place. Before the match begins you may adjust the list of team players and their formation on the field. When the match begins, you should move your player in 3rd-person view to run to appropriate position, try to catch or to get the ball, and want to make a score. While you are moving on the field, the map shows the position of the ball and other players. Commentator watches the match and tells either who is controlling the ball now, or what event was occurred on the field.

meta.name: I Want More Diamonds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Far in the future, in the recent past a giant meteor explodes near the Earth, and a lot of the diamond crystals has landed on Earth. Giana has started to get the diamonds, and she's done it!!
However some reports were recieved, that the biggest diamond of the meteor fell on the Troll's Land, Giana didn't know this for a while! She decided to get this too. She took four kinds of weapons, but this was spread on the Earth during she flew by her spaceship above the Troll's Land.
What a pity!!! She had to start without guns, but it couldn't be impendiment. This adventure has begun again...

p: I Was a Cannibal for the FBI (Europe).T64
n: I Was a Cannibal for the FBI (Europe)

meta.path: ./I Was a Cannibal for the FBI (Europe).T64
meta.name: I Was a Cannibal for the FBI
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.38 KB

In "I Was a Cannibal for the FBI," you play an agent recruited by the FBI a year ago and sent undercover into a cult of cannibals. After being discovered, you were taken to a neighboring island and imprisoned. Time is running out, as the cannibals are returning — hungry! Your only chance is to escape before they find you or face the inevitable fate of becoming part of their menu. Skill, speed, and determination are your only allies.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador asume el papel del personaje homónimo Ball y la jugabilidad toma la forma de un shoot 'em up de desplazamiento vertical. También fue uno de los primeros juegos en presentar una amplia gama de potenciadores (a través de discos de poder). I Ball presentó un memorable discurso sintetizado.

p: I, Ball II - The Quest for the Past (Europe).T64
n: I, Ball II - The Quest for the Past (Europe)

meta.path: ./I, Ball II - The Quest for the Past (Europe).T64
meta.name: I Ball II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.56 KB

La altamente desarrollada e inteligente raza esférica quiere hurgar en su pasado para descubrir su evolución y su linaje. Tienen que enfrentarse a los peligros radioactivos de las antiguas minas y los riesgos que esconden. Su misión: recuperar todo artefacto que les permita
penetrar en su pasado.
Los diversos bloques tienen propiedades que deben explotarse debidamente para recogerla llave y llegar a la salida en cada pantalla. Otros objetos incluyen bombas mágicas, partículas de vida (cuatro constituyen una vida adicional) y piedras preciosas. Cuando se recoge una piedra preciosa, ocurre algo insólito que generalmente es una ayuda, pero a veces puede ser algo frustrante.
