meta.name: I-Alien
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In I-Alien you fight for survival as a captured creature aboard a hostile ship – you must navigate dangerous areas and find a way out before time runs out. You dodge obstacles, use teleporters, and battle numerous enemies while searching for a critical objective. Helpful items can give you temporary advantages, but unexpected effects can also throw you off. Under constant time pressure, you push forward step by step, rescue allies, and try to secure your escape before it's too late.

meta.name: I-Wizard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.53 KB

I-Wizard is an action-adventure game where the goal is to collect eight music boxes and play them at the exit. The game is set in and around a large mansion haunted by four ghosts, which you can defend yourself against by throwing large or heavy objects at it. There are many rooms around the mansion and many items whose function you need to figure out in order to complete the game. Adding to the tension is the need to be wary of the ghosts as they move quite quickly, as well as the fact that you only have a short amount of time to make decisions in the inventory menu.

meta.name: I-Xera
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.07 KB

A highly explosive and pretty logo has fell off the Empire's flagship and landed in a soap-bubble factory splitting into four pieces. You have been sent with the latest military robot suit and weapon into the factory to retrieve the pieces. Before the pieces can be collected you must find the Mini Interdimensional Storage Unit to carry pieces of the logo found, as well as any other objects to help you in your mission.

meta.name: Ian Botham's Test Match
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.47 KB

Ian Botham's Test Match offers a cricket experience for one or two players with three different game modes: a limited match, a one-day match, and an extended test match. The player can choose between "Armchair Cricket", where the game assigns names to all team members, and "Custom Team Selection", where custom names can be entered. At the start, a cricket field is displayed with a bowler, a wicket-keeper, and two opposing batsmen. The player strategically places nine fielders around the pitch before the first over begins.

meta.name: Ice Busters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.25 KB

Ice Buster is an arcade adventure set in the Ice Age.
First Eskimo Eddie has to make his way to Percy Penguin, who has been captured by a polar bear named Growler.
This can be achieved by navigating a series of platforms while jumping over snowballs that Growler throws at him. Eddie only has to save Percy once before he can move on to the next level.
In the second level, the entire screen is filled with ice blocks that gradually disappear, forming a maze. Percy appears in the middle of the maze. Additionally, four snow beetles appear and begin wandering the maze to kill Percy. Percy has to crush all the snow bugs in the maze with ice blocks. The ice blocks can also be melted, creating more space for Percy to fit through. Any snow beetle that touches the maze's electrified edges is dazed, allowing Percy to destroy it.

meta.name: Ice Cream Stall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.11 KB

In "Ice Cream Stall," you start your own ice cream stand with limited resources and aim to outcompete rivals. Up to ten players can go head-to-head to see who builds the most successful business. A mix of strategy and skill determines who creates the best ice cream recipes and attracts the most customers.

meta.name: Ice Guys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ice Guys is a platform game with cartoon graphics. One solo player or two team mates fight against a horde of little monsters. Their only weapon against the creatures is the snow on the ground - but there is plenty of it! So they keep throwing snowballs at their attackers to get them caught in an avalanche. The avalanche can be kicked thus turning it into a deathly bowling ball. Combination hits will be rewarded with goodies which can be collected. Diamonds can be traded for special items in a shop. Stars will qualify the players for a sleigh race bonus game and ice creams will eventually be turned into extra lives.

meta.name: Ice Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.87 KB

In Ice Hunter you take on the role of Thorak on an important mission – deep inside a cave, you search for special blocks needed to complete a structure. You must navigate multiple levels, find the right paths, and transport the blocks carefully. Every move requires planning, as you can only carry so much and must use the best route downward. Only by combining your actions and managing the return journey will you move closer to your goal.

meta.name: Ice Palace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.90 KB

The wicked Ice Queen has murdered the good king and placed the kingdom under a terrible spell of forever winter. The young prince of the now frozen realm ascends the Ice Palace to collect the scattered and hidden pieces of his father's crown that can be used to vanquish the forces of evil. Once the whole crown is found, the Ice Queen can be destroyed.
The player is required to navigate through a honeycomb like maze and find the seven pieces of the golden crown, whilst fighting off enemies and avoiding traps. With each piece of the crown found, the player is taken to the next level. During an encounter, the player must use verbal commands to find the crown pieces. The player has limited time to find the whole crown before the holy candle melts and the game's good-and-evil meter degrades to evil.

meta.name: Ice Palace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.76 KB

In Ice Palace, you control a penguin through three diverse challenges that require skill and quick reflexes. In the first stage, you use randomly falling ice blocks to build a staircase and reach your partner, all while avoiding melting blocks and holes. Bonus points can be earned by collecting fruit, and limited super jumps can help you escape tricky situations. In the second stage, you construct an ice tower by stacking blocks onto a truck that delivers them to the central pillar, all while extinguishing falling fire with ice to protect the tower. In the third stage, you build another staircase from ice blocks while dodging fire and a snowman attacking you with snowballs. With each of the eight difficulty levels, the game speeds up until it continues in an endless loop.

meta.name: Ice Station Zero
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Ice Tea
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.10 KB

meta.name: The Ice Temple
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.28 KB

The Ice Temple begins with a stolen space cruiser and quickly turns into a quirky rescue mission against an alien conspiracy. Nick Razor tracks the thieves to a remote ice temple, only to discover that it is actually a massive reactor draining energy from an entire planet. To prevent disaster, he must find every part of the machine and throw them into the shredders. With its offbeat humor, frozen sense of danger, and unusual hero, the game becomes a distinctively charming adventure.

meta.name: Ice-Cold II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.33 KB

Ice-Cold II challenges you to prove yourself as an interstellar ace pilot and the last hope for salvation. Your nerves must stay ice-cold as cunning and aggressive aliens launch their attacks. Blast down as many as you can with your laser, and unleash one of your two devastating rockets when needed. But beware: if even a single alien breaks through your defenses and hits you, the game – and all hope – is lost.

meta.name: Ice Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quick thinking and strategic decisions are essential to successfully mastering the game and achieving the highest score possible.

meta.name: Iceland Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.84 KB

In “Iceland Adventure,” the player must escape from Isiseros, relying on their trusty 12-shot shotgun. The goal is to make a safe escape, with a passport playing a crucial role. Dangers and challenges make the journey to freedom thrilling and unpredictable.

meta.name: Icicle Works
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.12 KB

Christmas is just around the corner and Santa Claus has a big problem. When he returns from vacation, he finds all of his presents scattered and buried under snow. With the potential for avalanches and all the bad-tempered penguins and polar bears running around and bothering him, it doesn't get any easier. It is the player's job to help Santa Claus and collect all the presents before Christmas.nnnnIcicle Works is a Boulder Dash variation. The player's goal in each level is to obtain a series of packages needed to build a toy. The game is time-limited and the player loses a life if they do not complete a level quickly enough.

meta.name: ICUPS
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.65 KB

Quieres convertirte en un agente especial de I.C.U.P.S. (Comisión Internacional para la Solución de Problemas Universales), pero antes de que puedan aceptarte, tienes que pasar dos pruebas que componen dos partes diferentes del juego. La primera parte se muestra desde una perspectiva de arriba hacia abajo. Estás al control de una nave espacial y eres atacado por diferentes tipos de enemigos. La mayoría de las naves enemigas no son letales en sí mismas, pero tienen la capacidad de disparar hacia arriba, hacia abajo o hacia los lados. Para derrotarlos, puedes disparar hacia arriba o empujarlos hacia el borde de la pantalla.

meta.name: Identikit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.64 KB

Identikit is a memory game where you must memorize bizarre faces and then reconstruct them from memory. Various facial features like eyes, nose, mouth, or ears appear in bright colors and strange shapes – the more absurd, the harder it gets. The game challenges your focus and visual memory, as every detail matters when recreating the face. A charming game with simple graphics and surprising difficulty.

meta.name: IFR
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.46 KB

IFR is a civil flight simulator focused entirely on instrument-based flying. With no external view, you control your aircraft solely through cockpit readouts: speed, altitude, heading, climb rate, fuel, radio navigation, and artificial horizon are all essential. The goal is to navigate safely, ascend and descend properly, and execute precise landings – just like in real IFR training. Technically demanding and ideal for simulation enthusiasts with a passion for aviation systems.

meta.name: Ikari III : The Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

¡La hija del candidato presidencial ha sido secuestrada! Tu misión es cruzar las líneas enemigas y rescatarla. Este es el tercer juego de la serie Ikari Warriors, con jugabilidad arcade/acción similar: vista cenital, desplazamiento vertical y numerosos enemigos. Comienzas solo con los puños, pero conforme avanzas puedes hallar armas y objetos que te ayuden en la misión.

meta.name: Ikari Warriors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.62 KB

Ikari Warriors throws you into a relentless advance through hostile territory spanning jungles, rivers, and ruined landscapes. You push forward step by step, dodging attacks and constantly adapting to new situations. Along the way, different weapons become available, giving temporary boosts in firepower, but the pressure never eases and mistakes are quickly punished. The appeal comes from the nonstop momentum, the changing arsenal, and the struggle to survive against overwhelming odds.

meta.name: Ikari Warriors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juegas como dos soldados, probablemente fuerzas de élite, muy parecidos a Rambo. Tu misión es "simple", tienes que cruzar las líneas enemigas, pero tus enemigos son muy numerosos. En este shooter de desplazamiento vertical, vas armado con una ametralladora y granadas, por supuesto en cantidades limitadas. A veces encontrarás vehículos como tanques con una fuerza de ataque más considerable. Atravesarás selva, ríos, zonas en ruinas, ... El juego se vuelve aún más interesante en el modo para dos jugadores (en cooperación).

meta.name: Ikarus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.43 KB

Ikarus is a Joust clone in which players control a phoenix and must try to hit their opponent from a higher position. Pressing the fire-button causes the phoenix to flap its wings and fly upwards. Only when the phoenix is flapping its wings can players influence the direction of its flight. Successfully hitting an opponent from a higher position scores one point. The first player to score ten points wins the game.
Apart from a two-player-mode there is also a single-player quest mode, featuring ten levels with increasingly difficult opponents.

meta.name: Iketa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.30 KB

Iketa puts you into one-on-one battles where you must outfight ninja opponents using a range of attacks and movement techniques. You aim to win two rounds in each match to progress, facing increasingly challenging rivals along the way. The time limit adds pressure, forcing quick decisions and precise execution. Whether playing solo against a series of fighters or facing another player, the experience revolves around timing, reactions, and smart use of your moves.

meta.name: Ikkiuchi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ikkiuchi is a head-to-head martial arts game.
Ikkiuchi is Japanese and means something like duel; a fair duel between ninja adepts in blue and red suits in the local order castle according to the “Best of Three” scheme. Ikkiuchi can be played either with two players against each other or alone against the all-powerful computer. All battles are time-limited and each player has the same attacks and defenses available to ensure fairness and balance. However, players have to find out two special features for themselves. . .

meta.name: Illgen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Illgen, your goal is to uncover an image by gradually sectioning off parts of the screen. Once at least 75% is revealed, you can press a key to expose the full image and enter a bonus round, where you play a Reversi-style puzzle. Numerous enemies try to stop you, but you can shoot them temporarily. Collecting symbols grants you extra lives, more shots, and other bonuses.

meta.name: Imagination
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.67 KB

Imagination is an Interactive Fiction game that includes four different adventures that parody other well known games. Their names are: 2002 - A Very Odd Day in Space, The Lords of Half Past Nine, Panic Miner and Raid over Margate. Each game presents you with a unique setting and different challenges. To solve Imagination, you have to enter these games and solve various puzzles that sometimes require you to use an item from one game in another game.

meta.name: Imhotep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.98 KB

Los libros sagrados. Hace muchos años, en la tierra del Nilo, vivió el poderoso faraón Zoser, dueño de todo egipto. La gente le adoraba como si él fuese un poderoso dios.Confiaban en él con fé ciega, imponiendo que él les concedería abundantes frutos en la tierra. Todo fué bien hasta que en el décimo año de reinado, el Nilo no creció. Los campos y las llanuras de Egipto no fueron regadas por las aguas, origen de la vida, y dejó de haber cosechas: las tierras cayeron en la aridez.

meta.name: Imperium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.71 KB

Imperium sends you into a dangerous mission as the astronaut Roberto, with the fate of humanity depending on your success. Your goal is the enemy command center on Antezium, but the path there is filled with deadly foes that can only be avoided through precise running, ducking, and jumping. Its appeal comes from that direct fight for survival, combined with the sense of a long and difficult journey and the heavy responsibility resting on your shoulders.

meta.name: Imperium Galactum
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Imperium Galactum creates a remarkably broad space scenario in which expansion, conquest, and management are tightly interwoven. Rather than focusing only on isolated battles, the game lets you plan entire star systems, develop ships to your own specifications, deploy troops and colonists with care, and even deal with resistance on conquered planets after a successful invasion. Its special appeal comes from that wide strategic scope, because many of the ideas here would later become the foundation of entire generations of space strategy games.

meta.name: Imperoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.85 KB

Imperoid puts you in control of a starship battling through asteroid fields and enemy formations. Piloting the Imperoid Glider, you unleash a liberation attack, taking down waves of foes with precision to reclaim space.

meta.name: Implosion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Implosion places you in a desperate mission where a hostile planet is on a collision course with Earth and must be stopped from within. You infiltrate dangerous areas, destroy massive energy cores and weaken the planet's defenses while relentless enemies apply constant pressure. Once all threats are eliminated, a portal opens that must be entered quickly, as lingering is hazardous. Collected crystals grant valuable upgrades and rewards for bold play – intense, fast-paced and defined by constant danger and split-second decisions.

meta.name: Impossamole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Monty Mole, tras vivir en lujo desde sus anteriores aventuras, es secuestrado por una raza alienígena que le encarga una misión: atravesar cinco mundos para recuperar los sagrados rollos de sus Guardianes. Los primeros cuatro —el Lejano Oriente, una mina en Klondike, un mundo helado y una selva amazónica— deben completarse para acceder al quinto. La jugabilidad, basada en plataformas, incluye desplazamiento horizontal, cuerdas y escaleras. Monty cuenta con una patada voladora, una bomba inteligente y puede recolectar armas y bombas adicionales. Cada nivel presenta peligros y enemigos temáticos: teleféricos, bolas de nieve, ninjas y monos, entre otros.

meta.desc:

In The Impossible Game, you control a square navigating a constantly scrolling world, aiming to get as far as possible. Your square can only jump to avoid obstacles like dangerous triangles and deadly floors, while black squares serve as platforms. If you die, you're sent back to the start to try again. You can place flags along the way to practice tricky sections and refine your route. Additionally, achievements are awarded for reaching specific milestones. Precision and timing are key to conquering this challenge.

meta.name: Impossible Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Impossible Mission es un trepidante juego de plataformas y puzzles donde encarnas a un agente secreto que debe detener al malvado profesor Elvin Atombender, sospechoso de sabotear ordenadores de seguridad nacional. Infiltrándote en su fortaleza y evitando robots letales, debes recoger fragmentos de una contraseña para acceder a la sala de control. Tienes solo seis horas (en tiempo de juego) para completar la misión: cada fracaso —ya sea al perder una vida o usar la ayuda del ordenador portátil— resta minutos. Robots, habitaciones y piezas del puzzle se generan aleatoriamente, asegurando alta rejugabilidad.

meta.name: Impossible Mission II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tienes 8 horas para evitar que Elvin, un genio psicótico, destruya el mundo en esta secuela del exitoso "Impossible Mission". Entra en la torre fortaleza de Elvin, esquiva sus robots, crea combinaciones de seguridad para cada torre, recupera secuencias musicales y únelas para crear una melodía completa para llegar a la sala de control central de Elvin.

meta.name: In 80 Days Around the World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In 80 Days Around the World retells the famous wager of Phileas Fogg, who claims at London's Reform Club that he can travel around the globe in just 80 days and stakes his entire fortune on it. Together with his loyal butler Passepartout, you set off on October 2nd, alternating control between both characters. A world map lets you manage your journey, speed up travel through bribes, or improve your finances by playing cards. These planning phases are regularly interrupted by fast-paced action sequences – racing through the jungles of India, catching acrobats in Japan, dodging dangerous animals in America, and facing further challenges. Each segment demands sharp reflexes, as failure can abruptly end the adventure – leaving you to find out whether you can return to London in time to win the bet.

"Inca Curse" comenzando en una selva sudamericana, cerca de un templo inca aún intacto, tu objetivo es entrar en la estructura y cazar tesoros. Dentro del templo hay numerosos tesoros (cada uno con un valor en puntos), pero también trampas para atrapar a los codiciosos. Encontrarás una Cámara de Sacrificios, una Sala de Fuego y una Piscina. Recoge tantos tesoros como puedas y regresa al claro de la selva para completar la aventura.

meta.name: The Incredible Laboratory
meta.desc:

In "The Incredible Laboratory," you step into the role of a mad scientist renowned worldwide for creating monsters from unusual chemicals like "Fuzzy Mold," "Bubbling Mud," and "Stinky Socks." However, there's a catch: you can't always remember which chemicals produce which body parts! Your task is to experiment with the chemicals in the lab to discover the combinations that result in the desired monster parts. The wizard's wise advice: keep detailed notes so you're not solely reliant on your eccentric memory. A game full of creative experiments and surprises!

“Indiana Jones in the Lost Kingdom” is an adventure that tells a new story independent of the films. Indiana Jones sets out in search of a lost civilization, solving puzzles and overcoming dangerous traps to find the treasure and escape alive. The game features six screens, with exits guarded by monsters and puzzles. There are no hints — you must not only solve the puzzles but also figure out what needs to be done. The game makes it clear: “Nobody explained the rules to Indiana Jones. And nobody will explain them to you.”

meta.name: Indians, Indians
meta.desc:

In Indians, Indians you explore the history of Native American peoples through the lens of a 1980s educational game. While progressive for its time, it still reflects a colonial perspective and includes portrayals that would be considered outdated and problematic today. Nonetheless, it offers a revealing glimpse into how history was taught and interpreted in that era – including its blindspots and contradictions.

meta.name: Superstar Indoor Sports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Indoor Sports brings together four classic indoor games: Bowling, Air Hockey, Darts, and Ping Pong. Not all games appear on every platform, but each features multiple AI difficulty levels and player-versus-player options. Bowling involves three phases — lining up, setting angle, and timing the release. Darts require aligning the shot, setting curvature, and power, with shifting views to track the dart's path. Air Hockey is fast-paced with a tilted overhead view, ending after five minutes or twelve points. Ping Pong includes a skill-balancing system to create fair matches.

Although the game was initially unreleased, its mechanics were later repurposed in other titles. Years later, a developer completed the original version, allowing "Infection" to finally be experienced in its intended form.

You also need to find food or your character will collapse from hunger. The game features non-linear gameplay – you're free to explore in any direction and must figure out the safest route. Known for its brutal and highly visual death scenes, this grim platformer demands precision, timing, and nerves of steel.

Tu equipo te ha abandonado, ahora estás solo bajo el calor abrasador del sol para encontrar las pirámides... Pero llegar a ellos no es la única dificultad, también debes sobrevivir a los numerosos obstáculos que te bloquean durante tu exploración en su interior.

"Infiltrator" combina un simulador de helicóptero en primera persona con acción y aventura de espionaje en perspectiva isométrica/tercera persona.
Tú, como Johnny McGibbitts, piloto experto y neurocirujano, recibes una misión contra el "Líder Loco". Debes volar en helicóptero tras las líneas enemigas y crear una distracción. Puedes engañar a los helicópteros para que crean que eres uno de ellos y mostrar documentos falsos a los guardias del campamento enemigo. Si no se dejan engañar, puedes usar un spray de gas somnífero o una granada. El campamento tiene muchas casas con habitaciones llenas de objetos útiles, pero a menudo no los necesitas debido al límite de tiempo para la operación.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Infiltrator" combina un simulador de helicóptero en primera persona con acción y aventura de espionaje en perspectiva isométrica/tercera persona.
Tú, como Johnny McGibbitts, piloto experto y neurocirujano, recibes una misión contra el "Líder Loco". Debes volar en helicóptero tras las líneas enemigas y crear una distracción. Puedes engañar a los helicópteros para que crean que eres uno de ellos y mostrar documentos falsos a los guardias del campamento enemigo. Si no se dejan engañar, puedes usar un spray de gas somnífero o una granada. El campamento tiene muchas casas con habitaciones llenas de objetos útiles, pero a menudo no los necesitas debido al límite de tiempo para la operación.

p: Infiltrator Part II - The Next Day (Europe).D64
n: Infiltrator Part II - The Next Day (Europe)

meta.name: Infiltrator Part II : The Next Day
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Infiltrator Part II: The Next Day, Jimbo McGibbets regresa para asumir peligrosas misiones tras las líneas enemigas. Te infiltras en campamentos enemigos a pie, te infiltras en chozas, reúnes armas e información, y usas granadas de gas para neutralizar a los guardias. Entre misiones terrestres, pilotas un helicóptero de combate de alta tecnología desde la cabina, repeles aeronaves enemigas y atacas las defensas terrestres. La estrategia, el sigilo y la potencia de fuego son clave para el éxito.

meta.name: Eindeloos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.12 KB

"Endless" was once a world-famous tourist attraction, drawing visitors from all countries to its vast cave system. But everything changed when an alien superbeing was awakened during an expedition on one of Neptune's moons. Filled with rage, it turned its attention to Earth, made "Eindeloos" its fortress, and took the form of a mystical heart to fall into a deep sleep once more. The player controls a helicopter from a multidirectional perspective and must descend into the caves to defeat the being and its armies. Along the way, they must avoid moving obstacles such as mines, energy wires, and scrolling rails.

meta.name: Infinite Inferno
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Infinite Inferno is an adventure game for the Commodore 64. In this game, you wake up after a party in a mysterious situation and must figure out how to escape your dilemma. It starts with the unexpected situation of waking up trapped in a box after previously celebrating a farewell party with friends. The game begins as you wake up with a hangover and a headache, only to find that your friends have locked you in a box. Your task is to escape this predicament and understand the background of the situation while dealing with the challenges of the environment.

meta.name: Infinite Inferno
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Infinite Inferno is an adventure game for the Commodore 64. In this game, you wake up after a party in a mysterious situation and must figure out how to escape your dilemma. It starts with the unexpected situation of waking up trapped in a box after previously celebrating a farewell party with friends. The game begins as you wake up with a hangover and a headache, only to find that your friends have locked you in a box. Your task is to escape this predicament and understand the background of the situation while dealing with the challenges of the environment.

meta.name: Infodroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.65 KB

Infodroid takes place on a planet where everything revolves around managing and delivering information and packages. Your goal is to outmatch the competition and rise as a major player in the business. Deliveries are handled by droids moving along five lanes of varying speeds. Your headquarters acts as a hub, granting access to different rooms. Along the way, rival company droids will try to ram you, forcing you to dodge by jumping between lanes. The money you earn from successful deliveries can be spent on buying new droids or upgrading existing ones with stronger shields or boosts that let you leap across multiple lanes at once.

meta.name: Ingrid's Back!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Ingrid's Back! you play as clever but clumsy gnome Ingrid Bottomlow, trying to stop greedy Jasper Quickbuck from turning her village into a yuppie resort. With three clever plans – gathering signatures, finding a lawful workaround, and going undercover as a maid – you aim to expose him. Flopsy the dog and cousin Daisy assist you in a living world full of movement, chatter, and inventive puzzles.

Flopsy the dog and cousin Daisy assist you in a living world full of movement, chatter, and inventive puzzles.

Flopsy the dog and cousin Daisy assist you in a living world full of movement, chatter, and inventive puzzles.

meta.name: The Inheritance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.15 KB

"The Inheritance" is an adventure game where the player, due to an accident, has lost their memory and must regain their cultural knowledge and memories. To do so, they travel the world in search of lost insights and people who can help in rediscovering their past. The player can choose to play as either a male or female character, with the selection made by moving the joystick upwards. To change direction, the fire button is pressed, and the desired path is chosen. The goal of the game is to recover the lost inheritance.

meta.name: The Inheritance - Chaos In Scotland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.36 KB

In “The Inheritance: Chaos in Scotland,” Peter Stone finds himself in a Scottish castle donated by his late aunt. To prove his identity and claim the inheritance, he must locate the family book while impostor nephews cause chaos. The player navigates the castle in first-person, interacting with objects and collecting items, with an inventory limited to four objects. A unique challenge is managing Peter's dwindling stamina, which must be replenished with found food. Decisions can impact the survival of other characters, but the ultimate goal is to secure the inheritance and survive.

p: Inheritance, The - Panic in Las Vegas (France).D64
n: Inheritance, The - Panic in Las Vegas (France)

meta.name: The Inheritance : Panic In Las Vegas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Inheritance: Panic in Las Vegas" is a point-and-click adventure where the player controls Peter Stone, a shady character traveling to Las Vegas after his wealthy aunt's death to claim his inheritance. The cursor is moved with the arrow keys, and the space bar is used for interactions. The inventory is represented by a handbag that can be minimized. The game is divided into three sections with password saving: First, Peter must leave his apartment and reach the airport on time while dealing with annoying tenants. In the second section, he faces terrorists and obstacles at the airport. In Las Vegas, he finally needs to find the notary and earn a million dollars in the casinos to claim the inheritance.

meta.name: Erben des Throns v2.00
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Inherits of the Throne v2.00 you play as a baron vying for control of a fragmented realm whose king has been assassinated while the rightful heir is away on a crusade. Expand your territory, command armies, manage taxes and village growth, and fight strategic battles to unify the kingdom under your rule. The game is turn-based and includes customizable options such as map size, random events, and even a mode where you race to seize power before the heir returns. Up to four players can compete in hot-seat multiplayer.

meta.name: Injured Engine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Injured Engine is an educational simulation where you learn how a car engine works. You test a faulty engine, monitor sounds and instruments, and identify what's wrong. A cross-sectional view lets you explore and zoom into each part, with explanations provided. Once diagnosed, you enter the repair shop to inspect, fix or replace parts. The goal is to keep the cost per mile as low as possible. In the challenge mode, you're under time pressure to fix five major faults as they appear.

meta.name: The Inner Lakes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.95 KB

The Inner Lakes puts you in the role of a determined amateur angler on a quest to catch the Irish record tench. After a long drive, you explore lakes and streams, encounter people who ask for help, and solve simple puzzles. Fishing requires using commands like CAST IN, REEL IN, and STRIKE – with patience and skill, you just might land a legendary catch.

meta.name: Inner Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Inner Space is a horizontally side scrolling shooter where you control a spaceship and must blast wave after wave of alien ships over nine levels. At the end of each level is a boss and these take a number of shots before destroying it. If you touch any ship or bullet then you lose one of five lives and when all lives are gone it is game over. Every time you destroy a wave of ships, an icon moves across the screen and when collected gives you a better weapon. This is indicated by a row of icons below the playing area and each time you collect a icon the next one is highlighted. Press space and the weapon is used but if you don't destroy a wave when an icon is highlighted then you lose the chance to select it.

meta.name: Inner Space Plant Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.42 KB

In "Inner Space Plant Attack," you fight to save Earth's plant life. Throughout the game, you must fend off threats and take measures to prevent the plants from perishing. Your mission requires skill and quick action to protect nature.

meta.name: Insanity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.44 KB

Insanity is a colorful puzzle game where you remove matching tile pairs from a stacked board. The tiles feature letters, numbers and symbols, arranged in layers – so strategic thinking is required to find free pairs. The game includes customizable music, tile sets and color themes, allowing you to tailor the experience to your liking. Despite the name, the insanity stays fun – as long as you keep your cool.

meta.name: Insectophobia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.88 KB

Insectophobia is a humorous game where the player must fend off an insect invasion in their home. Armed with a flyswatter, the pesky intruders are squashed. A second player can join the action with a can of bug spray to help defeat the insects together. The game features a static background that changes as the game progresses, providing entertaining visuals along the way.

meta.name: Insects in Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.63 KB

Insects in Space is a side-scrolling shooter with similarities to Defender. Insects killed everyone on Earth except a few babies. This causes the mystical leader of motherhood, St. Helen, to travel to Earth's remains and save the babies. The most important feature of this protagonist is the fact that she is topless and - as prominently mentioned in the manual - "big breasted", but she controls and shoots just like the space ship normally found in those games.

meta.name: Insomnia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Insomnia is a fast-paced puzzle game where you must place falling blocks on matching color fields. The goal varies by mode – sometimes you collect all blocks of a color, sometimes you avoid certain combinations or race against time. Each level introduces new challenges that demand concentration and quick thinking. Those who adapt to the rules and react fast have a chance to climb the high score ranks in Insomnia.

p: Inspector Gadget and the Circus of Fear (Europe).T64
n: Inspector Gadget and the Circus of Fear (Europe)

meta.path: ./Inspector Gadget and the Circus of Fear (Europe).T64
meta.name: Inspector Gadget and the Circus of Fear
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.10 KB

When the International Circus comes to town, a mysterious series of disappearances begin, and Inspector Gadget is called into help. Once his involvement is discovered, Penny and Brains are kidnapped, making Gadget's task bigger. This involves getting through each side-scrolling level, avoiding the meanies by jumping them, and reaching the final target. There are many holes which lead to different sections of levels. The C64 version adds an icon system allowing you to collect and use your gadgets.

meta.name: The Institute
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Institute is a dark text adventure where you play as John, trapped in a nightmarish asylum surrounded by madness and manipulation. Taunted by doctors and plagued by drug-induced hallucinations, your only goal is to escape. Using a basic two-word parser, you explore your grim surroundings, collect clues and items from dream sequences, and uncover fragments of your own past. The focus lies on the surreal story and disturbing atmosphere rather than complex gameplay – unsettling, strange, and intense.

meta.name: Intensity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.74 KB

Intensity places you aboard an overrun space station where rescue, not combat, is the primary objective. You pilot a skimmer across single-screen areas, marking landing spots so a rescue drone can pick up astronauts emerging from various openings. Saving more survivors increases your rewards, but also raises the difficulty of the stages that follow. Between missions, earnings can be spent on improved skimmers and drones that withstand more damage or offer tactical advantages. Tension grows as enemies mutate into more dangerous forms, some hunting you directly while others turn rescued people into threats, making even small mistakes fatal.

meta.name: Insector Hecti in the Interchange
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 87.94 KB

In Insector Hecti in the Interchange, you play as a digital detective exploring complex circuits to undo the damage caused by the devious Victor Virus and his gang of bugs. Across 50 circuit boards, they've altered the orientation of key components. Your mission is to walk the circuits, identify the misaligned pieces, and rotate them back to their correct positions. A ping confirms each successful fix. Only by carefully restoring each board can you save the system.

meta.name: Interdictor Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The player pilots a spaceship from a 1st person perspective. The ship automatically warps through hyperspace, and arrives in combat with an enemy vessel. The player has a limited fuel supply, and must quickly destroy enemy vessels. As the player proceeds, they arrive at local starbases, which allow the player to save their progress and earn ranks. The goal is to reach the rank of Commodore.

meta.name: Intergalactic Cage Match
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.22 KB

Intergalactical Cage Match is a single screen one to two player wrestling game where the ring is viewed from an elevated angle set in space as you attempt to beat five other fighters from across the universe. At the start of the game you can select your fighter as well as your opponent and the idea is to climb to the top of the cage that surrounds the ring. You have various moves that are controlled by joystick combinations and as well as kick and punch you can headbutt and throw your opponent. You are able to climb the cage at any time but if your opponent is still able to fight then he can shake the cage to throw you off. Both fighters have a energy gauge and every hit taken decreases it and when it reaches red then that fighter hits the canvas. You can kick your opponent while he is down and when he isn't able to get up then you can climb the cage to win the fight. After the fight you can select another fighter and select another opponent.

meta.name: Interlaced Pairs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Interlaced Pairs is a puzzle and memory game designed for one or two players. The goal is to find matching pairs, challenging concentration and memory skills. An entertaining game that can be enjoyed solo or in competition with another player.

meta.name: International 3D Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.60 KB

International 3D Tennis is a tennis game with ten camera angles, 1 or 2 players, 64 different computer opponents with 15 skill levels, 72 tournaments based on real events and 4 court surfaces (grass, clay, carpet and cement). You can choose 22 tournaments and play in a full tennis season. Other features is to learn to play topspin and backspin balls, four player ability levels (amateur, semi-pro, pro and ace), TV tennis theme tunes and Any-time save option. The game uses vector graphics that gives it a 3D look.

meta.name: International 5 A-Side
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.44 KB

“International 5 A-Side” brings the fast-paced action of five-a-side football to the screen – faithfully and in detail. In a tournament featuring eight international teams, two skill levels, and variable match lengths, four outfield players and a goalkeeper compete. Unique rules like the semicircular goal area, which only the keeper can enter, and a walled arena that causes ricochets, add tactical depth. On top of that, the ball must never be played above head height – quick reflexes and smart positioning are key to victory.

meta.name: International Basketball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.93 KB

El Baloncesto es uno de los deportes más emocionantes y divertidos. Practíquelo ahora con su COMMODORE 64. Con este juego podrá Vd. enfrentarse a su ordenador o retar a su mejor amigo en un emocionante partido de baloncesto.

meta.name: International Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.43 KB

Asume el control de un equipo de fútbol internacional europeo en este juego de presupuesto. Se selecciona automáticamente un equipo inicial de 11 jugadores y 2 suplentes de la lista de 24 miembros del equipo y otros 16 'aspirantes', pero puedes moverlos a tu antojo. Puedes elegir la formación, el estilo de juego y las tácticas de tu equipo para tener la oportunidad de clasificarte en los grupos de 4 equipos para llegar a los campeonatos más importantes. También se debe organizar el entrenamiento del equipo. Durante el partido puedes ver en qué parte del campo se encuentra el balón (más tarde Premier Manager utilizó un sistema similar), así como actualizaciones sobre los momentos clave.

meta.name: International Ice Hockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

International ice hockey is a simple ice hockey game in which the player participates in a league. The goal is to reach the top of the league, which is achieved by winning against other teams.When their own team has possession of the puck, the player can initiate a shot by holding down the fire button - the longer it is held, the more power goes into the shot. On defense, the player can choose between two control methods: either manually switched by the athletes or the game automatically switches to the control closest to the puck.Other options include strategy (positioning of the athlete), three difficulty levels, time per game period (two, five, or twenty minutes), and whether to repeat the game's highlights after each third. Offside and icing are ignored.

meta.name: International Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.38 KB

Take control of an international soccer team in this economic management game. A first squad with 11 players and 2 substitute players will automatically be selected for you from a list of 24 squad members and 16 other “hopefuls”. However, you can move it as you wish. You can choose your team's formation, playing style and tactics to give yourself the chance to qualify for the major championships in the groups of four. Team training also needs to be organized.

meta.name: International Ninja Rabbits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Having saved the day by destroying a chemical plant in Ninja Rabbits, Bugs must now travel the world and destroy several more chemical plants to save the environment from pollution. To get to each plant our hero must walk from left to right on a scrolling side view game. Bugs doesn't just have to travel above ground but has the option in various places to go underground as well. The baddies appear from the right and using various moves, punch, kick or swing his stick, our hero can defeat the baddies. The baddies can fight back and if they hit you then your damage meter (in the shape of a carrot) will get smaller before it disappears and you lose a life.

meta.name: International Rugby Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.37 KB

Seven-a-side rugby union is brought to life in this budget game.  The action is viewed from the side, although kicks to the posts are played from a behind-the-posts perspective. Scrums and line-outs are incorporated for as realistic a game as possible given the player restriction. A tournament can be played with up to 8 players, with as many computer teams as required to fill the gaps.
In the ST version the tactical side of the game is very complex - seventeen different formations are on offer. Other gameplay variables can be set - player stamina (lower values forcing you to play a more conservative game), how long a player takes to recover from a tackle, and the standard strengths of passes and kicks, pus some very complicated mathematical coefficients. The ability to rename teams, change kits and alter the match lengths seem banal by comparison.

meta.name: International Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.99 KB

International Soccer gives you fast-paced arcade football action without big tournaments or leagues – instead, you only play friendly matches with two halves of 200 seconds each. You can either face the AI with nine levels of difficulty or compete against another human player. Each team fields seven players, and you always control the one closest to the ball, while the AI handles your teammates. Corner kicks and throw-ins are included, but there are no fouls – so no yellow or red cards to worry about. Using the joystick's fire button, you can pass or shoot, and movement is possible in all eight directions.

meta.name: International Speedway
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.13 KB

It's time to put on leather clothes, helmet and goggles. It's time to become world champion in the fast-paced motorcycle speedway that revolves around an oval. After entering name, country and continent, the player starts in the local championship league. Win the league and move on to the next higher league against tougher drivers. The ultimate goal is to work your way up the leagues to become world champions.
The game is watched from behind the driver as he navigates the oval track. The screen also shows a bird's eye view of the track, showing the positions of all drivers. Also visible: lap time, number of laps, speedometer and a picture of the driver's hand and helmet. The controls are simple: the fire button accelerates, steers left and right. There is no brake, but once per race a special boost can be activated by pushing the joystick forward.

meta.name: International Sports Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.50 KB

The International Sports Challenge lets you and up to three friends compete in six different sports and 21 different events. You can choose from any mix of individual disciplines or play them consecutively with the 26 mile marathon.
Available sports include:
* Marathon,
* Diving: one and two meter springboard, five meter platform or medley competition. In total there are more than 40 dives available.
* Show Jumping: Difficulty levels include Gymkhana, National, International and World.
* Swimming: 50, 100 or 200 meter race with breaststroke, butterfly or freestyle. You can also swim 200 meters individual medley (50 meters each breaststroke, freestyle, backstroke and butterfly).
* Cycling: 1000 and 2000 meter distances in sprint or pursuit races.
* Shooting: Skeet, Trap, Boar (on the move) or Target Shooting.

meta.name: International Team Sports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"International Team Sports" lets players compete in five team sports against other nations to win medals. After selecting a country, a team of seven members is assembled and strategically assigned to the various sports, taking into account the number of players required per sport and ensuring everyone gets sufficient participation. The sports include water polo, indoor soccer, volleyball, the 4x100-meter swimming relay, and the 4x400-meter running relay. The goal is to achieve championship victory through clever team management and successful performance in the competitions.

meta.name: International Team Sports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"International Team Sports" lets players compete in five team sports against other nations to win medals. After selecting a country, a team of seven members is assembled and strategically assigned to the various sports, taking into account the number of players required per sport and ensuring everyone gets sufficient participation. The sports include water polo, indoor soccer, volleyball, the 4x100-meter swimming relay, and the 4x400-meter running relay. The goal is to achieve championship victory through clever team management and successful performance in the competitions.

meta.name: International Tennis (Commodore)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.53 KB

In International Tennis, you play a simple singles match that follows the basic rules of the sport. The joystick moves the player, and the button is used to serve or swing the racket. Holding the button while moving the stick affects shot direction and power. A blinking line shows where to stand when serving. Players can also choose clothing colors and the computer opponent's difficulty level. Aside from that, the game offers no additional features.

meta.name: International Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.24 KB

International Tennis allows four players to play tennis on three different courts (grass, clay and asphalt). The game can be played in different match variations. You can play singles with the men (five sets) or women (three sets) or play mixed with both in doubles. You can choose to take control of all players or go for a cpu-vs-cpu match. The action is seen in the third person, as is usually the case in tennis games.

meta.name: International Truck Racing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.30 KB

Este simulador serio de carreras de camiones, en vista cenital, recrea con fidelidad el manejo realista de estos vehículos: desplazamiento aparentemente lento y entrecortado, y colisiones irregulares. Cada carrera incluye 6 camiones y se disputa en circuitos internacionales famosos. Cada pocas vueltas debes repostar entrando a boxes y recogiendo la bandera de tu color. Solo los tres primeros obtienen puntos, y debes quedar entre ellos para avanzar a la siguiente ronda.
meta.developer: J. Carlyle, I. Copeland & D. Sowerby

meta.name: Interview
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Interview, the player takes on the role of a job applicant on their way to an important interview. The mission begins with the goal of reaching the bank in time to withdraw money for a suit. Along the way, the player must avoid obstacles such as open manholes, banana peels, dogs, trash cans, and falling flower pots, as each hit costs precious time. After reaching the bank, the perspective shifts to a city map where the player must locate a tailor for the suit, a dry cleaner, and finally the office for the interview. Dangers like cars, more dogs, pedestrians, and open manholes lurk along the route. Only those who arrive clean and on time within 15 minutes will land the job.

meta.name: Into the Eagle's Nest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Into the Eagle's Nest se ambienta en la Segunda Guerra Mundial. El jugador debe infiltrarse en una fortaleza enemiga, rescatar a los soldados aliados capturados, destruir el edificio y recuperar las obras de arte robadas. La misión abarca ocho niveles, cada uno con objetivos específicos. Si bien algunas pinturas se pueden recolectar libremente, otras deben extraerse de cajas. Con munición limitada, numerosos guardias patrullando y llaves estratégicamente ubicadas, un enfoque cauteloso y calculado es clave para el éxito de la misión.

meta.name: Into the Mystic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.23 KB

In Into the Mystic, the world is in turmoil as magic vanishes, leaving a void in people's lives. After much deliberation, the council sends Merlin to find someone brave and foolish enough to take on the task. One evening, Merlin appears at the player's door, urging them to solve the mystery of the disappearing magic. The player sets out on their journey, but danger strikes quickly: a band of marauding orcs. After fleeing through the forest, the player rests near an ancient fort, which allows for only a brief, foul-smelling visit. The surroundings offer few answers, and the shadowy woods feel menacing. Back at the forest's edge, the player gazes at the sleeping orcs and must decide how to proceed. It seems to be a matter of "kill or be killed," while the mystery of magic remains unsolved.

meta.name: Into The Nature
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Into the Nature, the player controls a bird navigating through a side-scrolling landscape, battling numerous enemies along the way. Skill and quick reflexes are required to defeat approaching foes and avoid obstacles.

meta.name: Intrigue!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Intrigue!, your brother Joe vanishes while investigating a conspiracy to release a virus into the air over Washington D.C. You take over the case, questioning shady suspects, collecting clues, and trying to locate the villain's hideout, shut down the virus device, and unmask the mastermind. With over 2000 possible outcomes, every playthrough is different – no one can be trusted, and nothing is certain.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Intrigue!, your brother Joe vanishes while investigating a conspiracy to release a virus into the air over Washington D.C. You take over the case, questioning shady suspects, collecting clues, and trying to locate the villain's hideout, shut down the virus device, and unmask the mastermind. With over 2000 possible outcomes, every playthrough is different – no one can be trusted, and nothing is certain.

meta.name: Intruder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.60 KB

In "Intruder," you find yourself in a forbidden garden where carnivorous, multicolored weeds try to surround and devour you. Your task is to evade the weeds for as long as possible. The longer you survive before they encircle you, the higher your score. Once you are completely trapped, you can no longer move, and the game ends.

meta.name: Intruder (CP Verlag)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.09 KB

In "Intruder," you pilot a spaceship in an action-packed shoot-'em-up designed in the style of "Uridium." In single-player or cooperative mode with a second player, you fight your way through enemy territories, fending off waves of opponents while showcasing your skills. Precision and teamwork are the keys to success.

meta.name: Intruder - The Space Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Intruder: The Space Quest you embark on an exciting space adventure that demands quick reflexes and skill. As a solo pilot, you navigate your ship through dangerous areas, overcome challenges, and fight through hostile obstacles to complete your mission.

meta.name: Intruder Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.13 KB

"Intruder Adventure" is a text adventure and part of the infamous "Disk 50" collection by Cascade Games. In this game, you explore an unknown world, solve puzzles, and navigate dangerous situations to complete your mission successfully. Intelligence and a spirit of exploration are crucial to making progress.

meta.name: Invade-A-Load!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.39 KB

Invade-a-Load allowed players to enjoy a small Space Invaders-like mini-game while the main game was loading on the Commodore 64. This mini-game was ready to play in under a minute, providing entertainment during the often lengthy multi-minute load times of the main game. In at least one instance, Invade-a-Load was even preferred by a critic over the main game itself. This technique was particularly popular in the UK, as the US market had largely transitioned to floppy disks by that time.

meta.name: Invader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.60 KB

In Invader, up to four players battle for survival in a horizontally scrolling space shooter. Enemy waves appear in bizarre formations, and players must destroy them to stay alive. Precision and quick reflexes are crucial to fend off the advancing foes. The game was released in Italy under the name Fox 2000.

meta.name: Invaders 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Invaders 64, the player controls a laser platform at the bottom of the screen, tasked with shooting down aliens that move side to side in formation while gradually advancing closer. The aliens drop bombs that must be avoided, while four shields provide temporary protection but deteriorate with each hit. Occasionally, a mothership appears, offering bonus points if destroyed. The game features an alternating two-player mode and allows players to choose from five difficulty levels.

meta.name: Invaders of the Lost Tomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

I have begun my quest to find SCARABAEUS, the fabulous emerald jewel of the Pharaoh. I have been bitten by a deadly venomous spider on entering the tomb and now I must find medicines and hieroglyphs before my life is over. The thought of a new dawn seems distant to me now as I begin my descent into the dark horrors of the Pharaoh's Tomb to find the mighty SCARABAEUS!

meta.name: Invasion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.49 KB

Los juegos de estrategia con un elemento de movimiento en tiempo real no comenzaron con Dune 2, y esta fue una implementación temprana del concepto. Su ejército ha aterrizado en un planeta alienígena y tiene la intención de destruir su estación de control meteorológico, e idealmente la mayor cantidad posible de sus unidades.
La acción se ve desde arriba, y usas un cursor para dirigir unidades, y automáticamente apuntas y atacas unidades enemigas. Una vez que explotes la torre de control del clima, explotando al menos 2 bombas junto a ella, debes huir del planeta lo antes posible. Proteger todas sus unidades es importante y requiere un enfoque de visión general táctica, pero las bombas son particularmente vitales.

meta.name: Invasion Fall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.83 KB

In Invasion Fall, the player controls a platform at the bottom of the screen, battling incoming enemies in the style of the classic Space Invaders. The enemy waves steadily advance, and the player must shoot accurately to stop them and survive. Skill and quick reflexes are the keys to success.

meta.name: Invasion II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.19 KB

In Invasion II, the player leads an army on an alien planet with the objective of destroying the enemy weather control station and eliminating as many opposing units as possible. From a top-down perspective, the player directs their units using a cursor that automatically targets and attacks enemies. To destroy the station, at least two bombs must be detonated. Afterward, the player must quickly evacuate the planet. Tactical planning is crucial to protect their units, especially the bombs, which are essential for mission success.

meta.name: Invasive Action
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.46 KB

In Invasive Action, the player must navigate a spaceship through a dangerous mushroom farm to escape the planet. Along the way, they must dodge or destroy mutated giant mushrooms and combat rogue harvest robots. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to overcome the obstacles and make a safe getaway.

meta.name: Invasor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.14 KB

Invasor is a classic Space Invaders clone where the player battles aliens resembling designs from Galaxian or Gorf. Using a cannon at the bottom of the screen, the goal is to shoot down the advancing enemies before they reach the ground. Precise shooting and quick reflexes are the keys to success.

meta.name: Inve$t
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Inve$t, it's all about making big money. In this turn-based business game, you buy companies, sell their products, and reinvest profits into new ventures, shares, or improvements. Up to four players compete for dominance across six industries – from pharmaceuticals to space engineering. The winner is the one who amasses the most wealth or builds a monopoly. Saboteurs and spies infiltrate companies to cause chaos, unless stopped by detectives. The game was only released in German.

meta.name: Invert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Invert is an addictive puzzle game with a built-in level editor that tests both logic and reflexes. You've been captured and thrown into a deadly cell – your only goal is to escape and reunite with your girlfriend. To do so, you must invert all tiles into their correct form before time runs out. But beware: monster guards patrol the levels and hurl bombs into your cell. A shield can save you, but only for a while. Some tiles will aid you, while others will hinder your progress – and only by experimenting will you uncover the path to freedom.

meta.name: Invertus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.28 KB

Invertus is a time-based puzzle game where the player must turn all black tiles into white. To do this, the player selects a field of four (2x2) squares, reversing their colors – black becomes white and white becomes black. With each level, the configuration of tiles grows more complex, steadily increasing the challenge. Precise thinking and quick action are essential to solve the puzzles before time runs out.

meta.name: Invisible Clock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.75 KB

Invisible Clock continuously shows a 24-hour digital clock in the lower screen border. It's controlled via SYS commands: SYS 49152 displays the clock, SYS 49152,"hhmmss" sets the time (leading 0 – reverse video), SYS 49152,color changes the color (0–15). It uses raster interrupts – TI$ becomes inaccurate while running. Sprites 0–2 are used and $0340–$03FF is reserved for sprite data. After RUN/STOP-RESTORE, the display must be re-enabled.

meta.name: IO : Into Oblivion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 98.00 KB

An enemy has entered your region of space in a mothership, and unleashed foes aimed at destroying you. As the planet's top pilot, the player is sent out to ultimately destroy the mothership, in this horizontally-scrolling shoot 'em up. As well as aliens, the player will encounter gun turrets and missiles, plus bosses at the end of each level. Levels 3 and also add narrow R-Type-style gaps.
Smart bombs appear on the screen at random intervals, which can be used in two ways. Flying over them destroys everything on the screen, but shooting them turns them into power-up tokens or protective orbs, to be picked up. Players lose all these weapons every time they are defeated by enemies.

meta.name: IQ Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In IQ Baseball you compete against another player or the computer, combining baseball action with quiz questions. When a player is up to bat, a question is pitched and you must press the correct letter key to answer – quickly and without pressing return. Correct answers move you around the bases or allow you to score, while wrong answers can halt your advance. Skillful play, good timing, and solid knowledge determine who wins the game.

meta.name: Iridis Alpha
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.07 KB

There is war on the planet Iridis Alpha between the Zzyaxian and the Gilbies. The Gilbies have to fight back by killing the Zzyaxian fighters to get their energy. This can then be put back into the planet's core. The Gilbies have a twin who live on the underside of the planet, and both Twins have to be alive for both to survive. Switching between GRF's is essential for survival.

meta.name: Iron Horse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.49 KB

Iron Horse pone al jugador en el papel de un vaquero encargado de detener a los asaltantes de trenes. El jugador se desplaza lateralmente por el tren, ya sea en el interior o en el techo, y puede elegir entre tres armas: puños, látigo o pistola. Además, hay disponible un arma especial que crea una manta de fuego y derrota a todos los enemigos terrestres. A lo largo del viaje, aparecen vaqueros enemigos que atacan con armas como pistolas, látigos, fuego o dinamita. Cada golpe cuesta una vida. Los sacos de oro esparcidos por el tren pueden recogerse para conseguir puntos extra. En ciertos puntos, el progreso se ve bloqueado por grupos más grandes de enemigos que deben ser derrotados para continuar y, finalmente, reclamar una gran pila de oro. La habilidad y la rapidez de reacción son esenciales para completar la misión.

meta.name: Iron Lord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El Reino Verde era una tierra próspera y pacífica bajo el reinado del rey Tibor, que esperaba tranquilamente a que su hijo creciera y le entregara su hacienda. Una noche, Zolphar, el hermano de Tibor, exiliado durante años tras un complot fallido para hacerse con el trono, regresa de entre los muertos. Los dos hermanos se reconcilian, pero Zolphar, utilizando magia diabólica, mata a Tibor y levanta un ejército de demonios contra el reino. El capitán Maltholm consigue escapar después de que sus soldados hayan sido diezmados por las criaturas, y salva la vida del hijo del rey. En los años siguientes, mientras Zolphar consigue gobernar el reino, Maltholm entrena al niño para la lucha. Ya adulto, le encomienda la tarea de vengar a su padre, reunir un ejército y matar a Zolphar. Eres el soldado entrenado en el código de honor de los Señores de Hierro.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.84 KB

Ironhand is a horizontally scrolling space shooter reminiscent of games like Uridium. The player pilots a spaceship through hostile terrain, dodging obstacles and fighting enemies. Precise maneuvering and quick reactions are essential to overcome the challenge. The high-score table features names inspired by Frank Zappa's songs. The game was released in Italy under the name Fleet.

meta.name: Island - Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.97 KB

Island is a strategy game where the player must perform the right actions to survive and escape from a deserted island. On each turn, only one type of action can be chosen: collect water, search for food, send a message, gather planks, or rest. Each selected activity carries risks and has specific consequences. The key to success lies in collecting supplies, managing resources wisely, and avoiding dangers. Escape is possible after building a raft or finding a bottle with a message from a ship.

meta.name: The Island of Dr. Destructo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.78 KB

In The Island of Dr. Destructo you lead a mission to destroy the enemy fleet and ultimately the island stronghold. You control a plane within a confined area and shoot down enemy aircraft so they crash into a target at the bottom of the screen. Repeated hits at the same spot create whirlpools that eventually destroy the objective. You encounter different enemy types, some destructible and others requiring quick evasion. You also have a bomb available once per level for precise attacks. A day–night cycle adds variety and noticeably changes the gameplay conditions.

meta.name: Island of Spies
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.09 KB

Island of Spies begins with a crash behind enemy lines after being hit by anti-aircraft guns during a routine patrol. The player must survive the crash, fight through enemy territory, and sabotage the enemy's invasion plans. To escape the island, the player must hijack a helicopter at a nearby airfield and overcome the enemy's anti-aircraft defenses while ensuring they are not shot down by their own forces. Skill, strategy, and quick action are crucial to successfully complete the mission.

meta.name: Island of the Dragons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Island of The Dragons takes you to a mysterious land that cannot be found on any maps, defying the laws of science and man. The story begins with an excerpt from the diary of Jack Roberts, a pilot who stumbles upon an unknown island on November 1, 1992. This island holds secrets and dangers only accessible to the bravest adventurers. You will encounter unexplored territories and fantastic creatures, and must face the challenges that this enigmatic land presents.

meta.name: The Island!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.28 KB

The Island! places the player on a deserted island, where they must find a way to escape. Along the way, they must avoid monsters and hostile island inhabitants while collecting all treasures. The game is beginner-friendly, offering helpful hints and occasional tips to guide the player through the adventure. Skill and smart decision-making are essential to overcome the island's challenges and escape safely.

meta.name: Isnogud : The Grand Vizir
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.87 KB

In Isnogud: The Grand Vizir, you play as the power-hungry vizier Iznogoud, determined to overthrow the Caliph of Baghdad and take his place. You explore the palace, collect items, and interact with quirky characters using flattery, threats, gifts, or tantrums. Each character reacts differently, and only the right approach will bring you closer to your goal. But be warned – the wrong choices may land you in a dungeon, or worse.

meta.name: ISS : Incredible Shrinking Sphere
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Incredible Shrinking Sphere puts you in control of a morphing ball in an isometric maze filled with hazards and tricky physics. Navigate through four connected sections, using special tiles to shrink, grow, and alter the ball's behavior. Only by mastering size changes and movement can you overcome tight spaces and traps to reach the exit. Precision, quick reflexes, and spatial awareness are key to surviving this rolling challenge.

meta.desc:

Istar's Crossword Program puts the player in the role of a crossword enthusiast working through a variety of puzzles. The interface presents a classic grid where the player fills in words based on given clues. The game offers the ability to view definitions, make mistakes and correct them, creating an authentic puzzle experience. The challenge is to fill in the entire grid correctly, with the game suitable for both beginners and experienced puzzle solvers. The intuitive controls and variety of puzzles ensure sustained fun while also encouraging thinking skills.

meta.name: It's a Knockout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.41 KB

“It's a Knockout” is based on the TV show about the same game. Players, each representing a European country, compete in six arcade-style mini-games to determine the winner. Each game is played in order and each player takes a turn. The goal of each mini-game is to collect as many points as possible in a limited time - the player with the highest score is rewarded with six points, the next with five, and so on. After all games have been played, the winner with the highest score wins the competition.

meta.name: It's Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's Magic tells the story of Tommy the tomcat, who must return to the Dream Islands after a magic experiment gone wrong. To find his way home, he must collect the scattered pieces of a shattered crystal ball along with magic potions. The journey is split into worlds and stages, where you need to gather all diamonds and obtain a special potion that only appears after defeating certain monsters. Tommy can use his magic to attack enemies, but unless destroyed they reappear in the same spots. Before leaving each world, a boss battle awaits to test your skills.

meta.name: It's Magic 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's Magic 2 continues the story of Tommy the tomcat, who once again embarks on an adventurous quest to return to the Dream Islands. He must collect the shards of the shattered crystal ball and search for magic potions, which only appear after defeating certain monsters. Each world is divided into stages filled with diamonds, enemies, and traps to overcome. Tommy can attack with magic, but unless enemies are destroyed they reappear in their original spots. At the end of each world, a powerful boss awaits, demanding all your skill to progress further.

meta.name: It's only Rock'n'Roll
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's only Rock'n'Roll puts you in charge of a newly formed rock band aiming for fame, fortune, and flashy status symbols. You start with a pool of energy that decreases with every action, and you plan your rise step by step. Songs are computer-generated and rated, after which you decide on tours across different regions, balancing costs, profits, and popularity. Concerts range from small pubs to huge arenas and can sometimes be cancelled due to illness, weather, or other mishaps. A manager helps you – or causes scandals – while you launch fan clubs, sign record deals, and bid on luxuries like yachts or castles. With the right mix of creativity, strategy, and a bit of luck, you can earn the popularity points, millions, and symbols of success needed to become a rock legend.

meta.name: Italy '90 Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.52 KB

"Italy '90 Soccer" puts you on the pitch of the World Cup in Italy, where you choose a team and aim for the championship. From a side-scrolling view, you control either the player with the ball or the one closest to it, moving in eight directions, trying to gain possession and shoot – the longer you hold the kick button, the stronger the shot. Each team fields an unusual seven players including the goalkeeper.

meta.name: Italy 1990 : Winners Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Italy 1990: Winners Edition recreates the 1990 World Cup with all 24 participating teams in a classic top-down football game. You choose formations and lineups before each match, control players with the ball glued to their feet, and tackle using blocks or riskier slides. Match durations can range from 4 to 90 minutes, and each player behaves differently based on team strength, giving every game its own feel.

meta.name: Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.30 KB

Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road throws you into intense off-road races where four vehicles compete on varied tracks, often mirrored or reversed to keep the challenge fresh. Victories bring fame, cash, and the chance to upgrade your machine with more acceleration, higher top speed, better grip, or refilled nitro. But each loss costs you a credit, and letting rivals dominate may end your run. Only sharp driving skills and smart upgrades will carry you to first place and let you conquer the dust-filled excitement of every race.

meta.desc:

"Iwo Jima" is a strategy game based on the historic World War II battle in which U.S. forces captured the island of Iwo Jima to secure airbases for the fight against Japan. You play as the U.S., while the computer controls the Japanese forces with five difficulty levels. An overview map of the island displays symbols representing terrain, minefields, enemy units, and your own forces. Players issue commands to their units in turns, with the outcomes calculated afterward. The objective is to defeat the Japanese forces and gain complete control of the island.

meta.name: J-Bird
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

J-Bird is a conversion of the arcade game Q*Bert. The object of the game is to change all tiles in a pyramid to the target color by having J-Bird jump on the tile. Various creatures and objects can get in the way of J-Bird. These include a bouncing snake, cats, falling balls, and frogs. There are four rounds per level, and each level increases in difficulty by having more enemies onscreen and requiring more complicated rules for a tile to reach the target color (for example, on the second level you need to jump on each tile twice). On the sides of the pyramid are platforms which J-Bird can jump onto to evade the snake. If the snake is close enough to the platform when J-Bird jumps on, the snake will fall off the edge.

meta.name: Jabcojada
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.11 KB

Jabcojada is a minimalist Tron-style light cycle game. Two players speed across the screen, leaving solid trails behind them. The goal is to outmaneuver your opponent, forcing them to crash into a trail or the edge of the arena while keeping yourself safe. Simple, fast, and unforgiving.

meta.name: Jack and the Beanstalk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.95 KB

"Jack and the Beanstalk" tells the story of Jack and his adventure surrounding the magical beanstalk. You embark on a journey to solve puzzles and explore the exciting world of the fairy tale.

meta.name: Jack and the Beanstalk

In "Jack and the Beanstalk," you take on the role of Jack and must outwit the giant to obtain his magical hen, embarking on an exciting adventure filled with challenges.

meta.name: Jack Attack
meta.desc:

Jack Attack es un desafiante juego de acción y puzles en el que debes derrotar a todos los enemigos en una cuadrícula rectangular. Puedes empujar o soltar bloques para aplastarlos, ya sea atrapándolos entre dos bloques o dejando caer uno sobre ellos. Pero ten cuidado: si un bloque o un enemigo te cae encima, pierdes una vida. Algunos niveles incluyen agua, que es mortal para ti, pero segura para los enemigos. Además de eliminar a todos los enemigos, puedes ganar puntos extra al subirte a cada plataforma, que desaparecen después de un tiempo determinado. La velocidad también se recompensa con puntos extra por completar el nivel rápidamente.

meta.name: Jack Charlton's Match Fishing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Jack Charlton's Match Fishing" allows up to eight players to compete in a fishing tournament. Each player is assigned a random fishing spot along a lake, where various fish species such as pike, roach, and bream can be found. Before starting, a detailed description of the fish available in each area is provided. Using this information, players must choose the appropriate fishing rod, bait, and depth. During the game, one of the eight fishing spots flashes, prompting the corresponding player to press the matching number key as quickly as possible. A short animation then displays the result, which depends on the reaction speed and whether the selected equipment was suitable.
