Cada hoyo está extraído de campos famosos de todo el mundo: el 8 de Pebble Beach, el 18 de Muirfield, el 12 de St. Andrews, el 12 de Augusta, el 10 de Riviera, entre otros. Permite jugar de uno a cuatro jugadores, en modalidad de golpes (stroke play) o por hoyos (skins game).

meta.name: Jack the Nipper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.87 KB

Jack estaba cansado de todos los peleles de su pueblo, de sus juegos aburridos y de sus buenos modales para dormirle. Así que Jack, que tiene un carácter bastante desagradable, decidió animar un poco las cosas, cogió su fiel pistola de lunares y se dispuso a sembrar el caos. 
En "Jack the Nipper" guiarás a un bebé por la guardería, la comisaría de policía, el museo, las calles secundarias y los huertos. Al mismo tiempo, no pierdes ninguna oportunidad de realizar una serie de trucos desagradables.
Lo primero que tienes que buscar es tu pistola de guisantes para disparar a diversos objetos o personas.  A continuación, corre entre los adultos, tira los platos de la estantería, mata fantasmas con el lanzador de guisantes, descubre la tarjeta de crédito de mamá y ayuda a escapar a los delincuentes del pueblo. El objetivo está claro: ¡convertirse en el bebé más travieso de la historia! El juego termina cuando el contador de picardías alcanza el 100%.

p: Jack the Nipper II - Coconut Capers (Europe).T64
n: Jack the Nipper II - Coconut Capers (Europe)

meta.name: Jack the Nipper II : In Coconut Capers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.53 KB

El travieso niño Jack se encuentra en Australia, con el objetivo de progresar a través de 192 tableros de plataformas de acción. Empieza con nueve vidas pero sin armas, aunque tiene a mano una provisión de cocos.
La jungla está llena de serpientes, monos, pájaros y todo tipo de criaturas, que hay que evitar o matar. Para avanzar por los niveles, tienes que usar escaleras, carros mineros, árboles, cuerdas y troncos, entre otras cosas.
Además de completar el juego y acumular tantos puntos como sea posible, también puedes intentar ser lo más "desagradable" posible, lo que se mide con un "Naughty-O-Meter" visible junto a la puntuación.

meta.name: Jack The Ripper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jack the Ripper turns a horrifying historical setting into a dark adventure in which you fall under suspicion yourself and must prove your innocence before the police seize on you as a convenient scapegoat. Its closeness to the real events gives the game an uneasy and oppressive atmosphere, while the text-driven design places strong emphasis on precise input and cautious actions. That mix of historical inspiration, criminal uncertainty, and deeply unsettling mood makes it feel less like a conventional adventure and more like a tense struggle against fear, suspicion, and looming condemnation.

meta.name: Jackal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.56 KB

The enemy army has captured too many of your forces. Being held in P.O.W. camps, these soldiers are effectively out of the war... unless some kind of rescue operation can be mounted. Heavy Forces are too slow and visible to be of any use, but perhaps something smaller and lighter may make it in where larger forces would fail. A small jeep, maybe two, crewed by about 4 people.... minimal enough not to represent too much of a loss and yet suitable enough to aid in rescue. But of course, if these brave men want to succeed AND come back alive; they'll need to fight like animals... they'll need to fight like jackals...
Jackal is an overhead view jeep game for up to 2 players. The controller moves in four directions, button A fires your gernades (upgradable to bazooka) and button B your machine gun which ALWAYS fires to the top of the screen. Your mission is to locate facilities where soldiers are being held prisoner, rescue as many as possible, and escort them to a safe landing zone where they will be air transported away. After that, you'll need to fight a boss battle against the enemy to progress.

meta.name: Jade Necklace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.84 KB

You are a private investigator and after receiving a phone call from Mrs Gloria F. Bannister, you agree to search for her necklace which has been stolen before her husband finds out it's missing. You must move around a city looking for clues, questioning various people as well as receive other jobs and face various dangers. The Jade Necklace is a a text adventure that has text on screen that describes your location. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

meta.name: Jagd in San Francisco
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jagd in San Francisco places you on Alcatraz – infamous, remote, and nearly escape-proof. But escape is exactly your goal. Using a command list, you choose your actions: talk, buy, steal, even kill. You explore locations, gather clues, and try to slip through the city's grasp. Every move holds risk, and every decision brings you closer to freedom or ruin.

meta.name: Jahangir Khan's World Championship Squash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Squash simulations are something of a rarity, and it was this niché that Krisalis aimed one of their many sports simulations into. The rules of squash are accurately recreated, with a realistic court layout (viewed isometrically) and a need to hit legal shots. Three different ball speeds, variable match lengths and an 'easy' mode are on offer. Different tournament types are on offer, at 'club' and 'tournament' levels, with a customisable ladder system of multiple divisions to rise up. There is a full roster of opponents to play in one-off or tournament modes.

meta.name: Jai Alai
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.83 KB

"Jai Alai" es un juego basado en la Pelota Vasca, un deporte originario del País Vasco cuyas variantes son muy populares en el resto de España. Los partidos enfrentan a dos equipos (compuestos por dos jugadores cada uno), con un sistema de puntuación muy similar al del "ping-pong", es decir, el equipo puede puntuar si está en posesión del servicio, en el caso contrato, el ganar el punto solo le permite recuperarlo. En vez de una red, se juega lanzando la pelota contra un muro utilizado como un "tercer jugador".

meta.name: Jail Break
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.55 KB

«El alcaide ha sido tomado como rehén. Libéralo, sin importar el costo».
Como policía, tu objetivo es neutralizar a los convictos fugados que lo retienen. Para lograrlo, avanzas por calles del centro, un parque, un puente y finalmente la prisión. Al rescatar rehenes obtienes armas (pistola, pistola de gas lacrimógeno, etc.), seleccionables desde la barra inferior. ¡Cuidado!: disparar a un rehén te hará perder todas tus armas.

meta.name: James Bond
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.34 KB

En James Bond 007, controlas al agente 007 en su vehículo multifunción, capaz de moverse por tierra y mar, saltar peligros y disparar a enemigos. Cada nivel, con scroll horizontal, está inspirado libremente en una película de Bond: Diamantes para la eternidad, La espía que me amó, Moonraker y Solo para tus ojos. Cada uno presenta enemigos diversos y un objetivo único: aterrizar en una plataforma petrolífera oculta para detener a Seraffino, localizar y destruir el laboratorio submarino de Stromberg, etc. Al completar todas las misiones, ganas. ¡Buena suerte, señor Bond!

meta.name: James Fly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.57 KB

In "James Fly," you control James, a fly, in a side-scrolling arcade adventure. Your goal is to search for gold coins and useful items within a castle. The screen is divided into two sections: the gameplay area and an information panel displaying points, lives, and a map of the explored area. Since James has no weapons, you must skillfully dodge numerous enemy creatures by jumping and adjusting your running speed.

meta.name: James Pond 2 : Codename Robocod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En su segunda aventura, James Pond debe recuperar los juguetes que el Dr. Maybe ha robado. Pond ha sido armado con un dispositivo de estiramiento estilo Inspector Gadget, que puede usar para ver áreas más altas o arañar los techos para deslizarse a través de ellos. La jugabilidad se lleva a cabo en mundos temáticos en torno a determinados tipos de juguetes, como artículos deportivos, dulces y aviones. Los niveles se desplazan hacia los lados, aunque se incluye una pequeña cantidad de movimiento vertical. En cada nivel, Pond debe recolectar 2 pingüinos y llegar a la salida, aunque generalmente hay varias salidas y muchas áreas secretas para explorar.

meta.name: Jammin'
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are Rankin Rodney and your task is to collect four instruments on a top view single screen and place them in their correct home over 20 levels. The screen is split into various coloured areas which are connected by different coloured moving circles. The coloured area you are on means you can only jump onto the same coloured circle and only jump off into the same coloured area. To change to a different colour you must jump onto a moving diamond which then allows you to jump onto a different coloured circle or into a different coloured area.

n: Jara-Tava - The Isle of Fire (Australia) (Side A)

meta.name: Jara-Tava - The Isle of Fire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your recently deceased uncle has left you a map that supposedly shows the location of Captain Kidd's treasure and sends you on a journey to explore the remote islands of Jara-Mau and Jara-Tava in the South Pacific. Can you survive the shark-infested waters and an impending volcanic eruption to walk away with the fabled treasure?nnnnAs in most parser-driven games, actions are carried out by entering simple commands: "inventory", "south", "get sword", "tie rope", etc. A static first-person perspective illustrates the current scene and the player can Examine the map in your inventory to see the overall layout of the island. Despite the game's short length, there are several different solutions to the challenges: the manual states that there are four ways to travel between islands and three ways to find the treasure.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your recently deceased uncle has left you a map that supposedly shows the location of Captain Kidd's treasure and sends you on a journey to explore the remote islands of Jara-Mau and Jara-Tava in the South Pacific. Can you survive the shark-infested waters and an impending volcanic eruption to walk away with the fabled treasure?nnnnAs in most parser-driven games, actions are carried out by entering simple commands: "inventory", "south", "get sword", "tie rope", etc. A static first-person perspective illustrates the current scene and the player can Examine the map in your inventory to see the overall layout of the island. Despite the game's short length, there are several different solutions to the challenges: the manual states that there are four ways to travel between islands and three ways to find the treasure.

meta.name: Jars' Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.47 KB

In Jars' Revenge, you control a creature tasked with destroying the Quotile bases. Your creature starts on the left side of the screen, and you can move it in various directions while using your cannon fire to break through a shield on the right side. The goal is to create a gap in the shield to activate a rocket, which you must then fire to destroy the base. The rocket appears when you either consume the shield or touch the base. If you miss the rocket, you can continue eating the shield or touching the base to generate a new rocket. If you are hit by the rocket, you lose a life. The base also fires a rocket that chases you, and you must avoid a whirlpool that occasionally appears. A neutral area provides protection from destruction, but you cannot fire while inside it.

n: Java Jim in Square Shaped Trouble (Europe)

meta.name: Java Jim - Square Shaped Trouble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.38 KB

In "Java Jim - in Square Shaped Trouble," you play as Jim on a game board with a volcano in the center. The volcano continuously spews fireballs, which Jim must avoid as they are deadly. Using the joystick, Jim jumps from square to square. When you release the joystick, Jim begins digging at his current position, potentially uncovering something. Your goal is to find the item displayed as the "target" in the upper left corner of the screen. Once this is done enough times, the volcano transforms into a staircase, allowing Jim to proceed to the next board.

meta.name: Jawbreaker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.81 KB

Jaw Breaker places you on a screen with five horizontal lanes, where your task is to eat all the candies to move on to the next level. Watch out – smiling faces chase you down, and touching them costs a life. Occasionally, a lollipop appears in the center of the maze for extra points. In the four corners are special dots that change the maze's color, giving you a short chance to eat the faces instead. The maze will flash again as a warning before returning to normal. Moving openings between the lanes let you switch paths – but they can also trap you if a face gets too close.

meta.name: Jeep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.95 KB

In "Jeep," you control a lunar jeep patrolling 900 kilometers across a damaged moon surface. Your goal is to jump over rocks and crevices, destroy large obstacles, and achieve the highest score. Time is limited, requiring you to accelerate and react quickly. Enemy UFOs attack, dropping purple bombs and placing green mines that explode on the slightest contact. The game is presented in a 2D scrolling view where you control the speed, jump, and shoot both horizontally and vertically. Collisions with pits, obstacles, or enemies result in the loss of your jeep. Challenging levels and a high-score table add extra layers of difficulty.

meta.name: Jeep Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.01 KB

Based on the gameplay of the Arcade game Moon Patrol, you have to drive a jeep back to your base through enemy territory. The game is viewed from the side and the screen scrolls constantly as you jump obstacles, and shoot grenades and other items. You are able to speed up or slow down the jeep and the faster you travel the higher you can jump with the ability to control your direction in the air. Hit an obstacle, gap or a weapon and you lose one of five lives and sent back a certain distance. On screen there is also a map showing how much of the territory you have completed.

meta.name: Jeepers Creepers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Jeepers Creepers," you control a spider from a top-down perspective on a single screen. Your goal is to infect seven rows of cabbages by running over them and changing their color. You must color all the cabbages before the bonus timer runs out to advance to the next level. Along the way, you must avoid dangerous creatures, such as a bird that eats you and costs you one of your three lives. A fly can reset the cabbages' color but can also be caught for bonus points, while a caterpillar also resets the color but does not attack you. At the start, you can select one of the first five levels.

meta.name: Jeopardy!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jeopardy! brings the popular TV game show straight to the screen. Three players compete by coming up with the correct question for each given answer. Two rounds, each with six categories, and a final round test both reflexes and knowledge. Correct responses earn between $100 and $1000, and finding a Daily Double lets you wager any amount of your current total. The player with the most money at the end wins. With saveable high scores, selectable male and female avatars, and a huge variety of questions, Jeopardy! delivers the authentic quiz experience – fast-paced, challenging, and all about thinking on your feet.

n: Jeremy Silman's Complete Guide to Chess Openings (USA) (Disk 1)

meta.path: ./Jeremy Silman's Complete Guide to Chess Openings (USA) (Disk 1).G64
meta.name: Jeremy Silman's Complete Guide To Chess Openings
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Jeremy Silman's Complete Guide to Chess Openings is designed not just to teach you opening lines by rote, but to give you a better understanding of how to build up a game sensibly from the very first moves. The focus is on thoughtful play, strategic ideas, and gaining control of the board as early as possible. That educational approach is what gives the program its appeal, because it does more than pass on knowledge – it helps you play openings with greater awareness and confidence.

meta.name: Jet Combat Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Take a seat in the cockpit of the fastest jet fighter in the USA, the McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle. This complex flight simulator realistically recreates the aerodynamic characteristics of the real jet, so you can learn to fly like a real fighter pilot. Practice landing in crosswinds or tracking an enemy aircraft at 20,000 feet. Learn to use the latest onboard avionics - a navigation radar for position tracking, an instrument landing system for difficult conditions, and a flight computer that shows your position on the ground and helps locate enemy aircraft.

meta.name: Jet Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.22 KB

In Jet Duel, you dive into intense air combat, where two players face off against each other. You control a fighter jet, aiming to shoot down your opponent with precise shots while avoiding their attacks. Speed, precision, and skilled maneuvers are crucial to defeating the enemy and emerging victorious from the duel. The key is to take control of the skies and outsmart your opponent with clever tactics and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Jet Flight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.70 KB

A Blitz clone from the rather infamous Cassette 50 compilation from Cascade Games. You are the pilot of a fighter plane. Fuel is running dangerously low and in order to refuel your bomber, you must destroy the enemy city before landing. Use your bombs carefully as there is only one available at a time. Your skill level is increased after five consecutive landings. You may change your skill level up or down at the end of each game.

meta.name: Jet Power Jack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.37 KB

In this platform-action-game based on Jet Pac you have to collect the fuel pods for Jack's flying saucer. To do this you must negotiate the aliens using your jet pack, and then get the fuel pod and put it into your ship. This is not as easy as it seems, as the jet pack is very difficult to control!

meta.name: Jet Set Willy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.98 KB

In Jet Set Willy you guide Willy through his enormous mansion containing more than sixty interconnected rooms. Before he is allowed to go to sleep, he must collect all the scattered items around the house and tidy everything up. Each room presents its own hazards, including spikes, spinning blades and tricky jumping sections. Because many rooms have multiple entrances and are linked across different levels, the mansion quickly becomes a complex maze to explore. Careful navigation and precise timing are essential if you want to search every room and complete the task.

Una vez más, cada habitación tiene sus propios peligros, como pinchos, cuchillas giratorias y cuerdas. El camino a través de la casa tiene que recorrerse con cuidado, debido a las múltiples entradas a ciertas habitaciones. Además, éste es quizá el primer juego de acción en el que la cartografía es una ventaja.

meta.name: Jet Strike Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.06 KB

In Jet Strike Mission, you pilot a jet bomber with the goal of surviving enemy attacks and completing missions successfully. You must safely take off from the base before the enemy destroys the launch site, then fly at the appropriate altitude and speed to the designated target. Constant evasive maneuvers are needed to protect yourself from aerial attacks. At the target, you must destroy it, which may require multiple approaches. After completing the mission or running out of ammunition, you return through enemy fire and must land safely, with speed and trajectory being critical.

meta.name: Jet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based on the classic flight simulator from subLOGIC. Choose either an F-16 Fighting Falcon for land missions or an F-18 Hornet for missions that begin at sea from an aircraft carrier. You can practice flying and aerobatics in “Free Flight” mode, conduct dogfights against Soviet MiGs, launch strikes against land or sea-based targets, watch a demo, or load a subLOGIC scenery disc. Both combat modes allow you to choose which missiles and bombs you want your plane to have.
Most of the indicators that a real jet fighter would have are present: altimeter, heading, frame load, gear status, brake status, fuel level, radar, attitude and range. You can turn some of them on and off. Controls consist of either the joystick or numeric keypad to control and other buttons to control your optional indicators, landing gear, weapons and even the ejector seat!

meta.name: Jet-Boot Jack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.78 KB

Music notes have escaped throughout the world, and Jet-Boot Jack must collect them up. There are ten levels, the first five of which can be played from the main menu. Gameplay is platform-based, and largely involves progressing down the levels, using holes and moving platforms. Enemies hover over the holes, but these can be disabled by toggling the right switches. There are also timing-based hazards such as arrows emerging from walls and lazer beams - contact with any of these costs one of your five lives. You also lose a life if you run out of energy. Some levels vary the format by requiring you to simply collect every note on a single screen, which has regeneration points and one-way platforms.

meta.name: Jet-Boys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Jet-Boys, you join an elite unit tasked with protecting the Saturn system from a villain who has occupied a moon and built a dangerous reactor. Equipped with jetpacks and laser pistols, you fight through waves of enemies, infiltrate the space fortress, and deactivate the reactor before the moon's minerals are destroyed. Power-ups enhance your weapons, shields, and speed, while defeated enemies fill the timer for the final boss battle of each level.

meta.name: Jetmobile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.23 KB

"Jetmobile" is a game where players control a jet-powered caterpillar, aiming to eat as many lettuce leaves as possible within two minutes. The caterpillar must avoid biting itself or hitting the boundaries of the play area. A hungry blackbird adds an extra challenge. Bonus points are awarded based on survival time.

meta.name: Jetsons : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Jetsons Computer Game lleva a la caótica familia futurista del clásico dibujo animado a una aventura interactiva en ocho niveles variados. Empiezas como George Jetson en 2062, empleado de Spacely Space Sprockets, recolectando dinero y objetos útiles mientras esquivas a tu jefe furioso y máquinas defectuosas. La jugabilidad alterna plataformas en scroll lateral con trepidantes secciones al volante del Jetcar. Cada miembro —Jane, Judy y Elroy— protagoniza su propio nivel: proteger la casa trucada de Jane, ayudar a Judy a perseguir a su ídolo pop o sacar a Elroy de la escuela. Requiere buen timing, reflejos rápidos y uso inteligente de objetos para superar el caos tecnológico.

meta.name: Jewel Raiders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.82 KB

In this game, which is viewed from the side on a single screen, you are a member of the Galactic Jewel Raiders and have infiltrated a vault to steal two jewels and throw them through the green window. You start at the bottom of the screen and must move upwards, collect a jewel, and then return back down. Between you and the jewels are protective fields that move across the screen with gaps, fields that turn on and off, and two guards that either move toward you or move up and down. You can shoot sideways to eliminate the guards, but a new one always appears. If you touch a guard or a protective field, you lose one of your three lives.

meta.name: Jewels of Babylon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.52 KB

The Jewels of Babylon are the most beautiful jewellery collection in world and were created 3000 years ago in the old city of Babylon, and now in the 19th Century, they are in English hands. Queen Victoria has decided to give them to an Indian Princess as a wedding present but they have been stolen by Pirates on the West Coast of Africa from the ship carrying them. You have survived the attack and now you have vowed to find the Jewels and take them to their destination. After much searching you have found the pirates and their base on a remote island and so you must get on the island and retrieve the Jewels. Jewels of Babylon is a graphic text adventure where you are shown a picture of your current surroundings before you see text describing where you are. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with each location.

meta.name: Jewels of Darkness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This is a collection of three previously-published Rainbird interactive fiction (with graphics) games. It contains:
1. Adventure Quest
2. Colossal Adventure
2. Dungeon Adventure

meta.name: Jewish IQ Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Jewish IQ Baseball you compete against another player or the computer, combining baseball action with quiz questions. When a player is up to bat, a question is pitched and you must press the correct letter key to answer – quickly and without pressing return. Correct answers move you around the bases or allow you to score, while wrong answers can halt your advance. Skillful play, good timing, and solid knowledge determine who wins the game.

meta.name: Jhothamia 6
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.79 KB

In "Jhothamia 6," a catastrophic emergency landing strands you on an alien planet. What began as a relaxing vacation in the solar system takes a dramatic turn when your spaceship spirals out of control and crashes on Jhothamia 6. As the sole survivor, you face the daunting task of escaping this hostile planet and finding safety, with your ship severely damaged. Your adventure starts in the wreckage of the spacecraft, where you take your first steps toward navigating the challenges of this unfamiliar terrain. Survival will require skill, ingenuity, and determination.

meta.name: Jigsaw
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Jihad : Raid over Baghdad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.89 KB

Jihad: Raid over Baghdad places you in a side-scrolling aerial battle where you face enemy aircraft, ground defenses and incoming fire while constantly under pressure yourself. You keep your jet moving, dodge attacks and fire strategically to push through wave after wave of combat. The continuous forward motion creates tension, as hazards and enemies leave little room to rest and demand quick decisions. The result is a straightforward action experience focused on reflexes, positioning and persistence.

n: Jim Henson's Muppet Adventure - Chaos at the Carnival (USA) (Side A)

meta.name: Jim Henson's Muppet Adventure : Chaos at the Carnival
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Jim Henson's Muppet Adventure: Chaos at the Carnival” begins with Miss Piggy being kidnapped by the sinister Dr. Grump – and her friends, including Kermit, Gonzo, and Fozzie, set off to rescue her. They must brave five carnival attractions before facing off against the Grumpasaurus in the final showdown. Navigate a tunnel of love while dodging obstacles, hit passing ducks with tomatoes, land a spaceship using rockets, race bumper cars while avoiding crashes, and find your way through a maze filled with guard dogs. In the final battle, the Grumpasaurus must be tickled until he bursts into uncontrollable laughter.

meta.name: Jimbo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jimbo has to rescue his kidnapped cousin and fight his way through five dangerous stages filled with enemies, traps, and tricky terrain. Using his trunk, he throws stones, while especially stubborn foes can be taken out with the limited supply of boulders. Bonus items improve the score, long jumps and a parachute help him progress – only water remains a deadly threat. The result is a charming adventure that successfully combines a lovable hero, direct action, and varied obstacles.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Jimmy's Soccer Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.34 KB

“Jimmy's Soccer Manager” is a football management game where you take charge of Kettering Town from the 5th division and aim to lead them to league and cup success. With a squad of 13 players, you assemble a team of 11, without considering formations. Players can be placed on the transfer list to receive offers from CPU teams, or bids may come in via phone at any time. Each week, three players are available for signing, but only one bid can be made. Ticket prices for matches are adjustable, and players may request salary increases. Matches are played out with a moving timer, displaying the score and goal scorers. Training and substitutions during matches are not possible.

meta.name: Jimmy's Super League
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.17 KB

Jimmy's Super League lets you manage a football team and compete in a league against Europe's top clubs. After selecting your team, you sit in your office in a first-person view, where different parts of the room let you buy or sell players, scout for talent, take loans, or check your league position. Once your choices are made, you proceed to the next match. The game displays a side view of the pitch along with text commentary of the action. During goalmouth incidents, an animation shows the striker against the goalkeeper, revealing whether the shot results in a goal or a save.

meta.name: Jinks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 73.37 KB

Jinks added a largely new concept to the Breakout type games, offering much freer paddle movement (both horizontally and vertically), a horizontally scrolling screen and the ability to flip the triangular paddle as needed. The objective is to survive on the planet Jinks - an exploration mission on this resource-rich planet has gone wrong. As hazards, there are objects that can destroy the paddle or make it smaller. There is also the ability to shake the screen if the ball is in a looping position.

meta.name: Jinn-Genie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.03 KB

In Jinn-Genie you battle through four perilous levels to free the wise man imprisoned deep within and defeat the evil Ilfreet who rules the Golden City. Blending shoot-'em-up and platforming action, the game demands quick reflexes, as touching any creature or guard costs a life. With only five lives, you must fight your way in, rescue the magician, and bring Ilfreet down for good.

meta.name: Jinxter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aquatania se ha convertido recientemente en la tierra de la desgracia, gracias a un grupo de brujas conspiradoras. Tendrás que encontrar cinco amuletos y un brazalete mágico para salvar Aquatania. Los acontecimientos del juego son alocados, y te encontrarás en situaciones disparatadas.
El mundo de Jinxter es realista, pero las exageraciones lo hacen extraño y confuso. Todos los personajes están ocupados con sus propias tareas, y para conseguir que te ayuden, generalmente tienes que asegurarte de que están contentos de hacerlo.
Los diálogos pretenden dar un toque cómico al conjunto. A menudo, los rompecabezas pueden resolverse de más de una manera, pero la más obvia no siempre es la correcta.

meta.name: Jocky Wilson's Darts Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.82 KB

Jocky Wilson's Darts Challenge is a darts game endorsed by the 1989 world champion. 
The game options are a 16-player tournament featuring up to four human players, a head to head game for two players, and single-player 'round the clock' (hitting the numbers 1 to 20 consecutively against a time limit).
During gameplay, the whole of the board is seen. The dart cursor swirls around the screen, can be controlled in a limited fashion and is released by pressing fire.

meta.name: Jocky Wilson's Compendium of Darts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.69 KB

Zeppelin's second game licensed by the successful dart player. The control system involves controlling a hand that guides the arrow. However, this constantly moves in a random arc, which reflects realistic fluctuations but initially makes precise aiming difficult. The six games included include standard 501 darts rules.
The other games are variants loosely based on football (hit the mark to score) and bowling (where a player throws a "jack" dart and the goal is to score a goal). . There's also Ten-Dart Century (score exactly 100 points with 10 darts), Shanghai (where only darts thrown at a specific area score), and Scram (where a player shoots to knock sectors out of play one at a time, and the opponent must score as much as possible to differentiate yourself from the others).

meta.name: Joe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.94 KB

You play Joe the dog, who must avoid the alligators, piranhas and other baddies such as the Birdie, Cuttie (scissors) and Jumper and move across the game board, turning all the tiles green to advance to the next level.

meta.name: Joe (1985)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.71 KB

Joe is a rare 8-bit game from Norway. In this game, the player controls Joe, who must climb over fences, collect all the keys, and safely return to the hideout without being caught by the guards. The controls allow Joe to move using the following key inputs: CTRL for left, left arrow for down, 1 for up, 2 for right, and spacebar to jump. Press a key to start the game! The Factory Mode also offers a game creation package.

meta.name: Joe And The Seriff
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.41 KB

"Joe and the Seriff" is a game where two players face off in a duel. The game focuses on fast-paced shootouts and offers an arcade-like experience, where the goal is to defeat the opponent. Players must act skillfully and strategically to succeed in the duel.

meta.name: Joe Blade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.46 KB

El soldado Joe Blade debe rescatar a seis oficiales del loco Crax Bloodfinger, que los ha secuestrado y los mantiene cautivos en distintas partes de su base. Por el camino, encuentra seis bombas que debe activar, dándole sólo 20 minutos para salvar a todos.
Joe Blade se juega en vista lateral. Las bombas se desactivan colocando las letras en orden alfabético, pero la mayor parte del juego consiste en disparar y recorrer el laberinto.

meta.name: Joe Blade II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Londres en 1995 es una ciudad hostil y peligrosa dirigida por matones. Los civiles inocentes que salen de sus casas se enfrentan casi con toda seguridad a la violencia. Joe Blade, un héroe aclamado desde su éxito en el juego original, es el hombre que debe poner las cosas en su sitio. Si consigue matar a 100 matones y salvar a 20 civiles en el espacio de diez minutos, los matones se retirarán y la ciudad se salvará.
Como Joe, tienes que moverte por las calles y matar a los matones dándoles patadas en la cabeza (llevan chaleco antibalas). Como en el primer juego, las calles tienen forma de pantalla parpadeante y están conectadas por numerosas puertas.

meta.name: Joe Dick - Private Investigator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.99 KB

Your investigations start outisde of the old Anderson Mansion, but will you be able to do your duty to find the files that will crack this one open AND still get out alive?

meta.name: Joe Gunn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.89 KB

Joseph J. Gunn is a passionate archaeologist who stumbles upon an unknown pyramid in the Egyptian desert. Could it be the lost tomb of the Crocodile King? To find out, he must enter the tomb, decipher its secrets, and escape alive. Joe Gunn is a puzzle-based platformer. The player controls Joe through the tomb, solving puzzles and searching for items that will help him progress. Joe can move and jump, using specific actions to investigate the environment. Items like scarabs, books, and amulets trigger events that allow further progress. The player must avoid dangers such as bats, snakes, mummies, and environmental hazards like rolling boulders. One goal of the game is to collect golden masks.

meta.name: Joe the Whizz Kid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.99 KB

You, Joe AKA: Joe The Whizz kid, are are stuck in a shop. This store has a few different areas for you to walk through like a food section and a hardware section. If it floats or moves along the floor avoid it, make your way to the end of the level unscathed to continue.

meta.name: John Elway's Quarterback
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In John Elway's Quarterback, it's one player vs. the computer or two human players going head-to-head in single-game American football action.  Select your team's home city (there is no NFL or NFLPA license, so there are no real teams or players) and then battle the opposing team for four 15-minute (accelerated real-time) quarters.  Graphics are simple: one team has blue uniforms, the other team red ones.  The human player gets control of the quarterback on offense and the middle linebacker on defense.  The play perspective is top-down and vertical-scrolling.  Choose from 9 offensive--mostly passing--plays and 6 defensive plays.  Teams have 9 players each.

meta.name: John Lowe's Ultimate Darts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In John Lowe's Ultimate Darts, you experience a collection of dart-based games inspired by two-time world champion John Lowe. The game features 10 difficulty levels, with only part of the dartboard visible at a time, making certain targets more challenging. In addition to a practice mode, classic variants like 501 and Round-the-Board are available. There are also creative modes, such as a football-inspired game where players with the higher score after three throws capture territories, and a cricket game where players alternately score runs or knock their opponent out with a bullseye hit.

meta.name: John Madden Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

John Madden Football is the first entry in the famous football series, co-designed by sportscaster John Madden. The game focuses heavily on strategy and tactics rather than pure action. You build formations, plan plays, and lead your team across the field in pursuit of victory. Different versions were released on many platforms, with the Mega Drive edition becoming especially well known. This game laid the foundation for one of the most successful sports franchises of all time.

meta.name: Johnny Reb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.35 KB

Johnny Reb is a turn-based strategy game for one or two players, based on the American Civil War. Players can control an army of either the Union or the Confederation.
There are three types of units: infantry, cavalry and artillery, and it's possible to decide how many of each type the player's army should consist of. After the initial set-up, the battlefield is generated. The goal is to capture the enemy's flag, but it's also possible to achieve a victory by points. Army control is handled with the keyboard - units can move in eight directions. Artillery can shoot over distance, the other unit types can directly attack by simply moving to an adjacent square.

meta.name: Johnny Reb II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based on the American Civil War, Johnny Reb II is a one or two player strategy game. After the title screen a menu appears allowing you limited tinkering of the game's parameters. You can also choose which side you want to play as.
Once you are happy with your choices the game begins. The game is viewed overhead of the terrain with your and the enemies' forces shown as icons. Moving the cursor with your joystick, you can highlight an icon and get details about that unit. On the right of the screen different icons appear showing the type of orders that are available. Some icons can make other icons appear allowing you to elaborate each order.

meta.name: Joker Poker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Joker Poker deals you five cards that are scored according to standard poker values. The aim is to build the strongest hand possible. After the initial deal you may discard cards to draw new ones, but if your new hand is weaker you bust and lose points for that round. You can keep risking draws until you bust or decide to stick with your hand. Cards are selected using the number keys 1 to 5, and they are displayed graphically on screen. An optional display shows the current leading hand each round and the score to beat. The number of rounds per game can also be set.

meta.name: Jolly Jack's Run Ashore!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.45 KB

After three months at sea, you Jolly Jack have been given shore leave for the night and your aim is to get drunk, have sex with a woman before getting safely back to your ship. You have 50 pounds in your pocket and you have to explore the town, Sharksville to fulfill your needs. Jolly Jack's Run Ashore is a adventure where text on the screen describes your surroundings and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your location.

p: Jonny Quest in Doctor Zin's Underworld (Europe).D64
n: Jonny Quest in Doctor Zin's Underworld (Europe)

meta.name: Jonny Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based on the Jonny Quest cartoon, you play as Jonny. Her father Brenton Quest was killed by the evil Dr. Zin kidnapped and forced to create a laser to be used to conquer the world. Your mission is to save your father by defeating Dr. Explore Zins terrain and collect and use various items scattered outside and inside the terrain. These items include keys to open doors and torches to see into dark places. However, you are limited to four items.During your exploration you will encounter various enemies and if they touch you you will lose part of your energy bar and when it is empty it is game over. They can punch and kick and have the ability to jump high and long distances. Quickly double-tap left or right to run instead of walk.

meta.name: Josh
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Josh is a word-based puzzle game where you push letter tiles around the playfield to form a correct word at a specific target position. Every move requires careful planning, as the tile layout can quickly become confusing and wrong pushes may block progress. The appeal lies in thinking several steps ahead and the satisfaction of finally assembling the word correctly – mentally challenging, even if the heavily scrolling background can be tough on the eyes.

meta.name: Jot-a-Word Genie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Jot-a-Word Genie compites contra la computadora para adivinar una palabra secreta de cinco letras. Introduces una palabra y el Genio te dice cuántas letras coinciden con la palabra oculta. Pero cuidado: el Genio no tolera trampas y solo acepta palabras válidas. Con lógica, deducción y un poco de suerte, te acercarás a la respuesta. Este juego, que también se puede jugar en solitario, ofrece un desafío mental para todas las edades.

meta.name: Journey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Journey," you pilot a diving spaceship through dangerous caves, dodging walls and destroying cave mutants. Additionally, you must collect fuel to continue your mission and save the surface world. How long can you survive?

There are 11 treasures to be brought to the surface. The cave system is BIG and there is a lot to discover, many riddles to solve, a lot to worry about and to hope

Journey to the Centre of Eddie Smith's Head is a traditional text adventure made using the Quill adventure generation software from Gilsoft. You tell the game what you want to do via a textual interface and the parser is based on verb / noun input. Scientific genius Eddie Smith is working on a new and improved atomic bomb for the British government when he hits his head on a nuclear reactor in the laboratory. Able to remember his mission, in his post-concussion state he thinks he should use the weapon on his own country. The player is in the shoes of one of Eddies colleagues, and the task is to search the research complex and the near lying city and eventually hunt down the irrational genius and thwart his plan.

A Journey to the Centre of the Earth takes you on an adventurous trip deep below the surface, inspired by Jules Verne's famous story. You descend farther and farther, search for treasures, and have to bring them safely back to the surface. Along the way, various puzzles block your progress and must be solved to reach new areas. Its appeal comes from the mix of exploration, treasure hunting, and the mysterious feeling of gradually entering an unknown world.

meta.name: Jouste
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.63 KB

In Jouste, you take on the role of the Queen's champion, battling evil knights who also ride flying ostriches. To defeat an opponent, you must strike them from a higher position with your lance, turning them into an egg. Collect the egg before it hatches to eliminate the knight permanently. If you are struck from below, you lose a life. Once all opponents are defeated, you advance to the next level. If you take too long, a pterodactyl appears, forcing you to evade. In later levels, the floors disappear, and lava creatures can drag you to your death if you get too close.

meta.name: Jr. Pac-Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.38 KB

Jr. Pac-Man, secuela de la legendaria saga Pac-Man, presenta al hijo del protagonista. Por primera vez, los laberintos se desplazan lateralmente y abarcan dos pantallas de ancho, sin túneles de escape. Los objetos bonus ahora se mueven: destruyen Pastillas de Poder y convierten puntos normales en puntos grandes, que ralentizan al jugador pero dan más puntos si se comen. Tras perder una vida, esos puntos mutados desaparecen. Jr. es perseguido por los cuatro fantasmas clásicos (Blinky, Pinky, Inky y Tim) y puede devorarlos tras comer una Pastilla de Poder.

meta.name: Judge Dredd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 91.68 KB

En Judge Dredd, encarnas al icónico juez encargado de combatir el crimen y restablecer el orden en Mega City One. Completas seis misiones, cada una seguida de un nivel bonus temático. Si tardas demasiado, la tasa de criminalidad sube y, si se dispara, pierdes. El Lawmaster (tu moto) acelera el desplazamiento, pero impide disparar o arrestar, lo que puede agravar el caos. La perspectiva es lateral: alternas entre caminar y conducir, y usas diversas armas para imponer la ley.

meta.name: Judge Dredd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Judge Dredd," you step into the role of the renowned law enforcer tasked with combating crime and stabilizing Mega City One. You tackle six missions, each followed by a thematically fitting bonus level. Taking too long to complete a mission increases the crime rate, and if it gets too high, the game ends. Using your Lawmaster motorcycle allows faster movement but prevents shooting or making arrests, potentially increasing the crime rate. You control Dredd from a side-scrolling perspective, switching between walking and riding, and use various weapons to maintain order in the city.

meta.name: Juggles' Rainbow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juggles' Rainbow helps your child learn basic concepts like direction, color recognition, and early pre-reading skills. Designed for kids aged 3 to 6, it teaches up/down and left/right through bright visuals, simple tasks, and friendly feedback. It's an easy and engaging introduction to computers – perfect for young learners just starting out.

meta.name: Juice!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.94 KB

Juice! puts you in control of Edison, the kinetic android, who must battle through six levels of increasing intensity. Your goal is to complete a working circuit while a host of electrical enemies try to stop you. Nohms appear suddenly, bouncing around the grid – one touch and Edison melts away. When they vanish, they leave behind capacitors that quickly evolve into deadly Killerwatts, hunting you relentlessly. Your only aid comes from Recharges, which restore your energy. But beware – Flash, the lightning dolt, tears apart your hard work and adds further chaos to the challenge. Only quick reflexes and persistence will allow you to complete the circuits and secure Edison's mission.

meta.name: Juke Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.28 KB

In "Juke Box," you combine music, strategy, and skill as you compete against the computer or another player. Your goal is to create golden records on the game board by moving from tile to tile and completing golden discs. The more records you produce, the more coins you earn to keep the music playing. Plan your moves carefully, as getting stuck in a dead end ends the game and silences the music. Keep the rhythm alive and showcase your strategic prowess!

meta.name: Jumbo Jet Lander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.61 KB

In “Jumbo Jet Lander,” the player pilots a jumbo jet, aiming to land it safely on a runway. Similar to “Lunar Lander,” the player inputs the desired rate of climb and thrust for each move. The screen displays critical data, including rate of climb, acceleration, speed, altitude, distance to the runway, and remaining runway length. The objective is to execute a precise and safe landing.

meta.name: Jump
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.52 KB

In "Jump," you guide your character through a challenging world filled with gaps to leap across. Precise timing and quick reflexes are crucial to mastering jumps and avoiding obstacles. Showcase your skill and see how far you can go!

meta.name: Jump Jet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.34 KB

“Jump Jet” puts you in the cockpit of a vertical takeoff jet, piloted by someone who actually flies them in real life. Depending on your chosen rank – from Flight Lieutenant to Group Captain – the challenges vary, with a practice mode to ease you in. You'll steer precisely through the skies, deploying guided missiles and guns, while keeping a close eye on fuel – and, at higher difficulty levels, the effects of the wind.

meta.name: Jump Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.23 KB

In this puzzle game, like the board game Checkers, you jump over your opponent's piece to neutralize it. If you can jump multiple times, the better! Jump more than your opponent and you win! Many starting scenarios to choose from.

meta.name: Jump! Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jump! Machine is a 1 player arcade game.
Played from a side view, the player controls an obese character who moves sideways, climbs ladders and jumps. Each level has two screens with warp points that allow movement between the two. The goal is to collect all the cherries between the two screens by jumping on them. There are numerous dangers, including spikes, various monsters, and falling too deep. Levels also feature slides, ladders, elevators and other challenges. The player starts with 9 lives and there is also an editing feature that allows for the creation of custom levels.

meta.name: Jumpin Jack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.09 KB

Jumpin Jack is a classic Frogger clone where you must guide a frog safely across a busy road and then a river. You dodge cars, leap onto turtles and logs, and aim to land in one of the five slots at the top of the screen. The C64 and MSX versions feature a pseudo-isometric visual style and add bonus opportunities with a female frog and an insect to eat. Once all five slots are filled, the game restarts – but at a faster pace.

meta.name: Jumpin' Jimmy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jumpin' Jimmy is a platform game in which you control a kangaroo trying to collect fruits and baby kangaroos across four levels. Each level scrolls left or right as you move. At the start of a level, the screen scrolls and you move the joystick to make your kangaroo fall to the next platform. Different creatures move around each level, and if they touch you, you lose one of four lives. Falling from a height will also kill you, but you can jump down from a certain height. Various objects are scattered throughout each level that can help or hinder you. These include stars that transport you to another location on a level, elevators, and objects that make platforms disappear.

meta.name: Jumping Jack (CP Verlag)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Jumping Jack, two players compete simultaneously. The goal is to reach the top of the screen by avoiding gaps opening below and jumping through gaps appearing above. Skill and timing are essential to successfully complete the levels and outpace your opponent.

meta.name: JumpJets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.36 KB

In JumpJets, you control a jet from an isometric perspective as you fly over islands and the sea. Your goal is to destroy fuel tanks, helicopters, planes, and patrol boats guarding the waters between the islands. After the first phase, you can land on a carrier to refuel and restock ammunition, requiring precise control and quick reflexes. You then return to the battle to face further challenges.

meta.name: Jumpman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

As a bomb disposal expert, Jumpman is called to Jupiter Headquarters after the Alienators have rigged the entire complex with explosives. In each stage, you must collect every bomb, climb across platforms and ladders, and use the jet booster to reach higher areas when needed. Enemies and dangerous falls make the mission far more hazardous than it first appears. The result is a tense rescue adventure that neatly combines precise movement, awareness, and the constant pressure of an imminent threat.

meta.name: Jumpman Junior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jumpman Junior is the sequel to Jumpman and features similar gameplay with all new levels. As Jumpman, your goal is to disarm all of the bombs on the level before time runs out. Each level consists of a variety of platforms, ladders, and ropes you will need to jump and climb to reach the bombs. To make the game more challenging, a bullet will fire on the screen from time to time which will cause Jumpman to lose a life if hit. Each level has a different theme to it, and a few also have additional dangers as well. You will encounter deadly fires, the bouncing hellstones, moving ladders, disappearing platforms, and more.

meta.name: Jungle Drums
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.34 KB

This particular jungle will haunt your dreams by the time you will have explored all 14 levels of the game. Part of your almost impossible mission is to find the key. Further details about your mysterious task will gradually be let known as you bravely meet the perils of man-eating plants, spiders, skeletons and many more.

meta.name: Jungle Hunt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.50 KB

Jungle Hunt cuenta con cuatro aventuras únicas, cada una de las cuales se repite con dificultad creciente. Si no sobrevives a estas aventuras, no sólo perderás tu vida, sino también la de la encantadora Penélope, ¡que ha sido capturada por caníbales!
La primera parte pone a prueba tus habilidades de Tarzán: ¿puedes balancearte sobre las lianas sin precipitarte al vacío? La segunda parte te enfrenta a una banda de repugnantes cocodrilos en un caudaloso río. Afortunadamente, tienes un cuchillo para defenderte. En la tercera parte, tendrás que enfrentarte a rocas de diferentes tamaños. Una vez superados todos estos peligros, te queda enfrentarte al temible caníbal, armado con una temible lanza. ¿Serás capaz de derrotarlo y salvar a la bella Penélope?
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Jungle Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.05 KB

In "Jungle Patrol," you control a vehicle navigating a horizontally scrolling landscape, dodging alien enemies and defending against their attacks. To progress, you collect fuel by shooting fuel canisters. Skill and quick reactions are essential to overcoming challenges and navigating through hostile territory.

meta.name: Jungle Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.73 KB

Jungle Quest is an action / arcade game where you must progress through various stages that require you to execute different skills.  These vary between swinging on vines, swimming alligator infested waters, avoiding avalanches of various sized boulders and finally cannibals!  The main goal of the game is to rescue your girlfriend who has been kidnapped by said cannibals.
The game is very similar to Jungle Hunt with different style graphics.

meta.name: Jungle Raid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.80 KB

In "Jungle Raid," you play as George Chesthair, dropped behind enemy lines to fight your way through treacherous terrain. Your mission is to eliminate anything that moves with quick reflexes and precise shooting. Skill and fast decision-making are crucial to surviving this intense adventure. Good luck — you'll need it!

meta.name: Jungle Story
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.81 KB

In "Jungle Story," you guide Mowgli through a horizontally scrolling jungle, dodging dangers such as animals, spears, and coconuts. Elephants and snakes approach from the right, while spears come at you from the left. Additionally, monkeys in the trees throw coconuts that you must avoid. To complete a level, you must defeat five quickly passing tigers with fire pots. Skill and quick reactions are essential to overcoming the challenges and continuing the jungle adventure.

meta.name: Jungle Trouble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.92 KB

"Jungle Trouble" takes place in a jungle setting where the player must travel from the bottom right corner of the screen to the top left corner in order to reach home. Along the way, numerous obstacles must be overcome, including crossing platforms without falling into the water or being attacked by crocodiles. An axe can be picked up at the beginning of the game and is needed to chop down trees or defend against monkey attacks, although it gets damaged over time. If the axe is lost, it must be acquired again. The final challenges include swinging on a vine over a fire pit and jumping across increasingly larger gaps between platforms. If the player manages to overcome all obstacles, they will safely reach their destination.

meta.name: Junior Wordsplits : A Game of Words
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.10 KB

Junior Wordsplits: A Game of Words is an educational game that helps children recognize and build essential English words in a fun way. Word beginnings and endings are shown separately, and players must correctly match them to form complete words. With hundreds of common words and a user-friendly interface, the game turns spelling and vocabulary practice into an engaging and rewarding experience.

meta.name: Junkyard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Junkyard," you awaken as Doctor Nemesis in a grim location, abandoned by unknown enemies who couldn't risk you testifying at a trial. Trapped in a scrapyard filled with androids and deadly security systems, you have only limited time to escape before a slow-acting poison overcomes you. The scrapyard will be permanently sealed in a few hours, and no one will ever know what happened to you. Your skills will be put to the ultimate test – can you escape in time?

Junkyard Jalopies is a flick-screen platformer where you have to move around two screens per level to collect car parts to finish a car on the bottom left of the first screen. Before you collect car parts you first have to get to the junkyard from the left to the right of the screen, jumping over tyres. Each screen is made up of five levels (with an extra one at the bottom of the screen), and you have to use lifts to go up and down the levels while avoiding creatures and moving objects. If you hit a tyre, creature or object, fall down a level, or allow the timer to reach zero then you lose one of six lives.

meta.name: Juno First
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Juno First” pits you against an ever-growing wave of enemy aliens out to destroy your ship – the longer they survive, the more dangerous they become, so quick elimination is key. Special formation waves feature patterned enemy attacks. The radar shows where and what kind of aliens will appear. White bombs must be dodged, while homing bombs can be destroyed. Shooting an asteroid and capturing the mystery inside stops alien fire for about 10 seconds – and grants bonus points for each alien destroyed. You have 99 seconds to complete each wave – the faster you finish, the greater your bonus. An extra ship is awarded every 100,000 points. The warp button lets you escape tough spots – three warps per wave, which don't carry over.

meta.name: Jupiter Lander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.88 KB

In Jupiter Lander you control a spaceship battling Jupiter's gravity, aiming for a safe touchdown on one of three landing pads. Speed and fuel consumption are critical: land within the yellow zone for points and a fuel refill. Harder pads give higher score multipliers. Crash too hard or hit the cliffs, and you're done. Run out of fuel, and the mission's over. A simple yet demanding test of precision and control.

meta.name: Jupiter Lander (Courbois Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.91 KB

In "Jupiter Lander," you navigate a spaceship through dangerous ledges and menacing stalagmites to find a safe landing spot. Precision and skill are crucial for a successful landing.

meta.name: Jupiter Mission 1999
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jupiter Mission contains elements of graphic/text adventures, space war role-playing games and arcade joystick games. The different elements in Jupiter Mission are connected by a plot. Government agents drag you from your home early on a cold January morning and put you in charge of a solo mission to Jupiter.
The game's story is then complemented by graphical adventure elements and the player performs various arcade sequences such as shooting asteroids to avoid damage, landing on a moon, and exploring.

meta.desc:

“Just a Mot” is an interactive learning program that helps expand your French vocabulary, teaches the correct gender of nouns, and trains you to spell French words properly. Across categories like essentials, food & drink, people, shopping, or travel, you practice by matching and writing words, earning points for correct answers. A game mode tests your reflexes, while the writing mode challenges your memory and spelling – including correct use of accents. It's a playful and structured way to improve your French.

Create and write your own Animated stories using 9 Scenes, 48 Objects and 25 Animations.

meta.name: Kaiser
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kaiser (German for emperor) is a political/business simulation set in 18th century Germany. Players take the role of nobles in the Holy Roman Empire and compete for the crown of the emperor. One to nine players can play, beginning by entering their name and gender and being assigned a state in the empire. Gameplay then takes place in turns, each consisting of a number of consecutive screens. In the first screen, players can sell and buy grain and land. Grain is necessary to feed a noble's subjects. Bad weather can result in harvest losses, making it necessary to buy extra grain to prevent starvation. Providing more grain than necessary increases population growth and the state's reputation. Acquiring more land increases population and is necessary for economic growth. Following the trading screen is a statistics screen, displaying births and deaths, immigration and emigration as well as income and expenses. The third screen allows control of income. Players can set taxes and tariffs and can determine how harshly the justice system works - setting it to a level that is too brutal might increase income in the short term but also lead to increased emigration. Another overview screen follows, displaying a player's lands and properties in detail. The fifth screen allows for spending the turn's income. It is possible to buy marketplaces and grain mills (both of which increase income) as well as construct part of a palace or a cathedral (both of which have no direct use but are required to move into the highest levels of nobility). Each building option requires owning a certain amount of land. Constructing five marketplaces and three mills results in the creation of a city.

meta.name: Kaktus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.41 KB

In the desert, the giant cactus is now becoming extinct and it is your task to save one of the last few that remains in this single screen shooter. Viewed from the side, you control an insect/gun that sits on the bottom of the screen underground with the cactus in the middle of the screen. Through two holes in the ground you must blast the wasps and hornets that move across the screen advancing downwards, either side of the cactus, to stop them eating the bottom of the cactus.

meta.name: Kalah
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.29 KB

Kalah brings the classic strategy board game to the screen and pits you against a computer-controlled opponent. You play on a symmetrical board with several pits and your own Kalah, where collected stones are stored. By carefully distributing stones counter-clockwise, you plan ahead, gain extra turns, and capture your opponent's pieces. Timing and foresight are crucial, as the game only ends when no moves remain or one player controls the majority of stones – every move can shift the balance of power.

meta.name: KaleidoKubes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.80 KB

Kaleidokubes is a puzzle game where cubes with colored triangles are placed on a board. Each side must match the adjacent cubes' colors, and every new cube must connect with at least one side. Points are scored for each placement, with more matching sides yielding higher scores. On each turn you get one cube, which can be rotated, and a limited time of 30 or 60 seconds. If time runs out or you pass, points are lost and the opponent takes over. The game ends when the board is full or both players pass consecutively, and the winner is the one with the highest score.

meta.name: Kami-Kaze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.68 KB

In "Kami-Kaze," you control a Xenon fleet combat ship tasked with preventing humans and dogs from destroying vital battle plans. After one of the ships crash-landed on Earth, it camouflaged itself with a psycho-visual shield, making it appear as toilets. Humans attempt to enter the ship, while dogs try to steal the plans, which now look like toilet paper. You must stop the humans and protect the plans, but be cautious: if you shoot a dog, a helicopter is dispatched to attack you. Your ship is fragile and loses a life if it takes damage or if the plans are completely destroyed.

meta.name: Kamikaze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Kamikaze, you pilot a small plane across enemy territory, dodging fire and taking down enemy aircraft and ground units. Your goal is to find and shoot down a dynamite-carrying plane, collect the explosives, and crash into a castle gate to free hostages. A new plane is then used to airlift the freed hostages – two at a time – back to base, requiring multiple trips. Once all hostages are rescued, you move on to the next, even tougher level.

meta.name: Kampfgruppe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un juego táctico a nivel de pelotón de guerra blindada que abarca casi todas las armas terrestres utilizadas en el Frente ruso desde 1941 hasta 1945. Kampfgruppe pone al jugador al mando de un grupo de batalla alemán o ruso, proporcionando cuatro escenarios históricos y un número infinito de escenarios creados al azar.

Un juego de acción y totalmente apasionante, en cuatro episodios, donde adoptas el papel del Sheriff en la misión de hacer la paz con los indios. Un juego para aficionarse, con música soberbia y efectos sonoros llenos de realismo
El primer nivel consiste en disparar a pájaros, con un mínimo de 3 para avanzar. Debes apuntar delante de los pájaros, para tener en cuenta la distancia que recorrerán al disparar. En el tercer nivel tienes que disparar a los malos, que emergen de los lugares (banco, taberna, tienda) en una disposición exacta del Salvaje Oeste.
En el segundo nivel se intenta saltar por encima de rocas y cactus, mientras que en el nivel 4 hay que saltar por encima de un tren a toda velocidad para hacerse con su control.

meta.name: Kane II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The notorious Black Hole Gang caused Marshall McGraw a lot of trouble back in the old days, almost causing an Indian war before he caught them and sent them off to jail. But now they're free and up to their old tricks, kidnapping the daughter of the Indian chief in an attempt to start another war.
In Kane II, it is up to McGraw to once again save the town of Kane, over the course of four stages. In the first, McGraw rides his horse alongside a train to shoot at bad guys, then he has a shootout with the Black Hole Gang at Fort Apache to rescue the Indian princess. Once he has done this, he tames his new bronco to be his new companion, and finally, he must escape the clutches of the Black Hole Gang and ride off into the sunset.

meta.name: Kanga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.26 KB

In Kanga, you hop across a pyramid-style grid similar to Q*Bert, changing the color of each platform in the correct sequence. Every jump shifts the color while enemies appear to challenge your path. You'll need sharp timing and quick reflexes to conquer all seven increasingly tricky levels. Fast-paced and vibrant, this game promises hours of arcade-style action – you might just hop right out of your chair.

meta.name: Kangarudy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Kangarudy, your goal is to guide a transporter and its kangaroo safely from one point to another – either by land or water, depending on the selected mode. You choose from four routes and control the transporter's speed and direction while the kangaroo balances on top. With precise hopping and clever use of a parachute or jetpack, you must avoid hazards like boulders and steep slopes. Be warned: running over animals like rabbits will crash your transporter. Timing, reflexes, and route strategy are key to surviving the down-under madness.

In Kangarudy II: The Adventure Continues, you must return rescued kangaroos to their homeland in Australia. After selecting a route on the world map, the game shifts to side-scrolling levels where you drive a truck or boat from left to right, avoiding hazards and collecting power-ups like parachutes or extra lives. The biggest challenge: the kangaroos don't stay put. They jump out regularly, and you must position your vehicle just right so they land safely – otherwise, you lose a life. Depending on your chosen route, levels may include fog or darkness to make things trickier.

meta.name: Karamalz Cup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A surprisingly complex ice hockey simulation game. An unofficial English language version is also available. The game allows players to take part in a world championship tournament. Karamalz Cup is a promotional game for the malt beer brand Karamalz. It is a national team ice hockey game in which you play a tournament. The schedule is based on the 1993 World Cup. There are twelve teams to choose from, which are divided into two groups. In the groups everyone plays against everyone else, the first four teams in the table after the end of the group phase reach the quarter-finals. Unlike other computerized versions of the sport, you always play against the exact same player, even if another player from your team has the puck. Karamalz Cup is the very first advertising game that was developed in 1993 by the advertising agency The Art Department for the private brewery Henninger Bräu AG for the Karamalz bran

meta.name: Karate Champ
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Karate Champ es un juego de lucha para uno o dos jugadores. ¡Los jugadores compiten entre sí en nueve ubicaciones diferentes para ver quién tiene las mejores habilidades de karate! Para ganar una partida, el jugador debe ganar dos o tres rondas derribando a su oponente con una gran variedad de movimientos de karate. Se otorga un punto completo o medio punto por derribar a tu oponente y el primer jugador que gane una ventaja de dos puntos gana la ronda. Una ronda tiene un limite de tiempo de 30 segundos, el jugador que tenga más puntos gana. Al final de cada partida hay una ronda de bonificación donde el vencedor puede ganar puntos extra derribando objetos voladores que se lanzan en su camino.

meta.name: Snap Dragon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, you enter the Dragon Temple and fight your way through nine levels to defeat all enemies and earn the prestigious 5th Dan Black Belt. You start as a Red Belt and must defeat each opponent individually to progress. The game is a side-scrolling Beat 'em Up, with the screen scrolling as you move through the levels. You have various moves such as high kicks, punches, and leg sweeps, which are executed using the joystick and fire button. Additionally, you can fight with a bamboo staff for extra power. Your health bar and your opponent's health bar represent different body areas; when one reaches zero, either the opponent is defeated, or you've lost a life. Each new level grants you nine more lives. A unique feature is that if you stop moving the joystick for a while, the computer will take over your character's movements, but you can resume control by pressing the fire button.

meta.name: Karateka
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Karateka es un juego de acción en Commodore 64. El malvado Akuma ha destruido tu tierra natal y ha secuestrado a la princesa Mariko. Como maestro de artes marciales, eres el único capaz de llegar al palacio de Akuma para enfrentarte a él.
Solo, armado con tu conocimiento del Karate, debes luchar contra los guerreros de Akuma, cada uno más poderoso que el anterior. En el palacio deberás seguir luchando, para rescatar a Mariko debes enfrentarte al cruel Akuma en un combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

meta.name: Karnov
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Jinborov Karnovski (also known as the titular Karnov), is a Russian circus strongman who is collecting all of the pieces of a treasure map so he can become a wealthy man. This Lost Treasure of Babylon is being guarded by the evil dragon Ryu. While the gameplay is basically the same as the other versions, the story for the Famicom version is different. It involves Karnov, who comes from a small town called Cleamina, being called by God to be his envoy. Karnov is tasked with getting rid of the evil troublemaker known as Alakatai.
Karnov features nine stages of side-scrolling action.  Karnov's main attack is to breathe fireballs at his enemies.  Karnov can collect power-up orbs which can increase the amount of fire he can breathe out. Karnov is also able to jump, with the height being increased by collecting boots. Other items Karnov can carry and use include bombs, ladders, boomerangs, clappers (which destroy minor enemies that are currently on the screen instantaneously), and shields. Occasionally, Karnov will be able to make use of certain items such as wings which let him fly in the air and a scuba gear helmet which lets him swim underwater. Also, scattered throughout the stages are K icons. Collecting 50 of these will reward Karnov an extra life.

meta.name: Karting Grand Prix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.12 KB

In Karting Grand Prix, you race across eight different tracks from an overhead view and compete against two opponents for victory. Before each race, preparation matters, as dry roads, rain, or ice noticeably change the handling and require the right tyres. Bumping into other karts has consequences, weakening your tyres and possibly leading to a puncture. This creates an exciting mix of speed, control, and smart setup choices – read the track well and drive cleanly to stay in the race longer.
