meta.name: Kat Trap : Planet of the Cat-Men
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kat Trap: Planet of the Cat-Men takes place in the 24th century, where Earth, abandoned after solar flares, is now ruled by the hostile Kat Men. When humans attempt to return, the Kat Men resist. The war droid MT-ED is sent in, accompanied by Hercules 1 – who is quickly kidnapped. MT-ED must now explore fourteen deadly environments, fight the Kat Men, and rescue Hercules. Each type of enemy requires a specific weapon to defeat, making every step a tactical challenge.

meta.name: Denaris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Katakis tells the story of a once peaceful planet turned into a warzone by machines that evolved beyond human control. As the pilot of the DS-H75 Eaglefighter, you battle through twelve enemy-filled zones with asteroids, hostile forces, and massive end-bosses to save the planet. Your ship can be upgraded with a satellite and various weapons, while precision and quick reflexes determine your survival. In cooperative mode, a second player can control the indestructible Force unit.

meta.name: Kayak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.32 KB

In Kayak, you control a kayak from a first-person perspective and aim to navigate river courses as quickly as possible. You must pass through gates, ensuring the white post always stays on your left side. You can steer your kayak left or right and adjust your speed. Successfully passing through a gate earns a black square in the top-left corner, while touching a post results in a white square. Missing a gate incurs a time penalty. River currents can push your kayak off course, making navigation more challenging.

meta.name: Kayden Garth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The title--produced in Germany but for some reason in English--looks a bit like an Ultima clone but lacks the gameplay depth of even Akalabeth. The story is that Kayden Garth is a prison planet in the Beta Draconis sector, administered by an automated orbital station, but recently the Galactic Confederation has received an emergency signal from the station indicating that it's being pulled out of orbit. (Depending on whether you go by the poorly-translated manual or the back of the box, there might also be reports of prison riots.) The Galactic Confederation sends a team of four people to investigate.

meta.name: Kayles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.13 KB

In "Kayles," you win by taking the last bottle. This logic and strategy game challenges you to plan wisely and outmaneuver your opponent to claim victory.

meta.name: Kayleth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.49 KB

The Zyronians were an advanced, pacifist civilization until the tyrant Kayleth arrived. From his spaceship, he sent down armies of androids and enslaved the planet Zyron, forcing its inhabitants to work in mines and collect chromazine, a rare mineral, for him. You are a Zyronian who has devised a plan to liberate the planet from Kayleth's rule. At the beginning of the game, however, you are trapped in an unknown location and cannot remember the events that brought you to this situation. In order to find out where you are, what happened to you and ultimately save your home planet, you must interact with various (android) characters, solve different puzzles and survive encounters with wild creatures.

meta.name: Kellogg's Tour 1988
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.37 KB

Kellogg's Tour 1988 turns a long cycling race into a sporting challenge in which success depends not only on endurance, but also on maintaining strong performances across many stages. On the journey from Newcastle to Westminster, it is not just about moving forward, but also about battling for special classifications and prized jerseys that give each section added importance. That blend of stage-by-stage thinking, overall ranking, and the pursuit of different honors gives the game an appealing racing character that goes beyond simple speed.

meta.name: Kempelen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kempelen draws on the famous legend of the Mechanical Turk and turns that historical illusion into a genuine contest on the chessboard. Instead of mere deception, the focus here is on real chess, combined with the fascination of an idea that was once admired as a technical wonder. Its appeal comes especially from that link to the mechanical myth, because it revives the old dream of a thinking machine and this time makes it truly playable.
meta.developer: Attila Kovács, István Bilek & Tamás Révkirá

meta.name: Ken Uston's Professional Blackjack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Ken Uston's Professional Blackjack” is a detailed simulation entirely focused on the art of professional blackjack. Based on the strategies of renowned expert Ken Uston, the game recreates tables from over 70 U.S. casinos, each with unique house rules – from deck count and dealer behavior to splitting, insurance, surrender, and more. Up to seven players can join, either human or CPU-controlled, with customizable cash and betting units. Players can even design their own casinos with personalized rules. The game's main goal is to teach card counting, offering drills across four skill levels, detailed statistics, player ratings, and live strategy feedback to help refine your play.

meta.name: Kendo Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.80 KB

In this ninja beat 'em up you take control of Kendo in a mission to retrieve secret documents which have been stolen. You have to fight your way through various guards and large dogs using your sword as well as kicks and forward-rolls. You must also go through several particle beams which block your path by collecting shields matching the colour of the beams. After usage the shield becomes exhausted and you must collect another one to advance. Other items such as a pipe wrench and wire-cutters can be collected to aid your progress.
The documents are located in a safe which you must open by entering the code. Once in possession of the documents you must get to the roof and make your escape via helicopter to complete the mission.

meta.name: Kennedy Approach
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kennedy Approach puts you in the role of an air traffic controller, guiding planes through takeoffs, landings, and airspace transitions. You issue commands for altitude, heading, and speed to avoid collisions and keep flights on schedule. One mistake can lead to airborne chaos – only with precision, timing, and sharp oversight can you master the skies.

meta.name: Kenny Dalglish Soccer Match
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.66 KB

Kenny Dalglish was a hugely successful player for Celtic, Liverpool and Scotland, before becoming the first person to win the English league championship while both playing and managing (for Liverpool in 1985, also winning the FA Cup that year). This was his second licensed game, and is a side-scrolling action game featuring single matches played between a team in red and a team in blue, each of which can be any of 9 skill levels. Matches can be varied between 10 and 90 minutes. The ball is loosely controlled in a manner similar to the Kick off series, although it isn’t possible to pass the ball a short distance, so an element of hitting and hoping comes into play, especially as the ball can’t be curved far. The ball bounces quite heavily, and is very difficult to shoot on target from closer than 30 yards or so.

meta.name: Kenny Dalglish Soccer Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.98 KB

En 1989, Kenny Dalglish apenas jugaba en el Liverpool y se enfocaba casi por completo en su rol como entrenador, por lo que un juego de gestión futbolística sin acción arcade bajo su licencia tenía sentido. El juego se basa exclusivamente en iconos y menús, quizás el primer paso para llevar el género a los 90. Cualquier equipo que elijas comienza desde la 4ª división. Puedes seleccionar resúmenes de los partidos, que se ven desde una perspectiva lateral y muestran goles y jugadas cercanas, aunque también puedes desactivarlos.
Comienzas con plantillas de más de 20 jugadores de las cuales eliges tu equipo de 11, cada uno con una calificación de habilidad directa. Las formaciones se seleccionan colocando a cada jugador en una posición precisa junto a la formación del equipo rival, utilizando un sistema bastante avanzado para la época. A través de un menú separado, puedes consultar con el presidente (para ver si está satisfecho con tus esfuerzos), el fisioterapeuta (para revisar lesiones), el ojeador (que sugiere jugadores para comprar) y más.

meta.name: Keno
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.22 KB

Keno is built entirely around the simple idea of a number-based gambling game, where you choose your numbers from a larger pool and then hope to score as many matches as possible. Its appeal does not come from strategy or skill, but from the tension between your stake, your expectations, and the possible reward when your picks line up with the computer's numbers. That plain blend of selection, risk, and luck gives the game its characteristic gambling appeal.

meta.name: Kensington
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.84 KB

Kensington is a digital version of the board game where one or two players compete to control two hexagons by surrounding them with their own pieces. Each player places 15 counters, then takes turns sliding them along lines. Forming a triangle allows you to move an opponent's counter – a square lets you move two. The game includes three skill levels and adjustable speed settings.

meta.name: Kentilla
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.68 KB

Kentilla is a sequel to an earlier text adventure by Derek Brewster, Velnor's Lair.
At the end of the previous game, Velnor was defeated and his soul was thrown through the Void into the flames of the Abyss. In the elapsed second that the corridor was opened, Grako returned from the Abyss and now controls the source of Velnor's power, the Moonstone of Aigrath. The aim of the game is to defeat Grako and return him to the flames of the Abyss. The player is assisted by the mystical sword Kentilla and companions like Elva, who can carry things as well as carry out tasks and fight.
The game's text parser not only accepts the normal "Go North" and "Get Item" commands, but also allows the player to issue commands to others, such as "Tell Elva "Get Moss"".
The game also plays music while the game is running.

meta.name: Kentucky Derby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Kentucky Derby," you experience the famous horse race at Churchill Downs. Bet on thoroughbreds and choose your favorites as you try to turn the odds in your favor and enjoy the thrilling races of the Kentucky Derby. Up to four players can join and place their bets.

meta.name: Kentucky Racing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.95 KB

In most funfairs or theme parks you would find a stall which lets you participate in a horse race against other people. Customers throw a ball trying to get it into a hole. If the ball enters the hole the their horse will move. The further away the hole, the further the horse will move. The winner receives a prize.
Kentucky Racing is the computer version of this game.
meta.genre: Deportes con animales / Carreras de caballos

meta.name: Kermit's Electronic Storymaker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.69 KB

“Kermit's Electronic Storymaker” invites children to write their own story – sentence by sentence, word by word. Using a preset vocabulary from the Muppet Show, they create tales on the computer that are then brought to life by Kermit, Miss Piggy, Gonzo, and the rest of the gang as animated scenes. No matter how silly or imaginative – as long as the sentences are grammatically correct, the Muppets will obey. A charming blend of learning, creativity, and interactive fun.

meta.name: Kernal's Chaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.35 KB

"Kernal's Chaos!" is a classic shoot'em-up game for the Commodore 64. The game challenges you to fend off wave after wave of enemy attacks in a hectic battle. The action-packed game mechanics require quick reactions and tactical skill to survive the increasingly intense attacks. The game's music is particularly noteworthy: the soundtrack was written by famous C64 composer Rob Hubbard and uses the piece "Crazy Comets", which is known for its energetic and captivating sounds. The music perfectly complements the game's fast-paced action and enhances the intense atmosphere.

meta.name: The Ket Trilogy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A compilation of all three parts of the so-called Ket trilogy:
- Mountains of Ket
- Temple of Vran
- The Final Mission 
The lands of Ket have long been split into feuding groups and have never known peace. Recently though, particularly vicious attacks have come from beyond a range of mountains in the east - these are known as the Mountains of Ket. To put a stop to these attacks, the Lords of Ket have joined together and called for you. You are told that the force behind the raids comes from two people: Priest/King Vran Verusbel, leader of the cult of Mad Monks, and their High Priestess, Delphia; the most beautiful woman in existence. They base their attacks from an evil place, the Temple of Vran. It is thought by the Lords that the death of both Vran and Delphia would cause the raids to stop. This then is your ultimate task, but beware as both are cunning and devious.

meta.name: Kettle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.45 KB

You play the role of a flying cauldron as you attempt to escape from 30 levels in an underground system that is viewed from the side and that scrolls as you move. Each level has an exit, but it can only be opened if you find a can opener hidden in a gut. There are various guts scattered throughout a level, but only one leaves behind a can opener when destroyed, while the other guts leave behind an alien, a bonus, or a jar to replenish energy. However, each intestine releases bubbles and when touched your energy is reduced, which is also lost if you are touched by a discovered alien. If you run out of energy, it's game over.

meta.name: Key Finders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.59 KB

In Keyfinders, you must explore a labyrinth built by an egocentric person with malicious intentions. It's clear that this labyrinth is designed to confuse and torment. Instead of the usual ghosts, you'll encounter space shuttles, bouncing balls, spiders, small robots, and bats. The labyrinth is also filled with traps. The hero, Nebraska Joe, is trapped in this maze and must jump, climb ladders, and collect keys and equipment to fight through the dangerous environment. There are four levels to conquer in order to escape the labyrinth alive. Any resemblance to a famous archaeologist is purely coincidental.

Keyboard Cadet places you in a futuristic cockpit where your typing skills determine success or failure. Letters and symbols appear in space, and you must type them quickly and accurately to score points. With multiple speed levels, the challenge ramps up steadily, turning the task of learning touch-typing into an exciting sci-fi adventure.

meta.name: KGB Superspy

KGB Superspy sends you into a risky helicopter rescue mission behind enemy lines. Across several operations, you pick up scientists, carry them to safe houses, and eventually attempt the dangerous border flight to the West. Soldiers, tanks, jeeps, and jetpack enemies stand in your way, while fuel and energy always need careful attention. The mission becomes especially tense through disguised decoys, limited resources, and the constant shift between rescue, combat, and navigation.

meta.name: Kick and Kill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Kick and Kill, a fast-paced platformer, you race to reach the ceiling first. Play solo or with a friend as the brooms Clean and Clone, working to clear all bugs from the field. Avoid lively goblins, as touching them costs a life. The game features increasing difficulty, numerous animations, and customizable "Sets" for a personalized experience. Excitement and fun are guaranteed as you navigate progressively challenging levels.

meta.name: Kick Box Vigilante
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.95 KB

You have been invited to the Siandown temple by the Old Masters to fight some of their warriors, because the Masters believe that no Westerner can become the Master of the Kick Box. Of course, the Masters don't want to be proven wrong, so they have prepared you to face four of the best boxers.

meta.name: Kick Off
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.96 KB

En Kick Off se vive el fútbol desde una vista cenital, diferenciándose de otros títulos del género. El balón no se adhiere al pie, exigiendo precisión y dominio técnico. El modo entrenamiento permite perfeccionar habilidades, y cada jugador tiene atributos únicos (velocidad, resistencia, precisión, agresividad), lo que influye en la jugabilidad y fomenta estrategias profundas.

En Kick Off se vive el fútbol desde una vista cenital, diferenciándose de otros títulos del género. El balón no se adhiere al pie, exigiendo precisión y dominio técnico. El modo entrenamiento permite perfeccionar habilidades, y cada jugador tiene atributos únicos (velocidad, resistencia, precisión, agresividad), lo que influye en la jugabilidad y fomenta estrategias profundas.

meta.name: Kick Off 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Kick Off 2, el juego original se enriquece con modos de torneo completos con jugadores ficticios y cuatro tipos de campo, incluyendo superficies de plástico controvertidas con un comportamiento impredecible del balón. La jugabilidad exige habilidad, ya que el balón no se pega a los pies de los jugadores, lo que requiere precisión en el ritmo y control. Con la práctica, podrás dominar movimientos avanzados como chilenas, pases de tacón y pases largos para llevar a tu equipo a la victoria.

meta.name: Kickman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.63 KB

You control the skillful unicyclist. Your job is to rack up points by breaking and catching balloons, ghosts, and PAC-MAN on your head.

meta.name: Kid Grid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The goal is to conquer spaces to collect points and complete a grid. Your character is Kid Grid and your main attributes are maneuverability and a stun gun that you can use against a group of 4 pursuers whose task is to corner and kill you. The stun gun freezes the pursuers immediately, but only briefly, allowing the Kid to escape from them to further build the grid. Depending on the difficulty of the level you are at, 3, 5 or 7 stuns are allowed. Unused stuns can accumulate as you progress for use later in the game. Question marks appear throughout the game and are a valuable asset that must be captured to earn points. The player's score decreases when the question mark disappears. There are 5 difficulty levels and the player starts with 5 lives. If 10,000 points are reached, another life is allowed. Scoring is as follows: completing a square: 100 points, capturing a question mark: 100-500 points and failing to capture a question mark: 10 points penalty.

meta.name: Kid Grid II - Kid vs. Kid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kid vs. Kid in Kid Grid 2 is an action-packed puzzle game for two players where the goal is to outwit and defeat the opponent with strategic moves. Players must use their cognitive skills and reaction speed to anticipate and counter the opponent's moves. To win, it's crucial to correctly predict both one's own decisions and those of the opponent, and to act strategically. The game promotes strategic thinking and combines puzzle elements with quick decision-making, making it a challenge for both players. It is especially suited for friends or families looking for mental challenges and competitive fun.

meta.name: Kid Niki to the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kid Niki must rescue Princess Margo from the evil Stone Wizard. Armed with his spinning sword, he clears out every enemy in his way. Along the journey, he can find special items like a golden bell that attacks from a distance, a silver bell that creates a sound shield, a Mini-Niki for an extra life, or a Mini-Princess that deflects death once. Seven zones with dangerous bosses await him before he chases the Stone Wizard into the eighth and final round for the ultimate showdown.

meta.name: Kidnapped
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.98 KB

You have been kidnapped! You awaken on the ninth floor of a strange building to find that your kidnapper has left you unattended. You must try to escape from the building one floor at a time. Each floor is independent of the others. You cannot carry items from one floor to another and you cannot return to a previous floor. Everything you need to escape from a given floor can be found on that floor! This makes you feel like you're playing nine mini-Adventures rather than one big Adventure.

meta.name: Kids on Keys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.70 KB

Kids on Keys combines three small learning games that help young computer beginners practice reading and typing. In the first game you type falling letters before they hit the ground – and later full words tossed down by the game's mascot. The second game focuses on full object names: everyday items float downward, and you must type their names correctly. In the third game a word appears at the bottom, and you enter the number of the matching icon shown on the screen. Bonus rounds in the second and third tasks partially hide the icons, forcing you to rely more on memory. Together, the three challenges form a playful training course that steadily sharpens recognition, reaction and typing skills.

Kikstart is a motorcycle trials racing game it allowed 2-player simultaneous (via a split-screen facility) or 1-player, vs-computer play. The basic premise of the game is to control a bike using acceleration, braking, "hopping" and "wheelies" to navigate across a course of various obstacles, from ramps and gates to telephone boxes and tires.

meta.name: Kikstart 128

In Kikstart 128, you control a motorcycle through challenging stunt courses. Play solo against the clock or compete with a friend in split-screen mode. Choose from 16 courses filled with obstacles like trees, cars, buses, and water pools that require skillful jumps and precise handling. Accelerate, brake, perform wheelies, and jump to reach the finish as quickly and safely as possible. Skill and quick reflexes are the keys to success.

meta.name: Kikstart C16
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.93 KB

In Kikstart C16, you control a motorcycle through tricky stunt courses, testing your skills in a single-player race against the clock. Your goal is to safely and quickly guide your rider through three of 16 courses, overcoming obstacles like trees, cars, buses, and water pools with skillful jumps. Using a joystick or keyboard, you can accelerate, brake, perform wheelies, and tackle obstacles while managing five lives to complete the challenges. Skill and precision are essential to reach the finish line.

meta.name: Kikstart 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based around the Kikstart TV show, the game allows you to recreate all those death-defying stunts in the comparative safety of your home.  Viewed from the side, there are many hazards to avoid along the way. Some of these include steps to jump over, tyres and hedges to plough through at maximum speed, and mud which will slow you down.
24 courses are built in, and you can choose a set of 5 of these to race at a time, or let the computer choose them at random. More importantly, a course designer allowing you to create one of your own is included, with full control of the placement of the many hazards..

meta.name: Kikstart III

A set of new Kikstart courses created with the Kikstart Construction Set created by Nitro and The Illusion.

meta.name: Kikugi
meta.desc:

In Kikugi, you play a single-player puzzle game inspired by a traditional Japanese strategy game. The goal is to remove pieces by jumping over them until only one piece remains, ideally ending in the center of the board. The game features various levels and board layouts with different numbers of pieces. It demands focus and strategic thinking to successfully overcome the challenges.

meta.name: Kill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Kill, you pilot a spaceship in a space shooter where evading and avoiding dangers is often the best strategy. Despite the name, the focus is less on attacking and more on skillful navigation and survival. Precision and quick reactions are key to succeeding in this action-packed game.

meta.name: Kill the Saucers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.61 KB

In Kill the Saucers, you undertake a secret mission to destroy the enemy base. Guided by the motto "Shoot what's necessary," you navigate hostile territory where skill and precision are crucial to overcoming challenges and completing your mission successfully.

meta.name: Killed Until Dead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Killed Until Dead es un sofisticado juego de misterio con un toque de humor. El jugador debe resolver todos los aspectos de un caso de asesinato antes de que suceda. Los cinco mejores escritores de misterio del mundo se han reunido en un hotel y uno de ellos matará al otro a menos que Hércules Holmes pueda resolver el caso. La jugabilidad es una mezcla entre el juego de mesa Clue y los rompecabezas de lógica en papel, en los que el jugador debe eliminar pistas en secuencia. Para resolver el asesinato inminente, tendrás que registrar las habitaciones de los sospechosos, confrontarlos con la evidencia y programar las cámaras de seguridad del hotel para grabar reuniones secretas.

meta.name: Killer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.59 KB

In Killer, you face a timed word-guessing challenge where you must crack the password to save your life. The game follows the principles of Hangman. You select letters, with incorrect guesses causing the gallows to drop one step closer. A letter grid shows already used and recently chosen letters. The game offers three difficulty levels to match your skills. Precision and quick thinking are essential to win.

meta.name: Killer Piller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.75 KB

In Killer Piller, you defend your orchard from ravenous caterpillars devouring everything in sight. Armed with lethal insect spray, you must stop the infestation before all the trees are destroyed. Beware: the caterpillars lay eggs that hatch into deadly moths, which will hunt you down. Skill and speed are crucial to saving your orchard.

meta.name: Killer Watt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.79 KB

Killer Watt sends you deep into an underground tunnel system, piloting your ship while hunting twelve light bulbs you must destroy to advance. As you move through the tight passages, you avoid or shoot creatures, constantly watching how much shield strength remains. Touching enemies or scraping the walls for too long weakens your protection and can eventually cost you a life. Once all twelve bulbs are gone, you head all the way left to hit the switch and enter the next of five increasingly hostile caves. Before starting, you choose both your shield strength and the level you want to begin on.

meta.name: Killer-Ring
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.37 KB

Killer-Ring puts you at the center of the screen with one rule – shoot everything that moves. Enemies swarm from all directions, and you must spin, aim, and fire constantly. With each round, the difficulty ramps up, and if you manage to reach the mysterious spaceman, blast his heart for bonus points. It's a wild, chaotic shooter with dark humor and relentless action.

meta.name: Killing Fields
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.00 KB

In Killing Fields, you can participate solo or with a friend in a competitive game. Strategically place your bets and test your luck as you aim for the best outcomes. Excitement and strategic thinking are at the heart of this game.

meta.name: Killing Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 59.66 KB

You have survived a battle in space, but your spaceship is damaged beyond repair and must be evacuated. That's why you make your way to the nearest planet with your emergency landing ship. The planet you head to is uninhabitable after a giant brain that controlled all life died out. But as you approach the surface, you realize that this is not true as you are attacked by various life forms. There are three levels in which you have to shoot or avoid different aliens and vehicles. If you are touched or shot, you lose one of three lives and are sent to the start of the level. At the end of levels one or two, you face a giant brain guard that must be destroyed to advance to the next level. At the end of the third level is the giant brain itself.

meta.name: Killozapp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Killozapp you launch your spaceship with the words “Ave Caesar! Morituri te salutant!” before diving into fast-paced stages filled with enemies. During the action you must dodge incoming attacks while firing back to clear your path. Quick reflexes and accurate timing are essential as threats appear constantly. The game is enhanced by stylish graphics and catchy music that keep the action lively even when you lose a life.

meta.name: Killwave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.00 KB

In Killwave, you pilot a ship in a vertically scrolling shooter. As a ROM hack of Killwarp, the game delivers thrilling action as you battle through waves of enemies. Precision and quick reflexes are vital to overcoming challenges and defeating your foes.

meta.name: Kindercomp
meta.desc:

An early learning game for kids aged 3-8. This program is a collection of 6 learning games: Draw, Scribble, Names, Sequence, Letters and Match.

meta.name: Kindergarten Kids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.28 KB

In Kindergarten Kids, you experience a challenging shooter game with adorable graphics, especially enjoyable in two-player co-op mode. Team up with a friend to navigate action-packed levels where skill and teamwork are essential for success.

meta.name: Kinetic Connection
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Kinetic Connection, you solve puzzles by picking up, rotating, and placing objects on a grid to complete a mysterious picture. While you can view the original image for guidance, doing so decreases your time limit more quickly. Puzzles range from 4 to 96 pieces, and many images are animated, offering clues for correct placement. Quick thinking and creativity are key to mastering the challenge. You can save your progress and play solo or with a friend.

meta.name: Kinetik
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.82 KB

En Kinetik, controlas una nave que tiene en cuenta la inercia y la gravedad, por lo que muestra reacciones físicas realistas. Debes completar 44 niveles recogiendo las letras P, A y X en ese orden, y luego salir para ganar. Los niveles están salpicados de enemigos y objetos que recoger. Los objetos requerirán energía para ser utilizados.

meta.name: King Solomon's Mines

"King Solomon's Mines" is a text-based adventure game with graphical elements that takes players on a perilous expedition through Africa. Searching for the legendary mines of King Solomon, players explore various locations, collect items, and solve puzzles to progress. Interactive text input allows engagement with the environment and decision-making that shapes the course of the adventure. Strategy, exploration, and problem-solving skills are essential to uncover the secrets of the mines.

meta.name: King Tut's Tomb Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.25 KB

King Tut's Tomb Adventure sends you into the dark passages of an Egyptian pyramid by torchlight, seeking to loot King Tutankhamun's treasures and escape the Mummy's wrath. You begin outside the massive structure with only some food, matches, and a torch, venturing into the sprawling tunnels filled with dangers, puzzles, and mythical beings. The goal is to find all hidden treasures and make it out alive. Scoring 175 points means full completion.

meta.name: King's Bounty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Todo iba bien en el reino gobernado por el Rey Maximus: los cuatro continentes vivían en armonía y todos llevaban una existencia feliz y próspera, mientras el Cetro del Orden, en manos del Rey, mantenía a raya a las fuerzas de la oscuridad. Pero Arech Dragonbreath, líder de las Legiones de la Oscuridad, consiguió apoderarse del Cetro del Orden con poderosa magia. Se retira a su guarida, deja que sus lugartenientes se apoderen del resto del reino y entierra el Cetro. Dibuja un mapa de su ubicación, luego lo rompe en 25 pedazos, confiando 16 a sus lacayos, quedándose uno para él y escondiendo los 8 restantes con poderosos artefactos mágicos. De ti depende recomponer el mapa, devolver el Cetro al Rey y derrotar a las fuerzas de la oscuridad.

The King's Rule est un programme d'apprentissage interactif pour Commodore 64 conçu pour développer l'esprit de déduction des élèves à partir du CM1. Dans un décor médiéval, les joueurs doivent résoudre des énigmes en identifiant des schémas cachés et en explorant différentes explications du comportement d'un système. Des personnages hauts en couleur gardent les portes d'un château et proposent des énigmes que les joueurs doivent résoudre en utilisant des déductions déjà validées. Ce programme aide les élèves à formuler des hypothèses et à développer leur raisonnement logique.

Kings of Comedy is a charming game based on early Hollywood comedies. Players take on the roles of two characters, Charlie and Harold, who may be inspired by iconic silent film comedians Charlie Chaplin and Harold Lloyd. The storyline and gameplay reflect the comedic adventures of that era, providing humorous entertainment.

meta.name: Kings of the Beach
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kings of the Beach lets you play as Sinjin Smith or Randy Stoklos in training, match, or tournament mode across five beaches. Controls are simple, but timing and teamwork are crucial. Alongside real pros like Ron Von Hagen and Mike Dodd, quirky characters from other games spice up the roster. A fun twist is arguing with the referee – you might win a point, or earn a red card if you push your luck.

meta.name: Kitron : The Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Kitron: The Challenge is a Tron-like dueling game with a larger than usual playing field. It is the first TRON remake with a computer opponent that can learn from mistakes through artificial intelligence so as not to repeat them in the same situation. A brake activated with the fire button allows you to drive more slowly in curves without any disadvantages, as the opponent also slows down. Due to the learning process, the opponent can do "stupid things" in the first 2-3 levels; however, precise strategies are required at higher levels. The game can be paused by counter-steering. The game modes include: DUEL MASTER, a duel on an empty field; LABYRINTH, in which the opponent must be trapped in increasingly difficult labyrinths; and HANDICAPDUEL, in which random barriers ensure increased attention.

Es un juego de acción y puzle cuyo objetivo es atrapar fichas de colores que caen y formar filas, columnas o diagonales monocromáticas. Cada nivel exige un patrón distinto, y la dificultad aumenta: las fichas caen más rápido, en mayor cantidad y con más colores conforme avanzas.

Klemens is a platform game where the player must rescue eight of his twin brothers locked in the cages scattered around the labyrinth. Destroying the cages requires finding the dynamite. Unfortunately Klemens may carry only one item at a time, so finding a brother without dynamite requires remembering the back route. The labyrinth consists of 256 chambers inhabited by numerous hostile animals and other obstacles, such as ground spikes, bouncing balls or coming from the ground skeletons. Each enemy may be annihilated by jumping on it. Contact with hostile creature or obstacles takes some energy, which may be supplemented by energy potions and temporary immortality shields.

Klepkomania builds on the familiar ball-and-paddle formula and adds a few tricky twists that make the action less predictable. Cartoon graphics are hidden behind the blocks and are gradually revealed as you play, while indestructible or returning elements make progress more difficult. On top of that, erratic birds create extra chaos and force quick reactions. That mix of classic gameplay and small annoyances gives the game its distinctive appeal.

Combina conducción, disparos y elementos de aventura, con límite de tiempo en cada desafío.

La impresionante aventura de arcade Knight 'n' Grail presenta a un valiente caballero en una búsqueda para encontrar lo único que librará a su amada de una maldición que la ha convertido en un dragón: el mágico Grial. Muchos peligros te esperan mientras exploras más de 200 pantallas en tu búsqueda para encontrar el Grial. Sin embargo, no estás indefenso. Encontrarás varias mejoras de armamento y armadura durante tus viajes e incluso descubrirás nuevos poderes que te permitirán llegar a áreas previamente inaccesibles.

En Knight Tyme, el Caballero Mágico llega al siglo XXV a bordo del barco mercante USS Pisces tras rescatar al mago Gimbal. Para regresar a su tiempo, debe navegar por el espacio, visitar planetas y reabastecer la nave antes de quedar varado. Usando el sistema Windimation, interactúas con el mundo mediante un menú de comandos para recolectar objetos, examinar cosas, dar órdenes o lanzar hechizos. Pero cuidado: algunas salas son mortales al instante y requieren resolver puzles para acceder de forma segura.

meta.name: Knightmare (Activision)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.45 KB

Knightmare drops you inside Damonia Castle with no gear, no clues, and only a flickering candle to show your health. You move through its 3D rooms and perform actions using a simple verb–noun system that offers only the words relevant to your current situation. Puzzles, traps, and blocked paths demand sharp thinking, while two advisers – one honest, one deceitful – give alternating hints that you must judge for yourself. As you progress, you discover weapons and magical items such as a freezing rain cloud, a living key, or a heavy anvil that crushes evil. Step by step you work your way out of the castle, always trying to stay ahead of the darkness closing in.

meta.name: Knights of Legend
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Knights of Legend is set in the fantasy land of Ashtalarea. The evil Pildar has captured the ruler of the land, known as the Duke, and a warrior named Seggallion, who has fought and defeated Pildar in the past. The player controls a party of adventurers whose quest is to rescue the prisoners, and eventually vanquish Pildar. The player can create a party of adventurers, choosing between the traditional races of humans, dwarves, and elves, as well as a new race called Keldar, who possesses the power of flight. The game world is explored from top-down perspective. Turn-based combat takes place on separate screens. The combat system in the game is quite complex, including various types of attacks, parrying and dodging, as well as the possibility of targeting individual body parts of enemies. The player also selects commands for a defensive round, trying to anticipate the opponent's move.

The combat system in the game is quite complex, including various types of attacks, parrying and dodging, as well as the possibility of targeting individual body parts of enemies. The player also selects commands for a defensive round, trying to anticipate the opponent's move.

Knights of Legend is set in the fantasy land of Ashtalarea. The evil Pildar has captured the ruler of the land, known as the Duke, and a warrior named Seggallion, who has fought and defeated Pildar in the past. The player controls a party of adventurers whose quest is to rescue the prisoners, and eventually vanquish Pildar. The player can create a party of adventurers, choosing between the traditional races of humans, dwarves, and elves, as well as a new race called Keldar, who possesses the power of flight. The game world is explored from top-down perspective. Turn-based combat takes place on separate screens. The combat system in the game is quite complex, including various types of attacks, parrying and dodging, as well as the possibility of targeting individual body parts of enemies. The player also selects commands for a defensive round, trying to anticipate the opponent's move.

meta.name: Knights of the Desert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Knights of the Desert is the operational level simulation of Rommel's famous North African Campaign of WWII. The game begins in March 1941 and ends in February 1943 in 12 turns each representing 2 months. Both players goals are the same. That is to sweep across the northern coast of Africa pushing the enemy as far back as possible capturing key towns such as Benghazi and Tobruk along the way. The only difference is the direction you are heading. As the German Commander your main goal is east to Alexandria. As the British Commander your main goal is to sweep Rommel all the way back to El Agheila and win the game. Knights of the Desert provides for solitaire play where the computer directs the British.

meta.name: Knockout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.85 KB

Knockout! is a boxing game your goal; Become world heavyweight champion. To do this you first have to become European champion. Before fights you can choose the stamina of your boxer and the computers between one and four, with one being the strongest. There is also a two-player option, which consists of just a fight between both fighters. The last option you have is the ability to create an opponent. This allows you to move the boxer around the ring, throw punches and defend yourself with a limited number of moves before you have the chance to fight him. The fights themselves are viewed from the side, with the entire ring visible on the screen and you taking control of the boxer in the red pants on the right.

meta.name: Know Your Own IQ & Personality
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Know Your Own IQ & Personality, you can test your intelligence through a series of challenges of varying difficulty. Based on the principles of renowned psychologist Hans Eysenck, the game analyzes your responses and calculates a personalized IQ score. It provides an engaging and interactive way to assess your cognitive abilities.

meta.name: Knuckle Busters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.20 KB

Knuckle Busters puts you in rebellion against a totalitarian system where, in 2133, criminals aren't jailed but reprogrammed in mind and body. You're one of the few who resist the brainwashing – and now you're running for your life. Six zones separate you from freedom, and the clock is ticking toward the city's self-destruction. With fists and kicks, you battle guards and reconditioned enemies, scavenge for food, water, and keys, and hunt for hidden power-ups. Every second counts. Every fight could be your last.

meta.name: Kobyashi Naru
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.48 KB

Split into knowledge, wisdom and understanding sections, the Kobyashi Naru trial must be completed in order to gain immortal status. Collect the required objects from each one in this adventure game.
The game offers pictures of each location and significant objects, and a textual description of each location, but beyond this the game system is atypical of 1980s adventures, especially those originating on cassette. A set of icons is displayed in the top half of the screen, which are selected to activate movement, item manipulation, analysing the scene (by selecting specific words of text), and actions like ascending, throwing and swimming. Puzzle solving always uses objects either in the scene description or your inventory.

meta.name: Kobo64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.63 KB

“Kobo64” is an action-packed arcade game where the player clears labyrinthine alien space stations of enemies. The goal is to destroy blue orbs on the walls of the mazes and work toward the center of the station to completely eliminate it. The game starts leisurely but quickly becomes more intense as the challenges escalate. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to master the frantic situations.

meta.name: Koko
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.15 KB

“Koko” is a platform game where the player controls Koko, who is on a quest to find the magical orb that can grant any wish. To achieve this, Koko must explore a dark underground cave, defeat patrolling robots, and face an immortal guardian. Along the way, the orb and 23 treasures must be discovered, requiring skill and determination. A challenging adventure with exciting gameplay.

meta.name: Kokotoni Wilf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.10 KB

Kokotoni Wilf has been sent on a bold journey through time, to recover the seven pieces of the Dragon Amulet. There are 63 screens across 6 times zones to trek through in order to find these star-like objects.
These screens are viewed from the side, and resemble Jet Set Willy, except that Wilf can fly through them and hover at a precision point. With hazards ranging from dinosaurs to spears to spaceships, and pieces located in hard-to-reach places, you will need this extra skill, especially as you have no weaponry. Most screens have more than 2 exits, but some are dead ends or lead directly into hazardous points. On each world you can immediately access the first 3 screens.

meta.name: Kong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.05 KB

“Kong” is a classic Donkey Kong clone where the player attempts to rescue Fay Ray from the clutches of King Kong. The game consists of four levels with distinct challenges. In the first level, Kong rolls barrels toward the player, which can be smashed with a hammer to earn bonus points. The second level takes place in a factory where the player must dodge approaching cakes on a conveyor belt. In the third level, the player chases Kong through a skyscraper, using elevators and avoiding falling steel beams. The finale unfolds in Kong's hideout. Each level begins with a set amount of bonus points that decrease over time, rewarding quick action. Additional points can be earned by collecting umbrellas and handbags.

meta.name: Kong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.91 KB

In Kong you fight through four perilous levels to rescue Fay Ray from the clutches of King Kong. From rolling barrels and conveyor-belt cakes to skyscraper elevators and falling girders – each stage brings new dangers. The faster you finish, the more bonus points you keep. Smash barrels and collect umbrellas and handbags for extra score. A gripping Donkey Kong clone with classic arcade spirit.

meta.name: Kong Strikes Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Kong Strikes Back you attempt to rescue a girl from the clutches of a giant ape. To do this you run along the twisting tracks of a rollercoaster, gradually making your way toward the top of the screen. Along the route you must avoid various hazards such as incoming cars and other obstacles on the track. You carry a limited supply of bombs that can be used to destroy the vehicles, while ladders allow you to change paths or avoid danger. Bonus items scattered along the way increase your score. Once you reach the girl, the game continues with the next level and a new challenge.

meta.name: Kongo Kong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.66 KB

Kongo Kong is a single screen platformer inspired by the arcade game Donkey Kong where you control a fireman trying to rescue a girl held hostage from an escaped Gorilla from the City Zoo over various levels. You have to run along platforms while climbing ladders to reach the Gorilla while avoiding various creatures and objects. The creatures take various forms and the objects include barrels and axes and if you touch one then you lose one of three lives. When you reach the girl then you move off the screen to the next level to try to rescue her again.

meta.name: Kopido
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.64 KB

Kopido challenges you under relentless time pressure as you must guide balls into their designated wheels. Every move needs careful consideration, since wrong actions waste precious seconds and disrupt the delicate balance. As the complexity increases, tension rises until precision, awareness, and nerve decide success or failure – a puzzle that perfectly blends frustration with determination.

meta.name: Koronis Rift
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los Antiguos han abandonado el planeta, dejando atrás numerosos artefactos y naves para que los saquees. Envía a tu droide a recoger módulos e intenta averiguar para qué se utiliza esta antigua tecnología. Pueden ser baterías, escudos o incluso armas, que te ayudarán a luchar contra los platillos de gatillo fácil que te persiguen.
El juego utiliza gráficos fractales y el terreno es vasto y detallado.

meta.name: Kosmic Kanga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.19 KB

In Kosmic Kanga, you control a super kangaroo equipped with a jetpack and a gun in a side-scrolling level that moves from right to left. Using the joystick, you leap over obstacles, dodge enemies, and collect bonus items to increase your score. The goal is to make it back to your spaceship alive while achieving the highest score possible. Quick reflexes and precise movement are key to surviving this wild intergalactic hop.

meta.name: Krakout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Clon de Breakout al estilo Arkanoid, que a diferencia de la mayoría de juegos similares tiene el bate en un lateral de la pantalla (hay opción izquierda/derecha) en lugar de en la parte inferior.
Hay varios tipos de ladrillos especiales, pero a diferencia de, por ejemplo, Arkanoid, no caen hacia el bate. En su lugar, cuando golpeas un ladrillo especial, éste se voltea para mostrar una letra. Por ejemplo, E (Extiende el bate), C (Atrapa la bola), M (Misil), B (Bomba, explota al ser golpeada por la bola, eliminando una serie de ladrillos) y X (Vida extra).
Los enemigos/obstáculos son más variados que en Arkanoid. Algunos hacen que el bate se congele, otros mastican y se comen la bola y te la escupen.

meta.name: Krazy Kar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.09 KB

In Krazy Kar, you control a car from a top-down perspective as the screen scrolls vertically upward. Your goal is to ram or land on other vehicles to earn points while driving through four different seasons. You can adjust your speed but must drive fast enough to jump over obstacles like rivers. Oil slicks and touching the road edges cost a life, while warning signs alert you to upcoming hazards. Skill and quick reactions are crucial to navigating the course and scoring as many points as possible.

meta.name: Krazy Kong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.18 KB

Krazy Kong is a single screen platformer loosely based on the arcade game Donkey Kong where you have to rescue Maidens at the top of the screen held by a giant ape. Starting at the bottom of the screen you must run up the platforms diagonally in the form of steps, with three levels of platforms to navigate. As you run up the screen you must avoid barrels that are thrown by the ape by jumping over them. If you hit a barrel then it is game over and if you reach the Maidens then you can rescue one before attempting to get the next one on a new screen.nn

meta.name: Kromazone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.52 KB

The Kromazone is the elite training area of the Terran Space Fleet Naval Academy. Here the best pilots in the fleet are put through their paces. If you want to become a starfighter pilot and perhaps fight against the Maranzar one day, you have to survive the Kromazone. Kromazone is a 3D game in which the action is viewed from the cockpit of a MantaRay fighter plane that automatically flies forward. In the first level, the task is simply to avoid flying balls. Only when this phase is completed will the fighter's blasters be activated and the enemy can be fired upon. The MantaRay can take a certain number of hits before it is destroyed. The remaining number is displayed at the bottom of the screen. The game can be played alternately by two players who can compete for a high score.

meta.name: Krymini
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Krymini is a puzzle game in which the player gets presented with a 6x6 grid. Balls with different colours are spread out on this grid, along with some unoccupied fields. The goal is to move every ball once: depending on the colour the ball has to be moved by a different amount of fields. After a ball is moved, it is converted into a permanent stone. Each level has to be solved within a time limit.

meta.name: Krypton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.07 KB

Krypton is a horizontally scrolling, side-view shooter where you control a superhero as the screen constantly scrolls from left to right as you attempt to save the Earth from attacks by super-beings in various levels. You crashed a space shuttle on Earth after a trip from your home planet, but instead of feeling sorry for yourself, you enjoy living here and have vowed to protect your adopted planet from any threat with laser shots from your eyes. One such threat has emerged in the form of super beings intent on destroying you and the Earth by exploiting your weakness, Krypton. You have to move around the screen and shoot the creatures that are throwing krypton at you, while also dodging missiles and shooting more krypton upwards from a ground control pod. If you hit a creature, Krypton, a rocket, or the pod, you lose one of three lives. Occasionally the edge turns blue and that means your girlfriend is falling off a skyscraper. You have to save her before she hits the ground.

meta.name: The Krypton Factor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game you take the role of a contestant in the TV game show The Krypton Factor. The gameplay is divided up into different types of mental skill including Observation in which you are told a story and shown a picture. The story is then told again but with subtle changes along with the picture which alters. You must then type in what text has changed and also what has altered on the picture. There are also mathematical puzzles involving you remembering a sequence and working out the sum quickly as the clock is ticking away. As the game progresses there are also physical tasks to do including moving the Ergobuggy around a course and finishing off with a general knowledge quiz.

meta.name: Kulfon W Krainie Zlego Demona
meta.desc:

Kulfon w krainie złego demona is a platform adventure game. Kulfon's fiancée was kidnapped and imprisoned in the castle. The player must find a way to rescue by using proper objects scattered in the surroundings, in the castle and the underground level. Kulfon may carry up to two items and interact with encountered characters. Fall from a height or swimming without diving equipment means the loss of life.

Puedes controlar a tu personaje con el joystick o el teclado - 18 maniobras diferentes incluyendo paradas, patadas voladoras, barridos de pierna, patadas giratorias, ¡incluso saltos mortales!

This takes place in a side-view beat 'em up similar to Way of the Exploding Fist. Mythical winged and dog-headed monsters and half-human hybrids are your opponents, fought one at a time. You can duck and jump, and the weapon at your disposal can be used for high, middle and low strikes. Containers offering magical powers (both good and bad) can be found and unlocked. Once inside the temple there are more foes to defeat.

Ábrete camino a través de un nivel y comienza el siguiente con un medidor de energía renovado y un temporizador. Una vez que liberas a tu princesa, vuelve al principio donde tus enemigos vuelven más rápido y desagradablemente.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Game was available both as the German original and as an English translation. The story of the game is relatively bleak. After the two brothers Peter and Thomas lost their parents, they moved to a small town and opened a pizzeria there. But even there, after a while, there is no peace, because a gang of protection rackets terrorizes the whole city and demands money from the brothers. When they can no longer pay the increasingly higher protection money, the gang burns down their pizzeria. When they heard about a martial arts tournament in the city shortly afterwards, Peter challenges the leader of the gang: if he defeats him in the tournament, the gang must disappear from the city. But the leader kicks Peter illegally in the head during the fight, and so violently that he dies from it. Thomas swears vengeance on his brother's grave and sets out to free the city from the gang.

After saving the city from a nuclear holocaust, Kevin is promoted to reporter and tasked with investigating Dr. You's mansion. The place feels familiar, though he cannot recall ever being there. The screen layout features images and animations of recent actions and hints about people or objects at the top, a clock, power gauge, score, and exits in the middle, and a command input field at the bottom for interacting with the environment.

Kwik Snax es un juego de acción y reflexión en el que tienes que recoger toda la fruta de un nivel sin que te golpeen los enemigos. El nivel se compone de 2 tipos de bloques: móviles (los cubitos de hielo del primer nivel), o fijos (los copos de nieve del primer nivel). Puedes empujar los bloques móviles para despejar un camino o aplastar a un enemigo. En comparación con otros juegos de este tipo, hay una ventaja: puedes empujar tantos bloques móviles a la vez como quieras, siempre que no haya bloques fijos o frutas bloqueando tu línea de bloques móviles. Es más, puedes mover o empujar bloques a través de los límites del nivel: lo que sale por la izquierda o por la parte inferior de la pantalla reaparece por la derecha o por la parte superior, y viceversa.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.37 KB

In Lady Tut you search underground for Lady Tut's sarcophagus by navigating five mazes, collecting all rings and unlocking doors to proceed. Each door needs a key found within the same maze. Creatures wander the corridors, but later you can obtain a gun to defend yourself. Only those who collect fast, dodge smartly, and strike at the right time will reach the goal.

meta.name: Lancelot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Travel back to the Age of Chivalry when knights were bold, galloping across the countryside and rescuing damsels in distress. Level 9 recreate the time of wizards and the Knights of the Round Table in their greatest adventure yet. Lancelot is a 3-part adventure, spanning the complete saga from the foundation of the Order to its finest hour - the quest for the Holy Grail. Guide Lancelot through his many exploits at Camelot, battle with wayward knights, and win the love of Guinever and Elaine. The challenge which has fascinated treasure hunters through the centuries is now yours - and you'll need all your strength, wit and valor to achieve your goal.

meta.name: Lancer Lords
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.64 KB

Lancer Lords is a single player combat game that has the player jousting with other knights atop an ostrich. Every victory over another knight causes the defeated ostrich to lay an egg before mount and rider disappear in a puff of smoke. These eggs must be destroyed before they hatch into another opponent.
As the game progresses the levels become harder with progressively more ostriches in the arena and shorter hatching times for the eggs.

meta.name: Land of Neverwhere
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.60 KB

In Land of Neverwhere you play a lone mercenary sent to rescue eight stranded space kids hiding in silos near a hostile base. You must guide each kid safely to the planet's right side while avoiding its inhabitants. You can shoot enemies, but contact costs you ego points. If your ego runs out, the mission ends. The kids are defenseless – if they touch an enemy, they're thrown into space and you're sent back to the start. Each rescue is against the clock.

meta.name: Land of the Giants
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.23 KB

Land of the Giants draws on the familiar fairy tale Jack and the Beanstalk and turns it into its own adventure about rescuing two kidnapped children. Rather than simply retelling the original story, the game focuses on puzzles and exploration, which makes its fairy-tale world feel more active and tangible. That combination of a well-known tale and a fresh interpretation gives the adventure much of its appeal. The result is an imaginative journey driven by discovery, problem-solving, and the charm of classic adventure design.

meta.name: The Land
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.92 KB

In “The Land,” players compete for control over a fertile territory. What begins as a peaceful negotiation quickly escalates into betrayal and a struggle for dominance. Players interact, strategize, and vie to claim the land for themselves while defeating their rivals.

meta.name: Lander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.65 KB

"Lander" puts you in the role of an aspiring space commander who must prove flight readiness across four different planets. Viewed from the side, you guide your landing craft through narrow tunnels, use gravity to your advantage, and aim to land precisely on one of three platforms. With limited fuel and sensitive controls, every move counts – land too fast, and you'll crash. Only those who master finesse and timing will earn their wings.

meta.name: Havoc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.58 KB

The Dark Lords have defeated the wizard High Vanish and taken control of the land of Haven. Before his death, he left behind magical items that must now be found by the reptilian man Sador in order to defeat the Dark Lords. Haven is divided into nine areas, including forests, deserts, and villages. After each item is found, a cryptic clue is given for the next one. However, the Dark Lords have sent many monsters to stop Sador. You can shoot them, but if they touch you, your energy bar shrinks. The Lands of Havoc is a maze game viewed from a top-down perspective, featuring two difficulty levels and adjustable game speed.

p: Lane Mastodon vs. the Blubbermen (USA) (Side A).D64
n: Lane Mastodon vs. the Blubbermen (USA) (Side A)

meta.name: Lane Mastadon vs. the Blubbermen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Lane Mastodon vs. the Blubbermen" takes place in the year 2029, as the evil Blubbermen invade Earth. Only the brave Lane Mastodon can stop them, in a setting reminiscent of 1950s science fiction films. The game is part of the so-called InfoComics series and follows the same system as its counterparts. The player reads text and follows the story through comic panels, featuring automatic zooming, panning, and rotation. At certain points, choices must be made that steer the story in different directions.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lapis Philosophorum: The Philosophers' Stone puts you on a quest to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone to save King Gieselmer Gutfried. Poisoned by his impatient stepson who seeks the throne, the childless king's fate – and the future of Alkanien – depends on you. Explore the land, solve puzzles and type commands to guide your hero, with each scene accompanied by a matching illustration.

meta.name: Las Vegas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.44 KB

Las Vegas is a simulation of a three-reel slot machine. To increase the chances of winning, it is possible to hold certain reels (Skill Stop) or nudge them for a certain number of times if permitted; The player can also bet on an existing win. The aim of the game is to win jackpots.
Las Vegas also has a high score table and a number grid.

meta.name: Las Vegas
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Las Vegas Casino
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.73 KB

Las Vegas Casino is a single-player casino simulation. The game brings the atmosphere of a casino floor to the C64, offering faithful digital versions of four popular gambling games: Blackjack, Baccarat, Roulette, and Craps, each presented with clear rules and accessible controls. Blackjack and Baccarat use a first-person viewpoint, placing you directly opposite the dealer, while Roulette and Craps are shown from a top-down perspective that makes betting and table interaction easy to follow. The gameplay focuses on straightforward, pick-up-and-play mechanics with joystick-driven menus and clean layouts, making it easy to jump between games and chase a winning streak without lengthy setup or explanations. While it doesn't push the Commodore 64 technically, Las Vegas Casino succeeds through solid rule implementation and addictive pacing. The presentation is clean and functional, and the variety of games helps maintain long-term interest, especially for casual sessions.

meta.name: Las Vegas Video Poker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.48 KB

With 20 coins in your hand, you approach the electronic poker machine confidently, with the aim of making a killing. There are several winning hands, with a Royal Flush paying out at 250-1, a Royal Flush at 50-1 and Four of a Kind at 20-1. Smaller winnings can be scored with multiple pairs or pairs of 'face cards'. There are five skill levels, and four different values of money to play with. After the initial draw you can choose which cards to hold in the hope of getting the best possible combination together. There is no opponent to play, and thus no bluffing involved.

meta.name: Laser Gun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.54 KB

Laser Gun is a fast reflex game for the Commodore 64 that tests your precision and color awareness. You control a small character who fires a laser at bouncing colored balls – but beware: only the ball that matches the border's color can be shot. Once hit, you must grab it and carry it to the basket in the right corner. All other balls are deadly and will end your game on contact. The goal is to collect and deliver all the correct balls safely – a challenge that demands focus and lightning-fast reactions.

meta.name: Laser Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Laser Squad, controlas a un grupo de soldados que parecen marines espaciales (y a veces cyborgs). Antes de llevarlos a la batalla (vista desde arriba y avanzando por turnos), debes comprarles armas y armaduras con una cantidad predeterminada de créditos, teniendo en cuenta las habilidades individuales de tu escuadrón. Los soldados no ganan experiencia con el tiempo.
Se ofrecen tres misiones:
1: The Assassins: en la que tendrás que enfrentarte a Sterner Regnix y sus guardias.
2: Moonbase Assault: te reta a destruir la base de datos de OmniCorp.
3: Rescue from the Mines : debes evitar la violencia en favor de una misión de rescate.

meta.name: Laser Strike (Isis Hathor)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.45 KB

"Laser Strike" es un juego espacial trepidante en el que recorrerás campos de asteroides mortales, volarás a través de cuevas heladas, recolectarás módulos solares y bombardearás ciudades asteroidales enemigas. En el camino, te encontrarás con peligrosos enemigos y deberás reaccionar con rapidez para sobrevivir. Gráficos y efectos de sonido intensos acompañarán tu explosiva misión espacial.

meta.name: Laser Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Laser Zone puts you in control of two "Zone Gunners" – one on the wall, one on the floor – using a single joystick. You must shoot incoming waves of enemies before they reach the walls, where they become untouchable and close in on you. You can move beyond screen edges, but when enemies reach your zone, things get dangerous. Use an Electric Bolt to wipe the screen in emergencies. Reflexes, awareness, and timing are key to survival.

meta.name: Laserblaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Laserblaster sends you up the city's skyscrapers as a human fly tasked with exterminating troublesome bugs. But you can't actually fly – you must cling to the building walls while blasting the pests with your laser. Caution is vital, as the bugs become vicious once injured. It's a risky balancing act between precision and survival, where every move can mean the difference between victory and a deadly fall.

meta.name: Laserwheel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.86 KB

Laserwheel puts you in the cockpit of a starfighter battling an alien invasion across the eight sectors of the Hyperspace Causeway. You sit at the center of a circular field while aliens and bombs orbit the edge, dodging your attacks and retaliating when hit. Destroyed enemies may split or explode unpredictably, and missed shots bounce back to damage your craft. As you fight, other sectors are simultaneously under siege – their status shown in the Lase Scan on the right. If a bar empties, that sector is lost. Survive the countdown with sectors remaining, and you advance to the next, faster, deadlier wave.

meta.name: The Last Amazon Trilogy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„The Last Amazon Trilogy“ tells the story of a former UNICEF worker who, in the 1990s, vaccinated isolated indigenous tribes in the Amazon rainforest. Armed with a rifle, a bulletproof vest, and a shortwave radio, she vanished for five years without a trace. After her return, she settled in a small desert town in Arizona and found peace in her new life. But a South American drug lord, whose factory she had destroyed, seeks revenge and sends an army of mercenaries to raze the town and kill her. Now she must defend herself and her new home as “The Last Amazon” – one last time.

meta.name: The Last Amazon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.28 KB

„The Last Amazon“ tells the story of a young UNICEF worker who, in the early 1990s, traveled to the remotest rainforests of South America to carry out a vaccination program for isolated indigenous tribes. Armed with a rifle, a bulletproof vest, vaccines and syringes, and a small shortwave radio, she vanished without a trace for five years. Upon her return, she must face the challenges of her experiences.

meta.name: Last Battle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Last Battle es un juego de desplazamiento lateral y uno de los primeros disponibles para Sega Genesis. Básicamente, eres el héroe rebelde que, con una sola mano (o con los pies), luchará contra todo un ejército enemigo por la libertad de su pueblo. Un juego de desplazamiento lateral típico de karateka.

meta.name: Last Chance Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Last Chance Racer throws you back onto the track as a burned-out ex-pro chasing the rush one last time. But the sport has changed – it's no longer a test of finesse, but a brutal, high-speed fight for survival. Dodge water hazards, weave through obstacles, and outlast violent opponents in a race where every second counts. There are no rules, just instinct. One mistake, and it's over. This is racing stripped to its rawest form – fast, fierce, and unforgiving.

meta.name: Last Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Last Duel cuenta la historia de dos planetas en guerra entre sí. En el planeta Bacula, la tribu Galden ha derrocado al gobierno y se ha hecho con el poder de todo el mundo. Ahora invaden el pacífico planeta Mu y secuestran a la reina Sheets.
Los habitantes de Mu han decidido pasar a la acción. Pidieron a sus mejores científicos que desarrollaran un arma capaz de derrotar a los Galdens. Después de muchos meses, consiguieron desarrollar un vehículo con una inmensa potencia de fuego, capaz de saltar en el aire para evitar el peligro en tierra. Además, puede transformarse en una nave aérea cuyo propósito es eliminar a cualquier tipo de enemigo en el cielo.
Los jugadores deben guiar su vehículo a través de seis desafiantes niveles mientras destruyen a todos los Galden a su paso. Disparar a las cápsulas de energía esparcidas por el nivel aumenta la potencia de fuego del jugador.

meta.name: The Last Fight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.22 KB

The Last Fight es un juego de acción de karate donde encarnas a un maestro que debe derrotar a seis rivales progresivamente más difíciles para alcanzar el título de maestro supremo. Cada oponente tiene un estilo único, lo que exige adaptación táctica. Destaca por animaciones fluidas y controles precisos, permitiendo ejecutar golpes, patadas y combinaciones variadas. Sin sistema de puntuación, su desafío radica en niveles sucesivos más profundos que los juegos arcade clásicos, centrados en técnicas típicas del karate.

meta.name: The Last Gladiator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Last Gladiator is an action game where the player becomes a gladiator or a gladiatrix and enters the Colisseum where a number of more or less strange creature have to be fought. Each level starts with the player having to pick up a weapon which is then used to kill the creatures as they enter the arena one at a time.

meta.name: Last Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.52 KB

Tu pueblo te odia y te ha exiliado, pero respeta tus habilidades como piloto de combate. Así que te han enviado a una misión suicida para eliminar a sus enemigos y evitar que te acosen en el futuro.
El juego es un shoot-em-up con desplazamiento multidireccional desde arriba. Tu nave gira pulsando izquierda o derecha. Tu nave está equipada con bombas inteligentes, y su arma básica puede mejorarse recogiendo fichas que los enemigos derribados pueden liberar.

meta.name: The Last Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres el último miembro vivo de tu clan ninja después de que fuera brutalmente masacrado. Ahora buscas vengarte del malvado shogun responsable. The Last Ninja es un juego de acción y aventura ambientado en el Japón medieval. El juego se presenta en una vista isométrica, y el ninja del jugador puede caminar en cuatro direcciones, saltar, luchar contra los enemigos y recoger los objetos necesarios en su camino. Durante la lucha, el ninja puede utilizar varios movimientos diferentes y bloquear ataques. Hay algunas armas que encontrar, como bombas de humo y shurikens.

meta.name: Last Ninja 2 : Back with a Vengeance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El malvado Shogun Kunitoki, una vez vencido pero no destruido, usa sus poderes místicos para transportarse a través del tiempo y establecer un nuevo imperio tiránico en la Manhattan actual. Por temor a los crecientes poderes de Kunitoki, los dioses arcanos usan su sabiduría para traerte al Last Ninja y enfrentrarse a tu enemigo otra vez. ¿Será la batalla final? ¿Podrás eliminar a Kunitoki de una vez por todas?

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En The Last Ninja 3, encarnas a Armakuni, el Último Ninja, quien es arrastrado nuevamente a la lucha contra el malvado Shogun Kunitoki. La batalla transcurre entre los templos del Tíbet, fuente del poder místico de Armakuni. El Shogun busca corromper estos santuarios budistas para aniquilar su energía y debilitar la incipiente hermandad ninja. Armakuni debe impedir su siniestro plan antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

meta.name: Last Ninja Remix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Ninja Remix" is a revised version of "The Last Ninja," in which the player once again takes on the role of Armakuni. During training, he is teleported to modern-day New York, where he must battle his arch-enemy, Shogun Kunitoki. The game features an isometric perspective, various combat techniques, and weapons like shuriken or swords. In addition to fighting, puzzles must be solved and items such as keys or ropes strategically used. The re-release as "The Last Ninja Remix" introduced graphical improvements, a new introduction, and a revised soundtrack.

meta.name: The Last Planet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.38 KB

In The Last Planet, you play as Nick, a space pilot who has crash-landed yet again – but this time on a mysterious alien world with Earth's fate at stake. Having escaped an alien prison and uncovered plans for an invasion of Earth, your mission is to find and repair a spaceship, then escape in time to sound the warning. As a text adventure, the game challenges you to explore, solve puzzles, and survive, using wit, courage, and a bit of reckless luck.

meta.name: The Last Survivor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 61.54 KB

A Uridium clone, space based shoot'em up where you are the commander of a mighty interplanetary spaceship whose mission is to patrol areas of the cosmos where there are enemy alien fleets. Each area gets you closer to the heart of the fleet, and so increases in difficulty.

meta.name: The Last V8
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.96 KB

Seven years have passed since world war III, and only now dare you leave your shelter in order to investigate what has become of the surface world. You drive out in your specially-equipped vehicle, the Last V8, only to discover that the outside world is more hostile than you would have expected. Your task is now (as commended by a digitised voice at the beginning of each level) simply to get back to the base in as short time as possible.
