meta.name: The Last Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Last Warrior you pilot a spacecraft from a 3D-style cockpit perspective while battling enemy ships. As you fly across a futuristic landscape, hostile craft appear ahead and must be destroyed using your weapons. The display shows important information such as score, rockets, altitude and shield strength so you can monitor the condition of your ship. Enemy hits weaken your shields while destroying opponents increases your score. Accurate aiming and quick reactions are essential to survive the attacks.

meta.name: Latent Fusion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this Armalyte clone, you need to pass four levels, each with a boss. In order to advance one level of the game or to reach the goal, all four must be dumped. For a laser volley, the fire button must be held down until the display at the bottom of the screen has fully charged (it then starts to flash). If you then let go of the fire button, the laser beam is fired. When eradicating the opposing rows on the opposite side, a bonus particle occasionally falls off, which the player should collect with his space shuttle. By shooting the bonus field several times, various bonus options are activated. The bonus options can be a protective shield, some upgraded weapon, guns above and below, a rear laser, etc.... You have 10 lives to accomplish your mission.

meta.name: Later
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.28 KB

meta.name: Laurel & Hardy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.70 KB

Laurel & Hardy stars the two famous comedians in their quest to throw cream cakes in each others face. The interface is divided into three horizontal parts: the middle one shows the match statistics and the possessions while the other two represent the town from the side. The first order of business is finding the cream cake shop to get ammo. For finding the way in the big city, it is recommended to purchase a map. Various items on the way may help or bring disadvantages, e.g. a bike to become faster (but are forbidden in certain parts of the city) and liquor bottles (soda is good and beer is bad). After a successful hit a point is rewarded and after one has a certain number of points (can be specified before starting the match) he wins.

meta.name: Law Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.25 KB

“Law Man” is a vertically scrolling shooter with a Western theme that supports cooperative play. Take on the role of a lawman, fight your way through dangerous territories, and overcome enemies. Teamwork and quick reflexes are the keys to success.

meta.name: Law of the West
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Occidente está fuera de control y hay un nuevo sheriff en la ciudad. Mientras paseas por las polvorientas calles de esta ciudad de vaqueros manteniendo la ley en orden, te encuentras con muchos personajes que van desde los pistoleros hasta las damas. Debe usar sus habilidades de conversación para superar cada personaje y, si eso no tiene éxito, es posible que tenga que usar sus habilidades de dibujo rápido y establecer la ley.

meta.name: Lawn Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.08 KB

Lawn Tennis lets the player compete against the computer or another player in a five-set tennis match. The tennis court is displayed from an isometric perspective across the entire screen, and the rules and scoring follow real tennis points. At the beginning, the player can choose from five difficulty levels (one to five).

meta.name: Lazarian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.04 KB

Lazarian puts you in command of a spaceship on rescue missions for stranded vessels. You'll face meteorites, aliens, and flying eyes, all of which threaten to destroy your ship. Sharp shooting and careful dodging are key as each level pushes you further into hostile space.

meta.name: Lazer Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.81 KB

In Lazer Duel, you control a tank and face off against either an opponent or the AI. The game combines classic combat mechanics with puzzle elements. Your goal is to fire your shot in such a way that it bounces off diamond-shaped objects to hit your opponent. Occasionally, you will hit bonus items that grant you points or an extra life. However, be careful, as there's also the risk of hitting yourself. Skill and tactical planning are crucial to winning the duel.

meta.name: Lazer Maze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.80 KB

„Lazer Maze“ is a strategy game where the player must predict the exit point of a laser beam fired into a room filled with mirrors. The game board is a 10 x 10 grid populated with angled mirrors. The player is assigned a starting position for the laser and must determine its exit point. If guessed correctly, a creature at the exit point is hit; if wrong, the monster throws a bomb to destroy the player. The difficulty increases with more mirrors in the room. Points are awarded based on the number of reflections a shot takes, and the final score is calculated once the entire room has been covered with lasers.

meta.name: Lazer Maze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Lazer Maze“ delivers an action-packed competition in split-screen mode, where two players face off against each other. From an overhead view, each player controls their laser, aiming to outsmart and defeat their opponent. The fast-paced gameplay demands strategic thinking and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Lazer Tag
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.90 KB

Similar to paintball, but using infrared guns instead of physical projectiles, laser tag is a non-violent no-contact shooting game. As a cadet in the Lazer Tag Academy your objective is to conquer the laser tag challenges and scale up the ranks. Every level has a time limit to score as much points as possible.

meta.name: Lazer-Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.77 KB

Lazer Force allows you to play four versions of classic arcade games over 32 levels. The first level is a vertically scrolling version of Salamander. You have to avoid flames spouting from the wall and shoot the enemies coming down the screen. The second level is a version of Centipede. Shoot the enemies coming down the screen while shooting flying enemies avoiding hitting mushrooms. The third level is a side view version of Moon Cresta. Let your ship fall and steer it to a re-fuelling point. Pressing the fire button gives you boost as you fight gravity pulling you down. Try to land gently. The fourth level is a top down vertically scrolling game. You must steer your ship through a tunnel avoiding the walls. Holding the fire button speeds up your ship giving you a bigger score. Repeat these levels eight times to complete the game.

meta.name: Lazy Jones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.79 KB

Lazy Jones es una serie de juegos en un solo juego donde debes convertirte en Lazy Jones, el shirker más perezoso y hábil en el negocio cuyas únicas ambiciones son mejorar sus juegos y evitar el trabajo a toda costa. En el hotel Lazy Jones hay 18 habitaciones, la mayoría de las cuales tienen su propio juego de computadora que usted, como Jones, aprovecha cada oportunidad para jugar en lugar de limpiar, ocasionalmente escondiéndose en el armario de la escoba y el inodoro para evitar ser atrapado por su enojado gerente - o el fantasma del gerente anterior - o para evitar toparse con su carrito de limpieza y tener un ataque al corazón al pensar en el trabajo.

meta.name: Le Mans
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.37 KB

"Le Mans" es un juego de carreras de coches en el que debes conducir lo más lejos posible para un tiempo determinado. Al adelantar a otros corredores (de estilo de conducción poco convencional) sin causar un choque, se ganarán puntos (1000 puntos por cada 10 coches). Si se consiguen más de 20.000 puntos antes de que se acabe el plazo, recibirás más tiempo y podrás seguir conduciendo. 
A mayores de la pista habitual, debes dominar la conducción sobre hielo, en curvas, de noche y en autopistas. Si chocas, debes retornar hasta el garaje (PIT), que se encuentra a la izquierda de la pista, lo que cuesta unos valiosos segundos, además, el número de coches adelantados se establecerá en cero.

meta.name: Le Parc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Le Parc you face a large playfield that must be filled with matching symbol tiles under time pressure – but simple rules don't make it easy. Each tile must match its neighbors in shape or color, requiring careful planning with every move. You quickly realize that careless placement can block your progress, while smart organization gives you the upper hand. The combination of time pressure, strategy, and increasing complexity keeps challenging your thinking until the very end.

meta.name: Leaderboard Executive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Leaderboard Executive“ is another entry in the „Leaderboard Golf“ series, following „Leaderboard“ and „Leaderboard Tournament.“ The golfer's controls remain the same, but some graphical and gameplay changes have been introduced. Bunkers and trees add more challenges, and two golf courses are available, which can be played with up to three friends, offering between 18 and 72 holes.

meta.name: Leaderboard Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Leaderboard Golf“ marks the beginning of Access' long line of golf simulations. The shot starts by holding the fire button to set the power, then pressing it again to apply a hook or slice if needed. The greens are sloped, so this should be taken into account when planning shots. Four 18-hole courses are available, which can be combined freely in a 4-round match with up to four players. There are three difficulty levels: novices only need to choose the right speed, direction, and club. Amateurs must also time their shot precisely to control the ball's curve—conventional golf wisdom suggests eliminating unwanted spin before intentionally applying it—while the professional level introduces wind fluctuations as an additional challenge.

meta.name: League Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.16 KB

A football management game where you take over one of 64 clubs and try to lead them to glory. You start with only 11 players and the maximum is 15. So you will be happy to sign new players and you will get this opportunity after each one Game when a player is offered and their skills and form are displayed. You can teach your players to improve these skills and sell players you don't rate particularly well.
Matches are played in a series of short animations with the home team wearing red and the away team wearing blue. At full time you will be told how many injuries there were. The league season consists of 15 games, one against each team, with the top two teams promoted.

meta.name: League Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.58 KB

League Football is a football management game where you must lead a team from the fourth division to winning the first division and other trophies. You have various options to support your path to success, including selecting players and formations, coaching, and buying and selling players. Once you're satisfied with your decisions, the game moves to the match highlights. It starts with a text screen showing a clock counting down to the 90th minute. If an incident occurs in the penalty area, the screen switches to an animation showing the penalty area from a top-down view. If a chance is missed or a goal is scored, the game returns to the text screen. During the highlights, you can make changes to your players.

meta.name: League Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.73 KB

League Soccer is a football management game that puts you in the role of a manager guiding a team through league and cup competitions. You can choose from 92 English league clubs and must manage your squad, handle contracts, and keep a close eye on finances. Weekly expenses such as wages and bonuses strain your budget, and poor decisions or excessive debt can end your career abruptly. The goal is to use smart planning, transfers, and tactics to lead your team to the top and claim trophies.

meta.name: Leaping Larry
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.19 KB

In Leaping Larry you take on the role of a determined caveman on a dangerous rescue mission after your bride-to-be is kidnapped. You make your way through winding caves, avoiding traps and creatures while searching each screen for the key to progress. Careful timing of jumps and smart crouching are essential as hostile tribesmen fire arrows at you. Every mistake costs a life, making precision and focus the key to success.

meta.name: Learn The Alphabet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Show Perry the Penguin which letters to load onto the trucks. Then the construction of the alphabet city begins. Here come the trucks for another load of letters! And that means you have a job to do. Perry the penguin needs your help finding the matching letters. Use him to climb to the letter floor, where you can search the alphabet. Do you need an uppercase letter or a lowercase letter? Which truck should it go on? Every time you fill the trucks, they go to the construction site and build more of the alphabet city. Learn the Alphabet starts with letter recognition games and then moves on to simple spelling challenges like filling in the missing letters.
Learn the Alphabet helps develop an understanding of uppercase and lowercase letters as well as letter and word recognition.

meta.name: Learn To Add
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Learn to Add is an educational game designed for children ages 3-7. The object of the game is to complete a rainbow by solving number problems. On each turn, you first select a number from 1 to 9. The computer will then present a problem involving that number along with several groups of balloons of varying quantities. You then need to guide an animal over to the group of balloons which has the same number of balloons as the number that would solve the problem. On easier skill levels, you just need to select the group of balloons that matches the number selected. Tougher skill levels present addition problems where you need to fill in the blank. Each time you answer correctly, part of a rainbow appears on the screen. Complete the rainbow, and you win!

meta.name: Learn To Spell
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Learn to Spell is an educational game for 1 player.
The player controls a dolphin that collects fragments of three-letter words and brings them back to a submarine. The submarine indicates either the beginning or the end of words, and as the player forms words, dots appear on the submarine. When all submarine points are met, the player descends to a lower level.

meta.name: Charles Goren : Learning Bridge Made Easy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Charles Goren: Learning Bridge Made Easy” is a Bridge tutorial tool for your computer. Based on the works of renowned Bridge columnist Charles Goren, the game aims to teach players improved Bridge-playing techniques. The software assists players with hand evaluation, bidding, and direct competition. Gameplay includes multiple quizzes where players answer questions about point valuation or decide on the best next move. Additionally, there are 100 pre-defined hands that players must play through, selecting the optimal moves. Incorrect decisions prompt corrective feedback, helping players refine their skills.

meta.name: Learning with Leeper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Learning with Leeper, eliges entre cuatro juegos de aprendizaje moviendo a Leeper a un ícono. En uno, relacionas huesos con el número de perros del lateral. En otro, identificas símbolos, letras, formas o palabras coincidentes de una selección. Si te equivocas, la respuesta correcta parpadea brevemente. El tercer juego te permite explorar un laberinto aleatorio con la ayuda de una oruga. El cuarto te permite colorear escenas como casas, montañas o personas: sin presión, solo diversión.

meta.name: Leather Goddesses of Phobos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Leather Goddesses of Phobos es un juego de aventuras basado en texto. Está dirigido principalmente a un público adulto, y al principio del juego es posible establecer el nivel de "contenido sugerido". El juego está ambientado en 1936, y eres capturado por las Leather Goddesses (Diosas del Cuero) para realizar pruebas que servirán para transformar la Tierra en un gran centro dedicado a su propio placer.

meta.name: Leather Goddesses of Phobos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Leather Goddesses of Phobos es un juego de aventuras basado en texto. meta.name: L.E.D. Storm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En L.E.D. Storm compites en autopistas futuristas del año 2011, ideales para amantes de la velocidad. La carretera, con scroll vertical, te lanza curvas, saltos y rivales que puedes aplastar con saltos bien sincronizados. En bifurcaciones al estilo Out Run, debes elegir ruta al instante. Recoge bonificaciones: puntos, energía o un ariete para impactos más potentes. Si caes, un cabrestante guiado te permite recuperar el coche y continuar.

meta.name: Legacy of the Ancients
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Legacy of the Ancients begins with a young shepherd who stumbles upon a corpse and unknowingly sets off on a grand adventure. A black disk, a bracelet, and a scroll lead him to the Galactic Museum, where he learns he must destroy the Wizard's Compendium. Gaining access to museum exhibits requires special coins earned through combat, quests, or purchases. Progression comes not from experience points, but from completing tasks. Towns and overworlds are top-down, while dungeons and the museum are in 3D. Minigames improve attributes, casinos offer risky profits, and robbing banks draws the city guards' attention.

p: Legend of Blacksilver, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: Legend of Blacksilver, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.name: The Legend of Blacksilver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Legend of Blacksilver you take on the role of a hero chosen by fate to save the kingdom of Bantross. Princess Aylea appears to you in a dream, pleading for you to rescue her father, King Durek, from the clutches of the power-hungry Baron Taragas, who has uncovered Blacksilver – an artifact of immense power. With a falcon feather as proof of your mission, you embark on an epic quest filled with magic, intrigue, and ancient secrets. Its refined interface and deep RPG mechanics make it a worthy successor to Legacy of the Ancients.

meta.name: The Legend of Kage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.21 KB

Juegas como Kage, un hábil ninja en busca de rescatar a la princesa Kiri de las manos del señor de la guerra Yoshi. Armado sólo con una espada y 'estrellas ninja', debes pelear a través de innumerables secuaces y el jefe ocasional para completar tu misión. Los niveles incluyen el bosque, foso, dentro y fuera del castillo. Estos niveles se repiten a medida que cambian las estaciones. La jugabilidad es desplazamiento lateral. Los movimientos de Kage incluyen la habilidad de saltar muy alto en el aire, agarrar y trepar árboles, bloquear y atacar con su espada, y lanzar shuriken. El juego puede ser un desafío, porque mueres de un golpe. Se puede jugar a 2 jugadores, pero es por turnos.

meta.name: The Legend of Sinbad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 59.37 KB

The Legend of Sinbad casts you as the famous sailor kidnapped by the evil Sultan Salabim. You must first escape his dungeon before confronting him in a final showdown. The game spans five levels: escape from the prison, defeat guards behind doors, protect a camel caravan in the desert, battle flying enemies on a magic carpet, and finally face the Sultan himself – now transformed into a dragon. Touching enemies, being hit, or running out of time costs lives – precision and timing are key.

meta.name: Legend of the Amazon Women
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.73 KB

„Legend of the Amazon Women“ tells the story of Lady Wilde, who has survived a plane crash deep in the Amazon jungle. Her child, Penelope, is missing, and the only clue points to a mysterious tribe of Amazons rumored to inhabit the region. Convinced that they have kidnapped her child, she sets off on a dangerous journey, armed with a club, determined to get Penelope back. As she moves through the jungle, she must defend herself against armed Amazons who attack her while she fights her way forward.

p: Legend of the Apache Gold, The (Europe).T64
n: Legend of the Apache Gold, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Legend of the Apache Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.65 KB

There is a legend that when an Indian Chief dies, he is buried with his gold. You, Luke Warme, sitting in the Skintsville Saloon have just heard that a Indian Chief has just died. With no money, meaning no drink, you decide to find his burial place and see if the legend is true. Aboard your wagon after feeding your horse, a flick of the reins moves you on. But you are ambushed by Indians and held captive in a tent. Thus the beginning of your adventure.
The game is viewed and played as a graphic text adventure. A picture shows your location with a text description of the surroundings. You must type in your actions and solve whatever puzzle the game has thrown at you.

meta.name: The Legend of the Knucker-Hole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.99 KB

Legend of the Knucker-Hole Starring Jet-Boot Jack is a sequel to the game Jet-Boot Jack where once again you play the role of Jack in this platformer trying to rescue a Princess. A dragon has kidnapped the King's only daughter and so you must traverse downwards in the Dragon's home, a Knucker-Hole and attempt to kill the dragon and lead the princess to safety.

meta.name: Legion of the Damned
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.38 KB

Legion of the Damned lets you hack and slash your way through a village overrun by undead horrors. Play as the fast-attacking Amazon or the long-range axe-throwing Barbarian – though he starts with fewer lives. Alone or with a friend, you side-scroll through waves of abominations in classic arcade style. Simple story, brutal action – just kill everything that shouldn't be moving.

meta.name: Legion of the Damned II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.60 KB

Legion of the Damned II puts you in the boots of Detectives Starr and Michael as they battle through a modern city overrun by vampire gangs under the revived queen Stryxia. After her blood-soaked resurrection, Stryxia has twisted the criminal underworld into her personal army. You'll fight through three brutal stages – the inner city, industrial zone, and outskirts – in a desperate push to find her lair and end the nightmare. Grit, guns, and guts are your only hope.

meta.name: Legionaire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.50 KB

“Legionaire” puts you in the role of Caesar, commanding up to ten Roman legions against numerically superior barbarian forces in a campaign to conquer Gaul. Starting with just a few units, including cavalry and Caesar's elite legion – the strongest on the battlefield – you'll need to outmaneuver the enemy using terrain and Roman discipline. Each battle plays out in real time, requiring sharp tactics and quick decisions. Though your legions are powerful, only through clever positioning and strategic planning can you overcome the hordes. The campaign becomes increasingly difficult, making this an early and demanding real-time strategy classic.

meta.name: Legions of Death
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.17 KB

Legions of Death is a menu-driven strategy game set during the Punic Wars, fought between the Roman Republic and Carthage (264 to 146 BCE). What stands out is that it focuses on naval warfare. While Greeks built their ships for ramming attack, Romans - lacking experience in sailing - developed new boarding tactics to exploit their strong infantry. Contrary to game advertisement the single player mode only allows you to play as Carthaginians, Roman side is available only in two player mode.
nnFirst design your ships (from a modest bireme up to impressive septireme, add boarding ramps, towers, sails), crew them (slaves, archers, marines) and finally deploy the galleys on a top-down map of the central Mediterranean. In turns, maneuver your vessels, conquer the coastal cities to collect tax and repair your ships, then return the gold to your capital. The first side to meet victory conditions (treasury size, cities held, ships sunk) is the winner.

meta.name: LEM
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "LEM," the player pilots a lunar landing module, inspired by the Apollo Lunar Module, with the goal of safely landing on the Moon's surface. Subsurface hazards must be avoided to successfully complete the mission. Precise control and skillful navigation are crucial to bringing the module safely to its destination.

meta.name: Lemmings
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tu tarea consiste en rescatar a los Lemmings en 120 niveles de acertijos vertiginosos. Estas criaturas simplemente caminan a ciegas por el mundo con la esperanza de alcanzar la seguridad al final del nivel; desafortunadamente, estos niveles incluyen caídas pronunciadas, huecos en el suelo, barreras y ríos, entre otros peligros.

meta.name: Lemon Blues
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Puzzler in which you must line up the lemons next to each other to beat each level. But all is not as simple as it sounds. That's Bodo with the excavator, and he's still excavating, "it sounds like every year at many carnival events. At Lemon Blues you take on the role of a bulldozer driver. Your goal? Very easily! You have to line up the three yellow lemons with the help of the purple fruits (horizontally or vertically). You can control your excavator with the joystick in port # 2. Also: Lemon movement Move to the fruit and press fire. The fruit will stop at the next wall or the next lemon. Destroying the purple lemon First press fire and then in the direction where the purple lemon is. Attention! It must be on a wall or another lemon. Destroying the Enemies One hit with a lemon is enough to kill these fellows. After each level you will receive a code word that you can enter again the next time you start.

meta.name: Lenitive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lenitive is a futuristic duel shoot'em-up where you battle either a second player or the C64 itself. Two floating fighters engage in intense shootouts in a stylized space setting above a surreal landscape. Quick reflexes, timing and precision are key to taking down your opponent and advancing to higher levels. The visual style is minimalist yet atmospheric – perfect for fast, competitive bouts.

meta.name: Leonardo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En este juego de rompecabezas de arriba abajo, debes ayudar a Leonardo, un ladrón de poca monta, en sus movimientos criminales. Usa tu joystick para guiar a Leonardo a través de 50 niveles diferentes, incluyendo bancos, museos y almacenes. Al pulsar el botón de disparo de tu joystick, puedes empujar todo lo que esté en tu camino, excepto las paredes. Los objetos empujados no se detendrán hasta que choquen con otros objetos o con el oficial de policía y su fantasmal ayudante que intentan detener tus robos. Cada nivel es más grande que la pantalla, en la mitad inferior de la pantalla tienes un útil radar para orientarte. Si te quedas sin tiempo o te atrapa la policía, perderás una de tus cinco vidas. Si consigues dominar los diez primeros niveles, recibirás una contraseña con la que podrás empezar la siguiente partida directamente en ese nivel.

meta.name: Leopard Lord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.15 KB

Leopard Lord is an adventure game set in and around a castle filled with monsters, mazes, and magical items. Your task is to find the correct items before facing FORDEL, the powerful Leopard Lord. One mistake is fatal—there are no second chances.

meta.name: Leppard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Leppard you control a diamond-collecting robot navigating dangerous mazes where every move matters – your goal is to gather enough gems to progress. However, hostile enemies constantly pursue you, waiting for the right moment to catch you. You must dodge cleverly, plan your routes, and use bombs at the right time to gain some breathing room. With tight time limits, you're forced to make quick decisions under pressure. Even defeated enemies return, turning the challenge into an ongoing fight for survival.

meta.name: Lethal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.13 KB

Lethal drops you onto the hostile planet Stank after ejecting from your crashing Star Hopper, forcing you to complete the journey to the spaceport on foot. What seems simple quickly turns deadly – the planet shakes, lava flows, and hostile natives attack with arrows and killer bouncing balls. Ammo can be found at marked blocks, but your weapon only fires when you jump, demanding perfect timing. You can carry just ten rounds, so make every shot count, leap over lava pits, and fight your way to safety at the spaceport.

meta.name: Lethal Bombs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lethal Bombs delivers classic Bomberman-style chaos with a dark twist. You place bombs to destroy all targets and ghosts, but beware – as long as one target remains, a new ghost appears for each one you destroy. Those that can respawn return stronger and deadlier. The clock is always ticking, and when time runs out, you'll need divine mercy. Tense, explosive, and unforgiving – a game where every second counts.

meta.name: Lethal Combat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Lethal Combat" is a hidden mini-game that is integrated into the Commodore 64 game "Flummi's World", released in 1994. It can be unlocked by entering the password "Substance" in the main menu of "Flummi's World". In "Lethal Combat", the player takes control of a spaceship and has to fight through waves of enemy units. The gameplay is reminiscent of classic shoot-'em-up games and offers an additional challenge within the main game.

meta.name: Lethal II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.94 KB

Lethal II continues the chaotic adventure of its predecessor, this time in a modern side-scrolling format. Once again, you guide your brave hero across perilous platforms, dodging obstacles and battling through hostile terrain. The game feels similar to Bounder, except that the action scrolls horizontally instead of vertically. Precision and quick reflexes are key to survival – a fast-paced return to the unmistakable charm of the original.

meta.name: Lethal Weapon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en la saga cinematográfica, en este juego encarnas a Martin Riggs o Roger Murtaugh para superar cuatro misiones principales —más una final— eligiendo al agente más adecuado en cada caso. Recorres Los Ángeles caminando, saltando y nadando, mientras pateas o disparas para detener el crimen: infiltrarte en el muelle para frustrar el traslado de dinero de narcos; neutralizar terroristas suicidas en el metro; desactivar una bomba en un centro comercial; rescatar al rehén Leo Getz en un edificio de oficinas; y, por último, descubrir y detener a un exsargento de policía que provee balas perforantes a criminales locales.

meta.name: Lethal Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lethal Zone is a fast-paced horizontal shooter that throws you into relentless space battles. You pilot your ship through tight passages, dodging enemy fire and blasting hostile formations with precise shots. Holding and releasing the fire button unleashes powerful charged bursts, while rapid tapping fires a steady stream. Defeated foes drop power-ups that enhance and modify your weapon strength. You begin with five lives and earn another every 50,000 points. Four intense levels with striking boss enemies demand sharp focus and lightning-fast reflexes.

Leviathan se desarrolla en paisajes isométricos de ciencia ficción en los que hay que destruir a todos los enemigos. El jugador controla una nave espacial y tiene que volar a través de tres niveles (con la posibilidad de girar y cambiar la altura de vuelo). Además de enemigos voladores, también hay estaciones de defensa terrestres que destruir. Aunque la munición es ilimitada, el combustible debe rellenarse regularmente aterrizando junto a una cápsula de combustible. Tres bombas inteligentes que destruyen todo lo que hay en la pantalla pueden utilizarse en situaciones peligrosas. Cada nivel tiene un límite de tiempo.

meta.name: Lex Feareon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.81 KB

Lex Feareon is an action game where you control six gyrocopters through caves, avoiding numerous obstacles such as massive blocks, falling weights, cave walls, and trolley carts. Each collision causes you to lose a life and restart the current level. The game requires quick reflexes and precise control, as the right timing is crucial to navigate the obstacles and complete the levels. The challenge increases with each level, testing your ability to stay focused and react swiftly to the ever-present dangers.

meta.name: 007 : Licence to Kill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.59 KB

"License to Kill" es un juego multinivel y multirol: controlas helicópteros, barcos y petroleros, realizas acrobacias mortales con paracaídas y te lanzas al mar para practicar esquí acuático descalzo. Se necesita puntería y fuego firmes: dispara con precisión y elimina a los malos. Está lleno de acción y sigue de cerca las últimas aventuras del agente secreto mejor guardado del mundo en la nueva y más emocionante película de todas. James Bond en Licencia para Matar... ¡ya disponible en tu pantalla chica!

meta.name: Lifeboat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.69 KB

Lifeboat is based on true events – the sinking of the clipper Alana in 1927 off the coast of Australia. Only five of the 82 people on board survived, and you experience the story through the eyes of one of them. Adrift in a small lifeboat with others, surrounded by fog on the open sea, your choices determine how you deal with fellow survivors, use resources, and whether you can endure the days ahead. Conversation, observation, and wise actions are key to your fate.

meta.name: Lifeforce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lifeforce tells the story of a desperate mission in a devastated world where a malfunctioning power station has given rise to sentient machines and left cities uninhabitable. Fighting massive nuclear-powered creatures and hostile aliens, you advance in a tank to gradually regain control of the area. The objective is to capture key components from your enemies while navigating a scrolling environment filled with threats from every direction. Multiple weapons, limited energy and a fragile shield demand tactical thinking, as only careful planning, precise attacks and timely retreats can open the path to reclaiming the city.

meta.name: Life Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En una remota región del universo nació Zelos, una criatura alienígena cuyo apetito creció sin cesar, devorando cientos de galaxias, planetas y estrellas. Ahora tu planeta ha entrado en su trayectoria, y tú —junto a un compañero— debes alzar el vuelo para salvarlo. Life Force es un trepidante shooter basado en el arcade original, con seis niveles que alternan entre scroll lateral y vertical, cada uno culminando en un guardián poderoso. Al destruir ciertos enemigos obtienes potenciadores: armas más potentes, mayor velocidad y escudos. Admite uno o dos jugadores simultáneos.

meta.name: Lifeform
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lifeform places you in a dark future where an alien organism has wiped out all life on a distant planet. Sent as the last hope, you explore hostile locations and make choices that shape your progress. The focus is on atmosphere, exploration, and gradually uncovering what truly happened – every new situation requires careful thought, as the next decision may determine success or failure.

meta.name: Life-Term
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.52 KB

Eres Jake Stalin y has sido acusado injustamente de asesinato. Como castigo, te han enviado a un planeta llamado Souzel y te han encomendado la tarea de convertir los residuos de una docena de planetas circundantes en materias primas. Aquí vivirá hasta que muera. ¿Podrás escapar de este planeta o pasarás el resto de tu vida reciclando residuos ajenos?
Life-Term es un juego de aventuras de texto ilustrado en el que puedes ver una imagen de tu entorno mientras lees un texto que describe lo que ves. Escribe comandos para resolver puzzles y completar tareas.

meta.name: Light Cycles v3.2b
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.09 KB

In "Light Cycles V3.2b" you control a light motorcycle that leaves a glowing trail, similar to the ones in the "Tron" film series. The goal is to survive as long as possible by avoiding collisions with walls or your own trail.

meta.name: Lightforce

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El sistema Regulus ha sido atacado por fuerzas alienígenas, y tú eres el único caza terrícola capaz de limpiar la zona y rescatar a los rehenes.
Este shoot 'em up con scroll vertical tiene 5 niveles: primero debes atravesar las defensas para acceder al sector alienígena; luego enfrentas planetas de selva, hielo y desierto, hasta alcanzar el complejo final enemigo. Los enemigos presentan patrones y formaciones de ataque variados, además de diseños coloridos y diversos.

meta.name: Limes + Napoleon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Limes + Napoleon“ is a competition between two robots that must complete various skill exercises. The winner will be used to search for valuable metals on distant planets, while the loser will be discarded. The goal is to maneuver the glowing „Glidstar“ into the opponent's goal. However, the opponent can hook in to knock the rival down and take control of the Glidstar. Additionally, „Bufo“ acts as a troublemaker, knocking both robots off their feet. The game is primarily designed for two players but can also be played against the computer. Each robot has a spare body, which the player can switch control of at any time

meta.name: Lincoln
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Lincoln" tells the story of a supercomputer created to rule mankind peacefully after all wars had ended. But its designer secretly integrated his own brain to gain power. Years later, Lincoln becomes a fortress, enslaving humanity and demanding sacrifices. As the leader of a 90-man rebel unit, you launch a multi-stage mission: infiltrate the system via hidden pods, shoot down defense systems, navigate caves and cities, decode gates with wooden flute-playing beings, and finally inject nine computer viruses into Lincoln to destroy him and liberate humanity.

meta.name: Line of Fire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Line of Fire es un shooter en primera persona inspirado en Operation Wolf. Estás atrapado tras las líneas enemigas y tienes que escapar a toda costa. A lo largo de 8 niveles, dispararás al menor indicio de presencia enemiga. Las situaciones son variadas, y tienes que salir del campo de visión de un francotirador o tomar el control de barcos, por ejemplo. Además, tu viaje te llevará de la jungla a la base enemiga o a una ciudad en ruinas.

meta.name: Linking Leroy Visits Legoland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.59 KB

“Linking Leroy Visits LEGOLAND” was an unreleased game for the Commodore 64. It was a 2D platformer with two levels themed around “Town” and “Classic Space.” Originally intended as a connector between scenes in the “LEGOLAND 2” demo by Fairlight, development ceased after a 1992 preview following the end of collaboration with LEGO. Planned modifications to remove LEGO graphics and complete the game were ultimately abandoned.

meta.name: Linking Logic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.80 KB

Linking Logic is an educational game where children guide Buddy or Betty through a five-story building from top to bottom. With help from Billie the Bird, you place bridges, walls, ladders, and springs to create a safe path. No gaps are allowed, and all patterned tiles must be collected along the way. If a tile is missing when the child reaches the ground floor, the game is lost. Each level brings new challenges that encourage logical thinking, planning, and pattern recognition – all in a playful format designed for imaginative learning.

meta.name: Linus vs Simon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.99 KB

In "Linus vs Simon," two players face off in a strategic board game. The goal is to complete boxes by drawing lines. When a player completes a box with four lines, they earn a point and can draw another line. The game ends when the entire board is filled, and the player with the most marked boxes, represented by stars, wins. A tactical duel requiring quick thinking and foresight!

meta.name: Lions of the Universe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lions of the Universe is a side-scrolling space adventure where you fight your way through maze-like areas. You collect freely placed tokens to upgrade your weapons while facing enemies that attack both in waves and individually.

meta.name: Little Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.72 KB

In "Little Adventure," the player awakens as a robot inside a fueling sphere with no apparent exits. Due to a power outage, the robot remembers only its identity. The goal is to escape the sphere by discovering clues and solving puzzles. The path to freedom requires careful exploration and logical thinking.

meta.name: Little Blue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Little Blue," the player controls a small character tasked with collecting puzzle pieces. However, touching any other objects results in the loss of a life. The game is challenging, requiring precision and quick reflexes to succeed.

meta.name: Little Computer People
meta.desc:

Little Computer People te permite ver cómo un hombre y su perro viven su vida en su casa. El hombre actúa como cualquier otra persona en su vida diaria, pero también puedes interactuar con él jugando a las cartas, por ejemplo. También puedes darle instrucciones y a veces te enviará cartas en las que describe cómo vive y si es feliz. Se considera un precursor de los Sims.

In The Little Dragon, you control a small dragon as it navigates scrolling levels, collecting stars along the way. You must avoid various dangers like owl-bats, bees, flying saucers, and other monsters. Your goal is to collect as many stars as possible while progressing through each level, all while dodging the many obstacles and enemies that stand in your way. The game challenges your reflexes and timing, offering a fun and fast-paced adventure for players of all skill levels.

You are the King of the Little Green Men and you have just escaped from your captors but you are now stranded on this strange alien world. You play the role of the King as you attempt to meet up with your spaceship in this scrolling platform game where the screen scrolls when you move. There are various creatures and hazards that need avoiding and if you touch any then you lose one of three lives. As you progress you come across check-points and when you die you start from the last one you walked through.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Little Icarus

You control Icarus who is trying to catch up with his father Daedalus. You must fly through the lands of Greece avoiding various creatures such as birds and bees while trying to catch up with your father. There is an energy bar at the top of the screen that increases faster the higher you are in the air. So if you fly close to the ground it will slow down. Clouds move from left to right at the top of the screen, increasing your energy bar when you touch them. On the ground, as well as on buildings, ships and trees, there is a cat that moves across the ground and occasionally jumps when you are close to the ground. When you touch a creature, you are moved down a short distance. When you hit the ground or objects, or your energy bar fills up, you lose one in five lives.

meta.name: Little People Bowling Alley
meta.desc:

Can you knock down all six pins with one ball? No gutter balls for you! The computer can keep score or, as an added feature, the player can learn to ad his score in the manual scoring phase.

meta.name: Little Puff in Dragonland
meta.desc:

Puff es un pobre dragoncito que decide explorar el mundo más allá de su hogar: Dragonlandia. Por desgracia, se ha perdido y quiere volver a casa. Puff es demasiado pequeño para ir solo en esta aventura, así que tienes que guiarlo a través de muchos niveles, resolviendo puzzles, evitando trampas y encontrando las cuatro partes del pase para volver a Dragonland.

meta.name: Little Sara Sister

"Little Sara Sister" is a game inspired by "The Great Giana Sisters" and can be considered a sort of prelude to the "LSS" series. The game features two short levels and a simpler soundscape compared to later installments. Released as part of the Minigame Competition 2004, it captures the nostalgic charm of classic platformers.

"Little Sara Sister 1.5" is part of the "Little Sara Sister" trilogy and features nine levels inspired by "The Great Giana Sisters" games. The game offers an improved and tailored soundscape compared to the first installment.

"Little Sara Sister 2" is the final installment of the trilogy, offering a classic gaming experience with new challenges. The game continues Sara's adventures, combining nostalgic charm with a lovingly crafted world.

"Little Sara Sister Trilogy" is a revised and expanded collection of the three standalone games in the series: "Little Sara Sister," "Little Sara Sister 1.5," and "Little Sara Sister 2." Players explore approximately 50 unique locations, including caves, Antarctica, and an Egyptian pyramid. A menu allows the selection of the desired game before starting.

meta.name: Live and Let Die
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.51 KB

Live and Let Die puts you into a high-speed chase on the water where you pilot a motorboat and try to travel as far as possible before fuel runs out. At intense speed you navigate tight sections, avoid obstacles and shoot at enemy units, while the game delivers a strong sense of motion and urgency. Constant focus is required, as a single mistake can quickly end the run, and only skillful steering combined with precise shooting allows you to push further.

meta.name: Liverpool : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.91 KB

Arc Developments converted their football game to the Commodore 64 using a top-down view very similar to Kick Off. Options are otherwise virtually identical, with cup and full season options over a variable match length, although player profiles feature basic statistics instead of textual information, and you can play shorter matches than in the 16-bit version. Gameplay is also very similar, with one-touch passing and fairly close ball control, although the control of free kicks is less precise in this version.

meta.name: James Bond 007 : The Living Daylights - The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.96 KB

El agente 007, el conocido James Bond, vuelve a la acción. De nuevo algún pérfido personaje ha aparecido en el mundo del crimen. Y, esta vez, se trata de alguien digno de la intervención del famoso agente. En esta ocasión, el agente británico debe hacer alarde de su inteligencia y sus cualidades físicas y se verá envuelto en numerosas aventuras para poder llegar hasta donde se encuentra el peligroso traficante Brad Whittaker. Éstas transcurren en lugares dispares como Gibraltar y Afganistán, pasando por otros como Viena, Tánger? Contará con la ayuda del general Koskov, agente doble del KGB, al que tendrá que proteger, tarea que, cómo no, llevará acabo con perfecto éxito, tras sobrevivir a algún que otro intento de asesinato. No obstante éste deberá ser vigilado por Bond para no ser traicionado. Pero Bond descubrirá que el general está aliado con Whittaker traficante de armas y opio, lo que modificará en parte sus órdenes. Cuando 007 haya destruido a las fuerzas de Whittaker y sus esbirros habrá terminado la misión, y la bella Kara le estará esperando.

meta.name: Living in a Maze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Living in a Maze” places you in a labyrinth of confusing corridors that you must escape to avoid missing an important job opportunity. Your arch-nemesis has trapped you in a rotating capsule and locked you in this maze to stop you. Collect keys to open doors, but be cautious—some walls are illusions. Traps are everywhere, some deadly and others transporting you to another part of the labyrinth. Find the exit and overcome all obstacles. Good luck!

meta.name: Livingstone, I Presume?
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.94 KB

Tu eres el famoso explorador, Stanley, y debes encontrar al Dr. Livingstone en una jungla repleta de trampas. Serpientes, monos lanzadores de cocos y pozos son parte de los "placeres" de tu viaje. Usaras un cuchillo, una pertiga, granadas y un boomerang para despejar tu camino.

meta.name: Load 'n Play
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.17 KB

Load'n Play was originally designed as a small extra to keep you entertained while your Mastertronic game was loading from tape. As the full title slowly filled the memory, you could play this mini-game in the meantime. It was included on several Bulldog releases such as Street Beat, offering a simple but fun distraction to make the loading wait more enjoyable.

meta.name: Loco
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.40 KB

Loco is a side view horizontal scrolling game where the screen scrolls from left to right constantly as you control a steam locomotive trying to collect flags over five levels. The main playing area has you looking at your locomotive as it pulls away from a station and you must blast and destroy the various vehicles that are planes, airships and trains, when their cross your path. Below the main playing area is a map of the various tracks that can be driven on and you use up or down to change tracks when they meet.

meta.name: Loco (Coplin Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Loco" challenges you to master everything at once. Using two joysticks, you control your train, switch tracks to avoid oncoming trains and bombs, and shoot smoke or steam to better handle obstacles. At the same time, you need to keep an eye on the track layout to reach your destination and refill your fuel supply. Teamwork might be the key to success.

meta.name: Locomotion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.58 KB

“Locomotion” takes you back to the Wild West, where you play as a train engineer collecting gold trucks to deliver to the bank – across two game modes with varying control over speed and track switching, you couple trains, fix obstacles, evade bandits, avoid ghost trains and keep an eye on fuel and water, making every switch of the rails a choice between fortune and disaster.

meta.name: Locomotion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Locomotion is an arcade-puzzle game in which you are presented with a top-down view of a railway network with a number of stations and junctions. Trains are released from stations at random intervals, each with a destination station. Your job is to get a set number of them to this destination within a time limit.
You control a cursor which can click on each of the junctions, toggling their positions. When trains reach a junction which is not set in a direction they can move through, they will stop until you move it. When they reach the wrong station they simply reverse and continue. If two trains make contact, they are lost, and a penalty is accrued.

meta.name: Locomotive Switcher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A train-yard strategy game. You can choose to play the Flat Yard version or the Hump Yard version. Locomotive Switcher brings and operating railroad layout to the Commodore 64 compute screen. The micro-layout consists of mainline, six switches and seven loading areas. Sophisticated car motion logic simulates train movements to a degree not possible on "real" model railroad layouts.

meta.name: Lode Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El emblemático juego Lode Runner ha originado una saga y ha servido de inspiración a innumerables títulos. La acción en estado puro se mezcla con los enrevesados niveles, mientras recoges oro y evitas a los robots enemigos haciendo agujeros en el suelo. Usa la cabeza y tus reflejos para completar los puzles y avanzar a los siguientes.
Además del juego normal, en el modo edición podrás diseñar tus propios niveles... ¡y alcanzar nuevas cotas de diversión!

meta.name: Lode Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El emblemático juego Lode Runner ha originado una saga y ha servido de inspiración a innumerables títulos. La acción en estado puro se mezcla con los enrevesados niveles, mientras recoges oro y evitas a los robots enemigos haciendo agujeros en el suelo. Usa la cabeza y tus reflejos para completar los puzles y avanzar a los siguientes.
Además del juego normal, en el modo edición podrás diseñar tus propios niveles... ¡y alcanzar nuevas cotas de diversión!

meta.name: Lode Runner II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lode Runner II is an almost identical version of the original, but it includes 104 new fan-created levels. The bricks have been changed in color from red to blue. Additionally, there is a defective version circulating, in which only 21 levels are playable, as the data from level 22 onward has been overwritten.

meta.name: Lode Runner III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Lode Runner III" is an unofficial sequel to "Lode Runner II" that includes only minor changes.

meta.name: Lode Runner IV
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lode Runner IV is a fan-made version featuring bright green bricks. Of the 127 levels, only 32 are new, while the remaining 95 are mostly taken from "Lode Runner II" and partially rearranged. The story revolves around Professor Jones, who must recover Egyptian statues stolen by a mad collector. Using the Papyri of Set, he gains the ability to temporarily transmute matter to deceive guards and create obstacles. This version was released in Italy under the title Trafugator.

meta.name: Lode Runner Mix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Lode Runner Mix," also known as "Hansmann's Lode Runner," was revised and released as an optimized version of the project under the title "Tricky Mix."

meta.name: Lode Runner V
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lode Runner V is another fan edition featuring blue bricks. Of the 107 levels, only 14 are new, while the rest are taken from earlier versions, partly from Lode Runner II and Lode Runner IV.

meta.name: Lode Runner's Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lode Runner's Rescue is a 1985 action game developed by Joshua Scholar for the Commodore 64 and Atari 8-bit computers as a follow-up to Doug Smiths's Lode Runner. Lode Runner was published by Brøderbund, but the sequel was published under the Synapse Software name, a company acquired by Brøderbund in 1984.

meta.name: Log!cal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Log!cal is a bizarre puzzle game in which you have to arrange colored balls (green, purple, blue or yellow) to form quartets in any of several locations on the game board. These locations are, in fact, balls you can spin, then send any of the balls in them through the connection path.

meta.name: Logger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.24 KB

Logger is a classic Frogger-style game. You guide your character across a busy road filled with cars and trucks, then navigate a fast-flowing river by hopping on logs, turtles, and other floating hazards without falling into the water. The goal is to reach the safe homes at the top of the screen, with each round becoming progressively harder. Precision, timing, and quick reactions are essential to fill all the empty slots and rack up points.

meta.name: Logic (CP Verlag 1995)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Logic" exige concentración y habilidad para replicar con precisión un cuadrado basado en una plantilla, todo bajo presión de tiempo. La plantilla se muestra en el lado derecho de la pantalla, mientras que el cuadrado en el que se debe trabajar está en el lado izquierdo. Usando el joystick, controlas una flecha horizontal y verticalmente entre las cuatro columnas y filas. Al presionar un botón, la fila seleccionada se mueve una posición. El objetivo es organizar el cuadrado mediante movimientos estratégicos para que coincida con la plantilla. El límite de tiempo deja poco espacio para la deliberación. Un consejo útil: Para cambiar el control de la flecha de horizontal a vertical, muévela hacia la esquina superior derecha y presiona el joystick hacia abajo. ¡Disfruta del desafío del rompecabezas!

meta.name: Logic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.34 KB

Logic is a 3D tic-tac-toe thinking game for 2 players or against the computer.

meta.name: Logic Levels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.01 KB

A ball is dropped at the top of a multi-level maze and must successfully navigate to the slot at the bottom of the puzzle. The player controls a hand icon that can be used to place a variety of tools in the maze, including bridges, vertical walls that prevent the ball from moving, and jumpers that push the ball up a level. Spray cans can change the color of the ball to win prizes of the same color. The player can control when to activate these items while the ball is rolling. As the ball rolls, it loses energy and the player must reach the end with energy intact. Energy is obtained by changing to the correct color and moving across energy fields. There are holes in the maze and if the ball rolls sideways, the level is lost. The levels are getting more and more difficult.

meta.name: Logic Workout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

"Logic Workout" challenges you to engage your brain and decipher symbols.

meta.name: Logik 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Logic 64” is a challenging logic puzzle game. The goal is to solve puzzles that put your logical thinking to the test.

meta.name: Logo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Logo offers three independent puzzle games, each with 120 levels. Between the levels, digitized images appear as a motivational factor. All puzzles must be solved within a time limit, and every five levels a password is provided. In the first game, a stone combination shown at the bottom must be replicated by placing stones with values from one to four on the playing field. Each placed stone increases the value of adjacent stones by one, with values above four resetting to one. In the second game, a given stone combination must be removed by clicking on stones. Neighboring stones also disappear, and new stones can appear in empty spaces. In the third game, stones must also be removed, but only stones of the same color and value can be taken. The values of adjacent stones increase by one.

meta.name: Logo Robot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

In Logo Robot, you control a blinking robot that moves across the screen, painting polka dot or checkerboard patterns in different sizes and colors. You teach it how to move and draw by giving commands such as “Forward 10” or “Repeat.” This lets you create your own pictures and even put on a little art show. Along the way, you're introduced to the basics of the Logo programming language, building logical thinking and an early understanding of computer programming.

meta.name: Lollipops
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lollipops is a colorful educational game that teaches children counting and basic arithmetic in a playful way. Set in a candy shop, you answer questions like “How many red lollies?” or “2 + 2 = ?” by selecting the correct number. Wrong answers are gently corrected, while right ones earn cheerful praise. With its simple visuals, bright colors, and easy-to-understand prompts, the game makes learning math fun and engaging – perfect for young beginners.

meta.name: London Blitz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.53 KB

London Blitz puts you in the boots of a Royal Engineers lance corporal during WWII, tasked with disarming unexploded bombs scattered across London. A map shows their locations – then the tension begins. On the C64, you rotate dials to enter numbers and try to trigger the disarm switch. On the Atari 2600, control schemes vary with bomb color: green bombs have fixed slider-switch assignments, orange bombs change randomly, and blue bombs offer no control – you just hope. Each defused bomb earns progress toward a promotion. Failures cause demotion. Reach captain to win – fall below lance corporal or die in a blast, and it's game over.

meta.name: The Lone Ranger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.85 KB

The Lone Ranger is a text adventure where you play as a Texas Ranger. Disguised with a mask, you navigate the game by selecting from predefined responses to catch the villains.

meta.name: Lone Wolf : The Mirror of Death
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.09 KB

In this standalone adventure from gamebook hero Kai-Master Lone Wolf, the player controls the daring adventurer as he climbs the grim mage tower Kazan-Gor, an inverted pyramid that widens toward the top. Lone Wolf pursues a lore stone of Nyxator that sits at the very top. The warlock Gorazh has stocked his tower with monsters and traps, including the magical mirror Dhazag-Oud, whose seven shards reflect superior likenesses of those who look into it. These encounters lead to boss battles that Lone Wolf must overcome to continue on his path.

meta.name: Lonely Rider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.01 KB

Lonely Rider places you in the role of a solitary hero on a perilous mission to rescue your kidnapped comrades. Your journey takes you through the desert and directly into the enemy camp of the Native Americans, deep into their caves, right in the heart of their territory.

meta.name: Long Lance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Long Lance puts you in command of either American or Japanese naval forces during World War II's South Pacific nighttime battles. As a strategic theater commander, you assign task forces, set movement orders, and define combat doctrines like engagement range and tactical behavior. Time advances in 20-minute increments, with the game pausing for key decisions. It's a text-only simulation supported by a physical map and markers to track positions. With scenarios like Savo Island and Guadalcanal, Long Lance offers deep, slow-burning naval warfare strategy where planning and foresight matter more than speed.

meta.name: Long Life
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Not long ago in the past, the wizards and magicians ruled the whole world. Nowadays less people believes in the existing of supernatural things unlike the earlier days. Things got forgotten, which were counting very much in the everyday life of our kings. There are few very few people who have the knowledge to use these skills. Far away from the society, they can touch their relics, what mean guarantee their leading. If a relic gets into the hands of evil then it'll cause dreadful happenings to people.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.60 KB

You are Tommy Astle, an experienced reporter for the local city newspaper and your Editor has just tasked you to investigate a few mysterious deaths. There has been talk of the supernatural and a mythical creature called The loogaroo and off course you are sceptical, but the further you investigate, the more you become a believer. Will you get to the bottom of these deaths and the creature or is it all just a myth?

meta.name: Look Sharp!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Look Sharp! you will find two game packages, namely Old MacDonald's Farm and SORT – Space Observer Recruitment Test. In Old MacDonald's Farm you experience three sections: In Memory a friendly farmer shows you four animals with descriptions that you must remember and correctly match once the labels disappear. In Observation you are presented with three seemingly identical sequences and must spot the difference. In Reflections you observe two constantly changing images and must quickly react when they match.

meta.name: Loony Balloon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.09 KB

In Loony Balloon you pilot a delicate hot-air balloon, carefully navigating it across the screen to collect all objects and land safely on the pad before time runs out. Touching any wall bursts the balloon and costs one of your five lives. Gravity and wind make the balloon sway constantly, demanding precise timing and gentle control. With five skill levels – from Novice to Kamikaze – the game delivers an increasingly challenging test of patience, finesse, and steady hands.

meta.name: Loopz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Loopz you must create closed loops from randomly appearing shapes. The pieces consist of lines, corners, and curved segments that can be rotated and placed anywhere on the grid. At first it seems easy, but soon the board fills up, the timer ticks down, and you're scrambling for space. Unused pieces stay on the board, so planning for multiple potential loops becomes vital. With each level, the challenge grows, and before long you'll find yourself dreaming about Loopz – an addictive puzzle that puts your logic and composure to the test.

meta.name: Lord of the Balrogs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.87 KB

Lord of the Balrogs is a role-playing game with graphical elements as you control five members of a party to find and destroy The Evil Lord, inside a Fortress in the Forest of Zorg guarded by Balrogs. The Evil Lord is planning to send a vast army out of the Forest and seize the Fair Land and send it into eternal darkness. Your party is made up of five different characters and they are a Warrior, Amazon, Hobbit, Cleric and a Sorcerer with each one being named by yourself and each one having a different level of health. The only way to have the power to destroy The Evil Lord is to find six sacred relics scattered around all six levels of the Fortress with other treasures to be find as well.

meta.name: Lord of the Rings : Game One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Lord of the Rings you follow Frodo, Pippin and Sam on their dangerous quest to bring the Ring to Mount Doom. The adventure begins in the Shire, where Frodo sets out from his home and soon joins forces with companions such as Sam, Pippin, Aragorn and Gandalf. Along the journey they encounter various characters and dangers, including Tom Bombadil, the Green Knight and the Balrog, while trying to escape the forces pursuing them. Later the group expands into the Fellowship as new companions like Boromir and Legolas join the quest. Step by step the game guides you through the key events of the story and lets you experience the novel's journey firsthand.

meta.name: Lords
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lords places you in the role of a god-like figure leading your people in a struggle against a rival group. On a large scrolling map, set in either forest or desert terrain, you start at one end while your opponent begins at the other. You direct your people to build houses and castles, and you can unleash magical catastrophes such as lightning, poison, decay, or terrain alterations to weaken the enemy nation. Your magical powers regenerate over time, but using larger catastrophes temporarily renders you powerless.

meta.name: Lords of Chaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lords of Chaos draws you into a shattered fantasy world where powerful wizards battle for control. Every turn demands careful planning, as movement, combat and magic are limited and must be used wisely. On your path to escape you gather treasure, summon creatures and unleash complex spells, while enemy mages counter you with the same tools. The appeal comes from its tactical depth, risky decisions and the constant dilemma between building power or pushing straight for the objective.

meta.name: Lords of Conquest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lords of Conquest is based on the board game Borderlands and challenges players to build or capture three cities and hold them for at least one round to win. To achieve this, players must gather resources like iron, coal, wood, gold, and horses while protecting them from others. Against a single opponent, tactical warfare takes center stage, while games with three or four players include a trading phase where resources can be exchanged, requested, or extorted. The game features twenty pre-made maps, including North America, China, and the world, as well as options to generate new maps or create custom ones in the editor.

meta.name: Lords of Doom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lords of Doom takes you to the abandoned desert town of Vertic, where werewolves, vampires, mummies, and zombies have wiped out the population. Four characters – Sharon, Charlie, Susan Leicester, and Abraham Van Halen – join forces to drive out the evil and defeat each creature's overlord. You guide the party from a first-person view through a haunting pseudo-3D town, searching buildings, collecting items, and solving puzzles while managing hunger, thirst, and health. Battles unfold in real time, and only careful planning, courage, and a bit of luck can free Vertic from the Lords of Doom.

meta.name: Lords of Karma
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.38 KB

The first sign of the unconventional nature of this text adventure is the terse description in the game manual. Unlike most games of its time, Lords of Karma doesn't prepare players with a written narrative with appealing illustrations. Even the plot of Lords of Karma is discovered in the game itself, as are the landscapes and scents of its magical world. There are treasures and deadly enemies, but what to do with the loot? All you know is that you collect "karma points" to get to heaven, and you start in the center of the mythical city of Golconda. Common shortcuts and two-word commands guide you through this text-based, turn-based adventure, but hesitation leads into the mouth of a hungry crocodile. Thankfully, death isn't final here - the karmic wheel keeps turning. You lose worldly goods and end up on a mountaintop, but the map stays the same and the karma points remain.

meta.name: Lords of Midnight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.76 KB

The Lords of Midnight transports you to an epic world where Doomdark's forces seek to conquer the 4,000 territories. You begin with Luxor the Moonprince, his son Morkin, Corleth the Fey, and Rothron the Wise, each possessing unique abilities. Additional lords, such as Lord Dreams, Lord Blood, or the Utarg of Utarg, can be recruited as the game progresses. If Luxor dies, only Morkin remains under your control. Victory can be achieved either by defeating Doomdark's armies or recovering the Moonring, a task only Morkin can undertake. The world features lakes, castles, plains, and forests, often inhabited by the Fey. Doomdark's troops move at night, giving the game a turn-based structure. Characters can be killed by dragons, Skulkrin, or wolves, making every decision crucial.

meta.name: Lords of Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Doctor Who references are obvious in this adventure - you play a time travelling hero, who faces a group of Time Lords as they attempt to rewrite human history. To do this, you must collect nine objects which have an hourglass symbol on, from nine different time zones. You will encounter tigers and an Ice Queen in the Ice Age, a guard and a frog in the middle ages, a Cyberman in the future, and more mundane tasks in the present day. To enter different time zones, go into the grandfather clock in your home (the starting location) and activate one of the nine cogs.
Lords of Time is played by typing commands to guide your character, moving in compass directions and with standard commands such as OPEN DOOR, GET GLASS and EXAMINE CAR. Objects you will encounter include keys, an emerald and a petrol can.
