meta.name: The Lost City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.12 KB

You are an explorer deep in the jungles of South America searching in a Lost City of the Maya for relics. There are ten of these valuable Maya relics to find scattered around the surrounding area in buildings and temples. The quest won't be easy as there are plenty of traps and red herrings to be discovered. The Lost City is a graphic text adventure where pictures show you each location while text describes what you can see. You type in commands with the keyboard to control your hero and interact with various locations.

meta.name: Lost Dutchman's Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.55 KB

Lost Dutchman's Gold takes you on a perilous quest for the legendary Dutchman's gold mine, deep in Arizona's Superstition Mountains. Armed with a mule, a rifle, and a few tools, you begin your adventure in a miner's cabin at the foot of the mountains. As you journey through the desert, a ghost town, and the deadly canyons of the Superstition Mountains, you search for a hidden map that could lead you to untold riches. But beware — hostile Native Americans and the dangers of the wilderness lurk around every corner.

meta.name: Lost in the Amazon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.96 KB

“Lost in the Amazon” places you in the role of the sole survivor of an expedition to South America in search of the legendary Golden Condor. After a plane crash, you are stranded in the heart of the jungle, completely disoriented. Your survival depends on how well you navigate the dangers of the Amazon rainforest and find a way out.

meta.name: Lost in the Labyrinth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.05 KB

Lost in the Labyrinth places the player in the role of an adventurer exploring a maze, searching for stairs to ascend to higher levels, and ultimately seeking the exit. Along the way, the player encounters creatures that must be defeated in close combat. If defeated, the player loses one of their four lives. Various items, such as hammers, spears, and bombs, can be found and used. The game is controlled with a light pen, allowing movements and actions to be executed directly on the screen.

meta.name: The Lost Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Lost Ninja tells the story of a dark kingdom plagued by evil creatures after the sinister sorcerer Erona opened the gates of hell. Erona seeks world domination, and you are the last hope to defeat him and seal the gates to save the kingdom. Your journey takes you through perilous regions filled with deadly foes as you strive to stop Erona and restore peace.

meta.name: Lost Robot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Lost Robot” tells the story of an experiment in which a humanoid robot is sent through a dimensional portal for the first time to explore the risks of interstellar travel. On February 20, 4003, the robot is transmitted to a planet in the Alpha Centauri system. However, a slight deviation sends it to an unknown, alien world. Your mission is to guide the lost robot through hostile landscapes, overcome attackers, and find the way home. This multi-screen platform shooter adventure requires strategy and skill to safely bring the robot back.

meta.name: Lost Tomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

“Lost Tomb” takes you deep into an ancient pyramid, where you must navigate from chamber to chamber to collect treasures, evade traps, and defeat enemies. You are equipped with a weapon and a limited number of whips. The whip clears everything in your immediate surroundings, including enemies, traps, and even walls, while your weapon can be reloaded infinitely. The pyramid itself is hostile: linger too long in one spot or step into a trap, and the walls begin to quake and fire. Each level of the pyramid features stairs leading deeper, along with two possible exits. A map helps you plan your route, but beware of the treacherous throne rooms, which are full of traps and rarely encountered.

meta.name: The Lost World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.63 KB

“The Lost World” casts you as Edward Malone, a reporter for the Daily Gazette. When reports from your friend Maple White, who spoke of a lost world, suddenly cease, you travel to his last known location. At a base camp below a plateau, you learn that Maple has died. Determined to uncover the cause of his death and explore this mysterious land, you must first find a way to scale the steep cliffs. The game is a text-based adventure where you explore your surroundings and progress through your journey by entering commands.

meta.name: Lotti
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.23 KB

Lotti is a tactical number duel played on a grid where you reveal hidden values and use them strategically against your opponent. When selecting a field, you decide whether its number is added to your own score or subtracted from your rival's total – each choice can significantly shift the balance. This creates constant tension between risk and reward as the board gradually clears. In the end, whoever has the higher total score wins – a calm yet surprisingly sharp contest of numbers and timing.

meta.name: Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge takes you through a series of racetracks from around the world. You compete against 19 opponents and must finish in the top 10 to progress. Your placement in each race determines your starting position for the next. The rival drivers have humorous names inspired by Formula 1 racers. You can choose between sound effects and music. In many races, you'll need to make a pit stop for fuel to reach the finish line. The tracks are filled with obstacles like oil slicks, construction zones, rocks, and rivers that slow you down, though there is no damage model for the cars.

meta.name: Love Bytes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.08 KB

Love Bytes presents an interactive adventure where you shape the story by choosing from selectable responses. Rather than typing commands, you pick options that steer conversations, situations and relationships in different directions. Each choice alters what follows, encouraging replay to explore alternative paths and outcomes. The experience revolves around curiosity and experimentation as multiple story variations gradually unfold.

meta.name: The Love Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Love Game presents a series of questions and choice-driven situations focused on relationships, pop culture and personal judgment, where your answers shape the outcome. You select from predefined options, earn points and compare results across sessions or players. The appeal comes from the mix of knowledge, opinion and playful humor that keeps each run feeling slightly different. The result is a light quiz-style experience built around entertainment, curiosity and experimentation.

meta.name: The Love Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Love Quest guides you through an interactive program that combines personal input, questionnaires and evaluations to create a playful compatibility profile. You set up your data, complete different sections and receive feedback highlighting connections, similarities or differences. The structure feels like a blend of questionnaire and adventure, gradually unlocking new areas and allowing comparisons of results. The experience focuses on curiosity and self-exploration rather than traditional gameplay goals.

meta.name: Love Tramp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Love Tramp follows a playful journey through colorful environments where you overcome obstacles and avoid hazards in an effort to reunite with a lost companion. You leap over fences, dodge creatures and keep moving as the path gradually becomes more demanding. The experience relies on timing and awareness, since small mistakes can quickly halt progress. Its lighthearted presentation blends with classic platform action to create a charming adventure driven by persistence and purpose.

meta.name: Lucifer's Realm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

After your death in hospital, you have been wrongly sent down to Hell from the gates of Heaven where you find Lucifer himself has his own problems. He has discovered that Adolf Hitler is attempting to raise an army including Mussolini and Reverend Jim, to overthrow Lucifer and take over Hell. He has tasked you to stop Hitler in his power struggle and as a reward you can return back up to Heaven.
Lucifer's Realm is a graphic text adventure where you see pictures for each location while text below describes what you can see in the location. You type commands with the keyboard to control your hero and interact with various locations.

meta.name: Lunar Blitz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.42 KB

In “Lunar Blitz,” you play as a spaceship pilot flying over the surface of an alien planet when you realize you're running out of fuel and must make an emergency landing. The problem is that the only landing spot is a city, leaving you no choice but to bomb the buildings to create a runway. The game is displayed from a side view on a single screen, where you fly from left to right. Upon reaching the edge of the screen, you reappear on the left side but one level lower. You must drop bombs from your ship to destroy each building, with a short delay between bombs. If you manage to destroy the city, you advance to the next level, but if you collide with a building, the game is over.

meta.name: Lunar Jailbreak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.22 KB

A sort of sci-fi version of Keystone Kapers. Has menu options of music/sound effects and multicolour/black-and-white graphics modes. Even a subgame included in which you can win a jetpack for extra speed. You can't lose any energy or lives but If the prisoner gets to the airlock then it's game over.

meta.name: Lunar Lander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.51 KB

In “Lunar Lander,” the player pilots a lunar landing module, aiming to safely land on the Moon's surface. Fuel, speed, and distance to the surface must be carefully managed. Precise control and strategic planning are crucial for a successful landing.

meta.name: Lunar Lander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this version of “Lunar Lander,” the player pilots a lunar landing module, aiming to safely land on the Moon's surface while carefully managing fuel, speed, and distance. This variant stands out for its particularly appealing “Skramble”-style graphics, making it one of the most visually impressive adaptations.

meta.name: Lunar Leeper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.41 KB

En Lunar Leeper debes guiar tu nave espacial mientras recoges a los rehenes repartidos por la superficie y los pones a salvo. Tu tarea se vuelve difícil debido a los extraterrestres que saltan e intentan agarrarte a ti y a los rehenes.
Si te acercas a un rehén mientras hay un extraterrestre cerca, seguirá caminando hacia ti para atraparte. Si te atrapan, pierdes una vida, aunque puedes dispararles. El problema es que no puedes dispararles mientras están quietos y tienes munición limitada. También tienes combustible limitado, y si estás medio vacío, deberás recargar en el depósito para poder continuar.
Entre niveles, ingresas a una caverna donde debes encontrar un enorme objeto flotante. Luego debes disparar a su núcleo para pasar al siguiente nivel de dificultad.

meta.name: Lunar Outpost
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Lunar Outpost puts you in command of a Lunar Assault Vehicle tasked with defending a remote moon base against endless waves of enemy Zytrons. Scattered across the outpost are vital supply buildings that must be protected at all costs. Your mission is clear: hold the line for as many days as possible and prevent the outpost from falling.

meta.name: Lunar Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Lunar Rescue” is a lander game where the objective is to land on the green platform. You control the ship with the joystick: move down to release the ship and up to stop it.

meta.name: Lunari
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.31 KB

“Lunari” is a shooter in the style of “Uridium.” The story revolves around humanity's adventure in space, requiring the use of specialized tools to survive in a hostile environment. Without gravity, both physical and mental balance can be affected. Additional dangers like cosmic radiation, extreme temperatures, and the absence of essential gases for breathing necessitate the development of a spacecraft capable of overcoming these challenges. The game lets you take control of such a ship, designed for space combat and the protection of a large space station.

meta.name: Lunattack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.21 KB

The war on the Seiddab rages on, and you now take part in an attack on their moon base. You fly a hovercraft a bit above the moon's surface, and must shoot down the enemy's DAB tanks. After that ring of defense is penetrated, you must dodge your way through a space minefield above a mountain range, and then a missile firing range before reach the Seiddab's command base. Unlike its predecessor, 3D Seiddab Attack, you are now flying, and can make more adventurous maneuvers.

meta.name: Lupenio
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.84 KB

In Lupenio, you play the greatest thief of all time on a quest to steal King Solomon's legendary diamond. Hidden deep inside an ancient house filled with traps, snakes, rats, and other dangers, the jewel won't be easy to reach. Each key opens only one specific door, so careful planning and smart decisions are essential. Skill, timing, and the right strategy will lead you to your prize.

meta.name: Lupo Alberto : The Videogame
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lupo Alberto: The Videogame is based on the popular Italian comic and lets you play as the mischievous wolf Alberto or his girlfriend Maria. Across ten levels, your goal is to find a suitable place to be alone with your true love. Along the way, all the other characters from the series stand in your way – especially the watchdog Mose, who is always after you. With humorous style, simple gameplay, and a charming presentation, the game captures the wit and playfulness of the original comic and gained particular popularity in Italy and Germany.

meta.name: The Lurking Horror
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A pesar de una terrible tormenta de nieve, un joven estudiante de G.U.E. Tech va al laboratorio de informática de la escuela para trabajar en su trabajo final. Sin embargo, ha ocurrido algo extraño. El archivo que contiene el trabajo del estudiante ha sido parcialmente sobrescrito por los archivos del Departamento de Alquimia. Al principio, el único objetivo del estudiante es encontrar su documento perdido, pero pronto se da cuenta de que algo mucho más siniestro está ocurriendo en el interior del edificio de la escuela.
The Lurking Horror es el único juego de aventuras de texto con temática de terror de Infocom. El juego se desarrolla en el edificio de la escuela embrujada, en medio de una ventisca que ha hecho imposible la huida. El jugador explora los entornos y debe resolver rompecabezas para superar los obstáculos. Hay criaturas hostiles en el juego, la mayoría de las cuales deben ser derrotadas o desbaratadas utilizando objetos específicos.

meta.name: The Lüscher Profile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Lüscher Profile allows you to explore your personality and mindset through your preferences for colors, shades, and shapes. By analyzing your responses to various tests, a profile emerges that reflects your current approach to work, relationships, and life as a whole. While a short version of the test has existed for years, the computer version brings Dr. Lüscher's revised, longer test to use for the first time. This blend of modern technology with a proven psychological tool helps you better understand the most important person in your life – yourself. It's a program you'll want to share with friends and return to often.

meta.name: Mabel's Mansion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Barney, el botones, acaba de recibir la desafortunada noticia de que su tía Mabel ha muerto. Para compensar, parece que Mabel le ha dejado a Barney su considerable fortuna como herencia. Mabel ha escondido sus tesoros en su mansión de 90 habitaciones y ha creado una serie de trampas y rompecabezas que Barney debe resolver para demostrar que es digno de su fortuna. Su tía también ha convocado a varios monstruos del inframundo para que vigilen la mansión y frustren los avances de Barney. El fantasma de Mabel sigue rondando el escondite más grande, y debe ser evitado si Barney quiere reclamar su recompensa.
El jugador debe explorar a fondo la mansión, ya que las llaves han sido hábilmente escondidas por toda la casa. Hay que empujar o manipular varios muebles, lo que desencadenará eventos en otras habitaciones. Hay armas colgadas en las paredes que pueden utilizarse para derrotar a las criaturas de los dominios de Mabel.

meta.name: Macadam Bumper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.09 KB

A single classical-style pinball table is provided in this simulation. A table editor is also provided - this allows you to choose a shape for the table and arrange the component parts as you wish. Up to four players can take it in turns, each with five balls in turn. Unusually, the default table has multiple flippers at the bottom of the table, as well as some located higher up. Use them to return a ball higher on table and to prevent it being lost at the bottom of the table. Hitting some valuable areas of table gives you a bonus. Gain as many points as possible to rack up a high score.

meta.name: Macarthur's War : Battles For Korea
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

MacArthur's War is a turn-based 2D simulation of the Korean War. The player takes the role of Douglas MacArthur, the commander in chief of the United Nations forces, but you can also assume the role of the Chinese general staff. Confronted with the Korean crisis, you can manage the conflict at a limited level or you can escalate it into a Asian or Global showdown between the superpowers.
The included scenarios are: 'Across the 38th', Taejon, Naktong Bulge, Unsan, Ch'ongch'on River, Chosin Reservoir, Chipyong-ni, Imjin River.

meta.name: Macbeth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Macbeth” is an unusual adventure simulation that takes you through the dark rise of Lord and Lady Macbeth in four chapters. From the first encounter with the witches to a deadly banquet and the siege of Dunsinane, you take on shifting roles, solve puzzles, gather ingredients, and manipulate fate. Whether as an ambitious noblewoman, witch's apprentice, or war-weary lord – each chapter tests your knowledge of Shakespeare's play and challenges you with decisions where time and text comprehension determine victory or downfall.

meta.name: MACH - Maneuverable Armed Computer Humans
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An evil robot called Nektron has enslaved three planets and it's the player's job to take on the role of a Maneuverable Armed Computer Human and free the planets.
The action takes places in multi-directionally scrolling stages seen from a top-down perspective. The goal of each of the three stages is to destroy a set number of certain types of enemies. Beginning with the weak Vacilators, followed by the more resilient and heavily armed Gyphons and finally, large mother-ships. There are many other types of enemies as well. They will sometimes drop power-ups that replenish energy or give access to more powerful weapons. The game gets increasingly difficult as the number of enemies that have to be destroyed increases and mother-ships start appearing several times throughout a level.

meta.name: Machine Gunner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.40 KB

"Machine Gunner" is a shoot'em-up game for the Commodore 64. In this game, the player controls a machine gunner who fights his way through enemy lines and defeats various enemies. The game is characterized by its action-packed game mechanics and challenging levels.

meta.name: Macman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Macman” is a maze game inspired by the classic Pac-Man. The goal is to eat all the dots in the maze to progress to the next level. Three ghosts also roam the maze, and touching them costs a life. Power pellets in the corners allow you to eat the ghosts for a short time.

meta.name: Mad Doctor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.91 KB

Mad Doctor is a multi-screen action-adventure game with strategy elements. You play as Dr. Franz Johann Blockenspiel, and must leave your castle to search the village of Strudelberg for body parts with which to build your very own monster. These parts might come from fresh graves, the hospital, or a recently executed criminal. Alternatively, you can take matters into your own hands and murder villagers you find wandering around. You must be careful, as committing too many evil deeds will cause the villagers to rise up against you.
The player has a lot of agency in the game; you can read books left by your uncle, you must eat and drink to stay alive, and you can lock people in a cell for later use if the body you build doesn't work out. If you succeed in building a monster from suitable parts, animating it by electrifying a kite and are able to subdue it with tranquilisers, you can exhibit it in the village hall and finally gain the fame and notoriety you seek!

meta.name: Mad Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.98 KB

In Mad Man, you play as Ike Nash, a New York City police officer waiting for his big break. That moment arrives when an asylum inmate escapes and the murders begin to pile up. You must track the fugitive killer and solve the case.

meta.name: Mad Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Mad Mission” is a simple shooter game where you must defend yourself against endless waves of alien attacks. The game features very basic graphics and repetitive attack patterns. Originally published by Hewson, it underwent several releases under different names in Italy.

meta.name: Mad Mix Game : The Pepsi Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.73 KB

Ahora después de muchos años, el personaje más popular de cuantos han pasado por las pantallas de un ordenador, el COMECOCOS vuelve con una imagen renovada y con nuevos  y divertidos personajes que te harán disfrutar a lo largo de 15 apasionantes niveles.
MAD MIX es sin duda el comecocos de las próximas generaciones.

meta.name: Mad Nurse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Mad Nurse, the player takes the role of a nurse in a chaotic maternity ward where babies constantly leave their cots and get into danger. They stick fingers into sockets, drink medicine, or fall down the lift shaft. The goal is to grab them in time and return them to their beds before harm occurs. The ward spans three floors connected by a lift, and babies appear randomly, moving from left to right.

meta.name: Mad Planets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.57 KB

Mad Planets is a space shooter where, instead of aliens or enemy ships, planets with orbiting moons serve as adversaries. At the start of each attack wave, the planets approach from a distance to hurl their moons at your ship. As long as the moons are orbiting, the planets are invulnerable. Only after all the moons are destroyed do the planets become “mad” – indicated by a bright orange glow – and attempt to destroy your ship by ramming it.

meta.name: Mad Springs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Mad Springs” is reminiscent of “Bubble Bobble” and offers an entertaining adaptation of the arcade classic. Players must progress with skill and strategy to defeat enemies and collect points.

meta.name: Madballs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.90 KB

Welcome to Orb, the most chaotic planet in the universe. Once a normal world, a cosmic storm transformed it into the home of the outrageous MADBALLS – grotesque, silly, and utterly insane. Characters like Dust Brain, Skull Face, and Slobulus battle in a wild race for dominance over the planet. Players join their zany antics and outwit every rival to claim ultimate power. But the path is littered with obstacles: trash cans, oil slicks, fried eggs, and crazed chickens stand in the way. The fight for supremacy is wild, bizarre, and full of surprises – welcome to the mad world of MADBALLS!

meta.name: Madness - Solitarie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.99 KB

“Madness” is a Mahjong-style game focused on tile removal. It offers strategic challenges within a classic design.

meta.name: Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Madness is a platformer that features 30 screen sized levels. The goal of each levels is to reach the exit within the time limit. The catch is, that the exit needs to be activated by lighting all torches that are spread throughout a level. Naturally, there are lots of different obstacles and enemies trying to stop the player. Most enemies follow a set path, however some may chase the player's sprite through the entire stage. As the levels become more complex, it is necessary to work out routes that don't end in a dead end and allow the player to reach the exit in time while still avoiding enemies.

meta.name: Madrax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 79.68 KB

In Madrax, you explore a labyrinth in the kingdom of Almahagor to collect six Thor idols from Morador's dungeon and thwart the evil plans of the wizard Gothan. Enemies can be defeated using balls, bombs, or a sword, but ammunition is limited. You can also destroy foes by touching them, though this reduces your health. Power-ups like ammo and healing items help you progress. The labyrinth features doors that can either teleport you to new locations or act as traps that cause damage. Along the way, you collect useful items such as lamps for dark areas, keys for locked doors, and ladders to bridge broken paths. Skill and strategy are crucial to stopping Gothan.

meta.name: Mag Max
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Mag Max, invasores alienígenas amenazan la civilización y han devastado los planetas. Antes de la invasión, un grupo de científicos creó un arma final, Mag Max, y escondió sus partes bajo tierra. Tu misión es localizar los componentes dispersos de Mag Max para aumentar su poder y derrotar a los enemigos. Comienzas pilotando una pequeña nave de combate con potencia de fuego limitada, pero con cada pieza recolectada, como la cabeza, las piernas o una lanza láser, Mag Max se fortalece. Al entrar en cráteres, puedes acceder al inframundo, donde las armas y los enemigos se vuelven más desafiantes. Solo a través de la hábil recolección y la acción estratégica puedes salvar la civilización.

meta.name: Magazine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.98 KB

Magazine is a challenging puzzle game where the player takes on the role of Bruno, a warehouse worker at CP-Verlag. His task is to push heavy pallets of Magic Disks into the elevator. Since the data carriers are filled with programs and games, Bruno can only push the pallets, not pull or lift them. Strategic planning is essential, as poor decisions quickly lead to dead ends. Adding to the pressure, a timer requires Bruno to store all pallets on time. If the time runs out, the game ends. Restarting a level requires sacrificing a life. Players can aim for the title of "Employee of the Month" with skillful play, disable music in the main menu, and return to previous save points using codes. This humorously designed game combines tactical thinking with fast-paced challenges.

meta.name: Magdom II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.75 KB

En Magdom II, la tarea del jugador es recoger todas las llaves verdes en un nivel de plataformas y usarlas en la salida ubicada en la parte inferior de la pantalla. El juego combina mecánicas clásicas de plataformas con controles simples, requiriendo habilidad y planificación estratégica para tener éxito.

meta.name: Magess Of Midgard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Magess of Midgard, the player must defend the city of Caer Del Taryn from enemy invaders. Using precise spells cast by placing a target on the map, the player must eliminate the attackers. If the enemies manage to plunder the city too often, it will be destroyed, leading to the collapse of civilization. Skill and quick action are crucial to saving the city and its inhabitants.

meta.name: Maggie Aip
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Maggie AIP, the player interacts with Maggie, an AI program inspired by Eliza. Maggie invites players to share personal thoughts, fears, and problems, providing a playful platform for reflective conversations.

meta.name: Maggotmania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.47 KB

Maggotmania pits you against a writhing menace descending from the top of the screen while you control a blue creature at the bottom. You move left and right, slightly forward and backward, continuously firing upward to break apart the giant maggot. When hit, it splits into separate segments that advance further downward, leaving flowers behind that block your shots until destroyed. Additional creatures such as spiders and snails appear, offering bonus points but adding to the chaos – a frantic single-screen shooter where reflexes, positioning, and steady fire determine your survival.

meta.name: Magic (Macmillan Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.83 KB

Magic allows players to learn professional magic tricks through simple graphics and computer-based presentations. It provides a playful and easy-to-understand introduction to the art of magic.

meta.name: Magic Balls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.31 KB

In Magic Balls, the player engages in a Breakout-style game, destroying blocks while dodging enemies and collecting power-ups that add variety and strategy to the gameplay. Skill and quick reflexes are the keys to success.

meta.name: The Magic Candle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En The Magic Candle, asumirás el papel de Lukas y su grupo de valientes aventureros, con la misión de impedir que el demonio Dreax escape de la vela mágica. A medida que la vela se consume, tendrás un tiempo limitado para completar tu misión. Explorarás pueblos, viajarás por todo el mundo, te adentrarás en peligrosas mazmorras e interactuarás con numerosos PNJ para obtener pistas y apoyo. Tres niveles de dificultad determinan el tiempo disponible para alcanzar la victoria, y la planificación estratégica y la toma de decisiones inteligentes son clave para el éxito.

The challenge lies in the precise execution of spells and the ability to defend against your opponent's attacks. It's all about reacting quickly and acting strategically to come out as the victor.

The Magic Events was created to celebrate the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. In the game, you participate in various events, including swimming and athletics.

meta.name: Magic Fields
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Magic Fields is a challenging puzzle game featuring 99 levels and a saveable high score. The goal is to clear the field by removing all visible shells. Each press of the fire button flips the selected field and the adjacent fields in the four cardinal directions, including the one beneath the player character. A level is completed when no shells remain visible. Players start with three lives, and a time limit demands quick thinking, as running out of time costs a life. Progress cannot be exploited by pausing the game, as the screen is cleared during pauses. After the game ends, players can enter their name in the high score list, saved on the disk. Skill and logic are essential to mastering this challenging game.

meta.name: Magic Johnson's Basketball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.39 KB

Magic Johnson's Basketball ofrece una trepidante acción de baloncesto de dos contra dos, para jugar solo o con un amigo. En lugar de los clásicos equipos de cinco jugadores, controlas a un jugador marcado y puedes cambiar de compañero con solo pulsar un botón. El juego se desarrolla en una pantalla horizontal que abarca toda la cancha, con un árbitro pitando faltas y el público reaccionando a cada movimiento. Tu objetivo es ganar partidos, aumentar tu salario y conseguir un puesto en la Pantalla de Grandes Ganadores. Entre cuartos, puedes consultar estadísticas como el porcentaje de tiro, los rebotes y los robos. Si el marcador está empatado, la prórroga continúa hasta que alguien gane. Con cinco niveles de dificultad, el ritmo y el desafío del juego crecen con tu habilidad.

meta.name: The Magic Journey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.81 KB

The Magic Journey is a text adventure created by Joseph Rezeau using the Quill Adventure Writer. It begins with a simple discovery of an object on the ground, but from that moment on, everything becomes increasingly strange. A mysterious journey awaits you.

meta.name: Magic Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.57 KB

In “Magic Madness,” you take on the role of a witch tasked with retrieving four magical scrolls stolen by the evil wizard Colo and his henchmen from Neverland. The witch is equipped with four magical items – a cloak, a cross, a wand, and an hourglass – each with unique abilities to help her defeat the creatures in Colo's realm. The game is divided into four sections: sky, forest, caves, and ice, presented as horizontally scrolling levels. Along the way, the witch finds chests containing bonus points, extra time, magical weapons, or a balloon that takes her back to the previous section. At the end of each section, she faces the guardian Anteater, whom she must defeat to obtain a scroll and progress to the next area.

meta.name: Magic Micro Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.16 KB

"The Magic Micro" está basado en la serie de ITV Magic Micro Mission y presenta dos secciones de juego distintas. En la primera parte, el jugador controla un shooter desde la cabina, apuntando y disparando a platillos voladores que se mueven en patrones elípticos a través de la pantalla usando una mira. En la segunda parte, el juego cambia a un rompecabezas en un tablero de circuitos colorido con forma de laberinto. El jugador guía a un robot para recoger derrames de aceite dispersos mientras evita obstáculos como "chips" móviles y elementos similares a resistencias. Ambas fases requieren habilidad y reflejos rápidos para tener éxito.

meta.name: Magic Mouse in Goblin Land
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.32 KB

In Magic Mouse in Goblin Land, you guide a little mouse on a quest to find a magic book. The evil witch Anabel has sent her goblins to stop you, but you are given stars to defeat them. Your task is to climb branches and platforms, avoid obstacles, and use your stars wisely while the clock ticks down. Only with skill and speed can you overcome the dangers and retrieve the magical book.

meta.name: Magic Of Endoria
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Magic of Endoria, you find yourself in the fantasy kingdom of Endoria. Long ago, disgusted by the world's evil, the gods transformed themselves into crystal shards and retreated to the underworld. Whoever gathers all the shards will gain dominion over Endoria. Now, two rival archmages have learned of this myth and set out on a quest. You take on the role of one of these mages, competing against your rival to claim ultimate power over Endoria.

meta.name: Magic Poker 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.95 KB

Magic Poker 64 is a poker game set in a Wild West atmosphere, capturing the tension of a classic card duel. The player is dealt five cards and can use keys 1 to 5 to decide which cards to exchange. Possible winning combinations are displayed in the top-right corner of the screen. If the player has a strong hand, they can press the spacebar to double their bet before the next round. Winnings can also be risked for a chance to score even higher. The game combines strategic decision-making with the dramatic flair of a Western showdown.

meta.name: Magic Rufus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 71.76 KB

The sequel to Reckless Rufus. Antwicky, Rufus' homeland, has been taken over by evil witches. Rufus attempts to defeat them by putting on a cape and learning to use magic spells.
Rufus moves around a landscape made up of platforms and ladders, avoiding or fighting enemies including witches, demons and vikings. First a number of prisoners must be freed from cages on each level, and then the exit must be found. Magic spells (which include weapons, and the key to open cages) can be bought from Spell Stalls or just found lying around. Chests provide coins to be spent at the Spell Stalls.

meta.name: Magic Serpent C64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Magic Serpent is a Snake variant. The player controls a snake called Lenni who has to eat all fruits which are divided over the scrolling level. Said levels are constructed like mazes, i.e. many small gangways. Every time a fruit is eaten, the length of Lenni grows. The player needs to control Lenni (he moves and turns automatically when meeting a wall; the player only needs to intervene when another turn is in order) in a way so he does get in his own way. Each level has to be completed within 60 seconds, but collecting clocks extends this limit. Other power-ups are rabbits (make Lenni faster) , snails (make Lenni slower, but no slower than the default speed), axes (the length of Lenni gets cut back to the starting value) and teleports to the starting point of the level. Each power-up also effects the points.

meta.name: Magic Spells
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Magic Spells is an educational program designed to help children aged 6 to 10 learn basic spelling and grammar rules in a playful way. The game features three interactive mini-games with animated graphics and sound. In Scramble Spells, players must arrange the letters of given words in the correct order. In Flash Spells, words are briefly displayed, and players must recall and type their correct spelling from memory. The word lists span various categories, such as animals, fruits, and orchestra, and players can create, save, and share their own custom word sets. Magic Spells combines fun learning with creative customization options.

meta.name: Magic Square
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.10 KB

Magic Square is a sliding puzzle where 15 numbered tiles must be arranged in the correct order. The goal is to solve the puzzle as quickly as possible by strategically shifting the tiles. Skill and foresight are essential to mastering the challenge.

meta.name: Magic Square
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.72 KB

Magic Square is a logic game where the player must complete a magic square, ensuring that each row, column, and diagonal adds up to the same sum. The numbers from 1 to 9 must be strategically placed to solve the puzzle and achieve the goal.

meta.name: Magic Stone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Magic Stone is an interactive adventure where the player explores the manor of Count Von Schwarzherzen in the desolate Transylvanian wastelands. The estate is rumored to be cursed, and legend speaks of a magical stone hidden within its walls that can transform lead into gold. Equipped with a magical amulet that changes color in the presence of dark magic, the player must investigate the manor, locate the stone, and uncover the secret of its power. The key lies in the count's notebook, said to be bound in human skin. Skill and keen observation are essential to solving the puzzles and completing the adventure.

meta.name: Magic Tile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Magic Tile challenges players to focus and think logically. The goal is to place all available tiles on a chessboard to progress to the next level. Tiles can only be placed adjacent to spaces that match their color or symbol. Creating multiple matching connections simultaneously earns bonus points. At the start, players can choose options such as difficulty level and the ability to save or load progress. Skill and strategic planning are crucial to succeed.

meta.name: Magic Wood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.95 KB

In Magic Wood, the goal is to collect mushrooms while avoiding dangerous enemies. Bats, a snake, and a sorceress who hurls deadly lightning bolts attempt to stop the player. Some mushrooms might also be poisonous. As the difficulty increases, enemies become more unpredictable and can temporarily turn invisible. An audio cue and a flashing symbol warn the player of imminent danger. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to overcome the challenges.

meta.name: Magical Formula
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hundreds of years ago when snails still dwelled the Earth, Sonny the Snail lived happily with his parents in a place called Snail Meadow, and he was about to marry Dawny, his snailgirl of his dreams. All his happiness came to an end one day when troops of evil skeletons invaded Snail Meadow, robbed each house, killed their cattle, and kidnapped the snailwomen. After seeing Snail Meadow living in big sorrow, a wizardsnail decided to help them, but in order to do so, he needed several magic items - which include scrolls, mushrooms, money bags, and bag of coins - so that he can create his magical formula used to help track down the snailmates. He sends Sonny to collect these items.

meta.name: Magician
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.73 KB

Welcome to "Magician." Dark and foreboding, Vygor's castle rises atop the mountain peak. A village clings to the steep cliff, seeking refuge in the ancient stones, yet its only hope lies with me. I am Sanec, son of the great wizard Osyth, whose scrolls and power orb were stolen by the evil sorcerer Uygor. It is now up to me to reclaim them before the new moon begins in three days, for if I fail, the forces of darkness will destroy the orb and unleash satanic hordes upon the Earth.

meta.name: A Magician's Apprentice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.96 KB

Welcome to "A Magician's Apprentice." You take on the role of Wuntvor, apprentice to the great wizard Ebeneezum, who one day vanishes without a trace. Driven by concern, you set out to find him and rescue him from whatever dangers may have befallen him.

meta.name: Magician's Ball, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.91 KB

In "The Magician's Ball," you play as Caro, a magician tasked with defeating an evil sorcerer to break the curse that has turned a young girl to stone. The game combines text adventure with graphics and features "Tubular Bells" by Mike Oldfield as in-game music. A unique feature is the ability to issue commands to other characters. Additionally, you can take control of Azul, another character. If Caro dies, you can still complete the game by continuing as Azul. Skill and strategy are crucial to defeating the sorcerer and saving the girl.

meta.name: Dizzy IV : Magicland Dizzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.88 KB

Dizzy, the egg protagonist, is back in his fourth installment: Magicland Dizzy. The land has been corrupted by an evil wizard, and it's Dizzy's job to set everything right. To do this, he must walk, jump and flip through a large number of screens, pick up and use various items, and talk to people.

meta.name: Des Magiers Kugel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Des Magiers Kugel is a logic puzzle game designed to dispel boredom and challenge the player's reasoning skills. With clever strategy and patience, the puzzles can be successfully solved.

meta.name: Magische Steine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.76 KB

In Magische Steine - Magic Stone, the player embarks on an adventure to free the island of Aldora from the tyrannical rule of the wizard Tenomy and his monstrous hordes, which have plagued the land for 15 years. Armed with 1,000 gold coins and 150 rations, you explore the island, purchase armor and supplies in villages, and battle Tenomy's creatures to claim treasures. The goal is to find nine magical stones hidden by Tenomy in six dungeons and other locations, guarded by powerful monsters. Only with these stones can the wizard's tower be unlocked for the final showdown. Strategy, resource management, and combat skills are vital to saving Aldora.

meta.name: Magnetic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.52 KB

Magnetic is a strategic board game for two players, played on a 10x10 grid where stones of two colors are placed. The goal is to own more stones than your opponent when the board is completely filled. If an opponent's stone is positioned between two of your stones, it changes color and becomes yours. The game can be played against the computer or another player, with an additional demo mode where the computer plays against itself. Skill and strategy are essential to secure victory.

meta.name: Magnetron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.78 KB

In Magnetron, the player controls the robot KLP-2, whose mission is to destroy a series of space stations orbiting the planet Quartech by overloading or shutting down the four nuclear reactors on each station. KLP-2 transports nuclear fuel rods with positive or negative charges and varying weights between the reactors. The weight affects the robot's speed and makes maneuvering, especially on slopes, more challenging. The charge of the fuel rods determines how the robot interacts with arrow tiles on the floor: a positive charge moves it in the direction of the arrow, while a negative charge moves it in the opposite direction. Skill and strategic planning are essential to overcome the challenges.

meta.name: Magnetron (Brøderbund)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Magnetron, the Helios Exploration Starship returns to Earth, now under siege by alien invaders. The player pilots a photon spacecraft tasked with destroying all weapon systems across 50 enemy fortresses. The ship is affected by inertia, with enemy magnetic forces influencing and complicating its movement. Fuel is consumed through movement and the use of a protective shield but can be replenished at designated platforms. Solid walls destroy the ship on contact, while elastic walls reflect shots, offering opportunities for strategic gameplay. A level editor allows players to create and save custom levels.

meta.name: Magnetron (Brøderbund)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Magnetron, the Helios Exploration Starship returns to Earth, now under siege by alien invaders. The player pilots a photon spacecraft tasked with destroying all weapon systems across 50 enemy fortresses. The ship is affected by inertia, with enemy magnetic forces influencing and complicating its movement. Fuel is consumed through movement and the use of a protective shield but can be replenished at designated platforms. Solid walls destroy the ship on contact, while elastic walls reflect shots, offering opportunities for strategic gameplay. A level editor allows players to create and save custom levels.

meta.name: Magyk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.55 KB

In Magyk, the player controls a crosshair to aim at and destroy moving asteroids. Precision and quick reflexes are crucial to successfully overcoming the challenge.

meta.name: Mah Gong - Special Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mah Gong: Special Edition is a game where Mahjong tiles must be removed. The task is to find matching tiles and clear the board, either against the clock or in the classic solitaire mode. The game is accompanied by an atmospheric oriental soundtrack and appealing graphics. Face the challenge of the dragon and master the game!

meta.name: Mah Jongg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.09 KB

“Mah Jongg” is a relaxing game where matching tiles must be removed. The goal is to find and remove all pairs, requiring strategic thinking to leave space for future moves. The game ends when all pairs have been successfully removed, offering many hours of entertainment, especially on long winter evenings.

meta.name: Mail Order Monsters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mail Order Monsters is an action/strategy game, identified by some people as a precursor to the Pokémon series. The player or players create a variety of monsters, bestow them with different traits and equip them with modern and/or futuristic weapons to do battle. Monsters can be further customised through buying special abilities, such as adding tentacles to use advanced weaponry. Two players can fight against each other, play capture the flag, or compete for a high score against a computer-controlled horde. In single-player mode, the computer controls an opponent to fight. Battles take place on various different maps that can have tactically significant effects, such as mountains for agile monsters to hide behind during combat. Monsters can be stored on diskette and can be upgraded by victories against other monsters or computer opponents.
meta.developer: Evan Robinson, Paul Reiche III, Nicky Robinson

meta.name: Main Frame
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Main Frame casts you as humanity's final chance against a supercomputer that has decided people are merely bugs in its code. With backup from an orbiting space station and a powerful exo-suit, you jump and fight your way through buildings, mountains, caverns and high-tech bases on the path to TriComplex III. Droids, traps and secret weapons stand between you and your goal, turning each area into a mix of platforming and tight arcade combat. Step by step you push deeper into the machine's domain until you can finally shut the system down.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Majik
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.60 KB

“Majik” tells the story of King Markham, who, on his deathbed, desperately hopes to see his only son and heir, Prince Gideon, one last time. Rumors claim that Gideon is being held captive by the sinister Domir, as he alone can unite the Clans of the Reaches and thwart Domir's reign. The wizard Piradon is tasked with rescuing the prince, but his magical powers are limited in the dangerous lands he must traverse. The game is a first-person adventure where players progress by completing tasks.

meta.name: Mama Llama
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.98 KB

Mama Llama has you protecting three llamas from alien attackers by steering a killdroid that destroys enemies as you move over them. If Mama dies, the run ends. Before each round you see a 10×10 grid of waves, with icons and colors showing enemy types and amounts. Using two pointers you shift rows and columns to choose the next wave, while all others keep growing in the background. Limited anti- and retro-genesis devices let you halt or reduce growth, but time is short. Overfilled or completed waves turn into “nogo” fields – and if too many of them end up in your active selection square, your run is over.

meta.name: Man Don't Get Angry
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.64 KB

Man Don't Get Angry is a board game where the goal is to get your pieces to the finish line while trying to block or send back your opponents' pieces. The gameplay is similar to "Sorry", where players advance by rolling dice and making strategic moves.

meta.name: The Man From Granny!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.81 KB

“The Man from G.R.A.N.N.Y.” puts you in the role of a secret agent tasked with thwarting the schemes of the subversive organization C.R.O.W. Your objective is to locate and eliminate an enemy agent before they use a formula to turn the population into zombies. After being ambushed and having your drink spiked in Zazas, you wake up in an alley without equipment and with a pounding headache. Your mission starts now – good luck!

meta.name: The Man from N-10
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.15 KB

“The Man from N-10” is a maze game with elements of platforming and shooting. Your mission is to retrieve stolen top-secret documents as you battle through various challenges. Speed and skill are essential to complete your mission.

meta.name: Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Manager places you in the role of a purchasing and sales manager for a company. Your task is to independently manage the department by making decisions about the type, quantity, and price of raw materials as well as the sale of finished products. You must carefully calculate to achieve optimal profits while navigating a market that reacts sensitively to supply, demand, and pricing. To succeed, you'll also need to closely assess the behavior of your competitors.

meta.name: Mancala
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Mancala” is a digital version of the classic strategy game where your goal is to capture as many seeds as possible through clever sowing and tactical thinking. You play against either another person or an AI, and in each turn you take all the seeds from one of your six bowls and distribute them counterclockwise across the board. If the last seed lands in an opponent's bowl containing exactly two or three seeds, they are automatically captured – even from previous bowls if they meet the same condition. The player with the most seeds at the end wins. A calm yet deeply strategic game for sharp minds.

meta.name: Mancala
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.02 KB

“Mancala” is a digital adaptation of the classic strategy game played with stones, seeds, beans, or counters and rows of pits. The objective is to capture all or a specific number of the opponent's pieces. Rooted in a millennia-old concept dating back to ancient Egypt, the game offers a strategic challenge for two players.

meta.name: Manchester United
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This football management simulation with an arcade twist puts you in charge of the world's most famous team. Pick your dream lineup, plan training, and develop your players as you aim to win as many trophies as possible. Matches can be fully simulated or played out directly, giving you hands-on control when needed.

meta.name: Manchester United
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This football management simulation with an arcade twist puts you in charge of the world's most famous team. Pick your dream lineup, plan training, and develop your players as you aim to win as many trophies as possible. Matches can be fully simulated or played out directly, giving you hands-on control when needed.

meta.name: Manchester United Europe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Manchester United Europe lets you lead your team through European football glory – either by managing from the sidelines or taking direct control on the pitch. Choose your lineup, set your tactics, and decide whether to watch the AI play or score the goals yourself. Only smart decisions and key moments will bring your team to victory.

meta.name: Mancopter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.64 KB

Mancopter is a side view horizontal game where the screen scrolls from right to left when you move, as you control your hero flying a primitive helicopter powered by pedal-power for a race over the ocean. You must fly and pass as many other competitors as you can as you try to get from the start-line to a finish-line a long distance away. To fly your helicopter you keep pressing the fire button to stay airborne and press left to move along the screen. If you stop pressing the fire button then you fall downwards towards the water, if you stop pressing left then your momentum keeps you going until you slowly come to a halt. The race is timed and you start with seventy seconds and this decreases as you race but passing buoys gives you forty extra seconds.

meta.name: Mandragore
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mandragore es un juego de rol publicado originalmente en Francia. El reino estuvo en paz durante el reinado del rey Jorian. Cuando murió en un extraño accidente, esta paz se rompió cuando Lord Yarod-Nor tomó el control y comenzó un reino de tiranía y malevolencia. El jugador lidera un grupo de cuatro personajes (con la opción de definir sus propios personajes o tomar un grupo predefinido) a través de la tierra para finalmente desafiar, enfrentar y derrotar a Yarod-Nor en su propio castillo. Antes de hacerlo, el grupo debe explorar nueve castillos, cada uno de los cuales contiene un problema y pistas que serán útiles más adelante en el juego. Tendrás que luchar contra varios monstruos inusuales, entrar en pueblos para comerciar y desarrollar las habilidades de tus personajes.

meta.name: Mandroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.54 KB

“Mandroid” puts you in the role of an agent on planet Cove 4, searching for stolen classified files. Your mission is to locate Chris Auker and retrieve the Mandroid documents before they fall into the hands of the criminal mastermind Max. You explore the cityscape on foot or with a remote-controlled vehicle that helps you move faster – as long as you avoid toxic rivers and keep it powered. Throughout the streets and buildings, you encounter various cyborgs. You can choose to interact with them peacefully, threaten them for intel, or take them down to acquire superior weapons. Many carry essential map data, and money is key to progressing – earned through gambling or credit terminals. Every choice you make shapes the mission – diplomacy or force, caution or boldness?

meta.name: Manganoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.12 KB

Manganoid is an Arkanoid variant for up to two players. Regardless of the number of players there are two palettes available - one the top and left side. Removing cubes from the board reveals a manga style picture. All other Arkanoid rules apply, especially bonuses facilitating (two balls) or hindering (smaller pads) the task.

meta.name: Mangrove
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.09 KB

Mangrove is set in a mangrove swamp where you must protect healthy cells from cancer cells while creating new healthy cells. You start with 30 cells in the center of the screen, while cancer cells appear from the edges. Using a crosshair, you move across the screen to eliminate the cancer cells. If a healthy cell is touched by a cancer cell or is not connected to at least four other cells, it disappears. As you move the crosshair, you can create new healthy cells, but they must quickly be connected to others to survive. Gamma radiation is available to destroy all cancer cells on the screen, but its use is limited. The game ends if fewer than twelve healthy cells remain.

meta.name: Maniac Mansion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La Mansión Edison siempre ha sido una vieja y espeluznante casa en las afueras de la ciudad. Hay rumores de experimentos extraños y criaturas extrañas que viven entre la familia Edison. Incluso se cuenta que un meteorito se estrelló cerca de la casa hace casi 20 años. Más recientemente, una chica llamada Sandy ha desaparecido del instituto local y su novio Dave jura que vio al Dr. Fred llevársela. Dave sabe que no puede hacerlo solo y que necesitará la ayuda de otros dos estudiantes si quiere tener alguna esperanza de infiltrarse en la mansión y salvar a Sandy.
Los jugadores comienzan eligiendo a dos estudiantes para acompañar a Dave a la mansión Edison, y luego pueden cambiar entre los dos personajes a voluntad. La mayoría de las acciones se realizan seleccionando verbos en la pantalla y aplicándolos a un objeto. Cada personaje conserva una personalidad distinta y puede tener una forma de resolver un problema diferente a la de sus compañeros.

meta.name: Maniac Mansion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Maniac's Computer Diary 1989
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.70 KB

“Computer Maniacs 1989 Diary” is an interactive diary program that displays the time and date while providing interesting facts for each day. In addition to its core functionality, it includes extra features such as weather forecasts, horoscopes, snack suggestions, and practical tips like how long to boil an egg or how many days remain until the next birthday. It also offers entertaining elements, such as overweight assessments or number suggestions for football pools. Additionally, games like Hangman, a word search, and a reaction game are integrated.

meta.name: Maniax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Maniax is a Qix variant. The basic playing principle: the player controls a dot which can draw lines on the screen and when a closed figure is drawn, the color of the area changes. Additionally there are enemies, either confined to the uncolored or colored areas, which cause the player sprite to die if touched. The goal is to color 75% of the screen.

meta.name: Manic Miner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.11 KB

En Manic Miner, juegas como el minero Willy, que descubre por casualidad los restos de una avanzada civilización ya desaparecida. Tendrás que buscar los tesoros ocultos (minerales preciosos) en el fondo de la mina para llegar a la puerta de salida, antes de que se alcance la cuenta atrás que indica el nivel de oxígeno restante. Los enemigos móviles e inmóviles pueden impedir el avance de Willy. El suelo puede derrumbarse en algunos lugares y las cintas transportadoras dificultan el movimiento. La puntuación se basa en el oxígeno restante.

meta.name: Manic Miner 2010
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.38 KB

“Manic Miner 2010” is an unofficial remake of the classic game, where you play as Miner Willy, a daring adventurer navigating a network of underground caves left behind by an advanced but extinct civilization. These caves contain valuable metal ores. Across 20 caves, you must collect all treasures before the time (air) runs out, while overcoming guardians, obstacles, pitfalls, quicksand, and other hazards typical of a classic platformer.

meta.name: Mansion Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.14 KB

Mansion Quest challenges you to locate the estate of your late, eccentric uncle and secure your inheritance. He lived somewhere near Upper Puddleton, but the exact location is unknown. Your task is to gather clues and unravel the mystery of the mansion.

meta.name: Map-Race 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.66 KB

“Map-Race 2” is an entertaining educational game that puts your knowledge of Canadian geography to the test. Using a joystick, you guide a colored blob over a stylized map of Canada and try to locate the target city as quickly as possible – like Windsor in this round. You can play solo or race against another player, with both speed and precision counting toward your score. The challenge is to stop directly on the target to succeed. It's a creative blend of racing and geography quiz with charmingly simple presentation.

meta.name: Maps 64 : Europe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Maps 64: Europe” is a geography-based educational game where you pilot a small airplane to locate European countries on a map. Each round displays the name of a country – like Norway – and challenges you to fly there accurately within a time limit. The faster and more precise you are, the more points you earn. As levels progress, the difficulty increases, testing your familiarity with European geography. It's an entertaining and instructive flight across the continent.

meta.name: Maps 64 : USA
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Maps 64: USA” is an interactive educational game designed to help you learn the geography of the United States in a fun way. You can choose from three modes: In Search mode, you type in names of states, rivers, seas, or mountains, and the game takes you to the correct location. In Test mode, you must identify locations pointed out by the computer within a time limit. The most dynamic mode is the Heligame, where you pilot a helicopter and fly to the indicated places to score points. If you score high enough, you'll earn extra time and face tougher challenges in the next level. A fun and educational way to explore the map of America.

meta.name: Maps 64 : World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.73 KB

“Maps World” (originally “Topografie Wereld”) is a Dutch educational game designed in the 1980s to help primary school children learn world geography, based on a mid-80s map that still includes countries like the Soviet Union. There are three gameplay modes: In “Opzoeken” (Look Up), you enter a location and the game shows it on the map. In “Overhoring” (Quiz), you must name the locations pointed out by the computer within a time limit. In “Helikopterspel” (The Helicopter Game), you pilot a helicopter and must fly around the world map to find specific locations. They only become visible when you're close enough. Each correct find earns you points, and high scores reward you with extra time and harder-to-find places in the next level. A classic yet effective game for learning global geography.

meta.name: Marauder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Marauder sends you with Captain C.T. Cobra to the hostile planet Mergatron, where the jewels of Ozymandias have been scattered. In his powerful Battlecar, Cobra battles vertically through enemy fortresses, blasting turrets and rival vehicles while struggling to survive. Some color-coded turrets alter your car's stats – sometimes helpful, sometimes disastrous. You also have 16 smart bombs, which vanish quickly once the action intensifies. At the end of each stage, a boss awaits, testing every ounce of your reflexes and firepower.

meta.name: Marble Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Una adaptación del juego de arcade. Marble Madness es un juego de laberinto abstracto para uno o dos jugadores. El objetivo es guiar una pequeña canica de vidrio sobre un laberinto tridimensional y llegar a la meta antes de que termine el cronómetro. Los segundos que quedan en el cronómetro cuando se cruza la línea de meta se transfieren al siguiente nivel. Además de tener que sortear la canica por traicioneras pasarelas y rampas, numerosos obstáculos y criaturas hostiles tratarán de frenar el avance de la canica o derribarla por el borde de una plataforma, perdiendo aún más preciosos segundos hasta que aparece una canica de reemplazo. En el modo de dos jugadores, ambos compiten por alcanzar la meta primero. Marble Madness presenta seis laberintos diferentes.

meta.name: Marble Springs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Marble Springs reinvents the classic Arkanoid/Breakout formula, replacing bricks with a constantly moving, segmented dragon that must be defeated. Using a paddle and ball, you chase this agile creature through each level, adjusting your ball's energy for greater damage — though higher power also increases speed and risk. If your score ends in 400 or 800, your paddle expands for better control. If the ball is about to escape, a quick press of the fire button boosts your movement for a last-second save. Precision and skill are key to defeating the dragon and advancing to the next level.

meta.name: Marie Celeste
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Marie Celeste" begins aboard a stolen space yacht drifting through pirate territory, approaching an enemy ship. Your mission is to uncover the pirates' treasure, transport it to the supply room, secure the valuable Dymenthium bars for your ship, and unravel the mystery of the pirates' fate.

meta.name: Mario Bros
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.92 KB

Mario y Luigi, los mejores plomeros en el mundo, tienen un trabajo de verdad en sus manos. Una gran cantidad de personajes se han adueñado de las alcantarillas, y los hermanos deben sacarlos de las tuberías.
El rompecabezas de plataformas que primero introdujo a Luigi al mundo posee modos de un jugador y multijugador con dos modos distintos de juego, pero con el mismo objetivo. Cangrejos, tortugas y moscas que luchan deben ser despejadas saltando desde abajo para así golpear la plataforma en la que se encuentran y después patearlas lejos. Cada nivel es completado cuando se recolecta un cierto número de monedas.
Para el modo de dos jugadores el primero en recolectar un cierto número de monedas gana.

meta.name: Mario Bros II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.02 KB

Mario Bros II es un juego no oficial creado por fans, inspirado en el título Game & Watch Mario Bros. Mario y Luigi trabajan en una fábrica de llenado de botellas, colocando cuidadosamente cajas sobre cintas transportadoras. Con dos mandos analógicos, los jugadores mueven a los hermanos arriba y abajo para atrapar cajas que caen y pasarlas a cintas superiores. Si se pierde una caja, esta se estrella y enfurece a los supervisores. Al completar el proceso, la caja se sella y carga en un camión. Cuando se embalan ocho, el camión sale, concediendo a los hermanos un breve descanso antes de la siguiente ronda, más difícil.

meta.name: Mario Bros. (Ocean)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.06 KB

Mario Bros. es un clásico arcade donde Mario y Luigi combaten criaturas en las alcantarillas. Mientras reparan tuberías, son atacados por tortugas, cangrejos y luciérnagas que emergen de las cañerías. Para vencerlos, deben golpearlos desde abajo y luego empujarlos fuera de la plataforma; cuidado: algunos regresan más peligrosos. Ya sea en solitario o cooperativo, ofrece acción frenética y duelos emocionantes una y otra vez.

meta.name: Mario Goes to Diamonds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Mario Goes to Diamonds, you control Mario through several levels where you collect diamonds and avoid obstacles. The modified version of the original brings the well-known character into a new environment where clever maneuvering and timing are required. Your goal is to collect all the diamonds in each level and skillfully avoid dangers in order to progress.

meta.name: Mario's Brewery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.23 KB

Mario's Brewery is a Donkey Kong clone. Instead of trying to defeat Donkey Kong and save his girlfriend, the player must instead avoid a rampaging soda machine. The player controls Mario, who can move sideways, climb ladders and jump over hazards. The player has 3 lives and loses a life when colliding with a hazard.

meta.name: Mark Set Go!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A multi-event sports competition game with over seven different disciplines to choose from. Fun to play alone or with several people. All graphics are drawn in detail, the animations of the fighters are perfect.
With MARK-SET-GO you've come to the right place, you get a real competitive atmosphere when you play! A really exciting game in which you have to prove your skills in the individual disciplines and give your full effort.
* 100 meter run
* Long jump
* 400 meter run
* TRAINING CAMP
* BOXES
* RIFLE SHOOTING
* SHOOTING RANGE

meta.name: Market Forces
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.54 KB

Market Forces is a game focused on supply and demand. At the start of each round, players receive a market analysis and clues about which goods may be in demand in the future. There are five goods: corn, bacon, coffee, orange juice, and sugar. Each player decides how much they want to buy and at what price, but this information is hidden from the other players. The amount a player receives depends on how much the other players buy and at what price. If a player bids more, they get all of the goods. Players who buy more than they can afford fall into debt and lose if they can't pay it off. In the selling phase, players sell their goods, with prices depending on supply and demand. Unsold goods are lost. The game lasts for six rounds, and the player with the most money at the end wins.

meta.name: The Market Place
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Market Place" is an educational business simulation that teaches children fundamental strategies like pricing, advertising, and profit calculation. Up to six players can experiment with different scenarios. Selling apples involves setting a price per piece and observing its impact on daily sales. Tomato sales require allocating an advertising budget to sell 1,000 plants while managing revenue, expenses, and profits. Running a lemonade stand combines pricing and marketing, with weather affecting daily sales. The goal is to maximize profit through smart financial decisions.
meta.developer: K.W. Neff, S. Jensen & C.C. Cooper

meta.name: The Marlo Files
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Marlo Files is a collection of two thrilling text adventures: The Museum Caper and Dial M for Marlo. Both mysteries put your detective skills to the test as you solve intricate puzzles and unravel gripping stories. Are you ready to prove your investigative prowess?

meta.name: Mars Lander (Supernova Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.04 KB

In Mars Lander, the player pilots a landing vehicle from the launch platform to a base in the mountains. The goal is to carefully and gently land the vehicle on the red strip without causing damage. Precise control is essential for success.

meta.name: The Mars Saga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Mars Saga" puts you in the role of a stranded space traveler who finds himself in a remote frontier settlement on Titan. Your only chance of escaping this hostile place is to assemble a team and locate a lost city on Mars. In this turn-based RPG, characters evolve through various attributes and skills while you recruit new members for your party throughout the game. Exploration primarily takes place from a first-person perspective with an overview map and status display, while battles are fought from a top-down view. You can either take control yourself or let the AI handle the encounters.

meta.name: The Mars Saga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Mars Saga" puts you in the role of a stranded space traveler who finds himself in a remote frontier settlement on Titan. Your only chance of escaping this hostile place is to assemble a team and locate a lost city on Mars. In this turn-based RPG, characters evolve through various attributes and skills while you recruit new members for your party throughout the game. Exploration primarily takes place from a first-person perspective with an overview map and status display, while battles are fought from a top-down view. You can either take control yourself or let the AI handle the encounters.

meta.name: Marzio
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.69 KB

"Marzio" is an Italian-language action game featuring classic arcade elements. Quick reflexes are essential to overcoming its challenges.

meta.name: MASK
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"MASK" is based on a popular 1980s animated series and follows the battle between M.A.S.K. (Mobile Armored Strike Kommand) led by Matt Trakker and the criminal organization V.E.N.O.M. (Vicious Evil Network of Mayhem). M.A.S.K. agents wear special helmets that grant them superpowers and conceal their identities. Their greatest enemy is Miles Mayhem, a former friend of Matt and co-founder of M.A.S.K., who betrayed him long ago. The game consists of four areas where Matt must pilot his Thunderhawk vehicle, avoiding V.E.N.O.M.'s armored cars and tanks while completing specific tasks in the correct order to complete his mission.

meta.name: MASK II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

MASK II is a single player side scrolling shoot-em-up and is the second game in the M.A.S.K series. This game consists of three missions: Mission one is about destroying an oil refinery that V.E.N.O.M. have set up in the middle east as part of their bid to control oil prices. ?Mission two starts with a tribe in the jungle who worship a fabulous ruby. V.E.N.O.M. have stolen the ruby and are using it in a laser ray gun. It is M.A.S.K.'s job to destroy the laser and to return the ruby to the tribe in the jungle. ?Mission three sees V.E.N.O.M. holding the president of the P.N.A. hostage and the mission is to rescue him and get him to the summit talks in time to sign a peace treaty.

meta.name: The Mask of the Sun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Mask of the Sun" puts the player in the role of Mac Steele, an archaeologist, adventurer, and treasure hunter. After being poisoned by a newly discovered artifact, there is little time left to find the legendary Mask of the Sun—the only hope for a cure. The journey leads deep into Mexico, where ancient Aztec ruins hold the secrets of a long-lost civilization. The game is a classic text adventure featuring graphical representations of the player's surroundings to aid in exploration and puzzle-solving.
