meta.name: Masquerade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres detective y te enfrentas a tu último caso mientras intentas acabar con un jefe del crimen. La gente no habla y todas las pistas que has encontrado son inútiles, hasta que consigues descubrir a un títere de la misma organización criminal. Le sigues hasta un hotel donde consigues noquearle. Con ciertos objetos de su cuerpo, puede encontrar un nuevo enfoque para su caso más difícil.
Masquerade es una aventura gráfica y de texto en la que ves una imagen de cada lugar en el que te encuentras, mientras que el texto debajo de la imagen describe lo que puedes ver. Utiliza el teclado para escribir comandos con los que controlar a tu héroe e interactuar con los distintos lugares y personas.

meta.name: Master Blaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Master Blaster" is a game collection featuring "Phaserdome", "The Red Obelisk", and "Sentinel".

meta.name: Master Blaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.60 KB

"Master Blaster" puts the player in the role of a pilot controlling a Federation clearance ship, tasked with clearing the space lanes between Pluto and Mercury of asteroids, alien ships, and meteors. When shot, asteroids break into smaller fragments. To fully secure each planet in the solar system, three sectors must be cleared before docking with the factory ship. The game is presented in a top-down view, showing the entire sector. The ship can be rotated left and right and moved forward, while all threats on the screen must be eliminated. After clearing a sector, the player must pass through a gate to advance to the next area.

meta.name: Master Chess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.23 KB

Master Chess brings the classic game of chess to the screen without unnecessary distractions, focusing entirely on the pure contest of planning, awareness, and intelligent moves. Rather than relying on effects or gimmicks, it keeps the substance of the game at the center, while adding useful features such as saving matches, setting thinking time, and freely creating custom positions. That clear approach is exactly where its appeal lies, because Master Chess does not try to reinvent chess, but to present it in a reliable and pleasantly accessible way.

meta.name: Master Digger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.02 KB

"Master Digger" is a platform game where the player must collect bonuses and tools to advance to the next level. Skill and strategic thinking are essential to overcome obstacles and navigate through the various levels.

meta.name: The Master Hacker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.60 KB

"The Master Hacker" puts the player in the role of a hacker infiltrating someone else's computer system—an environment where they truly don't belong. A strange sense of importance lingers as the only clue at the beginning is the on-screen prompt "LOGON PLEASE:". From that point, it's up to the player to use skill and intelligence to uncover the hidden world behind the system and navigate through unknown digital pathways.

meta.name: Master Head
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.52 KB

Master Head is a variant of Soko-Ban. On each level, the player, as a warehouse keeper, must push around crates to get them onto the right spots. Once all crates are moved onto a marked spot, the level is complete. Crates can only be pushed one at a time and cannot be pulled. A single wrong move can be undone with the P key. If the player gets stuck, it is possible to restart the level, but it causes the player to lose a life.

meta.name: Master Mind
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.85 KB

"Master Mind" allows the player to play the well-known logic and deduction game, where a secret color combination must be deciphered through strategic guessing and reasoning.

meta.name: Master Mind 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.67 KB

"Master Mind 64" allows the player to play the well-known logic and deduction game, where a secret color combination must be deciphered through strategic guessing and reasoning.

meta.name: Master of Camouflage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Master of Camouflage casts you as a mysterious knight who can blend into walls and appear or disappear at will. Doors and obstacles cannot truly stop him, yet relentless robotic pursuers track his every move. Every action must be carefully considered, as one mistake can quickly corner you. Only through smart planning, clever use of camouflage and tactical movement can you survive the hunt and prevail.

meta.name: The Master of Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.66 KB

Thelric the Wizard has kidnapped you by beaming you into his world, and will only set you free if you recover for him the Amulet of Immortality. The game engine is menu-driven, using the joystick to select options from menus to activate each of the game's main functions. The screen display has both top down and side-view representations of what is going on around you, plus measures of your mind and body health, and an inventory. To help, Thelric teaches you four spells - a magic missile to attack creatures, a burn spell which works over a wide radius, a spell to drain enemy energy, and a magical shield. Additional weapons (including daggers and a mace) and potions can be collected throughout your quest.
meta.developer: Richard Darling, Jim Wilson, Rob Hubbard

meta.name: Master of the Lamps
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.93 KB

En Master of the Lamps, encarnas a un príncipe oriental que aspira a convertirse en rey. Hay dos fases de juego distintas, en las que deberás demostrar tu valía. This interactive fiction title (one of three licensed Masters of the Universe titles released in the mid 1980s) might suit the more intellectual He-Man fans. Skeletor has developed an Earthquaker device, which uses hypnotic rays to control a horde of Rockbinders - gigantic boulder beasts capable of gnawing through solid rock. As the game starts, the beasts are tunnelling beneath the Shadowlands and approaching Eternia. As Adam AKA He-Man, can you stop Skeletor and his evil plan before it is too late? The game is reasonably easy by adventure standards, and uses a largely two-word parser with commands such as ENLIST, EXAMINE and FIT. Time saving commands include GET ALL and DROP ALL, and BOM (back one move) for undoing mistakes.

Masters of the Universe: The Movie es una adaptación de la película homónima. Encarnas a He-Man y debes encontrar las ocho cuerdas de la Llave Cósmica antes que Skeletor. Para ello, luchas por las calles, localizas cuerdas ocultas y derrotas enemigos: en el desguace te enfrentas a Blade y Karg en una pelea a puño limpio; en la tienda de electrónica de Charlie, neutralizas guardias; y en las azoteas, libras un espectacular duelo láser sobre un disco volador. Tras reunir todas las cuerdas, te espera la batalla final contra Skeletor.

meta.name: Masters of Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Masters of Time" puts the player in the role of a time machine pilot traveling faster than light through the timestream. The mission is to locate and record past events on Earth. In different time strata, the player must find time holograms while avoiding timeguards and timebombs that threaten the mission. Once a hologram is discovered and captured, digitized information about the event is automatically received. When energy runs low, the player must enter the intertime level, returning to the present by crisscrossing the universe. To become a true Master of Time, all gathered information must be programmed into the computer database. The game features full-color 3D graphics and includes an editor allowing players to create their own illustrated history!

meta.name: MasterType
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.84 KB

MasterType blends typing practice with fast-paced space defense. As a wizard, you protect a command ship at the center of the screen while missiles approach from every corner, each labeled with a word. Only by typing the words quickly and accurately can you repel the incoming threats. The ship is divided into sections – if one area is hit twice, the entire vessel explodes and the game ends. A beginner mode and adjustable words-per-minute target let you tailor the challenge – turning keyboard training into an exciting race against time.

meta.name: Match Buster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Match Buster is an adventure game where you play as "Match Buster," a superhero digging through caves and collecting magical coins. The goal is to collect a certain number of coins and reach the cave's exit to proceed to the next level. There is no time limit. Colored gems can be transformed into coins by aligning three of the same kind in a row. Obstacles and hazards require tactical skills, while challenges include pushing objects and making the best use of limited space.

meta.name: Match Day
meta.desc:

Match Day es un juego de fútbol que te permite jugar un partido contra la computadora, contra un amigo o con siete amigos en una competición de copa.

El juego tiene la posibilidad de realizar diferentes jugadas como golpes de cabeza, centros y tacones.

meta.name: Match of the Day
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.41 KB

There was a massive wave of football management games in 1992, and this was Zeppelin's contender. It was licensed around the BBC's football highlights programme famed for its classic theme music. The standard options exist (such as training, transfers and tactics) but the control system is unique. A diary is presented on the table, and you have to drag the icons for the activities you want to focus that amount of time on. This not only makes the presentation and style unusual, but also accurately represents the limited amount of time a real manager has.

meta.name: Match Point
meta.desc:

Match Point brings tennis to the screen with full rules and a pleasantly lively presentation. You fight your way through quarter-finals, semi-finals, or the final, play longer matches, and have to use ball speed, direction, and spin cleverly to outplay your opponent. Small details such as spectators following the action, ball boys, and the shadow beneath the ball add extra atmosphere to each rally. The result is a polished tennis game that effectively combines sporting precision, tournament flair, and exciting exchanges.

meta.name: Match-Wits

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Match Wits" challenges two players to find hidden words by taking turns flipping squares. The goal is to match word pairs, which are then removed from the board. As squares disappear, a hidden picture puzzle is gradually revealed. Once enough pieces are uncovered, a player can attempt to guess its meaning. The first to enter the correct answer wins the round. A game consists of three rounds, with the player scoring the highest points emerging victorious. Six categories are available—animals, cities, multiplication, words, sports, and famous people. Additionally, the game includes a program that allows players to create and edit their own content.

meta.name: The Match

“The Match” is a football management game where you must guide a team from the English 4th Division to the top of the 1st Division and win cups along the way. You can choose from 40 teams, with each division containing ten teams. On the main menu screen, you receive information about your team and have various options, such as selecting and training players, receiving physio reports, managing transfers, and checking bank details, league tables, and fixtures. Once everything is prepared, the match begins, shown from a side view with a slightly elevated angle. As the players move on the field, events are described in text below. The game allows matches to be paused and their speed adjusted.

meta.name: Matchbox

A grid with colored squares is displayed, and by strategically placing or removing colors, the pattern in the target area must match. Various game modes such as "No Color," "Cross," "No Center," "Four Corners," or "Five Points" provide different challenges. Each move counts, and the goal is to complete the pattern in as few moves as possible.

Matchboxes es una combinación de un juego de memoria / concentración y un juego de adivinanzas de palabras. El juego es jugado por dos jugadores (el segundo puede ser IA u otro humano) en una cuadrícula que contiene 36 cajas. Al voltear una caja, se revela una figura animada y el objetivo es obtener pares del mismo tipo y color. El jugador seguirá descubriendo cajas hasta que no se haga una coincidencia. Debajo de la cuadrícula hay una palabra que se revela parcialmente a medida que se abren cuadros y después de cada partida, el jugador tiene la oportunidad de ingresar la palabra. El jugador que primero ingresa la palabra correcta gana el juego. Hay algunas variaciones diferentes del juego: una que carece de la parte de adivinar palabras, otra con palabras invertidas y otra donde la palabra está codificada.

The goal is to escort a prince and princess to the church, properly attired and accompanied by a parson. To accomplish this, all shops and buildings must be visited, and their occupants questioned to determine what items are needed and how to obtain them. The maximum possible score is 255.

Players can also choose to have more than two guesses per turn or play with only a single match allowed per move.

Por ejemplo, si la distancia a recorrer es de 30 km, el jugador debe elegir dos ramas de +10. Each floor is guarded by security systems, requiring the player to decode and input the correct codes to access elevators. From an isometric perspective, the player navigates rooms featuring walls, doors, and office furniture. Dangerous robots pursue and attack, reducing health as displayed on the biomonitor at the bottom of the screen. The current floor and remaining time are also displayed on the interface.

During the race, players encounter other riders – colliding with them or the track edges slows the bike down. Crashing into obstacles or riders at high speed causes the bike to explode, wasting valuable seconds. The game ends if time runs out or all six stages are successfully completed.

The game also includes a scenario editor, allowing players to create and save their own holes to share with others.

Para ello, las recorre: unas se transforman al pisarlas, otras solo lo hacen si te acercas desde una dirección concreta. Por supuesto, enemigos intentan detenerle: cualquier contacto reduce su energía, y al agotarse, pierde una vida. Los niveles incluyen potenciadores que dan vida extra, recargan energía o permiten eliminar enemigos al tocarlos durante un tiempo limitado. Además, Flippo puede saltar sobre enemigos y huecos.

The game increases in difficulty by adding more ghosts with each level, making it harder for the player to collect all the points. If the player accidentally traps points behind a wall, they can use one of three available grenades to blast through the black walls and reach the hidden points. The goal is to collect all the points in the maze without being caught by the ghosts.

In “Mazemania,” you are trapped in the center of an invisible maze. Your goal is to find the exit as quickly as possible. If you want to see the maze, you can press the joystick's fire button — but it will cost you 10 seconds. Speed and a good memory are essential!

meta.name: Mazer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.07 KB

Mazer is a Worm/Snake-style game designed for two players. Players control worms that navigate the field and grow longer as the game progresses. The objective is to maneuver skillfully without colliding with obstacles, the opponent, or their own segments. Strategic planning and quick reflexes determine the winner.

meta.name: Maziacs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.03 KB

Maziacs is a maze game. The maze in Maziacs has no edges but has around 100 locations and a new maze is generated at each game start. The aim of Maziacs is to find the treasure and take it to the point the game started.

meta.name: McDonaldland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Hamburglar stole Ronald's magic trick box! In this 2D platformer, it's up to you to play as Mick or Mac and win it back. Travel through different countries and meet McDonald's characters as you travel to locations like Ronald's Clubhouse, Birdie's Treehouse and Hamburglar's Hideout and collect Ronald's cards.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mean Car is a top-down racing game – the player navigates a car through streets, avoiding obstacles, controlling speed, and collecting bonus points while minimizing vehicle damage. Precision and quick reactions are crucial to achieving a high score.

meta.name: Mean City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 69.98 KB

In the cities of the world, humans once again have a new battle, after surviving a world wide nuclear war there is a new war against against semi nomad mutants who live outside the cities in the barren wastelands. You take the role of one such mutant named Sante and you have to attempt to enter the city of Concurb 2 G-Gow to rescue your Father, Hante who is the leader of the Tribal Federation of Mutants. Once you manage to enter the city you must find four pieces of a digital key to enter your Father's cell and take him back to your cave outside the city. To make matters worse, your cousin Calte (played by player two or the computer) is also trying to gain entry and find your Father, not to rescue him but to kill him so he can become leader and if he finds you as well he will kill you.

meta.name: Mean Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.68 KB

Mean Machine is a vertically scrolling top view racing game where the screen scrolls up as you move your vehicle while trying to complete a lap of a track to advance to the next race. You can speed up and slow down your car as you try to overtake the other racers. Be careful of those behind you as you try to complete the lap within a time limit. Your vehicle is armed with limited amounts of missiles and oil slicks, but more can be collected as you travel. You must stay on the track or road, as touching the sides increases the damage meter, but in the event of an accident it will be immediately replenished and you will lose one life in three. As with the other drivers, there are also obstacles such as wreckage and water that must be jumped over using ramps.

meta.name: Mean Streak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En el futuro, la mayoría de la gente viaja con Matter Transporters, pero para los rebeldes esto es aburrido. Tomaron el camino orbital abandonado y lo convirtieron en el Battletrack. toma motocicleta Mean Streak y se lánzate a atravesar este peligroso mundo de estilo Mad Max, con el objetivo de atravesar estas difíciles carreteras de visión isométrica. Estás armado, pero también lo están los Outcasts a los que debes enfrentarte. Los peligros incluyen paredes, huecos en la carretera y manchas de aceite. Un escáner en la parte inferior de la pantalla da una advertencia avanzada. Puedes recoger armas mejoradas, combustible adicional y cajas de aceite, que puedes dejar caer en los senderos de las bicicletas en movimiento. Además de disparar a otras bicicletas, puede aplastarlas contra las paredes al costado de la carretera o contra los riesgos mencionados anteriormente.

meta.name: Mean Streets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Mean Streets" te pone en los zapatos de Tex Murphy, un carismático detective privado en un mundo ciberpunk, encargado de resolver el asesinato de un profesor universitario. Este profesor era uno de los ocho científicos involucrados en un misterioso proyecto para controlar personas a distancia. A medida que Tex profundiza en el caso, descubre más muertes relacionadas con el proyecto y se cruza con sospechosos de alto calibre: desde el jefe de la inteligencia británica hasta el dueño de una compañía de vigilancia y la propia hija del profesor. Interactúa con un elenco de personajes variopintos, haciendo preguntas incisivas o soltando algún soborno para obtener pistas jugosas. Aunque los puños pueden volar, la diplomacia suele ser tu mejor arma. Y no todo es investigación: surca los cielos en tu Lotus Speeder en emocionantes secciones de simulación de vuelo.

meta.name: Mech Brigade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

“Mech Brigade” is a tactical platoon-level simulation portraying a hypothetical armored warfare scenario between NATO and Soviet forces. Players can choose between four scenarios or create their own. NATO players may select a nationality from France, Great Britain, the United States, or West Germany. The game features five difficulty levels. Gameplay consists of an orders phase, where players issue commands to their units, and a combat phase, where units execute these orders one by one. While the majority of units are armored vehicles, there are also helicopters, artillery, and infantry. The game ends automatically after 15 turns (20 in assault scenarios), but it can end earlier or be extended if all parties agree. Victory points are awarded at the end to determine whether the battle resulted in a draw, a marginal, substantive, or decisive victory.

meta.name: Mechanicus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mechanicus is a pinball game for up to four players, notable for its three different tables (levels) and a variety of extras. Each player starts with three balls, and extra balls are awarded at specific scores (30,000, 80,000, 130,000, and 180,000 points). After the last regular ball, a “special ball” enters play, with its duration depending on the timer value shown at the bottom right. Losing this ball costs three minutes from the timer. If the ball is stopped by a flipper, a status report is displayed in the status bar. At 100,000 points, an exit opens, allowing access to the next level. In multiplayer mode, the exit is opened for all players as soon as one player reaches the required score. Regardless of who hits the exit first, all players are transported to the next level.

meta.name: Mediator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.85 KB

"Mediator" puts the player in the role of a galactic savior searching for the legendary Good Mediator, who holds the mythical Time Crystal. This crystal grants its owner the ability to psychokinetically banish destructive elements to another time zone. The journey starts on Xylos and leads to a distant planet, but at any moment, a recall to Xylos or Pholos may occur to fight off the menacing Zags with joystick-controlled rockets.

meta.name: The Medicine Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.09 KB

In "The Medicine Man," you play as Copecoee, the ancient god of energy, summoned to save a village from an impending flood. Using the control keys, you guide Copecoee and unleash energy beams to destroy raindrops and snowflakes. Each destroyed raindrop earns you 10 points, and snowflakes grant 20 points. Quick reflexes and precise aiming are essential to stop the flood and protect the village.

meta.name: Medieval Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.70 KB

"Medieval Adventure" takes you into a medieval world where you play as King Arthur, tasked with retrieving the Holy Grail from the fortress of your arch-enemy, the Black Knight. Your dangerous journey leads you through the Cregin Forest, where numerous perils await. Proper use of your weapons and armor is essential for survival. You have access to a sword, dagger, crossbow, and grappling hook, each of which must be used strategically to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. You will find yourself in life-threatening situations that require quick decision-making. Every wrong move could mean the end of your quest, but with skill and courage, you can defeat the Black Knight and complete your mission.

meta.name: Medieval Lords : Soldier Kings of Europe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Medieval Lords: Soldier Kings of Europe es un simulador de estrategia política / bélica que comienza (en su primer escenario) en 1028 AD y continúa hasta los 100 turnos o 500 años. Pueden participar hasta 10 jugadores, con el ordenador controlando hasta 6 jugadores. Se pueden establecer límites en la cantidad de acciones que se pueden realizar en cada turno, así que tenga cuidado con la expansión excesiva si no hay mucho tiempo para dar órdenes. 
El juego se desarrolla en Europa, el norte de África y el Medio Oriente, en un mundo lleno de conquistas, enfermedades y cambios. gestione asuntos internos como la economía y la estabilidad política, antes de intentar conquistar o formar alianzas con otras regiones. Eventos aleatorios como plagas y órdenes religiosas aseguran que cada juego sea diferente.

“Medieval Mayhem” is a simple shooter game – the player must fight enemies with precise shots. Quick reactions and accuracy are crucial to succeed.

meta.name: Medusa's Cave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.21 KB

Medusa's Cave takes you into a mysterious underworld filled with magic and danger, where you must explore the legendary cave of Medusa. With clever decisions and sharp wit, you must solve puzzles and face numerous creatures lurking in the dark depths. Your commands shape the course of the adventure – every choice can open new paths or lead to a dead end. As you unravel the secrets of the cave, the ultimate challenge looms closer: the encounter with Medusa herself. Will you manage to survive the myth?

meta.name: Mega Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.78 KB

En Mega Force controlas una nave espacial y te enfrentas en duelo contra otro jugador. Ofrece una experiencia competitiva y trepidante: debes destruir a tu rival mientras esquivas obstáculos y proyectiles al mismo tiempo.

meta.name: Mega Paratrooper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A multi-genre game, primarily a shooter, consisting of 4 levels/goals. The first goal called Fight in Space is a pure shooter. The second, Space Harbor, requires you to select three of the correct add-ons to progress (the incorrect ones end the game). Space Harbor Deeper Rooms is an insanely long snake game. Ultimate Fight is a safe cracking game that seems impossible because the code could be anything!

meta.name: Mega Phoenix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.08 KB

"Mega Phoenix" lleva el concepto del clásico juego arcade "Phoenix" a los años 90 y más tarde fue incluso adaptado a una versión de máquinas recreativas por Gaelco. El juego es un shoot 'em up de pantalla única donde el jugador se mueve de izquierda a derecha mientras dispara a oleadas de enemigos. Una función de escudo está disponible por una corta duración, pero requiere un período de recarga e inmoviliza la nave mientras está activa. Las primeras oleadas consisten en pequeñas criaturas alienígenas que vuelan en formación, sumergiéndose al azar hacia el jugador; el contacto con ellas resulta en una vida perdida. A continuación, fénix mortales disparan al jugador, seguidos por el Mega Phoenix y finalmente una lucha contra un jefe. El juego luego se reinicia con dificultad aumentada.

meta.name: Mega Poing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.35 KB

Mega Poing is a classic Pong clone that retains the familiar gameplay while featuring a modern visual style. Two players compete against each other, controlling paddles to keep the ball in play and score points. Alternatively, the game can be played solo against the computer. The controls are precise, and the gameplay remains true to the original, while the futuristic design and animations give it a fresh presentation.

meta.name: Mega Spaceboy 3D
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.44 KB

“Mega Spaceboy 3D” is a simple space shooter designed not as a full-fledged game but rather as a learning project to demonstrate collision detection and other essential game mechanics. The player controls a small spaceship, shooting at falling geometric objects while avoiding obstacles. The gameplay emphasizes precise collision handling and fundamental mechanics, making it a useful example for those interested in game development.

meta.name: Mega Turbo 3D
meta.desc:

“Mega Turbo 3D” is an arcade-style avoid-it game designed as a teaching project to introduce game creation concepts. The player controls a vehicle on a road, avoiding obstacles such as puddles, lightning, and other hazards while the environment dynamically changes. The game focuses on fundamental mechanics like collision detection, movement control, and gameplay logic, making it a great learning tool.

meta.name: Mega Worm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.62 KB

„Mega Worm“ is a classic snake/worm-style game where the player controls a continuously growing creature. The goal is to collect objects while avoiding collisions with its own body or obstacles. As the worm grows, the challenge increases, requiring precise control and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Mega-Apocalypse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mega-Apocalipsis se ambienta en un universo extraño lleno de planetas, lunas, estrellas y cometas que giran por la inmensidad del espacio. Investigaciones del Instituto de Investigación Avanzada han determinado que muchos de estos planetas están habitados, algunos por seres inteligentes, otros por criaturas bastante tontas, como los buccinos. El jugador es elegido como explorador con la tarea de buscar con audacia nuevos mundos extraños y emocionantes. Sin embargo, la misión es clarísima: ¡destruirlos por completo!

meta.name: Mega64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.84 KB

“Mega64” is a remake of “Megamania” for the Commodore 64, where you control a spaceship and defend yourself against quirky enemies such as hamburgers, diamonds, irons, flies, and cubes to score points before your energy runs out.

meta.name: Megabike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.83 KB

„Megabike“ is an action-packed shooter where the player rides a futuristic motorcycle through hostile terrain. The goal is to blast through anything in the way while dodging obstacles and eliminating enemies. Quick reflexes and precise aiming are key to surviving this high-speed combat game.

meta.name: Megabrain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"MegaBrain" is a memory game. The focus of this game is to test and train the players' memory. Players must remember patterns, sequences or positions and reproduce them correctly in order to collect points and reach the next level. As the difficulty increases, the patterns become more complex and require more concentration and a good short-term memory from the players. The gradual increase in difficulty ensures that "MegaBrain" offers an exciting challenge for both beginners and experienced memory players.

meta.name: Megahawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.86 KB

In Mega Hawk, you control a spaceship as enemies approach from the background. Your mission is to find a new universe, which you achieve by flying through and fighting your way across various levels. These include flying through tunnels, deep space, and over the surface of a planet. Along the way, you encounter various creatures and enemies that you can either avoid or shoot down. If you're hit, you lose one of your three lives. Each level has a decreasing timer bar, and a level is considered completed if you survive until the timer runs out.

meta.name: Megamax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.23 KB

Megamax is a simple platform game that focuses on minimalistic mechanics, emphasizing precise jumping and running. Players navigate through a series of obstacles, with timing and skill being the core challenges.

meta.name: Meganova : The Weapon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Meganova: The Weapon sigue a Philip Sunset, alias «Long Hands», un ladrón maestro cuya «profesión» es una de las mejor pagadas de la galaxia: robar lo que no le pertenece. Pero esta vez ha ido demasiado lejos: se ha apoderado del Sistema Sprocket, artefacto ultrasecreto del ejército Drowhar, que ahora lo persigue para reducirlo a polvo cósmico. Afortunadamente, Philip también es piloto de las fuerzas interestelares de la Confederación Terra-1, y cualquier ayuda que reciba podría ser clave para sobrevivir.

meta.name: Megawarz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.90 KB

“Megawarz” takes place in space – the Cyclonic Megawarz Uniship Mk1 travels from planet to planet via warps to reach Earth. The mission begins on Pluto, accessible with a single warp. The ship can rotate in all directions and thrust forward but comes to a stop without propulsion. Enemy aliens must be defeated to activate the next warp. A collision resets the level and costs a life. In addition to lasers, there is a limited shield. Astronauts floating in space grant bonus points and extend shield energy. After several warps, a bonus screen appears where astronauts must be saved from mutation.

meta.name: Megazone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.13 KB

Megazone turns flying through narrow cave systems into a tense fight for survival, forcing you to guide your helicopter with precision through dangerous terrain. Obstacles, enemy guns, and the constant need for fuel ensure that you are never simply flying straight ahead, but always weighing every movement and every shot with care. That blend of tight navigation, constant pressure, and targeted attacks gives the game a gripping and demanding appeal.

meta.name: Melee : The Battle Boardgame
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.21 KB

„Melee: The Battle Boardgame“ takes place on a board with spaces labeled from A to X – arranged from left to right and top to bottom. The player places their pieces by entering the letter of the desired starting position. To move a piece, they enter the current letter followed by the target space – for example, „A“ followed by „B“ to move a piece to the right.

meta.name: Melonmania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.95 KB

In “Melonmania,” you control Mr. Megafat, a famous melon grower who must protect his ripe melons from monsters on a midsummer night. The goal is to collect 30 melons and place them in a barrel near his hut before the night ends. You navigate through different areas, dodge monsters, shoot at them, and ensure your energy bar doesn't run out. Energy increases when monsters are avoided but decreases upon contact. If the bar depletes, you lose one of your lives. The game ends when the moon reaches the right edge of the screen.

meta.name: Melting Trail
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Melting Trail" desafía al jugador a sobrevivir el mayor tiempo posible en un camino que se derrite. A medida que el campo de juego se disuelve gradualmente, el jugador debe navegar sin pisar cuadros sólidos o ya derretidos. Con el tiempo, el juego se vuelve más difícil, ya que quedan cada vez menos áreas seguras disponibles.

meta.name: Memologie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.18 KB

“Memology” is a simple puzzle game where the goal is to find all hidden image pairs on a 6x6 grid. Discovered pairs remain visible with the “ok” marking. The game has a limited number of moves, which is displayed on the lower indicator.

meta.name: Memomania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.75 KB

Memomania is a simple puzzle-solving game. The goal requires finding all the covered pairs of pictures on the board. Discovered pairs disappear from the board. There is no time, counter on the top left corner indicates how many mistakes may be done.

meta.name: Memorix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.80 KB

„Memorix“ is a brain game that challenges and trains memory skills. The player is shown a screen with 25 pairs of identical icons for ten seconds before they are hidden. Within a set time limit, all matching pairs must be found. The game is not designed for those with a photographic memory but aims to help improve memory retention.

meta.name: Memorix II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.85 KB

„Memorix II“ is the improved sequel to „Memorix,“ offering an enhanced challenge for memory training. As in the original, the player is shown a screen with pairs of identical symbols for ten seconds before they are hidden. Within a set time limit, all matching pairs must be found. Improvements over the original may include increased difficulty, additional game modes, or a larger variety of symbols. The game remains an effective way to train memory and enhance cognitive performance.

meta.name: Memory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.66 KB

You awake slowly to bright lights. You are feeling confused as you look around the room. You cannot remember how you got here. As you begin to awaken you realize that you are tied down to the bed! As your eyes begin to focus you see a TV on the wall. It appears as if you're in a hospital room. Who are you, why are you here and can you escape?

meta.name: Memory Building Blocks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Memory Building Blocks is a tile matching memory puzzle game. Designed for young children, players take turns matching shapes, colors, words, tunes, and pictures. There are a variety of board designs, and allows for one or two players. A score or each player is displayed when all tiles are flipped.

meta.name: Memory Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

„Memory Castle“ is an educational game where the player takes on the role of a knight who must complete tasks within a castle. The game provides instructions that the player must memorize in order to answer questions correctly and proceed. A wrong answer results in the game ending, while correct choices allow progress. There are three difficulty levels, each differing in the number of instructions to remember: easy (6 instructions), medium (12 instructions), and hard (20 instructions). Upon successful completion, the player is rewarded with a different prize depending on the difficulty level.

meta.name: Memory Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.54 KB

In “Memory Manor,” children help Wee Willie wash windows before the water supply runs out. They must remember which windows to clean, such as those with cats, flowers, or birds, while avoiding windows with grim faces, as these consume too much water. Rain complicates the task by smudging the windows, making it harder to remember. The game promotes memory training, concentration, and careful planning.

meta.name: Memotest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Memotest is a memory game that can be played using either a joystick or a light pen/stylus. It features two game modes: matching pairs of numbers or finding identical shapes. Players flip over tiles one by one and must remember their locations to find matching pairs.

meta.name: Menace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Six ruthless dictators have collaborated to create the planet Draconia, which contains some of the most gruesome and harmful life-forms imaginable, all indulging in some rather unsavoury actions. Thus, you must go in your spaceship to destroy them all. The game is a side-scrolling R-Type-influenced shoot 'em up consisting of six visually-diverse levels. Waves of enemies come towards you to be shot, and reveal tokens, which when shot at will cycle through several available weapons. These include lasers, cannons, improved ship power and a shield.

meta.name: The Menage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 71.39 KB

The Menage challenges the player to solve a murder case by identifying the culprit, uncovering the motive, and finding the murder weapon. The story takes place in a lavishly decorated building where the occupants are visibly shaken. Each suspect has their own alibi and story, but not all can be trusted. The player must interrogate individuals and gather clues to uncover the truth.

meta.name: Mental Blocks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mental Blocks consists of three games: Free Fall, or Fits and Pieces, is a 3D version of Tetris. Instead of forming a line, you must form a complete layer before it will disappear. The California Achievement Cubes, or Mental Detector, shows you a cube, and challenges you to figure out which of the four unfolded cubes matches the cube. The single-player version has a timer, while the two player version has you pick the proper cube first. What's Next, Pussycat?, or Shapes Happen, shows you three shapes, and asks you to pick the next shape in the series from a set of four choices. Again, you either face the timer or your friend.

meta.name: Mercenary
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mercenary begins with a crash landing on the planet Targ, where you must find a way to escape. Caught in a civil war between the native Palyars and the invading Mechanoids, you can take on missions for either side, capturing resources and destroying facilities to earn money for your getaway. Multiple strategies are available, allowing you to decide whether to leave Targ simply or escape with the wealth you have amassed.

meta.name: Mercenary 2 - The Second City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mercenary: The Second City is an expansion disk for Mercenary, which features the same gameplay and controls. Following the successes over Targ's Central City, the controller of the BENSON computer relaxes and enjoys himself. Soon however, he grows bored and starts looking around for new challenges on the still hazardous Planet Targ. Rumors about the Palyar Commander's brother-in-law living in the southern hemisphere suggest that this may be a good challenge. In this Second City, the battle between Palyars and Mechanoids still rages... and nothing is as it seems.

meta.name: Mercs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El Presidente de los Estados Unidos ha sido secuestrado durante un viaje a un país centroafricano. Para evitar una ruptura diplomática, se llama a un cuerpo especial de élite: los Mercs.
En este Run and Gun tendrás que limpiar y destruir las cajas para encontrar armas más potentes y botiquines para restaurarte durante el juego. Al final de cada nivel te enfrentarás a un jefe. Su energía está representada por cuadrados rojos. Todos tienen un punto débil que te permite derrotarlos sin exponerte demasiado. Con cada serie de golpes, el poder del jefe disminuirá hasta erradicarlo. Las armas son bastante variadas, por ejemplo, después de la sencilla M16, pasarás a un tipo de arma desconocida con un disparo en abanico muy eficaz y después al lanzallamas.

meta.name: Merlin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.60 KB

Merlin challenges the player to defend the most powerful wizard of all time against the combined forces of evil. Using magical spells, Merlin must fight off dark creatures sent to defeat him. Since his magical energy is limited, he must regularly brew a potion by collecting magical ingredients and dropping them into the cauldron. However, enemy creatures will attempt to sabotage the brew by dropping anti-spells on parachutes. The greatest threat is the Hellwasp – a single touch means instant death.

meta.name: Mermaid Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.99 KB

In “Mermaid Madness,” players take on the role of Myrtle the mermaid, who has finally found her dream man, the diver Gordon, after 112 years. However, Gordon is less than thrilled – he flees into the water and gets stuck under a ship. Myrtle must rescue him by navigating an underwater labyrinth, collecting items, and using them in the correct locations to progress. Along the way, she must avoid enemies, as their touch depletes her energy. Energy can be restored by collecting beer bottles. With no scrolling, players explore the surroundings while Gordon's air supply acts as a time limit.

meta.name: Merry Christmas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Merry Christmas from Melbourne House is a short graphical text adventure for kids. It's Christmas Eve, and there's trouble at the North Pole. Can you help Santa get ready in time and deliver the presents? Players must solve simple puzzles while exploring the North Pole to assist Santa on his journey.

meta.name: Metabolis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.69 KB

Your land has been invaded by the evil Kremins, who have used their magic to turn all your friends and family into birds and mice. You were also turned into a bird, but luckily the transformation wasn't complete and you retained your brain. You have decided that you are the only one who can defeat the Kremins and break the spell. In this arcade-like platformer, you must explore their vast flickscreen domain and search for the serum that will turn you human. Additionally, a wizard must be found to strengthen your weakened heart before collecting four pieces of nuclear fuel, which he places in the reactor room to blow up the domain, destroying all the Kremins and breaking the spell.

The player controls a llama which is positioned at the bottom of the screen and spiders descend into the play area  using threads, breaking them and dropping to the ground before mutating and mounting a crawling attack. The llama's primary weapon is it's own spittle, which is fired up at a 45 degree angle from horizontal in the direction the beast is facing, before ricocheting off one side of the play area, the otherwise useless planar shield high above the llama's head and then the other side of the play area before slamming into the ground and stopping. That shield can also be positioned vertically with the joystick, allowing the player to change how the spit moves around the screen and in turn aim at attackers or their threads pretty much anywhere.

En 1995, un grupo de mercenarios causó una crisis en Sudáfrica al erigir la fortaleza "Outer Heaven". Fox Hound solicita la ayuda de un nuevo recluta, Solid Snake, para investigar la desaparición de Gray Fox y la misteriosa arma.

An action/adventure game set in a dismally futuristic 2010. Ian, a young metal guitarist, finds his bandmate Sadok shot; rumor has it that sinister forces have it in for heavy metal bands, and after recovering from his hangover, Ian sets out to investigate. His quest takes him into the streets teeming with mutants and thugs, as he seeks to contact his remaining bandmates and gradually piece together the details of the conspiracy.
As the game progresses Ian will have to take on the bad guys using a variety of weapons, procure money to make purchases, find or buy certain essential items to unlock new quests and areas, and talk to NPCs for hints on what is happening and what to do. The game is divided into episodes, with graphical cutscenes serving to communicate the plot.

meta.name: Metal Warrior 2

The game plays much like its predecessor, being a side-scrolling action/adventure. Phantasm will have to deal with characters both friendly and hostile, whether with words or with weapons; she starts out wielding only her fists, but more armaments can be found, as well as a host of other useful items. New features include an experience system, which works somewhat like Castlevania's, and a password feature which lets you continue your game in case of a premature death.

meta.name: Metamorphosis 2 - Attack on Cyglorx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.90 KB

Metamorphosis is a single screen game spread over four screens as you enter the fortress belonging to 'The Creator' and your quest is to destroy him as well as any robots that inhabit his home. The first screen has you attempting to get to an exit at the top of the screen while robots move around the screen leaving a trail of walls that can't be passed. If you touch a robot then you lose one of five lives and have to attempt to escape again. The second screen is full of eggs containing robots guarded by tanks and you have to destroy all the tanks while avoiding getting shot or hitting the tanks themselves. Once all tanks are destroyed then the eggs will hatch and you need to destroy all the robots. Later screens have you facing more robots, The Creator himself as well as his power source which needs destroying to complete your quest.

meta.name: Creators Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.30 KB

The Creator has created an army consisting of robots and insects to destroy the earth, while also dropping bombs on the worlds major cities. You have been given the task of driving a tank to destroy The Creator while destroying as much of his army as you can as well as destroying a bomb before it can be dropped on a city.
Creators Revenge is a sequel to Metamorphosis and is a mixture of a top view vertical shooter where the screen scrolls upwards constantly, and a top view single screen shooter as well.

p: Metamorphosis IV - Labyrinth of the Creator (Europe).D64
n: Metamorphosis IV - Labyrinth of the Creator (Europe)

meta.name: Metamorphosis 4 - Labyrinth of the Creator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

After trying to destroy 'The Creator' in Creators Revenge, you are once again attempting to destroy him in his heavily guarded fortress in this top view flick screen maze game. The Creator is in a sealed chamber and you have to move around the fortress through multiple exits on each screen looking for three keys so you can open a room containing a power source which keeps the chamber sealed. The keys have to be collected in order, with each key collected opening the room containing the next key. Once all three keys are collected then you can open the power source room and destroy it before finally entering the chamber containing The Creator and destroying him.

meta.name: Metaplex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Metaplex sends you into a vast metal complex hidden inside an asteroid, where the two-headed alien Garth is preparing his plans to destroy Earth. To stop him, you must collect flasks, fill them with acid, and use them to destroy four power units that sustain his strength. As you explore the complex room by room, Garth's minions stand in your way and force you to use shields and lasers carefully. This creates a tense maze adventure that effectively combines exploration, resource management, and the fight against an overwhelming threat.

meta.name: Meteor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.91 KB

Meteor challenges the player to navigate a spaceship through a hazardous asteroid field. As meteors rush across the screen at varying speeds, the player must dodge them precisely to avoid destruction. The remaining time and number of lives are displayed on the right side of the screen. With each second survived, the difficulty increases, making quick reflexes essential to progressing to the next level.

meta.name: Meteor Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.77 KB

Meteor Madness is a shoot-'em-up game where the player controls a crosshair to protect their ship from a meteor shower. With quick reflexes and precise aiming, you fend off the incoming threats.

meta.name: Methodos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.95 KB

Methodos puts the player in control of a silver orb navigating a twisting labyrinth. The goal is to collect puzzle pieces while shooting or avoiding enemy creatures. Teleporters and floor triggers help unlock new paths and further exploration. However, time is limited, making quick actions and strategic movement essential to successfully completing the level.

meta.name: Metranaut
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.12 KB

Metranaut is a platform game where the player controls an astronaut who must collect all the fuel pods on the screen. These pods also form part of the platforms and change color when stepped on. Once all fuel pods are collected, the player moves to the next level. Besides walking, the astronaut can use a jetpack for short bursts of flight, but air supply is limited. Enemies follow set movement patterns and must be avoided, as contact results in losing a life. Some platforms slowly disappear when walked on, requiring careful navigation. The game also includes a screen editor, allowing players to design and play their own custom levels.

meta.name: Metro Blitz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.41 KB

Metro Blitz is a side view single screen shooter where you control a spacecraft to protect a huge city below, from an alien attack of various waves. To destroy the city, the aliens will appear from the edges of the screen and crash into the city to destroy a part of it. Once the words Metro-Blitz have been removed from beneath the city then you have failed and it is game over. To stop the aliens you have to keep shooting them while avoiding touching them or the sides of the screen, or you lose one of ten lives. To move to the next wave you have to survive while a bar decreases and when it disappears then you move to the next wave. You can select your starting wave on the title screen (1 - 24).

meta.name: Metro-Cross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un sencillo juego de desplazamiento lateral en el que encarnas a un patinador que debe superar una serie de obstáculos para llegar al final del nivel.
Puedes patinar hacia arriba o hacia abajo por la pantalla, o incluso saltar, para protegerte de las tuberías que encuentres por el camino. A medida que avanza el juego, los obstáculos son más frecuentes y más difíciles, pero la esencia sigue siendo la misma. La sincronización lo es todo en este juego.

meta.name: Metron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.66 KB

"Metron" puts the player in control of a spaceship with the mission to destroy everything in space—including mines, cruisers, and star bases. Cruisers remain invisible until the player nears their base, at which point they attack and start circling the ship, forcing the player to eliminate them. Two types of asteroids appear: red ones contain minerals that increase the score when destroyed but must be dealt with quickly before being replaced by a processor. Green asteroids leave behind smart bombs, which can be used to destroy star bases, though only three can be active at a time. The game ends when the player's energy runs out or if the ship moves off the playfield.

Driving a souped-up F40, he must hunt down and destroy red cars while racing against a strict time limit. Collisions with buildings or other vehicles should be avoided, and shooting too many civilian cars results in instant failure. Reckless driving near police cars will get the player stopped, wasting valuable time. A city map assists in tracking down the targets.

meta.name: Miami Dice

“Miami Dice” is a digital version of the classic casino game Craps. Two dice are rolled, and the player can place bets on the outcome of the next throw. There are numerous betting options that can be used strategically. The game presents a side view of the table, showing the player, up to three other participants, and the croupier. After each roll, an option screen can be brought up to place new bets.

“Miami Vice” follows the investigations of Crockett and Tubbs as they attempt to take down a drug ring led by Mr. J. The player starts by arresting low-level dealers before moving up to their suppliers and ultimately the bosses in a casino. Missions combine driving sequences and shootouts in an overhead view of Miami. Criminals can be stopped to gather information, though some must be taken down by force. When a meeting is discovered, the player can enter on foot to collect evidence or make arrests — but the criminals inside won't simply let them do their job. Everything happens under a time limit, and crashing the car results in a one-minute penalty.

„Michael Jordan vs Larry Bird: One On One“ brings together two of the greatest NBA legends. While Michael Jordan impresses with spectacular dunks, Larry Bird stands out with his incredible accuracy from long range. meta.name: Mickey Mouse : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.02 KB

El Rey Ogro y sus secuaces han tomado el Castillo Disney, y Mickey debe recuperarlo. El juego empieza en una secuencia de escaleras que Mickey debe subir, disparando a cualquier criatura que se interponga. Al llegar a una puerta, accede a la segunda fase: laberintos multiantalla vistos desde arriba, con múltiples salidas por pantalla. Fantasmas y ogros bloquean su camino, pero Mickey cuenta con una pistola de agua (contra fantasmas) y un hacha (contra ogros), ambos con munición limitada que debe reponer. Algunas puertas requieren llaves para abrirlas.

meta.name: Mickey's Runaway Zoo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mickey's Runaway Zoo has Mickey and Goofy teaming up to return escaped animals to the zoo. Young players must find hidden numbers in colorful landscapes and press the matching key on the keyboard. When the correct number is entered, a short animation plays, showing that exact number of animals boarding the wagon for their return to the zoo.

meta.name: Mickey's Space Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Mickey's Space Adventure“ begins when Mickey and Pluto stumble upon a spaceship. Once aboard, they receive a mission from the planet Oron: A thief once stole the planet's memory crystal, broke it into nine pieces, and hid them across different planets in the solar system. Mickey must now travel through space, retrieve the crystal fragments, and restore Oron's memories. Along the journey, information about the visited planets is displayed, and the ship's computer occasionally provides hints. Instead of traditional text input, players use the cursor keys to highlight words and form short sentences. If an illogical action is chosen, the game suggests better alternatives.

meta.name: Micro Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.71 KB

A pinball game for up to four players. The game features one simple pinball table. Lighting up the letters ABC at the top of the table scores 10,000 points. (The letters can be rotated by the player.) Also includes most of the usual pinball features, including bonus multipliers.

meta.name: Micro Drivin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.41 KB

„Micro Drivin“ is an adventure game where the player drives a car to take part in the great island treasure hunt. Along the journey, clues must be deciphered, and correct decisions made to reach the goal. The gameplay combines driving mechanics with text input, requiring both driving skills and logical thinking.

meta.name: Micro Hexagon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.60 KB

MICRO HEXAGON is a minimal action game by Paul Koller, with music by Mikkel Hastrup. This Commodore 64 reinterpretation of the original SUPER HEXAGON was released on the 1st December 2013 as an entry in the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Competition (2013), in which it achieved 2nd place.

meta.name: Micro Mouse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.08 KB

Micro Mouse is a top view maze game where the screen scrolls up or down when you move a robot to repair the circuits of a super computer. The powers-to-be who own the computer feel that it is a waste of time sending in trained engineers to solder broken parts of the circuit when small robots containing a cyber brain can do the job themselves. You have been tasked to train a robot in the shape of a mouse by moving the robot around the circuit manually, repairing broken sections so that it will learn the job in hand.

meta.name: Micro Mouse Goes De-Bugging
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.91 KB

“Micro Mouse Goes Debugging” takes place inside a computer program, where you play as Micro Mouse collecting missing letters and inserting them into the flashing lines of code, while hostile bugs try to drag the letters back to their cages – only by skillfully switching between collecting and using datakill for defense can you prevent system crashes and progress through increasingly complex levels.

meta.name: Micro Olympics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eleven Track 'N' Field style events are recreated in this joystick-waggling based game. Five are simple running events of different distances ranging from 100 meters to 1500 meters. Unlike Daley Thompson's Decathlon the longer events don't involve a different technique, or different performance measurements, making the 1500m quite tiring. There are also three throwing events (Javelin, Discus and Hammer), and the High / Long / Triple Jump events. Each event has a pre-defined world record to chase.

meta.name: Micro Painter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.90 KB

In Micro Painter, you control a small painter working on a grid to draw lines in various colors. The goal is to complete specific patterns while defending yourself against obstacles or enemies that appear on the screen. The challenge increases as you progress, with the grid filling up faster, requiring more careful work to complete the given tasks. The faster you go, the more precision is needed to succeed.

meta.name: Micro Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.74 KB

„Micro Rescue“ puts the player in the role of a pilot who must rescue six stranded men from the planet's surface and return them to the mothership. Avoiding obstacles and keeping an eye on the fuel supply is crucial as time is constantly ticking away. Skill and quick reactions are essential to save all the men in time.

meta.name: Micro Rhythm (Europe)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 600.32 KB

meta.name: Micro Rhythm+ (Europe)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 693.65 KB

meta.name: Micro-MUD (Multi User Dungeon)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Micro-MUD” is a single-player version of “Multi User Dungeon,” where the computer simulates human players. The goal is to reach 102,400 points and become a wizard – achieved by defeating other players, completing minor tasks, or collecting treasure. To secure treasures permanently, they must be placed in the swamp – otherwise, they are lost. The game world includes over 400 locations and a database of 100 characters, with only 10 active at a time. However, 112 hostile enemies make the journey more dangerous. With just 250 treasures available, they are quickly collected, causing the game to reset. Played in the style of a classic text adventure – with no graphics – commands control the character, who interacts with other simulated players in real time.

meta.name: Microchess #3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.87 KB

“Microchess #3” is a chess simulation with a minimalist design and stylized pieces – offering a strategic challenge against a computer-controlled AI. The unique representation of the pieces gives the classic game its own visual identity.

meta.name: Microcosm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.56 KB

The interstellar freightliner, Nimbus, is crippled, deep in unchartered space. Insect mutations roam freely about the ship, threatening to devour the priceless cargo of Terran plant life. There is one last hope. With your help, the maintenance engineer may just be able to repair the maintenance ladders and keep the plants alive until help arrives...
Each repair section of maintenance ladder can be collected - one at a time - from the roof despatch point, and carried to one of the ladder 'stumps' in the plant house. When all the ladders have been repaired you will move on to a new plant house.

meta.name: Microdeal Shuttle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.36 KB

“Microdeal Shuttle” is an early simulation of a NASA mission to retrieve a failed satellite – with most controls handled via joystick. The mission is divided into five phases. After an automatic lift-off from Earth's gravity, you guide the shuttle to a rendezvous point. Once the satellite is in sight, approach it carefully before using the robotic arm to capture and secure it in the cargo bay. During re-entry, you steer the shuttle into a designated target zone, before finally guiding it to a safe landing in an external view. The cockpit features a realistic instrument panel displaying altitude, speed, and course information. Certain mission phases switch to an outside view for clarity. Failing a stage does not abort the mission – instead, points are awarded based on performance.

meta.name: Microgo1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Microgo1” is a digital adaptation of the classic board game Go, which can only be played against the computer. Black and white stones are placed alternately on a grid board, with the goal of controlling territory and capturing opposing stones through strategic encirclement. The game includes options to pass or resign, while a counter keeps track of captured stones. With its minimalist presentation, “Microgo1” offers an authentic Go experience for fans of strategic board games.

meta.name: MicroLeague Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“MicroLeague Baseball” is purely strategy-based rather than action-driven – featuring licensed teams and players, including classic teams from the past. Each play is visually represented, accompanied by a running commentary that describes the events in detail. A wide range of strategic options allows for selecting between seven batting techniques, utilizing substitutes, and determining player aggressiveness in key situations. Defensive choices include field positioning and pitching styles – with Fastballs and Curveballs requiring careful use. Players may suffer injuries, which can be minimized through proper warm-ups, and controversial calls can lead to arguments with the umpire.

meta.name: MicroLeague Baseball : General Manager : Owner Dis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

“MicroLeague Baseball – General Manager / Owner Disk” expands the game “MicroLeague Baseball,” one of the first video games officially licensed by Major League Baseball. The expansion allows players to create players and customize teams through trades. The game emphasized management aspects and introduced features such as adjusting batting stances and positioning fielders. It included legendary teams like the 1927 New York Yankees, 1955 Brooklyn Dodgers, 1975 Cincinnati Reds, and more, complemented by AL and NL All-Time Greats as well as the rosters from the 1984 All-Star Game.

meta.name: MicroLeague Baseball II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“MicroLeague Baseball II” is a baseball management simulation where the player takes on the role of a Major League manager. With realistic statistics for pitching, hitting, fielding, and running, the game offers strategic depth. It features an exclusive “Quick-Play” option as well as famous teams from both the past and present.

meta.name: Microleague Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

MicroLeague Football is a football simulation where the player acts as the head coach of a team. Before the game, home and visiting teams can be selected, with either being controlled by a human or the computer. The player can make roster adjustments as needed. During the game, the player can call plays, set pass patterns, make substitutions for injuries, and make other strategic decisions. A 'quick' game option is also available, displaying only the results, which can be printed if desired.

meta.name: MicroLeague Wrestling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

MicroLeague Wrestling is a wrestling game, the very first one licensed by the World Wrestling Federation. The game can be played by one or two players and comes with two possible match-ups, each with a separate match disk. There is Hulk Hogan versus "Macho Man" Randy Savage (all platforms) and Hulk Hogan versus "Mr. Wonderful" Paul Orndorff (Atari ST/C64). For DOS and Amiga the second match is Hogan vs. Dibiase. A bout can last 10, 20 or 60 minutes.
Game presentation before, during, and after fights is modeled after WWF TV shows and features digitized stills of actual WWF personalities, including wrestlers, managers, interviewers, commentators and announcers. Digitized images illustrate on-camera interviews, the wrestlers' entrances (complete with renditions of their themes), ringside commentary, and the reactions of the crowd.

meta.name: Keith van Eron's Pro Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

¡Vuélvete loco por el fútbol! MicroProse Soccer es divertido y emocionante, y te brinda la oportunidad de competir a nivel mundial. El juego presenta una perspectiva aérea del campo, lo que facilita el desarrollo de los partidos. Puedes desafiar a la computadora o a un oponente, eligiendo entre 16 equipos diferentes. Los gráficos y efectos de sonido capturan la atmósfera y la acción de un partido real, y una vez que hayas comenzado, ganar depende de tu habilidad: ¡los jugadores pueden realizar una gran variedad de movimientos! MicroProse Soccer: fácil de jugar, pero difícil de dominar, esta simulación te mantendrá enganchado día tras día.

meta.name: A Mid - Hallow Night's Scream
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.15 KB

In A Mid: Hallow Night's Scream, a spell has been cast on you, and you are no longer quite yourself. Your task is to escape the dusty study and collect the necessary ingredients in time to get your cauldron boiling before the witching hour strikes. To achieve this, you must solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and uncover the secrets of the spell that has trapped you in this predicament. While keeping an eye on the clock, you will encounter various magical challenges and obstacles that you must overcome to save yourself and regain your full power.

meta.name: Midnight Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.78 KB

Midnight Raider is reminiscent of Henry's House and is a platformer in which the player must collect various objects in a giant kitchen setting. The levels consist of oversized household items such as plates, forks, and pots that serve as platforms. The player must strategically use ladders and jump pads to reach all the collectibles while avoiding enemy elements. Precise timing and skillful movement are key to success.

meta.name: Midnight Resistance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Midnight Resistance, te enfrentas al poder brutal del Rey Carmesí y sus Fuerzas Carmesí tras secuestrar a tu abuelo y cinco familiares para pervertir su conocimiento científico con fines malignos. Como miembro de la resistencia, atraviesas nueve niveles de plataformas con scroll, cada uno culminando en una batalla contra un jefe final. Los enemigos atacan a pie y en vehículos, y torretas ametralladoras jalonan tu camino. Al derrotarlos, sueltan llaves que puedes canjear en puntos de compra por armas (ametralladora, lanzallamas…), aunque debes adquirir munición aparte; al agotarse, pierdes el arma. Su sistema de control te permite disparar en múltiples direcciones y arrastrarte por bordes bajos, una mecánica inteligente que puede salvarte en situaciones críticas.

meta.name: Midway Campaign
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.05 KB

Midway Campaign es una simulación por ordenador de la batalla de la isla de Midway en junio de 1942, posiblemente una de las batallas más decisivas de la historia de la guerra. El ordenador controla la flota de barcos japoneses cuyo objetivo es invadir y capturar la isla de Midway. Tú diriges a las fuerzas estadounidenses, superadas en número, y tu única ventaja es el elemento sorpresa. El juego termina si todos los portaaviones de un bando son hundidos.

meta.name: Miecze Valdgira 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Miecze Valdgira II continues the epic journey of the dwarven mage Aldir. After lifting the curse from the castle and liberating Heldgor in the first part, he was crowned king of the fortress and surrounding lands. But injustice still plagues the world, and once again, he is called to battle. Choosing to go alone, he sets off for Dale to free the city from the grasp of a ruthless tyrant. However, before he can complete his quest, he falls into the trap of Bloody Zeno, is stripped of the legendary swords of Valdgir, and thrown into a dungeon. Now, he must fight for survival—without weapons, but with unwavering determination. Will he escape and emerge victorious once more?

meta.name: Mig Alley Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„MiG Alley Ace“ takes you into the intense aerial combat of the Korean War, where you pilot a jet over the infamous „MiG Alley“ in North Korea, battling enemy aircraft. This was the setting for the world's first large-scale jet-to-jet dogfights, including legendary encounters between the American F-86 Sabre and the Soviet MiG-15. The game features five different scenarios based on real battles, playable solo or in two-player mode — either cooperatively or in direct duels. Your objective is to shoot down as many enemy planes as possible before your own squadron is destroyed. Precision flying, tactical skill, and quick reflexes will determine your success in the skies.

meta.name: Mig-19
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.84 KB

„MiG-19“ puts you in the cockpit of the legendary Soviet MiG-19, the world's first mass-produced supersonic fighter jet. As a pilot of this twin-engine interceptor, you must dodge incoming enemy fighters, evade ground-based attacks, and ensure a safe return to the tarmac. Mastering agility, quick reflexes, and precise flying is crucial to surviving the hostile skies and completing your mission. Can you fight through enemy lines and bring your jet home in one piece?

meta.name: Mig-29 Soviet Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.56 KB

La comparación más cercana a este juego de aviones sería Afterburner. El ángulo de visión se sitúa ligeramente detrás de tu avión, que debe disparar a los aviones, tanques e instalaciones enemigas mientras evita su fuego. Está armado con diferentes tipos de armas, incluyendo bombas de lanzamiento, misiles aire-aire y una bomba nuclear. Puedes recoger más recogiendo los paracaídas que caen en tu camino. Hay cadenas montañosas, desiertos y etapas árticas que atravesar en el camino, con grandes boss a los que enfrentarse.

En lo que parece ser un mundo de fantasía medieval llamado Varn, un grupo de aventureros busca entrar en el codiciado Inner Sanctum. Pronto los héroes se dan cuenta de que uno de los cuatro reyes que gobiernan las tierras de Varn es en realidad un impostor, una criatura del espacio exterior. Su tarea es encontrar al verdadero rey y detener al misterioso viajero espacial, revelando así la verdad sobre el origen del mundo.The Secret of the Inner Sanctum es un juego de rol y la primera entrega de la serie Might and Magic. El concepto básico del juego es similar al de los juegos de Wizardry, aunque el juego no se centra únicamente en la exploración de mazmorras y presenta zonas y ciudades en el mundo exterior que se pueden recorrer físicamente. En este sentido, el juego se parece a The Bard's Tale, aunque tiene un entorno de juego mucho más amplio con varias ciudades.

La secuela de la exitosa Might and Magic I, se jactó mejores gráficos, un mundo más grande, pero aun asi sigue siendo más o menos el mismo motor de juego y presentación. Embárcate en un viaje glorioso y salva el mundo de CRON y de ti mismo. Un equipo equilibrado es una necesidad en este juego. Hay varias ubicaciones y elementos que están restringidos a ciertos géneros, alineaciones o razas. Un equipo compuesto por buenos hombres humanos no te llevará muy lejos. El tiempo juega un papel importante en este juego. El viaje en el tiempo es parte de él, pero en un nivel más básico, encontrarás que los personajes envejecen a medida que avanza el juego. Si esperas demasiado, las estadísticas de tus personajes cambiarán para reflejar su envejecimiento.

After selecting a specialist subject and two teammates, various rounds follow: multiple-choice questions, guessing musicians with up to three clues, choosing between easy and hard questions, matching events to years, and a quickfire round with a time limit. Finally, the remaining Jukebox questions are answered.

The spacecraft then has to navigate safely into a black hole to continue the journey. As the game progresses, the difficulty increases, requiring greater skill and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Mill Mania

According to ancient Iridani law, the first born son of the Great Galactic Emperor has to participate in a Test of Arms to become Prince of the Southern Nebular and become first in line to the throne. You are Prince Kronos and your father is Iridon I and the time has come for you to take the test which means being transported to the toughest battlefield in the Universe, Earth. You have to visit five time zones and fight an opponent from each era in a one-on-one fight with a weapon to pass the test. The time zones are Caveman, Knights, Arabian, Pirates and a final battle in space.

By continuously shooting upward, the bug can be hit, splitting into two parts that move in opposite directions. If it touches the screen edge or an obstacle, it moves down one row and continues its path. The screen is filled with mushrooms that block movement but can be destroyed with multiple shots. Additional creatures like spiders and snails appear, which can either be avoided or shot for bonus points. If the Millibug reaches the bottom, it moves back up. Touching the bug or any other creature results in the loss of one of three lives. Before starting, players can select a skill level from one to nine.

Three companies from Computer, Oil & Gas, Retail Sales, Auto, and Heavy Industries are present on this market. Stock prices are changing each week due to economical, political, or social situations. On each turn you should examine the news and trends, and buy or sell a certain quantity of stocks in order to increase your net worth. Based on your net worth, you'll be classified by one of the five ranks: Novice, Investor, Speculator, Professional, or Broker. The higher rank you have, the more investment opportunities are available to you. The goal is to finish the session with as a high a net worth as possible; the highest rank is Millionaire. Inside begins a dangerous journey through a neural maze – white blood cells and antibodies follow set paths and must be avoided, or you'll grow in size and lose a life. The walls will also make you grow if touched, blocking your progress. If you manage to destroy the central neuron with your laser, you can continue navigating the brain – but enemies get faster and the battle grows tougher.

meta.desc:

Mindbender uses similar gameplay principles to Deflektor, which means that you have indirect control over a beam of light. On each of the 50 levels you must guide it from a starting point to an ending point, taking out all the enemies along the way. Rotating each of the many mirrors on the level to send the beam onto the points the enemies hover over does this – reaching many of them will involve several attempts at finding the right combination of angles. Rotating barriers, light bulb switches and locked sections must all be taken into account, but there are also magic balloons later on. All this must be done within a time limit, and directing the beam back into itself causes overloads and must be avoided, Tron-style.
