Minitron is a minimalist arcade game reminiscent of classic Tron-inspired light cycle duels. The player controls a continuously moving line and must navigate carefully to avoid crashing into walls or their own trail. Tactical maneuvering and quick reflexes are key to surviving as long as possible in this fast-paced gameplay.

meta.name: Minnesota Fat's Pool Challenger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.98 KB

"Minnesota Fats' Pool Challenge", also known as "Hustler," offers a top-down view of the billiard table and allows for different playstyles. Using a joystick and key commands, players can shoot balls, break, or bank the cue ball against an opponent or the table itself. The six available modes include pocketing any ball into any pocket, potting balls in a specific order, sinking a designated ball into a chosen pocket, scoring points by potting balls in marked pockets, a variant with fewer balls, and a mode where players must play both the lowest and highest numbered balls.

meta.name: Minotax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.45 KB

Minotax throws the player into an action-packed mission, flying into a heavily guarded fortress with a jetpack. Skillful dodging is essential to evade enemy guns and deadly traps. Inside the citadel, laser guardians must be bypassed and generators destroyed to weaken the defense system. The labyrinth is treacherous, but if every brick in the protective walls is taken out, victory is within reach.
meta.developer: H. Zilken, J. Bonow & G. Wollseifen

meta.name: Mirror Galaxy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.76 KB

Mirror Galaxy is a classic shooter where you become embroiled in space battles. The game takes you through various waves of enemies, where you must defend yourself with gunfire. Mirror Galaxy fits into the popular shoot-'em-up games of its time.

meta.name: The Miser
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.21 KB

The Miser follows the story of Ebenezer Scrooge, who must perform twelve good deeds to atone for his miserable existence. To Scrooge, this task seems almost impossible, but before he can complete it, he must first discover what these deeds are and how to accomplish them. He must observe his surroundings, question passersby, and gather clues. Only after completing all tasks can he return to his nephew's house to conclude his journey.

meta.name: Major Indoor Soccer League
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The official game of the MISL, this game allows you to create an expansion team and build it into a championship franchise. You can trade and create players, modify team rosters, and train players for the season. Team stats are kept for 9 seasons, and the game offers the ability to coach, GM, play or all 3.

meta.name: Miss Mind Ania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.27 KB

Miss Mind Ania is a variation of the classic logic game, where the player competes against Ania. The goal is to decipher a secret number combination through strategic guessing and logical deduction. Each input is evaluated with clues to help find the correct sequence.

meta.name: Missile Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Missile Attack" is a defense game where the player must protect a base from incoming missiles. Enemy projectiles descend from the sky, and the player must intercept them with precise countermeasures before they destroy the cities. The challenge lies in strategically managing limited resources while responding to increasingly fast and numerous attacks.

meta.name: Missile Blasta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.54 KB

Missile Blasta takes the player into deep space, defending their home planet from incoming giant alien nuclear missiles. Each hit blasts a missile to pieces and earns 100 points. The player must avoid direct contact with the missiles, as each hit depletes a shield. If all five shields are lost, the ship is destroyed, and Earth is doomed.

meta.name: Missile Busters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.80 KB

"Missile Busters" is a catch-it type game where the player must protect their home planet from an evil alien race. The only way to stop the invasion is by collecting incoming missiles into the Missile Compaction Container. Survival depends on successfully catching the missiles—losing all lives means the aliens have won, and the planet will be destroyed.

meta.name: Missile Busters II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.20 KB

"Missile Busters II" is a collect-em-up style game where the player must protect their planet from falling missiles once again. To stop the threat, the missiles must be collected into the Missile Compaction Container. If the contamination damage counter reaches 100%, the planet is doomed. Various power-ups can be either helpful or useless. Left and right arrow objects expand the container's length, making it easier to catch missiles. Bomb power-ups should be avoided at all costs, as they will instantly destroy the planet.

meta.name: Missile Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

¡Misteriosos invasores están atacando tus ciudades! Como comandante de una base de misiles, es tu responsabilidad defenderlas. Los enemigos llegarán desde el cielo para intentar destruir las ciudades de la parte inferior de la pantalla. Debes disparar misiles para evitar los bombardeos. Tienes una cantidad limitada de munición, así que asegúrate de que tus disparos son precisos.

meta.name: Missile Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.34 KB

¡Misteriosos invasores están atacando tus ciudades! Como comandante de una base de misiles, es tu responsabilidad defenderlas. Los enemigos llegarán desde el cielo para intentar destruir las ciudades de la parte inferior de la pantalla. Debes disparar misiles para evitar los bombardeos. Tienes una cantidad limitada de munición, así que asegúrate de que tus disparos son precisos.

meta.name: Missing Links
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Missing Links is a word puzzle where players must fill in missing letters in words and sentences. The goal is to reconstruct the passage with as few mistakes as possible. The challenge lies in using linguistic intuition and pattern recognition to complete the text. As the passage unfolds, more clues become available to aid the next guesses. The difficulty level can be adjusted, ranging from omitting only a few letters to leaving entire texts blank. Players can choose passages from well-known children's literature classics, including My Side of the Mountain, The Wind in the Willows, From the Mixed-Up Files of Mrs. Basil E. Frankweiler, The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, and Charlie and the Chocolate Factory.
meta.developer: H. Chomsky, J.L. Schwartz & E. Grubbs

meta.name: Mission 1 : Project Volcano
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Mission 1: Project Volcano" challenges the player to infiltrate a hidden command complex. Selected for their expertise in computer operations, the player must locate the main computer room and delete the command program by entering the destruct code. Intelligence reports indicate that the code is concealed somewhere within the facility.

meta.name: Mission 2 : Project Gibraltar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.52 KB

"Mission 2: Project Gibraltar" is the sequel to Mission 1: Project Volcano and takes the player on a covert operation in Gibraltar. The objective is to infiltrate the secure facility on The Rock and uncover the secret of the Blue Room. A Russian agent has infiltrated a nuclear complex, and the player's mission is to identify and "remove" the spy.

meta.name: Mission AD
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.87 KB

„Mission AD“ puts players in the role of elite assassin Rik O'Shey, tasked with eliminating all enemy assassins inside a hostile bunker. This side-view flick-screen shooter challenges players to complete various missions within a set time limit. The bunker consists of eight areas connected by transporters, and each screen has two levels accessible via elevators. Armed with a gun, players must search each area and take down the required number of assassins before time runs out.

meta.name: Mission Asteroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

En este juego, eres un astronauta con una misión: Enviar un cohete para destruir un asteroide que se dirige directo a la tierra. El problema es: Como encuentras un asteroide sin un plan de vuelo? 
Esta aventura es muy corta, y para cumplir tu tarea, el juego requiere que ingreses uno o varios comandos para generar distintas acciones. El avance del juego puede ser guardado en un diskette en cualquier punto del mismo.

meta.name: Mission Egg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.24 KB

Mission Egg takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where giant chickens lay massive eggs but refuse to hatch them. The player must free the chicks by carefully moving the eggs while avoiding deadly radioactive clouds. A special cloud, however, teleports the player to another position instead. Jumps are limited and must be used strategically. Once a chick hatches, it must be kicked off the screen — if it collides with a radioactive cloud, it explodes and can destroy additional clouds. Coins grant bonus points for the next level.

meta.name: Mission Elevator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 71.70 KB

Mission Elevator puts you in the middle of a high-stakes rescue operation inside a skyscraper threatened by terrorists. Across multiple building segments and floors, you must locate an emergency key and collect the scattered parts of a secret code to reach the bomb in time. Clues are gained by questioning characters or carefully exploring the surroundings. Every choice affects your progress, as mistakes cost precious time. Blending action with puzzle-solving, the game becomes a tense race against the clock – only logic, strategy and steady nerves will lead to success.

meta.name: Mission Genocide
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.82 KB

In Mission Genocide you pilot a starfighter over the enemy Bad Star Empire to avenge their attack on your home planet, CRYS-CIT. Your goal is to destroy as many of their fighters and installations as possible to reduce the chance of another devastating assault. Quick reflexes, accurate shooting, and constant movement are key to surviving this relentless vertical shooter.

meta.name: Mission II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Mission II" challenges the player to save the universe from imminent danger. Evil forces have planted multiple bombs across different systems, and there is only a limited time to locate and deactivate them before they explode. The shifting gravity adds an extra layer of difficulty, making movement more challenging. Players must carefully navigate around walls, as one wrong move can be disastrous—too late... BOOM!

meta.name: Mission Impossible
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.63 KB

Mission Impossible is a classic text adventure where the player is drawn into a secret mission. The story begins in a briefing room, where someone has just fled in panic. The player must examine clues, solve puzzles, and make strategic decisions to complete the mission. Careful exploration and logical thinking reveal the unfolding plot, with unexpected twists and lurking dangers.

meta.name: Mission Impossibubble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.93 KB

In Mission Impossibubble you wander around an isometric, 3D-ish sort of maze. There are six of them, and at the end of each you'll rescue a baby bubble that's – yup – been kidnapped (there really was a lot of this in '80s games, eh? Chilling– Ed). Before you can reach each bubble you have to collect individual pieces of a map that are thrown across every stage, forcing you to explore every corner of the code. Each level has its own theme with baddies to match: there's a spooky one, an arctic one, and you really have to check out level two even if it's just by watching our video. It's very clearly a love letter to Gremlin's Bounder. Great stuff!

meta.name: Mission Jupiter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Mission Jupiter," you venture into the depths of Jupiter and battle through ten levels filled with impressive lifeforms. Your mission requires careful management of your fuel and laser weapon energy, with opportunities to replenish supplies from the planet's surface. Each lifeform has unique behavior that you must master to defeat them. Skill and strategy are essential to overcoming the challenge.

meta.name: Mission Monday
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.35 KB

Mission Monday throws the player into the heart of the Vietnam War, where they take on the role of the brave Sergeant Tan, tasked with delivering a top-secret order to a remote outpost deep in the jungle. The area is surrounded by enemy forces, making the journey extremely dangerous. In an armed jeep, the player must jump over mines and obstacles, fight enemy soldiers, destroy rolling balls and tanks, and evade deadly traps. Only through daring stunts and quick reflexes can Mission Monday be completed successfully.

meta.name: Mission Nada
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.27 KB

Mission Nada begins with the last, unsettling words of the scouts: "We regret…". What lies beyond the B-screens remains a mystery, as no one has ever returned to tell the tale. But those who have summoned the courage to step into the kiosk, retrieve 9.80 DM from their pockets, and fearlessly place the money on the dark sales counter are ready for the ultimate challenge. With a space glider, the journey into the unknown begins—no turning back, only the hope of outrunning the Devil's trident.

meta.name: Mission Om (Europe) (Side A)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 886.90 KB

meta.name: Mission Om (Europe) (Side B)
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.03 MB

meta.name: Mission Omega
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.37 KB

„Mission Omega“ revolves around a mysterious alien craft codenamed Omega – armed with dangerous missiles. The objective is to reach the ship, disable its four reactors, and escape within an hour to secure its technology without it firing or falling into enemy hands. The player controls a robot droid navigating through the ship's corridors and rooms. The game uses an icon-based control system, with the first task being to equip the droid with weapons and power sources. Instead of manually directing each move, the player can use the inbuilt map to plot a course for the droid.

meta.name: Mission on Thunderhead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.64 KB

From the author of Maxwell Manor, Mission on Thunderhead is an action game with a science-fiction theme. Thunderhead is a once-desolate planet now teeming with life, thanks to the hated Eternals. They have set up an underground complex, which is their main power base. The game is split into two parts - Operation Tempest and The Final Appeal. In Operation Tempest you must find and activate the device needed to destroy the planet. In The Final Appeal you must find the items which will allow you to appeal the charges the Eternals hit you with. Gameplay involves jumping and shooting - the player must collect the items which allow you to defeat monsters. There are also mazelike sections. Weapon power-ups and reloads can be found, as can extra lives. The game has 10 preset levels, and a seed number to allow over 1000 variations of play.

meta.name: Mission X
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.94 KB

"Mission X" begins with the player being abducted by aliens and taken to a distant planet designed to resemble an English village. However, beneath the peaceful facade lies the unknown. The mission is to find a way back to Earth by exploring the surroundings and uncovering clues to facilitate the escape.

meta.name: Mission X-2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Mission X-2" takes the player to the Starbank of Astra, the most secure treasure vault in the galaxy. Protected by advanced alarm systems and relentless cyber guards, it has long been considered impregnable. However, for the protagonist, robbing this bank is a challenge of great prestige. While breaking in was relatively easy, the real danger now begins—defense systems are active, robotic sentries patrol every corridor, and deadly traps can incinerate intruders in an instant. With skill and strategic thinking, it is possible to hack terminals to manipulate the guards or uncover valuable information to pave the way to wealth and fame.

meta.name: Missione H
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.12 KB

“Missione H” throws the player into a new intergalactic battle – just after the peace treaty has been signed. Once again, rebels are regrouping to seize control of the galaxy. The planned vacation on Mars must wait – duty calls. The player commands a highly advanced spaceship made up of three units. If the first two survive the fourth level, all three will merge into a super-powered war machine. Precise shots are crucial, as half-destroyed enemies remain dangerous. A smart tactic is to start off to the side to avoid being surrounded before shifting into a central defensive position. Phantom enemies only appear when they're already dangerously close – constant vigilance is required!

meta.name: Moby Dick
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.46 KB

Moby Dick challenges you to steer your boat across the sea, constantly moving from left to right while you control its speed. You must drop depth charges to destroy enemy submarines lurking below, all while a helicopter passes overhead dropping bombs – which you can shoot down with rockets. Beware of the whale swimming across the screen: if you hit it, a green boat appears and rams you, costing a life. However, if you manage to catch the helicopter pilot parachuting down after a successful hit, you'll be rewarded with bonus points.

meta.name: Model Builder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Create your model cars, give them Engines, transmissions and fuel systems and then take them out on the track for speed and handling trials.

meta.name: Modem Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

One or two player real-time strategy game where you control armies of Infantry, Cavalry, Artillery, and Spies searching for your opponent's Command Center.

meta.name: Moebius
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Moebius” is a side-scrolling shooter set on a distant planet – you control Moebius, a space mercenary fighting the forces of the Controller, ruler of the empire. You move Moebius left and right, shooting creatures and robots before they collide with him, aiming to reach the transporter that takes you to the next planet. Each planet has its own inhabitants to battle. After a few levels, you gain access to a jetpack and later a hovercar – both use fuel and will explode when it runs out. Fuel recharges automatically when walking on solid ground.

meta.name: Moebius : The Orb of Celestial Harmony
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

In Moebius: The Orb of Celestial Harmony you play as the Headmaster's disciple, seeking the stolen Orb of Heavenly Harmony taken by the rogue student Kaimen. Your journey demands mastery of both body and spirit as you traverse the elemental planes of earth, water, air, and fire. Karma is key: noble deeds strengthen it, while selfish acts diminish it. Combat unfolds in a side-scrolling style, requiring skill, patience, and inner focus. With swords, shurikens, and mystical attacks, the game blends Eastern philosophy with intense action and spiritual depth.

meta.name: Mole Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.54 KB

Mole Attack is a classic reaction game where moles pop up from nine holes, and you have 60 seconds to whack them with your hammer. You need to react quickly, moving the hammer with either the joystick or keyboard to strike at the right spot and drive the moles back. Every hit scores points, and only lightning-fast timing will let you beat the high score.

meta.name: Molecule Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Molecule Man es un juego isométrico de laberintos. La única forma de escapar del laberinto es usar el teletransportador, pero sólo puedes usarlo después de haber recogido las dieciséis secciones de la placa de circuitos del nivel. Para reducir la dosis de radiación, también debes tomar pastillas periódicamente. Empiezas el juego con veinte de estas pastillas, pero rápidamente se te acabarán y tendrás que buscar en el laberinto máquinas expendedoras de pastillas antirradiación. Pero, por supuesto, necesitas dinero para usar estas máquinas. Así que también tienes que recoger las monedas esparcidas por los alrededores. Se pueden recoger bombas para destruir secciones de la pared y acceder a otras salas.

meta.name: The Mollusk Redux
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Mollusk Redux” takes you through four oceans – Atlantic, Pacific, Indian and Antarctic – each made up of six levels where you play as a soft-bodied sea creature tasked with eating a set number of fish. Along the way, you must avoid enemy eels, piranhas, sharks and falling anchors. But you're not defenseless – a limited supply of ink allows you to fend off attackers and survive the deep-sea danger.

meta.name: ABC Monday Night Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

¡ABC Sports y Data East se unen para llevarte al campo! ¡Ponte el casco, ponte esa máscara negra bajo los ojos y prepárate para el fútbol americano al estilo Frank Gifford! Cuenta con tecnología de síntesis de voz de la AFB. Puedes cambiar de receptor al instante, lanzarle jugadas de blitz enloquecedoras al mariscal de campo y mirar fijamente a las animadoras pechugonas. Todo suma: es fútbol americano.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mondu's Fight Palace (a.k.a. Tongue of the Fatman) is a bizarre and varied fighting game where you select from different alien races (including humans), each with unique abilities and fighting styles. You can buy weapons, place bets on match outcomes, and fight your way through enemies to reach the infamous Fatman. To keep things balanced, special moves lose power the more they're used. A two-player head-to-head mode is also included.

meta.name: Money Minefield
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.17 KB

Money Minefield is a collect-'em-up game where you maneuver your car through a deadly minefield – avoiding obstacles and collecting money bags. The PETSCII-based presentation suggests it may have been ported to or from other Commodore systems. Good luck!

meta.name: Money Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.80 KB

“Money Wars” puts you in the role of a robber who must grab money bags and return them safely – all while dodging deadly arrows raining down from above. Played from a side view, you move from the left edge to the money on the right, then back again. Three brick barricades offer temporary cover, but they take damage and eventually disappear. You have two special abilities: one increases speed, the other creates a force field that destroys arrows – both consume energy, and unused energy grants bonus points. A new money bag appears after each delivery, and every fifth one brings you to a new level. The game ends when all three lives are lost.

meta.name: Monkey Business
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.38 KB

“Monkey Business” is a clever puzzle game based on the “Towers of Hanoi” concept – your goal is to help a stack of monkeys pick two apples from a tree. You can only move one monkey at a time, and a smaller monkey may only sit on top of a larger one. There are three locations to move monkeys between, and through smart rearrangement, you must re-stack them beneath each apple. Once both apples are picked, the level is complete. Your score depends on how many moves it takes. Three skill levels offer varying challenges by changing the number of monkeys involved.

meta.name: Monkey Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.49 KB

Based on the original television series that ran from 1978 to 1980, the player controls Monkey as he makes his way through four levels and rescue the princess from the evil dragon. In the first level, the player rides a cloud, and must use lightning bolts to destroy three waves of flying creatures. In the second level, the player must collect all the fruit while avoiding or jumping over creatures. Vines and ladders must be navigated in order to get some fruit. The third level has the player navigating a steep cliff. Four birds drop rocks onto the path, causing it to crack. The player must jump over these cracks. Finally, in the last level, the player must defeat the dragon by throwing spears at it, while avoiding its fire.

meta.name: Monkeymath
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.58 KB

Monkeymath es un divertido juego educativo que combina las matemáticas con un trabajo en una fábrica. El jugador controla a un mono que trabaja en una línea de ensamblaje, eligiendo los números del 0 al 9 para resolver problemas matemáticos. El juego incluye ejercicios de suma, resta, multiplicación, división y conteo con distintos niveles de dificultad. El mono tiene un tiempo limitado para maximizar su puntuación y, a mitad de su turno, disfruta de un merecido descanso con un plátano.

meta.name: Monolith Tank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.45 KB

“Monolith Tank” is a fast-paced top-down shooter where you and a buddy take on enemy jets, tanks and fortified positions – all while dodging or blasting through tank traps that limit your movement. It supports simultaneous two-player gameplay, making it a chaotic and thrilling experience for fans of explosive arcade combat.

meta.name: Monopole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 73.61 KB

Monopole is an unofficial game based on the well-known property trading board game Monopoly, for two human players. All 40 squares of the board are mapped as normal, with the properties joined by railways and utilities to buy. Chance and Community Chest cards are as standard, as is Jail and Just Visiting, while the Free Parking jackpot system (which official licenses never feature) and auction-style purchases are both optional. Moves are made by rolling the two simulated dice, then using the transactions menu to offer to buy an opponent's properties, buy houses or hotels, mortgage one of your properties, or check who owns which addresses.

meta.name: Monopoly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.19 KB

„Monopoly“ is a digital adaptation of the classic board game, where players roll dice to move around the board, purchase properties, and build a real estate empire through strategic trading. The goal is to bankrupt opponents by collecting rent on developed properties. The game includes familiar rules such as auctions for unpurchased properties, paying taxes, and going to jail. Developed properties cannot be traded, affecting strategic decisions. A mix of luck and tactical planning determines success.

meta.name: Monopoly Deluxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 94.30 KB

Monopoly Deluxe es una versión basada en el clásico juego de mesa. El juego recrea fielmente las reglas y las características mas reconocibles del juego de mesa, como por ejemplo las reconocibles fichas de los jugadores (la plancha, el sombrero, el perro...). Permite que hasta seis jugadores (humanos o CPU) compitan entre sí para ganar la mayor cantidad de dinero posible negociando casas y hoteles en calles famosas de Londres. El ganador será el superviviente cuando todos los demás competidores quiebren.

meta.name: Monster Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.93 KB

Monster Attack is a zany arcade shooter in the vein of “Space Invaders” or “Gorf,” dropping you into a deadly carnival in space. The invaders wear cheerful, smiling masks – but beneath them lie grim, death-dealing machines attacking from all directions, even below. In your space cruiser, you'll need lightning-fast reflexes to avoid being laughed at – and blasted out. Every shot counts, because in the end, only you should get the last laugh.

meta.name: Monster Buster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.84 KB

Monster Buster pits you against a descending swarm of colorful monsters that steadily creep downward from the top of the screen. By firing matching creatures into place, you form groups of the same type to clear them away. Successful combinations bring relief, while missed shots increase the pressure. As the pace intensifies, careful aim and forward planning become essential – a lively arcade-style challenge where chain reactions make all the difference.

meta.name: Monster Munch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.02 KB

“Monster Munch” is a top-down single-screen maze game where you guide Munchie around the maze, eating all the dots to advance to the next level. As you move, four monsters also roam the maze, and touching them costs one of your three lives. To help you, four power-pills sit in the corners – when eaten, they turn the monsters blue and vulnerable for a limited time. If you eat a monster, its eyes return to the maze center, where it regenerates and resumes chasing you. A question mark appears occasionally – collecting it grants bonus points.

meta.name: Monster Power
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Monster Power" is a high-octane drag racing game that throws players into the heart of a spectacular quarter-mile showdown. With seven-thousand horsepower nitro-burning machines, racing legends like "Big Daddy" Don Garlits, Dan "the Snake" Purough, and three-time World Champion Shirley "Cha-Cha" Muldowney battle it out. The goal is to master precision timing and achieve maximum speed to claim victory on this dangerous track. Pure adrenaline where every second counts!

meta.name: Monster Smash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.06 KB

Monster Smash is a side view single screen platformer where your task is to capture all the monsters that are partying around the local graveyard. The screen has four rows of platforms containing four gravestones on three of the levels and part of the platforms can be turned 90°. The partying monsters appear from the top and left of the screen and move to the right of the screen along the platforms. Turning the platforms makes the monsters move downwards when they hit the turned parts and head to the bottom of the screen. Pressing the fire button makes the gravestones move up and down and when a monster hits a gravestone then they are captured. If the monster hits the other side of the screen then they have escaped and let too many escape, shown by a gauge, then it is game over. Once a certain amount of monsters have been captured then you move to the next level. Before you start the game you can select the level number from one to nine.

meta.name: Monster Tribe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Monster Tribe” is a space shooter with a thoughtful twist – maybe the aliens are the monster tribe, or maybe it's society itself that becomes monstrous when faced with the unknown. A moral tale or a weekend shoot-'em-up – you decide. You control a small ship that moves freely and fires straight forward. Three large alien beings roam the screen – when hit, they start returning fire, though they can't be destroyed. You earn points for each hit, but lose one of your five lives if you're struck.

meta.name: Monster Walk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.90 KB

“Monster Walk” is a simple but ruthless maze game – your goal is to reach the other side of the labyrinth, but monsters are out to hit you, and the walls are radioactive: touch them and you die. Careful timing and precision are essential as you navigate the tight corridors and avoid enemies. Only those who stay calm and move carefully will make it to the end.

meta.name: Monsters & Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.58 KB

In “Monsters & Magic,” the player embarks on a text-based adventure where imagination serves as the primary graphics card and the computer acts as the Dungeon Master. The player is given a character with set health points and starting gold, which can be used to purchase equipment such as weapons and armor. While exploring lairs and battling monsters, the player earns experience points, levels up to become stronger, and takes on new challenges.

meta.name: Monsters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.79 KB

“Monsters” is a Pac-Man variant where you must collect all objects on the board while avoiding constantly moving enemies. Contact with them drains your energy, and unlike the original, there are no power dots to fight back – it's all about quick maneuvering and outsmarting your opponents. With 40 levels in total, the game increases in difficulty as you progress through trickier mazes.

meta.name: Monstrum
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.73 KB

Monstrum es un clásico juego de plataformas en el que debes abrirte paso por un laberinto mortal para derrotar a una criatura monstruosa escondida en su guarida. Para llegar hasta ella, recoges objetos y los usas en los lugares adecuados, mientras combates oleadas de enemigos —momias, caballeros y murciélagos— y esquivas trampas como pinchos en el suelo o giratorios. El éxito depende de dominar los saltos, lanzar el cuchillo con precisión y asestar golpes con el bastón en el momento justo.

meta.name: Monte Carlo Casino
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.73 KB

“Monte Carlo Casino” is a casino simulator featuring five different games of chance where you wager virtual money. You start with $10,000 and aim to increase your winnings through smart betting. The games can be played in any order – if you get tired of poker, for example, you can stop and switch to another game. Just like in a real casino, it's up to you to test your luck or walk away.

meta.name: Montezuma's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.15 KB

“Montezuma's Revenge” sends you as adventurer Panama Joe deep into a deadly maze of ancient Aztec catacombs. Your goal is a legendary treasure, but on the way you'll face rolling skulls, dancing spiders, vanishing chains, and raging fire. Jumping and climbing are your only tools as you navigate locked doors and deadly traps. Combat isn't an option – any contact with an enemy means instant death. Only skill, timing, and courage will uncover the secret of the catacombs.

meta.name: Montrix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.09 KB

Montrix is a fun Cybernoid-style shooter with puzzle elements, where you pilot a small ship through richly designed levels. It's not just about shooting – you also have to find the right keys for the right doors to progress. Precision, timing, and smart navigation are key to dodging enemies and advancing. The blend of action and puzzle-solving keeps things engaging throughout.

meta.name: Monty Mole
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.87 KB

“Monty Mole” sends you underground as a mole on a mission to steal coal and ultimately seize control of coal production – but it won't be easy, as acid pools, crushers and deadly traps stand in your way. The Commodore 64 version features smooth scrolling and replaces lives with an energy bar that depletes when Monty touches hazards or falls. If it runs out, the game ends – but collecting boxes of worms will restore your energy.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Monty on the Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Monty On The Run” continúa la historia de Monty, el topo, quien debe huir del país tras escapar de prisión, antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Este juego de plataformas repleto de puzles te reta a guiar a Monty a través de peligrosas pantallas llenas de enemigos, trampas aplastantes y caminos complicados con cuerdas y plataformas. No todas las zonas son accesibles a la vez, y recolectar dinero y objetos útiles es esencial. Antes de empezar el juego, debes elegir cinco objetos de un conjunto de 21 para crear tu "Kit de Libertad". Solo la combinación correcta te permitirá escapar, lo que requiere un poco de ensayo y error.

meta.name: Monty Plays Scrabble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.63 KB

This a Scrabble game hosted by the eponymous Monty, who provides an additional computer opponent to the players' game. The game simulates the Scrabble board, and players taking turns drawing letter tiles and playing them from the 7 tiles available to them to create words. Players can also skip their turn if they are unable to spell a word with the letters available to them. Scoring is similar to the physical version of Scrabble, with bonus tiles and different scores per letter, and players must agree that each word played is valid. Follows original Scrabble rules.

meta.name: Monty Python's Flying Circus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Monty Python's Flying Circus is an arcade style game based on the UK television series of the same name. Players control one of the "Mr. Gumbies" and maneuver him through multiple screens, throwing fish at flying feet and similarly surreal enemies. Periodically the game cuts away to a non-sequitur aside, such as a lesson on "the larch," or a quick game of breakout.

meta.name: Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.09 KB

Moon is a minimalist yet challenging simulation where you control a moon landing. Before starting, you enter a time limit and try to land your spacecraft safely on the lunar surface. As your lander descends, you must fire the engine and manage speed at just the right moment – too early or too late results in a crash. Precision is everything.

meta.name: Moon Base Alpha
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.21 KB

"Moon Base Alpha" is a text-based adventure where a massive meteor is hurtling toward your moon base – and only you can stop the catastrophe. As the countdown ticks away, you explore different sections of the base, locate critical equipment and act through precise commands to find a solution in time. Every step matters – fail, and the fate of all lunar colonies is sealed.

meta.name: Moon Bug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Moon Bug is a variation of Frogger where you dodge planets and meteors and jump from rocket ship to rocket ship to safely reach the docking bays across the way. Each bay you enter becomes unavailable – limiting your options until all four are filled and the next round begins – only now with everything slightly more challenging.

meta.name: Moon Buggy!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.14 KB

Moon Buggy puts you in command of the ATMB vehicle on a moon base under alien attack. Your mission: stop the enemy incursion. You speed up, slow down, jump over craters, blast rocks, and fend off saucers, rockets, tanks, and landmines. The buggy only moves forward, but with rockets and skill you earn points for destroyed enemies and distance traveled. The game records the top five scores of the session.

meta.name: Moon Ceti
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.82 KB

“Moon Ceti” is a simple yet engaging shooter game in which the player must fight enemies using precise shots. Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: Moon Cresta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.86 KB

El jugador inicia el juego con una pequeña nave armada con un cañón láser. Al completar las primeras cuatro pantallas de ataques alienígenas, la nave de jugador se unirá con el segundo "nivel" de ésta. Después de pasar a través de otras dos pantallas con aliens, la nave se unirá con la tercera y última parte de ésta, dándole al jugador un arma más poderosa para acabar con sus enemigos.
Después de completar las primeras ocho pantallas, la nave del jugador se revertirá a su primera encarnación.

meta.name: Moon Crisis 1999
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.33 KB

Struggle to manoeuvre your EAGLE space craft just above the moon's surface. Attempt to defend your bases from enemy time bombs. If you are quick you can pick them up and drop them into the nuclear fusion dump. If however, you are not, your craft will be blown into a thousand pieces.

meta.name: Moon Crystals
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.87 KB

A Balloon Rescue style game put in a space setting and with a collect-'em-up layer added to the tense time/fuel limits. This was released as the B side game of "To Hell and Back".
A brave ship has been commissioned to descend into the diamond fields of a dangerous lunar volcano: the aim of the mission is to collect as many of the Moon Crystals as possible before the volcano erupts. To do this the ship has a set of thrusters that will allow it to move quickly between the caves. Using it, however, requires some practice if you want to avoid crashing into the walls of the cave. Consumption of fuel must be watched, but you can restock by grabbing the fuel cans that have been seeded throughout the cave tunnels. Only after collecting all the gems from a section of caves will you be able to access the next set. There are 16 levels in all to complete the cave search.

meta.name: Moon Dust
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.66 KB

“Moon Dust” challenges you to cover a porthole at the center of the screen with something called “moon juice”. You control the astronaut Jose Skrjabin, who drops a seed square and then moves in arcing paths across the screen to spread the juice by crossing over the seed. Flight patterns emerge from Jose and from spherical ships you must avoid – and as the moon juice spreads and leaves trails, the music shifts dynamically based on a generative algorithm. Points are awarded after each level using an algorithmic system – and if you score high enough, you'll earn more seeds.

meta.name: Moon Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.17 KB

La luna está bajo ataque de una horda de alienígenas, y debes detenerlos en tu buggy armado. Conduce a lo largo de la superficie disparando a los alienígenas y esquivando sus balas. La superficie no es plana, hay cráteres y rocas con los que evitar el contacto, y minas terrestres en la superficie. Los platillos voladores crean nuevos cráteres cuando se estrellan. Los 25 puntos de reinicio están codificados con letras.

p: Moon Patrol (Avalon Hill Microcomputer Games, Inc.) (USA).T64
n: Moon Patrol (Avalon Hill Microcomputer Games, Inc.) (USA)

meta.name: Moon Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.10 KB

“Moon Patrol” sends you racing across the rugged lunar surface – dodging enemy ships, bombs and dangerous craters. In your futuristic moon vehicle, you leap over obstacles, shoot anything that threatens you – and push forward section by section – all under fire and with ever-increasing difficulty.

meta.name: Moon Shuttle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.02 KB

Aliens have invaded our asteroid belt! It's up to you to get rid of them. Your space ship on the bottom of the vertically scrolling screen dodges and shoots at asteroids, hostile ships and the like. By moving left and right and firing rapidly, first you must clear a path through the asteroids. Only then you can take on the alien craft. Pushing up on the joystick increases speed, but crashing into an asteroid means death. A bonus is awarded if you pass through unscathed. Once on the other side, the aliens attack from the top and sides of the screen and drop missiles. The first wave is just a teaser. Progressive waves are more aggressive and harder to kill. If you destroy a certain number of aliens, more asteroids must be avoided or destroyed, followed by yet another alien attack, and so on, until eventually all are defeated or you have no

meta.name: Moonfall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Similar a Elite, es una mezcla entre un juego de comercio y un juego de acción. El jugador viaja a la Luna, visita las colonias y compra/vende uno de los 18 recursos diferentes. Por supuesto, es importante saber dónde encontrar el producto que se busca para obtener un buen beneficio. El dinero debe reinvertirse en mejoras de armamento (además del fuego láser inicial, los misiles guiados y las minas) para sobrevivir a los ataques de los piratas espaciales. El jugador también puede optar por dedicarse al comercio pirata y atacar cargueros. La nave está equipada con un motor de viaje de alta velocidad que acelera el tiempo de desplazamiento entre colonias. También hay misiones que completar.

meta.name: Moonmist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Moonmist" is an interactive text adventure where players take on the role of a famous young American detective who travels to England in response to a plea from an old friend, Tamara Lynd. At Tresyllian Castle, a mysterious old estate, players encounter intriguing guests, cryptic clues, and a hidden valuable treasure. But Tamara is most concerned about a ghost that seems to be haunting her. Is it a warning? Jealousy? Or is someone disguising themselves to scare her? The game features four different story variations, chosen at the start by selecting a color. Additionally, some characters interact differently depending on whether the player chooses a male or female detective.

meta.name: Moonracer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.34 KB

“Moonracer” delivers fast-paced, fantasy-themed racing where two players compete head to head in split-screen view. With futuristic vehicles, you speed through surreal landscapes filled with obstacles – always chasing the best time – and victory over your rival.

meta.name: Moons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sus unidades de élite han sido convocadas por el Consejo Central de la Humanidad, mientras los habitantes del mundo confían en la victoria contra los gigantes. La misión consiste en aniquilar sus hordas y destruir sus cruceros espaciales, donde se diseñan y construyen sin cesar nuevas máquinas de combate.
Tras el fatídico experimento en el planeta Gerkatas, la humanidad vive en estado de alerta. Ya una docena de mundos han caído ante los monstruos biomecánicos creados allí. Originalmente, la idea era usar criaturas vivas para colonizar planetas inhóspitos y cultivarlos mediante bio-creaciones. Pero al fallar el generador del Complejo de Operaciones Carisma, el experimento se descontroló: las criaturas evolucionaron en depredadores inteligentes, agresivos y letales. Ahora buscan exterminar a la humanidad y conquistar el universo.

meta.name: MoonShadow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.91 KB

“MoonShadow” sends you into the dark hell caverns with one goal – to destroy the evil serpent. You'll explore large, open-ended levels and fight enemies using a throwing dagger. As you progress, you'll discover more weapons to switch between. Your inventory holds up to six useful items like keys or healing potions. A unique time limit tracks your progress – shown by how much of the moon Fulax is being covered by the moon Septerios.

meta.name: Moonshadow (Ocean)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.11 KB

“Moonshadow” begins with a crash on a strange planet – awakened too late from cryo-sleep, it's now up to you to rescue your crew. You pilot your spacepod across the surface and through underground tunnels, searching for replacement Plasma Pods to escape this hostile place. Enemy droids and obstacles try to stop you – but your blaster takes them down. A computer aboard the main ship helps you out, while you're always shown your time, item held, score – and your status displaying Air, Energy – and Power.

meta.name: Moonsweeper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.91 KB

En Moonsweeper, tu objetivo es salvar a los mineros de las lunas del cuadrante estelar de Júpiter. Comienzas tu misión en el espacio, donde debes evitar las mortíferas auroras, las antorchas de fotones y las balas espaciales procedentes del sol del cuadrante. De vez en cuando verás pasar una luna, y volando cerca de ella podrás descender a su superficie. Al explorar la superficie, verás mineros atrapados a los que tendrás que rescatar volando sobre ellos. También hay varios obstáculos en la superficie lunar que debes evitar o destruir, como torres y satélites lunares, así como destructores alienígenas de la superficie. Si sobrevives y rescatas a seis mineros, podrás despegar de la superficie utilizando los anillos de aceleración.

meta.name: Moonsweeper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.91 KB

„Moonsweeper“ sends you on a dangerous rescue mission in the star quadrant of Jupiter, where stranded miners await help on the moons. Your mission begins in space, where you must dodge deadly aurora flares, photon torches and solar projectiles. When a moon passes by, you can descend to its surface by flying close. There, you must sweep low to rescue miners by flying over them. But danger awaits – towers, satellites and alien surface destroyers must be avoided or blasted away. Once you've picked up six miners – the maximum your ship can carry – you can take off again using accelerator rings. The moons vary in difficulty, and only those with quick reflexes will survive. Your ship is equipped with photon torpedoes and a shield – though using the shield costs you points.

meta.name: Moontorc
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.29 KB

„Moontorc“ tells the tale of a brave knight on a quest to rescue Princess Lalena from the clutches of the Dark Lord. In this flick-screen platformer, you must battle through four dangerous levels, armed with a sword. Hostile creatures and deadly obstacles like water drain your energy – every touch weakens you, and once your energy runs out, it's game over. To complete a level, you must collect three pieces of a mysterious Moontorc and hand them to troll guards at the end – only then will they let you pass.

meta.name: Moonwalker : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"¡Michael!", resuena la voz de Katy. ¡La has encontrado! ¡Pero aún hay más niños perdidos! ¿Podrás detener al genio psicópata Mr. Big y a su escuadrón de matones antes de que secuestren a todos los niños? ¡Tú puedes, si eres Michael Jackson! ¡Haz el moonwalk sobre asaltantes, apóyate en los malvados y aplasta a los punks! ¡Supera en combate, salta y baila! ¡Muévete como solo Michael puede, al ritmo de Smooth Criminal, Beat it, Billie Jean y Bad! ¡Ningún villano puede resistir la magia estelar de Michael! Derrota a gánsteres en el Club 30. Recorre las calles. Balancea, gira y patea a los demonios del cementerio. Relájate en las cavernas y luego aplástalos con armas ultratecnológicas en la guarida de Mr. Big. Vive el videojuego más brutal de la historia. ¡Desafía la física con el baile de Michael! Nunca pierdas la calma. ¡Míralo y sé tú mismo! ¡El Moonwalker de Michael Jackson!

meta.name: Mopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.17 KB

“Mopper” puts you in the thankless shoes of a janitor at the worst school imaginable. Your mission: clean every section while fending off students, teachers – and dogs – all while managing a bad back that gets worse the more you scrub. When your back gives out, it's time for a forced break. Luckily, you've got weapons like throwable soap and a screen-clearing cleaner called Gleamo that wipes out enemies and dirt alike. The game is played from a top-down view, with free movement, timed missions, refillable cleaning supplies, and enemies to dispatch. The cleaner you get – the richer you become.

meta.name: Moptown Hotel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Moptown Hotel," you enter an entertaining and educational world that challenges your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. The game features seven mini-games designed to enhance your pattern recognition and logical reasoning. Alongside the charming Moppets from Moptown, you solve tasks while exploring the various floors of the hotel. An exciting adventure that blends fun and learning seamlessly!

meta.name: Moptown Parade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Moptown Parade” is one of the earliest titles from The Learning Company, designed to help kids aged 4 to 7 develop pattern recognition and logical thinking. The goal is to line up whimsical Moppet creatures so that they follow specific rules – for example, if the rule is “2,” each new Moppet must differ from the previous one in two traits, such as size and color. You can adjust the number of traits from 1 to 4, making the game easier or more complex. It's a relaxed and playful way to build thinking skills – one Moppet at a time.

meta.name: Mordon's Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.98 KB

You have a reputation as a worthy and capable adventurer. One day you encounter an old man named Mordon, who explains that he is one of the Ancient Ones, who have been guiding universes in a positive way for centuries. However, they have been dying out through old age, and so have built a time machine. 
A younger Ancient One named Bostafer scuppered this, destroying the machine in the hope of using it to make himself immortal. Can you retrieve all the pieces from time and space before Bostafer?The pieces have attained mythical status in some cultures, so retrieving them may not be an easy task.
Mordon's Quest is a pure-text IF game containing 150 locations and understanding over 400 words. Items you will find early in the game include a blowpipe, a black pearl and a crystal orb. Commands include CLIMB, SACRIFICE and INSERT, as well as standard movement and object-retrieval methods.

meta.name: Moribund
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Moribund” is a classic single-screen platformer where your goal is to collect all the diamonds and treasures to advance to the next – increasingly difficult – level. You're equipped with a unique ability: creating stepping stones to navigate the environment. But be careful – your supply is limited, and the clock is ticking. Strategic movement, quick thinking, and sharp reflexes are your best allies in this imaginative pixel-world challenge.

meta.name: Morph
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.71 KB

“Morph” is a colorful single-player puzzle game where you control a small ball to push other balls around. When balls of the same color meet, they disappear – your goal is to clear the screen. As the game progresses, more balls and increasingly complex layouts challenge your puzzle-solving skills.

meta.name: Morpheus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Morpheus te sitúa en un universo de 50 «Aíteres», cada uno compuesto por un núcleo central y 32 órbitas. Tu misión: entrar en un Aíter, destruir suficientes órbitas y desactivar el núcleo. Al morir, este expulsa un Morphi, que puedes eliminar para obtener puntos y dinero extra. Antes de desplegarte, puedes comprar, vender o desguazar cascos y armas. La vista es cenital, con movimiento libre en cualquier dirección, y un radar te ayuda a localizar órbitas y núcleo. Al progresar y mejorar tu nave, esta puede crecer hasta casi llenar la pantalla.

meta.name: Morphicle : The Transforming Car
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.60 KB

„Morphicle: The Transforming Car“ challenges the player to save the world by using the transformable vehicle "Morphicle" to locate and defuse a bomb. Each level consists of three sections. First, the vehicle must be driven along a road to reach the entrance of an underground compound while avoiding the edges. If a dead end is encountered, the vehicle can temporarily transform into a plane to fly over obstacles. In the second section, it turns into a glider, navigating through a maze controlled by icons, where touching the walls results in game over. The final part is a sliding puzzle, where an image of the bomb must be reassembled within a time limit to successfully defuse it and receive a password for the next level.

meta.name: Mortal Dogfight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Mortal Dogfight" is an exciting air combat game for the Commodore 64 in which you defeat your opponent in intense duels. You choose one of three aircraft and compete in action-packed battles, where skillful maneuvering and clever tactics are crucial to outwitting your opponent and emerging victorious.

meta.name: MOT
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“MOT” is no ordinary friend – he's a three-meter-tall interdimensional monster with a tail and horns, who travels through time and space as easily as you walk from your bedroom to the kitchen. Unfortunately, he also has a habit of hiding in your closet, smashing your furniture, or emptying the fridge in the middle of the night. And when you tried to tell your parents it was MOT – not you – who wrecked their car, they sent you to a psychiatrist. But MOT is your friend, and when he calls for help, you wouldn't let him down… would you?

meta.name: Mothership
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.95 KB

“Mothership” is a fast-paced space shooter in which you defend your home planet against an enemy invasion. The threat comes from a massive mothership and swarms of fast-moving drone fighters that behave like crazed lemmings. You pilot your ship through the Zarway space corridor, dodging and shooting enemies. The higher you move on the screen, the faster the action – but the greater the rewards for each kill. In the first phase, you must shoot ten drones in a row without getting hit. Succeed, and you'll get a chance to destroy the mothership with three successful shots. There are three difficulty levels: at level 1, drones only try to crash into you – at level 2, they shoot – and at level 3, they do both. Avoid crashing into the corridor walls or you'll lose a life. The game can be played solo or in turns with another player.

meta.name: Motley Tetris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.70 KB

Motley Tetris is a unique twist on the classic puzzle game, incorporating a visual element into the gameplay. As players stack blocks and clear rows, an image gradually forms in the background from the uncleared squares. The objective remains to survive as long as possible while achieving the highest score, revealing the hidden picture as the game progresses.

meta.name: Moto X Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.84 KB

“Moto X” delivers dirt-bike action at its wildest. Tear through rough terrain at full speed, pop wheelies, leap over dunes, logs, and ravines, and tear through mud, sand, and ice. The 3D view even shifts to a helicopter perspective as you powerslide through curves, conquer hills, and launch perfectly timed jumps – a fast-paced thrill ride for adrenaline-hungry riders.

meta.name: Motocross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Motocross kicks off with adrenaline – strap on your helmet, rev the engine and hit the course. Through corners, over hills, into ruts and down straights you fight for time and try to stay ahead of the pack. But be warned – stray off the track and you'll either lose precious seconds getting back or end up flat on your backside. Who says computers don't like to get dirty?

meta.name: Motocross Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.87 KB

Motocross Racer is a bike racing game where you need to race through three different scenes in the shortest amount of time possible. Each scene takes place in a different location with a different perspective. First you will race through the desert with a 3-D behind the bike point of view. Rocks, cacti, scorpions, and other obstacles should be avoided or you'll crash and lose valuable time. Next you'll race a winding path uphill through the woods. This section has a top down view, and you'll lose time if you wander off the track or crash into obstacles. The final segment of the race takes place on the beach with a side scrolling point of view. Various obstacles and other racers will all get in your way here! If you crash too many times, or take too long the game will be over.

meta.name: Motor Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.58 KB

Motor Mania es un juego de conducción con vista superior en el que la pantalla se desplaza verticalmente hacia arriba mientras intentas conducir tu coche de carreras durante tantos kilómetros como puedas. Comenzando en una gasolinera, puedes controlar tu velocidad hasta 80 mph, frenar y moverte hacia izquierda o derecha mientras evitas a otros conductores y diversos obstáculos. Hay tres tipos de carreteras para conducir (autopista, carretera secundaria y camino de tierra) y debes evitar golpear los laterales y a los otros conductores o perderás una de tus cinco vidas. 
Los obstáculos que encuentras afectan diferentes aspectos del coche, como baches que hacen que su dirección sea errática, parches en el camino que lo frenan, avalanchas y cruces con vehículos que se mueven a travesando el camino. Las gasolineras aparecen de vez en cuando y aquí podrás repostar, arreglar el coche y recargar de la batería.

meta.name: Motor-Way
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.73 KB

“Motor-Way” sends you on a perilous road-crossing mission – your goal: rescue the girl on the other side. Move from left to right, dodging cars speeding past you. It's an attempt to follow in the footsteps of “Frogger” – and while it may be considered one of the worst examples of its kind, it's certainly memorable because of it.

meta.name: Motorbike Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Motorbike Madness ve las carreras cuesta abajo desde una perspectiva isométrica influenciada por Marble Madness. Debes llegar al fondo dentro del límite de tiempo, permanecer dentro de los límites de la pista y evitar peligros como agua, troncos y automóviles estacionados. Cuanto más rápido completes el trazado, más premios en metálico recibirás. Las reparaciones de cualquier daño a la moto deben pagarse con esto, pero el resto se puede gastar en mejoras. Los controles son giratorios, con el botón de disparo o el espacio utilizado para los caballitos.

meta.name: Motorcycle 500
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.05 KB

Motorcycle 500 is a manager game where you are the manager of a motorcycle racing team that competes in the World Grand Prix across different seasons. The goal is to have a driver as champion and for your team to win the constructors' championship. At the start of the game, you must first select the team you want to manage and the team's main sponsor, who will each pay you money for the upcoming season. You will then need to select two drivers to drive for you, with each driver receiving an annual salary from your team. Once you've made your selection, you'll be taken to the main menu and can choose from various options as you attempt to become world champion.nnnnBefore you race, you can see the upcoming races of the season as well as the rankings of your drivers and team.

meta.name: Motor Cycle Rally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.31 KB

On your motorcycle, you have entered the Motor Cycle Rally where you start and finish at Ariel Castle searching the surrounding area for the Award. On your ride you must find various objects to use in the correct places as well as find equipment to help you in your search.

meta.name: Motorhead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.05 KB

A vehicle shooter, dodge the tanks, mines copters, jets strafing, blow them up before they can get a bead on you. For some reason you must also avoid whatever anvils must be at the base of bushes and foliage and walls of all sorts.

meta.name: Motos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.82 KB

En este juego controlas un coche de choque cuyo objetivo es sacar a tus rivales del tablero —mientras ellos intentan lo mismo contigo— para avanzar de ronda. Si tardas demasiado, una bola de fuego destruye una baldosa, reduciendo el espacio y aumentando el riesgo de caer. En algunas rondas aparecen potenciadores: mayor fuerza al chocar o la habilidad de saltar sobre huecos. Al saltar, puedes debilitar y romper baldosas, creando trampas para que los oponentes caigan.

meta.name: Mountain Bike Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This budget game is essentially Kikstart without the engines. It's viewed from the side, with 12 courses to complete within their respective time limits. You control the bike by setting the speed and jumping at the right moments. Hazards to negotiate include hills, walls, rocks, spikes and ice. Some of these can be circumnavigated by buying the right add-ons from the shop after each race. The amount of money you have to spend is dependent upon how quickly you completed the previous race.

meta.name: Mountain King
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.21 KB

“Mountain King” takes you deep into a mysterious diamond mine where you climb across dark platforms with a flashlight, collect diamonds, uncover hidden spirits and ultimately retrieve the crown of the mountain king – but only if you make it back to the surface in time, without bats stealing the crown or falling victim to the spider's web below, will you become the true king of the mountain.

meta.name: The Mountain Palace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.53 KB

The Mountain Palace takes you to a rocky mountain ledge overlooking a mysterious valley, where you, as a bold adventurer, follow the call of fortune – with courage and determination, you explore your surroundings, follow clues and set off in search of the hidden palace of the long-dead king, always wary of the dangers that lurk around every corner.

meta.name: Mountie Mick's Death Ride
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador asume el papel del agente Mick, que debe impedir que unos bandidos roben nueve trenes. La pantalla se desplaza automáticamente de derecha a izquierda, lo que significa que tiene que seguir moviéndose hasta llegar a la parte delantera del tren. Entonces se balancea sobre una carretilla para pasar al siguiente nivel.
Hay muchos obstáculos en su camino, como saltos entre vagones, escapes de gas y túneles oscuros. Las máscaras de gas y las antorchas recogidas le permiten sobrevivir a los dos últimos. La mayor parte del tiempo, sin embargo, Mick tiene que vérselas con los propios bandidos. Intentan matarle, pero esto puede evitarse esquivando las balas, respondiendo a los disparos o cayendo sobre sus cabezas. Ambos bandos también disponen de granadas.

meta.name: Mouse Trap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.17 KB

“Mouse Trap” is a lively platform game where you guide a nimble mouse through a colorful world of cheese, cakes and balloons – navigating clouds, ladders and moving platforms while dodging flowers, bouncing balls and dinosaurs, you must collect all items and reach the exit door before the ticking bomb runs out.

meta.name: Move : The Ultimate Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A puzzle game that is quite a challenge. In this game you can slide pieces around to create matches that are removed from the playing area, allowing you to slide and match more until the level is clear, and you can move on to the next head-scratcher.

meta.name: Move It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.83 KB

Move It challenges your strategic thinking as you take turns shifting pieces on a seven-by-seven grid to line up four of your own – a piece just moved must remain still on the next turn, and you can use both your own and your opponent's pieces to reach your goal, with a single empty space always allowing movement and carefully planned manipulation slowly bringing you closer to victory.

meta.name: Move On!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.93 KB

Move On! throws you into a chaotic universe where entropy is spiraling out of control – to prevent disaster, you must restore order by skillfully shifting icons that represent scattered energy structures, matching identical symbols to make them self-annihilate and reduce entropy, all while dealing with bombs and transmitters that trigger special effects on their surroundings.

meta.name: Move Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Move Out puts you in the role of a warehouse worker in a maze-like storage hall, pushing heavy crates filled with precious cargo into the freight elevator – using a forklift that can't lift but only push. One wrong move might trap a box against a wall, making it immovable and costing you a life. Between pallets, corners and your own logic, the game becomes a test of tactics, planning and patience – all set to surprisingly catchy music and a tongue-in-cheek tone. For those wanting full control, an integrated editor lets you build your own storage nightmares.

meta.name: The Movie Monster Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Movie Monster Game” puts you in the role of a colossal threat – choose from six giant creatures, including the officially licensed Godzilla, a tarantula or a robot, and rampage through iconic cities like London, Paris, New York, Moscow or San Francisco. Whether your mission is to escape, rescue or destroy a landmark, each scenario adds a unique twist. Unlike its predecessor “Crush, Crumble and Chomp!”, this game lets you control your monster freely in classic arcade style, as jets, tanks and missiles try to stop you. A chaotic and charming solo experience for monster fans.

meta.name: Movie Musical Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.42 KB

Featuring the musical band the Jazz Scats, the player creates a music video for the band. The player chooses a band member, and then places a variety of props on the scene. The player can choose from a variety of musical scores to accompany the scene. The player then can move their chosen character throughout the animated scene as music plays. Items, props, and music are chosen from a number of menus represented by dots at the top and bottom of the screen. Movies can be saved and reviewed at a later date.
