meta.boxback: Z:/Digistorage/Arley4dCloudMedia/c64/images/Movie Musical Madness Starring the Jazz Scats (USA, Europe).zip-boxback.jpg

meta.name: Movie Studio
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Movie Studio” drops you into the dream factory of Hollywood, where you bring your very own film project to life on the C64 – using creative tools to direct characters, design sets and structure scenes, you explore locations and develop your own mini-production just like a real director on the studio lot.

meta.name: Moving Target
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juegas en el papel de un comando enviado a las profundidades de la jungla sudamericana por el Grupo Especial de Control de Drogas de las Naciones Unidas, cuya misión es volar la refinería subterránea de cocaína perteneciente al diabólico barón colombiano de la droga. Por desgracia, la unidad a la que perteneces ha caído en una emboscada y tú eres el único superviviente, pero has jurado seguir adelante y completar la misión.
Armado con una pistola ametralladora Uzi, deberás registrar la refinería utilizando escaleras para subir y bajar por los distintos niveles y buscar bombas para colocarlas en sus posiciones correctas. Las puertas cerradas también bloquearán tu camino, pero se pueden encontrar llaves y utilizarlas para mantenerte en el camino de la misión.

meta.name: Stringer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.41 KB

In Stringer, you play a photographer who photographs women for his own enjoyment. The object of the game is to search behind doors for four items: a pass, a key, a camera, and a lightbulb for the camera. Once you acquire these, open the door at the farthest left and photograph a woman who tries to look pretty by crossing her legs every five seconds.

meta.name: Mr. Cool
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.72 KB

„Mr. Cool“ is a vibrant action game where you hop across a pyramid-shaped field to change the platform colors to a target hue. You must avoid enemies approaching from the sides and above while completing your color transformation. The game features 15 increasingly difficult rounds – after which it restarts at a faster pace. Though inspired by „Q*Bert“, this game introduces new elements and a sharper challenge, making it more than just a clone.

meta.name: Mr. Dig
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.60 KB

Mr. Dig is a dig-and-run action game where your goal is to collect all the cherries on the screen to proceed to the next level. As you tunnel through dirt or move along existing paths, enemies will chase you – but they can only follow tunnels and can't dig themselves. To fend them off, you can throw a bouncing ball – but only one at a time – or drop an apple on them by digging away the dirt beneath it. If you get touched by an enemy, you lose one of your five lives. When all lives are gone, it's game over.

meta.name: Mr. Do!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.74 KB

In "Mr. Do!" you control the title character as he collects all the cherries in a maze while being chased by relentless enemies. To defend himself, Mr. Do can drop apples onto his foes or throw a power ball that destroys them on contact. He only has one ball at a time, and it must return before he can use it again, so timing is key. Occasionally, an alpha monster appears carrying a letter from the word EXTRA – hit it with the power ball to collect that letter. Once you've completed the word, you earn an extra life. Collect all the cherries to advance to the next, more difficult level.

meta.name: Mr. Do's Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.45 KB

In "Mr. Do's Castle" you control the clown Mr. Do! as he navigates a multi-level castle, aiming to either eliminate all unicorns or remove all cherry blocks to complete the stage. Using a hammer, you can knock out floor blocks to drop enemies or create new paths. Deadly unicorns patrol the castle and relentlessly pursue you. There are three blocks with key symbols – knock them out to unlock the door on the roof. If you reach the door, the unicorns temporarily become harmless and carry letters from the word EXTRA. Hitting one earns you that letter, and spelling the full word grants an extra life. Skull blocks add another twist: knocking out two in a row turns all blocks between them into a bridge. As you progress, castles become more complex and the unicorns faster and more numerous.

meta.name: Mr. Dynamite
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.06 KB

Mr. Dynamite is a fast-paced arcade game where the player must catch falling dynamite sticks before they hit the ground. Missing one brings the game closer to an end, as an explosion means game over. The challenge increases as the speed of the falling explosives rises. Precise timing and quick reflexes are essential to achieving a high score.

meta.name: Mr. Egghead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.43 KB

Mr. Egghead is a platform game developed as a demonstration to showcase the capabilities of a game development tool. It encourages players to refine the mechanics, add new levels, or modify graphics and sounds rather than viewing it as a finished game. The gameplay involves navigating a single platform level, avoiding obstacles and enemies, and collecting objects.

meta.name: Mr. Freeze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.96 KB

La tarea de Mister Freeze consiste en descongelar los 6 compartimentos del frigorífico evitando peligros como comida voladora, cubitos de hielo y robots guardianes. No importa en qué orden descongele los compartimentos, cada vez que uno de ellos vuelva a estar operativo, un botón especial lo indicará en la parte superior de cada pantalla, y Mister Freeze tendrá que ir hasta el fondo de la pantalla para pasar a otro compartimento. Ah, sólo tiene 6 vidas, así que ayúdale a salvarlas...

p: Mr. Frosty and the Killer Penguins (Europe).T64
n: Mr. Frosty and the Killer Penguins (Europe)

meta.name: Mr. Frosty and the Killer Penguins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.51 KB

Mr. Frosty and the Killer Penguins is a single screen platformer where you move a snowman around the screen to collect all the snowballs to move to the next screen within a time limit. The snowballs are needed to build three giant snowmen and once all have been built then the game is completed and you start all over again.

meta.name: Mr. Heli
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Es 2999 y el señor Muddy amenaza su planeta. Afortunadamente, tienes un helicóptero grande totalmente armado con el que atacar a sus secuaces sádicos. Sube a bordo y vuela a través de cuatro niveles de vista lateral, principalmente desplazándose de izquierda a derecha pero con alguna variante, cada una de las cuales termina con un jefe.Además de los enemigos, hay muchos bloques en los niveles. El sistema de actualización de armas está integrado en estos, que funcionan de dos maneras diferentes. La mayoría arrojará cristales, que si se recogen se agregan a su efectivo total. Los demás revelan una imagen de un arma con un precio: ponte en contacto con ella mientras llevas suficientes créditos y comprarás esta arma. Cuando se agota tu barra de energía, pierdes una vida; Cuando esto sucede, pierde todo su dinero.

meta.name: Mr. Mephisto
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.64 KB

Mr Mephisto turns the journey to heaven into a dangerous climbing challenge where you constantly face obstacles. You ascend moving staircases, collect essential items, and search for the correct exit while enemies try to stop you. One wrong step or careless move can send you back and cost one of your limited lives. That mix of skill, timing, and constant pressure gives the game its demanding appeal.

meta.name: Mr. Pixel's Cartoon Kit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Mr. Pixel's Cartoon Kit“ is a user-friendly animation program that lets you create your own little cartoons in a humorous way. With characters like Mr. Pixel, a car, and surprising elements such as sharks, you can plan movements, assemble scenes, and play back the sequences – including rewind function and different animation directions. Perfect for anyone who wants to unleash their creativity and bring funny stories to life.

meta.name: Mr. Pixel's Programming Paint Set
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 279.46 KB

Mr. Pixel's Programming Paint Set is a creative learning program that helps children develop basic computer programming skills while having fun creating designs and drawings. Using various tools and commands, they can generate patterns, apply colors, and program repeatable sequences to gain a deeper understanding of computer-generated graphics.

p: Mr. Robot and his Robot Factory (USA).D64
n: Mr. Robot and his Robot Factory (USA)

meta.name: Mr. Robot and his Robot Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador controla un robot y debe guiarlo a través de 22 niveles de plataformas utilizando escaleras, cintas de correr, trampolines, escaleras mecánicas, imanes, transportadores y otros dispositivos. Debes recoger todas las píldoras de energía de un nivel para completarlo, pero sólo tienes un tiempo limitado para hacerlo, ya que pierdes energía constantemente. Caer desde muy alto o golpear a un enemigo matará a tu robot. Recoger energizantes te permite matar temporalmente a tus enemigos. El juego también cuenta con un editor que te permite crear tus propios niveles.

meta.name: Mr. Speedy and his Adventures
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.60 KB

Mr. Speedy and his Adventures is a fast-paced top-down action game in which you must paint all the discs of a 7x6 grid – and do so within a time limit. Discs are painted by moving over them, and in later levels they require multiple passes. Gaps must be avoided, and leaving the grid is fatal. Adding to the challenge are jelly-like enemies that glide across the screen – touching one, stepping into a gap or running out of time costs you one of six lives.

meta.name: Mr. T Meets His Match
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mr. T Meets His Match es un juego de memoria inspirado en los clásicos juegos de emparejamiento. Cuenta con los modos Animal Wildcard y Switcharoo, donde los jugadores deben emparejar imágenes de animales según su color, forma u otros atributos. A medida que se enfocan y reconocen patrones, podrán resolver combinaciones cada vez más desafiantes.

meta.name: Mr. T's Measuring Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Mr. T's Measuring Games” is a collection of educational games focused on size and height comparisons. Players must grow or shrink objects and animals to match specific sizes and then position them accordingly. The game challenges the ability to recognize and adjust proportions and sizes correctly. It also features varying difficulty levels to provide different challenges.

meta.name: Mr. T's Number Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Mr. T's Number Games“ is a collection of educational games focused on numbers and quantities. It includes „How Many?“ and the „Elephant Game“, where players identify and assign quantities or engage with numbers and water consumption in a playful manner.

meta.name: Mr. T's Shape Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Mr. T's Shape Games“ is a collection featuring two games – „Jigsaws“ and „Shape Maker“. In „Jigsaws“, players must correctly assemble geometric shapes to complete an image. „Shape Maker“, on the other hand, allows the selection and placement of different shapes like squares, circles, or triangles on the screen. The game is controlled through keyboard inputs, enabling players to choose and position the desired shapes.

meta.name: Mr. TNT
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.44 KB

Mr. TNT puts you in control of a blobby character navigating a grid to collect sixteen sticks of dynamite. At the same time, burning fuses move across the board – touching one means instant explosion. The twist is that every tile crossed disappears permanently, making careful route planning essential to avoid trapping yourself. Fuses can even eliminate themselves this way. A level ends when all dynamite is collected or all fuses have burned out – then a new grid layout presents fresh challenges and more scoring opportunities.

meta.name: Mr. Wimpy : The Hamburger Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.40 KB

At the beginning, Mr. Wimpy must avoid moving manhole covers in his kitchen to reach the pantry and collect ingredients for his burgers. A character named Waldo tries to steal the ingredients from him. After this first level, the game becomes a "BurgerTime" clone, with Mr. Wimpy running across platforms while pushing four different burger ingredients down onto plates. He must avoid enemies such as Sid Sos (a walking sausage), Ogy Egg (a fried egg), Sam Spoon (a spoon), and Pam Pickle (a pickle). Mr. Wimpy can freeze enemies with pepper for a short time or crush them by placing an ingredient on top of them. He has limited amounts of pepper, which can be replenished by collecting coffee or ice. The player starts with four lives, which can be lost by falling into a hole in the first level or by enemies in the platforming level.

meta.name: Mr. Wino
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.42 KB

Mr Wino is trapped in his own nightmare after a night out getting drunk and falling asleep in his home. To escape from this nightmare and wake up, you must control Mr Wino in this flick-screen platform game and collect all the bottles on each level made up over various screens to open barrier to the exit. Some bottles collected will open doors blocking exits and each screen needs to be completed before his air gauge that is slowly decreasing runs out. Moving around the various screens are creatures and if these are touched then you lose one of three lives. Certain objects also need avoiding like spikes and moving pillars with moving platforms to encounter.

meta.name: Mr. Wiz!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.35 KB

„Mr. Wiz!“ is a variant of „Mr. Do!“ in which you control a wizard wandering through a garden, collecting cherries while avoiding nasty gremlins. You can defeat the gremlins by throwing a crystal ball or by dropping apples on them. If the gremlins get angry or trapped, they might dig their own tunnels or eat the apples. Picking up a magic mushroom rewards you with bonus points but also permanently enrages the gremlins. Unlike the arcade original, there are no alpha monsters or additional enemies – and you can't freeze their movement.

meta.name: Mrs. Mop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.53 KB

Mrs. Mop is the overworked cleaning lady in the worst school imaginable. Surrounded by unruly students, hostile teachers and even attacking dogs, she must clean the school section by section – all while managing a back that gets worse the more she scrubs. If it gives out completely, she'll need a week of rest. Thankfully, she's not defenseless: she can hurl soap or unleash the powerful Gleamo – a screen-clearing substance that cleans and destroys everything in sight. Viewed from above, you guide Mrs. Mop as she scrubs floors, dodges enemies, refills her bucket, and beats the clock. The more she cleans, the more cash she earns.

meta.name: Ms. Pac-Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.12 KB

En 1982 llegó Ms. Pac-Man, secuela del exitoso Pac-Man, manteniendo la esencia de “comer puntos y evitar fantasmas”, pero con novedades. Ms. Pac-Man debe limpiar cuatro laberintos distintos y desafiantes, repletos de puntos y frutas rebotantes, mientras esquiva a Inky, Blinky, Pinky y Sue —cada uno con comportamientos únicos. Un contacto con cualquier fantasma le cuesta una vida. Al comer un Energizer (hay cuatro por laberinto), los fantasmas se vuelven azules y pueden ser devorados por puntos extra (200, 400, 800 y 1600). Tras unos segundos, sus ojos regresan a la caja central y renacen para perseguirla de nuevo.

meta.name: MTV Remote Control
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Remote Control is based on the MTV quiz show of the same name. During the game, three contestants (computer or human controlled) compete against each other by answering questions about different television shows, movies, characters, or actors/actresses. There are two rounds of play, followed by a third final “think really fast” round.

meta.name: MTV Remote Control
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Remote Control is based on the MTV quiz show of the same name. During the game, three contestants (computer or human controlled) compete against each other by answering questions about different television shows, movies, characters, or actors/actresses. There are two rounds of play, followed by a third final “think really fast” round.

meta.name: Muggin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.59 KB

"Muggin" is a fast-paced duel game where two players compete simultaneously in a split-screen view. The goal is to complete an obstacle course faster than your opponent – precise controls and sharp reflexes determine victory. The screen is divided into a top and bottom half – each player controls their character on one of these lanes. The competitive atmosphere and easy gameplay access make "Muggin" a fan favorite at C64 tournaments.

meta.name: Mugsy's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mugsy's Revenge puts you in the Prohibition era, where you gradually build up an illegal alcohol business. You make decisions about production, bribes, and investments, guided by conversations with your assistants. It's not just about planning, though, as occasional action sequences bring you face to face with the police. That blend of strategy, atmosphere, and bursts of arcade-style action gives the game its distinctive appeal.

meta.name: M.U.L.E.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.36 KB

Set on the fictional planet Irata (Atari backwards), the game is an exercise in supply and demand economics involving competition among four players, with computer opponents automatically filling in for any missing players. Players choose the race of their colonist, which has advantages and disadvantages that can be paired to their respective strategies. To win, players not only compete against each other to amass the largest amount of wealth, but must also cooperate for the survival of the colony.

meta.name: Multi-Player Soccer Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.10 KB

“Multi-Player Soccer Manager” is a football management game where up to four players can participate simultaneously. Players start as managers of a randomly selected team in Division 4, aiming to achieve promotion to higher divisions through strong performances. Each season consists of 30 league matches, with the top two teams earning promotion and the bottom two teams being relegated in higher leagues. In addition to the league, all teams compete in cup tournaments such as the League Cup and the F.A. Cup. Players can make transfers, organize training, and expand their stadiums. Successful managers may receive job offers from higher-tier teams, while poor performance can lead to dismissal. The game ends when no job is accepted, or the player decides to retire.

meta.name: Krystals of Zong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.95 KB

In this game, the player must gather the treasures for all eight levels. But to be able to enter the treasure caverns, the player is required to collect certain keys, and open the doors in which the key's color matches the border's. These keys are collected in other rooms. If the right key is obtained, the player is able to pass through the doors, enter the cavern, and get the treasure. While searching the rooms, you can also get swords that you can use to kill snakes, bats, spiders, and mummies; and the torches to see. Besides treasures, other things that you can get in the caverns are pixie boots which you can get for extra speed, and two potions - one for teleportation, one for invincibility. There are eight levels in the game, and going up ladders take you to the next level.

meta.name: Munch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Munch is a maze game where you collect points either alone or in a simultaneous two-player mode. In a familiar setting, you guide your character through winding corridors, gather items and avoid enemy creatures chasing you. Strategic movement and sharp timing are key to staying alive and maximizing your score. In two-player mode, the game becomes especially exciting as both players race through the maze – either in competition or working together.

meta.name: Munch Man 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Munch Man 64 is a single screen maze game based on the arcade game Pac-Man where you move Munch Man around a maze to eat all the dots. While you eat the dots you are chased by four ghosts and if you touch a ghost then you lose one of three lives. There are four large dots in each corner and when eaten allow you to chase and eat the ghosts for a short period of time. Occasionally a fruit will appear and when eaten give you bonus points and a level is completed once all the dots are eaten and you then play the same maze full of dots again. Two players can play and each player takes it in turn to play when the other player loses a life.

meta.name: Munch Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Munch Mania is a single screen maze game based on the arcade game Pac-Man where you move Munch Maniac around a maze to eat all the devil dots. While you eat the dots you are chased by four ghosts and if you touch a ghost then you lose one of three lives. There are four flashing senior devil dots in each corner and when eaten allow you to chase and eat the ghosts for a short period of time. Occasionally a fruit will appear and when eaten give you bonus points and a level is completed once all the dots are eaten and you then play the same maze full of dots again.

meta.name: The Muncher Eats Chewits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„The Muncher Eats Chewits“ puts you in control of a prehistoric monster on a mission to retrieve its stolen eggs from Japanese explorers. This plays out as widespread destruction – smashing buildings and defeating attackers to rack up a high score. Depending on whether you're on the ground or scaling a building, you can perform different attacks, including a limited number of fireballs that can be replenished by eating petrol trucks. If you find an egg, you can carry it to a waste disposal site that's repurposed as a breeding ground – essentially acting as an extra life. When another giant monster appears, the screen stops scrolling until either it or the player is defeated.

meta.name: Munchie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.97 KB

"Munchie" is an educational game that promotes basic math skills in a playful way. Players solve problems in addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Each correct answer moves the green Pac-Man closer to the goal, while each wrong answer allows the ghost to catch up. The game combines learning math with an exciting race to escape the ghost and reach the goal.

meta.name: Munchman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.56 KB

Munchman is a maze game in the style of Pac-Man. You navigate the maze, eat dots, and avoid four ghosts. A power pill in each corner of the maze allows you to eat the ghosts for a short time. Bonus points can be earned by collecting fruit, and an extra life is awarded at 20,000 points. The cartridge version includes a two-player option.

meta.name: Munchy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.10 KB

„Munchy“ is a classic maze game where you guide your character through tight corridors, collecting points while being chased by four colorful enemies. To fight back, you can grab special items that temporarily turn you into the hunter. The goal is to clear the entire maze without getting caught. The game features smooth controls, crisp visuals and catchy sound effects – perfectly capturing the nostalgic arcade experience.

meta.name: The Munsters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.83 KB

Los personajes de la serie de televisión de los años 60, Los Munsters, han sido transportados a un misterioso castillo del que intentan escapar. En cada fase utilizas sucesivamente a los diferentes miembros de la familia, que debes de intentar salvar completando el nivel.
A medida que atraviesas cada habitación, debes recolectar elementos que te ayudarán a completar cada desafío. Deberás aumentar el poder de tus hechizos disparando a demonios, zombies y vampiros, ya que esto te permitirá enfrentar otros desafíos. Evita entrar en contacto con estos monstruos, ya que consumirán tu energía y podrían matarte; solo tienes una vida para completar este desafío.

meta.name: Muppet Learning Keys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Muppet Learning Keys," children aged three and up learn typing and computer skills in a playful way. This educational game combines special hardware and software compatible with the Commodore 64 and Apple platforms. The software includes programs such as "Muppetville," "Muppet Slate," "Muppet Word Book," and the "Sesame Street" game "Astro-Grover." The charming Muppet theme makes learning enjoyable and engaging for young users.

meta.name: Muppets on Stage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Muppets on Stage” features three different stages for children to explore: Discovery allows for free keyboard exploration, Letters focuses on identifying uppercase and lowercase letters, and Numbers challenges children to match the correct number of pictures shown on screen with varying levels of difficulty. It is designed for children from Kindergarten to First Grade, but can also be used effectively in special education settings.

meta.name: Murder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.05 KB

One evening a body is found in the Rambling Hall. This is the country home of the senior member of the Cabinet, Third Lord Rambling. You, Chief Inspector Pincher of the Yard has been called to the scene of the murder and it seems that one of the guests in the house is a murderer. The object of the game is to interview all suspects until you can establish who has done it through the process of elimination. You have a time limit to discover who the culprit is. It must be done before midnight or the murderer, who is stalking you, will get you.

meta.name: The Murder at Osbourne Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.02 KB

A murder has occurred at the castle of Lord and Lady Osbourne, and you have been called in to solve this murder mystery. After the crime occurred, the murderer ran from the room and threw the murder weapon into another room. At that time, the corpse was discovered and it was decided that everyone would remain where they were until you can arrive, question them, examine the evidence and solve the mystery.

meta.name: Murder in Flight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.17 KB

“Murder in Flight” is a strategic detective game where the player takes on the role of an investigator tasked with solving a murder. The goal is to interrogate suspects, check their alibis, and uncover contradictions through clever questioning. Each clue brings the player closer to the truth, but only one person can be the killer. Every turn presents a choice – verify an alibi, interrogate a suspect, or make an accusation – but beware: a wrong accusation could end the game. Deduction, patience, and a sharp mind are essential to uncover the murderer.

meta.name: Murder off Miami
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Based on the book by Dennis Wheatley, Murder off Miami is a three part graphic text adventure where you play the role of Detective Officer Kettering who has to investigate the death of a British financier, who it seems committed suicide on a cruise ship off the coast of Miami. Clues must be found and people talked to as you try to uncover the answers to this mysterious death. Text describes each location with the occasional graphic showing what you see in a location and the keyboard is used to type in commands to control your hero and interact with each location.

meta.name: Murder on the Atlantic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Murder on the Atlantic” takes place in 1938 aboard the Bourgogne – a large French ocean liner carrying wealthy passengers and spies eager to capture emerging computer technology. As a detective, you investigate two mysterious murders that occurred on the ship. The game is entirely menu-driven – you choose which part of the ship to explore, search rooms, or read statements from up to forty suspects. You don't interact with them directly, but receive written information. As the investigation unfolds, you discover a decoder to decrypt secret messages. The puzzles involve finding specific code words. Once the solution is pieced together – using various physical documents that come with the game – the second part begins, where you must correctly answer a series of questions to win.

meta.name: Murder on the Atlantic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The famous detective Sir Charles Foxworth is on vacation on the Mississippi with his servant Regis on the Delta Princess. He is taking a walk across the upper deck of the ship when he spots an open cabin door. Behind it: a dead man. It turns out that the body is Raleigh Cartwright III. Sir Charles has three days to find the murderer, because then the ship will reach New Orleans and give the perpetrator a safe chance to escape.

meta.name: Murder on the Waterfront
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Murder on the Waterfront” is a graphic text adventure – you are the ill-fated adventurer trying to find Mary before it's too late and she ends up dead. You explore shadowy streets, like the area near Joe's Bar on 45th Street, and follow clues to change Mary's fate before time runs out.

meta.name: Murder on the Zinderneuf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Murder on the Zinderneuf” takes place in 1936 aboard the dirigible Zinderneuf, where a murder has been discovered mid-flight. As the only detective on board, it's your job to identify the killer before the airship lands. From a top-down view, you search rooms for clues and interrogate the fifteen passengers. You can choose to be polite, forceful, naive, or use other approaches to get information – but ignoring someone now might mean they'll be uncooperative later. Your task is to piece together the evidence and uncover the murderer before time runs out. You play as one of eight detectives, and with each playthrough, the killer, motive, and clues are randomly changed.

meta.name: Make Your Own Murder Party
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Murder Party” is a creative piece of software that makes it easy to organize your own murder mystery party – perfect for up to eight players. Based on your guests' names, the program generates a unique story with roles, motives, clues, and personal secrets. Each participant receives a personalized booklet outlining their role and the known facts. Two scenarios – “Empire” and “Big Kill” – are available, with the murderer and motive randomly selected each time, offering strong replay value. The software also provides invitation letters, menu suggestions, music and decoration ideas – but once everything is printed, it steps aside, and the rest is up to your guests' acting skills!

meta.name: Make Your Own Murder Party
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Murder Party” is a creative piece of software that makes it easy to organize your own murder mystery party – perfect for up to eight players. Based on your guests' names, the program generates a unique story with roles, motives, clues, and personal secrets. The software also provides invitation letters, menu suggestions, music and decoration ideas – but once everything is printed, it steps aside, and the rest is up to your guests' acting skills!

meta.name: Murray Mouse Super-Cop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.76 KB

In "Murray Mouse: Super-Cop," you take on the role of Murray Mouse, fighting the mouse mafia in 1930s Chicago. The mafia plans to steal the cheese moon, and it's up to you to find and arrest the ten members before their plan succeeds. In this side-scrolling arcade adventure with flick-screen gameplay, you solve puzzles by finding scattered items and placing them in the correct locations. You can carry only two items at a time, which you can pick up and drop as needed. Use your wits and skill to stop the mafia and save the moon.

meta.name: Mushroom Alley
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.09 KB

Mushroom Alley is a single screen shooter inspired by the arcade game Centipede where you move left and right, and a certain distance forwards and backwards to protect your garden from various insects. You had planned to work on your garden, but after light rain overnight, the garden is full of mushrooms attracting the insects to nest, so you need to destroy the insects to protect your beloved garden.

meta.name: Music Match
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.76 KB

Music Match es un juego de memoria musical donde los jugadores deben emparejar fragmentos de música coincidentes. Escuchando con atención y recordando las melodías, pueden encontrar los pares correctos y sumar puntos. El juego desafía la memoria auditiva y ofrece una forma entretenida de reconocer y asociar sonidos de manera lúdica.

meta.name: Mutant
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.90 KB

“Mutant” is a text-based adventure with graphical elements, placing you in the role of a hardened lone operative recruited for covert missions. This time, you're sent to a remote South Sea island where a mysterious creature – possibly a result of old nuclear testing – has emerged. Your mission: track and destroy the beast. You explore forests, valleys, and abandoned locations, typing in simple commands to interact with your surroundings and uncover clues. Dangers lurk around every corner, and your choices shape the course of the narrative.

meta.name: Mutant Monty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.52 KB

Mutant Monty puts you in control of a determined hero collecting gold across 40 distinct rooms while trying to rescue a princess. To progress, each room must be cleared of all gold nuggets within a set time limit. Deadly creatures roam the area, and touching them or running out of time costs a life. Monty moves automatically in the chosen direction and can change course mid-motion – the longer you push the joystick, the faster he gets.

meta.name: The Mutant Spiders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.16 KB

“The Adventure 1: Mutant Spiders” (also known as “Commodore Adventure #1”) is a text-based adventure game where your mission is to save the world from an invasion of giant mutant spiders. You must find and destroy their eggs before they hatch and unleash chaos. But reaching their nest won't be easy – not only will the spiders fight back, but the forces of nature themselves will stand in your way. Only clear thinking, determination, and smart choices will prevent disaster.

meta.name: Mutants
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.16 KB

“Mutants” is a multidirectional scrolling action game set in a grim future where you battle a threat created by the ruthless arms company Survivor Zero Corporation. In a galaxy torn apart by centuries of war, the corporation has engineered genetically modified war mutants – the MGMs – that mutate rapidly into ever more dangerous forms and threaten all life. You're part of a small group of rebels, piloting the ship “Rainbow Warrior” in a last-ditch effort to stop the devastation. Your mission: recover 15 pieces of a self-destruct mechanism scattered across testing grounds and reassemble it at the control center – all while engaging in fierce battles against the relentless mutants.

meta.name: Muzzy Zoophyte
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Muzzy Zoophyte“ is a futuristic twist on billiards where nothing works like the classic game of cues and green felt. Set in the year 3000, you pilot a spherical black vehicle across massive halls with rough terrain, trying to push oversized colored balls into their matching colored holes. Precise control and clever planning are essential, as the playing field is filled with huge block obstacles and, most annoyingly, oversized grey balls. These grey balls can be moved but must never be pocketed. If a colored ball touches a grey one, both become stuck – and you'll need to find another way around, if one even exists. It's a tactical, fast-paced skill game with a character all its own.

meta.name: My Grand Piano
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.87 KB

Play and sing in Fisher-Price style with this colorful and very large piano. Your mom can't say this is an outdoor toy! Now you can play over thirty different songs without having to read a single note! Just listen to a song, then play each note along with the computer and hear it played back to you. That's how you make music! Once you get really good and have learned all the songs, you can even invent your own. Based on the popular Fisher-Price toy, My Big Piano introduces young children of all ages to the joy of music. It provides a simple and fun introduction to piano theory and classic children's songs – it's also a great way for beginners to build confidence with the computer keyboard!

meta.name: My House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.89 KB

"My House" presents players with the unusual task of repairing a broken printer, requiring true heroism.

meta.name: My Secret File
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.68 KB

My Secret File is a digital version of a personal diary, based on the book of the same name by John Astrop. Across different sections, you can record thoughts, impressions, and memories – about your family, your room, your pets, or your favorite clothes. The program encourages reflection and writing, offering a child-friendly introduction to capturing personal experiences on a computer. Ideal for young users who want to learn self-expression in a playful way.

meta.name: Mychess II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mychess II Is an early chess game for multiple platforms, and the sequel to Mychess. Games can be played 2-player or versus the computer. Players must type in their individual move commands, and only legitimate moves are allowed. Players can set up individual chess challenges, replay famous games from history, and can set time limits between moves for tournament play. Gameplay can be displayed in text-only mode, in a traditional 2D view, or in 3D mode.

meta.name: Mysterious Mountain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.24 KB

"„Mysterious Mountain“ takes you deep into a mysterious cave system where, as a nimble adventurer, you must collect scattered items across multiple levels. You move along platforms, leap over gaps, and use ladders to switch between areas. But beware – dangerous creatures lurk everywhere and try to block your path. Only those who dodge cleverly, act swiftly, and plan wisely can fight their way to the top of the mysterious mountain."

meta.name: Mysterix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mysterix is an unusual Pac-Man clone that puts a fresh spin on the classic formula with its distinct visuals and modified maze layout. The goal is to collect all the dots while avoiding four monsters trying to stop you. Luckily, power pills temporarily turn them blue and vulnerable, allowing Mysterix to eat them until they return to their normal form. While clearly inspired by the original, the game stands out with its unique design and built-in level editor that lets you create your own mazes.

meta.name: Mystery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mystery is a classic side-scrolling platformer in the spirit of Mario Bros. or Giana Sisters, where you embark on a rescue mission to save your two brothers, Charlie and Barney, who have been kidnapped by an old witch. As you journey through colorful scrolling levels, you must beware of dangerous creatures and tricky obstacles. Collect magical items and as many coins as possible to boost your life power and improve your chances. With its vibrant visuals and traditional gameplay, Mystery delivers the charm of early platformers – a fairy tale adventure with nostalgic flair.

meta.name: Mystery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mystery is a puzzle game where you must recreate a color pattern shown in a small grid on the right. The large field on the left is filled with colorful blocks that you can rearrange by shifting rows horizontally and vertically to match the target combination. Time is constantly ticking, so quick thinking and precise moves are essential. Beneath the dark visual style with its gargoyle motif lies a clever puzzle challenge against the clock.

meta.name: Mystery Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mystery Island challenges the player to find the hidden treasures of the island. The goal is to locate all the treasures and store them in the cave behind the waterfall. The player can carry up to five items at a time, requiring two trips to secure all ten treasures. Skill and a well-thought-out plan are essential to overcome the island's challenges successfully.

meta.name: Mystery Master : Felony
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

There is a crime wave in the town of Huxley! As a mystery master, you need to help the police solve 12 different crimes that have taken place. Throughout each of the cases you can interrogate suspects, search for clues at various locations, or use police station resources to analyze clues. To win you need to find out who the criminal is within the given time limit, as well as collect enough evidence to convict him and send him to jail.

p: Mystery Master - Murder by the Dozen (USA).D64
n: Mystery Master - Murder by the Dozen (USA)

meta.name: Mystery Master : Murder by the Dozen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mystery Master: Murder by the Dozen casts you as a police detective solving twelve murders in the city of Micropolis. You interview witnesses, collect evidence, and analyze lab reports to uncover the clues you need. Every action – especially traveling between locations – adds time to the game clock. One to four players can compete, racing to solve the mystery first and in the least amount of time. After the case is introduced, players take turns selecting an option, receiving a clue number, and looking it up in the manual. When a player believes they've solved the case, they present their theory and check the complete solution. If it's 100% correct, they win and a new case begins. If any part is wrong, they're out and the others continue investigating.

meta.name: The Mystery of Munroe Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Mystery of Munroe Manor, renowned detective Basil Byron is tasked with investigating the peculiar behavior of British adventurer Lord Munroe, who withdrew from public life two years ago after returning from Egypt. Upon his return, he avoided reporters, fled in a private carriage, and transported a large load of crates, chests, and artifacts. Rumors suggest he retreated to his estate in the west. Basil explores Castle Kreep to uncover clues about Munroe's whereabouts and his enigmatic behavior. Players issue commands such as "LOOK," "GET," or "GO" to explore rooms, collect objects, and examine exits, piecing together the mystery.

meta.name: Mystery of the Indus Valleys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.47 KB

You are a historian and a member of the London Archaeological Society, so you Sir James Wentworth have been sent to the Indus Valleys due to your knowledge of South American tribes, customs and Antiquities. Your quest is to find the fabled Scythian Tablet and the Alexandrite's Starstone and bring them back to London but no one has ever returned from the valleys since the area started being explored in the early 1900s.

p: Mystery of the Lost Sheep, The (USA).D64
n: Mystery of the Lost Sheep, The (USA)

meta.name: The Mystery of the Lost Sheep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Mystery of the Lost Sheep places you in the role of a farmer who wakes up one morning to find all his sheep missing. Your mission is to find and recover them all. In this text-based adventure, you explore various locations described on the screen and guide the farmer by entering commands to interact with the environment and uncover clues.

meta.name: The Mystery of the Nile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.97 KB

In this unofficial adaptation of the film "The Jewel of the Nile," three travelers have been captured by a dictatorial regime in an Arab country. They must flee the country immediately and the player is the only one who can help them.
In the first images, all three tourists need to be reunited from their different prison cells. Each character must also find their weapon of choice. Control between individual travelers can be switched at any time by entering 1, 2 or 3.
Once the three travelers are reunited, each screen acts as a puzzle of sorts: the player has a few seconds to strategically place each character before enemies appear. When they do this, two of the characters automatically react to the enemies. If all enemies on the screen are eliminated and the three characters survive, they advance to the next screen.

meta.name: Mystery Voyage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mystery Voyage is a three-part text adventure that casts you adrift in the middle of the sea, thrust into a dramatic survival scenario. After a storm sinks your ship, you find yourself on a raft in an endless ocean, surrounded by sharks and without a clear direction. Sun, hunger, thirst, and the fear of the unknown accompany your journey, where you make choices and navigate through mysterious events using simple text input. Each part draws you deeper into a tale of survival, discovery – and perhaps even redemption.

meta.name: Mystic Mansion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.36 KB

Mystic Mansion (aka Castle Hassle) lets you explore a sprawling haunted house filled with many rooms, where you take on the role of a small ghost searching for hidden treasures. Your objective is to collect as many valuables as possible while fending off enemies, solving puzzles and using room names as subtle clues. Alongside versatile combat options, you can transform into useful objects to overcome specific obstacles. Time pressure, limited lives and rising demands make careful planning essential – playful, challenging and driven by exploration and creativity.

meta.name: Mystical Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mystical Mission puts the player in the role of a H.E.R.O.-like character who must navigate through twelve rooms to collect all the gems. Equipped with a grappling hook, you swing from platform to platform and occasionally get access to a gun.

meta.name: Myth (Magnetic Scrolls)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Myth takes you into ancient Greece, a land of legends where gods watch silently as mortals and heroes clash. But this time the story shifts away from the usual victor's viewpoint. From the “Unwritten Histories” you witness the struggle of the Olympian gods fighting to hold their place as a new faith approaches. With a light touch you follow Poseidon through the Underworld, searching for the dark helmet of Hades and diving into the roots of classical mythology along the way.

meta.name: Myth : History in the Making
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En este juego de plataformas, eres un simple mortal que ha sido llamado por los dioses para derrotar a varias criaturas mitológicas que el malvado Dameron convocado de los infiernos. Los niveles de este juego tratan sobre diferentes mitologías, desde la antigua Grecia hasta los vikingos, pasando por Valhalla (donde te espera nada menos que Thor con un martillo). Además de saltar de plataforma en plataforma, también lucharás contra los enemigos y jefes que encuentres en tu camino con multitud de armas: al principio solo tendrás tus puños para defenderte, pero luego encontrarás armas más poderosas, como espadas. Hay muchos tipos diferentes de enemigos en cada nivel. Normalmente, los enemigos siguen apareciendo y viniendo hacia ti desde todos lados, sin importar cuántos mates, por lo que debes avanzar rápidamente para evitar que se te acumulen.

meta.name: Mühle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.49 KB

„Mühle“ is a digital version of the classic board game, where players take turns placing stones to form rows of three and remove opponent's pieces. Once all stones are placed, they can be moved along the lines to create more mills. The objective is to reduce the opponent to fewer than three pieces or block them from making a legal move.

meta.name: NaCl : Natriumchlorid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.56 KB

NaCl: Natriumchlorid is a challenging platform shooter where your first task is to locate a key to gain access to the next section. Using teleport lifts, you navigate through the levels and unlock a door that leads you into the so-called Transverat. But be careful – touching any sprite, mine, or deadly zone results in instant failure. Precision and awareness are essential for survival.

meta.name: Nam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In NAM you reenact various battles of the Vietnam War by choosing from six different scenarios. Each scenario lasts between 15 and 25 turns, with each turn divided into eleven distinct phases. After each move, victory points are calculated for both sides based on units destroyed. At the end of a scenario, the total number of victory points determines how decisive the battle outcome was.

meta.name: The Nam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.87 KB

The Nam is an action-packed shoot-'em-up where the player controls a helicopter and engages enemy forces. Set in a Vietnam War-inspired scenario, the player must fend off enemy aircraft, ground units, and missile attacks while navigating through hostile airspace. The game demands quick reflexes and precise dodging to survive enemy assaults and achieve the highest score.

meta.name: Namcap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.91 KB

In Namcap you experience a crazy twist on the classic Pac-Man, with the entire game flipped upside down and mirrored. You guide your character through a maze, collect dots, and avoid the ghosts, but the reversed perspective seriously challenges your orientation and reaction speed. The familiar gameplay remains, but the twisted view turns it into a completely new challenge.

p: Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle (USA) (Unl).T64
n: Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle (USA) (Unl)

meta.name: Nanako In Classic Japanese Monster Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 95.67 KB

Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle es un ingenioso puzzle-platformer en el que encarnas a la valiente Nanako, que recorre 25 habitaciones apiladas verticalmente para rescatar a su hermana Mya, desaparecida en una torre misteriosa. Cada sala es un puzle autosuficiente que exige colocar cajas con precisión, esquivar con astucia y calcular saltos al milímetro para alcanzar la salida superior. Los karakasa (paraguas fantasmas) actúan como plataformas, aunque pueden cobrar vida repentinamente. Incluso puedes soltar cajas en pleno salto para crear puentes flotantes. Tras completar cada sala, aparece una contraseña en kun-script estilizado para guardar el progreso.

meta.name: Napoleon at Waterloo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Napoleon at Waterloo you command Napoleon's army during the famous Battle of Waterloo. On a top-down map with abstract symbols, you issue movement orders that are executed with a delay. Battles start automatically when units meet, with morale and fatigue influencing the fighting. A match lasts eleven in-game hours, about thirty minutes real time, and victory is determined by the number of casualties inflicted.

meta.name: Napoleon in Russia : Borodino 1812
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Napoleon in Russia: Borodino 1812 you can reshape the course of the historic Battle of Borodino. You either take on the role of Napoleon or lead the Russian forces, with every decision affecting the outcome of the battle. Whether the French conquer Moscow or the Russians successfully defend their homeland and push Napoleon back is entirely in your strategic hands.

meta.name: NARC
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

NARC is an action game for one or two players where you must infiltrate the criminal Mr. Big Corporation. Across eight stages with over ten sectors like junkyard, subway, drug lab, and downtown, you collect safe cards to unlock exits. Using a map and your equipment, you face various enemies or make arrests, while carefully managing your limited ammunition and missiles. You are backed by a helicopter and a fast car, and picking up items like money, drugs, and extra weapons boosts your chances of survival.

meta.name: Narco Police
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Narco Police es un videojuego de acción y estrategia en tercera persona, desarrollado por Iron Byte y publicado por Dinamic Software en 1990; fue publicado para las plataformas Commodore Amiga, Sinclair ZX Spectrum, MSX, Atari ST, Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64, y posteriormente sacaron una versión para PC MS-DOS.

meta.name: Narnia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.72 KB

Narnia is the first video game based on C.S. Lewis' famous book series and combines classic action with card and dice games. In the first episode, you must touch flowers and beavers to collect heart points and bring frozen Narnia back to life while hostile dwarves and Edmund's attempt to reach the witch threaten your progress. In the second episode, you navigate through an icy maze, dodge deadly crystals, and aim to reach the lion Aslan. Doors lead to additional card adventures where dice games determine success or failure.

meta.name: The National
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.89 KB

The National is a horse racing management game where you act as a trainer aiming to win the Derby, the Grand National, and the Trainer of the Year title. You buy horses, train them for distance or track conditions, hire jockeys, place bets, and manage breeding for extra income. Before each race, you get details on prize money, race length, going, form, and odds. Betting options include win, place, and head-to-head picks. Races are shown from a top-down view with numbered horses moving vertically across the screen. After each race, you return to the main menu to plan your next big victory.
meta.genre: Deportes con animales / Carreras de caballos

meta.name: NATO Assault Course
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.62 KB

In NATO Assault Course, one or two players compete in an obstacle course as one of four characters - the Hitman, the Ninja, the Flame, and Tommo. To do this, they must accomplish certain tasks including jumping over brick walls, crawling through pipes, jumping over fire pits, crawl across a tightrope, and using their weapon to fire at targets. The winner is the first one over the finish line. The game includes a course designer that allows players to design their own courses, then compete in them.

meta.name: NATO Commander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In “NATO Commander,” you take control of Western European forces as the Warsaw Pact armies advance through Central Europe in a fictional Cold War scenario. Combat unfolds in accelerated real-time but can be paused to issue strategic commands. You coordinate units in offensive or defensive positions, monitor their morale, and assign air squadrons to tasks such as air superiority, ground support, or reconnaissance. Chemical and nuclear weapons are also at your disposal. The outcome of the game is determined by political and military losses, which can force one side to surrender.

meta.name: Nautilus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.31 KB

In Nautilus you play a diver whose goal is to collect all the keys in each level and escape.

meta.name: The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal is a detailed simulation of the naval battle during World War II. The player takes command of the US fleet group in the South Pacific and prepares for combat against the Japanese. On both strategic and tactical levels, the player controls the aircraft and ships of the aircraft carriers Enterprise, Lee, and Callaghan. All military details, such as speed, maneuverability, armor, and guns, have been realistically recreated. The objective is to defend the US airbase on Guadalcanal and destroy the Japanese fleet. The game begins on November 10th at 12:00 PM, with time progressing with each move. The player can issue orders for course, speed, attacks, and air patrols.

meta.name: Naval Battle of Tsushima
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Naval Battle of Tsushima simulates the decisive naval battle of the Russo-Japanese War, where the Japanese fleet crushed the Russian Baltic Fleet in the Strait of Tsushima on May 27, 1905. The game offers both a strategic mode with tactical combat and a combat-only mode. Each strategic turn represents one hour, while tactical turns represent five minutes. In two-player mode, you command the Japanese fleet and aim to destroy the Russians before they reach Vladivostok. In solo play, you control the Russian fleet and must guide your ships safely to Vladivostok. The game features 29 major warships and allows custom scenarios. Playtime ranges from 15 minutes to three hours, depending on the chosen mode.

meta.name: Navarone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.91 KB

Navarone is a single-screen shooter where you move a M.R.S.22 One-Man Submarine around the screen to blow up four Heavy guns at the top of the screen with torpedoes. You are part of an invading force but with the guns in the way, you have been tasked to remove them so your colleagues can complete the invasion.

meta.name: Navcom 6 : The Persian Gulf Defense
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Navcom 6: The Persian Gulf Defense puts you on the bridge of a naval cruiser and turns operations in the Persian Gulf into a tense mix of protection duty, threat hunting, and constant responsibility. Depending on the mission, you escort convoys, actively search for enemy forces, or face especially dangerous scenarios, always having to balance decisiveness with caution. That blend of military tension, tactical decision-making, and the danger of harming allied units in the heat of battle gives the game a dense and demanding appeal.

meta.name: Navigator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.07 KB

Navigator puts you in the cockpit of a spacepod deep beneath the planetary surface. Your mission: navigate through tight, treacherous cave systems without touching the walls even once. Every collision costs a life – and lives are few. The challenge increases with every passing moment, but so does your score, as long as you stay intact. Every second counts, every movement demands focus – can you make it through the tunnels?

meta.name: Navy Moves
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

NAVY MOVES es el arcade más alucinante de los últimos años. Tu habilidad se verá en tela de juicio, más de una vez, con este magnífico juego. Cualquier parecido con otro video-juego es pura coincidencia.

meta.name: Navy Seal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ponte en la piel de un agente SEAL de la Marina de los EE. UU. y embárcate en tres misiones con terroristas, rehenes y similares. La trama es bastante superficial, ya que cada misión es independiente. Cada misión tiene varias "partes" con diferentes mecánicas de juego, lo que convierte el juego en una especie de minijuegos. Nadar y navegar en submarino son algunas de tus tareas. Sin embargo, la jugabilidad predominante consiste en acción arcade de desplazamiento lateral con un toque realista, por lo que solo tienes una vida y no hay potenciadores disponibles durante las misiones.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Como muchos de los juegos de Ocean, este obtuvo la licencia de una película. Controlas una serie de combatientes de élite de EE. UU. con el objetivo de destruir misiles en poder de terroristas. Debes destruir los misiles colocando bombas junto a ellos y luego huyendo del lugar.
Por supuesto, conocerás a muchos más luchadores a lo largo del nivel y recogerás armas mejoradas a medida que avance el juego (ninguna de las cuales encaja con la película ni con la lógica de la vida real). La jugabilidad es principalmente de desplazamiento lateral, pero los niveles son más altos que la pantalla.

meta.name: Nba
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

NBA is a sports simulation that allows players to replay individual games or entire basketball seasons while tracking team statistics with an integrated stats tracker. Players can relive legendary teams from the 1960s to the 1980s, including 20 of the best teams from that era. The game features 5-on-5 matches in three modes: player vs. player, player vs. computer, or computer vs. computer. The stats tracker records steals, blocks, assists, rebounds, shooting percentages, free-throw percentages, and playing time. Strategic decisions, such as offensive and defensive tactics, can be made before the computer calculates the game progression. An optional expansion included team and player trading.

meta.name: The Necris-Dome
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.70 KB

The Necris-Dome casts you as a Special Forces operative smuggled aboard Earth's orbital graveyard in a casket. Once a peaceful resting place maintained by mandroids, the dome's Arch-mandroid has become self-aware and is constructing weapons to attack Earth. With humanity having long abandoned warfare, you are the last resort. Explore the hostile station, uncover clues, and stop the rogue intelligence before it's too late – in a future where even the dead aren't truly at rest.

meta.name: Necromancer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In “Necromancer,” you play as Illuminar, a wizard who wields the powers of light and nature to battle Tetragorn and his dark creatures. Using your Wisp weapon, you create an army, defend trees from Venom Spiders, and use the trees to overgrow spider larvae. Hatched Sith Spiders and Hammerfists threaten your mission but can be defeated with skill and strategy.

meta.name: The Nectar of the Gods
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.75 KB

You begin your adventure in a hotel room on the second floor of modern Athens, with a breathtaking view of the ruins of the Acropolis. Your mission is to find the Nectar of the Gods, a magical wine that grants immortality. On your journey, you will travel through various locations in Athens and possibly venture into the surrounding mountain paths and ancient sites. Along the way, you will solve puzzles, gather clues, and uncover secrets that bring you closer to your goal. But be on guard, as the search for the nectar may involve dangerous trials and unexpected encounters with mythical creatures or rival adventurers.

meta.name: Neg Slot Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.86 KB

Neg Slot Machine is a gambling simulator for the Commodore 64. In this game, players can try their luck on a virtual slot machine by placing coins and spinning the reels to achieve different symbol combinations. The game offers an authentic recreation of a classic slot machine and allows players to recreate the casino experience at home.

meta.name: Neighbours
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Neighbours puts you in the role of Scott Robinson racing through skewed courses in the iconic Ramsay Street universe. Your rivals include Mike on a skateboard, Charlene in a go-kart, Henry on a lawnmower, and Matt on a motorbike. Eight races take place in familiar locations like Ramsay Street and Lassiter's. Navigate gates, dodge emus, kangaroos, Mrs. Mangel and Bouncer – and pick up litter to restore your popularity. Top speed or maneuverability? It's your choice in the midst of the chaos.

meta.name: NEIL Android
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the year 2099, the spaceship EPIC makes another one of her journeys when she is suddenly caught in a plasma storm, forcing her off course into unmapped. Due to the damaged caused by the storm, the EPIC was forced to land on an uninhabited planet to make urgent repairs. While on the planet, the ship's crew had no idea that an unknown virus made its way onto the ship. Upon returning to the EPIC's home base of Altontron, the crew became aware that the ship had been infected by the alien life form.
They have sent an android called NEIL to get rid of the aliens. Each room of the ship contains nine green aliens that NEIL needs to destroy. As well as these aliens, there are also robots that come in the room from time to time. When shot, these robots leave behind cells, which give NEIL extra ammunition, allow him to replenish his air supply, or use a smart bomb which kills all aliens in the room. Finding a turbo lift allows NEIL to travel between floors.

meta.name: Nellan is Thirsty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.86 KB

Nellan is Thirsty sends you exploring Mr. Klinkoyn's nine-room house in search of four misplaced treasures. Meanwhile, Nellan the thirsty cat longs for a bowl of cool milk. Guided by a magic map and the help of friendly house dwellers, you enter text commands to complete your mission. But time is limited to just 72 scoots – a whimsical blend of treasure hunt, care, and childhood imagination.

meta.name: Nemesis : Escape From Euboea
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.59 KB

„Nemesis: Escape From Euboea“ takes place in a distant galaxy where the planet Silenus has been conquered by the hordes of Pterelaus. The surviving Silenians flee to the underground city of Euboea while an impenetrable force field encloses the planet. The elders approve a desperate plan: brave warriors must fight through the Dicte cave system to reach the Tegean plains. Their goal is the only passage through the force field, located above the Pterelaen stronghold in the Brauron mountains. If they succeed in escaping, the final assault on the mothership awaits. After a prayer to Nemesis, the perilous mission begins.

meta.name: Nemesis the Warlock
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.60 KB

El héroe de 2000 AD, Nemesis, debe derrotar al malvado Torquemada, Gran Maestre de Termight, y a las hordas de Terminadores que ha enviado. El juego se desarrolla en 30 niveles de pantalla fija, formados por redes de plataformas. Armado con una pistola (munición limitada) y una espada, debes eliminar una cantidad fija de Terminadores por nivel. Estos siguen patrones predecibles, lo que permite anticipar sus movimientos. Los Terminadores derribados permanecen en pantalla: si vas mal, Torquemada puede reanimarlos como zombis letales armados con guadañas.

meta.name: Neoclyps
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.79 KB

Neoclyps is a fast-paced side-scroller where you pilot a spaceship across a hostile alien landscape. Your goal is to destroy strategically placed radar bases in a futuristic city without crashing into buildings. With precise flying, accurate shooting, and the smart use of temporary shields gained by downing enemy ships, you'll battle your way from easy beginner levels to the brutal Ace stages beyond level 13. The higher the level, the nastier the target placements – and the more intense the thrill.

meta.name: Neptunes Daughters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Players control Neptune who is exploring the depths of the ocean in search of his daughters held captive by the sea snake. The game is split into two sections. The first section has the player guiding Neptune through a series of underwater caverns while destroying jellyfish. The player also must shrink down weeds that get in their way. The weeds grow back to their original size after a few seconds, so the player must swim past them in a limited amount of time.
The second section has the player shooting crabs while avoiding falling debris. By shooting crabs, the player can pick them up and take it to the structure nearby where the player will see the daughters trapped in an aquarium guarded by the snake. To set her free, the player is required to drop the crab onto the snake's tongue. If the player repeats this enough times, the daughter is set free and the game restarts with a higher difficulty level.

meta.name: Net Nut
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.97 KB

Net Nut is a grid capture game where you move along lines, coloring in blocks by surrounding them – much like Amidar or Cruisin' on Broadway. Timing and planning are key, as enemies pursue you while you aim to fill in as much of the grid as possible. More coverage means more points, but careless moves can cost you lives. Only those who master the grid can prove themselves as true Net Nuts.

meta.name: Nether
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nether was originally pitched as a Doom clone and gained attention in the Commodore community. However, the version released in Commodore Scene #31 turned out to be a basic exploration game with blocky graphics but an innovative lighting engine. Development continued, and by 2004 a new engine called Nether G-II emerged – smoother, but lacking sprites. After that, the project went silent until 2012, when it resurfaced as Aptitude, now a puzzle game seemingly inspired by Portal. A free three-level preview was released, but the full version never followed.

meta.name: Nether Earth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.50 KB

Nether Earth is a realtime strategy game that takes place in the distant future. A war is being waged between humans and ancient race of aliens called Insignian. On their mysterious planet there are four bases to capture - Kerberus, Tarras, Faretra and Diolkos. Use factories to build giant battle robots, similar to Mech units in other games. Commanding robots, capturing factories and defeating enemies in realtime are the player's primary goals.

meta.name: Netherworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Te encuentras atrapado en Netherworld, un mundo totalmente diferente al que conoces, un mundo de estructuras fantásticas y seres extraños y maravillosos. El único modo de volver al mundo real es conseguir la suficiente moneda local para pagar la salida, de no ser así, pasarás el resto de tu vida esquivando continuamente las burbujas de ácido, los dragones y otras criaturas semejantes.

meta.name: NetRacer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.10 KB

NetRacer puts you behind the wheel in a top-down futuristic racing game where you compete against others across the network – a rare multiplayer racer on the C64. Navigate tight tracks, dodge obstacles, and aim to outrun your opponents. The game supports network configuration via IP, gateway, and port forwarding, and even features IRC integration. Speed, damage, and remaining cars are tracked in real time – and every crash brings more tension.

meta.name: Neuromancer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basada en la novela ciberpunk de William Gibson. Ambientado en un futuro siniestro, encarnas a Case, un vaquero del ciberespacio que se encuentra arruinado en la ciudad de Chiba. Consigue un portátil y el software adecuado para piratear las bases de datos de la ciudad y recuperar tu acceso al ciberespacio. Compra y mejora implantes cerebrales para aumentar tus habilidades informáticas, y vende partes de tu cuerpo para comprar nueva tecnología. Una vez en el ciberespacio, tendrás que luchar contra las malvadas IA que custodian las bases de datos más importantes. Toda esta información encierra el extraño secreto de este mundo de sociedades endogámicas.

meta.name: Neuronics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Neuronics is a tile-matching puzzle game with similarities to Swap: The player is presented with a number of tiles with different symbols and colours. If two or more identical tiles are next to each other (diagonally does not count), they disappear. To make this happen, the player can swap two adjacent tiles. However, there is a time limit to consider and empty places left behind by removed tiles are not usable. The goal is to clear the whole field.

meta.name: Neutmare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.56 KB

Neutmare is an enhanced Pong variant playable in both single-player and two-player modes. Inspired by early video games, it combines classic tennis gameplay with a modern touch and atmospheric background music. In single-player mode, you play against a wall, aiming to reach a target score to advance levels. In two-player mode, the first to score 15 points wins.

meta.name: Neutral Corner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.26 KB

Neutral Corner puts you in the ring for a classic boxing bout – either against the computer-controlled champion or a second player. Fights follow tradition: touch gloves, head to your corner, and come out swinging when the bell rings. Smart blocking, well-timed punches, and stamina management are the keys to victory. Whether you send the champ to the mat or hit the canvas yourself depends entirely on your reflexes and grit.

meta.name: Neutral Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.85 KB

Neutral Zone takes you to the outer edge of the galaxy, where your mission is to defend Alpha IV from waves of alien attackers. Using a 360-degree rotating weapons pod, you must locate and destroy one enemy ship at a time before it damages your turret or Alpha IV. Each ship varies in speed, size, and firepower, and your radar guides you to the target. If your turret is hit, it rotates slowly until self-repair kicks in – giving enemies more time to strike. On higher levels, enemy missiles come faster and with deadly accuracy. Eliminate all ships to complete the mission and select a new game.

meta.name: Neutralizor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.56 KB

Neutralizor sends you into a dangerous mission as commander across three hostile planets, where radiation pods threaten to destroy an entire resource-rich region. With jetpack and laser, you fly over the planetary surfaces, search for the pods, and destroy them before the radiation reaches a critical level. At the same time, alien ships and creatures make the mission far more dangerous. That pressure between searching, attacking, and preventing planetary disaster gives the game its tense appeal.

meta.name: The Neverending Story
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Neverending Story you play as Atreyu, journeying through Fantasia in search of a savior from the real world. The land is threatened by the all-consuming Nothing and risks fading into oblivion. Based on the film, this text adventure features simple commands and uses images to display your location, companions, items, and current events as you navigate with a limited vocabulary to save Fantasia.

meta.name: The Neverending Story II : The Arcade Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Neverending Story II es un peculiar juego de plataformas basado en gran medida en la película. El concepto es simple: eres Bastian y la Emperatriz Infantil te invoca una vez más para salvar Fantasía, la Tierra de los Sueños.
El juego en sí es un juego de plataformas donde tienes que superar a gigantes (como en la película) o empujarlos por precipicios. Con cada nivel, recibirás un nuevo avance en la trama, generalmente unas cuantas páginas escritas en un "libro".

meta.name: New Intro Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.28 KB

New Intro Game was never meant to be a real title – just a placeholder that stuck when developer Proj got sick and missed the chance to rename it. Despite its odd name, it served a clever purpose: a fast-loading, 98-block mini-game meant to keep players entertained while their main game loaded slowly from cassette. A quirky accident turned into a practical pre-loader – and a fun bit of retro gaming history.

meta.name: New York City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In New York City, you guide Ed Hick through a chaotic day trip to the big city in his red Plymouth Continental, facing traffic confusion and bad luck. Harmless cars can be run over, but tow trucks will wreck your car. If it's damaged or runs out of gas, you must walk to the garage and pay $100. Run out of money and you'll need to brave the bank – dodging robbers – to get cash. Your goal is to visit two specific buildings, each with its own mini-game, all while managing parking meters and avoiding being towed. The entire adventure must be completed in a single day.

meta.name: New-Boulderdash 01
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

New-Boulderdash 01 introduces new levels in the style of “Boulder Dash,” expanding on the classic gameplay with additional challenges. Players must once again apply clever strategies to overcome obstacles, collect valuable diamonds, and avoid deadly hazards such as falling boulders or hostile creatures. The new challenges demand not only precise timing and foresight but also a keen sense of the optimal path to successfully complete the levels and achieve the highest possible score.

meta.name: Newcomer - Enhanced Version Rev.2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

A prison island - and Neil has only just arrived. He is a NEWCOMER. Why is he here? Confusion, blurry images... Jealousy! Now he remembers - his wife and the villain with whom she cheated on him - he killed them both. After that, he didn't care about anything, he was arrested and... Suddenly his thoughts stop and there's nothing left... And now he's lying here.
