meta.name: The Newzealand Story
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El objetivo es que Tiki supere el nivel sano y salvo, evitando el fuego enemigo y los pinchos, y finalmente salvando a uno de sus amigos kiwis. El armamento inicial consiste en un suministro infinito de flechas, pero las recogidas pueden convertirlas en bombas, láseres o bolas de fuego que rebotan. Una característica especial de este juego es la posibilidad de conducir diversos vehículos voladores, como globos, dirigibles y ovnis. Los vehículos pueden encontrarse en uso o robárseles a un enemigo. Los niveles que Tiki tiene que explorar son bastante extensos, lo que anima al jugador a explorar y navegar para encontrar la salida y los numerosos secretos ocultos en el laberinto. En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla hay un minimapa que muestra la ubicación de Tiki y la de su amigo Kiwi encarcelado, que también es la salida de cada etapa.

meta.name: NEXUS
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.45 KB

En Nexus, interpretas a un periodista del Clarion enviado a Colombia para rescatar a un colega secuestrado que se acercó demasiado a un barón de drogas. Al mismo tiempo, tiene la tarea de responder 32 preguntas clave para descubrir una gran exposición sobre el anillo de drogas. Su misión comienza en una playa fuera de la sede del cartel, donde un N.E.X.U.S. El agente gubernamental ofrece asistencia: aceptarla es opcional, pero necesitará ayuda más adelante. Rescatar a su amigo es la prioridad, pero si usted también persigue la primicia o simplemente escape depende de usted.

meta.name: Nibbly '92
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nibbly '92 is a snake game where you guide a constantly growing serpent through a maze. The goal is to eat all the dots on the screen without trapping yourself. Once a maze is cleared, a new one appears. After sixteen levels the mazes repeat, but with higher difficulty as the snake grows faster, eventually making the puzzles nearly impossible to solve.

meta.name: Nick Faldo Plays the Open
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.99 KB

Nick Faldo Plays the Open offers a detailed golf simulation with a split-screen display. The upper part of the screen is initially used for configuring controls and key assignments, then displays a course map that can be viewed in different scales to help line up shots. The lower part of the screen consists of seven windows that provide various information and actions. Two windows display wind speed and course data such as hole length, par, and stroke count. Another allows switching between a large and small map. Three windows are used to prepare the shot, while the last executes it.

meta.name: Nick Faldo's Championship Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

There are two courses, plus a hidden 9-hole course on Mars with reduced gravity, with match play and stroke play options against one of 8 varied-difficulty computer players. The control system is quite unusual, as the strength of the shot is chosen before you start the swing, but you have to click within a range to activate the shot, and this range is narrower if your shot is intended to be more powerful. An extra click can be made to add wrist snap, which increases the shot's power. The wind calculation is more complicated than most games of the era, and the rough is harder to play out of than usual, as you can't make slight stance adjustments easily.

meta.name: Nick Nack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nick Nack is a fast-paced shooting gallery where you have just 30 seconds to shoot as many flying nick-nacks as possible. The challenge increases with each level – the higher you go, the more of the flying objects start shooting back. Speed, accuracy, and reflexes determine your success or failure.

meta.name: Nightbreed : The Action Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nightbreed: The Action Game te sumerge en las profundidades de Midian como Boone, luchando a través de catacumbas, monstruos y fanáticos. Poco a poco reúnes las tres llaves, te enfrentas a MASK y recibes el don de Baphomet, que te permite transformarte brevemente en Cabal —lo bastante poderoso para resistir incluso a los Berserkers—. Ya en la superficie, liberas al pueblo de Midian, solo para descubrir que MASK ha secuestrado a Lori. Entonces desciendes de nuevo, lo enfrentas en una batalla final y te abres paso de vuelta a la superficie, donde por fin se produce el ansiado reencuentro.

meta.name: Night Driver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.10 KB

Night Driver is a fast-paced night racing game where your goal is to score as many points as possible within 90 seconds by passing checkpoints. Crashing into road edges, obstacles, or oncoming cars will cost you time and speed. Choose from four tracks – beginner, pro, expert, or random, with the latter changing every time and resisting memorization. Game options include infinite time and honking alerts for incoming cars.

meta.name: Night Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are a Night Fighter whose mission is to encounter and destroy as many of Earth's alien attackers as possible. The aliens get faster and more sinister at the higher levels, so be on your guard at all times! A vertically scrolling shooter where you can shoot forward or to the sides.

meta.name: Night Mission Pinball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Night Mission Pinball" is a pinball simulation that allows players to adjust various physical parameters to customize their gameplay. These include the number of balls, ball speed, table incline, and bumper kick strength. The game can be controlled using either a keyboard or a joystick.

meta.name: Night of the Walking Dead
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.20 KB

In Night of the Walking Dead you are the heir to the Musgrave millions, but to claim your inheritance you must retrieve Aunt Bedilia's locket, buried with her twelve years ago. A taxi drops you off at a cemetery under a full moon, in a small Louisiana town, right outside a modern morgue. To succeed, you must find her grave, recover the locket, and return it safely – but what lies beneath the ground this night is not as dead as it should be.

meta.name: Night Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.91 KB

Night Racer puts you in a dangerous night-time race of the Intercontinental Rally Championship. Each course winds through dark pine forests, and your car is rigged with a timed explosive that can only be defused at official checkpoints. You must avoid green opponent cars and overtake the yellow race leader – but if time runs out, you explode or are out of the game.

meta.name: Night Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.96 KB

En la Segunda Guerra Mundial, el acorazado Bismarck ha dominado hasta ahora. Armado con torpedos y una ametralladora, ¿podrás destruir el Bismarck e inclinar la balanza de la Segunda Guerra Mundial a favor de los Aliados? Descúbrelo en este juego de simulación de vuelo y estrategia.
La forma de llevar a cabo esta tarea depende en gran medida de usted. Tendrás que manejar los instrumentos del avión, despegar y planificar las zonas donde patrullarás en busca del Bismarck. Hay cuatro paneles de instrumentos separados para controlar las funciones de mecánico, navegante y artillero, así como los controles principales de vuelo. Se mantienen estadísticas sobre la proporción de la flota enemiga que destruyes.

meta.name: Nightshade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.00 KB

Un valle pacífico y acogedor se ha vuelto malvado y hostil. Además, muchas personas han desaparecido. Tu objetivo es averiguar qué ocurre en el valle, pero ¿podrás volver con vida? Tienes que tener cuidado con las criaturas con las que te cruces y destruir a los cuatro supermonstruos.

meta.name: Night Shift
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Night Shift es un extraño juego de plataformas y puzles.
Una exitosa empresa de juguetes busca un empleado enérgico para manejar una máquina poco convencional. Te esperan generosas recompensas... ¡si aceptas el reto!
Domina a la BESTIA para producir figuras de acción de Star Wars, Indiana Jones y tus juegos favoritos de LucasArts. Tienes que alcanzar tu cuota cada noche para conseguir un aumento, y tu cuota irá en aumento. Tendrás que abrirte camino desde la cadena de montaje hasta la mansión de la colina, esquivando desagradables abogados y plagas peludas. Si fracasas, ¡te despedirán!
El juego se divide en 6 tipos de equipo diferentes, cada uno con sus propias misiones (suministrar energía, utilizar una llave inglesa para apretar tornillos, etc.).

meta.name: Nightdawn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Nightdawn, the player takes the role of an engineer who has to prove that his remote-controlled tank is better than the previous model. To do so, he needs to master a series of top-down mazes. The goal of each level is to find the exit, but it is secured with locked doors and energy barriers. Navigating the maze and finding the means to overcome the doors (finding keys) and barriers (finding switches) is the main challenge of the game, but there are also mines, turrets and patrolling robots. During the course of a level there are optional and needed upgrades to find, e.g. a cannon (initially the tank can't shoot), a mine detector, extra energy or a radar.

meta.name: Nightmare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nightmare begins in your bedroom, where you are horrified to find the room completely tidy. Your task is to locate the missing trash bag and return it to where it belongs.

meta.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en la película Pesadilla en Elm Street, es un juego de acción en el que eliges uno de los cinco personajes e intentas liberar a tus amigos de las garras del malvado Freddy Krueger.
Tu personaje tiene dos medidores: uno de "alma" y otro de "poder". El "alma" es tu salud y si se agota mueres. El "poder" te permite usar tu ataque especial, diferente para cada personaje. Te encontrarás con un montón de monstruos a los que puedes intentar derrotar con armas o con tu ataque especial.
Empiezas en las calles de la ciudad, donde tienes que encontrar la casa de Freddy mientras le evitas. Una vez dentro puedes explorar los  pisos de la casa. Tienes que encontrar a tus amigos antes de que Freddy los mate; el juego te muestra en qué nivel está cada uno de tus amigos y cuánta alma le queda.
En la casa encontrarás muchos objetos que puedes coger y usar. Algunos objetos te curan, otros son armas y otros tienen otros usos.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.60 KB

Nightmare Park takes you through a creepy park where you must navigate from the entrance at the top of the screen to the exit at the bottom. Along the way, you encounter random mini-games, such as dodging rampaging rhinos, guessing a gorilla's name, or escaping deadly laser beams. Successfully overcoming these challenges allows you to continue your journey, but failure means the adventure is over.

meta.name: Nightwing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.13 KB

In Nightwing you're transported from the distant past into a far future, waking inside a vast dome built by your descendants after Earth was ravaged by war and pollution. Humanity once took shelter there before departing the planet. Now Earth has healed, but barbaric Animen roam the lands outside. Your mission is to uncover the dome's secrets and lead mankind back to reclaim their home. The game blends text input with location images, showing exits and player commands clearly in a split-screen layout.

meta.name: Nim
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.42 KB

A BrainLogic puzzle released as a game in the Cassette 50 collection. Nim is a mathematical strategy game in which two players take turns removing objects from different piles or heaps. Each round, a player must remove at least one item and can remove any number of items as long as they all come from the same pile or pile. Depending on the version played, the goal of the game is to either avoid the last object or take the last object.

meta.name: Nine Princes in Amber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nine Princes in Amber casts you as Corwin, one of nine royal siblings vying for the throne of Amber – the one true world from which all others are but shadows. But you awaken drugged, disoriented, and with no memory, armed only with the address of your scheming sister. From there, you journey through shifting dimensions, tangled politics, and perilous alliances. Based on Roger Zelazny's novels, this interactive fiction focuses on dialogue, choices, and manipulating those around you. With 40 possible endings, every encounter carries weight – your fate shaped entirely by your decisions.

meta.name: Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.44 KB

In Ninja you take on the role of a silent warrior fighting through a series of side-scrolling stages. Armed with a dagger and shuriken, you confront enemies that block your path and can defeat them both in close combat and from a distance. Along the way you collect scattered idols that restore your strength and increase your score. Once all idols have been gathered, your mission is complete and the game is won.

meta.name: Ninja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.62 KB

In Ninja, you embark on a perilous adventure filled with puzzles and danger. Centuries ago, the Grey Ninja stole a sacred statue from the rival Kubuto Clan and hid it in the Temple of Sharloon. Many have failed to retrieve it – now it's your turn. Your only clue is an ancient poem from the 5th century. Entering the dark Dragon Head Forest, deep in enemy territory, you realize: only with skill, courage, and cunning will you survive this mission.

meta.name: Ninja Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.23 KB

En Ninja Commando, encarnas a un ninja que avanza por niveles de scroll lateral, saltando huecos, esquivando obstáculos y combatiendo a ninjas enemigos. Las puertas generan continuamente rivales, aunque nunca hay más de cuatro simultáneos. Al principio solo puedes atacar saltando sobre ellos, pero al derrotar tres seguidos desbloqueas armas a distancia: shurikens, bombas, lanzallamas o pistola. Además de ninjas, te enfrentas a obstáculos indestructibles y enemigos como gólems, gusanos y aves.

meta.name: Ninja Hamster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

After a long journey over the seas, Ninja Hamster has come home to find his village being terrorised by a gang lead by Sinister Rat and The Lizard of Death. In this beat-em-up you must fight six members of the gang as well as the two leaders, one by one to save your village. The game is viewed from the side with the whole level shown on the screen. With a joystick or keyboard you use the fire button and a direction of the joystick/keyboard to pull off various kicks to hurt your opponent. Each fighter has a energy bar and an apple and when either is hit then their bar decreases but the bar will keep increasing when not hit. Once the bar is empty then the losing fighter is knocked down and part of his apple is removed. The winner of the fight is the fighter who removes the whole of his opponents apple. If you win then you move on to the next fighter. There is a two player option where the two players fight each other but both have two apples.

meta.name: Ninja Massacre
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.31 KB

Ninja Massacre es un clon de Gauntlet para 1 o 2 jugadores. Como ninja, debes recorrer un laberinto para recolectar tesoros y mejoras mientras eliminas a todos los enemigos. El juego cuenta con 50 niveles que pueden completarse con un sistema de contraseñas, evitando así reiniciar desde el primer nivel. En el modo para dos jugadores, ambos juegan simultáneamente. La perspectiva del juego es desde arriba, pero los ninjas y los enemigos se muestran de lado. Solo se muestra una pequeña parte del laberinto a la vez, desplazándose a medida que te mueves. El joystick permite controlar al ninja, mientras que el botón de disparo lanza estrellas ninja. También es posible jugar con el teclado.

meta.name: Ninja Master
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.28 KB

Ninja Master combina cuatro pequeños juegos secundarios en uno.
Eres un aprendiz de ninja. Quieres impresionar a tus compañeros y convertirte en un auténtico ninja. Es la hora de los juegos anuales, y tienes que competir y triunfar en ellos para lograr tu objetivo. Los juegos constan de cuatro eventos:
Evento 1: el evento de la flecha
Evento 2: Romper un bloque de madera
Evento 3: La prueba de la estrella Shuriken
Evento 4: La prueba del dardo
En todas las pruebas, hay una puntuación de clasificación y tienes tres intentos para superarla. Si lo consigues, pasas a la siguiente ronda. Si fallas, vuelves al principio.

meta.name: Ninja Rabbits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The protagonist has a carrot as a life bar. As he takes damage, his carrot bar gets eaten. When his health bar is empty, he falls to the grounds and loses a life. He starts the game with 3 lives. He can go only to the right but sometimes down into sewers. He can use either his hands, feet, or stick to attack. Enemies include flying dragons, street thugs, other ninja, bears, frogs, and other anthropomorphic animals, one of the enemies resembles Raphael from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, in the second level of the game, one of the enemies resembles Splinter.

meta.name: Ninja Scooter Simulation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.84 KB

Ninja Scooter Simulation es un trepidante juego de scroll lateral al estilo de Metrocross, donde recorres circuitos urbanos en scooter con un ajustado límite de tiempo. Debes superar barreras, terreno irregular y rampas; desde el nivel 3, otros conductores aparecen como obstáculos. Son clave las maniobras rápidas y los saltos bien sincronizados con aterrizajes precisos para evitar caídas. Las cinco posiciones en pantalla presentan distintas combinaciones de caminos libres, peligros y bonificaciones: el pensamiento ágil y los reflejos rápidos te darán ventajas de tiempo y mejoras de velocidad.

meta.name: Ninja Spirit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tú eres el espíritu del lobo balnco "TSUKIKAGE" y has tomado la forma de un guerrero Ninja para luchar contra el Maligno.
Lucha con espadachines Ninja, Samurais, Ninjas Gigantes, místicos Hombres-Cometa, lobos y mosqueteros antes de llegar a la confrontación final con el malvado Warlock.
Viaja a través de las peligrosas pasarelas, pantanos y puentes colgantes, y trepa por las escarpadas rocas evitando el gas venenoso. Abrete camino por las traicioneras cavernas, pero ten cuidado con las partes más bajas del techo y con los cantos, que te pincharán a las paredes.
Elimina a los Ninjas que dejan una "bola de espíritu" en su lugar. Recógelas para tener espíritus extras, que te seguirán en cada movimiento y ataque que realices, darán más potencia a tus armas y proporcionarán armas extra, como la mortífera "cuerda de fuego".

meta.name: The Ninja Strikes Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.25 KB

In The Ninja Strikes Back, you battle waves of ninjas and spiders, collecting weapons, potions, and treasures along the way while dodging enemy fire. With each level, the intensity grows, and only those who shoot accurately, move quickly, and position themselves wisely will survive. A fast-paced, no-nonsense shooter with classic arcade appeal.

meta.name: The Ninja Warriors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Beat-em-up de desplazamiento lateral para dos jugadores, adaptado del juego de monedas Taito, que presentaba tres monitores uno junto al otro. La versión para Amiga se desarrolló en formato buzón para mostrar la mayor cantidad posible de gráficos de fondo de pantalla ancha. Los jugadores controlaban robots Ninja, que luchaban por los niveles usando Shuriken y cuchillos. A medida que los Ninjas recibían daño, su atuendo clásico se desgarraba para revelar extremidades, torso o cabeza robóticas. Cuando el daño alcanzaba un nivel crítico, el robot Ninja explotaba, dispersando partes mecánicas de su cuerpo. Al igual que en SWIV, el título posterior de The Sales Curve, The Ninja Warriors utilizó el sistema de carga dinámico de la compañía para cargar los sprites, sonido y gráficos de fondo desde el disco sobre la marcha.

meta.name: Niobia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.99 KB

Niobia is a horizontally scrolling space shooter where you play as the Federation's top pilot sent to stop a new alien invasion threatening the solar system. Armed with photonic lasers, you face relentless waves of enemies, dodge obstacles, and blast your way through hostile forces. Fast reflexes, constant firing, and pure endurance are essential if you want to halt the alien advance. Only those who hit everything and avoid contact can triumph in the end.

meta.name: The Nite-Express
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.65 KB

The Nite-Express is a game where the goal is to avoid obstacles or enemies. The objective is to survive in each level while dodging all hazards as you move forward. The game is controlled using a joystick, offering a classic challenge for retro gaming enthusiasts.

meta.name: NO : Never Outside!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

NO: Never Outside! is a game set in a dark world where "it" exists, but is not human, and being outside is deadly. The game features 110 locations, animated graphics, and over 35 objects that can be investigated. It is an icon-based adventure controlled with pointers and dropdown menus, and includes several integrated arcade games. The player encounters various interactive characters that drive the storyline forward.

meta.name: No Deeper Meaning
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

No Deeper Meaning challenges the player to arrange tiles by cleverly swapping and rotating them so that matching pairs are formed without putting other tiles in an unsolvable position. Every move needs to be carefully considered, as every decision can affect the entire playing field. The game combines tactical thinking with forward-looking planning and keeps the player on their toes with ever new challenges.

meta.name: No Limit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

No Limit is a top-down racing game where players choose from various drivers and cars to compete in a championship. Races take place from an overhead perspective, requiring skill and precise handling to navigate challenging tracks. In addition to achieving fast lap times, players must avoid vehicle damage, as collisions with opponents or obstacles affect performance. The choice of driver impacts vehicle attributes such as braking and acceleration. Those who master strategy and driving techniques can claim victory in the championship.

meta.name: No Mercy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

No Mercy is an arcade bitmapped "rail-shooter", where you basically hold the gun and shoot just about everything that moves, while conserving your ammo and grenades. Shoot ammo/grenades and healing items on the screen to "pick them up". Your primary machine gun can kill everything if you hit it enough times, but you can also use the grenade launcher for really deadly targets like helicopters or armored cars. You can collect a machine gun which will allow you to shoot faster for a few seconds.

meta.name: Nobby the Aardvark
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nobby the Aardvark is on the hunt for Antopia after an ant ready to be lunch told him about this wondrous place. So begins Nobby's search over eight levels for ant heaven. 
Nobby the Aardvark is a mixture of game styles that include platform, mulit-scrolling, and top down maze levels. Vehicles included are a hot air balloon and a submarine. The joystick is used to control Nobby and the fire button is used to fire objects. If Nobby runs out of ants to fire then he can top up at an anthill.

meta.name: Nobby the Aardvark
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nobby the Aardvark is on the hunt for Antopia after an ant ready to be lunch told him about this wondrous place. So begins Nobby's search over eight levels for ant heaven. 
Nobby the Aardvark is a mixture of game styles that include platform, mulit-scrolling, and top down maze levels. Vehicles included are a hot air balloon and a submarine. The joystick is used to control Nobby and the fire button is used to fire objects. If Nobby runs out of ants to fire then he can top up at an anthill.

meta.name: Nocturno
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.42 KB

Nocturno is a puzzle solving game, featuring 99 levels. Each level requires reaching the end spot by jumping on proper tiles before the time runs out. There are several types of tiles, differing in the way and direction of the ball's rebound. Jumping off from the tile causes immediate disappearance of it. Falling from a tile means a loss of life.

meta.name: Nodes of Yesod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 71.02 KB

In Nodes of Yesod, you play as Charlie, an I.C.U.P.S. agent sent to the moon to stop a mysterious signal coming from a strange monolith. Exploring surface and cavern areas, you use a mole device to attack certain enemies and a burrowing tool to dig through walls. Your goal is to find eight keys to access the monolith – but beware the red spaceman who steals your progress on contact. Only smart navigation and tool usage will let you solve the mystery.

meta.name: Maze of Nogard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.06 KB

Nogard is a text-based fantasy adventure where the player, as a Nogard warrior, must deliver six items to the king, who is hiding in his storeroom under a bed during a war. Armed with only the official Nogard Warrior Battlepack – a plastic bag, a newspaper, and a pair of clean underwear – the player embarks on a humorous and challenging mission. Later, simple graphics were added, and the game was re-released as “Maze of Nogard.”

meta.name: N.O.M.A.D
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.85 KB

Cyrus T. Gross has built the TALOS asteroid and directed it towards earth. Only the Nemesis Organisation's Mobile Attack Droid 471 can save humanity now. 
In N.O.M.A.D., players take control of the Mobile Attack Droid 471 as it ventures through the city, in this top-view shooter. Players begin with four lives. The Droid moves with considerable inertia (although some rooms disable this), and control involves using left and right to rotate it, pushing forward to provide thrust in the direction it is facing, and pushing backwards to reverse. 
The early part of the route is linear, but later on there are junctions to plan around. Moving enemies, spawning points and wall-mounted guns are the main threats. There are many switches along the walls, which open the sealed doors located throughout the levels, although a switch doesn't automatically operate on the nearest door. The game features regular checkpoints, which will restore the droid to that point after the lose a life. Points are awarded constantly for survival, and for shooting the enemies and other targets.

meta.name: Nomad : The Space Pirate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.30 KB

In Nomad: The Space Pirate, players take on the role of Nomad, a space pirate scavenging precious metals from the farthest corners of the galaxy. However, the more ores you collect, the more relentless the pursuers become, eager to seize your valuable cargo. Players must fend off enemy attacks and navigate dangerous obstacles while attempting to escape with their loot. Surviving in the harshness of space is the ultimate challenge.

meta.name: The Nomad of Time
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.22 KB

In The Nomad of Time, you play British officer Oswald Bastable, commanding the airship H.M.S. Shards through a futuristic steampunk world. Your mission is to navigate between temporal ports, explore diverse locations, and complete the journey within 60 in-game days before supplies run out. You control the airship via function keys and interact on the ground using a text parser. Time management, exploration, and smart decisions are the key to mastering this real-time text adventure.

meta.name: Nonterraqueous
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.02 KB

Nonterraqueous puts you in control of a seeker drone on a deadly planet ruled by a master computer. Your mission: find and destroy the machine. Armed with lasers and bombs, you navigate the maze, but can change form at swap stations – losing weapons but gaining immunity to acid. Psyche stations recharge your mental energy, but overloading means instant death. One wrong move, and it's game over.

Nord y Bert no pudieron hacer Head or Tail of It es un juego de aventura de texto que gira en torno a juegos de palabras y juegos de palabras. Las expresiones idiomáticas y los clichés se han convertido en objetos del mundo real en la ciudad de Punster, y el jugador tiene que resolverlos para ganar. Hay siete escenarios separados que se pueden jugar en cualquier orden, así como el último al que se puede acceder solo después de haber completado los siete. Estos escenarios son: • El extraño de las compras: los productos en una tienda de comestibles han sido reemplazados por homónimos sin sentido (como "alces de chocolate"), y el jugador debe revertirlos a su forma normal.
? Jugar Jacks: Equipado con un elemento llamado "Jack of All Traits", el jugador tiene que construir palabras que comiencen con "Jack" para resolver acertijos.
? Comprar la granja: las expresiones cliché deben usarse en su significado literal al explorar una granja.

meta.name: North & South
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Con los famosos héroes de comics de "LES TUNIQUES BLEUES" (Las Chaquetas Azules), creados por LAMBIL y diseñados por CAUVIN, revive con cierto realismo histórico y mucho humor la Guerra Civil americana.
Tu objetivo es destruir a todos los ejércitos enemigos y asegurar así la victoria de tu bando (Norte o Sur). Controlarás a tus ejércitos por todas las zonas de combate de la Guerra Civil. Puedes o no respetar la historia, eso depende de ti.

meta.name: North & South!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

North & South! is an unofficial homebrew title loosely inspired by the well-known Infogrames game. As commander of the North or South, you move armies across a strategic map, manage resources, and secure supply lines. Battles switch to a real-time combat view where you control units like artillery directly. The game blends tactical planning with action-packed skirmishes – nostalgic, challenging, and with its own unique charm.

meta.name: North Atlantic Convoy Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.01 KB

It is May 8, 1941 and you are Captain of the mighty German battleship Bismarck the single most powerful ship in the Atlantic. Hitler has given you the nearly impossible task of fighting through the British Home Fleet and sinking enough convoys to force Britain to surrender. Your level of victory will be determined by how many merchant ships and battleships you can sink. Your decisions will determine the fate of the Bismarck.

meta.name: Northeast Corridor

Across more than 300 miles of track, you must keep high-speed passenger trains on time, prevent slow freight trains from causing delays, and avoid traffic jams. Every switch, schedule, and decision matters – a real challenge for strategists with nerves of steel.

meta.name: NorthStar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.71 KB

NorthStar puts you on a deadly mission through a space station overrun by aliens. Armed with a lance, you fight your way from left to right, fend off enemies attacking from all sides, and use your weapon to climb ledges. Defeated foes release bubbles for points or stars for extra lives, but oxygen is limited and time is ticking. With just four lives, relentless enemies, and tight corridors, the pressure never lets up.

meta.name: Norway 1985 - When Superpowers Collide
meta.desc:

The game simulates NATO forces in Norway during the summer of 1985. The player may choose to play either the NATO or Russian forces, and can play in turns against another human component or against the computer.

meta.name: Nosferatu the Vampyre

Tu eres Jonathan Harker, un empleado inocente del agente Renfield. El Conde Drácula desea comprar una casa en tu lugar de origen, Wismar. Tu has sido enviado a su castillo para completar la venta, descubriendo su verdadera identidad...
Ahora debes actuar rápido para protegerte a ti mismo y a los habitantes de Wismar de su poder. Si Nosferatu se muda a la casa podría en poco tiempo tomar control de todo el pueblo y convertir a los inocentes habitantes en vampiros. Te dejaste las escrituras de la casa en la mesa del comedor, y han desaparecido. Dehes encontrarlas y escapar en cuanto puedas. Nosferatu es más peligroso que nunca durante la noche, cuando las puertas del castillo están cerradas.

Los movimientos se realizan introduciendo la fila y la columna donde quieres colocar tu símbolo (X u O). El objetivo es alinear tres símbolos. El juego combina reglas sencillas con profundidad estratégica y ofrece nuevos desafíos gracias a sus niveles de dificultad ajustables.

meta.name: Nova

Ciertos bloques bloquean el haz, mientras que otros son destruidos por él. Cada nivel ofrece un conjunto diferente de mosaicos y limita cuántos puede usar. La planificación cuidadosa y una buena comprensión del comportamiento del haz son esenciales para resolver los rompecabezas cada vez más complejos.

La nave también está equipada con un rayo de energía que puede absorber la energía de los tanques y utilizar esta energía para crear escudos temporales alrededor de las ciudades desprotegidas.Si las 4 ciudades son destruidas o la nave es alcanzada 10 veces en un turno, el juego termina.

meta.name: Nova Force

It seems that all is lost on the distant planet Deimos. The Rutilians have reached the interplanetary base where the access and defense codes are stored. However, a scientist from the Super Confederation has developed a new Nova Proton weapon: an experimental ship that is autonomously controlled, not relying on the computer systems. This ship could infiltrate the enemy's defense network, combat their cruisers and fighters, destroy the missile bases, and turn the tide. But this highly advanced ship requires an exceptionally skilled pilot. You have been chosen as a member of Odin to lead the Nova Force on this difficult mission to restore peace on Deimos and save humanity from a great catastrophe.

meta.name: Nova II
meta.desc:

Certain blocks block the beam, while others are destroyed by it. Each level offers a different set of tiles and limits how many you can use. Careful planning and a good grasp of beam behavior are essential to solving the increasingly complex puzzles.

La fuente de energía y energía de la Tierra es la fisión nuclear, obtenida de un mineral raro llamado Uranio 235 que se descubrió a principios del siglo XXI después de que el suministro de combustible fósil de la Tierra finalmente se agotara. El uranio 235 finalmente se agotó, pero se descubrieron enormes depósitos de mineral en las muchas lunas de Saturno y se negoció un acuerdo con el dictador llamado Rayol, el primero en suministrar a la Tierra este precioso mineral. Siglos después, Saturno tiene un nuevo Premier llamado Rayol IV o Rayol el Perverso y ha decidido que necesita un zoológico que contenga diferentes razas de los habitantes de la Tierra, por lo que ha exigido que la Tierra le dé 1000 de sus habitantes. La Tierra rechazó esta afirmación y, por lo tanto, Rayol ha impedido que el uranio 235 se entregue a la Tierra y las reservas en la Tierra se están agotando y el potencial de inanición masiva debe hacerse. En lugar de enviar una fuerza de masas para hacer la guerra a Rayol y al planeta Saturno, los líderes de la Tierra han decidido enviar a un hombre para participar en una incursión sorpresa. Has sido el hombre seleccionado para esta importante misión, y en tu nave cargada con nueve robots tienes que visitar todas las lunas de Saturno, transportar a un robot y recoger la mayor cantidad de uranio 235 que puedas.

meta.name: Nuclear War Games

Unfortunately, he has forgotten it—though he remembers a song he composed, which holds crucial clues to shutting down the system.

meta.name: Nucleus

You must first destroy their defensive lines before taking out the enemies themselves. If the aliens reach the surface, the mission is lost. Hits from enemy fire can be recovered from a few times, but direct contact with the ground means a permanent game over. Fight bravely and defend Earth!

meta.name: Nuke
meta.desc:

meta.name: Nukenin and the Ronin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.78 KB

Nukenin and the Ronin takes you to post-feudal Japan, where renegade samurai and ninjas cross your path. With precise shooting and quick evasive moves, you must eliminate enemies and position yourself wisely to withstand the steadily increasing dangers.

meta.name: Nukewar

En el siglo XX, usted y un país vecino desarrollan una fuerza de ataque nuclear. El único objetivo de su vecino es aniquilarle por completo. La destrucción nuclear continúa hasta que se agotan todas las armas o se negocia una tregua.

In the motivating context of bowling competition, children must solve decimal and fraction problems as the clock counts down. Answering a problem correctly in two seconds or less means a strike, so there's no time to spare! Children experience the pride of success while mastering some of the skills necessary for high school math. Children will: •Understand the relationship between fractions and decimals • Learn to calculate quickly and accurately • Improve problem solving skills • Willingly spend hours on math practice Features •Formats for one or two players • Built-in clock that promotes quick thinking • Interesting graphics • Easy to use game design

Twelve difficulty levels, different characters with varying speeds, and a self-test mode provide variety.

Oil slicks, rocks, and night driving add extra challenges before your final score is shown.

In Number Puzzler, you compete against the computer or another player to solve math problems across different game modes. In Number Builder, you're on a construction site and must quickly calculate the correct numbers before time runs out. Number Chaser combines quick reactions with number estimation – you control a race car and must stay in the correct number lane while avoiding obstacles.

meta.name: Number Nabber / Shape Grabber

A small monster roams the screen – if it touches you, you're sent back to the center. There are four levels of difficulty.

In the fourth game, Magic Square, a 3x3 grid must be completed so that all rows, columns, and diagonals add up to the given magic number.

El objetivo es alcanzar ciertos números meta, sumando, restando, multiplicando o dividiendo números al saltar sobre los signos matemáticos. Una vez que se alcanza un número meta, el contador se reinicia y comienza una nueva tarea. El juego puede jugarse en modo solitario, contra una IA, o con un segundo jugador, ya sea simultáneamente o alternándose.

After 20 turns, the final score is displayed in a special way before starting a new round.

Fail to care for the baby, and Angry Agnes, the furious mother, will appear—seeking revenge.

Snails, beetles, and butterflies move from right to left, either along the ground or in erratic flight patterns. Touching one costs you one of your three lives and forces you to restart the level. Before starting, you can choose the game speed (slow or fast) and your starting level.

As a fish, the player could "go exploring" or "play for points". The object was to decide which fish to eat, while trying to survive and avoid other enemies; such as otters, ospreys, and bait from fishermen. When simply exploring, the player could select from six different species of fish, such as Mackinaw Trout, Whitefish, or Rainbow Trout; however, when playing for points, the computer randomly assigned the type of fish that the player will play as. In addition, the titles for each of the types of fish and other creatures are removed when playing for points, forcing the player to rely on memory; also the game was timed. After every five moves, the player played as a different type of fish.

meta.name: Odinshrine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Odinshrine is a Viking-themed text adventure where you visit sacred altars, receive divine messages, and survive your journey by eating when hungry. Starting below deck on a ship, you explore shadowy places, face danger, and overcome challenges with guidance from the gods. Your ultimate goal is to rescue the captive Sif. Intuition, exploration, and timely prayers are key to success or failure.

meta.name: Odysseus : Trojan Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.85 KB

Odysseus: Trojan Warrior throws you into a fantastic rescue mission. An evil wizard has kidnapped a princess and forces her to use her magical powers to fortify five regions against intruders. As a mysterious rider on a flying horse, your task is to save her by blasting through waves of enemies. Contact with foes or their bullets costs you one of three lives, but power-ups scattered along the way provide valuable help. After clearing each region, you must navigate a perilous tunnel at high speed, dodging obstacles and walls before entering the next stage of your quest.

meta.name: Odyssey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.82 KB

Odyssey throws you into a journey of no return – through an uncharted, hostile land filled with deadly threats. Plague Pests swarm, lethal Robo Crabs guard the way, and a powerful alien fleet stands ready to strike. You are alone, armed only with your fast-firing laser and the courage to fight back. There is no turning back – survival depends entirely on victory. Each screen takes you deeper into this forbidden world, where endurance, quick reflexes, and precision shooting determine whether you succeed or perish.

meta.name: Odyssey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.84 KB

Odyssey is a single-screen platformer where you navigate multiple tiers filled with hazards. Enemies block your way as you leap, dodge, and search for the right path. Doors, platforms, and traps shape the playfield, while your task is to collect lamps without losing your lives. Sharp timing and quick reflexes are essential to overcoming the challenges and progressing from one screen to the next.

meta.name: Odyssey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Odyssey throws you into a journey of no return – through an uncharted, hostile land filled with deadly threats. Plague Pests swarm, lethal Robo Crabs guard the way, and a powerful alien fleet stands ready to strike. You are alone, armed only with your fast-firing laser and the courage to fight back. There is no turning back – survival depends entirely on victory. Each screen takes you deeper into this forbidden world, where endurance, quick reflexes, and precision shooting determine whether you succeed or perish.

meta.name: The Odyssey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Odyssey places you in the role of King Odysseus in the aftermath of the Trojan War. After ten long years of siege, your perilous journey home to Ithaca begins, where your wife Penelope and your son Telemachus await – though rumors suggest unrest in your kingdom. Along the way, you must secure food and water, maintain enough men to crew your ship, and face countless challenges. At least twenty men are required to sail, though you begin with forty. Using simple commands, you guide the narrative, explore locations, and command your crew. Your progress can be saved and resumed as you edge closer to reclaiming your throne and restoring peace to Ithaca.

meta.name: The Official Father Christmas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.63 KB

"The Official Father Christmas" takes place on Christmas Eve, with Santa rushing to deliver presents worldwide. First, the player enters their name, which later appears in a personal letter to Santa. The first level is a flip-screen collecting game where Santa gathers the scattered parts of his sleigh at home. If he collides with running elves, the item he is carrying is dropped and must be found again. Next, the player selects six gifts they want (computer, doll, book, etc.), which are listed in their letter to Santa. Santa then collects these presents as they fall from the top of the screen. Finally, the delivery phase begins, with Santa flying his sleigh over scrolling continents, dropping presents by parachute to homes indicated by arrows. However, clouds and airplanes can knock the presents off course.

meta.name: Ograton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.21 KB

Ograton es un arcade en el que debes guiar una bola rebotante por un laberinto para recoger tesoros y esquivar obstáculos. La bola oscila entre cables hasta que la sueltas; entonces rebota hasta tocar otro cable. Tiene un número limitado de «puntos de impacto», por lo que hay que calcular bien el momento para alcanzar tesoros y evitar cañones láser y peligrosas bolas negras «zombi». Al reunir los tesoros correctos, se abre la salida al siguiente laberinto.

meta.name: Ograton II - The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.37 KB

Ograton 2: The Revenge es un arcade en el que debes guiar una bola rebotante por un laberinto para recoger tesoros y esquivar obstáculos. La bola se desplaza de un lado a otro por unos cables hasta que la sueltas; entonces rebota por el laberinto hasta tocar otro cable. Tiene un número limitado de «puntos de impacto», por lo que debes calcular bien el momento para dirigirla hacia los tesoros y evitar cañones láser y peligrosas bolas negras «zombi». Al reunir los tesoros correctos, se abre una salida hacia el siguiente laberinto.

meta.name: Ogre
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ogre is a digital adaptation of Steve Jackson's board game, placing you in a turn-based strategic showdown. On a hex-based battlefield, one player commands an army of infantry, tanks, and howitzers, while the other controls the massive supertank known as the Ogre. The conventional forces must try to halt its advance, while the Ogre can crush ordinary units with ease. Every turn demands tactical skill, careful planning, and weighing risk against opportunity.

meta.name: Oh No!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oh No! es un shoot 'em up trepidante con scroll multidireccional. Ambientado en un futuro lejano, encarnas a un criador de bueyes que, a bordo de su nave Badjak, debe impedir que alienígenas se los roben. Cuentas con dos armas: un láser y un bumerán que dispara por la parte trasera. Si destruyes a uno de los progenitores de buey —que aparecen ocasionalmente—, obtienes un nuevo ejemplar. El juego tiene ocho mundos; para completar cada uno debes derrotar a nueve oleadas alienígenas. Pierdes cuando te roban todos los bueyes.

meta.name: Oil Barons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Oil Barons the goal is to become the wealthiest player by skillfully discovering and drilling for oil. You survey various regions – from icy polar areas to scorching deserts – for their oil potential, select the best drilling sites, and execute your strategy. Political decisions such as bans on drilling in protected areas can disrupt your plans. In addition to the classic mode, there are options like reality mode with more realistic costs and randomized oil fields, as well as customizable modes. The game resembles a board game with a large grid and pieces, while the computer handles bookkeeping and adds random elements.

meta.name: Oil Barons
meta.desc:

meta.name: Oil Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Oil Challenge" is an arcade-style collect-'em-up game. In this game, players take on the role of an oil prospector who uses a drilling rig to search the ground for oil wells. The goal is to collect as much oil as possible without encountering enemies that could destroy the rig. Similar to the popular game Oil's Well, players control their rig through underground tunnels and must both efficiently mine resources and skillfully avoid the dangers of enemies. Any contact with an enemy results in the loss of a life or the end of the game, so players must plan strategically and react quickly to secure the valuable oil wells.

meta.name: Oilmania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oilmania is a skill-based game centered around oil production. Players must act wisely to succeed while overcoming the challenges of the oil industry. Speed and precision are crucial to achieving the goal safely.

meta.name: Oil's Well
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Oil's Well you control a drilling arm that extends deep into the earth to extract as much oil as possible. As you reach further down, dangerous creatures lurk in the tunnels, and one touch of them on your drilling arm costs you a life. To survive, you must retract your arm quickly and plan your path carefully. The goal is to mine all the oil reserves and fill your pockets without being caught by the monsters.

meta.name: Oink!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.51 KB

In Oink! you take on the role of Uncle Pigg, editor of the comic of the same name, who desperately needs pages for the next issue. To gather them, you play three different mini-games, with your performance deciding how many pages you earn. Pete's Pimple is a Breakout-style game where you can also blast enemies with a laser cannon. Rubbishman is a horizontal shooter similar to Uridium, where you must clear blocks and obstacles ahead. Tom Thug plays like Gauntlet, a top-down shooter where you stun or kill enemies, collect extra lives or keys, and fight your way forward. Between stages, you can read the unlocked comic panels, adding a humorous touch to the action.

meta.name: Oisac
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.04 KB

In Oisac you control a crosshair across the screen and must shoot down the soldiers of the Oisac empire. Enemies appear in the center and move toward the edges – if they escape, part of your shield is depleted. Once the shield is gone, the game ends. To complete a level, you need to destroy twenty enemies. Ghost ships are especially dangerous: if they manage to escape, they instantly wipe out your entire shield.

meta.name: Old Bones Dice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.05 KB

Old Bones Dice is a gambling game based on three dice, similar to Crown & Anchor. You bet on a number you think will appear. If your number shows up on one die, you win double your stake. If it appears on two dice, you get triple, and if all three dice match your number, you receive four times your stake. Each roll determines whether you increase your winnings or lose, before placing a new bet and trying your luck again.

meta.name: Oldbones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.61 KB

Oldbones is a board game similar to checkers but with a twist: pieces are captured by moving onto them instead of jumping over. The computer always makes the first move, and you respond by entering the coordinates for your move, choosing a starting and destination square. The goal is to be the first player to capture six of the opponent's pieces. This creates a tactical duel where every move can change the outcome.

You write down clues in your quest to find King Olin of Myrrh, kidnapped by the evil sorcerer Vargor. Anara the wise woman will guide you along on your search.

n: Olli & Lissa - The Ghost of Shilmoore Castle (Europe)

meta.name: Olli & Lissa : The Ghost of Shilmoore Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.27 KB

Panic at Shilmore Castle! tells the story of Sir Humphrey, a ghost who lives in a castle with his friends Olli and Lisa. When the castle is bought by Eugine Portcullis III Jnr., who plans to tear it down and ship it to the USA, Sir Humphrey decides to drive Eugine away. However, the ghost has lost his ability to become invisible and can only regain it if Olli finds special ingredients. In this game, the player controls Olli, who must search for each ingredient and bring it back to Sir Humphrey within a time limit. Each screen is filled with spooky figures, snakes, bats, and dangerous pits. Olli cannot truly die, but if he touches an enemy, he is sent back to the start of the screen, wasting valuable time. Once he has collected all eight ingredients, Eugine Portcullis III Jnr. is finally driven away.

meta.name: Olli & Lissa III : The Candlelight Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.86 KB

In Olli & Lissa III: The Candlelight Adventure you play as Olli searching a spooky castle for stolen car parts. First, you need a magnifying glass to spot them, then a spanner to use them. With both in hand, you head to the basement to reassemble the car. Along the way, you can collect useful bonus items like keys, candlelight refills, extra lives, and phones. But beware – the haunted castle is filled with dangers.

meta.name: Ollie's Follies
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.93 KB

Ollie's Follies drops you into a hazardous robot-run factory with 24 screens packed with traps, platforms, and tricky mechanics. Each level has one deceptively simple goal – reach the opposite side. But teleporters, guard robots, intricate ledges, and later moving platforms and laser bolts turn every room into a challenge. Some doors require keys, and falling too far is just as deadly as touching a robot. A classic sci-fi platformer that demands precise timing and bold, confident jumps.

meta.name: Ollo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.04 KB

In this game, players navigate a spaceship and use its built-in laser to destroy enemy ships. Once enough enemies in a level are eliminated, players can progress to the next level, where the enemies are significantly stronger. If the player comes into contact with one of these ships, they lose a life. When all lives are lost, the game is over.

meta.name: Ollo II : The Final Conflict
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.22 KB

Ollo II: The Final Conflict puts you in control of a UFO armed with lasers and bombs. Use the lasers to blast enemy aircraft out of the sky and drop bombs to wipe out ground targets such as buildings and defenses. Your goal is to destroy as many structures as possible without losing a life. Once you've caused enough destruction, you move on to the next stage – but every hit brings you closer to defeat. When all lives are gone, the battle ends, and the fate of the world is sealed.

meta.name: Olympic Skier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Olympic Skier sends you onto the slopes to score as many points as possible across several winter sports challenges. Slalom, ski jumping, and downhill each demand a different approach, so you constantly have to adapt to new movements and risks. It is not only about finishing, but about the performance that is rated afterward. That mix of varied events, score chasing, and sporting competition gives the game its entertaining appeal.

meta.name: Omega : Neural Cybertank Design & Simulation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Omega: Neural Cybertank Design & Simulation puts you in the role of a cyber-tank engineer, not as a pilot, but as a programmer. With a limited budget, you select components and write AI scripts that define how your tanks behave, move, engage enemies, and communicate with allies. Using an in-game text editor, you create routines that determine success or failure in automated battles. Progress earns you higher clearance levels and expanded resources – victory lies not in reflexes, but in code.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Prepare for combat in this horizontally scrolling space shooter, where you fight against aliens attacking in constantly changing formations. You control a spaceship, tasked with destroying the invaders while avoiding enemy fire. The game features well-animated visuals with beautifully drawn sprites, as well as engaging sound effects and music to enhance the experience.

meta.name: Omega Race
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.55 KB

Omega Race puts you in the cockpit of a spaceship fighting against enemy droid ships. These leave behind mines that must be destroyed before they become a danger. The challenge peaks when the last ship of a wave attacks in a spiraling pattern. Your goal is to score as many points as possible and survive for as long as you can, as the game has no set ending. Mastery of movement is essential: your ship is controlled by rotation and thrust, and can only be slowed with reverse thrust – preventing you from firing at the same time. Hitting the screen edge causes a force wall to rebound you unpredictably, forcing you to quickly regain control to avoid crashing into enemy ships.

meta.name: Omega Race II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.40 KB

Omega Race II is an unreleased sequel that builds on the proven mechanics of the original. Once again you pilot a spaceship, controlled only by rotation and thrust, making movement highly challenging. Waves of enemy droid ships attack and leave behind mines that must be destroyed in time. The last unit of each wave is especially dangerous, moving in a spiral pattern. Hitting the edge of the screen bounces you unpredictably off a force wall, forcing you to quickly regain control. The objective is to score as many points as possible and survive through as many levels as you can – with no fixed ending.

meta.name: The Omega Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.08 KB

Fanatics have captured the building in which the destructive Doomsday device is stored, and have set it to explode. This gives you 25 minutes to reach the building and destroy it. Viewed from the cockpit of your vehicle, Omega Run is a 3D shoot 'em up cum flight simulator. Your cockpit dials include a timer, altimeter, damage report and a long-range scanner. Enemy mounted laser beams and anti-aircraft fire must be dodged, while re-fuelling is required mid-game The game can be customised in may ways to fine tune the exact difficulty.

meta.name: Omni-Play Basketball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Two distinct basketball games are offered in this package, with 3 skill levels and sets of players. One recreates the real game closely, offering a full league for 1 or 2 human players, which can be saved to disk. The other is faster-paced, with the Flow-Control feature for easier shooting. 
Shot time limit and match length can be varied, as can kit and court colours. Long range shots and slam-dunks are all available. The game features 9 years of historical statistics for teams and players.
