meta.name: On a Move
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

On a Move is a challenging logic game where you push colored blocks through a maze to touch and eliminate matching blocks. You must avoid obstacles and unmovable walls while planning your moves carefully. Once all blocks are removed, you progress to the next, more difficult stage. Special mechanics like bombs to destroy unpaired blocks and handling odd numbers of colored blocks increase the strategic depth. A password system unlocks a level editor – letting you create your own puzzles.

meta.name: On Court Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.67 KB

In On Court Tennis, the computer controls your player's movement, allowing you to focus entirely on precise shot placement. To win, you'll need well-aimed volleys, lobs, and drop shots. The result is a tactically rich game where clever shot selection is key. One or two player matches can be played over three or five sets, on asphalt, clay, or grass courts. The AI opponents are modeled after tennis legends like Jimmy Connors and Björn Borg and adapt to your playing style. Court layout and service rules are faithfully implemented.

meta.name: On Cue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.35 KB

On Cue es un juego que te permite jugar una partida de billar de bola 8 o snooker contra un amigo o el ordenador, con diferentes niveles de habilidad. El juego se ve desde arriba, con toda la mesa en pantalla. Las reglas de ambos juegos se siguen al pie de la letra, y el ganador en el snooker es el jugador que consigue más puntos, mientras que en el billar es el primero que emboca sus bolas y la bola negra.
Para meter la bola en ambos juegos, primero hay que colocar una cruz donde se quiere que vaya la bola blanca y, a continuación, pulsar el botón "fuego" para ajustar el efecto. Si vuelves a pulsar el botón de disparo, aparecerá una barra de potencia y, utilizando la izquierda o la derecha, podrás ajustar la fuerza con la que quieres golpear la bola blanca. Cuando estés satisfecho con la potencia, vuelve a pulsar el botón y el disparo se efectuará.

meta.name: On Field Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.55 KB

On-Field Football is a game based on the sport of American Football where you can play the computer or another player following the rules closely. Before you play a game you can select how many players or a demo game, how long for a game (5 or 15 mins), and how the players will play a game. The view of the pitch is a 3rd person perspective at a elevated angle with the action behind the offensive team. 
The game kicks off and once the player catching the ball is tackled then decisions need to be made. Using the joystick, you push it up, down, left or right to select a play and this needs to be selected within 30 seconds. Once both teams have selected then you can control either the quarter back if offensive or a defender if defensive. Once the quarterback has passed it the player with the ball is under your control. You are also able to punt the ball or kick the ball for the extra point or a field goal.

meta.name: On the Bench
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.76 KB

On the Bench puts you in charge of a football club from one of England's top four divisions, with the aim of winning leagues and cups across multiple seasons. You'll manage transfers, training, stadium upgrades, and finances while keeping track of squad stats and league tables. Matches are text-based, with key events shown during a live ticker. After each game, you review your weekly financials before moving on to the next match – success depends on smart planning, strategy, and the right player decisions.

meta.name: On the Farm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In On the Farm you control a sheep that has escaped from its pen and is running wild across different farm fields. Your goal is to eat all of Farmer Dave's crops to advance to the next level. As you move around the fields you must avoid colliding with animals, because three hits will end the game. Some animals can be jumped over to score points, but Farmer Dave and his workers cannot be jumped on without losing a life. You also have to watch the clock while avoiding magical mushrooms that can cause trouble if eaten.

meta.name: On the Farm : Part II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In On the Farm: Part II you no longer control the sheep but instead play as Shep, a loyal border collie. Your job is to herd a required number of sheep back into their pen before the time limit runs out. To guide them you must chase the sheep, bark at them and position yourself so they move in the right direction. If you are too slow, the sheep will wander away from the pen again. Wolves may also appear and must be driven away to protect the flock. Only by bringing enough sheep safely back to the pen can you complete the level and advance.

meta.name: On the Farm : Part III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In On the Farm: Part III you take control of a greedy seagull from St. Ives who wants to feast on Farmer Rich's crops. Unfortunately the sheep are after the same food, so your job is to stop them by dropping on them from above. During the game Shep the sheepdog may appear, and hitting him can grant you improved abilities. You can also target Madoone the mole to gain powerful special attacks. At the same time you must avoid Farmer Rich and his dangerous pet eagle Edgar, as touching them will cost you a life. Only by hitting enough sheep can you advance to the next level.

meta.name: On the Tiles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.97 KB

En On the Tiles, un gato callejero merodea por las callejuelas oscuras de la ciudad para demostrar que es el más duro del vecindario. Para hacerlo, recolecta huesos de pescado para acceder a nuevos territorios. El viaje es peligroso, con halcones, erizos, ranas y gatos rivales que representan amenazas, todas las cuales deben ser saltadas o escupidas. El contacto drena energía, que se puede reponer comiendo gorriones y ratones. Las pulgas infestan su pelaje, y tener más de diez costará una vida. La gente arroja objetos, y un perro guardián está listo para devorar cualquier gato que se acerque demasiado: el camino hacia el dominio felino está lleno de peligro.

meta.name: On-track Computer Model Car Racing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.43 KB

En On-Track Computer Model Car Racing, compites en circuitos detallados contra un oponente virtual o un amigo. Ya sea que superes a tu rival o te salgas de control en una curva, el juego captura el espíritu de las carreras clásicas de slot. Las pistas están claramente diseñadas, los controles son directos y cada vuelta cuenta. La precisión, el tiempo y el conocimiento del circuito determinan quién cruza la meta primero.

meta.name: One Arm Bandit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.54 KB

It is a fruit/slot machine. You can work out your need to feed coins without the expense or travel! High resolution graphics make this the ultimate video slot machine game. Just pull the handle and watch the fruit spin. The computer will keep track of your winnings. Good luck!

meta.name: One Bite Too Deep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.83 KB

In "One Bite Too Deep" you play Oscar, who is tasked with sending the resurrected Master and his minions, who are terrorizing the locals and sucking their blood, back to their resting place. The action takes place on a research station in an unknown land, high on a cliff. Oscar is equipped with a dagger and a shield with limited use to fight his way through the labyrinths of the cliff, courtyard and station. Minions lie in wait for him and can only be fended off briefly with a dagger or shield. Touches reduce Oscar's blood bar; if it is empty, the game ends. He has to find five objects in the station before he can defeat the Master.

meta.name: One Man and his Droid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Control a droid on the planet Andromadous trying to herd Ramboids (alien sheep) into a teleporter. First the droid has to travel through a chamber filled with constantly moving Ramboids. Then the Ramboids must be herded towards the teleport receptor in a particular order. As well as the droid's standard movement mode, it can also tunnel or dig through the caverns. In later levels, the cavern designs become more complex and moving blocks create further problems.

meta.name: One-on-One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 63.35 KB

One-on-One brings basketball legends like Julius Erving and Larry Bird straight to the virtual court and sets a new standard with smooth animation and detailed gameplay. From fall-away jumpers and steals to blocks and spin moves, each action feels like a real duel, complete with personal fouls and a 24-second shot clock. The highlight is a backboard-shattering dunk that summons a grumpy janitor to clean up the mess, muttering censored complaints. With customizable score goals and even instant replay, this game is both a competitive showdown and a humorous milestone in sports gaming.

meta.name: One-day Cricket
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

One-Day Cricket captures the pulse of international competition. Australia, New Zealand, England, and the West Indies battle for the coveted trophy as the stadium erupts under brilliant floodlights. The bowler charges in, hurling a blazing ball down the pitch – you swing at just the right moment, and the crowd explodes in cheers. Precision, timing, and nerves of steel are everything – do you have what it takes to keep the pace?

meta.name: Oo-Topos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oo-Topos turns an important cargo mission into a sudden struggle for survival on a hostile alien planet. After crash-landing, you have to escape captivity, recover your valuable cargo, and repair your ship well enough to leave. Through text commands, you explore strange rooms, examine clues, and solve the problems standing between you and freedom. This creates a classic science-fiction adventure that blends escape, repair work, and the search for a way home in an engaging way.

meta.name: Oops!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oops! is a tricky arcade puzzle game where you guide a Quadroid across 32 levels. On each screen you must collect eight gravity pods while navigating a maze of platforms. Nasty creatures roam the area – touching one or falling off costs you one of your three lives. Various platform types mix things up: some disappear, others switch on and off, while some send you in a set direction. To fight back you can drop bombs to destroy enemies and collect question marks for bonuses like extra lives, more time, or points. Teleporters move you to different screen areas, and after every two levels you enter a bonus stage with no enemies, where you race against time to grab as many extras as possible.

meta.name: Open Sesame
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 70.00 KB

Open Sesame blends word knowledge with playful tension as you help Ali Baba unlock the secret of the treasure cave. Every correctly spelled word opens the door a little wider and brings you closer to success, while mistakes trigger dangerous consequences as the hidden thieves strike back. With each attempt, the pressure increases, making accuracy and focus essential to reach the goal.
meta.developer: M.C. Harding, C.P. Beesley & M.K. Hobbs

meta.name: Opera House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Opera House tells the story of an aspiring opera singer dreaming of a chance to stand in the spotlight. After receiving an invitation to the famous Palace Theatre, home of the National Opera Company, the player finds the building deserted. Just when all seems lost, footsteps suddenly echo, and the adventure begins.

meta.name: Operation Sabotage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.57 KB

Operation Sabotage places you in a dark future where an interstellar war will decide the fate of humanity. As an elite agent, you infiltrate an alien base with the goal of destroying a powerful defense system from within. The entire world is presented through text, requiring careful observation, logical reasoning and precise interpretation of clues to locate objects, uncover paths and survive dangerous situations. Every command must be chosen wisely, as progress comes from patience, exploration and gradually uncovering the unknown environment.

meta.name: Operation Anoria
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.88 KB

Operation Anoria is a two-part arcade adventure that drops you into a tale of interstellar piracy gone wrong. In a futuristic setting, you collect and use items, battle enemy drones, and try to take control of a catastrophic situation. Energy, time, and resources are limited – only smart decisions and quick reflexes will see you through the mission.

meta.name: Operation Fireball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.11 KB

Operation Fireball is a horizontal scrolling shooter viewed from above at an elevated angle, with the screen scrolling constantly from left to right as you use various modes of transport to get to a base to blow up a submarine. Between each mode of transport is a small animated scene as you move from one to the next and the modes are car, speedboat, ski, motorbike and helicopter. You must shoot or avoid the enemy in various vehicles or on skis, as well as avoid obstacles like rocks, oil patches and trees. Helicopters fly overhead and drop bombs while missiles fly from the right to the left and can only be avoided. If you are hit by anything then you lose part of a shield gauge but when not being hit increases it and if it empties then it is game over.

meta.name: Operation Fox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.66 KB

Operation Fox is a lightgun-like shooter where you control the crosshair on the screen using a joystick or mouse on the Commodore 64. The gameplay revolves around aiming at and shooting targets as they appear on the screen, similar to Operation Wolf. You must complete military missions, facing various enemies and objectives, such as shooting enemy soldiers, destroying equipment, or rescuing hostages. However, you must avoid hitting friendly targets, as penalties will follow. The game features different enemy types, including soldiers, helicopters, and tanks, which require precise aiming. Obstacles like barriers increase the difficulty.

meta.name: Operation Hanoi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.87 KB

Lee Ho Fook and his forces has invaded Campuchia and forced the population to work as slaves in his Jade Mines. The mines are being plundered to sell to Middle East arms dealers who are supplying parts to a new super-tank disguised as oil refinery parts. You are the leader of a small force sent in to destroy the tank before Lee Ho Fook uses it to invade the surrounding areas.
Operation Hanoi is a one player game where the action is viewed as a 1st person perspective as the game scrolls to the right. Enemy soldiers and vehicles appear from the sides and top of the screen. You control crosshairs on the screen to aim and fire; grenades can also be thrown.
You only have so much ammo so shoot parachutes falling from the sky which carry extra ammo as well as 1st aid boxes to keep you alive. As well as your main playing area you can also see your score, ammo, lives, amount of enemy and a hits bar.

p: Operation Iceberg - The Battle for Okinawa (Europe).T64
n: Operation Iceberg - The Battle for Okinawa (Europe)

meta.name: Operation Iceberg : The Battle for Okinawa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.09 KB

Operation Iceberg: The Battle for Okinawa es un juego de estrategia basado en la histórica batalla de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, en la que las fuerzas estadounidenses capturaron la isla de Iwo Jima para asegurar bases aéreas y luchar contra Japón. Juegas como EE. UU., mientras la computadora controla a las fuerzas japonesas con cinco niveles de dificultad. Un mapa general de la isla muestra símbolos que representan el terreno, los campos minados, las unidades enemigas y tus propias fuerzas. Los jugadores dan órdenes a sus unidades por turnos, y los resultados se calculan posteriormente. El objetivo es derrotar a las fuerzas japonesas y obtener el control total de la isla.

meta.name: Operation Ironhawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.09 KB

Operation Ironhawk is a well-made combat game accompanied by music by Rob Hubbard. The player can kick enemies, shoot with a weapon or bazooka, or throw grenades. Aside from these actions, there doesn't seem to be much more to do than move back and forth between two floors. It serves as a nice demonstration of a game with potential.

meta.name: Operation Market Garden : Drive on Arnhem , September 1944
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

"Operation Market Garden" recreates the largest airborne operation of World War II, launched on September 17, 1944. As the Allied commander, you lead the U.S. 82nd and 101st Airborne Divisions, the British 1st Airborne Division, and the 30th Corps toward their strategic objectives. Points are earned by securing key supply points, while losses occur if enemy forces overrun your supply zones or German units hold cities. Victory is determined by your final score, with five success levels. The game can be played solo against the computer or with a second player and offers four difficulty levels along with advanced and beginner-friendly gameplay options.

meta.name: Operation Neptune
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Operation Neptune puts you in the role of special agent Robert "Rip" Steel, commanding a high-tech submarine against the sinister Yellow Shadow. Your mission: destroy enemy undersea mining bases while defending your own installations. In a hostile deep-sea environment, speed and strategy are essential. One mistake could cost you the mission – only smart tactics, precision, and quick thinking will lead to success.

meta.name: Operation Neptune
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Operation Neptune puts you in the role of special agent Robert "Rip" Steel, commanding a high-tech submarine against the sinister Yellow Shadow. Your mission: destroy enemy undersea mining bases while defending your own installations. In a hostile deep-sea environment, speed and strategy are essential. One mistake could cost you the mission – only smart tactics, precision, and quick thinking will lead to success.

meta.name: Operation Proboszcz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.24 KB

Operation Proboszcz is a first person shooter. The game takes place on a single screen location. The player's task is to track down and kill all the priests. A new priest appears every few seconds in a various window of the church. The player moves viewfinder to the right, left, up or down and performs shoot. The game offers two difficulty levels - for standard players and radical Catholics. The second one causes viewfinder to move in unpredictable ways, as if the player was drunk.

meta.name: Operation Swordfish
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.89 KB

Operation Swordfish is set in 1942 during World War II. The Allies are planning an invasion along the Mediterranean coast, supported by a large convoy of ships that are threatened by enemy vessels and aircraft. The player assumes the role of a submarine captain whose mission is to destroy as many enemy units as possible before the Allied fleet arrives or the submarine is destroyed. The game combines two modes: in Cannon Mode, the player shoots down aircraft attempting to bomb the submarine, while in Torpedo Mode, enemy ships can be targeted with torpedoes. Switching between the modes is crucial to effectively counter enemy attacks.

meta.name: Operation Terminal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Operation Terminal" puts the player in the role of an agent infiltrating a secret facility to secure classified documents. During the mission in the mysterious Antimatter Complex, the player must evade traps, strategically place bombs, and monitor equipment battery levels. Precise timing and quick decisions are essential to remain undetected and complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Operation Thunderbolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Operation Thunderbolt vuelves a encarnar al héroe de Operation Wolf, ahora acompañado de un compañero. Un avión secuestrado ha sido obligado a aterrizar en Kalubya, y los rehenes están escondidos en varias localizaciones. A lo largo de ocho misiones, lucharás contra fuerzas enemigas a pie, en jeep o en lancha. La munición y los cohetes son limitados, aunque caen cajas con suministros y los enemigos dejan objetos al ser abatidos. Busca equipo extra como chalecos antibalas o armas especiales. La precisión y los reflejos rápidos son clave para completar la misión y rescatar a los rehenes.

meta.name: Operation Thunderbolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Operation Thunderbolt vuelves a encarnar al héroe de Operation Wolf, ahora acompañado de un compañero. Un avión secuestrado ha sido obligado a aterrizar en Kalubya, y los rehenes están escondidos en varias localizaciones. A lo largo de ocho misiones, lucharás contra fuerzas enemigas a pie, en jeep o en lancha. La munición y los cohetes son limitados, aunque caen cajas con suministros y los enemigos dejan objetos al ser abatidos. Busca equipo extra como chalecos antibalas o armas especiales. La precisión y los reflejos rápidos son clave para completar la misión y rescatar a los rehenes.

meta.name: Operation Whirlwind
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Operation Whirlwind places you in command of an armored battalion during World War II, tasked with capturing a heavily defended city within a strict time limit. You coordinate different unit types, secure terrain, overcome natural obstacles and respond to hidden threats such as minefields and surprise enemy deployments. Each turn is divided into multiple phases covering preparation, movement, combat and high-risk assaults, demanding strong situational awareness, planning and adaptability. Victory or defeat depends on how effectively you manage limited information, ammunition and time under the pressure of the fog of war.

meta.name: Operation Wolf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Has sido reclutado para la "Operation Wolf", un intento desesperado de rescatar prisioneros del enemigo. A lo largo de una serie de misiones, te enfrentarás a una gran variedad de enemigos, desde soldados a ninjas, pasando por coches patrulla y helicópteros, entre otros.
Operation Wolf es una conversión del juego arcade de Taito. Se trata esencialmente de un "rail shooter", en el que disparas a casi cualquier cosa que se mueva. Disparas munición, granadas y objetos curativos para "recogerlos". Tu ametralladora principal puede matar cualquier cosa si le das lo suficientemente fuerte, pero también puedes usar el lanzagranadas para objetivos realmente mortíferos como helicópteros o vehículos blindados. Como extra, puedes recoger una ametralladora superpotente que te permitirá disparar más rápido durante unos segundos.

meta.name: Opium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.34 KB

Opium is a head-to-head duel in which two players compete simultaneously on an increasingly dangerous playing field. Every move leaves a glowing trail that quickly grows into a snake-like body, steadily reducing freedom of movement. The goal is to outmaneuver the opponent and force them into a situation where they collide with a wall, the background, themselves, or their rival. As each round progresses, the trails grow longer and mistakes become more likely – a tense contest driven by reflexes, foresight, and psychological pressure.

meta.name: Oracle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oracle presents you with tricky logic challenges where you play as a frog using carefully planned hops across a blank island to bring all elements together. Every move permanently alters the situation, meaning poor decisions can quickly leave you stranded with no solution. The appeal lies in forward planning, recognizing safe movement sequences, and constantly balancing progress against risk – a calm yet demanding puzzle that rewards patience and foresight.

meta.name: Oracle II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oracle II challenges your logical thinking with time-limited puzzles where the goal is to clear all stones from the board. By carefully matching identical colored stones, you trigger chain reactions, while a movable marker can only travel across connected tiles. Special stone types such as triple matches, persistent joker stones, and pure obstacles ensure that every move must be considered carefully. Constant time pressure creates a tactical puzzle that demands planning, awareness, and flexibility to overcome seemingly hopeless situations.

meta.name: Oracle III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oracle III focuses on pure puzzle-solving, challenging you to clear each screen by carefully pushing blocks together in groups of at least two matching tiles. As the difficulty increases, thoughtful planning and foresight become essential. Multiple tiers of challenge provide long-term motivation, with an unlockable mode offering an extra test for skilled players. Clean presentation and customizable options keep the attention on the puzzles themselves, turning every level into a self-contained logic challenge.

meta.name: The Oracle's Cave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.13 KB

The Oracle's Cave is an adventure game where you type in various one-letter commands with the keyboard and watch a side-view animation of your actions with the screen scrolling in various directions. You play the role of an adventurer who is trapped at the entrance of a Oracle's cave complex and the only way out is to go through the Oracle's cave on level four within five days. You have the choice of four quests which have you collecting a certain amount of treasures while collecting certain treasures guarded by either The Mummy, The Centaur, The Fiery Dragon, or The Black Knight

meta.name: Orange Squash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.65 KB

Orange Squash is a single screen platformer where you play the role of Oswald the Orange, trying to escape his packing case in the ACME fruit processing factory in the Spanish countryside, to stop being turned into pure orange juice. On each screen is a flag and you must navigate the platforms using smaller ones to get higher, and ropes to get lower, and touch the flag, before your juice gauge empties. The juice gauge is constantly decreasing but you can collect lemons on the way to keep increasing it. There are various creatures on the screen that can be avoided or shot but shot creatures appear again after a couple of seconds. If you are hit or shot by a creature, you lose part of your juice gauge and are taken back to the start of the screen.

meta.name: Orb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.50 KB

Orb challenges you with a clever puzzle concept in which you must guide connected sphere containers into matching color-coded transmitter fields to remove them from play. In a distant solar system, the Orbs manage the distribution of goods between several planets, with inertia, rebound surfaces and deflection elements playing a key role. Without brakes, movement is controlled entirely through walls, bounce elements and rotating segments that alter direction. Every move requires careful planning, as only correctly moving containers are accepted by the transmitters, giving the game a thoughtful, demanding and logically structured flow.

meta.name: The Orb of Light
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.98 KB

The Orb of Light places you in the radiant Chamber of Light within the palace of King Elrad the Second, where an intense brightness contrasts with an ominous emptiness. At the center stands a crystal cage that once held the Orb of Light and now lies empty, signaling an impending threat. Your mission is clear yet grave – to restore the lost Orb of Light before darkness spreads across the land and takes hold.

meta.name: Orbit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Orbit offers a calm, logic-driven experience set against a space-themed backdrop, where you must carefully uncover and remove matching tiles. The layout demands forward planning, as only certain tiles can be accessed and every move shapes what follows. Gradually the board clears, with focus and pattern recognition taking center stage, and the appeal comes from methodically dismantling the intricate arrangement.

meta.name: Orbitron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.75 KB

Orbitron puts you in the role of the last remaining fighter pilot tasked with defending the planet Hyperion from an alien invasion. Positioned at the bottom of the screen, you move in all directions while shooting down or avoiding incoming enemies. Colliding with an alien or getting hit costs one of your three lives. With each level, the pace quickens and new alien types appear – only those with endurance and precision can prevent the planet's downfall.

meta.name: Orbits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Orbits is a Tetris clone with a special charm. Each stage is named after a planet and accompanied by atmospheric SID music. Instead of forming lines, you must bring identical stones together – once they touch, they dissolve. Your goal is to fit in all the stones and clear the way to the next level. On the right side of the screen, you can see how many stones are still to come, and with skill and foresight you can work your way from planet to planet.

meta.name: Orbitter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.26 KB

Orbitter places you in a perilous situation high above a massive planet whose surface is marked by deep crevasses and narrow landing zones. Your orbit decays rapidly, fuel is limited and the planet's strong gravity turns every mistake into a fatal one. You must choose a landing spot and guide your spacecraft with extreme precision – only a carefully controlled descent determines whether you survive or crash.

meta.name: Orc Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.19 KB

Orc Attack places you on the battlements of a castle under siege by advancing hordes of orcs. You move along the wall with slippery, inertia-based controls that demand careful speed and positioning. As the orcs below set up ladders and climb higher step by step, you must collect stones and drop them through gaps in the battlements to halt their advance. The tension comes from the mix of movement control, timing, and constant pressure to be in the right place at the right moment.

meta.name: Orion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Orion is a challenging puzzle game – impressing with its simple yet demanding mechanics. The playing field is divided into two sections: on the right, a matrix contains numbered stones, which must be transferred to the left side. Placing a stone increases the value of adjacent stones – left, right, above, and below. While the early levels are manageable, the difficulty rises, and the tight time limit adds pressure. Every ten levels – a password is provided to save progress. Players who achieve a high score can enter their name into the leaderboard.

meta.name: Orion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.37 KB

Orion challenges the player to escape from the star system – where their spaceship has been trapped. To succeed, a total of 18 energy bundles must be collected throughout the system. The gameplay revolves around precise movement and avoiding obstacles – requiring skillful navigation to overcome various dangers. The engaging challenge is accompanied by an atmospheric soundtrack.

meta.name: Orion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.67 KB

„Orion“ takes place in an unstable constellation – its chemical balance must be restored to prevent distortion. This requires collecting elements from mining colonies, which are controlled by hostile aliens. The player takes control of the hero, moving sideways through the mines while battling enemies. The joystick controls movement – with the fire button used to attack. The screen also displays the score, shield status, and remaining lives.

meta.name: The Orion Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Orion Quest takes place in the year 2554 – as the long-standing war between Earth and the planet Zarp reaches a critical stage. The Zarps have planted a massive bomb capable of destroying Earth and have threatened to detonate it unless their demands are met. Previous missions attempting to land on Zarp and retrieve the necessary data to disarm the bomb have failed. Now, only one last hope remains – the player takes on the role of the sole survivor of a mission that was shot down during landing. After surviving the crash, they find themselves stranded on the hostile planet – with no clear way back. The game combines graphical depictions of the surroundings with text-based descriptions, and interaction is handled by typing commands via the keyboard.
meta.developer: Neil M. White & Dave C. Jordan

meta.name: Orm and Cheep : Narrow Squeaks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.00 KB

Orm and Cheep: Narrow Squeaks is a game based on the 1980s British children's puppet show on CITV, with the main characters Orm (worm) and Cheep (bird). The game consists of four mini-games. The first three are sideways single-screen games, while the last is a vertically scrolling game with a top-down view. Before the game starts, a reaction test determines the difficulty level. The words "Orm" and "Cheep" appear and must be stopped near a line. After each game, a score is displayed by removing squares from a picture - the better the result, the more of the picture is visible.

n: Orm and Cheep - The Birthday Party (Europe)

meta.name: Orm and Cheep : The Birthday Party
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.79 KB

Orm and Cheep: The Birthday Party is a game based on the British children's puppet show from the 80s on CITV. It's Orm's birthday and he organizes his party in three parts with the help of Cheep. At the beginning, a reaction test sets the level of difficulty: the words "Orm" and "Cheep" move down and must be stopped near a line. The game is controlled by pressing buttons. Part 1: Orm bakes a cake and Cheep gets the ingredients from unlabeled jars on the top shelf. Part 2: Cheep searches for Orm's friends in the maze to scare away the rat, crow and cat. Part 3: The guests are seated incorrectly; they must be seated correctly to start the party.

meta.name: The Ormus Saga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„The Ormus Saga“ is set in the year 1227 in the land of Beryland, which has fallen under the control of the Ormus Cult. The player takes on the role of a hero determined to challenge their rule. The journey begins on the southwestern shores of Beryland, near the city of Remfield. In addition to traditional exploration, the player can recruit and equip troops. These units can be used to fight wandering creatures like orcs and snakes or to seize and defend strategically important cities. To access the services of an occupied city, the player must first reclaim it.

meta.name: The Ormus Saga II : Guild of Death
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's January 7, 1228 in Beryland - two years after you successfully defeated Lord Marox and the Ormus cult, a new adventure awaits our heroes. A much more demanding task lies ahead of us. After reading the compendium, you will know the black book called Ulbore. The book has finally revealed the terrible truth about Sullivan and the Brotherhood of the White Rose. It's now up to you to complete 9 tasks provided by God's servants to save the kingdom from Armageddon. You only have about 12 months to do it. If the year is over and you fail to enter the Eternal Halls of Carion, it's game over.

n: Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.path: ./Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
meta.name: The Ormus Saga III : The Final Chapter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The King of Beryland has disappeared again and the creature Azerus of the Ormus Cult has risen to power. The player must defeat the Ormus Cult a third time. The player moves through a 2D scrolling land area and can visit a number of towns and dungeons. Each city is represented by a separate map where the player can talk to NPCs and shopkeepers. All commands are available through a series of menus at the bottom of the screen. In cities, the player can hire troops who can help in battle. Additionally, cities are often occupied or attacked by the Ormus Cult, and troops are necessary to defend or liberate cities. These troops can also be equipped with weapons. Monsters appear in the overworld or can be fought in cities. In combat, the player attacks directly on the map and can cast spells, attack with weapons or use his troops to attack.

meta.name: Orpheus in the Underworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Orpheus has discovered a passage to the underworld of Hades – but he can't return unless he collects all the scattered treasure. On his perilous journey, he must avoid monsters, traps and obstacles. The underworld has two levels, which he navigates using ladders or holes in the ground. One wrong step costs a life – only those who dodge well and find everything will escape.

meta.name: Osar II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.41 KB

Osar II challenges you in a compact and intense arena where you must strike an alien creature with precise laser fire while evading enemy attacks. The battlefield becomes increasingly dangerous as enemy hits damage the ground and create holes that restrict your movement. Touching these destroyed areas costs a life, making precision, positioning and quick reactions crucial for survival.

meta.name: Oskar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oskar drops you into a contaminated frontier town where a reactor accident has turned ordinary insects into towering monsters and sent the population fleeing in terror. As a lone farmer, you stand against the mutated threats and push through hazardous areas as the screen keeps scrolling forward. Each section demands precise timing, courage and persistence, with survival depending on smart movement and determination – dark, fast-paced and driven by the struggle of one man facing overwhelming chaos.

meta.name: Osmium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.45 KB

The planet Osmium is home to the evil Rexillian Blitztroopers and your mission is to fly over the surface of the planet and destroy them all. In this horizontal side view shooter that scrolls from left to right constantly, you have to shoot as many aliens as you can or avoid them over various levels. There are various obstacles that need avoiding as well and if you touch an alien or obstacle then you lose one of three lives. Occasionally icons will scroll from right to left and if shot will give you better weapons but if you touch one then you lose a life. At the end of each level is a boss in the shape of a big ship and you must destroy it or avoid it as it moves towards you to go to the next level.

meta.name: Osprey!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.57 KB

Osprey! places you in charge of a conservation effort focused on helping ospreys nest, raise young and survive ongoing threats. You plan across multiple years, allocate limited resources and respond to changing conditions such as weather and public impact. Each season brings fresh decisions that require balancing protection, awareness and prevention. The appeal lies in long-term planning, managing uncertainty and comparing intentions with outcomes – calm in pace, yet demanding through strategic depth and its strong grounding in real-world conservation.

meta.name: Ostfrieslandgames
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ostfrieslandgames is a humorous parody of competitive games like Winter Games or California Games, set in Ostfriesland, Germany. Players compete in unusual disciplines such as cow milking, pig shooting, cycling with square wheels, tea bag tossing, and roof building. Some events feature unique challenges, like throwing cow products into the opponent's bucket. Players can practice each discipline individually or compete in all events consecutively against the clock, the computer, or other players. The game offers an entertaining blend of skill, humor, and joystick acrobatics.

meta.name: Oter - The First Invasion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.09 KB

Oter offers a creative twist on the classic Space Invaders formula, where players face powerful boss enemies at the end of each round. This added challenge brings variety to the gameplay, requiring precise shooting and strategic planning to defeat the bosses and progress further in the game.

meta.name: Othello
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.20 KB

Othello is the digital version of the well-known board game played on an 8x8 grid. Both players begin with two pieces placed diagonally in the center. The goal is to have the majority of pieces in your color by the end of the game. To capture, you place a piece so that a line of your opponent's pieces is trapped between your new piece and another of your own, whether horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Those pieces are then flipped to your color. Players take turns until the board is full or no further moves can be made. Strategy, foresight, and sharp observation determine the winner.

meta.name: Otherworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.00 KB

Otherworld traps you in a hostile underworld where your only escape is collecting enough diamonds before time runs out. Piloting your agile ship, you face dragons, moving mines, acid-spitting creatures, and more. To survive, you must fly fast, shoot accurately, and grab power-ups like hourglasses, shield boosts, or temporary invincibility. Each level is a ruthless race against time and danger.

meta.name: Oubliette
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oubliette draws you into a vast multi-level dungeon explored with a party of adventurers you assemble yourself. Before each descent, you select companions from the tavern to form a capable group. Dark corridors are filled with monsters and dangers, but as your characters gain experience, equipment and stronger spells, their chances of survival improve. Magic is activated by typing specific commands, adding a distinctive touch to every encounter. Over time your heroes age and may even die – a demanding adventure that blends risk, strategy and exploration.

meta.name: Ouch!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.71 KB

Ouch! pits two pink blobs against each other in a quirky airborne duel. Floating across the screen, you aim to drop heavy weights onto your opponent at just the right moment. Precise timing and clever movement determine who lands the hit and who escapes. The first player to reach nine points wins – a simple yet delightfully chaotic arcade showdown.

meta.name: Ouch! II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.01 KB

Ouch! II continues the quirky showdown and is designed strictly for two players. Once again, airborne opponents face off, where quick reflexes and precise timing determine who scores the hit. Each player tries to outmaneuver the other and strike at the perfect moment. With no single-player option, the focus is entirely on head-to-head action – a fast and fun competitive experience for spirited duels.

meta.name: OUT
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 76.19 KB

OUT strips the formula down to pure reflex-driven play, putting you in control of a paddle and a ball as you chip away at walls of blocks. Each round demands precise positioning and quick reactions as the ball accelerates and keeps you constantly alert. Variations in layouts and subtle changes in pacing require you to adapt from stage to stage, preventing the action from feeling repetitive. Its minimalist presentation keeps the spotlight on timing and control – a straightforward test of your reflexes where every mistake is immediately felt.

meta.name: Out of this World
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.95 KB

Out of this World puts you in the role of a test pilot who becomes stranded in a strange world after a mysterious incident. You fight through side-scrolling stages, blast waves of enemies, and collect a floating symbol to advance to the next area. Defeated foes may drop colored modules that grant temporary weapon upgrades, while any collision with an enemy costs a life. Between stages, intense transition sequences test your reflexes as you dodge or destroy incoming hazards to continue.

meta.name: Out on a Limb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.54 KB

Out on a Limb retells the tale of Jack and the Beanstalk as a compact adventure across individual screens where you climb higher and explore the Giant's castle. You leap across clouds, move carefully between platforms and search for legendary treasures such as the harp, egg and gold while roaming creatures punish mistakes. Each area demands precise timing and awareness, as even a brief misstep costs a life. Extra collectibles and score factors tied to time spent encourage thorough exploration, making every room a small new challenge.

meta.name: Out Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

OutRun es un juego de carreras que permite al jugador competir en diversos terrenos en un Ferrari listo para usar, con una pasajera femenina, a lo largo de una serie de pistas cortas.
La jugabilidad se ve desde arriba y detrás del automóvil. Las carreteras están llenas de curvas cerradas y peligros, y el contacto con ellos puede hacer que el automóvil se vuelque y el jugador pierda tiempo. En cada sección de la pista hay una bifurcación en el camino, lo que permite al jugador elegir en qué dirección desea ir. El jugador debe completar un total de cinco secciones de pista, de las quince en el juego.

meta.name: Out Run Europa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tercera entrega de la serie OutRun, que revolucionó los juegos de carreras en perspectiva en tercera persona. Los niveles transcurren por diversos escenarios europeos mientras intentas escapar de la policía. A diferencia de los anteriores, cada nivel usa un vehículo distinto —motos y motos acuáticas incluidas—, lo que aporta variedad y exige habilidades diferentes. Debes completar cada tramo dentro de un límite de tiempo estricto, sorteando y adelantando a otros coches. Además, puedes elegir entre efectos de sonido o banda sonora.

A diferencia de los anteriores, cada nivel usa un vehículo distinto —motos y motos acuáticas incluidas—, lo que aporta variedad y exige habilidades diferentes. Debes completar cada tramo dentro de un límite de tiempo estricto, sorteando y adelantando a otros coches. Además, puedes elegir entre efectos de sonido o banda sonora.

meta.name: Out-Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.25 KB

Out-Space sends you into an unusual space battle where classic attack waves meet a delightfully absurd enemy lineup – instead of spaceships you face umbrellas, slices of toast, fish, snakes and more. You hold your ground against incoming formations, dodge projectiles and try to eliminate enemies quickly before they close in. The familiar pattern of advancing rows and increasing speed keeps the pressure constant, while the bizarre opponents give the action a humorous, almost surreal tone. The result is a blend of traditional arcade tension and playful creativity that turns every wave into a small surprise.

meta.name: Outback
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.91 KB

Based on the arcade game Pooyan, Outback lets you take on the role of Boss Roo, who tries to save nine Joeys from the clutches of the Swagmen in three levels. The game is viewed from the side, with levels displayed on a screen as your hero stands in an elevator powered by a pulley system on the right side of the screen that moves up or down. 32 Swagmen must be killed by using a bow and arrow to destroy the escaping Swagmen's baloons or parachutes, causing them to crash in order to advance to the next level. Before playing the game, you can choose between different options: number of lives (3-5), difficulty level (1-3) and points for extra lives (30,000-50,000). The joystick or keyboard can be used to control Boss Roo.

meta.name: Outcrush
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.28 KB

Outcrush pushes you upward through space as enemy ships and hazards flood the screen and test your reflexes. The diamond-shaped ship stands out as a recurring threat, forcing careful dodging while you blast everything else in sight. The constant forward momentum keeps the pressure high as formations grow denser and mistakes become costly. Managing energy, positioning smartly and maintaining steady fire combine into a fast rhythm that drives you from one wave of combat to the next.

meta.name: Outlaw (Hawksoft)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.75 KB

Outlaw is a duel game set in the Wild West, located in a desert full of cacti. It offers a classic dueling experience where two players compete in a fast-paced shootout. The opponents face each other on a desert-like terrain, trying to outdo each other in a race for the quickest reaction time. Each player takes on the role of a cowboy or outlaw and must defeat their opponent with precise shooting. The game requires quick reactions and good aiming. Players must carefully time their shots and, if necessary, dodge their opponent's shots.

meta.name: Outlaw
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.74 KB

La aventura transcurre en el Viejo Oeste, en tiempos de pioneros, y protagonizan dos despiadados forajidos que buscan refugio huyendo a México. Para lograrlo, deben atravesar zonas plagadas de peligros: nativos americanos, habitantes de un pueblo fronterizo de Arizona, soldados cazabandidos, animales como serpientes y bisontes, y fenómenos naturales como vientos fuertes. Para sobrevivir, deben esquivar con cuidado balas, animales y objetos lanzados por el viento. Se defienden con sus fieles Colts. Si tienes un amigo, podéis jugar los dos a la vez, cada uno controlando a un forajido.

meta.name: Outlaw
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Outlaw puts you in the boots of a bounty hunter in an action-packed Western shooter. Your mission is to take down four notorious outlaws, choosing your targets in any order. Once all are defeated, a final, even tougher level awaits. Along the way, waves of enemies stand in your path, requiring quick reflexes and precise shooting. Destroying barrels grants valuable power-ups like boots for extra speed, a rifle with extended range, or dynamite to clear the screen of foes. Only the fastest gunslingers will restore law and order to the Wild West!

meta.name: Outlaws
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.14 KB

In Outlaws you play a wild west hero called Lone Rider. The game takes place on the prairie, and in cities. It's a side-scroller, and you sit on the back of your horse during the entire game. The enemies in the game are mostly bandits, but occasionally Indians will attack you as well. You can ride in both directions, fire at enemies with your handgun, and jump over obstacles with the horse. To avoid being shot, you can also duck in the saddle.
On some levels, there are civilians walking around, and if you kill them by accident, it will have a negative effect on your score.

meta.name: Over The Net
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Over the Net you can play Volleyball matches lasting 1, 3 or 5 sets, with each set being won by the first player to reach 15 points. Teams include the Rollers, CoCo, the Beach Boys (obvious pun in their name) and the in-house Geniases. The action is viewed from the side, with the full court visible. When fire is not pressed, joystick motions move your player in this direction; when it is, they attempt to hit the ball in that direction. As in real volleyball, the ball hitting the ground on your side of the net, or going out of bounds without bouncing, costs you a point.

meta.name: Over the Rainbow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.94 KB

Over the Rainbow has you play as Alex, hopping across floating cubes to color them all – but it's a perilous mission. Dodging gumdrop monsters, melting Grody the Witch, zapping Buzzbat, avoiding Eraser Rabbit, and surviving Croak the Frog's smash attacks keeps you constantly on your toes. Use clouds to escape, rain to melt, and lightning to strike. Only smart moves and perfect timing will get you safely over the rainbow.

meta.name: Overlander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.33 KB

Overlander te sitúa al volante de un coche blindado y bien armado en un mundo postapocalíptico, donde los trabajos de transporte son peligrosos pero lucrativos. Eliges entre dos misiones: una más arriesgada, pero mejor pagada. La mitad del dinero se cobra por adelantado, el resto al entregar. Antes de salir, puedes mejorar el vehículo con turbos, blindaje y armas superiores —todos de uso limitado. Coches hostiles atacan a tiros o embistiendo, y las carreteras son traicioneras. La prudencia ayuda, pero la agresividad, más.

meta.name: Overlord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Overlord challenges you to find clues and hidden objects that grant you access to the chamber of the evil overlord B'aalcknyte. Your goal is to defeat him, rescue your friends, and win the game.

meta.name: Supremacy : Your Will Be Done
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Supremacy: Your Will Be Done casts you as the dictatorial ruler of the Epsilon Galaxy, tasked with maintaining control over armies, resources, and political stability. Following an experiment in hyperdrive technology, scientists discovered four buffer dimensions containing uninhabited planets between the Epsilon Galaxy and a foreign dimension. However, powerful empires from these dimensions have also gained access. Your mission is to combat these alien species to secure control over the buffer worlds and ensure your dominance.

meta.name: Overrun!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Overrun! delivers a demanding tactical simulation of modern squad- and battalion-level warfare, where you command combined forces of infantry, armor, artillery and helicopters. Set in realistic European and Middle Eastern environments, you make decisions under time pressure while managing limited orders, a fragile chain of command and incomplete information. Continuous action in short time pulses, highly detailed weapons and vehicle modeling, and the importance of terrain, line of sight and unit facing ensure that constant focus and precise planning are the difference between victory and complete defeat.

The goal is to force your opponent into crashing with one of the obstacles or to outdrive them on the track.

meta.name: Oxxonian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Oxxonian throws you into a bizarre world where the Oxxonian people are threatened by Zargo and his creatures from a parallel dimension – aiming to block access to their staple food, popcorn gateaus. To stop him, you must explore mazes, fight enemies, and search for food, weapons, money, and tools. Everything is hidden in different types of boxes, which only open when three of the same type are placed side by side. You can push and pull them like in Sokoban, but your energy is constantly draining – putting you under relentless time pressure.

meta.name: P47 Thunderbolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El P-47 fue uno de los aviones más resistentes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, y en este shoot 'em up lateral tomas los mandos para enfrentarte a oleadas de nazis. Las versiones de 16 bits permiten jugar a dos simultáneamente, y repetir hasta cuatro veces con dificultad creciente —cada vuelta, más intensa. Empiezas con una ametralladora, pero al recoger letras obtienes bombas, misiles en abanico o multilanzadores. Cada arma mejora si sigues recolectando su token correspondiente. También hay ítems para ganar vidas extra o aumentar la velocidad. Acción sin tregua, potencia a raudales y cielo lleno de enemigos: pilotar nunca fue tan épico… ni tan explosivo.

meta.name: P. Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.84 KB

“P. Man” is a variant of the classic Pac-Man that introduces an extra challenge. Instead of eating dots, the player consumes large turtles, which then transform into small turtles. Once all the large turtles are eaten, the player must go back and collect the small turtles to complete the level. Skill and strategy are key to mastering the tasks successfully.

meta.name: P0 Snake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.11 KB

"In 'P0 SNAKE,' you control your snake using just a single button. Holding down the fire button rotates it counter-clockwise, releasing rotates it clockwise. With this simple mechanic, you slither across the screen collecting dots – each one making your snake longer. But be careful not to crash into your own tail. A variety of enemies, obstacles, and movement-altering terrains add further challenges. Luckily, only the head is vulnerable – use that to your advantage!"

meta.name: Pac Mann
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.88 KB

“Pac Mann” is an unusual variant of classic collection games, where enemies follow fixed routes. The goal is to avoid all dangers and collect all points to progress to the next level.

meta.name: Pac-Boy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pac-Boy is one of the many but beautiful and playable Pac-Man clones.

meta.name: Pac-Family
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Pac-Family“ is an enhanced Pac-Man clone that offers more gameplay variety than many other versions. The player controls a Pac-character through a classic maze, collecting points while avoiding ghosts. The game features four difficulty levels, catering to different skill levels. A particularly generous aspect is the starting number of lives – with 25 at the beginning, players can enjoy extended play sessions. The colorful and detailed design gives the game its own unique identity within the Pac-Man genre.

meta.name: Pac-Land
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pac-Land es un juego de desplazamiento lateral para 1 o 2 jugadores con un toque caricaturesco. Ahora equipado con brazos, cara y piernas, Pac debe guiar a un hada de regreso a su hogar en Fairy Land, pero esta tarea no será fácil porque Inky, Blinky, Pinky, Clyde y Su perseguirán a Pac-Man mientras viaja. Pac-Tierra. Cuando finalmente transporta al hada de regreso a su casa, Pac recibe unos zapatos mágicos que lo ayudarán a llegar a su propia casa, donde será recibido por su familia: la Sra. Pac-Man, Baby Pac-Man, Chomp Chomp. y Amargado.

meta.name: Pac-Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.18 KB

Uno de los juegos más populares e influyentes de la década de 1980, Pac-Man está protagonizado por un pequeño comepuntos amarillo que se abre camino para despejar un laberinto de varios puntos y frutas que habitan en el tablero.
El objetivo de Pac-Man es desafiado continuamente por cuatro fantasmas: el tímido fantasma azul Bashful (Inky), el fantasma rojo que se arrastra Shadow (Blinky), el veloz fantasma rosa Speedy (Pinky) y el olvidadizo fantasma naranja Pokey (Clyde). Un toque de cualquiera de estos fantasmas significa una pérdida de vida para Pac-Man.

meta.name: Pac-Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pac-Mania es una variación del juego Pac-Man. Debes guiar a Pac-Man por un laberinto y comerte todos los puntos del tablero para pasar a la siguiente ronda. Numerosos fantasmas multicolores también deambulan por el laberinto tratando de detenerte. Si te comes una de las bolas de energía del laberinto, los fantasmas se volverán azules temporalmente y huirán de ti. Pac-man puede ganar puntos de bonificación al comerse los fantasmas cuando están en este estado. El laberinto ahora está en 3-D y es más grande que la pantalla que se desplazará para seguir la acción. Para ayudar a salir de apuros, Pac-Man ahora tiene la capacidad de saltar. ¡Pero ten cuidado, porque algunos de los fantasmas también han aprendido este truco y podrías terminar en una colisión en el aire!

meta.name: Pacman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.66 KB

This homebrew version of Pacman stays true to the classic gameplay of collecting points and avoiding ghosts but introduces a new challenge with the side-scrolling orientation of the playfield. The altered perspective requires players to rethink their movements and strategies, while the familiar elements of the original deliver nostalgic gaming fun.

meta.name: Pacman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.34 KB

“Pacman” is one of the many recreations of the classic Pac-Man game. This version was particularly widespread and offers the familiar gameplay where players collect points and avoid ghosts.

meta.name: Pac-Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.76 KB

Pac-Mania es una variación del juego Pac-Man. Debes guiar a Pac-Man por un laberinto y comerte todos los puntos del tablero para pasar a la siguiente ronda. meta.name: Pacos Pete : The High Plains Drifter
meta.desc:

“Pacos Pete” throws you into a wild Western adventure – first you battle through the blazing desert, engage in gunfights, and compete in beer drinking and arm wrestling in the saloon. But the real challenge comes last: milking a stubborn cow. Speed, skill and a good sense of humor are needed to conquer all parts of this bizarre showdown.

meta.name: Pactron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.76 KB

“Pactron” is a classic maze chase where you collect all the dots in the level while four ghosts emerge from the center to hunt you down. Power pellets in the corners briefly turn the tide, allowing you to hunt them instead. Three selectable difficulty levels offer the right challenge – whether cautious planning or daring point chasing, only smart moves will get you to the next level.

meta.name: Paddington and the Disappeaing Ink
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.22 KB

One morning Paddington was in the garden testing out some tricks on his magic equipment when he came across one he hadn't noticed before. It was called “magically disappearing ink” and it looked really interesting.nnnnSo begins Paddington's encounter with magical ink, as he soon discovers, to his dismay, that it is not easy to write a postcard with disappearing ink.nnnnPaddington and the Disappearing Ink is an educational game designed to help children ages 7 to 9 develop basic letter writing skills.

meta.name: Paddingtons Early Visit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.78 KB

Included with this game is an illustrated storybook with Paddington Bear, first created in books by Michael Bond, that serves as a preamble to the mini-games.nnnnPaddington receives a present of a bedside clock from Jonathan and Judy, with glow-in-the-dark hands that can be seen in the dark.nnnnBut the clock doesn't have numbers, only lines which must be deciphered. There are several mini-games which help children on how to tell time and read clocks: Wayup, Figures, Digital, Clock, and Stopwatch.

meta.name: Paddington's Garden Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.77 KB

In Paddington's Garden Adventure, you help Paddington Bear catch butterflies during a countryside week. Viewed from an elevated top-down angle, you navigate a maze to find five named butterflies worth different points. Touching one catches it automatically, but avoid hedgehogs, wasps, and flower walls – each costs you a life. With only three lives, the goal is to score high and complete the game quickly. When it's over, you're treated to a sweet farewell as the butterflies are released back into the wild.

meta.name: Paddington's Problem Picture
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.05 KB

In Paddington's Problem Picture, Paddington proudly takes charge of Mr. Gruber's antique shop for the day. But things soon go awry, and it's up to Paddington's curiosity, logic, and charm to put everything right. The game is a delightful picture-based adventure filled with small mishaps, thoughtful problem-solving, and classic Paddington warmth.

meta.name: Paddington's Shopping Mix-up
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Paddington's Shopping Mix-Up" follows an adventure where Paddington sets off from 32 Windsor Gardens on a shopping trip. Players assist Paddington by solving simple math problems such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to complete the shopping successfully.

meta.name: Paddles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Paddles up to two players compete in a variation of classic Pong. Each player controls a paddle on one side of the screen and tries to return the ball when it comes their way. Every successful return scores points, with faster balls being worth more. The unique twist is the flashing energy field in the center of the screen: whenever the ball touches it, its direction and speed change. This makes each rally more unpredictable and demands even sharper reflexes and timing.

meta.name: Paint & Corners
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.91 KB

Paint & Corners challenges you to draw lines across an open playfield and fully paint enclosed areas. The goal is to plan routes carefully, connect corners, and use space efficiently without trapping yourself or choosing poor paths. As you progress, the challenge increases, making awareness, timing, and clean line placement essential. The appeal comes from the blend of relaxed creativity and tactical thinking, where every decision has a visible impact on the result.

meta.name: Painter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.93 KB

In Painter, the player takes on the task of completely repainting the façade of a house. Equipped with brushes and paint, the character is controlled to move right, left, up, and down to cover every section of the wall. The challenge lies in avoiding the oddly behaving residents who try to disrupt the work and end it prematurely. Additionally, time is ticking, adding to the pressure. If the player manages to repaint the entire façade, the next wall awaits completion. Skill and timing are crucial to succeed.

meta.name: Pair of Memory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.76 KB

„Pair of Memory“ is a classic memory-matching game where players flip over hidden cards to find matching pairs. It can be played solo or with two players, taking turns to reveal and memorize card positions. The goal is to find more pairs than the opponent to win the game.

meta.name: Pakacuda
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.63 KB

Pakacuda is a Pac-Man variant with an underwater theme. Instead of the yellow hero, you control a hungry fish swimming through a maze and eating smaller fish. But beware – you are also prey for the octopuses that relentlessly chase you. If they catch you, you lose a life. Your only protection comes from the eels: eating one charges you up for a short time, allowing you to defeat the octopuses. Once the charge runs out, however, the enemies reappear and the chase continues.

meta.name: Paladin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.21 KB

In Paladin you pilot a spaceship over an alien landscape and try to rescue human prisoners from attacking aliens. The enemies fly through the sky, fire at you and attempt to abduct the people on the ground. You must shoot the aliens before they carry their victims upward and kill them, while also catching any falling prisoners with your ship before they hit the terrain. A map at the top of the screen helps you keep track of dangers and rescue situations. In addition to your laser, you can also use smart bombs to destroy all visible enemies at once. Once all humans are saved and all aliens are defeated, the next wave begins with new enemy types and greater difficulty.

meta.name: Pancake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.78 KB

Pancake puts you in the crispy edges of a freshly baked treat that refuses to be eaten. Escaping from hungry children, your quest is to hop around the world collecting delicious fruits dropped by birds to boost your flavor – and your score. But danger is everywhere: hens, chicks, and towering humans all want a bite. Dodge, jump, and grab what you can to stay alive. Can you help the pancake stay free and tasty? A delightfully weird survival romp with syrupy stakes.

meta.name: Pancho
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.00 KB

Pancho hops across platforms in an isometric view, coloring tiles just by landing on them. A wild Muncher chases him, costing a life on contact. A bouncing bean resets tiles but can be caught. Pancho starts each level on one of two flying carpets that offer safety – the Muncher can't reach them. Pressing fire teleports him to a carpet, but only four times per level.

meta.name: Pandora
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.25 KB

The generation ship Pandora has been set to infect the Earth with a nasty spore of deadly flowers. You have to stop this ship with the help of all the people on board that are still alive. The only person that can stop the ship is you. When you arrive, you have to get ID from the entry officer, or else you get frazzled by a roof lazer. The time limit to destroy this ship before it begins infesting the Earth with spores is 999 seconds.

meta.name: Pandora's Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.78 KB

Pandora's Box challenges you to stop the world's evils from escaping. As a creepy creature nears the top, Pandora must blow on it just as it reaches its largest form. A well-timed gust stuns the creature and locks in the side colors. Cleverly directing it to the matching color on the box's side exterminates it. If Pandora is bitten, she must drink a potion matching her facial color to receive the correct antidote.

meta.name: Pang
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador controla a un personaje confinado en un tablero del tamaño de una pantalla en el que rebotan bolas gigantes que amenazan al personaje. El personaje sólo puede moverse a izquierda y derecha y lanzar garfios hacia arriba en ángulo recto para reventar las bolas. Cuando se golpea una bola grande, ésta se divide en otras dos de tamaño intermedio, que a su vez se dividen en dos bolas más pequeñas, que pueden destruirse definitivamente. Cuanto más pequeña sea la bola, menor será el rebote y más ajustada la sincronización para pasar por debajo de la bola. El objetivo del juego es destruir las bolas antes de que se agote el tiempo sin ser golpeado.

meta.name: Pango
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.39 KB

Pango puts you in control of a character navigating a maze, outwitting and defeating enemies by pushing blocks. Clearly inspired by a well-known arcade hit, it builds on that popularity with fast-paced and challenging gameplay. Only smart tactics and quick reflexes will keep you alive in the tightening arena.

meta.name: Panic 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.90 KB

Panic 64 challenges you to manipulate platforms strategically to make monsters fall to their doom. You place bombs on floors, blast holes into the structure and guide enemies so they drop through multiple levels until they are eliminated. As you progress, the difficulty increases because enemies must fall farther, making careful planning essential. At the same time, you must avoid explosions and direct contact, creating a tense balance of timing, positioning and risk management.

meta.name: Panic Analogue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Panic Analogue" challenges the player to keep Redhead alive in his cave. Water droplets and fireballs constantly fall from above, and Redhead must catch every droplet to stay fresh while collecting fireballs to keep his torch lit. If a droplet hits the torch, disaster ensues – and swallowing a fireball, of course, also leads to catastrophe.

meta.name: Panic Button
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.22 KB

"Panic Button" puts the player in the role of a worker on a production line, assembling products from falling individual parts. The parts drop randomly from three chutes, and only one part can be carried at a time. The goal is to assemble the parts in the correct order, as incorrectly assembled products are useless. A "Panic Button" allows the player to temporarily stop the conveyor belts for better control. As the game progresses, the speed increases while faulty products disrupt the playfield, adding to the challenge.

meta.name: Panic Dizzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.79 KB

Dizzy Panic!
"Dizzy hits the panic stations as the hydraulic crushers get closer and closer, belching steam - the machines going into termination sequence and its down to you to stop it."
Dizzy Panic! was a puzzle game similar to Tetris, which involved moving a wall left to right so that falling shapes can pass through the appropriately shapes holes in the wall.

meta.name: Panic Express
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.47 KB

Panic Express is a game where you take on the role of Agent X, tasked with stopping a runaway train before it falls into enemy hands. You start on the roof of the last car and must run from right to left across 14 cars to reach the out-of-control locomotive at the front within a time limit. Each screen features a car and an obstacle that must be overcome either by jumping or lying down. Obstacles include smoke, electrified floor panels, helicopters dropping bombs, and many other dangers. You must also jump between the gaps of the cars, and if you fall into a gap, touch an obstacle, or run out of time, you lose one of your six lives.

meta.name: Panic Planet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.41 KB

Panic Planet challenges you to defeat all monsters on a stage before your oxygen runs out. Each level is made up of five platforms connected by ladders. You start at the bottom while monsters approach from the top. To eliminate them, you dig a hole, wait for a monster to fall in, and then close it so the creature drops down and disappears. In later levels, monsters must fall through multiple floors to be defeated. You can also drop through holes yourself, but never into one occupied by a monster. Any contact with enemies costs you a life, making timing and quick thinking essential for survival.

meta.name: Panic Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Panic Run" challenges the player to safely launch a spaceship during a meteor storm. With limited energy, only a single shield is available, which can be directed fore, aft, port, or starboard at a time. The goal is to protect the ship during launch and earn points for every meteor intercepted. The player must strategize to successfully reach orbit.

meta.name: Panther
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.96 KB

In Panther you take on the role of a pilot flying a rescue craft to save the last survivors of an attacked colony – while aliens strike, your mission is to bring people to safety. You control your aircraft with adjustable altitude, where speed and handling depend heavily on how high you fly. Enemies appear in waves, constantly forcing you to choose between evasion or combat. At the same time, you must land to pick up survivors, leaving you vulnerable. Your ship can only withstand a few hits, and later additional threats like missile systems make your task even harder. Each mission becomes a tense balance between rescue and destruction – and only skillful play allows you to save as many people as possible and achieve a high score.

meta.name: Panzer Battles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Panzer Battles is a hex board game style WWII war game. The game is based on the same engine originally used in Battlefront. The included Scenario package has forces and battles involving Soviet, German, British, American forces.You command corps of units in an effort to achieve the objectives laid out in the scenario briefing which follow actual battles during the war. With several scenarios included, and an excellent scenario editor it allows for extended gameplay.

meta.name: Panzer Grenadier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Panzer Grenadier” is a solitaire wargame that places you in command of an armored infantry regiment on the Eastern Front during World War II. As part of the elite Grossdeutschland Division, you lead infantry, tank units, and artillery support – including mortars, guns, Panzer IVs, Panthers, and Tigers. Five historical scenarios challenge you across three levels of difficulty. After each turn and at the end of the game, one of four levels of victory is determined. Strategy, careful planning, and effective use of resources are key to achieving success.

meta.name: Panzer Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Panzer Strike is a tactical level simulation of small unit actions during WWII. Three theatres are covered: the entire Eastern Front, Western Front campaigns that do not involve American troops and the North African Campaign. Panzer Strike includes practically every ground weapon used by the combatants in this theatre(over 250 weapon types). Units consist of infantry squads or single guns and tanks.You can choose to simulate either single battles or entire campaigns spanning several years. In the single battles you can play against another person but in campaigns you play against the computer. The ultimate objective of the campaign games is to fight and win as many battles as possible before the war ends. If you suffer heavy losses during one battle it will take a long time to replace and upgrade your forces before you can fight the next battle. Single scenarios can last from 30 minutes to 2 hours with campaigns lasting up to 30 hours.
