meta.name: Panzer-Jagd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.59 KB

Panzer-Jagd puts you on the Eastern Front, commanding 25 tank and infantry units, each representing a platoon. Your mission is to push forward across randomly generated maps filled with ambushes. Any units that survive are carried over to the next battle when a new map is created. The goal is to advance as far as possible with the forces at your disposal. The length of a game varies depending on your strategy and skill.

meta.name: Panzers East
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Panzers East, you command the entire Axis force during the invasion of the Soviet Union that began on June 22, 1941. You have 24 game weeks to conquer territory, destroy Soviet forces, and minimize your own losses. Each turn represents one week, and final victory is determined by the ratio of Axis to Soviet victory points. The game demands strategic thinking, careful planning, and precise management of resources under time pressure.

meta.name: Paper Plane
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Paper Plane you guide a falling paper airplane through a twisting maze that leaves little room for error – tight passages and an increasing number of obstacles demand quick reactions and precise timing. As the descent becomes more intense, you must carefully maneuver to avoid crashing into edges and barriers. With each section, the challenge grows, pushing you to adapt to the unpredictable paths ahead.

meta.name: Paperboy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en el juego arcade, el objetivo de Paperboy es repartir periódicos a tus clientes mientras causas el mayor daño posible a las casas de quienes no son clientes. Para complicar aún más las cosas, te encontrarás con numerosos obstáculos, como obreros de la construcción, neumáticos descontrolados, patinadores, perros y gatos, coches e incluso algún que otro tornado.

meta.name: Para Academy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.63 KB

In Para Academy you face a demanding paratrooper training program – only those who succeed in every discipline can rise through the ranks. You tackle a variety of challenges that test endurance, strength, and timing, all under strict time limits. Each success moves you forward, while failure costs lives and forces you to try again. Completing disciplines unlocks bonus stages for extra points. With every promotion, the requirements increase, pushing you to improve your skills to keep up.

meta.name: Para Assault Course
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.47 KB

In Para Assault Course you take on a demanding obstacle course and try to complete it as quickly as possible – just like in real paratrooper training. You move through different courses, overcoming obstacles such as walls, ropes, and daring slides while mastering rhythm and timing. Every movement counts, as only a smooth and mistake-free run leads to top times. Whether playing solo or competing head-to-head, the focus is on performance, and with increasing difficulty each course becomes a true challenge.

meta.name: Parachutist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.19 KB

In Parachutist you guide a skydiver safely to the landing zone – but the descent is far from easy. Only after jumping can you open the parachute and control your movement, while strong and shifting winds constantly push you off course. You must choose the right moment and adjust carefully to reach the target precisely. Every wrong move can send you drifting away, making timing and control essential.

meta.name: Paradroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Paradroid is set aboard a massive spaceship viewed from a top-down perspective. Across its many decks and rooms, you encounter hostile droids that must all be destroyed. You control the “Influence Device,” a special droid with the designation 001. Every droid is represented by a number that reflects its strength – the higher the number, the tougher the opponent. Your main tool is the ability to take over other droids: by “linking” into them, you destroy your old shell and assume control of the stronger droid. This mechanic allows you to fight your way through the ship, with the goal of eliminating all hostile units.

meta.name: Paradroid : Competition Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.15 KB

En Paradroid tienes que limpiar una flota de naves de robots hostiles. Para ello controlarás la unidad de influencia de la serie 001, que puede conectarse a otros robots y controlarlos después de una conexión exitosa. Totalmente necesario ya que la serie 001 solo está equipada con un débil láser y un escudo bajo. Después del "control", los circuitos de cada "robot anfitrión" resultan dañados, cuanto más avanzado es el robot, mayor es el daño. La tarea del jugador es eliminar a los robots hostiles en 16 cubiertas por toda la nave, ya sea controlándolos o con arma. Hay en total 24 tipos de robots de 10 clases diferentes.
Esta versión "Paradroid Competition Edition" es más rápida y fluida que la original.

meta.name: Paradroid : Heavy Metal Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.81 KB

A game that combines "Paradroid" with graphical elements inspired by "Morpheus." In addition to aiming for a high score, players can attempt to clear one or more ships entirely of robots and successfully transfer from the 001 Influence Device to the unstable 999 Droid. Although the manual mentions a limited fleet, the game on the Commodore 64 never truly ends. After clearing the eighth ship, named "Itsnotardenuff," the player is simply placed back on the ship, now with higher-ranked droids on every deck.

meta.name: Parallax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.42 KB

Parallax es un juego de acción dinámico basado en una cuadrícula de 12×12 en el que te desplazas por el campo para destruir los Generadores Gravitónicos Oscilantes de los malvados Silurianos. Mientras recorres la cuadrícula, cuatro lanzadores orbitales disparan misiles desde los bordes de la pantalla. Puedes alternar entre dos velocidades y disparar hacia adelante para defenderte. Cada nivel presenta un nuevo patrón de generador que debes recoger. Con solo tres vidas, se requieren reflejos rápidos y una estrategia precisa para derrotar a los Silurianos.

meta.name: Parallax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Parallax throws you into a dark future where a supercomputer known as The Big One controls the world. Its code is uncrackable – unless you find scientists, drug them, and bring them to the machine. Each will unlock one letter of the code. But the search is perilous: aliens patrol the base and can gang up on you. Played from a top-down perspective with full multi-directional scrolling, you can upgrade weapons, recharge shields, and even exit your ship to explore on foot. Money? Maybe a sedated scientist has value. The game's namesake parallax scrolling and its epic 11-minute intro track set the tone.

meta.name: Paranoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Paranoid, you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen, keeping a ball in play to break all the blocks above. Just like classic Breakout, every hit counts, and as the speed increases, so does the challenge. Precision and timing are key – lose focus, and you lose the ball.

meta.name: Paranoids Anonymous
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.03 KB

“Paranoids Anonymous” is a quirky text adventure where you feel your way through a building full of absurdities in search of the elusive president Rufus T. Paranoia – with a wink and plenty of patience, you navigate cryptic clues and locked-off paths at a meeting no one will talk about and no one would ever admit to attending.

meta.name: Paranoimia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Paranoimia is a challenging puzzle game where identical tiles must be merged to make them disappear. The difficulty lies in keeping track of movements and avoiding blocking your own path. Tiles can only be moved left or right, requiring strategic planning and foresight to prevent the board from becoming a dead end.

meta.name: Paranom - Elite Squad 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.07 KB

"Paranom: Elite Squad II" is a sophisticated puzzle logic game.

meta.name: Paras
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.62 KB

The object is to bring the war to a swift close by destroying the enemy's line of communication - a bridge. To do this your 15 men are dropped behind enemy lines. They may be equipped with 5 different weapons and an unlimited number of grenades.

meta.name: Paratroopers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.34 KB

Paratroopers is a fast-paced single-player game where you control a ground-based gun and try to shoot down enemy paratroopers and aircraft. Every helicopter, bomber or parachutist you destroy earns you points – but every missed shot costs you. If too many soldiers land, they form a tank and destroy your gun. You can shoot parachutists directly, target their helicopters or hit their parachutes for a rather brutal landing.

meta.name: Parisian Nights
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.92 KB

In Parisian Nights you wake up as secret agent Monsieur Phillip Groucy, stark naked in a shady Parisian bedroom, with no memory, no money, and your credit card stolen. Set between the world wars, the game takes you through seedy neighborhoods in search of clues, dignity, and direction. While trying to recover your belongings, you must also maintain the health of both body and soul – and things are only going to get wilder from here.

meta.name: Park Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.41 KB

In Park Patrol you take on the role of a dedicated park ranger trying to restore order in a nature reserve overrun by careless visitors – trash is scattered everywhere and even rare wildlife is put at risk. You move across land and water, collecting litter and stepping in when swimmers get into trouble. At the same time, you must watch out for curious animals and keep an eye on your energy, as running out of food quickly ends your efforts. Your supplies aren't safe either, since hungry ants are eager to steal them. The more efficiently you work, the more points you earn – but only with awareness and good time management can you stay in control of this chaotic mission.

meta.name: Parky and the Yellow Submarine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.30 KB

Parky and the Yellow Submarine challenges you to collect as many gold tokens as possible before time runs out. Underwater dangers such as fish, clams, crabs, stingrays, and jellyfish threaten your journey. Some rooms have multiple exits, allowing different paths to be explored. Helpful items aid your progress, while each collected gold token extends your time by 9,000 units. However, colliding with walls or sea creatures costs a life. The game ends when all lives are lost.

meta.name: Parsec
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Parsec throws you into a fast-paced space mission where you pilot your ship through hostile zones and fight off relentless waves of enemies. Ever-changing formations, tougher mini-boss encounters, and major confrontations keep the pressure rising, while useful power-ups briefly open up new tactical options. The central threat is clearly defined – a looming planetary collision must be prevented – giving the action a serious undertone that adds weight to the intense gameplay. The result is a high-speed challenge that tests reflexes and endurance alike.

meta.name: Party Quiz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Up to four players or teams can compete in this 2,500-question trivia game. The box includes four hand-held quick response controllers attached to four-foot cables; there is no need for players to crowd around one keyboard. You can choose the length of the game, the number of players (one to four), and the time allowed to answer a question. You can also handicap advanced players.
Media for Commodore 64 and Apple II/Atari 8-Bit computers is included in the one box.
Questions comprise of general knowledge, history, music, math pop culture and American television.

meta.name: Pass Your Driving Test
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.28 KB

Pass Your Driving Test guides you through many lessons covering road rules, driving behaviour, and common test scenarios. You progress through topics, answer questions, and check your understanding as different situations are explained step by step. Each lesson focuses on an important aspect, helping you judge traffic decisions more confidently and avoid typical mistakes. The structured collection becomes an interactive learning experience that reinforces knowledge and prepares you for exam-style situations.

meta.name: Les Passagers du Vent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Passengers on the Wind, you follow Isa and Hoel as they become entangled in a dangerous journey on the eve of the French Revolution. Their quest takes them from Brittany to Africa in search of the truth behind Isa's origins. Along the way, you take control of more than fifteen different characters, all drawn into the dramatic events of the late eighteenth century.

meta.name: Passengers on the Wind II
meta.desc:

Passengers on the Wind II puts you in control of several characters whose fates are shaped by your decisions. Each choice determines the places they visit, the events they encounter, and how their stories unfold. The screen displays the action, the current character, and a text-based action menu. Using keyboard or joystick, you select actions, watch flashbacks in different speeds, or intervene directly. The game consists of seven episodes that unlock progressively. Saving your progress is possible but requires a blank, formatted disk.

meta.name: Passing Shot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.99 KB

In Passing Shot you compete on international tennis courts, facing off against the computer in fast-paced matches – your goal is to progress through tournaments and prove your skill. You choose your serve style and rely on precise timing and positioning during rallies. The shifting perspectives require both awareness and quick reactions. Whether playing solo or as a team, only consistent performance and smart decisions will lead you to victory.

meta.name: Passport to London
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Passport to London you take on the role of a tour guide trying to manage a chaotic group of tourists – some of them have stolen valuable items and keep wandering off. You travel between locations, gather clues, and try to determine who took what. You must manage your time and money carefully while suspects constantly move and new leads appear. Unexpected events add further unpredictability, requiring you to stay flexible. Only by paying attention and making the right deductions can you solve all cases in time.

meta.name: Passport to Paris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Passport to Paris you take on the role of a tour guide who must reunite a scattered group of twelve tourists in a very limited time. You investigate several famous locations across the city, solve small challenges, and gather clues to track everyone down. Time and money are limited, making every choice about travel and destination order crucial. A race against the clock unfolds, blending exploration and strategy – only careful planning and smart decisions will get everyone back in time for departure.

meta.name: Pasta Blasta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pasta Blasta you defend valuable supplies against a growing threat – enemies appear from all directions, trying to carry them away. You move dynamically across the screen, using momentum and aiming in all directions to stop them. Your ammunition is limited, so you must carefully decide when to shoot or collect resources. Special tools can give you a temporary advantage, but must be used wisely. As the pace increases, each round becomes more intense, demanding full focus.

meta.name: Pastfinder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.09 KB

By the year 8878 A.D., exploration had become a thing of the past.
Looking into the past. Searching it. Unearthing its mysteries and uncovering its adventures. The Ruling Council had bestowed this critical task to an elite group of stellar explorers. Known simply as, Pastfinders.
To join their ranks, one must possess the stamina to search hundreds of uncharted lands. The knowledge to select only the proper tools for survival. The ability to dissect complex maps. And, the unending desire to live dangerously.
Membership is now open to you.

meta.name: Pathal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Mega-Pathal is a Tetris clone – players must strategically stack falling blocks to complete lines and score points. Before starting, they can choose from different music tracks to customize their experience.

meta.name: Pathfinder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pathfinder is a collection of four games designed for children aged five to eight. In each game, the player controls a rabbit, Mr. Grub (a mole), a frog, or a kangaroo. In Rabbit, you guide a rabbit through a maze to the exit while collecting carrots. In Picnic Maze, Mr. Grub moves on a 10 x 7 grid, collecting food in a specific order for his picnic. In Frogs, you lead a frog across a pond, gathering friends without landing on lily pads or crossing your own path. In Kangaroo Maze, you program the kangaroo's route through a maze by directing it with specific directions and jumps.

meta.name: Pathwords
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Pathwords is a word game for one to four players where you have to make as many words as you can on a 109 diamond shaped letter grid. Starting on different sides of the diamond, each player takes it in turns to make a word from the letters by moving in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal direction within a chosen time limit. Once a word has been made then the letters are replaced by new letters except the last letter and this is the starting letter for the players next turn. Points are awarded for how many letters and which letters are used with Z and Q scoring high. Once a game has been completed then the players words are shown and their final score, with the winner being the player with the highest score.

meta.name: Patience
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.77 KB

Patience, also known as Solitaire, challenges you to build four full suit stacks from Ace to King in ascending order. Cards are laid out in seven columns, with only the top card of each column revealed. You can move cards onto others of alternating color and one rank higher, and sequences can be shifted if they follow this rule. Aces are placed aside to start new suit stacks. If no more moves are possible, you draw three cards at a time from the deck, playing only the top one. The goal is to organize all cards into the four suit piles before you run out of moves – a calm yet strategic test of planning and patience.

meta.desc:

meta.name: Patience Polly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.65 KB

In Patience Polly, you guide Polly across a screen full of face-down cards, trying to uncover the one the game requests. You flip cards by standing beneath them and pressing the fire button. Depending on your settings, up to 52 cards can be in play. Some hide jokers that spring to life and chase Polly around – if one catches her, she's sent back to the start of that screen. Three selectable difficulty levels affect how intense the chase becomes. And if you're unsure how to begin, a looping demo plays until Polly gets caught by a joker. Fast, quirky, and frantic card-flipping action.

meta.name: Patternia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.65 KB

Patternia es una versión digital del clásico rompecabezas de lógica Torres de Hanói. El objetivo es mover todos los discos de diferentes tamaños al pilar correcto usando tres varillas, pero solo se puede mover un disco a la vez, y nunca se puede colocar un disco más grande sobre uno más pequeño. Con cada movimiento, la presión aumenta a medida que se registra el tiempo y los errores. Solo quienes planifiquen con antelación y apilen con inteligencia podrán resolver el rompecabezas en el menor número de movimientos y superar el desafío.

meta.name: Patton vs Rommel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Patton vs Rommel“ simulates an alternate battle for control over Normandy, where General Patton and Field Marshal Rommel face off. The player accumulates points depending on their chosen side – positive for the Allies, negative for the Axis. While the game focuses more on entertainment than deep strategic simulation, it offers various options and detailed feedback, including tactical advice from computerized versions of both commanders. A key feature is an early version of „Fog of War,“ where enemy units remain hidden until a zone is entered or contested.

meta.name: Paul der Kaefer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.10 KB

In Paul der Käfer you control a tiny, unusual hero flying through peaceful-looking landscapes that quickly turn lively and dangerous. As you progress, you dodge obstacles and fend off enemies blocking your way. It becomes especially charming in co-op mode: Paula joins you and together you fight your way through the colorful chaos. A simple concept that shines through its playful presentation and the fun of playing together.

meta.name: Paul Whitehead Teaches Chess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Paul Whitehead Teaches Chess is a comprehensive chess tutorial that combines an educational program with the opportunity to play against a chess engine. It targets players ranging from absolute beginners to intermediate levels, with the latter being quite challenging. The tutorial is divided into 11 sections and visualized through a large-scale plan. It starts with basic topics like "How the Pieces Move" and "How to Capture Pieces" before advancing to concepts such as "Opening Principles," "Tactics," and "Strategy." The "Strategy" category alone comprises 167 screens. Usability is a key focus, allowing users to switch between topics freely without being restricted to a specific order.

meta.name: The Pawn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Pawn you find yourself in a strange world where nothing feels quite normal and you must figure things out step by step. As you try to escape Kerovnia, you encounter unusual characters, gather clues, and take on various tasks that draw you deeper into the story. Your choices and inputs shape the journey as you solve puzzles and explore new locations. The world feels lively and quirky, and only careful thinking and smart decisions will help you uncover its secrets and find a way out.

meta.name: The Pay-Off
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Pay-Off throws you into the grim streets of New Jersey, where you're drowning in gambling debts. Luigi, a feared bookie, demands 40,000 dollars while you've only got 50 bucks to your name. To survive, you must make risky choices – rob a bank, steal a gem, or find other shady ways to raise the cash. You guide your character through a dangerous world filled with shady figures, making choices that decide whether you can pay Luigi back or whether your fate is sealed.

meta.name: Payday
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Payday you spin through space collecting as many money bags as possible while staying in constant motion and avoiding danger. At the same time, you compete directly against another player who tries to grab the loot before you do, adding extra pressure. The action is fast and chaotic, demanding quick reflexes, while the energetic music drives the pace even further. A simple yet intense experience where timing and competition are key.

meta.name: Payday
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Payday you play through the ups and downs of everyday finances, aiming to end the game with more money than your opponents. Moving across a calendar-based board, you manage income, expenses, and investment choices while constantly weighing risk and reward. Bills pile up, opportunities appear, and sometimes you're forced into loans that can become costly later. Those who manage their money wisely, seize the right opportunities, and stay in control will come out on top.

meta.name: P.C. Fuzz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.90 KB

In PC Fuzz you patrol a busy street as a police officer, keeping an eye out for criminals and troublemakers. When robbers appear, you must act quickly, knock them out, and transport them before they escape. At the same time, other characters and events add to the chaos, requiring constant awareness. Occasionally, bonus opportunities appear if you hit the right targets. A fast-paced experience that relies on quick reactions and timing.

meta.name: Pea Picker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.59 KB

In Pea Picker you navigate a maze collecting as many green peas as possible while constantly being chased. A relentless enemy stalks you through the corridors, forcing you to choose your paths carefully and react quickly. Doors can be used to your advantage for a short time, but they won't hold forever. When the situation shifts, you can turn the tables and go on the attack yourself. A classic concept that relies on speed, planning, and timing.

meta.name: Peace Women
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.42 KB

A satirical take on the Greenham Common Women's Peace Camp that started in 1981 in protest against nuclear weapons being placed at RAF Greenham Common airbase in Berkshire, England. The game itself is a simple shooter with the player switching between a Sinclair C5 electric tricycle, a witch's broom, a tank, and a pogo-stick at each level to infiltrate the airbase in the end.

meta.name: Peanut Butter Panic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.39 KB

In Peanut Butter Panic you team up with another player to create sandwiches and keep going. You collect stars to power the machine and use coordinated jumps to reach higher areas. Cooperation is key, as working together lets you launch each other to greater heights and progress more efficiently. At the same time, you must watch out for hazards that can undo your progress. A unique experience that blends teamwork, timing, and quick reactions.

meta.name: Peanuts Maze Marathon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

"Peanuts Maze Marathon" is a child-friendly maze game where characters from Charles Schulz's Peanuts must be guided safely to their destination. Between the start and endpoint lies a randomly generated maze that players must navigate. Successfully finding the path triggers a short animation. An optional time limit can be set, with preset values or a custom duration.

meta.name: Peanuts Picture Puzzlers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Peanuts Picture Puzzlers, you are shown a Peanuts-themed picture that is divided into four blank sections. Your task is to select and place the correct pieces to complete the picture. Once finished, you are rewarded with a short animated vignette. You can choose between timed and untimed puzzles.

meta.name: Pearl of Dawn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pearl of Dawn, the land of Halden once thrived under the protective power of the Pearl of Dawn, safe from disease and hunger, until the Lord of Darkness returned and unleashed monsters upon the villages. He seized the pearl and hid it deep within his castle. Your task is to step into the role of the ranger Dolk, gather weapons and healing potions, and fight back with your slingshot against the creatures. The goal is to reclaim the pearl and save Halden from destruction.

meta.name: Pebbles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.89 KB

In Pebbles you dig through a crumbling environment in search of valuable jewels hidden among dirt and debris. As you move carefully, you must avoid being trapped by falling rocks. Every move can open new paths or put you in danger, especially with time running out. Quick thinking and precise timing are essential to collect the jewels and escape in time.

meta.name: Pedestrian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.54 KB

In Pedestrian you control a pedestrian who has to cross a busy road. But that's just the beginning: After he has safely reached the road, further dangers lurk, such as spiders and aliens that block his way. Then he has to cross a river populated by crocodiles to get home safely. The game requires quick reactions and precise movements, because every wrong step can be fatal. Make sure the pedestrian always stays on his feet to master the challenges!

meta.name: Pedro
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.15 KB

Pedro turns the defense of a flower garden into a wonderfully offbeat action challenge where you have to fend off waves of animals with smartly placed barriers and quick reactions. Rather than relying on pure speed alone, the game constantly pushes you to think ahead, since eaten flowers must be replanted and even your supply of seeds is never truly safe. That blend of pressure, planning, and the unusual perspective gives Pedro a character of its own and makes this gardening struggle feel like a surprisingly tense fight for survival.

meta.name: Peg-Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Peg-Out brings the classic feel of cribbage into a compact digital format where you combine cards and try to outscore your opponent point by point. The focus lies on tactical decisions about which cards to play or hold back, with every move directly affecting your score. The game guides you through each phase and gives you time to examine your hand, develop strategies and search for the strongest combinations. Despite its calm presentation, it creates a tense back-and-forth where planning, timing and anticipation of possible plays determine victory or defeat.

meta.name: Pegasis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.64 KB

Pegasis is an aerial dueling game where you ride a winged horse and defeat flying enemies by striking them from above. To take flight, you must continuously flap your wings – timing your flaps lets you rise or fall to get the upper hand. Hitting enemies from above knocks them off their mounts, sending them to the ground. Striking dismounted foes increases your score and spawns new challengers. In addition to single player, two players can compete at the same time.

meta.name: Pegasus Bridge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pegasus Bridge places you in the tense hours just before the Normandy landings and turns the capture of strategically vital bridges into the heart of a gripping wartime scenario. The focus is not only on the assault itself, but also on everything that makes such an operation so fragile – from morale and fatigue to strong winds, scattered paratroopers, and the danger of the bridges being destroyed at the last moment. That combination of interlocking factors gives the game a dense, nervous atmosphere in which every decision carries weight and the historical mission feels like a demanding tactical challenge.

meta.name: Pegasus Odyssey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.75 KB

Pegasus Odyssey puts you in control of a winged Pegasus, with flight mechanics similar to the arcade classic Joust. Against a backdrop of mountains and a glowing volcano, you face giant bats emerging from a cave. To defeat them, you must strike from above – if they strike you from higher up, you lose a life. Defeated bats turn into eggs that bounce to the ground; if not stepped on in time, they hatch into new enemies. Your Pegasus can only stay airborne by constant flapping, while horizontal movement continues through inertia. You can land and slide on the ground, while bouncing off the top edge of the screen. When you die, the volcano releases a fireball that transforms into your new Pegasus. Two players can join in cooperative play, with their pegasi passing harmlessly through one another. Ten levels of difficulty keep the challenge intense.

meta.name: Penalty Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.80 KB

Penalty Soccer is a football game with easy rules: save 10 penalties before the striker scores 10. For every victory you qualify to the next level. For each level the game goes faster and your goalkeeper moves slower. Totally there is ten levels. Before the game starts you can choose who to take the penalty and this represents the difficulty level. In total there are eight levels with Keegan being the easiest and Maradona the most difficult.

meta.name: Penetrator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your fighter must penetrate four defense rings, and blowup a neutron bomb cache - an almost impossible feat! Radar bases track your movements; the treacherous landscape conceals missile silos. 
Also: redesign the landscape of Penetrator and add missiles and radar bases to suit your abilities!

meta.name: Pengo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pengo you play a penguin trying to survive ice mazes for two minutes to progress. You avoid enemies, crush them with sliding ice blocks, and score bonus points by aligning diamonds or defeating four or more enemies within a minute. Touching an enemy costs a life and triggers a new maze layout. Ice blocks can also be removed by pushing them against walls or other blocks.

meta.name: Pengo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.51 KB

Pengo, based on the arcade classic, puts you in control of a penguin navigating an icy maze, crushing enemies with sliding blocks while avoiding contact. Bonus points are awarded for lining up diamonds. Each round lasts two minutes – survive, and you advance to the next layout. Speed, tactics and sharp timing are key to success.

meta.name: Pengo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.38 KB

En Pengo, encarnas a un pingüino que debe sobrevivir dos minutos en laberintos de hielo para avanzar. Esquiva a los enemigos, o ¡aplasta a los descuidados empujando bloques de hielo! También sumas puntos extra alineando diamantes o eliminando cuatro o más rivales en menos de un minuto. Si te tocan, pierdes una vida y el laberinto se reorganiza. Pero ojo: los bloques no solo sirven para aplastar —también desaparecen si los empujas contra paredes u otros bloques, abriendo nuevos caminos… o encerrándote sin querer. Simple, adictivo y lleno de tensión fría: cada segundo cuenta, cada desliz, se paga.

meta.name: Pengo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.72 KB

Pengo, based on the arcade classic, puts you in control of a penguin navigating an icy maze, crushing enemies with sliding blocks while avoiding contact. Bonus points are awarded for lining up diamonds. Each round lasts two minutes – survive, and you advance to the next layout. Speed, tactics and sharp timing are key to success.

meta.name: Pengon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pengon you play Willy the penguin, trapped in a frozen maze filled with deadly mutant sea lions. Your only defense is to push ice blocks into them, crushing them against the walls. Inspired by Sega's Pengo, the C64 version retains the core gameplay of quick thinking and sharp movement, even if it differs visually from earlier ports. Outsmarting enemies and clearing the maze is the key to survival.

meta.name: Pensate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pensate, you guide a castle across a checkerboard grid, moving from the bottom to the top, turn by turn. Before the game starts, you decide how many moves per turn are allowed. But the board is filled with ten enemy types, each with unique movement patterns. Some move in fixed directions, others mirror your moves, rotate them, or leap like chess knights. In practice mode, you choose your own enemy setup. In tournament mode, you face preset levels that grow harder each round – playable solo or in a two-player match, where one player moves from top to bottom.

meta.name: Penultimate Fantasy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.56 KB

"Penultimate Fantasy" is a classic role-playing game where players explore a world, complete quests, and engage in turn-based battles. The goal is to retrieve four magical crystals while the heroine Tia enhances her abilities, collects new equipment, and fights off enemy creatures. The game delivers a nostalgic RPG experience with strategic combat and an open-world environment.

meta.name: Peppi's Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.84 KB

Peppi's Quest sends you and your dragon Peppi through a harsh side-scrolling world filled with enemies constantly coming at you. As you dodge incoming attacks and fire back, it creates a fast and intense action flow that keeps you moving at all times. The contrast between regular enemies and larger boss encounters gives the journey through its grim cityscape a steady sense of excitement.

meta.name: Percy Goes Home
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.44 KB

Percy turns an underwater treasure hunt into a lively screen-by-screen adventure in which the little penguin must gather as many pearls as possible while safely making his way home. In each stage, you collect every scattered treasure, avoid sea creatures moving in fixed patterns, and race constantly against the clock. That blend of clear objectives, increasing time pressure, and careful navigation through simple but dangerous mazes gives the game a charming yet pleasantly demanding appeal.

meta.name: Percy Penguin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.43 KB

In Percy Penguin you control a small penguin navigating an icy board filled with green ball enemies. Push ice blocks to crush foes or rearrange the layout. To complete a level, either eliminate all enemies or collect the three hidden diamonds. The faster you finish, the higher your score. The game offers two difficulty levels and three lives per playthrough – controllable via joystick or keyboard.

meta.name: Perils of Darkest Africa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.72 KB

Perils of Darkest Africa sends you on an adventurous search for the jewels of King Solomon's mines, turning the journey into a trek filled with danger, mystery, and unpredictable twists. As you cross the continent, you repeatedly face new challenges that keep the path to your goal uncertain and exciting. Its particular appeal comes from the vivid way these situations are described, creating the feeling of standing right in the middle of an exotic and perilous adventure yourself.

meta.name: Periscope Up
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.43 KB

Periscope Up places you in a tense underwater mission where you pilot a submarine to stop a system spiraling out of control. You explore a hazardous complex, collect vital items such as keys and fuel, and use your onboard weapons to overcome obstacles. Along the way, deadly laser beams and crushing passages demand precise navigation and careful planning. Only through thorough exploration, smart decisions and good timing can you reach the supercomputer in time to prevent global disaster.

meta.name: Perplex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.41 KB

Perplex turns a simple core idea into a surprisingly demanding puzzle game in which you must convert all the grey blocks into brown ones using only a limited number of moves. What seems manageable at first quickly develops a strong brain-teasing appeal, because every touch matters and each step has to be planned carefully. Its blend of clear rules, many levels, and complete freedom from time pressure gives the game a calm yet highly absorbing character.

meta.name: Perplex 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Perplex II continues the puzzle concept of its predecessor and once again focuses on tricky challenges where every move has to be chosen with care. The sequel feels like a natural refinement of the familiar idea, asking you to find solutions not through speed, but through smart planning ahead. That strong focus on precise move sequences and steadily fresh challenges gives the game its calm yet deeply engaging appeal.

meta.name: Perplexian Challenger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The incredibly responsive three-axis joystick control of a space fighter is in your hands. Split screen graphics provide a continuous display of your ship's instrumentation, as well as a three-dimensional, animated view of space. You, as a pilot, must utilize lightning fast reflexes to destroy invading ships, and avoid their return fire. Simultaneously, you must maneuver your ship to capture space debris that remains from the explosions.

The Case of the Mandarin Murder is a text adventure with graphics, based on the Perry Mason detective stories by Erle Stanley Gardner. A woman is in jail after her rich husband is found dead, and the skillful attorney Perry Mason must prove her innocence. The gameplay is influenced by Infocom's games in similar genre.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #09 - Perseus & Andromeda
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.04 KB

Perseus & Andromeda draws on Greek mythology and turns the famous heroic tale into a classic adventure full of trials, encounters, and gradual preparation for a great rescue. As Perseus, you set out to defeat Medusa and free Andromeda, with the right equipment, your dealings with other characters, and the triggering of key events all shaping your progress. Its close connection to the well-known legend gives the game a fairy-tale heroic appeal and makes the journey feel like an ancient myth brought to life in playable form.

meta.name: Persian Gulf Inferno
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.74 KB

An oil platform in the Persian Gulf is being threatened by terrorists who have taken hostages and placed an atomic bomb somewhere on the platform to blackmail the government. You are assigned as a special agent to rescue the hostages and defuse the bomb. However, you're not helpless, as you have various weapons at your disposal. But you only have 30 minutes to complete your mission. Along the way, you'll navigate a maze of corridors, stairs, elevators, and rooms, meaning the mission will require intelligence, quick reactions, and good orientation.

meta.name: Pertharion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pertharion combines puzzle design and dexterity into a demanding challenge in which you guide a rolling ball across a field of tiles with different effects. What seems manageable at first quickly becomes tricky, because each color follows its own rules, some tiles disappear, and a single mistake can mean instant failure. Its appeal comes from that mix of planning ahead, careful movement, and collecting essential tiles, while the option to build your own levels adds even more lasting fascination.

meta.name: Pesky Painter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.91 KB

Pesky Painter turns a simple single-screen challenge into a brisk skill-based game in which Peter the Painter has to complete the tasks given by the King. Everything takes place on one screen, keeping the action direct and easy to follow, while enemies ensure that the pressure never really lets up. Once the objectives are completed, the cycle begins again, but with greater resistance, making the challenge noticeably tougher. That steady balance between familiarity and rising danger is what gives the game its entertaining appeal.

meta.name: PET Checkers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.75 KB

Pet Checkers allows the player to play checkers against the computer. The standard international rules apply: taking turns the player may move any piece one tile diagonally as long as that tile is free. Normal pieces can only move towards the other player, but once a piece reaches the other side of the board, it is crowned and can from then on move in both directions. Pieces can be hit by being jumped over. The first player to lose all pieces loses the game. The game keeps track of the time and uses field number input to determine moves. This game was originally created for the Commodore PET computer, but as it could also be run on later Commodore Machines, they were some of the first games available for the new platform.

meta.name: Petch II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.17 KB

In Petch II you control a penguin through icy mazes just like in the original, but at double speed. This ROM hack ups the pace and raises the challenge. Dodge enemies, crush them with ice blocks, and earn bonus points by aligning diamonds in rows. Defeat four enemies in one minute for extra rewards. Touching an enemy costs a life and resets the maze – quick reflexes and sharp planning are now more critical than ever.

meta.name: Peter Beardsley's International Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.57 KB

"Peter Beardsley's International Football" presents the action in a side-view perspective and focuses on a European Championship tournament. The player can select eight teams from 26 European nations, including some that no longer exist today. Two players may face off in tournament matches, though there is no direct option for a dedicated two-player game. Shot power varies depending on how long the fire button is held, while ball physics are unconventional, with the ball always bouncing back in the direction it came from. Goalkeepers remain on the goal line rather than utilizing the entire penalty area.

meta.name: Peter Pack Rat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Peter Pack Rat you control a junkyard rat who enjoys collecting objects around his home. Your goal is to gather a certain number of items scattered across the yard and bring them back to Peter's hideout to complete the level. The game is viewed from the side as you move across platforms, climb ladders and travel through pipes to reach new areas. Along the way you collect various objects such as keys and other items, and you can even swim across water sections. Enemies roam and fly around the area trying to hurt Peter, but you can avoid them or shoot them to stun them for a short time.

meta.name: Peter Shilton's Handball Maradona
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.50 KB

Rather than attempting to simulate the whole of football, this title concentrated on the goalkeeper's task of saving shots. In each match you will face a succession of shots from different distances and angles, and aim to save as many as possible. 16 teams were included for you to select your team and opposition from. There's a practice mode, and a skill challenge, where you move up through the game by saving 4 successive shots. The C64 version has a little sampled speech and extra sound.

meta.name: The Pettigrew Chronicles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 147.96 KB

En The Pettigrew Chronicles, te pondrás en la piel del agente secreto Rupert Pettigrew, encargado de encontrar a cinco agentes desaparecidos y la legendaria espada Safras. La misión se desarrolla en cuatro partes: La Búsqueda, El Regreso, El Descubrimiento y La Conclusión. Experimentarás una mezcla de exploración, espionaje y aventura clásica. Combinando elementos del Diario de Pettigrew y la Operación Safras, el juego ofrece una historia de espionaje unificada, llena de puzles, giros inesperados y pistas ocultas.

meta.name: Phaedra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, you have to stack polygons raining down from above as orderly as possible, with the faces exactly matching and not leaving too many spaces between each piece. If a horizontal line has no spaces, it disappears, making the figure tower lower and giving you more time to think. Quit the game when your lock reaches the top of the screen. If you complete 150 lines you will advance to the next level: if you complete 3, 4 or 5 lines in a row you will receive bonus pieces to fill in the gaps created. You can think about where you want to place the piece and see the next piece in line at the top left.

meta.name: Phalsberg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Phalsberg takes you to the small planet of Kalvor, where a once peaceful kingdom has fallen into chaos after the overthrow of King Philoxal. After Blackstar seizes power and scatters the royal attributes across the continent, a dangerous search begins for the crown, the scarab, and the golden sceptre. The open world invites you to explore new places step by step, follow clues, and stand against the threat of the new regime. That mix of classic power struggle, grand journey, and mysterious artifacts gives the adventure its appealing fantasy character.

The island of Gelnor has been taken over by The Black Knights, who demand sacrifices and homage as they travel from town to town. Defeat them and their master, Nikademus! meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.45 KB

In “Phantasmagoria,” the player solves unusual puzzles to find their way to the princess, who is destined to save them. The game flips traditional roles on their head and presents creative and unexpected challenges, especially toward the end.

meta.name: Phantom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.39 KB

“Phantom” is a skill-based game in the style of “Skramble,” but without any shooting – the focus is entirely on dodging. The player pilots a jet through a hazardous landscape filled with vertically launched missiles, which must be avoided with quick reflexes and precise movements. Progressing safely earns points, but a single mistake can lead to disaster. With no weapons to rely on, survival is all about maneuvering – a game that puts reflexes and concentration to the test.

meta.name: Phantom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Phantom” is a top-down maze action game where you play as a professor tasked with cleansing four cursed buildings of ghosts, monsters, and hellish portals. Armed with a laser, you fight through four floors per building, keeping an eye on energy and fuel while collecting keys, bombs, and other power-ups. The goal is to clear each floor before moving on to the next – a fast-paced battle for survival against the supernatural.

meta.name: Phantoms of the Asteroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.95 KB

Phantoms of the Asteroid throws you into a desperate rescue mission: a massive asteroid is heading for Earth, and only by locating 36 uranium cubes and bringing them to a single collection point can disaster be avoided. Using your jetpack, you explore the maze-like interior of the rock while your fuel and oxygen steadily run low, forcing you to rely on scattered refill stations. Force fields block your path but can be briefly disabled by standing on the correct control pads. Phantom creatures home in on your position, disappearing on contact while draining your energy, and hazards like fire, spikes and toxic plants punish every moment of carelessness. You push forward cube by cube, balancing danger and caution, until all 36 pieces are finally secured.

meta.name: Pharaoh
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.51 KB

Pharaoh is a platformer that puts the player in the role of a hero who battles through various levels inspired by ancient Egyptian architecture. The player must overcome obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect power-ups to progress. The game uses some sprites from the title Myth, suggesting similar gameplay mechanics and design elements, but is set in an Egyptian-themed world. It offers a typical platformer experience with multiple screens and a variety of enemies and traps to overcome.

meta.name: Pharaoh's Curse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.87 KB

In Pharaoh's Curse you play an adventurer entering an ancient pyramid rumored to hold the pharaoh's legendary treasure. For thousands of years the tomb has been considered a deadly trap filled with dangers. As you explore the chambers you must avoid traps and enemies, including the guardian mummy said to roam the corridors forever. Only by moving carefully and reacting quickly can you venture deeper into the pyramid, collect treasure and escape the tomb alive.

meta.name: Pharaoh's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pharaoh's Revenge blends fast-paced chases with tricky maze-solving, creating constant pressure. As you navigate complex paths, you must also evade an opponent who is always trying to corner you. Only by solving the maze correctly do you reach safety, turning each round into a race against time. A large number of levels and the ability to create your own stages add plenty of variety and long-term appeal.

meta.desc:

Phase 4 delivers straightforward space action, sending you through several stages full of constantly respawning alien ships in your fighter craft. Each area comes with its own backdrop, from alien pyramids and the darkness of space to an extraterrestrial city, before the finale shifts sideways across a built-up zone. To progress, you need to shoot down enough enemies, giving the game a clear and direct rhythm. Once the run is complete, the required number of hits increases, making the push toward the next stage increasingly demanding.

meta.name: Phase Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.48 KB

Phase Out places you in a series of abstract challenges built around mystical spheres and shifting patterns where every move must be considered carefully. You progress through many sequences, dismantling arrangements and using the unique properties of each element to open the path forward. Beneath its minimal presentation lies a steadily increasing challenge that rewards planning, patience and understanding of the mechanics. The dark narrative backdrop gives the puzzles extra weight, making each solved sequence feel like another step toward a vast cosmic ambition.

Only precise joystick control will keep you on course and guide you safely through the narrow passages. Every touch is fatal, fuel is limited – full focus is needed if you want to escape this deadly maze.

meta.name: Phileas Fogg's Balloon Battles

Phileas Fogg's Balloon Battles puts you in the role of Phileas Fogg, who interrupts his world journey to aid the Allies. Flying in a hot-air balloon, you map enemy territory, locate huts, and drop bombs. You control height and direction with wind, gas, and sandbags while dodging obstacles and cannon fire from Musketeers. As the day grows longer and warmer, the balloon reacts more unpredictably, making the challenge even tougher.

meta.name: Philippic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.32 KB

Philippic turns colors and test tubes into a surprisingly tricky logic puzzle where you have to build the correct combination step by step. You control a mechanism that picks up colors and places them onto stacks, while additional hidden layers of colored compartments reveal themselves as you progress. This quickly creates a complex chain of decisions that requires careful planning and attention. That blend of strategy, timing, and hidden information gives the game its challenging appeal.

meta.name: PHM Pegasus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

PHM Pegasus es una combinacion de juego de simulación y acción. Controlas un bote de misiles de hidroala naval y necesitas completar una variedad de misiones diferentes. Algunas de las misiones incluyen destruir todas las naves enemigas en un área determinada, la vigilancia requiere que identifique la ubicación de las naves enemigas (¡sin hundirlas!), O escoltar una nave de suministro a través de territorio hostil. A medida que las misiones se completan con éxito, ganas puntos según el éxito de la misión, y con el aumento de puntos puedes avanzar en rango, desde el trapeador hasta el almirante. 
Tu desempeño en una misión no afectará a las futuras, y también puedes elegir jugar misiones fuera de orden. Varias misiones incluyen otras naves que puedes controlar para ayudar (tanto barcos como helicópteros). Se incluye un modo de compresión de tiempo, que se puede usar para reducir la cantidad de tiempo de espera para llegar a un destino, o incluso dejarlo activado para que las secuencias de acción sean más desafiantes.

PHU is built around an extremely direct reaction-based idea: you have one minute to shoot as many Psychoballs as possible. This creates instant pressure, because every hit counts and every missed moment can make the difference. The simple concept becomes especially appealing when competing with friends, where it all comes down to speed and accuracy. The result is a short, frantic game made for quick rounds and straightforward score chasing.

meta.name: Physics Test : 'O' and 'A' Level

Physics Test - 'O' and 'A' Level turns exam preparation into a clear multiple-choice exercise built around physics questions. The tasks are selected at random, so each round can feel a little different and works well for repeated practice. After every answer, you receive immediate feedback and score points, giving the otherwise sober learning program a small playful incentive. The result is a simple but useful knowledge quiz for focused study.

meta.name: Pi. R Squared
meta.desc:

In Pi. R Squared you guide a sphere across interconnected cogs, collecting parts of a formula in the correct sequence. You switch between cogs at their meeting points, avoiding enemies while carefully managing movement: hold a key to move slowly against the cog's direction, or release to move faster with it. You only see a section of the puzzle at a time, so timing, awareness, and planning are crucial to solve this intricate mechanical challenge.

meta.name: Pick'n Pile
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.65 KB

Pick 'n Pile is a Tetris-style puzzle game. On each level there are a variety of symbols arranged in columns on the screen. By moving the symbols around, you need to create columns which contain identical symbols; once all the symbols in a column are the same, that column disappears. Your goal is to earn points and complete the levels by making all of the symbols on the screen disappear. Occasionally, you may become stuck with a symbol that doesn't match anything onscreen; when this happens, you can call for an additional symbol to drop onto the screen. However, as the symbol which appears is random you may need to create quite a few symbols before the one you need appears. Each level has a time limit in which it needs to be completed; run out of time and you lose a life; lose all lives and the game is over.
In addition to the regular symbols, there are also some special objects on the screen which may help or hinder your progress. These include bombs which destroy several symbols at once, blocks which may get in the way or be arranged to help out, death heads which diminish time more quickly, and flower pots which can't be moved.

meta.name: Picture Kingdom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.61 KB

Picture Kingdom lets you manage a kingdom turn by turn, making decisions about land trade, grain rations, and planting. You must feed your people, ensure good harvests, and manage your resources wisely, while random events may disrupt your plans. The simple graphics don't change the classic gameplay – every decision matters as you try to lead your realm to success.

meta.name: Picture This
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Picture This combines early language learning with a simple, image-supported storytelling environment. Young players see scenes and terms that help them recognize words, expand their vocabulary, and connect language with pictures in a playful way. The calm presentation and story-like framing make the learning feel accessible and less dry. The result is a friendly educational program that brings together imagination, word understanding, and curiosity.

meta.name: Pieces
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pieces puts your logical thinking to the test by challenging you to combine identical shapes in a clever way. The objective is to place matching elements side by side or remove them at the same time so they disappear from the board. A single stranded piece can halt all progress, making careful planning essential. The appeal lies in its simple rules and the increasing challenge of ensuring that every move avoids an unsolvable situation.

meta.name: Pile Up
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pile Up you must arrange boxes on a manufacturing line into the correct order. Your task is to move all boxes from the left side to the right side, while the required final sequence is shown beneath the line. The middle area can be used as a buffer, so you need to use it cleverly to store boxes temporarily and sort them into the proper order. At the same time the clock is always ticking, which means you must not only think logically but also act quickly. The game combines puzzle-solving with time pressure and demands a good sense for sequencing and efficient reordering.

meta.name: Pile-Up
meta.desc:

Energy reserves on Earth are scarce and more energy is urgently needed to keep the planet running. In a remote corner of the universe, various landscapes filled with spheres have been discovered that will keep Earth's energy levels high. Your task is to fly over the landscape in a special ship to collect the balls and place them in a transformer that will send them to Earth.

meta.name: Pilgrim
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.72 KB

Legend has it that deep in a mountain in the land of Meridan lies a Guardian who is believed to be eternal and would provide help to the people in their darkest need. The Guardian is needed now as Silvian have invaded Meridan once again, destroying everything and killing people with new and strange weapons. You have decided to test the legend of the Guardian by exploring the lands ahead to find the mountain that contains the Guardian.

meta.name: Pill-Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.06 KB

Pill-Box turns falling pills and stubborn viruses into an addictive matching game where reaction and planning go hand in hand. You place capsules so that matching colors connect and the germs gradually disappear. The fuller the playfield becomes, the more important overview, quick decisions, and a bit of strategy become. That mix of a simple concept, rising pressure, and satisfying cleanup gives the game its lasting appeal.

meta.name: Pilot 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.23 KB

Pilot 64 puts you in the cockpit of a propeller aircraft at night and turns a flight from Norwich Airport into a focused exercise in takeoff, navigation, and safe return. Before departure, you set wind and fuel, study the map, and keep an eye on restricted zones and hazards. In the air, numerous instruments help you judge speed, altitude, heading, and distance correctly. That mix of preparation, instrument flying, and careful landing gives the game its calm but demanding simulation appeal.

meta.name: Pinball 9
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.05 KB

Flipper 9 resembles a slot machine where you have to bounce a coin from the side of the machine into holes at the back. Flipper 9 has nine holes, and you have 15 coins to fill all the holes. Only the force of the bounce determines where the coin lands.

meta.name: Pinball Construction Set
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pinball Construction Set lets you build your own custom pinball machine from the ground up. Drop bumpers, ramps, spinners, and targets onto the table, paint your own signs, tweak gravity, bounce, speed, and strength to your liking. Bonus mechanics can be wired up with a few clicks. You can save your creations—or even compile a fully standalone version to share with friends who don't own the original program. It's a game for anyone who prefers to hold the hammer themselves.

meta.name: Pinball Spectacular
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pinball Spectacular delivers a quirky mix of pinball and breakout on a retro-styled digital table. Using paddle controls, you launch a square-cut ball across bumpers, logos, target letters, and spinners, trying to score big before your three balls run out. Side traps and a timed ball barrier add extra unpredictability. And when idle, the game puts on a little demo show for you.

meta.name: Pinball Wizard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.45 KB

En Pinball Wizard hay una sola mesa, con 2 sets de flippers y 4 bumpers en cada lado, lo que permite múltiples rebotes. Encima de estos hay otro set de bumpers (que no aportan puntuación), cada uno de los cuales tiene una letra en la parte superior con la palabra 'Sagitario, si se completan, obtendrás un bonus. También se mantiene una bonificación acumulativa, que aumenta en incrementos de 50, se proporcionan bonus fijos, y al tocar en las zonas 'hi' con suficiente frecuencia se aumenta el valor de los bumpers.

meta.name: Pinfaball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.78 KB

In Pinfaball, you must roll a ball through a wall of spinning obstacles to reach the exit on the right side of the screen. Precision is key, as the moving objects appear randomly and can knock you out of the game at any moment. One wrong move sends you back to the start – a true challenge for patience and reflexes.

meta.name: Ping-Pong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

De la máquina recreativa de Konami, Ping Pong recrea el trepidante tenis de mesa. Para ganar cada partido, debes llegar a 10 puntos con una ventaja de 2 puntos. Si el marcador llega a 10-9, el juego continúa hasta que alguien tenga una ventaja de 2 puntos o llegue a 15, de forma similar al tenis. Hay nueve niveles de dificultad, que aumentan a medida que avanza el juego. El jugador tiene la ventaja de sacar primero, y como el saque se revierte cada cinco puntos, tienes garantizadas más oportunidades de sacar que tu oponente (recuerda la importancia del 10 y el 15 en la puntuación). El sistema de puntos recompensa los intercambios largos y los grandes márgenes de victoria, ya que obtienes puntos por cada golpe, por cada punto ganado y por cada punto de margen de victoria.

meta.name: Ping-Pong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.67 KB

"Ping-Pong" is a classic version of table tennis where two players or one player against the computer compete. Players can adjust various settings such as background color, paddle color, and ball speed. The goal is to hit the ball past the opponent to score points. The minimalist design and simple customization options provide a timeless gaming experience.

meta.name: Pingo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.41 KB

Pingo puts you in control of a little penguin navigating an icy maze, pushing blocks to crush enemies or clear paths. Your goal is to defeat all Snoobys before time runs out. Clearly based on Pengo, the game delivers classic arcade action with fast reflexes and retro charm.

meta.name: Pink Panther
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The goal of the game is to help Pink Panther guide his sleepwalking employer through his house without waking him up. To help you in this, Panther can use various items, such as a little bell, which he can use to attract the sleeping man.
The game is a sidescrolling adventure and takes mostly place in the house of the employer. Pink Panther can himself move freely in the house, but at the same time he needs to keep his eye on the sleepwalker, so that he can prevent him from stumbling on various objects, such as rugs and tables.
Before each level you can purchase different kind of objects from a store. These items can be used to gently lure the sleeping man in the right path.

meta.name: Pipe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.06 KB

Pipe offers a fast pipe-building puzzle made for short sessions, where you have to connect your starting point to the target station. You choose the needed pipe pieces from the side and place them directly, while the computer works on its own connection at the same time. Since the two pipe networks do not block each other, success mainly depends on speed, overview, and choosing the right piece at the right moment. One wrongly placed part can ruin the entire round, giving the simple concept immediate tension.

meta.name: Pipe Dream
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En este rompecabezas abstracto, cada nivel te reta a armar una red de tuberías para que el flooz —una sustancia misteriosa— fluya por la mayor extensión posible. Las piezas aparecen al azar: hay siete tipos: tramos rectos (horizontal/vertical), curvas en las cuatro direcciones y cruces que permiten flujo simultáneo en ambos ejes. Todas admiten entrada por cualquier lado. Cuando el flooz encuentra un extremo abierto o una pieza incompatible con la anterior, la tubería se cierra y se puntúa según su longitud. Planificación rápida, adaptación constante y decisiones bajo presión: cada conexión cuenta, y un giro mal colocado puede cortar el flujo… y tus esperanzas. Elegante, adictivo y sorprendentemente profundo.

meta.name: Pipeline Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pipeline Run uses a familiar but effective core idea, putting you in control of a pipeline that moves through underground tunnels to collect oil while constantly avoiding approaching dangers. Its appeal comes from the balance between pushing forward and pulling back, because you not only have to navigate carefully but also judge exactly when to attack enemies and when caution matters more. Time pressure, the need to clear every field completely, and the risk of overload all help turn this simple concept into a surprisingly tense and gripping action challenge.

meta.name: Pipes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.02 KB

Pipes challenges you to design a working water supply network for a neighborhood. With a limited budget, you must find the shortest and most efficient way to connect houses to the system by choosing the right pipe types and placing them wisely. Every decision matters, as mistakes cost money and complicate progress – the more houses you aim to connect, the tougher the challenge becomes and the more careful planning is required.

meta.name: Piracy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.21 KB

Piracy is a neat, aesthetically stylish pseudo-board game, based upon the checkers concept. However, it definitely has some novel differences which make for an entertaining experience. One of these is the 17th Century naval setting, with the opposing galleons of Black Pete the pirate, versus Captain Carlos of the Spanish Armada. Each opposing ship has 15 troops (checkers) laying in wait in the cannon bays, ready to pounce out onto the "game board". Each of the five cannons bays has three troops. You have the option to play as Captain Carlos or Black Pete.

El objetivo del juego es encontrar los dos tesoros piratas en la isla del tesoro. Before the game starts you can select from three crafts to pilot.

meta.name: Pirates Of The Barbary Coast
meta.desc:

De vuelta a su barco tras hacer negocios en el puerto, el capitán Articus se entera de que su barco ha sido atacado y que su hija Katherine ha sido secuestrada por el pirata Bloodthroat. Exige un rescate de 50.000 monedas de oro en un plazo de treinta días o la venderá.
Debes liberar a la niña de las garras de los viles piratas de la Costa Berberisca pagando el rescate. Afortunadamente, tienes un mapa del tesoro y eres un mercader experimentado.
Comienzas el juego en el puerto de Casablanca. Puedes elegir un destino o visitarlo. En general, todos los puertos tienen el mismo aspecto. Hay un comerciante, un muelle de reparación de barcos y una tienda. La principal diferencia entre los puertos es el precio de las mercancías. Tu principal objetivo es comprar barato y vender caro. Empiezas el juego con 5000 monedas de oro.

meta.name: Pirates!
meta.desc:

¡Juega como un bucanero en la época dorada de la piratería en el Caribe! Este juego te permite elegir entre 6 "épocas" diferentes (por ejemplo, "El Imperio de Plata" de 1560 a 1600, "La Guerra por el Beneficio" de 1640 a 1660, etc.), una de 4 nacionalidades (inglesa, francesa, holandesa, española), 4 niveles de dificultad y una de 5 habilidades especiales (habilidad de esgrima, habilidad de navegación, etc.) Están representados 9 tipos de barcos diferentes.
El objetivo del juego es retirarse con la mayor cantidad posible de oro y tierras, el mayor número posible de rangos/títulos (coronel, almirante, marqués, duque) y una esposa. Estos objetivos se consiguen saqueando ciudades, capturando y hundiendo barcos enemigos, quedando bien con los gobernadores para recibir títulos, obteniendo información de los "malvados españoles" que retienen a tus familiares, capturando a malvados piratas, etc.

meta.name: The Pit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.91 KB

The Pit sends you underground after your spaceship lands, tasking you with digging through a maze of tunnels while danger lurks everywhere. Falling rocks, creatures, traps, and corrosive hazards force careful movement and quick decisions, as every step can be the wrong one. Instead of a traditional timer, a machine slowly destroys the area around your ship, meaning staying below for too long can cut off your escape. After collecting the treasure, the most dangerous section awaits: a room with a shifting floor above a hungry monster that must be crossed at the right moment – a tense balance between risk, timing, and exploration.

meta.name: Pit-Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pit-Fighter es un juego de lucha en tercera persona que presenta gráficos digitalizados de luchadores reales y efectos de zoom. Los jugadores seleccionan uno de los tres luchadores (Buzz, Ty o Kato) para enfrentarse a cualquiera que se atreva. Al final de un partido, los jugadores reciben individualmente un Bono de Eliminación, un Bono de Brutalidad y un Monedero de Lucha. Cada tercer partido es un Grudge Match donde los jugadores prueban las habilidades de los demás. El último hombre en pie es el ganador de este partido de tres derribos. Los jugadores se abren camino hacia el combate de eliminación para decidir quién gana la oportunidad de destronar al campeón, el guerrero enmascarado.

meta.name: Pitfall!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.59 KB

Pitfall! es una aventura clásica de plataformas donde encarnas a Harry, el Explorador, en su incursión por la selva en busca de tesoros: lingotes de oro, plata, bolsas de dinero y anillos de diamantes. Pero la jungla no perdona: troncos rodantes y caídas restan puntos; escorpiones, cocodrilos, serpientes, fuegos, pantanos y pozos sin fondo te cuestan una vida. Tienes solo 20 minutos para recogerlo todo. Cada salto, cada cuerda columpiante, cada decisión debe ser precisa. Porque aquí no basta con ser valiente: hay que ser ágil, rápido… y tener un poco de suerte. ¿Lograrás salir de la selva rico… o serás solo otro explorador olvidado entre las lianas?
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Pitfall II : Lost Caverns
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.50 KB

Juegas como Pitfall Harry en busca del diamante de Raj, su sobrina Rhonda y tesoros en algún lugar de los Andes. Ranas venenosas, anguilas, escorpiones, murciélagos y otros peligros se interponen en tu camino. Pitfall II es la secuela de Pitfall, el juego de plataformas original. El modo de juego sigue siendo prácticamente el mismo: cada pantalla presenta una vista lateral de los obstáculos que hay que superar y los posibles tesoros que hay que recoger. A lo largo del camino hay puntos de control. Al morir, Harry Pitfall es enviado de vuelta al último punto de control cruzado.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Pitstop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.93 KB

Pitstop combines high-speed racing with an extra twist that gives the game its distinctive character: you not only have to drive fast, but also keep an eye on tire wear and fuel so you know exactly when to head into the pits. A large part of the tension comes from those pit stops, because you control the pit crew yourself and every second matters while the race keeps going around you. That blend of speed on the track, tactical timing, and frantic pit work gives the game a lively and unusually engaging appeal.

meta.name: Pitstop II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.89 KB

Compite en Fórmula 1 en varios circuitos intentando vencer a un ordenador o a un oponente humano. Ten cuidado con el combustible y los neumáticos: tendrás que hacer una parada en boxes para cambiarlos y repostar. El deterioro de los neumáticos se indica por su color, que es negro al principio y se va aclarando a medida que sufren daños. Una vez que se vuelven blancas, una colisión envía el coche fuera de la pista.
Seis circuitos diferentes están disponibles para la carrera, incluidos Brands Hatch y Vallelunga. Las pistas pueden jugarse por separado o todas juntas en un Gran Premio. Los jugadores pueden elegir cuántas vueltas quieren dar y 3 niveles de dificultad diferentes.

meta.name: Pixel City Skater
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pixel City Skater is a skill-based game where you guide a skateboarder through dangerous city streets using only one button. A single mistake means instant game over, demanding total focus and quick reflexes. The game features 59 levels as well as an endless mode, where survival is the only goal. With simple controls but rising difficulty, it offers a tough challenge that keeps pushing you to try again.

meta.name: Pixie Pete
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pixie Pete presents a single-screen, side-view playfield where you guide Pete through dirt tunnels to collect all the carrots. As you dig, tunnels are formed that enemies can move through even though they cannot dig on their own. Using an extendable pump, you can defeat them from a distance, but any direct contact immediately costs a life. Once all carrots are collected, the game advances to the next round, with a selectable starting point and steadily increasing challenge.

meta.name: Pizza
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.05 KB

Pizza turns delivery orders into a small coordinate and direction-learning game. You take orders, find the customer's position on the grid, and tell the driver how many streets to go right and how many to go up. Correct directions bring happy customers and money, while mistakes lead to complaints and cost you. Its appeal lies in the simple combination of map reading, counting, and quick orientation.

meta.name: Plane Combat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.82 KB

Plane Combat throws two players into the sky at the same time for fast-paced aerial duels. Each controls a plane, chasing the opponent, weaving through clouds, and trying to land the decisive shot. Reflexes, positioning, and clean flying determine who scores the next hit and who disappears from the screen. It's a pure head-to-head showdown where only the better pilot survives.

meta.name: Planet Attack
meta.desc:

A clone of Scramble, basically a horizontal shoot'em up where the player has to bombard the surface, avoid rockets and shoot enemies that in case of this game include flying toilets.

meta.name: Planet Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.19 KB

Welcome to Planet Force! Shoot the aliens before they reach the danger zone - the zone in where you fly! If you can't hit them in time, try to avoid them. After you have blasted one wave you will get a bonus - this will be score and a shield, activated by the spacebar. have fun playing!

meta.name: The Planet Miners
