Es el 1 de enero de 2050 y, tras décadas de investigación y desarrollo en el campo de los viajes espaciales, la humanidad está lista para viajar a los planetas del sistema solar para establecer bases mineras. El jugador tendrá que asegurarse valiosas concesiones mineras por todo el sistema solar, mientras el consejo minero ha estacionado naves patrulla por todo el sistema para asegurarse de que todo el mundo cumple las normas. Comienzan así varias semanas de intensa exploración, maniobras políticas, sabotajes y adjudicación de concesiones que decidirán el curso de la explotación económica del espacio exterior durante los próximos cien años.

meta.name: Planet of War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Planet of War takes place in the year 2350, a century after the alien PAO spacecraft completely conquered planet Nap. The invaders still rule, but now it's your turn to liberate the planet. Equipped with a heavily upgraded ship, you fly through enemy territory, dodge attacks, and deploy bombs and weapons to fight back. With radar, time limits, damage tracking, and limited bombs, you must stay sharp – one mistake, and Nap remains under alien control.

meta.name: Planet Popper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Planet Popper puts you in control of a small spaceship fighting off waves of colorful, attacking mini-planets. Blast them before they collide with you and rack up points with every hit. Quick reflexes are key in this simple yet addictive arcade shooter – it's all about survival and high scores in deep space.

meta.name: Planet Probe
meta.desc:

Planet Probe is an educational quiz that challenges you to identify the planets in our solar system based on visual clues like color, size, and position. With simple controls and a helpful hint system, it's perfect for young space enthusiasts or anyone looking to brush up on their planetary knowledge – a fun and informative journey through space.

meta.name: Planet Ranger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Planet Ranger, guías a un personaje parecido a un Pitufo por un paisaje alienígena de colinas y cráteres, muy al estilo de Moon Buggy. Saltas, esquivas y sobrevives en cada sector mientras controlas tu salud y tu progreso planetario. Curiosamente, tus vidas están etiquetadas como "naves", lo que añade un toque peculiar a esta versión de ciencia ficción de un clásico juego de desplazamiento lateral.

En Planets Defender, el jugador tiene la tarea de defender su planeta contra una flota de ovnis que se acerca. Además, el hiperimpulsor puede activarse para dar a los misiles un refuerzo de velocidad, pero esto hace que los controles sean más desafiantes. Los ovnis escapados regresan y aumentan la amenaza, mientras cada misil cuenta para salvar al planeta de la destrucción.

meta.name: Plaque Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.09 KB

“Plaque Man” is an educational action game about dental care. The player controls a toothbrush navigating a maze full of teeth, cleaning them from yellow to white. Meanwhile, plaque clusters chase the player, and contact with yellow teeth can create cavities that must be repaired by drilling and filling. Teeth that are too badly damaged fall out and appear at the bottom of the screen. The game ends if an entire row is filled or if all lives are lost due to contact with plaque. Fluoride toothpaste can provide temporary protection and slow down tooth decay.

meta.name: Plasma Bolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.38 KB

Plasma Bolt throws you into a fast-paced space shooter where dodging is just as important as shooting. Asteroids and mines drift across the screen – and hitting a mine ends the run instantly. At the same time, green plasma barriers power up ahead of you. To break through, you must shoot the side nodes of each barrier to open a passage. Timing, precision and steady movement determine how long you'll survive in this stream of hazards.

meta.name: Plasmatron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Plasmatron is a fast-paced shooter where the player takes on the role of a pilot who has been mistakenly sent to the hostile planet Loughton 2. Flying a Plasmatron fighter, you must evade and destroy incoming missiles and enemy ships to survive and achieve the highest possible score. By skillfully maneuvering and reacting quickly, players can dodge attacks while competing for a place on the high-score list. The game can be controlled via keyboard or joystick, and a pause function allows for breaks during longer missions.

meta.name: Plasto
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.93 KB

Plasto turns you into a pipe fitter and challenges you to build the longest possible connection between a starting point and an endpoint using given individual pieces. Step by step, you place suitable pipe shapes on the playfield and have to think carefully about how the line can be continued in a useful way. The more cleverly you use the pieces, the longer your construction becomes and the higher your score rises. This creates a calm puzzle game that combines planning, spatial thinking, and the satisfying appeal of a neatly completed connection.

meta.name: Plato's Cave
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Plato's Cave is an educational game for the Commodore 64. The player fires a laser from any position into the border of maze that can measure from 3 x 3 - 13 x 13. Within the maze there are user-defined number of hidden items including reflections to the right, reflections to the left, mirrors, positions that absorb, and simply empty squares. The player must determine the location and type of all items by firing a laser and determining its exit point. The player then receives a score based upon how accurately they define the maze. The game keeps track of entry and exit points, and can receive hints if stuck.

meta.name: Platoon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Platoon, basado en la película, te pone al mando de cinco soldados en Vietnam, intercambiándolos según pierdan vidas (cada uno resiste tres impactos).
Primero, un nivel lateral por la jungla: saltas, te agachas, cruzas caminos y destruyes un puente antes de hallar una aldea con antorcha, mapa y trampilla. Hay trampas y ataques aéreos —no solo enemigos en tierra.
Luego, una sección en 3D en primera persona por túneles, buscando bengalas y brújula. El control cambia: al detectar enemigos, usas una mira para disparar con precisión; al entrar en habitaciones, cambia de nuevo.
Después, defiendes un búnker de noche con bengalas limitadas para localizar y abatir enemigos antes de que te alcancen.
Sigue la secuencia del ataque aéreo: dos minutos para alcanzar una zona segura al norte, guiado por la brújula.
Finalmente, enfrentas al sargento Barnes desde una trinchera: debes impactarle cinco veces con granadas para derrotarlo.

In the space station on Vegatron, men work hard to earn their wages in the mercury mines. To entertain themselves, the miners have created a new game where contestants have to jump between squares wearing an antigravity jumpsuit.
The players control a bouncing ball on a field of tiles. The player selects the ball to bounce 1 or 2 tiles at a time in the cardinal directions. Certain colored tiles can temporarily speed up or slow down the ball bounce speed. If the player's ball goes out of the playing field or is hit by the opponent's ball, they lose a life. The goal is to tap all the squares of the player's color, and after tapping enough squares move to the next level.

meta.name: Play a Match
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.17 KB

"Play a Match" is a tennis game where players can compete against either the computer or a friend. The game is controlled via joystick, allowing for various settings, such as changing the court color or adjusting the difficulty level. Gameplay follows traditional tennis rules but omits the second serve to maintain a faster pace. Shot direction is determined by precise timing — hitting the button at different moments results in either a straight or angled shot. With practice, players can execute strategic shots to outplay their opponent.

meta.name: Play Bridge with Sheinwold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Play Bridge with Sheinwold teaches the fundamentals and nuances of bridge, based on the strategies and explanations of renowned author Alfred Sheinwold. Players can work through various scenarios, learning how to bid, play their cards effectively, and make cooperative decisions. The program is designed not only to explain the rules but also to build a deeper understanding of tactics and teamwork at the table.

meta.name: Play Golf - Ye Olde Course

Play Golf - Ye Olde Course takes place on a golf course set in the beautiful, rolling terrain of Roscommon County, Michigan. The course features a varied landscape, making the golfing experience both challenging and enjoyable. Players must contend with the natural features of the terrain to perfect their shots and achieve their goals.

Play Your Cards Right is a computer version of the British game show, first shown on ITV in 1980 and hosted by Bruce Forsyth. The game was divided into two parts: a question and then high/low playing with cards. A player is asked the question of how many out of 100 people gave a particular answer. The other player would then say whether the actual answer would be higher or lower. If the second player was wrong, the other player played the cards first and vice versa.

meta.name: Plazma Ball

Plazma Ball turns American football into a tactical turn-based contest where smart planning matters more than raw speed. Before kickoff, you arrange your team, then move individual athletes or several of them from round to round, block opponents, and set up calculated passes. Whether throws and clashes succeed depends on the abilities of those involved, giving every decision real weight. The result is a thoughtful sports game that blends football with strategy and long-term league competition.

meta.name: Plexonoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Plexonoid, you use a paddle and energy ball to break through 33 levels of blocks in a quest to rescue your friends trapped on the planet Gohdinia. Two billion years ago, the tyrant Gohd began his reign – now it's up to you to destroy his empire. Each cleared level brings you closer to your goal. Power-ups, clever block layouts, and a sci-fi setting give this Arkanoid-style game a unique twist.

meta.name: Plop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.80 KB

Plop puts you in control of a small plane and challenges you to destroy giant killer bees before they become a deadly threat. As the insects buzz across the screen, you dodge their movements and try to shoot them down with precision. The simple scenario quickly gains pace, as you constantly switch between attacking and evading. This creates a small, direct action game driven by quick reactions and the chase for the next hit.

meta.name: Plotting
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Originating in the arcades, Plotting involves several different types of blocks, bearing symbols such as squares, circles and crosses. Using a small yellow object to direct a block across onto a particular section of a shaped wall. It will then rebound onto a set of blocks at a particular angle, with the intention of removing similar blocks it touches. This is done against a time limit, and there are special blocks to help out with extra lives.

meta.name: Plug It!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.74 KB

A single-screen platformer that's pretty much inspired by games like Manic Miner and Jet-Set Willy.

meta.name: Plumb Crazy!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.94 KB

Plumb Crazy! puts you in the role of George the Plumber, who must prevent a hot water tank from exploding under strict time pressure. On a single screen, you connect pipe segments from a valve to the tank while pressure steadily rises and a bonus slowly drains away. You collect different pipe shapes, lay them freely, and must fix mistakes in time before both timer and pressure run out. Obstacles and roaming threats add extra tension, turning each round into a fast-paced test of planning and execution.

meta.name: Plundered Hearts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Plundered Hearts está ambientada a finales del siglo XVII, donde llevas la vida refinada de una joven y bella inglesa. Te has enterado de que tu amado padre está enfermo, así que viajas a las Indias Occidentales para cuidar de él. Al principio de la historia, el barco en el que viajas es atacado por piratas y tú eres secuestrada por el elegante capitán pirata. Pero eso no te disuade de tu determinación de encontrar a tu padre. Por el camino, te encontrarás con peligros, aventuras... y romances.

meta.name: Plural
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Plural sends you into a fast space battle where you fight through enemy formations and dangerous projectiles. As groups of opponents appear and the screen keeps scrolling sideways, you need to fire accurately and dodge skillfully to stay alive. The clear arcade focus creates an immediate flow without unnecessary detours. This results in a brisk shooter driven by speed, constant fire, and the chase for the next successful hit.

meta.name: Plutonium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.24 KB

In Plutonium you control a grid of atoms, each with 2 to 4 electrons depending on its position. All start out gray and neutral. One player colors an electron red, the other responds with their own placement. Once an atom is fully colored, it explodes, spreading color to neighboring atoms and overtaking opposing electrons. The exploded atom returns to neutral. By placing electrons strategically, you can trigger chain reactions to clear the field in one powerful move. Colored atoms can't be selected again.

meta.name: Pneumatic Hammers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.89 KB

Red alert! The gold prospecting base in Lee Valley is under threat of destruction. The power plant is out of control and there is no other option than to disconnect the pneumatic hammers from the power plant. The hammers have been installed in the bridge piers over the river. The prolonged action of the overactive hammers is causing landslides that are increasingly endangering the base. Red O'Blair, a famous doer of the impossible, is hastily called in to save what can still be saved. Your task is to help Red build a new lever out of the only metal available, gold. To create the lever, nuggets of very pure quality and large quantity are required...

meta.name: Pocket Rockets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pocket Rockets puts the thrill of drag racing right on your screen. You can ride one of four available machines – Suzuki Katana, Kawasaki Ninja, Yamaha FZR or Honda Hurricane – and compete either against the clock or existing records. Instead of traditional circuit racing, the focus here is on acceleration, perfect gear shifts and precise timing to push your bike to the finish line and set new records.

meta.name: Pod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.54 KB

In Pod you guide the small hero on his quest to retrieve the stolen Magic Orb. A dragon has raided the village and taken the artifact once brought by Pod's grandfather – now it's up to you to save the village. The game scrolls sideways as you move through forests, collect diamonds, and avoid deadly obstacles. But Pod can't walk – he moves only by jumping. By alternating the up and down controls, you charge the jump gauge, allowing longer leaps the more it's filled. Along the way, birds and club-wielding giants threaten to drain your magic bar, and when it's empty, you lose one of your three lives. Touching fences or water, however, means instant death.

meta.name: P.O.D. : Proof of Destruction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In P.O.D.: Proof of Destruction you pilot a small spaceship across a grid that represents your civilization's power network. Movement is restricted to the four main directions along the grid lines while aliens fire relentlessly from every angle – no spot is truly safe. Their shots temporarily cut sections of the grid, limiting your movement until the lines reform. Every fourth stage switches things up with a bonus round focused purely on blasting enemies for extra points, though danger still lurks. Across 25 challenging levels, you must survive until the timer runs out. You begin with three lives, earning one extra per completed level (up to five), but time never resets after losing a life.

meta.name: Poga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Poga moves through a strange mechanical world using nothing but bouncing, turning every stretch into a small test of skill. Spinning nuts, electromagnetic coils, and flying robot birds make the journey more dangerous, while the constant hopping puts increasing strain on his mechanical body. To keep going, you collect oil cans and try to push your score higher at the same time. Poga blends precise control, rising danger, and an unusual way of moving into a charmingly distinctive adventure.

meta.name: Pogo Joe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pogo Joe has you bouncing across barrels, gradually changing every field to the required color. Unlike its obvious inspiration, the playfields are more varied, and the barrels themselves come with different properties. Enemies make the recoloring task more difficult, but super jumps and special colored barrels give you valuable advantages. The result is a lively skill game that builds on familiar ideas and pleasantly expands them with its own twists.
meta.developer: William F. Denman Jr., Oliver Steele

meta.name: Pogo Stick
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.85 KB

Pogo Stick challenges the player to bounce through maze-like levels, fixing broken bricks and collecting bonuses while avoiding obstacles and enemies. The game is time-based – all bricks must be repaired before the hourglass runs out to advance to the next level.

meta.name: Pogo Stick Olympics
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.19 KB

Pogo Stick Olympics throws you into a quirky sports tournament where every event is performed on a pogo stick. Five challenges await: in Balloon Popping you jump high to burst balloons in the air, in the 110m Hurdles precise timing is crucial, the Triple Jump has you pop a balloon, clear a hurdle, and leap far into the sandbox. Target Practice tests your aim with darts at moving circles, and in the Obstacle Course you must dodge or use obstacles to reach the finish. Each event awards points – only by scoring enough can you move on to the next stage.

meta.name: Pogotron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.97 KB

Pogotron is a side-scrolling platformer where the player bounces across different planets on a Turbo-Pogo to find missing parts of their spacecraft. Each planet starts at a protected landing pad, where six ship parts must be delivered. Hostile creatures and laser traps act as obstacles that can either be avoided or destroyed. Hits deplete the energy bar, and when it reaches zero, the player loses a life but keeps any collected parts. After assembling the spacecraft, fuel pellets must be gathered to leave the planet. Between worlds, a mini-game challenges the player to defeat a guardian.

meta.name: PoInG!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.22 KB

In PoInG! you face off in a two-player twist on the classic Pong. Each player controls a paddle and tries to hit the ball past the opponent into their goal. Special field elements add extra unpredictability, making every rally more exciting. The first player to reach 9 points claims victory.

meta.name: Point X
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.26 KB

In Point X you take on the role of a mercenary tasked with flying your spacecraft over a planet's surface to destroy Point X. This vertical-scrolling shooter spans ten levels where you must fend off waves of alien ships while bombing ground installations using a targeting sight. Some bases will fire back, and each hit reduces your damage bar – once it reaches zero, it's game over.

meta.name: Poker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.11 KB

Poker is a poker game set in a Wild West saloon. You start with $1000 and face six computer opponents: Matt Dillon, Black Jake, The Mayor, Billy the Kid, Joshua Smith and Doc Holliday. Moll the barmaid is on hand to offer advice if needed. The game uses classic 5-card poker rules. After the deal, each player antes $1, with raises doubling the last bet. Players may discard up to three cards to improve their hand before a second betting round. Then the hands are revealed. The goal is to win all your opponents' money – or lose all of yours.

meta.name: Poker Sam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.70 KB

Pokersam is a take on 5-card stud with a unique twist. The computer opponent Sam doesn't just deal the cards but also adds humor, personality, and even voice to the game. With a good poker face and the right choices, you'll need to take on Sam at the table and prove you're a true poker ace.

meta.name: Polar Pierre
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Polar Pierre is a single-screen platformer where you guide Pierre to raise all the flags in each level. Along the way you'll face hazards such as lightning, snowball shooters, and electric generators that must be avoided. Helpful items like springboards, lifts, and bridge builders assist your progress. Be careful not to fall too far, as long drops or touching obstacles cost one of your three lives. Once all flags are raised, head to the finish to move on to the next level.

meta.name: Pole Position
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.43 KB

Pole Position puts you in control of a Formula 1 car, where you first must prove yourself in a qualifying lap. Only by finishing within the time limit will you secure a spot in the Grand Prix – the faster your lap, the better your starting position and the higher your bonus. Once the race begins, you compete not only against rival cars but also against the relentless race timer. Every car you pass earns extra points, along with distance bonuses. Fail to reach the checkpoint in time and it's game over – but cross the finish line and you'll be rewarded with valuable bonus points for remaining time and overall performance.

meta.name: Pole Position II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.74 KB

Pole Position II es la secuela arcade de Pole Position, donde vuelves a conducir un coche de F-1 en carreras de clasificación cronometrada, intentando conseguir la pole position. Luego comienza la carrera, con la esperanza de hacerse con el primer puesto. La diferencia entre Pole Position II y su predecesor es que ahora tienes cuatro pistas para elegir.

meta.name: ZZZ(notgame):Police Academy
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.80 KB

meta.name: Police Academy II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.77 KB

Police Academy II is a tongue-in-cheek simulation game featuring a series of training lessons and shooting exercises for aspiring law enforcement professionals. Players must dodge bullets, recognize targets, and demonstrate their skills through a variety of entertaining challenges.

meta.name: Police Cadet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The player takes on the role of a police candidate who is training to become an officer. On the screen, numerous people walk back and forth between the doors of a seemingly busy subway station. The player controls the crosshairs and must quickly shoot all criminals with a gun before they disappear into another door. The player must be careful not to shoot innocent people. At the bottom of the screen, a police scanner tracks recent criminal events and the remaining time in the training session. At the end of each session, the player receives a score based on criminals and innocents shot.

meta.name: Polonäse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.75 KB

“Polonäse” is a quirky and fast-paced action game full of humor, where you control an ever-growing conga line through a tight space. The goal is to collect as many dancing figures as possible without crashing into the walls or your own tail. Each new follower makes your line longer – and harder to control. A countdown timer adds pressure, while colorful graphics and a grinning dancing cop on the side crank up the chaos. A unique cult-style game that challenges your reflexes and spatial awareness.

meta.name: Poltergeist
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.96 KB

Poltergeist puts you in command of an exorcist spacecraft as you battle through 32 dangerous levels. Your mission is to destroy the generators – flashing boxes – and use teleport pads to advance to the next stage. Along the way, you'll face relentless minions of the Poltergeist. Collecting Power Transmuters upgrades your weapons, giving you stronger ways to fight back. In addition to standard shots, you can unleash a powerful freak bomb to clear threats. Different weapons can be activated with key presses as you maneuver through the side-scrolling battlefield, bringing you closer step by step to the final confrontation with the Poltergeist.

meta.name: The Pond
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.84 KB

The Pond is an educational game that teaches numbers, logic, and patterns through playful exploration. You help a small frog cross a pond full of lily pads by choosing the direction and number of hops for each move. The goal is to discover the correct sequence that guides the frog safely to the far side. You'll need to plan ahead, avoid dead ends, and test alternate routes. With six levels of difficulty, this colorful challenge offers rewarding brainwork for players of all ages.

meta.name: Pong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.12 KB

El primer videojuego comercial, que fue un éxito, fue Pong. Es una simulación de tenis de mesa para dos jugadores, similar a Tennis for Two. El desarrollador de este juego de computadora fue el estadounidense Ralph H. Baer en 1968, en su prototipo Brown Box (más tarde Magnavox Oddysey). Nolan Bushnell en Atari usó esto como inspiración para crear el gabinete arcade para Pong. Se hizo inmensamente popular, y desde entonces fue portado a la mayoría de las plataformas, sobre todo al Atari 2600. También llegó a la mayoría de los primeros ordenadores domésticos, como el Apple II y, por supuesto, el Commodore 64.

meta.name: Pontoon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.32 KB

In Pontoon, you play against the computer aiming to reach as close to 21 as possible without going over. A "Pontoon" – an Ace with a Ten or face card – beats everything, even a five-card trick. With a mix of luck, risk-taking, and smart choices, you try to beat the computer's hand and play your cards just right.

meta.name: Pontoon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.10 KB

In Pontoon, you play against the computer aiming to reach as close to 21 as possible without going over. A "Pontoon" – an Ace with a Ten or face card – beats everything, even a five-card trick. With a mix of luck, risk-taking, and smart choices, you try to beat the computer's hand and play your cards just right.

meta.name: Pontoon, Roulette & Aces High
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.17 KB

This collection includes three games: "Pontoon," a card game similar to Blackjack, where the British version uses terms like "twist" (draw a card), "stick" (hold), and "buy" (double the bet). Players can buy on hands with 2 to 4 cards and continue drawing cards afterward. "Roulette," where bets are placed on a single number or the colors red or black. A ball is spun against the direction of the wheel until it lands in one of 20 numbered and colored pockets. "Aces High," a strategic card game where cards are distributed across tableau piles. Cards of the same suit as a higher-ranked card are played. Empty tableaus must be filled with a card from another pile before additional cards can be dealt.

meta.name: Pool
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.37 KB

In Pool you get a simple yet engaging billiards experience that focuses purely on skill and precision. No fancy effects or complex controls — just aim, strike, and try to clear the table with as few shots as possible. It's a straightforward concept, but that simplicity is exactly what gives this classic C64 title its charm.

meta.name: Pool
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.98 KB

In Pool you step up to the virtual billiard table to test your precision, timing, and sense of angles. Position the cue ball, choose your shot, and control the strength to sink your targets with skill. Whether competing against another player or practicing solo, every strike matters. The clean visuals keep things focused, and the physics respond with surprising realism. A calm yet competitive slice of cue-sport mastery on the C64.

meta.name: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons : Pool of Radiance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pool of Radiance comienza en la ciudad de Phlan, amenazada por fuerzas malignas. Tú y tu grupo deben liberarla de monstruos y oscuridad. Paso a paso, explorarás la ciudad y sus alrededores en busca de la legendaria fuente de poder ancestral: el Pool of Radiance. Guías a tu grupo a través de mazmorras laberínticas en primera persona, mientras las batallas se desarrollan en el clásico estilo cenital por turnos. Cada decisión, cada movimiento, puede significar la victoria (o la derrota), marcando el inicio de una aventura épica.

meta.name: Pooyan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.15 KB

Pooyan puts you in the role of a brave pig determined to protect her piglets from attacking wolves. Near the pigs' home, you ride up and down in a cable car, shooting at enemies drifting downward before they can safely reach the ground and climb up to you. Beyond straightforward attacks, special moves allow for risky but rewarding actions that grant high bonus scores. The action later shifts to the wolves' lair, where tougher enemies, new dangers and a powerful leader raise the pressure and demand sharp reflexes and precise timing.

meta.name: Popeye
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.43 KB

Popeye es una adaptación del clásico arcade de acción y plataformas. Encarnas al marinero más fuerte (y torpe) del puerto, decidido a conquistar el corazón de Olivia: ella está arriba de la pantalla, lanzando tokens de amor que debes recoger antes de que toquen el suelo. Consigue los necesarios y pasarás a un nivel más difícil. Pero no será fácil: Brutus ronda el escenario, intentando atraparte. Si logras una lata de espinacas, ¡zas!, lo noqueas… si no, él te noquea a ti. Además, botellas, pájaros y otros objetos vuelan sin control: un impacto y pierdes una vida. Cada nivel tiene una distribución única de plataformas y escaleras, y cambia el tipo de objeto que cae —flores, corazones, notas…— manteniendo la tensión fresca. Amor, espinacas y caos vertical: puro espíritu cartoon, con el corazón (y los moretones) en su sitio.

meta.name: Popeye
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.17 KB

Popeye follows the sailor on his adventurous quest to collect hearts and win the love of Olive Oyl. However, his jealous rival Bluto is determined to stop him with brute force. Popeye's journey takes him deep-sea diving, soaring in a flying saucer, deceiving dragons, and even launching himself as a human cannonball. Only skill, courage, and the occasional can of spinach can help him outsmart Bluto and succeed in his mission.

meta.name: Popeye 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Popeye 2, los extraños sucesos han vuelto a Sweethaven… y solo un hombre con lata de espinacas en mano puede salvar el día. Nuestro héroe debe, una vez más, rescatar a Olivia, reducir a Bluto a papilla y, además, cuidar a Pepín, dar de comer a Guille (¡sin que robe tu hamburguesa!) y vigilar a Jeep, el leal pero travieso perro. Todo esto mientras salta entre escaleras, esquiva botellas voladoras y acumula espinacas para esos momentos ¡glup! de emergencia. Más caótico, más familiar y tan entrañable como siempre: porque en Sweethaven, el caos no es una excepción… es el menú diario.

meta.name: Popeye III : Wrestle Crazy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Popeye 3: Wrestle Crazy, nuestro marinero favorito es secuestrado por los belicosos alienígenas Kraggs y llevado a un asteroide perdido en los confines de la galaxia. Allí, debe participar en un torneo de lucha interestelar: derrotar a cinco oponentes extraterrestres… o la Tierra será conquistada. Olivia y Guille lo animan desde las gradas —lanzándole espinacas y hamburguesas al ring para mantener su energía. Con suficiente espinaca, ¡Popeye activa su ataque estelar: el «Tifón Turbo»! Pero cuidado: los rivales también pescan comida, y Bluto —por supuesto— complica todo lanzando bombas al cuadrilátero… que, con ingenio, Popeye puede usar en su contra. Caos, músculo y espinacas interestelares: porque hasta en el espacio, el bien huele a lata abierta.

meta.name: A Popples Christmas Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A Popples Christmas Adventure tiene lugar en el mundo mágico de los Popples. Los Popples fueron unos peluches populares de los años 80, creados por MATTEL, que podían plegarse en una especie de bola gracias a un bolsillo en su espalda, de ahí su nombre. En el juego, los jugadores pueden comenzar cantando un karaoke de Jingle Bells y luego guiar una cruz a través de un pequeño laberinto.

meta.name: Portal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Where are all the humans? Upon returning from your 100 year voyage in the milky way, you find earth empty and abandoned. Between the decaying remnants of civilization, you discover a terminal for Worldnet, the global network that recorded all human activities. The answer must lie deep in its database. Anxious, you log on.

meta.name: Portal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Where are all the humans? Upon returning from your 100 year voyage in the milky way, you find earth empty and abandoned. Between the decaying remnants of civilization, you discover a terminal for Worldnet, the global network that recorded all human activities. The answer must lie deep in its database. Anxious, you log on.

meta.name: Poseidon : Planet Eleven
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.31 KB

People can no longer live on Earth. It needs to regenerate. The whole mankind moved to a different galaxy consisting of eleven planet. When the last ship was about to colonise the last planet of the system, there was unexpected crash that caused the crystal - the important source of energy - to fall into several pieces.

meta.name: Poster Paster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.55 KB

Juegas el papel de Bill Stickers, un pegador de vallas publicitarias. Pegas las vallas publicitarias por toda la ciudad, para mostrar los anuncios en el papel que pegas. Debes coger los rollos de papel y pegarlos en la valla publicitaria. Si el papel está en la posición correcta se pegará, si no se cae. Asegúrate de que tu escalera está en la posición correcta, y no te inclines demasiado de la escalera. No toques los wazzocks que se mueven por el suelo, te electrocutarán. Afortunadamente, desaparecerán si les disparas con tu pintura.

meta.name: Postman Pat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.28 KB

Kids TV favourite Postman Pat aims to stamp his authority on the games scene by delivering a first-class licensed game. Your job is to guide Pat and his van around a particularly busy day of work.First you go to the post office where Mrs Goggins will give you the letters or parcel to be delivered.You will also have to help herding Peter Fogg's sheep, and do all this against a time limit. The game includes  a rendition of the show's music, as well as two difficultly levels - according to the inlay the easy version is for children, and the harder one for 'the serious gamer'.

meta.name: Postman Pat II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.98 KB

Postman Pat II follows you on a lively delivery round through the village, as Pat's van has broken down and he must deliver the mail on foot. Your first task is to collect the scattered letters while stray hens get in your way – and a good cup of tea helps Pat stay energized. But delivering mail is only part of the job, because as a trusted member of the community he is always ready to lend a hand – items must be found and used correctly, friends have to be located, and only by keeping track of the map will you complete every task successfully.

meta.name: Postman Pat III : To the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.44 KB

Postman Pat 3 is a Paperboy-style game. Pat agrees to help deliver telephone directories on behalf of his friend Delivery Man Dan, who's broken his leg. The play controls Pat's van, and must deliver directories to as many houses as possible whilst avoiding obstacles and without running out of fuel. There are five days in which deliveries may be attempted and failure to deliver enough of the directories in the five days may result in Dan losing his job.

meta.name: Postman Pat's Trail Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.53 KB

Postman Pat's Trail Game is a top-down driving game based on the 1981 British stop-motion TV series. Players control Pat's van through the village of Greendale to locate lost vehicles or animals like Jess, Pat's cat. Starting from the post office, players follow trails to recover items and return on time before the clock runs out. Collisions with road edges or cows cost time, while blocking cows force players to wait or find an alternate route. After each task, points are awarded, and a new mission can be started. The game features six difficulty levels, ranging from very easy to challenging.

meta.name: Pot Fun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.38 KB

Pot Fun invites you to a colorful slot-machine session built around reels, symbols, and the hope of the next payout. You start a round, watch for matching combinations, and wait to see whether your stake turns into a worthwhile reward. The playful presentation with its many displays and bright motifs strengthens the classic arcade-gambling atmosphere. This creates a straightforward game of chance driven by luck, anticipation, and the appeal of the next spin.

meta.name: Pot Nabber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.04 KB

„Pot Nabber“ is a classic platform game where your goal is to collect green pots scattered across multiple floors, all while avoiding giant robots guarding the area. You climb ladders and move between levels, timing your movements to avoid the patrolling enemies. You can jump to evade them, but beware – the robots can shoot you. Ladders offer brief moments of safety, but careful strategy is needed to collect all the pots and survive.

meta.name: Pot Panic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Pot Panic" is a puzzle game where the player takes on the role of a dishwasher at a busy restaurant. Falling pots must be stacked so that five of the same type are aligned on top of one another. Once this is achieved, the pots disappear, creating space for new ones. The goal is to stack strategically to handle the continuous flow of pots.

meta.name: Potsworth & Co.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Potsworth the well-spoken dog and his Midnight Patrol chums (Rosie, Nick, Carter, Keiko and Freddy) were stars of a successful cartoon, one of the many Hanna-Barbera IPs turned into licensed games by Hi-Tec. The Nightmare Prince has stolen the Grand Dozer's sleep potion, and the pieces have been placed around the Dream Zone. The Midnight Patrol race into action to restore Dozer's decent night's sleep.
The game takes place across 5 levels of platform action. There are many switches, which are activated by pushing crates onto them. Moving platforms and small ledges ensure a test of timing and planning. There are hidden paths and bonuses to uncover, and dying always puts you back where you die with an invincibility period. Each character has its own special weapon or feature, all activated by hitting the fire key or button.

meta.name: Potty Painter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.09 KB

Potty Painter In The Jungle is a single player action game with puzzle elements.
Bizarrely, considering the name of the game, the player takes the role of a gorilla. The gorilla is being hunted and must elude his captors. If successful they then do battle with the fearsome 'Teddy Twins'.
The game takes place on a grid with irregularly sized rectangles. Each rectangle has a score associated with it. By going around all four sides of the shape the player gets the score it contains. The objective here is to score on all squares.
Having survived this phase of the game the player then progresses to the second part of the game where they must guide a teddy bear towards a banana.
The third and final part of the game is similar to the first part but here the player takes the role, not of a gorilla but of a paint roller and the hunters are teddy bears.

meta.name: Potty Pigeon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.65 KB

Potty Pigeon sends you on a reckless mission with the slightly unhinged Percy as he tries to build a cozy nest despite constant danger. In the middle of heavy traffic he collects branches while dodging a pigeon-hungry cat and a greedy ferret. Once he reaches the runway, new threats appear – kamikaze planes, balloons and mischievous sparrows make survival even harder. But Percy refuses to quit and even carries explosive surprises to clear his path and complete his nest step by step.

meta.name: POW Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.61 KB

POW Adventure puts you in the role of a German spy working for the Allies. Your mission is to infiltrate an English POW camp, steal a set of secret plans, and escape to deliver them to the resistance. You have only two hours, and your watch keeps track of time. Classic text commands guide your actions as you move through the woods, gather equipment like a uniform, pistol, or mirror, and make strategic choices that determine the outcome of your mission.

meta.name: Power (Avantage)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

On June 1st, the United Nations received the following message: "Hello. I have the honor to inform you that on June 9th, at exactly 8 p.m., I will destroy the five largest cities in the world with thermal nuclear weapons." The UN delegates concluded that you were the only one crazy enough to stop this madman. So it's up to you to save the lives of 50 million people...

meta.name: Power at Sea
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Power at Sea is a 2D naval action/strategic game. 1944, war in the pacific. You are the commanding officer of a small strike fleet. Within 96 hours you have to secure the Leyte Gulf. In order to take opposing islands, you have to destroy first the land cannons and bunkers and send then the landing boats with the correct number to troops ashore. Defeat enemy battleships and carriers with your own fighters and protect your ships with Anti-Aircraft guns against enemy kamikaze fighters.

meta.name: Power Boat Race
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.89 KB

Power Boat Race is a chaotic racing game where the player pilots a powerboat along mostly one-way tracks filled with fjords and narrow passages. Bridges must be cleared by precise ramp jumps, where players can skim past other boats to gain an edge. The boat is equipped with bombs that can be placed on the track to hit opponents and earn points. Additional bombs and fuel are scattered along the course, often dangerously close to the banks, where collisions can cause crashes. After a crash, a new boat is conveniently placed further ahead. Meanwhile, a helicopter drops bombs that must be avoided, often obscuring the player's view, while rival boats crowd together to push the player into walls.

meta.name: Power Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 141.94 KB

Power Box takes the player to a summer day in the mid-1980s, managing rail traffic in Leicester and Stafford during two four-hour shifts. The goal is to coordinate traffic smoothly while minimizing delays to scheduled timings. Careful planning and quick decision-making are crucial to meet the challenges.

meta.name: Power Drift
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Power Drift es un arcade de carreras frenético donde pilotas buggies todoterreno a toda velocidad por cinco circuitos distintos —cada uno con cinco etapas— que van desde ciudades y desiertos hasta tramos sobre el agua. Elige entre 12 pilotos únicos: ejecutivos, skinheads, mohicanos… cada uno con su estilo y actitud. Tu buggy tiene solo dos marchas —alta y baja— y, al encenderse el semáforo en verde, es acelerador a fondo. Para pasar de etapa, debes quedar tercero o mejor. Golpes contra otros buggies u obstáculos te frenan, así que equilibra velocidad y precisión. Completa las cinco etapas de un circuito y desbloquearás un nivel bonus: más curvas, más adrenalina… y la misma regla de oro: no levantes el pie. Caos controlado, con sabor ochentero y neumáticos humeantes.

meta.name: Power Pyramids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.16 KB

The pyramids on Earth actually come from the planet T-Pyge, whose inhabitants not only built them but also sold them to other worlds. Two ships were needed for transport – one for the structure and one for the power supply. Since that became too expensive, they decided to shut down the pyramids during transport and reactivate them at their destination. You've now delivered four of these structures to Earth and must supply them with energy.

meta.name: Power Signal Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.48 KB

"Power Signal Box" is a train simulation and management game where the player controls signaling systems in a rail yard. The goal is to safely and efficiently manage the movement of freight engines and cars. The PSB Highlands routes present unique challenges, requiring careful planning and skilled management. Developed by Dee-Kay Systems in 1988, the game emphasizes strategic thinking and quick decision-making to ensure smooth rail operations.

meta.name: Power Struggle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Power Struggle allows you to compete against a friend or the computer for world domination in either the West or the East. After you select your page, you will be shown a world map. Countries belonging to the West are green, countries belonging to the East are red, and neutral countries are white. Your goal is to conquer as many lands as possible while your opponent does the same.
You will be shown icons and have to decide how to take over lands within a time limit. These options are attack, supply, exercise political influence or build factories and armies. Once you have made both decisions, the orders will be executed. Although you can take lands, your opponent can take yours and vice versa. Therefore, keeping these countries is part of the challenge.

meta.name: Power Surge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.20 KB

Power Surge is a game where the player must guide an orb through a flashing maze and reach the exit before time runs out. If the orb touches the flashing maze, the player is sent back to the start. The game is challenging but playable and intentionally kept simple to embrace its humorous and lighthearted nature.

meta.name: Power, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Power” is set in a futuristic world – humanity is threatened by aliens using antimatter machines to destroy energy sources. The player controls a hovering vehicle, navigating through rotations and acceleration while using limited lasers and shields against aliens and mines. If the vehicle is destroyed, the player switches to a jetpack to retrieve a new vehicle. Turrets must be destroyed to pass through shield gates. The mission ends with the destruction of the facility's core before the tractor beam captures the player.

meta.name: Power-Play Hockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.80 KB

"Power-Play Hockey" lets two players team up to face a computer-controlled team. The goal is to gain the upper hand through skillful passing, powerful checking, and precise shooting. On the ice, you'll experience power plays, penalty kills, and spectacular goalie saves with the stick. Get ready for thrilling and intense hockey action!

meta.name: Powerama
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.90 KB

Powerama is a top-view vertical shooter where the screens scrolls upwards constantly as you control a spacecraft whose mission is to save Earth from a large invading force over various levels. You have to fly low over various alien space cruisers so you can fly beneath their force fields and destroy as many solar panels as possible. As you fly you will encounter many alien ships trying to stop you and if you hit one or are shot then you lose one of five lives. Occasionally flashing squares appear and when flown over give you either extra speed, lives or bullets. When you reach the end of the level you will encounter a Mothership which needs destroying to move on to the next space cruiser.

meta.name: Pro Powerboat Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.07 KB

Pro Powerboat Simulator throws you into high-speed races across tight, winding waterways where speed and control are constantly tested. You guide your boat through fjords and junctions, launch off ramps for daring jumps and try to outmaneuver rivals, even mid-air. Bombs can be deployed to disrupt opponents and earn points, while fuel and extra supplies are placed dangerously close to hazards along the banks. Crashes, aerial attacks and aggressive competitors crowding the course turn each race into a chaotic balance of speed, risk and tactical decisions.

meta.name: Powerglove
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.36 KB

Powerglove drops you into a future where fossil fuels are gone and only two massive thermal reactors beneath the poles keep humanity alive. After an explosion in the northern reactor, all connections are severed and communication with engineers and rescue robots is lost — leaving you as the only hope. Equipped with an armored suit and the Powerglove, you fight through five sprawling levels, hunt down the control diamonds and activate the emergency systems. Malfunctioning maintenance drones, energy doors, powerboots and tight, fast controls create a classic run-and-gun experience that keeps you moving nonstop.

p: Powerplay - The Game of the Gods (USA).D64
n: Powerplay - The Game of the Gods (USA)

meta.name: Powerplay - The Game Of The Gods
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, you take on the role of one of the four great gods – Apollo, Hermes, Hecate, or Aphrodite – and select a team of four warriors to compete for you in the Powerplay tournament. The competition isn't about weapons but knowledge. Your characters start in a cross formation on a game board divided into four colors, each representing a field of knowledge. With a correct answer, you can move a character, possibly landing on a teleport field that randomly relocates them. If you encounter a member of an opposing team, a quiz challenge occurs. The winner gains a point, while the loser loses a point and is demoted. At 25 wisdom points, the character levels up, becomes harder to defeat, but faces more difficult questions.

meta.name: Power Play Hockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.25 KB

Powerplay Hockey is a ice hockey game concentrating on the game between the USA and the USSR. Before starting the game you are to choose the number of players (on-on-one or five-on-five) and length of match (two, tvelwe or twenty minutes per period). When in the game try wrist shots, slap shots, faceoff, drop passing, and body checking. Roughing and crosscheking will give you a penalty.

meta.name: Ratan Ballads
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.65 KB

In Powers of Gloom you enter a dark world filled with dangers and mysterious places. As you progress you explore different areas, discover new paths and face a variety of challenges that shape your journey. The game's atmosphere is defined by its gloomy setting and the tense moments that draw you deeper into the adventure. While different releases introduced small visual and presentation changes, the core experience remains the same – a journey through a shadowy world of exploration and trials.

meta.name: Powerstar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.02 KB

"Powerstar" is a vertically scrolling game where the player pilots a spaceship through a narrow and dangerous tunnel to reach the heart of the enemy attack system. The corridor is filled with obstacles such as meteorites and enemy spacecraft that must be avoided. The player fires lasers to destroy or keep enemies at bay and must maintain energy levels by collecting energy stars. After successful navigation, the spaceship must rejoin the mothership to continue the daring mission.

meta.name: Powertrak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.79 KB

"Powertrak" places the player in the role of a heroic volunteer, who becomes the last hope for the surviving community in Sector 98 after the devastating impact of the comet Blazer 76 on Delos V. To escape the toxic environment, the player must navigate a manually-guided shuttle through a complex network of magnetic rails. The objective is to reach and repair the central beacons, allowing the path to the spaceport in the central sector to be cleared and enabling the community's escape.

meta.name: Powertris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Powertris" is a game following the classic Tetris mechanics, where the player must strategically place falling blocks to form complete rows and score points.

meta.name: Pozitronic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.15 KB

Pozitronic is a fast-paced duel game where two players go head-to-head, trying to score by getting the ball into the opponent's goal while defending their own. Each of the 20 rounds features shifting obstacles and goal locations, making every match fresh and unpredictable. The player with the most points at the end wins – reflexes, tactics, and adaptability are key to victory.

meta.name: PP Digger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.59 KB

„PP Digger“ is a Boulder Dash clone where you must collect a set number of diamonds before time runs out. Rocks (or "rockstones" as the game calls them) are crucial: they fall when the ground beneath them is removed, creating new paths. They can also be used strategically to crush pumpkins and ghosts. Additional challenges include changers that turn rocks into diamonds when placed on them and destructible walls blocking access to new passages. Once you've collected the required diamonds, you can advance to the next room for more treasure hunting.

p: PP Hammer and his Pneumatic Weapon (USA).D64
n: PP Hammer and his Pneumatic Weapon (USA)

meta.name: P.P. Hammer and his Pneumatic Weapon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

P.P. Hammer and his Pneumatic Weapon sends you through caves, castles, and other dangerous places as a treasure hunter, with valuable finds often hidden deep below the surface. Using the pneumatic hammer, you dig through the ground, open new routes, and have to avoid being trapped by blocks that quickly return. With good timing, those same blocks can even be turned into traps for enemies, while invisible platforms and transporters keep adding surprises. Tight time limits and limited chances give the treasure hunt extra pressure and turn every stage into a precise challenge.

meta.name: Pra-Se
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pra-Se sends a steady stream of symbols falling from above, which you catch and move into suitable columns. The goal is to match two identical shapes so they disappear and free up space again. Special pieces such as bombs can remove additional blocks when combined correctly. This creates a fast puzzle game that neatly blends awareness, clever sorting, and timely reactions.

meta.name: Predator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Predator es un plataformas de desplazamiento lateral que toma la ambientación y personajes de la clásica película de Arnie. Sin embargo, no es una adaptación fiel: tu escuadrón ya ha sido aniquilado al comenzar y tendrás que luchar contra escorpiones, soldados enemigos y esquivar obstáculos antes de enfrentarte varias veces al propio Predator. Es un plataformas clásico de correr, saltar y disparar, con la particularidad de que empiezas sin ninguna arma y tienes que ir recogiendo las que encuentres durante la partida.

meta.name: Predator 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.97 KB

El lugarteniente de Los Angeles Mike Harrington está acostumbrado a tratar en la guerra entre bandas de traficantes Españoles y Jamaicanos, ¡pero ahora está atrapado en la peor pesadilla de la ciudad! El temible alienígena de la especie Predator ha llegado con la intención de sembrar destrucción. Es tu trabajo detenerle.
El juego es un shooter de punto de mira influenciado por "Operation Wolf". La cámara se situa a la espalda de Harrington mientras el juego avanza según completas secciones. En las versiones de 16-bit hay soporte para control por ratón. Has de mantener tu armadura funcional recogiendo recargas, y hay potenciadores de armas como metralletas y lanzamisiles para recoger. Sin embargo no puedes ir disparando a lo loco ya que matar a un solo inocente hace que Harrington pierda su empleo.

meta.name: Premier II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.42 KB

Premier 2: Superleague is a standard football management game, in which you take charge of a team in the 16 team super-league and aim for league success. You can choose your team and substitutes for each match, with injuries and suspensions to factor in as the season goes on. You can use the substitutes at half-time or later in the matches (which last for 90 seconds of real -time). Between matches you can buy and sell players, each of which have ratings up to 9 for ability and form.

meta.name: Premier League
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.58 KB

Premier League is a football management game where you must try to win the league against seven other teams from England. There are five skill levels (1-5) to select and you also can edit team and players names. Options are limited to buying and selling players, deciding to have a special training session, and selecting your team for the next game. After comparing your team with your opponents you move to the match highlights which is text only and you just wait for any major incident to happen. You can select your sub at half-time and half-way through the 2nd half. After the game you can see your weekly balance before selecting your options for your next game.

meta.name: President
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.89 KB

President turns the leadership of a small nation into a strategy game with a distinctly cynical edge, forcing you to balance public welfare, economics, military strength, and the simple goal of staying in power. While you are expected to reduce hunger and disease, the game also pushes you to manage resources cleverly, uncover raw materials, trade with other nations, and expand both infrastructure and armed forces so you can win over the population in time for the next election. That blend of development, limited priorities, and political calculation gives the game its own appeal, because it is not just about governing, but about constantly fighting for approval and survival in office.

meta.name: President Elect - 1984 Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In President Elect you can replay any of the presidential elections from the Kennedy-Nixon contest of 1960 to the Reagan victory of 1980. 
Or, if you prefer, you can set up a fictional contest between candidatesfor any of the elections including the 1984 contest.
The game has a data file for 21 Democrats, 22 Republicans, and 2 third party candidates.

meta.name: President Elect : 1988 Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

President Elect: 1988 Edition is an updated version of the original President Elect adding the campaign data for the upcoming (at the time) 1988 election. The game is a comprehensive computer simulation of a presidential campaign from Labor Day to election night. The game can be played by 3 players each assuming the role of campaign manager/candidate. The game proceeds through 9 weekly turns where the player decides how and where to concentrate their campaign efforts. Weekly polls are provided to give the players an idea on how they are doing. On election night the returns come in on a minute to minute basis until a winner is determined. The election night may be simulated in real time (2-6 hours) or the votes may be counted in 15 seconds. President Elect has seven historical scenarios (from 1960 to 1988) or a virtually unlimited number of hypothetical or ahistorical scenarios.

p: President is Missing, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: President is Missing, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.name: The President is Missing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the game, set in 1996, the President of the United States attends an anti-terrorism summit in Europe with ten Western European leaders. Terrorists attack the summit and stun participants and security personnel with sleeping gas. The terrorists then kidnap the president and the other leaders and hold them hostage. The terrorists leave behind a tape in which they declare that they are Islamic and make numerous demands in exchange for the safe release of the hostages.
The player takes on the role of the special investigator who must find the president and the remaining hostages. The investigator works from his computer terminal, which has access to the dossiers of many different people, including known terrorists and members of the Cabinet. The investigator also has eight special agents that he can send out to question people or find out information. The agents' reports are then saved to the computer.

The investigator also has eight special agents that he can send out to question people or find out information. The agents' reports are then saved to the computer.

With limited funds and time, you must carefully plan your campaign across various states, book flights, and gather votes. Every move matters as rival candidates compete for voter support. Strategy, timing, and political instinct are key to winning the election and claiming victory on election day.

You answer questions to earn spins, then decide whether to use them yourself to build winnings or pass them to opponents in hopes they hit a setback. meta.name: The Price is Right
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

GameTek's home version of the classic game show The Price is Right. Bob Barker and the Beauties are not present, but a multitude of pricing games from the show, as well as the wheel and the showcase, have been faithfully replicated. 
Four (or a maximum of eight, counting both rounds - the programme suggests switching players) contestants can play, with the computer filling in for the rest. Whether bidding on Contestant's Row or playing a pricing game, contestants will attempt to closely guess the price of an item provided. All items in the game are often-unintentionally-humorous misspellings of recognizable brand names, to avoid trademark infringement.
Pricing games include the Mountain Climbing (in which your 3 guesses must be less than $300 away in total, otherwise a goat will push you over the edge), Safe Cracking (in which you have 3 possibilities for each part of the price, and must correctly guess it) and the Dice Game (in which you accept or reject random rolls to get the real price).
There is a persistent Hall of Fame with winners and their scores, and a parser for guessing/bidding prices. Players have to type in their price guesses, and answer to the math of how "off" they were, as they would if they were on the show.

Along the way, you discover spells ranging from confusion and healing to danger detection, using an intuitive interface to overcome the challenges.

meta.name: Pride
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.47 KB

In Pride, you guide a ball through rooms filled with colored stones and have to clear the path to the exit with care. You can only remove a stone when your ball has the same color. Paint buckets let you change colors, but they disappear after one use – so every decision matters. Rolling ahead without thinking can trap you quickly, while smart planning opens the way to the next level.

meta.name: Prime Ducks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Prime Ducks is an educational game that introduces players to the world of prime numbers. In this game, ducks swim in the water, each carrying a number. The player must identify which ducks are prime numbers by catching them with a ring. The goal is to collect all the prime numbers in the level while avoiding ducks with non-prime numbers. The game teaches the concept of prime numbers in a fun way and helps enhance mathematical skills.

meta.name: Primitive Ping-Pong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.23 KB

"Primitive Ping-Pong" is a simple and colorful version of the classic Pong game. Two players control paddles to return the ball and score points. The game combines a nostalgic design with vibrant graphics while staying true to the original gameplay.

meta.name: Prince of Persia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 505.05 KB

Prince of Persia es un juego de plataformas ambientado en Oriente Medio. El jugador controla al Príncipe de Persia, que puede andar, correr, agacharse, saltar, agarrarse y luchar con espadas. El objetivo es completar todos los niveles para liberar a la princesa en el tiempo límite de una hora. Cada nivel consiste en una mazmorra cada vez más grande con muchas trampas (precipicios, losas que ceden bajo los pies, pinchos que sobresalen del suelo).

meta.name: The Prince
meta.desc:

In The Prince you travel across a large kingdom to rescue a princess and also convince her to escape with you. To succeed, bravery alone is not enough – you must also gather enough wealth and find all the scattered parts of a craft needed for the escape. Throughout your journey you collect gold, jewels and bravery points while exploring much of the world. Many of the crucial items are hidden inside strange and often confusing sub-games that require additional skill. At the same time, you are constantly harassed by enemy hordes that must be avoided or fought. Only by fulfilling all these demands will the princess agree to flee with you.

meta.name: Princess and the Frog
meta.desc:

In Princess and the Frog you play a love-struck frog on a daring journey to the princess's castle. First you must cross a road crowded with galloping knights, then brave the castle moat teeming with snakes and alligators. The gators are especially treacherous, diving without warning and dragging you under if you're riding on their backs. Only precise timing and quick reflexes will get you safely to the castle – where true love turns you into a handsome prince.

Siete presos han iniciado un pequeño motín y de ti depende evitar que se convierta en uno mayor. Tienes 15 minutos para encontrarlos y tirarlos del tejado.
Puedes atacar a los prisioneros con tu rifle o dándoles patadas en la cabeza. Cualquier otro contacto consume energía, y sólo tienes una vida. Se necesitan llaves para abrir las puertas.

Seen from a top-down perspective, you explore different areas such as the cell block, laundry, or cafeteria while avoiding the patrols of the guards. One careless move can end your escape attempt instantly. Depending on the chosen difficulty level, timing becomes trickier, and only with patience, skill, and a solid plan can you slip past the guards and make it to freedom.

Timing, quick reactions and proper distance from your opponent are essential during the fight. By blocking effectively and striking at the right moment, you can gradually wear down your opponent and win the bout.

The bouts follow realistic rules, making every round and every successful strike important for the score. Throughout the fight the crowd adds to the atmosphere, cheering or mocking the fighters, with their reactions shown through speech bubbles.

You press right to move your bike, move up or down to steer and to change gears you hold down the fire button and press up or down. Certain obstacles like logs and holes can't be ridden over so you press fire to get off your bike and push it. Hitting an object throws you off your bike and wastes time and the winner is the person who finishes the course in the fastest time.

To serve, you press the button once to toss the ball, and again to hit it with your racket – full service rules apply."

Si tienes suerte, incluso podrías obtener un ace. Si no, deberá estar listo para devolver el golpe de su oponente. Corre de un lado a otro mientras intentas seguir golpeando la pelota sobre la red hasta que tu oponente falle, o lo hagas tu. Instead of guarding the universe, PROBE threatens mankind itself and has set the doomsday clock ticking. Your mission is to stop the machine before it's too late.

Your answers affect your success and the number of stars you earn. The more stars you accumulate, the more likely you are to make it to the first team. Después viene la parte de cross-country, donde tendrás que navegar con precisión entre las banderas, evitando árboles, edificios y otros peligros. Con gráficos isométricos rápidos que recuerdan a Marble Madness, el juego exige reacciones rápidas y precisión en el ritmo de tu tabla.

meta.name: Professional Ski Simulator

Gameplay consists of simulated downhill skiing of increasing difficulty. Players can race against each other, or against the computer. The slope must be completed passing through all of the checkpoints and within a time limit. The game is viewed in overhead isometric 3D perspective. The game screen always tracks the leading contestant, so if a player falls too far behind he will lose sight of his skier. However, an icon map in the corner of the screen shows the locations of both players and the checkpoints, enabling a skilled player to still complete the race.

Player fitness must also be managed to avoid overexertion.

The included Pebble Beach Golf Course, as well as a second course featuring famous holes from around the world, offer diverse gameplay options. Additionally, 20 computer-controlled opponents modeled after famous golfers are available. An expansion module featuring the courses of Merion and Oakmont was sold separately.

Poor timing can result in a draw or fade effect on the shot. On the green, shot power must be selected before direction, taking the general slope of the green into account. There is no indicator showing the distance between the ball and the hole.

Prohibition es un shoot'em up ambientado en el Nueva York de 1930. La ciudad está invadida por gánsteres y la policía te ha contratado para librarte de ellos. El modo de juego es sencillo: te enfrentas a una hilera de edificios, aparece un gángster y tienes que dispararle antes de que se agote el temporizador en pantalla y te dispare él primero. Puedes esconderte hasta que el temporizador se reinicie, pero esto también es limitado. Al final de cada etapa hay una ronda de bonificación en la que tienes que disparar a los gángsters en una habitación, sin posibilidad de esconderse y con un temporizador más rápido. A medida que avanzas en cada etapa, el juego se vuelve más rápido y los enemigos más difíciles de encontrar y golpear. Por supuesto, tu objetivo es llegar al final del juego con la mayor puntuación posible.

Fight your way across different locations in the solar system, avoid hazards, use platforms, and unleash your powers to stop the Chancellor's advance.

One mistake can cost millions, one smart move brings your vision closer to reality. What starts as dry management quickly becomes a gripping balancing act between ambition, logistics, and survival in space.

Only if you make it back safely will you rise through the ranks. The ultimate goal: become a general and earn the Congressional Medal of Honor.

Supplies must be transported one at a time, and getting shot causes you to drop them and take damage. Once enough supplies are gathered, the final task is to deliver and drop the bomb – all while dodging and attacking.

meta.name: Protector
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.50 KB

Protector is a horizontal side-view scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls constantly left or right as you control a ship trying to stop an alien invasion force. You were just flying a few solons above your home planet when you were attacked and it is your job to destroy as many of the invasion force as you can to save your planet. As you fly left or right, the aliens appear and you keep blasting them avoiding the aliens and their bullets. if you touch an alien or it's bullets then you lose one of three lives. Before you start the game you can select the skill level (1-9).

meta.name: Protector II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.42 KB

Protector II is a side-scrolling action game that throws you into a high-stakes rescue mission during an alien invasion. You pilot a ship to fight off airborne and ground enemies while saving individual humans – first from an alien vessel, later from a city threatened by an erupting volcano. Unlike Defender, you can only carry one person at a time and must drop them into a teleporter to ensure their safety. The gameplay is continuous, with shifting missions and no level breaks. More challenging than many of its inspirations and with a deeper narrative focus.

meta.name: Protium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.42 KB

Protium is a side-view horizontal scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls constantly from left to right as you control spacecraft blasting and avoiding aliens over various levels. Earth have been threatened with hyperspace by the aliens and because their base is so far away, an attack isn't plausible. The only solution is to activate the Galactic Shield but this requires large amounts of Protium and there isn't any on Earth. To get some, Protium, a ship laden with it has to be stolen and brought back to Earth to save the planet.

meta.name: Protronix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Protronix” is less of a game and more a collection of impressive Commodore artwork, surprising in both variety and quality. From abstract shapes to more daring illustrations, the collection showcases the creative range of the era. The final piece clearly targets a more mature audience – an unexpected ending for something that was actually distributed under the name of a well-known publisher.

meta.name: Prowler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 62.90 KB

Prowler takes you to Ursa Minor Delta-V, where you pilot a futuristic Northall Q15 helicopter-jet hybrid to repel invading forces. Presented in first-person 3D, the game features air and ground combat against hovercraft and aircraft, supported by radar, heavy shields and advanced weapons. Multiple modes, five skill levels, training options and set scenarios add variety, while a tactical map lets you identify and strike key enemy sectors.

meta.name: Psi 5 Trading Co.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

PSI-5 Trading Company puts you in command of an interstellar freighter crewed by eccentric aliens. You must navigate through pirate-infested space, choosing whether to fight or evade attackers while dealing with constant emergencies as systems fail and damage spreads. Every decision and every second matters – poor timing can doom your mission. Only cool leadership and smart coordination of your quirky crew will ensure the precious cargo reaches its destination.

meta.name: Psi Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.26 KB

Psi Warrior is a fast-paced sci-fi adventure where you play a psionic warrior descending a deserted military silo to level 60 on a magnetic hoverboard. Use ramps to avoid damage – jumping down costs speed. To confront the source of a strange power, you must gather equal amounts of psionic and ID energy. These appear as colored clouds which must be shot before passing through them. But beware – if the energy levels are imbalanced, it will kill you instantly.

meta.name: Psi-Droid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.38 KB

Psi-Droid takes place aboard the transport ship Dreadnought Nine, where a pulsebomb has broken into nine pieces. Without it, Earth will be doomed, so as a search droid you must recover every part. The game is a flick-screen platformer in which you explore the ship while avoiding hostile droids that drain your energy on contact. Armed with a gun, you can shoot them, and scattered pods provide extra firepower or energy boosts. Transporters move you to different ship areas, adding variety to exploration. At intervals, a bonus game appears where you shoot descending poles from the bottom of the screen. Your mission is to collect all bomb pieces and save Earth.

meta.name: Psion Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.11 KB

In Psion Attack, you fly through hostile territory and have to hold your own against numerous attackers. As the screen keeps moving, enemies, shots, and obstacles appear, demanding quick reactions and careful dodging. Every hit matters, and every opening can make a difference – stay calm, keep control, and fight your way forward bit by bit.

meta.name: Psycastria
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.70 KB

The Psycastrians have attacked. Using their mind control abilities, they have taken over many world leaders, causing untold war and devastation. Now it is up to you to strike back. Take your fighter across 16 bases, on land, on sea, on the moon, and in space.
Psycastria is a top-down horizontal scrolling shooter. Go across each base, destroy the 10 energy pods that power the Psycastrian war machine while avoiding buildings and engaging alien spacecraft, then go to the next base. Unusually for a shooter, you can turn around at any time to go after any missed targets. Between bases, there is a bonus level that tests your timing at destroying aliens.

meta.name: Psychic Kaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Psychic Kaos is a unique horizontal shoot 'em up where you must shoot or dodge enemy ships while trying to "solve a puzzle". This puzzle involves finding the single available piece (out of seven) hidden beneath the playing field and throwing it at the right moment onto an incomplete enemy to form a coherent whole. Using the joystick, up/down moves your ship, and left/right selects the piece to throw. There is no ending to this game, only a scoring system.

meta.name: Psycho
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.27 KB

Psycho has you flying over the sea, dropping bombs onto passing boats and trying to score as many points as possible before time runs out. Good timing is essential, as the targets move across the water and need to be hit at the right moment. The simple task makes the game easy to get into, while every missed drop wastes valuable seconds. This creates a direct score-chasing game that combines aim, reaction, and the urge for a better round.

meta.name: Psycho : Arcade Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Psycho: Arcade Quest takes you into the eerie Bates Motel, where stolen jewels and a missing curator are waiting to be found. As a brave detective, you search the house, inspect suspicious objects, and race against time, because the whole case has to be solved within four hours. Randomly appearing enemies can slow you down and cost valuable minutes until you finally find a way to defend yourself. This creates a tense horror adventure that effectively combines investigation, time pressure, and dark humor.

meta.name: Psycho : Arcade Quest
meta.desc:
