Psycho Hopper is a side-scrolling action game set on the bizarre planetoid Dreams – a luxury vacation spot in the middle of the Belt of Unreality. During the “Season of High Unlikelihood,” you embark on a treasure hunt in a fantasy castle. Bouncing along on a gas-filled bubble and armed with a blunderbuss, you traverse each level from left to right searching for four parts of a valuable artifact. You must avoid or shoot the enemies on screen, as touching them reduces your gas gauge, and once it's empty you lose one of your three lives. The goal is to collect all parts and conquer the perilous dream world.

meta.name: Psycho I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.55 KB

Psycho I begins with a strange encounter in which an alchemist and psychiatrist from Scotia stirs a magical cauldron and joins you. Rather than presenting clear goals right away, the adventure relies on odd descriptions, unusual characters, and a slightly absurd mood. Through text commands, you respond to situations, answer questions, and gradually feel your way through its peculiar world. This creates a mysterious text adventure shaped by bizarre atmosphere, dry humor, and encounters that spark curiosity.

meta.name: Psycho III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.70 KB

Psycho III brings the unusual blend of magic and psychology to its conclusion. In a world of strange questions, odd characters, and elusive hints, you continue moving through the story by entering text commands. The atmosphere feels mysterious and slightly eccentric, as if every conversation hides more than it first reveals. This creates a distinctive finale that combines curiosity, wordplay, and surreal encounters into a memorable text adventure.

meta.name: Psycho Pigs UXB
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.73 KB

Deja de comer cortezas y muerde esta pata de cerdo: El ?PSYCHO PIG?.
Tendrás que pelear, en medio de una masa de porquería intergaláctica, con un grupo de super-gorrinos que se defienden, con los más cochinos medios, para que no les conviertas en un aperitivo.
Recoge las bombas que te arrojarán y devuélveselas antes de que ellos te conviertan a tí en salchichas. Este juego no es una porquería, pero tú tendrás que ser el rey del juego sucio.
Las cochinadas más divertidas.

meta.name: Psycho Soldier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Psycho Soldier continues the story of Athena, introducing her descendant Athena Asamiya, who now wields powerful psychic abilities. Together with her friend Kensu, you battle through a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mutants. The game blends classic side-scrolling platform action with shooter elements, featuring a constantly moving background, plenty of power-ups, and Athena's psychic blasts. The result is a unique hybrid of platforming and shooting that can also be played with two players.

meta.name: Psycloid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.90 KB

In Psycloid you navigate your spaceship through tricky levels that blend action and puzzle elements. The goal is to collect all the energy capsules before the timer runs out and your ship self-destructs. It may sound easy, but swarms of drones constantly get in your way. Each stage presents a new challenge that can only be overcome by finding the right strategy.

meta.name: Psykozone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.61 KB

Psykozone throws you straight into chaos – after the fall of the United States, countless regions now lie scattered across the land. Between them stretch the deadly highways of the PSYKOZONE, where lawlessness reigns supreme. You must fight your way through territories ruled by gangs and genetically altered bikers to reach the Pacific. With a full tank, armed weapons, and an engine roaring for survival, your road to hell begins – only the strongest will make it through.

meta.name: Psytron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.09 KB

“Psytron” puts you in control of a central AI responsible for the survival and safety of the Betula 5 space station. You manage all critical systems, maintain oxygen supply, assign tasks, and defend the facility against attacks or sabotage. The game gradually introduces your responsibilities over five learning levels before challenging you with the final stage, “The Final Conflict,” where your full skill set is put to the test. Each stage must be played five times, and you need an average score of at least 50% to advance – control, efficiency, and quick thinking are key to success or failure.

meta.name: Psyxx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Psyxx you face waves of incoming enemies and try to stop them with accurate shots. During the action you must not only aim carefully but also move strategically to avoid enemy fire. As the game progresses the pace increases, demanding faster reactions and better timing. Only by choosing the right position and firing at the right moment can you survive the growing challenge.
meta.developer: Chris Yates, Thomas Koncina & Thorsten Koytka

meta.name: Pub Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pub Games is a themed compilation of seven games that have been popular in pubs across the UK for decades. The games can be played either as a "Full Pub Games Run", where the player plays through all the games and lasts approximately two hours, or as a practice mode, where players can select games in any order.
The following games are available:
Darts, bar billiards, dominoes, table football, pontoon (black jack), poker, bowling

In Pub Quest, you have to pay your bill after a long night at the pub, but you have no money with you. Your only hope lies somewhere in the sewers, though you need the right equipment and a clear plan before heading down there. With the landlord waiting and time running against you, you explore the area, enter commands, and search for a way out of this awkward situation – when you are not quite sober, even reaching the hidden money becomes an adventure.

meta.name: Pub Trivia Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pub Trivia Simulator is a game that attempts to simulate an Arcade Quiz Machine found in public houses. The idea is to move up a pyramid answering questions on various subjects to reach the top so you can attempt another pyramid but for money. Before you start the game you can select how many players (1-4), which question block to load (1-3) and which avatar for your player.

meta.name: Pub Trivia Simulator

meta.name: Pucman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.27 KB

“Pucman” places players in a maze where they must collect points and avoid enemies. The gameplay remains simple but challenges players with strategic maneuvers and quick decisions. The controls are intuitive and reminiscent of classic arcade games, creating a nostalgic gaming experience.

meta.name: Pudding Breath
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.13 KB

In Pudding Breath, you guide a little fairy through a Christmas nightmare filled with flying puddings. You have to keep dodging, because every hit drains energy and brings the game closer to an end. With objects crossing the screen from all directions, there is barely time to breathe – stay calm and find the gaps in the chaos to keep the fairy in the air for longer.

meta.name: Pudwerx and Dawsy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.96 KB

In Pudwerx and Dawsy, you fight through a simple but tactical arena filled with platforms and ladders. Instead of just shooting wildly, you use the different routes to position yourself better, surprise enemies, and escape dangerous situations. The stripped-down presentation keeps the focus on movement and planning – climb smartly and attack at the right moment to gain the advantage.

meta.name: Puffy's Saga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Puffy's Saga tells the story of Puffy and his girlfriend Puffyn, who are trapped in a strange world full of dangers. You can control either Puffy, who is stronger, or Puffyn, who moves faster. The game is played from a top-down perspective and resembles a cute variant of Gauntlet. Each of the 20 levels requires you to eat a set number of dots while enemies surround you and drain your energy on contact. Meat restores energy, and your gun not only destroys enemies but also turns many into edible snacks that restore your strength. Keys open locked doors, while Magic Goms grant powers such as revealing a map or casting firebolts. Additional bonuses like invincibility or teleporting help you survive the perilous mazes.

meta.name: Pull
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.88 KB

Pull pits two players against each other in a direct head-to-head duel where every movement and decision matters. Inside a confined arena, quick reactions meet tactical foresight as both sides try to outmaneuver and defeat their opponent. Energy management, positioning and timing determine victory or defeat, and mistakes are punished instantly. The appeal comes from immediate competition, constant pressure and the certainty that only one will leave the arena alive – intense, unforgiving and entirely centered on the duel.

meta.name: Pulse Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.81 KB

Pulse Warrior replaces traditional weapons with energy manipulation, asking you to collect pulses and redirect them at enemies. You guide your ship through many zones, absorb power from solar platforms, and unleash stronger shots the more energy you gather. Pushing too far risks overheating, forcing careful timing and restraint. The unusual concept blends movement, risk, and planning – an action-focused skill challenge that rewards control, awareness, and strategic decision-making.

meta.name: Pulsoids
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.87 KB

Pulsoid is a game for one or two players and the aim is to remove all the Mirrorblocks above the Energy Mirror on each screen with the Energy Mirror and Laserpulse to move to the next level. As the Laserpulse bounces around the screen, it removes the blocks when hit but some blocks need multiple hits to remove it. Some blocks when hit release a Bonus Battery with a letter on it and when collected by the Energy Mirror gives the player a power-up like increase length, multiple pulses and activates a Plasma Barrier. If a pulse goes past the Energy Mirror to the bottom of the screen then the player loses one of three lives and if playing a two player game, the other player then plays.

meta.name: Pulz 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.30 KB

In Pulz 64, you fight your way through a chaotic field filled with tanks, bulldozers, and growing snakes. You have to avoid the vehicles while also stopping the snakes from spreading out of control. With every move, the screen becomes more dangerous as more threats close in around you – react quickly and stay aware to survive the night-time snake attack for longer.

meta.name: Punch & Judy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.61 KB

In Punch & Judy you control Punch, who must gather all parts of his tent and then find his cast around the streets of Bridlington in the summer of '89. You can move sideways, through alleys, and into buildings. Each tent part must be brought to the beach before fetching the next. Once the tent is complete, hit each cast member to lead them back. A policeman takes you to the station and removes your items, while a crocodile speeds up the tide – unless you drop one of your limited sausages to scare it off.

meta.name: Punchy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.01 KB

Como su nombre indica, Punchy se desarrolla en un teatro. Es una adaptación de "Punch & Judy": encarnas al jorobado Bobby y tu objetivo es abrirte paso a través de 16 escenas teatrales para rescatar a la bella Judy de las garras de Guiñol. Cada escenario está lleno de los peligros típicos de una obra de teatro tradicional, como cocodrilos, pasteles de nata y tomates podridos, así como fosos que tienes que cruzar utilizando plataformas móviles. De vez en cuando tendrás la suerte de atrapar una salchicha que vuela por los aires mientras te mueves.

meta.name: Punctuation Pete
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.82 KB

Punctuation Pete has you correcting poorly punctuated text by moving a character through the lines and inserting missing periods, commas, and capital letters. Your goal is to turn a messy paragraph into a proper, readable passage. Designed as an educational game, it offers a playful way to improve grammar and punctuation skills, especially for kids and language learners.

meta.name: Puppy's
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.53 KB

Puppy's guides a little dog through a house full of platforms and ladders, where every stage asks you to collect all the fruit. Along the way, you jump over holes, duck under birds, and avoid snakes and balls that pop out at the wrong moment. Good timing becomes increasingly important, as the hazards keep moving and some enemies can suddenly speed up. This creates a cute but demanding platform game that pleasantly combines collecting, reaction, and careful movement.

meta.name: Pure Seed
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Pure Seed, you guide a ship through side-scrolling zones and use a ball as your main weapon. To destroy enemies, you release it, watch its bounces, and have to catch it again before your limited number of bounces runs out. Marked areas help you move to higher levels, but enemies can carry the ball away and throw you off rhythm – release it wisely, follow up carefully, and keep an eye on the radar to get closer to the next level.

meta.name: Pure-Stat Baseball

It features eight legendary teams, ranging from the 1927 New York Yankees to the 1976 Cincinnati Reds. Games can be played between two players, against the computer, or fully simulated. Defensive players choose the pitch type and field positioning, while batters select their hitting technique. The game calculates the outcome and displays it in animated form on the screen.

Purple Heart is a top-down shooter à la Ikari Warriors. The player has to guide a soldier through six levels, killing everything that gets in his way. Enemies attack with guns and grenades and become increasingly stronger as the game progresses. Vehicles, helicopters and occasional traps (such as spikes shooting out of the ground) cannot be destroyed and must be avoided. Several extra weapons can be picked up, including: a double-barrelled shotgun, a machine gun, a flamethrower and a rocket launcher. While the shotgun replaces the standard weapon, all other weapons have limited ammunition, indicated by a bar at the bottom of the screen. At the end of each level, a boss-fight awaits the player. A simultaneous two-player mode is also available.

meta.name: Purple Turtles
meta.desc:

Purple Turtles challenges you to cross a river by using moving turtles as a living bridge while collecting fruit from the far side. You plan each step carefully, wait for safe positions, and move at the right moment as turtles suddenly dive and reappear. One mistake costs progress, making timing and patience essential. As difficulty increases, multiple turtles move at once, raising the tension – a skill challenge that rewards awareness, rhythm, and precise decision-making.

meta.name: Push
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.61 KB

Push is a Sokoban variant.
A nice strategy game that looks quite simple at first glance, but has some difficulties. After starting, you will see a house with 28 cleverly placed boxes. The game's main character appears at the top left of the screen and can be brought to life using the joystick in Port 2. All boxes should now be pushed to the exit. When you finally manage to do this, the game is over!

A crate can only be moved when the path is clear, and one wrong push can trap it in a corner or block your own way. The counters for moves and pushes invite you to search for better solutions – think patiently and avoid rushing to clear each field cleanly.

meta.name: Push-It
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Push-It!, you compete in a direct sliding-puzzle contest and try to rebuild the 5x5 picture faster than your opponent. Every move changes the pattern and can either bring you closer to the goal or create new detours. This turns the match into a quick duel of awareness, planning, and steady control – shift the pieces cleverly, and you prove yourself as the puzzle master.

meta.name: Puxxle
meta.desc:

Puxxle invites you into a calm puzzle game where you arrange colored areas and gradually bring the picture into the right shape. Each move changes the layout, so it pays to look closely instead of shifting things at random. Together with the music, this creates a relaxed brain-teaser feel – ideal for short rounds where patience and a good eye matter more than speed.

meta.name: Puzzlacki
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.19 KB

Puzzlacki is a classic puzzle game with 8 available pictures. The player may setup difficulty level and timer or select any of the pictures. The game screen is divided into three parts: table with mixed puzzles, timer, picture frame.

meta.name: Puzzle : Gates of the Incas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.09 KB

Puzzle: Gates of the Incas places you before a sacred Incan stone gate, where only the sharp-eyed may pass. Nine tiles display ancient symbols, but one is an impostor. Spot the odd one out before time runs out, or your quest ends in failure. Every correct answer brings you closer to treasure, every mistake to ruin. A simple yet tense puzzle game wrapped in the mystery of a lost civilization.

meta.name: Puzzle Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Puzzle Mania is a digital version of a 25-piece sliding puzzle, where numbered pieces must be arranged in the correct order to restore a larger overall image.

meta.name: Puzzle Panic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.93 KB

Puzzle Panic guides you and the character Benny through a series of pattern-based challenges that work both as standalone puzzles and as parts of a larger meta puzzle. You follow clues, touch symbols in the correct order, and avoid hazards as each stage introduces new ways of thinking. Completing levels reveals pieces that must later be combined to solve the final sequence, gradually uncovering the bigger mystery. The experience blends logic, observation, and timing – a varied puzzle adventure that rewards pattern recognition, patience, and problem-solving skills.

meta.name: Puzzle Shuffle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.14 KB

Puzzle Shuffle challenges you to restore a scrambled picture under time pressure. Once the game begins, the individual pieces are mixed up, and you have to move them back into place with as few moves as possible. On the left, you keep track of time, points, and the high score, while every move needs careful thought – a direct puzzle game for anyone who likes to spot patterns, combine quickly, and improve their result.

meta.name: Puzzlemaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Puzzlemaster desafía al jugador a ensamblar una imagen a partir de piezas dispersas. Cada pieza debe colocarse en el lugar correcto para ganar puntos y completar la imagen final.

meta.name: Puzzlenoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Puzzlenoid, you're presented with two grids of golden blocks – the left shows the starting pattern, the right the target. Your task is to manipulate the left grid to match the right one, all within a limited number of moves and time. Each action must be carefully considered, as points, time, and moves are restricted. A game for calm thinkers with a sense for structure and logic.

meta.name: Puzznic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.83 KB

El reto en cada nivel de Puzznic consiste en maniobrar una selección de bloques hasta colocarlos en su posición para despejarlos todos, haciendo contacto con bloques del mismo estilo. Controlas una cruz direccional que puede mover un bloque a izquierda o derecha, haciendo que caiga si no hay ningún bloque debajo del espacio que ocuparía.
Resolver los niveles presenta una serie de complicaciones. Las plataformas móviles hacen que tengas que mover un bloque en un momento determinado, o en un orden concreto, para evitar que se bloqueen.

meta.name: Pyjamarama
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.92 KB

Wally Week está atrapado en una de sus propias pesadillas y puede que no se despierte a tiempo para ir a trabajar en la fábrica de automóviles. Sólo tú puedes salvarlo del desastre inevitable, encontrando la llave que puede acabar con su sueño. Su mundo de sueños es vasto y variado, con escaleras mecánicas, ascensores y puertas cerradas. Solo se pueden transportar dos elementos a la vez, pero algunos deben usarse en conjunto y otros solo se activan cuando los pisas mientras llevas uno o dos elementos necesarios para activarse.

meta.name: Pyramid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.32 KB

The player takes the role of an archaeologist. The game starts in a tent on the site of an excavation. The object of the game is to explore the site and to recover four treasures and bring them back to the tent. Progress through the game is measured by the player's score, the maximum possible score being 100.

meta.name: Adventure #08 : Pyramid Of Doom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.23 KB

Adventure #08: Pyramid of Doom te lleva a una peligrosa búsqueda del tesoro en las profundidades de una pirámide egipcia recién descubierta. Secretos, trampas y antiguos rompecabezas te esperan mientras buscas valiosos tesoros mientras intentas escapar con vida. Con un sencillo sistema de comandos de dos palabras, recorrerás pasajes ocultos y te enfrentarás a los desafíos de la tumba. Pero cuidado: ¡no todos los que entran en la pirámide logran salir!

meta.name: Pyramid Pete
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Pyramid Pete is an isometric puzzle platformer reminiscent of „Q*bert“. The player controls Pete, navigating a pyramid-shaped playfield while changing colored tiles and avoiding enemy creatures. Every move presents a new challenge, as unpredictable foes add to the difficulty, requiring strategic thinking. Speed and foresight are crucial to mastering levels and achieving a high score.

meta.name: Pyramid Puzzler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.92 KB

Pyramid Puzzler challenges you to test your strategic thinking and reaction speed. Your goal is to outsmart the computer and reach the top of the pyramid first. Each correct answer allows you to move, while wrong answers set you back and give the computer an advantage. Smart positioning and quick decisions can influence the computer's path and keep it away from victory. But be careful – every move matters, and the time pressure adds to the challenge!

meta.name: The Pyramid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.10 KB

The Pyramid sends the player on a quest to find the lost tomb of Rak-Tuman and its immeasurable treasures. But the journey is perilous – many have set out, yet few have returned. Equipped with a map, the player ventures through the vast desert, where getting lost is a constant threat. Should they reach the mysterious pyramid, tricky puzzles, deadly traps, and eerie creatures await. The game is a classic text adventure where the environment is described, and the player interacts with the world through keyboard commands.

meta.name: The Pyramid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.73 KB

The Pyramid is a shoot 'em up set in a massive pyramid with 120 chambers. The player starts at the top and makes their way down through various rooms, each featuring unique alien types with fixed movement patterns. The character can move in all directions but can only shoot left and right. After defeating enough enemies, a crystal falls, which is needed to deactivate the force fields at the exits. Its color changes from white to yellow to blue – only in its blue form can it be safely collected. A shield protects the player from enemies, but once its energy reaches zero, the game is over.

meta.name: Die Pyramide
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.42 KB

A highly recommended platform game. The game can be quite frustrating as there are many different paths and only one exit. Also unlike other games, enemy movements are completely random.

meta.name: Pyro's Pyramid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

You have entered the desert of Lostsand and travel to the Pyramid of Pyro.
You adventure in a Pyramid (the Pyro's Pyramid) and your mission is to gain as much experience as you can and bring back the Eternal Flame, one of Pyro's prized possession.
A map of the dungeon is provided in the top right corner of the screen.

meta.name: Q*bert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.00 KB

Qbert brings classic arcade action to your screen, challenging you to transform a pyramid into the target color by hopping across its tiles. Each jump changes a tile, but in later levels you'll need to step on tiles multiple times – or avoid doing so too often. All the while, enemies such as Coily the snake, Slick, Sam, and falling balls try to stop you. Fortunately, floating discs at the pyramid's edge can save you – leap onto one at the right moment and Qbert is carried safely back to the top while Coily plunges off the board.

meta.name: Q-Bopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.55 KB

Q-Bopper is a blatant rip-off of Q*Bert. You must advance your character to change the colors of the cubes while watching out for enemies and even yourself as you don't want to change the colors back.

meta.name: Q-hop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.90 KB

Q-Hop is a swedish Q*bert clone.

meta.name: Q10 Tankbuster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.39 KB

Q10 Tankbuster puts you in the cockpit and sends you into hostile war zones where you destroy enemy vehicles, planes, and key targets using your front gun and bombs. Occasionally a blue helicopter appears – if hit, it drops an icon that grants more firepower, a shield, or an extra life. Taking hits from bullets or enemy machines costs a life. Once all lives are lost, the game ends. Each level concludes with a massive boss vehicle you must defeat to advance. The screen scrolls sideways constantly as you steer your aircraft.

meta.name: Qa!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

QA! begins after a failed expedition whose camp has been completely destroyed. Your only chance of rescue is to learn the radio frequency – but one of the two people who know it is dead, and Kate Mallender has been taken by the people of QA. That leaves only the search for her: step by step, you explore the surroundings, interpret clues, and make your way through a mysterious adventure where survival and rescue are closely connected.

meta.name: QIX
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, you guide a marker which must draw rectangles and other weird objects in order to claim your territory, and you can either draw these rectangles fast or slow. Drawing the rectangles using the "slow" method awards you the most points. Once a rectangle has been made, it will be colored in to show that you have claimed your territory. While drawing the rectangles, you need to watch out for Qix (pronounced "kicks"), a series of colored lines that crawl the screen. In addition to Qix, you also need to avoid the Sparks who travel around the border, as well as any lines that you have made, as well as The Fuse, who travels along the line that you are drawing. Once you have claimed enough territory, you proceed to the next level.

meta.name: Quad II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.96 KB

Quad II expands the classic ball-and-paddle idea across all four sides of the screen, making the task of clearing the blocks especially lively. You keep the ball in play with several paddles, aim for the remaining stones, and collect useful bonuses when they appear from destroyed blocks. At the same time, you have to avoid dangerous symbols – creating a frantic reaction game where quick switching and good awareness are essential.

meta.name: Quadra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.44 KB

Quadra turns the classic noughts-and-crosses idea into a spatial battle of wits across four levels. You place your stones to create a line of four – horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or across several layers. Since the opponent is building their own lines at the same time, you constantly have to balance attack and defense – an unusual puzzle game that cleverly expands familiar rules.

meta.name: Quadranoid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quadranoid is a cooperative Arkanoid-style game for two players. Each player controls their own paddle, and teamwork is essential to keep the ball in play and clear all blocks. The colorful layouts and shared challenge add excitement, coordination, and a fresh twist to the classic Breakout formula.

meta.name: Quadrant
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quadrant combines the familiar Tic-Tac-Toe idea with a race against the clock and a scoring duel against the computer. You place your marks as cleverly as possible, try to complete lines, and need to score more points before time runs out. Only by winning the round do you advance to the next stage. Thanks to its unusually elaborate presentation, Quadrant feels far livelier than its simple core concept might suggest.

meta.name: Quadratic Area
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.38 KB

“Quadratic Area” is a tricky isometric game where the player controls a Pacman-like character that moves across a game board while avoiding obstacles. The charming, grinning ball-man is navigated across a field of diagonal paths using joysticks or a keyboard, with precise control being crucial to avoid falling. The game combines elements of classic titles and stands out with 3D graphics that create an engaging gameplay experience. Players can compete solo or in pairs, with skillful movement across the board being the key to success.

meta.name: Quadrato
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.19 KB

Quadrato challenges you to move all stones into their designated holes while thinking carefully about every step. What first seems simple quickly becomes tricky, because narrow paths, walls, and badly placed blocks can block the route to the solution. This creates a calm but demanding pushing puzzle – whoever plans ahead and moves the stones in the right order gets closer to the goal piece by piece.

meta.name: Quadro-Power
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.47 KB

"Quadro-Power" is a single-screen game where one to four players navigate simple mazes. The goal is to collect all the dots on the paths and achieve the highest score across multiple screens. The paths are connected by discs with gaps, and they are filled with dots, hearts, and diamonds. Hearts provide bonus points, while diamonds grant set points. To change paths, players enter a disc and rotate it 90 degrees, which costs set points. The more points a player has, the more times they can rotate the discs, but if the points go negative, one of five lives is lost. Touching creatures or running out of time also costs a life, and the next player takes their turn.

meta.name: Quadromania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.57 KB

“Quadromania” is a challenging puzzle game that requires logical thinking and strategic planning. Players must act skillfully to solve puzzles and achieve complex patterns or objectives, while the gameplay captivates with its clear structure and increasing difficulty levels.

meta.name: Quak-Attak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.90 KB

Quak-Attak puts you on a flying mount and throws you into airborne duels against several opponents. With your laser lance, you have to strike from above, knock your rivals out of the saddle, and then catch them on the ground before they escape. At the same time, dragons and enemy attacks keep the danger constant – a fast, chaotic combat game where height, timing, and bold attacks decide each round.

meta.name: Quake Minus One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.44 KB

„Quake Minus One“ is set in a future where the Western world has built the massive geothermal plant Titan beneath the Atlantic Ocean to harness energy from the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. The facility is operated solely by robots. A group called the Robot Liberation Front seizes control of the machines, demanding equal rights for robots — otherwise, they threaten to use the plant to trigger a massive earthquake that would endanger America, Europe, and Africa. Titan is controlled by five main computers: Zeus, Poseidon, Vulcan, Ares, and Hermes. Scientists have managed to regain control of Hermes, and using the robots under its command, it is now up to the player to reclaim the remaining systems before they regain dominance.

meta.name: Quango
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quango puts you in control of a droid exploring eight hazardous caves to collect mushrooms. Careful planning is vital, as poisonous plants, rocks, and hostile droids block your path. Quango birds relentlessly chase you, and your limited supply of bombs can clear obstacles or destroy enemies – but can also kill you if you're too close. Only sharp thinking and quick moves will get you through this deadly challenge.

meta.name: Quann Tulla
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.25 KB

Quann Tulla begins with an urgent mission: a stolen spaceship must be recovered and a traitor stopped before vital secrets fall into the wrong hands. But your own ship is damaged, the air is running out, and simply surviving becomes the first challenge. Through typed commands, you explore locations, solve problems, and work your way toward the goal step by step – a tense space adventure where every decision matters.

meta.name: Quantum
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.40 KB

Quantum presents you with an abstract puzzle where colored fields, symbols, and movable elements have to be used correctly. You move through the playfield, look for the right paths, and try to understand the arrangement step by step. The reduced presentation is exactly what gives it its appeal – a tricky brain-teaser where observation, planning, and careful experimentation lead to the solution.

meta.name: Quark IX
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.57 KB

Quark is described as a '3D-Space Simulation', you control an 'astro fighter' and the aim of the game is to take off from your planet and seek out enemy ships and engage them in combat before they destroy the main reactor on your planet. Although the advert states that it would be 'in shops 2nd June' there are no in-game screenshots, only a picture of what would presumably be the cover of the game. The game was never officially released.

meta.name: Quark IX
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.62 KB

Quark is described as a '3D-Space Simulation', you control an 'astro fighter' and the aim of the game is to take off from your planet and seek out enemy ships and engage them in combat before they destroy the main reactor on your planet. Although the advert states that it would be 'in shops 2nd June' there are no in-game screenshots, only a picture of what would presumably be the cover of the game. The game was never officially released.

meta.name: Quartet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Your job is to basically find the end-of-level boss, and then defeat it to obtain the key that will open the level exit, but your task is made difficult by the planet's inhabitants. Get the jet-pack to make it easier to navigate the level and shoot any inhabitants that get in the way. These inhabitants will leave behind something that you can get to increase your score, and the inhabitants will eventually regenerate. If any one of them touches you while you have the jet-pack, you land on the ground or the nearest platform, and have to get it again; and the same rule applies to the key.

meta.name: Quarx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quarx is a calm puzzle game in which you move different blocks along dark paths and place them in the correct positions. With each new stage, the layouts become more complex, so you need to plan your moves ahead and carefully consider the order of your actions. Even small mistakes can force you to start another attempt. Quarx draws its appeal from its clear puzzle concept, steadily increasing challenge, and the satisfying feeling of finally solving a difficult arrangement.

meta.name: Quasar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.50 KB

Quasar is a single player space shoot-em up game. The story behind the game places the player in command of a sophisticated space fighter on a mission to destroy the Etron rocket base on the planet Hagon thus saving the galaxy.
The game starts with the player flying down a space tunnel shooting down enemy astro-fighters that attack both head on and from behind. Following this phase the player then engages more enemy fighters in space before progressing to the next level which is on the planet surface. The player has three lives and the aim of the game is to achieve a high score.

meta.name: Quasar Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.88 KB

Quasar Zone is a single-screen shooter where you move a spacecraft, left or right on the bottom of the screen blasting aliens that appear at the top of the screen in various patterns over various levels. You are blasting aliens in a part of the Universe where mega races battle each other for supreme power with spacecrafts that have surpassed the laws of physics. As you blast, most of the aliens have a random attack pattern and can be avoided but certain aliens keep moving across the screen getting lower and these need to be destroyed as they will move across the bottom of the screen and kill you. if you are hit by an alien or its weapon then you lose one of three lives. To move to the next level you need to score 5000 points.

meta.name: Quasimodo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.23 KB

"Quasimodo" is an action-packed platformer where you play as a hunchback defending his tower from attacking knights by hurling rocks at them. After each wave, a new phase begins where you climb ladders and swing across bell ropes, collecting gems to deposit in altars. Deadly bats and rolling boulders make the journey more perilous, while archers on higher levels fire arrows at you. The cycle of defense and exploration repeats endlessly — a never-ending struggle for survival in the dark heights of the tower.

meta.name: Queens
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.12 KB

Queens is a chessboard-based game, initially featuring only pawns that can capture diagonally or move one square diagonally. If a pawn reaches the opponent's side of the board, it transforms into a queen, who can only move diagonally, as many times as she wishes. Unlike chess, capturing pieces is mandatory. A strange alternative to chess, which, while lacking the depth of its illustrious predecessor, can entertain you for a while with its attractive graphics and a pleasant soundtrack.

meta.name: The Quest for Atlantis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.82 KB

You must recover valuable platinum diamonds scattered along the walls of the underground city. Extreme precision is required, as the slightest contact with the walls will cause your gyro ship to explode. Also be alert to the defense lines the Ancients built before fleeing the planet: powerful lasers, cannons hidden between rocks, falling weights that can crush you. Each Rumble collected gives you energy to continue your mission.

meta.name: Quest for Quintana Roo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.80 KB

In Quest for Quintana Roo, you play as Yucatan Sam, climbing and exploring an ancient Mayan temple in search of a hidden vault filled with treasure. Poisonous snakes, deadly lightning, spiders, and mummies stand in your way, and you'll need to manage limited weapons and air supply wisely. Use your pickaxe and acid flasks to uncover secret rooms, and rely on your Geiger counter to guide you to hidden items. Only those who search smartly and survive the dangers will reach the vault.

meta.name: Quest for Tarek
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quest for Tarek is a futuristic text adventure that takes the player on an exciting journey aboard a spaceship. The plot unfolds in a science fiction setting in which the player must solve a series of puzzles and overcome challenges in search of Tarek, possibly a missing crew member or a valuable cargo.

p: Quest for the Garden of Eden (USA).D64
n: Quest for the Garden of Eden (USA)

meta.name: Quest for the Garden of Eden
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Travel back through time to stop Adam from eating the apple! Avoid the obstacles of the ages! Jump over Robert Bruce's spider! Beware Cleopatra's fine asp! Watch out for Dr. Livingstone's gorilla! But whatever you do, get back to the garden for all our sake's. Plan in arcade or adventure mode, or do both!

p: Quest for the Golden Eggcup, The (Europe).T64
n: Quest for the Golden Eggcup, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Quest for the Golden Eggcup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.01 KB

The Quest for the Golden Eggcup is a humorous, single player, text adventure. The game doesn't have a grand back story about wizards and magic, instead it starts with the player standing in the middle of the motorway and being hit by a pink Citroen C5 driven by a very pink, pink panther. Naturally they get run down and are killed immediately whereupon they meet God who gives the player their quest, which is to find his treasured golden egg cup or else there will be dire consequences. The player's progress is recorded both as a score and in the number of turns taken.

p: Quest for the Holy Grail, The (Europe).T64
n: Quest for the Holy Grail, The (Europe)

meta.name: The Quest for the Holy Grail
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.26 KB

The Quest for the Holy Grail falls into the genre of a text adventure game but in addition to the text there are simple pictures which help add to the descriptions of the locations you are in and add to the atmosphere as you move around the game world.
You take on the role of the knight Sir Tappin, who is on a mission to track down the Holy Grail. You must navigate your way around the villages and countryside of medieval England to track down the clues that will help you on your quest. You will need to find objects to help you negotiate your way past the characters dotted along the way, such as the White Rabbit and the Knight Who Says Nic. The Quest for the Holy Grail is a trip through a possible version of history, with a liberal sprinkling of humour thrown in too.

meta.name: The Quest of Kron
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.22 KB

meta.name: Quest of Merravid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.89 KB

You are Merravid, son of Aranoid and you have been asked by Dwarves in the land of Thargon to retrieve their magical firestone. After being lost for many years it has been tracked down to a mountain and guarded by a dragon. The Dwarves tried and failed to get it back and have now asked yourself to try but not until you wear the correct armour. Only one set of armour exits in the land though and it is scattered throughout the land and you have to collect the pieces before you can face the dragon. The Quest of Merravid is a text adventure with the screen having text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

p: Quest of the Space Beagle, The (USA).D64
n: Quest of the Space Beagle, The (USA)

meta.name: The Quest of the Space Beagle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Quest of the Space Beagle tells the story of a stranded spaceship traveling through a distant galaxy. In search of a way home, the player must face numerous adventures, including battles against hostile spacecraft and the exploration of mysterious labyrinths. The journey takes the player through the entire known universe, using authentic star maps to chart the correct course.

meta.name: Quest, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.68 KB

The Quest is a text adventure where the player's task is to find an ancient man of wisdom called The Maker and reunite him with his source of power. Like in other text adventures the player interacts with the world by entering two word commands made up of nouns and verbs such as "go north" and "eat pie". Items found can be placed in a inventory with a "get" or "take" command but the maximum weight that can be carried is 50 lbs. The hero has a strength rating which decreases for every move and it is therefore necessary to find food to eat and water to drink to regain it. Some food and water can be poisonous and has to be avoided since it will instead decrease the strength. The game consists of 120 rooms and 53 objects and ends with a 37 room maze.

meta.name: The Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Quest is a graphic fantasy text adventure computer game released in 1983 by Penguin Software. Originally designed by Dallas Snell for the Apple II and was later ported to several other home computer systems of the era. The game takes place in a medieval fantasy setting in the Kingdom of Balema as a dragon threatens its citizens. The player takes the role of the King's newest Adviser and with the help of the King's champion, Gorn, set out to end the dragon menace.

meta.name: A Question of Sport
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El juego se basa en el concurso de la BBC del mismo nombre. Dos equipos compiten respondiendo a preguntas deportivas. Se conceden 2 puntos por una respuesta correcta. Si responde incorrectamente, el equipo contrario tiene la oportunidad de responder a la pregunta, pero sólo gana 1 punto.
Los candidatos están representados por caras digitalizadas, cada una especializada en un deporte concreto. Los capitanes de los equipos eligen en cuál de los diez deportes desean especializarse.

You play Spider-Man, Peter Parker's crime-fighting alter-ego, as he takes on Mysterio, who can block out Parker's Spidery senses using his canisters of poison. As in The Hulk, the Examiner plays a key part in the game, as he initially strips Spider-Man's knowledge and prepares him for the battle. Throughout the game you meet many familiar Marvel characters, using the clues in the provided guidebook to help you deal with these situations correctly.

“Questron” takes you into a vast fantasy world viewed from a top-down perspective. Towns, forests, mountains, and enemies are represented with classic tile graphics, and your character's appearance changes depending on your mode of travel – starting, for example, on foot. You issue turn-based commands to fight, explore, and manage your inventory. Later in the game, dungeons shift to a 3D first-person view, adding tension and variety. Strategy, exploration, and courage are key to conquering this adventure.

„Quick Draw McGraw“ is a fast-paced side-scrolling action game where the player – as a cartoon cowboy – must protect trains from bandits. You run along and across train cars, dodge obstacles like smoke clouds or birds, confront enemies and use precise shots to clear your path. Clever jumps let you access lower levels of the train – but fall to the ground, and you must start over. Certain sections shift into a first-person view where foes must be spotted and shot quickly – hitting a grandma by mistake costs you energy. At the end of each train, a boss awaits – defeat him to move on.

meta.name: Quick Thinking!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.93 KB

Quick Thinking! blends learning with fast-paced gameplay in two action-packed games that sharpen math skills and reflexes. In Sum Vaders, you shoot down aliens by selecting the correct total before they land – a math shooter in space. In Robot Tables, you navigate a factory world and must match the correct answer to multiplication problems. But be warned: a terrifying wrong-answer robot appears if you fail, adding an eerie twist to this educational title. Fun and functional – with a touch of fright.

meta.name: Quick-Cartage Company
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Quick-Cartage Company you take on the role of a truck driver aiming to earn as much money as possible through smart planning and navigation. You travel across maps with different scales, choose your own routes, and deliver building materials from supply yards to the correct construction sites. You must carefully decide which routes are worth taking and which cargo brings the highest profit, as your capacity is limited. Mistakes like poor planning, accidents, or running out of fuel cost time and money, while smart decisions push you ahead. In the end, the winner is the one who completes deliveries most efficiently and builds the greatest fortune.

Quink is a puzzle game for one or two players. In each round of the game, eight names, places, or objects will appear on the screen that will be associated in some way. Out of the eight items, two to six will not be related to the others. The player needs to identify which item(s) are loners and remove them from the list in the given time limit. For each wrong guess the player will lose a life; if three lives are lost, the game ends.

meta.name: Quintic Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.69 KB

The player controls a spacecraft over a grid of dots and can move across the screen and shoot in all eight directions. Hordes of mutants (small creatures of indefinite appearance and of different colors) appear at the base of the screen and slowly advance upwards and must be hit before they reach the upper side, otherwise the game is lost instantly. Along the lower edge and the two side edges there are three laser cannons, in the style of the best known Gridrunner , who follow the spacecraft and shoot beams of rays upwards and horizontally; a single beam is harmless, but if the spacecraft is caught in the intersecting area between a horizontal and a vertical beam, a life is lost. In the event of a collision with a mutant, only 1/10 of the vital energy is lost and the mutant is destroyed. Progressing in the game, appear other types of enemies that shoot rockets from the edges.

Quinx is a top-view single-screen game where you play the role of Arthur Crown, stressing about his final exams in Food Economy at the London School of Economics. The stress has led to Arthur dreaming at night about Ink Worms and a large piece of paper that he is standing on and has to be protected from the worms. The worms appear at the side of the paper and start to move across leaving behind an ink trail. Arthur has to run around the paper and swat the worms to kill them trying to stop any from reaching the other side of the paper.

Quizam! is a quiz game for 1 to 8 players
Eight mysterious dark satellites orbiting the Earth must be destroyed. Your onboard computers have malfunctioned and generated an enormous amount of strange, cryptic and even trivial questions! Knowledge must be combined with careful strategy if you want to gain access to the satellites and complete this mission successfully!
Players move around the game board trying to collect the eight satellites displayed on the screen. At the start of each round, the player attempts to correctly answer a 4-question multiple-choice question. The player receives movement points based on how quickly they answer questions. The player must have the correct number of movement points to end his turn directly on the satellite. There are 8 different board layouts, 8 different difficulty levels and the games can be short or long.

Quo Vadis sends you into a vast cave labyrinth where you search for a mysterious scepter while constantly balancing exploration and danger. Your crusader fights through sprawling chambers, avoids lava pits, and has to fend off monsters while his weapon fires automatically in the direction he moves. That makes encounters especially hectic, because escape and attack are closely tied together. With only one life, visible energy loss, and helpful treasure chests, the game becomes a tense adventure that demands careful movement and quick reactions.

meta.name: Quod Init Exit
meta.desc:

Quod Init Exit is a humorous single-screen platformer where you control a hungry pig. Your goal is to grab enough food before starving – but beware: poison bottles mean instant death. Once the hunger meter is full, a toilet appears. Reach it in time to complete the level. Miss it, and all that's left behind is a pile of pig poop – game over. A simple concept, bizarre idea and classic arcade action with a twist.

Quota tasks you with collecting enough green Moonunits and blue energy pills to prepare your ship for takeoff. Once your energy reserves are sufficient, you launch from the pad and battle attacking aliens – maneuvering carefully, firing accurately, and avoiding enemy hits. After clearing the skies, you slow down to land and refuel before continuing your mission, repeating the cycle until all objectives are complete and the exit opens – a constant balance of gathering, flying, fighting, and precise landings.

Quark is described as a '3D-Space Simulation', you control an 'astro fighter' and the aim of the game is to take off from your planet and seek out enemy ships and engage them in combat before they destroy the main reactor on your planet. Although the advert states that it would be 'in shops 2nd June' there are no in-game screenshots, only a picture of what would presumably be the cover of the game. The game was never officially released.

In R: The Ultimate Joystick Killer, two players compete to destroy their own fields as quickly as possible. First, you click your starting field, then your own fields in any order, and finally your target field. If you accidentally click an opponent's field, it becomes yours, giving them an advantage. Speed and strategic thinking are crucial to win. A sturdy joystick is recommended — it's going to get intense!

meta.name: R-Nest

R-Nest is a Q*Bert-style single-screen game where you hop around a cube pyramid, painting the tops by landing on them. Early levels need just one touch, later ones require several. Avoid bouncing balls, the snake Gangal, and Zouszous, who resets your progress. Falling off loses a life but restarts you at your last position. Collect green pills to stun enemies and use side elevators once per level to return to the top.

The experience blends cautious exploration with frantic evasion – a skill challenge where timing, path choice, and awareness make the difference.

The Race Against Time places the player in the role of Sudanese athlete Omar Khalifa, who faces a unique challenge. Starting from the El-Mowheli aid camp in Sudan, Khalifa travels across six continents within a limited time to raise flags and ignite flames. Along the way, he passes world-famous landmarks such as the Statue of Liberty, the Leaning Tower of Pisa, the Sydney Opera House, and the Eiffel Tower. The player can collect items to overcome obstacles but can only carry one item at a time. Found hourglasses grant extra time, but the race ends if time runs out or Khalifa encounters dangerous obstacles.

Race Chase is a classic racing game for the Commodore 64. In this game, players take on the role of a police officer who pursues criminals in a high-speed vehicle through various cityscapes. The goal is to catch up with the fleeing criminals and stop them before they can escape. The gameplay is characterized by its simple controls and the 8-bit graphics typical of the time. Players must avoid obstacles, navigate traffic and maintain speed in order to successfully catch the criminals.

meta.desc:

In The Race, your goal is to complete six different courses to become champion. The screen is split in two so two players can drive at the same time. For the first time in the history of the competition, you try to complete the routes in your 6000 SUX Turbo sports car. The races themselves take place in packed stadiums six miles above ground on Simu – World Four, with people also watching in their IPF Styro houses.
Each course must be completed within a certain time period and there are various obstacles blocking your way. Ramps and jumps can be used to overcome the obstacles. If you have an accident, you will float through the air but at the slowest speed. By pressing fire you can land and accelerate again. Once you reach the finish line, move on to the next course and attempt to complete it.

The Races: Go Racing with Peter O'Sullevan turns horse racing above all into a social betting game in which not only the race itself, but also the preparation beforehand creates much of the appeal. You compare horses, form, trainers, and jockeys, place your money carefully, and hope that your smart picks will bring in the biggest return. The fact that several players can compete against each other adds an enjoyable sense of rivalry to the whole experience. As a result, the game thrives less on raw action than on tension, risk, and the thrill of the next bet.

Practice modes let you retake shots, which is especially useful for beginners since each attempt involves choosing the target ball, its intended position, shot strength, and spin. With 16 levels to beat, you'll need speed, caution, and clever moves to keep Barry safe and well-fed.

The player with the highest score after two minutes wins. A built-in editor also lets you design your own courses and play them right away.

After entering your name, you enter the plaza, where you have complete freedom of movement – just like the bull. You earn points by skillfully passing the animal with style and finesse. In moments of danger, you can drop your capote to run faster and distract the beast. And if the bull does manage to hit you, no worries – you simply get back up – reclaim your cloth – and face the challenge again.

meta.name: Rags to Riches
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.83 KB

The game starts with the player assuming the role of an unnamed homeless vagrant living in a fictional city, divided into four sections, titled North, South, West, and East. The player begins in the South section. To complete the game the player must accumulate $1,000,000 cash by progressing from the life of a vagrant, cleaning up by getting a haircut, securing odd jobs, attending High School, College, and eventually becoming a millionaire. Money is collected by finding dimes and $1 notes on the street and taking up employment. Bottles can also be found and exchanged for money at several stores. Movement within the city is within a scrolling two-dimensional landscape containing non-interactive pedestrians and foes. A subway system with an entrance in each section of the city allows the player to travel between sections of the city. Before travel, the player must purchase a ticket, with a maximum of five tickets able to be held at any one time.

meta.name: Raid 2000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.15 KB

The Xanthidians have invaded Earth and are slowly spreading across countries and cities, taking control. You are tasked with destroying the invaders in four raider boats from a base in the South Pacific. You have to look at a world map with purple areas under alien control and green areas still under human control. Moving a Raider vehicle over an invading part will tell you if an alien reactor facility is active.
Once you've selected an area, the game turns into a top-down shooter, scrolling in different directions as you move your ship, and speed is controlled via the joystick. You must find and destroy the reactor before destroying all the ships with your laser.

meta.name: Raid on Bungeling Bay
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Raid on Bungeling Bay puts you in control of a combat helicopter flying missions over enemy territory, aiming to destroy factories before the enemy war machine grows too strong. You launch from a carrier that must be protected, as it's your only source of bombs and repairs. With enemy forces growing from tanks to a massive battleship, each mission becomes a high-stakes act of precision, strategy, and firepower.

meta.name: Raid on New York
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.56 KB

Raid on New York puts you in control of Japan's last Kamikaze pilot, limping over Manhattan after being hit during the Pearl Harbor attack. You must bomb skyscrapers to clear a path for landing, repair your damaged plane, and continue the assault. Timing your bomb drops is crucial – miss too often, and you'll crash before touching down.

meta.name: Raid over Moscow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Raid over Moscow te sumerge en una crisis global: la Unión Soviética ha lanzado un ataque contra EE. UU., y solo tu escuadrón puede cambiar el rumbo. En múltiples fases llenas de acción, primero despegarás desde el hangar con tantas unidades como sea posible, aunque la baja gravedad dificulta el despegue. Después, te adentrarás en territorio soviético, evitando radares, luchando contra aviones enemigos y planeando cerca del suelo para pasar desapercibido. En escenas posteriores, dispararás desde las ventanas a los artilleros enemigos, defenderás la entrada de la base y usarás discos rebotadores para desactivar los robots de mantenimiento. El objetivo es sobrecalentar la base soviética y detener el ataque, todo antes de que explote la bomba.

meta.name: Raiders of the Lost Arch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.38 KB

“Raiders of the Lost Arch” challenges you to evade fluttering monsters and collect all the treasures. With each completed level, the monsters become faster and more aggressive, steadily increasing the difficulty. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to secure the treasures.

meta.name: Railboss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rail Boss places you in the role of a railway pioneer tasked with building a line across the American West. You manage workers, provide protection against bandits and respond to threats that constantly endanger progress. Stations built along the route generate income to pay staff and acquire new resources, while external dangers demand constant vigilance. The appeal comes from developing under pressure, balancing risk and investment, and racing against forces eager to exploit every weakness – strategic, tense and driven by the struggle to push forward.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Birmingham
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.42 KB

"Rail Traffic Control: Birmingham" is a railway simulation game where the player takes control of train operations at Birmingham Station. Managing arrivals and departures, handling delays, and optimizing track capacity are key responsibilities. The simulation provides a detailed representation of train movements, requiring strategic planning to ensure smooth operations.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Bristol TM
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.85 KB

In Rail Traffic Control: Bristol TM, you take on the role of a signal controller at Bristol Temple Meads station. You manage train arrivals and departures, respond to delays, switch tracks, and monitor platform occupancy – all in real time. Precision and a clear overview are key to keeping the rail network running smoothly.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Buxton
meta.desc:

In Rail Traffic Control: Buxton, you manage freight traffic around Buxton station. You coordinate incoming and outgoing cargo trains, assign locomotives, and schedule shunting assistance. The goal is to minimize delays and maintain smooth operations within a complex rail network.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Carlisle
meta.desc:

In Rail Traffic Control: Carlisle, you take charge of managing railway movements at the Carlisle Locomotive Works. Your task is to ensure smooth operations, maintain the passenger train schedule, and meet all contractual obligations to achieve success.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Crewe

In this game, you take on the responsibility of managing the rails at the Crewe Locomotive works. You orchestrate the movements in the "iron ballet" of heavy trains and ensure that passenger trains run on time to meet all contracted schedules and succeed.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Doncaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.02 KB

Rail Traffic Control: Doncaster puts you in charge of one of the busiest railway hubs in the country. You must manage incoming and outgoing trains, coordinate platforms, and keep everything running on time. One mistake could lead to delays – or total gridlock. Only sharp planning, quick reactions, and mastery of signals and switches will keep the iron ballet on track.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Exeter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.58 KB

In Rail Traffic Control: Exeter, you manage train traffic at Exeter station, ensuring that all arrivals and departures run smoothly and on time. You handle platform assignments, monitor delays, and make sure the right trains are in the right place at the right time – a challenging game for players who thrive on precision and planning.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Leeds City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.93 KB

Manage the rails at the Leeds City Locomotive works. Orchestrate all movements in the iron ballet of heavy rail of all sort. Keep the passenger trains running on time and meet all your schedule contracts to prosper.

Coordinate movements in a precise interplay of heavy trains of various types. Keep passenger trains on schedule and fulfill all contract plans to achieve success.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Manchester Piccadilly
meta.desc:

In “Rail Traffic Control - Manchester Piccadilly,” you take responsibility for managing all train traffic on one of the main routes. Your task is to keep the trains on schedule while avoiding daily disasters through careful planning and quick action. Skillful management is essential for ensuring smooth operations.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Penzance
meta.desc:

Rail Traffic Control: Penzance puts you in charge of train operations at the Penzance Locomotive Works. With a clean but data-heavy interface, you manage arrivals, departures, shunting movements, and platform assignments – a logistical ballet of steel and schedules. Keep passenger trains running on time and meet all contractual service goals to succeed. It's a no-frills, detail-oriented sim for those who enjoy the challenge of precision, timing, and operational control behind the scenes of rail transport.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Peterborough
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.72 KB

In Rail Traffic Control: Peterborough, you take control of train traffic at a key junction. You must efficiently coordinate arrivals and departures, handle delays, and assign trains to the correct platforms. Every decision matters to ensure smooth and timely operations.

meta.name: Rail Traffic Control : Reading
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.11 KB

In Rail Traffic Control: Reading, you manage the busy rail traffic of a major station with multiple inbound and outbound routes. Your job is to ensure timely departures, handle delayed trains efficiently, and keep platform usage under control. A game for planners who can stay calm under pressure.

meta.name: Railroad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.52 KB

Railroad challenges you to prevent a looming train accident by shifting the tracks on screen in time. Your train moves relentlessly forward, and only by quickly rearranging the rails can you keep it on course. You also have three chances to turn the train using the fire button, altering its direction. With each level the speed increases, demanding sharper reflexes and careful planning to keep the ride safe.

meta.name: The Railroad Works
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Railroad Works lets you design and build your own model railroad. Using scenery and shipping/receiving sites, you can create layouts ranging from simple to complex. Once built, you can run one or two trains across the track, choosing between steam or diesel engines. Five types of rolling stock are available – boxcars, cattle cars, tank cars, passenger cars, and a caboose. More advanced challenges involve transporting cargo and passengers between sites and keeping to a set schedule.

In Rainbow Dragon, you control a dragon trying to escape a vast cave system. Your goal is to destroy ten magical chests, which are blocked by obstacles that must be removed with magic. The screen is split: at the top, a status panel shows four pillars representing the crumbling cave system. If they break, the game ends. A glowing rod can be activated by pressing the spacebar to repair the pillars and gain more time. Below, the dragon must carefully navigate the caves, as collisions with walls reduce energy. If the dragon's energy is depleted, the game ends. Some areas are blocked by laser fields, which can be deactivated by switches.

meta.name: Rainbow Islands
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Rainbow Islands, Bub y Bob aparecen como niños —no como dragones— y tienen el poder de crear arcoíris. Estos atrapan enemigos bajo su arco, que se liberan al saltar encima, obteniendo así gemas de colores. Cada isla consta de cuatro niveles con scroll vertical y un jefe final especialmente duro en la cima. Durante el recorrido puedes recoger potenciadores para aumentar la velocidad o generar más arcoíris, lo que mejora el control y la supervivencia.

meta.name: Rainbow Walker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.45 KB

Rainbow Walker puts you in the feathers of a baby owl with a magical mission: to bring color back to the rainbow high above the clouds. What starts out gray slowly becomes vibrant as you hop across square tiles, each jump adding color. But beware – some tiles are deadly holes, and sinister goblins, birds, and creatures are out to stop you. Only clever dodging can save you. The game plays out in a pseudo-3D style with shifting day and night cycles – a dreamy skybound quest where timing means everything.

meta.name: Rainbow Warrior

El concepto consiste en una serie de mini-juegos que relatan las campañas y las acciones de Greenpeace a favor del medio ambiente durante los años 80.

Rally Cross Challenge recreates the classic BBC-style rallycross in a top-down format, sending you across mixed tarmac-and-gravel tracks with seriously tuned cars. Six circuits are on offer, and depending on your system up to four players can join the mayhem, each with their own driving quirks and rivalries. To advance, you need to finish in the top three. After each race you spend your earned points on upgrades – turbo, steering, traction, aerodynamics, brakes and repair time. Every event becomes a blend of clean driving, strategic nudging and constant fine-tuning to squeeze out a little more speed in the next round.

meta.name: Rally Cross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rally Cross te sitúa en circuitos cerrados donde cada vuelta limpia y cada duelo ganado te dan puntos. Estos se invierten en mejoras: mayor velocidad, resistencia o maniobrabilidad para las próximas carreras. Cada circuito presenta curvas cerradas, zonas ajustadas y pequeños obstáculos, exigiendo un equilibrio constante entre riesgo y control. Con cada mejora, crece el impulso de arriesgar más y alcanzar puntuaciones aún mayores.

meta.name: Rally Driver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.50 KB

„Rally Driver“ is a racing simulation that requires both driving skill and strategic planning. Instead of offering a pure arcade experience, the game provides a detailed map where players must choose routes with different characteristics. Some roads allow higher speeds, while others are prone to flooding during rain or may be closed. To avoid penalties, players can stop at checkpoints to get updates on current conditions. In addition to traditional racing challenges, unexpected hazards such as spectators running onto the track or stray farm animals must be avoided. A strict penalty is imposed for driving in the wrong direction. The race consists of three stages, with drivers being eliminated after the first two.

meta.name: Rally Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.03 KB

Rally Simulator es un juego de carreras entre cuatro oponentes. El desplazamiento muy suave añade realismo y dinámica a las carreras reales. Te espera una carrera de ensueño que pondrá a prueba las habilidades de los mejores pilotos.

meta.name: Rally Speedway
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.09 KB

Rally Speedway throws you into a frantic wheel-to-wheel showdown, especially when playing with a friend. The controls are sharp, the cars slide convincingly and you can tweak how they handle. But the real highlight is the two-player mode: both cars share one screen, and if one falls so far behind that it would scroll off, the race stops. The slower driver takes a penalty, both cars are placed side by side – and the fight continues instantly. You can even shove your opponent off the road to mess up their run. And if the six built-in tracks aren't enough, you can create your own with the editor and save full sets of courses.

meta.name: Rallye
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.30 KB

Rallye puts you through a tough motorcycle challenge across the African desert. Four stages await, but each one unlocks only if you finish the previous within five minutes. Rocks scattered along the road cost you precious seconds when hit. Before starting, you choose one of three difficulty levels or a training mode with no rivals around you. Using the joystick, you control speed and direction: up to accelerate, down to brake, left or right to steer, and fire to shift gear. It's a dusty, demanding ride – and every mistake eats away at your time.

meta.name: Rambo : First Blood Part II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rambo debe recorrer seis zonas de abajo a arriba mientras se defiende de oleadas de enemigos, y termina con un jefe al final del nivel. Rambo está armado con una ametralladora que solo puede disparar hacia arriba, izquierda y derecha, así como en diagonal entre las direcciones mencionadas. También cuenta con flechas explosivas, en cantidad limitada, pero que pueden dispararse en ocho direcciones.

meta.name: Rambo III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rambo III para Commodore 64 es un juego de acción basado en la película del mismo nombre protagonizada por Sylvester Stallone. El jugador interpreta a John Rambo, quien ha ido a Afganistán para salvar al coronel Trautman. Rambo tiene varias armas para cumplir diversos objetivos (encontrar la salida del nivel, salvar rehenes, destruir un tanque, etc.) durante las seis misiones del juego.

meta.name: Rambo IV
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.09 KB

Rambo IV – despite its name – has nothing to do with the famous movie series or its official games. You pilot a helicopter in a vertically scrolling shooter reminiscent of classics like 1943. Enemy planes, tanks, and gunfire stand in your way as you push relentlessly through enemy lines.

meta.name: Rampage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.19 KB

George, Lizzy y Ralph eran estadounidenses normales, hasta que un experimento salió mal, convirtiéndolos en un gorila, un lagarto y un hombre lobo respectivamente. Después de esto, los tres planean ir destruyendo edificios, y hasta 3 jugadores pueden participar.
Romper los bordes de los edificios el tiempo suficiente los hará colapsar. La policía y el ejército te persiguen y te dispararán, así que intenta destruirlos. Necesitarás comer regularmente, con cosas como las plantas que se te ofrecen, para evitar volver a ser humano.

meta.name: Rampart
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rampart fusiona Tetris con un shoot-'em-up: originalmente un arcade para uno o dos jugadores, combina estrategia y acción artillera. Construyes tu castillo con piezas al estilo Tetris, colocas cañones, bombardeas al enemigo y reparas los daños —y vuelves a empezar. Versiones posteriores del arcade incorporaron modo para tres jugadores, y la conversión para PC también lo incluye, ofreciendo una adaptación fiel y entretenida, ideal para partidas multijugador en el mismo ordenador.

meta.name: Ramparts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.96 KB

Sir Griswold y Sir Larkin han sido hechizados por el Espíritu Maligno y convertidos en feroces gigantes vagabundos. Ayúdales en su aventura a través de la Inglaterra Medieval para vencer el hechizo y convertirse en Caballeros de la Tabla Redonda.

meta.name: Ranarama
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.46 KB

Ranarama tells the story of the wizard's apprentice Mervyn, who is turned into a frog by a misfired spell and must now fight against an invasion of 96 enemy wizards in his dungeon. From a top-down view, you guide him through eight levels with sixteen screens and at least fifty rooms each, with rooms revealed only upon entry. To gain new magical abilities, you must solve a mini-game by correctly assembling the word RANARAMA during encounters with warlocks, earning runes for power, offense, defense, and special effects. Losing a life means losing all gained powers, and another loss ends the game completely.

meta.name: Ranch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.28 KB

Ranch lets you create and animate your own Wild West scenes – with cowboys, animals, buildings, and more. Start with a blank screen, then place, color, move, and animate characters and objects however you like. Whether it's a nighttime campfire, a cattle roundup, or a stagecoach ambush, the only limit is your imagination. A creative learning game for kids ages 5 to 10 that encourages visual thinking and interactive storytelling.

meta.name: Ransack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Ransack, you control AL, a vengeful battle droid sent by the council to punish eight rebellious planets. Due to budget cuts, you're the only one dispatched – a robot with a faulty stabilizer. Bouncing and swaying, you fight your way through hostile worlds, shoot enemy ships, and dodge hazards like spikes. Losing energy weakens you, but power-ups like double fire or bombs can aid survival. Only fast reflexes and smart attacks will get you through the mission.

meta.name: Ransom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.64 KB

Ransom is a short graphic text adventure that serves as a demo for the Graphic Adventure Creator. You begin by a rushing mountain stream in front of an old stone bridge leading to a dark cave. Clues and items like an oil lamp await discovery. Using classic text commands, you navigate through the story while stylized images illustrate the scenes. The game is a strong showcase of what the creator tool can do.

meta.name: Rapid Fire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.57 KB

„Rapid Fire“ puts the player in the role of an undercover cop tasked with destroying a warehouse owned by a gang of bank robbers. The objective is to reach the top level – where the central power electrode is located – but several levels must be cleared first. Along the way, the cop must take down various thugs using a machine gun – which can overheat with excessive use. At the end of some levels, a plasma computer must be destroyed before progressing. This is done by shooting the rotating plasma vent – while dodging incoming energy bolts.

meta.name: Raskel

“Raskel” is a side-scrolling shooter where you pilot a spaceship defending your planet's vital power rail – if it's destroyed, so is your world. As you fly left and right at variable speeds, a train below lays track bombs. You must destroy a set number of alien attackers before they inflict too much damage, tracked by a visible damage gauge. Colliding with enemy ships or their bullets reduces your energy, and when it hits zero, you lose one of five lives. With 20 levels, detailed stats, and fast-paced action, “Raskel” is a high-stakes race to prevent annihilation.

meta.name: Rasputin
meta.desc:
