Como valiente caballero, debes destruir la "Joya de los Siete Planetas" neutralizando los ocho hechizos "defensivos" instalados por Rasputín. En la portada del juego verás el nombre de Rasputín escrito en letras rusas, ocho letras para ser exactos. Verás estas letras escritas en bloques de piedra en el juego. Todo lo que tienes que hacer es saltar sobre la piedra para desarmar el hechizo y tomar todo su poder... Una vez "absorbidos" todos estos hechizos, nacerá de la nada una criatura infernal. Una vez derrotada, se convertirá en una roca sobre la que tendrás que saltar para absorber el hechizo definitivo, que te permitirá derrotar al vil Rasputín...
Los gráficos son notables, la animación y los cambios de pantalla absolutamente perfectos. La atmósfera es realmente única, hechizante pero muy particular...

meta.name: Rastan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rastan presenta cinco niveles o un juego de piratería y corte con un jefe al final de cada nivel. Numerosos enemigos te asaltan en tu viaje, como demonios voladores, quimeras, valquirias, pirañas, esqueletos no muertos y más. Lucha hasta el final y salva la tierra de Lograth de una perdición segura. El juego presenta diferentes armas como hachas, mazas y espadas de fuego, cada una con sus propios atributos como alcance extendido o poder de ataque. La armadura también se puede recoger en forma de escudos, capas y armaduras, lo que reduce el daño de los ataques enemigos. Otros artículos incluyen anillos (aumenta la velocidad de tu arma) y joyas para obtener puntos de bonificación.

meta.name: Raster Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.67 KB

Set in the future, the object of Raster Runner is to guide your bike around the arena while trying to surround your opponent with the energy trail your bike leaves behind. Your opponent is doing the same. When one of the bikes crash, the player who took control a bike loses one life. A crash can be avoided by activating a force field, but only up to three can be activated. The player who loses all of their lives loses the game, while the other player wins. To assist you, a small overview map can be used to keep track of the bikes.

meta.name: Rasterscan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Controlling the spherical MSB, a repair droid which has lost most of its capabilities, only you can repair the Rasterscan spaceship and bring it back under control. The first job is to get the droid repaired, after which you must regain control of the power generator and the engines.
The game is controlled by moving MSB directly, with a teleport facility on the droid allowing you to move one object at a time. Spanner-type devices are mounted from the floor - guiding MSB into the top of these reveals puzzles which can be used to unlock doors to reach other sections of the ship. Before any power can be generated and the ship's scanner accessed, a leak must be fixed by finding and using a piece of spare piping.

meta.name: Rat Splat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.67 KB

Rat Splat sends you into the sewers, where an out-of-control rat infestation urgently needs to be contained. You lure the rodents out with cheese, chase them across ladders and platforms, and use your hammer before they manage to eat all the bait. At the same time, an angry monster is on the hunt, and only an aerosol can can stop it, while the increasingly overpowering cheese smell becomes a danger of its own. This creates a wonderfully frantic mix of hunting, defense, and time pressure.

meta.name: The Rat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.32 KB

The Rat places you in the role of a hungry rat exploring multiple warehouse floors where you must eat pieces of cheese to unlock the path onward. As soon as you start, the remaining cheeses begin moving, turning the task into a frantic chase while spiders and snakes roam the area. You dodge dangers, use temporary countermeasures, and try to grab the final pieces at the right moment, as special letters change the situation – sometimes plunging the area into darkness, opening new routes, or removing threats. When only one piece remains, an additional hazard appears and raises the tension – a lively mix of collecting, evasion, and quick decision-making.

meta.name: Rats

meta.name: The Rats
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Rats places you in a crisis where a spreading rat infestation must be contained through careful coordination and planning. You deploy emergency forces to affected areas, allocate equipment, and respond to new outbreaks while researchers work on improved countermeasures, defenses, and powerful solutions. Every decision shapes how effectively you can stabilise the situation, as key locations must be protected and resources used wisely. If the threat spirals out of control or your forces are lost, the entire system collapses – a tense struggle against a constantly growing danger.

meta.name: Rattler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.78 KB

In Rattler you guide a constantly moving snake around a single screen viewed from above. Your goal is to eat eggs that appear one at a time while moving only at right angles. Each egg you collect makes the snake grow longer, making movement increasingly difficult. Once enough eggs are eaten, a gap opens at the top of the screen that allows you to move to the next level. A time limit adds pressure, as failing to eat an egg quickly causes more to appear that must also be collected. If you collide with your own body, hit the outer walls, or are struck by one of the bouncing balls on the screen, you lose one of your lives.

meta.name: Raumpatrouillie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.33 KB

Raumpatrouillie sends you into the depths of space with one simple objective: survive. You pilot your ship through an increasingly crowded starfield, dodging everything that comes your way. As the speed rises, quick reflexes and precise control become essential. One collision ends your mission – a minimalist yet demanding test of skill set among the stars.

meta.name: Raw Recruit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.13 KB

Anyone aiming to prove himself a soldier must prove his physical ability, reactions, stamina and sheer courage. As the Raw Recruit of the title, six events make up this challenge. To quality you must complete all six events, but you can continue the game to rack up as good a score as possible even if you fail to complete one.
The first event takes place on a Rifle Range, with a requirement of hitting 16 targets to qualify; the later Pistol Range is similar but adds hostages.There are also Cross Country and Assault course events, involving running and jumping over hazards, and a Tug-O-War and Fitness challenges for pure strength and stamina testing.

meta.name: R.B.I. Baseball 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

R.B.I. Baseball 2 features all 26 major league teams, each with a full roster of players. You can choose any National or American League team. You can even play one of the 1989 All-Star squads.
The game features One Player and Two Player options as well as a Password mode to enable you to play a full season (one game against every team in the division). In addition, a watch mode provides you with the best seat in the house for a computer-controlled match up.
This second version is similar to the original game in terms of gameplay. This time around the game uses the teams and statistics from the 1989 season. Just as in the original, you get to see what it's like to step up to the plate as Ricky Henderson, pitch the ball like Nolan Ryan, and catch a line drive like Ozzie Smith.

meta.name: RCA : Radio Controlled Action
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.29 KB

In RCA: Radio Controlled Action, you control a nimble RC race car on a track swarming with aggressive opponents aiming for head-on collisions. Only lightning-fast reflexes can save you from their sudden moves and feints. You're allowed up to three crashes – after that, it's over. Bonus items occasionally appear, offering points, speed boosts, or higher jumps.

meta.name: RDF 1985 : When Superpowers Collide
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game simulates a battle between the American Rapid Deployment Force and Soviet forces for control of the Saudi Arabian oil fields. The player may choose to play either the American or Soviet forces, and can play in turns against another human component or against the computer.

meta.name: Re-Bounder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.47 KB

Re-Bounder brings the bouncing tennis ball back – and this time, your goal is to collect all 16 smart bombs to win. Precision is key, as landing on sand, spikes, traps, or enemies means trouble. Mystery squares marked with a "?" can help – offering longer jumps or time boosts – or betray you with hidden dangers. Excellent parallax scrolling, polished visuals, and catchy sound create a fast-paced experience. Easy to pick up, brutally hard to master – Re-Bounder is a punishingly fun test of timing and control.

n: Reach for the Stars - The Conquest of the Galaxy (Australia)

meta.path: ./Reach for the Stars - The Conquest of the Galaxy (Australia).D64
meta.name: Reach for the Stars - The Conquest of the Galaxy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Reach for the Stars is a "spaceploitation" game. The player has the opportunity to name his civilization and those of his (up to three) AI opponents before he begins his attempt at galactic domination. The 2D galaxy map is marked only by planets and their names in few different colors. Also, there is no diplomacy and no player control over tactical combat. What remains is a hard-core game of grand strategic and economic production. The player must tweak his planets, build ships, research new tech levels, and deploy fleets. All of the underlying dynamics can be altered and customized by the player

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Reaction is a fast-paced reaction game for one or two players that requires precise timing. Four fields per player appear on the screen, with their lights flashing red at irregular intervals. Each color corresponds to a specific key. Pressing the correct key earns points, while an incorrect key press ends the game. As time progresses, reaction time shortens, increasing the difficulty level. Control keys can be customized, and the music can be muted using the spacebar. The goal is to score as many points as possible and dominate the leaderboard.

meta.name: Reaction (Magic Disk 1990)
meta.desc:

“Reaction” is a skill game that requires quick reactions and typing speed. To move the ball forward, players must type the displayed letters as quickly as possible to reach the goal. Any delay can hinder progress and make the game more challenging.

meta.name: Reader Rabbit And The Fabulous Word Factory
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

The series centers on the adventures of Reader Rabbit and his friends, including Sam the Lion and Matilda the Mouse. The grayish-blue Reader Rabbit is the protagonist of all the games. His wardrobe has included a red T-shirt and a red and blue striped sweater (similar to the Montreal Canadiens jersey, but without the logo).
Generally, the series consists of point-and-click adventure games where the player must use their inventory and interact with characters to solve a series of puzzles. These puzzles were originally reading-based challenges but different titles focus on other subject areas. Visually, the game consists of a series of static screens which the player can navigate through by clicking on certain "travel" hot-spots. Other hot-spots can trigger an interaction with a character, item, song or mini-game.

meta.name: Real Ghostbusters, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En The Real Ghostbusters encarnas a un cazafantasmas que debe limpiar diez niveles infestados de espíritus. Primero los debilitas con tu pistola y luego los atrapas con el haz de protones, almacenándolos en la mochila. Por el camino recoges recargas del haz, mayor potencia de fuego o un escudo. También aparece Slimer como potenciador: flota a tu alrededor y elimina fantasmas al tocarlos. Poco a poco, avanzas entre oleadas de apariciones hasta dejar la ciudad a salvo.

meta.name: The Real Stunt Experts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.78 KB

You take the role of stuntman Fred MacMuscle who has been down on his luck but is offered to handle the stunts for a new series - Ricky Steel, Secret Agent. The caveat is that you are expected to cover your own insurance for each of the dangerous stunts.
Completing each stunt scene will give you a certain amount of money that allows you to pay for the insurance for each stunt. The stunts vary from driving a car along a track, using ramps to jump over obstacles while shooting or avoiding others to flying a helicopter to rescue prisoners of war and rescue hostages from a burning building.

meta.name: Realm of Darkness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.88 KB

The king has tasked you with traveling through his kingdom and returning the stolen crown jewels, which are believed to be scattered across the small island. You start on a sandy beach and must search the entire kingdom to find the jewels and other valuable treasures and return them to the king. Each environment is described in detail and requires precise instructions to move around and interact.

meta.name: Realm of Impossibility
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Realm of Impossibility sends you on a perilous journey through a network of dungeons where you must gradually collect powerful crowns to stop a dark foe. Each area is made up of interconnected rooms that need to be explored, exited and often revisited. Hostile creatures constantly chase you but cannot be destroyed, forcing you to rely on smart movement, careful timing and positioning. By placing obstacles at the right moments, you can delay pursuit and gain breathing room – a tense mix of exploration, strategy and constant pressure that demands focus and awareness.

meta.name: Realm of the Trolls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The trolls are posing a threat to humanity, and it's your job to sort them out in this traditional-style platform game, which features over 200 screens. You have a gun and bolts of energy available to protect you. The graphics have detailed sprites but very plain backdrops, in an attempt to create a mood. Unusually a construction kit is included, allowing you to design your own levels down to the last detail. Another novelty is the option of mouse control on 16-bit systems, a seemingly impractical option for a platform game.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: The Realm of Zaroc
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.17 KB

meta.name: Realm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.19 KB

Maintaining the correct orbit of the planets in our solar system is controlled by the planetary orbit coordinator, but this has stopped working and the planets are moving away from the sun. You are tasked with controlling a robot called XR3, sent into the heart of the POC to make it run and find missing planets. The game is an arcade adventure maze game viewed from above. The screen scrolls as you move. To complete your task, you must collect all the bonus crowns scattered throughout the POC. Additional items collected deeper in the maze are needed to solve the puzzles by placing them in the correct locations.

meta.name: Realms of Darkness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Conocido en Occidente como Realms of Darkness, este juego combina la jugabilidad tradicional de los RPG con algunos elementos tomados de las aventuras de texto. Reúne a un grupo de uno a ocho personajes y emprende una búsqueda para obtener poderes, riquezas y objetos mágicos derrotando a los monstruos. El juego consta de muchos escenarios, cada uno de los cuales requiere varias horas de juego para ser completado. Muévete por los reinos utilizando el teclado y/o el joystick. Viaja y explora ciudades, mazmorras, cuevas y otros tipos de viviendas. Para crear personajes, debes determinar sus rasgos y habilidades, que se definen mediante seis atributos: Sabiduría, Inteligencia, Agilidad, Fuerza, Vitalidad y Suerte. Elige su profesión o clase. Puedes elegir entre Luchador, Mago, Sacerdote, Ladrón, ... Por último, decide su raza: gnomo, enano, elfo o humano.

meta.name: Realms of Midgard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.81 KB

Realms of Midgard places you aboard a powerful galleon, tasked with defending every city across different realms. Enemy forces attempt to overrun the towns, while brave farmers push their carts from the fields to the city. Your only means of defense is a barrage of cannonballs to stop the invaders. But hostile forces aren't your only challenge – unpredictable weather can make your mission even more difficult. Can you save the cities and repel the invading forces?
meta.developer: C. Yates, J. Wells & R. Bayliss

meta.name: Reaxion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Reaxion throws you into a digital emergency where you must stabilize a damaged power-plant system before disaster strikes. On a grid of tiles, you make every one match by flipping them – but every press affects the chosen tile and all adjacent ones. Each level starts with a new pattern that must be solved under a strict time limit. With every move the tension rises, because one wrong click can scramble the entire board.

meta.name: Reaxion Extended
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Reaxion Extended offers new levels where you once again stabilize a failing reactor system under time pressure. On the tile grid you must make every field match, but each click flips not only the chosen tile but all adjacent ones. Every new pattern demands a different approach, and each move can either save the board or scramble it completely – which is exactly what makes this extended version so engaging.

meta.name: Rebel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.15 KB

In Rebel you play as the worker THX2240 who attempts to escape from a massive industrial complex where labor conditions resemble slavery. Using a stolen crowd-control vehicle, you try to break out through ten levels filled with locked sections and security systems. Doors and locks can be opened by directing a solar beam onto them using mirrors, weakening the mechanisms until they give way. At the same time patrol guards roam the compounds, trying to stop your escape. Every failed attempt to open a door costs you a life, so careful planning and precise placement of the mirrors are essential to make it out of the complex.

meta.name: Rebel Bomber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.09 KB

The object of the game is to destroy our alien enemy's cities. You must fly a space shuttle over their planet's surface and drop bombs on the cities on your route. Your computer will guide your craft over each city. All you have to do is release the bombs. To drop a bomb, press the fire button on either joystick or press F7. If you destroy the whole city then you get bonus points and a chance at the next target. Finish 10 cities to be a champion. Published in several Keypunch compilations including Space Games and the Challenger Pack.

meta.name: Rebel Charge at Chickamauga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rebel Charge at Chickamauga is a tactical simulation of the South's last major offensive thrust during the American Civil War. The game uses a refined version of SSI's Gettysburg game system and is played in 13 turns each representing two hours of real time over a two day period. Players are awarded points based on casualties and territorial objectives. At the end of each turn and the end of the game points are calculated and compared to a chart which determines your level of victory. The game can be played under 3 different sets of rules (Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced) and can be played against another person or the computer can play either side.

meta.name: Rebel Planet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.31 KB

In Rebel Planet you take on the role of a SAROS agent, resisting the alien Arcadian overlords. Disguised as a trader, you pilot the Caydia to Tropos, Halmuris, and Arcadion, meeting underground fighters and gathering intel to destroy the Arcadian central computer and free humanity. This open-ended text adventure drops RPG dice mechanics in favor of strict schedules, limited inventory, and essential sci-fi tools like the lite-kube, limcom, and hcaps. Combat is rare – success depends on codes, stealth, and perfect timing.

meta.name: The Rebels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Rebels you fight through a series of stages where you must defeat a certain number of enemies to obtain keys. By performing well-timed kicks from the correct distance you eliminate opponents and earn the keys you need. These keys are then used to close gates that block your progress through the area. Each gate requires its own key, so you must defeat enough enemies before you can seal them. Once all gates are closed and the remaining foes are defeated, you advance to the next level.

meta.name: Rebound
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rebound is a Breakout style game and an Arkanoid clone. In this classic arcade game, the player controls a bat that bounces a ball to destroy a wall of bricks. The goal is to clear all the bricks in the level without letting the ball go out of bounds. Rebound stays true to the tried and tested Breakout principle and offers a variety of levels with different wall layouts that steadily increase the difficulty and challenge. Some power-ups appear as the game progresses and give the player helpful abilities such as a larger bat, additional balls or slower ball speeds, which offers additional tactical options.

meta.name: Reckless Rufus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.25 KB

Admiral Greave has caught Rufus hiding on the Astro Cruiser heading for Earth. To stay on the ship Rufus has to earn his keep so he is beamed down to the planet Killey to collect rare crystals. Once enough crystals have been collected then Rufus can get back on board and go to Earth. There are 5 crystals a level to collect.

meta.name: Recog-Nice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.91 KB

Recog-Nice es un juego de memoria de palabras sencillo pero desafiante. Aparece una palabra en la pantalla y usas el joystick para decidir si es nueva o ya la conoces. Al principio, todo es nuevo, pero pronto las palabras se repiten, poniendo a prueba tu memoria. Se registran los errores y la dificultad aumenta con cada ronda. Un reconocimiento rápido y una memoria a corto plazo aguda son clave para el éxito.

meta.name: Red 200
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.87 KB

Red 200 is a game similar to Robbo, a puzzle game in which the player guides a robot. The player must collect all screws scattered around the board while avoiding deadly magnets, nuclear signs and other obstacles. In order to not become attracted by a magnet it's necessary to cover it with a box. Getting to a specific part of a maze requires the use of an appropriate item. Collecting all screws opens an exit door to the next level.
The game features 200 levels.

meta.name: Red Alert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.17 KB

Red Alert is an espionage strategy game for up to four players, each playing a secret agent. Gameplay largely comprises of random set-piece situations, with a decision to be made which will influence later situations.

meta.name: Red Arrows
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.56 KB

Las actividades del famoso equipo de exhibición de aeronaves de la RAF cobran vida en esta simulación. El jugador puede participar en rizos, volantines y sobrevuelos, trabajando en tándem con pilotos amigos a tan solo 1,8 metros de distancia, volando a más de 480 km/h. Las instrucciones se dan durante el vuelo; siga la altura y dirección solicitadas para maximizar el atractivo visual de la rutina y evitar colisiones. El empuje y la dirección se pueden automatizar durante el vuelo; esto implica una penalización de puntuación, pero permite a los nuevos jugadores dominar las funciones más complejas.

meta.name: Red Heat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.21 KB

Red Heat, basado en la película de Walter Hill con Schwarzenegger y Belushi, te pone en la piel del detective soviético Ivan Danko, que viaja a Chicago para atrapar al temible narcotraficante georgiano Victor Rosta.
Es un beat 'em up lateral al estilo de Vigilante, con cuatro niveles fielmente ambientados en la trama original. Enfrentas constantemente a los Cleanheads, sicarios aliados de Rosta. Atacas con puñetazos (lentos pero de mayor alcance) o cabezazos (rápidos, pero cuerpo a cuerpo). La única defensa es agacharse —no hay saltos ni evasivas. Ocasionalmente consigues una pistola con seis disparos. Otros objetos restauran salud, dan acceso a niveles bonus o te hacen perder el control momentáneamente.
Una peculiaridad es su área de juego tipo panorámico y que todos los personajes aparecen dibujados desde la cintura hacia arriba —detalle que cobra sentido en el primer nivel, ambientado en una sauna rusa, tal como en la película.

meta.name: Red Max
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.63 KB

"Red Max" is a top-down action game where the player takes on the role of an awakened crew member on the Moon. After humanity successfully relocated to the Moon, the adventure begins when the Death Lords plant 27 fission mines and disrupt the power supply. Equipped with a space motorbike, the player must defuse the mines, activate nuclear cooling systems, shut down power plants, and awaken crew members to fight the enemy. Along the way, the player needs to collect fuel for the motorbike and avoid obstacles like laser gates, electric fences, and slimy areas that weaken shields. The map scrolls dynamically in all directions as progress is made. Careful planning and strategy are essential to complete the mission with the limited number of lives.

meta.name: Red Moon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En aquellos tiempos antiguos, la luz de la Luna era el medio de toda la magia de la Tierra. Perdió casi toda su fuerza. A partir de entonces, su débil luz ya no fue suficiente para garantizar la continuidad de los antiguos hechizos. Comprendiendo el peligro, los magos más poderosos unieron sus fuerzas y crearon uno nuevo: el cristal de luna roja... Pero el reino cayó en la barbarie y la luz del cristal se extinguió. Debes encontrar el famoso cristal para restaurar el antiguo Conocimiento. Durante tu búsqueda, podrás hacerte con nueve tesoros y tendrás a tu disposición una serie de hechizos que te serán útiles para obtener información o combatir. Cada hechizo cuesta una parte de tu capital mágico, que debes restaurar. Para luchar contra criaturas agresivas, es mejor tener un arma y una armadura de antemano.

meta.name: Red Storm Rising
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La Unión Soviética, sometida a una fuerte presión tras la destrucción de una de sus mayores refinerías de petróleo, necesita asegurarse una nueva fuente de petróleo, y para ello necesita dejar fuera de juego a Occidente... lo que significa invadir Europa y luchar contra la OTAN hasta la paralización..... Y la única forma que tiene la OTAN de impedirlo es reforzar sus fuerzas con convoyes de Estados Unidos y otros países.
Usted está al mando de uno de los submarinos de ataque americanos. Debes controlar el océano contra la armada soviética a toda costa, o la batalla terrestre se pondrá fea. En parte simulador de submarinos, en parte campaña dinámica y en parte simulación de la Tercera Guerra Mundial, Red Storm Rising es una asombrosa visión de la guerra moderna.

meta.name: Redhawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.19 KB

By shouting 'Kwah!' ordinary Kevin Oliver can transform himself into superhero Redhawk, a power you must use in this cartoon adventure. As you travel the city you must pay attention to your popularity ratings - you can play the game either to perform good or evil. 
The game uses a text parser with a vocabulary allowing for actions such as walking, looking around, arresting people, hitting them, using objects, or waiting in a set position for a set amount of time - every action sees time get used up. Standard input methods such as using AND or commas to delimit multiple commands, and leaving out words like THE and SOME are implemented.
Being in Redhawk mode uses up energy, so this must be used sparingly.The screen display is in comic book style, with the last 3 drawings on screen at each time.

meta.name: Relaxed Motions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Relaxed Motions” is a tricky puzzle game where you rotate blocks of the same color to align them side by side or on top of each other. Once correctly positioned, you earn points. If you manage to group all blocks in a level, you move on to the next stage. Success depends on logic, planning, and the right sequence of moves within limited attempts.

meta.name: Renaissance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.75 KB

“Renaissance” es una versión digital del clásico juego de mesa Othello, cuyo objetivo es terminar la partida con más fichas de tu color que las del oponente. Al colocar tu ficha vertical, horizontal o diagonalmente frente a otra, volteas todas las fichas del oponente a tu color. Los jugadores alternan turnos hasta que no les queden más movimientos. Esta versión ofrece diversas funciones: seleccionar el nivel de habilidad del ordenador (1-9), intercambiar colores, deshacer movimientos, probar contraataques y cambiar la situación del tablero. Un cursor controlado por joystick te permite colocar las fichas en el tablero.

meta.name: Rendezvous with Rama
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Rendezvous with Rama, you command the spaceship Endeavor on a mission to intercept what was first thought to be an asteroid – until it's revealed to be an enormous alien starship. Your goal: explore its vast, mysterious interior before it exits the Solar System. Based on Arthur C. Clarke's novel, the game delivers a cerebral, text-driven sci-fi experience filled with puzzles, awe-inspiring discoveries, and the eerie silence of a long-abandoned world.

meta.name: Renegade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.25 KB

Vivir al filo de la navaja significa no tener tiempo para pensar ni para descansar, pero cuidado? ¡¡¡siempre hay tiempo para morir!!!, Tú, el RENEGADO, conoces bien los bajos fondos y por eso eres el único que te atreves a adentrarte en sus oscuras y peligrosas calles.

meta.name: Renegade F-16
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.35 KB

In Renegade F-16, you control a rogue fighter pilot armed with a nuclear bomb, flying from Kennedy air force base to obliterate a major American city. Choose your target, evade defense systems, engage interceptors with Phoenix missiles, deploy countermeasures, and navigate with strategic commands. Every move takes time – and the Pentagon is watching. Only precise tactics will get you to your target and unleash nuclear destruction.

meta.name: Renegade III : The Final Chapter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Cuando un chico pierde a su chica, también pierde el control.
Ahora, en el último capítulo, RENEGADE debe reunir todas sus fuerzas y rápidos reflejos para conseguir liberar a su chica de las garras de sus captores.
Lucha contra el hombre Neolítico, guerreros Medievales y las atormentadas Momias del Antiguo Egipto. Tu desafío final te llevará más allá del presente, a un mundo que nunca olvidarás...
Pero recuerda... tu chica quiere verte vivo.

meta.name: Rent-a-Cop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rent-a-Cop puts you in the role of a security guard chasing thieves through multi-level buildings within a strict time limit. You move between floors, use elevators and navigate rooms while trying to cut off the escape route before time runs out. The result is a fast cat-and-mouse pursuit where quick decisions and timing are key to using shortcuts and avoiding obstacles. Each round raises the pace and demands better awareness, making every chase more intense than the last.

meta.name: Repton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.46 KB

Un shoot 'em up de desplazamiento lateral inspirado en Defender, pero añadiendo mucho al concepto. Vuelas a través de un paisaje de desplazamiento horizontal en bucle con el objetivo de proteger tu base. Hay un total de ocho enemigos en pantalla en un momento dado. Los Quarriers intentan construir la base enemiga robando partes de la tuya. Los Drayns te roban energía y luego se la suministran al enemigo. Afortunadamente, puedes recuperar la energía que te quitan, pero no puedes recuperar partes de tu base. Los otros seis enemigos solo intentan matarte. Cuanto más grande se vuelve la base enemiga, más rápida y precisamente pueden lanzarte enemigos.

meta.name: Repton 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Repton 3 challenges you to recover treasure from cleverly constructed caverns where falling rocks, monsters and eerie spirits make every move risky. You dig carefully through the environment, plan your steps ahead and solve increasingly complex puzzles that require both dexterity and logical thinking. New dangers such as rapidly spreading poisonous fungus, timed explosives and unusual puzzle mechanics add fresh pressure and constantly force you to rethink your approach. Larger stages and tools for creating your own content encourage you not only to conquer the world but also to expand it creatively and design new challenges.

meta.name: Rescue From Mars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Rescue from Mars" is a side-scrolling shooter where players must save endangered Mars colonists from hostile aliens. Skill and quick reflexes are key to fending off attacks and ensuring the colonists' safety.

meta.name: Rescue on Fractalus!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rescue on Fractalus is an action game played from a 3D first person point of view. Your mission is to rescue stranded pilots on the planet of Fractalus. You begin each mission from the mother ship, and when your quota of pilots has been rescued you must return there so you can move on to the next level. To help locate the pilots and navigate the tricky terrain, your spaceship is equipped with various instruments, such as a compass, altimeter, and scanner. Your enemy, the Jaggi's, have numerous forces on this planet and will be attempting to stop you. Gun emplacements, flying saucers, and the Jaggi themselves are all capable of destroying your ship if you don't destroy them first. To defend yourself from these threats, your ship is equipped with torpedoes. As the levels progress, the Jaggi defenses become more aggressive, and you will even need to fly some night missions where visibility is limited!

meta.name: Rescue Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rescue Squad puts you through three stages of an ambulance driver's rescue work. First you must guide your vehicle through a maze of houses and traffic to reach a fire before the timer runs out. Once there, you catch people leaping from the building while dodging falling flower pots. When the fire truck arrives, you enter the blazing structure to search for survivors. By touching them you can lead them to safety at the windows, all while avoiding deadly fireballs. Each stage demands quick reflexes and skill to save as many lives as possible.

meta.name: Retaliation
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.80 KB

meta.name: Retro Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.53 KB

Retro Ball is a head-to-head digital air hockey game for two players. Each controls a paddle, aiming to score by hitting the puck into the opponent's goal. A coin toss decides who starts, and also resets play if the puck gets stuck on the center line. Matches are timed, and the player with the most goals wins. You can choose between a fast or slow puck to adjust the game's speed and intensity.

meta.name: Retrograde
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Retrograde casts you as a warrior from the planet Choom, fighting against seven deranged dictators who threaten the entire solar system. Equipped with a jetpack, you fly across the planet's surface and atmosphere, blasting enemies and dodging their attacks. To reach the bunkers containing the nerve centers, you must locate planetbusters. Blending side-scrolling action with top-view combat, the game demands both quick reflexes and strategic thinking.

meta.name: Retrograde
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Retrograde casts you as a warrior from the planet Choom, fighting against seven deranged dictators who threaten the entire solar system. Equipped with a jetpack, you fly across the planet's surface and atmosphere, blasting enemies and dodging their attacks. To reach the bunkers containing the nerve centers, you must locate planetbusters. Blending side-scrolling action with top-view combat, the game demands both quick reflexes and strategic thinking.

meta.name: Star Wars : Return of the Jedi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.74 KB

Star Wars: Return of the Jedi transforms the third film into an arcade action experience across three sequences. First, you play as Princess Leia on a speeder bike racing through Endor's forests, dodging trees and dealing with enemy troopers, sometimes by luring them into Ewok traps. Next, Chewbacca pilots a captured AT-ST to battle Imperial walkers, with occasional shifts to guiding the Millennium Falcon through fleets of Star Destroyers and TIE Fighters. The finale takes place inside the Death Star, where the Falcon must reach and destroy the reactor, then escape before the massive explosion engulfs the ship.

meta.name: Return of the Mutant Camels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.49 KB

Also known as "Revenge II" or "Revenge of the Mutant Camels II". "Return of the Mutant Camels“ places the player in a world where mutated giant camels must defend Earth against the returning forces of Zzyax. Enemies include flying mailboxes, letters, Pac-Man ghosts, and microchips. The player can fire in any direction by moving the joystick while holding the fire button. Additionally, miniature versions of the camel can be dropped as bombs. After completing a level or losing a life, the player can move to an adjacent level on a 10x10 grid. Upgrades such as stronger shields, energy refills, or enhanced weapons with larger or smarter projectiles can also be acquired.

meta.name: Return of the Space Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Edward Egg, from the planet Egg, leads a difficult life. Living on Egg is a real headache since all the inhabitants are called Edward, which look like eggs. Edward's name is chosen, from a list of inhabitants also called Edward Egg, to defend the planet from the Space Warriors that have just returned. Edward climbs into his egg-shaped craft and sets out to destroy the Space Warriors, whose spaceships also happen to look like eggs.

meta.name: Return to Earth
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.75 KB

meta.name: Return to Eden
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The command robots of Snowball have found the colonisable planet Eden, and already set about colonising this lush verdant planet. Not easy though - native plants and animals have adapted and fought back at the threat to their territory. A walled area now encloses the city, which is crumbling around you.
When Snowball 9 reaches the planet, Commander Kim Kimberley is filmed apparently committing a murder. As Kim, you must escape from the 'justice' of crazed robot droids. Snowball 9's landing is made dangerous due to the robots malfunctioning.
Return to Eden is an interactive fiction game which sets you as Kim, and challenges you to enter and survive within the robot city. Strange and surreal outcomes about - what do you get when you plant a brick? The world includes a bank, a theme park, the Corridors of Power, and a Starbike.
Unlike its predecessor, it features graphics, with over 200 illustrative pictures featured. adds the ability to type while the screen is updating. Vocabulary is simplified - a new IT command refers to the last-mentioned object, and clothing can be WEAR'ed without being GET'ted first.

meta.name: Return to Oz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.00 KB

Based on the dark 1985 Walt Disney film Return To Oz, which was a non-musical sequel to The Wizard of Oz, it combined story elements from L. Frank Baum's novels Ozma of Oz and The Wonderful Land of Oz”.
After she returns to Kansas, no one believes Dorothy's story. When she can't sleep, Aunt Em seeks help from a doctor who wants to subject her to scary tests in a mental asylum. Dorothy escapes and finds herself back in the Land of Oz, where she learns that the Nome King has taken over and destroyed the Emerald City and the Yellow Brick Road. Her new companion is Billina, the chicken who can talk in Oz. You'll meet a scarecrow named Jack Pumpkinhead and a robot named Tik-Tok, among others. Dorothy must stop the Nome King and the witch Mombi, who wants Dorothy's head for her collection, and restore Princess Ozma to the throne.

meta.name: Revelation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Revelation is a sideview shooter scrolling in multiple directions, taking its cue from Revelations, the final book of the Bible. The player is trapped in the caverns of Hell, attempting to locate the Monster of the Apocalypse, with over 40 caverns to pass first. You are constantly dropping downwards without applying thrust to your vehicle, and must avoid any contact with lava pits or other hazards. Foes include the Falcon Fiend, Gorson (The Demon Lord of the Imps) and Belial (The Demon Lord of the Bats). The game can be started from waves 1, 4, 9, 14.

meta.name: Revenge of Defender
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A side scrolling shooter, the object is to defend your colonies from various waves of attacking aliens. Revenge of Defender features layered scrolling screens, and new background artwork and enemies for each of 7 levels.

meta.name: Revenge of the Moon Goddess
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.07 KB

“Revenge of the Moon Goddess” begins deep in the South American jungle, where you're in search of the legendary City of the Sun. Your goal is to recover the golden statue of the Moon Goddess and make it back. Friendly locals have taken you upstream and will return in one week. Now you stand on a rotting dock – the river to the east, jungle to the west – and your choices will decide whether you return with treasure – or just stories.

meta.name: Revenge of the Mutant Camels
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Revenge of the Mutant Camels“ is a bizarre sequel to „Attack of the Mutant Camels“, where the player controls a mutated camel. The camel is initially armed with small blue shots but can collect power-ups to gain new weapons and upgrades. The game features surreal humor and a variety of strange enemies – including British telephone booths, exploding sheep, ski kangaroos, flying toilets, and even the player-controlled jet from „Attack of the Mutant Camels“.

meta.name: Revenge of the Tomato
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.03 KB

In Revenge of the Tomato, you embark on a secret mission to stop a threat posed by mutated, flying tomatoes. These dangerous tomatoes have caused chaos in cities, villages, and on the streets, devouring both people and spacecraft. Your goal is to fight back against the tomatoes with a state-of-the-art flying vehicle, advancing toward the Mega-Tomato, all while rescuing people stranded on rooftops.

meta.name: Revenge of the Toothless Vampire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.42 KB

Revenge of the Toothless Vampire puts you in the unusual role of a vampire missing his most essential asset. As Cedric, you navigate hostile surroundings to recover your false teeth and regain your strength. Along the way, you must avoid dangerous obstacles and time your actions carefully to achieve your goal and escape the town.

meta.name: Revenger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.22 KB

Revenger sends you into a vertical maze of platforms, ladders, and locked doors where you carefully move up and down, avoiding hazards and outsmarting enemies. With precise timing you leap across gaps, dodge projectiles, and search for the correct path through the twisting structure – every mistake drains energy and demands even sharper focus. The game thrives on its straightforward design and the constant pressure to stay one step ahead of your foes – easy to grasp, yet demanding until the very last jump.

meta.name: Reversi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.19 KB

One of the best and most graphically intriguing versions of the 21+ versions of Reversi created for the Commodore 64 and published by Eagleware International.

meta.name: Reversi GTI
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.94 KB

"Reversi GTI" is a digital version of the popular strategic board game where the goal is to capture the most spaces on the board by flipping the opponent's pieces.

meta.name: Revolution
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.31 KB

Revolution flips your sense of space completely, because your ship stays fixed while the entire world rotates around you. Subtle joystick moves spin the environment, pulling powerups into reach, lining up asteroids for destruction and shifting you away from incoming aliens. The longer you survive, the tougher everything gets, making stronger weapons and solid shields increasingly vital. You constantly balance offense and evasion as the world whirls around your anchored craft like a spinning battlefield.

meta.name: Revs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 96.24 KB

Revs is a racing simulation that puts you into the world of Formula 3 and is known for its realistic approach. Unlike many racing games of its era, it allows you to adjust aerodynamic settings and race on a fully three-dimensional track. You can even drive in the wrong direction or leave the track entirely. The game is considered a precursor to the developer's later Formula 1 simulations, already showcasing an early focus on authenticity and attention to detail.

meta.name: Revs

Revs is a racing simulation that puts you into the world of Formula 3 and is known for its realistic approach. Unlike many racing games of its era, it allows you to adjust aerodynamic settings and race on a fully three-dimensional track. You can even drive in the wrong direction or leave the track entirely. The game is considered a precursor to the developer's later Formula 1 simulations, already showcasing an early focus on authenticity and attention to detail.

meta.name: RG Rampage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In RG Rampage, you jump through six compact levels while dodging flying and rolling robots. Your goal is to collect golden issues of Electronic Games scattered around. Once you've gathered enough, you ascend to a higher level of consciousness – and the next stage of the game. Despite its tiny size, the game delivers tight action and charming retro visuals.

meta.name: Rhymes & Riddles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

"Rhymes & Riddles" offers three game modes – nursery rhymes, riddles, and famous sayings. Players must guess the missing letters to reconstruct full sentences. Incorrect letters increase the mistake counter, while correct answers bring them closer to completion. The game combines language skills with an engaging puzzle mechanic.

meta.name: Richard Petty's Talladega
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.78 KB

Richard Petty's Talladega is a racing game where you get to take the super speedway as you race against king Richard Petty and 18 top pro drivers. After trying to qualify for a pole position, you use strategy to plan your pit stops, draft leading cars to pick up time and save fuel and be prepared for yellow caution flags.

meta.name: Rick Dangerous
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rick, un intrépido aventurero, parte hacia el Amazonas en busca de la tribu Goolu. Por desgracia, su avión se estrella sobre la peligrosa selva amazónica. ¡Ayuda a Rick a salir de este lío! 
Rick tendrá que progresar a través de varias localizaciones (cueva, pirámide egipcia, castillo medieval ocupado por nazis...) cuyas trampas deberá evitar. Los controles son sencillos: la dirección hacia arriba te permite saltar o trepar, la dirección hacia abajo te permite agacharte y la dirección diagonal hacia abajo te permite arrastrarte. Rick también cuenta con un pequeño arsenal de una pistola, bombas y un palo para aturdir a sus enemigos durante un breve periodo de tiempo.
El juego es efectivo pero muy difícil ("try and die"), tendrás que memorizar las trampas y repetir cada paso muchas veces para progresar.

meta.name: Rick Dangerous 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Es Londres en 1945. Rick Dangerous ha vuelto a casa después de frustrar los planes del ruin "Fat Man" de destruir la capital del Reino Unido. Pero Londres vuelve a estar amenazada. Una flota de platillos volantes aparece en el cielo de Londres. Decidido a llegar al fondo del asunto, Rick cambia su ropa de aventurero por la de un superhéroe y se dirige a Hyde Park, donde acaban de aterrizar los platillos.
El viaje se desarrolla en Hyde Park, las cuevas de hielo, el bosque y las minas atómicas. Al igual que en el primer juego, se desbloquea un quinto nivel tras completar los cuatro niveles estándar.
Rick puede subir escaleras y arrastrarse por espacios reducidos. Está equipado con una pistola láser y seis pequeñas bombas, pero también puede golpear.

meta.name: Ricochet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.17 KB

En Ricochet, controlas una paleta en la parte inferior de la pantalla que rebota una pelota hacia arriba para destruir bloques. Cada golpe hace que un bloque desaparezca y la pelota rebote, requiriendo reacciones rápidas para mantenerla en juego. El objetivo es eliminar los bloques que construyen el universo para evitar que la Dimensión-5 se convierta en una enana blanca. Tienes tres vidas, y la precisión y la sincronización son clave para sobrevivir.

meta.name: Ricochet Maze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.56 KB

“Ricochet Maze” is a skill-based game where the player must guide a ball by strategically deflecting it to hit ten targets. Deflectors can be placed to alter the ball's trajectory. Landmines, which appear periodically, add an extra challenge as they instantly destroy the ball. Random angles make control more difficult, creating unpredictable challenges.

meta.name: Ricochet Muncher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Ricochet Muncher” challenges you to shoot as many robots as possible before they send red diamonds to infiltrate you. You control a turret at the bottom of the screen that moves horizontally and fires vertically. A small character bounces across the screen, and your goal is to hit it before the timer runs out. If you succeed, you earn 100 points – if not, the computer gets 200. With every few hits, another row of objects appears for the character to ricochet off, making the gameplay increasingly chaotic.

meta.name: Riddle of the Redstone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Riddle of the Redstone is an interactive text adventure that plays like a blend of puzzle-solving and a choose-your-own-adventure story. The eccentric Mr. Dillworth, nearing his death, has decided to leave his fortune to a charity – but only the one clever enough to solve his riddles will inherit it. You, as the final candidate, receive three clues and begin exploring Dillworth's estate in search of the truth. At every step, you must make choices that shape your fate. Choose wrongly, and your game ends – forcing you to start over. A color-coded bag system – green for success, yellow for caution, red for failure – tracks your progress, while occasional illustrations bring scenes to life. Mystery, logic, and danger intertwine in this cerebral challenge.

meta.name: Riddle of the Sphinx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.21 KB

Riddle of the Sphinx combines a maze adventure with a series of random challenges that constantly test you on your way to the treasure. As you navigate the paths, you collect wealth by completing various tasks, sometimes through skill and sometimes through luck. Only once you have gathered enough can you enter the Sphinx's tomb, where the final riddle awaits. That mix of exploration, mini-games, and risk gives the game its varied appeal.

meta.name: Rigel's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 103.14 KB

The Re-Unification War is in full swing throughout the 22nd Century Galaxy, during your career as reporter Harper. When you are sent to Rigel V, your partner Elliott is killed by a bomb, and attempts to communicate some instructions to you as he fades. You catch part of them, telling you to proceed eastwards, disarm a device protected by andriod guards, and find a light-guide. In this text adventure, you set about doing precisely those things. Solutions have a sense of realism - you have to dive to avoid bullets and use a mine detector. Objects include an Identicard, a Jetcycle and dipswitches. Input is mostly VERB NOUN, but a few commands require fine-tuning.

meta.name: Rik the Roadie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.58 KB

You are Rik, roadie to the world famous pop group, "Alternative Rock". In order for Alternative Rock to stay popular, you, as their roadie, must get all their equipment to the gig, take it into the hall, and set up the sound levels before the gig starts.

meta.name: Rimrunner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rimrunner puts you in control of a warrior navigating side-scrolling levels, fighting hostile creatures and searching for shield generators that require recharging. A radar indicates both your position and the status of the generators – green for stable, flashing for unstable, and red for critical. Enemy attacks drain your health and can knock you off your Runner. On foot you are slower and restricted, but it's the only way to recharge the generators. This creates a constant balance between action and tactical decision-making.

meta.name: Ring Master
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.23 KB

Ring Master es un alegre juego con temática de circo donde el jugador debe presionar repetidamente el botón de disparo para hacer que un hombre salte más alto. Luego, una mujer es lanzada al aire con un balancín, y el jugador debe alinearla cuidadosamente con los atrapadores manteniendo presionado el botón izquierdo.

meta.name: The Ring of Power
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.31 KB

Ring of Power is a text-based adventure game where the player explores a mysterious world and solves puzzles to progress. Starting in a dark room with a shiny copper lamp, the player can move in various directions and interact to uncover clues and advance the story. Thoughtful commands and exploration are key to unraveling the game's secrets.

meta.name: Rings of Medusa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rings of Medusa is a strategy game with light role-playing and business simulation elements. Located in a medieval kingdom, the game puts the player in control of the former king's son. Unfortunately, an evil sorceress called Medusa has taken control of the country and is now dominating the people.
The prince's task is to find five magical rings that will give him the power to overthrow the sorceress and claim back his heritage. In the beginning the hero will try to earn money by doing trade between different towns, or try his luck at bounty hunting or at treasure hunts. Once enough money has been earned to maintain a larger army, the prince will send forth his men to search for the rings which are in the possession of large soldier of fortune armies rallying the lands.
Sometimes the player takes part in small arcade sequences like sword fighting and sea fights, or controls an army on the battle field.

There is always something to discover – from shops and inns to mysterious inhabitants, not all of whom can be trusted. Caves and dungeons add even more to the sense of adventure and give the journey a pleasingly mysterious tone.

Ringside follows the career of a boxer rising through the ranks. You start by distributing 100 points across punch power and defense, and earn more points by defeating stronger opponents. During matches, punches are selected by directional input plus fire button, while defense is handled by movement or auto-guard. A minigame between rounds lets you recover energy. Beyond career mode, the game features two-player battles and sparring in training mode.

meta.name: Ringside Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ringside Boxing is a strategic sports simulation where you don't control the boxers directly but choose their fight strategies. Similar to Title Bout or Strat-O-Matic games, the focus is on tactics and stats. Match legendary fighters from different eras – Ali vs. Marciano or fantasy bouts like Jones vs. Benn. Your decisions shape the fight's outcome – a tense and brainy experience for boxing fans.

meta.name: Ringside Seat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ringside Seat lets you manage legendary fighters across eight weight classes in a realistic boxing simulation. With over 45 iconic boxers, detailed stats, and strategic choices like “Stick & Move” or “Go For The Knockout,” you guide the match round by round. Whether playing against a friend, the computer, or watching an AI vs. AI bout, fights unfold with text and semi-animated action. You can view scores live or post-fight. It's a deep and tactical experience for true boxing strategists.

meta.name: Ringwars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.37 KB

Hundreds of ring worlds are converging on our solar system devouring everything on their path. Now it's up to the player to stop them.
Ring Wars features several parts. First, you follow the intelligence reports and locate ring worlds orbiting a planet. Traversing hyperspace, you engage in combat with the ring world defensive fleet, and, after it's defeated, enter the ring world itself. There, you set up a nuclear bomb within its reactor, and have to flee before its timer runs out. Then you depart, setting course to a friendly moon base, to reload your lasers, mount another nuclear bomb, and repair. After a while, the mothership defense goes low enough for you to pursue it. Defeat it and the menace is no more.

meta.name: Ripper!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ripper! turns the legend of Jack the Ripper into an eerie text adventure that draws its power not only from its dark atmosphere, but also from real time pressure. With unsettling music constantly playing in the background, you use the parser and interact with both famous and fictional characters to uncover who is behind the murders before time runs out. Its special appeal comes from the blend of real-time play, Victorian atmosphere, and the feeling of sitting in dim light while being pulled into a sinister mystery yourself.

meta.name: Risk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.02 KB

Risk brings the classic battle for world domination to the screen. On a colorful world map, you place armies, conquer territories, and plan strategic moves against your opponents. The goal is to occupy entire continents and take over enemy regions – from the Middle East to Australia. Every turn demands smart tactics, courage, and perfect timing. Whether attacking or defending, winning or losing – in the end, only one player can claim control of the world.

meta.name: Risk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Risk is the official adaptation of the famous Parker Brothers board game. Two to six players – human or computer-controlled with three difficulty levels – battle for global domination by building armies, conquering territories, and planning their strategy. The game includes four versions: UK and US full games, plus shorter variants of each. In the UK short game, players win by completing a secret mission, while in the US short game, the goal is to capture enemy headquarters. Though the rules and card designs differ slightly between editions, the objective remains the same – to conquer the world through smart, calculated strategy.

meta.name: Risk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

Risk is a card game that blends tension and strategy. You're dealt five cards and must decide whether to keep your hand or take another risk for a better one. But beware – if you push your luck and fail to improve your score, you bust and earn nothing. Points are awarded for poker hands like pairs, straights, or full houses, enhanced by the value and suit of each card. With every round, the suspense builds, and only those who balance courage with calculation can emerge victorious.

R.I.S.K.: Rapid Intercept Seek and Kill takes place on the planet Christon 3, where a secret weapons project is suddenly threatened by an alien invasion. As a fighter pilot, you launch from a secure base, upgrade your ship, and choose your next missions from a tactical map. During sorties, you battle enemy craft, collect supply pods for repairs, ammo, or upgrades, and even rescue scientists for special bonuses. After each mission, you return to base through treacherous underground tunnels. Precision, speed, and strategy are vital if you hope to stop the assault on Christon 3.

We need to run, take that speedboat! A wet and wild pursuit as the bad guys try to catch you and you try to leave them in your wake by dropping mines and trying to dodge them into watery obstacles.

River Raid es un juego de acción de desplazamiento vertical. Vuelas en un jet por un río en un intento de destruir los puentes que son vitales para el enemigo. Sin embargo, el río está fuertemente custodiado, con globos, barcos, helicópteros y aviones enemigos que intentan detenerte. En el camino tendrás que volar sobre las estaciones de combustible para repostar el avión y seguir volando.
El avión está armado con un cañón con munición ilimitada. Se puede utilizar para destruir los vehículos enemigos y puentes, pero un jugador descuidado puede destruir accidentalmente una estación de combustible. Chocar con los margenes del río o con un avión enemigo destruye tu avión y te hace perder una vida.

meta.name: River Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.67 KB

You are the owner of the fastest motorboat in the region. Their knowledge of the treacherous river and the dense jungle that surrounds it on both sides is unmatched. Therefore, you have been given the task of retrieving a group of scientists trapped in the upper reaches of the river. With supplies running low, it's important that you don't waste time finding them and getting them to the safety of the hospital.Rely on your lightning reactions and steer your boat at high speed between floating logs, crocodiles and rocks while avoiding the river banks. To help you clear a passage upstream, your boat is equipped with a powerful, fast-acting 30mm cannon.

meta.name: RMS Titanic
meta.desc:

RMS Titanic te pone al mando de la Compañía de Salvamento del Titanic, con la tarea de recuperar artefactos del naufragio y, finalmente, rescatar el barco. En la superficie, gestionarás las finanzas, las ruedas de prensa y las operaciones de la empresa. Bajo la superficie, guiarás al robot T.S.1 a través de un laberíntico naufragio en busca de ocho bolsas de flotación. En el camino, descubrirás objetos ocultos que debes combinar para desbloquear puertas, cajas fuertes y compartimentos secretos. Solo quienes equilibren la gestión estratégica con una exploración minuciosa podrán rescatar el Titanic.

meta.name: Road Course
meta.desc:

Road Course tells the story of a man bent on revenge who fearlessly takes to the asphalt. Billy, the Knight of the Road, knows neither fear nor remorse and ignores every traffic rule. On the infamous A47 he faces a merciless battle for survival where only the strongest endure. With quick reflexes and unwavering determination, you must navigate the chaotic traffic – a turbocharged nightmare of steel, tarmac, and raw resolve.

meta.name: Road Duels : The Corvette
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.35 KB

In Road Duels: The Corvette, you take the wheel of a powerful sports car and race through dangerous streets, where numerous opponents try to stop you. Equipped with built-in weapons, your car allows you to fight back and eliminate your pursuers in order to reach your goal. Speed, precise control, and skillful evasion of obstacles are key to coming out on top and being the victor at the end of the road.

meta.name: Road Raider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game is set in a bleak future where the world has been devastated by a holocaust. The ruthless Dr. A Noid has turned humans into mindless zombies using his artificial food, "SLU." To stop him, the player first drives an ATV through the city, destroying enemy vehicles and avoiding mines and turrets. Various buildings can be explored, where the player fights through rooms filled with zombies, dodges traps, and searches for ammunition, food, and a pass to the arena. The third part of the game is a deadly demolition derby in which enemy vehicles must be pushed into holes in the ground. After surviving the arena, the journey continues from city to city, leading up to the final confrontation with Dr. A Noid.

meta.name: Road Rally U.S.A.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Road Rally U.S.A. blends arcade action with geography learning, sending you on a road trip through six real regions of the United States. From a top-down view, you guide your vehicle along roads while dodging dangers like thunderstorms, mailboxes, and falling rocks. Clues and maps help you reach the correct destinations, but you'll also need to plan fuel stops along the way. Points are awarded for each location reached or for passing flag bearers. A challenge is completed when you successfully reach three destinations. But beware – running out of gas or taking a hit costs you one of your four vehicles, and once they're gone, the journey is over.

meta.name: Road Roller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.45 KB

Road Roller is a colorful spin on the Crush Roller formula, putting you in control of a road roller tasked with painting the streets purple. Ghouls chase you constantly, but with clever maneuvers you can trap them by painting the ends of the railway bridge and taking them out. Rats and cars also foul up your progress by leaving messy tracks, which you can squash to clean up the roads. Speed, strategy, and sharp timing are essential as you race through the maze to complete your task.

meta.name: Road Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este juego se basa en un juego de arcade lanzado por Atari.
Juegas al Correcaminos. Debes correr por la carretera, esquivando camiones, minas terrestres, caída de rocas, etc. y además no ser atrapado por Wile E. Coyote. También debes comer alpiste en el camino o te desmayarás y Wile E. te atrapará.
Puedes obtener puntos por comer alpiste y hacer que Wile E. sea atropellado por camiones, rocas que caen, etc.
Las versiones Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64 y ZX Spectrum son para un solo jugador. La versión Atari 2600 es para uno o dos jugadores, alternando. La versión Atari 2600 también tiene otra diferencia en la que no TIENES que comer el alpiste pero puedes por los puntos. Esto puede deberse a limitaciones de programación en el Atari 2600.

Road Runner and Wile E. Coyote brings the classic cartoon to life in an action game with two recurring stages of increasing difficulty. First, you control Road Runner on a single screen, pecking as much birdseed as possible – while dodging Wile E. Coyote's traps from above. The more seed you collect, the better your chances in stage two – where you sprint away from Wile E., leap over his traps, and reach a cliff – soaring to safety as he plummets below, just like in the cartoons.

meta.name: Road to Moscow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Road to Moscow“ puts you in command of the German army on the Eastern Front of World War II, with the goal of pushing back Soviet forces. The battlefield stretches from Finland to Crimea, with east shown at the top – your troops move upward. You can play a full campaign starting in 1941 or focus on individual yearly operations: the 1941 invasion, the 1942 second offensive, the 1943 Russian counteroffensive or the 1944 battle for Poland. Each campaign spans a year, with two moves per month. The objective is to force the Soviets to abandon Moscow, Stalingrad, Leningrad and everything west of them. The game is viewed from above on a small section of the map, with units shown as icons.

Along the way, snakes and crocodiles add extra danger, making sharp timing and quick reflexes essential to get all the frogs safely to their destination.

Every year a vicious biker gang has a race. You are fed up with this gang taking over so in your souped up car you become the Road Warrior. You must drive along the road shooting the bikers down. Remember to keep an eye on your fuel. If you don't kill a certain amount of bikers, when you stop for fuel you are killed.
The game is viewed from above your vehicle as you control your speed and steering with your joystick. Fire button fires your cannons. The screen shows apart from your vehicle and road, your speed, fuel, score and how many bikers to kill.

RoadBlasters es un juego de acción de carreras futurista. El objetivo es llegar a la meta de una sola pieza a lo largo de cada uno de los 50 niveles. Numerosos enemigos están en el camino para tratar de detenerte, incluidos vehículos blindados, motocicletas, cañones al costado del camino, minas terrestres y más.
Su vehículo está equipado con una ametralladora para ayudarlo, y ocasionalmente un avión de armas volará y arrojará potenciadores adicionales que se pueden recolectar. Algunos de estos son los U.Z. cañón, misiles de crucero y aumento de velocidad. Tu coche tiene una cantidad muy limitada de combustible, sin embargo, puedes recoger más en el camino cruzando el punto medio de un nivel, o recogiendo las esferas de combustible rojas y verdes que aparecen en el camino o después de destruir a ciertos enemigos. En muchos niveles, recolectar combustible es fundamental; de lo contrario, no podrá llegar a la meta.

Roadburner makes you the terror of the road in a horizontally scrolling action game where you blast away any car that tries to force you into the breakdown lane. Your vehicle is both weapon and shield as you battle through heavy traffic, turning enemy cars into wrecks. Only sharp reflexes and well-aimed shots will keep you moving forward and secure your dominance on the tarmac.

meta.name: Roadtoad
meta.desc:

Roadtoad takes the classic Frogger concept and adds an extra layer of challenge. Instead of just crossing a busy highway and then navigating logs, lily pads, and crocodiles on the river, here you face three danger zones. First, you dodge cars, trucks, and trailers on the interstate. Next comes a section filled with aliens and bugs blocking your path, before the final river crossing with the traditional obstacles. Each stage demands sharp reflexes and precise timing to reach safety.

El crimen ha florecido y las autopistas se han convertido en campos de batalla de varias bandas. El protagonista es uno de los líderes de una de estas bandas. Más patriota que los demás señores del crimen, acepta una misión del FBI: encontrar a ocho científicos capaces de desarrollar una vacuna contra esta enfermedad mortal.

Europe is suffering the same bio-war that has devastated America in Roadwar 2000. In Roadwar Europe, maniacal terrorists have destroyed one city and are threatening the entire continent. The player and his gang are its last hope. Player's mission is to locate and disarm the bio-bombs, and destroy the terrorist headquarters along with its leaders.

meta.name: Roadwars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Roadwars puts you on a long, hilly road made dangerous after a barrier malfunction. Armed with a laser gun, you must blast away side rails while avoiding the gaps they create. You're always up against another droid, who can be either ally or rival – and pushing them into a hole you just made is a particularly satisfying tactic. Along the way, obstacles like barriers and spikes threaten your progress, but bonus weapons and speed boosts give you an edge. Collisions with hazards or your opponent will drain your shields, and once they're gone, survival becomes a matter of sheer luck.

meta.name: Robbers of the Lost Tomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.21 KB

You have discovered a lost tomb and inside it's many rooms are four Sacred Tablets which you are on a quest to find. In this 1st person perspective game, you must move from room to room searching for the tablets while attempting to avoid Mummies, snakes and ghosts. In each room, you are presented with three numbered doors and you have the option of throwing a knife or moving through a door. You will be told as well if there is any danger close by. If you encounter any ghosts, they will move you to another part of the tomb but the Mummies and snakes need avoiding or a knife thrown at them to kill them. Before the quest you can select your skill level (1-10) and if you want the Mummies to move about the tomb. On certain skill levels you can decide how many knives to carry, and how many Mummies and perils you want in the tomb.

In Robin Hood you embark on a daring mission to rescue Maid Marian from the clutches of the Sheriff of Nottingham. The journey spans several stages: first, you fight your way through Sherwood Forest, shooting down ambushing guards. Next, outside the castle, you must dodge incoming arrows and take out the henchmen to open the gate. Inside, the final challenge awaits – behind many doors lie gold, foes, or Maid Marian herself. Find her, and victory is yours; fail, and the Sheriff triumphs.

meta.name: Robin Hood : Legend Quest

Robin debe rescatar a Maid Marion de las garras del Sheriff de Nottingham, recogiendo tesoros por el camino. Robin va armado con un arco y flechas con los que puede acabar con gárgolas, trolls y demás. Los diseños de los niveles son largos y laberínticos, con la necesidad de recoger llaves y descubrir pasadizos secretos para encontrar todas las secciones de los mismos, y el oro que contienen. Muchas de las plataformas móviles sólo se activan recogiendo una llave para ellas en otro lugar.

In Robin of the Wood, you take on the role of the outlaw Robin, whose mission is to reclaim the legendary Silver Arrow, offered by the Sheriff of Nottingham as bait in a grand archery contest. To take part, you must first acquire equipment from a tree spirit – provided you can afford it. You wander through the forest collecting money bags or persuading wealthy nobles to make a “donation.” Along the way, you encounter allies like the hermit, who heals you if you don't attack him, and enemies such as Norman soldiers, the Sheriff himself, witches, and wild boars. Armed with sword and bow, you must survive these trials, gather gold, and eventually compete in the contest to win the Silver Arrow.
