Although then a successful cricket player, Robin Smith licensed a management game. Playing against the computer, you can play a single match or a series of 3 or 5 one-day matches, as one of the top 7 international sides. These matches can be anywhere between 40 and 60 overs per side in length.
First you select your team off 11 based on their battling, bowling and wicket-keeping abilities. A coin toss decides who bats first, after which you choose your tactics for the upcoming over, based on weather and wicket conditions. The bowling side has 9 field layouts to choose from.
The action is represented from a top-down view of the whole field, with a running commentary as to the results of each stroke, showing what type of shot was played, who fielded the ball, and how many runs were scored.

meta.name: Robin to the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Maid Marion has been captured and held in Nottingham Castle by the evil Sheriff and as Robin Hood, you must attempt to navigate through the castle and rescue her. The game is a single screen platformer where you have to move around each screen to collect all the flashing keys to move to the next screen. Ropes can be climbed to get to higher parts on the screen. There are many obstacles to avoid which are gaps in the walls, guards with spears, arrows flying across the screen and falling objects. If you touch any object or fall into a gap then you lose one of three lives.

meta.name: Robo Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.77 KB

Robo Runner is a simultaneous two-player, side-scrolling shooter where each player controls a robot in mirrored arenas filled with enemies and obstacles. The goal is to defeat your opponent using precise shots and smart movement. An energy bar tracks your robot's health – speed, reflexes, and strategy determine who will win the match.

meta.name: Robo's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Robo's Revenge turns guiding a bouncing ball into a demanding test of skill, where your goal is to lead it safely through each level and out to the exit. Because movement is shaped by bouncing rather than complete freedom, the game demands a strong sense of timing, routes, and the right moment for every action. That blend of precision, caution, and steady progress gives the game a direct and appealing puzzle-like character.

meta.name: Robobolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.04 KB

You are a robot and you have been tasked to save the spaceship you work on which is infected with a Space Virus and is full of radiation. The ship contains various levels and each level must be cleared to move on to the next one. On each level you must collect four Death Pods which you can only carry one at a time and take it to an Assembly Unit. The pods must also be placed in the Assembly Unit in the correct order. Roaming each level is other robots and when touched decreases your energy but you are equipped with a laser and can blast them which also increases your energy.

meta.name: Robocop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El agente Alex Murphy fue asesinado en las calles de Detroit. La corporación OCP vio la oportunidad de vender un nuevo policía a la ciudad en crisis: tomaron los restos de Murphy, los blindaron en titanio, borraron su memoria y crearon a RoboCop. Ahora, limpia las calles y elimina a Clarence Boddicker, su asesino... aunque quizá no sea el verdadero jefe.
Basado en la película de 1987, controla a RoboCop en un side-scroller: golpea desarmados, dispara armados. Mueve izquierda/derecha/agáchate (sin saltar). Recoge armas de enemigos, power-ups para salud/energía. Tras niveles: identifica caras y bonus shooter en primera persona.

meta.name: Robocop 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

RoboCop 2 es un juego basado en misiones. Las misiones tienen varios objetivos, como destruir las armas nucleares o matar a todos los enemigos. Si no destruiste o mataste lo suficiente, serás transportado a una misión de entrenamiento, que es una perspectiva en primera persona. Si también fallas el entrenamiento, debes ir al comienzo de la misión anterior. Una misión cumplida con éxito o suficientes puntos conseguidos por el entrenamiento te permiten pasar a la siguiente etapa. A diferencia del primer RoboCop, no hay límite de tiempo y puedes saltar.

meta.name: Robocop 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En RoboCop 3 tienes que completar misiones (como rescatar a sus amigos que están siendo retenidos como rehenes), que se dividen en varios niveles más pequeños. Los niveles suelen consistir en varias plataformas, y están muy pobladas de enemigos que te disparan. Puedes reunir kits de reaparación especiales, que serán utilizados para restaurar su salud después de haber completado un nivel. "RoboCop 3" es más un shooter que sus predecesores, teniendo más y más duros enemigos.

meta.name: Roboservant
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Roboservant, you control a small robot navigating a vast labyrinth filled with traps and hazards. Your mission is to complete important tasks for your boss, while each level introduces new dangers, enemies, and tricky challenges. A unique feature is the ability to create your own levels—up to 16 screens long—which you can then play yourself or let others try to conquer. This makes the game not only a test of skill but also a creative playground for designing your own labyrinth adventures.

meta.name: Robot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.34 KB

In Robot, you take on the role of a combat robot who must battle through eight levels filled with hostile machines. Your mission is to blast enemy robots into pieces while dodging their attacks and staying alive. Only by defeating all enemies can you progress to the next stage.

p: Robot Rascals - A Zany Scavenger Hunt (USA).D64
n: Robot Rascals - A Zany Scavenger Hunt (USA)

meta.name: Robot Rascals
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Robot Rascals” has you control a robot in a turn-based scavenger hunt – combining strategy, action and board game mechanics as you use cards to search for specific items in the terrain. The first player to collect all the objects shown on their cards wins. Luck cards shake things up – allowing you to trade or steal cards, often at another player's expense. At the start of each turn, one such card is drawn. Ten unique robots with different traits are available – and the terrain also affects gameplay.

meta.name: Robot Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.59 KB

In Robot Run, you fight your way through maze-like rooms filled with hostile robots. Your goal is to take them down before they eliminate you. But be careful—they can fire not only straight but also diagonally, making dodging much trickier. On top of that, an invincible foe relentlessly chases you, forcing you to react quickly and reach the exit. Skill, sharp reflexes, and smart movement determine how long you survive and how high your score will be.

meta.name: Robotron : 2084
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.19 KB

You are a mutant human, who by some freak of nature has the ability to shoot energy pulses from his body in eight different directions! Your job is simple: save humanity from their own creation -- the ROBOTRONS! The gameplay is pretty unique for the time. You can move and fire in any of eight directions. You get thrown in a room with various evil baddies strewn about, you've got to kill all the robots while at the same time finding some way to grab humans and avoid death.

meta.name: Robots of Dawn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Robots of Dawn, you take on the role of Earth detective Elijah Baley, sent to the distant planet Aurora to solve the murder of Dr. Han Falstofe, a leading roboticist specializing in humaniform robots. Several suspects emerge, including his rival Dr. Amadiro, his daughter Vasilia, his surrogate daughter Gladia, and the spurned ladies' man Gremionis. Even Baley's loyal partner, the robot R. Daneel Olivaw, is not beyond suspicion. You gather evidence, interrogate suspects, and face your fear of open spaces on Aurora, all while contending with the Aurorans' prejudice against Earthmen. Each playthrough differs, with a different murderer, shifting clues, and varied responses. To succeed, you must prove motive, means, and opportunity, and present your case to the Chairman of Aurora to convict the true killer.

meta.name: Robots!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Robots! puts you in control of a small hero who must collect all the rubies on screen while avoiding hostile robots and bombs. You can defend yourself with a laser, but enemies grow in number and strength as you progress. At higher levels, a spider appears, carrying bombs toward the rubies and making them even more dangerous. The goal is to collect all rubies in each stage to advance, earning points for rubies, destroyed robots, and bombs. Completing a level rewards you with bonus points and an extra life. Across eight perilous levels, every touch of an enemy, bomb, or spider proves fatal.

meta.name: Robox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.73 KB

In Robox, you awaken as the last C-class combat robot, tasked with saving a desperate colony in the Beta system. The peaceful inhabitants are under attack by the dreaded plasma eaters, who are stealing their atmosphere and water. No one else can help – only you are reactivated to confront the invaders. With courage, firepower, and iron determination, you stand against the enemy, while the story is sprinkled with humor and playful references to other heroes.

meta.name: Robox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.27 KB

In Robox, you awaken as the last C-class combat robot, tasked with saving a desperate colony in the Beta system. The peaceful inhabitants are under attack by the dreaded plasma eaters, who are stealing their atmosphere and water. No one else can help – only you are reactivated to confront the invaders. With courage, firepower, and iron determination, you stand against the enemy, while the story is sprinkled with humor and playful references to other heroes.

meta.name: Robozone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A nearby planet is emitting a dangerous level of pollution, so you must go in destroy the source. The game is split into three levels, all of which are shoot 'em up based but in different ways. The first level has multi-directional scrolling and a maze aspect. The second is an into the screen 3D section requiring fast reactions. Finally you come to a horizontally scrolling, time-limited side-viewed section as you close in on destroying the emitter.

meta.name: Rock n' Bolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.03 KB

Rock n' Bolt sends you up a towering construction site that feels more like a tangled mix of beams, bolts and plans. You hop from girder to girder, tightening bolts in the right order and solving puzzle after puzzle while the clock keeps ticking. Each finished section earns bonus wages you can use to hire extra help and bring order to the chaos faster. Floor by floor you work through all 100 levels – a wild blend of speed, strategy and the thrill of working high above the ground.

meta.name: Rock Paper Shear
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rock Paper Shear combines Tetris mechanics with the rules of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Stones, papers, and scissors fall from the top of the screen, and you must place them so that they beat each other—scissors on paper, paper on rock, rock on scissors. Matching pairs disappear, clearing the playfield. As the speed increases with each level, quick thinking and clever stacking become key to survival.

meta.name: Rock Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.92 KB

In Rock Run you pilot a spaceship through a dense asteroid field. The goal is to avoid the deadly rocks and progress as far as possible without crashing. Speed and quick reflexes are crucial, as every collision drains your energy and brings you closer to game over. The longer you survive, the higher your score climbs, but the challenge increases with each stage.

p: Rock Star Ate my Hamster, A (Europe).D64
n: Rock Star Ate my Hamster, A (Europe)

meta.name: Rock Star Ate My Hamster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres Cecil Pitt, un aspirante a manager de estrellas del rock. Tienes que elegir a las estrellas de rock que vas a dirigir viendo sus cintas de audición. Una vez elegidos tus artistas, tienes que decidir qué tipo de equipo proporcionarles: nuevo, de segunda mano o dudoso. Los equipos dudosos son muy baratos, pero te arriesgas a pagar por tu elección más adelante en el juego.
Para convertir a tu grupo en una estrella, tienes opciones como el entrenamiento, los trucos publicitarios y la compra de regalos para tus estrellas. Cada acción que elijas hace avanzar el calendario un día, y tienes hasta diciembre para alcanzar tu objetivo final: el superestrellato.

meta.name: Rock 'n Roll
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Rock 'n Roll you guide a ball through a massive labyrinth packed with traps and obstacles. Momentum carries you over ramps, through tubes and across fragile tiles, while laser barriers and deadly drops stand in your way. Keys unlock doors, switches reshape the paths and coins can be spent on useful items like bombs, parachutes or repair picks. Lose too much energy or fall off the platform and you're out. With 32 tricky levels, you'll need skill, patience and steady nerves to make it all the way through.

meta.name: Rock'n'Rhythm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Rock'n'Rhythm is an educational music program designed to introduce children to instruments and rhythms in a playful way. Using a colorful jukebox interface, you select songs or instruments and can then record, mix, and play back different sound tracks. Animated musicians like drummers accompany the input and make the process more vivid. The program allows you to practice rhythms, compose your own sequences, and experiment with band elements, making music theory accessible in a simple and fun way.

meta.name: Rocket Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.42 KB

Rocket Ball imagines a future where wars are replaced by brutal roller-skating matches between four global teams. Five players per team race to grab the rocket ball and shoot it into the right-side goal. If it touches the left wall, play resets. Touching the ball knocks you down, and carrying it makes you a target. Players can only move left but can speed up or slow down. With tight controls and intense pacing, it's a futuristic sports brawl of reflexes and raw competition.

meta.name: Rocket Launch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.93 KB

Rocket Launch puts you in command of four Tornado squadrons tasked with destroying weapons factories in Helsinki, Magdeburg, Belgrade, and Kiev. These targets are protected by deadly surface-to-air missile bases that launch without warning. Your planes are more accurate than the missiles – but only if you plan your strikes carefully. Every move matters if you want to stop the arms race.

meta.name: Rocket Ranger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the 1940s, the Nazis built a base on the moon and plan to use a mysterious substance called Lunarium to reduce people's intelligence. However, in the 21st Century time travel has been mastered, as have jet-propulsion backpacks, plus some cataclysmic weaponry and advanced code-breaking equipment. These items are sent back in time to you in order to change the result of the war by using this technology to find their five rocket factories and destroy the moon base.

meta.name: Rocket Ranger

In the 1940s, the Nazis built a base on the moon and plan to use a mysterious substance called Lunarium to reduce people's intelligence. However, in the 21st Century time travel has been mastered, as have jet-propulsion backpacks, plus some cataclysmic weaponry and advanced code-breaking equipment. meta.name: Rocket Roger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.22 KB

Rocket Roger is a multi-directional scrolling platformer where you explore a vast planet made up of 30 zones, each with multiple screens. Using a jetpack, you collect crystals, dodge hazards, and keep an eye on your fuel. Transporter pads act as checkpoints, letting you restart from them if you lose a life. Navigation and timing are key as you work your way through this sprawling alien world.

meta.name: Rocket Smash EX
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rocket Smash EX throws you into a frantic mission to build and fuel a rocket to escape a hostile world. Oxygen runs low, meteors strike, and aliens swarm – all while a deranged company AI mocks you and your boss actively sabotages your efforts. Collect gems to pad your miserable salary, and maybe stumble upon an alien princess. But the real challenge? Surviving long enough to blast off.

meta.name: Rockfall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Rockfall, you guide a small character through a multi-level construction site filled with hazards. Moving obstacles patrol each floor, and your task is to dodge them while ascending safely to the top. For every 100 points, you earn an extra life. The fire button lets you pause the game or briefly turn invisible to bypass tight spots. With simple mechanics and increasing difficulty, Rockfall challenges your reflexes and timing.

meta.name: Rockfall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.85 KB

Rockfall is a Boulder Dash clone with 48 levels. In each level, you must collect all diamonds before the timer runs out. Be careful of falling boulders – they only stay put on flat surfaces and can't be outrun once in motion. Later levels introduce monsters and pulsators. Monsters roam randomly, while pulsators always follow walls and turn left at each decision point. You can crush monsters with boulders, but pulsators must be lured into traps. The first level gives you 180 seconds, and each following level adds 120 seconds plus any leftover time. If the timer reaches zero, it's game over.

meta.name: Rockfall II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.26 KB

In Rockfall II, you return to perilous asteroid mines to recover vital gemstones used for energy production. Each cave requires you to collect a set number of stones, shown at the bottom of the screen. Once gathered, you must return to the entry door to move on to a harder cave. Dangers include unstable rocks and hostile alien beings called Crokko – touching them costs you a life. But if you manage to crush them with boulders, they transform into the valuable stones you're after.

meta.name: Rockford : The Arcade Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.03 KB

This is a rocks'n'diamonds style game. Play in six different worlds (as a explorer, cook, doctor, etc.) of increasing difficulty, and grab the coins/apples/hearts while avoiding the boulders. And there are enemies to make your life (even more) difficult.

meta.name: Rockus : The Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rockus: The Game is a flick-screen platformer originally created as an entry for a 64'er magazine competition in 1993 but never officially released. What makes it remarkable is that about 90% of the code was written in BASIC and only 10% in machine language. You guide a hi-res overlay character through simple platforming levels where you must collect a set number of disks and keys before reaching the exit on the right. Some blocks can be punched to reveal bonus items like diamonds, coins, umbrellas for temporary invulnerability, stars for extra lives, fireballs to throw, or boots for faster running. While a bit glitchy at times, it's a solid little game and offers a fun short challenge.

meta.name: Rocky
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.28 KB

Rocky is a simple boxing game where you face your opponent in the ring. Gameplay focuses on classic punches and dodges, while the crowd and judges watch from the stands. The game keeps things straightforward, emphasizing direct duels, quick reflexes, and good timing to survive the rounds and claim victory.

meta.name: The Rocky Horror Show
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.51 KB

En The Rocky Horror Show encarnas a Brad o Janet, intentando rescatar al otro, convertido en piedra. Solo reuniendo todas las piezas de la Máquina Medusa —y llevándolas una a una a la De-Medusa— lograrás liberarlo. Mientras exploras el castillo, recoges llaves y desactivas campos de fuerza, pero varios personajes te entorpecen: te roban o esconden la ropa y otros objetos. Riff-Raff es especialmente peligroso con su pistola láser, y Eddie, una vez descongelado, recorre el castillo en moto. Solo con planificación cuidadosa y acción rápida podrás salvar a tu pareja y escapar antes de que el castillo despegue.

meta.name: Rocky's Boots
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rocky's Boots is a simple educational puzzle game where you can learn about logic circuits. You control a nondescript square, moving it about several rooms. Each room contains basic electronic parts like AND, OR and NOT gates, flip-flops, delays and clocks. You can pick these up and combine them to build simple or complex circuits. After a helpful tutorial, the task in the game is to build "kicking" machines: Objects of different colors move through an area and turn sensor outputs on and off. You now have to build a circuit that activates a kicking device which kicks the right objects out. When you do it just right, Rocky the raccoon dances a little jig to a joyful melody for you! The game also features an editor where you can build you very own kicking puzzle.

meta.name: Rodland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rodland es un juego de acción, versión de la recreativa del mismo nombre. El software incluye 40 pantallas donde tienes que eliminar a todos los enemigos mas una pantalla de jefe de fase o final. Por cada oponente asesinado, recibes una bonificación que usas para matar a otros enemigos con movimientos especiales.
El juego nos presenta la historia de dos hadas llamadas Tam y Rit, cuya misión es rescatar a su madre que ha sido capturada y llevada a un castillo.

meta.name: Rodney to the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Rodney to the Rescue, actúas como un valiente caballero trepando por el muro del castillo para rescatar a tu amada Gwendolyn. Sigue el camino sinuoso hacia arriba mientras evitas a los guardias enemigos y un dragón volador. El objetivo es llegar a la plataforma superior sin ser golpeado, solo entonces puedes salvar a Gwendolyn y convertirte en un verdadero héroe.

meta.name: Rogue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.06 KB

Rogue is a turn-based dungeon crawler in which the player controls an adventurer who must explore the dangerous Dungeon of Doom to find the valuable Amulet of Yendor. The player character starts at the top level and slowly works his way down. The game uses ASCII characters to represent locations, objects, monsters and the protagonist himself. There are 26 different types of monsters, symbolized by their first letters (e.g. L for Leprechaun). Monsters have different abilities and attack modes. Each dungeon level contains a grid of three by three rooms and dead ends. The levels become increasingly complex and labyrinthine and the monsters become stronger the deeper the hero goes into the dungeon. The player character can purchase better weapons and armor, gain experience points and level up. If the player dies in the dungeon, he has to start the game again.

meta.name: Rogue Trooper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.83 KB

Rogue Trooper takes place on the devastated planet Nu-Earth, where an endless war rages between the Norts and the Southers. During a crucial mission, the Souther forces are betrayed and massacred in the Quartz Zone, with only one genetically engineered infantryman surviving. With the help of the biochips of his fallen comrades Helm, Gunnar, and Bagman, he sets out to prove the betrayal and bring the traitor to justice. To do so, he must recover eight scattered videotapes that hold the evidence. While taking down enemy patrols, he must also avoid sustaining too many hits in order to complete his mission.

meta.name: Roland's Ratrace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Roland's Ratrace follows TV star Roland Rat, who is late for work while his car refuses to start. You must guide him through London's sewers before the time runs out, or he'll lose his job. To make matters worse, his friends have been kidnapped and must be rescued. The game is a flickscreen platformer with multiple levels, ladders, and exits, some of which lead deeper into the screen. The goal is to collect door pieces and a key to open the large door at the end of the sewer, leading to the Inner Sanctum where Roland's friends are held.

meta.name: Roll Call Usa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Roll Call USA is a multiplayer quiz game about the 50 American states.
Get ready to amaze your family and friends with fun facts about state capitals, major industries, major cities, statehood dates and other trivia. Combine historical and geographical facts in a colorful question and answer game that tests your knowledge of the 50 states.

meta.name: Roll Over
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Roll Over sends you on a fast-paced journey through multiple countries, each represented by a challenging maze. You guide a rolling ball through shifting pathways, collecting all items – like smiley faces or light bulbs – to advance to the next stage. With every level, the maze grows trickier, demanding sharp planning and quick reflexes. The timer is always ticking, so one wrong turn can cost you everything. A clever action-puzzle that tests timing, focus, and spatial awareness.

meta.name: Roll-a-Word
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Roll-a-Word is an educational game from The Electric Company series that helps children practice reading, rhyming, and spelling in a fun, interactive way. A colorful word machine spins letters to form or change words, and you complete sentences, identify rhymes, and explore how letters create new meanings. With its blend of animation, sound, and simple gameplay, it feels like a playful word lab – perfect for young learners who love experimenting with language.

meta.name: Roll-About
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.80 KB

Roll-About puts you in control of a small ball rolling through maze-like levels packed with enemies and hazards. You can shoot almost everything in your path and collect stars for bonus points. But watch out for spikes – they're indestructible and deadly on contact. Speed, precision, and timing are key to surviving and finding your way out before your run comes to a sharp end.

meta.name: Rollaround
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Rollaround“ is a puzzle-action game that feels like a more tactical version of „Marble Madness“. The player controls a ball through 20 levels, each consisting of nine fixed screens. The objective is to collect a set number of colored crosses, with fewer choices available as the game progresses. Moving enemies require strategic planning, while different floor structures affect gameplay. Holes can be jumped over, and special squares transform crosses or holes. Mystery tiles trigger random effects, while clock squares pause the timer or slow down enemy movement.

meta.name: RollerBall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.01 KB

RollerBall is a variant of the territory-capturing game where you must use your “Space Scriber” to fill at least 75% of the playfield. The goal is to trap the ball the game is named after – but if it touches you or your trail before a section is closed, you lose a life. Adding extra challenge are two “Squeezer” enemies that patrol the outlines of already claimed areas, making the task even harder.

meta.name: Rollerboard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.12 KB

Rollerboard puts you on a skateboard in classic side-scrolling fashion. Instead of motorcycles like in the Kikstart series, you roll through obstacle-filled levels on four wheels. With only three boards in reserve, every jump and move matters, as each crash costs a skateboard. Accelerating, braking, tackling hills and jumping at the right moment are all done with the joystick. Skilled players can also pull off flips and spins to rack up valuable bonus points.

meta.name: Rollercoaster Rumbler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rollercoaster Rumbler puts you in the front seat of a roller coaster, armed with a machine gun. As the ride speeds along, targets suddenly appear, and you must hit them at the right moment to score points. Speed and precision determine how well you can master the wild ride.

meta.name: Rollin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.82 KB

Rollin is a fast-paced arcade action game set in a maze-like grid where each square adds points to your score when you trace all four sides. As you navigate, enemies move across the screen, and touching them costs one of your three lives. Enclosing all four corner squares changes their color and awards a bonus that doubles with each success. Odd-numbered levels let you collect dots freely, while even-numbered ones demand precision – lines only count when tied to a completed box. A tricky blend of timing, planning, and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Rolling Ronny
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Who says being an errand boy is dull ? Take Rolling Ronny - he's the coolest dude in town. Help him rollerskate and shoot his way through nine levels of parkland, city streets, office complexes and even the underground sewers to his final destination at the other side of town. Collect cash by running errands for the inhabitants of this weird and wonderful town to earn enough money for a bus ticket to the next part of this barmy game.

meta.name: Rolling Thunder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.38 KB

Rolling Thunder es la fuerza policial secreta más poderosa del mundo y tú eres su mejor agente. Tu misión es detener una conspiración clandestina para conquistar el mundo y salvar a la agente Leila, que ha sido capturada. Arrancando solo con un arma de fuego, debes atravesar pasillos y pasadizos secretos fuertemente custodiados para encontrar a Leila y detener al enemigo. Rolling Thunder presenta una acción de desplazamiento lateral basada en el juego de arcade.

meta.name: Rolling Twins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.44 KB

Rolling Twins puts your multitasking skills to the ultimate test. You control two balls at once – one on the top half of the screen, one on the bottom – and must collect all the cells within a tight time limit. The playfields are filled with obstacle stones that block your path or even reverse your controls. While one ball may glide freely, the other often gets stuck, creating total chaos. Mastering perfect timing, awareness, and coordination between both sides is the only way to roll the twins to victory.

meta.name: Rolloverture
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.77 KB

Rolloverture has you helping the maestro restore a hopelessly scrambled musical score. You scurry across platforms, climb ladders, flip conveyors, and sort notes by jumping onto the correct music balls. Placing a note correctly brings you closer to completing the overture, while mistakes speed up the action and raise the challenge. Each round offers different melodies and freshly scrambled notes, letting you learn about music, rhythm, and note order in a playful way.

meta.name: Roloid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.33 KB

Roloid tests your spatial awareness and timing. On screen are two layers – one above, one below. Your task is to shift the upper layer so it perfectly covers the one beneath. Every move matters, as you only have a limited number of attempts and the clock is ticking. Precision, focus and quick reactions are key if you want to align the patterns flawlessly before time runs out.

meta.name: Rome and the Barbarian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.75 KB

Rome and the Barbarian is set in the 5th century A.D. when the Roman empire struggled against the barbarian threat. The player takes the control over the empire in an attempt to bring things under control. The game is played on a top-down European map with abstract symbols representing units etc. The majority of the game focuses on economical aspects. Money from taxes is key, as it is used to pay for troops and bribe barbarians tribes - therefore it is important to read the statistical data which is given on separate menu screens. But of course there is also a military component: uprising barbarians have to be defeated and important cities brought back to the empire. Movement order for units are directly given on the map.

meta.name: Rommel : Battles for North Africa
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Rommel: Battles for North Africa“ is a turn-based, hex-grid strategy game recreating the battles between Allied and Axis forces in North Africa during World War II. Players can engage in eight scenarios from both sides, including historical battles such as „Sidi Rezegh“ (1941), „Alam el Halfa“ (1942), and „Kasserine Pass“ (1943), as well as an alternate German invasion of Malta. Based on the „Battlefront“ system, the game operates at a corps level, incorporating factors like weather, terrain, supply, experience, and morale. Victory depends on capturing key locations within the turn limit. The game includes a scenario editor („WarPlan“) and a map/unit graphics editor („WarPaint“).

p: Romper Room's I Love my Alphabet (USA).T64
n: Romper Room's I Love my Alphabet (USA)

meta.name: Romper Room's I Love my Alphabet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.38 KB

Romper Room's I Love My Alphabet is an educational game based on the long-running American children's TV show Romper Room, designed for kids aged 2 to 7. Guided by Max – a cheerful, tomato-like character on legs – children learn letters, vocabulary, concentration, and basic associations in a fun and interactive way. The game features four activities: first, Max introduces each letter with a playful action; then kids can press keys to make Max perform them. Later, they're asked to find the right letters or guess which one Max is acting out. It's a charming blend of learning and play, making the alphabet come alive through motion and imagination.

meta.name: Romulus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 76.08 KB

"In 'Romulus' the task of debugging mega-chips for the Igos Transputer Company is yours. Using your Vector Module, you enter the chip and stabilize its circuits by clearing out intelligent bugs. Each channel ends with a transition phase featuring three sub-games: first, you must memorize and repeat a sequence of tones and colors; second, you match animated patterns in pairs of boxes; and finally, you face the computer in a battle to place six nodes on screen while removing the computer's. The main game is a horizontally scrolling shooter where you control your ship's direction and speed with the joystick and fire your weapon with the fire button. Your score, lives, and time are always visible on screen."

meta.name: Ronald Rubberduck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.50 KB

The player controls Ronald, a bubble shooting duck, who tries to navigate a number of dangerous stages to reach the exit door. Ronald can swim in all directions and fire horizontally while underwater. While flying, gravity constantly pulls Ronald down, and he must flap to stay airborn. Ronald can fire directly downwards while flying, and he has a total of 9 bubbles per level. The player must shoot the switch on each level to open the exit door. Dangers include jumping frogs, swimming octopi, and flying birds. If the player touches any obstacle they lose a life and must restart the stage. The player starts with 5 lives.

meta.name: Cyclon Zap : Space Bomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.93 KB

Roofus is a mix between Space Invaders and a wave shooter – with a cross-hairs element that adds extra difficulty. Your mission is to destroy the invaders before they reduce your spaceship to cosmic dust. The enemies line up in combat formation based on their rank and dive toward you unpredictably before retreating to prepare for another attack. If you manage to eliminate the entire fleet, a new wave of even fiercer aliens will appear to challenge you again.

meta.name: Room Ten
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.08 KB

Room Ten takes place in the zero-gravity arenas of the Galcorp worlds, where boredom is cured with a new form of extreme sport. It's essentially a three-dimensional Pong duel – a fast-paced test of reflexes, timing, and precision. The goal is to shoot the ball toward your opponent so they can't return it. If the ball hits the opponent's back wall, you score five points, and the first to reach 35 wins. The screen displays both players' viewpoints simultaneously for added intensity. Speed, AI difficulty, and color scheme can all be adjusted – and with the two-player mode, the futuristic training chamber quickly becomes a real battleground.

meta.name: Roomlord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.09 KB

Precious heirlooms must be retrieved to retain the inheritance of "Roomlord". A large family mansion, apparently unoccupied for years, has become a magical building controlled by weird and wonderful characters. After skillfully selecting your first choice of room you enter the doorway. At once you are confronted with the room guardians, "Demons", "Cyclops", "Chinese Dragons", "Gangsters", and many others. The Heirloom is visible... How do you reach and secure it? Where is your exit?... How do you escape? What danger is not visible? 16 full playing screens of intense graphical adventure will elevate you to "Super Roomlord".

meta.name: Rooter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.79 KB

Rooter places you in a futuristic setting where you pilot a spacecraft through highly technical environments and engage hostile units. You maneuver carefully through intricate structures, react to enemy attacks and try to maintain control of the playfield as speed and challenge gradually increase. Skill, quick reflexes and precise timing determine how far you can progress.

meta.name: Rootin' Tootin'
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.01 KB

In "Rootin' Tootin'," you control a tuba navigating a maze of musical staves, collecting notes while being pursued by various instruments. These instruments — such as cymbals, triangles, guitars, and pianos — each have unique abilities to hinder your progress. Collected notes can be used as weapons, destroying enemies in their path. Additionally, you can become intangible for a short time, making you invulnerable but unable to collect notes. Skill and timing are crucial to mastering this musical challenge.

meta.name: Rotator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.31 KB

Rotator challenges you to arrange a 3×3 grid by rotating 2×2 groups. The goal is to reach the order 1–9 – each turn shifts four tiles at once, so smart move sequences matter. You plan ahead to avoid dead ends and bring the grid into the correct sequence efficiently.

meta.name: Roulette Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.44 KB

Roulette Simulator lets you and up to seven other players sit down at a virtual Las Vegas-style roulette table. Each player starts with 5000 in cash, and the game ends once the last human player runs out of money. You place your bets on a classic roulette layout, choose “Spin Wheel,” and watch the animated wheel spin until the result is revealed. Afterward, the table is cleared and new bets can be placed. During the betting phase, you can view wheel and player statistics at any time.

meta.name: Round About
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.66 KB

Round About is a fixed-screen shooter where the player isn't limited to the bottom of the screen. Instead, you move along all four edges, circling enemies that swirl in the center. The enemies are abstract shapes that move in coordinated swarms. Once one wave is cleared, the next appears. You begin with three lives and gain extras after every few completed levels.

meta.name: Round the Bend!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 84.84 KB

Round the Bend! captures the bizarre humor of the TV show and sends you into the sewers as Lou Brush to recover eight missing comic pages. After selecting a route from the pipe network, you navigate scrolling platform sections, avoid hazards and search for the scattered sheets. Each recovered page leads to a unique single-screen sequence with layered challenges. Inspired by the show's absurd themes, the game delivers a quirky adventure packed with strange and playful scenarios.

meta.name: Roundabout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.30 KB

Roundabout is a fast-paced strategy game in which you are constantly fleeing from so-called whirligigs – boomerang-like creatures that relentlessly hunt you. Your goal isn't just to survive but to cleverly trap them. Using swinging doors that you can move in four directions, you try to enclose them on all sides. If a creature is blocked for even a short moment, it disintegrates. Each round starts with a certain number of whirligigs, which increases with each level. From level 7 onward, the number stays the same, but their speed increases. You score points by trapping whirligigs, and the faster you complete a level, the more bonus points you earn. If a creature touches you, you lose a life. Once all lives are lost, the game is over.

meta.name: Row Boat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.49 KB

Row Boat challenges you to guide your rowboat to the top of the water tank before it fills completely. Along the way, you must dodge falling obstacles and carefully navigate between platforms. Speed and precise control are crucial to reach the goal in time and avoid being swallowed by the rising water.

meta.name: Row Regatta
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.97 KB

meta.name: Rowdy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rowdy puts you against the clock with a limited number of jumps, each one removing a tile from the bottom row. By choosing the right timing and sequence, you aim to create matching combinations among the remaining symbols so more tiles can disappear. Every move reshapes the board, making foresight and awareness essential. Clearing all tiles allows you to advance, blending quick reactions with strategic planning.

meta.name: Rox 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.14 KB

Rox 64 is an arcade action game in which the player controls a spaceship and must dodge falling meteors. The play area is limited, requiring skillful maneuvering to avoid being hit. As the game progresses, the challenge increases with meteors appearing in unpredictable patterns and becoming more frequent. The goal is to survive as long as possible and achieve a high score.

meta.name: Roy of the Rovers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Roy of the Rovers blends narrative exploration with sports action, first placing you in the role of Roy Race searching for kidnapped teammates to rebuild the squad. You investigate locations, gather clues and try to rescue as many players as possible before the big match begins. The second phase focuses on the game itself, whose outcome depends heavily on your earlier success. This structure creates a unique experience where adventure and gameplay intertwine, making every rescued teammate matter.

meta.name: Rsvp
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Ruba E Fuggi
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Rubbish Monster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.23 KB

„Rubbish Monster“ puts the player in a maze where the goal is to eat all the dots while being chased by four enemies. They roam the corridors, trying to catch the player. Collecting special power pellets temporarily reverses the roles, allowing the player to hunt the enemies instead. Strategic movement and the smart use of tunnels help evade the pursuers or trap them.

meta.name: Rubicon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rubicon throws you into a radiation-scarred world after a nuclear disaster, where you fight your way through hostile areas to shut down reactors and contain the catastrophe. Along the journey you face mutated, unusually intelligent creatures that turn every section into a demanding survival challenge. The action is relentless, requiring constant reactions, precise aiming, and smart use of equipment, while special canisters let you gain new weapons if handled correctly. Occasional flight segments add variety and expand movement – an intense push through dangerous environments that rewards patience, practice, and persistence.

meta.name: Rubicon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rubicon throws you into a radiation-scarred world after a nuclear disaster, where you fight your way through hostile areas to shut down reactors and contain the catastrophe. Along the journey you face mutated, unusually intelligent creatures that turn every section into a demanding survival challenge. The action is relentless, requiring constant reactions, precise aiming, and smart use of equipment, while special canisters let you gain new weapons if handled correctly. Occasional flight segments add variety and expand movement – an intense push through dangerous environments that rewards patience, practice, and persistence.

meta.name: The Rubicon Alliance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 58.50 KB

In this intergalactic 3D action-flight-simulation your mission is to save the Rubicon, an constructed anti-matter zone that was made by the alliance of the eight planets of the Hyturian system. In 2746 after many centuries of war between the eight planets of the system, they decided to build up this anti-matter zone around the entire system as protection against each others. It worked fine for several decades - the peace remained unthreatened. But now the time has come that the Rubicon barrier has been breached, by the entry of a new planet and its hostile home race, the Space Thugs. Enter your Starfox fighter, save the whole system, and find out who breached the system.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.33 KB

p: Ruff and Reddy in the Space Adventure (Europe).T64
n: Ruff and Reddy in the Space Adventure (Europe)

meta.name: Ruff and Reddy in the Space Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.46 KB

Due to an accident involving Professor Flipnoodles' Pocket Rocket (would you trust a scientist called Flipnoodles? I certainly wouldn't, especially as mad scientists cause so many computer game plot disasters) the Hanna Barbera characters have been hurtled into space. The Lilli-Punies have kidnapped them, and will only let them free if they can rescue their missing compatriots.
The search starts on the surface of the planet, but also takes Ruff underground into the cavernous regions the Lilli-Punies live in. These have lots of water, which Ruff must avoid. Plenty of extra lives can be collected along the way, with solving puzzles as important as good reactions and dexterity.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Rugby : The World Cup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.79 KB

Rugby : The World Cup brings the championship tournament to life and makes a rarely represented sport accessible and fast-paced. The competition mirrors the real tournament structure with all participating teams, while the gameplay is streamlined to ensure smooth and direct action. Scrums occur frequently, penalties are removed, and continuous play takes priority. Each team features distinct strengths that clearly influence matches – creating a competitive experience focused on speed, awareness, and timing.

meta.name: Rugby Boss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.77 KB

Rugby Boss allows you to manage a team in the form of rugby popular in the North of England and take them from Division 2 and become champions of Division 1 as well as any cups. You have various options like buying and selling players, selecting your team and looking at the fixtures and League Table. Once you are happy with your selections it is on to the next game which is just represented by text. You see a timer counting upwards to 80 mins and the names of both teams playing. Text appears when any scoring incident occurs.

meta.name: Rugby Coach
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.37 KB

Rugby Coach puts you in charge of a Rugby League team, challenging you to rise from Division 2 to claim the championship and cup victories. At the start, you select one of 16 teams and manage your squad by buying, selling, and arranging players. Statistics, fixtures, and the league table keep you informed about the competition. Matches are presented in text form, with a small visual of the pitch showing scored points. As the timer runs from 0 to 80 minutes, you also see other match results update in real time. You have two substitutions available and can adjust tactics at any moment to influence the outcome.

meta.name: Rugby League Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.34 KB

In “Rugby League Manager,” you take charge of a rugby league team in northern England. From your office, you use a joystick to control a hand and select various options and actions to lead your team to success. Once your decisions are made, it's time for the next match. Games are presented from a top-down perspective, with a bar indicating the ball's position and a text box describing the actions. Time and score are always visible, and holding the fire button speeds up the gameplay.

meta.name: Run for Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.79 KB

Run For Gold is a single player athletics game in which the player trains two athletes for middle distance running, one for the 400m discipline and another for the 800m & 1500m disciplines.
The player must guide their runners to success in a series of local races before being allowed to race in four major championship finals, Crystal Palace, the European championship, the world championship and finally the Olympics. The game has forty runners who use individual, realistic race tactics against whom the player must compete.

meta.name: Run for the Money
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Run for the Money, dos jugadores controlan bizlings: comerciantes alienígenas que se han estrellado en el Planeta Simian y necesitan urgentemente pintura para reparar el escudo de su nave. Para comprar la pintura, primero deben ganar dinero produciendo plátanos sintéticos (synannas) a partir de la materia prima ruf y vendiéndoselos a los simios nativos. Los precios del ruf fluctúan, lo que requiere estrategia y asunción de riesgos. La publicidad ayuda a impulsar las ventas. Los gráficos semanales muestran el rendimiento del negocio y una máquina de predicciones ofrece información sobre las tendencias futuras. Los jugadores pujan por la pintura cuando aparece la furgoneta de pintura: cuanta más pintura se aplique al escudo, mayor será la probabilidad de un lanzamiento exitoso cada dos semanas.

meta.name: Run Like Hell
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.22 KB

"Run Like Hell" takes players on a thrilling adventure through a magnificent, enchanted forest that captivates with its beauty while being plagued by countless monstrous creatures. The gripping soundtrack intensifies the atmosphere as players face the daunting challenge of surviving in this perilous environment. Speed and determination are crucial to escaping the dangers that lie ahead.

meta.name: Run the Gauntlet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Run the Gauntlet está basado en el concurso británico homónimo y te reta en una serie de pruebas extremas en tierra y agua. Tanto si conduces buggies, motos acuáticas, botes neumáticos o quads, cada disciplina exige reflejos rápidos y control preciso. En el camino debes esquivar droides hostiles y peligros ambientales. La prueba estrella es La Colina, un circuito de obstáculos que se supera a pie. Hasta tres jugadores pueden turnarse, y la secuencia de retos se randomiza en cada partida —lo que, en versión de casete, puede provocar tiempos de carga frustrantes.

meta.name: Runaway
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Runaway puts you in the role of a prisoner captured by evil demons, and your only goal is to escape the deadly dungeons. Two monstrous guards relentlessly chase you, trying to block your path to the exit at the top of the screen. Only quick reflexes and perfect timing can save you from this nightmare.

meta.name: Runners
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.45 KB

In Runners your shift as a cop doesn't end after work – the real action starts on the way home. Criminals are speeding away after robbing homes and shops. You grab your pistol and try to stop them with precise shots before they get away. With vertical scrolling, a clear mission, and catchy music, every drive becomes a battle against crime.

meta.name: Running Balls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.76 KB

In Running Balls, two players face off: one controls the blinking ball and tries to escape, while the other gives chase. The longer the fleeing ball avoids capture, the more points it earns. Once caught, the roles switch. A simple yet thrilling duel that tests reflexes, timing, and skill – perfect for quick head-to-head matches.

meta.name: The Running Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres un ex policía sospechoso de asesinar a varios civiles. Un día te escapas de la cárcel y te diriges al aeropuerto para huir. Por desgracia, vuelves a ser capturado, pero no por la policía. Esta vez tu captor es el responsable de la serie de televisión Running Man.
El programa es el pasatiempo más popular del futuro, y la gente apuesta enormes sumas de dinero sobre su resultado. Te persiguen asesinos profesionales, y tienes que correr y mantenerte con vida para ganar dinero. A lo largo de cuatro niveles, deberás luchar contra los cazadores y llegar hasta el final si quieres volver a ser libre.

meta.name: Runway 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.50 KB

In Runway 64, you sit in the cockpit of an aircraft and must manage speed, altitude, and controls to fly and land safely. Instruments such as the altimeter, compass, radar, and airspeed indicator guide you. Various keys adjust speed, flaps, landing gear, and elevator controls. The goal is to follow recommended altitudes as accurately as possible, earning points while avoiding penalties for mistakes.

meta.name: Rupert and the Ice Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.03 KB

Rupert and the Ice Castle takes you into a frozen stronghold where Rupert's four friends are trapped in ice awaiting rescue. You guide him across slippery platforms, avoid enemies, and deal with treacherous surfaces that make every movement unpredictable. Each collision with a foe costs one of his precious Ice Pills – and once they are gone, the game is over. After every rescue, Rupert briefly returns to Nutswood Cottage, but the challenge intensifies: you must first collect scattered clothing items before freeing each friend, while additional enemies such as snowball-throwing snowmen raise the stakes. With every full rescue cycle, the pace and danger increase – a charming yet increasingly demanding winter adventure.

meta.name: Rupert and the Toymaker's Party
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.64 KB

El pobre Rupert se ha quedado solo mientras todos sus amigos se han ido a divertirse a la juguetería. Para unirse a ellos, tiene que recoger todas las invitaciones repartidas por las 32 pantallas que componen el castillo.

meta.name: Rush'n Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rush'n Attack in the United States (Green Beret) is an action video game developed and marketed by Konami in 1985 on arcade machines. The game was quite successful and was ported to various family systems. It had a sequel on arcade machines in 1989, MIA: Missing in Action.
In this action game, known to be very difficult due to its handling, the player embodies an American soldier armed with a knife whose mission is to rout an entire army in order to avoid a nuclear war across six horizontally scrolling levels (missile base, airport, port, forest, warehouse and enemy base).
The character can lie down, jump, climb a ladder, stab, use a bazooka or grenades. These secondary weapons are recovered when certain enemies are eliminated.

meta.name: Russia - The Great War in The East 1941-1945
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Russia: The Great War in the East 1941-1945 is a turn & hex-based wargame. The player takes the role of either German Oberkommando des Heeres or Soviet Stavka, conducting the full Eastern Front campaign of the Second World War (4 years lasting 47 turns) - three smaller scenarios are also available (portions of the main campaign focusing exclusively on either Army Group North, Centre or South).
The menu-driven interface is similar to earlier titles from the Battlefront Game System series, however it was modified for strategical level of command (army group/army), with corps-sized units moving under computer control, as you assign objectives (and stance) only to armies - particular corps may be later ordered to attack, defend, rest or retreat. The amount of ground and air support (in points) may be also assigned.

Russia: The Great War in the East 1941-1945 is a turn & hex-based wargame. The player takes the role of either German Oberkommando des Heeres or Soviet Stavka, conducting the full Eastern Front campaign of the Second World War (4 years lasting 47 turns) - three smaller scenarios are also available (portions of the main campaign focusing exclusively on either Army Group North, Centre or South).
The menu-driven interface is similar to earlier titles from the Battlefront Game System series, however it was modified for strategical level of command (army group/army), with corps-sized units moving under computer control, as you assign objectives (and stance) only to armies - particular corps may be later ordered to attack, defend, rest or retreat. The amount of ground and air support (in points) may be also assigned.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un ser maligno llamado Ligar está a punto de conquistar la tierra de Argool. Su poder es tal que ninguna criatura viva se atreve a enfrentarlo. Pero el legendario guerrero Rygar resurge de su tumba para restaurar la paz y la justicia. Armado con su mítica Diskarmor —un escudo con cadena—, recorre vastas tierras hacia la guarida del demonio, mientras sus secuaces intentan detenerlo en vano.
Originalmente arcade, Rygar es un juego de acción en scroll lateral. Controlas al héroe, que avanza por fases plagadas de criaturas hostiles. Además de la Diskarmor, usa otras armas, incluyendo proyectiles en cuatro direcciones. Por los niveles se dispersan «poderes»: aumentan el fuego del arma, añaden tiempo, dan invisibilidad temporal, puntos extra, etc.

meta.name: Sabotage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.06 KB

Sabotage casts you as a mercenary in a relentlessly upward-scrolling barrage, fending off waves of alien attackers. You maneuver across the screen, dodge incoming fire, and blast your way forward to reach the end-level guardian and land safely – yet the mission is far from over. On the ground, you explore a maze, hunt down a rebel holding crucial blueprint fragments, and prepare for the ultimate confrontation with the elusive Mothercraft. Temporary invincibility or a rapid forward boost offer tactical advantages – but every hit costs a life and forces you to replay the section – an intense blend of constant firepower and strategic searching that becomes even more gripping in alternating two-player action.

meta.name: Saboteur
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.52 KB

Eres un mercenario altamente entrenado en las artes marciales. Te emplean para infiltrarte en un edificio central de seguridad que está camuflado como almacén. Debes robar un disco que contiene los nombres de todos los líderes rebeldes, antes de que la información sea enviada a todas las estaciones remotas. Trabajas contra reloj, tanto en robar el disco como en escapar. Debes entrar en el edificio por el mar en bote de goma; luego sólo podrás salir por medio del helicóptero que encontrarás en el tejado. Tendrás que encontrar tu camino por el almacén, usando las propias municiones de los guardas en tu lucha.

meta.name: Saboteur

Eres un mercenario altamente entrenado en las artes marciales. Te emplean para infiltrarte en un edificio central de seguridad que está camuflado como almacén. Debes robar un disco que contiene los nombres de todos los líderes rebeldes, antes de que la información sea enviada a todas las estaciones remotas. Trabajas contra reloj, tanto en robar el disco como en escapar. Debes entrar en el edificio por el mar en bote de goma; luego sólo podrás salir por medio del helicóptero que encontrarás en el tejado. Tendrás que encontrar tu camino por el almacén, usando las propias municiones de los guardas en tu lucha.

meta.name: Saboteur II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.51 KB

El héroe ninja del Saboteur original ha sido asesinado, y su hermana Nina está decidida a vengar esta injusticia. Cuenta con una amplia gama de movimientos de kung-fu y debe ponerlos en práctica a lo largo de 700 pantallas de acción. El diseño del juego es muy similar al original, incluyendo el inusual estilo gráfico del fondo. Las secciones del juego se dividen en varios niveles, separados principalmente por escaleras, y con multitud de armas y municiones para recoger. Para superar el juego, tendrás que recolectar cintas y un código informático de 14 partes.

meta.name: Sabre Wulf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Asumes el papel de un intrépido explorador que debe encontrar las 4 piezas de un amuleto mágico en las profundidades de una jungla tropical. Te enfrentas a animales salvajes a los que puedes disparar. También tienes que resolver una serie de puzles que te obligan a manipular objetos descubiertos durante tus exploraciones.

meta.name: Safe-Cracker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.12 KB

In this game you are a secret service spy and have to recover documents stolen by foreign agents. The secret documents are in a safe that you have to crack. They have an advanced tool to do this. You will hear a click when you either have the number directly or this has just happened in the combination.

meta.name: Sailing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.32 KB

In sailing, the player takes part in a sailing league with the goal of reaching the top.
The same basic process applies to every event:
The player challenges another boat, up to two places higher in the league standings, to a race and various changes must be made to their own ship based on the opposing ship and the weather forecast. Before starting a new league, the player chooses a skill level, which determines the starting position in the rankings and thus the difficulty level of the next opponents.
The races themselves take place from a first-person perspective and involve following a course while going faster than the other ship. The information obtained from the display at the bottom of the screen - wind strength, wind direction, boat speed and a minimap - should be used to determine the best course of action.

meta.name: Saint & Greavsie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Saint and Greavsie is a sports quiz game in which one to four players have to answer sports-related questions. Players begin by throwing a ball through a series of stadiums. There is a green bar to the left of these stages. The higher the green bar, the greater the distance the ball travels. Depending on where the ball lands, the player must answer three types of questions from one of four question packs.
* Home questions (worth one point)
* Away questions (worth two points)
* Derby questions (worth three points)
Players can choose to answer the question or pass it to the next player. If the player answers a question correctly, a penalty shootout occurs, in which the player scores a goal to score bonus points.

meta.name: Saint Dragon / St Dragon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los monstruos cyborg se han apoderado de la galaxia, reduciendo raza tras raza a la esclavitud. Al ser diseñados por el hombre, estos seres tienen una potencia de fuego y capacidades de ataque superiores, y solo pueden ser derrotados por uno de los suyos. St. Dragon, el guerrero cyborg, elige luchar contra esta tiranía, y ese es el papel que desempeñas en este juego de disparos de desplazamiento horizontal.
Te esperan cinco niveles estilo R-Type, con una amplia variedad de armas en oferta. Cuando pierdes una vida (incluso tu última vida; también se ofrecen continuaciones) no pierdes nada de tu armamento potenciador, pero los puntos de reinicio están bastante separados. La principal característica única del juego es la cola blindada que tienes, que puede usarse para protegerte de los atacantes y puede causar un daño considerable por sí sola si se usa bien.

meta.name: Saliva Kid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Fast-paced platforming action with the German fairy tale of Hansel and Gretel. In a distant land, two children got lost while playing and now wandered around helplessly. The player now has the task of finding the two lost friends. The journey leads through 32 levels. Hot desert sand, rain, snow and ocean depths must be overcome to bring the two poor children back to their world. To top it off, they have to compete against robots in a futuristic techno world.

meta.name: Salvage 3 - The Master
meta.desc:

In 1899 the good steamship Victoria was lost at sea. At first it seemed like nothing more than a tragic accident due to the harsh weather. But was it!?! Use your detective skills in an exciting search for a centuries-old spy. Discover the traitor, find the gold... become a salvager!

meta.name: Sam - Der Schatzsucher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Sam: Der Schatzsucher" (translates to Sam: The Treasure Hunter)is a classic platformer where the player controls Sam through a vertically scrolling world to collect treasures. The gameplay revolves around navigating Sam through different levels filled with obstacles and enemies. The goal is to collect all the treasures while Sam must either avoid or confront dangerous foes.

meta.name: Sam's Jam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.75 KB

Sam's Jam throws you into a bizarre jam factory where Sam must eat falling drops of jam and strawberries – but not too much, or he'll explode at over 16 stone. As he snacks, he gains weight, which can be reduced in the sauna on the right. Missed food feeds a rat below, and once it's full, it appears on Sam's floor – avoid it or squash it with the lift. When the vat is empty, head to the sauna to clear the level. Later stages introduce hazards like bouncing enemies, acid rain, and barrels. Touching any of them – or overindulging – costs a life. Three lives. One jam-fueled madness.

meta.name: Samantha Fox Strip Poker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.90 KB

Samantha Fox Strip Poker lets you play either 5-card or 7-card stud poker, depending on the system, against UK pop star and glamour model Samantha Fox. The better you play, the less she wears – it's classic strip poker with a celebrity twist. Standard poker rules apply, and winning hands gradually unlock increasingly revealing digitized images. A nostalgic slice of 80s softcore wrapped in a simple poker game, aimed squarely at fans of pixelated provocation.

meta.name: Samber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Samber is a platform game similar to Lode Runner. It involves players collecting a number of items in the level, while avoiding several enemies that run around. Holes can be dug through the ground and are there for the enemies to fall through to the platform below. Once all the required items have been collected, the player proceeds to the next level. In later levels, there are colored-coded doors that can be opened by using the appropriate keys. Lives are lost when the player makes contact with an enemy or falls down holes. The game features 30 levels.

meta.name: Sammy Lightfoot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Go through three levels jumping over obstacles that get in your way. Use trampolines and swings to get to hard-to-reach places and avoid hazards or falling down gaps. Get to the top of the screen in order to proceed to the next level. Once three levels are completed, the game restarts with increased difficulty. Before you start the game, you can access the options screen which lets you customize the screen to include another player, turn off the sound or the scene music, or let either player start at any particular level.

meta.name: Samson And Delilah
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.26 KB

A simple and awkwardly presented single screen platformer with many options of play. In the book of Judges from the Old Testament is the story of Samson. The story takes place at a time when the people of Israel were enslaved by the Philistines. You know the story, he had great strength as long as he kept his long hair, but when Delilah cut it, he could be captured and blinded. So make your way to the pillars, you must avoid the guards, Delilah's shears, past any lions and to the arches to beat the level.

meta.name: Samurai Trilogy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Samurai Trilogy” lets you choose between three fighting styles – karate, kendo, and samurai – and challenges you with six opponents in each discipline, all with unique strengths and backgrounds. Before each duel, you select training methods such as meditation, strength training, or breath control, and assign points to attributes like skill, speed, stamina, and strength for both attack and defense. In battle, you can use 16 different moves and tactics to outsmart your opponent. A match ends when either the attack or defense bar of a fighter is depleted. A training mode is also available.

meta.name: Samurai Warrior : The Battles of Usagi Yojimbo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Samurai Warrior: The Battles of Usagi Yojimbo” takes place in 17th-century Japan – a land torn by civil war, where powerful warlords battle for control of the Shogunate and the nation itself. At the heart of the conflict stands Usagi Yojimbo, a lone Ronin Rabbit of remarkable endurance and swordsmanship, who must resist the forces of darkness. This is a tale of combat, subtlety, and honor – where following the way of Bushido and showing proper manners may preserve your karma and win allies, while rash behavior could turn friends into fierce enemies. You'll face cunning bandits, deadly ninjas, and unexpected attacks as you journey through exquisitely detailed landscapes and encounter a wide range of colorful characters.
