meta.name: Santa Claus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.54 KB

In Santa Claus, you control Santa on his sleigh, flying through a snowy night and trying to deliver as many candy canes as possible to the homes of good children. Use the fire button to drop them accurately, but beware: crashing into trees, flags, or flying objects costs time. The more accurate your drops, the higher your score – but too many misses will change the screen border and end the game. A simple, charming Christmas-themed game with a festive feel.

meta.name: Santa Paravia And Fiumaccio
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Probably one of Keypunch's best releases, Santa Paravia and Fumaccio is a fun empire management game with a strong emphasis on economics. Up to 6 players compete against each other in a bid to become the best ruler of a fictional Renaissance country. Gameplay is turn-based, with a very strong boardgame flavor. Each player takes turns issuing commands in different phases, deciding on policies ranging from economic, military and civil. Lack of dynamic screens may make the game too ?dry? for most gamers, but anyone who likes a thoughtful, statistics-based business game will probably find it interesting.
Lack of save game feature makes the game ideal as a quick multiplayer business game a la Monopoly that anyone who is interested in medieval business will enjoy, if he/she can get friends to join a game. Those who are looking for a more authentic Renaissance experience would do well to skip this one.

meta.name: Santa's Xmas Caper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.42 KB

Se trata de un juego de disparos de desplazamiento lateral con temática navideña. Papá Noel intenta completar su viaje anual de entrega de regalos mientras lucha contra elfos renegados. Mientras Papá Noel y Rudolph atraviesan paisajes estacionales, los elfos atacan con regalos y bombas. Santa puede contraatacar lanzándoles regalos. El juego se divide en tres secciones principales: Laponia, el Océano Atlántico y la entrega actual.

meta.name: Santa's Grotty Christmas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.82 KB

"Santa's Grotty Christmas" tells the story of a completely chaotic Christmas. Rudolph's nose has turned black, the goblins have become cannibals and eaten the elves, while the fairies have moved on to other duties. Now it's up to Santa to navigate his ill-prepared sleigh safely over the rooftops of the world. He must battle dark forces and avoid numerous dangers to deliver the Christmas presents before his supply of fairy dust runs out.

meta.name: Sanxion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 61.10 KB

Sanxion te pone al control de un avión futurista, luchando a través de interminables oleadas de enemigos coloridos. El juego se destaca por su vista dividida: una perspectiva panorámica a vista de pájaro en la parte superior y el campo de batalla principal debajo. La velocidad de desplazamiento está determinada por la posición de tu avión: más lento cerca del borde izquierdo, más rápido hacia el centro. No hay jefes finales ni potenciadores, pero después de cada etapa entras en rondas de bonificación donde el desafío es disparar, recolectar o esquivar objetos en una carrera contra el tiempo.

meta.name: Saracen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Saracen blends action and puzzles as you guide a crusader through trap-filled mazes to detonate a bomb beside a motionless Saracen chieftain. Along the way, you must avoid patrolling guards, ricocheting cannonballs, and deadly hazards. Armed with a bow, you can collect directional arrows to stop enemies or destroy walls – but you can only carry one item at a time. Each of the 100 levels has a unique solution that requires clever use of limited tools and flawless execution.

meta.name: Sarada Doja
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.05 KB

Sarada Doja is a classic arcade-style game where your task is to make your way through a multi-level building. You climb ladders and move across platforms while dodging hazards and avoiding enemies. The goal is to survive by evading projectiles, steering clear of dangers, and finding the right path through each floor. Quick reflexes and good timing are key to lasting in this fast-paced challenge.

meta.name: Sarakon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A simple variation of the classic game of Mahjongg (also known as Shanghai). Each of the 40 levels consist of rows and piles of tiles, patterned with symbols such as butterflies and masks. Pair them up within the time limit to move on a level. The difficulty is that a tile can only be moved if it has no tile on top of it, and a gap either to the left or right (or both). Careful planning ahead is required if all tiles are to be cleared.

meta.name: SAS 2064
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.76 KB

meta.name: SAS Combat Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"SAS Combat Simulator" has you fighting through enemy territory with your machine gun and a limited supply of grenades while facing a relentless stream of foes. The levels feature platforms and ladders, and you must constantly fend off incoming waves. Bonus items, represented by the Codemasters logo, grant advantages such as vehicles for added protection, smart bombs, or rapid fire to help you survive the onslaught.

meta.name: Satan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 103.90 KB

Debes encontrar tres pergaminos mágicos en la primera parte del juego de hack 'n' slash de desplazamiento, antes de que puedas hacer el viaje para derrotar a tus enemigos y rescatar a los otros magos en la segunda parte.
El contacto con los enemigos en el camino agota tu energía limitada, y también estás trabajando contra un límite de tiempo en cada sección. Además de tus poderes mágicos puedes recolectar espadas para atacar, así como rayos que se pueden recolectar para destruir a todos los enemigos en la pantalla. En la segunda parte, los enemigos vencidos liberan monedas, que se pueden gastar en las secciones de la tienda en recargadores, escudos y teletransportadores, entre otras cosas.

meta.name: Satans Hollow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Satans Hollow throws you into a hellish aerial battle against waves of gargoyles. Your goal is to collect bridge pieces to build a path over a river of lava and ultimately face Satan himself. Each victory leads to a longer bridge and tougher enemies as darkness descends. Gargoyles hurl explosive eggs and rocks, floating devil heads spit fire, and you must survive using rockets and a limited shield. Every round grows more intense as you push deeper into Satan's domain.

meta.name: Saturn's 10 Moons
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.38 KB

"Saturn's 10 Moons" begins with a crash landing on one of Saturn's remote moons, after your spaceship runs out of energy. Luckily, you've landed near a deserted mining base – possibly the only place where you can find the dilithium crystals needed to restart your ship. In this text-based sci-fi adventure, you explore metallic tunnels, solve puzzles and make choices that determine your survival.

meta.name: Saturnlander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Saturnlander” is an arcade-style lander game where the player navigates through 24 phases. Despite being programmed in BASIC, the game features solid controls and rewards players with an end sequence upon successfully completing all levels.

meta.name: Saucer Attack!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.20 KB

Saucer Attack! places you as the last line of defense between an alien invasion and the landmarks of Washington D.C. From a first-person view, you control an energy turret and must shoot down flying saucers before they destroy monuments or land. If you score 150 points before the aliens reach 50, you'll face a final showdown in space against the Mothership. To win, hit its Command Module while wearing down its shields. Time progresses from day to night – but your mission remains the same: save what's left of Earth.

meta.name: Savage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Savage contiene tres partes diferentes, cada una con su propio estilo.
Juegas como Savage, un guerrero musculoso que ha sido encarcelado en un castillo. Cuando se libera, descubre que su encarcelamiento era una treta para encarcelar a su amada. Debes avanzar por las 3 partes del juego para salvarla.
El primero es un simple shooter de desplazamiento lateral, en el que disparas a tus enemigos para recoger los tesoros y las armas mejoradas que sueltan al morir. El segundo es un juego de disparos en primera persona en 3D que se parece a Space Harrier, con calaveras que derribar y monolitos que evitar. En la tercera sección, juegas como la forma de águila de Savage, volando a través de los niveles de estilo plataforma evitando los peligros de tiempo y disparando a cualquiera en tu camino. En esta sección puedes disparar burbujas para liberar potenciadores.

meta.name: Adventure #10 - Savage Island Part One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Savage Island es el único juego de varias partes de la serie de aventuras de Scott Adams, todas ellas con un parser y una interfaz muy similares. Al final de este juego, los jugadores reciben una contraseña que les permite jugar la segunda parte. Los juegos de Savage Island son también probablemente las aventuras más difíciles de la serie.
El jugador comienza atrapado en una pequeña isla en el océano, que se enfrenta a un huracán y también tiene un volcán activo. El jugador puede cruzar un río y también tendrá que explorar una red de cuevas. Los objetos se suelen encontrar recorriendo la arena con las manos.
La isla guarda un gran secreto, que sólo se descubrirá cuando se terminen las dos partes del juego.

meta.name: Savage Island Part 1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.02 KB

Savage Island es el único juego de varias partes de la serie de aventuras de Scott Adams, todas ellas con un parser y una interfaz muy similares. Al final de este juego, los jugadores reciben una contraseña que les permite jugar la segunda parte. Los juegos de Savage Island son también probablemente las aventuras más difíciles de la serie.
El jugador comienza atrapado en una pequeña isla en el océano, que se enfrenta a un huracán y también tiene un volcán activo. El jugador puede cruzar un río y también tendrá que explorar una red de cuevas. Los objetos se suelen encontrar recorriendo la arena con las manos.
La isla guarda un gran secreto, que sólo se descubrirá cuando se terminen las dos partes del juego.

meta.name: Savage Island Part 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.04 KB

La segunda mitad de Savage Island continúa exactamente donde termina el otro juego. Incluye una misteriosa hoja de código que podrás descifrar al completar el juego y que revelará el secreto definitivo de la isla.

meta.name: Savage Pond
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Savage Pond you begin as a small tadpole in a pond and try to build a thriving frog colony by feeding and surviving. As you swim through the water you eat amoebas and worms that occasionally fall into the pond, increasing your score. After eating enough worms, a beetle larva appears, which must be caught before the counter resets. Successfully doing so allows the game to progress further. With each step you gradually develop and move closer to establishing a successful frog population in the pond.

meta.name: Save Me, Brave Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.07 KB

"Save Me, Brave Knight" is a collection of pseudo-3D arcade minigames set in a medieval fantasy world. The player controls an armored knight on horseback, armed with javelins, whose goal is to save a maiden from the clutches of a seven-headed dragon. The game consists of four levels: First, the knight must open a lock by hitting it three times with the spear. In the castle courtyard, he fends off flying creatures such as witches and large birds. Then he fights the dragon by destroying its heads and dodging its fiery breath. In the last level, the knight must choose between two doors, one of which hides the maiden.

meta.name: Save New York
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.72 KB

"Save New York" is a shooter where the action takes place on one screen only; but there are lots of things going on on that screen. You see blue sky over skyscrapers and subway tunnels beneath. New York is under attack, and you are a pilot in a little blue airplane who must save it from destruction caused by aliens. At the beginning of each stage, the aliens begin to drop from the sky. Your goal is to cruise around in your plane and to shoot them, preferably before they descend on a building, because then they will begin to crush it until it is destroyed completely.

meta.name: Save Your Teeth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.75 KB

Save Your Teeth puts you in control of a small spacecraft flying freely through the playfield as sweets appear from different directions and must be shot to protect your teeth. You manoeuvre around hazards, keep your distance, and react quickly to new targets before they cause damage. As the speed increases, the action becomes more hectic, with multiple treats appearing at once and demanding precise aim. Beneath the playful idea lies an action-focused reflex challenge that rewards awareness, timing, and steady control of your craft.

meta.name: Say Simon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Say Simon," you play a C64 version of the classic memory game "Simon Says." Your task is to replicate the sequence of sounds and colors presented by Simon correctly. With each round, the pattern becomes longer and more challenging, demanding increasing focus and a sharp memory. A fun and engaging game for anyone looking to test their recall skills!

meta.name: Sblock - Sliding-Block Puzzles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sliding Block Puzzles is a series of sliding block games for multiple systems. The player chooses the difficulty level (ie. the number of columns and rows), as well as the image they wish to solving using a sliding block puzzle. There are 4 puzzle images.

meta.name: Scallop Scoot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scallop Scoot puts you in control of a small scallop navigating a lively underwater world focused on feeding, growth and survival. You collect algae and worms to become stronger while constantly avoiding hungry predators. Careful movement and timely retreats into protective shells are key to staying safe and progressing through the hazardous environment.

meta.name: Scanner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.09 KB

Scanner is a Skramble-style horizontal shooter where you pilot a Ftaumschrle (whatever that is) through treacherous terrain to reach your base. Missile launchers, mines, and narrow courtyards make every second of flight a test of reflexes and precision. The game scales difficulty with your performance, ensuring rising tension. A continue function lets you resume from your last position – if you've earned it. How far can you make it?

meta.name: Scapeghost
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scapeghost blends crime, the supernatural, and a dark atmosphere into an unusual adventure in which you return from the afterlife as murdered police officer Alan Chance to uncover the truth behind your death. Instead of relying on physical strength, you use ghostly powers, listen in on conversations, gather clues, and work with the help of other dead souls to gradually uncover an ever deeper web of guilt and secrets. Its greatest strength is the eerie mood, which is intensified by the division into multiple parts and gives the whole experience the feeling of a grim supernatural investigation.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.74 KB

meta.name: Tread Bear
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.55 KB

Fred Bear has decided to have a cheese sandwich for his supper. Eating it has made Fred tired, so he falls asleep. He starts dreaming that he is driving through Toyland, which is occupied by fluffy snakes, wooden ducks, space men, toy trucks, and several other inhabitants. Unfortunately, touching any of these toys poses a danger to Fred as doing so causes damage to his car, and if the car inflicts enough damage, it breaks down and Fred is sent to heaven. Fortunately, Fred is equipped with a nuclear honey pot and some balls of honey, which can be thrown at the toys to put them out of commission.

meta.name: Scare City Motel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.71 KB

You are the owner and manager of Scare City Motel. You have to get as much money as possible while at the same time fill all the rooms. After 10 days it is shown how much money you got. A simple illustration of supply and demand, and of course the "best price" changes each time you play.

meta.name: Scarper!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.80 KB

Scarper! puts you in charge of an unusual rescue mission on the planet Tubark: ten escaped programmers have to survive the long walk to the rescue ship. As they march across the landscape, you fly above them and protect the group from attacking Crudilites. Constant fire is risky, though, because excessive shooting also drains your energy, which only recovers when you hold back. This creates a tense escort mission that cleverly combines attack, restraint, and the protection of a vulnerable group.

meta.name: Scary Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.40 KB

Scary Adventure takes you on a dangerous journey through a mysterious world. Your goal is to recover 20 treasures, each marked with a *, and return them to their proper place. The game uses a simple text interface with directional commands like “north,” “east,” or “west,” letting you uncover the eerie world one step at a time. Every move could bring you closer to victory – or to doom.

meta.name: Scary Monsters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.44 KB

The former football star and adventurer Harry Johns is on Dr. Graves' Island stranded. Graves is a psychotic surgeon who has discovered an obsession with monsters. He has transformed the island's inhabitants into ghosts, mummies, werewolves and witches. Additionally, there are six sleeping monsters in the buildings they roam, including a witch, a mummy, a werewolf, Frankenstein, Dracula, and a Hunchback. These monsters must be destroyed, and to complete the task, Harry must find the correct weapon, which is stored in one of the six buildings.

meta.name: Scenario
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scenario is a fairly simple and simplistic strategy game for one to four players, playing in a fictional World War I scenario. Your aim: conquer Europe. The game requires a mouse, but doesn't work with all mouse drivers (probably only with the Microsoft standard one). Quite a blatant disregard to historical accuracy even in this alternate history premise, and quite boring to boot. Proof that Starbyte should stick to their (more or less average) line of management games rather than anything else.

meta.name: Sceptre of Baghdad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The first day of the year and people had begun to gather in the palace courtyard. At noon, the beloved Caliph must display the sacred scepter to prove his right to rule over the land of Baghdad.
However, a few hours earlier:
The Caliph woke up and felt very strange. Everything around him seemed to have gotten bigger. Nervously, he ran through the palace to the room where he kept his magic lamp. He climbed onto the table and polished the lamp until a ghost appeared. “How can I help you, O Master”?
“Why am I so small? What happened to my palace? What does all this mean?” asked the Caliph.
After an oppressive silence the spirit spoke:
“It seems that an evil sorcerer from a land beyond the great sea has summoned your palace full of monsters and obstacles to prevent you from displaying the scepter at noon. He intends to strip you of all your power in order to become caliph himself.”

meta.name: Schatzsucher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.70 KB

"Schatzsucher" (Treasure Hunter) is an exciting skill-based game where you control your character, based on Indiana Jones, through a house to collect bags of gold. Unfortunately, you don't have unlimited time to do so. Additionally, you're being chased by a ghost, whose evasion is not always easy and sometimes even impossible. In five different levels and with four game speeds, you must face this challenge. And all of this in a 20-line program!

meta.name: Rock Paper Shear
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Rock Paper Shear combines Tetris mechanics with the rules of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Stones, papers, and scissors fall from the top of the screen, and you must place them so that they beat each other—scissors on paper, paper on rock, rock on scissors. Matching pairs disappear, clearing the playfield. As the speed increases with each level, quick thinking and clever stacking become key to survival.

meta.name: School Bus Driver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.16 KB

In School Bus Driver you take control of the classic yellow Fisher-Price school bus. Your job is to safely drive the Little People children through the countryside, picking them up and dropping them off at school. The game teaches coordination, observation, and sound judgment as you navigate various roads and environments. Watch the traffic, stop carefully, and drive responsibly — the safety of your passengers depends on you!

meta.name: Chase HQ II : Special Criminal Investigation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Chase H.Q. II tiene la misma combinación de acción y carreras que la primera parte. Debes encontrar y detener los coches de cinco matones. El perfil de los sospechosos se define antes de cada misión y tu tarea es encontrarlos entre el tráfico. Para detenerlos hay que golpear sus vehículos de tal forma que pierdan el control, respetando el tiempo límite.

meta.name: Scooby-Doo and Scrappy-Doo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Este juego de plataformas licenciado te pone en la piel de Scrappy Doo, que debe atravesar cuatro niveles para rescatar a Scooby y Shaggy. Como su nombre indica, Scrappy destaca por usar los puños para derrotar a sus enemigos. El castillo y su acceso están llenos de escaleras, plataformas y huecos que exigen precisión. A lo largo del recorrido hay vidas extra (mediante Scooby Snacks), periodos de invencibilidad y puntos adicionales (hamburguesas), muchos de ellos en zonas peligrosas que requieren un timing exacto y asumir riesgos considerables para alcanzarlos.

meta.name: Scooby-Doo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los amigos de Scooby —Shaggy, Fred, Daphne y Velma— han sido secuestrados en un inmenso castillo propiedad de un genio malvado. Scooby debe recorrerlo para rescatarlos en este beat 'em up con plataformas y escaleras. Los enemigos incluyen fantasmas que salen de puertas, murciélagos (que hay que esquivar agachándose), calaveras (para saltar), resortes y los temibles Ghoulfish. Scooby dispone de varios ataques, aunque debe estar quieto para ejecutarlos. Empiezas con seis vidas; obtienes más al recoger Scooby Snacks o completar cada uno de los cuatro niveles.

meta.name: Scooby-Doo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scooby-Doo was conceived as part of a larger Hanna-Barbera game series, offering a charming 3D-style arcade adventure featuring Scooby and his gang. With detailed cartoon visuals, light action sequences, and kid-friendly gameplay, it stood out as one of the most polished Scooby titles for the C64. However, a licensing fallout ended the partnership abruptly: after MicroIllusions released The Jetsons without proper approval, Hanna-Barbera revoked all rights, halting the series. Most of the games, though nearly complete, never saw release – leaving Scooby-Doo as a rare and impressive remnant of an ambitious but ill-fated project.

meta.name: The Scoop!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.06 KB

In The Scoop! you play a reporter for a struggling local newspaper, trying to uncover the big story that will make your name and solve your financial troubles. You start your day at home, follow your morning routine, and head to work, where your boss assigns you different cases to investigate in search of that elusive scoop. The game is a classic text adventure – you read on-screen descriptions of each location and type commands to explore, interact with objects, and follow leads to the next scene.

meta.name: Scorpio
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.65 KB

Scorpio has you push through five demanding stages, blasting upward through enemy waves while constantly watching for both foes and hazardous terrain. Wiping out full formations leaves behind capsules that provide meaningful upgrades like stronger weapons or a satellite, but losing a life sends you back to replay the entire stage. Extra ships are earned through scoring, rapid fire is available by default, and four difficulty levels set the pressure – the farther you get, the more timing, positioning, and risky power-up grabs decide whether you survive.

meta.name: Scorpion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.79 KB

Scorpion places you in a simulated test scenario where a new combat machine navigates a complex network of pipelines. Movement is restricted to the pipes themselves, requiring you to collect planted bombs and eliminate all bomb layers to clear a level. Moving obstacles follow repeating patterns, forcing careful planning at every junction. Precise timing is essential, as wrong turns are hard to recover from – the mix of strict movement rules, increasing complexity, and smooth scrolling creates a consistently challenging experience.

meta.name: Scorpius
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scorpius sends you and a partner into the deadly depths of planet LRV 1168, where toxic gases are leaking from underwater tunnels. Equipped with aquaglyders, you investigate the source – but danger lurks below. A monstrous creature that rules the tunnels has unleashed its minions to destroy you. Only skill, firepower, and teamwork will help you survive and uncover the mystery behind the toxic emissions.

meta.name: Scortia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.51 KB

Scortia is an arcade game, a clone of Arkanoid. The gameplay features all the classic elements. The task requires clearing the play field of the blocks by hitting a ball with the paddle positioned at the bottom of the screen. Certain blocks release bonuses or unsafe surprises. Shiny bricks can't be removed from the board, causing the ball to rebound in various directions.
The game features 25 levels.

meta.name: Scottish League Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.94 KB

"The Scottish League Football Game," released in 1993, is a detailed football management game focused on the Scottish league. Players take on the role of a manager, guiding their team through competitions like the Scottish Cup while managing over 500 players across different teams. The game offers several management features such as coaching, training, injury treatment, salary management, and monitoring player retirements.

meta.name: Scout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scout is a side-scrolling shoot-em-up featuring a bouncing buggy-like vehicle that battles aliens across eight levels. With your spaceship scattered in pieces across eight planets, you pilot your scout capsule to find the pieces and return home. Between you and the rubble are a variety of nasty aliens. To survive, you have to shoot the aliens, collect the pieces, and then make your way home.

meta.name: Computer Scrabble De Luxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 58.04 KB

Computer Scrabble De Luxe brings the classic board game to the screen, faithfully following the official Scrabble rules. You can challenge the computer and choose from eight difficulty levels to test your word skills at any level.

meta.name: ZZZ(notgame):Scrambit Mania
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Scramble 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.14 KB

Scramble 64 puts you in control of a plane navigating hostile terrain as you battle through mountain ranges, dodging and destroying missiles, tanks, UFOs, and other defenses on your mission to reach and destroy the enemy base. Apart from the updated graphics, the main difference is that bombs now fall horizontally. Keep an eye on your fuel – only by bombing fuel depots can you continue your flight.

meta.name: Scramble Spirits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.57 KB

La interpretación de Sega sobre el estilo de 1943 de shoot'em ups de desplazamiento vertical se estableció en el futuro. Tu avión de combate está envejecido y con poca potencia, pero debes enfrentarte a grandes aviones, tanques y objetivos terrestres para alcanzar la victoria. Cada nivel termina con una sección de intensidad particular vista de cerca antes de enfrentar finalmente a un jefe. De vez en cuando se encuentran bombas inteligentes por ahí, y pueden destruir todo en la pantalla, aunque no puedes usarlas en los jefes. Se proporciona un modo simultáneo para 2 jugadores.

meta.name: The Scroll of Akbar Khan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Scroll of Akbar Khan takes you to a mysterious desert city in search of a legendary scroll said to grant eternal life. As an adventurer standing before the gates of Akbar Khan, you'll explore streets, buildings, and hidden chambers to uncover clues and solve puzzles. The game blends text input with small illustrative graphics showing your surroundings, rewarding careful observation and clever thinking. Each move brings you closer to the ancient secret – or to your doom in the burning sands.

meta.name: The Scrolls of Abadon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.34 KB

For his own amusement, a Wizard has constructed a strange game inside his head. It takes place on a grid loaded with pieces of an Amulate, all of which must be collected. When you collect one, an arrow appears preventing you from moving back in that direction; failure to obey the Wizard sees him release a beast, which must be avoided.
You are the player in this forced 3D world. As well as Amulate pieces, there are also scrolls to collect - these produce spells which can be activated by typing the name. Spells include freezing the enemies, a level skip and a smart bomb. Other than the bomb, each one lasts for 20 seconds. 
Power Disks are activated once a screen is clear, and take you to the next one. Other hazardous creatures to avoid include the Kitz and the Nim, who kill you on contact.

meta.name: A Question of Scruples
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A Question of Scruples turns moral dilemmas into the heart of a social game of bluffing and judgment. You present other players with tricky yes-or-no questions and try to predict how they would respond according to their personality. If expectation and answer match, you move closer to your goal – when they do not, the group decides whether the response was believable. This creates an unusual party game driven by reading people, lively discussion, and the question of how well you truly know your fellow players.

meta.name: Scuba Dive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scuba Dive puts you in the role of a fearless pearl diver descending into the depths of the ocean, where sharks, jellyfish, squid, and other deadly creatures await. You patiently wait for clams to open before swooping in to grab their precious pearls, diving ever deeper to find larger treasures. Hidden cave systems hold ancient riches, but your oxygen supply is limited and massive tentacles guard these forbidden areas. Once you have gathered as much as you can, you must return safely to the surface, reach your boat, unload your loot, and strap on a fresh tank before diving again – an exciting underwater adventure balancing risk and reward.

meta.name: Scuba Kidz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.34 KB

You take on the role of a diver and must navigate underwater caves in search of your kidnapped friends. As they explore these caves, their air supply runs out, forcing them to rise to the surface to replenish air. By finding an air tank, players can stay underwater longer. When you run out of air, the game is over.
Useful items can be found on the seabed. These items include keys that unlock passageways; Bubble Power, which allows players to trap creatures in bursting bubbles; additional speed; and monster suit that scares away the creatures. Some passages are blocked by walls and players must use their bubble power to destroy the wall.
Between the caves, players must destroy a shark. When the shark is destroyed, players move on to the next cave.

meta.name: Scud-Busters
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.34 KB

meta.name: Scumball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.10 KB

Scumball sends you into the city's infested sewer system with LINDA, a maintenance droid tasked with clearing out deadly creatures. Her laser can eliminate smaller monsters, but some enemies kill instantly while others drain her power, which must be restored by collecting scattered batteries. Additional hazards such as water, spike pits, and strange pods are immediately lethal. Deep below, a giant slime monster awaits, requiring eight grenades hidden throughout the sewers – and LINDA can carry only one at a time. With multiple lives, bonus items, and a detailed end report, the game delivers an intense underground action challenge that demands reflexes, planning, and resource management.

meta.name: Scumm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Scumm challenges you to merge matching tiles so they disappear from the board. With each move, you shift elements into position, bringing identical symbols together to clear space and create new opportunities. As pressure builds, only careful planning and smart combinations will keep the board under control and earn you high scores – a classic puzzle experience that rewards logic and foresight.

meta.name: Scuttle
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.74 KB

meta.name: SDI : Strategic Defense Initiative
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.32 KB

SDI: Strategic Defense Initiative is a classic-style shoot-'em-up where you control a satellite tasked with intercepting waves of bombs targeting the USA. Movement and aiming are handled independently – allowing for precise firing and evasive control. Defensive phases require you to stop incoming threats, Missile Command-style. Offensive stages are free-flight shoot-'em-up sequences where you destroy dangers before they activate, while trying to preserve destructible (but valuable) platforms.

meta.name: Se-Kaa of Assiah
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This is a story of good versus evil. The Wise Women maintained order and peace for many years until the Dark Hordes came. These evil creatures had one goal: to wreak havoc wherever they went. They stole the Sage's three artifacts of power, the Staff of Light, the Hammer, and Vib-Ra's Box. Deprived of their powers, the Wise Women could no longer keep the Dark Hordes at bay.
Legend tells of a warrior who enters the Dark Horde's stronghold, the Castle of the Dead, and retrieves these artifacts and returns them to their rightful homes, thus restoring the power of the Wise Women and ridding the land of evil.
Episode one is about exploring the Dark Hordes' stronghold and escaping with the artifacts.
Episode two, which can only be accessed after completing episode one, focuses on restoring the artifacts to their rightful locations.

meta.name: Sea Dragon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.85 KB

Sea Dragon es un shooter arcade de desplazamiento lateral. El jugador pilota un submarino a través de amenazadoras cuevas submarinas para destruir un reactor fuertemente custodiado. Minas, torretas y una gran variedad de enemigos son los obstáculos para alcanzar este objetivo. El submarino está armado con misiles, torpedos y un arma "Big Kill" (que afecta a todo lo que aparece en la pantalla) para ayudar al jugador en el éxito de la misión. Con suministros de aire limitados, el jugador debe salir a la superficie para reponer aire siempre que sea posible.

meta.name: Sea Muncher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Sea Muncher” puts you in the role of a miniaturized human who has been shrunk to the size of a pinhead through a secret experiment and now resides in a tiny air bubble lodged in the gill of a small saltwater fish. Your goal is to reach a foreign shore undetected and alive while navigating a perilous ocean filled with deadly threats. Giant sharks patrol the waters, turning every mistake into a fatal trap – quick reflexes and smart anticipation are essential to survive the hazardous journey through the sea.

meta.name: The Sea Phantom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.12 KB

In The Sea Phantom, your adventure begins at the eerie Windward House, an old mansion perched high above Smuggler's Cove. Your mission: board the ghost ship, break Captain Thorne's curse, and uncover the hidden pirate treasure. But first, you must survive the night and unravel the mansion's dark secrets.

meta.name: Sea Ranger
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: The Sea Voyagers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Sea Voyagers you take part in an interactive journey through the history of famous European explorers. Instead of action, the focus is on learning: you discover information about around thirty historical figures and their voyages. One mode allows you to select an explorer, read key facts about them and see the routes they traveled on a map. This knowledge becomes useful in other game modes where you match explorers with the nations they sailed for, connect historical facts to the correct person or try to identify an explorer from only a few clues. The game blends quiz elements, puzzles and history lessons into a calm and educational experience about the early age of exploration.

meta.name: Sea Wolf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.33 KB

You are the commander...and Sea Wolf puts you in charge of sinking and destroying all enemy ships. You are armed with 4 torpedoes which will reload after you fire. Your primary targets are the small P.T. Boats which travel quickly through the water. You can choose the length of your playing time. Game times vary from 1 to 9 minutes in 1 minute intervals.

meta.name: Seabase Delta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.59 KB

In Seabase Delta you continue the story of Ed Lions, who, after the sinking of his submarine, now finds himself trapped in an enemy underwater base. The adventure begins in a corridor beside a corpse and a mysterious briefcase – the first clues in a deadly game of espionage and survival. Through exploration, logic, and smart decisions, you must find a way to escape from the depths of the base. Every choice matters, and behind every door lies a new puzzle waiting to be solved.

meta.name: Seafox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.16 KB

In Seafox you pilot a submarine through treacherous waters filled with enemies above and below. You attack with torpedoes fired forward or upward, but ammo and fuel are limited. Only the green supply ship and its loyal dolphin can save you in time. Destroyers drop deadly depth charges, enemy subs hunt you down, and some ships even reflect your own torpedoes back at you. Skill, timing, and a calm mind will determine whether you rise as a hunter or sink as a wreck.

meta.name: Sea Horse Hide'n Seek
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.04 KB

In Sea Horse Hide'n Seek you guide a group of playful seahorses through a colorful underwater world. With patience and a sharp eye, you lead them safely across the coral reef as they constantly change colors to hide from danger. The lagoon is full of surprises – timing and observation are key to bringing them safely to the old shipwreck. A calm yet captivating adventure set in the shimmering depths of the sea.

p: Search for King Solomon's Mines, The (USA).D64
n: Search for King Solomon's Mines, The (USA)

meta.desc:

The Search for King Solomon's Mines takes you to Africa in 1903, where a dying adventurer leaves clues to a legendary treasure trove. As you journey through the jungle, you'll encounter towering natives, icy landscapes, an active volcano, and many dangers. At the start, you choose five pieces of equipment from a list of weapons, tools, and supplies to aid your expedition. Puzzles come in three levels of difficulty, and the world is visually represented. Commands are entered using a verb-noun system, and the game allows saving your progress.

meta.name: Search For Magdarr
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Search for Magdarr," the story from "Dungeons of Magdarr" continues. Magdarr has escaped, and the player must track him down once more. You can either continue with the familiar characters or assemble a new team. The adventure features a new storyline, new monsters, new magic, and revamped combat mechanics.
meta.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Mazmorras

meta.name: Search for Reaper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.29 KB

Search for Reaper sends you to Adventure Land on behalf of King Scott, where you must recover the golden sword Reaper and bring it back, as it is the kingdom's last line of defense. From that clear mission grows a classic sense of adventure in which exploration, close observation, and overcoming obstacles take center stage. Its appeal comes from that simple, fairy-tale-like premise, because it keeps the focus entirely on the dangerous journey and the importance of what you are trying to recover.

meta.name: Search for the Lost Dick
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Search For The Lost Dick” invites you on a humorous adventure reminiscent of a “choose your own adventure” game. With interactive decisions, you control the story's progression and embark on an unexpected, slightly chaotic journey. It's a game that doesn't take itself too seriously and encourages exploration.

The Search for the Secret of Life is a graphic text adventure where a picture shows your surroundings while text provides further clues. By typing in commands, you guide your actions, solve puzzles, and complete tasks. The secret of life lies hidden within two houses, the address of one of which you already know. You enter one house to uncover part of the secret and then find your way out. The adventure is divided into three parts – The House, The Eighth Sea, and The Secret. Only by completing all three will you finally uncover the secret of life.

Search for the Titanic is an oceanographic simulation. You begin as an inexperienced oceanographer. You must build your reputation by exploring other lost vessels and earning the resources for a Titanic search. You plan, obtain funding, a ship, personnel, and equipment. Then chart a course and battle elements and dive for wrecks. Includes over 75 wrecks to explore, more than 100 navigational maps and charts and 47 ports of call. Find the Titanic and you will see real photos. Use simulated Sonar and underwater cameras.

In Seas of Blood you command the dreaded corsair ship Banshee across the perilous trade routes of Khul's Inland Sea. Your mission: to amass as much treasure as your hold can carry, through cunning raids, daring plunder, and ruthless ambition. From the squalid port of Tak to the distant isle of Nippur, you'll face rival pirates, sea monsters, and treacherous storms. Incorporating classic Fighting Fantasy elements like SKILL and STAMINA stats, simulated dice rolls, and thrilling combat, the game delivers a rich blend of adventure, danger, and high-seas strategy.

meta.name: Seaside Special
meta.desc:

Los politícnicos han invadido la Tierra y se han apoderado del Gabinete Tory en el 10 de Downing Street. Sólo un hombre puede detenerlos: Radium Rodney. Para salvar la Tierra, Rodney debe recoger algas radiactivas en la playa de Rotaway, y luego viajar al 10 de Downing Street para lanzar la hierba a los falsos políticos.

meta.name: Seastalker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You must save the Aquadome!  But is it in more danger from an inside traitor, or a vicious sea monster? As a famous inventor and scientist, you will use your inventions and skills to save the day.

meta.name: Seawar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.62 KB

Seawar is a two-player game in which the players try to destroy their opponent who is piloting a submarine or an aeroplane without damaging the neutral ships. Both vehicles move constantly from left to right or right to left. They can also move up, down or change speed. The submarine can hit its opponent with missiles and the plane can drop bombs. Whoever hits his opponent scores one point. If instead one of the ships crossing the sea is hit, the opponent gets a point. Whoever scores 20 first wins.nn

meta.name: Seawolfe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.39 KB

El jugador controla una pequeña nave en la parte inferior de la pantalla que se mueve lateralmente, disparando verticalmente a las naves enemigas que llegan. Las naves enemigas se lanzan desde un gran barco en el centro de la pantalla, y se cruzan horizontalmente, bajando una fila cada vez que se cruzan. Si un barco llega al fondo de la pantalla, destruye una de las boyas de señalización, reduciendo el alcance del movimiento del jugador. A medida que el jugador destruye las naves enemigas, éstas comienzan a moverse de forma más errática y rápida. Si se destruyen todas las boyas, se acaba el juego.

meta.name: Secret Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.09 KB

Esta es la tercera aventura de la serie de aventuras de texto de Scott Adam. Se desarrolla en una central nuclear. Debes correr contrarreloj para cumplir tu misión o el reactor podría estar condenado. Usas comandos de una o dos palabras para moverte y manipular objetos.

meta.name: The Secret of Bastow Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Secret of Bastow Manor” is a text-based adventure where you explore the abandoned estate of Bastow Manor to uncover its treasure. As you navigate the house, you must avoid dogs, traps, and the mysterious inhabitants. The game uses a simple parser system for commands like “READ NOTE,” “OPEN DOOR,” or “CLIMB TREE.” You can navigate using shortcuts such as “N” for north and view available exits with “G.” Your collected items can be checked with the command “I.” The C64 version enhances the text with rudimentary graphics and simplifies interaction by listing the objects in your surroundings.

meta.name: Secret of Kandar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.45 KB

In this flick-screen side view arcade adventure, for reasons unknown you have to enter and explore a castle to find a secret object. You start outside the castle with a banner and a dagger and you must get a key and enter through the front door. Once inside each screen is split into two floors with stairs connecting the various levels with doors to enter where the correct keys must be found. You can only carry two objects at a time with objects being picked up and dropped in the correct locations. There are various nasties moving about and obstacles to avoid as touching these loses one of three lives and you are sent back to the outside of the castle. Holding down the fire button and pressing down brings up a status screen showing objects carried, locations visited, score and how many lives.

meta.name: Secret of St. Bride's, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.32 KB

In "The Secret of St. Brides" the player takes on the role of Trixie Trinian, a determined young woman who wants to uncover the secret of St. Brides. Together with her friends Cynthia and Fiona, she is tasked with finding out why everyone at the boarding school thinks they are living in the 1920s and restoring normality. A side quest is to find an amulet that is independent of the main goal of the game. The traditional text adventure was created using Gilsoft's Quill software, with inputs typed in verb-noun format. The graphics are full-screen and the game was originally only sold by mail order, but received a distribution partnership after good reviews.

meta.name: Secret of the Silver Blades
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Los héroes del juego llegan desnudos a través de un pozo mágico a una ciudad helada. El grupo intenta salvar la ciudad asediada y luchar para descubrir el secreto de los Silver Blades...
La jugabilidad es muy similar a la de los juegos anteriores. El jugador debe crear un grupo de personajes. La exploración tiene lugar en entornos pseudo-3D, en vista en primera persona. Las batallas involucran al grupo controlado por el jugador y al grupo enemigo en una pantalla de batalla de arriba abajo. Las órdenes se dan turno a turno y los personajes controlados por el jugador pueden navegar libremente por el campo de batalla. A diferencia de los juegos anteriores, no hay desplazamiento por el mapa del mundo. Toda la exploración tiene lugar en el mundo 3D.

meta.name: Secret Tunnel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.54 KB

Secret Tunnel challenges you to navigate a deadly maze filled with invisible traps, fake walls, and unpredictable switches. Your goal is to reach the end while collecting as many diamonds as possible. You have limited health, and shields can deactivate one trap. Switches might open paths, remove obstacles – or do nothing at all. Every move requires caution, because one wrong step could cost you the game.

meta.name: Sector 90
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sector 90 is a side scrolling action game where the player has to fight their way into the inner-ring of a concentric-circled enemy base, plant an explosive and escape within 90 seconds. Throughout the game, the player will find various puzzles / locks / keys / enemies to defeat. The enemies consist solely of a single type of robot, and the puzzles are all very simple (played on the status panel ) and simply involve hitting some sort of 'choose' key at the correct split-second.

meta.name: Security Alert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Have you ever wanted to be a thief and break into buildings and steal treasures? If the answer is yes then the game Security Alert is for you. The game allows you to get into five buildings which include a jewelery store, a museum, a bank, a research building and an embassy. Each building is more secure and bigger than the last. You need to find loot but the main aim is to find a certain treasure.
There are many security systems in each building including cameras, robots and infa red beams. You have tools to do the job with as well as collecting tools on the way. Every time you are seen the alert goes up but lay low and the alert goes down. Don't lay low too long as there is a time limit. Get caught and it's game over.

meta.name: Seek and Destroy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.91 KB

In Seek and Destroy you take command of your own fleet and embark on a dangerous mission to destroy as many enemy submarines and battleships as possible. You can strategically place your ships and launch targeted attacks on enemy units. It requires a good sense of tactics and quick decisions to defeat the enemy fleet and protect your own ships. But be warned, the enemy is just as determined to destroy you - good luck on your mission!

meta.name: Seesaw
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.87 KB

Seesaw has you battling an evil lord who drops heavy blocks onto a see-saw beneath his castle wall. By standing on the opposite end at the right moment, the impact launches you upward, allowing you to climb higher step by step. Green monsters patrol the wall, trying to grab either you or the rising blocks, and if too many weights pile up, the see-saw becomes stuck. Being caught or crushed costs you a life. Your goal is to propel yourself to the top of the castle and defeat the wicked lord – an unusual skill-based challenge built around timing and risk.

meta.name: Sensitive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.83 KB

Sensitive is an action puzzle game with a very simple premise. The player controls a ball which has to roll over a set of platforms to the exit. The trick is that each tile disappears after the player has rolled over it. This requires careful planning of which path to take across the platforms to get tot the goal.
Each level is a single screen with grey and yellow tiles. Rolling over the yellow tiles will cause them to disappear, the grey tiles won't dissolve when the ball rolls over them. Later levels introduce special tiles, like tiles you can roll over twice, one-way tiles and teleporters
There are no level passwords so each new game starts from the very beginning with a fixed set of 4 lives.

meta.name: Sensor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.64 KB

Sensor is a simple yet challenging memory game in the style of Simon. In each round, an increasingly complex sequence of colors and tones is presented and must be repeated exactly. The four colored pads each represent a unique tone and color – one mistake costs a life, and players have five tries. With each level, difficulty rises, and those who make it far can aim for a new high score. Perfect as a party game or quick concentration exercise.

meta.name: Sentence
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sentence throws you into a grim future where survival depends on mastering both evasion and combat. The game blends two core styles: a run-and-avoid mechanic filled with traps and hazards, and classic beat-'em-up action where you fight enemies head-on. Timing and awareness are key, as the screen quickly fills with threats and the difficulty ramps up fast. Balancing flight and fight is essential if you want to make it out alive.

meta.name: Sentinel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.98 KB

In this sequel to Dimension X, you join the warriors of Dimension X to continue fight against evil on the planet Jaraloba. This time it is flown in outer space, while you are controlling the space jet. Gorganitor squadrons were detected in all 50 sectors (10x5 matrix) of your star cluster, and you should clear them one-by-one. Sitting in cockpit of your space jet, you may examine the view in first-person perspective, accelerate, decelerate your jet, move in 360 degrees, and shoot the enemy spacecrafts. During your mission, radar helps you to detect the enemies out of your view, but energy is exhausting, time is flowing, and shields are decreasing with enemy shots.

meta.name: Sentinel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.40 KB

Sentinel puts you back in the fight against evil, this time in space above the planet Jaraloba. As a space jet pilot, you fly through 50 hostile sectors and engage in intense battles with Gorganitor squadrons. From a first-person cockpit view, you steer in all directions, dodge attacks, and fire at enemy fighters. Radar, energy, and shields guide your survival – but time and resources are limited, and every hit brings you closer to destruction.

meta.desc:

The Sentinel puts you in control of a Synthoid, a telepathic robot tasked with conquering surreal checkerboard landscapes. Starting at the lowest point, your goal is to reach the highest platform where the ever-watching Sentinel stands. You don't move directly – instead, you scan the terrain, absorb objects to gain energy, build stacks of boulders, and create inert Synthoid shells to transfer your consciousness into. Only through strategic positioning and careful energy use can you evade the Sentinel's gaze and take control.

The rules are easy to understand, but the path quickly becomes a tactical challenge as your opponent can block, redirect, or slow you down. Every move changes the situation on the board – plan ahead and use the right moment to make your way to the goal step by step.

meta.name: The Serpent's Star
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Serpent's Star you play archaeologist Mac Steele on a perilous quest through Tibet to find the mythical gemstone. After a rival steals crucial scrolls, you must navigate the mysterious city of Kara-Koram alone. Typing commands, you explore, collect items, solve puzzles and make choices that shape your journey. Rich text descriptions paired with graphics guide you as you uncover the path to the legendary Serpent's Star.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.27 KB

In Serpentine you control a segmented snake in a maze, trying to outlast and devour three enemy snakes. You can only bite the tail of snakes longer than you – head collisions are fatal. Bite off segments to shrink them until you can consume them whole. Eat frogs to grow, and be mindful of eggs left behind – yours grant extra lives, enemy eggs hatch more foes. You can eat eggs to stop that. Each new level brings a different maze and tougher enemy snakes, ramping up the challenge.

meta.name: Serpentone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.02 KB

“Serpentone” is a Snake game where you must also collect fruit. Skillfully control the snake to gather points and avoid obstacles.

meta.name: Serve & Volley
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A tennis game where camera is always static, which means whether you're on one side of the net or the other, the camera will always show both players from the same angle, which seems like a platform game. You can play a single match or full tournament, as well as resume if you achieved some points while playing before. You can play against computer AI or another player on the same computer, or you can select DEMO for computer(s) to demonstrate you the game.

meta.name: Sesame Street : Letter-Go-Round
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sesame Street: Letter-Go-Round invites young players into a cheerful learning carousel where they catch letters, recognize them and form simple words. The Ferris wheel spins with new letters in every bucket, while a Muppet pet selects the target letter or word beforehand. You pick the right match – sometimes uppercase, sometimes lowercase, sometimes mixed or even as a missing part of a small word. It's playful, easy to grasp and tailored perfectly to children aged three to four, helping them take their first steps in letter recognition and basic word building.

meta.name: Sesame Street - Pals Around Town
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An animated game to get to know the neighborhood. Kids can learn about the community by exploring five different locations and creating scenes with Sesame Street friends and familiar objects.

meta.name: Session
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Session is a Sokoban-style puzzle game with many other elements.
The goal is to use the smiley to move all the boxes one after the other onto the designated target fields, although there is no specification as to which object should be moved to which target field. The boxes can only be pushed and not pulled; moving several boxes at the same time is not possible. The only possible directions of movement for the character are up, down, right and left. No diagonal moves are possible.

meta.desc:

In The Seven Cities of Gold you take on the role of Christopher Columbus and later the Spanish conquistadors, exploring the New World or a randomly generated map. You establish forts and missions, return gold to Spain, and earn promotions from the Queen. The vast game world invites exploration, while arcade sequences portray encounters with natives where language barriers play a key role. The historical map of 1492 accurately places the indigenous peoples of the New World, letting you decide whether to gain the riches of the Aztecs and Incas through trade or conquest.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Seventh Fleet is a strategic naval and air warfare simulation that reenacts a hypothetical conflict between Soviet and U.S. forces in the Pacific in 1996. The player controls the naval and air forces of one side and acts as the theater commander, creating task forces, assigning missions, and responding to operational events. The game is played in text format and uses a game board with pieces to track positions. It begins on June 1, 1996, with time progressing in half-day intervals. The player manages task forces, issues movement orders, and launches attacks. The game can escalate into a nuclear war or end in a ceasefire, with a score system measuring the effectiveness of the command.

meta.name: Sex Vixens from Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.06 KB

In "Sex Vixens from Space," Brad Stallion, a charming hero of the future, takes on the mission to stop "The Tribe" – a group of space Amazons spreading interstellar terror with their dangerous Sex-Ray weapons. Supported by Sandie, a ship's computer, Brad navigates through two planetary landscapes, a space station, and his own ship, the "Big Thruster." Along the way, he encounters various women, whose meetings are not always entirely conventional. With skill and charm, Brad strives to complete his mission successfully.

meta.name: Seymour Goes to Hollywood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.59 KB

Seymour goes to Hollywood to star in his first motion picture. As he arrives in his limousine, he soon discovers that the Dirk, the studio manager, has disappeared in Miami. Seymour must start production of his film by himself.
Seymour Goes To Hollywood is a platform adventure, another Dizzy clone, this time replacing the egg character with an amorphous blob of unknown origin. Like in the Dizzy games, the main objective is to collect everything that isn't nailed down (using the fire button) to solve puzzles. In the upper left portion of the screen sits an inventory with three slots and besides that the score points and the energy bar. Seymour loses energy when touching dangerous objects and hazardous environments. When the bar gets empty, Seymour transforms into a pile of bones and the player loses one life. The game starts with three lives (shown as clack boards under the energy bar) and no way of saving progress.

meta.name: Sergeant Slaughters Mat Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Sgt. Slaughter's Mat Wars" challenges the player to prove themselves in the ring, using powerful moves like punches, body slams, and flying pins against opponents. Wrestlers can be thrown over the ropes and continue fighting outside the ring. Victories earn combat pay and allow progression through the ranks toward the championship. Outside of the matches, the player can also take on the role of a manager—bidding on a wrestler in Sgt. Slaughter's auction house, training them, and guiding them to the top. The game features five different wrestling tycoons and four arenas.

meta.name: Shackled
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A multi-player, multi-level labyrinth/maze game in the genre of Gauntlet; originally an arcade game. Players take the role of Kevin, who is trying to rescue his friends from their jail cells. As prisoners are released, they will attempt to follow Kevin, and also attack nearby enemies. Kevin's goal is to lead each prisoner to the exit, and onto the next level. Some levels have hidden passages which lead to bonus/secret levels.
As with any Gauntlet-style game, finding enough keys to deal with each door is crucial.  Kevin can pick up weapons such as grenades and boomerangs,  and other enhancing objects such as faster movement, a smart-bomb diamond, and other bonus objects for points.

meta.name: Shades
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

On the island of Arulan, the curse of the "Shades" causes people to disappear and reappear at other locations. This curse also brought monsters and traps, making the island a dangerous place. You play as a hero determined to break the curse, defeat the monsters, and save the island. The game can be played solo or with up to three other players. It is a flick-screen arcade adventure where you explore the island from a top-down perspective. Armed with a sword, you fight monsters, avoid traps, and search for secret doors. Your "Physical State" decreases through combat and traps, and when it reaches zero, the game ends. You collect items to fulfill your mission and improve your high score. The curse can transport you back to earlier locations, and if all players die, the game is over.

meta.name: Shadow Dancer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Shadow Dancer es un juego en el que controlas a un Shinobi. Con la ayuda de tu perro, debes matar a tus enemigos mientras te aventuras en lugares como aeropuertos, ferrocarriles, cascadas, alcantarillas, etc. Además, debes encontrar y desactivar varias bombas en el camino antes de salir de cada una de estas zonas. También tienes la opción de usar magia contra los enemigos, que puede consistir en tornados o bolas de fuego.
Hay varias misiones que debes completar, y cada una tiene objetivos diferentes, como neutralizar a un comando enemigo, interrumpir la ruta de suministro del enemigo, asaltar las unidades industriales del enemigo, atacar las fuerzas subterráneas del enemigo y liberar y asegurar la base de la lanzadera. Cada misión consta de tres etapas y hay un jefe en cada una de las etapas de la misión final.

meta.name: Shadow Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Shadow Force is a space shooter where you control a spaceship and fight against waves of enemies. You must navigate through various levels, defeat foes, and collect power-ups to progress in the game. The levels are challenging and feature fast-paced action, typical of many games from that era. The game was included in a collection of "Best Games" from various platforms, reflecting its significance during its time.

meta.name: Shadow Of The Beast
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Siendo niño, Aarbron fue secuestrado por los Sacerdotes del Señor Bestia, drogado y convertido en su Mensajero. Todo cambió al presenciar el sacrificio de su padre: despertaron sus recuerdos y juró venganza.
Shadow of the Beast, clásico de Psygnosis, es un platformer lateral famoso por su parallax scrolling, gráficos exuberantes, banda sonora de David Whittaker y dificultad extrema. Controlas a Aarbron en un mundo hostil: saltas, te agachas, golpeas o usas una patada voladora. Los enemigos suelen caer con un impacto, pero requieren precisión. Trampas fijas exigen movimientos exactos. Solo tienes una vida y 12 puntos de golpe, recuperables con objetos bien escondidos —lo que eleva el desafío a cotas legendarias.

meta.desc:

“The Shadow over Innsmouth” throws you into a side-scrolling underwater adventure, where you pilot an old-fashioned submarine and face nightmarish creatures lurking off the dark coast of Innsmouth – inspired by H. P. Lovecraft's eerie tale, you fight to survive in a world ruled by terrors from the deep.

meta.name: Shadow Skimmer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.00 KB

“Shadow Skimmer” puts the player in the role of a space pilot conducting an inspection with the Shadow Skimmer glider. When the main computer fails and blocks the return path, an alternative exit must be found. Security systems identify the glider as an intruder, forcing the player to navigate through three maze-like sections. Exits remain locked until a hidden energy generator is destroyed. Some obstacles require rotating the glider, but this makes it vulnerable. Shield energy protects against hits, but after three losses, the game ends. A laser aids in defense, but destroyed enemies are instantly replaced.

meta.name: Shadow Warriors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Shadow Warriors es un puerto directo de la versión arcade de Ninja Gaiden. Es un beat'em up en las venas de Double Dragon con Ryu Hayabusa, un ninja que debe luchar contra miembros de un culto malvado que buscan cumplir las profecías del fin del mundo de Nostradamus.
Ryu Hayabusa puede atacar a sus enemigos usando sus manos y pies descalzos o usando una espada (por un tiempo limitado). También puede realizar movimientos como un lanzamiento de cuello volador, una voltereta hacia atrás y patadas colgantes, realizados mientras cuelga en objetos de escenario. Lanzar enemigos contra objetos como cabinas telefónicas, bidones de aceite o contenedores de basura los destruirá, revelando potenciadores como artículos de salud y espadas. En algunos puntos, Ryu tendrá que realizar movimientos acrobáticos para continuar. Tiene una barra de vida que comienza con 5 unidades.

meta.name: Shadowfax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.05 KB

Shadowfax puts you in control of Gandalf riding his white horse, zapping wave after wave of Nazgul with magic lightning. The black riders keep coming faster and in tighter rows, and your only goal is to survive as long as possible and rack up the highest score.

meta.name: Shadowfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Shadowfire puts you in command of the Enigma Team – six unique mercenaries with different abilities. Your mission: rescue Ambassador Kryxix and capture the ruthless General Zoff, all within just 40 minutes. Tactical planning is key – only by using each team member wisely can you bypass defenses, infiltrate enemy territory, and complete your objective in time.

meta.name: Shadows of Mordor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Shadows of Mordor es una aventura de texto con licencia oficial de “Lord of the Rings” basada en la segunda parte de la trilogía: “The Two Towers”. Puedes elegir jugar como Frodo o Sam, siguiendo su peligroso viaje por Mordor. El juego se ciñe fielmente a la trama del libro, con numerosas localizaciones acompañadas de ilustraciones evocadoras. Inusualmente para una aventura de texto, el mundo funciona en tiempo real: si dudas, los acontecimientos se suceden y las criaturas vagan de un lugar a otro. Esto crea una inmersión intensa y desafiante en el oscuro mundo de Tolkien.

meta.name: Shakey City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.33 KB

The player is caught up in an earthquake and must rescue all the other survivors and escape. The parser is simple and uses the standard verb-noun format, though only the first two letters of each word need be entered. All directions are in form "go east", etc. and the walkthrough assumes that the player has typed in "go" before each direction listed. Sometimes, however, the first word in an object's name (e.g baking soda) has to be entered, while, at on other occasions, it is the second word (e.g. rubber gloves). There are many unused items in this game, but the tasks are usually logical, even if belief has to be suspended on many occasions. There is also a time factor, so get moving!

meta.name: Shaman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.60 KB

Shaman is a side-scrolling arcade game, where the player must collect the designated number of bottles scattered around before the time runs out in order to reach the next level. Each level is inhabited by numerous animals, which may be killed with rocks. Contact with them means a certain death and necessity to start the level from the beginning. .

meta.name: Shamus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Shamus” is a fast-paced maze-based action game where you navigate a sprawling labyrinth in pursuit of the villainous “Shadow.” To unlock new areas of the map, you must find keys and matching locks while dodging relentless enemies and deadly electric walls. It's a game of constant action, exploration, and challenge, demanding quick reflexes and strategic thinking. As a spiritual successor to the arcade classic “Berzerk,” it builds upon the formula with added depth and intensity.

meta.name: Shamus Case II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.24 KB

“Shamus Case II” puts you in the role of Shamus, a detective-adventurer who enters the underground lair of an escaped villain you previously captured. Your mission is to bring him back. To succeed, you must navigate a dungeon full of traps, monsters, and misleading paths. Avoid enemies or use limited weapon fire to defeat them. Scattered treasure chests contain useful items like keys and hints that help you progress through the maze.

meta.name: Shanghai
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Shanghai is one of the first video game adaptations of tile-based mahjong, functioning purely as a logic puzzle. You must remove 144 tiles by matching free pairs – only tiles with at least one open side can be selected. The layout is pyramid-shaped and has nothing to do with traditional mahjong rules. The game features five preset challenges, some with time limits, random layouts and even multiplayer mode. Sharp eyes and concentration are key to winning.

meta.name: Shanghai Karate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.59 KB

In Shanghai Karate you follow young Yo Lin, the sole survivor of a brutal attack on his martial arts academy by the traitorous Wang Chen. Carrying the sacred scrolls, he battles his way through four Chinese locations – from the Great Wall to the Yangtze River and the caves of Loyang – to finally face Wang Chen in the Dragon Temple. By shooting scattered icons to replenish your resources, you push forward level by level until the next area is reached.

Miss a gate or run out of time, and it's game over – success depends on accuracy and perfect timing.

Accuracy alone is not enough – success comes from a combination of sharp reflexes and perfect timing.

meta.name: Shooting Gallery

Shooting Gallery puts you at a carnival shooting booth where moving targets appear along different paths and must be hit quickly. With limited ammunition and increasing speed, success depends on steady aim, good timing and fast reactions to progress through the rounds. The straightforward design delivers immediate fun focused entirely on precision and concentration.

meta.name: Shooting Gallery

Deben salvar la Tierra de los invasores mercenarios de Bozon. Primero debes llegar a los territorios de Bozon, luego aniquilar sus fuerzas ocultas en cavernas y acechando en mares subterráneos, antes de destruir la nave de invasión principal. Sidewize puts you in a jetpack to fight back against an alien threat attacking multiple planets at once. You are free to choose the order of missions and can move in all directions through horizontally scrolling areas while enemies attack from both sides of the screen. Constant evasion, precise shooting and collecting upgrades shape the experience, as stronger weapons, shields and extra chances significantly affect survival. The appeal lies in the smooth movement, escalating challenge and the freedom to decide your own path through the galactic counterattack – fast, intense and firmly focused on action.

Sigma 7 confronts you with a malfunctioning space station where rogue robots have taken over. To reach the central controls and restore order, you must overcome several very different stages, each with its own rules and demands. The opening section challenges you to survive a diagonally scrolling sequence filled with mine formations that must be avoided or destroyed before they return from unexpected angles. Once inside the station, the experience shifts to a maze-like area where you control a heavy vehicle, collect glowing energy nodes, fend off enemies and remember which elements cannot be collected in order to reach the exit in time. The appeal comes from the sharp shifts in gameplay, pattern memorization and constantly adapting your approach – varied, demanding and highly focused on concentration.

Step by step, you explore a dying future, gather clues, and follow traces of ancient knowledge toward a mysterious destination. The atmosphere relies heavily on its bleak tone and the strange locations you uncover. That blend of exploration, thought, and a macabre setting gives the adventure its distinctive appeal.

Con diferentes niveles de realismo, y por tanto de dificultad, controla parámetros como la profundidad máxima, los torpedos, etc. El juego cuenta con un modo Campaña, además de los modos Entrenamiento y Misión Individual, que te permitirán ganar experiencia mientras te mantengas con vida.

De lejos, procedente de las nubes, se dejaba entrever una especie de zumbido, cada vez más intenso, que poco a poco se tornaba ensordecedor. Y tras él, una impresionante nave nodriza hacía una aparición estelar.
De ella salieron dos naves de combate surcando el cielo, planeando sobre las aguas, proyectándose con sombras silenciosas de un futuro incierto. Había terminado la cuenta atrás y empezaba la aventura.

Estos juegos se habían lanzado previamente para algunos, pero no todos, estos sistemas. Silicon Dreams se puede jugar como tres juegos separados, pero para obtener la máxima cantidad de puntos debes completarlos en orden (llevando tu puntuación de una aventura a la siguiente). Snowball tiene gráficos por primera vez, y los otros dos juegos tienen más gráficos que antes, y se han agregado algunas descripciones de texto más largas a los tres juegos.

This revolutionary system possesses more artificial intelligence and computing power than anything humanity has ever built. But its secret will only be revealed to the greatest computer developer. To claim this knowledge, the world's leading tech companies send their best minds into a ruthless battle. Only those who outmatch the competition will uncover the ultimate truth of the SYBORGS. Will you be the chosen one?

Silkworm es un clásico shoot-em-up de desplazamiento horizontal. La principal diferencia entre este juego y muchos otros shoot-em-ups de desplazamiento lateral es que estarás tanto en tierra como en el aire.
El primer jugador jugaría como un helicóptero, pero si un segundo jugador se une al juego, jugaría como un jeep. Ambos jugadores tendrían que protegerse entre sí y a sí mismos. Después de un cierto número de muertes, se formaría un helicóptero "ganso" en la pantalla. Si los jugadores lograran destruirlo, obtendrían el poder de un arma. Esto continuaría durante todo el juego, y podría aparecer un "ganso" incluso durante la pelea con el jefe del final del nivel.
