"Slide!" is a puzzle game where players must rearrange the numbers in sequence to restore order to the universe.

meta.name: Sliding Skill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Sliding Skill, you assist a warehouse worker in sorting colored crates. Your task is to move the crates so that all crates of the same color are grouped together. Once the order is restored, you can proceed to the next room with a new challenge. You also have suction cups to move crates that cannot be pushed otherwise. Use them wisely by targeting a crate, pressing the button, and selecting a direction. Keep in mind that your time is limited, so work quickly and precisely.

meta.name: Slightly Magic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.25 KB

Slightly Magic is a platformer-adventure game not unlike Codemasters' own Dizzy and Seymour series, but is generally shorter and easier than most other games of that genre.
In Slightly Magic you are cast as Slightly - mischievous nephew of legendary wizard Bigwiz, who has suddenly taken off on some urgent business, leaving his castle in disarray with dragons and magical spells running amok. One of the dragons kidnaps the princess, and now Slightly has to save her.
In addition to standard inventory puzzles of Dizzy games, Slightly Magic introduces a magic system that requires multiple objects to be combined in order to achieve effects ranging from frightening the enemies to turning the player into a fish.

meta.name: Slimer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.58 KB

"Slimer" puts the player in the role of a hungry ectoplasmic ghost, floating through a colorful environment while trying to collect as much food as possible. At the same time, dangerous bombs must be avoided – as an accidental touch can end the game instantly. The challenge lies in timing movements correctly, as food can only be eaten with an open mouth – but in this state, bombs become an even greater threat.

meta.name: Slimey's Mine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.24 KB

Slimey is a frog and he has found himself trapped on an asteroid field and his ship in bits scattered around mines deep in certain asteroids. You must find the entrances to these mines and explore the caverns inside. The game starts with yourself on one of the asteroids and is viewed from above with a small part of the asteroid field shown on the screen with the screen scrolling when you move.

meta.name: Slinky
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Slinky puts you in control of a spring that hops across blocks to change them all to a target color – clearly inspired by Q*Bert but with unique twists. Magnets, clouds, raindrops, and monsters affect your progress: monsters are deadly, magnets catch you only if you stop, raindrops boost speed, clouds make you dusty. If both hit you, your spring rusts and gets dragged off by an oil-can. Besides having five lives, you must also avoid running out of points – every jump drains your score, and only bonus pickups can keep you alive.

meta.name: Scalextric
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.74 KB

Scalextric brings the feel of classic slot-car racing to the screen, focusing on close duels, controlled speed, and well-timed overtakes. Across different tracks, you try to clear corners and chicanes as quickly as possible without losing too much momentum or crashing into the car ahead. Side bumps can help during overtaking and add extra tension to each race. Custom course designs broaden the appeal even further, turning the action into a pleasantly varied racing experience.

meta.name: Slot Machine Version I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.78 KB

Slot Machine is a digital version of exactly that. The player can play on a single "one armed bandit". The player can stop at any time and the game keeps track of the player's virtual payments and winnings.

meta.name: Slot Machine Version II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.04 KB

Slot Machine is a digital version of exactly that. The player can play on a single "one armed bandit". The player can stop at any time and the game keeps track of the player's virtual payments and winnings. This version is updated with brilliant colors and images as all fruit machines should have.

meta.name: Slug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

It's late on Friday night, and Slug is sitting with his girlfriend, watching the horror film Emperor Hades Meets the Yak-Faced Melboids from East London Part 37 (Revisited), when his girlfriend is suddenly taken away by a mechanical arm, to another world. As Slug, you have to collect five hearts on each of the levels, which consist of four moving platforms with holes allowing you to fall down to and jump up to higher and lower platforms.

meta.name: Slugger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.42 KB

Slugger puts you in the ring as the challenger facing off against various opponents, aiming to outscore them punch by punch. With precise hits and good timing, you try to dethrone the champ. Every strike counts, and each round brings you closer to victory or defeat. Simple to play, intense to win.

meta.name: World Series Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.53 KB

World Series Baseball focuses on fast, approachable baseball action, letting you play full games across several innings while facing a computer opponent with varying challenges. The rules stay close to the real sport and are introduced clearly, but the emphasis is on pace rather than statistics. The action is shown from a distinctive perspective, the pitcher's throws appear in a separate window, and during fielding you automatically control the player closest to the ball – forcing quick decisions. Features like base stealing, varied pitch styles and customizable team colors add extra variety, while short intermissions with cheerleaders and advertising banners create a lively stadium atmosphere.

meta.name: Slurpy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Slurpy puts you in control of a strange green creature inside a single-screen cave. Each level tasks you with eating ten floating seeds while a variety of monsters try to stop you. Fortunately, most enemies can be devoured as well by sucking them in with Slurpy's long trunk and turning danger into opportunity. Still, direct contact costs a life, leaving little margin for mistakes – skillful movement, positioning, and smart use of the suction ability are key to survival.

meta.name: Sly Spy - Secret Agent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En el papel de un agente secreto inspirado en James Bond, tu misión es detener a toda costa a una organización terrorista llamada Consejo para la Dominación Mundial. Después de recibir el informe, se le lleva por aire al lugar donde comienza la acción. Saltando del avión, caes libremente a la zona de aterrizaje. Varios tipos malos se unen a tu posición e intentan eliminarte. Un aterrizaje exitoso conduce a ocho niveles de advertencia que incluyen escenas como obras de construcción, fábricas, acción submarina y una persecución en moto.

meta.name: Sly Spy - Secret Agent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En el papel de un agente secreto inspirado en James Bond, tu misión es detener a toda costa a una organización terrorista llamada Consejo para la Dominación Mundial. Después de recibir el informe, se le lleva por aire al lugar donde comienza la acción. Saltando del avión, caes libremente a la zona de aterrizaje. Varios tipos malos se unen a tu posición e intentan eliminarte. Un aterrizaje exitoso conduce a ocho niveles de advertencia que incluyen escenas como obras de construcción, fábricas, acción submarina y una persecución en moto.

meta.name: Slynky in Moroder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.99 KB

“Slynky in Moroder” follows the tale of a curious thief who discovers a mysterious map near his home. It leads him to a cursed site said to contain a hidden golden statuette. Armed with a pickaxe and a shovel, he begins his dangerous quest. But the undead and treacherous underground traps stand in his way. Only those with sharp reflexes and a brave heart will survive the dig. A darkly whimsical adventure with classic platforming action.

meta.name: Smaller-Bigger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.20 KB

Will the next random number be smaller or bigger? Care to make a bet on that? Sort of based on the TV quiz show Play your Cards Right, except for instead of guessing if cards are higher or lower, you guess if balls are higher or lower and you can also play your joker. Balls vary from 1 to 99, so the game is not as easy as it seems. Score as many points as you can. Challenge a friend. That's where it gets fun.

meta.name: Smaragd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.12 KB

In Smaragd, you venture deep into Africa, where a treacherous jungle river leads you into the territory of wild tribes. Mysterious forces guard the legendary treasures of the Emerald Castle — only the bravest have a chance to reach it. But will you succeed, or will you fall to the challenges ahead?

meta.name: Smartees
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Smartees" is a Pac-Man-style collection game where up to four players compete or cooperate. The goal is to navigate mazes, collect point-scoring objects, and avoid obstacles and enemies.

meta.name: Smash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Smash" is an unusual tennis game played from a 2D side view. This means players cannot move sideways but can move forward, backward, and jump, similar to the "Super Volleyball" games. When hitting the ball, the controls allow adjusting shot height and power but not trajectory due to the viewing angle. The camera always follows the ball, so players are not always visible, but a mini-map keeps track of their positions and the ball. There are four male and four female players, each with unique stats and nationalities. The game offers a choice between a single match or a knockout tournament. The number of sets and games per set can be customized in single matches but progressively increase as the player advances through the tournament.

meta.name: Smash Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.34 KB

Smash Out is a Pong clone which looks quite nice, and plays ok for a Pong clone. It is nothing spectacular, but it was never mean't to be. This was to make a bit of money until the bigger things out there could be tackled, such as other projects like Championship Run and History Of The World.

meta.name: Smash the Windows
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.19 KB

In Smash the Windows, you play a variation of the classic game "Breakout." Your goal is to break as many windows as possible using only nine bricks. You must use your bricks wisely by skillfully bouncing them off your paddle at the bottom of the screen. Control the paddle with the Z (left) and M (right) keys. Precision and timing are key to success and to shattering all the windows.

meta.name: Smash T.V.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El año es 1999. El programa de televisión más popular del mundo es Smash TV, un concurso ultraviolento entre dos combatientes armados hasta los dientes, desatado en una serie de escenarios mortíferos que están llenos hasta el estallido de hordas de bestias sin cerebro y robots asesinos. El objetivo del juego es destruir todo a la vista e intentar obtener más efectivo y premios que el otro jugador. Los hornos tostadores, las videograbadoras, los autos sofisticados y las vacaciones de lujo están ahí para tomar... para cualquiera que pueda sobrevivir el tiempo suficiente para disfrutarlos. Smash TV es un increíble shoot-em-up del cerebro de Eugene Jarvis, creador de Robotron: 2084. Mantiene el estilo de juego frenético y el método de control de dos joysticks, pero agrega mucho gore, violencia, un toque de sátira y ese modo de dos jugadores de suma importancia.

meta.name: Smash-Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.73 KB

"Smash-Ball" is an action-packed game where the player must collect money bags in space while dodging incoming meteor fragments. Without warning, the wealthy banker planet Bankonia in the Hyponid system explodes, sending millions of debris pieces hurtling toward the neighboring planet Ballonia. Panic ensues as sirens wail, reconnaissance planes take flight, and the spherical inhabitants of Ballonia scurry like startled bees — except for one. Smash, a yellow-skinned Ballonian who works as a garbage collector, remains calm. He is the last hope, navigating through the debris field to collect as many money bags as possible without being struck by the incoming meteors.

"SMASHED – The Strangest Mobile Army Surgical Hospital East of Detroit" follows Pigseye Peers, a newly qualified surgeon assigned to a mobile military hospital unit in Korea. There, he experiences the chaotic daily life of the strangest team east of Detroit. The game is a humorous parody of the popular TV series MAS*H and combines classic text-based input with occasional graphics.

meta.name: Smasher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.06 KB

"Smasher" is a simple yet entertaining game where the goal is to hit moles that dare to pop their heads out of their burrows into your yard. Press the right key quickly to smash them with a hammer and give them a reason to relocate.

meta.name: Smasher 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Smasher II" features new levels created with the Breakout Construction Kit, challenging the player to skillfully break all the blocks.

meta.name: Smiley's Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.94 KB

Smiley's Run is a fast-paced maze game where the player controls Smiley, navigating through a complex labyrinth while being chased by multiple snakes. The goal is to skillfully evade them and find a safe path through the maze. The snakes move relentlessly, often leaving trails that make progress more difficult. Precise controls and quick reflexes are essential to survive and reach the exit.

meta.name: Smuggler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.02 KB

Smuggler is a fast-paced platformer in which you guide a smuggler around the screen collecting barrels and tossing them back into the ship's hold – all while avoiding hazards such as kangaroos and penguins. At the beginning of each level, you're told how many barrels must be returned before proceeding. Success takes dexterity and timing – and a clever route through the increasingly chaotic screens.

meta.name: The Secret of Smugglers Inn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.90 KB

„The Secret of Smugglers Inn“ is a text adventure with graphical support in which you search for the hidden entrance to a smugglers' hideout. You'll wander through gloomy moors, examine old buildings and solve puzzles to uncover clues about a hidden book and an escape by sea. Only those who think cleverly and remain persistent will be able to uncover the secret.

meta.name: Smurf 2 : The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.84 KB

In Smurf 2: The Revenge, you jump, hop, and skip over numerous obstacles to find your way and reach the goal. The game challenges you with various platforming sections, requiring quick reflexes and precise movements to navigate through the levels and overcome the hazards in your path.

meta.name: Smurf Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.59 KB

“Smurf Rescue” tells the story of a rescue mission – Smurfette has been kidnapped and is being held on a platform in Gargamel's castle. You control a Smurf navigating perilous environments, jumping over obstacles, dodging spiders, and making your way up to Smurfette to rescue her. Once the rescue is complete, the journey begins again – with faster obstacles and a longer, more challenging path to the castle.

meta.name: Snacks 4 Snakes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.16 KB

Snacks 4 Snakes is a fast-paced battle of reflexes and turns, where you glide your snake across the field, trying to survive as long as possible without crashing into obstacles or other snakes. Every move leaves a trail that becomes a deadly barrier – for you and the others. The goal is to outsmart your opponents, cut them off, and stay alive. Chaos and tension rise with every additional player on the field.

meta.name: Snaffle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.01 KB

“Snaffle” is a word-based puzzle game for two to four players, where quick thinking and a strong vocabulary are key. The goal is to form valid words from a random selection of letters. The first player to enter a correct word earns the points. Each round offers a new letter mix, constantly challenging both strategy and speed. With multiple players competing head-to-head, the game becomes a thrilling word battle of brains and reflexes.

meta.name: Snake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.70 KB

"Snake" lets you guide a snake across the screen, devouring boxes to earn points. As the snake grows longer with each bite, maneuvering becomes more difficult – crashing into a wall or yourself ends the game. Every 50 points earns you bonus time. Control is via joystick or keyboard, with a key to pause or resume. A timeless classic with simple mechanics and increasing tension the longer you survive.

meta.name: Snake Attack!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"¡Snake Attack!" es una versión oscura y trepidante del clásico juego de serpientes, ambientado en un laberinto de plataformas y obstáculos de temática industrial. Guías a una serpiente brillante por estrechos pasillos, acumulando puntos mientras evitas colisionar con el entorno o contigo mismo. Los niveles se vuelven cada vez más complejos, lo que requiere una planificación cuidadosa y reflejos rápidos. Con sus gráficos melancólicos y una atmósfera cruda, "¡Snake Attack!" le da un giro fresco a un concepto ya conocido, combinando mecánicas retro con un toque futurista.

meta.name: Snake Byte
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.84 KB

“Snake Byte” is a classic arcade-style game where you guide an ever-growing snake across the screen to devour apples. Each apple makes the snake longer, and after consuming ten, a door to the next level opens. The layout becomes more intricate with each stage, increasing the challenge of avoiding walls and your own body. Adding pressure, bars on both sides of the screen slowly rise – if they reach the top before you eat another apple, three more apples are added to your goal. Precision and planning are essential to survive this increasingly tricky maze of movement.

meta.name: Snake for One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Snake for One," you control a red snake across a rectangular green field, collecting small black dots to grow longer and earn points. Crashing into the wall or your own body ends the game. The standout feature is the menu system, allowing you to adjust parameters like speed and difficulty, and even access an editor to customize the playfield. A classic single-player Snake game enhanced with configuration options and extra replay value.

meta.name: Snake Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Snake Mania” is a variant of the classic Snake game, featuring great music and appealing visuals. Control the snake, collect points, and avoid obstacles as you master the playing field.

meta.name: Snake Or Die
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Snake or Die" is a fast-paced game where you steer a winding snake across a grid of colorful tiles. Your goal is to collect all the glowing pieces before time runs out. Holding the fire button increases your speed – necessary to beat the clock. But beware: as the snake grows, controlling it becomes more difficult, and any obstacle can end the run. Speed and precision are essential to reach the next level.

meta.name: Snake-Pit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.11 KB

Snake Pit is a fast-paced game in which the player controls a character in the shape of a grinning face. The goal is to eat all the eggs that completely fill the single screen space and survive as long as possible to reach the next level. Also in the field are several snakes with a different color. They cannot escape until you drill a hole in their wall by eating the eggs there. Only the Red Snake can move instantly. Once the snakes are free, they will also start eating the eggs and the player character must avoid their heads. Plus, with each egg they eat, their bodies grow longer, which can block their path. There is a strategy that involves walling up the snakes for as long as possible while avoiding the red snake. The goal is to eat all the eggs for the second phase to begin.

meta.name: Snake-Pit

Snake Pit is a fast-paced game in which the player controls a character in the shape of a grinning face. They cannot escape until you drill a hole in their wall by eating the eggs there. Only the Red Snake can move instantly. Once the snakes are free, they will also start eating the eggs and the player character must avoid their heads. Plus, with each egg they eat, their bodies grow longer, which can block their path. There is a strategy that involves walling up the snakes for as long as possible while avoiding the red snake. The goal is to eat all the eggs for the second phase to begin.

meta.name: Snakeout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.57 KB

"Snakeout" is a breakout-style game where you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen, bouncing a ball to break all the bricks above. Unlike classic versions, gaps between blocks allow for clever shots and satisfying combos. The ball speeds up the longer it stays in play, and you have a limited number of balls. Success depends on sharp angles, precise timing, and smart planning. A minimalist yet engaging arcade game with high-score chasing appeal.

meta.name: Snakes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.39 KB

“Snakes” is a competitive two-player duel game that combines elements of classic Snake and Tron gameplay. Each player controls a snake within their own grid, growing longer with each move. The aim is to survive as long as possible without crashing into your own trail or that of the opponent. The split-screen layout keeps things organized, while different speed levels add intensity. Strategy, quick reflexes, and spatial awareness are key to winning this digital showdown.

meta.name: Snakman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.73 KB

“Snakman” is a Pac-Man-like game where the player collects green and red tokens in a maze. Red tokens temporarily make the ghosts vulnerable, allowing them to be captured, while both green and red tokens award points. Gremlins must not touch Snakman, as this results in losing a life. Skilled timing and strategies, such as repeatedly capturing gremlins right after their escape, can lead to high scores. The movement direction remains locked until it is changed or a barrier is reached.

meta.name: SNAP
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

SNAP is an educational game where you solve tasks involving irregular English verbs. Three verb forms appear on the screen, and you must choose the correct one to score points and avoid mistakes. Speed and focus are essential for success and to improve your language skills in a playful way.

meta.name: Snare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.07 KB

Snare puts you in the role of Humphrey, who must recover the princess's gems stolen by aliens at the king's command to avoid execution. Across 30 single-screen levels, you must collect all the gems before time runs out and an earthquake destroys everything. Dangerous aliens, sticky blobs, bombs, teleporters, hidden treasures, and time boosts add to the challenge. A wrong move, an explosion, or running out of time costs one of your five lives.

meta.name: Snare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Snare" te lleva a un laberinto mortal dejado por el adinerado André Thelman, donde deberás navegar en un bote para encontrar el teletransportador correcto al siguiente nivel. Debes saltar agujeros, derribar robots hostiles de diferentes tipos y resolver puzles de interruptores. Ciertas casillas restringen tu movimiento, y todo el nivel gira al girar el bote. Puedes conseguir potenciadores como vidas extra o saltos de nivel, pero solo se activan tras completar el nivel actual.

meta.name: Snipes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.66 KB

Snipes is an educational game for children that teaches letters, numbers and math through playful interaction. You navigate a maze, collecting correct answers while avoiding obstacles and enemies. Depending on the mode, you learn the alphabet, numbers or math – all paired with simple gameplay and immediate feedback. It's ideal for younger players who want to combine learning and fun.

meta.name: Snoball in Hell
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.84 KB

Snoball in Hell es una variante de romper ladrillos mezclada con un shoot'em up. El jugador controla el Snoball, un vehículo similar a un tanque que puede moverse arriba y abajo por el borde izquierdo de la pantalla. El objetivo de cada uno de los 16 niveles del juego es eliminar todos los ladrillos golpeándolos con una bola que rebota, pero aquí también hay muchos enemigos que corren hacia la Snoball. Tienes que dispararles o esquivarlos porque cualquier contacto supone la pérdida de una vida. Perder la pelota también supone la pérdida de una vida y el jugador dispone de cinco vidas en total.
Además de los enemigos, el jugador puede sacar bonificaciones que ayudan y antibonificaciones que entorpecen. Las bonificaciones incluyen puntos extra, velocidad de disparo ralentizada, rebote automático, escudos, vidas extra y salto de nivel, mientras que las antibonificaciones incluyen puntos negativos, velocidad de disparo ralentizada, ...

meta.name: Snodgits
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.84 KB

Han desaparecido objetos de Mystery Manor, el hogar de la familia Snodger y de un grupo de extrañas criaturas llamadas snodgits. Famosos detectives de todo el mundo han sido llamados para investigar los robos. Tú juegas como Benton, el mayordomo chapucero que quiere intentar resolver el caso antes que nadie, al tiempo que presta sus oportunos servicios de mayordomo.
Benton puede empezar el juego en una de las cinco casas. Las casas están formadas por paredes, muebles de todo tipo, objetos coleccionables y habitantes en movimiento. La vista de la casa es isométrica y puede girarse 90 grados pulsando el botón "fuego", lo que a veces es necesario para ver objetos ocultos. También hay disponible una vista en planta del piso actual en la parte inferior de la pantalla.

meta.name: Snokie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Snokie, guías a un pequeño pingüino en un peligroso viaje de regreso a casa a través de un mundo invernal de desplazamiento lateral. Saltas grietas, esquivas rocas y compites contrarreloj. Si tu pingüino muere, el siguiente comienza desde el último punto de control. Los entornos cambian a medida que avanzas, lo que te obliga a cruzar témpanos de hielo y evitar la caída de estalactitas en cuevas. Quienes perseveran se reencuentran con un gran pingüino en su cueva. El juego ofrece un modo normal y uno rápido, y admite dos jugadores por turnos.

meta.name: Snooker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.96 KB

Snooker & Pool is a double pack that includes the games Snooker and 8-Ball Pool. The game is shown from a top-down perspective, allowing you to see the entire table. After the white ball is placed in the semi-circle, you can select the desired direction for the shot by positioning a cursor. Optionally, you can also choose an effect for the shot from eight different directions, and the strength of the shot is determined by moving a power meter. The game can be played against the computer (on three difficulty levels: Beginner, Amateur, and Pro) or against another player. Additionally, the game includes an editor to set up trick shots.

meta.name: Snooker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.91 KB

Snooker simulates the game of snooker, where players take turns using the white ball to strike the red or colored balls according to the rules of the game. The strength of the shot and the spin can be adjusted using the spacebar and arrow keys.

meta.name: Snooker Management
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.32 KB

Snooker Management puts the player in the role of a snooker manager – aiming to climb the world rankings. Beyond playing matches, players can enter tournaments, train, and make strategic decisions. Financial aspects play a crucial role – as prize money, gambling, and banking influence progress. Shady options like match-fixing and loans from dubious lenders are also available. By carefully managing matches, training, and finances – the player must build a successful career across multiple seasons.

Snooper Troops puts you in the role of an investigator solving the mystery of a ghost trying to scare the Kim family out of their new home. Using the SnoopNet computer, you roam the neighborhood, gather clues, and enter empty houses – all while avoiding being caught by the owners. Only those who observe carefully, map out the area, and connect the facts can accuse and convict the culprit behind the scare.

meta.name: Snooper Troops (Case 2) : The Disappearing Dolphin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Snooper Troops (Case 2): The Disappearing Dolphin te lleva a resolver el misterio de Lilly, la delfín desaparecida. Con una linterna, una radio de pulsera y la computadora SnoopNet, investigas la zona, interrogas a los sospechosos, reúnes pistas y descubres la verdad. Solo con razonamiento lógico y tomando notas con cuidado podrás identificar al culpable y hacer que tu acusación sea válida.

meta.name: Snoopy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.64 KB

Snoopy is a classic platformer with twenty single-screen levels where you play as the famous Peanuts dog, moving from left to right while avoiding hazards. After completing all twenty levels, the game restarts with increased speed. It doesn't get easier – just faster.

meta.name: Snoopy to the Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

Snoopy to the Rescue throws you into an action-packed mission to save Woodstock from a castle. In classic side-scrolling style, you run and jump through stages, stop timers to match a target sum, collect keys to freeze enemies, and avoid deadly hazards like water and falls. Only quick thinking, fast moves, and precise jumps will lead to a successful rescue.

meta.name: Snoopy to the Rescue

Only quick thinking, fast moves, and precise jumps will lead to a successful rescue.

meta.name: Snow 'em Down
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.29 KB

In Snow 'em Down, you control a flying sled as you collect snowballs while avoiding enemies. The snowballs you gather can be used to fight off foes. The game features various levels that increase in difficulty, providing festive gaming fun. Quick reactions and skilled movements are necessary to successfully overcome the challenges.

meta.name: The Snow Queen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 89.40 KB

The Snow Queen is a text adventure loosely based on the fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen. You don't control Gerda directly but act as her advisor, helping her rescue her friend Kay who was struck by a shard of a shattered mirror. Gerda may choose to ignore your advice, making it essential to think in character when solving puzzles. The Commodore 64 version adds simple graphics to accompany the text and show each location.

meta.name: Snow Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.06 KB

Snow Run is a simple yet fast-paced game where you guide a skier through a snowy landscape. The goal is to weave between trees for as long as possible without crashing. As the speed increases, quick reflexes and coordination become essential. It's a classic high-score chase where every gap matters.

meta.name: Snow Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Deberás pilotar un F14-LBC "Rapier" en una serie de misiones sobrevolando Colombia. Te encontrarás con misiones terrestres de vuelo libre, destruye laboratorios de drogas, bombardea refinerías, destruye farmacias y destruye el convoy de narcóticos. Además enfrentarás otras misiones de vuelo libre partiendo de tu portaaviones, destruye portaaviones enemigos, destruye barcos con narcóticos y destruye suministros de petróleo enemigos.
En el aire te tendrás que enfrentar con el MiG-27, Su-27, MiG-29 y MiG-31 armados con misiles guiados por calor o por radar.
Podrás elegir entre los pilotos disponibles o crear uno nuevo.
Podrás elegir entre 2 niveles de dificultad: principiante (menos ataques enemigos) o experto (el más peligroso).
El clima afectará a la misión. El buen clima será excelente para el entrenamiento, y la tormenta será peligrosa pero excelente para los ataques, ya que puedes esconderte entre las nubes y acercarte al enemigo sin que se de cuenta.
Tendrás un copiloto que te ayudará, contándote todo lo que está sucediendo en cada momento.
Puedes evitar los misiles enemigos usando tus habilidades, usando reflectores antirradar o ... si no puedes, ¡puedes usar tu paracaídas!

meta.name: Snowball Caper 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.30 KB

Santa Claus is flying across the screen dropping presents. This is a race for two players only to grab as many of those presents as possible. The first player to reach their quota wins the game. Watch out though because there are huge snowballs falling from the screen. If one of those hit you or your opponent, then it will freeze the player for a short period of time. Using the fire button will allow Splidge or his friend to jump.

meta.name: Snowboard Race
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.86 KB

Snowboard Race is a fast-paced racing game where you compete against the computer on a snowy slope. The goal is to pass through each gate as quickly as possible – miss one, and 20 seconds are added to your time. With competitive racing at its core, only the fastest and most accurate make it into the top ten.

meta.name: Snowman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.84 KB

Snowman is a festive single-player shooter where you play as Tom, battling a horde of evil snowmen. After the Abominable Snowman killed your parents, you must take down his sinister minions with icy projectiles. The snowmen change from a grin to an evil scowl before attacking—hit them in time to stop them. Bonus points are awarded if you hit Santa Claus while he's carrying a green gift.

meta.name: The Snowman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.03 KB

The Snowman is a fixed screen platform game based on the book by Raymond Briggs. The objective of the game is to build a snowman which is done by collecting various items and then dropping them off at the right location. This includes snow, clothes, toys and ice. At the same time it's necessary to eat food to stay awake and avoid gas flames which melt the carried snow and ice. It's possible to freeze gas flames by picking up an ice lolly. There are also sleep monsters who send the player to bed if an alarm clock is not carried. The game contains four stages with different items that needs to be collected.

meta.name: Soccer 7
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.35 KB

Soccer 7 is a football management game that puts you in complete control of your team. You handle player training, conduct transfers, and manage both injuries and team morale. Fixture lists, top scorer stats, and manager ratings provide key insights to guide your decisions. The ultimate goal is to achieve success on the pitch while also building your club into the most profitable and dominant side in the league.

meta.name: Soccer Boss
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.71 KB

Take control of a football team in a division below the top one, and try to lead them to glory in both league and European competition. You start with a squad of 12 players, whose names can be changed, but have room for 15 players in total, with chances to buy and sell players. You can take out a bank loan, the level of which depends on your division.
The team's formation can be customised, and as outfield players are not limited to a single position, you can customise the team's strengths and weaknesses in quite a precise way. Matches are played out by listing scorers as they happen, and are followed by a full list of the division's other results. Finances change after each match to to wages, gate receipts, and possible incidents such as riots and illegal player approaches.

meta.name: Soccer Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.43 KB

Soccer Challenge gives you the chance to prove your skills and earn a place on a top football team. Before starting, you choose your kit color and difficulty level, then take on four different tests to show what you can do. Each task demands control, timing, and precise joystick movement to reach the required standard. After that, an assault course combines all the skills and rounds off the sporting test atmosphere.

meta.name: Soccer Cup II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.70 KB

Soccer Cup II is a football management game where you take charge of your club as manager. You assemble your squad, plan training sessions, and handle player transfers. At the same time, you need to manage finances, expand stadium capacity, and set admission fees. Each season presents new challenges, and your success depends on balancing strong performances on the pitch with smart financial management. The ultimate goal is to steadily build your club's strength and lead it to the top of the league.

meta.name: Soccer Director
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.42 KB

Soccer Director puts you in charge of the business side rather than the touchline. Your ultimate goal is to gain majority control of the country's top football clubs by acquiring shares. You buy and sell stock, take out loans, call shareholder meetings, and even place bets to increase your funds. At the end of a season, you must hold at least 501 shares in the top ten clubs to succeed. Strategy, careful planning, and timing are key to building your football empire.

meta.name: Soccer Pinball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.26 KB

Soccer Pinball fuses pinball and football in a fast-paced mashup. Launch the ball across the field, hit defenders to clear the goal, and score three times to advance. Later tables get tougher, and even switch to wild themes like a casino. But whether it's on grass or gambling grounds, hitting the right targets and keeping the ball in play is the key to scoring big. A chaotic blend of sporty flair and pinball madness.

meta.name: Soccer Quiz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Soccer Quiz blends football with trivia – your success depends entirely on your knowledge. You can't freely choose your team, but by answering questions correctly you train and strengthen it, while wrong answers weaken it. During matches, every situation is decided by your answers: on attack, a correct response means a goal, a wrong one is saved; on defense, the right answer blocks the shot, while the wrong one concedes. Starting in Division 4, you climb the ranks to the top league while also competing in the FA Cup and League Cup. With around 2000 questions, the game offers lasting challenge – entirely text-based, with no graphics.

meta.name: Soccer Rivals
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.32 KB

Soccer Rivals is a board game-style soccer management simulation where you compete against up to two opponents – human or AI – to take your team from Division 4 all the way to the Division 1 championship. There are 32 teams to choose from and five difficulty levels. The board consists of squares with symbols that allow actions such as buying or selling players, training, expanding the stadium, adding cameras or managing the youth team. Random events can impact your finances or squad, while a special square triggers an arcade mini-game where you can win money by hitting targets. After each turn you adjust your lineup before the next match is simulated.

meta.name: Soccer Star
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.72 KB

Soccer Star puts you in the role of a football manager starting out with a team from the lowest division. Through smart transfers, solid financial management, and winning matches, you climb the ladder season by season. Your goal is to achieve promotion, secure championships, and succeed in the cup. Just like in real football, you also need to manage finances carefully, as expenses like wages and fees can quickly cause trouble. The game can be saved, allowing you to continue your managerial career at any time.

meta.name: Soccer Supremo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.53 KB

Soccer Supremo is a football management game where you take control of a club and guide it through the season. You select your squad, decide on formations, and manage player transfers by buying and selling talent. Alongside team selection, you also oversee finances, track the league table, and review your club's career record. Every choice impacts your team's strength and match performance. The ultimate goal is to use clever planning and smart transfers to lead your club to success and climb the league rankings.

meta.name: Software House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.43 KB

"Software House" places players in the role of a manager tasked with running a successful gaming company. With unexpected twists and challenges, the game offers insights into the daily life and experiences of development studios like Cult and D&H Games.

meta.name: Software Star
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.49 KB

Software Star puts you in the role of a manager running a computer games company. Your goal is not only to make a profit but also to maintain the title of “Software Star” for ten consecutive months. You decide how much time to invest in game development, hire or fire staff, and manage your team's productivity. Advertising and public relations can be adjusted regionally, with the choice between honesty or hype. Seasonal effects such as weaker summer sales also come into play. At the end of each month you review your financial statement, and once a year the board evaluates your performance – if the results are poor, you risk being fired.

meta.name: Soko-Ban
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Soko-Ban is a classic puzzle game, the basis of numerous clones in the later years. It is set in a warehouse. On each level, the player must push crates (from square to square) to get them onto designated spots; once each crate is on a marked spot, the level is complete. Crates can only be pushed one at a time (so two crates next to each other cannot be pushed together), and cannot be pulled--so it's possible to get a crate stuck in a corner, where it cannot be retrieved! By the last levels, you must plan 40 steps in advance.

“Sokoban 64” is a challenging puzzle game where the player moves boxes in a warehouse to designated storage locations. Strategy and planning are crucial, as movements must be carefully considered to position the boxes correctly without trapping oneself. Each solution requires clever thinking and precise movements.

meta.name: Solar Fox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.72 KB

Solar Fox puts you in control of a spaceship racing through a grid of solar cells that must be collected to progress. Two sentinels patrol the edges, launching deadly fireballs you can only dodge – your ship is unarmed. You can fly at two speeds to adapt to the chaos. If you clear the grid before the “skip-a-rack” timer runs out, you'll earn bonus points and jump ahead a level. The game ends when all your ships are destroyed.

Solar Jetman marks the return of the infamous Jetman – this time, he's chasing riches across space. Piloting a fragile Jetpod, you navigate treacherous caverns, automatically activating a tractor beam to collect loot. But the heavier your haul, the harder it is to control your thrust, making each return to the mothership a tense challenge. Physics, timing, and pure greed collide in this tough-as-nails arcade sequel.

Sun Star puts you in command of a special spacecraft tasked with collecting energy from 16 solar grids. In each level, viewed from a first-person perspective with radar support, you must gather ten energy crystals. Crystals appear when one of four disruptors is shot, but vanish quickly – timing is key. Shooting and crashing drain your ship's energy, which can only be restored via hyper warp. But each warp costs you one collected crystal and can only be used a limited number of times per level.

meta.name: Soldier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Soldier throws you straight into the heat of battle. In the first level, you fight as a lone infantryman armed only with your rifle, blasting your way through waves of enemy troops on the march to town. Next, you take command of a tank to face heavily armed opposition, and finally, you pilot an attack helicopter to break through the last enemy defenses. Survive all three combat stages, and you'll win the war.

meta.name: Soldier of Fortune
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.56 KB

El jugador debe explorar una serie de cavernas subterráneas para matar a los monstruos que hay en su interior. El personaje del jugador puede moverse horizontalmente, saltar y utilizar las armas que encuentre en el laberinto. Cada monstruo requiere un arma específica de suficiente potencia para ser destruido. El jugador debe recorrer las catacumbas y destruir tantos monstruos como pueda en un tiempo limitado. El jugador comienza con 5 vidas, y el juego termina cuando las pierde todas.

meta.name: Soldier of Fortune
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Krillys robó la fuente de energía del Zodíaco y la rompió en seis pedazos. Sarnak fue enviado a buscarla y, con suerte, rescatar a sus amigos Teron, Gorman y Tartarus. Inicialmente viajas a través del bosque de Ebbedown, con una jugabilidad similar a Ghosts and Goblins.
El recorrido es mayoritariamente de izquierda a derecha, aunque también son frecuentes los movimientos descendentes por huecos y los movimientos ascendentes sobre plataformas giratorias. Algunas caídas pueden ser fatales, pero sobre todo aquellas que tienen una plataforma cerca, por lo que son evitables y no puramente aleatorias. Hay muchos teletransportes mágicos en el camino que acortan el viaje. A lo largo de tu misión, se ofrecen vidas adicionales (mediante la recolección de 8 cristales) y armamento mejorado.

meta.name: Soldier of Light
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.26 KB

Encarnas a Xain, el Soldado de la Luz, que debe visitar planetas invadidos y aniquilar a las hordas malignas que atacan a la humanidad. La jugabilidad principal es un shoot 'em up con scroll horizontal: Xain puede saltar, agacharse para esquivar enemigos y trepar a plataformas superiores. A lo largo del camino recoges armas extra —pero las pierdes al perder una de tus cinco vidas. Los planetas Lagto, Cleemans y Cleemalt están disponibles desde el inicio, cada uno con entornos distintos: Cleedos es desértico, Cleemalt, cavernoso, y Lagto, frondoso y verde. Tras completar un planeta, debes volar con éxito al siguiente.

meta.name: Soldier One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Soldier One puts you in the role of a lone fighter who sails to a hostile island, captures it and ultimately storms a fortress where a mad general is hiding – one who is planning further invasions from there. The game spans seven consecutive stages that you must complete to reach your goal. You lose energy each time you're hit, shown by a power bar – once it's empty, it's game over. Ammo is limited and decreases with every shot, with no chance to replenish it. Both your energy and ammunition carry over across all seven stages. Everything is set against the clock, as your high score is determined by your total completion time.

meta.name: Solid I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.51 KB

In Solid I you pilot your ship through a vast starfield as waves of enemy UFOs and fighters close in from every direction. Quick reflexes and accurate shooting are vital to survive and complete your mission. With impressive sound effects and surprisingly detailed C64 graphics, the game delivers pure arcade excitement – three ships, one mission: survive and blast everything that moves.

meta.name: Solitair
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.50 KB

In Solitair you face a classic logic challenge where you must clear the board through careful moves. Jump one piece over another to remove it, planning your sequence so that only one remains at the end. Each level features a unique layout and limited time to find the ideal solution. Precision, foresight, and smart strategy are key to mastering the perfect game.

meta.name: Solitax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.55 KB

In Solitax your goal is to clear the screen of stones by jumping over them – like a futuristic space-themed board puzzle. Each jump removes the stone you leap over, but only if the space beyond is empty. Bonus items like clocks add time, smiling faces grant extra points, and bombs will cost you dearly. As the levels progress, careful planning and precision become vital to success. Strategy, timing, and quick thinking are the keys to conquering this cosmic challenge.

meta.name: Solo Flight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Solo Flight allows you to fly a small plane, the Ryan ST-A with a new look cockpit instrument panel. At the start of the game you have two options, whether to fly the plane for practise or fly the plane for a mail run. You have the choice of six American states to fly over (instead of three in the original) which are Kansas, Washington, Colorado, Michigan, Massachusetts or Texas, each having their own weather and terrain. The games viewpoint is a 3rd person perspective behind the plane again with the joystick and keyboard to control your plane. The game also included speech to help you in flying by giving instructions as you fly.

Solo Flight: 2nd Edition is a new version of the original flight simulator Solo Flight and once again allows you to fly a small aircraft, the Ryan ST-A, with a redesigned cockpit instrument panel. You can choose between six American states to fly over: Kansas, Washington, Colorado, Michigan, Massachusetts or Texas, each with their own weather and terrain. The game also included voice acting to help you fly by giving directions during the flight.nnnnThe actual flying part involves you sitting on a runway, flying in the sky using the keyboard and joystick, and using the joystick to control the plane. A map can be displayed to ensure you are in the right direction. Once you reach another airport you can land.

meta.name: Solomon's Key
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Solomon's Key es un juego de plataformas con elementos de acción y estrategia. En cada nivel debes hallar una llave para desbloquear la salida. Cuentas con una varita mágica que crea o destruye bloques (aunque algunos son indestructibles); organizarlos con cuidado es esencial para moverte con seguridad. Enemigos recorren las pantallas: si te alcanzan, pierdes una vida. Algunos mueren al destruir el bloque donde están; otros hay que esquivarlos. Hay bonificaciones y magia ocultas —incluso dentro de bloques—: tesoros dan puntos extra, y otros permiten lanzar hechizos contra enemigos. Cada nivel tiene un límite de tiempo, lo que incrementa la dificultad.

meta.name: Son of Blagger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.29 KB

„Son of Blagger“ puts you in the role of Slippery Sid, a clever agent following in his father's footsteps. Each level challenges you to collect a number of keys scattered across platforms guarded by robots. With precise jumps and good timing, you must overcome obstacles while keeping an eye on the ticking clock – time is limited. Once you collect all the keys, a doorway opens to the next stage. But be warned – fall too far or miss your chance, and you'll lose a life.

meta.name: Sonar Search
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.12 KB

Sonar Search is a fast-paced strategy game where you command a group of destroyers tasked with hunting down and sinking five enemy submarines. Using sonar equipment, depth charges, and sighting reports from aircraft and other ships, you pursue the enemy vessels. You must be directly over a submarine to land a successful hit, while constant course changes and quick reactions determine your survival.

meta.name: Sonic Boom (Activision)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sonic Boom es un juego de disparos arcade con perspectiva de desplazamiento vertical en el que el jugador es un piloto estadounidense armado con el súper potente avión Sonic Boom. Para evitar la destrucción del mundo, los jugadores deben enfrentarse a enemigos de carne de cañón a lo largo de seis niveles. Sin embargo, hay cinco continuaciones disponibles, cada una con tres vidas. Al final de cada nivel hay un jefe que debe ser derrotado dentro de un límite de tiempo específico para avanzar. La mayoría de los enemigos son aviones, pero también hay tanques, trenes y torretas para aniquilar. Las oleadas de enemigos derrotadas revelan armas mejoradas y otros bonos.

meta.name: Sonic Boom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.10 KB

Sonic Boom turns records and dangerous sound waves into an unusual action game with a fast reaction pace. You have to stop the records from reaching the player and triggering new sonic attacks, while also dodging the deadly waves yourself. This creates a frantic flow where attention and quick decisions are constantly needed. Its appeal lies in the odd premise, the immediate pressure, and the fight against a threat born from music itself.

meta.name: Sonny the Snail
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sonny the Snail is a colorful platformer where you take on the role of the brave snail Sonny, on a mission to save his home, Snail Meadow. You'll jump and slide your way through whimsical levels filled with quirky mushrooms, sparkling gems, and tricky obstacles. It's not just about collecting points – you'll also need to avoid dangers and solve small tasks along the way. With its charming visuals and relaxed yet challenging gameplay, Sonny's adventure is a delightful entry in the world of animal-themed platformers.

meta.name: Sons of Liberty
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Three of the key battles of the American War of Independence are recreated here. The British army and American patriots can be played by either human or computer (with 3 skill levels). Each side's level of reinforcements and ammunition can be set on a 5-point scale. The smallest and shortest battle is Bunker Hill, while the Battle of Monmouth is distinguished by harsh weather, and Saratoga requires a different fighting style to the highly regimented one the British unsuccessfully used.

Three of the key battles of the American War of Independence are recreated here. The British army and American patriots can be played by either human or computer (with 3 skill levels). Each side's level of reinforcements and ammunition can be set on a 5-point scale. The smallest and shortest battle is Bunker Hill, while the Battle of Monmouth is distinguished by harsh weather, and Saratoga requires a different fighting style to the highly regimented one the British unsuccessfully used.

meta.name: Super Froot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.84 KB

Sooper Froot brings the feel of the arcade straight to your living room. You start with a stake of 2.00 and bet 0.10 per spin on landing a winning symbol combo. But it's more than just luck – with features like hold, nudge, and re-spin, you'll test both your fortune and your gambling instincts. Every spin becomes a mix of risk, strategy, and that thrilling hope of hitting it big.

meta.name: Sooty & Sweep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.70 KB

Sooty y Sweep son dos famosos personajes de la televisión británica que llevan más de cincuenta años apareciendo en diversos programas. Este juego de plataformas es el primero protagonizado por estos personajes, que se han metido en un buen lío.
Matthew se ha ido y ha dejado a Sooty a cargo de la casa. El problema es que Sweep ha dejado todos sus viejos huesos por toda la casa y ha dejado la puerta del jardín abierta, permitiendo que entren todo tipo de insectos. El juego consiste simplemente en recoger todos los huesos mientras evitas a las criaturas reptantes que ocupan la casa.

p: Sooty and Sweep's Fun with Numbers (Europe).T64
n: Sooty and Sweep's Fun with Numbers (Europe)

meta.name: Sooty's Fun With Numbers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.79 KB

Sooty's Fun With Numbers brings together six short mathematical tests for children up to around seven years old. With Sooty the silent magic bear and his friends Sweep and Soo, tasks such as counting, addition, number comparison, sorting, and completing number sequences are presented in a playful way. In the final race, several questions must be answered correctly to help Sooty's car reach the finish line and beat Sweep.

meta.name: Sorcerer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.52 KB

Tras derrotar al malvado Krill en "Enchanter", el intrépido aprendiz se ha convertido en un miembro de pleno derecho del Círculo, a las órdenes del famoso Nigromante Belboz. El héroe pronto se da cuenta de que algo extraño le ocurre a su maestro. A menudo habla consigo mismo y parece estar bajo algún tipo de influencia malévola. Un día, es secuestrado misteriosamente. Parece que el valiente Encantador debe emprender de nuevo un peligroso viaje para traer de vuelta al líder del Círculo.
El jugador interactúa con el mundo del juego tecleando combinaciones de verbos y objetos. Vuelve el sistema de hechizos del juego anterior, y ahora el protagonista puede beber pociones mágicas, lo que a veces debe hacer para resolver los rompecabezas del juego.

meta.name: Sorcerer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tras derrotar al malvado Krill en "Enchanter", el intrépido aprendiz se ha convertido en un miembro de pleno derecho del Círculo, a las órdenes del famoso Nigromante Belboz. El héroe pronto se da cuenta de que algo extraño le ocurre a su maestro. A menudo habla consigo mismo y parece estar bajo algún tipo de influencia malévola. Un día, es secuestrado misteriosamente. meta.name: Sorcerer Lord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.20 KB

El ejército del malvado Señor de las Sombras amenaza con invadir la pacífica tierra de Galanor. La alianza de las razas de Galanor se prepara para la guerra.
El movimiento y el combate se basan en turnos. Tú y el Señor de las Sombras reclutáis nuevas tropas alternativamente, movéis ejércitos por un mapa hexagonal e intentáis conquistar guarniciones enemigas. Algunas razas luchan con más fiereza en determinados tipos de terreno. La magia es un elemento aleatorio de poca importancia en las batallas y no está bajo tu control directo.

meta.name: Sorcerer of Claymorgue Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.09 KB

Número 13 de la serie Aventura de Scott Adams, y el primero que nunca se publicó en formato de texto (excepto las versiones BBC, Electron, Dragon y TRS-80). Solon, el Mago Maestro, ha perdido las 13 Estrellas de Poder. Depende de ti, su fiel aprendiz, recuperarlas del Castillo de Claymorgue. Es similar a los demás juegos de SAGA de la serie. ¡Además, hay algo de magia, por supuesto!

meta.name: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.76 KB

The Sorcerer's Apprentice casts you as a young apprentice left behind while your master goes on holiday – and chaos quickly unfolds. In the arcade phase, you must stop enchanted brooms from carrying water to a reservoir, each trip raising the flood level. Meanwhile, other creatures try to weaken the dam. You're equipped with a wand that can freeze the brooms, but only three times per game. With sharp reflexes and strategy, you can hold off the flood long enough to unlock level 2 and earn access to the text adventure.

meta.name: Sorcerer's Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 62.51 KB

Sorcerer's Castle Adventure is a text adventure with a twist. The player starts in an enchanted forest, where every location appears exactly the same, or are they the same location? The goal is to find the Sorcerer's Castle and save the princess, but finding the castle will be the first quest to embark on. Sometimes a Jester will pop from seemingly nowhere to give the player a cryptic hint. Some Commodore 64 versions feature saving and restoring.

meta.name: Sorcery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El jugador asume el papel de un mago cuyo objetivo es encontrar y liberar a 8 compañeros que han sido capturados por un nigromante. El entorno, representado de perfil, se compone de unos cuarenta paneles interconectados por puertas. Para completar su misión, el jugador debe descubrir la utilidad de los numerosos objetos que encuentra por el camino y deshacerse de los enemigos que le amenazan. El jugador sólo dispone de unos minutos para completar la misión, que requiere reflejos, sentido de la orientación, memoria y sentido táctico.
El mago, muy maniobrable, se desplaza volando. Es sensible a la gravedad y se ahoga en cuanto toca el agua. Debajo de la ventana de juego, se muestra el nombre del lugar atravesado, el objeto que se posee en ese momento, el porcentaje de energía restante y la puntuación del juego.

meta.name: Sorry!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Four players take turns drawing cards from a stack, in an attempt to be the first player to move their four pieces from the starting location around the board, and back to the home location. Initially, a player must draw a 1 or a 2 to move their piece out of the starting location. Sliding pieces allow the player to move an extra distance, and if two pieces land on the same location, the original occupying piece is sent back to their home to restart their journey. The player can set any number of the 4 players to be controlled by the computer.

p: SOS - The Game with no Name (Europe).T64
n: SOS - The Game with no Name (Europe)

meta.name: SOS : The Game with no Name
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.57 KB

Sydney the Droid has crash-landed his plane on Alpha Five, and he must search the city for the plane radio so that he can signal a rescue team to his location. While searching for the radio, Sydney must also avoid being eaten by robots that patrol the city. When he gets eaten, one of Sydney's three lives are lost and Sydney restarts from his present location.

meta.name: SOS Terrorists
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.33 KB

SOS Terrorists puts you in the role of Red Leader, commanding a special unit tasked with securing a town under terrorist attack. Before deployment, you must memorize the map, as orientation and quick decisions are crucial while patrolling the area and stopping assaults. Different vehicles allow flexible operations on land, water, and from the air, with every choice directly affecting the mission's outcome. If the situation escalates, it leads to direct confrontations where reflexes and situational awareness determine success or failure.

meta.name: SOS Terrorists II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.30 KB

SOS Terrorists II expands the familiar mission setup and once again puts you in command of an anti-terror squad operating in an unpredictable city. You secure large areas, switch freely between vehicles and weapons, and respond to constantly shifting threats. Planning and situational awareness are just as important as fast reactions, since no two operations play out the same and mistakes have immediate consequences. The appeal comes from blending tactical decision-making with direct action, where every choice can determine success or failure.

p: SOTE - Shadow of the Evil (Germany) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
n: SOTE - Shadow of the Evil (Germany) (Disk 1 Side A)

meta.path: ./SOTE - Shadow of the Evil (Germany) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
meta.name: SOTE : Shadow of the Evil
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

SOTE: Shadow of the Evil sends you into the dark depths of a sprawling dungeon with a party of adventurers you assemble yourself, where danger and mystery await around every corner. You move step by step through maze-like corridors, carefully mapping each level while confronting monsters, traps, and hidden chambers, managing and equipping your party strategically. Awareness, planning, and tactical choices determine your survival – a grim underground adventure that challenges both your sense of exploration and your endurance.
