meta.name: Soulless
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Soulless narra la trágica historia de un poderoso rey guerrero que anhela poner fin al derramamiento de sangre sin fin. Pero sus propios generales lo traicionan, transformando su cuerpo en una bestia mediante magia oscura y robándole el alma. Enterrado y olvidado, la guerra continúa durante mil años. Hasta que un día, un terremoto devastador destroza los muros de la tumba. Liberado, la criatura se propone recuperar su humanidad y finalmente traer la paz a la tierra que ha sufrido durante tanto tiempo.

meta.name: Souls of Darkon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.84 KB

Souls of Darkon takes you to Megron, a planet where science and magic once coexisted in balance. After the power-hungry Great Council unleashed Darkon, the world's knowledge fell into the wrong hands and chaos spread. As the last hope, you set out with your loyal robot companion Komputa to stop the rising darkness. Along the way, you explore strange locations, make crucial decisions and gather clues to defeat Darkon's influence. An atmospheric adventure blending fantasy and technology in an epic struggle.

meta.name: South Pacific Battles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "South Pacific Battles," you take command of the White Fleet to liberate a South Pacific island from the Black Fleet. You control aircraft carriers, patrol planes, bombers, battleships, destroyers, speedboats, and landing craft. Your mission is to strategically bomb and fire upon enemy forces while evading their attacks and taking countermeasures. Success demands skill and tactical thinking.

meta.name: Southern Belle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.20 KB

Southern Belle is a train simulation video game published by Hewson Consultants in 1985. Southern Belle was unique at the time of release in that it was the first 3D steam train simulator available for home computers. The game allows the user to take over the fireman and/or driver duties on a King Arthur class passenger steam locomotive on the London to Brighton line.

meta.name: Space - The Ultimate Frontier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Space - The Ultimate Frontier." Red alert, red alert! These are the voyages of the starship Enterprise. It is a five-year mission: to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations. To boldly go where no one has gone before, and shoot aliens with charged particle weapons!

meta.name: Space Academy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.09 KB

In Space Academy, you take on the role of a recruit undergoing various trials to test your skill and reflexes. First, you complete fitness training with tasks such as running, balancing on a rope, hurdling, dodging obstacles, and crawling through tight tunnels filled with laser traps. After the fitness training, you move on to weapons training, where you must shoot down obstacles or avoid them while navigating courses. Depending on the task, you either move automatically or fully control your character, including the ability to fly. Some trials require you to destroy a set number of targets, while others simply involve reaching the end of the course.

meta.name: Space Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.12 KB

In Space Ace you pilot a spaceship through open space while destroying drifting objects around you. As you move freely across the screen, new hazards appear that must be avoided or shot down. Each successful hit increases your score, but a collision will cost you one of your ships. As the game continues the challenge grows with more objects appearing in space. Quick reflexes and precise control are essential to survive as long as possible.

meta.name: Space Ace 2101
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.27 KB

In Space Ace 2101 you play as a bounty hunter living in a newly colonized star system that has come under attack by hostile aliens. Your mission is to locate the source of the invading ships and destroy it to save the colonies. Using your spacecraft, you explore different parts of the system, fight enemy vessels and search for the origin of the invasion. Along the way you must manage resources such as fuel, speed and shield strength. Only by finding and destroying the source of the attacks can you protect the colonies.

meta.name: Space Assassin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.81 KB

In "Space Assassin," you fly over enemy bases while battling through tight corridors and along pipelines. Enemy fire centers attack in continuous sequences and from various directions, including diagonal paths. Your mission is to dodge the shots and destroy as many enemies as possible. With precise timing and quick reactions, you overcome the steadily increasing challenges. The game can be played solo or simultaneously with a second player. Good luck!

meta.name: Space Battle Deluxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Battle Deluxe is a simple strategy game for up to four players (Lords) and optionally a computer opponent "Deep Jones", who is, however, not the brightest. Each player commands a fleet of spaceships and tries to conquer a randomly calculated galaxy, which on many planets is already inhabited by neutral peoples (natives). At the beginning each participant chooses his home world. The first player then enters his commands ("from which planet to which fly xx spaceships) invisibly. In the status window he can then see his worlds with an overview of production rate per year and the stock of ships. The game ends after a given number of game years (10 - 999). The a report is created to find the winner. This game is the forerunner to Advanced Space Battle.

meta.name: Space Battle Deluxe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Battle Deluxe is a simple strategy game for up to four players (Lords) and optionally a computer opponent "Deep Jones", who is, however, not the brightest. Each player commands a fleet of spaceships and tries to conquer a randomly calculated galaxy, which on many planets is already inhabited by neutral peoples (natives). At the beginning each participant chooses his home world. The first player then enters his commands ("from which planet to which fly xx spaceships) invisibly. In the status window he can then see his worlds with an overview of production rate per year and the stock of ships. The game ends after a given number of game years (10 - 999). The a report is created to find the winner. This game is the forerunner to Advanced Space Battle.

meta.name: Space Belt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.59 KB

In "Space Belt," you pilot a spaceship to face enemy attacks. Dodge incoming fire, shoot down enemies, and fight through waves of opponents to successfully complete your mission.

meta.name: Space Bomber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.18 KB

In Space Bomber, you take on the role of an attacker bombing cities. Your mission is to destroy the cities while dodging their defensive fire. Precision and timing are crucial to coordinating your attacks and achieving success.

meta.name: Space Combat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Space Combat, two players face off in a head-to-head duel, each piloting a spaceship. In the space arena, the goal is to outmaneuver and defeat the opponent through precise control and well-aimed shots. Strategy and quick reactions are key to emerging victorious.

meta.name: Space Crusade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Space Crusade you command a squad of Space Marines sent on missions aboard hostile alien starships. You control a commander and several marines who move through the ship's corridors in turn-based fashion while battling alien forces. Each mission has primary and secondary objectives, such as eliminating all enemies or destroying critical targets. As the commander progresses through the ranks, you must carefully plan your moves and use your marines strategically. During combat the game sometimes switches to dramatic close-up views, adding extra tension to the battles.

meta.name: Space Doubt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.91 KB

You are cryofrozen on a spaceship. Suddenly, you are awakened because aliens called Bogloids are attacking the vessel. The first thing you do is go get your proton beam. This proton beam can be used to kill Bogloids but the other thing it is for is to repair the holes the Bogloids created. Once the hole is repaired, your proton bream's power has been drained. This means you must get a new proton beam to continue your mission. You have a total of nine-hundred ninety-nine seconds to fix the ship and kill the invaders. If a Bogloid touches you, you die and the next astronaut in the cryofreezer is awakened. As there are three of you, that equates to three lives. If all lives are lost or the time runs out, then the ship will proceed to the planet Niblondis it was set for on automatic pilot and the Bogloids will then eat the entire population.

meta.name: Space Dunk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Space Dunk," you begin as an adventurer reminiscent of Indiana Jones before transitioning into two action-packed levels where you must pilot your spaceship through enemy attacks. Following this, you're faced with a challenge requiring you to skillfully dodge falling blocks. Precision and quick reflexes are essential to successfully complete all tasks.

meta.name: Space Fiends
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.49 KB

In "Space Fiends," you take control of a spaceship to protect a research base from aliens abducting geologists during their work. You move along the bottom of the screen, firing upward to destroy waves of attacking aliens dropping bombs. To rescue scientists, you must shoot the aliens holding them captive. Additional aliens appear on the surface, moving across the screen. If you touch them or are hit by a bomb, you lose one of your six lives. Your mission is to safeguard the scientists and eliminate all the aliens.

meta.name: Space Fight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.10 KB

In "Space Fight," you battle countless space enemies in a vertically scrolling shooter. With autofire activated, you can dive straight into the fray, but caution is essential as you have only a limited number of ships. Skill and perseverance are crucial to surviving the seemingly hopeless fight.

meta.name: Space Fight (edmans Data)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.56 KB

“Space Fight” is a vertically scrolling space shooter where you pilot a Tie Fighter-like spacecraft. Your mission is to eliminate all enemies in deep space and above massive space stations before they take you out. Quick reflexes and precision are the keys to success.

meta.name: Space Freeze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.75 KB

In "Space Freeze," you patrol the galaxy when enemy ships suddenly appear. Your ship is equipped with a state-of-the-art laser shield that instantly destroys intruders. The enemies grow increasingly faster, and if you take six hits, you and your ship freeze. Your mission is to fend off the foes with lightning-fast laser action and escape the icy threat. Get ready for a nerve-wracking flight through space!

meta.name: Space Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Space Gold," two players face off in a duel. The game offers an intense simultaneous gameplay experience where skill and quick reactions determine the winner. Get ready to outmaneuver your opponent in action-packed space battles.

meta.name: Space Gun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Gun nos traslada al año 2039. Los humanos comienzan a explorar el espacio en busca de nuevas formas de vida y fuentes de combustible utilizables. Pero lo que descubre son problemas. En el borde de la galaxia, otras criaturas que deambulan por los sistemas planetarios han descubierto que los humanos y las naves espaciales son excelentes fuentes de alimento y recursos para cubrir sus necesidades. Preparadas para enfrentamientos con otros equipos de exploración rivales, las tripulaciones humanas poco pueden hacer para defenderse mientras oleadas de criaturas de pesadilla descienden sobre sus naves y bases.
En respuesta a sus llamadas de socorro, la Federación ha reunido una serie de equipos de rescate liderados por sus mejores francotiradores militares para hacer frente a la amenaza alienígena. Como líder de uno de estos equipos, debes derribar a los intrusos y recoger a los supervivientes humanos.

meta.name: Space Gunner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.94 KB

In "Space Gunner," you defend the planet Namcap against the fleet of the Warlords of Zorlon. From a cockpit perspective, you control the crosshair with the joystick to target and destroy enemy ships. Your fuel supply increases by absorbing energy from exploding Zorlon ships. The challenge intensifies as you progress, testing your skill and precision. The control panel keeps you informed of your fuel level and score at all times.

meta.name: Space Harrier
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Corre… vuela… esquiva los obstáculos, pero contraataca oleada tras oleada de alienígenas. Armado con una arma descomunal, debes defenderte de las hordas extraterrestres usando la cabeza para moverte hábilmente por la pantalla. ¡Pero cuidado con los jefes finales de cada nivel!

meta.name: Space Harrier II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Harrier II sigue (muy de cerca) los pasos de su predecesor y te involucra a ti (un Space Harrier) para salvar "Fantasy Land". Esto, combinado con los muchos colores llamativos y destellantes que el juego arroja sobre ti. Hay 13 etapas para completar lanzando chorros y bombardeando a los malos y a los jefes a medida que se acercan. El juego se juega detrás del personaje principal y el paisaje se apresura en 3D similar al efecto utilizado en muchos juegos de coches como Outrun. El juego usa muchos de los enemigos y jefes del primer Space Harrier, pero también agrega una serie de nuevos.

meta.name: Space Hawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.12 KB

Space Hawk is a game where the player controls a vehicle and drives along a track. The goal is to stay on the track and avoid collisions with the walls, requiring quick reflexes and precise control. As the game progresses, the track becomes more challenging, with tighter turns and more difficult sections that increase the difficulty. The game is controlled with a joystick, requiring fast and precise movements to keep the vehicle on track.

meta.name: Space Hero : The Hero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.71 KB

In the distant future, Earth is being attacked by alien ships seeking to steal its natural resources. As the most experienced pilot, you have been chosen to destroy the aliens' headquarters. To do so, you must fight your way through all the defense levels. Three spaceships are available to you, and additional ships will be unlocked with each level you complete. If you manage to survive all nine levels, you will return to Earth as a hero.

meta.name: Space Hopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.72 KB

Space Hopper is an educational game designed to help children develop basic number skills for the numbers 0 to 9. Players control a Terratruck to load the Space Hopper from the space depot while comparing quantities to determine if they are greater than, less than, or equal to each other.

meta.name: Space Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.75 KB

In Space Hunter you set out on a dangerous mission to gather food for Earth. With no supplies left on the planet and previous expeditions having failed, you must explore distant star systems while facing hostile alien races that guard valuable resources. You travel through fifteen star systems and rise in rank as you complete successful missions. A radar system helps you locate enemy ships while you monitor your fuel, ammunition, and shields. To collect food and replenish supplies you must land on planets, where the game shifts to a top-down view and you explore maze-like environments in search of resources.

meta.name: Space Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.75 KB

This conversion of Space Invaders stays very true to the original despite being written in BASIC. Game play is exactly the same with the player in control of a tank at the bottom of the screen firing at advancing aliens. The aliens fire back and the player can take cover behind bunkers. The bunkers give way a little bit easier than in the arcade version due to fewer pixels. The sound also tries to stay true to the original with the ever increasing speed of the beat when the aliens draw nearer.

meta.name: Space Journey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Space Journey" is an educational program designed to motivate children to practice and improve their percentage calculation skills. In a two-minute mission, they must intercept meteors or land on planets by solving percentage problems correctly. Mistakes result in being lost in space. Three difficulty levels provide varied and engaging practice for one of the most challenging math skills.

meta.name: Space Knight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.44 KB

In Space Knight, you pilot a combat ship in a vertically scrolling space adventure. In the year 2073, the Alpha-Pluto Base was attacked by the Rovolians, leaving only a few survivors who took refuge in radioactive deposits shielded by lead walls. To aid them, you embark on a perilous mission in your Space Knight fighter. The enemy Rovolians have taken control of the base's defense systems and use them against you while their shuttles attack in waves. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to fend off the assaults and rescue the survivors.

meta.name: Space Lords : Centaurus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Lords: Centaurus pits four mighty rulers against each other in a furious battle for galactic dominance. Each controls a space station on the edge of a vast spiral nebula, defending it by deflecting glowing plasma orbs with their shields while hurling attacks at their rivals. Fast-paced matches, sharp reflexes, and chaotic energy make this cosmic showdown a wild and addictive party experience.

meta.name: Space Mania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.27 KB

“Space Mania” is a classic shooter in the style of “Galaga” or “Galaxian.” As the last survivor of the GERXI 21 moon base, you must defend yourself against waves of attacking aliens. Using a ground-to-air laser cannon, you aim to hit as many enemies as possible while dodging their attacks. Each contact with an alien costs a life. If you complete the game, you'll need to reload it to play again.

meta.name: Space Mates
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.91 KB

Space Mates es un shoot 'em up de ritmo rápido diseñado exclusivamente para dos jugadores.
Juntos, deben defenderse de las naves enemigas antes de que atraviesen los escudos y ataquen su base. La coordinación y los reflejos rápidos son clave para sobrevivir a las oleadas de enemigos y asegurar la supervivencia de la base.

meta.name: Space Math
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Space Math" combines mental arithmetic with gameplay reminiscent of "Lunar Lander". The player must safely land a spaceship by solving math problems. There are three difficulty levels and five problem categories, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, or a mix of all. Each correct answer helps keep the spaceship under control and ensures a safe landing.

meta.name: Space Mayhem
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.42 KB

"Space Mayhem" is a space shooter designed to taking alternating turns. Players face waves of alien enemies that become progressively faster and more aggressive. Quick reflexes and strategic thinking are essential to survive and achieve the highest score. The game features 11 distinct waves where players must succeed through precise shooting and skillful dodging.

meta.name: Space Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.13 KB

“Space Mission” is a text-based survival adventure where the player must fight to stay alive after crashing on Mars. With only 24 hours of oxygen and limited resources – a ray gun with four shots, binoculars, a pint of water, and four hand grenades – the goal is to reach the supply base 200 miles away. The environment offers different paths, but sand dunes, hills, and mountains create obstacles. Every decision matters to complete the mission and survive.

meta.name: Space Pig Duel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.74 KB

In Space Pig Duel, you take on the role of Commander Pork, facing off against the evil Baron von Oinkhofen, one of the most feared enemies in the entire universe. Your spaceship is slower and less well-armed than the Baron's, but with quick reflexes and the powerful LARD missiles (Largely Automatic Rapid Discharge), you have a chance to win. The game tests your dexterity and reaction speed as you defend against enemy attacks and battle the Baron. The player who shoots faster and flies smarter will come out victorious in this epic duel.

meta.name: Space Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.25 KB

Space Racer es un juego de carreras de acción con temática de ciencia ficción. El jugador controla una aeromoto futurista y compite contra vehículos similares controlados por la CPU. Las carreras tienen lugar en entornos con temática del espacio exterior, que se asemejan a superficies de planetas alienígenas. El jugador debe intentar evitar colisiones con las otras bicicletas para llegar primero a la meta; una forma más violenta de resolver el mismo problema implica disparar a los oponentes. La altitud de la hoverbike depende de su velocidad: cuanto más rápido va, más lejos del suelo está y viceversa.

meta.name: Space Relief
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.55 KB

In Space Relief you pilot a stolen Star Five Tessican Gunfighter through the territory of the Tessican Federation. Stranded in the system, you have hijacked the ship and must now fight your way across dangerous regions. As you fly over various landscapes, enemy pilots and defenses attack in waves, forcing you to shoot them down while avoiding their fire. Quick reflexes and accurate shooting are essential if you want to survive and make progress through the hostile territory.

meta.name: Space Rendez Vous
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Space Rendez Vous, two players face off in a race to score 10 points first. But it's not about destruction – points are earned by achieving a “rendezvous,” which only happens when a player lands or crashes. With split-screen action, players must manage their movement, radar, and energy carefully, watching for the perfect moment to intercept. It's a quiet yet tactical duel where precision and timing determine the victor.

meta.name: Space Ric-o-shay
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.80 KB

Space Ric-o-shay drops you into a sudden assault on an alien mothership above a remote outpost. You control a small ship, move sideways and fire upward while a massive enemy patrols horizontally and shoots back. Successful hits break the ship into segments that create new tactical options – destroyed fragments turn into bumpers that deflect future objects. Precision and timing are key, as collisions cost lives and the tension rises with each appearance of a larger foe.

meta.name: Space Rider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.36 KB

In Space Rider you take the role of a jetpack test pilot sent to a distant planet to try out new equipment. Once you arrive, you discover that the planet is inhabited by hostile aliens and giant insects. Using your jetpack you hover across the landscape, fighting enemies with your weapon while collecting gems scattered around the planet. The low gravity makes controlling the jetpack tricky, so precise movement and good timing are essential to survive and gather as many gems as possible.

meta.name: Space Rogue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Rogue es un juego híbrido que combina una simulación de vuelo espacial y combate con elementos de comercio y rol, como la interacción entre personajes y una estructura basada en misiones con una trama principal. El vuelo espacial tiene lugar en dos modos diferentes: Vuelo de crucero, ideal para viajes rápidos, y vuelo newtoniano, ideal para el combate y el vuelo de precisión. La exploración y el combate en 3D también se llevan a cabo desde distintas vistas de cámara. Cada sistema planetario tiene una variedad de destinos y obstáculos que atravesar.

meta.name: Space Rogue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Rogue es un juego híbrido que combina una simulación de vuelo espacial y combate con elementos de comercio y rol, como la interacción entre personajes y una estructura basada en misiones con una trama principal. El vuelo espacial tiene lugar en dos modos diferentes: Vuelo de crucero, ideal para viajes rápidos, y vuelo newtoniano, ideal para el combate y el vuelo de precisión. La exploración y el combate en 3D también se llevan a cabo desde distintas vistas de cámara. Cada sistema planetario tiene una variedad de destinos y obstáculos que atravesar.

meta.name: Space Rox
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.48 KB

Space Rox is a skill-based game in which the player controls a small blue spaceship and must evade incoming meteors. The meteors, represented as stars, continuously move from bottom to top across the screen. Quick reflexes are required to navigate safely through the chaos and survive as long as possible.

meta.name: Space Search
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.44 KB

In Space Search you pilot a spaceship through space in search of a planet capable of supporting life. As you travel between different planets you must steer carefully, because colliding with one will destroy your ship. If you approach a planet closely without hitting it, you can refuel and check whether it is the habitable world you are looking for. Careful navigation and precise control are essential to complete your mission.

meta.name: Space Sentinel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.48 KB

Space Sentinel places you in orbit above Earth, desperately fending off an alien invasion. Enemies swarm from all directions, and your only task is to blast them before they destroy the planet. No levels, no progress – just you, your laser, and a last stand to save Earth. The longer you survive, the more chaotic it becomes. A strange shooter that wastes no time.

meta.name: Space Ship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.25 KB

In Space Ship you find yourself on an alien planet where robots have stolen your spacecraft. To escape, you must search through several rooms of a base to locate your ship. Hostile robots roam the area and will electrify you if they manage to capture you. You must avoid them and carefully explore the rooms until you find your spacecraft. If you succeed, you can escape and warn Earth about the robots' planned attack.

p: Space Shuttle - A Journey into Space (USA).T64
n: Space Shuttle - A Journey into Space (USA)

meta.name: Space Shuttle : A Journey into Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.62 KB

Space Shuttle es un juego de simulación en el que eres el piloto del transbordador espacial Discovery. Tu objetivo es lanzar el transbordador Discovery, establecer una órbita alrededor de la Tierra, abrir las puertas de la bahía de carga y recuperar un satélite para repararlo, y finalmente aterrizar el transbordador con éxito, utilizando el menor combustible posible. Cada vez que se completa toda la misión, se repite en un nivel de dificultad superior (en los niveles de dificultad más altos, el satélite tiene una trayectoria de vuelo más errática). El juego se desarrolla desde una perspectiva en primera persona en la cabina del transbordador espacial, donde puedes controlarlo todo, desde los motores del transbordador hasta las puertas de la bahía de carga. Al final del juego obtendrás una clasificación basada en el número de acoplamientos con éxito y la cantidad de combustible utilizado.

meta.name: Space Station Hippy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.42 KB

In Space Station Hippy you defend a space station from waves of attacking alien swarms. Using a cannon connected to the station, you fire in the direction you are moving to destroy the approaching enemies. The aliens arrive in successive waves, and clearing them allows you to progress to the next attack. You begin with only a small number of lives, but earning enough points can grant additional ones. Quick reflexes and accurate shooting are essential to keep the station safe.

meta.name: Space Station Oblivion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.13 KB

El planeta Evath tiene dos lunas, Mitral y Triscupid. Mitral ha sido brutalmente explotada por unos forajidos, los Ketar, que han huido de la luna. En el subsuelo de Mitral se han formado grandes bolsas de gas, y si Mitral explota, miles de evathianos serán aniquilados al salir Evath de su órbita y la congelación acabará con toda la población del planeta. Los científicos han descubierto que un meteorito se aproxima y chocará contra Mitral en pocas horas, una auténtica catástrofe.
Tu misión es asegurar cada uno de los 18 sectores de Mitral colocando un equipo de perforación sobre las bolsas de gas que existen en cada sector antes de que el meteorito impacte contra el planeta.

meta.name: Space Stations
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.21 KB

In Space Stations you command a small rocket while learning basic number skills. Your task is to choose the planet that matches the number of solar panels displayed on your rocket, helping you associate quantities with their correct number symbols. As more space stations are successfully placed, the planets begin to move in unusual ways, adding an extra challenge to the matching process. The game is designed for younger players and helps develop early mathematical understanding.

meta.name: Space Talisman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.94 KB

“Space Talisman” is an early version of “Hero of the Golden Talisman” and differs in several aspects, including music, screen content, enemies, and an unusual swimming animation. The game made its way into the scene and circulated under various names, such as “Labyrinth” and “Progfine.” In Italy, it was released under the title “Minaccia al Mondo.”

meta.name: Space Taxi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Trabajas como taxista en una ciudad del siglo 23 y ganas tu dinero conduciendo pasajeros por esta loca ciudad. Cuando haces tu trabajo rápido y bien, serás recompensado, después de jugar con éxito los 24 niveles, que representan las 24 horas del día, un nivel de bonificación llamado "Pantalla misteriosa" y una pantalla final. En el juego Space Taxi, vuelas un taxi y llevas a los pasajeros de plataforma en plataforma o al siguiente nivel. La dirección del taxi debe hacerse con cuidado, ya que aterrizar demasiado fuerte, tocar los bordes de obstáculos y personajes o una colisión con elementos voladores como pelotas, cometas, etc., significará un choque.

meta.name: Space Towers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Towers is a fast-paced platform game where you climb through multi-level structures, collect keys and smash specific platforms to open new paths. Not every surface is safe – some crumble, others vanish or only offer temporary protection. As you jump and plan your route, various enemies with distinct behaviors try to disrupt your progress. Timing and awareness are crucial, since you have limited time to finish each level, grab bonuses and reach the exit.

meta.name: Space Train
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.58 KB

In Space Train you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen and try to stop a chain of enemy segments forming the “space train” before it reaches you. The train moves across the playfield in waves while gradually descending, and you must shoot its segments to break it apart. At the same time additional hazards appear that you must avoid. Quick reflexes and accurate shooting are essential to destroy the train in time and survive the attack.

meta.name: Space Trap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.82 KB

In Space Trap, you escape a prison beneath planet Morgon and enter a maze of tunnels. Oxygen is running low and deadly robots are in pursuit – some can be destroyed, others cannot. You must race through the corridors, monitor your oxygen supply, and reach a space scooter that takes you through a tunnel to more air and a tougher new level.

meta.name: Space Trip
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Trip sends you on dangerous away missions where you teleport onto various starships. First, you must locate a zap phaser, charge it, and use it to fend off the aliens onboard. Once the enemies are dealt with, your final task is to find the console and beam yourself out again. Each mission tests your reflexes and sense of direction if you want to make it back alive.

meta.name: Space Tunnel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.64 KB

Space Tunnel launches you off Earth in a lightning-fast, highly maneuverable spaceship as you attempt to survive seven brutal space tunnels. Only sharp reflexes and perfect control will get you through. Each tunnel demands your full focus – stay still, and your time runs out. Don't relax, and don't forget your balance, because even the smallest mistake could end your mission.

meta.name: The Space Vegetable Corps
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this 2D action game, the player controls a maintenance engineer who has become stranded on a deserted planet at the edge of the universe. It is the year 2040, and humanity is transforming moons into giant greenhouses. The protagonist, broke and with no way back, joins the Space Vegetable Corps to earn his way home. On three moons (Phobos, Deimos, Riscos), he must protect vegetables in domes, fend off aliens, and collect specific types of vegetables to meet daily objectives. Flying aliens steal domes, which can be destroyed if too many are killed. Some creatures release oxygen upon death, refilling the spacesuit. The vegetables grow in cycles and must be harvested at the right time. The game ends if all domes are destroyed or the oxygen runs out. The top 10 gardeners are saved in a high score table.

meta.name: Space Walk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Space Walk places you on the deadly planet Arkion, where the surface is covered by a corrosive ocean. To survive, inhabitants must stay airborne using rocket backpacks. Fuel is scarce, and survival turns into a daily aerial battle. As a Gravinaut, you fight for higher positions in the sky, slamming into rivals to destabilize their gyros and destroy their backpacks. Fuel is stored on massive floating ice glaciers of frozen chemicals, and you must navigate to them to refuel. The higher the glacier, the better the fuel – but also the tighter the security. Only those who fight smart and manage their energy wisely will survive.

meta.name: Space Walk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.89 KB

Space Walk puts you in control of an astronaut navigating space to retrieve a stray satellite. You must dodge or shoot incoming asteroids and other spacewalkers. Once you've collected the satellite, you need to hold the fire button to keep it secured as you return it to your ship. The level is completed once the satellite is safely inside, and the game continues to the next stage, where hazards move faster and become more challenging.

meta.name: Space Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Space Warrior you pilot a spacecraft from a cockpit-style 3D perspective while battling enemy ships in space. As you fly through the starfield, hostile craft appear on your radar and in front of you. Your goal is to lock onto them with your targeting system and destroy them before they can damage your shields. Each enemy destroyed increases your score, but hits will reduce your shield strength. Quick reactions and accurate aiming are essential to survive and achieve a high score.

meta.name: Space Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Space Warrior you fight in a chaotic universe left in turmoil after a devastating intergalactic war. Outlaws and dangerous enemies roam through space, spreading panic while plundering defenseless citizens. Piloting your spacecraft, you battle these hostile forces and try to restore order. As you progress you can upgrade your ship, making it stronger and better equipped for the growing threats. Defeat all enemies and you will ultimately earn the title of Space Warrior.

meta.name: Space Warriors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.59 KB

Space Warriors blends tactical board-game thinking with a futuristic space theme. Two sides face off on a symmetrical board, moving their units turn by turn and engaging in direct battles whenever opposing pieces meet. Each unit has its own strengths, making positioning and timing crucial. The appeal lies in balancing offense and defense while combining long-term strategy with fast, decisive confrontations.

meta.name: Space-Ball II : Race in Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.56 KB

In Space-Ball II: Race in Space you control a ball racing along a futuristic track in outer space. The game can be played by one or two players who compete to navigate the course as quickly and skillfully as possible. During the race you must avoid obstacles and carefully control your ball to stay on track. Quick reactions and precise timing are essential to maintain control and beat your opponent. The strange race takes place in a surreal dimension where the protagonist has ended up and from which he can only escape by winning the great Space Ball race.

meta.name: Space-Pilot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.76 KB

Space Pilot throws you into a time-spanning battle above an endless sky, where you fight waves of enemy aircraft with complete freedom of movement. Your jet flies in all directions, but the goal never changes: shoot down enemies, dodge screen-filling chaos, and face off against a boss guarding the path to the next era. From biplanes and helicopters to futuristic UFOs, each time zone brings fresh foes, mounting tension, and relentless action. Only those with steel nerves can survive the flight from 1919 to 2001.

meta.name: Space-Pilot II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.86 KB

In Space-Pilot II you pilot a spacecraft across an endless playfield where enemies attack from every direction. Your ship moves at a constant automatic speed, allowing you to focus on maneuvering and shooting. Destroying enemy ships earns points and gradually drains a time meter shown on the screen. Once the meter is completely empty, all enemies vanish and the game moves on to the next stage. Unlike the earlier game, all levels now take place in space with surreal and futuristic backdrops.

meta.name: Spacebike Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.38 KB

„Spacebike Simulator“ is a high-octane sci-fi shooter that puts you on the GTX Armored-Bike and launches you straight into the action. With fast-paced spinning movement, you blast your way through levels filled with interactive visuals and face off against some of the ugliest aliens ever to hit the screen. Watch ancient temples crumble as you bombard them with plasma bolts – but don't get too distracted, because at the end of each level awaits a powerful guardian that will demand every weapon you can get your hands on. And when it comes to pure firepower, you won't be disappointed. Just be sure to collect every coin dropped by the goo you destroy along the way – they might make all the difference.

meta.name: Spacebomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.42 KB

Spacebomb gives you a double challenge: first you must land your spacecraft safely before the mission even begins. Then comes a tense maze where touching a single wall means failure. Somewhere inside the tunnels lies a hidden atomic bomb, and you have only two minutes to find and disable it. Precise control, steady nerves, and sharp awareness determine whether you make it out in time—or vanish in the blast.

meta.name: Spacefighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Spacefighter tells the story of humanity's last beacon of hope. After centuries of oppression by the cold-blooded lizard race known as the Extruders, you take command of the Eagle MK3 to resist the empire. Your mission is to seek the legendary Blue Gene on the planet Intro – humanity's final chance for salvation. The journey begins on the peaceful oxygen world Ilfus, at the edge of the Pegus system, with your ship equipped only with the basics: a take-off device and a class 4 bug laser. With only 100 credits to your name, you must first gather resources – the fastest way being to capture animals. From there, a dangerous mission unfolds, pushing you deep into enemy territory.

meta.name: Spaghetti Western Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.90 KB

Como Clint Westband, el jugador encarna a un cazador de recompensas que va en caza de los desesperados en el salvaje oeste. Recorriendo las calles tiene que disparar a los bandidos para obtener más recompensa (en el trayecto puede recoger dinamita y lanzar a ciertos objetos), bolsas de dinero extra y llaves para abrir puertas. También hay objetos que se pueden recoger como fantasmas, escorpiones y avispones, los cuales si no se tiene cuidado pueden terminar matando a Clint. Asegúrate de no disparar a espectadores o parte de tu recompensa sera mermada.

meta.name: The Spanish Treasure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.88 KB

The Spanish Treasure is a text-based spy adventure full of danger and twists. As an international agent, you parachute out after your pilot is shot – and once on the ground, you're the next target. Now you must survive, follow clues, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the treasure. Only those who act wisely will retrieve the prize and return safely to Britain.

meta.name: Spare Change
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Spare Change, you are the owner and operator of the Spare Change Arcade, committed to ensuring your business runs as smoothly as possible. In the arcade there are coin machines, jukeboxes, telephones, cinema booths, popcorn machines and so on. The coin machines must be replenished with money from the cash register when they run out of tokens, but eventually the register must be replenished with cash from the safe. You must drop the tokens into one of your two storage containers. Once you have saved at least ten tokens, the cinema booth will open and you can go inside to move on to the next level. You will also receive a bag of money, but if you hold more than ten tokens, more than one bag of money will be awarded for each additional token collected. Getting nine bags full of money will take you to the next level.

meta.name: Sparkk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.35 KB

In Sparkk you set out on a dangerous quest to recover a stolen formula – your journey leads you into an abandoned castle where you must make your way down into the basement. While enemies are present, the real threat is time constantly running out. Every move must count, as only those who act quickly and stay focused will manage to find the formula and escape in time.

meta.name: Spartacus : The Swordslayer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are Spartacus and you are a Gladiator planning to rebel against the Roman Empire by escaping from slavery and releasing all the other slaves from the Roman Crassus. Sword Slayer is a fighting game where the game is viewed from the side and you must fight various opponents one at a time with your sword and shield as well as face an Eagle that swoops in. Once you have escaped the Arena you must defend against arrows flying towards you at different heights from the right of the screen. You and your opponent have three parts of energy. As you hit and block your opponent you attempt to get a clean hit and if a hit connects then the person hit loses a part of their energy. Lose all three and it's game over. The game also allows another player to play and that person plays as your opponents.

meta.name: Spatial Billiard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.90 KB

Billiards (in this case referring to English Billiards) is a game that is popular not just in England but around the world thanks to its popularity during the time of the British Empire. Billiards is a cue sport that is played by two players and utilities one object ball and two cue balls. Each player uses a different color cue ball and attempts to score more points than their opponent and reach the previously agreed total required to win the match. In this version instead of playing on a flat surface you play in a 3D type mode with the pocket at the bottom. Released in Commodore's "Fantasy Five" collection.

meta.name: Special Agent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Special Agent throws you into Moscow, where you must aid Agent Felix “The Cleaner” Hoover, who has been discovered while trying to steal blueprints for a secret Soviet spacecraft from KGB headquarters. Your mission is to help him finish the job and escape. Across scrolling levels, you'll battle KGB agents with your weapon, search doors for money, documents, bonuses, and the all-important key. Elevators allow you to move between floors, but beware: falling too far or taking a bullet will cost you one of your five lives. Only with skill and perseverance can you complete the mission.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Special Agent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.68 KB

Special Agent challenges you to track down Spectre, a ruthless hitman determined to eliminate your network across Europe. As the top agent, you must use intelligence reports, sometimes encrypted, along with timetables and computerized maps to follow his trail. Every move costs money and time, so only careful deduction and efficient resource management will convince Control that you deserve the title of Super Agent.

meta.name: Special Delivery : Santa's Christmas Chaos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.93 KB

In Special Delivery: Santa's Christmas Chaos you take on the role of Santa, tasked with delivering presents under constant pressure. You fly through winter landscapes, avoid obstacles, and collect gifts while dangers appear all around you. Once you've gathered enough, the challenge shifts to delivery – either dropping them mid-flight or carefully navigating inside houses without waking anyone. The gameplay changes between different situations, keeping things varied and demanding throughout.

meta.name: Special Operations
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.94 KB

Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un complejo altamente vigilado fue fotografiado por un avión de reconocimiento oculto en un bosque. Tras numerosos informes, se descubrió que este complejo de investigación estaba desarrollando un virus bacteriano y un nuevo tipo de cohete que, combinados, causarían devastación y enfermedades. Usted y un equipo de cuatro personas se han lanzado en paracaídas en el bosque circundante para encontrar la ubicación del complejo y luego entrar en él. Una vez dentro del complejo, debes obtener los planos del virus, el combustible del cohete y el sistema de guía antes de detonar la instalación. Una vez completada la misión, tienes que llegar a un punto de encuentro para que te recoja un avión.

meta.name: Spectipede
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.37 KB

In Spectipede you face increasingly hectic waves of enemies and try to survive as long as possible. The main creature moves unpredictably across the field and splits into multiple segments when hit, making things more chaotic. Additional threats appear that alter the playfield and force you to adapt constantly. Each enemy destroyed earns points, but the pace keeps increasing — only quick reactions and strong awareness will keep you alive and help you achieve a high score.

meta.name: Speed/Bingo Math
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.23 KB

"Speed Math & Bingo Math" is an educational game that playfully trains math skills. It offers two modes: In "Speed Math," players must solve arithmetic problems as quickly as possible to earn points. "Bingo Math" combines math with a bingo-style board, where correct answers mark spaces on the grid. The game encourages mental arithmetic and quick thinking and can be played solo or with a second player.

meta.name: Speedball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.47 KB

Speedball imagines a brutal sport of the future played on a compact court, which makes the action feel especially frantic and aggressive. Two teams collide with full physical force while fighting over the ball, and absolutely any method is fair game when it comes to getting it into the opposing goal. The action gains even more edge from the chance to influence things before the match begins and secure advantages, making every game feel like a dirty, fast, and wonderfully unfair battle for victory.

meta.name: Speed Buggy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Buggy Boy es un juego de carreras de Buggys. El objetivo del juego era recorrer uno de cinco recorridos (Offroad, Norte, Este, Sur u Oeste) en el menor tiempo posible. Cada recorrido tiene cinco etapas, cada una llena de obstáculos como cantos rodados y paredes de ladrillo. Se otorgan puntos por atravesar puertas y recoger banderas.
El jugador también puede golpear troncos y tocones de árboles para saltar el buggy sobre los obstáculos, ganando puntos extra mientras está en el aire. También se otorgan puntos extra por conducir el buggy sobre una rueda.

meta.name: Speed Demon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.65 KB

"Speed ​​Demon" transports the player into an exciting racing world in which the aim is to navigate through challenging tracks with skill and quick reflexes. The player controls a vehicle, avoids obstacles and tries to overtake his rivals. The gripping music accompanies the fast-paced gameplay and contributes to the intense atmosphere.

meta.name: Speed King
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.15 KB

Speed King es un juego de carreras de motociclismo en el que compites o entrenas en diez circuitos famosos, como Silverstone, Monza o Daytona. Antes de la carrera, eliges el número de vueltas y tu nivel de habilidad (principiante a profesional). La carrera, en perspectiva en tercera persona, te enfrenta a 19 rivales. La moto se controla con joystick, y además de regular la velocidad, debes cambiar manualmente entre seis marchas. Al terminar, se registran tus tiempos por vuelta y puedes seleccionar un nuevo circuito.

meta.name: Speed Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.99 KB

In Speed Racer, you race down the highway dodging cops, roadblocks, and potholes. But the real choice is yours: avoid pedestrians and old ladies or plow through them mercilessly. Earn angel points for kindness or devil points for chaos – and chase your personal high score. But what would Racer X think?

meta.name: Speed Reader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Speed Reader aims to increase your reading speed without sacrificing comprehension, combining that goal with a clear and strongly educational approach. Rather than simply displaying text, it challenges you to take in words more quickly while still retaining what you have read. That combination of practice, concentration, and immediate feedback gives it its appeal and lends the program a useful, almost playful training character.

meta.name: The Speed Rumbler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Speed Rumbler throws you into a high-speed mission of revenge, with Super Joe taking the fight to a terrorist group in an armed vehicle after they terrorize towns and abduct innocent people. Under constant time pressure, you race through dangerous areas, destroy enemy cars, and try to rescue prisoners while new threats keep appearing at every turn. That mix of speed, impact, and relentless momentum gives the game its raw energy and turns every drive into an explosive battle against the clock.

meta.name: Speed Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.91 KB

Speed Runner is a Light Cycle-style game for two human players played over ten fast-paced duels. Each player leaves a solid trail while moving – crashing into a wall or the opponent's trail means losing that round. The player who wins the most duels claims victory. Precision, quick reflexes, and smart driving are essential to win.

meta.name: Speed Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.51 KB

Speed Zone is a classic space action game where you pilot a high-performance spacecraft to defend the federation from waves of alien attackers. Your ship is equipped with an energy shield that absorbs enemy fire but has a limited capacity. Once the shield energy is depleted, you lose one of your three lives. The game blends fast-paced shooting with careful energy management – a race against time and overwhelming odds in the depths of space.

meta.name: Speed Zone II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.25 KB

Speed Zone II builds directly on its predecessor, expanding the proven space action formula with tougher challenges and faster enemies. Once again, you pilot a state-of-the-art spacecraft to defend the federation from relentless alien assaults. Your energy shield provides limited protection and must be managed wisely before it runs out and costs you one of your three lives. With more intense battles, tighter controls, and higher pressure, this sequel delivers an even more demanding experience among the stars.

meta.name: Speed-O-Cycles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.10 KB

Speed-O-Cycles turns a simple duel into a fast-paced test of nerves where every move matters. You control a light cycle that continuously leaves a trail behind it and try to force your opponent into a crash without trapping yourself in the process. With its use of speed, tight turns, and later obstacles, the game creates a gripping back-and-forth that constantly demands focus and a strong sense of timing.

meta.name: Speedball
meta.desc:

As manager and active participant in the action, you try to drag Brutal Deluxe from the bottom to the top while every match plays out at high speed, with heavy hits and constant pressure. Extra tournaments, power-ups, and nasty surprises on the pitch make the game feel not only raw and aggressive, but also wonderfully over-the-top and exciting.

meta.name: Speedway
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.55 KB

„Speedway“ is a cross between a horizontally scrolling „Spy Hunter“ and „Car Wars“ – with more shooting and less bashing.

meta.name: Speedway-Hero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.13 KB

In Speedway-Hero, you control a vehicle from a top-down perspective and race against another player to reach the finish line as quickly as possible. The game features a simple yet engaging racing mechanic typical of many late 1980s racing games. It allows for direct competition between two players, with a focus on precise controls and quick reactions.

meta.name: Speedy Delivery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

In this Christmas puzzle game you have to deliver presents to all the houses, but time is of the essence, so you have to take steps that will lead you ONLY to houses without presents and, if necessary, cross forests until all houses have presents. Every move must take you to the next house to deliver the festive Christmas presents. Any move that takes you out of the play area or to a house that already has gifts will cause you to lose the game.

meta.name: Speedy Slug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Speedy Slug takes you into a colorful micro-world full of insects, snails, and other quirky creatures. As a nimble slug, you jump and slide through charmingly designed landscapes, collect diamonds, dodge hazards, and use limited shots and a shield to defend yourself. The controls are responsive, the scrolling smooth, and the level design playfully inviting. While initially challenging, it unfolds into an entertaining and visually striking platforming experience that encourages exploration and replay.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Spell Now

Spell Now is an educational game designed to teach correct English spelling in a playful way. In various scenes – like a Wild West gallows or a classroom – you guess letters to complete the word. Wrong guesses result in penalties, while correct ones help you progress. With simple visuals and a learning focus, the game offers fun vocabulary practice.

meta.name: Spell of Destruction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wizardry/Spell of Destruction puts you in the role of Drinn, a wizard apprentice facing his final test – retrieving the legendary First Element from a dangerous castle. You explore isometric, scrolling rooms filled with puzzles and enemies, using magic and swordplay to advance. Fireballs fight foes, while spells like “Find it” and “Tell Tale” reveal chests and clues. But magic is limited, and every mistake counts – if Drinn dies or misuses a spell, the journey starts over.

meta.name: Spellbound
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.78 KB

Spellbound is the second adventure of Magic Knight following "Finders Keepers." He travels through time to rescue eight people, including his mentor Gimbal, who have been trapped due to a faulty spell. The game introduced an innovative control system using icons and windows. The player controls a pointing finger to navigate menus and execute various actions. All objects can be examined in detail, providing visual representations and possible hints for their use. In addition to managing Magic Knight's health and energy, the rescued characters must also be cared for and guided. Carrying too many items weakens Magic Knight, making careful inventory management essential.

At first Esmiralda will leave the JIMPYS to catch him. Should Jonny open the the first door she will start on her way back to the castle, throwing thunderbolts at him if he dares to touch another key. At first her powers increase as she are weak but will Can YOU help Jesse to home Tonny to open the doors and use the Book of Spells on HER before she returns and casts her evil spells on HIM?. Jonny has one friend in the form of a green goblin who will send the JIMPYS on their way!

meta.name: Spellbound
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Spellbound is an educational game from Timeworks that focuses on teaching children how to spell correctly in a fun way. The game is aimed at young learners who want to improve their spelling skills in a fun way. In Spellbound, players are presented with words that they must spell correctly, with the level of difficulty increasing as the player progresses. Through targeted exercises and a motivating user interface, the game helps train children's memory and spelling skills. Spellbound uses the positive effects of playful learning to practice spelling in different contexts.

meta.name: Dizzy V : Spellbound Dizzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.25 KB

Spellbound Dizzy es una continuación de las aventuras del huevo y sus amigos, esta vez con más de 100 pantallas con nombres individuales. Dizzy ha quedado atrapado en un mundo extraño mientras experimentaba con un libro de hechizos, y debe encontrar la manera de salir. La jugabilidad es muy similar a la de los juegos anteriores, combinando la resolución de puzles y la manipulación de objetos con saltos de estilo arcade y la evitación de peligros. También hay secciones adicionales de arcade sobre un carro de minas desbocado y algo de buceo.

meta.name: Spellbreaker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Spellbreaker brings the story of the Enchanter saga to a grand and threatening climax in which the very foundation of its magical world begins to crumble. After earning a name for yourself as a young spellcaster and rising to the head of the Circle, you now face a crisis where magic itself has become unreliable and the entire kingdom risks falling into chaos. That premise gives the adventure special weight, because personal growth and past triumphs now lead to the responsibility of taking a stand in the final conflict between order and ruin.

meta.name: Spelldiver
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Spelldiver turns word recognition into an underwater adventure where you play as a diver uncovering hidden words on the ocean floor and identifying them as quickly as possible. With strange sea growth and troublesome sea creatures getting in the way, the learning task becomes a lively search in which attention and speed are rewarded directly. Its blend of friendly adventure atmosphere, rising challenge, and a wide variety of words gives the game a strong appeal and makes reading practice feel pleasantly playful.

meta.name: Spellicopter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Spellicopter is an educational software game that enables children to develop their spelling skills in order to remain in flight. The screen display shows speed, altitude, fuel level, score and cargo. It offers three levels of difficulty, allowing the student to learn up to 400 words, in 40 categories, in beginner, intermediate and advanced modes.nnnnnnThe program could be played using keyboard or joystick, giving a sentence context clue for each word, allowing the student to maintain altitude and speed for correct spellings, utilizing screen graphics, animation and sound effects.

meta.name: Spelling Invader
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.32 KB

Spelling Invader is an educational game designed to help players improve their spelling skills. With a total of 168 lessons, it targets specific weaknesses for focused improvement. The game allows players to repeat challenging lessons, enabling continuous mastery of spelling. It offers an engaging way to build and reinforce knowledge effectively.

meta.name: Spellseeker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.50 KB

In Spellseeker you play a wizard who ventures into the Magic Maze to hunt down the dark sorcerer Ashlaa. The maze is crawling with monsters that drain your damage meter until it reaches zero. Along the way you can collect different types of magic and a shield, while wells may restore your damage and magic—or poison you. Teleports transport you to other maze sections. The game is an isometric flick-screen arcade adventure where you control your hero with a joystick and use the keyboard to select spells, unlock items or escape. The screen also shows your damage, magic, spell meters, a clock, and which monster you are currently facing.

meta.name: Spelunker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Spelunker sends you deep into dangerous caverns where every step has to be planned with extreme care as you search for treasure. Using ladders, ropes, mine carts, and narrow platforms, you push ever further onward while chasms, obstacles, and eerie enemies punish even the smallest mistake immediately. Its appeal comes from the mix of precise timing, constant tension, and the clever use of helpful items, turning the treasure hunt into a nerve-racking struggle against the depths.

meta.name: Speranza
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.33 KB

Speranza challenges you to think fast and act precisely. The goal is to align matching symbols so that at least three in a row appear and disappear from the field. The more combinations you create, the higher your score climbs. As the pace increases, quick reflexes and forward planning become essential to last longer and set new records.

meta.name: Spherebrain
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This is a logic game where the sphere you control can push certain types of blocks with the goal of getting all the dots on the field. Choose which blocks to shift to allow you to get all of them. Other types of blocks can give boosts to help you survive.

meta.name: Spherical
meta.desc:

Spherical demands forward planning because you do not steer the ball directly, but shape its route by creating and removing blocks. Once activated, the ball moves automatically and you must remodel the level so it safely reaches the target marked “In”. Enemies on fixed paths add pressure, while bonus items and special effects like invincibility, altered gravity, or teleportation open up new options. The planning phase is key, since you get time before the ball starts rolling to prepare the layout tactically – a puzzler that rewards patience, timing, and smart route design.

meta.name: Spheron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Spheron, you control a bouncing ball that must navigate through various levels to collect diamonds and reach the level's end. The game is time-limited, and you must avoid obstacles and enemies like water and storms. Each level presents additional challenges, and power-ups such as extra time or energy help you overcome these obstacles.

Spider and the Fly tasks you with trapping insects as a spider by weaving a growing web around them. To score points, flies and butterflies must be completely enclosed, while the web itself has a limited length and eventually closes back on itself. As your score increases, the difficulty rises, introducing new dangers and harsher penalties for mistakes. Moving hazards, spray attacks, and insects with varying point values demand careful planning, as only capturing enough prey allows you to advance to the next level.

meta.name: Spider Hunt

"Spider Hunt" is a crosshair shooter where the player must target and eliminate spiders.

Captured bugs grant you new cybernetic upgrades like jumping, climbing, or shooting. Only with the right enhancements can you reach and shut down the reactor to save the planet.

Spiders is a classic platformer set in the mountain of the spiders. As a small gnome, you must climb ladders, jump platforms, and collect all the keys while avoiding deadly arachnids. meta.name: Spike

Spike C64 Dislike challenges you with a simple yet addictive task: guide a bouncing ball over and under an endless series of spikes. The ball bounces automatically, and each press moves it forward. Timing is everything to clear the dangerous obstacles. But the true thrill lies not just in survival, but in chasing high scores. Every spike you pass earns points, and passing several in quick succession builds a combo that raises your multiplier. The faster you keep clearing spikes, the greater your reward – until the smallest mistake ends it all.

meta.name: Spike's Peak
meta.desc:

Spike's Peak challenges you to climb a treacherous mountain all the way to its summit. Starting at the base, each stage of your ascent presents new dangers. In the meadows, bears and eagles threaten you, and only clever jumping or hiding in caves can save you – though the icy caves make staying too long dangerous. On steep cliffs, falling rocks may knock you back down. At the snowy peak, avalanches and even a Yeti await to stop you. Only by planting your flag at the very top will you truly conquer the mountain.

meta.name: Spikey in Transylvania
meta.desc:

Spikey in Transylvania begins with a shipwreck that leaves Spike the Viking stranded on the shores of Transylvania. What first appears to be an ordinary village soon reveals its danger, as his crewmates have been captured and imprisoned in the castle's dungeons. Spike must rescue them, but first he has to escape the house of a seemingly friendly villager, whose door won't open. The adventure mixes puzzles with action, as you dodge dogs, ghosts, bats, and deadly traps throughout the castle. With limited energy and only a few lives, every encounter is a challenge, and only skill and persistence will allow Spike to save his friends.

meta.name: Spiky Harold
meta.desc:

In Spiky Harold you have limited time to prepare for winter – as a hungry hedgehog you explore multiple areas, trying to eat as much as possible. You move from screen to screen, avoid dangers, and collect food before time runs out. You must stay alert, as enemies are everywhere and cost you lives on contact. Pickups can help or hinder you, making every choice important. A fast-paced race against the clock where reflexes and awareness are key.

meta.name: Spin to Win
meta.desc:

Spin to Win turns hidden-phrase guessing into an entertaining mix of wordplay, luck, and score chasing. You spin the wheel, choose letters, and gradually try to uncover the phrase. Success depends not only on language sense, but also on the risk of the next spin and how much money it may bring. That combination of puzzle tension, chance, and competition gives the game its social appeal.

Esto, junto con el hecho de que muchas pantallas son enormes y con trayectorias diagonales, significa que al principio es difícil llegar lejos.
Gerald debe recoger cristales para recargar su energía y conseguir completar el nivel. Al moverte por cuadrados de colores, se abren puertas que te permiten avanzar a través de los niveles. Cada uno de ellos tiene diez pantallas diferentes que recorrer.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.63 KB

In “Spite and Malice,” you compete against the computer to convert as many spaces as possible on an 8x8 board into your color. By strategically placing and “capturing” opponent's pieces, you flip them to your side. The winner is determined by the highest number of occupied spaces at the end. The game offers eight difficulty levels, and while the computer plays without emotion, the challenge remains engaging and unpredictable.

meta.name: Spitfire '40
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Spitfire '40” puts you in the cockpit of a British fighter during the Battle of Britain. As a young pilot in 1940, you must prove your skill in navigation, flight, and combat over southern England. The simulation includes advanced maneuvers like rolls, loops, and split-S dives. Using a map, you guide your plane to targets while managing landing gear, brakes, and rudder control. Combat encounters are randomly generated – for example, six enemies ten miles out at 1500 feet. Practice modes for flight and dogfighting prepare you before heading into real missions.

meta.name: Spitfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.10 KB

“Spitfire” is a side-scrolling shoot-'em-up where you take control of a Spitfire pilot tasked with multiple missions. Fly over the English Channel, destroy enemy planes and grounded flying bombs, and protect your base in England from airborne attacks. All of this must be done before your fuel runs out and you crash. Your plane can take up to ten hits, but descending too fast leads to an instant crash. You have six Spitfires in total, but lose any on the ground and your chances diminish. Agility, accuracy, and timing are key to a successful air defense.

meta.name: Spitfire Ace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Aerial combat over Europe in World War II. Man your Royal Marine Spitfire and defend London during the Blitz.

meta.name: Spitting Image : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This game is based on the long-running British satirical television show featuring puppet characters of political figures and celebrities. A prophet predicts that in seven years a world war started by a mysterious leader will break out. To avoid this, a ruler of the world must be determined in this brawling game with six rulers: Ronald Regan from the USA, Margaret Thatcher from Great Britain, Mikhail Gorbachev from the USSR, PW Botha from South Africa, Ayatollah Khomeini from Iran and Pope John Paul II.

meta.name: Splat!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.59 KB

A spider must be guided safely through a maze, eating all the patches of grass. The screen scrolls in four directions, and the walls of the level are in a different pattern on each level, and must always be avoided for fear of losing a life. The main thing making life harder is that the level is always scrolling in random directions, and contact with the wall at the edge of the screen costs you a life. As a result, careful planning is required to ensure that you don't get trapped into a corner. There are seven levels of increasing difficulty to get through.

meta.name: Splidge's Snowball Caper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.54 KB

A tough game, snow joke. Guide Splidge left & right, collecting falling presents. But avoid collision with those biblets that just want to cover you in snow. Crazy game. Sort of fun in some kind of way.

meta.name: Split Personalities
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.43 KB

Los juegos de rompecabezas de bloques deslizantes fueron una de las muchas formas de entretenimiento no electrónicas reinventadas con nuevas perspectivas para la era digital. La premisa básica consiste en presentar 1 de 10 figuras (que representan personajes famosos como Ronald Reagan, Maggie Thatcher, Lady Diana e incluso Sir Clive Sinclair), con la figura completa mostrada en el lateral de la pantalla. Debes mover el cursor hasta la figura, tomar una pieza y colocarla en el área de juego principal, asegurándote de poder mover las demás al lugar correcto. A diferencia de las versiones de plástico, hay 16 piezas que encajan en 20 espacios, lo que permite una mayor libertad en cuanto a deslizamiento continuo.

meta.name: Splitter
meta.desc:

Splitter is a Polish puzzle game that involves arranging drawings from small pieces.

meta.name: Spook : The Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Spook: The Game challenges your logic and timing. The goal is to clear all the balls from the board, but every click comes with a twist: the selected ball disappears, while new ones appear horizontally and vertically. Each move reshapes the pattern, and the clock keeps ticking. Only careful planning and foresight will let you clear the field before time runs out.

meta.name: Spooked
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.92 KB

In Spooked you take on the role of a ghost hunter called to a haunted mansion, only to find 384 screens full of creepiness. Ghosts push you off course, sometimes dropping you into lower rooms, while you collect bugs and beetles to brew spells in cauldrons to fight enemies. Each life runs on a 4-minute timer that can be extended by picking up hourglasses. A neat feature is the “Scaredyness Factor,” which adjusts the difficulty dynamically to give struggling players a better chance.

meta.name: Spooks!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.17 KB

Spooks is an action-adventure set in a haunted mansion. Your goal is to collect eight musical boxes and play them at the exit. Four fast-moving ghosts constantly hunt you, and you can only defend yourself by throwing heavy objects at them. The mansion is filled with rooms and items whose uses must be discovered to progress. Tension is heightened by the fact that when using the inventory menu, you only have a limited time to make your decisions.

meta.name: Spooky Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.78 KB

Spooky Castle follows Gormless Gary on his quest to rescue Princess Clare and win her hand in marriage. He braves the haunted castle, where bats, ghosts, and open fireplaces threaten him. Contact with these drains his energy, and once it's gone, all lives are lost. Fortunately, crosses grant extra lives, potions restore energy, and keys open locked doors. The game is a flickscreen platformer, with each room showing part of the castle, while the display tracks your energy, keys, and collected crosses.

meta.name: Spooky House Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.34 KB

"Spooky House Adventure" takes place on Halloween just before midnight. The player ventures into a cursed neighborhood house and has 20 minutes to escape before Dracula appears. The game is based on "Haunted House" and features similar puzzles, but with a new map and an added time limit.

meta.name: Spore
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.92 KB

Spore's location is a laboratory where dangerous spores are cultivated. Unfortunately, an outbreak occurred and the spores will soon infect places outside the laboratory. The only way to stop them is to use every available antidote against them - but the canisters are in said lab...
So the player's task is to travel through the non-scrolling levels and collect all the canisters. He can use his handgun to kill the spores that attack him - but they are replaced by a destructible spore generator. Extras that can be collected in the levels are helpful: flasks regenerate life energy and pills can be activated at any time to drive away spores for a short time. Other special fields include earth (which can be destroyed by the player or the spores being passed through) and impenetrable barriers (which can be deactivated and are sometimes reflected by mirrors).

meta.name: Spork64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.45 KB

Spork64 presents an unusual and slightly absurd concept where you use a spork to quickly stab roaming enemies as they appear. The playfield is simple, but the timing of enemy movement demands fast reactions and precise rhythm. Despite its basic mechanics, the action becomes hectic and relies heavily on choosing the right moment. Its charm comes from the quirky idea, catchy music, and short, punchy gameplay loops.

meta.name: Sport of Kings
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.99 KB

Sport of Kings is a horse racing simulation where you place bets on up to 75 horses. While horse and jockey stats can be reviewed, they're randomly generated and only become meaningful after several races. To build early insight, you can run automatic simulations. The races unfold in side-scrolling view, and your winnings depend on your bet and the final results. Simple mechanics meet strategic betting and chance-driven excitement.

meta.desc:

The Sporting News Baseball is a baseball game under the MLBPA license, meaning that it features some of the star players, such as Roger Clemens, Ozzie Smith and George Brett. You can also choose to make up your own team from the members of the Baseball Hall of Fame. There are four modes of gameplay: player vs. player, player vs. computer or computer vs. computer. (you pick teams), computer vs. computer. (computer picks teams). The game can be saved to resume at a later moment.

meta.name: Sporting Triangles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sporting Triangles es una adaptación del famoso concurso británico de los años ochenta. Los jugadores deben responder a una serie de preguntas relacionadas con el deporte. Las preguntas se dividen en varias categorías, que incluyen conocimientos generales y deportes individuales.

meta.name: Sports Spectacular
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Sports Spectacular you are presented with three distinct sports challenges, each with its own pace and emphasis. Baseball revolves around alternating offense and defense, where precise timing determines success. Football focuses on tactical choices, letting you guide the match by selecting plays. Hockey provides fast-paced head-to-head action, putting reflexes and control to the test. Together they form a varied collection that shifts between strategy, tension, and direct competition – well suited for quick matches or extended play sessions.

meta.name: Alternative World Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Alternative World Games" is an unconventional sports simulation featuring eight quirky disciplines: sack race, boot throwing, pole climbing, running up the wall, balancing a pile of plates, jumping over a river, pillow fight, and pogo bouncing. At the beginning, players enter their names and select a country to represent. A record with the chosen nation's flag is picked from a box, and a parrot places it on a phonograph, playing the national anthem. After all players have registered, they choose which events to compete in, with each sport introduced by an animated depiction. Finally, players can opt for "Competition" or "Practice" before diving into the eccentric challenges.
