A puzzle game loosely featuring licensing from the 7Up soft drink. The gameplay involves up to 4 players, which can be either human or computer, each taking on spots of a particular colour. Starting from opposite corners, they take it in turns to move, either by 'reproducing' one of their spots to form another one in an adjacent square, or by making a jump, losing the square you did have but taking one two spaces away.nnnnnnWhen a piece lands next to one of another colour, that piece changes colour into that of their opponent. The winner of each round is either the last player with any pieces left, or the player who has the most pieces left when the level is full.

meta.name: Springreiten
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Springreiten puts you in the saddle for a head-to-head jumping competition, racing through an obstacle course against another rider. Timing and precision are crucial, as poorly timed jumps cost you time and points. The split-screen format adds to the intensity – it's a test of speed, accuracy, and equestrian skill.

meta.name: Spriteman 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.60 KB

In this Pac-Man clone, your task is to navigate a maze eating dots while avoiding Zippy, Stilty, Gippy, and Chris, four ghosts who also move around the maze. Contact with any of these ghosts results in loss of live. However, eating power pellets allows you to eat the ghosts who respawn near the center of the maze. Fruit can also be collected for bonus points, and eating all the dots in the maze advances you to the next maze.

meta.name: Spuk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Spuk, you move across platforms and ladders while ghosts roam the levels and make your path more dangerous. You have to dodge carefully, judge your routes well, and reach the next ladder at the right moment before a ghost catches you. With adjustable difficulty, the challenge can be balanced for different skill levels – keeping the haunted chase exciting for every player.

meta.name: Spy Hunter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.25 KB

En Spy Hunter, la acción se desarrolla desde arriba. Tu coche está equipado con ametralladoras que te ayudarán a eliminar a los numerosos enemigos de la carretera, pero ten cuidado de no disparar a civiles. De vez en cuando, te cruzarás con un furgón de armas y, si te topas con él, tu coche estará equipado con una segunda arma. En varios puntos, la carretera se divide y puedes entrar en un hangar para convertir temporalmente tu coche en un barco. Los coches intentarán sacarte de la carretera, los enemigos te dispararán desde la parte trasera de una limusina y los helicópteros te lanzarán bombas.

meta.name: Spy Hunter 2

"Spy Hunter II" is a "sequel" to the well-known game, where the player once again engages in high-speed chases to eliminate enemy agents.

In Spy School you play a trainee secret agent, putting your reflexes, precision, and timing to the test across four dangerous training zones. Dodge mines, avoid traps, collect secret data, and stay alert — one wrong move and your mission ends in failure. Survive all four challenges to advance to the next level of training and prove yourself worthy of becoming a true spy.

meta.name: The Spy Strikes Back!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.35 KB

In The Spy Strikes Back! you take the role of a secret agent sent to stop the terrorist Dr. Xavier Tortion. Your mission leads you to his fortress in the East German town of Aichenbach, where you must locate nine hidden clues to foil his plans. The stronghold is vast, consisting of multiple floors with many sections and rooms that must be searched carefully. Security robots patrol the hallways and will chase you if you get too close. While rooms offer temporary safety, the corridors are dangerous places to cross. Only by finding all nine clues can you finally put an end to Dr. Xavier's scheme.

El cómic homónimo de la revista cobra vida en este juego diseñado para uno o dos jugadores. La innovadora pantalla dividida muestra a los dos espías al mismo tiempo. Juega con un amigo o contra la máquina.
El Cuervo Negro y el Cuervo Blanco están listos para luchar antes de que suene la campana. Encuentra los artículos necesarios buscando en los cajones, armarios y muebles de la casa. Burla a tu oponente colocando trampas creativas en diferentes habitaciones (una bomba en un cajón de la cómoda, por ejemplo).
La lucha se produce cuando ambos espías entran en la misma habitación. Encuentra armas ocultas en las habitaciones para ayudarte en estos combates, ya que uno de vosotros morirá si os cruzáis.

El Espía Blanco y el mortífero Espía Negro continúan su batalla. Esta vez, el enfrentamiento tiene lugar en el Ártico helado, con el objetivo de encontrar los componentes esenciales de una tecnología totalmente nueva: un cohete totalmente nuevo. Tienes que conseguirlo antes de que lo haga el mortífero espía negro. La temperatura de tu cuerpo corresponde a tu estado de salud. Puedes entrar en calor entrando en un iglú y permaneciendo unos instantes junto al fuego. El tiempo es limitado para completar tu misión, ¡así que no te demores!

meta.name: The Spy Who Loved Me
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.34 KB

The Spy Who Loved Me puts you in the role of James Bond as he teams up with Agent XXX to stop a villain's plan for world domination. You control a gadget-laden vehicle capable of transforming to handle different situations, enabling chases, combat encounters and risky set pieces across varied environments. As you progress through hostile routes, weapons and special functions require quick reactions and smart maneuvering. The blend of driving, action and shifting mission scenarios creates a classic spy adventure focused on technology, timing and constant pressure.

meta.name: The Spy's Adventures in North America
meta.desc:

The Spy's Adventures in North America puts you on the trail of the infamous Dr. X, who has scattered stolen jewels across the continent. As a spy, you travel from place to place, collecting clues from agents and informants to track him down before he escapes again. Bribe informants with cash or jewels to get hints, but be careful – you only get three chances to guess his location. The faster you find him and the more jewels you recover, the higher your efficiency rating.

meta.name: Spy's Demise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sneak your way through the Soviet Embassy in Pyongyang via elevators, avoiding Soviet security on different floors to piece together the encrypted message. This is a platform game. You move from floor to floor avoiding the security that is constantly moving up and down on elevators. As you climb, you will collect all of the pieces that form an encrypted message as you advance to the next level. Spy's Demise is an action game written by Alan Zeldin for the Apple II, published by Penguin Software in 1982 . It was ported to the Atari, Commodore 64, Texas Instruments TI-99/4A, and Vector-06c. The game contained a puzzle which could be solved for a Spy's Demise T-Shirt. According to Antic magazine in June 1984, only four people had solved it.

meta.name: Spyplane
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.86 KB

Spyplane breaks away from traditional text adventures by placing you in command of an aircraft rather than a character on foot. As the captain of a long-range reconnaissance plane, you search for enemy units, gather intelligence using sophisticated onboard systems and constantly manage altitude, direction and safety. Weather conditions, terrain and hostile threats affect every decision, while risky low-level flights promise greater rewards. Tension comes from balancing information gathering with survival and executing a proper return to base, where even landing demands careful procedure.

meta.name: Sqij!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.60 KB

Sqij has found out that the key to eternal life is the Enertree, that sits in the Lotz-Too-Weet cave, deep in the caverns of Pylpapa. Problem is the tree is scattered over the caverns in six pieces and need to be collected and placed back in the cave. In this flick-screen, side view maze game, you control Sqij as you explore the caverns for the pieces of the Enertree while avoiding or shooting various nasties that live there. If you touch a nasty or the sides of the caverns then you lose part of an energy bar and when it reaches zero it is game over. In various parts of the caverns are laser doors and these can only be passed through with a pass. To get a pass you must collect three Doodlefoodle fruits and take them to one of three Dispensa-Monsta's. A pass can only be used once.

X-Change leads you into a twisting maze of revolving doors where you have to form as many squares as possible while being chased. As guardians pursue you, you open new paths, look for access to further phases, and risk ending up in traps or hopeless dead ends. This creates a frantic mix of thinking and reaction – whoever acts quickly, uses the doors wisely, and outsmarts the enemies gets the furthest.

meta.name: Square Hunter

"Square Hunter" is a minimalist game where the player controls a square to collect white squares while avoiding enemy squares of other colors.

meta.name: Square Pairs

In Square Pairs you uncover hidden squares and try to find matching word pairs. Instead of identical images or words, the game asks you to pair opposites, turning it into a mix of memory challenge and word game. This means you must not only remember where the words are but also think about which term logically matches the one you have revealed. As a result, the game requires concentration, good memory and a feel for language.

meta.name: Square Pit 64
meta.desc:

In Square Pit 64 you control a white square inside a confined arena, collecting smaller white squares to boost your score. But beware – colored squares in red, green, blue, and yellow will try to take you down. Each collision costs a life, and once all nine are gone, it's game over. A fast-paced, minimalist challenge where reflexes and precision decide your fate.

meta.name: Square Scape 2
meta.desc:

Square Scape II continues the clear puzzle idea and turns every movement into a small planning challenge. Your block slides in one direction until an obstacle stops it, which means the path to the exit has to be prepared carefully. With a limited number of moves, the simple concept quickly becomes a tricky challenge – whoever thinks ahead and uses every stop correctly will find the solution step by step.

meta.name: Square Sphere
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.09 KB

Square Sphere throws you into a fast-paced shuttle mission where you act as Earth's last line of defense against an incoming threat. Your ship, the Omega 4 Square Sphere, originally built for distant research in Zone 8, suddenly becomes the only craft capable of intercepting a torrent of meteorites hurtling toward the U.S. East Coast. The assaults come in dense waves, and every rock must be destroyed before it reaches the planet. You fight through the chaos blast by blast – fully aware that you alone stand between the world and its extinction.

meta.name: Square Supremacy

Square Supremacy challenges you to push heavy blocks through winding rooms onto the marked target spaces. Every move has to count, because a badly placed block can close off paths and make the puzzle impossible to solve. The clear playfield keeps the focus on order, space management, and forward planning. This creates a calm but tricky puzzle game that rewards patience, awareness, and carefully planned sequences.

meta.name: Square-Scape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Square-Scape places you in compact puzzle rooms where you have to reach the exit within a strict move limit. You move the striped square step by step, look for open paths, and have to judge carefully whether a token will help or disrupt your plan. This makes every move count twice – a clever puzzle game where awareness, planning, and careful movement decide the path to the goal.

meta.name: Squares
meta.desc:

Squares is a two-player strategy game where you take turns placing pieces on a grid, aiming to create a winning connection. Similar to classic connection-based games, success depends on smart placement, blocking your opponent and thinking several moves ahead. Each decision reshapes the board and can either open opportunities or give your rival an advantage. The experience centers on foresight, tactical planning and a head-to-head battle of strategy.

meta.name: Squash

Squash brings the fast-paced racket sport to the screen, letting you play either solo or with a friend. With racket and ball in hand, you must react precisely to keep the ball in play and score points against your opponent. Speed, timing, and smart placement are the keys to victory in this digital squash match.

In this otherwise cute world, all the pens have been stolen, preventing new cartoons from being created – your mission is to recover the scattered pens and stop Ink Blot. The compact arenas focus on quick reactions, dodging and constant movement as enemies appear from every direction and keep the pressure high. The playful style blends with frantic action, making each round feel like a chaotic cartoon showdown that pushes you to restore creativity to the world.

The guarding worms constantly chase you, and any contact costs you one of your lives. As you try to gather enough eggs, you must also collect glowing worms, because after a short time the lights go out and you'll be moving almost blindly. Once you collect enough, a special phase begins where you must avoid colliding with your own trail. Quick reactions, good timing, and sharp awareness determine whether you succeed or get lost in the chaos of the maze.

meta.name: Squish 'em

Climb up the side of a series of 48-story buildings to collect suitcases full of money, while avoiding creepy monsters and falling objects that try to knock you off. Fortunately, you can strike back against the monsters by smashing them flat, by smashing them on the head. Don't linger too long, though, since they are soon resurrected, white and unsquishable.

Once a wave is cleared, falling boulders provide the next challenge, giving the game extra momentum and making quick reflexes essential all the way through.

This version adds an extra dimension to the timeless memory game, testing your focus and reaction skills in a whole new way!

Stack Concentration is a classic memory-matching game designed for use with Stack Computers' light pen controller. Two players take turns selecting pairs of cards by pointing and tapping with the pen, aiming to find matches using memory. A correct match scores a point, while an error is signaled with a bass tone. While simple in concept, the use of the light pen makes it a unique and interactive experience for its time.

meta.name: Stack Up
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A good alternate title for this one would be Rows - not the kind you have when your wife finds lipstick on your shirt collar, but as an equivalent of Columns. The gameplay is essentially the same - groups of 3 variably-colored blocks fall towards the bottom of a 6x18 grid, and you must arrange them into groups of 3 of the same colour - except that the blocks are grouped horizontally rather than vertically.
Each individual brick falls as far as it can when you place the trio, so they won't necessarily all end up on the same line. Blocks fall as far as possible to fill gaps when lines are completed, so there are never gaps in the arrangement the way you get in Tetris. Each level sets you a target number of lines to form - 4 or 5 in a row count as 2 and 3 lines respectively for this calculation, a lá Klax. Horizontal lines score the least, with diagonals the most lucrative and vertical in between (this change from Columns makes sense considering the different building method).

Stairways is a quirky action game set in a bar. Your goal is to collect seven pieces of the legendary amulet of the great budgie WONGA. Along the way, you must shoot down hallucinations and avoid knocking over other patrons' drinks, or the doorman will throw you out. Your character has three stats: energy, hunger, and drunkenness. Hallucinations drain energy, hunger is satisfied at the burger kiosk, and to maintain intoxication you must keep drinking at the bar. The challenge grows as you sober up, making it harder to fend off hallucinations with thought bubbles. If you gather all amulet pieces before the timer runs out, you move on to the next level.

Stalag 1 puts you in the role of a camp commander who must remain constantly alert to prevent escape attempts. You move freely around the grounds, spot prisoners digging hidden tunnels and intervene before they reach the fence. Every second matters, as escaped prisoners raise the pressure and force quick reactions, while unpredictable distractions make the task even harder. The experience thrives on urgency, awareness and a relentless race against time, where just a few mistakes can bring everything to an end.

meta.name: The Standing Stones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Standing Stones you play as a knight tasked with retrieving the Holy Grail and Excalibur from Kormath's dungeon beneath the ancient stones. This 3D maze adventure viewed in first-person includes RPG elements like randomized stats, magical items, and encounters with minions you can fight, bribe, or greet. Treasure chests and potions are scattered throughout the dungeon, and Lancelot may appear to assist you. But beware – you only have one life, and survival depends as much on luck as on your choices.

Use falling pickups to improve your brawler's abilities by adding features like acceleration, lasers and level jump.

Star Battle places you in the cockpit of a spaceship with battles shown from a first-person view. You travel through different sectors, activate shields, fire torpedoes, and dodge asteroid showers. Enemy ships attack repeatedly, and with the help of radar and a sector map you keep track of the action. Every shot and every maneuver determine whether you survive in the endless depths of space.

Your ship comes equipped with advanced technology – warp and hyper light-drive, phasers, photon torpedoes, and a sophisticated Star Fleet computer system. Each enemy hit reduces your capabilities, pushing you closer to destruction. Only by defeating the enemy ships and destroying their Starbase can you save Earth.

Star Battles is an action-packed game for the Commodore 64 that takes you into the deepest reaches of space. Your mission is to destroy incoming hordes using photon bombs. The game offers six difficulty levels, ranging from Training to Kamikaze, challenging your skills at every turn. Featuring impressive 3D graphics for its time, Tunnel of Doom delivers an intense gameplay experience where quick reflexes and precise aiming are crucial to surviving the enemy waves.

"Star Blazers" is an action-packed, competitive game for one or two players. The game principle combines elements of shoot'em up and arcade action: the players have to shoot a bouncing bubble so that it lands in the opponent's goal. This is not just about accuracy, but also about quick reflexes and a good strategy to skillfully maneuver the bubble. The goal is to score more points than the opponent within a given time limit by getting the bubble into the other's goal as often as possible. The constant change of bubble position and the limited time create a dynamic competition that keeps both players on their toes. In the end, the player with the most hits wins, which makes the game an exciting and fast-paced duel.

But, as you change course to head home, a meteorite shower threatens to destroy your craft.nnnnPlayed from a 1st person perspective, the player has a crosshair in the center of the screen, and can move in all directions to shoot incoming dangers with its phaser blaster. The ship is armed with fore and rear ultratensile shields that become depleted as the Interceptor takes damage. As the shields are depleted, the ship's hull and navigation controls become damaged. When navigation is depleted the ship loses the ability to move in specific directions. When the hull is fully damaged the ship is destroyed. Between each mission the ship is given a number of repair points which can used to fix some of the damaged systems.

Both factions feature different ship types, each with unique movement, weapon systems and special powers. In Melee mode, you can enjoy quick battles against the computer or another player, while the scenario mode offers more strategic challenges – including predefined setups and tactical depth.

As captain of a strategic space station patrolling on the fringes of the galaxy, life can be pretty dull. Usually the cryogenic chamber is set to defrost only once every 10 years, but this time the RB-130 onboard computer has detected an alien battle fleet heading towards Federation territory. Your object is to destroy as many aliens as possible before you finally run out of power. Though your fate is to die far from home, you must do your best to defend the men, women and robots of the Federation so that they may live on.

Empire! turns the building of a galactic realm into a large mix of trading, missions, exploration, and space combat. You guide your ship between starbases, planets, and dangerous systems, collect resources, deliver goods, and fight alien invaders. At the same time, you constantly have to watch energy, heat, radiation, and shields, because poor decisions can quickly destroy your ship. With growing influence, new equipment, and your own starbases, the path gradually opens toward the ultimate goal: a united empire protected by a powerful frontier shield.

What seemed like a lazy mission quickly turns into a fierce battle in space.

meta.name: Star League Baseball

Star League Baseball has you assembling a roster before taking to the field where strategic decisions shape every moment of play. You select players based on their abilities, plan lineups, and react to changing situations from batting to fielding. Beyond single matches, extended competitions place greater emphasis on management and consistency. Practice modes help refine timing and control – a simulation that blends gameplay feel with planning and tactical awareness.

The maze is filled with dangerous enemies and obstacles that challenge the player's progress. With limited fuel and a small supply of antimatter bombs for defense, the player must strategize to navigate through all 16 levels and earn points. Speed and fuel management are crucial as threats are avoided or destroyed.

You track targets across a looping world, rely on radar for positioning, and collect gear from supply drops that grant mobility, weapons, or support. Subterranean sections open new routes and resources while health management remains crucial, with successful captures restoring strength. Bonus challenges add variety – a playful adventure blending exploration, action, and tactical item use.

The attackers approach from eight different channels, with a Superalien posing a special threat as it disrupts the display screen and spirals toward the outpost. Players can choose from three difficulty levels: Beginner, Advanced, and Hyper. With each new level, hit points are reset, but eight hits within a single round will destroy the star post. Quick reflexes and strategic skill are crucial to successfully fend off the threats.

The strongest and bravest among them are sent on a quest. The Space Federation aids their mission by deploying space fighters to clear a path through the galaxy. The player takes control of one of these fighters, patrolling the solar system while destroying or avoiding hazards and hostile aliens. As they progress through five different galaxies, additional challenges must be overcome.

Los Zylons han vuelto para atacar el sistema estelar Celos IV. En este shooter en 3D, el jugador toma el control de la estrella Liberty y debe viajar a planetas amenazados para luchar contra cazas y destructores voladores Zylon. Los escuadrones zylon también pueden ser atacados por el camino, y las estaciones espaciales amigas se utilizan para repostar. Para ganar, hay que destruir las bases de ataque zylon en sus propios planetas. El juego termina si la estrella Libertad se queda sin combustible, o si todas las ciudades son destruidas por los Zylons.

meta.name: Star Ranger

En Star Ranger la nave del jugador puede disparar en dos direcciones, pero la frecuencia de disparo es bastante baja. A diferencia de la mayoría de los otros Shoot'em Ups, los enemigos no simplemente vuelan por la pantalla y pueden ser destruidos o esquivados, sino que permanecen en la pantalla, intentando destruir la nave del jugador hasta que sean derrotados. Hay numerosos tipos de enemigos diferentes, cada uno de los cuales sigue un patrón de ataque único. Algunos enemigos intentan acercarse, mientras que otros siempre disparan desde lejos. También hay bombarderos, que llenan la pantalla con bombas indestructibles, así como naves que pueden volverse temporalmente invisibles. Para aumentar aún más el desafío, también hay momentos en los que debes esquivar asteroides o maniobrar la nave a través de pasajes estrechos.

Inside the ring you can use punches such as jabs, hooks and cross-punches aimed at either the head or body. Between fights you train your boxer to improve his abilities and prepare for the next challenge. Depending on your starting option, you either begin your career as a new professional at the bottom of the rankings or as a contender already halfway up the ladder.

Clever combat, thorough looting, and an eye on your next target will make you the most feared hunter in the galaxy.

Alongside your main gun you can use limited grenades or missiles. Some defeated enemies drop credits or weapons. Star Trekking: The Game challenges the player to make tactical decisions in space while engaging enemy forces in real time. The action is visualized through a star map showing the player's ship, enemies, and space stations. Power levels, shield strength, and available weapons such as torpedoes are always visible and play a crucial role in determining the next move. The goal is to neutralize the threat posed by enemy forces without losing control over the ship and its resources – every command brings the ship closer to victory or destruction.

meta.name: Star Trooper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.47 KB

On the Venus 4 stellar base a revolt broke out and the Venusians led by Lady K., a bitter enemy of the Terrans, came to power. Go on a mission on board your ship. But be careful, as soon as you enter the orbit of Venus 4 you will have to disengage from your ship and proceed to free flight. At first your ship will protect you from attack, but you can then rely solely on your skills.

meta.name: Star Warrior
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.78 KB

meta.name: Star Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.09 KB

Star Wars brings the arcade classic to the C64, letting you relive the film's most iconic moments. Across three stages that repeat with increasing difficulty, you first battle in space, then fight your way across the Death Star's surface, and finally attempt the legendary trench run. The goal is to endure as long as possible, because once your shield energy is depleted, the game is over.

meta.name: Star Wars : The Arcade Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.37 KB

Star Wars: The Arcade Game puts you directly in the cockpit of an X-wing, letting you experience the battle against the Empire firsthand. From a first-person perspective, you play as Luke Skywalker (“Red Five”) and face three phases: surviving waves of TIE Fighters, enduring the Death Star's surface gun turrets, and finally navigating the trench run to destroy the superweapon. You don't need to destroy every enemy, only survive long enough while managing your six shields. Once they are depleted and you take another hit, the game ends.

meta.name: Star-Lifter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Star-Lifter sends you alone behind enemy lines in the year 2150 to break up alien space convoys. Your ship can move freely across the screen while the action constantly scrolls to the right, pushing you deeper into danger. In each stage, a set number of enemy craft must be destroyed before the mission can continue. This creates a direct space assault that effectively combines speed, evasive skill, and focused fire.

meta.name: Star-Wreck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.63 KB

The player takes the role of Captain James T. Cake of the starship Paralysed. The mission is to travel to the planet Dandrox and deliver a Trell and a Rigellian Slime beast who are needed there for experimental purposes. On board there is the Thracian ambassador to Dandrox.and a Krall who's travelling elsewhere.
The ship starts falling apart as the game progresses and a number of the puzzles are based on resolving these problems in order to reach the destination.

meta.name: Starace
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Starace” is a racing game where you pilot a spacecraft through a series of tunnels, competing against other opponents. The game features vector graphics, giving it a unique visual style but also making it somewhat slow-paced. The challenge lies in navigating the tight curves of the tunnels while outpacing the competition. Despite its slower speed, the game remains engaging due to its addictive gameplay.

meta.name: Spaceball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In 2164, the planet Utalis was conquered by a Jitter-Bob invasion. Now the residents faced years of enslavement and humiliation. But like every year, the residents of Utalis can try to fight for their freedom this year in challenging Starball duels.
Starball is a mix of Breakout and Pong.

meta.name: Starbyte Super Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Starbyte Super Soccer is a football management simulation where you take charge of both the athletic and financial aspects of your club. The goal is to lead your team from the fourth division up to the top German league, with a specific seasonal objective set at the start. In addition to the real German league of the 1991/1992 season, fictional scenarios are available, such as a world league with national teams or immediate home-and-away matches. Throughout the season, you manage lineup, tactics, training, transfers, stadium expansion, and merchandising. Player strength is determined by position, form, and stamina. At the end of each season, a set amount of money must remain in the club's account, or you risk being fired. The game also evaluates your managerial performance, which is especially relevant in multiplayer mode.

meta.name: Starcross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The year is 2186. Humanity has established colonies on the moon, Mars, and several of the larger asteroids. Earth's sky is dotted with space habitats, and the spaceways are always busy. As usual, there is the urgent need for energy to power this advanced civilization; one of the primary sources of that energy is quantum black holes.
In Starcross, you are a miner of black holes, scouring the asteroid belt in your one-man survey ship. Finding and harnessing a single black hole can make a person's fortune. It's a lonely business, fraught with the known and unknown hazards of space. You've equipped your ship, the M.C.S. STARCROSS, with the best gear you could afford. You've put everything into this venture, and though you've tried before, you somehow sense that this time will be different.

meta.name: Stareggs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.34 KB

Stareggs throws you into a desperate space mission where you stand as the sole pilot and last hope for Earth. Alien hatcheries drift closer, releasing deadly creatures if their eggs are not destroyed in time. Every escape would spell disaster, making fast reactions and precise control essential. Before you can eliminate the hatcheries themselves, powerful guardians stand in your way, pushing your skills to the limit.

meta.name: Starfighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.18 KB

Starfighter is a cooperative shooter for the Commodore 64 where the player controls a spacecraft through enemy territory and battles numerous foes. The name of the game is its purpose – the player takes control of a Starfighter and must fight their way through challenging levels. The game is designed in such a way that cooperation with a second player is crucial for success.

meta.name: Starfighter I
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.05 KB

Starfighter I puts you in control of a crosshairs in space, where you must shoot enemy ships before they escape. With a moving starfield and arcade-style pacing, the mission ends if too many enemies slip past. Your goal is to score as many points as possible and beat the high score.

meta.name: Starfire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.50 KB

Starfire puts you in the cockpit of a starfighter for an intense first-person battle. Enemy fighters streak toward you, launching fireballs as you line up your laser sight to lock on and blast them out of space. Each kill earns points – and a bit of precious fuel to keep you going. Precision and reflexes are key: only quick aim and steady hands will keep you alive. When your fuel finally runs out, the mission ends – and the galaxy belongs to the enemy.

meta.name: Starflight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Starflight es un juego de exploración espacial. El jugador primero debe formar una tripulación, asignar sus posiciones y personalizar la nave espacial antes de despegar del muelle espacial. Una vez en el espacio, la interfaz predeterminada permite el acceso a los diferentes miembros de la tripulación y la navegación. La galaxia entera es desconocida y depende del jugador viajar a planetas distantes para explorarlos y aterrizar en ellos. Utilizando una interfaz de arriba hacia abajo, un módulo de aterrizaje planetario se aventurará con la tarea de encontrar minerales y datos biológicos para transportar de regreso al Puerto Estelar.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.80 KB

In this text adventure, you, the pilot and sole occupant of the Starship Ganymede, have just awakened from suspension sleep after ten years. You get to the bridge and see a blue button flashing. Pushing the button, you hear a communique from your superior. You are to locate the Megaship Armstrong, missing and out of communication for ten years, and determine why she has stopped responding and never reached the colony she was destined for. You are then to report back what you find. Good luck.

meta.name: Star Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Star Force starts off quietly until enemy ships breach your quadrant. You activate the long-range scanner, boost with turbo, and set your lasers to full power. You navigate your ship through space, managing shields, fuel, and weapons while tracking, locking on, and destroying hostile craft. What seemed like a lazy mission quickly turns into a fierce battle in space.

meta.name: Starforce Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.97 KB

Earth stands on the brink of destruction. After years of fighting, the Imperial Forces of Dalsarn have conquered most of the galaxy and are increasingly deploying robot ships. The Terran Star Force is overwhelmed and has barely any resources left to defend Earth. You play as one of the few surviving pilots flying a Star Force Fighter, battling against the overwhelming enemy fleet. Your mission is to defend Earth by fighting waves of enemies sent by the Dalsarn Empire. Your spacecraft is well-equipped, but you will constantly face superior foes who will make your mission extremely difficult. Only your skill and determination can determine whether you save Earth.

meta.name: Starforce Nova
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.91 KB

Starforce Nova takes you to a bleak future where Earth has been devastated by wars, alien invasions, and resource depletion. As Captain Paul Squires, you escort a carrier ship on a desperate search for a new home through the mysterious Dimension F. Flying your fighter, you defend the carrier sector by sector from alien attacks, offering humanity a final hope for survival.

meta.name: Starglider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.59 KB

Starglider places you in the cockpit of an outdated but still battle-ready attack vehicle, defending the planet Novenia against the Egrons. The invaders tricked the defense systems by disguising themselves as harmless Stargliders, so now you have to track them down and destroy them yourself. From the cockpit view, you control speed, targeting, and weapons, while shields, scanner, and map become vital to survival. This creates an intense sci-fi mission that combines tactical flying, precise aiming, and the fight against a cunning invasion.

meta.name: Starion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.34 KB

Aliens using a time machine have changed several crucial events in earth history. As Starion, a rookie starfighter pilot in 2010AD, you must correct these, in a hybrid of puzzle and action.
There are 243 sectors to correct, each representing a year. After selecting one, you are involved in first-person space dogfighting, viewed from within your cockpit. Pay attention to your multi-directional scanner to locate ships and mines. There are also indicators for your fuel and oxygen levels, pitch and yaw, and engine temperature.
Shot enemies release letters, which must then be flown over. Once an area is cleared, you must use the letters to form a word. Then, fly through the time gate, and decide which historical event the word relates to.

meta.name: The Starlight Zone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.05 KB

The Starlight Zone drops you into a neon-colored descent where danger lurks on every platform. Guide your tiny character downward, dodging the oddly shaped foes that swarm from all directions. Each floor gets faster and trickier, and one wrong move sends you back to the start. Simple in concept but brutally demanding, it's a relentless test of reflex and focus.

meta.name: Starquake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un mensaje acaba de ser interceptado por la Tierra procedente de un Planeta inestable emergiendo de un Agujero Negro en alguna parte del extremo de la Galaxia. Si el núcleo no es reconstruido, implicaría la destrucción de todo el Universo, con explosiones en cadena de estrellas.
BLOB, ser Biologico Operado remotamente, se le envía a un planeta inestable y se le encarga la tarea de evitar que explote. Esto implica recolectar varios elementos y llevarlos al núcleo del planeta.
El juego es una aventura de arcade vista desde el lateral, con 512 pantallas dispuestas en un patrón de 16x32. Existe un sistema de teletransportación, por lo que una vez que encuentre los códigos, podrá acceder rápidamente a diferentes partes del juego.
Las criaturas que debes evitar son inteligentes, y cada vez es más difícil de predecir a medida que te acercas al centro, pero estás armado con un arma y también puedes intentar evitarlas.

meta.name: Stars and Rings
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.02 KB

Stars and Rings is a one-button game where you control a star spinning in circles while holding the fire button. Releasing it launches the star in its current direction. Your goal is to pass through rings that appear on screen while avoiding the edges. It may look simple, but it demands sharp timing, quick reflexes, and a strong sense of motion – a minimalist challenge that's anything but easy.

It may look simple, but it's a test of precision, reflexes, and nerves.

The entire galaxy is controlled by a federation led by a tyrant called Alana who alone has access to a Mind-Lord computer that controls everything. The computer key is a crystal suspended from a necklace of Pentite which is one of the hardest elements known in the Galaxy and only a proton spear powered by Zyron and Trysst can cut it. You have been tasked with pursuing Alana and retrieving the crystal in your spaceship called Andromeda, but Alana is moving around the galaxy all the time, so her exact location is rarely known. You must scour the entire galaxy for starbases to take over to restrict Alana's movements and scan planets to find the spear and the elements that power it.

In StarTrash, the player controls a ball which needs to climb big mountains which are shown in an isometric perspective. The goal is to collect objects which were misplaced in the levels. Jumping in a hole or touching one of the critters causes the loss of a life. Bonus points are gained by collecting objects like money which are spread over the levels.

Stationfall is a text adventure game and a sequel to Planetfall, featuring the same protagonist who has been promoted from Ensign Seventh Class to Lieutenant First Class. However, the current work in the Stellar Patrol seems to be less satisfying than before, as the Lieutenant has to deal with boring paperwork. One day the Lieutenant receives an assignment that involves accompanying a spacetruck to a space station and picking up a load of "Request for Stellar Patrol Issue Regulation Black Form Binders Request Form Forms". The Lieutenant travels to the space station with his robotic side-kick Floyd. Once they arrive, they find it deserted, with only an ostrich and an Arcturian balloon creature left untouched. The two must investigate the station and find out what happened.

meta.name: Stealth
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Stealth, you pilot a stealth aircraft flying low over enemy territory, with one clear objective: to destroy the mysterious Tower of Darkness located 9999 meters away. Along the way, you take out radars, bunkers, and military targets to earn points. Yellow energy fields refill your fuel – red ones must be avoided. Once the tower is destroyed, you advance to the next, even tougher mission with the same core goal.

Stealth Mission is a flight simulator allowing you to fly three planes, F-19 Stealth Bomber, X-29 Experimental and a F14 Tomcat. There are four missions to fly but each mission can be played as easy or advanced making eight in total. Once your mission and plane is chosen then you can load your plane with a variety of weapons. There are 10 skill levels to choose from as well, 0 is easy, 9 is hard. 
Stealth Mission is viewed from a 1st person perspective. The main playing area is your view from the cockpit while all your instruments surround the edge of the screen. A variety of instruments are seen including altitude, thrust fuel and your radar. The joystick is used to steer your plane while there are a wide variety of keys used on the keyboard to help you fly a successful mission.
There are a variety of camera angles as well including a side view, view from the tower, satellite and even a missile camera.

meta.name: Steel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.37 KB

The space ship Steel is so advanced that it is completely operated by robots. As usually in video games, these robots went havoc and have to be put out of business. This job falls to the player who goes on the ship to shut down the security system. He is disguised as robot, but this does not stop the other ones from attacking.So the player wanders around the maze-like ship, consisting of non-scrolling screens, with the ultimate goal to collect eight cartridges. The enemy robots can be blasted away with the laser weapon, but contact costs energy.

meta.name: Steel Eagle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.79 KB

Steeel Eagle is 2D side-scrolling shooter game without real story. The player controls a jetfighter, he fights against enemies and bosses - he has normal shoot and more powerful, charged laser. He can find other weapons by shooting enemies. The game has 4 levels.

meta.name: Steel Heros
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Steel Heros, you battle in a two-player mode against a human opponent in a tank duel. The playing field takes up about two-thirds of the screen, and you control your tank using the joystick. The objective is to destroy the opponent, strategically using the ruins on the field for cover and waiting for the right moment to strike. The game ends when a player's health reaches zero, and the winner can enter their name on the high score list.

meta.name: Steel Robot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.98 KB

In Steel Robot, you pilot a spaceship across vast landscapes, facing various challenges to gather energy. With enough energy, you can upgrade your weapons and eventually transform into your most powerful form – a giant mecha robot. Each stage offers greater firepower but also tougher enemies to test your skills. Though never published, the game promised action-packed battles and the thrill of transforming into a massive war machine.

meta.name: Steel Thunder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Steel Thunder features multiple battlefields from Cuba to Europe. While actually inside the tank, the player can easily switch from the position of commander to gunner or driver, providing a high level of realism but still keeping the action moving. You can just stay in the commander's seat, give orders to the driver and gunner, and just watch what's happening, even if only from the inside view.
As the game progresses, the player also increases his rank. The initial mission setup screen presents the player with several tanks, from the Bradley to the M1A1. In addition, the player can also select specific crew members and view their respective “grades” in terms of their performance characteristics.

meta.name: Steg the Slug
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.18 KB

Steg the slug has to feed his family of "T'yungunz".  To do this he must blow bubbles to catch the grubs that they feed on and guide them through the level by blowing on them or nudging them past any obstacles in the way to the nest where T'yungunz live.  To complete a level, you must make sure that a certain number of T'yungunz are fully fed so they go to sleep.  If they don't get enough food then eventually they die.
The levels are full of contraptions such as bellows, and obstacles such as spikes and fire that will burst the bubbles.  Some of these can be activated or deactivated using various switches.
Usually Steg navigates each level by walking on the floor, and also he can climb up the walls and even walk on the ceiling.  There are also devices he can contruct out of the parts from the Acme Bionic Bitz Catalogue, such as the Rocket Pack, and Bionic Legs, which allow different ways of getting around each level.

meta.name: Steigar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.20 KB

You are Steigar and you made your living as a mercenary, getting paid to complete missions large or small as long as the price was right. Until the CIA managed to find and capture her, but she was too good at her job and so she was forced to join the US Navy and become a helicopter pilot to take part in one-man missions against various threats to the USA to participate. The game is a scrolling horizontal shoot-em-up viewed from the side. You start off on an aircraft carrier and fly over various assigned missions while shooting and killing many waves of enemies, including helicopters, planes, boats and tanks.

meta.name: Stellar 7
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Gir Draxon, Supreme Overlord of the Arcturan Empire has declared war on the Terran Federation. The leaders of Earth respond by sending the Terran Fleet on their way to Arcturus to intercept Draxon's armada. But this was a deadly mistake: the Arcturans have discovered warplinks, which allow them to transport troops from one link to another instantaneously, even across vast interstellar distances. With the fleet halfway across the galaxy, the enemy has already reached the Sol system and occupied Saturn's moon Titan. Now, humanity's only hope is the experimental Raven armored vehicle. One courageous pilot must take the Raven through seven different star systems, from Titan to Arcturus, defeating any and all Arcturans, using the warplinks to travel from one system to the next.

meta.name: Stellar Dodger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.97 KB

In this adventure, you take on the role of an interstellar shuttle pilot who maintains the vital connection between a star cruiser and its supply depots. Only the best pilots manage to pilot such a shuttle, as a high level of skill is required for safe landing and docking. In addition, crossing dangerous asteroid fields on the supply planets requires the utmost precision. Although you can shoot down the asteroids, this creates a gravitational vortex that draws even more asteroids into your sector. Your commander is demanding - after each successfully completed mission, a new, even more difficult challenge awaits you.

meta.name: Stellar Triumph

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.09 KB

In Sterntaler, you find yourself in the fairytale-like Star Valley, controlling a girl who must catch as many falling stars as possible with her dress. Green, red, and blue stars are worth different points, while deadly asteroids must be avoided. Once you reach 5000 points, you enter a bonus round where you're invincible. The controls are simple, the concept charming, and the atmosphere lovingly crafted – a quiet, star-catching fairytale in pixels.

meta.name: Steve Cartwright's Megamania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.17 KB

Steve Cartwright's Megamania puts you in control of a spaceship at the bottom of the screen as you fend off wave after wave of attackers. Enemies take on unusual and often humorous shapes, attacking in tight formations that demand quick reflexes and accurate shooting. As you destroy as many foes as possible, your energy steadily drains, adding constant pressure. A fast-paced shooter distinguished by its quirky style and escalating intensity.

meta.name: Steve Crossland : Sub Commander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.89 KB

Take out the enemy surface fleet, one silent torpedo at a time. Each ship is worth 100 points. Carriers are worth double, but take twice the hits to sink. Adjust for speed and remember that some of the ships have depth charges that can damage you and eventually you'll run out of torpedoes.

meta.name: Steve Davis Snooker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.99 KB

Steve Davis Snooker brings the rules of English snooker to the screen and can be played solo or with two players, but without a computer opponent. You score not only for potting balls correctly but also concede penalty points for fouls or misses, which are all tracked. After every shot you remain at the table, even if you foul or miss, making solo play more aggressive than real snooker since you never leave an opponent an opening. You can play with either 10 or the full 15 reds. After potting a red you select one of the six colors, chosen by its point value key. For each shot you set the aim, the shot power, and the spin.

meta.name: The Stickybear ABC
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

The Stickybear ABC is an early learning game for children aged 3 to 7, based on the 1980s children's book series of the same name. It teaches letter skills in three game modes: In ABC mode, pressing a key shows an object starting with that letter; in Match mode, the player matches a letter to the correct object; and in Order mode, letters must be placed in the correct alphabetical sequence.

meta.name: Stickybear Basketbounce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Stickybear Basket Bounce puts you in control of the lovable Stickybear as he catches falling objects in colorful factory settings and even in space, suited up for zero gravity action. You'll need to jump and dodge across the screen to collect bouncing items while avoiding dangers sliding across the floor. Objects bounce lower with time, so quick reflexes are key – miss too many or get hit, and you lose one of your three lives. Beat a stage and earn a life, but lose them all and a bulldozer shoves poor Stickybear right off the screen. A charming, fast-paced children's game with arcade energy and plenty of bounce.

meta.name: Stickybear Math
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Math es un juego educativo para niños de seis a nueve años, donde Stickybear se enfrenta a diversas situaciones que solo pueden resolverse resolviendo problemas matemáticos. Los jugadores deben, por ejemplo, recolectar la cantidad correcta de globos para poder escalar un pequeño muro. El juego fomenta el pensamiento matemático y las habilidades para resolver problemas de manera divertida.

meta.name: Stickybear Math II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

"Stickybear Math 2" is the sequel to the popular educational game where the character Stickybear once again faces mathematical challenges. Players must solve various math problems to help Stickybear out of tricky situations, such as collecting the correct number of objects or completing mathematical equations. The game playfully teaches multiplication and division while encouraging logical thinking and mental arithmetic.

meta.name: Stickybear Numbers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Numbers is a learning game for young children that helps them recognize and understand numbers from 0 to 9. For each selected number, a matching amount of colorful animated objects such as balls, rockets, or toy trucks appears on the screen, making counting fun and engaging.

meta.name: Stickybear Opposites
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Opposites is a learning game for young children from the Stickybear series that teaches opposites. Small visual scenes illustrate concepts such as “near” and “far,” “open” and “closed,” or “tall” and “short.” Players can switch between the opposites and move on to new concepts at any time.

meta.name: Stickybear Reading
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Stickybear Reading is a learning game for children aged four to eight featuring the character Stickybear. It offers three activities: In Sentence Builder, players create sentences from nouns and verbs, which Stickybear reads aloud and animates. In Sarah's Word Book, clicking objects shows their names and animations. In Word Bop, a magic cannon turns items into words and vice versa. The game can be played in both English and Spanish.

meta.name: Stickybear Reading Comprehension
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Reading Comprehension is an educational program designed to strengthen reading comprehension and content retention. Children read short stories like “A Dog Named Tiny” and then answer questions based on the text. With simple language and clear structure, it's perfect for early elementary learners. The friendly presentation and familiar Stickybear characters make learning fun while developing vital reading skills.
meta.developer: R. Hefter, S. Worthington & G. Doody

meta.name: Stickybear Shapes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Shapes is designed for children aged three to six and teaches the five most common geometric shapes: circle, square, triangle, rectangle, and diamond. In three activities – Pick It, Name It, and Find It – children learn to identify missing shapes, match shapes with their names, and find hidden shapes in pictures. The goal is to recognize shapes in everyday life, building a foundation for reading and math skills.

meta.name: Stickybear Spellgrabber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Spellgrabber is a learning game for children aged six to nine that improves spelling and vocabulary. In Picture Spell, Stickybear jumps across platforms to collect the letters of the displayed word. Word Spell has him catching falling letters to build a word. In Bear Dunk, a hangman-style game, he must guess words before falling into the water. With over 4,000 words, custom word lists, and adjustable difficulty levels, it offers long-lasting fun.

meta.name: Stickybear Town Builder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Stickybear Town Builder starts with a green, undeveloped area that the player can fill with various buildings. These are instantly constructed and automatically connected by roads. In two game modes, the player then drives a car from a top-down view through the streets – either to a specific map location or to a hidden key whose position is given only by cardinal directions.

meta.name: Stifflip & Co.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Count Chameleon recognises the importance of the game of cricket to the power of the British Empire, and knows that a simple Rubbertronic Ray to scupper the ball's bounce is all it takes to bring their power down. You control the team of Viscount Stifflip, Professor Braindeath, Colonel R G Bargie and Miss Primbottom, as they attempt to stop him.
The bulk of the game is icon-driven, and allows you to switch between the four characters at will. The control options are all described in slangy English terms, so instead of talking to characters you 'Chinwag' with them, and fights are called 'Fisticuffs'. These are a key aspect of the game, requiring prompt arcade reactions and correct move selection, especially as using the low blow too often results in a character being wiped out.

meta.name: Sting 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.22 KB

In Sting 64 Bertie Bee must defend his hive in this action game, taking place across three distinct single-screen parts. You play each of them three times in sequence in amassing a score, but they become harder each time.

meta.name: Stinger!
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Stir Crazy featuring BoBo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Stir Crazy featuring BoBo, you take on the role of the quirky inmate Bobo, who must endure his 17-year sentence by tackling a variety of unusual tasks. Sometimes you're serving soup in the canteen, other times peeling potatoes, helping fellow prisoners escape over the wall, or swinging across dangerous electric wires. In another event, you even need to soothe your snoring cellmates with lullabies so you can finally get some rest yourself. Each challenge demands quick reactions and skill, whether bouncing inmates on a trampoline, balancing on live wires, or keeping soup plates filled under pressure. In the end, your score depends on how well you handle these chores – and maybe you'll make Bobo's prison time a little easier.

meta.name: Stix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.75 KB

Stix pits you against Kwixx, a relentless being of pure energy that destroys everything in its path. Your task is to draw lines and create force fields that seal off areas until most of the screen is secured. Once an outline is completed, the enclosed space fills with color and further restricts Kwixx, but additional threats force you to stay fast and precise. Hesitate too long or collide with hostile particles and you lose lives, increasing the pressure with every stage – a tense balance of risk, planning and speed.

meta.name: Stock Car
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.60 KB

Stock Car puts you on a series of varied race tracks where control and awareness matter more than raw speed. You guide your car through turns, manage acceleration and gearing, and constantly avoid obstacles, barriers and unpredictable traffic. Before each race, settings can be adjusted to noticeably change the challenge and make every run feel different. The appeal comes from balancing risk and control at all times – immediate, demanding and focused on precise driving.

meta.name: Stock Market
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.85 KB

"Stock Market" is an economic game for up to six players, where you buy and sell shares in four mining companies. Stock prices fluctuate throughout the game, requiring strategic timing to buy low and sell high. The first player to earn one million pounds wins.

meta.name: Stockade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.67 KB

Stockade is a classic arcade-style maze game where you move through a fenced area, collecting points and bonus items. At the same time, you must avoid enemies who attack you with arrows and make your progress more difficult. Quick reactions and precise timing are key to surviving long and reaching a high score. Despite its problematic and stereotypical setting, mechanically it plays as a fast-paced, straightforward high-score chaser.

meta.name: Stocker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.02 KB

Stocker takes you on a high-speed race across the southern USA – from Florida to California. In top-down view, you drive your car over highways, bridges, country roads, and sometimes even through houses or water. Your main enemy is time, represented by the fuel tank, which only lasts 90 seconds regardless of speed. Gas stations along the route are essential to keep going. But beware: traffic, other drivers, and especially the police can cause you trouble. Running into a squad car earns you tickets, lowering your score and possibly ending the game. Question-marked forks offer the chance of shortcuts – or the risk of getting badly lost.

meta.name: Computer Stocks & Bonds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.86 KB

Stocks and Bonds challenges you to build wealth through smart trading on the stock market. Starting with $5,000, you choose from ten different securities, each with its own price and yield. The key is to buy low and sell high as prices fluctuate each year. Success depends on strategic timing and market insight – fortunes can be made or lost with every decision.

meta.name: The Stone Table
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Stone Table takes you into a cursed kingdom suffering under the spell of a banished sorcerer. After being exiled from the king's court, he has shrouded the land in darkness. Only an old hermit knows the path to four magical tokens hidden in a distant land – and only when they are united can peace be restored.

meta.name: Stones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.37 KB

Stones is a clever puzzle game featuring 30 tricky levels, impressively packed into just 5 KB and guaranteed to challenge your brain. The goal is to clear all stones from the screen within a time limit. Using the joystick, you move a blinking cursor onto a gray stone and confirm – all stones directly adjacent in vertical and horizontal directions are removed. Diagonal stones are unaffected. Empty spaces refill with new stones. Exceeding the time limit costs one of your three lives. Precision and foresight are key to solving every level.

meta.name: Stoneville Manor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In "Stoneville Manor," the player explores the estate of the late, wealthy Mr. Stone, who allegedly left his entire fortune to whoever finds and opens his safe. To achieve this, the player must manipulate objects and search the environment using two-word commands.

meta.name: Stop Stones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Stop Stones is a tricky maze game where your goal is to clear all the blue stones from the screen to finish the level. Sounds simple – but slippery ice tiles send you sliding, teleporters instantly move you elsewhere (triggered by pressing a button), and evil stopper faces block your path or chase you down. With five lives, smart planning is essential: choose the right moment to teleport and carefully navigate narrow passages without getting trapped. Timing, logic, and steady nerves are key to success.

meta.name: Stop the Express
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.41 KB

El ITA Express está bajo el control de los malvados Redmen y no se puede permitir por más tiempo. Aquí es donde entras como guardia de seguridad, ya que comienzas en la parte superior del último vagón del tren y debes recorrerlo, saltando los huecos, para llegar al frente. Los hombres rojos deben ser pateados sin compasión con un toque preciso antes de que puedan arrojarte del tren; también lanzarán cuchillos que hay que esquivar. Puedes cambiar las tornas gracias al Snakebird, que te recogerá si te subes a él y te permitirá tirarte encima de un Redman. Tienes un tiempo limitado para llegar al frente, indicado por el suelo que se mueve hacia atrás mientras el tren avanza. En la segunda parte del juego estás dentro del tren, tratando de sobrevivir el tiempo suficiente para que todo comience de nuevo con mayor dificultad.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Storm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.05 KB

Storm throws you into a fast-paced adventure where you move through equally sized rooms to rescue Storm's kidnapped wife from a heavily guarded laboratory. Together with a wizard companion, you battle waves of enemies, collect treasure, and gradually take control of each area. The experience relies on quick decisions, constant movement, and smart enemy handling – only those who stay alert and push forward consistently will reach their goal.

meta.name: Storm Across Europe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The game allows to simulate World War II in Europe on a grand strategic scale. The player controls land, sea and air action and has to manage limited resources for production and advanced research.
There are 6 historical scenarios included in the game, and they are labelled after the turn that they start on, from Autumn '39 to Summer '44. A scenario builder can be brought into action for players wanting to change the starting situation. It allows for the modification of an area's terrain type, population or raw material points it contains. The player can transfer units or change the beginning levels of the major powers like research and reinforcement.
Each game turn represents three months of action. The game map covers every part of the European conflict - from North Africa to Sweden, from Gibraltar to the Ural Mountains in Russia.

meta.name: Storm Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.84 KB

Storm Warrior tells the story of a cursed kingdom suffering under an endless, magically summoned storm. As the prince, armed with only a sword, you set out to find the source of the evil and break the spell. Your destination is the Witch Queen's dark castle, from where she controls the elements with her undead guards. Distrust shadows every step, as no one is safe from her magic and allies may turn at any moment – only caution, courage, and determination offer a chance to restore peace and balance.

meta.name: Storm Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB
