meta.name: Stormbringer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 73.95 KB

Stormbringer continues the story of Magic Knight, whose attempt to return home goes wrong after an accident involving a time machine. The mishap creates a dark counterpart – the Off-White Knight, known as Stormbringer, who uses a deadly storm cloud to hunt his original self. Since destroying the double would mean self-destruction, only one option remains: tracking him down and merging back into one. The adventure draws its tension from this unique premise, balancing pursuit, survival, and the inevitability of confrontation.

meta.name: Stormlord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 75.11 KB

La reina Badh ha ejercido una terrible venganza sobre la tierra secuestrando a las hadas. Para restablecer la situación, debes salvarlas.
A medida que avances por los niveles del juego, te encontrarás con hadas a las que podrás salvar tocándolas. Entre los enemigos se incluyen trampas para moscas Venus, lluvia ácida y dragones, que se pueden evitar o matar en las secciones de bonificación. Para alcanzar ciertos niveles, necesitarás la ayuda del águila Mael Dvin. Después de cada nivel, hay un juego de bonificación en el que tienes que recoger lágrimas para ganar puntos.

meta.name: Stormtrooper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Stormtrooper you pilot a spacecraft through vertically scrolling space stages, either solo or in cooperative two-player mode. You navigate tight metallic corridors, dodge incoming fire, and blast enemy ships to survive. The game blends classic shoot-'em-up action with precise control, offering an intense arcade experience that shines especially when played with a partner.

meta.name: Story House
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.52 KB

"Story House" invites young readers to create their own stories, which the computer brings to life with colorful animations and music. Featuring surprising endings and creative scenarios, such as a green dog chasing a blue cat, the game offers interactive entertainment for children.

meta.name: Story Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.21 KB

Story Machine invites you to experiment with language and create your own small stories. By typing simple sentences, words come to life as key nouns and verbs are instantly turned into animations. Step by step, you build short narratives, combine characters, actions and objects, and immediately see the results of your input. The focus is on creativity, expression and playful language discovery – calm, intuitive and motivating thanks to direct visual feedback.

meta.name: Story Tree
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

Story Tree invites you to actively shape your own stories and use language creatively. Through choices and branching paths, the narrative evolves step by step and can take many different directions. Unexpected twists challenge you to expand ideas, rethink connections and consciously engage your imagination. The focus is on playful storytelling, experimenting with language and enjoying the process of letting stories grow – calm in pace, yet stimulating for creativity and expression.

meta.name: Story Tree
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Story Tree invites you to actively shape your own stories and use language creatively. Through choices and branching paths, the narrative evolves step by step and can take many different directions. Unexpected twists challenge you to expand ideas, rethink connections and consciously engage your imagination. The focus is on playful storytelling, experimenting with language and enjoying the process of letting stories grow – calm in pace, yet stimulating for creativity and expression.

meta.name: Stowaway
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.49 KB

Stowaway places you in the hold of a ship as a hidden passenger trying to escape and make your way toward your destination. You explore through typed commands, examine objects and search for clues that unlock new areas or solutions. Limited time and restricted options make each decision meaningful, with small details often proving important. The experience focuses on exploration, experimentation and gradually piecing together a path to freedom.

meta.name: Stranded
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.41 KB

Stranded challenges you to help Moosh destroy the bridge between his world and Tysch's. To do this, you must collect as many tiles as possible on each level and make your way to the exit. Some tiles can't be collected, while others have unexpected effects. Most will vanish once you step on them, making the path increasingly dangerous. Every level can be completed within the time limit – but sometimes patience is the key to finding the way forward.

meta.name: Stranded
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.72 KB

Stranded takes you to the year 2510, where you play as Special Agent Sid of the S.A.S. After a dangerous mission, you are drifting back to Earth aboard your ship Excalibur when you are suddenly ambushed, knocked out, and left on a strange planet. Your mission is to explore the alien world, gather the items needed to repair and refuel your ship, and find your way back home. Each discovery brings you one step closer to returning to Earth.

meta.name: Strange Odyssey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.90 KB

Strange Odyssey es el sexto juego de la serie de aventuras de texto de Scott Adams, comercializado por Adventure International, la compañía de Scott. Se trata de una aventura de texto clásica con un analizador de dos palabras y una interfaz de pantalla dividida. 
Eres un viajero espacial cuya nave espacial se avería mientras orbita un asteroide remoto. Con tan solo una pistola fásica, un traje espacial y una pala, nuestra misión es recolectar cinco tesoros alienígenas y conectar con tu nave nodriza.

meta.name: Strangeloop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.34 KB

Strange Loop takes place in a space factory that has been taken over by aliens. Your goal is to reach the central control room and regain control before the reprogrammed robots launch an attack on Earth. As you navigate through 240 danger-filled rooms, you collect items such as fuel, suit patches, rings, and wrenches to help you overcome obstacles and shut down the computer.

meta.name: Stratagos
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.07 KB

meta.name: Stratego
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 60.05 KB

Stratego combines hidden information with a tactical struggle for the opposing flag. At the start, you place your units, bombs, and the crucial target on the board without knowing how your opponent has arranged their army. Only direct encounters reveal which piece is stronger, turning every advance into a calculated risk. Different board layouts and prepared starting formations add further variety, making each match unfold in a fresh way.

meta.name: Stratton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.69 KB

The Stratton Air Terminal is the latest comfort in space travel. Disaster has struck though. A terrorist bomb has exploded on one of the shuttles forcing it to crash into the terminal. The moorings have been smashed and all life support systems have been cut off. The fall defence units are now active causing any survivors to be cut off.
You have been sent in to save the day. Sat inside a buggy you have to deactivate the Central Computer, rescue survivors and make the base safe. With the entrance code gone you have to remove all the breakers and remove the last databus to shut down the computerised and mechanical parts.

meta.name: Street Beat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.83 KB

In Street Beat you play as Rockin' Rodney, roaming the streets of Funky Town with your boombox. Working for Interdisc Records, your mission is to collect demo tapes from local musicians and deliver them back to Funky Street. As your Ghettoblaster pumps out lively tunes, you get the townspeople dancing. Your ultimate goal is to find the perfect beat and make the whole city groove.

meta.name: Street Cat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sports game featuring you, the cat with various stages. Your task is to pass various obstacle courses, each more difficult than the last.
Events include:
The City Park
Inner City Interlude
The Underground Sewer
The Bowling Pub

meta.name: Street Cred Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un consorcio empresarial quiere hacerse con el edificio que alberga el gimnasio de Joe Lebrinskis en el East Side, y el coste de salvarlo es de 50.000 dólares. Su equipo ha decidido entrenarse para enfrentarse a los esbirros de la organización.
Para asegurarse de que cuentan con los mejores boxeadores, cada uno de ellos tendrá que asestar el mayor número posible de puñetazos al saco de boxeo en veinte segundos. Si lo consiguen, los boxeadores podrán pasar al siguiente ejercicio.

meta.name: Street Cred Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.87 KB

"Street Cred Football" strips away the polish and ambition of professional football and takes the game back to the street, where the only rule is to hit the crate – the goal – more times than your opponent. You choose your five-player team from a pool of 24 characters, including familiar faces like Joe Blade, and place them freely on the pitch. You control the player nearest to the ball, with full control over passing and shooting. Dirty tackles are not only allowed – they're encouraged.

meta.name: Street Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres Ryu, un luchador callejero. Tu objetivo es viajar a 5 países (Japón, EE. UU., Inglaterra, China y Tailandia) y derrotar a 2 enemigos en cada uno. Muchos de estos personajes, como Adon, Gen y Birdie, aparecen posteriormente en la serie Street Fighter Alpha.
Tras cada país, tendrás la oportunidad de obtener puntos adicionales en una pequeña ronda de bonificación, una función que aparece posteriormente en la mayoría de los juegos de Street Fighter. 
El jefe final es Sagat, el penúltimo jefe de Street Fighter 2. El objetivo es convertirte en el mejor luchador del mundo. Como en la mayoría de los juegos de lucha de torneo, una vez derrotado el jefe, el juego se reiniciará y comenzará desde el principio con un nivel de dificultad más alto. 
Es posible empezar una partida para dos jugadores, pero solo habrá una pelea (entre ellos) que determinará quién viajará por el mundo para luchar contra los oponentes controlados por la computadora.

meta.name: Street Fighter II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Street Fighter II brings together eight fighters from around the world in fierce one-on-one battles. Each character has distinctive techniques and memorable special moves – from Ken's Dragon Punch and Dhalsim's Yoga Flame to Guile's Sonic Boom. Those who overcome these rivals eventually earn the right to challenge the feared Grand Masters. The result is an energetic contest driven by strong personalities, spectacular attacks, and the determination to fight all the way to the top.

meta.name: Street Gang
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Street Gang the player takes the role of Mickey who just moved from the country to New York. Now he wants to become one of the big boys and join the street gang. But they set him a challenge: cutting off a curl of hair from their leader...
So in conclusion Mickey walks from left to right while defending himself again the enemy hordes. The game plays out as a standard brawler in which Mickey uses hand-to-hand combat against the foes. However, when he gets the hand of them he also can use other items like guns, baseball bats or teargas. Being hit by opponents, which sometimes hide in garbage bins, drain Mickey's energy and eventually one of his lives.

meta.name: Street Life
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.87 KB

meta.name: Street Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.24 KB

Street Machine sends you into a tough road race against several rivals, where speed is not the only thing that matters. Three demanding stages require a driving style that constantly adapts to the condition of the road. After minor crashes, you can repair damage yourself, but under time pressure you have to choose the right vehicle parts to keep your car race-ready. This creates an exciting racing game that combines high-speed competition with tactical damage management.

meta.name: Street Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.29 KB

Street Machine sends you into a tough road race against several rivals, where speed is not the only thing that matters. Three demanding stages require a driving style that constantly adapts to the condition of the road. After minor crashes, you can repair damage yourself, but under time pressure you have to choose the right vehicle parts to keep your car race-ready. This creates an exciting racing game that combines high-speed competition with tactical damage management.

meta.name: Street Rod
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The year is 1963 and you're one of the hotshots aspiring to be king of the county. You're given a small sum of money to buy your first car. Tune it for maximum performance and off you go. In the diner where other hotshots are waiting to take your prized possession, you race for money and pink slips and if you win, you get to take home their cars!
The game's interface is relatively easy and fun to use. You have your own garage as the interface itself. Options are in the form of the garage's elements such as the clock for the game's main menu and the newspaper as your source for buying cars and parts. Add to that a third person with an attitude that talks to you as you play It's really a neat idea by which up to now, no other racing games have that style. You feel that you're living in a virtual world as opposed to just going from menu to menu. Another realistic part is the ability for you to sell your car and haggle.

meta.name: Street Sports Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A baseball game for 1 or 2 players in which the action takes place in parks, vacant lots and backyards with makeshift bases, rather than on an actual diamond. In addition to the normal rules of baseball, players must cope with mud puddles, tree stumps, and other hazards. Features a split-screen view which provides an overview of the entire field alongside close-ups of where the action is happening.

meta.name: Street Sports Basketball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Street Sports Basketball proves that exciting matches do not need a grand arena – a schoolyard, parking lot, backyard, or alleyway is enough. You choose your team from kids with different strengths, make use of passes, steals, and dunks, and also have to deal with obstacles such as potholes or oil slicks. The varied courts give every game a slightly different feel and create a lively street-sports atmosphere. Street Sports Basketball combines relaxed competition, tactical team selection, and pleasantly dynamic playfields into a particularly charming basketball experience.

meta.name: Street Sports Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This American football game is played on the street with three players on each team, picked from the local neighbourhood kids. Each kid has his own skill. There are three positions, Quarterback and two receivers. The idea is to get the ball to the other side of the street. The team attacking has four plays to move 10 yards by either throwing or running with the ball. If the defence can stop the other team moving more than 10 yards in four plays then they get the ball. 
The game is viewed from the side. Here you can select which play to use. When happy with your play you control the quarterback. Move him/her in any direction with the joystick. If you want to pass then press the fire button. 
There are plenty of options including how many points, how many plays etc. You can even design your own plays.

meta.name: Street Surfer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.61 KB

Jump on your skateboard and take a ride along an highway! Clear the highway of empty, thrown-away, bottles. Pick them up for recycling. But beware of traffic, the shoulder, freaky chickens crossing the road, and holes on the road. Every time you're involved in an accident your life-energy decreases, but you can fill it up by collecting soft drink bottles thrown away by other drivers. At the end of each stage stands an recycling container, on the down-right side of the screen you get the information how many miles left to it. If you reach the containers you automatically fill it with all the bottles you picked up during the stage. For each of them you get bonus points. For filling up life-energy you receive the information when a car drives by the driver drinking a soft drink. Get close to the car and to approx. the same speed - and your guy drinks automatically from the soft drink. It's a good choice to drive most times in the mid of the highway - you never know when freaky high speed-racers come up to you.

meta.name: Street Warrior
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.49 KB

There's something bad going down on the streets of Chicago. The Boss of everything nasty is stepping up his operations and you have got to stop him! His highly trained thugs have been ordered to stop you as you progress through the streets, a graveyard and the wharf to reach his warehouse hideout. Collect the money left by the thugs as you take them out with kicks and punches and get yourself a bomb with which to end the Boss's stranglehold on the city. Also, beat up dudes.

meta.name: The Streets of London
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.60 KB

Streets of London starts with the player waking up in a police cell after a drunken night out. Lying there wondering what to do until the pubs open their doors again, the players character comes up with an answer that becomes the purpose of the game. There's no messing about with magic rings and power stones in this game, the objective is to find the ultimate treasure, the Holy Grail itself.

meta.name: Strider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juegas como Hiryu, miembro de la hermandad de los Striders, una especie de orden caballeresca moderna, que lucha contra el siniestro "Grand Master Meio", que desea conquistar el mundo. Diezmada su hermandad, usted es uno de los únicos Striders que siguen vivos para buscar venganza. El juego adopta la forma de un juego de plataformas. Armado con tu sable láser (Cypher), tendrás que eliminar a numerosos enemigos en varios niveles que van desde la Unión Soviética hasta la selva tropical.  También puedes colgarte de las paredes con un gancho metálico.
Ocasionalmente, las bonificaciones obtenidas al destruir cápsulas te permitirán aumentar el alcance de tu espada o ir acompañado de un pequeño robot que destruirá a tus enemigos. Apreciamos los espectaculares movimientos del personaje desenvainando su arma o girando en el aire mientras salta.

meta.name: Strider II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un Strider (the warrior) ha sido llamado para salvar a los habitantes del planeta Magenta. Armado con un láser giroscópico y un convertidor de materia, debe abrirse paso a través de un bosque, una ciudad en ruinas, asentamientos subterráneos, los tejados de un edificio y, finalmente, la nave prisión en la que se encuentra el líder de los Megantans.
La jugabilidad es similar a la del original, consistente en correr, saltar y atacar, con un personaje central muy dinámico. La pistola láser puede usarse estando quieto. Los ataques en movimiento con la espada siguen siendo posibles, combinándose ambas armas de forma similar a los juegos de Switchblade. Se pueden recoger fichas que te convertirán en un robot para enfrentarte a los jefes de final de nivel (si recoges las suficientes).

meta.name: Strike Aces
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Fighter Bomber you take the role of a military pilot competing in an international bombing and navigation contest. Throughout a variety of missions you must navigate accurately, locate targets and make quick decisions under pressure, reflecting the challenges faced by real pilots. You can choose from several aircraft and practice in free flight before taking on the main missions. During the campaign you face opposing aircraft while trying to complete your objectives and earn points for your performance. The crew that collects the highest score ultimately wins the competition.

meta.name: Strike Fleet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Strike Fleet you command an entire fleet of modern warships and lead them through a series of naval missions. The scenarios are inspired by political conflicts and international tensions relevant at the time of the game's release. During missions you can switch between different ships in your fleet and directly control their weapons and maneuvers. You can also deploy helicopters to assist with reconnaissance or attacks. Success depends on careful tactics and the coordinated use of your fleet's resources.

Place yourself behind your BB2 gun to knock out reconnaissance helicopters. Then defend yourself against wave after wave of enemy bombers with their fighter escorts. Finally have a go at picking out the enemy vehicles as they dodge behind buildings, but beware the armored cars, don't let them stop, turn and fire back.

meta.name: Strike Force Cobra
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.45 KB

Strike Force Cobra es un juego de acción en el que el jugador controla a un equipo de 4 miembros elegidos entre un equipo de 8 personajes disponibles con diferentes fortalezas y debilidades. El objetivo del juego es ayudar a los científicos secuestrados por el enemigo y evitar que pirateen su superordenador. El jugador controla a un solo personaje a la vez y debe desarmar las trampas para que los otros personajes puedan pasar.

meta.name: Strike School
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.04 KB

In Strike School cooperation is the only path to survival. Two players share a single control system and must work together to shoot a set number of targets before time runs out — fail, and both perish. Only perfect coordination and mutual trust will see you through. Occasionally, a medal appears, granting an extra life — a brief relief amid the chaos. Things get truly wild when more than two players share the same joystick, turning Strike School into a frantic mix of teamwork, reflexes, and accidental disaster.

meta.name: Strike Team
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 68.51 KB

Strike Team is a simple yet engaging shooter game in which the player must fight enemies using precise shots. Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: Strike Team Delta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.86 KB

In Strike Team Delta you fight as part of an elite squad and must take down enemy forces before they can eliminate you. During the missions you move through hostile areas, using cover and mobility to stay alive. Enemies appear suddenly and attack, making quick reactions and accurate shooting essential. Only by staying alert and positioning yourself wisely can you defeat the opposition and complete the mission successfully.

meta.name: Strike Team II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 62.39 KB

Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.17 KB

Strike is a game where you can play 10-pin bowling against a friend or a computer player (skill level 1-4). The game follows the rules of bowling, where you must knock down ten pins at the end of the lane in two shots, unless you land a hit on your first throw. You play over 10 rounds and the winner is the player with the highest score. The game features an isometric view that shows the player at the beginning of the track.

meta.name: Striker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.09 KB

In Striker you play as a young forward beginning his football career at the age of 18 in England's fourth division. Your goal is to help your team climb the leagues, win domestic and European trophies, or transfer to bigger clubs as your career progresses until retirement at age 34. Between matches you can train, discuss transfers with your agent or negotiate a better contract. During games the action focuses on the goal area, where you occasionally get the chance to take a shot. A moving bar represents the angle of your attempt and you must stop it at the right moment to shoot and hopefully score. After each match you receive a manager's report evaluating your performance.

meta.name: Striker in the Crypt of Trogan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.68 KB

Striker in the Crypt of Trogan casts you as a noble wizard battling the evil Trogan the Diabolical. You journey through maze-like flick-screen environments both above and below ground, using your sword to cut down hordes of henchmen. Skeletons and other dangers await, while your energy is limited but can be replenished with pickups. Scattered tokens can either enhance or weaken your weapon, forcing you to play carefully. Only with skill and caution can you face Trogan and defeat him.

meta.name: Striker Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.30 KB

“Striker Manager” is a football management game where you act as both manager and striker, guiding your team from the English 4th Division to the 1st Division while winning national and European trophies. If your skills impress, you can take charge of a European or international team with the goal of winning the World Cup. You can buy and sell players, set up the team, and deliver motivational speeches. During team setup, you can choose to play or stay on the bench if it benefits the team. Match highlights are presented in text format, with key moments marked by a clock. For goal attempts, whether by your team or the opposition, the game switches to an arcade sequence where you control either the direction of your shot or the movement of the goalkeeper from an elevated perspective.

meta.name: Strip Darts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.24 KB

Strip Darts: Knockout Tournament is an unconventional dart game where players compete in a pub contest. Due to excessive alcohol consumption, a spontaneous idea arises to play the game with special rules, which the opponent accepts. The player can choose between the 301 and 501 modes and competes against the computer. After each throw with three darts, points are deducted from the board. The goal is to lose all points before the computer does. The stakes of the game lead to humorous consequences, adding a playful touch to the experience.

meta.name: Strip Poker : A Sizzling Game of Chance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Strip Poker has you playing five-card draw not just for chips, but for clothing – or rather, the gradual removal of it from your digitized opponent. Win hands, and models like Suzi or Melissa will reveal more, all in chunky pixel graphics. Expansion disks offered new faces (and bodies) for the curious. Poker mechanics are basic, but the game's appeal was less about strategy and more about risqué novelty – a product of its time, more infamous than refined.

Strip Poker II updates the formula with a new interface and two fresh opponents – Donna and Sam. Starting with $100, you play five-card draw with adjustable bets ranging from $5 to $25. Win a hand, and your opponent sheds a layer of clothing. A second card draw lets you refine your hand before comparing results. The core concept remains unchanged: simple poker mechanics wrapped around digitized striptease – more about titillation than tactics.

meta.name: Strip Poker II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Strip Poker II calls itself an "erotic and sensuous game" blending video fantasy with hints of computer psychometry – but at its core, it's still classic five-card draw where you win to see digitized opponents gradually undress. Built entirely in machine language, the game boasts smooth performance, fast input, and for its era, surprisingly polished music. Marketed as intelligent and fantastic, it's more a provocative slice of 80s computer culture than a deep poker simulation – delivering titillation under the guise of gameplay.

“Strontium Dog and the Death Gauntlet” puts you in the shoes of Johnny Alpha – mutant, bounty hunter, and feared Strontium Dog from the 2000 AD universe. After being attacked by the Stix Brothers, you crash-land on a lawless planet ruled by deadly vegetation and ruthless criminals. Your mission: fight your way on foot to reunite with your companions Wulf and Gronk. In classic run'n'gun style, you dodge attacks, shoot back, and try to keep your energy bar intact. Every mistake brings you one step closer to death.

A rare and raunchy text adventure. A text adventure romp. The object: find your partner, figure out what pleases them, and enjoy mutually satisfying experiences! Tired of all the outer space mumbo-jumbo? Try this "earthly" adventure!

It's 2492 and you must pilot your Sub-Terranean Underground Network (S.T.U.N.) craft at speeds over 900 miles per hour through a series of courses to retain your title as S.T.U.N. Runner, completing each course before time runs out.
There are also enemies on each course, such as cycles, indestructible armored drones, and flying bird-like craft. Shoot or avoid them. If you hit them, you lose one of your shields (your craft has six total) and are slowed down temporarily. The more shields you have at the finish line, the more bonus points you get. Getting hit with no shields does not kill you, however. There are no lives in this game. The only way to lose is to fail to cross the finish line.

meta.name: Stunt Bike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.77 KB

Stunt Bike challenges you on a single screen to guide your motorcycle across hazardous obstacle courses. By accelerating, performing wheelies, and jumping off ramps, you move between platforms while collecting flags along the way. A limited fuel supply adds constant pressure, demanding precise timing and careful control. Only after all flags are collected does the exit open, allowing you to complete the course – any mistake can abruptly end the attempt.

meta.name: Stunt Bike Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.80 KB

To be the best stuntman in the business, you Chad Adams are going to have to prove yourself by taking your motorbike and attempting five different dangerous tasks. Your five tasks are: Hang-Glider Drop: Chad is swooping in on a hang-glider. You control the motorbike which you must avoid the obstacles on the road and trying to position yourself under Chad. When he is in line you press the fire button to drop him on the bike.

meta.name: Stunt Flyer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Stunt Flyer, players take control of a small propeller plane and must perform various aerobatic maneuvers during an airshow. The game is known for its realistic flight physics, requiring precise control and practice to successfully execute stunts like loops, rolls, and sharp turns.

meta.name: Stunt Track Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Race a single computer opponent for first place on a unique racetrack -- 100 feet in the air! You start in the fourth three-man division of a league, all racing each other twice, and must come top to progress. The action is viewed from within the car throughout the 3-lap races, with the distance between you always on screen.
Jump chasms, jumps, and drawbridges; take banks hard or slow; pass your opponent on the track or while catching mass air. Your car has the ability to burn a limited amount of turbo boost fuel as a way to accelerate faster and achieve higher speeds, but don't use it all up at once or you'll fall behind. Don't damage your engine too much; severe dents will show up during your next race.
Whatever you do, don't fall off the track, as this will cost you time as you are placed back on.

meta.name: Stuntman

At the end of an action movie you find yourself in a gunfight. All the forces of evil are against you. Get the chance, your life depends on it.

“Stuntman Seymour” puts you in the shoes of the daring Seymour, who battles through four uniquely themed movie sets as a stuntman – using precise shots and carefully thrown bombs, you fend off enemies, collect score items and face a bomb-tossing giant boss at the end of each stage, losing a life with every misstep.

A Columns type game where you match 3 colored gems to make them disappear and every section you finish unlocks some of the game's art. Published in Golden Disk 64 1991/09. Position the falling diamonds correctly and various graphics will appear. The higher the level of difficulty, the more exciting the game becomes. Either one or two players take part in a match and can save their score.

meta.name: Sub Battle Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sub Battle Simulator is set in World War 2, with the player on the American or German side. Six different submarines are simulated in a total of 60 missions. You will have to navigate, using five different levels of mapping, and plan attacks based on weather and surroundings, paying close attention to the radar. Watch out for torpedoes and Sonars. This was the first submarine simulation to include aircraft as opponents. You can choose to remain on the surface and defend yourself with your guns, or dive and hope to avoid the bomb and/or strafing that'll surely follow.

The entire game is rendered in stylish black and white, giving it a distinctive retro charm. Each time a player takes five hits, their submarine is destroyed, and the opponent earns a point. After that, a new round begins. The game is all about maneuvering skillfully, using the environment to your advantage, and reacting faster than your opponent to collect the most points.

You can move anywhere on the screen you like but if you are to the left, the enemies come at you sooner. Be aware, however, that you slowly sink unless you push up so watch that you don't bump an enemy from below.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.43 KB

Subbuteo recreates the famous table football game, which makes for something very different from Sensible/Kick Off/FIFA style games. It's effectively a turn-based strategy game of sorts, as each player has 30 seconds to make their move (within a 30 minute match length), which involves first selecting a player, then aiming the direction in which he will be flicked, then the power and swerve of the flick are determined by the length of time the button is held down for. 
With any luck, your player will hit the ball, and hit it such that it doesn't leave the playing area, and doesn't hit an opponent. If any of those rules are violated, possession passes to the opposition. Before each flick, the team not in possession can make a 'defensive flick' involving moving one of their players into a potential blocking position (without hitting the ball or an opponent, as this is a foul).

Submarine Rescue is an underwater rescue game where players must retrieve divers trapped in a cave. Once three divers are saved, the gate to the next level opens. Avoiding sea creatures, rocks, and plants is crucial. Skillful maneuvering and precision are key to completing the mission successfully.

meta.name: Submarine Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.17 KB

"Submarine Run" is a naval combat game where players command a submarine through enemy waters. The goal is to sink destroyers and cruisers with missiles while dodging falling depth charges. With three submarines at your disposal, strategic navigation and precise attacks are key to defeating the enemy fleet and surviving.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.38 KB

"Submarine Warfare" puts you in command of a nuclear-powered submarine tasked with locating and destroying enemy ships while evading attacks. In this real-time simulation, you use sonar, control dives, plan strikes, and strategize to survive. Precise navigation and tactical maneuvers are crucial for mission success. A training mode and a detailed manual help you master controls and tactics.

meta.name: Submarines
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.35 KB

"Submarines" is a simple action game where the player controls a ship at the top of the screen. Enemy submarines move underwater and must be hit with depth charges. Pressing any key drops a charge, earning points for each submarine destroyed. The goal is to score as many hits as possible before the enemies escape.

meta.name: Subsunk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.56 KB

In Subsunk you take on the role of Ed Lines, a reporter for the Seafaring Gazette sent to cover life aboard a modern submarine. When the vessel is attacked and sunk by enemy forces, Ed becomes the sole survivor trapped on the ocean floor. Alone in the wreck, you must restore power, uncover clues, and find a way to send the crucial SOS – the “SUBSUNK” message – back to HQ. Tension, isolation, and a creeping sense of urgency define this gripping underwater text adventure.

meta.name: Subterranea
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.67 KB

Subterranea puts you in control of a ship navigating through 16 treacherous caves packed with enemy formations, tight corridors, and destructible walls. Precision is key, as you must shoot control boxes to open gates. Between levels, guardians fill the screen with bubbles – shoot all the glowing ones for an extra life. Miss any, and you'll still advance, but without the reward.

meta.name: Suburban Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Hulk Hogan alias intergalactic hero Shep Ramsey travels through space, crash-lands on earth and beats up the bad guys. The first level is a R-Type-like horizontal space shooter; destroy formations of drones and collect weapon upgrades. After that, you'll enter three platform levels, in which you have to find nine items each. Avoid being shot and dispatch the enemies with kicks and jumps. After each mission, you'll encounter the level boss, who you're supposed to beat up in a Street Fighter clone.

meta.name: Subway Vigilante
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.87 KB

A fighting game which pits you as beret-wearing Guardian Angel-style vigilante against criminals in the London Underground subway system. Using the subway map to locate trouble hotspots, you then travel by train to confront the violent criminals in the stations. Once a station is cleared of bad guys move on to another location to do your vigilante duty.

The program provides a structured, self-paced learning experience, helping to understand and reinforce mathematical concepts through targeted exercises.

In Die Erben des Throns: Krieg um die Krone II, you command a baronial army across a procedurally generated fantasy realm in a quest for the crown. To win, you must collect three royal insignia – crown, scepter, and orb – hidden in conquered territories. Enemy barons, trolls, and dragons stand in your way. Similar to Risk, you deploy reinforcements and attack adjacent regions, but terrain affects battles, adding strategic depth. Only those who plan wisely and conquer boldly can seize the throne.

meta.name: Sudoku
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Sudoku, you fill in a 9x9 grid so that each row, column and 3x3 square contains all the digits from 1 to 9, with no repetitions. The game offers nine difficulty levels, with the number of missing digits varying - from a few gaps on the easiest level to many on the most difficult. Your goal is to solve the puzzle with as few errors as possible and secure your best time on the high score list.

meta.name: Suicide Express
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.63 KB

Suicide Express puts you in the role of the android Scih-Parg, sent to a hostile planet on a ruthless extermination mission. You pilot a nuclear train across a sprawling rail network, blasting alien threats and enemy vehicles while constantly managing risk and ammunition. Hits cost lives, supplies are limited, and carrying too much ammo becomes a danger in itself. Tension builds with every stage, as only precise shooting, smart routing, and careful balance between aggression and caution will see you reach the target and escape the planet.

meta.name: Suicide Strike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.99 KB

A side scroll single shooter aviation game which involves missions flown against an enemy headquarters that requires demolition. Your fuel supply is affected by your speed and maneuvers, and you will face enemy aircraft, surface to air missiles, and enemy gunships, attacking from all angles.

meta.name: Suicide Voyage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.81 KB

There is an energy crisis on Earth! Secret powers have subtracted almost all power from the Earth and bunked in a cave at the end of the world. Proceed in the cave with your agile glider - equipped with strong laser canons - to the energy lamps and shoot at them, to set the energy free again and to save the Earth from eternal coldness and darkness. But be careful and watch out for all kinds of obstacles because you only have four gliders for this precarious task!
So you fly with a spaceship through an underground cave system and need to beware of different enemies. You need to surmount different moving walls and barriers. Equipped with four ships and a laser you start your journey through the labyrinth. Hereby you need to take care not to collide with your surroundings. In the game you find energy lamps and if you hit them with a laser you can continue your game there if you lose a life.

meta.name: Sum Ducks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sum Ducks is an educational game for children that promotes math skills. In the game, ducks with numbered tags swim in a pool, and the player must throw rings onto the ducks to form an equation that matches the target value displayed at the top of the screen. Depending on the game variant, the numbers are combined using addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. For example, in the addition variant, the player must surround ducks with the number 10 to reach 50. Some ducks hide their numbers by diving underwater, while others only resurface when their number matches the target. A hippopotamus may appear with a helpful number. The game offers various difficulty levels to suit different age groups and skill levels.

meta.name: Summer Camp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

GET INVOLVED IN THE CRAZIEST CARTOON GAME EVER! Maximus Mouse has to retrieve the lost Stars&Stripes for the grand Opening Day of Summer Camp - but where is it? Screen after screen of madcap action, addiction and the most colorful collection of cute, crazy but deadly characters you're likely to find! It's the arcade game that tickles your funny bone but could wreck your vacation..!

meta.name: Summer Olympiad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Summer Olympiad positions itself as a rival to the Epyx sports titles, offering five classic events that also appear in those games – some with improved graphics and slightly different controls. You begin by choosing up to six players, entering names, selecting a country and then deciding which events – skeet, hurdles, fencing, triple jump and diving – will be part of the competition. Using the joystick, you highlight your desired disciplines and start the contest via the white box at the bottom. Summer Olympiad delivers a compact multiplayer sports package that puts its own spin on familiar events.

meta.name: Summer Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

Experimenta el poder, la gloria, la emoción y el desafío de la competencia atlética más grande del mundo: ¡LOS JUEGOS DE VERANO!
La impresionante CEREMONIA DE APERTURA se enfoca en 3.000 años de noble tradición mientras mira con orgullo, dispuesto a dar lo mejor de sí para honrar a su país.
Este es el momento en el que ha trabajado y entrenado tanto tiempo para lograr, probar su habilidad bajo presión contra los mejores atletas del mundo. Intentarás destacar en todo un espectro de eventos deportivos: atletismo, natación y buceo, gimnasia y tiro al plato.
Audacia. Habilidad. Estrategia. Determinación. Las marcas del verdadero campeón. Si sale victorioso, recibirá el premio del campeón, la codiciada MEDALLA DE ORO, ante la multitud entusiasta. ¡Tu triunfo podría incluso pasar a la historia como el mejor rendimiento personal de todos los tiempos!
¡Aprovechar el momento! ¡Prepárate para el desafío final! Pruebe los frutos del trabajo duro. ¡Da lo mejor de ti y VAYA POR EL ORO!

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Summix" revolves around number combinations, where the player must form specific sums by strategically arranging or combining numbers. The goal is to overcome logical challenges by carefully selecting the correct numerical values. While the exact rules and mechanics are not widely documented, the game has been praised for its challenging puzzles and innovative concept within the C64 genre.

meta.name: Sumo Wrestlers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.20 KB

Sumo Wrestlers isn't a typical fighting game but an educational typing trainer. Your sumo wrestler only advances when you type the displayed letters quickly and correctly. The faster and more accurate you are, the harder your sumo pushes the opponent back. This way, the game combines quick reflexes with typing practice, all wrapped up in a humorous Japanese sumo setting.

meta.name: Sun Star
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.55 KB

Sun Star puts you in command of a special spacecraft tasked with collecting energy from 16 solar grids. In each level, viewed from a first-person perspective with radar support, you must gather ten energy crystals. Crystals appear when one of four disruptors is shot, but vanish quickly – timing is key. Shooting and crashing drain your ship's energy, which can only be restored via hyper warp. But each warp costs you one collected crystal and can only be used a limited number of times per level.

meta.name: Sunburst
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.17 KB

Sunburst puts you in command of a spaceship navigating hazardous solar systems filled with asteroids and relentless enemies. Foes emerge from circular portals and one hit can mean disaster. Precision dodging and accurate shooting are essential to survive and collect energy pods dropped by defeated enemies. Fill your energy bar, and you can dive into the sun to travel to the next system. A fast-paced, high-stakes journey through the burning depths of space.

meta.name: Supa-Catcha-Troopa!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.84 KB

In Supa-Catcha-Troopa! you are the last hope for parachutists drifting down over the sea, counting on you to rescue them. You must catch them in your boat or throw out a net so they can climb aboard safely. But hurry – they often jump in pairs or threes, hoping safety in numbers will save them. Miss them, and they'll try to swim, but sharks are waiting below. Even success brings danger from above, as screeching pterodactyls swoop down to snatch men from your boat. Their lives depend on you!

meta.name: Super Alien Max
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.94 KB

Super Alien is a single-screen action game and a clone of the 1979 arcade game Heiankyo Alien and was released on the Commodore VIC-20. The player moves through the maze and can place traps on the floor. If a monster goes in, it will be trapped and the player can kill it by filling the hole. Points are awarded for each monster defeated, while touching that monster results in a loss of life points. The maze is shown from the usual top view, but the characters have a side view.

meta.name: Super Ball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.34 KB

Super Ball relies on a simple but demanding arcade concept in which you move through a confined area while avoiding dangerous obstacles. Its stripped-down presentation keeps the focus entirely on reflexes, timing, and accurately judging movement, so even small mistakes are punished immediately. That clear and direct design is where the game draws its appeal, creating a pleasantly tense sense of pressure with very little.

meta.name: Super Black Belt Karate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Faced with ever-increasing crime, you have decided to enroll in a martial arts school where you can learn all the techniques that will be useful for the defense of your property, or rather your person. When practicing against the computer or a friend, you must use all your skill, vigilance and cunning to face and destroy your opponent. Insist on training because good results are achieved only with patience and perseverance and you will see that this game will delight you very much.

meta.name: Super Blitz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.17 KB

Super Blitz puts you in the cockpit of a light bomber that is rapidly running out of fuel. Your only hope of survival is to level the city below to create a safe landing strip. The plane cannot be steered and automatically flies from left to right, descending slightly with each pass. You can only drop bombs at the right moment, making timing everything – as the aircraft flies lower, destroying the tallest skyscrapers becomes increasingly urgent. Bonus points are awarded for a successful landing or for hitting King Kong as he climbs a skyscraper.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.41 KB

Super Bowl XX recreates the Chicago vs. New England matchup and puts you in control of key plays. During kicks you adjust power and accuracy with the fire button, while direction is handled indirectly and returns only succeed with perfect timing. On offense you choose between short and long passes, select a receiver with the cursor and take control after the catch. On defense you can apply different formations such as man coverage or assigning a chaser, and you can switch between players at any time.

meta.name: Super Bread Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.55 KB

In Super Bread Box, you battle endless waves of enemies on a single-screen stage. They spawn from the top and run downward into fire unless you take them out. If they escape, they return faster and more dangerous. Your main objective is to collect crates that appear randomly. Each crate increases your counter and equips you with a new weapon while discarding the old one. As you progress, you can unlock new areas and modes that alter enemy strength and spawn behavior. Completing goals also unlocks new characters and weapons such as a grenade launcher, bazooka, revolver, or even a katana.

meta.name: Super Bunny
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A simple action game where the player is a rabbit who must cross the screen initially from left to right avoiding the various nasty critters in their way.
When the player reaches the right hand side of the screen their goal is to claim the carrot that is being dangled in front of them. If they get the carrot they are transformed into Super Bunny and must begin their journey back across the screen. In this super powered form the player can take revenge and defeat the critters standing in their way.
Super Bunny is similar to "cross the road" games such as the arcade game Frogger and Activision's Freeway.
The original box came with a complete "Super Bunny" comic book written and illustrated by air-brush artist Martin Cannon, staff artist at Datamost.

meta.name: The Super Can
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 81.72 KB

The Super Can turns an oddball premise into a lively platform adventure in which you must escape from a recycling plant while overcoming obstacles, gaps, and enemies across multiple screens. Its unusual setting gives the game a character of its own, as pipes, platforms, and dangerous machinery create a small but hostile world that demands constant attention. Its appeal lies in precise jumping, steady progress, and the feeling of gradually working your way out of a very bad situation.

meta.name: Super Cars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.15 KB

This is a top-view racing game, stylistically influenced by Super Sprint, from the company who later produced the Lotus series of games. There are 9 tracks at each of the 4 difficulty levels, which can be raced in any order (although the last track you race is made harder than usual). In the races you win money, which can be spent on the usual handling and power upgrades, as well as forward-shooting missiles. You must finish in the top 3 of each race to progress - initially there are 4 computer opponents, but more are added as you progress through the game You can upgrade your car throughout the game via the shop section. You are given an initial price, but also a number of options of things to say to the salesman ? get the right combination and the price will drop.

meta.name: Smith's Super Champs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.68 KB

Super Champs is based on the British TV show of the same name and lets players compete in various challenges similar to those featured on the show. These include races with motorcycles, quad bikes, jet skis, and mini hovercrafts. The show was originally sponsored by Heinz and later by Smiths, giving it a nostalgic advertising touch.

meta.name: Super Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.95 KB

Like the original but on steroids, just like on steroids. Everything is faster, more bullets flying, enemies moving so fast you can hardly react and just like with real steroids in the end it was more torturous than meaningful and not really worth what you sacrificed for it. Also, testicular shrinkage may occur.

meta.name: Super Cross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.43 KB

Super Cross kicks off with adrenaline – strap on your helmet, rev the engine and hit the course. Through corners, over hills, into ruts and down straights you fight for time and try to stay ahead of the pack. But be warned – stray off the track and you'll either lose precious seconds getting back or end up flat on your backside. Who says computers don't like to get dirty?

meta.name: 3D Cubert 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.92 KB

3D Cubert 64 relies on an instantly understandable but quickly frantic gameplay idea in which you must change the color of an entire pyramid of blocks while avoiding dangerous enemies. Those simple jumps from square to square create a satisfying blend of planning, rhythm, and risk, because every move matters and the path to safety only opens once everything has been set up properly. Its appeal comes from that mix of clear design, rising pressure, and the constant need to avoid the bouncing ball and the spider.

meta.name: Super Cup Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.65 KB

Supercup Football is an action-oriented football game played from a top-down perspective. The player participates in a league with a total of ten teams. In terms of controls, the game offers the usual mix of shooting, running, and tackling. A unique feature is a special move to perform a curling cross. When the opponent enters the penalty area, the player automatically takes control of the goalkeeper. During the game, the color of the field's grass can be changed in real-time.

meta.name: Super Cycle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Super Cycle” puts you on a high-speed bike and demands sharp reflexes. Viewed from behind, you race through tight turns, dodge rivals, and fight the clock. Three difficulty levels affect your time limit and the bonus you earn for quick finishes. With three gears, your bike hits top speeds around 120 MPH. After every two races, a bonus round challenges you to collect as many tokens as possible within the time limit – a brief pause before the next stretch of burning rubber.

meta.name: Super Deal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.16 KB

Super Deal turns the slot machine concept into a fast gambling experience built entirely around symbols, chance, and the thrill of the next big hit. With every new spin, you hope for the right combination and experience that familiar swing between anticipation, disappointment, and sudden success. Its appeal comes from that simple and immediate tension, making it a compact experience designed for quick bursts of luck-driven excitement.

meta.name: Super Dispatcher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Super Dispatcher you take control of a complex rail network, ensuring that numerous trains reach their destinations safely and efficiently – organization is key. You plan routes, coordinate movements, and respond to unexpected situations that can disrupt your schedule. With various customization options and changing conditions, each session presents a new challenge that tests your management skills. Only those who stay organized and plan wisely can keep everything running smoothly.

meta.name: Super Dogfight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.67 KB

Super Dogfight takes you to the skies for a thrilling duel above the clouds. Two pilots face off, each striving to be the first to reach ten points. Every hit matters, every evasive move can decide the outcome – and even a mid-air collision can change everything. With agile planes, full directional control, and lightning-fast reflexes, the battle becomes an intense test of skill until one pilot claims victory.

meta.name: Super Dominos Brothers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Dominos Brothers sends players on a challenging mission to rescue Brother Jack. However, before achieving this goal, five tests must be completed. The adventure takes players through various obstacles and hostile creatures that require skill and quick reflexes to overcome. Only those who conquer all challenges will ultimately be able to free Jack.

meta.name: Super Dragon Slayer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

What does a brave wizard do when the princess is kidnapped? Normally nothing as we have brave knights to save them, but not this time. The mighty dragon has a princess trapped in his lair and our brave magician must save her.
The gameplay is a classic side-scrolling shooter. The enemies come in predetermined patterns and never attack you directly. They're just there so you can dodge or shoot at them.
Shooting enemies gives you points but also increases your magic points. When you have enough magic points, you will be given a spell to cast. These spells are really useful and really fun. There's a bomb spell that kills everything on the screen, and a "frog" spell that lets you jump over large holes. Some spells change depending on the level of the game you are playing.

meta.name: Super ET
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.02 KB

Super ET turns the rescue of the little alien into a colorful mix of skill, luck, and quick reactions. To help E.T. build his transmitter, you search through trash cans for the needed parts, never quite knowing whether danger may already be waiting inside. Its appeal comes from that shifting balance of hope, risk, and sudden urgency once it is time to rush to Elliot's house, giving the game a simple but genuinely charming family-friendly feel.

meta.name: Super Flipper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Flipper is a pinball game. It features various themes, obstacles, and mechanics typical of the genre. The goal of the game is to keep the ball in play by controlling the flippers and aiming at targets to score points.

meta.name: Super G-Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.07 KB

Super G-Man is a side-scrolling game featuring realistic physics and gravity mechanics. As a space geologist who missed his ride home, you must navigate the “Sea of Dreams” while fending off nightmarish alien hordes. Contact with rock walls, landmines, or aliens costs a life. Equipped with a laser and a jetpack, you need to collect ammunition and fuel along the way, requiring precise maneuvering. Teleporters scattered across the surface allow you to shortcut portions of the journey.

meta.name: Super Gran
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.87 KB

Super Gran puts you in the shoes of the TV heroine as you try to stop the evil Scunner Campbell and his goons Tub and Rent-a-Muscle. Across eight levels that repeat after four, you'll pilot a flying machine, collect cars and cats, drive from a top-down view, and jump platforms while dodging bombs. Avoid enemies, drop bombs, and survive as long as you can – with just five lives, every move counts.

meta.name: Super Gran : The Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.61 KB

Super Gran: The Adventure puts you in pursuit of Scunner Campbell, who has stolen valuable items from the museum and Town Hall of Chisleton. As Super Gran, you explore the town in a classic text adventure style, with visuals accompanying the descriptions (text-only on the C16). You enter commands to move, examine locations, collect objects, and work your way toward stopping the thief.

meta.name: Super Gridder
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.91 KB

Gridder is a single screen game played over an 8 x 8 grid where you control a head and you have to fill in all the boxes to complete a level. As you move around the grid you paint the lines and when a box has been surrounded then it fills in. Scorpions also move around the screen and they must be avoided because if you touch one then you lose one of three lives. If you complete a level before the timer reaches zero then you receive bonus points.

meta.name: Super Hang-On
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Esta es una conversión del famoso juego de arcade de carreras de motos de Sega. En este juego corres una moto por todo el mundo, completando cada sección de pista dentro de un límite de tiempo. Hay otras motos en la carretera, pero no es importante superarlas, por lo que pueden considerarse como obstáculos en movimiento. Cada continente tiene un nivel de dificultad diferente: África es principiante, Asia es junior, las Américas son sénior y Europa es experto.
Este es un juego muy simple y directo, visto desde detrás de la moto en 2D (para que la pantalla no se incline con la moto). Los controles derecho / izquierdo son dirección, y arriba / abajo son cambios de marcha. Tu moto siempre se está moviendo, y tu velocidad depende estrictamente de la marcha en la vayas, aunque el contacto o salirte de la carretera reducen la velocidad de la moto.

meta.name: Super Huey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Huey combines flight simulation and action by putting you in control of the experimental UH-1XA helicopter across several very different play modes. From guided learning in flight school to more serious missions and a freer combat-focused mode, the game explores multiple sides of flying and creates a real sense of variety. Its most appealing feature is the cockpit perspective with its instruments, because it strengthens the feeling of truly sitting at the controls of a complex machine and having to master each flight with care.

meta.name: Super Huey II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Huey II turns helicopter flight into a varied arcade adventure, sending you through a wide range of mission scenarios – from combat operations and rescue missions to unusual locations like the Bermuda Triangle or blazing oil fields. Rather than aiming for strict realism, the game focuses on direct control, quick reactions, and the appeal of constantly changing objectives. That blend of light flight simulation, action-heavy mission variety, and straightforward gameplay gives it an entertaining and approachable charm.

meta.name: Super Huey II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Huey II turns helicopter flight into a varied arcade adventure, sending you through a wide range of mission scenarios – from combat operations and rescue missions to unusual locations like the Bermuda Triangle or blazing oil fields. Rather than aiming for strict realism, the game focuses on direct control, quick reactions, and the appeal of constantly changing objectives. That blend of light flight simulation, action-heavy mission variety, and straightforward gameplay gives it an entertaining and approachable charm.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB
