Rather than aiming for strict realism, the game focuses on direct control, quick reactions, and the appeal of constantly changing objectives. That blend of light flight simulation, action-heavy mission variety, and straightforward gameplay gives it an entertaining and approachable charm.

meta.name: Super League
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.50 KB

Super League is a football management simulation that blends traditional features with unexpected challenges. Beyond handling transfers, tactics, and finances, you must also deal with unusual situations – such as organized crime pressuring you to throw a match, or political measures like the introduction of membership cards that could threaten your club's survival. At the same time, you'll need to modernize your stadium and meet fan expectations. These elements combine to create a complex and demanding simulation that goes far beyond the scope of standard football management games.

meta.name: Super Mario Bros
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Super Mario Bros" en esta versión es una variante modificada de "The Great Giana Sisters", en la que se han cambiado los sprites para adaptar visualmente el juego al conocido universo de Mario. La jugabilidad básica se mantiene, pero ofrece una representación alternativa de la mecánica clásica de los juegos de plataformas.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Super Mario Bros III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.19 KB

Super Mario Bros III is an unofficial ROM hack that modifies an existing game with Mario-themed elements. Despite its name, it has little in common with the official Super Mario Bros. series. While the character jumps similarly, movement is noticeably slower, and many sprites are incomplete or inconsistently switch between original and modified forms.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Super Mario Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Mario Escape challenges Mario to survive using a jetpack while dodging waves of enemies and obstacles. He must manage his energy carefully — once it runs out, the game is over. Skill and quick reflexes are key to lasting as long as possible.

meta.name: Super Marios Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.95 KB

Super Mario's Revenge is a homebrew game designed as an unofficial sequel to Super Mario. Players guide Mario through new levels and challenges, battling enemies and overcoming obstacles along the way.

meta.name: Super Monaco GP
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.42 KB

Super Monaco GP is a first-person racing game. You must first qualify for a starting place by completing a shortened version of the route alone. The faster you drive, the higher your position on the grid. In the actual race, you compete against 19 other drivers and must not only try to beat them all, but also reach checkpoints within a time limit or the race is over. You also have to stay ahead of a certain position, which starts at 20th and gets lower and lower as the race goes on. Unfortunately, you start with a relatively slow car. By challenging other drivers, you can move to a better team and car and ultimately win the F1 world title. In addition to the famous Monaco course, others from around the world have been added to give the game a longer shelf life.

meta.name: Super Nibbly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Nibbly es una encantadora variante de Snake en la que guías a un gusano a través de varios laberintos. En un mapa superior, viajas de isla en isla, acompañado de divertidas animaciones. En cada aldea, comienza un nuevo laberinto, similar al de Pac-Man, pero sin enemigos. Tu objetivo es comerte todas las pastillas o galletas mientras el gusano crece. Una vez completado, el viaje continúa en el mapa hasta la siguiente parada. Reflejos rápidos, planificación y percepción espacial son clave para completar la aventura.

meta.name: Fruitbank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.89 KB

Fruitbank, also known as Super Nudge 2000, is a slot machine simulator featuring five reels. You begin with a chosen credit amount and try to land winning symbol combinations. The fifth reel controls a bonus mechanic where lights gradually fill; once fully lit, the Super Nudge feature allows you to shift reels for improved outcomes. Sometimes the lights carry over to the next spin, and a skill symbol can trigger the feature at the right moment. Winnings can then be gambled for higher or lower results, adding risk and excitement – a slot-style experience blending luck, timing and strategy.

meta.name: Super Oswald
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.62 KB

Super Oswald turns the icy skill challenge into a fast-paced two-player experience where you compete across slippery ice floes. At the same time, you leap from floe to floe, trying to keep your balance and react faster than your opponent – a single misstep can send you plunging into the freezing water. The head-to-head competition adds extra tension, as success depends not only on precision but also on steady nerves – an icy duel that truly comes alive in multiplayer mode.

meta.name: Super Pac Twins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.89 KB

In Super Pac Twins you guide a character through a maze while collecting all the dots to complete the level. As you move through the corridors you must avoid moving obstacles, because touching them reduces your energy. Collecting dots restores energy and helps you survive longer. The game also allows two players to play at the same time, each trying to gather as many points as possible and finish the stage.

meta.name: Super Pac Twins : Special Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.04 KB

In Super Pac Twins: Special Edition you guide a character through a maze while collecting all the dots to complete the level. As you move through the corridors you must avoid moving hazards that can drain your energy. Gathering dots restores energy and helps you stay in the game longer. This enhanced version introduces additional features including a single-player mode, several extra levels and a new ending sequence.

meta.name: Super Pac-Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.95 KB

Super Pac-Man es la segunda entrega oficial de Namco en la saga Pac-Man, pero ahora Pac-Man debe comer fruta y premios —manzanas, plátanos, rosquillas, hamburguesas, huevos fritos, mazorcas, zapatillas, trozos de tarta, frambuesas, limas, café, setas, naves Galaxian, campanas y tréboles— en lugar de puntos. La mayoría están ocultos en pasillos con puertas cerradas; para abrirlas, Pac-Man debe comer la llave más cercana al pasaje deseado. Como siempre, los fantasmas le persiguen hasta que pierde todas sus vidas, aunque puede usar los túneles de teletransporte a ambos lados del laberinto para despistarlos rápidamente.

meta.name: Super Password
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Password translates the well-known quiz show concept into an interactive experience, challenging you to uncover a final solution by interpreting layered clues. Multiple rounds increase the stakes, with correct answers earning cash and building pressure to reach the target amount first. The winner advances to a tense final challenge, where a full set of solutions must be deduced from highlighted starting letters and hints – an experience that rewards sharp thinking, language skills and deduction.

meta.name: Super Password
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Password translates the well-known quiz show concept into an interactive experience, challenging you to uncover a final solution by interpreting layered clues. Multiple rounds increase the stakes, with correct answers earning cash and building pressure to reach the target amount first. The winner advances to a tense final challenge, where a full set of solutions must be deduced from highlighted starting letters and hints – an experience that rewards sharp thinking, language skills and deduction.

meta.name: Super Phoenix
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.09 KB

In Super Phoenix you're in orbital flight over a planet, navigating through hostile zones filled with satellites, enemies, and other dangers. When dodging isn't enough, unleash your powerful cannon to blast through critical situations. Spread across fourteen levels, your reflexes and firepower are your only hope against the threats of space.

meta.name: Super Pipeline
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Pipeline es un juego de puzle y acción cuyo objetivo es mantener despejadas unas tuberías para que fluya el agua. Los enemigos incluyen saboteadores que taponan las tuberías, bichos que caen del techo y, en niveles avanzados, un monstruo que patrulla la tubería. El jugador dispone de una pistola para eliminar bichos y saboteadores, y al monstruo (solo por detrás). Además, le sigue un ayudante que retira tapones y mata bichos pequeños. En fases posteriores, muros protegen a los enemigos mientras suben por una escalera derecha hacia el tejado. Cada nivel termina al acumular una cantidad determinada de agua en el barril final.

meta.name: Super Pipeline II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La secuela de Super Pipeline añade nuevos enemigos y 16 niveles. Controlas al capataz (traje blanco), encargado de mantener el flujo en la tubería para llenar barriles —hasta tres en niveles avanzados—. Dos tipos de enemigos irrumpen: perforadores (taladros, soplete, cántaro de barro) y plagas (arañas, langostas…). Al hacerse un agujero, debes guiar a un obrero (traje verde) para repararlo; mientras lo hace, es vulnerable a caer.
El capataz lleva una pistola para disparar a los enemigos, pero también puede ser derribado. Complicaciones: la langosta solo se puede atacar por detrás (por su caparazón), y la «lluvia de chinchetas» en niveles posteriores es invulnerable al disparo.

meta.name: Super Pogo Stick
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Pogo Stick builds on the original game, adding new levels and additional challenges. The player continues to bounce through maze-like sections, fixing broken bricks and collecting bonuses while avoiding obstacles and enemies. Time is crucial – all bricks must be repaired before the hourglass runs out to advance to the next level.

meta.name: Super Rider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.91 KB

In this show jumping themed game, the objective is to guide Super Rider successfully through the Firebird Arena obstacle course against the clock.
Points are scored by avoiding giant pyramids, clearing yawning ravines and jumping fences. Every time the rider is thrown from the horse, there is a 5 second time penalty.
meta.genre: Deportes con animales / Carreras de caballos

meta.name: Super Robin Hood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Robin Hood, el primer socialista del mundo, deja de lado aquí la redistribución de la riqueza: su única preocupación es rescatar a Maid Marion de las garras del sheriff de Nottingham. Esto implicará atravesar el bosque de Sherwood, antes de ingresar a tu castillo y abrirte camino a través de sus habitaciones llenas de enemigos. La jugabilidad se basa en el movimiento en pantalla y las plataformas. Se deben evitar las arañas y los dardos protectores: el contacto con ellos drena tu energía inicial de 99, al igual que las caídas desde cualquier distancia, aunque se pueden recolectar tabletas de salud.

meta.name: Super Saper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.59 KB

Super Saper takes the familiar minesweeper formula in a simple form and focuses entirely on careful uncovering, logical deduction, and correctly interpreting the numbers across the board. Its plain presentation creates a calm but genuinely tense puzzle experience, because every safe move depends on good reasoning and a single mistake can end everything. That clear emphasis on pattern recognition and risk assessment is exactly what gives the game its lasting appeal.

meta.name: Super Scoop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.53 KB

In Super Scoop you control a vehicle suspended from an energy grid, repairing sabotaged contacts in the power network of the Pennysland nuclear plant. Rebels have attacked the facility to cripple the entire region, and you are the last hope to restore power. As you move from contact to contact, enemies try to stop you from completing your mission. Once all damaged links in a sector are fixed, you can advance to the next, more challenging area. Speed, precision, and timing are key to getting the energy flowing again.

meta.name: Super Scramble Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Scramble Simulator captures the appeal of a rough motocross challenge, asking you to complete a hazardous course cleanly before the time limit runs out. The game thrives on constant control over both bike and terrain, since jumps, slopes, and uneven ground can only be mastered with a good sense of speed and balance. Its most interesting touch is the combination of a precise side view with a helpful overhead perspective, making every section feel like a small technical test.

meta.name: Super Seven
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.03 KB

The game is a type of Tetris puzzle, where the goal is to drop a cube onto one of the cubes at the bottom of the container. Each cube changes its value, and your task is to match the value of your cube with one of the cubes at the bottom. A mistake results in losing a life. Once all lives are used up, the game is over.

meta.name: Super Seymour Saves the Planet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 59.32 KB

In the sequel to Seymour Goes to Hollywood, Seymour takes on his first movie role - as an eco-friendly superhero. With game design showing some obvious influence from Bomb Jack, Seymour jumps around a series of single screen areas collecting barrels of toxic waste. One barrel at a time is highlighted and is worth more points than the others, but will explode after a short countdown. Seymour is plagued by mutants which fly and bounce around the screen. Some must be jumped on from above, some must be hit from below.

meta.name: Super Skramble!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Skramble! is a clone of Konami's Scramble. In this single-player game, you pilot a craft over hostile terrain and through cave systems, shooting enemy planes, bombing ground stations, and avoiding missiles. The objective is to achieve a high score with the three available lives.

meta.name: Super Smash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.38 KB

“Super Smash” is a classic Breakout-style game where you use a paddle to bounce a ball against a wall of colorful blocks to earn points. If the ball hits the top of the screen, the paddle shrinks, increasing the challenge. Let the ball fall five times and it's game over. The game is controlled only via paddle in joystick port 1, providing a responsive arcade feel. Two players can take turns, and three difficulty levels – Normal, Special, and Progressive – offer options for every skill level. The game is available exclusively as a plug-in cartridge.

meta.name: Super Snake Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.81 KB

A Snake clone developed by legendary programmer Shaun Southern (Kickstart, Kickstart II, Trailblazer, etc.). However, there are more obstacles here than in the standard Snake game. For example, animated mechanical devices such as robots and the like.

meta.name: Super Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.33 KB

Super Soccer by Imagine is an arcade-style soccer game for the Commodore 64, focusing on fast-paced gameplay and straightforward action. It features decent graphics for its time, though the controls can be challenging. Unlike many soccer games of the era, Super Soccer blissfully avoids the management side of the genre, focusing solely on the on-pitch experience. Up to 8 players can join, making it an exciting multiplayer experience.

meta.name: Super Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.02 KB

Super Soccer is a text-based football management simulation where the player takes control of a team. The focus is on strategic decisions, such as setting bonuses for matches, analyzing league statistics, and adjusting tactics to guide the team successfully through the season. The simulation provides detailed information about opponents, including league position, points, and stats, requiring careful planning to optimize team performance and secure victories.

meta.name: Super Space Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Super Space Invaders combates contra formaciones alienígenas descendentes, al estilo del clásico arcade, pero con mayor variedad: enemigos más resistentes, jefes finales, potenciadores y fondos diversos incrementan la dificultad. Los invasores aparecen en múltiples formaciones, y los potenciadores recogidos te otorgan nuevas armas para hacer frente a las oleadas de ataque.

meta.name: Super Sprint
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Una conversión del juego de arcade, Super Sprint es un juego de carreras para uno o dos jugadores. El juego es desde una vista aérea de la pista de carreras. Las pistas de carreras comienzan de manera simple y gradualmente se vuelven más complicadas, y también pueden presentar obstáculos que van desde los conos de tráfico hasta los tornados. Ocasionalmente aparecerán llaves en la carretera, y cuando se recolectan, se pueden usar después de una carrera para mejorar su auto con mejores neumáticos, mejor aceleración o una velocidad máxima más alta.

meta.name: Super Spy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.79 KB

Super Spy blends spy adventure and high-stakes mission tension into a dangerous race against time in which you must track down a missing fighter jet carrying a nuclear payload and prevent disaster. At first, you work your way through clues, people, and obstacles like a secret agent, but the further you get, the more the game shifts into a direct search under increasing pressure. That mix of espionage atmosphere, puzzles, and later navigation through a threatening environment gives the adventure an appealing balance of thought and tension.

meta.name: Super Squash 88
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.18 KB

Super Squash 88 was for many years the only squash game of its kind and is licensed by the well-known professional player from the 1980s. The game offers a realistic view of the court, with the ball bouncing accurately and its shadow visible for added realism. Both offensive and defensive tactics produce believable effects. In addition to a single-player mode with four difficulty levels, the game also includes a two-player option – complete with audible score calls from Jonah himself.

meta.name: Super Star Trek
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.84 KB

Super Star Trek offers a detailed command input interface that gives the player full control over the ship and its systems. In classic text adventure style, numerous commands are available – from navigation and sensor scans to weapon systems and damage reports. The onboard computer provides tactical data, course calculations, and maps of the known universe. Each command requires precise input, while gameplay is conveyed through text output and symbols. The goal is to eliminate the threat of Klingon warships and protect the Federation – using logic, strategy, and a clear mind.

meta.name: Super Stock Car
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.47 KB

“Super Stock Car” is a top-down racing game where you race against three computer-controlled opponents on various tracks. Only part of the track is visible at a time, with the screen scrolling as your car moves. Your goal is to finish first over several laps to progress to the next course – fail to do so and the game ends. Hitting the sides or other cars slows you down, but doesn't cause damage. Quick reflexes and clean cornering are key to winning.

meta.name: Super Stunt Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.81 KB

This action shoot 'em up has an unusual setting, pitching you as a movie stuntman trying to complete the toughest scenes of the latest blockbuster. The scenes include desert chases, forest rallying and Grand Canyon jumps. There are 7 levels in total, each teeming with 'bad guys' and scenery obstacles. You score points for each enemy you shoot down. Unusually, you get bonuses for crashing anything up to twice (as this can be perceived to maximise the action stakes for the film), but a third crash means Game Over.

meta.name: Super Tact
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.48 KB

Super Tact brings a familiar board game to the screen in digital form and thrives on direct competition, smart planning, and a good sense for the right moves. From simple rules grows a tactical duel in which every decision affects the position and the options that follow. Its appeal comes from that clear focus on awareness, forward thinking, and careful placement, giving the game a timeless charm.

meta.name: Super Tank Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.70 KB

Super Tank Simulator puts you in command of a tank across eight challenging combat zones viewed from above. Using rotational control and forward/reverse movement, you must navigate narrow and branching paths where exploration often determines survival. The sturdy walls can deflect enemy fire – a strategic advantage for attacking from cover. You'll face threats like gun turrets, enemy tanks, and landmines. Your standard weapon gets stronger the longer it's held, and you can also collect smart bombs and shields. Each top-down section is followed by a first-person view level where you control a crosshair to take out helicopters and jeeps.

meta.name: Super Tau Zeta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.15 KB

Super Tau Zeta is a demanding side-scrolling space shooter that sends you and your fleet of ships through a series of varied and strikingly designed settings. From open space and asteroid fields to alien worlds and an extraterrestrial city, it creates a strong sense of journey and escalation that gives each new stage a distinct impact. Its appeal comes especially from the blend of challenging action, memorable boss battles, and atmospheric effects such as parallax scrolling and even a sunset over the alien city, giving the game a powerful and exciting feel.

meta.name: Super Tau Zeta II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.28 KB

Super Tau Zeta II continues the concept of its predecessor in a very consistent way, once again delivering a demanding side-scrolling space shooter with even more force and scale. You again battle your way through striking cosmic settings with your fleet, but the sequel feels a touch more lavish and even more focused on spectacular locations and big moments. Its appeal comes from the blend of tough action, boss encounters, and atmospheric effects such as parallax scrolling, making it feel like a heightened and even more intense version of the first game.

meta.name: Super Trivia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Trivia turns general knowledge into a straightforward quiz game that offers both easier and more demanding questions through its different difficulty levels. This makes it suitable not only for casual guessing, but also for deliberately testing your knowledge and taking on trickier topics. That clear blend of accessibility and increasing challenge gives the game its simple but entertaining appeal.

meta.name: Super Trivia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Trivia turns general knowledge into a straightforward quiz game that offers both easier and more demanding questions through its different difficulty levels. This makes it suitable not only for casual guessing, but also for deliberately testing your knowledge and taking on trickier topics. That clear blend of accessibility and increasing challenge gives the game its simple but entertaining appeal.

meta.name: Super Trolley
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.81 KB

Super Trolley recreates all the fun of shelf-stacking as a computer game. Your task is to keep the shelves stocked and the floors clean. First up you must collect the stock to be placed on the shelves, then move it to the appropriate part of the supermarket. Over 30 foods are featured, ranging from bread and milk to eggs and carrots. Each section of the supermarket has its own isometrically-viewed screen. The shoppers are there to get in your way, and other hazards include vandalising kids, un-house-trained dogs and moronic shoppers who don't take their item off the top of the shelves. The ultimate aim of the game is to do so well that you can take over as manager.

meta.name: Super Trucker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Trucker turns the daily routine of a truck driver into a surprisingly chaotic and action-filled driving challenge. You move back and forth between two factories with your truck, picking up or delivering containers while new dangers constantly get in your way on the road. Reckless drivers, sudden obstacles, and even military attacks turn a simple transport job into a hectic mix of driving skill, awareness, and nerves.

meta.name: Super Zaxxon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Zaxxon es un shooter espacial con perspectiva de tres cuartos. Eres el único piloto de una nave espacial solitaria, enfrentándote a las defensas de la fortaleza Super Zaxxon. Estás amenazado por todos lados por el fuego enemigo y por el riesgo de chocar contra multitud de obstáculos. Tus nervios y habilidades se llevan al límite mientras luchas contra el peligro, solo para enfrentarte al arma definitiva: los dragones Super Zaxxon. Derrótalos y comenzará un nuevo ciclo, aún más complicado que el anterior.

meta.name: Super Zaxxon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.68 KB

Super Zaxxon is a faster, tougher sequel to the classic arcade shooter Zaxxon. From its signature isometric view, you pilot your ship across an enemy fortress filled with gun turrets, radar stations, fuel tanks, and missile launchers. Then, you must navigate a narrow tunnel packed with enemy fighters, deadly mine layers, and floating explosives before reaching another asteroid where the fearsome Super Zaxxon dragon awaits. Compared to the original, your craft moves at a much higher speed, new enemies increase the challenge, and the outer-space segment is replaced with intense tunnel runs. Facing three Super Zaxxons instead of one, only the sharpest pilots will survive this upgraded assault.

meta.name: Super-Pacman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.60 KB

Super-Pacman is a Pac-Man clone with a fresh twist, taking the classic gameplay and enhancing it with new elements. Players guide Pac-Man through mazes, collect points, and avoid enemy ghosts. Additional features and an updated design provide a revamped experience that modernizes the classic formula.

meta.name: Super-Ski : The Downhill Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.10 KB

Super-Ski: The Downhill Simulator is a fast-paced skiing game where up to eight players race against the clock on eight different courses. The goal is to beat the target time shown in the preview to qualify for the next World Cup race. Each player starts with three lives – beating the time earns an extra life, while crashing or being too slow costs one. Precise maneuvering through trees and quick reactions are crucial to mastering the steep downhill slopes and fighting your way to the top.

meta.name: Superball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.59 KB

Superball turns the simple act of rolling a ball into a tense test of skill in which you constantly have to think ahead and avoid dangerous obstacles in time. What seems simple at first quickly builds pressure, because the course demands full attention and even the smallest lapse can be punished immediately. Its appeal comes from that direct blend of pace, awareness, and evasion, giving the game a gripping arcade feel.

meta.name: Super Bike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Super Bike captures the thrill of a wild motorcycle course and focuses entirely on speed, jumps, and quick reactions. Whether in motocross, enduro, supercross, or trials, each mode has you racing against the clock across demanding tracks, avoiding hazards, and trying to keep your bike under control even after risky leaps through the air. That blend of fast arcade action, varied disciplines, and ever-present danger gives the game an exciting and satisfyingly intense character.

meta.name: Superbike Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Superbike Challenge brings 1000cc motorbikes to life for a one or two player race. Unusually, the screen is split horizontally, with your action only ever using half of the screen. You can play a full season of races, or run at one of the 12 tracks as a stand-alone race (including Assen, Mugello, the old Hockenheim and Spa). A manual gearbox option and 3 skill levels ensure that you can't master the game immediately. Full information on your speed and revs, the race order and course layout are on screen at all times. Superbike Challenge is an updated version of Grand Prix 500 cc, with a better menu and title screen and some different in-game graphics.

meta.name: Supercuda
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.38 KB

Supercuda is a fast-paced maze game where you swim through tight corridors as a brave fish, collecting points while dodging dangerous sea predators. Instead of ghosts, you'll face various deep-sea creatures that cost you a life on contact. To defend yourself, you can pick up electric eels that let you temporarily disable your enemies. Each level brings more challenge – and only quick reflexes and smart movement will get you to the high score.

meta.name: Superhero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.42 KB

Superhero challenges you to save humanity from five powerful guardians threatening its peaceful existence. As you travel across the globe, you'll discover numerous hidden items – from classic tools like swords and power boots to advanced gear like teleport keys and an ESP indicator that guides your way. Some of these are only visible once you wear a special helmet. After defeating each guardian, you'll enter a deadly Deadzone bonus stage where you can earn an extra life – if you make it through unharmed. A detailed player status screen keeps track of your journey.

meta.name: Superkid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La Nueva York del futuro es un lugar peligroso en el que los delincuentes vagan por las calles y causan estragos. El alcalde está desesperado por ayuda y tú eres la respuesta a sus plegarias.
Eres Tom Essex y te bebiste una botella de poción inventada por tu tío que te convirtió en Superkid. Ahora tienes la capacidad de volar y tienes un Super Golpe que noquea a los criminales de un solo golpe. Tienes que explorar tres partes de la ciudad, deteniendo a los criminales pero también encontrando y rescatando a las chicas de los tejados y llevándolas a casa. También hay abuelitas a las que acompañar desde la biblioteca hasta sus casas. Ten cuidado de no tocar a las abuelitas o las matarás.

meta.name: Superkid in Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.62 KB

El joven Superkid es la única esperanza de la humanidad mientras varias especies alienígenas invaden nuestros recursos. Como Superkid, el jugador debe explorar cinco planetas alienígenas por turnos y encontrar cuatro piezas del detonador necesario para destruir cada uno de ellos. Necesitará las píldoras que están escondidas por todas partes para mantener su fuerza sobrehumana.
Además, está armado con una cuerda que puede utilizarse para colgarse de las secciones del techo de cada nivel. Antes de que comience la acción principal de plataformas, el jugador debe aterrizar la nave de forma segura en un trozo de tierra liso, con un punto de bonificación por hacerlo correctamente y una penalización de energía por hacerlo mal.

meta.name: Superleague Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.25 KB

Superleague Soccer is a football management simulation where you are responsible for both the athletic and financial success of your team. Through menus, you handle transfers, line-ups, and tactics while monitoring player statistics, values, and careers. A standout feature is the match presentation: you can either watch just the highlights or view the full game. In the full view, you can even give direct instructions to individual players, moving them to specific positions on the pitch.

meta.name: Superman : Man of Steel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Superman: Man of Steel casts you as the last hope of a world in chaos. Earthquakes shake the ground, terrorists kidnap key figures, and two archvillains join forces behind the scenes. As Superman, you must master your full range of superpowers – flight, heat vision, super strength, telescopic sight, and freeze breath – across multiple game segments. But time is running out, and only swift action can save humanity.

meta.name: Superman : The Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.75 KB

In “Superman: The Game,” two players — Superman and Darkseid — compete to either save the citizens of Metropolis or lure them into an underground lair. The game board is divided into six sectors, three above ground and three underground. Players use deflectors or superpowers to guide the panicked citizens. A sector can only be exited after collecting a diamond, allowing a new sector to be selected. The transition between sectors is determined by a “battle zone” mini-game, where the winner moves to the chosen sector while the loser is sent back to the previous one. Both players can use limited-range beams—Superman's heat vision and Darkseid's Omega Beam — to influence the game.

meta.name: Supermind
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.66 KB

Supermind allows the player to play the well-known logic and deduction game, where a secret color combination must be deciphered through strategic guessing and reasoning.

meta.name: Supersports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Supersports: The Alternative Olympics is a sports game with five humorous disciplines that are played one after the other. At the end, the player with the most points wins. The disciplines are:
* Crack Shot is similar to clay pigeon shooting, only in a back alley with cans as targets. Shooting a cat gives demerit points.
* Dare Devil Dive is reminiscent of a circus attraction: jumping from a high pole (three heights) into a water bar. Points are also rewarded for performing moves in the fall.
* Slate Smash involves smashing slates with your bare hands.
* Crossbow is a regular sport shooting discipline. The player must determine the position of the crossbow and the power of the shot, taking into account the wind direction.
* The Under Water Assault Course is an underwater obstacle course. Collecting coins earns additional points.

meta.name: Superstar Ice Hockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Superstar Ice Hockey you control one of 20 Canadian & US teams. The game has no license so you can't play with the stars. There are 4 divisions with 5 teams. After the regular season the best 2 teams of each division are qualified for the playoffs. Worth mentioning is that you are playing always the center - the other players are controlled by the CPU. In the multiplayer mode you can only play friendly games.

meta.name: Superstar Ping-Pong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.72 KB

“Superstar Ping Pong” is a table-tennis game where the player competes either against the computer or a friend. The table is displayed in a 3D view, showing only the paddle. The ball is hit by pressing the fire button, and the return angle changes depending on the timing of the shot. Players can adjust their skills by distributing up to 20 points among forehand, backhand, smash, and other stroke types. There is an option to choose between computer-assisted and manual paddle control, adjust game speed, and enable side switching after each serve. Once the table side and paddle color are selected, the game begins. Table tennis rules apply, with the first player to reach 21 points winning the set.

meta.name: Superstar Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Gary Lineker's Superstar Soccer" is a six-a-side football game where players can take on the role of a striker, goalkeeper (C64 only), or manager. The ball stays close to the player, who can pass, shoot, or head it. Goalkeepers are penalized for holding the ball too long – a rule later introduced in real football. Match length is adjustable from 6 to 90 minutes, and fouls are fully implemented. While the cassette version only offers single matches, the disk version includes a full season with 64 English teams across four divisions, with the option to play a 7- or 15-game season.

meta.name: SuperTed : The Search for Spot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.11 KB

SuperTed: The Search for Spot sends the little hero on a personal rescue mission in which he must save his kidnapped friend Spotty from the clutches of Texas Pete and his henchmen. Thankfully, the activated tracking device leaves a trail to follow, but reaching him demands full commitment, as SuperTed has to use his special powers wisely to overcome the villains. Its appeal comes from that blend of heroic rescue action, familiar enemies, and the unusual abilities of a flying teddy bear, giving the game a charming and adventurous feel.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: SuperTed : The Search for Spot
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.55 KB

SuperTed: The Search for Spot sends the little hero on a personal rescue mission in which he must save his kidnapped friend Spotty from the clutches of Texas Pete and his henchmen. Thankfully, the activated tracking device leaves a trail to follow, but reaching him demands full commitment, as SuperTed has to use his special powers wisely to overcome the villains. Its appeal comes from that blend of heroic rescue action, familiar enemies, and the unusual abilities of a flying teddy bear, giving the game a charming and adventurous feel.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Super Trux
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 54.18 KB

Super Trux throws you into a fast-paced truck racing trophy across nine European cities, where you race against the clock stage by stage. Driving through locations such as London, Brussels or Paris, you face blind hills, steep drops, roadworks that narrow the highway to a single lane and heavy traffic from rival trucks. Each course demands precise control, quick reactions and careful positioning to beat the time limit. At the end of a section the road splits, allowing you to choose your next destination, creating varied routes and making every run feel like a fresh challenge.

meta.name: Suprallay
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.06 KB

SupRallay puts you on a compact racetrack viewed from above, where quick reactions and clean cornering matter. You guide your vehicle through a winding course, hold the best line, and try to lose as little time as possible from lap to lap. The direct overview makes races especially easy to follow, with every driving mistake immediately visible. This creates an accessible racing game that pleasantly combines speed, course knowledge, and precise control.

meta.name: Surf City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Going to Surf City going to have some fun! When near the top of screen wait for wave and surf past marker buoys, try to go between two buoys with a space between them. Avoid the buoy, sharks and if the wave crests beneath you, you will fall off.

meta.name: Surfchamp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.65 KB

Surfchamp offers an exciting surfing experience. You can surf endlessly in practice mode without losing energy, or take part in a ten-round competition to get the highest score. Before surfing, you enter your name and stats, choose your board, suit to match the weather conditions, and check the forecast. The game starts on the beach, and you control your surfer from a slightly elevated rear view, choose a spot in the water, and paddle until a suitable wave comes along. Standing on the board, you control your surfer to perform tricks and ride the wave to the beach. Paddling and surfing decrease your energy, and when it runs out, the ride ends. A special feature of the game is the included plastic surfboard that is placed over the keyboard; by pressing certain areas, you control your surfer.

meta.name: Surfmania
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.72 KB

Surfmania is a game where players surf and aim for the highest score while avoiding obstacles such as whirlpools, Neptune, surf mines, surf hunters, and the Titanic. May the surf virus be with you!

meta.name: Survival of the Fittest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 39.18 KB

In Survival of the Fittest you are the survivor of a plane crash who finds yourself stranded in an unfamiliar place. While waiting to be rescued, you notice a mysterious light near the crash site. Curious about its origin, you begin exploring the surroundings to discover what is causing it. By entering commands you examine locations, gather clues and try to uncover the mystery before rescue arrives.

meta.name: Survive!
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.22 KB

meta.name: Survivor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Survivor puts you alone in space, piloting a small ship through expansive areas filled with turrets, asteroids and hostile defenses. You move freely across large playfields, dodge incoming fire and look for openings to break through enemy fortifications. The experience centers on careful maneuvering under constant pressure, with threats appearing from multiple directions and leaving little room to rest. Its open design creates a strong sense of exploration and survival, where each cleared section feels like progress through dangerous territory.

meta.name: The Survivors
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.24 KB

The Survivors tasks you with rescuing large numbers of people from a damaged dome complex by coordinating several specialized droids. Each has a distinct role – one digs tunnels, another teleports survivors to safety and a third moves heavy obstacles, forcing you to approach each situation strategically. As you progress through the levels, falling rocks and unstable terrain create constant danger, making mistakes costly and planning essential. The combination of unique abilities and a fragile environment creates a tactical rescue experience driven by timing, order and awareness.

meta.name: Suspect
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You have walked into a hotbed of deceit and trickery. And now they're accusing you of something you couldn't have done. But they have proof that you did it. "You're a killer," they say.And until you can prove them wrong, you're guilty as charged - murder.
Among society's upper crust, murder is the kind of nastiness that must be cleaned up quickly. So isn't it convenient that you, a struggling journalist looking for a good time and a good story, end up the scapegoat? The evidence is stacked against you, and you're being forced to prove your own innocence. And someone else's guilt. But, no one wants to help you. You're an outsider. And only an outsider could be so rude as to accept an invitation to the social event of the season. Then spoil it all.

meta.name: Suspended
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En una colonia espacial llamada Contra, un ser humano ejerce de regulador de los sistemas de soporte vital del planeta: controla el transporte, el clima y gestiona los recursos mientras se encuentra en un sueño profundo, gracias a la potencia neuronal de su cerebro. Este humano despierta, perturbado por el súbito desorden de los sistemas reguladores del planeta. Los miembros de la tripulación suponen que se ha vuelto loco y acuden a desconectar su mente. 
Suspended es un juego de aventuras basado en texto con un giro: en lugar de dirigir al protagonista, el jugador controla indirectamente a seis robots que le obedecen, exploran el entorno e interactúan con él.  El jugador avanza por el juego utilizando las distintas habilidades de los robots y resolviendo rompecabezas para salvar el planeta.

meta.name: Swag
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.82 KB

The Swag Man's on the job to burgle the millionaire's mansion. It's full of beautiful, valuable swag ready for the nicking! Unfortunately, he gate-crashed a fancy dress party and the guests are inpursuit. Help him collect the Master Code Cards which are hidden in the seemly never ending maze of rooms, to enable him to escape!

meta.name: Swamp Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Swamp Attack“ puts you on the edge of a settlement on the swamp planet Sylva 7, where you must defend against an endless wave of mutated plants and insects. With your photon cannon, you hold off hostile creatures that constantly advance and try to overrun the area. Every moment demands full concentration – the enemies multiply rapidly and attack from all directions. Survive long enough and you'll secure the colony's future.

meta.name: Swamp Fever
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.58 KB

In "Swamp Fever," Professor Oddbod leads an expedition through the swamps of Florida to find the mutated Aisuru flowers that were created by nuclear waste. However, the swamps are inhabited by dangerous creatures like man-eating flytraps and other monsters, which the professor must fight off with his weapon. The player controls the professor from a top-down perspective, collecting the 35 flowers to earn points. Every time the professor comes into contact with a monster, he loses energy. If his energy is depleted, the mission fails and the game ends.

meta.name: Swap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Swap challenges you to cleverly swap colored tiles to form sequences of the same color and clear them from the board. Different shapes add variety, while a limited reserve of tiles can be used when no matching neighbors are available. Your goal is to earn enough points to complete a level and advance to more difficult stages, where more colors, complex shapes, and additional constraints await. Undo moves can help, but they reduce your final score – so careful planning is key.

meta.name: Swap It
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Swarmed
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.39 KB

Swarmed is a minimalist yet challenging shooter game where the player must defend a small base against an ever-approaching wave of enemies. The threat comes from above – a dense mass of hexagonal structures slowly descending toward the ground. The goal is to destroy as many of these structures as possible before they reach the surface. The speed and pattern of the descending swarm make the game a true test of reflexes and precision.

meta.name: Los Angeles SWAT
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.05 KB

Eres un policía que patrulla las calles, con otros dos a tu lado. Tu trabajo es disparar a los pequeños alborotadores que se acercan. Estos alborotadores son inofensivos a distancia, pero son conocidos por lanzar bombas incendiarias a algunos policías. Cuando mueres a manos de uno de los alborotadores, uno de los policías te reemplaza y controla las calles. Si no quedan policías, se termina la partida.

meta.name: Sweep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.71 KB

Hungry rats and raging fires will block your way as you battle in the dark to sweep all the chimneys and win a bonus game.

meta.name: Sweet Sixteen
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.98 KB

meta.name: Swiss Family Robinson
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Swiss Family Robinson“ is a text-based adventure game based on the novel by Johann David Wyss – placing the player in the role of Fritz, the eldest son of a Swiss family stranded on a deserted island after a shipwreck. The objective is to leave the wreck, explore the island, and establish a safe shelter while overcoming tropical storms, wild animals, and the pranks of the youngest brother, Francis. Using simple text commands, the player interacts with the environment, solves puzzles, and gathers essential survival resources. Helpful features like a navigation aid and a „Guide to Nature“ book containing information on flora, fauna, and survival techniques make exploring the island more manageable.

meta.name: Switch It!
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.02 KB

meta.name: Switchblade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.49 KB

El Fireblade, el símbolo sagrado del antiguo clan Switchblade, ha volado en 16 pedazos a manos del malvado Havoc. Pero se dice que un Hiro puede salvarlo, y como Hiro, debes recuperar las 16 piezas y restaurar el orgullo de tu pueblo.
El juego está basado en plataformas y escaleras, y se desarrolla tanto en interiores como en exteriores. A diferencia del resto del juego, empiezas sin armas, y éstas se ganan directamente, en lugar de recoger monedas y comerciar con ellas en tiendas.

meta.name: SWIV
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Swiv es un shooter de desplazamiento vertical en el que luchas con un helicóptero y un jeep. Si juegas solo, puedes elegir uno u otro. El jeep es más complicado de usar, ya que no tiene la misma libertad de movimiento y puede quedar bloqueado por diversos obstáculos o verse obligado a cruzar un puente o una barrera ferroviaria. Por otro lado, el jeep puede detenerse y, sobre todo, puede disparar en todas direcciones. Entre los enemigos hay helicópteros, aviones, tanques y el famoso Goosecopter (de Silkworm), que siempre se arma ante tus ojos antes de lanzarse hacia delante para intentar estrellar tu helicóptero. Las principales novedades son las piezas de artillería enemigas, así como las enormes bases que te lo pondrán difícil.

meta.name: Swoop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Swoop” throws you into a fast-paced space battle where you control a laser base and fight off the relentless threat of swooping Birdmen. Three types of enemies strike in waves: Blue Hawks appear in large numbers and move slowly, Green Merlins fall twice as fast, and Red Condors are the deadliest – fast in both directions. If a Birdman slips past you, it drops an explosive egg on your track, temporarily limiting your movement. But beware: even destroyed enemies leave behind deadly debris that you must dodge with precision.

meta.name: Prince Clumsy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Prince Clumsy you set out as a somewhat clumsy hero on a perilous quest to rescue the woman of your dreams from the clutches of her wicked sister. Your path leads through both indoor and outdoor areas filled with enemies and hazards. Armed with a dagger, you fight off the henchmen guarding the route to the castle. Along the way you can collect bread and ale to restore your health and gather bonus items for extra points. Not everything you find is helpful though – traps such as super glue, poison and even a ball and chain can quickly complicate your adventure.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: The Sword of Fargoal
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.09 KB

“The Sword of Fargoal” sends you into a dark, randomly generated dungeon maze to recover a legendary weapon hidden deep underground. The sacred blade, once forged to defeat evil, was stolen by the powerful sorceress Ulma and concealed away. Only by returning it to Gedwyn, the blinded hero, can Ulma's power be vanquished for good. On your journey, you'll battle through hordes of ogres, hobgoblins, and other creatures, collect treasures, avoid traps, and search for the fabled sword. But finding it is only half the battle – you must also escape the dungeon in time before Ulma destroys it. The clock is ticking.

meta.name: Sword of Honour
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In the game you are a noble ninja, who has to prove the honour of shogun Yuichiro by recovering a stolen sword from the evil Toranaga. Walking from a village to a castle, you fight enemies and avoid traps using your skills in martial arts and Japanese weapons, collecting useful items and uncovering the twisty plot of the story.
Using a keyboard you can walk from screen to screen, jump, and pick up items. Using two mouse buttons you can kick or punch opponents as well as use, give or drop collected items.

meta.name: Sword of Kadash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Es un juego de acción / aventura de arriba hacia abajo ambientado en un laberinto de habitaciones y pasillos. El jugador puede moverse en cualquiera de las cuatro direcciones (y en diagonal) y disparar dardos. Solo se pueden disparar tres dardos a la vez. Estos rebotarán en algunas paredes y se absorberán o harán que se formen agujeros en otras. También son el método principal para derrotar a los diferentes monstruos que se encuentran dispersos. Los monstruos también pueden ser derrotados al entrar en contacto contigo, pero a su vez recibirás daño.

meta.name: Sword of Kopru
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.99 KB

Sword of Kopru confronts you with an unpredictable adventure where logic and improvisation are constantly tested. Objects keep their functions, but their names change, forcing unusual solutions and creating surprising situations. As you attempt to return a sacred artifact to its rightful place, you are repeatedly attacked by random monsters and pushed into dangerous scenarios with no guaranteed escape. The appeal lies in the blend of puzzle-solving, constant threat, and the feeling of struggling to survive in a hostile world.

meta.name: The Sword of the Storm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Sword of the Storm challenges you with a puzzling adventure that uses unusual, highly specific input verbs, making it feel demanding at first. If you carefully examine everything and pay attention to the hints scattered throughout, you gradually learn which actions matter and how to crack the tougher riddles. Progress depends on thorough exploration and solving several difficult puzzles as you hunt for the mystic blade. The final test is a confrontation with the demonic guardian that stands between you and the sword.

meta.name: The Sword of Zedek
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.83 KB

The Sword of Zedek challenges you with a text-driven fantasy world where every choice matters and time is limited. You explore a vast realm above and below ground, gather gold, recruit allies and search for powerful artifacts to increase your combat strength. Dark areas require preparation, encounters provide clues to valuable items and only sufficient power allows you to face the ultimate evil. Everything builds toward the decisive moment when you confront Ra in his throne room and determine the fate of the world in battle.

meta.name: Swordpoint
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Swordpoint you dive into a text-based role-playing experience reminiscent of classic pen-and-paper adventures like Dungeons & Dragons. You guide your character through a range of choices – from resting and taking on dangerous duties to duels or joining the military. Every decision affects your stats, equipment, and survival. With no graphics, the game emphasizes strategy, imagination, and making the most of the options presented to you.

meta.name: The Sydney Affair
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En The Sydney Affair, asumes el papel de un investigador recién ascendido a sargento mayor en Saint-Étienne. Tras recibir un disparo desde un edificio al otro lado de la calle, te toca resolver el caso. El asesino parece conocer bien los hábitos de la víctima. Con tu equipo, reunirás pistas y seguirás las pruebas. Al igual que en su predecesor, el juego se divide en dos partes: la recopilación de pruebas en la escena del crimen y la investigación de sospechosos con un teletipo. El examen minucioso de cada objeto y la deducción lógica son esenciales para resolver el misterio.

meta.name: Synergy
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.68 KB

meta.name: Synetic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Synetic is a straightforward yet gripping shooter where you must take down incoming enemies with precise shots. Success relies not only on accurate aiming but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy fire and position yourself strategically. Only those who combine skill, timing, and smart movement will be able to overcome the escalating challenges and emerge victorious.

meta.name: Synex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En Synex, controlas una nave espacial y te enfrentas a oleadas de enemigos. Disparos precisos y reacciones rápidas son clave para destruir formaciones enemigas y ganar puntos. Cada golpe cuenta, cada error cuesta una vida. El juego ofrece acción fluida con una estética estilizada, desafiando tus reflejos al estilo arcade clásico.

meta.name: Synopsis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Synopsis challenges your spatial thinking: you control a bouncing ball across a grid, with most tiles vanishing after impact. Some require multiple jumps to clear. The goal is to remove all tiles without trapping yourself. Only careful planning leads to a perfect run.

meta.name: Syntax
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.92 KB

In Syntax, you pilot a futuristic impulse-drive fighter to stop an alien invasion threatening Earth. Your mission: collect all ten radio deactivation crystals and drop them into the enemy base's ventilation shaft. Along the way, you'll navigate tight corridors, dodge hazards, and battle enemy defenses. Only with precision, endurance, and quick reflexes can you succeed – Syntax won't wait.

meta.name: Sysiphus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sysiphus combines puzzle-solving and dexterity into an unusual challenge in which you must shift orange blocks so that a green ball can reach its destination. What makes it especially appealing is that the ball cannot be steered freely, but moves clockwise through the maze, so every change to the path has to be planned carefully in advance. That blend of deliberate block-moving, dangerous holes, and constant forward thinking gives the game a distinctive and satisfyingly tricky character.

meta.name: Sysiphus in Aegypten
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Sysiphus in Ägypten combines a wonderfully eccentric adventure premise with the appeal of a dangerous journey through a twisting pyramid. At its center is not only the rescue of the vain pharaoh Taromina from her sleep lasting thousands of years, but above all the path leading to her, protected by obstacles, traps, and other dangers. That blend of unusual story idea, ancient Egyptian atmosphere, and the push into a hidden tomb gives the game a distinctive and exciting character.

meta.name: System
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

System is the first game in the System series, a collection of puzzle games known for their intellectual challenges. In this game, players are tasked with solving various logic puzzles that require strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Players must manipulate the environment to achieve specific goals, such as arranging objects in the correct order or unlocking new areas. A standout feature of the game is the built-in level editor, which allowed players to create and share their own puzzles and challenges. The game offers a variety of puzzles that test different abilities, such as pattern recognition and spatial thinking, with increasing difficulty as the game progresses. Additionally, the game includes narrative elements that link the puzzles together and add extra depth to the overall experience.

meta.name: System 15000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“System 15000” puts you in the role of a hacker with a special mission: $1.5 million has been stolen by the company Realco, and neither the police nor the courts can do anything about it. Your friend Mike asks you to dive into a complex web of databases and access codes to retrieve the money. With just one phone number and an entry code, you begin your digital investigation. You'll hack through virtual systems, explore bulletin boards, crack security barriers, and try to access the right network. Each success brings you closer to the stolen funds – but one mistake could cost everything.

The game offers a wide range of challenges testing skills like pattern recognition and spatial thinking, with increasing difficulty. Narrative elements connect the puzzles and add an extra layer of depth to the experience.

System-4 is an arcade platformer very similar to Q-Bert (except that the isometric surface is flat rather than pyramid-shaped) that allows two people to play at the same time.

meta.name: T-Bird
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.94 KB

Los jugadores controlan un Foourd T-Bird, un sistema de transporte capaz de alcanzar grandes velocidades de hasta 1346 mph. Su trabajo es destruir los enjambres de alienígenas (incluidos platillos voladores, cazas TIE, medusas espaciales, masas no identificables y similares) y esquivar sus disparos. Esto se puede lograr disparándoles con el zapper estándar o usando un misil inteligente para destruir todo lo que esté a la vista.

meta.name: Table Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Table invaders is an educative space invaders-like game. You have to destroy alien ships by solving maths problems.

meta.name: Table Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.48 KB

Play table soccer or Foosball without straining your wrists in this game. Block, pass, shoot and SCORE! At last a computer version of this fast and furious action packed football game. Use your computer joystick to take control of each line of players. Enjoy features such as angle deflection shots, great goalie saves, it's got the lot.

meta.name: International Table Tennis
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.12 KB

“International Table Tennis” brings the classic sport to the screen and lets you compete against seven opponents to become champion. Before the match, you can choose an exhibition game, a tournament, or customize your settings – including number of games, difficulty, ball speed, and rule options. Matches are shown from an elevated 3D view, with players represented by paddles and a visible hand only during serves. Games are played to 21 points, with serve changing every five points – regardless of who scores.

meta.name: Numberfun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Numberfun is a math learning game for children aged around six and up that teaches multiplication tables in a playful way. In the two programs Tablesums 1 and 2, players can practice any table from 1 to 10 or choose mixed problems. Correct answers earn points, wrong answers lose points. After 20 turns, the final score is displayed in a special way before starting a new round.

meta.name: TAC - Tactical Armor Command
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

TAC is a game of WWII tactical armored combat. You pick a nation (Britain, USA, Germany or Russia). Build a combat team of tanks, assault guns and tank destroyers and command the team you have created against the forces of the enemy.
The computer handles the technical details which leaves the decision making to you. You search for the enemy, find them, aim your gun, knock them out and the results of the combat are determined by the computer. The game can be played solitaire or by two people.

meta.name: Tag Team Wrestling
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.83 KB

A wrestling game that focused on teams.  You can either play as a face team (the good guys) or a heel team (the baddies)!

meta.name: Tai Chi Tortoise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 80.15 KB

Tai Chi Tortoise is a humorous platform game packed with cheese-related wordplay. The story follows Vincent Ratatoui, who has stolen all the world's cheese. Now it's up to the Tai-Chi Tortoise to recover it. You must make your way through over 100 screens filled with ladders, platforms and tricky obstacles. Along the way, you collect useful items such as a spade or jump shoes and put them to clever use. Some platforms vanish when stepped on but regenerate once you leave and re-enter the screen. With patience, skill and a touch of cheesy humor, you can restore balance to the world.

meta.name: Tai-Pan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Tai-Pan you set out to build your fortune in China – but the journey starts small and full of risks. First you need to secure a loan, obtain a ship, and gather a crew, even by questionable means if necessary. From there, your path is open: you explore the streets, make connections, and prepare your ventures before sailing between cities to trade. The seas bring danger, as you can board other ships and confront their crews. Every decision shapes your rise – whether you trade wisely, take risks, or carve out your own path through the world.

meta.name: Tales of Boon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tales of Boon challenges you to face deadly trials in a desperate attempt to save your family. Under the watchful gaze of unseen overseers, you navigate labyrinthine levels filled with traps, enemies, and shifting platforms. Every jump counts, every strike matters – only those with courage and precision can pass the test and reclaim their freedom.

meta.name: Tales of the Arabian Nights
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

After the first night with a new wife, Sultan Saladin has them killed and with a powerful army to protect him everyone is powerless to stop him. That is until the Sultan kidnapped Prince Imrahil's sister to be his wife and took her to Baghdad. You play as the Prince as you journey over eight levels avoiding various obstacles, guards and nasties before your sister is home and safe. You start on Sinbad's ship crossing the sea. You then travel up a river and through a cavern. The next level sees you flying a magic carpet towards the Sultan's palace. Once the princess has been rescued you can both escape from the Sultan on your magic carpet.

meta.name: Tales of the Cat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.84 KB

Players control a cat whose task is to survive the dangerous obstacles that everyday cats must face. The game is divided into two sections. In the first section, players must guide the cat to the road to collect an important item while avoiding getting run over by cars, and hazards that occupy the footpaths such as foxes, people, light bulbs, pot plants, and more. In the second, players have to make their way to the other side of the screen by jumping over creatures, avoiding bird droppings, and crossing rivers. Each screen needs to be completed in a certain amount of time. If the cat is hit by an obstacle, a life gets lost. The game is over when all of them are lost.

Tamer es un juego de acción de desplazamiento vertical. El jugador pilota un jet armado con un cañón de munición ilimitada por la superficie de Júpiter para alcanzar y destruir la base rebelde comunista. El planeta está fuertemente custodiado por cazas rebeldes, tanques y otros objetos voladores no identificados. Además de las unidades hostiles, el jugador debe evitar colisiones con rocas, basura espacial y otros obstáculos.

meta.name: Tamer Part Two
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.17 KB

Tamer Part Two is a slightly modified version of the first part, allowing two players to play simultaneously. The gameplay remains unchanged, except an additional fighter can support in the fight against the aliens. The levels look very similar, differing mainly in a sequence of surroundings objects (space debris, stars, asteroids) and emerging enemies (fighters, tanks, rockets).

meta.name: Tangent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.01 KB

Tangent is a side-scrolling shooter where you pilot a spaceship through futuristic stages, destroying a set number of enemies to progress. A radar shows enemy positions, and managing your ship's speed and direction is key to avoiding collisions. Enemy fire or crashes reduce your energy. At the end of each stage, a large mothership offers bonus points if destroyed – failure means forced progression without reward. As levels advance, enemies become faster, more numerous and better armed.

meta.name: Tangled Tales
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 192.00 KB

"Tangled Tales: The Misadventures of a Wizard's Apprentice" follows the story of a wizard's apprentice whose master has wrongfully taken possession of his spells. To reclaim them, three quests must be completed. At the beginning, players create their character by assigning points to strength, intelligence, speed, and charisma. The adventure takes place in a whimsical world filled with unusual characters, including knights and surfers, each playing a special role in solving the challenges. In addition to learning new spells and engaging in occasional battles, players must recruit allies and manage their gold wisely to overcome obstacles. The game world is divided into more than 100 screens that need to be explored.
