meta.name: Tanium
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.77 KB

Six years after destroying an alien force in Warhawk you are now retired on the planet Sloar with the cute animals playing arcade games but you're so bored. The chance has come once again from Intergalactic Federation to destroy an alien force who have invaded and taken over the planet Tanium. In your 'Quariad' stealth fighter you must fly over the surface of the planet over various levels shooting and avoiding various waves of alien ships. At the end of a level you will face a serpent like creature who needs destroying. Touching or getting shot from an alien craft will lose you one of three lives. Lose them all and it's game over.

meta.name: Tank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.72 KB

Tank is a two-player-only duel that imagines future warfare as a joystick battle on a cozy C64 while world leaders sip beer. Your goal is to destroy your opponent's tank while keeping an eye on your own DAMAGE and FUEL gauges. If your damage maxes out or fuel runs dry, you lose. It's simple, satirical, and ruthless – a tongue-in-cheek look at war through a retro lens.

meta.name: Tank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.24 KB

Your country has been taken over by a brutal dictator, and you must wipe out his forces and defences. You control a tank (surprisingly enough) armed with machine guns and cannons in this top-view scrolling shoot 'em up with arcade roots. Arrows guide you as to the optimal route. Available tokens to collect include fuel and equipment. Destroy enemy tanks and bases with the cannons, and infantrymen with the machine gun. There are rivers to cross using bridges, landmines, and enemy installations to beware of.

meta.name: Tank Action
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.95 KB

Tank Action puts the player in control of a small tank navigating a maze filled with walls, enemies, and bonuses – like Pac-Man, but armed. Instead of just dodging, you can fight back and clear paths with firepower. Well-placed power-ups and clever maneuvering are key to outsmarting enemies and racking up points before your lives run out.

meta.name: Tank Atak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.14 KB

Tank Atak plays similar to the Atari arcade game Battlezone, in which you control a tank which must drive left or right across a landscape, shooting enemy tanks and flying saucers in the process. Your tank is equipped with a radar that can be used to help you locate them. Once you do, you need to line them up in your sights and fire missiles once they are within range. Taking too long results in the windscreen getting smashed and the loss of one of your three lives. Lose all your lives and the game is over.

meta.name: Tank Battle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.87 KB

„Tank Battle“ is an action-packed tank game where the player controls a heavy battle tank and must defend against enemy attacks. With limited armor and increasing difficulty, strategic maneuvering and precise shooting are essential for survival.

meta.name: Tank Battle (Supernova)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.59 KB

Tank Battle is a two-player-only tank game where two opponents battle in a maze of walls. Each player controls a tank and must eliminate the other through strategic movement and precise shooting. The walls serve as both cover and obstacles, requiring tactical gameplay. The objective is to destroy the enemy tank before getting hit.

meta.name: Tank Division
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.87 KB

Tank Division is a two-player simultaneous game where each player controls a futuristic tank acting as a goalkeeper. The goal is to shoot the ball toward the opponent's net using cannon fire, with timing and precision being key. Only glancing shots can effectively move the ball, while head-on shots from both sides cancel each other out. The match ends when time runs out or when both players have used up all their shots. Quick reflexes and strategy are essential.

meta.name: Tank Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.35 KB

Tank Wars is a simple single screen action game for two players that is similar to the Atari 2600 game Combat. Each player controls a tank and has to shoot down the opponent. Each kill gives the player one point and the one that first reaches ten points will win the game. The game can be played with or without barriers that offer some protection. When used the game starts with each player placing nine rectangular barriers on the battlefield.

meta.name: Tankattack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.17 KB

Tank Attack requires you to use a board game playing with the computer. It is a fold out map which features a hex map presented in war-gaming style. It is split into four countries with a variety of terrains. There are four armored divisions comprising of four armored cars and eight tanks. Your aim is to destroy the bases of the other players countries by getting into range and blowing up the HQ. The computer acts as a moderator deciding the outcomes of fire-fights and keeping track of the status of each force. At the start of a turn the computer rolls a dice to determine how many movement units a player can use. The player can decide where to attack and where to move. The winner is the one with his bases still intact and the other players' destroyed.

meta.name: Tanker Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.31 KB

Tanker Rescue puts you in control of a helicopter tasked with saving workers from a burning oil rig and transporting them to the safety of a nearby tanker. You must avoid thick clouds of poisonous gas drifting over the sea. Brief contact is survivable, but staying too long will lead to a crash. Every rescue matters – but time is not on your side.

meta.name: Tanks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tanks is a tactical tank battle game where you command your units across a map filled with rivers, bridges, mountains, and destructible terrain. Unlike pure action titles, this game emphasizes strategy – positioning, cover, and smart use of grenades determine victory. Every move matters, as terrain and movement directly impact the flow of battle. A calculated war game for thoughtful commanders.

meta.name: Tanks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.30 KB

Tanks pits two players against each other in a stripped-down arena, one red tank versus one blue. The goal is to land shots and rack up points in a fast-paced duel. With simple controls and a clean layout, it's all about reflexes and precision. If the C64 ever had a sequel to Atari 2600's Combat, this would be it.

meta.name: Tanks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tanks is a 2-player-only game where both players battle head-to-head on a rugged battlefield dotted with terrain. Each commands a tank, aiming to outmaneuver and outgun the other. The isometric view adds tactical depth, encouraging use of cover and terrain. With no single-player mode, the focus is pure, intense one-on-one combat.

meta.name: Tanks 3000
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tanks 3000 lets two to four players battle it out with guided rockets, with the goal of being the last one standing. A surprisingly atmospheric intro and a detailed options menu set it apart from other C64 games. Every setting is adjustable at any time, keeping the action fresh. Even after countless rounds, new configurations can be discovered to make the game feel new again – ideal for competitive sessions or entertaining party play.

meta.name: Tapper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.20 KB

Tapper es un juego de acción donde eres un camarero y tienes que servir cerveza a los clientes más exigentes. Hay cuatro clientes, cada uno tiene su propia barra más larga que la anterior, a los que hay que mantener a raya. Si llegan al final de la barra sin recibir su cerveza, estás perdido, si se le pasa una y se derrama accidentalmente se pierde una vida y si uno de ellos te devuelve la jarra y no puedes cogerla, se perderá una vida también.
De vez en cuando aparecerá un item extraño en una de las líneas; si lo tomas, invocará un espectáculo estilo "cabarette" que mantendrá ocupados a algunos de los clientes.

meta.name: Target
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Target is a single-screen space shooter. The goal is to defend the planet from waves of enemy ships. The player controls a cannon that can move left and right. The level is considered complete when the cannon manages to survive for a specific amount of time.

meta.name: Target
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Target is a space shooter where the player controls a crosshair to shoot waves of enemy ships. The objective is to fend off the enemies that attack from various directions. As time progresses, the game becomes increasingly difficult as the enemies grow faster and more numerous. The goal is to survive as long as possible while defending against enemy attacks. The difficulty increases with each wave survived, raising the challenge.

meta.name: Target : Renegade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ellos vigilan cada paso, cada movimiento. ¿Eres capaz de atravesar los oscuros callejones y los aparcamientos donde mil peligros te acechan? En esta noche húmeda y calurosa, esto es sólo la punta del iceberg de tu escalofriante intento de enfrentarte a MR. BIG.

meta.name: Targon-64
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.03 KB

meta.name: Tarzan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.29 KB

According to an African legend, a human baby was abandoned in the forest. He was found and raised by a female monkey named Kala. Years later he was returned to England as John Clayton, Lord of Greystoke, to claim his rightful inheritance. However, he occasionally returns to the wilderness to become Tarzan, Lord of the Jungle.
Now is one of those occasions. Tarzan has returned to the jungle with his wife Lady Jane Greystoke, but their vacation comes to an end when Usanga, the evil chief of the Wamabo, kidnaps Jane to force Tarzan to retrieve the seven gems stolen from his tribal shrine. Tarzan has three days to find the gems or else Jane will be eaten by the tribe's pet, Sheeta the Panther.
If Tarzan manages to find all seven gems and deliver them to Usanga within the deadline, Jane will be released.

meta.name: Tarzan Goes Ape!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You play Tarzan, who the witch doctor has turned into a monkey. To change back to his human form, you need to collect six ingredients - necklace, mask, plant, crossbones, a bottle, and gem - and place them in his cauldron. While you are doing this, you deal with various forms of wildlife; such as snakes, birds, lizards, and cannibals; by stoning them to death. Fruit can be picked up for bonus points. There are two types of skulls that are scattered through each level. One that gives you reverse controls, and one that causes loss of life. When Tarzan has obtained all six ingredients, you proceed onto the next level. In between these, you play a bonus level where the object is to collect a number of gems before time runs out.

meta.name: Task III
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En el año 6038, la Galaxia Cybernetica está amenazada por un emperador maligno, años después de perder una guerra por su dominio. Cada nivel debe superarse dentro de un límite de tiempo, y se obtienen puntos extra al morir o completar una fase.
Task III es un shoot-'em-up con scroll vertical, visto desde arriba. El control de la nave recuerda al de Uridium: manejas su velocidad y puedes girarla 180° para volar en sentido contrario al desplazamiento de la pantalla. Es para uno o dos jugadores, que se turnan al perder una vida.

meta.name: Task-F
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.53 KB

Task-F puts you in control of a plane flying through varied terrain while projectiles and threats approach from multiple directions. You dodge incoming fire or shoot back, with new areas unlocking stronger weapon upgrades that expand your combat options. Hits carry real consequences because limited lives make every mistake meaningful and encourage careful maneuvering. The changing environments keep the experience fresh and push you to constantly adjust your strategy and pacing.

meta.name: Taskforce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Snide Gaintree and his Mercenaries has taken over a top-secret Air-Force base in the South Pacific containing cruise-missiles, and in less than four hours will be in control of the missiles. You have been sent in a state-of-the-art jetfighter to fly through the various caverns under the base to stop Gaintree in this side view flick screen shooter. As you fly you will encounter various enemy as well as gun-placements and lasers used as gates and if you touch any of these then you lose a life (five on the C64, nine on the C16). Your plane is armed though with various weapons from a standard forward shot to limited 3 direction, vertical shot and a laser. You also have limited shields but more can be collected by shooting barrels. Each level is 20 screens and at the end is an end of level boss that needs destroying to move to the next level.

meta.name: Taskmaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.04 KB

"Taskmaster" tells the story of a prince who wishes to marry Princess Kelly, but her father, King Otto, deems him unworthy. To prove himself, the prince must complete seven perilous tasks: surviving a night outside the castle while being attacked by embarrassed-looking zombies, defeating an evil wizard in the Dabbit Forest, retrieving four sacred stones from Vampire Mountain, slaying a certain number of monks from the Temple of Demons, destroying the ancient Spirit Stone of the Runes of Tygorth, recovering five real stones from the northern barbarian village guarded by evil barbarians, and finally, surviving swooping bird attacks on his way to the wedding ceremony. If he completes all tasks successfully, King Otto will grant him permission to marry Princess Kelly.

meta.name: Tass Times in Tone Town
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tu abuelo ha inventado un aparato que hace realidad todo lo que ve en sus sueños. Todos los extraños lugares y criaturas con los que puede soñar existen realmente en una realidad alternativa. Una de estas criaturas, llamada Franklin Snarl, ha viajado a través del dispositivo hasta nuestra realidad y ha secuestrado a Gramps, teletransportándolo al loco mundo de Tonetown. Espera que el abuelo permanezca siempre dormido, ¡asegurando así la propia existencia de Snarl!
Ahora depende de ti, el héroe del juego, viajar a la dimensión alternativa de Tonetown y salvar a tu abuelo. Interactúa con el entorno escribiendo comandos o eligiendo uno de los iconos de acción disponibles como interfaz. El juego combina así la interacción basada en texto con el enfoque más moderno de "point-and-click".

meta.name: Tass Times in Tone Town
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tu abuelo ha inventado un aparato que hace realidad todo lo que ve en sus sueños. Todos los extraños lugares y criaturas con los que puede soñar existen realmente en una realidad alternativa. Una de estas criaturas, llamada Franklin Snarl, ha viajado a través del dispositivo hasta nuestra realidad y ha secuestrado a Gramps, teletransportándolo al loco mundo de Tonetown. Ahora depende de ti, el héroe del juego, viajar a la dimensión alternativa de Tonetown y salvar a tu abuelo. El juego combina así la interacción basada en texto con el enfoque más moderno de "point-and-click".

meta.name: Tau Ceti
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un simulador espacial con diversos elementos de otros géneros. Tu misión es destruir a la armada robótica que controla el planeta.
Tras la colonización de Tau Ceti III y su posterior abandono a causa de una epidemia, los terrestres intentan volver al planeta con una cura. Pero las defensas automáticas siguen en funcionamiento e impiden todo aterrizaje.

meta.name: Taxman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.65 KB

“Taxman” is a platform game where you guide Humfrey through the land of N.O.D. to collect hay taxes and destroy all Herberts to survive. Gather coins (Hods) and tackle the land's challenges as you work to overcome obstacles. If you fail, you can simply restart.

meta.name: Tazz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tazz sends you through a series of dangerous rooms as the yellow Tazzman, where every bug has to be eliminated with your laser gun. Since you can only fire in four directions while standing still, every movement becomes a small risk, especially with enemies chasing you and the walls slowly closing in. Bombs give you valuable breathing room until the last bug is gone, the exits open, and the next room awaits. Bonus stages pleasantly break up the tension and reward careful collecting.

meta.name: Team Championship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.47 KB

In Team Championship, you take on the role of both a racer and a team manager. You must strategically manage your team while participating in motorcycle races to succeed. Decisions that affect the team play a crucial role on the road to victory.

meta.name: Team Championship II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.19 KB

In Team Championship II, you take on the role of both a racer and a team manager. You must strategically manage your team while participating in motorcycle races to succeed. Decisions that affect the team play a crucial role on the road to victory.

meta.name: Team Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Team Patrol you compete in fast-paced races against other players, controlling a nimble vehicle across challenging tracks – speed alone isn't enough. You must overcome obstacles, time your jumps, and avoid hazards that can slow you down or eliminate you from the race. Each course tests your timing and control, while direct competition adds extra pressure. Only those who combine speed with precision will come out on top.

meta.name: Team Tetris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.79 KB

"Team Tetris" offers three different gameplay modes, each presenting unique challenges. The "Easy Play" mode is designed for beginners, allowing for a more relaxed experience. The "Obstacle Game" increases difficulty by introducing barriers on the playing field that make block placement trickier. The "Random Blocks" mode takes it a step further, unpredictably altering the field with randomly placed blocks. The objective remains to complete full rows to clear the field and achieve the highest possible score.

meta.name: Techno Plyn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.81 KB

Techno Plyn is a Pac-Man-style arcade game where the player is chased by skulls but has the ability to shoot them. Certain sections of the maze must be navigated in specified directions, adding a strategic element. Special symbols have unique effects on gameplay – some, for instance, temporarily freeze enemies.

meta.name: TechnoCop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Techno Cop está ambientado en un futuro cercano. Eres un policía que intenta limpiar su ciudad de toda la escoria criminal. El juego consta de dos partes: una de conducción y otra de desplazamiento lateral. En la primera parte, conduces tu Ferrari rojo y destruyes los coches enemigos; en la segunda parte, das volteretas por los huecos, usas ascensores y disparas a montones de enemigos hasta llegar al jefe. Después de matar o atrapar al villano, vuelves a la carretera para la siguiente misión.

meta.name: Tectron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.63 KB

“Tectron” is a pure two-player duel in classic Tron style, where two light-trail opponents face off in a confined arena. Each player leaves a deadly trail behind that must be avoided. The goal is to outmaneuver your opponent into a trap without cornering yourself. Simple in visuals, but intense in gameplay – only your reflexes decide victory or defeat.

meta.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles es una trepidante aventura de acción donde encarnas a las cuatro tortugas ninja para rescatar a April O'Neil de Bebop y Rocksteady, salvar a Maestro Splinter de las Mecha-Turtles y enfrentarte al final a Shredder en lo más profundo del Technodrome. Controlas a una tortuga a la vez, pero puedes cambiar libremente entre Leonardo, Miguel Ángel, Donatello y Rafael. Si una cae, es capturada y hay que rescatarla antes de volver a usarla. El juego alterna dos perspectivas: vista cenital para explorar calles, edificios y alcantarillas, y lateral para los combates. Además del arma principal de cada uno, puedes recoger subarmas de uso limitado —como shurikens— para acabar con los enemigos.

meta.name: Tees-tyne Pullman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.43 KB

“Tees-Tyne Pullman” is a management simulation that places you in charge of operating the legendary Pullman train on the East Coast Main Line from London to Newcastle. Organize trains and cargo to maintain the schedule and ensure smooth operations. Strategic skill is essential to run the service efficiently and tackle the challenges of the route.

meta.name: Tele-Chess 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tele-Chess 64 places classic chess in an unusual setting and turns the board game into a duel that can even be played over telephone lines. That distinctive approach gives the program its own appeal, because it relies not only on strategy, forward thinking, and precise moves, but also on the idea of connecting two players who are far apart. The result is an interesting blend of timeless chess and a sense of technical pioneering that gives the game a special charm.

meta.name: Telengard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Telengard, you control a single adventurer with randomly generated stats like Strength, Intelligence, and Charisma, exploring a vast dungeon with 50 levels and 200×200 rooms per floor. The game runs in real time – monsters can attack even when you're idle. You gain experience by defeating enemies and finding treasure, leveling up to improve stats and learn stronger spells. Random features like altars, fountains, or thrones can help or harm you. With high Charisma, some creatures may even become friendly, offering healing or items.

meta.name: Telnyr II : The Golden Chalice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Telnyr II: The Golden Chalice" begins with the grim news that Telnyr "has been overrun by monsters, vagabonds, and restless spirits," and that "demons have stolen the Golden Chalice and hidden it in the darkest dungeon." Number 10 in the Mysterious Adventures series of interactive fiction is inspired by the Agatha Christie book "And Then There were None". The player's aim is to find the gold statue, formed by Major Johnstone-Smythe from most of his assets shortly before his death. The Major also made 10 worthless copies in various colours, and hid them in and around his mansion. Only the 10 'little indian' figurines, assembled together, would reveal the location of the final golden one. These figurines are hidden behind and under ordinary household objects, and in various hiding places. The game begins in a train carriage and the player's first task is to prevent the train from crashing, which must be achieved in a limited number of moves. Once this has been achieved the train arrives at Lower Massington station and the player must then find their way to the Major's mansion in Upper Massington.

Al reunirlos todos, esta se transforma en un fénix ígneo, otorgando invencibilidad temporal. Con varias secciones acopladas, también puedes dividir la nave para disparar en distintas direcciones. El éxito depende de recoger con inteligencia, separar estratégicamente y atacar en el momento preciso para sobrevivir a las implacables oleadas enemigas.

The first stage is based on the game Uridium, in which you have to fly over the surface of a planet or a spaceship and blow up a certain part of the landscape while dodging and shooting waves of alien spaceships that are shooting back at you. You can control the speed of your ship and have the screen scroll as you move, as well as turn around and fly the other way.
The second stage is a simple shoot-em-up where you shoot or avoid waves of ships while moving from left to right, constantly scrolling the screen. You cannot turn or control your speed. In the final phase you face a level boss. Destroy the boss and go to the next level.

Meteorites were seen crashing over Loch Ness in Victorian Scotland. Alien lifeforms have been spotted emerging from the loch at night, terrorizing locals and possibly even endangering the Loch Ness Monster. Something must be done to stop the creatures. So you came across an old Scottish engineer who designed and built a diving bell ship before he died.
Since the engineer was old and dying, he asked you to drive the vehicle and gave you brief instructions on how to use it before he died. They also managed to get a surface ship that lowers you into the water, lifts you out, and supplies you with spears and fuel. Before you dive, you must indicate to the captain on a map of the lake where you need to dive to kill the alien life forms.

Your goal now is to escape from the terrifying and deadly labyrinth of the Romulans. To achieve this goal, you must assemble a hypercom, the parts of which are scattered throughout the maze. This maze is a death trap from which there is almost no escape. You have three tanks at your disposal for your task of assembling the Hypercom.

Your goal is an overgrown temple that hides three valuable treasures – a red gem, a golden statue, and the sacred silver dagger of Nazca. To claim them, you must survive deadly traps and make it back out alive. The result is a classic treasure hunt with an exotic setting, a mysterious atmosphere, and a strong sense of risky exploration.

Success relies not only on accurate aiming but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy fire and position yourself strategically. Only those who combine skill, timing, and smart movement will be able to overcome the escalating challenges and emerge victorious.

En este título juegas como un hombre de familia que lleva a su mujer e hijos a unas vacaciones que nunca olvidarán, aunque por los motivos equivocados. Evita a los toros y los tiburones, ten cuidado para evitar insolaciones, y asegúrate de que tu familia no se escapa.
Llegar y sobrevivir a todos los peligros que el folleto se "olvidó" de mencionar es todo un desafío, pero es que además debes realizar 10 fotografías de las vacaciones para demostrar por lo que has pasado.

Just because a region is desolate and inhospitable does not mean it lacks value. The planet Colian is a case in point; It has ample supplies of the tough metal Aluma, the explosive Detonite, and the energy-giving Quaza Crystals. The ten colonies they mine are under Empire control and are forced to use their resources to produce destructive Terrorpod units.nnnnFind each of the colonies before the Terrorpods destroy them and set up a trade between them so that each of the colonies gets the supplies they need. As all of these actions unfold, try to ensure that enough components can be produced and retrieved in the colonies to use for the Federation's own construction efforts. Collect the resulting products to connect to your DSV to craft your own Terrorpod.

Terry wields a yo-yo as a weapon, which can be directed in different directions while holding down fire. However, the yo-yo's recoil can push him off a platform or into danger. Across twelve levels, players must cross rivers and defeat enemies like hedgehogs and snails. Hidden bonus items and time extensions can be found. The game allows players to resume from the last level reached, effectively granting unlimited continues.

Logical thinking, attention to detail, and the right combination of actions are key to advancing and solving the mysteries of this unusual park.

„Theseus and the Minotaur“ puts players in control of Theseus, the Athenian prince, as he navigates a randomly-generated labyrinth in search of the fearsome Minotaur. The maze can feature secret doors, mirror sections, and various creatures, including snakes so common they have a dedicated control key. Theseus starts with only his fists, which are sufficient for weaker enemies, but stronger weapons are required to defeat the Minotaur. Victory is only complete once the monster is slain and the player exits the maze through the original entry point – though leaving is possible at any time, whether the Minotaur is still alive or not.

meta.name: They $tole a Million
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

They Stole a Million pone al jugador en la piel de un genio criminal cuyo objetivo es amasar una fortuna mediante atracos meticulosamente planificados. Debe reclutar un equipo de especialistas con habilidades como explosivos, abrir cerraduras o conducir vehículos para huir, cada uno exigiendo un pago por adelantado y una parte del botín. Debe adquirir información y planos de posibles objetivos, como bancos o galerías de arte. La estrategia del atraco se planifica desde una perspectiva descendente, con el jugador posicionando estratégicamente a los miembros de la tripulación y coordinando el tiempo. Durante el robo, el jefe permanece afuera, dando órdenes por radio. Una fuerte presencia policial puede obligar a una huida inmediata, y si el jugador entra en la escena del crimen, estará indefenso ante un arresto.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The evil Goblin has used his magical abilities to ensnare all the toys in the neighborhood to go into his underground lair. Thing bounces to the rescue, and resolves to retrieve them from his 4 storey underground lair. To do this he must collect 9 pieces of a jigsaw puzzle on each floor. Needless to say, Goblin has not made things easy - a myriad of traps await our intrepid hero. There are traps all over, some crucial areas are guarded by switches, and the last of these switches locks the level-ending lift.

meta.name: Think Fast
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.97 KB

Think Fast is a logic and brain game that challenges your quick thinking and logical skills. As a single player, you must find the correct solutions to various tasks within a short time frame and react quickly to progress through the game. The game tests your ability to think on your feet and solve puzzles rapidly, providing a fun and stimulating experience for players looking to sharpen their mental agility.

meta.name: The Thinker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.94 KB

The Thinker challenges you to slide blocks in order to move the large red block from the top center down through the opening at the bottom. Every move is tracked, and the game records the total number of moves used. Be careful – three incorrect commands and you lose. Strategic thinking is the key to success.

meta.name: The Thompson Twins Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Thompson Twins Adventure, you join the pop trio on a quirky text-based journey inspired by their hit “Doctor! Doctor!”. Starting on a beach and soon descending into a mysterious cave, you use classic text commands like “look,” “take,” “read,” and directions such as “north” or “down” to find items and solve puzzles. The goal is to uncover the secret of the Doctor's potion. Released on a flexi-disc as part of a unique promo campaign, players who completed the game could win concert tickets and a backstage meeting with the band.

meta.name: The Three Musketeers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Three Musketeers” is a software adaptation of the novel of the same name and follows the story of a secret affair between Anne of Austria, wife of King Louis XIII, and the Duke of Buckingham. Cardinal Richelieu wants to remove Anne to increase his own influence over the king. When she sends a diamond necklace to the Duke as a token of love – the very necklace she is supposed to wear at an important ball – Richelieu sees his chance. Now it's up to the three musketeers Athos, Porthos and Aramis, along with newcomer D'Artagnan, to retrieve it in time. You play as D'Artagnan. The game plays like a choose-your-own adventure: you read lengthy written passages accompanied by static images and make decisions from several options – sometimes under time pressure. Only the correct choice moves the story forward. Occasionally, you must also choose cardinal directions, such as in a maze sequence.

meta.name: The Three Stooges
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Three Stooges turns the famous slapstick stars into a chaotic rescue adventure full of silliness, mini-games, and classic moments of nonsense. Moe, Larry, and Curly have to raise enough money to save an orphanage from a nasty banker, while naturally stumbling from one absurd situation into the next. Many tasks draw on familiar scenes and gags from the source material, making the game feel like a playable collection of their best foolishness. That mix of humor, nostalgia, and wonderfully over-the-top chaos gives the game its special charm.

meta.name: Threestone
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Threestone is a two-player strategy puzzle where brains matter more than speed. Players take turns placing stones on a grid of interconnected nodes, planning each move carefully to form advantageous lines and block their opponent. Every placement shifts the balance, forcing constant adaptation and foresight. Simple in appearance but deep in strategy, Threestone delivers a calm yet tense battle of wits between two sharp minds.

meta.name: Threshold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Threshold is a classic shoot 'em up where you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen and blast enemy formations at the top. The challenge comes from a limited fuel supply, which only refills after clearing several waves. On top of that, your ship's laser is prone to overheating – every shot raises the heat bar. Once it maxes out, you can't fire and must wait for it to cool down, all while your fuel keeps draining. This creates constant tension between attacking and managing your resources.

meta.name: Through the Trapdoor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.46 KB

Through The Trap Door sends Berk and his friend Drutt on an exploration of the mysterious world beneath the trap door. You control both characters alternately, solving puzzles, encountering new creatures, and unlocking doors to access further of the four regions. Sweets and toadstools scattered throughout grant Berk special abilities. Progress depends on using both characters together, as Drutt can reach places Berk cannot.

meta.name: Thrust
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thrust introdujo una mecánica única en los arcades: física realista y movimiento basado en inercia, influyendo directamente en títulos como Oids y en Exile del mismo autor. La acción, en vista lateral y gráficos vectoriales, refuerza su naturaleza matemática.
Como miembro de la Resistencia, debes penetrar en líneas enemigas para robar Klystron Pods —usando el rayo tractor— y alimentar naves estelares avanzadas. Redes de cañones fijos intentan derribarte; puedes desactivarlos disparando a su fuente de energía, pero esta acaba explotando, obligándote a huir. En niveles avanzados aparece gravedad inversa, elevando considerablemente la dificultad.

meta.name: Thrust II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thrust II builds on the inertia-driven flight of its predecessor and tasks you with a new mission on an artificial planet whose atmosphere still needs stabilising. You guide your craft through maze-like tunnels beneath the surface, locate scattered orbs, and carefully transport them back while tight spaces and enemies make every movement risky. Patrolling androids force you to choose between evasion and confrontation, and carrying cargo adds extra strain to your control. Piece by piece you gather the components needed – a demanding operation that relies on precision, planning, and steady nerves.

meta.name: Thrusta
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.72 KB

Thrusta puts you in control of a spaceship navigating a single open area where scattered eggs continuously release creatures. Your goal is to eliminate these beings by cleverly using the eggs and the layout of the level, as each used egg later reappears on a different platform. At the same time airborne enemies attack, forcing you to balance movement and offense while relying on your ship's laser for relief. Only after every threat has been cleared can you move on – a dynamic blend of manoeuvring, timing, and constant awareness.

meta.name: Thud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.41 KB

En Thud, debes atrapar ladrillos que caen antes de que golpeen el suelo y se rompan. Un carro cargado pierde constantemente su carga, y su tarea es ser lo suficientemente rápido con un balde para interceptarlos. El ritmo aumenta a medida que los ladrillos caen más rápidamente, exigiendo reflejos rápidos y un tiempo preciso. Con cada carga guardada, el desafío crece: un momento de vacilación, y el suelo recibe el golpe.

meta.name: Thud Ridge : American Aces in 'Nam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Thud Ridge: American Aces in 'Nam" puts the player in the role of an F-105 Thunderchief pilot during the Vietnam War. Missions take place in the heavily defended "RP-6A" area around Hanoi – which can only be reached by flying over the hilly region known as "Thud Ridge." The player starts as a lieutenant and undertakes various missions – including eliminating enemy tankers, bombing bridges, dropping leaflets, or engaging MiGs in air combat. Successfully completing missions increases the pilot's rank. Before each sortie, the mission briefing must be reviewed, and the aircraft must be equipped with weapons and supplies. After taking off from an airbase – such as Korat – the objective is to eliminate enemy MiGs, cross the "Ridge," and accomplish the mission.

meta.name: Thunder Arena
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.12 KB

Thunder Arena is a two-player-only shootout where reflexes and precision matter most. Set in a simple square arena, players go head-to-head, dodging and firing in fast-paced duels. There are no AI enemies – just pure one-on-one combat. With minimal graphics and direct action, this public domain game offers straightforward but intense competitive fun.

meta.name: Thunder Bombs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Thunder Bombs, you control a storm cloud that moves vertically at the center of the screen, firing lightning bolts left and right to destroy enemy bombs on either side. These bombs shoot back, and getting hit costs you one of your five clouds. You earn an extra cloud every 2000 points. Points are awarded for clearing stages – 100, 200, 300, and 500 respectively – across five increasingly difficult levels. Sharp aim and timing are key to surviving this electrifying arcade challenge.

meta.name: Thunder Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 77.78 KB

In Thunder Force, you and a friend battle through side-scrolling levels, brawling your way through waves of enemies attacking from both sides. Punch, kick, and grab weapons to survive until the end-of-level boss appears. Getting hit drains your energy, but it slowly regenerates as you press on. In two-player mode, both fighters are on-screen, adding to the action. Score, energy, and lives are always visible, while you jump, crouch, and attack in this fast-paced, no-nonsense beat-'em-up.

meta.name: Thunder Jaws
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thunder Jaws sends you on a dangerous underwater mission to infiltrate a secret fortress, rescue captives, and stop sinister experiments. After arrival you dive through hostile waters, avoiding mines, pollution, and predators while battling enemy divers and pushing steadily toward your objective. Inside the base, increasingly complex sections challenge you to defeat enemies, collect new equipment, and adapt your approach. The rising difficulty blends careful advancement with intense encounters – an action-driven operation where persistence and quick reactions determine success.

meta.name: Thunderbird
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.21 KB

Thunderbird puts you in control of a cannon at the top of the screen, aiming to clear a colorful wall of blocks below using a projectile. Each hit scores points, each miss wastes time. With every new round, the color pattern changes, but the goal remains the same – destroy everything before the blocks reach you.

meta.name: Thunderbirds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.07 KB

Thunderbirds puts you on a rescue mission to save trapped Egyptologists running out of air inside an ancient tomb. Before takeoff, you must wisely load Thunderbird 2 with equipment, balancing a strict weight limit — each ton reduces your score. Once inside the tomb, you navigate mazes blocked by colored obstacles: blue moved by Thunderbird 1, green by Thunderbird 2, and red by either. Some passages are too narrow for Thunderbird 2, requiring strategy. Fuel is limited, but earlier expeditions left supplies. With careful planning, you can rescue the team and uncover hidden treasure along the way.

meta.name: Thunderbirds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thunderbirds puts you in command of International Rescue, with George Tracy, Brains Hackenbacker, and the five Tracy sons, each piloting a Thunderbird craft. Across four missions, you control a two-man team and switch between them as needed. Choosing the right gear is essential. You'll navigate through hazards using lifts and ladders, solving puzzles along the way. From rescuing miners in a flooding shaft to repairing a nuclear sub, infiltrating a bank, and confronting a madman, each mission builds on the last in this escalating rescue adventure.

meta.name: Thunder Blade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thunder Blade te pone al mando del helicóptero Gunship Gladiator, encargado de detener el ascenso al poder de un dictador. A lo largo de doce fases y tres estilos de juego, sobrevuelas ciudades esquivando rascacielos mientras disparas a tanques, cambias a una vista trasera 3D para combatir helicópteros y aviones, y atacas aviones enemigos en un portaaviones. El reto consiste en esquivar balas mientras maniobras para disparar a baja altura y mantienes la puntería afinada bajo presión.

meta.name: ThunderBolt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.51 KB

In ThunderBolt, you pilot a jet fighter through a collapsing space-time continuum after a failed Chronoclasm experiment. As Earth and Proxima battle over temporal weapons, you're caught in a war spanning centuries – fighting enemies from past and future alike. This side-scrolling shooter challenges you to fly left to right without getting destroyed, using a standard unlimited shot and a powerful screen-clearing special attack. Every hit or wall collision drains fuel, forcing you to balance aggression with precision. With tight corridors and time-warping chaos, survival demands skill and sharp reflexes.

meta.name: Thunder Boy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Thunderboy, you play as a sci-fi exterminator battling waves of bugs and rodents across platform levels. Armed with a slowly moving laser cannon, you must eliminate a set number of pests to clear each stage. Timing and precision are key. When overwhelmed, unleash a powerful Smartbomb to stun all enemies – but act fast, as they'll wake up soon. One quick touch and they're vacuumed into your trusty Thunder backpack. It's frantic, weird, and oddly satisfying.

meta.desc:

Es un videojuego de desplazamiento lateral basado en la serie animada original de televisión ThunderCats en el cual tu misión será derrotar a las fuerzas de Mumm-Ra, que van desde enanos hasta murciélagos. Aunque comienzas solo con una espada, puedes recolectar más destruyendo los diversos contenedores a través de los niveles; las armas posteriores pueden destruir a estos enemigos más rápido y permitir ataques desde la distancia. Al llegar al final de cada nivel ve bonificaciones por tiempo y muertes. El camino a través del juego se puede variar en los niveles posteriores, por lo que puedes jugarlo más de una vez y encontrar nuevas secciones, a pesar de que los niveles individuales solo se desplazan de izquierda a derecha.

meta.name: Thunderchopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thunderchopper puts you in a Hughes 530 MG Defender helicopter, and offers several modes of play. First is training, intended to simulate the movement and physics of the real chopper. Next are rescue and combat missions, which test your perception, precision, and reflexes. For further challenges, there are finally sea rescue and armed escort missions. Each mode has three levels of difficulty. You have a limited selection of guns and missiles for combat, and an onboard computer guides you through missions. If you get bored with the game scenery, you can load scenery disks from subLOGIC's Flight Simulator series.

meta.name: Thundercross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are the Captain of the good ship Thundercross but problems are arising with the thrusters and power. No matter how much you use them, the ship seems to be pulled by a strange force. You realise in the area is a huge ship pulling you towards it. To add more problems, the ship has sent out various smaller crafts to destroy you. The only course of action is to confront the giant ship and blow it up. You must avoid and kill the smaller crafts attacking you before flying over the surface of the ship and destroy as much of it as you can. After a run over the surface you must face the smaller crafts again before flying over the surface of a different part of the ship. The crafts fire missiles at you and on the ship itself there are various defenses that fire as well. One touch by a craft, part of the ship or any bullet means your shield gauge decrease. Once it's empty it is game over.

meta.name: Thunderhawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Thunder Hawk is a challenging game where you fight enemies in a vertically scrolling scenario. You are given passwords to return to previously reached levels, so you don't have to repeat all your progress. The game offers a good mix of action and strategy, focusing on an intense gameplay experience with varied challenges.

"Ticket to Hollywood" is an educational quiz game centered on Hollywood movies, directors, and actors from the 1910s to the 1980s. Players explore six maps of various Hollywood locations from a top-down perspective and can travel across eight decades to visit sites from each era. The goal is to earn stars by using clues about locations and time periods to track down a mysterious director. Once found, players can ask the director questions to earn stars or answer their questions for bonus stars. During the journey, energy is consumed and can be replenished by correctly answering questions posed by the Movie Madame at various locations. The ultimate aim is to collect as many stars as possible to secure a spot on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

Tiebreaker is a tennis game. The graphics are isometric and action is seen from the side line. Using the joystick the player may move in eight directions. Depending on angle and pressure on the fire button, the player can control how hard to hit the ball. Each game is based on best of three sets and the scoring is according to standard tennis rules. The game features an Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) standard table occupied by computer opponents, and the objective is to reach the number one position. Before playing the player may configure nationality, sex, or color of clothes. Tiebreaker can be played in both single and multiplayer modes.

meta.name: Tiger Claw : C64 in Pixels Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.36 KB

Tiger Claw is a relentless beat 'em up where you fight as TIGER CLAW through 24 screens of martial arts chaos. With well-placed kicks and punches, you must recover four mystic scrolls before Fire Fist, Thunder Chain, and Angry Tongue unleash their true power. Beyond the main quest, you'll face additional enemies, new areas, and an arcade-style training mode to hone your skills. A separate multiplayer mode lets up to four fighters battle it out in a deathmatch arena – an explosive challenge demanding endurance, timing, and precision.

Tiger Mission is a vertically scrolling shooter in which the player controls a helicopter. The goal is easy to explain: destroying the enemy base at the end of five levels and avoiding the own destruction. Attackers only appear on the ground and using the standard cannon normally takes care of them. Additionally there is a limited amount of smart bombs available which can be unleashed at any time to wipe out everything on the screen. 
Extras can be collected after shooting boxes on the ground: smart bombs go into the inventory while everything else, e.g. turbo speed or better range, are limited in time and used immediately after picking them up. After losing one of the three lives, the current level has to restarted from the beginning.

Esta conversión de arcade es un beat 'em up en el que, como Lee Wong, debes rescatar a los niños del pueblo del malvado Ryo Ken Oh. Muchos niveles avanzan con scroll horizontal, aunque incluyen plataformas elevadas a las que puedes saltar para seguir rutas alternativas. Aparecen frecuentemente urnas mágicas con armas mejoradas. La mayoría de enemigos son fáciles: bastan un golpe para eliminarlos, aunque atacan en grandes oleadas. En las zonas interiores aparecen enemigos grandes, capaces de matarte de un solo golpe, en escenarios de varios niveles con escaleras.

meta.name: Tiger Tank
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.43 KB

In Tiger Tank, you control a tank through hazardous zones like forests, rocket pads, and refineries, collecting radiation packs. Enemies roam the areas – you can shoot them or learn their patterns to dodge them. Ammo is limited but replenished with each radiation pack. Colliding with enemies or walls costs a life. Once all zones are cleared, the game restarts at the forest – with your score reset to zero.

meta.name: Tiger Tanks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.97 KB

In Tiger Tanks, you face off in a direct duel against an enemy tank in a maze-like arena. Navigate tight corridors, dodge incoming fire, and aim to land the decisive shot. Every move matters, and every corner can be fatal. Score points with each hit – speed and precision decide who wins.

meta.name: The Battle of the Bulge : Tigers in the Snow
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Battle of the Bulge: Tigers in the Snow takes place in December 1944, as the Third Reich was crumbling and Hitler launched his final desperate offensive – the Ardennes assault. As the German commander, you lead tank and infantry divisions through snow-covered forests, capturing towns and pushing toward the Meuse River. If you play as the Allies, your task is to hold the line, defend key towns, and delay the German advance until reinforcements arrive. Each turn represents one grueling day of battle, and every decision matters – tactical skill, courage, and timing will determine whether you win or fall in the snow of the Ardennes.

meta.name: Tile - The Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tile: The Revenge is a modified version of the original Tile game. It challenges the player to solve puzzles by cleverly combining tiles and mastering the game.

Viewed from above, the task in Tilt is to rotate the screen so as to guide a ball across a maze into a hole. Unfortunately, if the ball hits any of the walls en route you have to start again, which means that the energy used on the previous tilts is wasted (and you only have a limited amount). There are a number of gates on each screen, which you must open by pressing the fire button at the right moments. As the game progresses the ball gradually gets bigger, giving you less margin for error on maneuvering it. There are also traps to avoid - these are active if the maze isn't tilting, so you'll have to keep it moving.

meta.name: Tilt
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.82 KB

Tilt combines a rolling ball maze with the logic of a sliding puzzle. To guide the ball safely from the entrance to the exit, you shift the maze tiles, collect appearing cans, and avoid magnets, holes, stop signs, and other traps. At the same time, the bonus keeps decreasing, so every detour and poor plan adds noticeable pressure. This creates a clever skill puzzle that neatly links spatial thinking, quick decisions, and precise forward planning.

Using simple two-word commands, you explore the rooms, search for useful items, and try to figure out how to escape before things explode—literally or figuratively. Every clue can save you, every wrong action can trap you. Bit by bit you piece together what you need to stop the threat and make it out alive.

In this game, players explore a labyrinthine environment where they must fight various enemies and overcome obstacles. The graphics use the capabilities of the 3D Construction Kit to depict a three-dimensional game world that was impressive for the time. The controls require skill and quick reactions to meet the game's challenges.

meta.name: Time Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.07 KB

Time Fighter sends you through seven chaotic eras as a time-jumping mercenary – from prehistory and the Middle Ages to the Wild West, the Prohibition Era, World War II, 1980s New York, and the space age. Each zone brings unique enemies and creatures to face in classic side-scrolling action. You run, jump, duck, punch, kick, and wield whatever weapon you pick up along the way. Your energy bar and limited lives determine how long you survive as you fight to restore order across the timeline.

meta.name: Time Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Time Machine, the player takes control over Professor Potts whose main profession is building time machines. As terrorists bomb his laboratory, he gets sucked ten million years into the past. During the course of his adventure he will visit five time zones with five screens each.
This is an adventure with action elements. Most of the game is spent manipulating objects in the different time zones which have an effect on a later zone, e.g. planting a seed in the stone age will cause a tree to appear in the later zones. He also may need to bring an object from one time to another. In each zone there is one big puzzle to solve in order to get access to the next zone (the ultimate goal is to prevent the time machine from getting destroyed), but constant traveling between the time zones is necessary.

meta.name: Mysterious Adventure #02 : The Time Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.05 KB

The Time Machine is the second in the Mysterious Adventure series of text adventures by Brian Howarth. You are a newspaper reporter, come to investigate the eccentric professor who lives all by himself out on the moors. You start the game in a swamp and must find your way to an old manor house. When you get there, you find the place deserted though. Ultimately you must rescue the professor by finding 3 missing prisms which control his time machine, which are lost in time. Items found in one destination sometimes have to be used in another.
As the other games in the series, the game uses an interpreter similar to the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also has the same limitations - a basic 2-word parser, limited vocabulary, and brief descriptions. Illustrations are included in Spectrum, C64, Dragon and Oric ports.

meta.name: Time Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Time Out focuses on reflexes as you guide a craft through tight caves and hazardous passages while avoiding collisions. Rather than combat, the challenge centres on precise movement and maintaining control as pressure steadily increases. Each section demands careful attention since small mistakes carry immediate consequences. The minimalist design creates strong tension – an avoidance-based skill challenge that rewards timing, focus, and smooth control.

meta.name: Time Scanner
meta.desc:

Time Scanner es un trepidante juego de pinball que combina mecánicas clásicas con retos temáticos. Tu objetivo: mantener la bola en juego, sumar puntos y completar objetivos específicos de cada tabla. Las cuatro mesas están divididas en dos secciones verticales con sus propios flippers; la pantalla solo se desplaza hacia abajo al caer la bola. En Volcán, debes escribir su nombre usando carriles especiales. En Ruinas, tras golpear todos los blancos y recoger dos bolas, se libera una bola de fuego que hay que guiar a un agujero. Saqqarah exige tiros precisos para cumplir metas piramidales, y la última tabla introduce bloques al estilo Breakout. La habilidad y el timing son esenciales.

Cada uno está custodiado por un secuaz de Gylend, pero antes debes superar oleadas de enemigos propios de cada era —algunos dejan armas al caer—. Además, hay varios teletransportadores repartidos en cada época que permiten desplazarse entre ellas.

Time Traveller is a text adventure with graphics. Someone has broken Father Time's magic hourglass and you eventually have to restore it. But first things first - as the game starts you wake up in 1990 with no idea who, where, or when you are, or how you got there. You need to figure out how to time travel in order to set things right.

meta.name: Time Traveller
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Time Traveller sends you on a dangerous mission into the past to alter the political balance of your own time. In three stages, you fight through decisive wars in human history. During World War I, you defend your troops on the front lines by shooting down enemy biplanes. In World War II, you protect the strategically positioned warship Liberty from attacks that could sink it. In the third global war, you are thrust into the future, where you must defend a space station against a flood of intercontinental missiles using advanced weaponry to prevent catastrophic geological instability on your planet. If you succeed, your name may be honored forever.

Each age starts with a historical quiz, followed by action sequences where you dodge wild beasts, Roman legionaries, medieval clergy, Tudor guards, and sewer rats. Your goal is to gather enough points to return to the 20th century. Later, you can revisit specific eras to improve your score. The game is both educational and entertaining, helping players memorize facts and dates while offering a historical challenge.

Time Tunnel casts you as a gnome with royal ambitions. To become King of the Gnomes, you must recover a lost document split into seven pieces – each hidden in a different time period, from 9600 BC to the year 9999. First, find the missing part of your time machine in your home – then begin solving puzzles across eras by placing items in the correct spots, even if that means time-traveling with them. You can only carry one object at a time, but your magic closet holds up to eight and can be accessed anywhere. You're also armed with a laser to clear your path.

Your choices shape the journey – where will you go? This is a classic text adventure wrapped in a dark time-travel mystery, where each decision brings you closer to unraveling the unknown.

meta.name: Time Zero

Time Zero places you in an unusual flying adventure where you control a realistic aircraft through tight cavern systems. Precise handling is crucial, as even simple turns become challenging within the confined space. As you navigate the winding passages, you encounter various visual and audio references that give the game a quirky, almost surreal atmosphere. The appeal comes from the combination of demanding controls, high difficulty, and a setting that clearly sets it apart from more traditional aerial action games.

Your task is to locate Anacron and save him by using historical knowledge. The game was designed to teach and reinforce the chronology of historical events in a playful way.

meta.name: Timerunner

"Timerunner" places the player in a challenging environment where time pressure and strategic movement are key. On a grid-based field, the player navigates through various obstacles while collecting important objects. The time limit adds extra tension – requiring clever use of elements on the field to reach the goal. Points are earned by successfully completing tasks, while failures result in lost lives.

El reino de Albereth está siendo atacado por fuerzas bárbaras. El rey Valwyn repele a los bárbaros, pero resulta herido en la batalla. En busca de un lugar donde descansar y recuperar fuerzas, abandonó la ciudad, pero nunca regresó. Ahora un nuevo héroe debe alzarse y defender su patria.
El juego consiste en mover al protagonista en tiempo real (día y noche) por distintos terrenos, como bosques, ciudades y mazmorras. El personaje recoge objetos básicos, como pociones de salud y magia, y armas cada vez más poderosas a medida que completa tareas y avanza en la trama. Las conversaciones se gestionan mediante frases clave. En las batallas intervienen varios tipos de criaturas, de las que puede haber diversas variaciones.

Cada uno de ellos debe recibir un objeto relevante antes de que se te permita sellar los portales. Para ello, tienes que formular un hechizo a partir de las runas que te dan los espíritus.
Empiezas buscando un arma y balas, moviéndote por una red de niveles y escaleras, esquivando o disparando a los numerosos enemigos que encuentras. Si pulsas simultáneamente las teclas de abajo y fuego, accederás a un menú que te permite recoger objetos, intercambiarlos con los guardianes y lanzar hechizos.

TimeZone: The Challenge Remains puts you in command of a ship in a fast-paced horizontal shooter where the Terrilon aliens are threatening Earth. The screen scrolls constantly, and one hit from an alien costs a life – you get five in total. Survive the level, and the next begins immediately. Two players can alternate turns, switching whenever a life is lost. Before starting, you can choose between fixed or randomized enemy patterns – either way, the challenge remains.

“Timezone” is an action-packed shoot-'em-up with adventure elements. As a brilliant inventor, you have developed a revolutionary machine called the TIMEBLASTER, which allows interplanetary travel in seconds. Before announcing this groundbreaking discovery, you travel to the planet Zynox for a final test. However, upon arrival, the TIMEBLASTER mysteriously disappears. Now, you have only a limited time to find the eight scattered parts of your machine before your oxygen supply runs out. The planet's inhabitants are far from friendly and will do everything to hinder your progress.

Tink! Tonk! Castle Clobber is a charming adventure game in which players help Tonk to recover a stolen toy chest from Gork's castle. Originally developed as a fun educational game, Castle Clobber takes players through a spooky garden and into the dark halls of the castle. Along the way, Tonk must collect keys to open doors and advance further into the castle. The tension is heightened by the threat of Gork, who attacks with his "evil eye" when he spots Tonk. So players must be careful and strategic to escape the castle dweller's gaze and reclaim the toy chest. The game combines adventure elements with simple puzzle mechanics that make exploring and collecting a fun challenge.

In Tink! Tonk! - Tink's Subtraction Fair, children strengthen their math skills by solving basic subtraction problems within the framework of five engaging educational activities. The program promotes mathematical skills, understanding of concepts like earning and spending, critical thinking, as well as memory and concentration. It features colorful, high-resolution graphics, clear on-screen instructions, lively animations, and original music.

The game promotes arithmetic skills and numerical understanding through playful learning.

The goal is for the ball to pass through every pipe segment exactly once and reach a defined endpoint without hitting a dead end. Clicking on a tile shifts the pieces toward the hole, changing the board dynamically. With 60 tricky levels, it's a true test of logic and spatial reasoning.

En Tir Na Nog encarnas a Cúchulainn, encargado de restaurar al pueblo Sidhe recomponiendo el Selló de Calum, fragmentado. El juego emplea una original vista lateral con navegación rotacional. Los puzles aparecen como mensajes crípticos en una tipografía celta estilizada, exigiendo pensamiento lateral para resolverlos. El combate es difícil al principio sin un arma adecuada, y aunque al morir vuelves al inicio, el mundo permanece persistente: planificar con cuidado y guardar con frecuencia son clave para triunfar.

A ball moves through the maze at a constant speed, bouncing automatically off walls while you can only influence its direction indirectly. You control a small unit that the ball can bounce off, or you can briefly catch the sphere and release it in a chosen direction. The goal is to destroy all breakable blocks or guide the ball to the exit of the labyrinth. As the levels progress, new hazards appear, including teleporters, movable walls and deadly symbols that cost you a life. The goal is to establish mines on Uranus, extract ore, and operate your ships wisely. Every decision affects your population, supplies, and the future of your base. Whether you expand, trade, or develop technology – your skill determines the fate of your space colony.

AND THEN: you need to buy supplies and expert help: a shopping list is provided. Some tings are essential and others may not be so spend wisely. In Titans you battle your way through the ruins of ancient Greece while facing wave after wave of dangerous monsters. As you move through the environment, different creatures attack and must be avoided or defeated. Each new wave increases the challenge, demanding quick reactions and precise control. Unusual enemies, including a winged horse, add even more danger to the fight. Only by surviving the attacks and defeating the monsters can you progress further.

meta.name: Titlebout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Titlebout puts you in the ring for competitive bouts where tactics matter as much as power. You select fighters with distinct strengths, adapt your approach, and use timing, defense, and targeted attacks to gain the advantage. Attributes such as endurance, accuracy, and strength shape each round, making strategy and adjustment essential. The head-to-head format turns every match into a battle of decisions – a boxing experience that rewards technique, planning, and reflexes.

meta.name: TKO
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In TKO you can play the career of a boxer. Create your boxer by trading off a mixture of attributes, for example a boxer who cuts easily will not tire as easily, and a boxer whose best punch is to the head will not punch to the body as efficiently
The main 1st-person perspective view shows the faces of both you and your opponent, including progressively injured faces as you land punches. A small overhead view helps you see when you or your opponent are close to the ropes.

meta.name: TKO Professional Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

TKO Professional Boxing is a detailed boxing management simulation in which the player takes on the role of a manager to bring his boxers to the top. Instead of fighting himself, the focus is on career planning and organization, where strategic decisions have to be made that influence the performance and success of the boxers.

meta.desc:

TLL te pone en la piel de un piloto experimentado que tiene una difícil misión que cumplir: derribar seis discos que representan fortalezas enemigas en zonas en construcción. Para ello, tienes que reducir tu altitud a medida que te acercas a cada disco, lo que te obliga a evitar los árboles y edificios que están más cerca del suelo.
La acción se ve desde arriba mediante una pantalla pseudo-3D, y se desplaza verticalmente. En el lateral de la pantalla se muestran tu altitud y nivel de combustible, junto con un minimapa muy importante. Tendrás que repostar con frecuencia, poniéndote en contacto con el portaaviones.

meta.name: To be on Top
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“To be on Top” is a music action game in which the player's goal is to create a song that will make it into the top ten of the charts.
If the song reaches a top 3 position in the charts, the player receives an invitation to the TV studio. There the player will perform the song on stage and must reach as many spectators as possible.

meta.name: To Hell and Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres el Arcángel Bertram, enviado desde el cielo a las profundidades del infierno para recuperar los Diez Mandamientos, robados por Mefisto. Para avivar tu furia y determinación, este también te ha arrebatado tu cuerno. Comienzas frente a las puertas del Infierno y debes adentrarte progresivamente en sus abismos, enfrentarte a Mefisto y destruirlo.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Toadforce
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Toadforce casts you as a bio-mechanical battle toad sent on a perilous mission: a distant planet holds the central computer of an advanced defense system, and you must destroy it. Armed with a jetpack and laser, you battle through five levels, descending deeper beneath the surface while facing hostile aliens and deadly obstacles. All the while, you must monitor your H2, PU, and O2 levels, drained by the hostile atmosphere but replenished by scattered bottles. Jetpack power and a temperature gauge also demand attention, since if any of them drop to zero, it's game over.

meta.name: Tobruk : The Clash of Armour
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.01 KB

“Tobruk: The Clash of Armour” puts you in the heart of the decisive battle for Tobruk, where you command Axis forces with strategic planning – smart movements, targeted attacks, and the use of mobile supply units along with air and engineer support are crucial to capturing Allied supply points and securing victory in this turn-based tactics game, with the option to directly control individual vehicles from a first-person view.

meta.name: Toby's Rescue
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Toby's Rescue is the first entry in the unfinished Arlia Trilogy. You play as an adventurer emerging from a ruined smithy – your tools destroyed, your doors ripped away, and dangers lurking everywhere. Through classic text commands you direct your actions, picking up items like a hammer, solving puzzles, and exploring the game world for the right path forward. Your mission is to rescue Toby and uncover the secrets of Arlia, all while contending with thirst, hunger, and deadly encounters that threaten your survival.

meta.name: Toddler Tutor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Toddler Tutor is an educational game collection for children that helps them learn the basics of letters and numbers. In addition to alphabet and number exercises, it offers colorful games like Rainbow Run and Match 'em to train memory and matching skills. By combining learning and play, it teaches kids recognition, counting, and association in a fun way.

meta.name: The Token of Ghall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Token of Ghall begins like a classic fireside tale and grows into a dark fantasy adventure filled with lost hope and final sacrifice. The story of King Ghall, the summoned warrior Ghunlh, and the secretly hidden token gives the world an immediate sense of mystery and tragedy. When the traveler accepts the challenge and sets out alone into the wilderness, the old legend becomes a personal quest of his own. That shift from a told legend to a lived journey is what gives the game its fairy-tale atmosphere and its underlying sense of danger.

meta.name: Toki
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Las manos de Bashtar han arrancado a Moho de su amado Toki. Toki no está mejor: ha sido convertido en mono por el hechicero Vookimedlo. Ahora Toki debe salvar a su amor y encontrar la forma de volver a convertirse en un hombre.
Toki tiene varios niveles: el laberinto de cuevas, el lago Neptuno, las cuevas de fuego, el palacio de hielo, la selva oscura, el palacio de oro... El principal ataque de Toki contra sus enemigos es escupirles, pero también puede saltar sobre ellos para derrotarlos. El escupitajo normal de Toki puede transformarse en una ráfaga de fuego si encuentras el objeto adecuado. Otros objetos son un casco de fútbol que protege temporalmente a Toki, zapatillas de salto de altura, relojes que añaden tiempo, monedas que aumentan el número de vidas ...

meta.name: Tolteka
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Tolteka, stupid and rolling oval rugby balls collide with spaceships trying to stop them in an attempt to reach the nearest exit.

meta.name: Tom & Jerry : Hunting High and Low
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tom & Jerry es un juego de plataformas basado en los icónicos personajes. Encarnas a Jerry, que debe atravesar cinco niveles recogiendo todo el queso. Además de obstáculos típicos, hay un límite de tiempo y Tom, que intenta atraparle. Puedes esquivarlo o usar el entorno para neutralizarlo temporalmente: una bola de bolos le noquea o un suelo preparado le hace resbalar. Los niveles principales son de scroll lateral, pero entre ellos cambia a perspectiva en tercera persona: Jerry corre por un túnel recogiendo queso y evitando dinamita o bombas.

meta.name: Tom & Jerry : Hunting High and Low

meta.name: Tom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.98 KB

Tom sends you exploring a sprawling tomb in search of treasure, moving across platforms, chambers, and hidden paths. You climb ladders, jump over hazards, and hunt for keys to unlock blocked areas and progress deeper inside. Creatures, spikes, and collapsing floors create constant danger, making careful exploration and precise timing essential. The experience blends movement, discovery, and risk – a classic platform adventure where awareness, speed, and smart route choices determine your success.

meta.name: Tom Throop's Bridge Baron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

In Tom Throop's Bridge Baron you can play over a million random bridge deals or input your own. The game won the 1986 CES Award and was the winner of the first Computer Bridge Tournament. It offers many realistic features – including a weak two-bid option, rubber bridge scoring, a hint system, two-player mode, the ability to save deals to disk, and automatic play. Bridge Baron stands as one of the most advanced and versatile bridge simulations of its time.

meta.name: Tomahawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Flight simulation specialists Digital Integration turned their attention to helicopter flight in this recreation of the AH-64 Apache. All the controls are realistically simulated, so the airspeed is dependent on the height of the vehicle, and you can move horizontally using the rudder option as well as rolling left and right. If using a Sinclair joystick interface you can use both ports to have all these controls accessible on dual joysticks, just like the real thing. Either way, a full instrument panel allows monitoring of these.
You are armed with cannons, rockets and anti-tank missiles, each of which has its target set up independently, but only one can be loaded at once. Flight options include day/night, clear/cloudy and air turbulence on/off, allowing beginners and experts to find a suitable setting. Scenery includes trees, mountains and pylons, while enemy targets include helicopters, turrets and tanks.

meta.name: TOMARC the Barbarian
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.73 KB

In Tomarc the Barbarian Senta is being held captive in a magical cage, and Tomarc needs to rescue her! In this action game you will control both Tomarc and Senta simultaneously. Tomarc is lost in a series of caves somewhere searching for his magic sword, and then must locate Senta to set her free. Deadly rats and other dangers must be avoided as you run and jump around the caves. Meanwhile, Senta must defend herself from giant bats and other creatures while trapped in the cage; although she can't move, she is capable of firing magic at enemies to destroy them. You are able to switch screens between the two characters to select which character to control. Listening to the sound effects can help you determine when the other character is in trouble and you should switch screens.

meta.name: The Tomb of Dracula
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.65 KB

Night falls... the vampires are hungry... you can't go back... your only chance of survival lies before you. The door closes behind you and you enter the world of Dracula's burial chamber. You know you are at the south door of the first level. The walls are cold and slimy. At every step you could come across horror figures: ghouls, zombies and blotters full of slime. At the start you have seven silver stakes in your hand for defense. At the start of the adventure you will be briefly shown a map of the first level of Dracula's Tomb. Your goal is to find a way through the chamber to the stairs to the next level in order to steal Dracula's treasure in the final level and find the exit to freedom. Along the way you can collect more silver stones for your defense. But be careful... you only have 30 minutes until Dracula awakens and appears.
