meta.name: The Tomb of Drewan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.70 KB

The Tomb of Drewan drops you into a vast 400-room maze where you gather artifacts, runestones, and spells while each room holds a guardian and several treasures. Your available actions depend on the items or magic you carry, opening new paths as you advance. Warriors strike only up close, while mages attack from afar, and their colors show how dangerous they are. Gold slows you down but can save you when the tomb lord appears. Only by fighting smart, using the right spells, and reaching the exit with all runestones can you escape alive.

meta.name: Tombola
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.59 KB

Tombola is a lottery-style board game similar to bingo that originated in Southern Italy. Numbers on your board are gradually called out, and the goal is to complete rows or specific patterns to score points or prizes. Mixing luck and suspense, the game provides entertaining rounds much like classic bingo, but with a regional twist.

meta.name: Tombs of Xeiops
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.49 KB

Tombs of Xeiops puts you in the desert as an adventurer searching for the lost city of Xeiops, eventually leading you into a sprawling tomb. You explore room after room, uncover treasures, and carry them back outside as you push deeper into the maze. The controls rely on simple two-word commands, so you must be precise with every action. Each treasure boosts your score, and only careful reading, smart decisions, and patient exploration will earn you the maximum points and let you escape with everything Xeiops has hidden.

meta.name: Tomcat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.24 KB

In the first half of 21st century technological advances allowed for construction of artificial islands. One of such military installations, ARTROCK 6, had turned rogue after being hit by a violent storm, its computer-controlled defensive systems firing upon anything that comes close. The player, being a top pilot, has been chosen to fly an upgraded F-14+2d Tomcat jet to destroy this electronic madness. F-14 Tomcat is a Flight Simulation game, published by Activision, which was released in 1988.

meta.name: Tone-loco
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.27 KB

Tone-Loco is a Simon-like game for the Commodore 64. You must replicate the sequence of patterns provided by the computer using the directional controls of the joystick. The length and complexity of the patterns increase as the game progresses.

meta.name: Tony La Russa's Ultimate Baseball
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tony La Russa's Ultimate Baseball (named after the manager of the Oakland Athletics at the time) was Strategic Simulations' short-lived foray into sports games. The simulation here is of a full season of major league baseball. You can view statistics for every team, and play with one or two players, or manage teams while the computer plays through the season for you. Players have injury records and performance streaks. The game could be enhanced with several add-on disks, sold separately: Great Teams 1901-1968, A.L. Stadiums, N.L. Stadiums, Classic Stadiums, and Fantasy Manager, which let you draft players into new teams and leagues.

meta.name: Toobin'
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.19 KB

Toobin' involves Biff and Jet racing their way down the rapids of a river, riding on tires. You rotate your tyre left or right, and drift as the current sends you, making sure to avoid the banks of the river, and the dividing lines in the middle. Hazards include crocodiles, stray logs and branches, and fishermen - you are armed with a limited supply of tin cans to take care of these. There are gates to slide through on the way down - these give you a points bonus. Each level has a strict time limit to adhere to, although there's a kickin' party at the end if you succeed.

meta.name: Tooth Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.39 KB

Tooth Invaders puts you in control of Plaqueman, who fights the plaque germ D.K. using a toothbrush and dental floss. You must clean every tooth, energize your brush with toothpaste, and use floss between teeth. Contact with D.K. results in elimination. If decay begins, warning sounds alert you – be fast and thorough.

meta.name: Top Cat : Beverly Hills Cats
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.46 KB

Top Cat is in Beverly Hills to track down Benny the Ball, prevent him gaining the contents of a will that is not rightly his, and find the rightful heiress. The game is a top-down puzzler of sorts. An object manipulation mode is used to pick up and use objects when necessary. Extra milk (for energy) and fruit (for points) can be collected. Skateboarders must be avoided as they can take objects and randomly move them. The members of your gang must all be gathered up on the first level and must be kept on your side by ensuring that your energy doesn't drop too low.

meta.name: Top Duck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Top Duck, you control a brave little duck who must navigate through a series of platforms and ladders. Your goal is to avoid the numerous enemies that are after your feathered friend – each contact costs a life. To defeat the enemies, you must lure them under a platform and then knock a block above them, which will fall and crush the foes. But be careful: the blocks you've dropped will later become new hazards. The objective is to reach the massive dome (Mega Dome) and collect a high score to celebrate your achievements. The game combines platform-puzzle elements with a touch of strategy, as you must carefully eliminate enemies while keeping track of the falling blocks.

meta.name: Top Fuel Eliminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Top Fuel Eliminator is a drag racing game. Select your tires, engine, and other stats before the race and try not to crash in the final race. It has both a first person view (at the bottom) and a third person side view (at the top) during the actual race. You are entered into a 16 race bracket, win four races to take the title.nn

meta.name: Top Gun
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Tom Cruise film featured an F-14 Tomcat plane, and this licensed game recreates this. Viewed from the cockpit in full 3D, the game is a straight head-to-head duel, against another player or the computer. You are armed with missiles (while put you in control of a small target zone, which must reman over your opponent for 3 seconds), flares and cannons (which overheat when overused)- use these more wisely than your opponent. Pay attention to speed and altitude too. The computer has 3 planes to throw at you, of which the last is the toughest, while each player in a 2-player game also has 3 'lives'.

meta.name: Top of the Pops
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Top of the Pops puts you in the role of a music producer trying to turn a profit from self-released records. You decide on song titles, artist names, and how much money to invest, with higher budgets increasing the chances of success while also raising the risk. Week by week, you watch how your songs perform in release lists and charts, adjusting your strategy to outperform the competition by the end – a tactical contest of trends, timing, and hit-making instincts.

meta.name: Topcross
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Topcross puts you into fast-paced motorcycle races where you speed along winding tracks and must avoid obstacles at high velocity. Precise steering and sharp timing are essential to prevent crashes and stay in the race as long as possible. As the speed increases, the challenge rises steadily, making focus and quick reflexes the key to success.

meta.name: Topper the Copper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.89 KB

Topper the Copper casts you as an unusual law enforcer shaped like a top hat on the trail of a criminal. Inside a multi-level building connected by corridors and a lift, you search numerous rooms for vital clues. Safes may contain the evidence you need – eight clues are required to identify the culprit among seven suspects. One safe also hides the key to the jail. Meanwhile, enemies and obstacles stand in your way – every hit drains part of your energy, which can only be restored at the police station. If time runs out or your energy is completely depleted, the mission fails – only persistence and awareness will see justice served.

meta.name: Topsy-Turvy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Topsy-Turvy challenges you with a risky task where you must first reach a bomb and then make it back to the exit once it appears. Activating the bomb turns all enemies into collectible points, but danger remains ever-present. Moving and stationary obstacles along with deadly lasers demand precise control and constant awareness, while relentless time pressure intensifies every decision. Success depends on balancing speed, caution, and perfect timing.

meta.name: Torchbearer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Torchbearer draws you into the island realm of Pastoria, which has fallen under the control of a dark wizard since the Torch of Truth was stolen. You begin your journey as an ordinary citizen, yet a rare artifact grants you uncommon potential. In your quest, you explore many islands, dungeons and sanctuaries, speak with townsfolk, study magic and improve your combat skills. Gradually you grow with each challenge, as the fate of the land is shaped by your choices and discoveries.

meta.desc:

Tornado es un clásico juego de disparos de desplazamiento lateral en el que pilotas un avión de combate por terreno hostil. Sobrevolando ríos estrechos y zonas desérticas, debes eliminar posiciones enemigas mientras te concentras en tu objetivo final: salvar a la población civil. Cada disparo cuenta, y cada error cuesta una vida. A medida que avanzas de nivel, la presión aumenta, los enemigos se multiplican y el terreno se vuelve más peligroso. Un juego de disparos sencillo pero apasionante donde la precisión y la sincronización marcan la diferencia.

meta.name: Torpedo (Susie Software)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.84 KB

Torpedo es un simulador de batalla submarina donde navegas en aguas hostiles desde una perspectiva en primera persona. Con sonar, brújula, profundímetro y combustible limitado, diriges tu embarcación, localizas objetivos y disparas torpedos precisos. Debes gestionar el rumbo, la profundidad y la velocidad, mientras vigilas la escasez de aire y energía. Cada disparo cuenta, y la navegación táctica es clave para la supervivencia.

meta.name: Torquest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.53 KB

Torquest places you in the role of Maithros, who awakens without memories and faces a defining choice. Saved by a mystic elder, you are asked to join an order and find your place in an unfamiliar world. The story unfolds through your commands as you explore locations, interpret clues, and make decisions that shape your journey. Atmosphere and narrative take center stage, creating a sense of uncertainty, curiosity, and gradual self-discovery.

meta.name: Total Eclipse
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.34 KB

Total Eclipse tells your story as an archaeologist who, in 1930, learns that a curse from the Sun God Ra will destroy the Earth if an eclipse blocks the shrine. To prevent the catastrophe, you travel to a massive pyramid near Cairo, where you must destroy the shrine. Your adventure begins two hours before the eclipse – time you must use to explore the pyramid, solve puzzles, and survive deadly traps. Hazards such as poison darts, falling stones, fatal drops, as well as exhaustion and dehydration, can strike you at any moment. Along the way, you can discover treasures to increase your score, while ankhs serve as keys to locked doors.

p: Total Eclipse II - The Sphinx Jinx (Europe).T64
n: Total Eclipse II - The Sphinx Jinx (Europe)

meta.name: Total Eclipse II : The Sphinx Jinx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.98 KB

Total Eclipse II: The Sphinx Jinx continues your adventure within the mysterious pyramids. This time, you must find twelve pieces of a sphinx hidden in the underground passages within two hours to lift an ancient curse. Along the way, you'll face not only challenging puzzles but also dangers such as mummies, poison darts, and heat exhaustion from limited access to water. While no items can be collected, gold bars you encounter will at least increase your wealth.

meta.name: Total Recall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en la película homónima, Total Recall te pone al mando de Douglas Quaid, quien debe llegar a Marte para encontrar las respuestas a sus dos preguntas: por qué lo persiguen y quién lo persigue. Para ello, Quaid debe superar nivel tras nivel derrotando a los enemigos que se interponen en su camino. Algunos niveles tienen diferentes mecánicas de juego y varían entre escenas de acción y de conducción. Las escenas de acción requieren principalmente la recolección de objetos antes de abandonar el nivel. Solo tienes una oportunidad para completar el nivel actual, lo que significa que si pierdes energía, el juego termina. La energía se pierde si te ataca un obstáculo o si un enemigo te dispara. Puedes obtener más energía recolectando píldoras o un corazón, según la plataforma.

meta.name: Tottem
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.75 KB

Tottem is a straightforward yet gripping shooter where you must take down incoming enemies with precise shots. Success relies not only on accurate aiming but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy fire and position yourself strategically. Only those who combine skill, timing, and smart movement will be able to overcome the escalating challenges and emerge victorious.

meta.name: Touchdown Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.45 KB

Call the plays, then run them using the keyboard or joystick. Digitized voices enhance the game, including the crowd, calling the numbers, and referee's calls.

meta.name: Tough Guys
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tough Guys puts you in the role of a karate fighter traveling the world to face the toughest opponents. In head-to-head battles, you compete against the computer or a second player, using punches, kicks and precise timing to gain the upper hand. One mistake can quickly lead to defeat, making focus and sharp reflexes essential. As the challenge increases, so does the pressure – only those who master technique and strategy will prevail against the strongest rivals.

meta.name: Tour de France
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.35 KB

Tour de France puts you in the saddle for the world's toughest cycling event, battling through 16 demanding stages across France. You'll pedal through richly detailed 3D landscapes, cheered on by crowds of enthusiastic spectators – but only those with stamina, strategy, and perfect timing will earn the yellow jersey in the end.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tournament Golf immerses you in the world of golf, from beginners to professionals. It features two complete 18-hole courses with fairways, greens, bunkers, and even moles. There is also a driving range and a putting green for practice, as well as a secret room in the bunker where you can let loose. All the challenges and frustrations of golf can now be experienced comfortably from your computer chair.

meta.name: Tournament Snooker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.15 KB

Classic Snooker also called Tournament Snooker allows one or two players to play a game of snooker from a top-down view. The player first selects the ball to be hit, then adjust the spin on the cue ball and the power of the shot, finally nominates a color after a legal pot. There are three levels of difficulty.

meta.name: Tower Commando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.43 KB

"Tower Commando" is a shoot'em-up game for the Commodore 64. The game was created using the Shoot'Em-Up Construction Kit (SEUCK). The aim of the game is to reach the top of a tower by fighting your way through enemy opponents. The gameplay is characterized by action-packed sequences and increasing challenge.

meta.name: Tower of Despair
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tower of Despair takes you to the land of Aelandor, once again threatened by the returned demon lord Malmor. After being banished to a limbo realm, he has escaped using a powerful artifact and reclaimed his tower, gathering strength with a dark servant at his side. Sent by a council of wizards, you embark on a perilous quest to find allies, recover a crucial relic and ultimately storm the tower itself. Along the way you face sinister locations, enemies and trials that demand courage and perseverance. The adventure delivers a classic fantasy tale centered on one clear goal: defeat Malmor and end the looming darkness for good.
meta.developer: Russell Clarke, Jamie Thomson, Steve Williams & Mike McKeown

meta.name: The Tower of Terror
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Tower of Terror sends you into a dark fortress packed with knights, monsters and deadly hazards across multiple levels. You leap over gaps, dodge attacks and confront enemies that punish every mistake. Each stage increases the challenge with new threats and traps that test your timing and reflexes. The experience is driven by precise jumping, quick decisions and steady progress through a hostile environment designed to make even fearless players uneasy.

meta.name: Nebulus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Nebulus (también conocido como Tower Toppler) parece un simple juego de plataformas, pero es todo un logro para la época de su primer lanzamiento (1987). La técnica de representación del juego es relativamente revolucionaria, ya que utiliza gráficos de "desplazamiento giratorio". Esto significa que la cámara permanece en el personaje mientras se mueve por la columna. 
El objetivo del juego es escalar torres en el tiempo dado para destruirlas. Por supuesto, una serie de enemigos y trampas bloquearán el camino del personaje. Prepárate para encontrar una dificultad bastante alta en el primer nivel. Cuando el personaje es golpeado, no muere pero baja un piso. Sólo muere si cae al agua.

meta.name: Towering Inferno - Fire
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.61 KB

In Towering Inferno, you control firefighters who are standing with a net at the bottom of a burning building. Your task is to catch falling residents, who often bounce and require multiple attempts to be safely caught. Overweight residents must not be caught and must be left to their certain death. You earn bonus points for catching furniture. Some residents burn in the air. If you miss too many residents or accidentally catch an overweight one, you lose a life. There are two difficulty levels and five stages.

meta.name: Toxic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.62 KB

Toxic is a side scrolling platform game, in the style of Bobix. The aim of the player is to get all the sacks scattered around the level and get to the final exit chamber. Then escape is possible only after gathering all 180 sacks. The action takes place in a city and it's sewers, inhabited by alien creatures. The only way to avoid them is proper use of jumping skills and selecting safe paths. Access to closed areas requires finding the right lever.

meta.name: Toy Bizarre
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.98 KB

Toy Bizarre pits you against a runaway horde of toy robots inside a department store. You shut off valves to influence where new toys appear and must also watch out for sudden safety checks before Hilda catches you. The attacking figures can be jumped over or briefly stunned, but after every survived hour the chaos starts all over again. This creates a wonderfully frantic game that charmingly combines timing, awareness, and a delightfully odd premise.

meta.name: The Toy Shop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Here's an unusual one: The Toy Shop is a set of computerized patterns for building your own mechanical models. You use the software to print out the pieces, then assemble them according to a set of instructions that come with the software. There are 20 different models, including trucks and cars with wheels that turn, a crane, an oil pump, a balloon-powered locomotive, a penny-powered clockwork bank, a helicopter powered by a rubber band, a sundial, a carousel, and the Spirit of St. Louis airplane with a working propeller. Designs can be printed on regular computer paper, then glued to card stock, cut out, and assembled.

meta.name: Toyballs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Toyballs you try to recreate the pattern shown on the right side by placing balls on the playfield. When a ball is placed next to or near other balls, they grow to the next stage, and there are four possible growth levels in total. Because of this interaction you must carefully plan where to place each ball so that the final arrangement matches the required pattern. As the levels progress the patterns become more complex, demanding better planning and spatial thinking.

meta.name: Toyz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.09 KB

In Toyz you move stones around the playfield to place matching pieces next to each other. The goal is to bring identical stones together so they disappear from the board. There is a twist, however – the stones only vanish after they have been moved at least once or when they collide with one another. This means you must plan your moves carefully and think about which stones to shift first. With a smart strategy you can gradually clear the entire field.

meta.name: The Tracer Sanction
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

As an interplanetary secret agent, you must roam the galaxy in your extremely fuel-conscious space ship (only 500 gallons to the nearest planet). Heaven knows what sort of engine your ship possesses, but as stars scroll past your cockpit you can hear what sounds like a very unhealthy motor-scooter in the background. 
There are some touches of dry humour, including an interminable queue of people that you can stand in for ever, never quite reaching the end. You'll also have some trouble with a certain crazed dwarf and some unstable stalactites -- at least if you go the way I did. A 'living tutorial' helps new adventurers get into the swing of things.

meta.name: Track & Field
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.35 KB

Track & Field is a sports game that allows the player to have an experience based around the Summer Olympic Games. Events include the 100 meter dash, the hammer throw, the javelin throw, the long jump, the high jump and the 110 meter hurdles.
The MSX version replaces the hurdles with a 400 meter dash.
The Famicom version loses the hammer throw and the high jump, but the NES version restores the high jump while adding skeet shooting, the triple jump and archery as events. The NES version also keeps the 110 meter hurdles and forgoes the 400 meter dash.
If the player wants to go to the next event or round then they will have to qualify, by beating increasingly difficult maximum times or minimum distances. This game contains a two player option, in which the players take it in turns.

meta.name: Tracker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.00 KB

Tracker is a mouse-controlled vector-graphics 3D strategy game depicting an ultra-violent TV show of the future. As a contestant, the player's mission is to be the first to ever complete it successfully. The task involves commanding a fleet of Skimmers charged with destroying various groups of combat vehicles, including Cycloids, Scouts and Defenders. Short and long-range scanners are available to aid in this.
The game takes place in a maze world containing a number of distinct sectors, each of which has its own type of enemy present. The Communication Centre powers the Cycloids, and are protected by the Defenders. Once these are taken out, the Centerpoint Sector must be destroyed to complete the level.

meta.name: Tracksuit Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.38 KB

Tracksuit Manager modificó el estilo de juego convencional de Football Manager de varias formas. Te haces cargo de una selección internacional que aspira a clasificarse y luego jugar la Eurocopa y el Mundial. Esto significa que no hay mercado de fichajes, solo un grupo de 100 jugadores elegibles del que se selecciona una plantilla de 22. Puedes ver informes sobre la habilidad y el estado de forma de cada jugador en cualquier etapa del proceso de selección de la plantilla y del equipo. Puedes organizar partidos amistosos para probar jugadores y asegurarte de que la plantilla juegue junta el máximo tiempo posible. Los partidos se presentan como comentarios en directo, con un pequeño gráfico que indica en qué zona del campo se encuentra el balón. Hay una amplia gama de opciones tácticas disponibles para dictar el estilo de pase del equipo, el enfoque defensivo, etc., y, como novedad, puedes dar instrucciones específicas a jugadores individuales (quizás decirle a un defensa particularmente rápido que marque individualmente a un extremo rival peligroso en lugar de quedarse en una posición fija).

meta.name: The Trading Game
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.16 KB

meta.name: Traffic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.58 KB

Traffic is a simple game where the player has to guide cars, motorbikes and buses through busy London streets by changing the traffic lights from red to green. The objective in order to advance to the next level is to get a preset number of vehicles through the screen, although it does not matter which exit you direct them through. Cars continue to queue off the edges of the screen (with numbers next to them if there are queued cars beyond your vision) and if the queue reach more than five cars, it's game over. A warning sound is given when five cars are queued; you must hope there are not also queues on surrounding roads. Cars always stay on their side of the road, and collisions are not possible.

meta.name: Traffic Jam
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.01 KB

meta.name: Verkeersrally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.49 KB

Traffix (also known as Verkeersrally) sends you into a hectic metropolis where map reading and traffic knowledge are your only tools. Your mission: locate six transmitters within one hour. Each transmitter works for only ten minutes, starting at 9:50, and if you miss its window, it's gone for good as the clock keeps ticking. As you navigate the maze of streets, you rely on signs, rules and your own sense of direction, always racing to reach the next active transmitter in time.

meta.name: Trail West
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.21 KB

meta.name: Trailblazer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tienes que guiar una nave con forma de globo a través de una sucesión de niveles. Los niveles presentan una pantalla de retazos, con agujeros que hay que evitar y cuadrados de distintos colores que afectan a la velocidad de la nave, así como un inversor de control. Hay un límite de tiempo para cada nivel.

meta.name: Cosmic Causeway : Trailblazer II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.29 KB

“Cosmic Causeway: Trailblazer II” challenges the player to roll through 24 levels within a time limit. Each level features unique tiles with specific effects: red slows down, green speeds up, black holes must be avoided, cyan reverses controls, and blue allows jumping. While aliens can be shot, all other obstacles must be dodged, as collisions or falls cost valuable time. Any remaining time at the end of a level is added as a bonus to the score. White blobs on the track grant credits, which can be spent on power-ups or tricks – but only for the next level. Available options include slowing down time, closing black holes, deactivating purple tiles, or activating a shield.

meta.name: Train Dispatcher
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Train Dispatcher you take charge of managing a busy rail network, ensuring multiple trains move safely and on schedule. You control switches, signals, and train movements in both directions as traffic becomes increasingly complex. Every decision affects the overall flow, requiring you to think ahead and prevent bottlenecks. Only careful planning and strong awareness will keep everything running smoothly.

meta.name: Train Dodgers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.20 KB

"Train Dodgers" is a game for the Commodore 64 in which you control trains through a complex rail network and have to be careful to avoid collisions. By setting switches in good time and adjusting the speed of the trains, you try to get all the trains to their destination safely. As the number of trains and the routes become more complex, the challenge increases and requires quick decisions and precise planning.

meta.name: Train Robbers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.36 KB

Después de ser un exitoso ladrón de trenes, Cactus Pete tiene ahora una recompensa de 4000 dólares por su cabeza. Juegas como Pete mientras intentas robar más locomotoras montando tu caballo al lado e intentando agarrarte a una escalera. El juego se ve desde el lado en un ángulo elevado mientras montas tu caballo al lado del tren, y puedes acelerar o reducir la velocidad, pero ten cuidado con cualquier cactus al lado de la vía que te hará caer del caballo. Si empujas a tu caballo durante demasiado tiempo, aparecerá un temporizador, ya que la energía de tu caballo disminuirá lentamente hasta que se vacíe y tu caballo se desplome.
Una vez que hayas subido a la escalera podrás subir al techo de los coches. A medida que te muevas de derecha a izquierda tendrás que sortear los huecos entre los coches, así como agacharte si se acerca un túnel. Una vez que llegues al último vagón, puedes meterte en él e intentar encontrar dos llaves para la caja fuerte mientras evitas a los perros guardianes. Si tocas una pierdes una de las tres vidas. Cuando tengas tu botín debes volver a subir al techo para llegar a la parte delantera del tren y volver a subir a tu caballo de espera. El siguiente tren te espera. Otro jugador puede jugar y ambos se turnan cuando el otro jugador pierde una vida.

meta.name: The Train : Escape to Normandy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Train: Escape to Normandy puts you in the role of a train hijacker escaping through hostile territory aboard a steam locomotive. While in motion, you must manage speed, steam pressure, and other systems, all while shooting down attacking fighter planes with mounted guns. During brief station stops, the focus shifts to providing cover fire against attackers to protect resupplying comrades. Constantly changing demands keep the tension high – success depends on balancing technical control, awareness, and quick reactions.

meta.name: Trains
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Trains takes you back to the age of steam locomotives, where building and managing your railway empire is the key to success. You drive your trains along the tracks, picking up raw materials from the right stations and delivering them to industries in need. Whether it's lumber for the sawmill, ore for the factory, or fruit and vegetables for the market – timely deliveries earn you profit and keep your business alive. With the money you earn, you pay your workers, fuel your locomotive with coal, and expand your rail network into more challenging regions. Success depends on planning, timing, and resource management – or else bankruptcy awaits.

meta.name: Tran
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Trance Sector
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Trance Sector is a fast-paced arcade game where the player must infiltrate a secret factory complex to prevent an impending intergalactic catastrophe. The alien race known as the Cygma Elite is producing deadly nuclear pods within a 32-story facility, intending to build the devastating Cygma Armageddon Bomb. The mission is to navigate through all floors of the Trance Sector, collect the pods, and trigger a chain reaction to destroy the facility before it annihilates the entire solar system.

meta.name: Trance Sector : Competition Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Trance Sector: Competition Edition is a challenging variation of the original game, featuring 32 new levels, tougher gameplay, and fewer lives. Set on an unknown planet inside a deadly nuclear reactor built by the hostile Cygma Elite, the player must navigate a spacecraft through hazardous areas, collect radioactive nuclear pods, and evade deadly enemies. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to conquer all levels and eliminate the alien threat once and for all.

meta.name: Trans-Atlantic Balloon Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 44.47 KB

In 1987, billionaire entrepreneur Richard Branson attempted to cross the Atlantic in a hot air balloon. In the game, you are challenged to a race across the ocean in a hot air balloon, with the winner being the first to cross the Atlantic. You can play against a friend or the computer, but instead of controlling the balloon, you control an eagle with a laser sight that controls the balloon. It also has to defend itself against the other competitors' eagle or a biplane that drops various objects onto the balloon. Children also float around carried by balloons and you score points if you touch them or lose points if you kill them.

meta.name: Transatlantic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Transatlantic puts you in charge of a shipping company with the goal of making as much money as possible within 100 days. You control up to five ships traveling between eight ports across the Atlantic. Profit is earned by buying and selling goods like gold, beef, or cotton at fluctuating prices. Alternatively, you can take on transport contracts that must be completed within a time limit. Every day counts and every decision matters – from setting courses to loading cargo or reviewing contracts. Strategic planning and economic thinking are key to success.

meta.name: Transformers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 81.62 KB

"Transformers" takes place on an Earth occupied by shape-shifting alien robots, turning the planet into a battlefield. The war between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons revolves around energy – the goal is to collect four pieces of the Energon Cube and return them to the Autobot base. The Decepticons will do everything in their power to stop this and use the cubes for their own purposes. The player controls five Autobots, which can switch between robot and vehicle form. In robot form, they can walk or fly, while in vehicle form, they drive across the platforms. The Defensa Pod allows switching between Autobots. Once all cubes are collected, the game restarts – with an increased level of difficulty.

meta.desc:

Based on the popular 1980s cartoon of the same name, the Decepticons build a giant robot to threaten the Earth. Players must track their actions on a game map and send the appropriate Autobot (Cliffjumper, Bumblebee, Rodimus Prime, Hot Rod, Hound, Pipes, Blurr and Kup are seen) to combat each threat and prevent the Decepticons from stealing energy to build their giant robot. To achieve this, the Decepticons' complicated plan must go through a series of events that take place in locations such as an offshore oil platform, a nuclear power plant, a dinosaur park, a space center, an Andreas Zoo and a pipeline.

meta.name: Translogic
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Translogic is a challenging logic puzzle game that tests your thinking skills and dexterity. The goal is to organize a chaotic ball system into the desired order. The screen is divided into two parts: the target arrangement is displayed on the left, while the current chaos appears on the right. Using the cursor, you move the balls until both sides match, progressing to the next level by pressing the spacebar. The status bar provides essential information, particularly the strict time limit, which must always be carefully monitored.

meta.name: Transporter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.92 KB

Transporter is a skill-based co-op game for two players, where each controls a spaceship. The goal is to transport boxes from a cave to the Earth's surface. First, the boxes must be delivered to a lower platform and then carried to an upper one. Players must monitor fuel and coolant levels – without them, the ship will explode. Each engine is controlled separately via joystick, making precision essential. With air resistance, gravity, and careful landing required, Transporter is a true challenge.

meta.name: Transputer Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.71 KB

In Transputer Man, you assist Matthew Slim, a mutant who has discovered a lost circuit board. Your mission is to find the Transputer of Learning to free him from his fate as Transputer Man. Skill and quick reflexes are essential to successfully complete this mission.

meta.name: Transylvania
meta.desc:

Transilvania comienza con la búsqueda de la princesa Sabrina, desaparecida hace dos semanas. El rey Juan el Bueno pide ayuda, y tú te ofreces como voluntario. meta.name: Trivial Fruit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Trivial Fruit is an arcade quiz game where one or up to four people answer as many questions as possible to win the game. Before you play, you can decide if there is a timer for answering a question and you can set the timer up to 995 seconds. You can also decide how many players you want and whether you want to play the short or long game. There is a 3x5 grid on the screen and when a question is asked about different topics, each answer represents a fruit. If the answer is correct, the fruit appears at a set position in the grid. Then answer the next question. Make a mistake, and if you're playing against another person, it's their turn until they either win or answer a question incorrectly. You can play alone, but there is no score, so try to win in as few questions as possible.

Todos los Sabios se encuentran en diferentes partes de la galaxia y sólo se puede llegar a ellos viajando por la galaxia respondiendo correctamente a las preguntas y respondiendo a una pregunta específica una vez que se ha llegado a ellos.
Las seis categorías de preguntas son las mismas que en el juego original, y hay 50 niveles de preguntas que resolver, pero la gran diferencia es que la categoría de pregunta es aleatoria.

meta.name: Trojahn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.65 KB

Trojahn is a side-scrolling adventure where you embark on a quest to rescue your beloved Elena from the clutches of an evil Minotaur. Along the way you'll face dangers such as spear-wielding Spartans, menacing Cyclops, deadly spikes, and finally the dreaded Minotaur. The game features a unique display: the action unfolds in a vertical playfield on the left, while the right-hand side shows eye-catching interlude screens. A fun romp of an adventure that might have you shouting “THIS … IS … SPARTA!” at your screen.
meta.developer: C. Yates, J. Wells & R. Bayliss

meta.name: Troll
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 66.88 KB

En Troll encarnas a Humgruffin, arrojado al extraño Más Allá de Narc —un mundo de goblins, cristales y techos transitables—. Tu única esperanza: recoger los cristales dispersos en cada cámara e introducirlos en un amuleto para romper el hechizo que te atrapó. Los goblins bloquean pasos con muros; tocarlos te petrifica progresivamente y te teletransporta a otra zona. Puedes crear agujeros, saltar al techo con pirámides, invocar un enano (mediante una seta) para romper suelos, o usar dados para abrir pasos al azar. La vista isométrica 3D muestra suelo y techo como planos navegables, convirtiendo cada movimiento en una decisión táctica. Una aventura excéntrica, estratégica y multidimensional, repleta de magia y peligros.

meta.name: Troll Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.10 KB

"Troll Castle" is a captivating text adventure. The game is part of the article "Teaching your computer English" and offers players the opportunity to expand their English skills in a playful way. In this adventure, the player enters the mysterious halls of a castle inhabited by an evil troll. The goal is to collect powerful magical items in order to defeat the troll and escape from the castle. Players must solve puzzles, make decisions and explore the environment, interacting exclusively with text commands.

meta.name: Troll's Tale
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

An evil troll has hidden all of the treasures of Mark, The Dwarf King. There are 15 treasures hidden throughout the land that you need to help locate. If you locate a treasure, but the troll is on the screen at the time, you will need to come back and find a way to make him leave. Troll's Tale is an adventure game which requires minimal typing, using the spacebar to select from several possible actions which are listed on the screen and pressing enter to perform the selected action.

meta.name: Trollie Wallie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.03 KB

Trollie Wallie sends you on a perilous shopping spree through a supermarket full of danger. Your goal is to collect 40 items from your list, but monsters, traps, and obstacles turn this errand into a real challenge. You can only carry five items at a time, forcing you to return to the start to pay and free up space. Switches remove barriers as you explore scrolling levels packed with surprises. Speed, caution, and a sharp memory determine whether you make it through your shopping trip alive.

meta.name: Trolls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This platform game features the small blue-haired cutesy creatures that were popular around the time (although surely not with most computer game buyers?). You play a Troll roaming the levels in the hope of rescuing as many baby trolls as possible - each level gives you a set minimum to retrieve before you can leave via the Pigstop.

meta.name: Trolls and Tribulations
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Trolls and Tribulations" is a side-scrolling platform game with puzzle-like elements, placing the player as a troll navigating a maze-like sewer system to retrieve valuable relics. Dangerous creatures like cretins, buzzards, skulls, and spiders guard the treasures. Each maze begins with defeating cretins by turning them into eggs and quickly shoving them into sewer water before they hatch again. Once the cretins are cleared, doors to the main maze open, where treasures and keys must be collected to progress. Movement requires precision as actions are step-based, and poorly timed jumps can result in fatal falls or encounters with indestructible monsters. The game features three selectable levels, each with multiple mazes requiring careful navigation and quick reflexes.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Tron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.40 KB

“Tron” lets you dive into a digital world where you engage in nerve-wracking light cycle duels against the computer or another player. Inspired by the famous movie, you guide your hero through perilous arenas full of speed and strategy. Six difficulty levels test your reflexes and fighting spirit – grab your joystick and enter the Motodrome!

meta.name: Tron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.48 KB

“Tron” brings the iconic light cycle duel to the screen: Two players – or one versus the computer – race across a grid, leaving deadly trails behind. The goal is to force your opponent into a wall or line without crashing yourself. With each level, speed increases and space becomes tighter. Reflexes, planning, and steady nerves are the key to victory in this digital arena battle.

meta.name: Tron
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.47 KB

“Tron” offers a thrilling head-to-head duel in split-screen arenas, where two light cycle riders engage in a relentless race. Each leaves behind a colored trail that must be avoided – the first to crash loses a bike. A turbo boost adds a tactical edge, giving players a chance to turn the tide at a critical moment. A nerve-wracking contest where reflexes and strategy determine victory or collision.

meta.name: Tronic Cycle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.59 KB

“Tronic Cycle” is a solo Tron-style game where the goal is to cover as many grid squares as possible without crashing into walls, your own trail, or randomly placed obstacles. Controlled by joystick or keyboard, each square you pass over earns you points. Before the game starts, you select difficulty and speed, which directly affect the pace and challenge. Quick reflexes, planning, and spatial awareness are key to progressing through the levels and achieving a high score.

meta.name: Tronic Force
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 63.15 KB

“Tronic Force” is an unusual puzzle game where your goal is to correctly arrange scattered jigsaw pieces on a large playfield. You move horizontal and vertical rows to align the pieces – but beware: once a piece is correctly placed, it locks in, while incorrect ones may later disappear. A preview panel shows the final pattern you need to build. With limited lives and increasing difficulty, strategic thinking is essential to successfully clear each stage.

meta.name: Tronik
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Tronik es un arcade de recolección en el que encarnas a un preso fugado que se desliza por pasillos oscuros para recoger fichas y comprar su libertad. Si te detectan, drones te perseguirán sin descanso: debes moverte con sigilo, recoger y escapar a tiempo. Cada nivel aporta nuevos retos; solo quienes piensen rápido y se muevan aún más rápido lograrán salir con vida.

meta.name: Troopa Truck
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.44 KB

Troopa Truck puts you on an endless patrol across the alien surface of Zon, racing in a police vehicle over rough terrain. Obstacles and mines demand perfect timing, while hostile ground tanks and airborne attackers increase the pressure. Your goal is to evade dangers skillfully, survive relentless attacks and last as long as possible to achieve a high score.

meta.name: Trooze
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Trooze challenges your logical thinking as you try to clear all stones from the playfield. Each move affects larger areas, with stones to the right and below a chosen position switching their state and creating new situations. Additional symbols can help or hinder you by affecting time, lives or score, or by triggering unexpected effects. The appeal lies in planning ahead and using the available extras wisely to completely clear the board.

meta.name: Tropical Fever
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.75 KB

In "Tropical Fever," the player takes on the role of a hunter who must recapture a variety of animals that have escaped from a large cage at the center of the screen. The hunter can find bananas along the maze to lure the monkeys back into the cage. After capturing the panthers, he must lock them up before continuing his search for other animals, such as the gorilla, in the jungle. The hunter can use water to continue his hunt, and occasionally, a bonus appears that he must catch quickly. If he runs out of water, he can refill at a special container. The player has three lives to complete the mission and must deal with increasingly dangerous animals to eventually bring all the creatures back to the sanctuary and win a prize. The game was released in Italy under the title "Caccia Grossa."

meta.name: Trouble at Bridgeton
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.93 KB

You have been entrusted with the management of Bridgeton Asylum while the manager is away, and you've royally messed up. You forgot to lock the main door, and now all the patients have escaped into the wide, bright world. Your task is to find them and recapture them before the manager returns and fires you. Trouble at Bridgeton is a text adventure where the text describes your location and any interesting objects. You enter commands to control your player using the keyboard.

meta.name: Trouble Bubble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.63 KB

Trouble Bubble takes you into a dreamlike toy world where colorful bubbles take on a life of their own. What begins as a nightmare turns into a mission in the next dream: you guide the bubbles toward scattered toys so they can wrap and collect them. A rival bubble interferes and tries to snatch the toys first, adding competitive tension. A small red square on the path randomly rearranges objectives, keeping the action unpredictable. Played solo or with two players at once, the pace quickly becomes frantic – a lively platform adventure built around a playful concept.

meta.name: TSI Cycles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.55 KB

TSI Cycles is an adaptation of the light cycle scene from the film Tron. The aim is to defeat the opponent through clever maneuvering by getting them to collide with their light trail or that of the player. Tsi Cycles is characterized by its simple controls and competitive gameplay.

meta.name: Tube Madness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Tube Madness, the goal is to construct the longest possible pipeline before the liquid starts flowing from the starting tile marked with an “S.” You have 90 seconds to complete the task, and with each level, the number of required pipe pieces increases, making the challenge progressively harder. Skill and quick thinking are essential to controlling the flow of the liquid.

meta.name: The Tube
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.40 KB

The Tube throws you into a nightmare of drifting debris and alien machinery. After a five-year patrol your ship suddenly fails, and before you can react you're pulled into a black hole – actually an alien garbage-processing system. You must survive three zones: the transfer zone that drags in all surrounding waste, a vicious tunnel of defense mechanisms smashing anything too slow, and finally the conquest area where ships and wreckage await dismantling. Only sharp reflexes and constant awareness will get you through to the other side.

meta.name: Tubular Bells
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.01 KB

This is more demo than game, a SID tour de force second combining art and melody into a wonderful ethereal experience. With the aid of the software house CRL and distributor Nu Wave, Mike Oldfield released an interactive Commodore 64 version of the album in 1986, which used the computer's SID sound chip to play back a simplified re-arrangement of the album, accompanied by some 2D visual effects. The "interactivity" offered by the album/program was limited to controlling the speed and quantity of the visual effects, tuning the sound's volume and filtering, and skipping to any part of the album.

meta.name: Tunnel Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.89 KB

In Tunnel Escape, you control your hot air balloon through a cave system to escape safely. The game is similar to a more complex version of Lunar Lander, where you must maneuver the balloon through the tunnel without making contact with the cave walls. You need to avoid obstacles and land safely before time runs out. Each successful landing earns you bonus points. There are a total of four balloons per game. The graphics are well-done compared to other games in the collection.

meta.name: The Tunnels of Doom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.95 KB

The Tunnels of Doom is an action-packed game for the Commodore 64 that takes you into the deepest reaches of space. Your mission is to destroy incoming hordes using photon bombs. The game offers six difficulty levels, ranging from Training to Kamikaze, challenging your skills at every turn. Featuring impressive 3D graphics for its time, Tunnel of Doom delivers an intense gameplay experience where quick reflexes and precise aiming are crucial to surviving the enemy waves.

meta.name: Tunnel Vision
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.11 KB

Tunnel Vision throws you into high-speed 3D tunnels of the future – solo or with a friend – as you compete to capture a ball and return it to the finish line. You control your vehicle from a rear-view perspective, dodging and blasting enemy drones with your laser. In two-player mode, the screen splits – player one on top, player two below. A tunnel map shows your position, speed, fuel, and shield levels. A built-in track editor lets you create your own twisting courses and shape the competition.

meta.name: Tunnelmaze Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.30 KB

“Tunnelmaze Adventure” is an adventure game where the player explores a complex tunnel system and must carefully map it to stay oriented. Every decision can determine the success or failure of the journey, and precise planning is essential to navigate the maze safely.

meta.name: Tunnels of Terror
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.92 KB

Tunnels of Terror throws you into a merciless gauntlet: lava below, lava above, deadly spaceships and beam-guarded corridors block your way. One slip means instant death. Only flawless precision and a hyper-sensitive joystick will see you through. If you brave the brutal path to the next level, you're either a glutton for punishment – or chasing the ultimate challenge run.

meta.name: Turbo 64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.40 KB

In Turbo 64 you compete with up to eight friends, racing in turns to achieve the highest score. You can choose between two tracks – Loonies Loop and Devils Deathtrack – as well as automatic or manual gears and up to nine laps. Each player drives in sequence, earning points for speed and endurance. But going off track or hitting obstacles will stop your car and freeze your score. The winner is the player with the highest score after all laps are completed.

meta.name: Turbo Boat Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.06 KB

"Turbo Boat Simulator" puts you in control of a high-speed boat, deep in enemy territory, on a mission to escape in one piece. Allied planes drop map pieces into the water, all of which must be collected to complete each level. Gameplay is side-scrolling, allowing you to steer your boat up and down the screen and control your speed. The waterways are filled with obstacles, blockades, and narrow paths – much like in "Spy Hunter". Enemy boats and planes attack with gunfire and drop deadly mines as you fight to survive and stay on course.

meta.name: Turbo Charge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La introducción nos muestra a unos terroristas iraquíes que irrumpen en un campamento militar de la ONU y escapan con el arsenal. Ahora es el turno de los agentes británicos Agaippa y Dausus para atrapar a los terroristas y asegurar el arsenal.
Este es un juego clásico de "Conduce y dispara". Controlas un coche deportivo rojo y conduces por una carretera estrecha, disparando a todos los coches que hay en el camino mientras intentas evitar los disparos del enemigo y los diversos obstáculos que hay en la carretera (según la historia, se trata de una persecución por países peligrosos como Arabia Saudí, Irak, Tailandia, Sudáfrica y otros).

meta.name: Turbo Esprit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.25 KB

En Esprit controlas un Lotus Esprit de la policía con la misión de desmantelar un cártel de drogas protegiendo a los civiles. Un mapa integrado muestra en todo momento la posición de los vehículos del barón, pero el timing es crucial: si los interceptas antes de que concluyan sus tratos, huirán y lo intentarán de nuevo. El entorno es amplio y detallado, con semáforos, intersecciones, pasos de peatones y transeúntes que esquivar. Las carreteras tienen varios carriles, y al girar al final de cada calle la perspectiva cambia al estilo flick-screen. Inusual para su época es la tabla de récords guardable.

meta.name: Turbo Bike
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.43 KB

Turbo Girl, también conocido como Turbo Bike es un videojuego español del año 1988 desarrollado por Gamesoft y publicado por Dinamic Software para ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, MSX y Commodore 64. Su lanzamiento se acompañó de una intensa campaña publicitaria en televisión de la mano de la revista Micromanía, que estrenó con la portada de Turbo Girl la segunda época y su formato más recordado de periódico.

meta.name: Turbo Kart Racer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.36 KB

In Turbo Kart Racer you jump into a go-kart and race against either a friend or the computer across multiple tracks to become champion. Races are viewed from above in split screen, showing only part of the circuit. Alongside normal acceleration you can use a limited turbo boost. Icons scattered around the track repair damage or refill turbo, with your kart flashing briefly when collected. A grey car also roams the track, sometimes carrying a spanner – crash into it to collect the tool. At the end of each race, the winner also takes any spanners the loser has gathered.

meta.name: Turbo Maze Man
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.45 KB

The player controls a Pac-Man like creature in a maze trying to eat all the pellets. Four ghosts are released from their homes, and will chase the player if approached too close. Power pellets in the corners of the screen will temporarily send the ghosts back to their homes. If the player clears a level, they advance to a more difficult challenge. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.

meta.name: Turbo Out Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La secuela de OutRun mantiene la jugabilidad básica del original: perspectiva trasera del coche y el reto de superar cada tramo dentro del tiempo límite. Los impactos pueden hacer que el vehículo derrape, reduzca la velocidad o incluso vuelque, perdiendo tiempo en todos los casos.
Hay 16 etapas ambientadas en EE. UU., avanzando progresivamente de este a oeste, todas con diseños visuales distintos. Cada 4 niveles accedes a una pantalla de taller para elegir mejoras. Como indica el título, ahora dispones de turbo: acelera el coche, pero su uso excesivo sobrecalienta el motor —y solo se recarga en los talleres—. Tienes 5 continuaciones; no terminar a tiempo te cuesta una.

meta.name: Turbo the Tortoise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Turbo the Tortoise you take on the role of a turtle who gains superpowers after a failed experiment. To repair its owner's machine, it must travel across six time periods – from prehistoric times and ancient Egypt to the future. Each era is presented as a side-scrolling platform level filled with enemies that can be defeated either with limited weapons or by jumping on their heads. Moving platforms, switches, fragile floors, and water hazards make the journey tougher, while hidden power-ups and extra lives often require clever use of enemies as springboards.

meta.name: Turf-Form
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.76 KB

Turf-Form delivers a deep racing simulation focused on analysis and informed decision-making. You can take detailed form data for each horse into account and receive predictions highlighting the strongest chances in a race. The appeal comes from relying on insight and evaluation rather than luck, using statistics and forecasts to achieve better long-term results.

meta.name: Turmoil
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.65 KB

Turmoil is a fast-paced shooter. You control a ship trapped in a chamber made up of seven tunnels. Your ship can only move up and down along a vertical corridor connecting the tunnels. However, you are not alone. A variety of enemies move through these tunnels, focused on destroying you. Therefore, the ultimate goal of “Turmoil” is to zoom up and down the center alley and blow up the aliens speeding past. Keep shooting and keep moving and you will survive to live another day! While moving up and down quickly, you also have to fire your own weapons to the left or right side. Part of the intensity of this game comes from the fact that you can't stay in one place for too long. If you do this, an indestructible enemy will fly towards you, forcing you to continue again.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Turn It challenges you to remove matching pairs of tiles from the board until nothing remains. This only works when the selected pieces lie on a clear line to each other, so every decision needs careful thought. A poor removal order can lead straight into a dead end, while time pressure and limited hints increase the challenge even further. The result is a calm but tricky puzzle game that demands overview, planning, and patience in equal measure.

meta.name: Turn It 2 : Future Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Turn It 2: Future Edition is a variation of Shanghai. The player must remove the stones with the same markings from the board until the entire board is completely empty. Removing the stones is allowed if they can be projected along the same line without any other stones blocking the way. Each level has a specific number of matching stones. The player can mark the stones or cancel the action to change their decision. There are dead ends if the strategy for removing the stones was wrong. The game is time-limited, and during gameplay, a certain number of "next move" suggestions are available.

Collecting power ups which are left behind by dead hostiles reward certain advantages, e.g. a shield. If the screen is left from one side, the ship appears at the opposite side of the screen.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Turrican II: The Final Fight es un juego de plataformas y disparos del tipo que se suele ver en las consolas, pero diseñado desde cero para ordenadores personales.
Su argumento es sencillo: un malvado mega-robot llamado "la Máquina" ataca la nave Avalon 1 de los Planetas Unidos, masacrando a todos los que se resisten. Todos excepto Bren McGuire, que consigue escapar y ponerse la armadura biónica experimental de Turrican. Como Turrican, se propone demostrar a la Máquina quién manda.
A diferencia de otros juegos de este tipo, este juego contiene tres niveles de acción de tiro horizontal. Hay seis grandes mundos para explorar, en los que eres bastante libre de ir donde quieras, ya que no hay desplazamiento automático y los niveles están llenos de vidas extra y armas ocultas. Todos estos niveles son muy diferentes: el primero, en el desierto de piedra, es muy colorido, mientras que los siguientes mundos son cada vez más oscuros.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.57 KB

Ekim (a Giant Ant) who was discovered by Pirates in 1647, was trained by them to recover treasure. On the caribbean island where he lives, is a hut where he must store the treasure. He can jump quite long distances, and walk on anything solid, i.e. land, logs, the bridge, turtles, crocodiles, or magic islands. He must step safely on the turtles, because not only are they slippery, but they tend to dive underwater when crocodiles are around. Ekim could drown, thereby losing a life.
Ekim uses up energy in his travels, which he must replenish by eating the foods which grow on the islands. To remove treasure, Ekim must get in and out of the chest while the lid is open. Since he can only enter the chest once on each round trip, he must collect as much as possible while in the chest. Every third successful trip the Pirates will return to remove the treasure collected.
The number of lives is shown on the island at the bottom right of the screen. Score is shown at the top right, and remaining energy appears on the island at the bottom left.

Different scenes and characters allow them to interact creatively while discovering visual and musical elements. The game focuses on exploration and creativity, giving young players a playful environment to experiment with colors, shapes and sounds.

meta.name: Tusker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Encontrar el misterioso Cementerio de Elefantes en África fue la búsqueda de toda la vida de tu Padre. Cuando desaparece, estás decidido a descubrir qué pudo haberle sucedido y qué secretos esconde. Esta aventura arcade de desplazamiento lateral se divide en tres etapas, que abarcan el duro y árido desierto, una red subterránea de cuevas y una jungla tribal. Los nativos se muestran hostiles a tu presencia, y debes encontrar armas para defenderte, aunque su uso no los tranquiliza al principio. El machete para abrirte paso por la selva es igualmente importante. En muchos otros puntos, necesitarás usar objetos que hayas encontrado por el camino. Los fondos son completamente 3D y pueden servir para ocultar al personaje cuando se encuentra detrás de árboles o rocas.

meta.name: Tutti Frutti 64
meta.desc:

In Tutti Frutti 64, you help Super Strawberry collect every ripe cherry in the orchard. You dig paths through the soil, dodge the Acid Apple Gang, and can take out enemies with well-placed shots. Extra care is needed beneath the apples, as they fall shortly after being undermined. This lively garden adventure grows from a blend of collecting fun, clever route-building, and constant pursuit pressure.

meta.name: Tv Sports Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

TV Sports Football presents American football like a television broadcast, giving every match a much more dramatic frame. Before kickoff, the presentation sets the mood, while cutscenes highlight key moments and make the action feel more like a real sporting event. On the field, the appeal comes from combining play selection with direct execution, as passes, runs, and tactical decisions come to life. That blend of TV atmosphere, strategy, and action is what gives the game its distinctive appeal.

You guide your ship through maze-like, scrolling levels where touching any wall or obstacle instantly kills you—much like in Berzerk. Shooting plays only a minor role, while skill, reflexes, and a steady hand determine your survival.

The world is alive – characters move in real time and are rarely in the same place twice. With weapons and armor you can defend yourself, but hunger, thirst and combat will lower your strength. The goal is to reach 1024 points and perhaps even uncover the secret of life.

Each single-screen stage challenges you with enemies, traps, and tight platforming that demands precise timing and quick reactions. Every room is a self-contained test of skill, pushing you to master movement and survive increasingly intense situations. As the stages progress, the pressure builds steadily toward the goal of breaking the curse and saving the world.

Antes de participar, puedes realizar un vuelo de entrenamiento para familiarizarte con los controles. Si cometes un error que afecta a tu vuelo, el cuadro parpadea en rojo para avisarte, pero puedes seguir volando. En todos los modos de juego, despegas de una pista y también puedes aterrizar.
La pantalla está dividida en dos mitades, la superior muestra la vista de la cabina y la inferior el panel de instrumentos. El panel de instrumentos es detallado y contiene todo lo que esperas encontrar en un simulador de vuelo.

In this game, you compete against an opponent in a "Head to Head" Tetris style. Your goal is to form rows of three identical blocks horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. When you succeed, the corresponding blocks disappear. The game ends when the blocks reach the top edge of the screen. In emergencies, you have three Jokers at your disposal that will make all blocks of the same type disappear when they touch them for the first time. Strategic thinking and quick decisions are crucial to succeed and defeat your opponent.

Twinball puts you in control of two balls at once, dodging obstacles across a grid-based arena – either solo or in cooperative two-player mode. The goal is to avoid incoming threats for as long as possible while the clock ticks down. Precision, focus, and teamwork are key, because one wrong move means losing a life. The longer you last, the higher your score – but the danger never lets up.

On a split-screen, two players or one player against the computer face off. Obstacles must be jumped over, and consumables picked up to gain points and energy. Reaching a checkpoint leads to the next level with fresh challenges.

“Twinworld” takes you into the fractured realm of Gaspar, where the fall of the Cariken dynasty allowed the dark druid Maldur to seize power. As Ulopa, the sole survivor of the royal family, you must embark on a perilous quest across 23 levels to recover the shattered pieces of a magical amulet. The journey blends surface areas with underground tunnels in classic platforming style. You wield three types of weapons, each with unique uses, and switching between them at the right time is crucial. Fallen enemies drop upgrades, and special tools like springs or a parachute help you overcome obstacles and explore hidden paths.

2 Player Soccer Squad se distingue de otros juegos de gestión de fútbol al permitir que dos jugadores dirijan un club cada uno, tomen decisiones y compitan en partidos de forma alternada. Además de los nombres reales de los jugadores, los usuarios pueden añadir sus propios nombres a la plantilla. El juego se desarrolla en una superliga ficticia con 20 equipos de clubes ingleses y escoceses, junto con una copa eliminatoria. Los jugadores con una puntuación de rendimiento de 15 se pueden comprar o vender, y la plantilla de 19 jugadores se puede ajustar para seleccionar un once inicial y dos suplentes. Los resultados de los partidos se muestran junto con los goleadores, aunque los goleadores se actualizan más rápido que los marcadores. You can rotate the wand in any direction – and in two-player mode, each player controls one end, making coordination and timing the ultimate test of teamwork.

You can buy to invest in commodities or sell to liquidate your holdings. A portfolio overview displays your assets, while price charts and news provide key insights for future decisions. The goal is to maximize your wealth through strategic trading and dominate the market.

You buy and sell goods, plan trade routes, and manage your resources to maximize profits. Every choice – whether in buying, selling, or investing – can make or break your fortune. Only sharp instincts, strategy, and bold decisions will make you the world's top shipping tycoon.

Tyler's Dungeons throws you into a massive maze of 250 rooms spread across four levels, all connected by elevators. Your goal: to find eight precious treasures and make it out alive. But danger is everywhere – every room hides a lurking enemy that mirrors your movement, while cross traps collapse around you and snake pits spring to life without warning. One mistake means instant death and a fresh start from the beginning. Only careful planning and steady nerves will see you through the deadly depths of Tyler's Dungeons.

meta.name: Type Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

A Space Invaders inspired typing game. Letters slowly descend from the sky, type them in order to destroy them. Any letter that is at the bottom of a column is a valid input; mistakenly inputting another drains energy.
There are 99 speeds (Anything above 80 requires a genetic mutation), and 39 lessons. These can include upper and lower case, symbols and special keys as options. Each lesson finishes with a sequence of words using the featured letters, to be input in as little time as possible, allowing for use of the delete key.
Score is based on WPM, letters destroyed, minus mistakes. There is a savable high score table plus you can save your game at any time. The package includes finger placement diagrams for all variants of the host platform.

meta.name: Type Snyper

Type Snyper combines typing practice with direct arcade action, turning the process of learning to type into a surprisingly lively defensive battle. As a helicopter drops letters and words over the city, you have to react quickly and accurately to destroy them in time with your laser. Its appeal comes from that blend of learning program, speed, and playful pressure, which keeps practice from feeling dry and instead makes it motivating and varied – especially since the training adapts to your skill level and even allows custom lessons.

Puedes simular batallas aisladas —en modo multijugador— o campañas completas que abarcan varios años, en las que juegas contra el ordenador.

Incluye prácticamente todas las armas terrestres empleadas (más de 220 tipos). Las unidades son escuadras de infantería, tanques o piezas de artillería individuales. Puedes simular batallas aisladas —en modo multijugador— o campañas completas que abarcan varios años, en las que juegas contra el ordenador.

meta.name: U-96
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.50 KB

Smart backbenchers integrated a really great game into everyday school life a long time ago. We are of course talking about the good old “Sinking Ships” or Battleship game, which could be played with graph paper. “U-96” now simulates this game on your breadbox.
After starting, you can first decide whether you want to compete against the really strong computer opponent or whether you would prefer to play a leisurely game for two (F1). In the subsequent positioning round, you have to place your ships as inconspicuously as possible. The computer then of course takes over the evaluation. It shows the number of hits and at the same time marks the damaged parts of the ship. Then the counteroffensive will begin immediately. You have a total of 20 shots at your disposal to scratch up the enemy fleet a little. However, you should exercise caution because you may have just sunk a mine.

meta.name: Brian Jack's Uchi-Mata
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.51 KB

"Brian Jack's Uchi-Mata" is a realistic and precise simulation of judo, where the player can learn and execute various throws such as O Soto Gari, Tomoe Nage, Uchi Mata, and De Ashi Barai. Matches can be fought against the computer or another player, with the option to perform illegal moves — though these are strictly penalized by the referee in competition mode. The techniques are displayed with smooth animations made up of over 400 images, making the movements particularly detailed and lifelike. The game is accompanied by high-quality music and sound effects. The joystick controls allow for precise movements, while the referee evaluates every action. The player can choose between a training mode to learn techniques or a competition mode for challenging fights.

meta.name: UCM : Ultimate Combat Mission
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.89 KB

You are a warmonger and plan to escape from this maximum security prison that orbits the earth with your fellow inmate Mandroid (played by a second player at the same time). Because Earth's prisons are full, space stations have been built to house criminals like you. You've managed to arm yourself with a weapon (Mandroid, a laser) and try to get past waves of guards coming at you by dodging or shooting them. When you reach the end of the prison, a space shuttle awaits you to take you to freedom. UCM: Ultimate Combat Mission is a run 'n gun game that gives you a high angle view of your player from a third-person perspective. They move vertically up while the screen scrolls.

meta.name: UFO
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.98 KB

UFO focuses on a simple but direct air-combat situation where you have to shoot down hostile flying saucers without getting caught yourself. Instead of moving through a scrolling playfield, everything takes place on a fixed screen, keeping the focus on positioning, timing, and accurate shots. Every hit matters, while a collision or enemy attack can quickly end the game. Its appeal lies in the stripped-down action, the clear objective, and the quick shift between hunting and dodging.

meta.name: UFO
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.82 KB

UFO puts you in the cockpit of the F21 Condor for Earth's last defensive battle against an alien invasion. You fight through waves of enemy ships, but you have to do more than aim and dodge, because your weapon can overheat if used too much. After each cleared section, a risky flight through a hypersonic corridor awaits before you can spend earned credits on shields and energy. Its appeal lies in the mix of classic alien defense, resource management, and short skill-based sequences between battles.

meta.name: UFO Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.57 KB

UFO Attack takes the idea of clay pigeon shooting and moves it into a small science-fiction scenario. UFOs appear in front of a striking backdrop, and you have to aim and shoot them down as quickly as possible. Success depends entirely on reaction, accuracy, and choosing the right moment to fire. This creates a direct target-shooting game built around a simple idea and a brisk sense of pursuit.

meta.name: Ugh!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Ugh!, you take on the role of a Stone Age taxi pilot, flying a foot-powered aircraft across single-screen 2D landscapes. Passengers appear on platforms, wave to you, and hop into your prehistoric taxi when you land nearby. They'll tell you where they want to go, and getting them there quickly earns bonus points. Each level introduces new obstacles and tight spaces, where precision and speed are key – fly too rough, and you might crash or upset your customers.

meta.name: Ugh!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.20 KB

In Ugh!, you play a caveman trying to survive the coming ice age by collecting food – in the form of pterodactyl eggs. Armed with a single spear, you must climb the mountain, steal eggs from Pterry's nest, and return to your cave. Pterry defends the nest by dropping rocks, while a T. rex prowls the mountain paths. You can kill either beast with your spear, but once you pick up an egg, you must drop your weapon. Reach 8000 points to unlock a new screen with a different path layout and even more peril.

meta.name: Uhg
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.35 KB

Uhg follows a hungry caveman exploring multi-level dinosaur caves in search of eggs that must be carried back to the surface one at a time. You descend using vines, search each layer and confront small dinosaurs that take multiple hits, constantly interrupting your progress. Because only one egg can be transported at once, repeated trips become part of the strategy and require careful planning. The blend of exploration, combat and back-and-forth movement creates an engaging adventure where timing and route decisions matter.

meta.name: UK Geography
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.68 KB

UK Geography is an educational program that tests your knowledge of towns, regions, islands, and mountain ranges in the United Kingdom. You are asked to locate places on a map, identify their names, or match the correct regions. Points are awarded for correct answers, with higher scores for first attempts and fewer if you use hints. With different test modes such as “Find the Town” or “Name the Region,” it offers a playful way to check and improve your geography skills while aiming for a high score.

Ultima I: The First Age of Darkness casts you as "The Stranger", summoned from another world to defeat the evil wizard Mondain. With the Gem of Immortality in his grasp, Mondain cannot be killed, and his forces terrorize the land of Sosaria. Your quest spans dungeons, open landscapes, and even space, as you gather clues, battle enemies, and grow stronger. Ultima I is considered a landmark in RPG history and the first true open-world computer game.
