meta.name: Ultima III : Exodus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

El tercer título de la serie Ultima, este fue el primer juego de la serie que contó con un grupo de aventureros en lugar de un solo jugador. También tenía ciudades grandes y detalladas con muchas personas con las que hablar, y un motor de combate separado donde tu grupo luchó contra múltiples monstruos en un sistema basado en turnos.
Después de la derrota del malvado mago Mondain y su amante Minax en las dos Ultimas, la paz ha regresado a la tierra de Sorsaria. El tiempo pasa y, finalmente, se producen alteraciones geológicas y un resurgimiento de la población de monstruos, y pronto se descubre que Mondain y Minax habían concebido un niño llamado "Exodus" antes de su muerte. Ahora ese niño se ha convertido en un adulto con el poder de vengar la muerte de sus padres. Obviamente, cae sobre ti el héroe para encontrarlo y detenerlo.

n: Ultima IV - Quest of the Avatar (USA) (Side A)

meta.name: Ultima IV : Quest of the Avatar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

En una hermosa tarde, te recuestas contra un árbol y dormitas, cuando de repente aparece una especie de puerta azul no muy lejos de ti, de la que caen una cruz Ankh, un mapa de tela y dos libros, uno que describe el mundo de Britannia, el otro que habla de magia. Al levantarte, observas un campamento de nómadas, que sorprendentemente no habías visto antes, y eres conducido al carro del adivino, que te hace una serie de preguntas, tras lo cual te desmayas. Y cuando despiertas, el mundo de Britannia está ante ti. ¿Podrás demostrar tu valía y ser digno de ser el Avatar de las Virtudes?
Ultima IV es un juego de arriba abajo, con la excepción de las mazmorras, que están en una vista en primera persona. Las fases de combate son por turnos. Britannia es un vasto mundo que puedes explorar a tu antojo.

meta.name: Ultima V : Warriors of Destiny
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Desde la desaparición de Lord British en una expedición a los confines de la Tierra, el mal ha vuelto a manifestarse, en forma de Señores de las Sombras. Aparecen en las ciudades, sembrando el pánico y apoderándose de las mentes de la gente. También han reaparecido orcos, trolls y demonios. No todo va bien, así que tus amigos de toda la vida te han llamado a ti, el Avatar, reflejo de todas las cualidades caballerescas, para que encuentres a Lord British y lo devuelvas a su trono. Todo lo que tienes que hacer es emprender una búsqueda, reclutar compañeros, interrogar a todo el mundo, explorar las mazmorras y luego irte a los confines de la Tierra, donde te espera lo desconocido.
Aunque el juego se desarrolla en el mismo mundo que Ultima IV, ahora está más detallado. El combate se ha mejorado ligeramente. El ciclo día/noche se utiliza juiciosamente, y los personajes que conoces tienen vida propia.

meta.name: Ultima VI : The False Prophet
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Varios años después de devolver a Lord British su legítima posición como monarca de Britannia, el Avatar es capturado por criaturas demoníacas y colocado en un altar de sacrificios. Sus amigos Lolo, Shamino y Dupre aparecen justo a tiempo para salvarle. En el castillo de Britannia, el Avatar se entera de que sus captores eran gárgolas, una raza de enigmáticas criaturas que recientemente han invadido Britannia y ocupado los santuarios de la Virtud. El Avatar se embarca en una búsqueda para liberar Britannia.
Ultima VI es único en el sentido de que es un mundo completamente continuo. No existe un "mapamundi" en el juego, todas las localizaciones están conectadas entre sí convirtiendo el mundo del juego en un entorno abierto. En comparación con anteriores entregas de la serie, el juego se centra más en las misiones y la exploración que en el combate.

meta.name: The Ultimate Event

The Ultimate Event is a game where you ride a hoverboard with a cannon along the beach boulevard while swarms of colorful balloons try to escape from you. You must not let them safely reach the Kaiju shelters – instead, you need to shoot down as many as possible! If you miss too many, the next participant takes over.

meta.name: The Ultimate Game Show
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"The Ultimate Game Show" is a guessing game reminiscent of "Wheel of Fortune," but without a spinning wheel. Players select letters and try to guess words or phrases to score points. The game combines strategic choices with elements of chance, offering an engaging challenge for multiple players. The objective is to achieve the highest score through clever guesses and smart decisions.

meta.name: Ultimate Quest : Catacomb
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ultimate Quest: Catacomb delivers an engaging exploration of the city, wilderness, and dungeon, where players experience adventures, collect treasures, and face battles. An updated version improves speed and ensures smoother gameplay while maintaining the classic role-playing atmosphere.

meta.name: Ultimate Wizard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This updated version of Wizard is a platform-style game which was likened to Epyx's Jumpman. Your character is the Ultimate Wizard. You must face dark enemies as you move through the bricks, ladders, staircases of the game. Cast spells to destroy them, or otherwise avoid them using levitation arrows or other magic. When you Wizard finds the key and places it in the keyhole, he is finished for that level, but soon the next level will appear while sounds play as the level materializes in front of the player.

meta.name: Ultra Snake
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.11 KB

In Ultra Snake, you guide your snake across a grid to claim a required percentage of territory and progress to the next level. Time is critical, as your health constantly drains. You must avoid enemies, traps, and your own trail – touching any of them reduces your health. Collect bombs to clear surrounding blocks and create space. The game ends when your health runs out. A fast-paced Snake variant with arcade flair and strategic depth.

meta.name: Ultrazoyd
meta.desc:

Tras atesorar preciados trofeos siguiendo los pasos de sus héroes preferidos de videojuegos clásicos (El Fuego que no Quema (que le viene divinamente para el recibidor), una pistola de protones con su cargador de iones, tres braguitas de Gremla, la chequera de Willy, el pijama de Wally, la Espada del Poder (la falsa, que la verdadera está en uso), un montón de café Saimaza ?), se entera de que un misterioso y excéntrico millonario, otrora ladrón, esconde en una vieja mansión cercana al Bosque de los Canutos (la conocida como Storm Palace) un porrón de monedas de oro, y decide emular a su gran ídolo Goody y birlárselas?
El tema es que no va a ser demasiado fácil... Los sótanos del Storm Palace son profundos y están llenos de recovecos. Por si no fuera esto suficiente, la intricanda disposición de las antiquísimas cámaras hace que no sea difícil perderse, errar el camino y encontrarse otra vez en el punto de partida. Eso fue lo que le pasó a Uwol: el ser el tío más ambicioso del universo le jugó una mala pasada y por querer adentrarse más y más en el palacio para encontrar más y más monedas terminó al fondo del laberinto? Vegas Craps is a simulation of the casino game. The game uses a graphical mouse based interface where the cursor is used to to pick up chips and place them on the board before clicking on the dice to roll. The player then either makes or loses money and the game continues with more rounds until money runs out. The starting amount of money is $1000 and when out of money the player gets the option to either borrow another $1000 or quit the game.

Vegas Gambler is a casino game for one player which features four common casino games: Video Poker, Roulette, Black Jack and Slots. 
At the start of the game you have $500 to bet with. The betting limits are $200 for Black Jack and Roulette and $5 for Video Poker and Slots. Once you have placed a bet you only need to hit play, the computer will automatically bet the same amount of money again and again, however if you play roulette you have to manually place your bet on the game board. Once you run out of money you may chose between borrowing another $500 or quit. The game features a save/load function for one game.

"Vegas Games" invites the player into a virtual casino where various classic gambling games such as poker, blackjack, craps, keno, slot machines, and horse racing can be played. The player places bets, wagers chips, and tests their luck while navigating different casino games. The thrill comes from the chance to win big or lose it all.

meta.name: Vegas Jackpot

Vegas Jackpot captures the classic appeal of a fruit machine and is all about luck, suspense, and the hope of hitting the big win. You insert a coin, spin the reels, and wait for the right line of symbols to appear. Small options such as holding or nudging individual reels give the randomness a slight tactical edge. The result is a simple but familiar gambling simulation driven mainly by the thrill of the next jackpot.

meta.name: Velnor's Lair
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.62 KB

Earth is in trouble from the Black Wizard Velnor, as he has finally found the tomb of Grako to turn himself into a demon. Time is short as he prepares for the change and so instead of sending a huge army to stop him, you have been chosen for this quest. You have arrived at Mt. Elk and you must enter the mountain and find Velnor hidden in the Goblin Labyrinth to stop his evil plan.

meta.name: Velocipede
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.44 KB

In Velocipede you take control of Mr. Megafat, who wants to reach the beach on his homemade bicycle, the Velocipede S.T.A., without walking a single step. As the screen scrolls sideways, you must avoid dangerous obstacles such as birds dropping fire and giant snails. Your bike is equipped with a plasma cannon and can also jump to defeat enemies or dodge them. Every collision breaks the bike and costs a life, though it can be repaired. A counter shows the remaining distance to the beach – and once you arrive, the next round begins with even tougher enemies. Speed and skill are the key to making it safely.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Velocipede II

Velocipede II is a sequel to Velocipede. In this action-dexterity game you find yourselves on the advanced Velocipede II firing unicycle, once again invented by Mr. Megafat, with four levels to complete within time limits. The game scrolls sidewards from left to right, with the player controlling speed but not vertical position. There are hazards to jump over and creatures to shoot or avoid. Falling into holes loses one of the player's four lives, while hitting an enemy drains an energy bar (which is refilled when a life is lost for either reason). When a level is completed, bonus points are awarded for the amount of remaining time. The game has a reputation for being very easy to complete within just a few minutes.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Vendetta

Vendetta te sumerge en una misión profundamente personal: tras el secuestro de tu hermano —un científico de élite— y su hija por parte de terroristas, decides vengarte. Antes, fuiste un héroe de guerra condecorado, pero ahora te han marginado… y regresas por la puerta grande. Con tu arsenal privado y un avanzado sistema de combate integrado en tu Ferrari F40, recorres muelles, bases militares, aeropuertos y parques, enlazados por rutas de conducción peligrosas. Mientras recoges pistas, combates enemigos implacables y limpias tu nombre, una cosa queda clara: esta vez, es personal. Esta es tu Venganza.

meta.name: Vendetta

Vendetta te sitúa en la América de los años 30, una época áspera de prohibición y guerras de bandas. Como gánster de poca monta, tu objetivo es dominar el barrio eliminando a las bandas rivales. Con una interfaz de punto de mira, debes disparar a figuras armadas que se esconden en los edificios del otro lado de la calle. Son pequeñas y están bien escondidas, pero una flecha te muestra dónde apuntar. Las balas y el tiempo son limitados: cada disparo cuenta. Gana dinero derrotando bandas, luego intercambia alcohol, compra armas o detectores de enemigos, o tómate descansos cortos para buscar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

meta.name: Vengeance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Una vez más, tu galaxia está bajo ataque y tú, piloto de una nave solitaria, debes enfrentarte a los alienígenas y expulsarlos. A medida que avanzas, puedes recoger cápsulas para mejorar tu nave: velocidad, potencia de fuego, vidas extra y energía. Lo último que puedes obtener es un dron que te permite teletransportarte a naves enemigas.
Al recogerlo, al pulsar la barra espaciadora aparecerá un menú. Selecciona «abordar nave» y aparecerá un cursor con el que elegirás la nave enemiga. Guías al dron en su interior buscando secciones del motor. Cuando localices las ocho secciones, repartidas entre ocho naves distintas, habrás completado tu misión.

meta.name: Venom
meta.desc:

En Venom, juegas como Rikka, una guerrera y amiga cercana del Arrel Ruler. Después de siglos de paz, el malvado Traklan regresa de su prisión subterránea para amenazar una vez más la tierra de Armosin. El viaje comienza fuera de la posada "Dancing Drayman", donde Rikka planea encontrarse con Arrel y Beris. A partir de ahí, exploras el mundo con tus compañeros, resuelve desafíos y confronta el malvado mal. El juego se controla a través del joystick o el teclado, utilizando un menú de comando para realizar acciones como mover, examinar o dar elementos.

meta.name: VENOM Strikes Back
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

VENOM Strikes Back begins with V.E.N.O.M. kidnapping Matt Trakker's son and taking him to the moon. Refusing to surrender, Matt launches a daring solo mission to rescue him. Unlike previous M.A.S.K. games, this time it's Matt himself in action, armed with four special masks that grant powers like flying, shooting, or becoming invincible. Each mask has limited energy and only one can be used at a time. Battling through V.E.N.O.M.'s moon base, Matt must overcome deadly obstacles, save his son, and steal a rocket back to Earth.

meta.name: Venture-Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.88 KB

Venture-Quest lets you guide the fearless Bill through a monster-filled dungeon, room by room. You battle enemies, collect treasure, and discover weapons, armor, and spells that aid your survival. Blending classic 2D arcade action with adventure elements, every doorway holds the promise of danger or reward – and only the brave will make it out alive.
meta.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Mazmorras

meta.name: Venusian
meta.desc:

In Venusian, you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen, fighting off attacking aliens in classic Space Invaders style. Holding down the fire button causes the entire game to speed up.

meta.name: Verminator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.37 KB

„Verminator“ challenges the player to maneuver a tank through tight and hazardous environments to collect yellow bombs. Avoiding contact with lava is crucial, while obstacles and tank traps can be blasted away. The challenge lies in precise control and minimizing damage, as only a single life is available.

meta.name: The Very Big Cave Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Essentially a graphical version of Colossal Cave, The Very Big Cave Adventure has the player navigating around a forest, collecting treasures and dealing with strange creatures. It involves reading a description of each scene, then typing in one- or two-word commands to perform an action, with some of them providing some humor to the player. Directions can be abbreviated as N, E, S, W.

meta.name: The Vice Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Vice Squad puts you in the role of Captain James Hutch, tasked with taking down El Guato, a ruthless Mexican drug lord expanding his empire into your city. Across multiple action-packed missions, you face his henchmen, battle through varied environments, and wield powerful weapons, with mission briefings preparing you for each step. Intense boss fights, energetic soundtracks, and classic arcade-style gameplay make the fight against the cartel a gripping experience.

meta.name: Vicious Circle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.79 KB

In Vicious Circle, you control a bouncing and rolling ball equipped with deadly lasers. Your mission is to infiltrate an enemy fortress and eliminate all opponents. Precision, quick reactions, and skillful maneuvers are essential as you fight your way through enemy ranks to complete your objective.

meta.name: Victory Casino
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.05 KB

Victory Casino places you in a text-based casino experience where decisions, judgment and a touch of luck determine success or failure. You switch between several game variations, place bets and eagerly follow the outcome of each round. The focus is on quick turns and clear rules, with scores and high numbers encouraging repeated play – simple in structure, yet engaging through constant risk and reward.

meta.name: Victory Road
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La historia se retoma directamente al final de Ikari Warriors. Felicitados por el general Kawasaki por haberle salvado, Paul y Vince (también llamados Ralf y Clark) regresan a su patria en un avión fletado por el general. Aparece una misteriosa tormenta y son arrojados miles de años al futuro (¡o a otra dimensión!). Son recibidos por una criatura alienígena que les dice que el malvado Zang Zip (Zangelt) se ha apoderado de este mundo.
Para ayudarles a volver a casa, utiliza sus viejas armas de fuego y otras nuevas para derrotar a más y más enemigos, como hombres verdes cíclopes, bestias con cabeza de piedra y el malvado Zangelt.

meta.name: Video Card Arcade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.75 KB

Video Card Arcade combines multiple card games within an arcade-style framework where you use limited credits to build your winnings over time. Each round asks you to decide whether to swap cards, push your luck or secure what you have, constantly balancing risk and reward. The different game modes demand distinct strategies, from assembling strong hands to carefully approaching target scores or predicting whether the next card will be higher or lower. The shifting tension between chance and choice creates a fast-paced experience where every decision directly affects your bankroll.

meta.name: Video Meanies

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.13 KB

“Video Meanies” follows the story of a maintenance droid tasked with activating all fifteen video game machines in an arcade set in a villain-filled castle. Some machines are outdoors, while others are in locked rooms. Keys are scattered throughout the arcade, many of them hidden behind locked doors. The droid must find matching keys to unlock doors and access more keys or machines. Upon reaching a machine, the droid can choose to gamble for an extra life or its own demise, or it can skip the game, activate the machine, and earn a bonus based on its remaining energy. Every room is filled with various dangers, adding to the challenge of the mission.

meta.name: Video Vegas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Video Vegas is a gambling video game for multiple systems.
Players start with an initial $1000 on their visit to the Las Vegas casinos. The player can participate in several gambling options, including: Lucky 7 Slots, Draw Poker, Keno, and Blackjack. In Lucky 7 Slots, the player can inset $1 - 3 for a chance to win big. A number of combinations can turn up lucky for the player and lead to big cash. In Draw Poker, The player bets $1 - 5 and then receives 5 cards. The player can hold or draw new cards once, and payout is based upon the player's hand. In Keno, the player bets $1 - 5, and can select 1 - 15 numbers from a total of 80. 20 numbers are drawn, and a player is rewarded based upon how many they pick correctly. Finally, there's Blackjack, were the player and computer draw cards trying to get as close to 21 without going over.

meta.name: Viduzzles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.20 KB

Viduzzles lets you solve classic jigsaw puzzles on your computer – with 25 or 50 pieces, and with or without outlines. First, you're shown the full image, then given an empty board and the puzzle pieces to complete it. Place the pieces and finish the puzzle as quickly as possible. Once done, a new picture awaits. A calm yet challenging game for fans of thoughtful puzzling.

meta.name: Vietnam
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.24 KB

Vietnam is a simple yet engaging shooter game in which the player must fight enemies using precise shots. Success depends not only on accuracy but also on quick reflexes to dodge enemy attacks and position strategically. Only those who act skillfully and react swiftly can prevail against opponents and achieve victory.

meta.name: A View to a Kill : The Computer Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eres James Bond y debes impedir que Max Zorin destruya Silicon Valley y domine el mercado de los microchips. Este juego te llevará a París y San Francisco. En París, tendrás que perseguir a Mayday en tu vehículo mientras desciende en paracaídas hasta su punto de extracción. En San Francisco, podrás conducir hasta el Ayuntamiento y entrar en una mina abandonada donde tendrás que desactivar una bomba. Si la bomba no se desactiva, se producirá un gran terremoto y Silicon Valley quedará inundado.

meta.name: Vigilante
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Vigilante es un beat-em-up de desplazamiento lateral. Presenta a un duro personaje que recorre las calles para luchar contra la banda de los Rogues, que han secuestrado a su novia María. El juego cuenta con cinco localizaciones distintas, como calles de la ciudad y un vertedero, con numerosos matones de diferentes características. Se lucha con los puños, los pies y la cadena, realizando ataques de pie, agachado y saltando. Cada nivel tiene un jefe final que requiere tácticas específicas. Los enemigos aparecen continuamente por los lados izquierdo y derecho de la pantalla hasta llegar al jefe. Esto significa que tienes que moverte a un ritmo rápido para llegar al final del nivel antes de que se agote el tiempo. Cuando los enemigos se acercan demasiado, agarran al personaje y es necesario pulsar rápidamente a izquierda y derecha para liberarlo, ya que entonces es vulnerable a los ataques.

meta.name: Viking Raider

In Viking Raider, you play as Lief, a Viking in Narvay where the greedy ogre Smoth has seized the throne and imprisoned Queen Dana in Castle Osk. Smoth is guarded by two large goblins. To reach him, you must buy the black key, open the throne room gate, defeat Smoth, and rescue Dana. To earn enough wealth for the key, raid the countryside for treasures and store them in your longhouse – all while fending off fierce monsters. Only clever raiding and brave fighting will restore the kingdom.

meta.name: Vikings, The
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In The Vikings, you play as Erik, tasked with rescuing your Warrior Queen from Death Island and stealing the fortress treasure. Your quest starts on Stoney Island, where you must find a sword, shield, ladder, and mast parts by burning huts and exploring. Locals attack with spears, but you can fight back endlessly with your sword. Once repaired, your ship takes you to Death Island — just don't sail too far or you'll fall off the edge of the world. On Death Island, faster enemies and a fortress protected by a wall await your final assault.

meta.name: Vincent
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Vincent is a jump and run game with a vampire of the same name as the main character. Vincent has to find his coffin within the time limit in each level. As a weapon against his opponents, he carries an axe with him, which he can use to strike forward.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: The Vindicator!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“The Vindicator!” tells the story of a lone hero rising against an alien invasion that has left Earth in ruins and driven humanity underground. Your mission begins in a maze-like underground complex where you must locate blueprints that reveal how to destroy the invaders. You'll need keycards, sharp aim to eliminate alien threats, and the wit to solve an anagram puzzle. Then, you move into a vertically scrolling section, piloting a plane – or a jeep after a life loss – as you blast your way toward the alien base with infinite basic ammo and limited special weapons like bombs or grenades. In the final stage, you infiltrate the base in a side-scrolling platform section, using elevators, trap doors, and fast reflexes to survive waves of enemies on your way to confront the Dark Overlord.

meta.name: Vindicators
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

«Vindicators» te pone al mando de un tanque lento pero letal, con la misión de impedir que el Imperio Tangente lance su invasión. Debes destruir 14 estaciones espaciales enemigas, cada una dividida en tres secciones que puedes abordar en el orden que elijas. La acción se desplaza en todas direcciones, y maniobrar el tanque requiere esfuerzo, dificultando las evasiones rápidas. Disparar con precisión y tomar decisiones ágiles es esencial. Durante las fases recoges estrellas de energía, que tras cada nivel puedes canjear por mejoras: armamento superior o mayor velocidad. Solo con táctica inteligente y mejoras continuas podrás salvar la Tierra.

meta.name: Violator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Violator is a horizontally scrolling space shooter where you pilot your ship through narrow passages while facing waves of enemies. Quick reflexes are needed to dodge obstacles and enemy fire while blasting opponents to survive. The steadily increasing difficulty demands precise maneuvering and accurate shooting.
meta.developer: R. Remsberg, S. Okhuyzen & J. van der Es

meta.name: Vioris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Vioris is a classic Tetris-style block stacking game with single or two-player modes. The goal is to clear complete lines and keep your field from filling up. In two-player mode, clearing two or more lines sends garbage lines to your opponent – making quick thinking and clever placement essential to victory.

meta.name: Viper Patrol
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Viper Patrol” is a strategic first-person space shooter where the player controls a combat ship from the cockpit view. Using a quadrant map, the player can monitor satellite arrays that power the planet's mines and track both their own position and approaching Myon ships. The Myons attack these satellites, damaging them — two onboard droids can repair both the satellites and the player's ship. The ship is equipped with various scanners and a manual or automatic targeting system. Shields provide protection but weaken with each enemy hit. The game ends if the planet's power supply is cut off due to heavily damaged satellites.

meta.name: The Visible Solar System
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.19 KB

The Visible Solar System puts you in command of a spaceship with over a billion miles of range, journeying through our Solar System. Equipped with advanced computer systems, you explore planets, gather data, and uncover fascinating cosmic phenomena. Your mission – expand knowledge and return safely to Earth.

meta.name: Vision
meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Vitamin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Vitamin“ puts the player on a futuristic mission to combat a galaxy-wide threat of computer viruses. Scientists have finally developed the antiserum "Vitamin," capable of countering the malware implanted by the virus mafia. The objective is to use a powerful new weapon to destroy the virus bosses' headquarters and save the vital systems of countless planets.

meta.name: Vixen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

La Vixen es la última humana en el planeta Granath, ahora dominado por una raza de dinosaurios. Criada por zorros, cumple la promesa hecha a sus mayores: erradicarlos y devolver el planeta a la humanidad.
Cada nivel debe superarse dentro de un tiempo límite, avanzando de izquierda a derecha. Su arma principal es un látigo, eficaz contra los dinosaurios. Además, puede usarlo para activar objetos: vidas extra, tiempo adicional, etc. También recoge fichas para transformarse en zorro; al reunir suficientes, accede a un nivel bonus subterráneo.

meta.name: Vixplode
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.43 KB

Vixplode is a strategy game played on a 6x6 board. The player and an AI opponent take turns placing counters on the board and it is possible to do so on squares that are vacant or squares that the player already occupies. The aim is to make counters vixplode which happens when the total number of counters on a square equals the number of adjacent squares. Counters will then move over to each adjacent squares which the player then will gain control of. A vixplosion can lead to chain reactions across the board. The game ends when only one of the players has counters left on the board. There are six different levels to play on with different playing abilities of the opponent.nn

meta.name: Viz : The Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Viz: The Game is an action game where the players run through various scrolling environments. It is based on a British comic magazine VIZ which, like the game, features lots of crude humour and fart jokes. The player controls one of the 3 Viz characters - Johnny Fartpants, Buster Gonad, or Biffa Bacon. The race takes place in five different scrolling environments; country, town, building site, beach and a disco. During the race you have to dodge traps and other characters from the VIZ comics. There are also two mini-games for each character which include Pint Drinking, blowing up balloons with farts and Pancake Flattening.

meta.name: Voidrunner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Voidrunner is Jeff Minter's second sequel to Gridrunner and throws you into the final battle of the droid wars. After their defeat in the Matrix Wars, the droids prepare a nuke to destroy Earth, so you're sent with a corps of pilots to their home planet to wipe them out. Gameplay feels close to Gridrunner and Centipede: enemies descend in patterns and must be shot down before they reach you, while the deadly zapper line pulses across the screen as an extra hazard. In true Minter style, you'll face not just droids but bizarre creatures like camels and goats. New to Voidrunner is the control of four ships instead of one, which start in formation but later split with inverted controls or different firing directions, adding both chaos and tactical depth.

meta.name: Voivod Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.07 KB

Voivod Attack is a challenging shooter where you pilot a spaceship and shoot enemies to collect weapon upgrades and bombs. The main goal is to hit the steam engines of a space station three times with bombs to completely destroy it. Only quick reflexes and clever resource management will lead you to survival.

meta.name: Volcano of Raka-Tua
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Volcano of Raka-Tua you explore Raka-Tua National Park, where danger comes not only from nature but also from lurking monsters. Your mission is to find five hidden treasures and return them to the Jail to win the game. Locations such as the Hotel, Statue, and Jail invite exploration as you move step by step through this text-and-graphic adventure. If you succeed, you'll be ready for the sequel: Escape from Raka-Tua.

meta.name: Volfied
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Encarnas al piloto de la nave espacial Monotros, que retorna a su planeta natal, Volfied, para salvarlo de una invasión alienígena. Al principio de cada nivel, el tablero de juego adopta la forma de un rectángulo: tu nave se mueve por el perímetro (el borde), mientras que varios alienígenas se mueven por el interior. 
Cualquier incursión de la nave en el rectángulo le permite cortar el tablero, dejándola vulnerable a los ataques enemigos. Cada zona cerrada que dibujes será validada.
Tendrás que recuperar al menos el 80% del tablero para completar un nivel.

meta.name: The Volleyball Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.90 KB

Volleyball Simulator is, as the name implies, a volleyball video game. The game consists of complete six-athlete teams and the original rule set of the sport. A single game mode is available, either against the AI or another player. However, there is room for customization in the tactics menu. Here, players can set the defense and attack strategy, as well as the position of each athlete.

meta.name: Voltage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.60 KB

Voltage lets you dive into a fast-paced clash where you constantly juggle pressure and precision. You launch your energy beam through a maze of blocks, redirect it at just the right moment, and try to outsmart your opponent with sharp angles and perfect timing. Every hit feels like a small victory – and every mistake gives the other side an opening. The blend of reflexes and strategy keeps every match unpredictable and makes you want to play just one more.

meta.name: Voodoo Castle
meta.desc:

At the same time you must defend yourself against hostile mutant aliens from the surface who attempt to stop your mission. Every maneuver must be carefully controlled, as fuel is limited and the environment is full of danger.

Mind the vulture's course, because otherwise you might find yourself trapped in a corner with the inevitable collision as only way out. A good tactic to ameliorate your chances is to dodge the vulture's bullets and concentrate your fire on its mates that are left hanging above. Each unit has its own strengths and weaknesses – missiles are fast but have limited range, while planes are slower but can operate indefinitely. In the first phase, a computer code must be broken by solving a sliding puzzle. A given figure within a 3x3 grid must be replicated by rotating pieces in a larger grid. Successfully completing this allows the player to select a missile launch site. Once the enemy launches its missiles, the second phase begins, where the player positions the crosshair over the radar dot of the enemy missile and launches an interceptor. This must then be guided precisely to neutralize the threat before it reaches the cities.

Warrior of Ras Vol.I: Dunzhin takes you into a dangerous multi-level dungeon where your goal is to recover a valuable treasure. Using simple keyboard commands, you explore the maze, encounter creatures, and must decide whether to fight, bribe, hide, or flee. Each enemy type demands a different tactic, and success depends on finding the right approach. With limited hit points, careful play is essential, as one mistake can end your quest. Beyond the main treasure, bonus rewards can also be discovered in hidden rooms or through bribery.

meta.name: Warrior of Ras Vol.II : Kaiv

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Warrior of Ras Vol.II: Kaiv continues the series, sending you into a monster-infested dungeon filled with treasures and dangers. You choose whether to aim carefully or risk a powerful strike. New features include a shop at the entrance, magical items, and the need to carry food and drink. Despite its high difficulty and often deadly encounters, the game allows saving at any time, offering some relief on the perilous journey.

meta.name: Warrior of Ras Vol.III : The Wylde

Warrior of Ras Vol.III: The Wylde continues the series with an unnamed hero exploring new lands, facing numerous random battles, and ultimately seeking a treasure. While the story and character progression remain minimal, the game expands upon the mechanics of its predecessors. Most notable is its detailed combat system, where each body part has its own hit points and armor. This forces you to choose between striking easy-to-hit but well-armored areas or going for vulnerable spots that are harder to reach. You can also aim carefully or sacrifice accuracy for powerful force attacks, adding tactical depth to the encounters.

meta.name: Warrior of Ras Vol.IV : Ziggurat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Warrior of Ras Vol.IV: Ziggurat concludes the series by combining the core aspects of its predecessors. From Dunzhin it takes the dungeon layouts, from Kaiv the expanded item selection, and from The Wylde the detailed combat system where body parts can be targeted. Once again, your goal is to recover a randomly chosen artifact hidden deep within the dungeon – this time in the Ziggurat of Ras, filled with traps, treasures, and monsters. The backstory is light, but the game shines through its tactical battles and vast array of equipment. At the start you receive 2000 gold to spend on armor, weapons, food, torches, and magical items. New to this entry is the option to purchase rings, wands, and potions directly from shops, adding another layer of strategy to your preparations.

meta.name: Wastelands
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wastelands is a futuristic one-on-one fighting game where combatants face off with laser swords. By combining directional and fire buttons, players can perform various actions such as jumps, rolls, kicks, or sword strikes. Hits score points, ranging from half a point to one and a half points depending on the attack. The first fighter to reach six points wins the round. The game features a single-player mode with adjustable difficulty levels and a two-player mode.

meta.name: Watch Out!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.82 KB

Watch Out! places you in a dusty western setting where you suddenly become sheriff and must face a particularly sneaky outlaw. Instead of a traditional showdown, the game becomes a tense cat-and-mouse chase that keeps you moving, dodging attacks and waiting for the right moment to take control. The open playfield forces you to read patterns and spot danger early while pressure builds from the relentless pursuer. The result is a fast, suspenseful confrontation that demands timing, awareness and steady nerves.

meta.name: Water Castle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.90 KB

A feel very much like an updated version of Air & Sea Battle from the 2600. Take out the endless convoy of ships and avoid the depth charges fired from the plane. They will get you if they even get close to you.

meta.name: Water Loop
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.38 KB

Water Loop follows Alfredo as he collects water while dodging falling objects. His goal is to reach the bucket in time and fill it completely by running back and forth repeatedly. The game is well-known for its use of Morning Has Broken as its musical theme.

meta.name: Water Polo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.47 KB

Water Polo puts you in charge of a team splashing through chaotic, action-packed matches where timing, ball control, and endurance matter. Behind the amusing duck-like motions lies serious strategy, requiring sharp reflexes and smart teamwork. Pass, block, score, and outswim your opponents in this demanding aquatic contest where only the clever and coordinated win.

meta.name: Waterline
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.95 KB

In Waterline, disaster strikes aboard the S.S. Slipshod after the navigator mistakes an iceberg for Pittsburgh. As Captain Clutch, it's up to you to keep the chaos afloat: guide passengers to lifeboats, salvage gold bars, and stop the boilers from blowing. Everything's sinking fast – it's a frantic race to stay above water, literally and figuratively.

meta.name: Waterski 3D
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.17 KB

Waterski 3D puts you on a high-speed ride behind a motorboat, dodging oil slicks and mines while lining up for risky ski jumps. Overspeeding explodes your boat, while hesitating turns you into shark bait. After a six-lap time trial to qualify, you dive into the brutal suicide course where precision and nerves are everything. Realistic water physics and breakneck pace make for a thrilling, stomach-flipping ride.

meta.name: Wavy Navy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Battle 30-foot waves, enemy fighter jets, bombers, and helicopters while dodging mines in this Galaxian clone that has a few novel twists. Your P.T. Boat can be moved left or right and can fire missiles to bring down enemy aircraft, but it also moves up and down, staying on the surface of the huge, slow-moving waves. Wavy Navy is a 1983 computer game designed by Rodney McAuley for the Apple II and published by Sirius Software. Atari 8-bit family and Commodore 64 versions were released the same year. Wavy Navy is a nautically themed fixed shooter with left and right controls to move the player's PT boat, but there is an additional vertical element as the boat moves up and down with the large ocean waves that scroll beneath it. The direction and speed of the waves vary per level.

meta.name: Waxworks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.52 KB

Number 11 and final entry in the Mysterious Adventures series. You've spent a fun day at the local fair. Now you decide to head over to the waxworks for some fun. But you are tired. You lie down for a snooze...
It turns out you are trapped in the Waxworks. Is it all a dream though? Around this time, the game engine was redone to allow complete sentences instead of the more primitive 2-word Scott Adams parser that had been used previously although early versions of the game may have still used the cruder parser.

meta.name: The Way of the Tiger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Three distinct side-scrolling beat 'em up game sections await in this title, licensed from a series of Fighting Fantasy-style books. As Avenger, you must clear the world of evil so as to protect the innocent, using your superior strength. 
The combat is split into Hand-to-Hand, Pole Fighting and Samurai Sword fighting, each of which are loaded separately from across 2 cassettes - a novelty at the time. In each mode there are 16 moves available, varying depending on whether fire (or the space bar in keyboard mode) is pressed. The moves are arranged logically, and reverse depending on the character's facing direction, similarly to the Exploding Fist games.

meta.name: Way Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wayout is an early use of first-person 3D perspective, featuring a small gameplay window but smooth 360-degree movement. You are trapped inside one of 26 mazes (composed of 90-degree direction changes) and must find the exit. The game records how many movement units you use up, and saves the best scores to disk. Up to nine in-progress games can also be saved.
You have a compass and a map-making kit, enabling the game to automatically map the areas you explore. These can be stolen by the Cleptangle beast, but you can chase him to get them back. 
You can't push against the wind without finding a special way of overcoming it. Fireflies automatically move with the wind, and can serve as a clue to its direction.

meta.name: Weather Tamers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"Weather Tamers" puts the player in control of weather patterns across North America. The map displays various meteorological phenomena such as storms, high and low-pressure systems. The player can gather data, make strategic choices, and influence weather conditions. The goal is to manage extreme weather events and create favorable atmospheric conditions.

meta.name: Weatherwar II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.13 KB

Weatherwar II is a tactical artillery game where weather becomes a weapon. Two rival sides take turns unleashing hail, rain, lightning, or tornadoes from a drifting cloud overhead. Wind speed and cloud position affect every shot, and players enter a numeric “charge” to guide their attack. The winner is the first to completely destroy the opponent's castle. A chaotic and clever clash of meteorological might.

meta.name: Web
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.13 KB

In Web you take on the role of a troubleshooter for Global Weapons Inc., tasked with saving a power plant on the brink of meltdown. Since entering the facility is too dangerous, you control your Remote Energy Manipulator called Sleepy, which navigates by shooting web strands in different directions to move through the maze of generators. Each strand lets you swing or travel, but your supply is limited, as is your energy, which decreases if you collide with roaming devices, traps, or walls. Finding and shutting down generators restores your strength and web supply. Your mission is to disable all 30 generators while battling through a scrolling labyrinth filled with hazards and enemies.

meta.name: Web Dimension
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.86 KB

This game, according to the manual is Darwin's Theory of Evolution turned into a fabulous musical fantasy. There are eight levels of evolution, each having three phases. The game is viewed in a 3D perspective with the web stretching into the back of the screen. You appear as a note starting right at the front of the screen. You use the joystick to move about the web and use the fire button to enlarge. There are no lives to the game and no end. You finish when you switch it off.

meta.name: Webster : The Word Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.38 KB

Webster: The Word Game is a word recognition game. The object of the game is to fill in the missing letters of an incomplete word. On each round a word will appear at the top of the screen with several letters missing. The word will slowly begin moving towards the bottom of the screen and along the bottom of the screen is the complete alphabet. The player needs to select the letters that are missing from the word before time runs out and the word reaches the bottom of the screen. Successfully completing a word earns points, but if the word reaches the bottom of the screen then the player loses a life. The game ends when all five lives are lost.

meta.name: WEC Le Mans
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Recreando la famosa carrera Le Mans 24, aunque afortunadamente no en tiempo real, la máquina recreativa de Konami llegó a los sistemas domésticos. Aunque compites contra otros coches, debes llegar a cada punto de control en el tiempo requerido para completar el juego. La vuelta se divide en tres secciones: la cuarta es idéntica a la primera, la quinta a la segunda, y así sucesivamente. A medida que avanza la partida, el tiempo de bonificación de cada sección disminuye, por lo que debes conducir mejor para mantenerte dentro. La noche también está representada, con todo oscurecido y la necesidad de usar faros. El circuito cuenta con barreras y árboles junto a la pista, así que evita el contacto con ellos y trata de no desviarte hacia el césped, ya que esto te ralentiza.

In Weird Dreams you find yourself as a gravely ill patient on the operating table, trapped within your own subconscious by a demon named Emily. The only way out is to recover four mystical orbs. To do this, you must tackle a series of surreal mini-games that feel like they were pulled straight from a Dali-inspired nightmare. You might feed cotton candy to a wasp, beat hopping totem poles with falling fish, or face off against a baked chicken in a haunted house. Strange puzzles and bizarre action combine as you fight your way closer to freedom.

meta.name: Weird Worlds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.93 KB

Weird World pulls you into a disturbing, surreal story where reality and madness gradually blur together. You step directly into the role of the main character and shape how the narrative unfolds through your choices. Encounters, dialogue, and observation create an eerie atmosphere in which nothing feels entirely reliable. The appeal lies in the slow descent into a strange world that both intrigues and unsettles you.

meta.name: Weird World 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.67 KB

Weird World II continues the bizarre journey and once again pushes you to the edge between reality and madness. After the events of the first adventure, you face the consequences and must decide if and how you return to the Kingdom of the Weird. Dialogue, dark humor, and absurd situations drive the story forward, with every choice triggering new twists. The appeal lies in playing with expectation and confusion, where it is never entirely clear what is imagination and what is real.

meta.name: Welcome Aboard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Welcome Aboard is an educational game featuring the Muppets that teaches computer literacy in a playful way. Five activities are included: on the Bridge, you help Kermit steer the ship using a Logo-like programming language. In the Game Room, you play an arcade-style game under Sam the Eagle's protests. In the Joke Library, you organize Fozzie's jokes in a database. At the Message Center, Scooter teaches word processing and email. And in the Salon de Beaute, you use a computer to find the perfect look for Miss Piggy.

meta.name: Welltris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Welltris, which is the first Tetris sequel, is originally designed by Alexey Pajitnov (the creator of Tetris) with Andrei Sgenov. 
It has the same gameplay concept as Tetris; simply all the player has to do is to rotate and maneuver the falling pieces into a proper position in order to form complete layers in the rectangular playground. But Welltris changes this rectangular arena into a four sided well with grid-like walls and bottom where the falling pieces can be moved from wall to wall within the well. Form the pieces into solid rows either horizontally or vertically on the bottom of the well. 
Billed itself as Tetris in three dimensions.

meta.name: Wembley Greyhounds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.67 KB

Wembley Greyhounds places you in a season of greyhound racing where one to three players bet on different dogs across multiple tracks. Before each race, you can review statistics and place your wagers strategically. During the race, dogs change positions as they chase the mechanical hare, and final results along with qualifiers are displayed afterward. Wins and losses affect the overall standings, with the ultimate goal of finishing first and claiming the Champion title at Wembley.

meta.name: Werewolves of London
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.98 KB

El objetivo del juego es deshacerte de la maldición licantrópica, lanzada por los restantes miembros de tu familia, asesinando a todos y cada uno de ellos. Cada vez que te encuentres en tu camino delante de uno de tus enemigos una cruz parpadeará en tu fila de icono. ¡Persigue y destruye! Si tienes éxito, cada cruz será tuya, y te librarás de la maldición cuando hayas recogido y guardado ocho de estas cruces.
Deberás encontrar víctimas que tengan objetos que te sean útiles, como billetes de metro, o llaves para la cárcel o el aparcamiento. La antorcha te ayudará a ver cuando te encuentres en las cloacas o en los subterráneos del metro y un ascensor te ayudará a subir a los sitios de difícil acceso. La lima te servirá para salir de la cárcel, y para curarte las heridas podrás usar vendas.
Si eres listo puedes esconder los objetos que te puedan servir para salir de la cárcel durante el día, para que así puedas usarlos más tarde. Prolongar tu hora de la comida al máximo es el objetivo principal del juego... ¡Buena caza!

Soft City huele a pólvora. Intenta defender el West Bank del ataque de los forajidos. Defiende a los inocentes y juega tu vida en el duelo con tres asesinos a sueldo.

meta.name: A Western Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.36 KB

A Western Adventure starts with your escape from captivity. From there, you head to the saloon to gear up and prepare for a perilous hunt through the desert in search of a wanted outlaw. Along the way, you'll need sharp senses, a steady hand, and a full canteen – the final showdown will test your aim. A quirky, colorful take on the classic Western tale with charm and challenge in equal measure.

meta.name: Western Contest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Western Contest lets you compete in various Wild West challenges – from shooting bottles and catching calves to taking on the role of sheriff. Using a crosshair, you must react quickly and aim precisely to master each task. Every challenge demands timing and a steady hand. The variety of mini-games keeps things exciting – proving that only true gunslingers will succeed here.

meta.name: Western Fighter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A Western shoot-'em-up set in the old Wild West during the pioneer era, featuring two ruthless bandits as protagonists. These outlaws must flee to Mexico, crossing many dangerous territories along the way. The dangers include Native Americans, the residents of a border town in Arizona, soldiers searching for bandits, as well as animals like snakes and bison, and natural phenomena such as winds and other elements. To survive, the bandits must skillfully dodge gunfire, animals, and objects thrown at them by the wind. For defense, they can shoot with their Colt revolvers.

meta.name: Western Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

„Western Games“ features six competitions in the style of the Wild West, requiring skill, timing, and quick reactions. In arm wrestling, the joystick must be pulled back at the right moment while pressing the button to apply strength effectively. In beer shooting, the goal is to hit five beer glasses faster than the opponent, with increasing nervousness making aiming more difficult. In tobacco spitting, the right bite must be taken, chewed, and spit at the perfect angle to achieve maximum distance. In milking, the joystick is used rhythmically to follow the udder's movements, while opponents can be disrupted with an elbow strike. In dancing, movements must be performed in rhythm – if the pianist stops playing, he must be encouraged with beer to continue. In the eating contest, spooning, balancing, slurping, chewing, swallowing, and drinking must be done in the correct order, as mistakes lead to time loss due to burping.

A correct guess earns points, while an incorrect one wastes turns. The game requires a clever combination of logic and strategy to solve the puzzle before the other players.

All of Tarkus and Eugene's friends have been kidnapped and you and a friend have to search seven sectors and find them all. If a two player game is selected then both wheelies play at the same time. Any sector can be chosen but the higher the sector the more Wheelies to rescue and more enemies to avoid or shoot. The game is viewed from above at an angle and you must guide your wheelies vertically up the screen which scrolls as you move.

meta.name: Wheelin' Wallie
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wheelin' Wallie is a side view horizontally scrolling game where you have to guide Wallie and his wheel across the ground to reach the end of the level eating dots for points as well as three flashing dots. Wallie himself is separated from the wheel and floats above it but both will move together left or right when moved except if Wallie moves up, the wheel stays on the ground. There are various baddies that scroll from the left or the right and cannot be touched by Wallie or his wheel or you lose one of five lives. The top of the screen will also kill Wallie. There are other obstacles that need to be timed like water where the wheel will leave the ground but slowly floats down and can only be controlled left or right. Opening and closing platforms need to be timed to cross as well.

meta.name: Where's my Bones?
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Where's my Bones? puts you in the spectral shoes of Brother Jeffrey, a ghost searching for his scattered bones in a side-scrolling underground maze. Murdered by a jealous demon, BJ must now navigate deadly caverns filled with creatures, lightning, and moving blocks. Armed with nine shields and eight lives, you'll have to shoot or dodge enemies and avoid walls to reclaim your bones and finally rest in peace.

meta.name: Whirlinurd
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.54 KB

Nurds are always hungry and Naples Yerty, Hooseby Nurd, Hamish Pupkin and Melvin Lugby are no exception and require feeding so they must explore 50 levels to find four pieces of food on each level.

meta.name: Whirly Bird Attack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Prevent enemy helicopters from flying out of view on either side. Enemy helicopters can be shot with the continuous fire machine gun or when necessary with one of the 5 nuclear missiles. If the enemy reaches the side, you lose. Released as part of "Sky Fighters" game pack.

meta.name: Whirlybird
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.11 KB

Whirlybird is an arcade style game which puts you in control a military helicopter. Each level has two goals. Firstly, you must destroy an enemy naval vessel by travelling to an island to load your copter with a bomb, and then dropping it on the battleship. While you are thus engaged, you are beset by two fast moving motor-boats armed with diagonally firing guns whose bullets you must dodge. Once the ship has been destroyed, the next stage starts with black planes that rapidly moving from the left to the right of the screen. You must shoot down three of these planes and capture the crew after they bail out of the plane into the water. After three have been captured, you have a limited amount of time to return the prisoners to the island. If this time runs out, it is game over, regardless of how many of your five starting helicopters remain.

meta.name: Whistler's Brother
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Whistler's Brother sends you on the trail of your missing brother, whose mysterious return from a year-long expedition in the South American rainforest raises more questions than answers. Once fellow students, you chose an unconventional path while he pursued a career in archaeology – until he came back without equipment, without notes, and muttering about priceless ancient artifacts. Driven by concern and curiosity, you decide to retrace his journey and uncover the truth behind his strange behavior. Amid forgotten temples, cryptic clues, and hidden dangers, an adventure unfolds that weaves together past and present.

meta.name: White Barrows
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.81 KB

In The White Barrows you take the role of an adventurer entering a network of ancient burial mounds to recover a magical chalice stolen by an evil wizard. The underground complex consists of about forty interconnected rooms, and you begin the game placed randomly in one of them. As you move from room to room you encounter creatures such as gnomes, trolls and dragons while trying to locate the wizard's hiding place. With a limited pool of magic points you can inspect neighboring rooms or raise magical barriers, but every action consumes energy. Only by managing your resources carefully and navigating the maze of barrows wisely can you find the wizard before your magic runs out.

meta.name: White Viper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.79 KB

You are the White Viper, you were traveling with a princess when a demon appeared and kidnapped her. You tried in vain to repel the attack, but unfortunately it failed and along with your armor and sword, they were taken to the castle of an evil wizard. In this five-part game you must now cross the land, enter the castle and save the princess. The game is viewed from the side at an elevated angle and you must complete the five parts, collecting your sword and armor along the way to face the wizard, bring the princess home and marry her.

meta.name: The Whitehouse Blues
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

A platformer set in the trapped and treacherous areas around and under the White House. Earn points by staying alive and picking up treasure.
meta.genre: Plataformas / Corre y Salta con desplazamiento

meta.name: Who Dares Wins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.16 KB

"Who Dares Wins" puts the player in the role of an S.A.S. operative storming an American embassy to eliminate terrorists and rescue hostages. Behind a series of windows, both terrorists and hostages appear in different colors. The task is to identify the correct enemy color, aim the crosshair, and fire. Only six shots are available per round, and when they run out, a specific target in the bottom left must be hit to reload. Each terrorist eliminated earns a commendation, and accumulating enough points leads to a promotion. However, accidentally shooting a hostage results in a demotion. If the player is demoted to the lowest rank or time runs out, the game ends. The color of the terrorists may change throughout the game, requiring quick reflexes.

meta.name: Who Dares Wins (dk'tronics)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.36 KB

Who Dares Wins casts you as an S.A.S. soldier sent into an American embassy to free hostages from terrorists. Various windows display hostages and enemies wearing different colored tops, and you must shoot only the terrorists, identified by a specific color. You have just six bullets, after which you must shoot a target in the corner to reload. Each terrorist earns you a merit, and enough of them promotes you—shoot a hostage, and you're demoted. If you get demoted from Private or time runs out, it's game over. To make things trickier, terrorist colors can change mid-mission.

meta.name: Who Dares Wins II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.75 KB

"Who Dares Wins II" challenges the player to reclaim eight occupied settlements. In vertically scrolling levels, the player fights through enemy lines, armed with a rifle and five grenades. As enemies appear from different directions to attack, the objective is not only to eliminate them but also to rescue captured comrades tied to trees. The terrain provides strategic advantages, which both the enemies and the player can use for cover and better attack coordination. Levels feature natural and artificial obstacles like rivers with narrow bridges, potholes, and railway tracks that must be overcome.

meta.name: Who Done It?
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.70 KB

Who Done It? puts you in the shoes of Jack Stalk, a hard-boiled detective chasing down his latest case. You'll explore rooms, gather evidence, and piece together clues to uncover the culprit. Every choice matters – one wrong move could send you down the wrong path. Only sharp intuition and a keen eye for detail will lead you to the truth.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

meta.name: Who Framed Roger Rabbit
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“Who Framed Roger Rabbit” places the player in the role of Roger Rabbit, who has been wrongfully accused of murdering Marvin Acme, head of the Acme Corporation. Acme's will states that Toon Town would be left to the Toons upon his death, but the document is nowhere to be found. The player must locate the will and save Roger's wife, Jessica, from the sinister Judge Doom and his weasels.

meta.name: Who Killed Cock Robin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.27 KB

In Who Killed Cock Robin?, you investigate the murder of Cock Robin by guessing the animal, location, and time through strategic selections. At the start, you choose from three to six options in each category. After your guess, you're told how many details are correct, and you can select a hint for one category. The goal is to determine the correct answers in as few attempts as possible. In an additional game mode, you memorize the colors of a shown suspect and match them to a neutral character before the solution is revealed. The game offers two difficulty levels: Easier and More Difficult.

meta.desc: ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.37 KB

meta.name: Whopper Chase (Spain)

meta.name: Wibstars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.33 KB

You play the part of a software / hardware distributor in the 8-bit days. Buy computers and games then sell them to shops for a profit, perhaps collecting some more on the way from sloppy rivals that drop stuff out of the back of their trucks. Beware though, getting to the shops is only half the battle, there's a whole load of platforms and traps to pass as well. Gameplay varies between vertical scroller and side-on platformer.

meta.name: Wicked
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.34 KB

In Wicked, a big evil has come to the world and the player has to drive it back. To do so, the twelve astrological signs (with three levels each) have to be purged. The basic idea is that portals spit out spores which can be either good or evil. The goal is to produce enough good spores to overrun and destroy all evil portals before the screen is filled with bad spores.

meta.name: Widow's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.46 KB

Widows Revenge is based on the arcade game Centipede and has you controlling a small craft at the bottom of the screen trying to shoot all the spiders that move about the screen advancing downwards. Your craft can move left or right and forward a small distance and also backwards, back to the bottom of the screen. Occasionally the spiders will stop and fire a web downwards and this needs avoiding. On screen are pods and eggs that can be shot or collected for points and shooting an egg will turn it into a pod. Other creatures that appear are a giant spider that moves across the screen laying more eggs and a bat flies around the screen. If you touch any creature or a web then you lose one of four lives and once all spiders have been killed then it's onto the next level.

meta.name: Wilberforce : The Sorcerers Apprentice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The wizard's apprentice has accidentally cast a spell that brought all the brooms to life, and now you must fight them. There are five levels, with the first three set in a cave system featuring side-scrolling and screen transitions. Each of these levels contains four scrolls and a magical item (wand, silver broom, and winged helmet) that must be collected. You start with five lives and limited time, but extra lives can be found along the way. At the beginning, you have three weapons available: magical crystals, fireballs, and lightning bolts. The wand is unlocked starting from level 2. The last two levels are platform-based, requiring precise jumping. In level 4, you must collect four scrolls, and in level 5, you need to destroy witches.

meta.desc:

The Wild Bunch casts you as a wrongly accused fugitive in the Wild West, searching for a real killer from a notorious gang. With $50 and a gun, you explore five towns, gather clues, play poker, and track suspects while staying ahead of a Pinkerton Agent. Fire too soon or kill the wrong man, and it's game over. Only through smart investigation, careful resource management, and perfect timing can you clear your name and bring justice.

meta.name: Wild Ride
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You are a clown and it is your job to try to stop a crazy bomber from blowing up and destroying a local fairground's rollercoaster. The game is flick-screen and viewed from the side as you move left or right on top of the rollercoaster. Below the rollercoaster is a scanner and this shows your position, position of the bomber and the position of a bomb. When a bomb is placed it moves upwards, bounces off the top of the screen and moves downwards and if it hits the track then you lose one of three lives. You have to run along the track to the correct part of the coaster and touch the bomb. Once you stop enough bombs then you move to the next level.

meta.name: Wild Streets
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 86.23 KB

Un tornado de miedo ha caído sobre la ciudad: el jefe de la C.I.A, poseedor de muchos secretos de estado, desapareció después de ser amenazado por cabezas rapadas. Tus excepcionales habilidades de combate, tu pantera negra entrenada ... y tu 357 MAGNUM se pondrán a trabajar para encontrar al No. 1 del C.I.A en un universo hostil.

meta.name: Wild West
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You have lost Fort Snake to Big Nose Bill and his gang, and you are now seeking revenge and to get your fort back. Problem is, you are now stranded in the desert with no one or anything around to help. You must search the desert and surrounding areas to get to Big Nose Bill and your fort.
Wild West is a graphic adventure and with the aid of three sprites giving advice, you must choose the correct advice on every screen. The top of the screen has a 1st person perspective off your surroundings while the bottom half is where the sprites are. Using a joystick you push left, right or down to bring up each ones advice. Pressing the fire button selects that sprite's advice. Push up with the joystick and you get a percentage of the game completed.

But everything goes awry when an enigmatic fellow known only as "El Bandeeto" destroys your script and litters your equipment all over your studio. Your goal is to retrieve these things and then to safely arrive at the shooting location.

Wildfire is a horizontally scrolling space shooter where you pilot your ship like an aircraft, dodging enemy bases, crushing hammers, and electric discharges from nuclear-powered electrodes. Enemy ships arrive in shifting formations, making escape routes tight. Fire your weapons to survive the chaos and blast your way through.

meta.name: Wildfire
meta.desc:

Alien robots are attempting to burn down your city by entering buildings and setting them on fire. You have been tasked to enter each building separately with fire extinguishers and put out any flames that are started by the robots who enter the building.

meta.name: Wildfire : The Revenge!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wildfire: The Revenge! is an updated version of the original Wildfire game and follows the classic principle of horizontally scrolling shooters. Players navigate through various levels, avoiding obstacles, shooting enemies, and surviving increasingly difficult waves of foes. The game features improved graphics and refined sound, leveraging the technological advancements compared to its predecessor. The difficulty is higher, with more complex enemy patterns, stronger bosses, and more challenging level designs. Players continue to face off against enemies in a futuristic space environment.

meta.name: William Wobbler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

William Wobbler puts you in control of William, whose goal is to collect ten scattered clues hidden within mysterious caverns. Your journey begins on the surface of an alien planet, where craters serve as entrances to the caves. Inside, you'll face numerous puzzles and obstacles: snakes to leap over, flying objects to duck beneath, and droids blocking your path. A special glowing orb can be found in one of the caves – once collected, it destroys every droid you encounter when it materializes. Skill and precise timing are essential to gather all the clues and complete the challenge.

The player can go through all the sequences in order, or read the story in the form of a scrolling manuscript and click on keywords to jump to a particular action sequence.

Chang and Koong-Shee are in love. The problem is that Chang is an employee and Koong-Shee is a princess. To make matters worse, she is forced against her will to marry a merchant named Ta Jin and is held in the grand palace grounds of a Mandarin palace. You play Chang and have to enter the palace grounds, get a key and find the princess's hiding place, which is guarded by giants, rescue her from the grounds and take her far away in a boat.

meta.name: Willy the Worm : Part II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.73 KB

Willy the Worm: Part II brings the familiar worm back in a compact, experimental experience focused on inertial, physics-driven movement. You guide Willy through straightforward yet demanding sections where momentum, direction changes, and control are crucial. Rather than scope or variety, the appeal lies in mastering movement itself – every mistake has immediate consequences, making precise handling the key challenge.

meta.name: Wimbledon '64
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.51 KB

Wimbledon'64 is a tennis game for two players viewed from one end of the court at an elevated angle. Before the game starts there are various options that can be selected and they are, Difficulty level (0-3), how many sets (1-3) and the speed of the ball (Slow or fast). The game follows the rules of tennis and the player has the ability to use backhand, forehand, lob and smash. The winner is the player to reach the number of sets chosen before the game.

meta.name: Win, Lose or Draw
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Win, Lose or Draw brings the concept of a well-known guessing show into an interactive format centered on creativity and lateral thinking. One player illustrates words or phrases while the others must interpret the often literal drawings to uncover their meaning. The appeal comes from the mix of imagination, interpretation and communication, as simple sketches can spark wildly different ideas – lighthearted in flow, humorous in outcome and firmly focused on shared guessing fun.

meta.name: Wing Commander
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.98 KB

Wing Commander puts you in the cockpit of a fighter jet patrolling a tropical island. Your mission is to protect key sites – especially the nuclear power plant – from enemy fighters attacking the island. After taking off from the runway, you freely navigate the skies, chasing enemy jets and defending your territory with precision and speed. Three skill levels – Novice, Pilot, and Ace – determine how relentless your opponents will be. A classic air combat experience demanding quick reflexes and a sharp eye on the horizon.

meta.name: The Wings of Circe
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Wings of Circe, Odysseus has been captured and cursed by a dark wizard. To save him, Circe transforms into Pegasus, the winged horse. As Pegasus, you soar through a mythical world battling dragons, hawk men, and skeletons. Only courage and skill will free Odysseus from the wizard's grasp – an action-filled tale of magic and legend.

meta.name: Wings of Fury
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wings of Fury es un juego de acción con algunos toques de simulación, en el que pilotas un avión estadounidense F6F Hellcat. El juego se ambienta en el Pacífico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Tu misión es derrotar a los japoneses destruyendo búnkeres, nidos de ametralladoras y barracones enemigos en una serie de islas. Los barracones y los nidos de ametralladoras se pueden bombardear con bombas convencionales, mientras que tendrás que usar cohetes para destruir los búnkeres de hormigón. Tras un bombardeo exitoso, regresa para aniquilar a los soldados japoneses con tus ametralladoras. También tendrás que hundir acorazados japoneses con torpedos y participar en combates aéreos con aviones de combate enemigos. Comienzas cada misión despegando desde un portaaviones, que deberás proteger de los ataques de los torpederos japoneses. Cuando te quedes sin combustible, bombas, cohetes o munición de ametralladora, puedes reponerlos volviendo a tu portaaviones. Tu portaaviones también es el lugar donde puedes reparar los daños de tu avión.

meta.name: Wings of War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

Wings of War lets you take to the skies in search of glory and adrenaline, piloting 36 of World War II's most iconic fighters and bombers. Engage in four thrilling scenarios – intercept V-1 rockets, fly as a night fighter, take down enemy bombers, or battle it out in intense dogfights. Precision, courage, and quick reflexes are your keys to survival – the sky shows no mercy.

It is your job to locate all the objects, determine who the proper owners are, and return them. You had better hurry though, before the wind returns again! Along the way you'll meet all the familiar Winnie The Pooh characters including Eeyore, Owl, Tigger, and Piglet.

meta.name: Winter Camp
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Winter Camp est la suite de Summer Camp. Maximus la Souris est désormais maître-nageur au Camp Nice'n'Icy, mais il remarque bientôt un oiseau qui jette un caillou du haut d'une montagne, déclenchant une avalanche qui menace d'engloutir le camp s'il ne l'arrête pas. Le type de niveau le plus courant est la patrouille. Il en existe trois: patinage sur glace, bateau et ski. Dans chaque niveau, vous devez effectuer un certain nombre de sauvetages. Les niveaux contiennent divers obstacles et objets à éviter. À la fin de chaque niveau se trouve un boss à vaincre grâce aux objets collectés. D'autres niveaux incluent un entraînement au patinage, une bataille de boules de neige avec des ours cachés dans les arbres et un jeu de mémoire avec une apparition de Clyde Radcliffe de la série Creatures. La plupart des niveaux ont une limite de temps, indiquée par l'oiseau qui se dirige vers le caillou.

meta.name: Winter Olympiad 88
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This is a winter sports game that lets you compete in five Olympic events: Downhill skiing, Biathlon, Slalom, Ski Jump and Bob Sled. It is very similar to offerings like Winter Games from Epyx.
In Downhill skiing, you must avoid the obstacles and make it to the bottom of the hill, by swerving left and right and adjusting your speed by pushing the joystick forward and back. The Slalom is similar, involving skiing around flags.
In the ski jump, you must position the skis for a proper landing. In the bobsled event, you must carefully control the angles so your bobsled doesn't flip. The Biathlon event combines skiing to shooting ranges and shooting the targets archery-style.

"Winter Games" es el sucesor de "Summer Games", que presenta diversas competiciones de deportes de invierno donde los participantes representan a diferentes naciones. En disciplinas como esquí alpino, salto de esquí, biatlón, bobsleigh, patinaje artístico, patinaje de velocidad, luge y esquí acrobático, la precisión en los controles, la habilidad y la sincronización son esenciales para alcanzar el máximo rendimiento. Cada deporte presenta sus propios desafíos, ya sea el control perfecto de las curvas en bobsleigh, la salida ideal en salto de esquí o la precisión en la puntería en biatlón. Las competiciones requieren una combinación de reflejos, estrategia y técnica, y cada disciplina ofrece una experiencia de juego única, permitiendo que tanto jugadores individuales como competidores se enfrenten entre sí.

meta.name: Winter Supersports 92
meta.desc:

Winter Supersports 92 is a sports game with eight events from the Winter Olympiad. The basic goal is to participate in all events in a row (events can be deselected, though) and the player with the most points is the winner. If multiple players participate, two of them are playing at the same time on a split-screen. Then the next batch of two starts.
Downhill Skiing, Giant Slalom, Pro Ski Challenge are downhill courses in which the player has to circuit obstacles.
The Bale Jumping and Speed Skating events require the player to alternate pressing left and right while keeping a rhythm.
Bobsled and Luge are also similar to each other: the athletes are shown from behind and the player has to steer the bob/luge. The bob additionally has a brake.
Skidoo Racing consists of a top-down course which needs to be completed as fast as possible. Only a part of the course is shown at a time; the screen scrolls.
