meta.name: Winter Wonderland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 49.65 KB

After studying and working as a Anthropologist for ten years you finally have the chance to make a huge discovery to put your name in the history books. Your Soviet friend Sergio has discovered a lost civilisation in the Himalayas, Tibet and has asked you to come to get your advice. After landing at the airport in Tibet and you being a qualified pilot, you hire a plane to fly near the site of the lost civilisation. The weather in the Himalayas can change so quickly and you find yourself flying in a snow storm pushing you higher until your engine is unable to cope and stalls. Noticing a huge snowfield below you decide to land there and try to walk the rest of the way on foot, if you survive the landing. The plane crashes but you escape the crash unscathed. Lost and alone in freezing temperatures you must try to survive and find your friend Sergio.

meta.name: Wipeout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wipeout is based on an American TV game show of the same name, televised during the late 1980's. There are 16 answers displayed on the board, 11 correct and 5 incorrect. The objective is to choose all 11 correct answers ($25 increments) without choosing a wipeout (incorrect answer). There is a "Hot Spot" prize behind one of the correct answers which adds additional money to the player's winnings. A wipeout will cause all their money to be lost including any money won on the "Hot Spot".

meta.name: Wishbringer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In this game, the player controls a postal clerk in the small fishing village of Festeron. The postmaster, Mr. Crisp, orders the player to deliver an envelope to the owner of Ye Olde Magick Shoppe. However, this seemingly innocent task inexplicably leads to a strange phenomenon: as the hero steps out, he finds that Festeron has been mysteriously transformed into a dark, ominous town called Witchville. Even cute little poodles have turned into hellhounds! Finding the Wishbringer, a stone that grants seven wishes to those who possess the right objects, seems like the only solution - or is it?

Amid a sudden fog, he loses his bearings and, after hours of wandering, stumbles upon a cabin. An old woman with white hair invites him to rest, places a blue hat on his head, and explains how he can find his way home before vanishing. Following her advice, he puts on the hat, and everything spins around him, leaving him in a strange, eerie place.

Filbur Apse was a particularly obnoxious person, who enjoyed upsetting and annoying anyone and everyone he came into contact with. One day, however, he went too far, annoying a seemingly harmless old man who turned out to be a wizard in disguise. As a punishment the wizard cast a spell which changed Filbur so that he was no longer obnoxious - and took all the fun out of his life! Can he find the magic ingredients that will make him thoroughly detestable once more? Part of the Classic Quests series.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.39 KB

The Witch's Cauldron is a text adventure with graphics where the protagonist is turned into a slimy toad by the witch Hazel, apparently inspired by the classic fairy tale The Frog King. Imprisoned on the witch's island, the player needs to get the main character back to his original form by collecting ingredients and mixing them into the cauldron, with complementary adventure game puzzles.

meta.name: WitchSwitch
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.11 KB

WitchSwitch throws you into an adventure where a village is threatened by a volcanic eruption and a river of lava. Only a wizard with the power of reversal can stop the disaster, but he depends on the help of the witch, who is under an evil curse. To free her, a pouch of magic powder must be carried through dangerous lands – first by the monkey, who lassoes a leprechaun to guide him through a swamp full of hazards, then across a bridge where ravens must be driven away and cats jumped over. The owl then takes over, flying across an acid lake while avoiding lightning and creatures until reaching the forest. There more dangers await, including a snail that must be stopped, before the powder is dropped into the witch's cauldron. This breaks the curse, allowing her to reach the wizard and save the village. Mistakes cost lives, and different skill levels ensure the challenge remains constant.

meta.name: The Witness
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Witness is a text adventure in which the player takes control of a police detective working near Los Angeles. The year is 1938, and on this stormy February night a wealthy but frightened man has asked the detective for protection. In spite of his best efforts, a death occurs, and the hero has twelve hours to solve the mystery and try to arrest the killer. If the player thinks there is enough evidence against one or more suspects to convince a jury of their guilt, he can arrest them and conclude the case.

meta.name: Wiz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.08 KB

Wiz transports you to the realms of Midgard and Neflheim, long bound together by a powerful spell as evil now begins to seep through. As a novice wizard, you seek to gain enough power to cast a mighty spell that could separate the worlds once and for all. Viewed from above, you battle through maze-like areas, firing magical bolts at waves of enemies. Beyond combat, you can study, prepare, and purchase new spells, but they must be cast in real time – and a miscast can have disastrous consequences. Powerful master wizards attempt to stop you at every turn – a tactical action adventure blending combat skill with careful spellcraft.

meta.name: Wiz-Biz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.67 KB

Wiz Biz is a text-based adventure with graphical elements in which you play as Ralph, a somewhat tipsy wizard with a fondness for drink. After a lively night in which he turned a man into a pink salamander for fun, Ralph wakes up in the dungeon of that very man's castle. Your task is to escape the gloomy cell by examining your surroundings, issuing clever commands, and combining items wisely. A humorous premise meets classic parser-style puzzles – a lighthearted escape adventure filled with magic and mishaps.

En Wizard, te embarcas en una búsqueda del tesoro llena de acción a través de cuarenta pantallas bellamente diseñadas llenas de magia, peligro y secretos. Salta sobre los huecos, esquiva las flechas mortales, escape de los trolls de lava y recoge las llaves para llegar a la salida de tu próxima aventura. Use escaleras, cuerdas, ascensores y puertas correderas para navegar los niveles mientras arroja bolas de fuego a enemigos animados y recolectan gemas brillantes. El objetivo es acumular puntos y subir a las filas de los diez mejores magos.

meta.desc:

King George's daughter Priscilla has been kidnapped by an evil wizard named Harlin, who holds her in his castle. The King offers half of his kingdom to anyone who would venture into the faraway mountain land, enter the castle, defeat Harlin, and bring back the princess. Only one adventurer is brave enough to accept this challenge.
The Wizard and the Princess is a text adventure with graphics. The game's environments are composed of still shots viewed from first-person perspective. The player types combinations of verbs and objects to interact with the game world, move between locations, solve puzzles, and advance the story.
The IBM PC version, entitled Adventure in Serenia, is the exact same game, with the exception of the plot introduction, which is described as a sequel to The Wizard and the Princess: Harlin uses the sands of time to undo his demise by the brave wanderer, and the player has to defeat him once again.

meta.name: Wizard Expert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wizard Expert builds on a familiar game concept and expands it with new challenges that show how creatively players could continue working with existing ideas. Rather than simply repeating what was already there, this modified version adds extra sections and its own variations, making the familiar adventure feel fresher and more demanding. Its special appeal comes from that fan-driven origin, because Wizard Expert is not just a game to be played, but a clear example of an existing concept being carried forward with new imagination.

The Wizard of Akyrz is the eighth game in the Mysterious Adventures series. The player begins in the royal palace, where the king asks him to save his daughter from an evil wizard. If the player should succeed, his reward will be priceless. Most instructions are either 90-degree compass moves, or verb-noun commands such as "get painting", "fit chain" or "climb tree". On the player's journey he will discover treasures, which must be stored in a special room, reached via a spell. The game engine has been redone to allow complete sentences, instead of the two-word Scott Adams parser that was used previously.

meta.name: Wizard of Id's Wizmath
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 171.42 KB

"Wizard of Id's WizMath" follows Spook, who must escape from the dungeons of the King of Id while being pursued by Turnkey. To unlock his path to freedom, he must solve math problems. Using the joystick, blocks can be moved into place to form a correct equation. When pushed, a block slides until it hits a wall or obstacle. Alternatively, a block can be held and precisely moved. The challenge is to solve the problem within a 60-second time limit before Turnkey catches Spook. Early levels require solving just one equation, while later stages demand multiple solutions. At the beginning, the player selects a floor in an elevator — higher floors present harder math problems. The game also asks for the player's age and suggests a difficulty level accordingly, though a lower floor can be selected.

The Wizard of Id's WizType is an edutainment title based on the comic strip created by artist Brant Parker and writer Johnny Hart. The title is designed to give keyboard novices lessons on how to improve their typing accuracy and speed.

Based on the famous novel by L. Frank Baum, The Wizard of Oz places the player in the role of Dorothy Gale who is transported by a cyclone to the magical world of Oz. Accompanied by her dog Toto, a Scarecrow, a Tin Woodman and a Lion, she tries to find her way to the Emerald City, where she hopes the Wizard of Oz can help her find a way back home.
Gameplay-wise, The Wizard of Oz is a typical text adventure. The player can type in various commands to interact with the game world, manipulate objects, talk to NPCs or ask Dorothy's companions for help.

En Wizard of Wor, controlas a un supuesto Guerrero a través de un laberinto lleno de criaturas mortales. Tu objetivo es conseguir la mayor cantidad de puntos posible disparando a los monstruos antes de que te atrapen. Algunos enemigos se mueven rápidamente o incluso se vuelven invisibles por un tiempo. Un radar en la parte inferior de la pantalla te ayuda a localizar enemigos ocultos. Los reflejos, la precisión y la percepción espacial son clave para sobrevivir a las oleadas cada vez más desafiantes.

Wizard of Words teaches grammar and spelling through a playful approach built around several varied challenges. Across different word and letter puzzles, you practice careful reading, correct spelling and recognizing language patterns. Progress comes from repetition and focus, while the range of activities keeps the learning process engaging. The appeal lies in combining knowledge, concentration and the satisfaction of gaining confidence with language skills.

En Wizard Plus, te embarcas en una cacería de monstruos a través de mazmorras laberínticas, ya sea en solitario o con un amigo. Los enemigos deambulan por los estrechos pasillos, pero con disparos certeros puedes eliminarlos antes de que te atrapen. El movimiento táctico, los reflejos rápidos y la buena coordinación son clave para sobrevivir en cada mazmorra. Como clon del clásico Wizard of Wor, Wizard Plus presenta una jugabilidad familiar con gráficos ligeramente actualizados y una estética renovada.

meta.name: Wizard Warz
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wizard Warz is an overhead view action RPG using "classic" graphics. You start of the game as an apprentice wizard with four minor spells, and aim to defeat 7 master wizards to become the chief wizard yourself. To aid you in your quest you must return six treasures to their rightful owners and find more powerful spells. 
There are also numerous monsters to fight on your travels, each with their own strengths and weaknesses to your offensive magical barrage.
You can also use a familiar to help your mission - for example, having a crow will let you see the furthest distance.

meta.name: Wizard Willy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.41 KB

The titular wizard has to rescue a princess named Fifi from a dark fortress where she is held captive by an evil emperor. The only way to reach the fortress is by collecting ten magic eyes scattered across four levels, and defeating the demonic guardians who will try to impede Willy's progress.
Wizard Willy is an action game with platform elements. Willy can fire lightning bolts at the many enemies who intervene. The enemies are dangerous to touch, but don't fire back until later levels. Four icons are available to collect. One kills all monsters in the area, another gives an extra life, the third restores Willy to full strength at his current life, and the last restocks his lightning bolts. The levels incorporate forests (which include climbable trees), dungeons, stairways and fortresses.

meta.name: Wizard's Crown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wizard's Crown is a fantasy role-playing game in which the player creates a party of up to eight adventurers and takes them on a quest to retrieve a magical crown from a wizard named Tarmon, who sealed himself and the crown in his laboratory five hundred years ago.nnnnnnThe game features tactical battles, during which the player navigates the party members in turns over the battlefield. Different weapons demonstrate unique characteristics; for example, spears can attack two squares away, flails ignore the enemy's shields, and axes have a chance of breaking them completely. Shields are used to defend against frontal attacks and those coming from whatever side the shield is equipped on. The player can opt to skip these details and have the battle proceed automatically.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Basado en la jugabilidad básica y las ideas visuales de Ultimate's Atac, Wizard's Laiz empieza explorando Pothole Pete, el cuál está atrapado en Lair hasta que pueda encontrar las cuatro piezas del Leon de Oro. El juego tiene una ligera vista vertical, con cuartos interiores delimitados por pequeñas lineas para variar de los escenarios enteros de jungla.
El ritmo del juego es bastante rápido, Y el desafío de las acciones se incrementa al no tener arsenal infinito. La ruta del juego no es lineal, es común encontrarse con múltiples salidas y cuartos secretos. Además la pantalla siempre tiene una área particular, a diferencia de las diversas secciones vistas en Atic Atac (lo cuál significaba que tenias que buscar la forma de llegar a otras secciones a través de las diferentes pantallas),  Un río es una sección central del dibujado, y delimita ciertas secciones de la pantalla.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.23 KB

Wizard's Tower is a two-dimensional RPG built with PETSCII graphics that drops you into a randomly generated fantasy world. Each new game creates a fresh map, meaning locations, encounters and routes vary slightly every time. You explore forests and dungeons, face creatures and dangers, and gradually develop your character. The experience blends exploration, combat and role-playing elements into a classic adventure driven by discovery and unpredictability.

En Wizardry I: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord, el demente Trebor poseyó un poderoso amuleto antes de que el malvado archimago Werdna lo robara. Un hechizo fallido de Werdna crea una mazmorra de diez niveles bajo el castillo de Trebor, que Werdna reclama como su guarida. Wizardry: Knight of Diamonds is the sequel to Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord. Wizardry V: Heart of the Maelstrom continues the story from Legacy of Llylgamyn. The peace brought by L'kbreth's Orb is shattered when chaotic forces begin to rise from beneath the Temple of Sages. These energies concentrate in the Maelstrom, a vast system of tunnels. A party of six adventurers is sent to find the Gatekeeper, the only one capable of sealing the chaos – but he is imprisoned by a rogue sorceress named Sorn. As the party descends through eight levels, they seek help from the Card Lords, appease them by retrieving their suits, and unlock the path to the Heart of the Maelstrom. There, a final battle with Sorn ensues. With her defeat, the Gatekeeper grants the Heart of Abriel, restoring order to Llylgamyn.

Its surreal presentation and fairy-tale-like oddness give the adventure a character all its own. The result is a distinctive game that draws much of its appeal from atmosphere, pace, and its curious core idea.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Wobbler is a puzzle game for one or two players where you must remove a set number of tiles from the screen. Each shot clears blocks when the patterns match – at the start you have a joker stone that can remove any pattern. With every hit, new stones appear, and special mechanics like swaps or deflecting walls make things trickier. A time limit adds extra tension to each round. In addition to the original levels, there are extra stages and even an editor that lets you create your own puzzles. Wobbler offers varied challenges that demand tactical thinking and precise timing.

meta.desc:

With time pressure and limited jumps adding to the tension, it's a balancing act of skill, patience, and quick reflexes.

meta.name: Wolfman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

You wake up one morning, covered in blood but seemingly uninjured. Could the rumours about a Werewolf's curse having returned be true, and could you be the one struck with this curse? Yes, they could. The game is split into three parts, played through the eyes of a different character each time. In the first you are the Werewolf's host, and must beat the curse back. Sex is added to ultra-violence in part 2; you play the woman who loves him, and must survive a night of passion. In part 3 you play the host again, and must reach Fi Shan monastery to find the cure.

t is a normal day at the Wombles' burrow. Orinoco is very hungry, Wellington is outside dodging the human beings, Great Uncle Bulgaria is hoping that someone will have dropped a copy of today's "The Times". It is time for the young Wombles to go out onto the common to find the litter. Great Uncle Bulgaria gives them a special task to look out for a copy of The Times and to bring it back as soon as they can. Tobermory tells them that he will also be out and about and will need them to find various items for the new marvelous invention that he is working on. He gives them the usual warning..."Watch out for the human beings!". Get wombling young Wombles!

Wonderball tells the tale of Sherlie's abduction and Dave's curse into a bouncing iron ball. As Dave, you roll through dangerous levels filled with water, spikes, and nasty creatures like Fireflies and Gugglies. Precision is key, as enemies appear based on your position, not time. Entering yellow underground sections starts a game of chance – offering extra lives, points, or bitter losses.

Antes de enfrentarse al hechicero en su castillo, Tom Tom tendrá que vagar por bosques poblados de arañas, saltar de plataforma en plataforma sobre el agua y atravesar una cueva llena de murciélagos. Como potenciador, Tom-Tom puede conseguir un monopatín, que puede ser difícil de dirigir. El objetivo del protagonista es rescatar a su amiga Tanya.

Esta entrega introduce las monedas de oro, obtenidas al vencer enemigos, que pueden intercambiarse con comerciantes por equipo que mejora las capacidades del protagonista, haciéndolo más eficaz en su aventura.

Wonderland sends you on an exploratory journey through a mysterious world where four magical crystals are hidden. Your mission is to locate them, overcome dangers, and bring each one to the Altar of the Winds. Along the way, you must navigate the landscape, avoid obstacles, and find the correct paths. Only when all four crystals are placed in their rightful position is your quest complete – a classic adventure that rewards exploration and persistence.

The thunder of broadsides mixes with the creaking of rigging as frigates maneuver into perilous positions. The outcome of battle depends on tactical decisions, as captains strive to gain the wind advantage and break through enemy lines. Legendary sailors like John Paul Jones aboard Bonhomme Richard, Admiral Nelson on H.M.S. Victory, and Lawrence of the Chesapeake set sail once again. With a simultaneous movement system, each turn remains uncertain, making every decision critical to victory or defeat.

meta.name: Woody the Worm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Woody the Worm is a tense test of skill. You guide Woody through tight mazes, collecting treasures for extra points while avoiding walls and patrolling enemies – one mistake and it's over. Early levels are especially brutal, with narrow corridors and fast enemy loops you must memorize to survive. Limited shields grant brief protection against enemies but not against the deadly scenery. Bonus items can be collected for higher scores, but doing so greatly increases the risk. Later, the game shifts to a hen-house, where you must gather keys to unlock a door while dodging aggressive chickens and a patrolling rooster. Here, shields are replaced by a turbo boost that doubles Woody's speed, though it must be carefully managed under a strict time limit.

n: Woolly Jumper - Sheep in Mind Space (Europe) (Unl)

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Woolly Jumper, you help Pepito, a lost sheep, escape the surreal world of Mindspace. Guide him through 16 levels guarded by green Martians, space chickens, and wobbling worms. The full version features enhanced graphics and refined jump mechanics as you navigate obstacles and safely lead Pepito through the nightmare landscape. Skill and timing are key to bringing him to freedom.

meta.name: Word
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.83 KB

Word challenges you with an unusual text-driven concept where thinking, reading and quick comprehension take center stage. Instead of direct action, you progress through instructions, rules and tasks that are presented in a deliberately playful and slightly ironic way. Advancement depends less on reflexes and more on attention, understanding and a willingness to embrace the game's quirks. Its appeal lies in its experimental approach, subverting expectations and encouraging the player to uncover the true essence of the experience.

meta.name: Word Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Word Challenge is a 1-player word forming game similar to the Parker Brother's game Boggle. In standard mode, players are given a 4 x 4 grid of 16 randomized letters, with the goal of making as many 3-or-more letter words as possible in a period of time. Words must be formed by using the next nearby letter, and each letter can only be used once in forming a word. The game includes a built-in dictionary, and only available words may be used to score points. The player competes against a computer opponent, with the goal of typing more correct words in a given time period than the computer opponent discovers. Players can modify the skill of the computer opponent, timer time, size of the game board, scoring method, and other aspects.

meta.name: Word Feud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Word Feud, it's not just about speed, but also accuracy. It's not enough to quickly find a matching word in the maze and move the window over it. You must ensure it's the correct word, which means you have to find the other copy! Remember, even if you think you've found the right word, it could still be the wrong one, as each round features a decoy word designed to confuse you. The decoy word can even be the same as the hidden word but in different colors!

meta.name: Word Flyer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Word Flyer is an educational game where two birds stand on a tower of letters. Individual letters or up to four-letter words appear on the screen and float toward the players. The goal is to select the correct word from the tower and quickly move it so that it matches the floating words. When the words are matched correctly, a gray bar at the bottom of the screen fills up. Once the bar is full, the game progresses to a more difficult level. The game starts with simple one-letter associations and increases in difficulty across five levels.

p: Word Games with the Mr. Men (Europe).T64
n: Word Games with the Mr. Men (Europe)

meta.name: Word Games with the Mr. Men
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.76 KB

„Word Games with the Mr. Men“ offers a collection of educational games featuring characters from Roger Hargreaves' children's books, designed for kids aged 5 to 8. The games help improve reading skills and introduce new words in a playful way. In „Mr. Noisy's Word Game,“ children learn about opposites, comparatives, and superlatives, with nine different activities to choose from. Other tasks involve matching words with pictures or selecting the opposite of a displayed word. „Read with Mr. Bounce“ teaches words like „above,“ „inside,“ and „on“ in various contexts. The game includes a specially designed keyboard overlay with small letters for better clarity, as well as an illustrated instruction manual for adults to guide children through the learning process.

meta.name: Word Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Word Invaders, the player uses their typing skills to save Earth from a space invasion. By accurately and quickly typing words, the attackers are shot down. With four difficulty levels, the game provides a steady challenge and helps improve typing proficiency. Combining effective learning with exciting action, it turns practicing typing techniques into a fun and engaging experience.

meta.name: Word Search II : Printer Version
meta.desc:

Word Search II: Printer Version lets you create your own word search puzzle for printing. You enter a list of words and define the grid size, which can be up to 38 characters wide and 22 high. The words are randomly placed in the grid, which is then sent to the printer. The screen is only used for setup – the game itself is played with pen and paper.

meta.name: Word Wobbler (Europe)

"Wordpower" is an educational game designed to expand vocabulary and improve spelling. Featuring over 1200 words across five categories – synonyms, similes, collectives, nouns, and their adjectives – the game helps enhance language skills and discover new ways of expression. Players can start with one of the two games: "Lines" is easier than "Shooting." Once familiar with the words, the writing option can be used to solidify spelling accuracy.

meta.name: Wordsearch

Wordsearch is a fascinating game for all ages. Try to find the hidden words in the letter maze before your time runs out. Different levels of difficulty and over forty different topics.

meta.name: Workman

“Workman” is a platform game where the player navigates a constantly changing level to collect diamonds and useful items. These items allow the player to modify the level and complete it within the given time limit. Three difficulty levels provide the option to jump straight into more challenging stages. Skill and strategy are essential for success.

meta.name: World Boxing Champ

meta.name: World Capitals : Countries and Capitals
meta.desc:

In World Capitals: Countries and Capitals, you're presented with capital cities like “Vienna” and must type in the corresponding country. This simple, text-based quiz tests your geographical knowledge and is perfect for learning or sharpening your understanding of countries and their capitals.

meta.name: World Champion Icehockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.14 KB

A hockey game where you can either compete for the World Cup or select a practice match. In World Cup mode, up to nine players can participate. On the ice, two teams face off with the goal of getting the puck into the opponent's net as many times as possible. The winner is the team with the most goals after 90 seconds of gameplay, potentially followed by overtime. You control one player at a time, identified by their jersey color, and control automatically switches to the player closest to the puck. In the Italian version, "Hockey Pista," the game was adapted to roller hockey, replacing the puck with a ball.

meta.name: World Champions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.63 KB

In World Champions, Premier II, and Premier League, you take control of a team in a 16-team Super League and aim for success in the league. You can select your team and substitutes for each match, taking into account injuries and suspensions throughout the season. Substitutes can be used at halftime or later during the 90-second real-time games. Between matches, you can buy and sell players, with each player having a rating of up to 9 for skill and form.

meta.name: World Championship Boxing Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In World Championship Boxing Manager you take the role of a manager guiding a heavyweight boxer from his early fights toward a potential world title. From your office you plan training, set tactics for upcoming bouts and negotiate fight purses and event opportunities. You must decide whether your fighter should focus on stamina, punching power or defense while also considering past injuries and the strengths of future opponents. With a large roster of rivals you gradually climb the rankings by selecting manageable fights and securing favorable deals. During the matches ringside commentary describes the action and hints at the judges' opinions – and you can adjust your boxer's tactics at any time to influence the outcome of the fight.

meta.name: World Championship Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.37 KB

In World Championship Soccer, you choose from 24 national teams to compete in a tournament modeled after the 1990 World Cup. You can customize your starting lineup to balance strengths and weaknesses. In addition to the tournament, you can play single matches against the CPU or a friend. The game is viewed from above with large player sprites, and rough play is encouraged – no free kicks or offsides mean fast, no-holds-barred soccer where only the ball matters.

meta.name: World Championship Squash
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.28 KB

World Championship Squash as the name suggests is a computer version of Squash for one to two players. You can play either a single match or play in a tournament. You have the choice of eight players as well to choose from. The number of rounds, skill level and ball type can also be adjusted. Normal squash rules apply and the server can only score a point.

meta.name: World Class Blackjack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

World Class Blackjack delivers a straightforward take on the classic card game, where you face the casino and aim to get as close to 21 points as possible. You choose when to draw, stand, or double down, constantly balancing risk against potential reward. Clean displays and a steady pace keep the focus on strategy and odds. The appeal comes from the familiar gameplay and the challenge of making smart decisions over time.

meta.name: World Class Leaderboard
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

World Class Leaderboard marca el final de la serie "Leader Board", desarrollada por Access antes de su conocida franquicia "Links". El viento, la sincronización y la potencia son factores clave para que los jugadores naveguen por búnkeres, obstáculos de agua y rough, lo que hace que los campos sean más desafiantes que en las versiones de 8 bits del original. Incluye un editor de campos. Los campos disponibles incluyen ubicaciones reales como St. Andrews, así como diseños ficticios como "The Gauntlet", que, como su nombre indica, está diseñado para llevar tus habilidades al límite.

meta.name: World Class Rugby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.99 KB

Like Domark's Rugby: The World Cup, World Class Rugby was released alongside the 1991 Rugby World Cup, which was won by New Zealand in a final against England. Recreating this full 16-team event is an option, as are individual friendly matches and an 8-team league.

meta.name: World Cricket
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.11 KB

Time to take to the field and manage a cricket team. This one-player game allows you to choose your team from seven countries and play versus the other ones. You can choose from three lengths of tour (home and abroad). These tours include one-day, three-day and a full blown test match.
The game is a standard managerial game with icons on the menu screen to allow you to manage your team. When you play a match a scoreboard appears with the runs totting up. Occasionally the game will show a highlight of a decisive moment. This is a side view, first showing the bowler then the batsman. Here the ball can hit the wicket. If the batsman hits the ball then it either shows a catch or a six.
During the game if you are batting you can choose the next batsman when a wicket has fallen or if you are bowling then when things need changing you can change bowler.

meta.name: World Cup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.39 KB

World Cup is a football game where you and seven friends can pick one of 10 teams and compete to get to the final and win it. The computer will play as the other teams not selected. The match action is viewed from the side above the pitch and the screen shows just a part of the pitch. The screen scrolls when a player moves with the ball. A joystick or keyboard can be used to control your team.

meta.name: World Cup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.91 KB

World Cup is a complete management strategy game, where you select your squad; try to qualify and then win the World Cup. With 39 international teams against you, it's not going to be easy. Watch your opposition, pick your friendlies carefully, hope you don't get too many injuries. Bring on your youngsters steadily, to fit your team. Hope the results go your way. Are you the best?

meta.name: World Cup Carnival : Mexico '86
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.17 KB

“World Cup Carnival: Mexico '86” is the first officially FIFA-licensed football game. It includes licensed elements and additional extras like a badge and a wall chart. In addition to the actual matches, there is a training mode featuring juggling exercises as well as penalty shooting and saving. Formations cannot be adjusted, and each match lasts three minutes.

meta.name: World Cup Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 83.91 KB

“World Cup Soccer” is based on the 1986 FIFA World Cup and offers two programs: the “World Cup Fact File” and the “World Cup Manager.” In the Fact File, players can review World Cup facts or answer quiz questions alone or with a friend, choosing from five options per question, with speed affecting the score. In the Manager mode, players select a team and aim to lead it to the final. Game highlights are displayed in text format, and during penalty kicks, players choose the direction for shooting or saving. In the second phase, players can participate in mini-games, such as headers or shooting drills, to earn points that influence the match outcome.

meta.name: World Cup Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

“World Cup Soccer” is a football game where players select one of ten teams and attempt to fight their way to the final and claim victory. Non-selected teams are controlled by the computer. The on-field action is displayed from a side view, with the screen scrolling as a player runs with the ball. The team can be controlled using a joystick or keyboard.

meta.name: World Cup Soccer : Italia '90
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.15 KB

This football simulation focuses on international football, allowing you to play a tournament or single friendly matches. Up to 8 human players can be involved in the tournament. Options include three skill levels, variable match lengths and a choice of sound or music (or both on some versions).
The match is viewed from the side, although it switches to a 3D view when the ball is close to the goal. The ball roughly sticks to the player's foot. Set pieces are controlled by moving an aiming cross-hair.

meta.name: World Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

"World Games" is a multi-event sports simulation where players compete in international competitions across various disciplines. Each sport is associated with a specific country and presents unique challenges requiring skill, reflexes, and timing. The events include weightlifting (Russia), slalom skiing (France), log rolling (Canada), cliff diving (Mexico), caber toss (Scotland), bull riding (USA), barrel jumping (Germany), and sumo wrestling (Japan). Each event features distinct mechanics that players must master to achieve top performance.

meta.name: World Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Each event features distinct mechanics that players must master to achieve top performance.

meta.name: World Geography
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.19 KB

World Geography puts your knowledge of the countries of the 1980s to the test. A random nation is selected on the globe, and you must choose the correct answer from three options. Questions cover the country's name, capital, currency, language, and population. Each round brings fresh challenges, making it a playful way to expand and check your geography knowledge.

meta.name: World Karate Championship
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

International Karate (IK) con su sistema de juego innovador así como por sus impresionantes gráficos y una memorable banda sonora es uno de los mejores juegos de lucha de C64.
Tienes 30 segundos para derrotar a tu oponente. Quien obtenga 2 puntos primero gana y si el contador se agota antes el jugador con más puntos gana.
¡Dos victorias te darán un nuevo cinturón y te moverán a la siguiente etapa para enfrentarte a un oponente aún más hábil!
Visitarás 8 lugares diferentes repartidos por todo el mundo, como Sydney, Egipto o Nueva York. Al final de cada etapa podrás jugar pequeños juegos de bonificación.
¡También hay un modo de dos jugadores donde tú y un amigo luchan en combates de venganza de 90 segundos!

meta.name: World of Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.32 KB

Enter the world of International League & Cup Football with this exciting strategy game featuring 240 top club sides from 15 different countries. Your career in football management may take you to many different clubs all over the world as you strive to reach the top in International Club Football.

meta.name: World Rugby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.15 KB

World Rugby blends sports management with presentation and match atmosphere by asking you to guide a national team step by step from the lower divisions to the very top. Before matches, the focus is on selection, training, and dealing with injured players, while the games themselves are staged like a television broadcast and shift to the field view at decisive moments. That combination of strategic team management and compact on-field sequences gives the game its own appeal, because you are not just watching events unfold, but actively shaping your country's rise.

meta.name: World Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.95 KB

World Soccer is a managerial soccer simulation in which the player is responsible for the financial and athletic success of a soccer team. The world soccer league is the home of the best teams of Europe and the player takes over a team from the 3rd division; the goal being to become the number one in the long run.

meta.name: World Soccer League
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.75 KB

The year is 1996. The World Soccer Council have announced the formation of a New World League and Cup competition. Formed into 2 Divisions the top 32 Club sides in the World will compete for the Title. WORLD CLUB CHAMPIONS. The Challenge: To build a World Class team capable of winning the Ultimate DOUBLE in league football - The Club Championship and the World Club Cup. This IS Club Football at the HIGHEST level!

meta.name: World Tour Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

World Tour Golf lets you play over a dozen well known courses, including Augusta and Pebble Beach. A split screen gives you an overhead view of the hole and a 3-D view. The control uses multiple button presses to set pace and draw/fade - fortunately a Driving Range is included to practice on. When you select a club, its range is superimposed on the view, making planning shots easier. Wind, pin placement and even weather conditions must be considered as you play your shot. Also included is a course architect for creating new courses or modifying existing ones.

meta.name: The World's Greatest Baseball Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

This game is a combo of managerial and play elements in baseball. You can pick from 25 recent World Series, All-Star and All-Time Classic teams. Choose your player lineup based on a player's batting average, fielding percentage, or ERA and other statistics. If you are unhappy with their performance, you can change them or even trade players. In the Statistical gameplay option you only manage the team and give orders like: change fielder/batter order, intentional walk, move infield in, hit and run, steal base, and bunt/sacrifice. In the Interactive Player Controlled Game, you pitch, hit and field the ball as well as managing the team. The game has an isometric side view of the whole field with the batter on the left of screen and outfield on the right. You can play against another person or the computer.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 325.92 KB

World's Greatest Football Game combines tactical planning with hands-on control on the field, letting you act both as coach and active player. You can design your own offensive and defensive plays or rely on a playbook, make strategic calls from the sidelines, and then execute them yourself once the play begins. As soon as the ball is snapped, you take full control – running plays, throwing long passes, making tackles or scoring points – while multiple camera views present the action from different perspectives.

meta.name: Worldcup 90 : Arcade Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.82 KB

Worldcup 90: Arcade Soccer brings the atmosphere of the 1990 World Cup in Italy to the screen. All participating national teams are included, though the player names are fictional. You can create your own teams, including name, tactics, and jersey colors, and customize the roster to your liking. In addition to single-player matches, there is also a multiplayer mode where two players can compete against each other or team up against the CPU. With additional interface support, up to two more players can join the game.

meta.name: The Worm in Paradise
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Eden has been successfully colonised, by creating several domed cities. Society is rigidly functioning, unemployment, crime and poverty all non-existent. The economy functions on fines rather than taxes, making for a plethora of petty rules and no penal punishment. Robot employees make everything run cheaply. Body part reselling allows hospitals to turn a profit. Robots can even control human reproduction. The end result is a society in which humans have no useful role. Who would live in a 'paradise' like this? The Worm In Paradise is the culmination of the Silicon Dreams series of interactive fiction. The game relies on strict timing and a day/night cycle (using a decimal clock with 10 100-minute hours) – return to your home before darkness falls, and don't expect robots to help with tasks which will not be finished in the day. Vital buildings can be located using colour-coded co-ordinates, but these change every time you load the game, so be careful to write them down.

meta.name: The Worm
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Worm tests your skill and reflexes as you guide an escaped worm through a series of challenging stages. The goal is to collect all items while avoiding obstacles and wall collisions, as every mistake costs valuable time or lives. The levels demand precise control and forward planning, with increasing speed and complexity pushing your abilities further. The appeal comes from the constant race against the clock and the satisfaction of mastering each stage efficiently.

meta.name: Worms?
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In IQ you control a worm-like creature called SAIL across a grid of diagonally placed dots, drawing six lines to form enclosed areas. You compete against up to three other computer-controlled SAILs, trying to skillfully and quickly claim spaces. There are three control modes to choose from: in New mode you manually control your SAIL and it learns your movement patterns, in Auto mode the computer takes over with intelligent movements, and in Wild mode your SAIL moves randomly.

meta.name: Worms
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.76 KB

"Worms" is a classic arcade-style game in the vein of “Snake”, where the player controls a constantly growing worm, collecting bonuses while avoiding obstacles and its own body. With every pickup, the worm grows longer and the challenge increases. Quick reflexes, foresight and good timing are key to beating the high score.

meta.name: Wozzle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

In Wozzle you must restore a scrambled playfield to its original arrangement. The correct layout is displayed on the right side, while the left side starts in a randomly shuffled state. Your task is to rotate the individual tiles until the left side matches the example on the right. When you rotate a tile, all connected neighboring tiles rotate as well, but only if they are directly linked together. This creates a challenging puzzle that requires careful planning and logical thinking to solve.

meta.name: The Wrath of Denethenor

Wrath of Denethenor is a top-down fantasy role-playing game. The player travels the realm of Deledain by keyboard only, and can learn up to ten different spells, each with unique visual effects. Wu Lung adapts the familiar Mahjong solitaire concept into a clear and colorful presentation. Tiles are stacked across multiple layers and can only be removed in matching pairs when they are accessible. Helpful features such as highlighting specific tiles, undoing moves, and customizable colors for each level assist strategic play. A competitive two-player mode adds variety by allowing direct head-to-head matches.

meta.desc:

In Wulfpack you command a destroyer tasked with protecting supply convoys crossing the Atlantic. In the first phase you patrol the sea lanes and hunt enemy submarines using depth charges to defend the convoy. Once your ammunition is exhausted you must return to port and carefully dock the ship to resupply. When enough supplies have safely reached England, the second phase begins where you support the invasion by bombarding enemy coastal defenses while avoiding mines and friendly ships. In the final phase you guide landing craft toward the beaches. If enough craft successfully land the mission succeeds, but if too many are lost the invasion fails.

Tus oponentes poseen movimientos especiales como el Full Nelson o el Camel Clutch del Sargento Slaughter. Antes de cada combate, tu oponente te provoca y debes responder con creatividad. Xenon es el misterioso predecesor del mucho más conocido Xenon 2: Megablast. En realidad, el juego no se parece en nada a su secuela, con un esquema de control y una jugabilidad completamente diferentes. Sin embargo, la trama se superpone cuando los Xenites hacen su primer intento de controlar la galaxia.
Xenon es esencialmente un shooter vertical. La diferencia entre Xenon y su secuela es que aquí el jugador controla el movimiento del campo de juego (arriba o abajo) simplemente moviendo la nave en la dirección elegida. Para hacer esto en la secuela, los jugadores deben golpear su nave contra la parte inferior de la pantalla y tirar hacia atrás de la palanca para desplazarse hacia atrás en el campo de juego.
También cuenta con un campo de juego 3D (algunos enemigos, por ejemplo, estarán montados en una especie de colinas, donde los jugadores no podrán dispararles). Para combatirlos, el jugador puede transformar su tanque en un avión. Luego, el juego cambia al estilo de juego más familiar, como se ve en otros shooters de desplazamiento vertical. El avión tiene que volver a transformarse en un tanque para combatir a la mayoría de las unidades terrestres.

La zona de juego principal se divide en dos partes, con la zona de tiro en la parte superior y la zona de plataformas en la parte inferior. Comienza con el área deslizante, que se desplaza horizontalmente hacia los lados y se mueve hacia la izquierda o la derecha a medida que mueves tu helicóptero. Otros helicópteros intentarán dispararte y agotar tu energía, lo que hará que pierdas tres vidas. También tienen un cañón para contraatacar. Tu objetivo es recolectar un paquete de energía a la vez y llevarlos a la entrada de la cueva subterránea. Una vez que hayas recolectado dos, puedes pasar a la parte de plataformas del juego dejando tu helicóptero y caminando a pie.

Xpiose combines the thrill of ping-pong with the classic breakout principle. You don't just hurl the ball at your opponent but must also break down the stone wall behind them until the hidden picture is fully revealed. Only then is the winner decided. Whether against the computer or a human player, each round comes with new surprises. Miracle bubbles can grant extra lives or points, but may also paralyze you or cause instant defeat. Anything can happen, so stay alert and quick on your reactions.

meta.name: XPLORE : The Star Fortress
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.68 KB

Nuestra nave espacial se dirige hacia un gran peligro. Debes penetrar el campo de fuerza letal de la fortaleza estelar, y la única manera de hacerlo es debilitándolo con disparos. Si impactas el campo de fuerza o alguno de los planetas que caen, ¡tu nave espacial estará perdida! Tienes tres intentos, ¡así que mucha suerte!

meta.name: XXX X-treme Zorbing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.67 KB

XXX X-treme Zorbing delivers fast-paced, sporty fun where you control a rolling ball and must dodge all obstacles in your path. As time goes on, the speed steadily increases, pushing your reflexes and focus to the limit. Every mistake can be fatal, while the rising pace creates constant tension and a challenging, adrenaline-fueled flow.

meta.name: Xybots
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.54 KB

Xybots es un shooter de ciencia ficción con entornos pseudo-3D explorados desde una perspectiva en tercera persona. El juego puede ser jugado por uno o dos jugadores; el modo para dos jugadores se desarrolla en pantalla dividida. El héroe o los héroes deben recorrer una serie de laberintos subterráneos al estilo de Gauntlet, eliminando a los enemigos y recolectando salud y otras bonificaciones de platillos voladores. Está diseñado para jugarse en modo cooperativo, aunque las balas de un jugador pueden dañar al otro.

meta.name: Xyphus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Xyphus es un RPG de fantasía en 2D donde el jugador puede desarrollar hasta cuatro personajes con atributos como puntos de vida, resistencia, fuerza, etc. Las razas disponibles son humanos, enanos y elfos, con una combinación de combate cuerpo a cuerpo y el uso de la magia en las profesiones. Aniquilar monstruos se recompensa con experiencia y oro, que se pueden usar para mejorar y adquirir nuevos objetos. El juego se divide en seis escenarios para derrotar al malvado señor demonio Xyphus y liberar las tierras de Arroya. Los personajes pueden moverse individualmente o en grupo en un entorno de arriba a abajo construido con hexágonos.

Yantzee is a digital adaptation of the dice game Yahtzee for the C64. The goal is to achieve specific combinations within up to three rolls per round – from ones and twos to full house, straight, or the rare Yantzee (five of a kind). Scoring follows the classic rules, and strategic decisions on when to record each combination are key to winning.

meta.name: Yes, Prime Minister
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Yes, Prime Minister pone a los jugadores en la piel del primer ministro británico James "Jim" Hacker, de la clásica serie de comedia de la BBC. A lo largo de una semana, deberán sortear el delicado equilibrio entre la popularidad, los intereses partidistas, la intromisión de gobiernos extranjeros y la a menudo incompetente función pública. Las decisiones se toman mediante diálogos de opción múltiple con personajes conocidos de la serie, con imágenes digitalizadas incluidas. El humor irónico característico de la serie está presente en todo momento, mientras Hacker se enfrenta a crisis absurdas, como la negativa francesa a continuar las obras del Eurotúnel hasta que se cambie el nombre de la estación de Waterloo. Los fans de la serie reconocerán muchas referencias, mientras que los recién llegados encontrarán mucha diversión satírica.

Las decisiones se toman mediante diálogos de opción múltiple con personajes conocidos de la serie, con imágenes digitalizadas incluidas. El humor irónico característico de la serie está presente en todo momento, mientras Hacker se enfrenta a crisis absurdas, como la negativa francesa a continuar las obras del Eurotúnel hasta que se cambie el nombre de la estación de Waterloo. Los fans de la serie reconocerán muchas referencias, mientras que los recién llegados encontrarán mucha diversión satírica.

meta.name: Yeti
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Un hábil cazador ha descubierto el territorio del misterioso Yeti. El problema: la bestia vive en una zona prohibida para los forasteros. Para capturar al abominable hombre de las nieves, el cazador, armado únicamente con un rifle Lee Enfield y varias granadas, deberá enfrentarse al clima y al terreno, superando obstáculos mortales y misteriosos enemigos que intentan matarlo.

meta.name: Yie Ar Kung-Fu
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Yie Ar Kung-Fu sigue la búsqueda de Oolong para convertirse en maestro de Kung-Fu. Tendrá que luchar contra un amplio abanico de oponentes en un entorno 2D tradicional de uno contra uno. Oolong dispone de una amplia gama de ataques que puede utilizar para reducir la barra de vida de su oponente, incluidos los tradicionales puñetazos, patadas y saltos. Los oponentes están bien armados con armas y ataques únicos, así que la tarea de Oolong no será fácil.

meta.name: Yie Ar Kung-Fu II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Lee Young es un joven maestro de artes marciales que es hijo de un valiente guerrero que libró a China de la Pandilla Chop Suey.  Sin embargo, un miembro sobrevivió y se declaró Emperador Yie-Gah. Ahora, como su padre, Lee Young tiene que librar a China de Yie-Gah y sus aliados de una vez por todas.

meta.name: Ylcodrom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Ylcodrom is a futuristic racing game where you drive one of five vehicles across dangerous tracks full of hazards. Slopes, descents and jumps must be mastered precisely, as a wrong move means losing a car. Points are awarded for reaching the finish line, taking out enemies while jumping or destroying obstacles such as rocks and mines. The game includes 31 pre-built tracks plus an editor to design and save your own. With variable scrolling speed depending on your vehicle's position, each race stays tense and challenging. The goal is to rack up as many points as possible and secure a spot on the high score table.

El Monstruo de la Avaricia ha robado todos los juguetes del mundo, así que Don Gato ha enviado a los Cazatesoros de Yogi a encontrarlos. El problema es que el monstruo ha capturado a todos los cazadores excepto a Yogi, así que Yogi debe encontrar a sus amigos y todos los juguetes. El juego es un laberinto con pantalla móvil, visto desde un ángulo elevado mientras controlas a Yogi.

meta.name: Yogi Bear
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 38.15 KB

Yogi debe viajar a través del Parque Yellowstone para rescatar a su amigo secuestrado Boo-Boo. Viaja a través de 198 pantallas para llegar hasta él, recogiendo seis manzanas acarameladas en el camino: estas se convertirán en un código que permite rescatar a Boo-Boo sin que su captor haga un escándalo. El parque se mueve lateralmente mientras Yogi entra y sale de las pantallas en capas. Contiene animales que pueden hacerte daño al contacto, así como agujeros negros y obstáculos de agua. También está prohibido el contacto con el personal del parque o con los turistas. El yogui debe prestar atención a su nivel de energía, que se mantiene robando peces y recogiendo cestas. Hay que rescatar a Boo-Boo antes de que él y Yogi tengan que hibernar.

meta.name: Yogi's Great Escape
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.97 KB

El oso Yogi ha despertado de su hibernación y ahora busca en su hogar, el Parque Jellystone, cestas de picnic traídas por turistas. Durante una de sus búsquedas, Yogi escucha una horrible conversación telefónica con el guardabosques Smith, que informa que el parque cerrará y que todos los animales serán trasladados a un zoológico. Es por ello que Yogi decide escapar, y así comienza su aventura. Debes guiar a Yogi a lo largo de seis niveles (que terminan en Nueva York), manteniéndote por delante de un rastreador y su perro. Debes completar cada nivel en 2 minutos y 40 segundos o se acabará la partida. En el camino hay obstáculos como agujeros y agua, y otros personajes que se interpondrán en tu camino. Tocarlos te hará perder una de tres vidas. Dispersos por los niveles hay diversos alimentos que te darán 100 puntos, así como otros invisibles que te darán 250 puntos. En ciertos niveles puedes recolectar seis objetos que te recompensarán con 7500 puntos.

meta.name: You Have to Win the Game
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.76 KB

In You Have to Win the Game a retro platformer takes you into a mysterious underground world filled with dangers and puzzles. The goal sounds simple, but the labyrinthine world is full of hazards like spikes, pits, water, and moving platforms. Many areas are only accessible once you discover hidden objects or devices elsewhere, which in turn open new routes while blocking others. Teleports, secret passages, and warped spaces add further complexity. Patience, skill, and keen observation are needed to inch closer to victory.

meta.name: Young Arthur's Quest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Young Arthur's Quest sends you on a classic journey toward the legendary sword and the right to become King of Britain. You explore different locations, gather clues and make choices that move you closer to your goal. Unity is a key theme, as obstacles and tasks can only be overcome when forces are brought together. If you manage to achieve that sense of cooperation, you can claim the sword and fulfill your destiny.

meta.name: The Young Ones
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 46.60 KB

The Young Ones is a licensed adventure game based on the BBC comedy show of the same name. The goal of the game is to move out of the house with most of your belongings intact. Players can explore, interact, talk, break or fix objects and solve object puzzles around the house while the computer controlled opponents do the same.

meta.name: Your Father's Nightmare
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.90 KB

Your Father's Nightmare es un juego de recolección trepidante y desafiante que requiere reflejos rápidos y una estrategia cuidadosa para esquivar peligros impredecibles. La habilidad y el pensamiento táctico son esenciales para reunir todos los objetos necesarios y luchar por sobrevivir a la pesadilla.

The Yuppie Trainer turns the stock market into a clear strategy game where you chase the highest possible profits through prices, news, and risky decisions. From a central menu, you monitor your assets, read reports, pay for tips, and buy or sell shares in larger blocks. Especially appealing is the way political and economic events influence prices, forcing you to draw your own conclusions. The result is an entertaining stock-market simulation that charmingly combines speculation, planning, and the dream of big money.

meta.name: Z
meta.desc:

En Z, tu mente se fusiona con tu nave mediante control cibernético: cada pensamiento se convierte en movimiento. Destruye a todos los alienígenas atacantes para ganar puntos. Tras eliminar a diez enemigos, aparecerá una unidad de energía. Al destruirla, se liberará una cápsula de energía. Persíguela y recógela para conseguir bombas de energía. Una vez que tengas suficientes bombas, abre un agujero en la barrera de fuerza móvil que rodea la Unidad de Transporte. Si el agujero es lo suficientemente grande, te transportarás por el hiperespacio al siguiente nivel.

meta.name: The Zacaron Mystery : Prutor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

The Zacaron Mystery: Prutor sends you into a classic science-fiction adventure in which the fate of Earth depends on a dangerous mission into deep space. With the home world's fuel reserves nearly exhausted, all hope rests on two mysterious Zacaron crystals hidden away on distant planets. As a seasoned space pilot, you set out for Prutor, where a traditional text-driven journey of discovery and decision awaits. That combination of a futuristic setting and classic adventure spirit is what gives the game its special charm.

meta.name: Zack!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Zack! puts a clever twist on the familiar stacking idea by having you place pairs of different hats and headwear instead of geometric shapes. The goal is to form matching lines and keep space available as the playfield gradually fills up. The mix of symbols creates its own rhythm, demanding quick recognition and forward planning. The appeal comes from a well-known foundation that feels fresh and surprising thanks to its unusual elements.

meta.name: Zaga
meta.desc:

Zaga te sitúa en una situación crítica en el planeta Zaga 1, donde una falla grave en la planta de energía de soporte vital amenaza a la población. Tu misión es pilotar un helicóptero a través de túneles subterráneos y llegar al núcleo de energía para solucionar el problema. Presentado en vista isométrica, te desplazarás por laberintos estrechos mientras puertas de seguridad impredecibles se abren y cierran. Cualquier colisión con una pared o puerta termina la misión al instante. En el camino, las estaciones de servicio son esenciales para evitar quedarse sin gasolina.

Zaga II: The Conflict es un juego de disparos de desplazamiento lateral para Commodore 64. Como secuela del Zaga original, continúa la dinámica de juego llena de acción donde los jugadores controlan una nave espacial y luchan contra unidades enemigas. El juego presenta gráficos fluidos y niveles de dificultad crecientes que desafiarán tanto a jugadores principiantes como experimentados.

meta.name: Zak McKracken and the Alien Mindbenders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Zak McKracken es un periodista sensacionalista (y no muy bueno en eso). Basándose en un sueño psicodélico, Zak un día se da cuenta de que algo anda mal: los alienígenas espaciales están atontando al público en general a través del sistema telefónico. Zak debe detenerlo, pero no puede hacerlo solo. Después de encontrar un cristal mágico (o algún tipo de cristal), Zak consigue la ayuda de la antropóloga Annie y sus amigas Melissa y Leslie. Entre los cuatro personajes (todos los cuales controlas), puedes destruir los dispositivos atontadores y salvar la tierra. No está mal para un periodista sensacionalista!

meta.name: Zalaga
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.07 KB

Zalaga es un juego de disparos de pantalla fija, casi idéntico a Galaga. El jugador controla su nave espacial en la parte inferior de la pantalla y debe disparar a los alienígenas que se mueven sobre él. Los enemigos vuelan en formación e intentarán disparar o colisionar con la nave del jugador. Una vez eliminados todos los alienígenas, el jugador avanza al siguiente nivel. Tras varios niveles, hay una fase de desafío donde los enemigos vuelan en un patrón determinado y el jugador debe derribar a tantos como sea posible. Algunas naves pueden atrapar la nave del jugador con un rayo tractor. El jugador puede recuperarla destruyendo la nave que la capturó, obteniendo así dos naves a la vez con el doble de potencia de fuego.

meta.name: Zamczysko

Zamczysko es un juego de plataformas ambientado en un castillo encantado. La tarea consiste en encontrar 5 diamantes custodiados por numerosas trampas y criaturas hostiles. El contacto con cualquiera de ellos consume cierta cantidad de energía que no se puede reponer. Las puertas cerradas requieren encontrar la llave. Caer desde las alturas no consume energía.

meta.name: Zamzara
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 170.75 KB

Juegas como la alienígena Zamzara, capturada y obligada a escapar de un complejo de laboratorios retorcido. Una bomba está a punto de explotar y debes buscarla y escapar en tu nave antes de que se agote el tiempo. Tras 15 minutos, se acaba la partida. En el camino te encontrarás cara a cara (algunos enemigos son literalmente caras que te disparan proyectiles) con enemigos grandes y pequeños. Derrótalos con tu arsenal, que incluye habilidades especiales explosivas que se extienden a ambos lados, muy eficaces contra montones de enemigos más pequeños. Al ser un título económico y llegar relativamente tarde en el ciclo de vida de C64, es conocido por sus gráficos de desplazamiento fluido y su increíble banda sonora de Charles Deenen, de Maniacs of Noise. También fue famoso por su alta dificultad, incluso para su época.

meta.name: Zap!

Un juego de disparos al estilo Space Invaders con triple disparo, publicado como parte de la colección "The Big 100". Recuerda que tu disparo debe dar en el blanco o llegar a la parte superior de la pantalla antes de conseguir otro. Detén todas las naves alienígenas antes de que crucen la pantalla.

meta.name: Zappy Zooks
meta.desc:

Zappy Zooks es un clon de Pac-Man donde controlas a Whirly, quien debe recolectar todas las Partículas Alfa en varios laberintos con vista superior que se muestran en pantalla completa. Mientras recolectas las partículas, debes evitar a los Zooks, ya que si los tocas, perderás una de tres vidas. En cada laberinto hay Tapones de Drenaje de Poder y, si los recolectas, puedes tocar cualquier Zook para obtener puntos de bonificación por tiempo limitado. Una vez recolectadas todas las partículas, se pasa al siguiente laberinto.

En un futuro lejano... se descubre una zona espacial que no obedece las leyes del universo. Ahora, como Fax McSheen, debes investigar con tus tres drones de ataque y destruir todo a tu paso, ya sea planeta o alienígena...

meta.name: Zaxxon

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.40 KB

El sistema de defensa Zaxxon debe ser destruido en este shoot'em up con vista isométrica, que originalmente tuvo un gran éxito en las recreativas. El juego consta de tres fases: la primera te lleva a través de Ciudad Asteroide, fuertemente protegida por aviones, armas y misiles. Muchas barreras tienen alarmas, lo que te deja con poco espacio para avanzar, y debes esquivar constantemente el fuego enemigo. 
La segunda fase es un tiroteo espacial contra hordas de aviones enemigos, aquellos que no lograste destruir en la primera parte de la tarea. Completa esta fase y accederás a la batalla final con Zaxxon, donde el juego se repetirá con mayor dificultad si sobrevives a la primera. Hay tres niveles de habilidad distintos, y los controles implican usar adelante para descender y atrás para ascender, como en una simulación de vuelo.

meta.name: Zaxxon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.29 KB

Zaxxon ofrece una experiencia clásica de combate espacial en perspectiva isométrica 3D. Pilotas una nave de combate a través de una base fuertemente fortificada, repleta de torretas, misiles y estaciones de radar. Tu misión: destruir el mayor número posible de objetivos, esquivar el fuego enemigo y gestionar el combustible —que, paradójicamente, se rellena al destruir depósitos de fuel. Esta versión en cartucho, frente a la edición en disquete del Reino Unido, ofrece un ritmo más rápido, un diseño de niveles ligeramente modificado y controles más precisos, acercándose al estilo original de la arcade.

meta.name: Zelta Pass
meta.desc:
